title: Muchos motivos para continuar / Encuentro de talentos
body:
> Feliz Martes talentosos,hoy estoy animada de estar en esta gran comunidad **EmpoderarTalent**, deseándole muchas Bendiciones. Es grato estar participando en la iniciativa de mi querida amiga @angelica7, la cual invita esta semana en [ Encuentro de Talentos](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-como-continuar ), con el Tema **Como continuar**. > _Happy Tuesday, talented people! Today, I am excited to be part of this great community, **EmpoderarTalent**, and I wish you all many blessings. It is a pleasure to be participating in the initiative of my dear friend @angelica7, who invites us this week to the [Talent Meeting](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-como-continuar), with the theme **How to continue**._
![GridArt_20260310_163715903.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/AKNMuVZnLkVXMbVhvaNMH8v3NguFJJvXT2iaxWAgxaMcyaCyExUst3rsbQbcV8z.jpg)

> Siempre existen muchos motivos para continuar, porque mientras haya vida hay esperanzas y muchas cosas por hacer, y cuando finalizamos muchas etapas en nuestra vida, debemos seguir haciendo otras actividades de manera que siempre nos lleve a tener un propósito. > There are always many reasons to keep going, because as long as there is life, there is hope and many things to do. When we finish many stages in our lives, we must continue doing other activities so that we always have a purpose.
![IMG_20260307_175830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23ycwQiC3EefTBf5QDH2WTCjFZRcxLdHExN1an8jDZ8VefnEW93krCFEWHa4dtmcrCH5M.jpg)

> Cuando terminamos una relación, nos jubilamos de nuestro trabajo, cuando alguien se nos muere, debemos continuar porque en la vida todo finaliza para comenzar nuevas oportunidades. En fin seguimos motivados con la finalidad de crecer, aprender y avanzar con las cosas maravillosas que la vida nos ofrece. > When we end a relationship, retire from our job, or someone close to us passes away, we must carry on because in life everything ends so that new opportunities can begin. In short, we remain motivated to grow, learn, and move forward with the wonderful things that life offers us.
![IMG_20260211_190802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/Eo8SphuHR3pKkwzgYnnzBG2chN55ktCqhuz4oAydPdSxwhKzNwtYNWDNDW5chphffef.jpg)

> Seguimos valorando el presente y hacer todas esas actividades que nos gusta, organizarnos en nuestro tiempo para reir, cantar, hacer ejercicios, caminar, viajar visitar los seres queridos, amarlos, inscribirme en aquel curso, entre otras, y no dejar las cosas para mañana por que nadie tiene la vida comprada ni sabemos hasta cuando tengamos ese privilegio de vivir. > We continue to value the present and do all those activities we enjoy, organizing our time to laugh, sing, exercise, walk, travel, visit loved ones, love them, enroll in that course, among other things, and not put things off until tomorrow because no one has life guaranteed and we don't know how long we will have the privilege of living.
![IMG_20260210_183130.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/Eos3AYxKfTW6RG4WaKo2eDJmYyCkQMmKCtL1tqBDaVx2TvftrkdhxxfsFGQymW1vryx.jpg)

> Cuando me jubilé hace 3 años, pensé que todo había acabado, me sentí aislada del mundo y sin ánimo de continuar, pues finalicé una etapa que disfruté mucho, agradecí y continuo haciendo otras cosas, como dedicarme más a mi, pues ahora tengo tiempo para compartir con mi familia y amigos. También para hacer deportes, así que todas las tardes camino kilómetros desde mi casa hasta el polideportivo, además que comparto con mi grupo de amigas, estamos en un estilo de vida saludable que me hace sentir mejor. > _When I retired three years ago, I thought it was all over. I felt isolated from the world and had no desire to continue, as I had ended a stage of my life that I had enjoyed very much. I am grateful and continue to do other things, such as dedicating more time to myself, as I now have time to spend with my family and friends. I also have time to play sports, so every afternoon I walk several miles from my house to the sports center. I also spend time with my group of friends. We are living a healthy lifestyle that makes me feel better._

> Cómo sigo escribiendo en esta plataforma? Porque me gusta mucho, pues tengo ya casi 8 años, activa, además de lo que generamos de dinero, interactuamos con gente talentosa, también expresamos sentimientos y conocimiento, dedicandonos, cada día a crear contenido original, con esto me mantengo ocupada y entusiasmado porque aprendo muchas cosas buena. A pesar que mi cuenta no es tan bien remunerada, porque mis publicaciones quedan baja o en 0.06. Eso no me importa, y no me desmotiva, ya que mi propósito es dar lo mejor de mi, mostrar mi mejor versión haciendo las cosas que me gustó. > Why do I continue writing on this platform? Because I really like it. I've been active for almost eight years now, and in addition to the money we generate, we interact with talented people and express our feelings and knowledge, dedicating ourselves every day to creating original content. This keeps me busy and enthusiastic because I learn many good things. > Even though my account isn't very well paid, because my posts get low ratings or 0.06, that doesn't matter to me, and it doesn't discourage me, because my goal is to give my best, to show my best side by doing the things I like.
![IMG_20260310_194338.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23zGm64Q9B2C72sQDaDB8sNe3HBwefiguSzqPUttaTSrmFwwc69F6HjcbPgKZ7tyxcgcf.jpg)
Me encantó escribir estás líneas dando mi opinión de este tema, que tiene mucha tela que cortar. Todo en la vida pasa, pero debemos tener fuerza para continuar, ya que siempre hay oportunidades para avanzar.Invito a participar a @roswelborges @leidimarc **Gracias por su atención, hasta la próxima, mis aventureros.** > I loved writing these lines giving my opinion on this topic, which has a lot to discuss. Everything in life happens, but we must have the strength to continue, as there are always opportunities to move forward. I invite you to participate @roswelborges @leidimarc **Thank you for your attention, see you next time, my adventurers.**
![IMG_20260209_183011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/2423uvUmsz6PBCuPE2JhKeYyVsggVZytovNJXxGkS5NtAi5fbYfKFCVcWVigrqtTqP4dv.jpg)

title: Fish with lemon, another oriental flavor (Eng/Esp)
body:
> Corvina is a white fish with soft flesh and a rather distinctive flavor. In fact, it differs from other fish in that it flakes easily, so it cooks very quickly. This fish is very versatile and rich in vitamins, making it perfect for a hearty breakfast or lunch, Oriental style. This time, the fish will have a touch of lemon, which enhances its flavor. In this case, I chose to accompany it with traditional grilled arepas.
![1000100811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23ynSNsFspADojFRmBgtywUZpVPgUkvhSAhuqpi6tJfbXfndZNpHaWAG15BfrGaYcPXG8.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 2 curvinas - 2 Creole lemons - 150 grams of wheat flour - 2 cups of water - Salt to taste - Oil
![1000100802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23z775tNyWuae3R4ftshHsQHb5TXwtQ4Qgd1mdrgmE8vzeHBDfmcbgtHga88hNyrMRGJZ.jpg)
## Procedure: I cleaned the fish, removing the guts, gills, and scales. Then I made two incisions on each side. I rubbed salt on the head and in the incisions. I heated a frying pan with enough oil and placed the fish in it to fry. I like them crispy, so I cooked them for ten minutes on each side. A secret to prevent the oil from splattering and burning us when we put the fish in is to add a pinch of salt while the oil is heating up.
![1000100805.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23uQrducqbtVdDFw1SVEs4p2zxmdbfEzDKT9eZs9YccbWQ1qfKahBdHvD1zAAptERMV7S.jpg)
Next, I put two cups of water and a pinch of salt in a bowl and gradually added the corn flour. I kneaded vigorously and within minutes I had formed three medium-sized arepas, which I cooked on a hot budare (griddle), rubbing oil on the surface with a napkin to prevent the arepas from sticking.
![1000100809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tveVrURxJDWmQzTVJTPm5JUiefxyMB1EHqAR2g3RrTB3c1MUK1nzYN2qWHnfZEuncqn.jpg)
When the fish was ready, I added a few drops of lime juice, the small kind with seeds, which gives this citrus fruit a wonderful flavor. The curvinas were delicious, so I was able to enjoy this healthy lunch with my arepas. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> La curvina es un pescado de carne blanca y suave con un sabor bastante peculiar. De hecho, se diferencia de otros porque se desmorona fácilmente, así que su cocción es muy rápida. Este pescado es muy versátil y tiene muchas vitaminas, así que es perfecto para un buen desayuno o almuerzo, al mejor estilo oriental. En esta oportunidad el pescado tendrá un toque de limón, lo que le mejora el sabor. En este caso, opté por acompañar con las tradicionales arepas asadas.
![1000100811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23ynSNsFspADojFRmBgtywUZpVPgUkvhSAhuqpi6tJfbXfndZNpHaWAG15BfrGaYcPXG8.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 2 curvinas - 2 limones criollos - 150 gramos de harina de trigo - 2 tazas de agua - Sal al gusto - Aceite
![1000100802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23z775tNyWuae3R4ftshHsQHb5TXwtQ4Qgd1mdrgmE8vzeHBDfmcbgtHga88hNyrMRGJZ.jpg)
## Procedimiento: Arreglé los pescados, extraje las vísceras, las agallas y las escamas. Luego realicé dos incisiones en los costados. Unté sal tanto en la cabeza como en las hendiduras. Monté un sartén con suficiente aceite y allí coloqué los pescados a freír. Me gustan crujientes, así que cociné diez minutos por cada lado. Un secreto, para que el aceite no salte y nos pueda quemar al poner los pescados, es agregar un punto de sal mientras se va calentando el aceite.
![1000100805.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23uQrducqbtVdDFw1SVEs4p2zxmdbfEzDKT9eZs9YccbWQ1qfKahBdHvD1zAAptERMV7S.jpg)
Posteriormente, en un envase, coloqué dos tazas agua, una pizca de sal y poco a poco agregué la harina de maíz, amasé con energía y en minutos formé tres arepas medianas, las cuales fueron a asarse sobre un budare caliente, al cual le pasé una servilleta con aceite por su superficie para evitar que las arepas se peguen.
![1000100809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tveVrURxJDWmQzTVJTPm5JUiefxyMB1EHqAR2g3RrTB3c1MUK1nzYN2qWHnfZEuncqn.jpg)
Cuando los pescados estuvieron listos, le agregué sus gotas de limón criollo, el pequeño que tiene semillas, el gusto que concede esta fruta cítrica es maravilloso. La curvinas quedaron deliciosas, así que pude disfrutar de este saludable almuerzo con mis arepas. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

INGLÉS🤍

Today I came here with something different to write about, but I felt the need to express this thought I had, which might not be the right one, maybe I'm just letting frustration or annoyance get the better of me, but it feels awful when you think you're bringing out a better version of yourself and improving in many areas to please others and have a good relationship (whether it's friendship, romantic, or family), and then for the smallest, most insignificant things, you're made to feel that you're not valued or that you don't have the importance you want to receive. Changing the subject, I haven't had internet these past few days, so I don't have much to do at home, and today while listening to music, I took some pictures because I felt pretty 😊. And as you know, I don't just like to share my day when I'm going out and dressed up, but also when I'm casual and at home 🏡.

ESPAÑOL🤍

 Hoy venia con algo distinto para escribir, pero me surgió la necesidad de querer expresar este pensamiento que tuve, que tal vez no sea el correcto, tal vez solo me dejo llevar por la frustración o la molestia, pero que mal se siente cuando crees que estas sacando una buena versión de ti y estas mejorando en muchos ámbitos para agradar y llevar bien una relacion ( sea de amistad, pareja o familiar ) y por mínimas pero muy mínimas cosas te hacen ver que no es valorado o no tiene la importancia que deseas recibir.
Cambiando de tema estos dias no he tenido internet asi que no tengo mucha distracción en casa y hoy mientras escuchaba música me tomé unas fotos porque me sentía bonita 😊 y como ya saben no solo me gusta compartirles mi dia cuando salgo y me arreglo si no tambien cuando estoy desarreglada y en casa 🏡 .

title: Acetone Rhythm Master Wave File Sample Set
body: ![Screenshot 2026-03-10 131259.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXEAYB79UAQxBERTHk8PiVzTqw3RzUAtW39SWSxjnCdWW/Screenshot%202026-03-10%20131259.jpg)\n\nThe Ace Tone Rhythm Master represents a foundational moment in the history of electronic percussion, serving as the direct ancestor to the legendary drum machines that would eventually define the Roland Corporation. Developed in the 1960s by Ikutaro Kakehashi, the founder of Ace Electronic Industries, these units were among the first fully transistorized, non-automatic rhythm generators. While later models in the Rhythm Ace series became famous for their preset patterns, the early \

and its siblings were initially designed as manual accompaniment tools. They utilized analog circuits—specifically diode matrix logic—to generate percussive sounds like the bass drum, snare, and hi-hat. These sounds were far from realistic, characterized by a warm, synthetic \

that became a beloved aesthetic in its own right, eventually influencing the sonic palette of the TR-808.\n\nAs the technology evolved, the Rhythm Master line transitioned into the more automated Rhythm Ace series, which featured the iconic push-button interface for selecting presets like Bossa Nova, Rock, and Waltz. One of the most unique features of these machines was the ability to press multiple rhythm buttons simultaneously, allowing users to layer and \

different patterns into complex, polyrhythmic grooves. This flexibility made them a favorite for early electronic pioneers and blues-rock artists like J.J. Cale, who used the steady, hypnotic pulse of the machine to anchor his signature \

The hardware itself was often housed in elegant wooden chassis, designed to sit atop home organs, reflecting its primary market at the time.\n\nThe legacy of the Ace Tone Rhythm Master is most visible in the birth of Roland in 1972. When Kakehashi founded his new company, he brought the blueprints and engineering philosophy of the Rhythm Ace with him. The first Roland drum machine, the TR-77, was essentially an updated and rebranded version of the Ace Tone Rhythm Ace FR-8L. This transition marked the shift from simple organ accessories to the sophisticated \

(CR) units that would later dominate hip-hop, techno, and pop music. Today, the original Ace Tone units are highly sought after by collectors and producers for their pure analog signal paths and the organic, slightly unpredictable timing that modern digital recreations often struggle to replicate.\n\nFree download: https://horrorweapon.gumroad.com/l/AcetoneRhythmMaster

昨晚妈妈又发了十几条语音给我，每条长达一分钟！听完觉得更加心累，病友昨晚失眠，一夜未睡，还好我没失眠！但是我早醒，五点未到就醒了！看到手机记录四点半就起来了，还好十点半左右睡了😴……昨晚整个晚上脑袋出现爸爸的样子，哎！好像没梦到什么，可能浅睡吧！我知道爸爸想我积极开心面对生活……

今天起来后，我打开手机听歌，慢慢情绪平复了！我去洗漱好，大概六点半吧哈哈。我马上拿手机下单两份牛肉丸汤河粉回来吃！吃完后看到大厅和饭厅很脏，我就拿起扫把🧹把客厅和饭厅打扫好！地板干干净净的挺舒服，我又把地上的鞋子放进鞋柜里！

我照镜子发现自己都挺精神的，摸起来脸蛋也是软软的！又臭美的自拍了一张照片，然后开始收拾一下房间的东西！虽然湿度大，挺冷的，但是阳光挺好的！我又下单开始买菜，老公说买一个青菜🥬和两个肉肉可以了！

我买了排骨🍖，昨天吃糖醋排骨挺好吃的，还有心心念念的茄子🍆和洋葱🧅还有黑木耳！收到货后发现洋葱和黑木耳还在购物车里，我也是醉了🥴，第一次那么煞笔的！

Let's take a look at the intriguing development and arrival of AI agents in the crypto space. We are no longer seeing the usual run-of-the-mill chatbots; instead, developers are working on building AI agents that are fully capable of transacting on the blockchain. One such functionality is the management of a wallet.

Consider the idea of an AI agent having the power and access to your wallet and being able to carry out several operations on your behalf. To some, this is the futuristic evolution of the crypto space. To others, this sparks an important question.

But can we really trust AI systems with our crypto wallets?

Crypto wallets are literally the keys to our assets on the blockchain. Once accessed, the one who gained the access to the wallet is in total control of all assets in it. The idea of giving such power to AI systems is highly tempting but also highly risky.

Firstly, AI agents may totally change the user experience of crypto for us. Many of us find it daunting to carry out actions like token bridging, working with smart contracts, or working with different DeFi platforms. An AI agent may make it easy for us to carry out these actions in mere seconds, just by giving it commands like \

However, the underlying risks are equally visible. First off, AI systems are not immune to errors or miscommunications with malicious contracts. So the risks associated with incorrect transactions initiated by the AI systems would be catastrophic since transactions on a blockchain are irreversible, resulting in instant loss of funds.

Another underlying issue is associated with security risks. In this case, a potential security threat would be the hacking of AI agents by cyber attackers, who would be able to access users' funds without their permission.

A critical issue associated with this concept is a concern for individuals who participate airdrop. Airdrops have emerged as a critical incentive for new crypto projects. Individuals often participate in new systems in hopes of gaining rewards in the near future.

Airdrop farmers can utilize AI agents to control multiple wallets at the same time under the same airdrop campaign, hence influencing the rewards received. An individual can have the capability to control as many as tens or hundreds of wallets through the use of automated agents to improve their chances of receiving more airdrops.

body.title: Bullet Journal: Marzo 2026 [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
>

¡Saludos, gente! Qué bueno estar de vuelta por aquí. Confieso que tenía varios días sin pasar, y es que los días siguen transcurriendo de una forma bastante extraña. No sé si es Mercurio retrógrado, el clima, o simplemente el ritmo acelerado de la vida, pero todo se vuelve caótico de repente. Ante esa sensación de dispersión, decidí retomar una de mis herramientas favoritas para poner orden: **mi Bullet Journal.**

Tenía toda la intención de compartirlo con ustedes la semana pasada, pero, como suele suceder, \

y los planes se posponen. Así que hoy, con algo más de calma, vengo a mostrarles cómo arranqué este mes.

>Hey, everyone! It's great to be back here. I admit I haven't been around for a few days, and that's because things have been pretty weird lately. I don't know if it's Mercury in retrograde, the weather, or just the fast pace of life, but everything suddenly feels chaotic. Faced with this feeling of dispersion, I decided to return to one of my favorite tools for bringing order: **my Bullet Journal.**

>I had every intention of sharing it with you last week, but, as often happens, “things happen” and plans get postponed. So today, with a little more calm, I'm here to show you how I started this month.

***

![1001178644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/1001178644.jpg)

***

Para este mes, mi estrategia fue clara: ir a lo sencillo. No le di muchas vueltas al diseño. De hecho, fue un proceso tan intuitivo que, casi sin darme cuenta, terminé haciendo todo el lettering en negro, con la única excepción de la portada del calendario. Esta vez, elegí la combinación de colores que siempre escojo cuando necesito terreno seguro; quería evitar el análisis excesivo y simplemente empezar a escribir, porque sentía la urgencia de darle forma a mis días.

Saludé al mes con un **\

** escrito con toda la intención del mundo. Y es que febrero pasó tan rápido que, literalmente, no me di cuenta ni de cuándo llegó ni de cuándo se fue. Ese desvanecimiento temporal me dejó una lección clara: necesito poner atención plena en el presente. >For this month, my strategy was clear: keep it simple. I didn't give the design much thought. In fact, it was such an intuitive process that, almost without realizing it, I ended up doing all the lettering in black, with the sole exception of the calendar cover. This time, I chose the color combination I always choose when I need to play it safe; I wanted to avoid overthinking it and just start writing, because I felt the urgency to give shape to my days. >I greeted the month with a **“Hello, March”** written with all the intention in the world. February went by so fast that I literally didn't notice when it arrived or when it left. That temporary lapse taught me a clear lesson: I need to pay full attention to the present. *** ![1001178648.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/1001178648.jpg) *** El **Calendario** fue mi prioridad absoluta. Decidí dedicarle tiempo a cada cuadrícula, asegurándome de que fuera útil antes que estética. No me malinterpreten, me encanta un bullet decorado, pero esta vez lo que necesitaba era un espacio funcional donde pudiera ver las fechas importantes de un vistazo, sin perderme en detalles minuciosos de horas o pendientes excesivos. El resultado es un espacio limpio, quizás un poco vacío ahora mismo, pero esa es precisamente la idea: dejar espacio para respirar. A veces, en el transcurso de los días, me siento más creativa y añado diseños alrededor de las notas. Veremos si eso ocurre este mes o si prefiero mantenerlo sobrio. De cualquier forma, el espacio está disponible. >The **Calendar** was my top priority. I decided to devote time to each grid, making sure it was useful rather than aesthetic. Don't get me wrong, I love a decorated bullet, but this time what I needed was a functional space where I could see important dates at a glance, without getting lost in minute details of hours or excessive to-do lists. >The result is a clean space, perhaps a little empty right now, but that's precisely the idea: to leave room to breathe. Sometimes, as the days go by, I feel more creative and add designs around the notes. We'll see if that happens this month or if I prefer to keep it simple. Either way, the space is available. *** ![1001178647.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/1001178647.jpg) *** Este mes era crucial resaltar mis **Pendientes.** Reconozco que me quedaron muchos del mes anterior; febrero fue un mes intenso, uno de esos que no olvidaré fácilmente, pero que también me impidió concentrarme en varias metas que había establecido a comienzos de año. Por eso, al redactar mis **Objetivos,** decidí ser amable conmigo misma. Intentaré dar lo mejor, pero si no logro cumplir todo, no pasa nada. Para mí, lo importante hoy es la visualización: tener mis metas ahí, presentes, recordándome hacia dónde quiero ir cada vez que abra la agenda. >This month, it was crucial to highlight my **Pending Tasks.** I admit that I had many left over from the previous month; February was an intense month, one that I won't easily forget, but it also prevented me from focusing on several goals I had set at the beginning of the year. >That's why, when writing my **Goals,** I decided to be kind to myself. I'll try my best, but if I don't manage to accomplish everything, it's okay. For me, the important thing today is visualization: having my goals there, present, reminding me where I want to go every time I open my planner. *** ![1001178646.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/1001178646.jpg) *** Finalmente, añadí la sección de **Finanzas.** Fue la última en crearse, pero probablemente la más necesaria. Al escribirla, me di cuenta de algo curioso: mi lettering es el mismo desde hace años. Es una caligrafía que ya forma parte de mi identidad, sale con una naturalidad absoluta. Puede que no sea la más innovadora, pero me resulta cómoda y familiar. Sé que este Bullet Journal se ve sencillo y quizás no sea el más llamativo visualmente, pero quiero que quede constancia en mi blog de que, aun en los momentos difíciles y extraños, hice el esfuerzo de mantenerme centrada. No sé si los astros realmente mueven nuestra realidad, pero sí sé que, cuando todo se siente extraño, escribir ayuda a aterrizar las ideas. Espero que mi intento de Bullet de este mes sirva de inspiración. ¡Gracias por pasar y leerme! 💖 >Finally, I added the **Finance** section. It was the last one to be created, but probably the most necessary. As I was writing it, I realized something curious: my lettering has been the same for years. It's a style of handwriting that has become part of my identity; it comes out completely naturally. It may not be the most innovative, but I find it comfortable and familiar. >I know this Bullet Journal looks simple and may not be the most visually striking, but I want to record in my blog that, even in difficult and strange times, I made the effort to stay focused. I don't know if the stars really move our reality, but I do know that when everything feels strange, writing helps to ground my ideas. >I hope my Bullet Journal attempt this month serves as inspiration. Thank you for stopping by and reading! 💖 *** ![1001178645.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/liveofdalla/23tbuQv8V4hj284kXqv1Xq1fQsVXPwopVaPUJL4cob9ZPcbsp5HhKYVhuSp1q2cgeCCv2.jpg) *** ***

body.title: Nuevo tatuaje, araña azul con dorado
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jdrh93/23zGgx42ztDo6p3QNB1ywaG8Ea1hrHHPZgUMiU2wXrta89xTFy6BuhjTj1r4iK33nfir7.png)

Nuevo proyecto de lienzo, esta vez una araña en micro realismo, carde asumió este nuevo proyecto conmigo y yo obviamente le dije que si, los diseño fueron variados, especialmente flores y animalitos que es su especialidad, pero pasamos a algo un poco mas lejos de su zona de confort, eligiendo este diseño, con unos colores muy llamativos, que consideramos que en mi piel seguramente se vería genial.

\

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jdrh93/23wgRi3k3t4P4apP7Xs91YUc7e9cLknzXRvkdq83gapUfk2SmLmtCzzTvosJ4kjHZ6eKe.png)

Así comenzamos, colocando el dibujo, habíamos estudiado varios sitios, pero quedamos en que el hombro seria lo mejor, ya que en otras partes del cuerpo, ya las tengo comprometidas para proyectos futuros, si el dinero me da para, obviamente, esperemos que si para seguir colocándoles algo cada cierto tiempo sobre todo de diseños tan coloridos que me encantan.

\

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jdrh93/23xVM9W6JbTHiCB1vMMeRVHn55YVZ6YXxW3ZH2gsgN2AtGvLTZ7AqaDV2XmGrTzmW8cMQ.png)

Terminamos el trazado de líneas, tomo su tiempo, bastantes detalles tiene el tatuaje en si, mas allá de los colores, el tema de cada una de las patas y las articulaciones del animal, es complejo llenarlo a la piel o a cualquier plataforma, sin embargo, se logro en aproximadamente 2 horas, el diseño es de alrededor de 8-9 cm.

\

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jdrh93/23x17EHe1pYqN3AVmfDihfZxNxMZCwni22bSeBWpRM67EYtTQhLFarN2p7JkK4YdMAFfz.png)

Avanzamos ya con el azul oscuro y con el marrón, primera vez que veo que utilizan ese color en un tatuaje, pero bueno le daba un toque bastante real a la araña sobre todo en el punto que lo combinas con el dorado, dándole realidad a la araña en el proceso.

\

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jdrh93/23ynUGimPe5ParXAPzRCVTyQ4oU5Xdu86KJBiFJpzfkW5EW3NxCBo9JYGKtYjtRKeJ1VZ.png)

Casi finalizado, le faltaba el brillo que le otorga el blanco a los tatuajes, además que la foto la tome de mi teléfono y no ayudo con la foto.

\

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jdrh93/23yJGXrtgUA3jurtNYYXyUrmDFwbF5vbwCuyF2pcNyBK3foUajYMQeevJmsGZ1aKUki7j.png)

Ya finalizado, abarca casi todo mi hombro, no es muy difícil la verdad, pero creo que para ser uno de sus primeros tatuajes con micro realismo esta bastante chévere, personalmente quede bastante contenido con el resultado, ustedes que opinan?

\

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jdrh93/23uFXkKiVXWNymDL7z6NqUM5rhMKQMaKSpwmtueNRFNdjjeoqKyS56KYY8brXQHADgfTn.png)

Al día siguiente.... En el próximo post les pongo como quedo la cicatrización, pero les adelanto que me ha picado como ningún otro jajaja

\

body.title: 「Vicky's Life」短剧｜《嫁首辅守寡一辈子，重生我改嫁了》（李是侥x廖银玥）
body.body:
![IMG_3814](https://s1.img-e.com/20260309/69ae80efce654.jpeg)

这两天看了几部不错的现代剧，突然想从待看清单里找部古装剧来看。男女主我之前应该都有看过他们的剧，女主不是很惊艳的长相，却胜在眼神表情灵巧生动非常讨喜。

从剧情的角度来说，女主父母兄长都战死沙场，她寄居在母亲手帕交府里很多年。她爱慕亲梅竹马的世子，在得知世子要娶郡主后，使了点手段迫使世子将她收入房中。

婚后她的处境非常艰难，若干年后被人杀害于别院中。重生归来女主很明确需要改变，她先是让养母正式收她为义女。这样既摆明了自己的态度，有杜绝同世子有交集。

她想安生度日不代表别人会让她如愿，府内其他姐妹、世子还有姨娘们都给她找事儿。世子的未婚妻郡主占有欲爆棚，也给她找了不少事情，都被她一一化解了。

我印象中这里面有个四小姐特别坏，郡主是阴着坏她则是又蠢又坏。不少损招是她想的，也有不少郡主的坏心思是她去落实的。不过有一说一，这个演员本身好漂亮。

总的来说，我觉得这部剧能看但一般，时间有限建议pass


（本篇完）


————————


喜欢影视剧、美食和旅行的天秤座80后妹纸，喜欢一切新奇温暖的事物

如果你喜欢我的文章，欢迎留言与我交流

body.title: Melodía de la voluntad. / Melody of the will. The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker. Part 30. [Esp-Eng]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmabPyY9vhRfaH9qr6uok6UuS1hbxc4A99ubyCHGHEQ8LB/1773188367368.jpg)

Hola querida comunidad de Hive Gaming. Espero que todos pasen un lindo día hoy. Como de costumbre y sin olvidarme de ustedes aquí les traigo mi pedacito de historia. 

>Hello, dear Hive Gaming community. I hope you are all having a wonderful day today. As usual, and without forgetting you, here is my little piece of history. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZN4AspPAE8qfwoYSDZpYauvC1Kcf6ecRYagJFCtYvCMH/1772921743549.jpg)

Anteriormente luego de recorrer varias zonas de la Torre de los Dioses, detener grandes fuentes de agua y enfrentarme a algún que otro enemigo. Encontré una pequeña deidad o estatuilla que se encontraba en la cima de un altar, al cuál desperté de su largo y letárgico sueño con tan solo un grito. ¿Pero qué sucedería luego?......

>Previously, after travelling through several areas of the Tower of the Gods, stopping large water sources and facing the odd enemy, I found a small deity or statuette on top of an altar, which I awakened from its long, lethargic sleep with just one shout. But what would happen next?......


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxdz6vGJR551qrn5gCGjMNQSPrwTUNP2CSpGRuitDabE/1773188762138.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmewWSUYri1Lw4Q2EhEjpJmiUvh2WFGG2iULDDPnWZ6FE4/1773188762271.jpg)

La pequeña deidad parecía que había recobrado vida. Sus grandes ojos tenían su mirada fija en mí, enseguida desde su altar comenzó a dar pequeños brincos como si caminara para acercarse. Caminé hacia otra dirección y el pequeñín me seguía. Era algo gracioso porque parecía mi mascota.

>The little deity seemed to have come back to life. Its large eyes were fixed on me, and immediately it began to take small jumps from its altar as if walking towards me. I walked in another direction and the little one followed me. It was kind of funny because it looked like my pet.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWQe2tfoyWndowigJQ3qyZwFHVaTbN9fbgmNFgpFHqxyz/1773188958526.jpg)

Al parecer el objetivo era sacar a la estatuilla de ese lugar guiándolo por pequeños caminos curvos como si fueran laberintos. No fué difícil mostrarle el camino hasta la salida.

>Apparently, the objective was to remove the statuette from that place by guiding it along small winding paths as if they were mazes. It was not difficult to show it the way to the exit.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSbRNKTtSpxhRg1eSEsBfeJYBVwwpvoBFE7KHYmCqM8A5/1773189157311.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSeWufXraFiGEQnvENUxJvuQFuzQZPAEU9pmtZFwzMdUq/1773189157429.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmavSQqfKHmqUkNELhi9cGBcGZdgChKkkt1wHcpAviAVQS/1773189157516.jpg)

En cuanto salimos de la habitación dejó de seguirme porque algo atraía más su atención. En el centro de una sala inmensa se encontraba un altar parecido al que había encontrado anteriormente. Fué con sus pequeños pasos hacia el mismo como si lo atrayera.

>As soon as we left the room, he stopped following me because something else caught his attention. In the centre of a huge hall was an altar similar to the one I had found earlier. He took small steps towards it as if he were drawn to it.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc9KX1yejsyzLxa5LaCLt55vEAazo9Ji3anKz4GJJHt3G/1773189337148.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaonkQJaw8HGVCapHroWNyoivcnNciftqUsW6V6feFctS/1773189337037.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTqAEy3cozuLQkW7MbPs7iD5XV7FBZsxusftg1vctb1jR/1773189337225.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUQhtiXTT5J1fTSenb1x9jx8K5uXsm1QspBa1Tji7nxPH/1773189337299.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR5C8Ayv5QsVRgvEbVkpK18etx9YbjHewwisaXn8cyvmZ/1773189337375.jpg)

Cuando subió al altar se puso en una posición exacta y de repente una energía comenzó a fluir en ese lugar. Era tan intensa la energía irradiada que se fué disolviendo poco a poco la imagen de la misma. Y en su lugar por sorpresa apareció un pequeño monolito con algo inscrito. Pero ya sospechaba de qué se trataba. Lo que estaba tallado lo había visto anteriormente cuando aprendí la melodía del viento. Así que solo era ponerlo en práctica con la Batuta.

>When he climbed onto the altar, he stood in a precise position, and suddenly an energy began to flow in that place. The energy radiated so intensely that the image gradually dissolved. And in its place, a small monolith with something inscribed on it appeared by surprise. But I already suspected what it was. I had seen what was carved on it before when I learned the melody of the wind. So it was just a matter of putting it into practice with the Baton.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTzm33srZK8jjQMUDXoUM8HHYUaSyVmMfFsKe8Lmcy7CW/1773189677137.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeHXLsuM4nd9HV3jU6FgVu9vkAwH6R6eXpN1PXQetDYMk/1773189677275.jpg)

Equipé mi batuta y siguiendo las direcciones de lo que estaba inscrito en el monolito enseguida surgió una melodía muy hermosa. Se trataba de la melodía de la voluntad. Aprendida seguro con un objetivo en esta Torre. Pero creo que eso será para otra aventura. 

>I equipped my baton and, following the directions inscribed on the monolith, a beautiful melody immediately emerged. It was the melody of willpower. I'm sure I learned it with a purpose in this Tower. But I think that will be for another adventure.

*********************************************
Soy @loren89 un fanático de los videojuegos y espero que les haya gustado la historia de hoy.

body.title: Shiraza: Empowering Other Cards
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSmTXBBiGErWE2EGqSVeqyjN5SZQFKMF1bCiw4uZWE3Ux/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog. Shiraza is the new epic Dragon splinter card from the Escalation set. I previously wrote about Shiraza and Ulundin Overseer combo. In today's post we'll take a more in depth look at Shiraza.

***

# Stats and Abilities

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYvFvxTuWDE1qpvms9Gwd6HeoVgq6nbjoTRpVsrWyuRt/image.png)

Shiraza is a seven mana, Neutral card that means she can be used by all splinters and all cards can benefit from her buff. 

Shiraza has great stats, boasting of three magic damage, excellent five speed and eight health. What makes her special is Weapons Training ability at level two that gives utility to cards that I don't usually use. When you buy a Shiraza, you're not just buying one card. You're giving utility to cards that would have just remained unused in your collection. Shiraza gives you more choices. Shiraza also has Phase at level three which is complemented by her excellent speed. At level five, she gains a debuff ability, Halving. 

For players with limited budget like me, a level two Shiraza with Weapons Training ability is a game changer. My cards that lay dormant in my collection now have utility. In addition, Escalation set came with a lot of no attack cards that pairs well with Shiraza.

***

# Comparison with Other Cards with Weapons Training

A level two Shiraza with Weapons Training ability costs around $8. Let's check out other cards that has the same ability.

## Daarg Deadblast

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVWakinwhh7B5n5ssvLYBCEZGfrQghZZfWnh4F6g7C84t/image.png)

Perhaps the closest comparison is the legendary Daarg Deadblast. He is also a seven mana card that deals two magic damage. He costs over $8 and has an additional ability, Swiftness. On the other hand, he is a Water splinter card that limits his utility to only Water compared to Shiraza who is neutral.

## Moxian Rebel

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPQ27juGcR3fN7ZQtC4HaYoQYiyANvTf52Sexh1zQwp5u/image.png)

The Moxian Rebel is also neutral card. It costs only sixty cents but it only deals one magic damage. It will have more attack but that is until level seven. 

## Bren Palesworn

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRUQnCP8rLwM1ePFpFNbBJoMpDuTYbCvvqMELSkspRjY7/image.png)

Bren Palesworn is also a neutral card. He has dual attacks that he can lend to cards with no attacks. He gains the Weapons Training ability at level two so it will cost around $15 to get that benefit. 


***

# Combos

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb9YzUoobLm1P4Mx8QAFupoaw55D1qtDdBfeH75eKKbBs/image.png)

Aside from Ulundin Overseer, there are plenty of cards in the Escalation set that will benefit from Shiraza's Weapons Training ability. These cards will gain two magic damage from a level two Shiraza. These are low mana cards that will easily find slots in your line ups.

## Ashveil Tactician

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUGhQdBzoPJQe5VdMz4kQq8d46e5xMZMuqePb9SVUxwCb/image.png)



Ashveil Tactician boasts of a slew abilities including two buffs Inspire and Flank. I find Inspire that she gets from level two most useful since it buffs the whole team with melee attack. She is also an Elf that will gain Execute from the Earth archon.

## Drifting Manatee

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdfUXtNvgZCDTu97HZ8xb5cotV5dktx2wtvsBxcNf1rhY/image.png)

Drifting Manatee is the Water card with three mana. It gains the Dodge ability at level two but he is awfully slow. He does gain a useful Cleanse Rearguard ability that will good in Noxious Fumes ruleset.

## Earthwork Sentinel

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQjhvJqpysEvd5psHqTN4E45hojgGixRAYzjGp2oU5d3a/image.png)

The Earthwork Sentinel is a three mana card that has four useful abilities. I have mine at level two that has the Slow ability. At higher levels, it gains Shield Ward and Triage.

## Kobold of Burden

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYBWexHbdmUqq6Np9zZcA9jM3iGCaxTJXx89fxNYmhJh4/image.png)

Kobold of Burden has five mana. Similar to the other cards, it will also have four abilities at maxed level. Most useful are Swiftness and Resurrect.

## Ignited Alchemist

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmadM1deNTcc1rmyRmTCU64vZEwz4C7UyKnZX9MMfjNkSf/image.png)

The only card in the group that has five abilities, Ignited Alchemist has the Incendiary debilitation that he turns into a buff with Flame Fed. Instead of decreasing health, he gains +1 every round. He can also fly that makes him a key card in Earthquake rulesets. 

***

# Featured Battle

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeQEFqKqqAenT545Ai9crSRHn8B7yGBtS2NZEXDiAag6p/image.png)

The battle was capped at twenty six mana. I fully utilized two of my no attack cards together with Shiraza. Aside from being low mana, they have utility that buffs and debuffs the enemy. Earthwork Sentinel slowed down the enemy while Ashveil Tactician has Inspire. Ashveil tactician is an elf and gained Execute to bolster her offense.

My enemy had the legendary Eternal Tofu. Before, I'd usually lose to this team but now my lineup is bolstered by the new Escalation cards that help me win battles. Shiraza and the other cards gave me the win in this battle.

[Link](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_a8cfe4c12aca228d0ee078fa997b5907?ref=logen9f)

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. Buying a spellbook allows you to earn SPS tokens and use the  market to sell in game assets. Also, we will both get 500 Credits which can be used top purchase cards once you buy a spellbook.

body.title: Has Technology Really Killed Romance?
body.body:
(https://shorturl.at/40ZlA)  https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWhuAMh3996iNseMe3rLoGjwMainWLrBGyqkzMbpCpQ9k/couple-outdoors-setting-tent.jpg 


Hello Assalamualaikum @everyone, greetings to all from @theindicators. How are you feeling today I hope all are fine and I'm also good 👍 😊 
A few days ago I saw a small post on social media where it was written that technology has killed romance. At first I smiled and ignored it, but later I kept thinking about it. The more I thought, the more I felt that maybe there is some truth in it.
If we look back a little, love used to be very different. People did not have smartphones, WhatsApp, or video calls. Communication was slow. Sometimes people used to wait for days or even weeks just to receive a single letter from someone they loved. That waiting itself was a beautiful part of the relationship. Every small message meant a lot.
I remember listening to stories from older people. They used to say that if they wanted to see someone they liked, they had to wait for the right moment. Maybe outside a street, maybe during a family event, or sometimes just a small glimpse from far away. Even a short meeting felt special.
But now things have changed a lot. Today if someone misses a person, they can just send a message or make a call. Within seconds they can see each other through a video call. Technology has removed distance completely.
At first this sounds like a good thing, and in many ways it really is. Technology helps people stay connected. Friends and families who live far away can still talk daily. Couples in long-distance relationships can see each other whenever they want.
However, sometimes I feel that something small but important has been lost in this process.
The feeling of waiting.
That excitement of not knowing when the next message will arrive. That nervousness before meeting someone. Those moments when a person used to replay a small memory again and again in their mind.
Now everything is instant. Messages are quick, replies are quick, and sometimes emotions also feel quick. When everything becomes so easy and fast, maybe the depth of some feelings slowly becomes lighter.
But I also believe romance is not completely dead. It has only changed its shape.
Real romance does not depend on letters or mobile phones. It depends on sincerity, respect, and genuine feelings between two people. Even in this modern world, if two people truly care for each other, they can still create beautiful moments together.
Maybe technology did not kill romance.
Maybe we just forgot how to slow down and feel it.
Sometimes the problem is not the phone in our hands, but the hurry in our hearts.
If we learn to value time, conversations, and small emotions again, romance will never disappear — no matter how advanced technology becomes.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@theindicators/has-technology-really-killed-romance-3ly)

title.title: Emotional Regulation - Midnight Letters #Prompt 22
title.body:
The desire to attain various kinds of skills in split seconds, is something I find common in at least 6 out of 10 people I come across, both online and offline. Some prefer to monetize everything they learn, while others would rather keep them as enjoyable hobbies or use them solely in their interpersonal relationships. I like to think that I fall under the second category.

Right now, I am more particular about learning the kind of skills that proves me to be a more emotionally grounded individual. At the top of that list is having the ability to regulate my emotions.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUcQ9ERSvV3CkECBsH6PBibBjkPASRnQVxbuSx6K6SFoj/1000386696.jpg 
 [Image from unsplash ](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-black-and-white-photo-of-a-woman-in-the-dark-DHfbOfSKXIo) 

Honestly, I am someone who, by reflex, reacts to people’s actions and situations by impulse. This does not mean that I am not logical at all. It simply means that I am more in touch with my emotional side the moment certain things happen. For example, someone who hasn't made an effort to speak to me in a long while suddenly reaches out when they need help, simply because they are sure I will never say no. Situations like that can trigger me badly or push me to make a hasty decision. 

Depending on how much value I place on such a relationship, I might immediately crash out in front of them or just offer the help they seek without thinking about the possible consequences. It is only later that I resent myself in private when I realize I was not obligated to help them in the first place.

There are also times when people hurt me badly with their words. Sometimes, it is their reactions that get to me the most. Other times it is how often they misunderstand me, which makes me feel like the bad person in the room. The more I try to explain myself, the harder it becomes to regulate my emotions, and sometimes, even my thoughts and actions.

Other times it is external situations that make me act out of place. As long as it is a triggering topic that affects real people, I find it difficult to control my emotions. I either express my feelings openly in public or hold on to a grudge, which I often consider valid. Still, in moments like this, I wish my emotions would not always get the best of me.

I want to be able to resist the urge to act on those emotions. While I have been making good progress, I still feel there is more for me to learn about regulating my emotions. I believe there is power in being neutral sometimes. Being able to let things be without worrying about the what ifs, because at the end of the day, many of those things may not matter. I may not be able to learn this skill overnight but I do hope that very soon, I will become a better version of myself, one who does not allow the actions or words of others to feel any more significant my life. 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb93G9wX8yBpnnSpgdwegAioiTvZFuRjUie7yHU3FqeRe/1000344395.png 
**THANK YOU FOR VISITING MY BLOG!🤗**

title.body:
![hive7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alejoview07/EoeM8KnbmkDfy8QegZEKxUvT8ZuUpvnk8vo9BsVdUjuTMnYfb3KrYaHwnJ79YZVqaCQ.png)

In the evolving landscape of digital social media, Hive stands out as a decentralized ecosystem designed to return power to the creators. Unlike traditional platforms where a central authority controls your data and monetization, Hive operates on a Delegated Proof of Stake (DPoS) protocol, ensuring that the community owns the network.

The Hive Ecosystem: More Than Just Microblogging
The beauty of Hive lies in its diverse array of \

or dApps (decentralized applications). Think of Hive as the database, and these apps as different windows to view and interact with that data:

PeakD & Ecency: Comprehensive blogging platforms similar to Medium but with blockchain rewards.

InLeo: A vibrant hub for short-form content (threads) and long-form financial/crypto analysis.

Splinterlands: A leading blockchain-based trading card game where every card is an NFT you truly own.

3Speak: A video-sharing platform built for free speech and censorship resistance.

Liketu: A visual-centric app perfect for photographers and lifestyle influencers.

How to Earn on Hive
There are three primary ways to build your portfolio within the ecosystem:

Content Creation (Author Rewards): When you post high-quality content, other users \

it. After seven days, the rewards are distributed between the author and the voters.

Curation (Voter Rewards): By discovering and upvoting great content, you earn a share of the rewards. The more Hive Power you have, the more significant your vote and your earnings become.

HBD Savings: The Hive Backed Dollar (HBD) is the ecosystem's stablecoin. Currently, placing HBD into the internal \
account offers a highly competitive 20% APR.

title.title: La última página de otra historia [Creación propia - Poema]
title.body:
Se me pierde en el espejo
el reflejo de mi propia expectativa. 

Ya no tengo ni un recoveco
para guardar el amor por esta vida. 

Se me escapa sin remedio, 
como un barco a la deriva, 

la ilusión que sin miedo
se sobreponía a la herida. 

Yo no sé qué será de mi vida sin ti.
Yo no sé a donde irás a parar sin mi,
ya no sé qué lugar es cuando dicen \
\nni tampoco donde ir cuando me esperan \

.

Hay muy poca magia en tu mirada
y ningún truco en tu perdón, 

ya no hay caos en tu riada
y muy poca gracia en tu canción

lo que era todo se convirtió en nada
y lo que era nada hoy es un montón:

Un montón de mentiras heladas
con el frío de tu ignoto corazón, 

una ausencia almidonada 
a fuego lento en el fogón.

Yo no sé si ya me olvidaste
o si en el despecho te quedaste, 
sólo espero que cuando me marche
tu descaro no vuelva a tropezarme.

title.title: Help needed? I'm trying to identify some guitar picks in my collection from touring bands around the world! 400 Hive in prices and possibly more!
title.body:
Introduction!

I have amassed an absolutely awesome guitar pick collection from various tours around the world, gathered over years of attending concerts and crossing paths with legendary musicians and incredible artists. Each pick carries a story and a connection to a specific moment in music history, but naturally, with such a vast and varied collection, I’ve hit a wall with some of them. While most of my picks are clearly labeled or memorable, there’s a select group that remains a complete mystery, lacking visible names, definitive logos, or easily identifiable tour markings. That’s why I'm launching this identification competition—I need the combined expertise and sharp eyes of fellow collectors and music fans to help me unlock the identity of these elusive pieces and finally place them in the correct context of their tour history!


![1000023793.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dylanhobalart/EoGwzvL5DUqbq9Ca4FMtVuxYjriwHZQq4M88J129Rv4R9DFreeHmavoRiFjw18dnNWy.png)



I've been fortunate enough to build a unique guitar pick collection over the years, gathered from various tours around the world where I’ve crossed paths with some famous musicians and incredible artists. Each pick carries a bit of music history, but naturally, I've ended up with a few whose origins remain a complete mystery to me. That’s where your expertise comes in! This competition is designed to tap into the knowledge of fellow collectors and music fans to finally identify these elusive pieces.
If you can successfully identify one of my unknown picks, I will send you 10 Hive as a thank you. If you manage to identify a second one, you’ll receive an additional 7.5 Hive. The competition officially closes 7 days from the time of this post, so get your identification attempts in quickly. However, don't worry if you crack a code after that; any valid identifications after the deadline will also be rewarded. Furthermore, if any of these picks are discovered to be particularly valuable or rare due to your information, additional rewards might be given to those who identify them! Good luck, and let the identification begin!

---
---

Interlude 

If you're not familiar with my guitar pick posts here on Hive, up being posting about these for a couple weeks now. And I've got a collection with some legendary guitar picks. Please check out my profile to see some of the guitar picks for my collection.

---

title.title: Que se comieron Que!
title.body:
> If you've ever tried lamb tamales wrapped in banana leaves, you know what's good. The flavor of the meat blends perfectly with the coarsely ground masa and spices. It's such a culinary experience that your head aches from the sheer pleasure. Here in the town of Bustamante, it's a rare treat, since it's impossible to find some of the spices, let alone banana leaves. Last Holy Week, I had the joy of a visit from my godmother, who comes from Naranjos, Veracruz. I like her a lot because she's always cheerful, and she also has the habit of bringing me Oaxaca cheese. This time there wasn't any cheese, but she did bring a couple of large lamb tamales. My mouth was watering, but I wanted to enhance the experience with a couple of Bohemias beers. My godmother loves those beers, so I don't need to say she was thrilled to come with me to get some. The beer depot is only two blocks away, so we decided to walk. She told me she was very happy because she was going to be a grandmother soon, and that my cousin Evelyn had just finished law school. Blocks go by quite quickly when you're having such a pleasant conversation. Things weren't going perfectly, but when we opened the door, we realized the neighbor's cats were eating the tamales. I grabbed a piece of dirt and threw it at the cats, but it was too late. Spanish = Si han probado los tamales de borrego en hoja de plátano, saben lo que es bueno. El sabor de la carne se mezcla con la masa martajada y las especias. Es una experiencia culinaria tal, que te duele la cabeza de tanto placer. Acá en el pueblo de Bustamante es privativo, ya que no es posible encontrar algunas de las especies y menos las hojas de plátano. La semana santa pasada tuve la dicha de recibir la visita mi madrina que viene desde Naranjos, Veracruz. Me cae muy bien porque siempre está alegre, pero además tiene la costumbre de traerme quesillo. Está vez no hubo quesillo, pero trajo un par de tamales de borrego de los grandes. De agua se me hacía la boca, pero quise aumentar la experiencia con un par de cervezas Bohemias. A mi madrina Le encantan esas cervezas, no tengo que decir que estaba encantada con acompañarme a traer algunas. El depósito está solo dos cuadras por lo que decidimos irnos caminando. Me platicó que estaba muy feliz porque pronto sería abuela y que mi prima Evelyn Acaba de terminar la carrera de derecho. title.title: Amiga CD32 Gamer (January 1995)
title.body:
>
Cover of the January 1995 issue of Amiga CD32 Gamer
The Amiga CD32 was basically Commodore's attempt at turning the Amiga 1200 into a gaming machine with a CD-ROM drive. The hardware was fine but from Commodore it was too little too late. In fact, when this issue of Amiga CD32 Gamer was published, Commodore was already out of business. The January 1995 issue includes:
  • News - Retailers still supporting Commodore and the Amiga; Sensible World of Soccer out for the Amiga but may not be released for the CD32; Gremlin released Amiga CD32 version of Shadow Fighter; and more.

  • Previews - A look at upcoming games including Base Jumpers, Nick Faldo Golf, Pussies Galore (it's probably not what you're thinking), and Worms.

>
Table of Contents from the January 1995 issue of Amiga CD32 Gamer
  • Frontier II - An in-depth preview of this sequel to Frontier: Elite II which was itself a sequel to Elite.

  • Reviews - Reviews of Pinball Illusions (a pinball simulation), PGA European Tour (golf game), SubWar 2050 (a futuristic submarine warfare game), Theme Park (like Sim City only a theme park), and more.

  • Playing Tips - Tips, tricks, strategies, and solutions for Beneath a Steel Sky, Tower Assault, and Jungle Strike.

  • Correspondence - Letters from readers about buying CD32 games, speakers, the magazine's cover CD, and more.

  • A-Z
    • - A guide to all of the CD32 software available.

>

title.title: Reflexiones sobre mi carrera: Fisioterapia [ES |EN]
title.body:
>



Les mostraré algunas fotos de lo que fue mi misa de graduación como Licenciada en Fisioterapia y les contaré mi experiencia en mi trayectoria de 4 años estudiando fisioterapia y como ahora la estoy ejerciendo, ya que hay diferencias.


Para empezar, no sabía que era Fisioterapia y nunca pensé hacer pasantías en una sala de terapias, incluso en la que queda en mi urbanización y terminar trabajando para ella. En ella, se ha atendido últimamente 83 pacientes en lo que queda de los días restantes.

A largo de 4 años, que siento que he envejecido, a principio fui \

pero sentí en la carrera que no estaba dando todo de mi aunque lo estaba haciendo, es que, la mala organización arruina todo. Es mentira que te vas a aprender los 206 huesos y 600 músculos esqueléticos. Me tocaba aprendermelos, acaletrear, dibujarlos, pintarme el cuerpo para identificarlos hasta que me di cuenta que no podía aprendermelos todos para una evaluación solo por \

.\n\nPoco a poco fui bajando mi rendimiento hasta que confundí algunos huesos a mitad de carrera. También ví el amiguismo pasar por encima de lo correcto, ví que regalaban notas, ví exigencias de dinero cuando no había para poder costearlo y eso no lo entendían, solamente \

con el resto. Me encanta Fisioterapia, todo su panorama y su protocolo de cuidado. Cuando la ejerces y no tienes suficiente experiencia, te das cuenta que no sabes nada hasta que repasas de nuevo a tu ritmo y a tu manera que si entiendes, solo por atender a un paciente y no por querer pasar una materia. En el camino va a haber dudas, inseguridades y miedo. Nadie lo menciona pero yo me atrevo a contarlo. Alguien que recién egresa de una universidad y del sector salud se da cuenta que no lo sabemos todos y por eso no quiero ser docente. Primero quiero tomar experiencia en la sala de terapias dónde trabajo hasta que el Universo me lo permite. ¿Hay fallas? Si, absolutamente. En estos días me ofendí porque una colega de otra universidad había dicho que la Simón Rodríguez no sirve y para contar anécdotas cai en cuenta, no funciona por la mala organización que existe. Por las malas, toca por mi cuenta volver a estudiar de nuevo desde los huesos hasta los músculos, alguna que otra patología por encima y las funciones de los agentes físicos. Todo eso vale a un bono de guerra, desgaste físico y mental atendiendo muchos pacientes todos los días. Para una chica como yo, que no sabe canalizar las emociones, toca pensar que te metiste en este mundo y toca si o si enfrentar la realidad venezolana. Hace años criticaba mucho el sistema de salud pero cuando eres nuevo trabajando para ello, hay deficiencias en trabajar a oscuras si o si me tocó como poner una compresa caliente sin tener luz y usar mi linterna del télefono para poder saber bien dónde colocarlo. De esta manera, se trabaja en el sector salud y en mi caso, medio turno. No he trabajado en otra área así que quiero pensar si es peor o mejor, me deja la duda. ----

> I will show you some photos of my graduation ceremony as a Physical Therapy graduate and tell you about my experience during my four years studying physical therapy and how I am now practicing it, as there are differences. To begin with, I didn't know what physical therapy was and never thought I would do an internship in a therapy room, even the one in my neighborhood, and end up working there. Recently, 83 patients have been treated there in the remaining days. Over the course of four years, which I feel like I've aged, I was a “good student” at first, but I felt during my studies that I wasn't giving it my all, even though I was. The thing is, poor organization ruins everything. It's a lie that you're going to learn all 206 bones and 600 skeletal muscles. I had to learn them, memorize them, draw them, paint my body to identify them until I realized that I couldn't learn them all for an evaluation just to “pass.” Little by little, my performance declined until I confused some bones halfway through the degree. I also saw cronyism take precedence over what was right, I saw grades being given away, I saw demands for money when there was no way to afford it, and they didn't understand that, only “to look good” to the rest. I love physical therapy, its whole scope and its care protocol. When you practice it and don't have enough experience, you realize that you don't know anything until you review it again at your own pace and in your own way, so that you understand, just to treat a patient and not to pass a class. Along the way, there will be doubts, insecurities, and fear. No one mentions it, but I dare to say it. Someone who has just graduated from university and entered the health sector realizes that we don't know everything, and that's why I don't want to be a teacher. First, I want to gain experience in the therapy room where I work until the universe allows me to. Are there flaws? Yes, absolutely. Recently, I was offended because a colleague from another university said that Simón Rodríguez is useless, and to tell you the truth, I realized that it doesn't work because of the poor organization that exists there. Unfortunately, I have to go back to studying everything from bones to muscles, a few other pathologies on top of that, and the functions of physical agents. All of that is worth a war bonus, physical and mental exhaustion from treating many patients every day. For a girl like me, who doesn't know how to channel her emotions, you have to think that you got into this world and you have to face the reality of Venezuela. Years ago, I was very critical of the healthcare system, but when you're new to working in it, there are shortcomings in working in the dark. I had to apply a hot compress without any light and use my phone's flashlight to see where to put it. This is how we work in the healthcare sector, and in my case, half a shift. I haven't worked in any other area, so I'm left wondering if it's worse or better. ---- ######

title.title: Tengo miedo. I'm afraid (Esp-Eng).
title.body: Tengo miedo de que un día el reloj se detenga,\ny que el \

,
que el hilo de tus manos se desprenda
y me quede habitando el mundo sin ti.
Temo al silencio que se instala en los pasillos,
a que tu risa sea un eco que el viento se llevó,
a buscar tu calor en las noches de invierno 
y encontrar solo el frío de lo que se terminó.
Es un miedo callado, que se cuela en la mirada
cuando te veo dormir y el alma se me aprieta,
pensando que la vida es una cuerda delicada
y que el amor, a veces, es una estación incompleta.
No le temo a la muerte, ni al tiempo, ni al olvido,
le temo a la mañana en que despierte y no estés,
a llevar en el pecho el latido de lo vivido
y no tener tus ojos para mirarme otra vez.
Temo que el \

se nos quede corto,
que el destino sea un juez con el alma de hielo,
y que este amor tan vivo, que hoy es mi soporte,
se convierta en un rastro de nubes en el cielo.
Tengo miedo de que el mundo siga girando igual,
de que el sol salga siempre por el mismo rincón,
mientras yo me hundo en un vacío abismal
buscando el pulso de tu mano en mi habitación.
No es que no confíe en lo que hemos construido,
es que el tiempo es un ladrón que no avisa al llegar.
Me aterra que un día, por un descuido del nido,
te me vuelvas un recuerdo que no puedo tocar.
Guardo tus gestos como quien guarda un tesoro,
registro tu aroma por si falla la memoria,
porque el miedo que cargo, y por el que lloro,
es que alguien más escriba el final de nuestra historia.

becomes a trail of clouds in the sky.
I'm afraid that the world keeps turning the same,
that the sun always rises in the same corner,
while I sink into an abysmal void
looking for the pulse of your hand in my room.
It's not that I don't trust what we've built,
It is that time is a thief that does not warn when it arrives.
It terrifies me that one day, due to neglect of the nest,
You become a memory that I can't touch.
I keep your gestures like someone who keeps a treasure,
I record your aroma in case memory fails,
because the fear that I carry, and for which I cry,
is for someone else to write the end of our story.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR1aUpSJXC9KgGmp6dZiyd6tV5PpWn9ePWRsKwT4jYjpV/1773181302013.png)

title.title: ChronoCrypto Journal LA County Grind Log Week of March 9 — In Progress
title.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chronocrypto/23t793WJ3WSgFz3RG6GuyM8ttXtYZAA1aZi8jF2rm8KhJwj8K8r8kaPgWMF5E1PBxBEbS.png)

Location: LA County  
Time reference: Tuesday, March 10 — 5:50 PM PST

This journal records the real process. Not the highlight reel. Not the filtered version people post online. Just the days as they happen.

---

## Monday — March 9

Monday began before the city had fully woken up. LA County always has this strange quiet window early in the morning where the streets feel paused for just a moment before everything begins moving again.

That window is where discipline lives.

The first batch of the week appeared early. Nothing huge. Just a standard grocery run. But the first batch is important because it breaks the barrier between planning and action.

Once the first order is accepted the system begins.

Drive. Shop. Deliver.

The aisles were mostly empty during the first store run. Employees stocking shelves. Shopping carts moving slowly. The quiet efficiency of a grocery store before the rush begins.

One batch turned into two.

Two turned into four.

By late morning the rhythm had formed and the brain switched into the familiar operational mode that comes from repetition.

Scan item.  
Confirm substitution.  
Load bags.  
Drive to next location.

The day built itself piece by piece.

Traffic moved normally across LA County and most orders were straightforward. A few substitutions. A few customer messages. Nothing unusual.

What mattered was momentum.

By the end of the day Monday closed at:

**$195.51**

A strong start to the week.

Not a lucky break.

Just consistent execution.

---

## Tuesday — March 10 (In Progress)

Today started differently.

The body still feels the mileage from Monday. Anyone working gig logistics understands that fatigue is not just physical. It is mental.

Every batch requires decisions.

Every store requires focus.

Every delivery requires navigation through LA County traffic patterns that change constantly.

Tuesday morning began slower than Monday.

Orders appeared but not with the same density as the previous day. That happens often during the middle of the week. The system breathes. Demand rises and falls.

Instead of forcing the pace the strategy becomes patience.

Wait for the right batches.

Choose efficient routes.

Avoid wasting time on low efficiency orders.

The first few deliveries were clean runs through local stores. A few substitutions. Standard grocery lists.

Nothing dramatic.

Just steady movement.

The afternoon brought better activity. Several solid batches appeared and the total began climbing.

As of **5:50 PM PST**, the current numbers show:

**Tuesday earnings so far:** $154.05  
**Current weekly total:** $349.56  
**Active hours:** 11 hours 8 minutes  
**Batches completed:** 16

But the day is **not finished yet**.

There is still time left in the evening window before the shift closes around **7:00 PM**.

Evening orders can sometimes be the most efficient. People finishing work. Families realizing they forgot groceries for dinner. Late meal preparations.

The Instacart system often wakes up again during this period.

So the numbers shown right now are simply a snapshot.

The final Tuesday total will only be known once the last batch is completed tonight.

---

## The Reality of the Work

Gig work in LA County is a moving system.

Orders appear and disappear.

Traffic shifts constantly.

Customer demand changes by the hour.

The only controllable variable inside the system is discipline.

Accept good batches.

Move efficiently.

Maintain energy.

Avoid frustration.

Small improvements each day accumulate into real progress over time.

---

## Where the Week Stands Right Now

Current numbers as of **Tuesday 5:50 PM PST**:

Weekly total so far:  
**$349.56**

Breakdown:

Batch pay: **$170.32**

Tips: **$179.24**

Pending tips: **$17.10**

Active hours: **11 hours 8 minutes**

Batches completed: **16**

The week is still unfolding.

Wednesday through Sunday have not happened yet.

This journal entry simply records the process while it is happening.

---

## Closing Thought for Today

The ChronoCrypto philosophy is simple.

Most people chase massive wins.

But systems are built through repetition.

One delivery.

One decision.

One hour of focused work.

Then another.

The city keeps moving.

Orders keep appearing.

And the journal keeps recording the journey.

Tonight is not finished yet.

The shift closes around **7 PM**.

There is still time for a few more batches.

And the week continues.

title.title: Round of 16 :: 1 st Lag 1 Day
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWvzTxGGXfyLmX2kkfexwVNN5CYtzmRUoWrkWUXeW5UD9/1773190456092.jpg)


ဒီမနက်မှာ UCL Round of 16 ပထမကျော့ ပွဲစဉ်များ ထဲမှ ၄ ပွဲ ကစားခဲ့၏။ နက်ဖြန်မှာ နောက်ထပ် ၄ ပွဲ ကစားမည် ဖြစ်၏။ ဒီနေ့ ကစားခဲ့သည့် ပွဲစဉ် ၄ ပွဲမှာ EPL အသင်း ၃ သင်း ပါဝင်နေခဲ့၏။ Tottenham, New Castle, Liverpool တို့ ဖြစ်၏။ သုံးသင်းလုံး ရလဒ်အားဖြင့် အားရစရာတော့ မရှိနေခဲ့ပေ။ Tottenham က Atletico Madrid ကို အဝေးကွင်းမှာ ၅-၂ ဖြင့် ရှုံးနိမ့်သွားခဲ့၏။ Tottenham ထက်စာရင် New Castle က တော်သေးသည်ဟု ဆိုရမည်။ အိမ်ကွင်းမှာ Barcelona ကို ၁-၁ သရေ ကစားထား၏။

Liverpool အနေဖြင့်လည်း Galatasaray အသင်းကို အဝေးကွင်းမှာ ၁-၀ ဆိုသည့် ရလဒ်ဖြင့် ရှုံးနိမ့်သွားခဲ့ရလေ၏။ Tottenham ထက်စာရင် Liverpool နှင့် New Castle တို့မှာတော့ မျှော်လင့်ချက် ပို၍ ကျန်ရှိနေသေးသည်ဟု ဆိုရမည်။ ထိုသို့ ပြော၍ Tottenham အတွက် မျှော်လင့်ချက် လုံးဝ မရှိတော့တာတော့ မဟုတ်ပေ။ ဒုတိယကျော့ အိမ်ကွင်းမှာ ၃ ဂိုးနှင့် အထက် သွင်းနိုင်ဖို့တော့ လိုပေလိမ့်မည်။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZW79iVLQmxEvHTC1MJZpLTNUpEjvp22DHHmW6QiSswTg/1773190456031.jpg)


သူတို့ ထက် အခြေအနေဆိုးနေတာက Atalanta ဖြစ်၏။ Bayern Munchen ကို အိမ်ကွင်းမှာ ၁-၆ ဖြင့် ဂိုးပြတ် ရှုံးနိမ့်သွားခဲ့ရ၏။ အီတလီမြေမှ တသင်းထဲသော အသင်းအနေဖြင့် ဒီအတိုင်းဆို Round of 16 အဆင့်ကနေ နှုတ်ဆက် ထွက်ခွာရတော့မယ့် ပုံပင်။ Bayern Munchen အိမ်ကွင်းကြီးမှာ Atlanta အနေဖြင့် ၅ ဂိုး ပြန်သွင်းပြနိုင်ဖို့က တကယ် မလွယ်သည့် ကိစ္စ တခုပင်။ 

နက်ဖြန် ပွဲစဉ်တွေမှာလည်း ထုံးစံအတိုင်း EPL မှ ၃ သင်း ပါဝင်နေသေး၏။ Leverkusen vs Arsenal, Bodo/Glmit vs Sporting CP, PSG vs Chelsea, Real Madrid vs Man City တို့ ဖြစ်ကြ၏။ PSG vs Chelsea ပွဲစဉ်ကတော့ တကယ် စိတ်ဝင်စားဖို့ ကောင်း၏။ ဖီဖာ ကမ္ဘာ့ကလပ် ဗိုလ်လုပွဲမှာ တုန်းက Chelsea က PSG ကို ၃-၀ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရထားခဲ့၏။ PSG တို့ ရှုံးကြွေး ပြန်ဆပ်နိုင်မလား ကြည့်ရပေလိမ့်မည်။

Real Madrid vs Man City ကတော့ မကြာခဏကို ဆုံနေကြ သလိုပင်။ အဘက်ဘက်မှာ အင်အားကြီးသည့် အသင်း နှစ်သင်း Round of 16 အဆင့်မှာ ခပ်‌စောစော တွေ့နေတာက နှမြောစရာပင်။ သူတို့ နှစ်သင်းထဲက တသင်းကတော့ ကွာတားဖိုင်နယ်မှာ Bayern Munchen နဲ့ တွေ့ဖို့ များနေခဲ့၏။ Round of 16 မဲခွဲထားမှုက တဖက်ထဲမှာ ချန်ပီယံဟောင်းတွေ များနေခြင်း ဖြစ်၏။ ဘာပဲ ပြောပြော UCL ပွဲစဉ်တွေက ရင်ခုန် စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားဖို့ ကောင်းတာ ဘယ်သူမှ ငြင်းမည် မဟုတ်ပေ။

_(photos from UCL page)_

title.title: The experience of purchasing the Doomshield Warden card and its importance
title.body:
Today is a very happy day for me, because today I purchased a new powerful card Splinterlands game called Doomshield Warden. Those who play game regularly know very well how important it is collect a powerful card. Especially when that card is useful for tanks defense, it increases  chances winning many battles in game.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUW9tdfMV7UHEdvC5FL91ooUjZvHFXoNCj7wwrELRFqcL/1773190079831.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRXUQhCSQnVAUDcXiLN2nz6h9PwKq1haqJHKLjo7CUENa/1773190080015.png)

Splinterlands is a strategy-based card game where each card has its own power tactical use. To win game, you not only need have powerful cards, but also have the ability use those cards correctly. In this regard, Doomshield Warden is a very effective card.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQt72MQYk8BNJsRmzdb39c5yZZmVcARbUac9CjENF668P/1773190079898.jpg)

When I first looked at this card, its artwork and design attracted me. The picture  card shows a powerful warrior large weapon in his hand heavy armor on his body. It is easy understand that this card is basically a defensive warrior.  This type card is usually used in the first position game so that the enemy's attack can take this card first.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRXUQhCSQnVAUDcXiLN2nz6h9PwKq1haqJHKLjo7CUENa/1773190080015.png)

The most important thing about this card is its defense and health. When a card has high defense and health, it can survive for a long time. the attacking cards behind it can safely attack the enemy. Therefore, Doomshield Warden often ensures protection entire team.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQNF5VMgndcwP9VqwPqqM84xsuWm7btD1HqVhSYAnGxrr/1773190080092.png)

Another thing is that different types abilities are added  this card at different levels. When a card is leveled up in Splinterlands game, new abilities powers are added that card. The same thing is seen in the case Doomshield Warden. As level increases, this card becomes stronger and gains new defensive abilities.

In many battles in game, situations arise where the enemys attack is very strong. Then, if there is no strong tank card in front, the entire team can be lost very quickly. Doomshield Warden reduces that problem a great extent. Because it can withstand many hits and can continue fighting for a long time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcxvD6V4xizbFW6tM4Lg6PvEpn2fFrct12RbfqPC5q2BT/1773190080413.png)

 Another important aspect of this card is its attack power. Although it is primarily a defensive card, its attack power is not low. When it stands in front enemy, it not only withstands damage, but also counterattacks. the enemy gradually weakens.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSvpy2BtsXkDxkUWZhYq5R2buBvWuJWZgQbLSZDJM8EGH/1773190080280.jpg)

Strategy is often the key victory Splinterlands game. If a powerful card can be used  right time and in right place, the outcome  entire match can change. Doomshield Warden is kind card that can act game changer in many matches.

 I was looking for a strong tank card that would make my team stronger. When this card was finally added my collection, I felt like my deck had improved.

Collecting a good card while playing game always creates a special feeling. Because every new card means new strategies new plans, and new possibilities. Doomshield Warden has opened the door those new possibilities for me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd4H6TnNBv1RSSjHqsyMyha6SmBxAAaXLixmUmYZdTiQS/1773190080520.jpg)

I plan to level up this card future.  Because increasing the level will increase its strength and power. Then it will become more effective and will help me win in many difficult matches.

The most interesting thing about Splinterlands game is that each card has its own importance. Sometimes even a simple card can give extraordinary results if used correctly. However having a powerful card like Doomshield Warden increases that possibility even more.

I believe that this card will play important role in many my battles in the future. Especially when I have fight against strong opponents, this card will lead my team from the front.

Doomshield Warden is not just a card but also a powerful defensive wall. It protects my team, repels enemy attacks, and gradually paves the way victory.

Today's experience purchasing this card will be a moment great joy for me. Because the joy collecting new powerful cards while playing game is really different.

I hope that in the future I will be able play many more great battles and achieve more victories using this card.

title.title: 奇怪的数学题
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![y1G6p0zpIy3pdCwF_vxt16.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/y1G6p0zpIy3pdCwF_vxt16/y1G6p0zpIy3pdCwF_vxt16.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

这几天辅导孩子作业看到有估算问题，说是有一个赛场分为东西南北4个大区，每个大区有2个小区，小明坐在第9排29号，是西区第一区最后一个座位。每个区的座位数都相同。估一估，赛场一共有多少个座位？
看到这道题后，我能想到的解题思路是，计算出一个小区的座位数：9x29=261，总共有4x2=8个小区，最后计算座位：261x8=2088个。
可是扫描题目旁边的二维码看到的解题过程居然是把9排估算为10排，29号估算为30号，计算式子变成了10x30x8=2400个。
对于二维码给的解题我表示有些不理解，明明有确切的数字为什么要估算成别的数字呢，感觉完全没必要啊。后来我想了一下，感觉应该是四舍五入，遇到小于等于4的数字舍去，大于等于5的数字进位。
还有一个道题：翻开一本书，最后两页的页码和是187，这本书的所有页码一共需要多少个数字？
根据187可以计算出最后两页的页码分别是93和94，但问的是需要多少个数字，我完全不知道问的是啥意思。用AI搜索才知道一位数字0~9是9个数字，两位数10~94有85个，所用数字85x2=170，答案是170+9=179个数字。
不知道为啥问这么模棱两可的问题，就连大人都理解不了，孩子们更加不理解。

---

title.title: Phone Photography Contest #103 - Cumaná Cathedral Church
title.body: In the heart of the city of Cumaná (Sucre, Venezuela), the oldest city on the American continent, stands the Cathedral of Cumaná or Metropolitan Cathedral of the Sacred Heart of Jesus. Built in the neoclassical style, it was rebuilt in 1936 after being destroyed by a terrible earthquake in 1929. It is a beautiful Catholic temple, almost entirely covered in wood and with attractive altarpieces that imitate those of colonial times, with their characteristic golden color and allusive images painted or modeled in stucco. It is very spacious, both in width and length. It has many sculptural images of the Virgin Mary and various saints, as well as beautiful stained glass windows. There are also symbolic tiles on the floor. But perhaps the most striking feature is the large lamps hanging from the ceiling (“chandeliers,” as they are called). I took some new photos with my cell phone on my last visit a few days ago. Here are three of them with different perspectives.
