title.title: 10 March 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3038: he ate what?
title.body:
/>

“OK, so, military life is not for the foodie, Rob – you might want to rethink going to West Point.”

Nine-year-old Milton Trent had just come from quality eavesdropping on his father, Sgt. Vincent Trent, talking about the things he had eaten during his 20 years of service.

Five-year-old Lil' Robert Ludlow, hearing this advice, would not be dissuaded.

“Naw,” he said. “I gotta go even sooner because, see, they need a general of food to fix this!”

“He ate what?” eleven-year-old Eleanor Ludlow said when she heard about it from her best friend eleven-year-old Velma Trent.

“Yeah, there's all kinds of bush meat in the world,” Velma said, “and if it is living in or under a bush in the fields of the world, it becomes part of the field rations. Rations from the field and such.”

“That's actually why the Confederacy lost the Civil War,” Eleanor said. “The rations from the field ran out, and General Lee could not watch all of his men starve.”

“Well, I can see that now, because, ain't no way,” Velma said. “Obviously my people needed to be free and you hard-working Ludlows needed to have your slave-owning relatives stop looking down their noses at you, and all that is good, but just imagine. They must have eaten up every rat, every squirrel, and got even past Dad and his French buttered snails.”

“They probably ran out of butter long before all that,” Eleanor said. “My great-great-great-great-great-grand uncle, being a man of taste, probably called it quits right there – who is going to serve the army they love snails with no butter?”

“Robert E. Lee was a lot of things,” Velma said, “but that cruel? Probably not.”

“I mean, there's folks we can ask – hey, Papa!” Eleanor said.

“Yes, Eleanor?” Capt. R.E. Ludlow said.

“You think that our ancestral uncle Robert E. Lee would have served his men snails without butter, or that might be why he surrendered?” Eleanor said.

“What?” Capt. Ludlow said.

“See, my dad was telling my big brother Melvin about eating French buttered snails as part of service one year,” Velma said, “and we figured they must have eaten anything and everything else like the Army of Northern Virginia to get down to the snails, but Eleanor was thinking Gen. Lee drew the line at un-buttered snails and just went on and surrendered.”

Capt. Ludlow took a moment to wrap his mind around this as Mrs. Thalia Ludlow started laughing in the background.

“OK,” he said. “First, buttered snails with garlic are considered a delicacy in parts of France, so Sgt. Trent was actually eating very well on that occasion. Second, that dish with or without the butter was probably not well known in Virginia in 1865, so that wasn't the reason – however, Eleanor and Velma, your knowledge of history is correct in that the lack of sufficient food was a major factor in Gen. Lee's decision. By April 5, the army was digging for roots and tubers and peanuts. No report about snails.”

“I'm glad the snails were safe,” Eleanor said.

“Yeah, because enough really was enough of all that,” Velma said.

“Gen. Lee would have agreed,” Capt. Ludlow said. “Everything has an end, and also everything new has a beginning … a Virginia in which our families can be friends and business partners needed to begin sometime. So it did.”

“You know, your grandfather didn't always believe that,” Velma said to Eleanor later.

“Yeah, there was a bad few weeks there,” Eleanor said. “But he was just so hurt … the way he was raised by his father, how are you supposed to have your parents as Black kids when mine are dead from drugs? Papa was raised as a little racist at first – but then his grandmother took him and he grew up with all kinds of kids too on the mountain. It just took the Lord a little while to just pull him back again from the foolishness – you noticed he never stopped us from getting to know and playing together.”

“No, he didn't,” Velma said. “Good thing he has gotten to the right side of the Civil War again.”

“Yep,” Eleanor said, “because who wants to sign up to keep on losing?”

The idea came to me when I found the pixel art image on Pinterest, and I thought it would look lovely on a necklace because most people love avocados. Plus, I thought it was adorable that the center of the seed was shaped like a heart. I hope you like it!
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/EokfVZCaUqRRZ95NexSp5qWZ3J4nYKnBaub9CSMbp8SZcmnvyg3sZaEtSHqXgqVTbuR.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Materiales / Materials

+ Hilo acrílico para crochet de 1mm: rosado, verde oscuro, verde claro, amarillo claro, beige y marrón. + Cordón de hilo chino + Tabla con gancho + 2 pinzas para ropa + Tijera + Regla + Encendedor > + 1mm acrylic crochet yarn: pink, dark green, light green, light yellow, beige, and brown. > + Chinese cord > + Board > + 2 clothespins > + Scissors > + Ruler > + Lighter
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/EoeESRE4ivruywdKpvYMUNxkB3JCtS2ZQRHppqSVPx28F58gWXJRX3L8tnRXaWBZiWC.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Proceso / Process

Como les dije al inicio este pixel art que usé como patrón lo conseguí en Pinterest, solo tuve que recortar la imagen para obtener un tamaño adecuado para el collar, dejando como resultado 16 columnas de cuadro que equivalen a 16 hilos guía y 20 filas que corresponden a las 20 hileras de nudos que se harán para completar la figura. > As I mentioned at the beginning, I got this pixel art that I used as a pattern from Pinterest. I just had to crop the image to get a suitable size for the necklace, resulting in 16 square columns that correspond to 16 guide threads and 20 rows that correspond to the 20 rows of knots that will be made to complete the figure.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/23x1Hn2vHrAHNFeJToFQdEfWfu1hb5xYB6NqKdBVVPRwHfWgMWBGDtpn4BFYc4xqw5tN4.jpg [Source](https://ar.pinterest.com/pin/866872628249268865/)
https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Para comenzar se corta 70 cm de hilo chino, tomar un extremo y hacer un nudo corredizo envolviendo el extremo opuesto, hacer lo mismo con el otro extremo, quemar las puntas con el encendedor, de ese modo se obtiene la base del collar ajustable, el cual se puede ampliar y reducir para pasar por la cabeza sin problema y ajustarse al cuello de la persona. Rodear la tabla con el collar y sujetar con las pinzas paras ropa. > To begin, cut 70 cm of Chinese thread, take one end and make a slipknot by wrapping it around the opposite end, do the same with the other end, and burn the ends with a lighter. This creates the base of the adjustable collar, which can be lengthened or shortened to fit comfortably over the head and around the neck. Wrap the collar around the board and secure it with clothespins.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJmsJS3sxVidj9wpdEkX5EbgNfFrL93sJk6k9YsXTrvxfd6hzWf2Lf43c7YBC96.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Con el hilo rosado cortar 8 hebras de 28cm, tomar las hebras por la mitad y anudarlas al centro del collar, tal como se muestra en las imágenes, agregar el hilo anudador de color de fondo sujetándolo con el gancho de la tabla. > With the pink thread, cut 8 strands of 28cm, take the strands in the middle and knot them in the center of the necklace, as shown in the images, add the knotting thread of background color securing it with the hook on the board.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJg8RRp7QAjRmMbLuv926QdatTUnva8eMNZ2HASNDMAsAdNTLCLabf2RrM1yAQx.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Proceder a hacer las hileras de nudos en correspondencia al patrón donde cada cuadro representa un nudo, agregar los hilos anudadores de otros colores según se vayan necesitando sujetándolos en el gancho de la tabla, los nudos se hacen cuando el hilo anudador envuelve dos veces cada uno de los hilos guía de izquierda a derecha en la primera hilera y de derecha a izquierda en la segunda y así sucesivamente, los cambios de color de hilo anudador se hacen cruzando las hebras por detrás. > Proceed to make the rows of knots according to the pattern where each square represents a knot, add the knotting threads of other colors as needed, attaching them to the hook on the board. The knots are made when the knotting thread wraps twice around each of the guide threads from left to right in the first row and from right to left in the second, and so on. Changes in the color of the knotting thread are made by crossing the strands behind.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJehD2Kz8iyug4cVejrmJpYzrakwYRSk6qTvUE1L8U1eYcq21Lu2EYGuBxWmH2g.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Al terminar las 20 hileras de nudos separar los hilos guía en 4 partes, hacer 4 nudos y cortar los hilos excedentes, cortar y esconder los hilos anudadores por detrás. No es obligatorio, pero recomiendo planchar a temperatura baja para obtener un resultado más prolijo. > After completing the 20 rows of knots, separate the guide threads into 4 sections, make 4 knots, and cut off the excess threads. Cut and hide the knotting threads behind the fabric. It's not mandatory, but I recommend ironing at a low temperature for a neater result.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AJmrzvLtgTvHbwRb8BrF7Rcjx4MSTUfdFVNipRUvVhAJan76rLBH6YByipjtdma.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

title.title: One of the best cards in Splinterlands, even with zero attacks
title.body:
> Those who play Splinterlands regularly know very well that you can't win by just attacking. The most important thing in the game is the right strategy and intelligence. At first, I myself thought that the cards that deal more damage are probably the most powerful. But after gradually entering the depths of the game, my misconception was broken. ![Screenshot_2026_0311_082703.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVkExGtXTJYnra7Sjz6hAfmbvexo87KZ1DTQvv1saqjQR/Screenshot_2026_0311_082703.jpg) I understand that defense or resistance also plays an equally important role in winning. Today I will discuss with you such a wonderful card from Water Splinter. At first glance, it may seem very ordinary or weak. Because this card does not have any attack power of its own. The name of the card is Digendark Surveyor. It is basically a card of the gnome tribe, and if you look at its stats, you will clearly see that its attack is absolutely zero. You may wonder how a card that cannot attack is so popular with everyone. The answer is hidden in the other great stats of the card. The Digendark Surveyor card costs only two mana to put on your battlefield. Those who play regularly know how valuable a two-mana card can be at the end of the game. Especially when you have to build a strong team with very little mana, these cards become the real heroes of the game. ![Screenshot_2026_0311_082714.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdVdH5Dpvn3ktpFwYZM5SEtDeeVrE6mPZegvqm9ugvyg9/Screenshot_2026_0311_082714.jpg) For just two mana, you get five health or life and two speed at level one. Getting so much health for a two-mana card is incredible. This simply means that it can easily withstand several strong attacks from the enemy and survive on the field. In the language of game strategy, we can call it a kind of meat shield. Its main function is to protect the other main attacking cards of your team from behind. Its main goal is to stand in front andabsorbt all the terrible blows of the enemy and lead the team to victory. However, what impressed me the most about this card is its magical ability. From level one, Digendark Surveyor comes with a great ability called Magic Reflect. Those of you who have noticed the screenshots I shared must have seen it. ![Screenshot_2026_0311_082723.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfJZUZ27rua5iRvRuEkqyUBBavoXMbzxdaJeiXkXWHMFR/Screenshot_2026_0311_082723.jpg) The function of Magic Reflect is that when an enemy hits it with a magic attack, half of that damage will be returned to the attacker. According to the rules of the game, the calculation of this damage return is always rounded up. That is, if you deal one damage, you will get one damage back. When playing with Water Splinter, we often have to face strong magic teams that attack a lot of magic. At those critical moments, if you put this card in the front row, it works like magic. When the enemies come to kill it, they themselves are destroyed due to Magic Reflect. ![Screenshot_2026_0311_082734.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXAwxirYYxX5qebsgifzHgoQtYbRoD7ppvTdANRwuKyvV/Screenshot_2026_0311_082734.jpg) When you level up the card over time, its effectiveness increases many times over. If you look at the card's level upgrade list in the screenshots, you can see that when it reaches level three, its health increases to six. Then its speed also increases to three, which is very useful. When you take it to level five while playing the game, another protective ability called Void is added to it. I personally think that this card is a must-have in the collection of those who love playing the game with Water Splinter. It can win you many tough matches. Sometimes, at the end of the battle setup, we see that we only have two mana left. Then we have to put a card in front that will not die easily. At that moment, Digendark Surveyor becomes the savior of the team with its harmless appearance and Magic Reflect ability. ![Daigendark Surveyor.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPzR1xH1Y5PEZcu2XGMSSYPEeQ9THeGMJSri9yJeir9PL/Daigendark%20Surveyor.jpg) Even in the game's Little League ruleset, where only four mana or fewer cards can be used, its dominance is worth seeing. No card should be judged or neglected solely by its zero attack. The Digendark Surveyor card has proven that time and time again, even with its zero attack. If used in the right place, even a harmless Vision card can turn the tide of the entire game in an instant. It's quite fun when your opponent sees their powerful magic cards being destroyed by this card. You can try it out in the battles ahead. My references:-https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=mirzaiqi
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcRZtMskgn8d4zcpv27xJwmGJvq247fQB6ZBKsC1JU4JT/1768123335168.png)

title.title: [Literature] Charles Dickens:  A Great Mystery Solved by Gillan Vase #12/131
title.body: Not I, I am sure. Why, you are like a Jack-in-the-box (I had one given me once, when I was a little lad, and it was the terror of my childhood), springing out like mad, when one never means or expects him. We business men are not accustomed to making contracts in a hurry; and I, in particular, am so remarkably slow in my decisions, that without sufficient time I can decide on nothing. Bless my soul! I’m all of a tremble still with the effort of stopping you. Give me time, my good fellow, give me time.”

>With his blue spectacles all awry, and his hat falling from his trembling hand; with his lips quivering, and the tears he had kept back with such difficulty during the interview falling thick and fast, the young man sinks into the chair again, opposite Mr. Grewgious, who is blowing his nose with a trumpet-sound.

>“I was just upon the point of saying,” begins Mr. Grewgious, speaking very slowly and distinctly, as if he fears his voice may turn traitor, and let out something he wishes to conceal, “that I didn’t object to give you a trial, contrary to custom, even without a character, when you broke into what may be termed the Emotional. Being myself a man born without emotions, or, at any rate, with emotions in so rarefied a state that they never expose me to the risk of an explosion, it is naturally mortifying and trying to my feelings to see people meandering into entirely unbusiness-like paths where I cannot follow ‘em. You took a by-path, sir, in entering into the Emotional, and I beg you to return to me now into the broad highroad of Common Sense.”

>How hard and dry are the words the old man utters; and his voice, hard and dry, too, chimes in unison. Yet his eyes, screwed together so tightly, are not screwed this time only to enable his short sight to reach further. And when he again attacks his nose, and brings forth a renewal of the trumpet-sound, he turns aside his head to make use of his handkerchief for another and more secret purpose.

>“Your duties would not be heavy,” he resumes, “ and though naturally hard (I was born so) I trust you would not find me an unjust master. Your salary, I will pay you monthly for the present (it is more convenient to me), a month in advance. If you are unprovided with lodgings, there are some nice ones not far from here which are to be had. The lady who keeps them — a most remarkable female of the name of Billickin — has begged me to remember that they are empty, and to help her to fill them. But that, of course, rests with you,” continues Mr. Grewgious, remembering, with some alarm, that a sojourn with that lady is not without its drawbacks. “Though she might take more kindly to a male than to a female,” he thinks.
>The stranger, who can hardly speak for tears, thanks him fervently.

>“It is a pleasant custom (among heathens) in ratifying a contract,” says Mr. Grewgious, “ to break bread over it. My coffee is cold, but my boy shall run over to Furnival’s for a fresh supply. Not that we are heathens, I trust; or that coffee is bread, or anything like it (though we may have a morsel to eat along with it, for I’m as hungry, myself, as a wolf), but I’m the most unfortunate man in the world at a simile, and invariably break down when I attempt one; and it may answer the same purpose, perhaps.”

>Mr. Grewgious, during these remarks, has been guilty of the rudeness of turning his back upon the stranger, and has been studiously contemplating indifferent objects in the room with a sudden interest in them which demands all the short sight with which Nature has provided him, for the young man has broken into low sobs, and is vainly struggling to compose himself. To give the stranger further time and opportunity, Mr. Grewgious shuffles out of the room; and on his return the young man has (to use Mr. Grewgious’ own words) emerged from the by-paths of the Emotional, and come out into the broad, high road of Common Sense.

>In with Mr. Grewgious, or rather, close upon the heels of that gentleman, comes a waiter from Furnivals’ with the smoking coffee, and the “bit of eatable,” which promptitude on the part of said waiter is so approved of by Mr. Grewgious that he rewards it on the spot with a piece of silver.

title.title: The Dystopian Future Is No Longer Fiction
title.body:
Every Tuesday I like to drop the needle on three songs that never get old, no matter how many times you hear them. This is not about discovering something new. It is about revisiting the kind of tracks that helped define an era and still hold up decades later.

![F3086E35-D694-46C9-A5C8-93249C1860E6.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdABNnECs5yNi5ajf6SmNA87JkuFgPNx3iBY3SU8rAX8x/F3086E35-D694-46C9-A5C8-93249C1860E6.png)

The late seventies were a fascinating moment for music. Punk was exploding, new wave was beginning to form, and rock was evolving into something more experimental. The result was a period where artists were taking risks and creating sounds that still influence music today.

This week’s picks come straight from that era. Three bands that all had their own identity and three songs that immediately stand out the second they begin. Turn the volume up and enjoy a small trip back to the late seventies.

First up is David Bowie with Heroes. Bowie was never afraid to push boundaries, and this track is one of his most powerful recordings. The song slowly builds with layers of sound while Bowie’s voice grows more intense with every verse. By the time it reaches the famous line about being heroes just for one day, it feels almost cinematic. It is one of those songs that captures both vulnerability and strength at the same time.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lXgkuM2NhYI

Next is The Cars with Just What I Needed. This song helped introduce the band’s signature mix of rock guitars and new wave keyboards. Ric Ocasek’s cool vocal delivery sits perfectly over one of the most recognizable riffs of the decade. The track feels tight, catchy, and effortlessly cool, which is exactly what made The Cars stand out when they arrived on the scene.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z5-rdr0qhWk

The third pick is The Police with Message In A Bottle. Right from the opening guitar riff you know exactly what song it is. Andy Summers’ guitar work carries the track while Sting delivers one of the band’s most memorable vocal performances. The song mixes loneliness with energy, turning a simple concept into a massive anthem that still sounds huge today.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MbXWrmQW-OE

What ties these three songs together is that they all came from artists who refused to stay inside one lane. Bowie was constantly reinventing himself. The Cars blended rock with the emerging new wave sound. The Police mixed punk attitude with reggae rhythms and sharp musicianship.

Another thing that stands out is how recognizable these songs are within seconds. A few notes of guitar or keyboard and you instantly know what you are hearing. That kind of identity is something a lot of modern music struggles to replicate.

These tracks also remind you how strong songwriting was during that period. The hooks were memorable, the production was bold, and the artists were not afraid to experiment with sound and structure.

There is also something timeless about the energy in these recordings. Even decades later they still feel alive when you play them loud. Great music has a way of refusing to age, and these songs are proof of that.

That is the fun of Three Tune Tuesday (BTW it is hosted by @ablaze). It is a chance to revisit the kind of music that helped shape rock history and still delivers every time you press play. So if you have not heard these songs in a while, give them another spin today. Turn the speakers up a little and enjoy three classics from the late seventies that never seem to lose their power.

In recent weeks, we have seen a direct correlation in financial headlines: the price of a barrel of oil rises sharply, and simultaneously, major global stock indices (like the S&P 500 or the EuroStoxx 50) experience notable drops.

If you are an investor who is just starting out, this scenario can generate anxiety. It is easy to get carried away by fear and think that your money is \

But before making any hasty decisions, it is crucial to understand **why** this happens and **how** it affects your strategy.

---

### 🔍 Why Does Expensive Oil Scare the Markets?

Oil is not just gasoline for cars; it is the basic input for almost the entire global economy. When its price rises, it triggers a domino effect:

1. **Increased Costs for Companies:** Almost any company depends on transportation and energy. More expensive oil means higher logistics and production costs, which shrinks profit margins.
2. **The Threat of Inflation:** High oil is a powerful engine of global inflation. When filling the tank is more expensive, consumers have less money left for other goods, slowing down the economy.
3. **Central Bank Response (Interest Rates):** To fight inflation, Central Banks usually raise interest rates. This makes borrowing more expensive, cooling down economic growth and punishing stock valuations.

---

### 🧠 Investor Psychology: Why You SHOULD NOT Panic Sell

Understanding macroeconomics is useful, but **managing your emotions is vital**. When you see your portfolio in red, the \

instinct tells you to sell. This is the most costly mistake you can make.\n\n* **You are doing DCA (Dollar Cost Averaging):** If you invest monthly, market drops are actually **good news**. Your fixed contribution buys **more shares** at lower prices. You are effectively \

\n* **The Market is Cyclic:** Historically, after every major crash, the market has always recovered and reached new highs. Volatility is part of the game.\n* **You Cannot Predict the Bottom:** No one has a crystal ball. If you sell today out of fear, you might miss the recovery. Trying to \

the perfect time to enter and exit is a strategy destined for failure.

### 🧱 Conclusion: Trust Your Long-Term Plan

Volatility is not the same as risk. The true risk is abandoning a good plan due to an emotional impulse. My strategy hasn't changed: ignore the noise, maintain the monthly discipline, and focus on the long term (20+ years). 

**Discipline and patience are your best tools!** 💪📈

# 🛢️ Petróleo al alza, Bolsas a la baja: Entendiendo la conexión y por qué NO debes entrar en pánico 📉

En las últimas semanas, hemos visto una correlación directa en los titulares financieros: el precio del barril de petróleo sube con fuerza y, simultáneamente, los principales índices bursátiles globales experimentan caídas notables.

Si eres un inversor que está comenzando, este escenario puede generar ansiedad. Es fácil dejarse llevar por el miedo, pero antes de tomar decisiones precipitadas, es crucial entender **por qué** sucede esto y **cómo** afecta a tu estrategia.

---

### 🔍 ¿Por qué el petróleo caro asusta a los mercados?

El petróleo es el insumo básico para casi toda la economía global. Cuando su precio sube, se desencadena un efecto dominó:

1. **Aumento de Costos para las Empresas:** Casi cualquier empresa depende del transporte y la energía. Un petróleo más caro significa mayores costos de logística y producción, lo que reduce los márgenes de beneficio.
2. **La Amenaza de la Inflación:** El petróleo alto es un motor de la inflación global. Cuando llenar el depósito es más caro, los consumidores tienen menos dinero para otros bienes, frenando el consumo.
3. **La Respuesta de los Bancos Centrales (Tipos de Interés):** Para combatir la inflación, los Bancos Centrales suelen subir los tipos de interés. Esto hace que pedir préstamos sea más caro, enfriando la economía y castigando las valoraciones de las acciones.

---

### 🧠 La Psicología del Inversor: ¿Por qué NO debes vender en pánico?

Entender la macroeconomía es útil, pero **gestionar tus emociones es vital**. Cuando ves tu portafolio en rojo, el instinto de \

te dice que vendas. Este es el error más común y costoso que puedes cometer.\n\n* **Estás Haciendo DCA (Dollar Cost Averaging):** Si inviertes mensualmente, las caídas son, paradójicamente, **una buena noticia**. Tu aportación fija compra **más acciones** a precios más bajos. Estás \

.
* **El Mercado es Cíclico:** Históricamente, después de cada gran caída, el mercado siempre se ha recuperado y alcanzado nuevos máximos. La volatilidad es parte del ciclo normal.
* **No Puedes Predecir el Suelo:** Nadie tiene una bola de cristal. Si vendes hoy por miedo, ¿cuándo volverás a entrar? Intentar adivinar el momento perfecto es una estrategia destinada al fracaso.

### 🧱 Conclusión: Confía en tu Plan de Largo Plazo

La volatilidad no es lo mismo que riesgo. El verdadero riesgo es abandonar un plan por miedo. Mi estrategia no ha cambiado: ignorar el ruido, mantener la disciplina de aportación mensual y enfocarme en el largo plazo (20+ años).

**¡La disciplina y la paciencia son tus mejores herramientas!** 💪📈

title.title: Psychics Are Not Demonic, And The Bible Is Bogus
title.body: ![Prettysleepy is the creator of this image/Source: Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2018/04/02/15/56/psychic-3284198_1280.jpg) ## 1.  A Religious Psychic In Denial There is this one YouTuber named Bryce Crawford who is quite annoying in that he preaches the gospel about Christian fundamentalist beliefs. In his one video below, he interviews a psychic and runs his mouth about how the Bible condemns them as being demonic. However, he himself turns around and uses psychic powers to indicate to her that he knows that she has hip pain. Bryce Crawford Is Either A Psychic In Denial Or A Snake Oil Salesman Peddling Religious Garbagehttps://youtu.be/EbClJBQnbl0?si=95ouyGqn_RdzZO_m Now let me get this. Mr. Crawford utilized psychic powers to tell the psychic personal things about her that no stranger would know, and then he turned around and told her to give up her profession as a psychic. Talk about hypocrisy on his part. The psychic's name is Bianca. Mr. Crawford insists that he gets his psychic abilities from the Holy Divinity. Well, I question the existence of God. However, if God really does exist, how does Mr. Crawford not know that Bianca is getting her psychic gift from the Holy Ghost, so to speak? This man clearly doesn't practice what he preaches. What I do find interesting about Mr. Crawford is that he admits that he was once a misotheist. Like a typical Bible-thumping buffoon, Mr. Crawford currently has an entire line of merchandise upon which he capitalizes. Bianca's face has been blurred out. She announced that she does believe in God. Mr. Crawford insists that he gets his psychic abilities from a divine being from up above, but he also claims, at the same time, that Bianca's gifted abilities could only come from demons. Hmmm. It sounds like a double standard to me. Could it be that there are no such thing as demons? That they're figments of the imagination in the minds of deluded religious extremists? Mr. Crawford and Bianca then agree that the Bible denounces psychics as demonic. Mr. Crawford even goes as far as citing verses in the Bible that supposedly connect psychic abilities with demons. However, it appears that not everyone interprets the Bible in that same manner, and I will provide you examples in that same regard further on herein. Mr. Crawford prays for Bianca's hip to be healed. For real? At this point in the video, I begin to suspect that Bianca is a hired actress and that Mr. Crawford staged this entire interview. In other words, it's all fake, and Mr. Crawford has given us no valuable information or insight regarding psychics and how they acquire their gifted abilities. On the other hand, in an interview on CBS Chicago, Jenniffer Weigel claims that her research into psychics has strengthened her faith in God. She also mentions that a Catholic priest wrote to her and told her that there are verses in the Bible that talk about people going to psychics in a positive manner. Ms. Weigel appears to dismiss religious extremists' condemnation of psychics as something as archaic as the stoning of innocent people. She suggests that everyone in the evangelical industry and the likes needs to get caught up with the times instead of spreading fairy tales about psychics getting their powers from demons. Below is a video of that same interview. Jenniffer Weigel Contradicts The Bible's Supposed Condemnation Of Psychicshttps://youtu.be/o8RrV7n3fnM?si=qPCwmJ_5ZCgNfOhP In the comments section to this same video, a YouTuber who goes by the user name of @Postulatedstated posted: > Dude the bible does not condone it, saul going to a medium isn't the bible granting permission. Can you believe this crap? did she really just try to do that? YouTuber @Postulatedstated? If you're reading my article, here is my response to you. A Catholic priest wrote to Ms. Weigel in a way that suggested that he believed that the Bible condoned Saul going to a medium. Therefore, as I stated, everything in the Bible appears to be open to individual interpretation. Further on herein, you'll see that others agree with me on this same point. ## 2.  The Unrealistic And Even Cruel Nature Of The Bible As I stated in my previous article titled \

the Bible condones all sorts of atrocities and injustices.  Religious extremists always come back with the excuse that such verses that do so are metaphorical, yet they want us to take the verses about psychics as being literal.  Well, they do not get to have their cake and eat it too.  In their video below, Penn Jillette and Raymond Joseph Derickson Teller (\

) expose the Bible for the load of nonsense and deplorability that it is. Penn And Teller Rake The Bible Over The Coals For Its Deceptive And Dishonest Naturehttps://youtu.be/Re0XkWdq6WU?si=o1c-qjAnmriON6pX Penn Jillette took the words right out of my mouth. That is, the Bible advocates prejudice, cruelty, and murder. Verses in the Bible condone homicide, violence, and predatory sexual deviance. Therefore, why should we rely on the Bible to educate us about psychics and how they get their gifted abilities? We shouldn't. Christian fundamentalists and religious extremists hate scientists, because scientists can and have debunked the contents of the Bible. We need to be listening to scientists about how psychics get their gifted abilities. We don't need to be placing our blind faith in what religious kooks like Kenneth Copeland and Bryce Crawford have to say about it. Now, I completely get it that some of you out there snipe at psychics as being scam artists and master manipulators. I'm not claiming that there are very bad people out there who proclaim themselves to be psychics only to take advantage of the vulnerable and the grieving. However, none of these so-called people of God like Bryce Crawford and Kenneth Copeland are taking their war against psychics in that direction. They're insisting that psychics get their powers from demons. I don't believe that real psychics don't exist at all. However, if someone could prove that they are all scam artists and fraudsters, would that revelation tend to disprove the existence of Satan and demons? Perhaps that could be the reason why evangelical preachers like Kenneth Copeland and Bryce Crawford wish not to take their war against psychics in that direction, because then they would appear as fraudsters and scam artists themselves. I believe that psychics do exist, but that's just me. If I were to meet a parent whose small child was a psychic, I'd be telling that parent to keep their child far away from religious kooks like Kenneth Copeland and Bryce Crawford. After you watch the movie *Silent Hill*, you'll know exactly why I would give that advice to a parent. ## 3.  Answers From Science Regarding Psychics And Their Gifted Abilities You may or may not have heard of a scientist named Dr. Julie Beischel. She has been conducting studies about psychics for some time now. If you want to know whatever you can find out about psychics, you need to turn to people like her rather than to religious kooks like Bryce Crawford and Kenneth Copeland. She'll give you cold, hard facts from her findings rather than the fear-mongering falsehoods that both Mr. Copeland and Mr. Crawford give you. What is so interesting about Dr. Beischel is that she realizes that there are scam artists, hucksters, and all sorts of fraudsters posing as psychics, and she has put safeguards in place to keep herself and others from wasting their time and money on those kinds of people accordingly. Below is a video with an interview of her. Dr. Julie Beischel Explains How She Conducts Scientific Research On Psychicshttps://youtu.be/4MY-aqf0iBU?si=XnO8hx5zFD75X4U1 I was glad that the interviewer posed the million-dollar question to Dr. Beischel and asked her about how she deals with religious zealots who condemn psychics as being evil pawns of the devil. I find it interesting that she implied that perhaps the people who translated the derogatory Biblical verses about psychics may have mistranslated them, because I mentioned that strong possibility in my article titled \

The fact that Dr. Beischel has an ally in the religious sector assisting her in her scientific research about psychics and who shares this same belief with her about the possibility of the Bible being mistranslated in reference to psychics definitely goes in her favor.  The evangelical ministers who yell the loudest are not necessary the most accurate ones.

![Sunriseforever is the author of this picture/Source:  Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2020/07/26/12/13/gothic-5439368_1280.jpg)

## 4.   Final Thoughts

Ladies and gentlemen?  Throughout most of my adult life, I've been inundated with sermons about how psychics are demonic and allow the devil to operate through them.  Some of what have seemed like the most unlikely people to badmouth psychics have tried to peddle this same nonsense to me.

I remember when I was on a business trip in Fresno, California, this one co-worker of mine tried to convince me that psychics got their gifted abilities from Satan and demons.  In hindsight, I don't even know why I wasted my time in listening to these people.

When you want to get real answers about such phenomena, science is always the best way to do so.  Scientists like Dr. Julie Beischel are going to base their findings and discoveries about psychics on facts rather than on the ravings of some religious fanatic or religious zealot.  Psychics already get a bad rap from society.  Therefore, I think we owe them at least the respect of proving whether or not they are genuine instead of branding them with a pitchfork symbol.

If demons actually existed and they were operating through psychics, I think that Dr. Beischel would have discovered something to that effect by now.  Instead, she has found harmless evidence that many of these individuals simply have a gifted talent that not everyone gets to experience.

Let's keep the Bible out of this entire fishing expedition involving psychics.  The Bible has enough misleading and mendacious information in it.  These psychics deserve better than for us to let the Bible dictate who they are and what they're all about.

Music is one of my favorite things to relax to, as many people can also probably have similar experiences. My musical tastes are incredibly diverse, I think. I can enjoy some really heavy gangster rap (not the radio trash), some metal, country, classical and so many others in between.

One of the coolest things about music is that all of the different kinds have their unique qualities to them and reasons that we listen to them. Some are more chill, others are upbeat and getting you motivated. 

There is a post series Three Tune Tuesday by a bunch of people but it's all organized by @ablaze, one of the coolest dudes from Ireland around!

# This Week's Choice: Somber Songs

I think that I will try to confine the post to be 2 or 3 songs of the particular topic to keep it shorter and so that people can listen to one or all of the songs without taking too much time!

title.title: The Last Faith: Destiny or coincidence?
title.body: >Hello to my dear Hive Gamers community. I hope you're all doing well and enjoying some great games. On this occasion, I want to introduce you to a Pixar Art-style video game, a really good and relatively unknown title. I'm talking about \

I hope you enjoy it.\n\n>Hola a toda mi querida comunidad de Hive Gamers. Espero que se encuentren muy bien, disfrutando de excelentes juegos. En esta grata ocasión, quiero presentarles un videojuego al estilo Pixar Art, muy bueno y poco conocido. Estoy hablando de \

. Espero que les agrade.
![307630.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uri07/23tGXZoULRxSU1qqZPpeGUPx8eBgtSNeb7nCB65aZMiz1Goo3oA5wYcj8TzWvkxtAJVkk.jpg)
[Fuente ](https://pin.it/47F0U51kn)
The story follows Eryk, who awakens in a decayed and impoverished world called Mythringal. Suffering from amnesia, Eryk remembers absolutely nothing of his life; however, he has an urgent mission: to escape this world, as his mind is rapidly deteriorating. He is now in a race against time, as he must find a cure for his rare amnesia or he will transform into something inhuman. >La historia sigue a Eryk, quien despierta en un mundo totalmente deteriorado y sumido en la miseria llamado Mythringal. Eryk sufre de amnesia y no recuerda absolutamente nada de su vida; sin embargo, tiene una misión urgente: salir de ese mundo, ya que su mente se está deteriorando rápidamente. Así que tiene una carrera contra el tiempo, pues debe encontrar la cura para su rara amnesia o se convertirá en algo que no es humano.
![307631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uri07/23t7938T77kVC9BKiknBsff1Z4gn2kKmYkVYZtbpzUeTeU1fq9AjE2YtakxZ2brkQEzev.jpg)
[Fuente ](https://pin.it/J65ys6oZb)
Throughout the game, we discover that the world is united in its misery by a plague of an incurable and strange disease that transforms humans into grotesque, bloodthirsty creatures. Furthermore, ancient religions, rife with sacrifices, are presumed to have unleashed the plague. Finally, and perhaps most importantly, the alchemy and black magic practiced by some societies in their attempt to achieve divinity and become gods failed spectacularly, unleashing utter chaos upon the entire world. >En el transcurso del videojuego, descubrimos que el mundo está unido en su miseria debido a una plaga de una enfermedad incurable y extraña que transforma a los humanos en seres grotescos y sedientos de sangre. Además, antiguas religiones, ávidas de sacrificios, se presume que liberaron la plaga. Por último, y no menos importante, la alquimia y la magia negra practicadas por algunas sociedades en su intento de alcanzar la divinidad y convertirse en dioses, fracasaron estrepitosamente, desatando el caos absoluto sobre todo este mundo.
![307639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uri07/23uEsREZj4AWRaZ4h35dRtDxJ1po9iPykKGnHVfcpAAcryJBYHVzsdB11ixnLKzseVnNY.jpg)
[Fuente ](https://pin.it/1xiMNMFRO)
As Eryk continues his missions, glimpses of his past are revealed, showing him that he is not merely an observer, but a key figure in the fate of this world. In addition to battling monstrous entities that remain, he must confront religions that survived the plague and plot to seize control of the world through dark magic, aiming to become gods. Thus, our protagonist must face them and uncover the truth. Little by little, it is revealed that he is the bearer of an ancient pact that must be fulfilled for the world to escape this misery and madness. >Mientras Eryk sigue las misiones, se le va revelando un poco de su pasado, descubriendo que no es un simple espectador, sino una pieza clave en el destino de este mundo. Además de luchar contra entidades monstruosas que han quedado, debe enfrentarse a algunas religiones que sobrevivieron a la plaga y que planean apoderarse del mundo mediante la magia negra, con el objetivo de convertirse en dioses. Así, nuestro protagonista debe enfrentarse a ellos y revelar la verdad. Poco a poco, se nos revela que él es el portador de un pacto muy antiguo que debe cumplirse para que el mundo deje de estar sumido en esta miseria y locura.
![307640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uri07/23t79CFn84gm8AVUnrNqYneWjYkPpKnkcxLroEtMJqfPECaGg4cCD7HqckAFEoQURsxj8.jpg)
[Fuente ](https://pin.it/4ntDdeRhj)
At first glance, it might seem like just another pixel art game with some elements of Castlevania, The Penitent One, and a touch of Resident Evil. However, it's a game with its own unique cinematic style that gradually reveals its details as you progress. The plot might seem a bit simple and repetitive, but the nuances are what change, and the main character is battling his own mind. Most of the lore isn't presented in the game's cutscenes, but rather in brief dialogues with NPCs at the beginning and end of missions, so you have to pay close attention to what they say to understand the plot and what you're about to do. I highly recommend playing it for its distinctly gothic aesthetic and because it tackles certain mature themes, much like The Penitent One, except here mental health is also a central theme, seemingly deteriorating little by little as you delve deeper into the game, and the protagonist is running out of time. Out of 10, I give it a 9.5, since the story's progression is somewhat slow and a little confusing, but that doesn't detract from its merits. Thank you so much for reading this far. I hope you enjoyed my post. See you next time with more pixel art games. Until next time! >A simple vista, puede parecer un juego más de pixel art con algunas características de Castlevania, El Penitente y un poco de Resident Evil. Sin embargo, es un juego con su propia cinematografía que, a medida que se avanza, revela sus detalles. La trama puede parecer un poco simple y repetitiva, pero lo que cambia son los detalles, y el protagonista principal está luchando contra su propia mente. La mayoría del lore no se presenta en las cinemáticas del juego, sino en pequeños diálogos de los NPC al terminar y comenzar misiones, por lo que hay que estar muy atento a lo que dicen para poder entender la trama y lo que vas a hacer. Recomiendo jugarlo mucho por su estética altamente gótica y porque aborda ciertos temas maduros, al igual que El Penitente, solo que aquí también está presente la salud mental, que parece deteriorarse poco a poco a medida que te adentras más en el videojuego, y el protagonista está quedándose sin tiempo. Del 1 al 10, le doy un 9.5, ya que el seguimiento de la historia es algo lento y un poco confuso, pero eso no le quita sus méritos. Muchísimas gracias por llegar hasta aquí. Espero que les haya gustado mi publicación. Nos vemos en otra oportunidad con juegos de pixel art. ¡Hasta la próxima!
![37949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/uri07/244KZwwJ22RuUwHbaYQTtQmqa2he8tbpQL5fLuVfz7sNNcmVx1SG9oCx1HeFHdhnwzC27.jpg)

title.title: Hong Kong - Exploring
title.body: While I was staying in Hong Kong, I explored mostly at the Yau Ma Tei and Tsim Tsa Tsui area, and on this day, I wanted to explore the Causeway Bay area. These two days are left for exploring in Hong Kong. I went to Ocean Park, Macau as well as Disneyland. So, my wife and I just randomly went around to explore the rest of Hong Kong.

/> This city is chaotic, lively, and fun. There seem to be lots of different places to explore. Every corner is filled with a place where you can explore. There are lots of parks in the city too. That's unbelievable.
/> Lots of tall buildings all over the city and every corner is a person doing something.
/> The steps are somewhere in Yau Ma Tei. Nicely painted steps.
/> Some graffiti on the wall. Not a lot of places are with graffiti.

/> I wanted to travel to Causeway Bay. The other side of Hong Kong. After a couple of days of being in Hong Kong, one of the best transports that I felt that is slightly underated is the bus service here. What is great about the bus service is that it arrives every couple of minutes and tours possibly most of the parts of Hong Kong that you would want to visit.
/> I read in an article while I was in Hong Kong that the number of Malaysian tourist here in Hong Kong every year is only about 400, 000.

/> The best thing about the bus is that you have some of the best views of the city. The night view from a bus here is even more amazing. The MTR is quite fun but you have to constantly change stations.

/> Sitting on the bus is one of the ways to get around here in the city. The only thing is that you need to make sure to prepare to get down before the stop, or else you have to run to the exit. By the time that happens, the bus may have already gone to another stop.
/> The next part of the city to explore. Causeway Bay, Hong Kong. Have a great day. @luueetang YouTube : www.youtube.com/luueejanice Tiktok: www.tiktok.com/@luueejanice

title.body: >\n\nFor this week's ZAPFIC Monday challenge, the prompt \

presented the opportunity to explore people's value systems. What one group may be able to tolerate, another would abhor and find it difficult to reconcile their beliefs. If the believe, either way, is strong enough, then the groups adopt it and attempt to live by its doctrine.

The thing to remember is that with freedom to choose, no one way is right or wrong. Society has certain tolerance levels for actions, though. I share a flash fiction story alone those lines.

The ZAPFICMonday challenge was created by @felt.buzz and consists of a story told in 240 characters or less. Quite a feat to accomplish. If you're interested, visit the current challenge post: [Monday 9th March 2026... it's #ZapFicMonday: ZapFic240! The \

ZapFic: Write a story using 240 characters OR less!](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@zapfic.club/monday-9th-march-2026-its-zapficmonday-zapfic240-the-original-zapfic-write-a-story-using-240-characters-or-less) **My story is below:**

It wasn't only the residents that objected to a naturalist park, their doctrine specifically enacted laws against it. \

>

Para el desafío ZAPFIC Monday de esta semana, el tema «credo» brindó la oportunidad de explorar los sistemas de valores de las personas. Lo que un grupo puede tolerar, otro lo aborrecería y le resultaría difícil conciliar con sus creencias. Si la creencia, en cualquier caso, es lo suficientemente fuerte, entonces los grupos la adoptan e intentan vivir según su doctrina. 

Lo que hay que recordar es que, con la libertad de elegir, ninguna forma es correcta o incorrecta. Sin embargo, la sociedad tiene ciertos niveles de tolerancia para las acciones. Comparto una historia de ficción breve sobre este tema.

El reto ZAPFICMonday fue creado por @felt.buzz y consiste en una historia contada en 240 caracteres o menos. Si te interesa, visita el post del reto actual: [Monday 9th March 2026... it's #ZapFicMonday: ZapFic240! The \

Zaplanowałem na wczoraj warsztaty ceramiczne. Nikt się nie zapisał. A raczej: jedna osoba się zapisała a potem anulowała. No cóż, czasem bywa i tak. Ale miało to też dobre strony, bo dzień był na tyle spokojny, że oprócz samotnego lepienia z gliny mogłem bez przeszkód kontynuować transformację głównej sali.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXBgLaAcFuVcjVbZjimZmwWyXRTrfkmXiiezFcVjEA1kG/dfuns_2026_03_11_004129190216817e2a.jpg)

Przede wszystkim zmieniłem nieco układ skrzynek przy niebieskiej ścianie. Już od dawna planowałem przesunięcie ich maksymalnie do ściany, żeby bardziej optymalnie wykorzystać przestrzeń. Możliwe, że jeszcze trochę zmodyfikuję układ przy okazji kładzenia profili na najniższym poziomie (niestety o tym zapomniałem), ale zmiany niewątpliwie idą w dobrym (optymalizacyjnym) kierunku.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ8WbNboBVatjJrkj5DXmG8HryQau2R6Wk7VzVHWNkaYq/dfuns_2026_03_11_004128ad3ccc5d7f6d.jpg)

Przy okazji robienia porządku znalazłem tabliczkę, która idealnie pasuje na drzwi w kontekście pomysłu @wstawarz'a.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRZNKHyf1oxBMoPPXfJALoHfoC2YXo5qMTJApCQUQEkcn/dfuns_2026_03_11_0041281c0fde6aefe9.jpg)

Postanowiłem nie odkładać tego na później i napisałem na niej OTWARTE / WE ARE OPEN oraz stare hasło z \

, które nie zmieściło się na nowym szyldzie. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVCkhCs881TMhXJou6nJaecBFhouATxf3CgMUV3MFAPfD/dfuns_2026_03_11_0041284e6ee1c6ea94.jpg)

Zauważyłem też, że ściana obok wielu włączników światła jest zabrudzona. Myślę, że można to \

przyklejając wokół kafelki do naszej gry. Pasują idealnie. Oczywiście nie białe tylko pomalowane lub zrobione z czarnej gliny.

. Está canción data de los primeros cinco años de la década de los noventa. En esta canción hago una comparación entre el amor y el elemento agua. El elemento agua lo plasmé concatenado con el amor, el amor que corre con el tiempo, que evidencia la cristalización de una relación. Yo estaba vivenciando en ese tiempo una relación que se cristalizó y de allí lo plasmé a la letra y a la melodía. body.title: If Wishes Are Horses, Laziness Will Abound
body.body:
SHOOTING STAR AND A WISH Tell us, do you believe the wish asking with a shooting star will come true or not? Have you ever heard about it or not? If you believe in this, then what is your wish at that time? Have you ever seen a shooting star and then wished for something in life??
Hello #scifimultiverse friends, I trust your week is going well. Welcome to my blog. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS6bsiGG89uivuctrDcx5xUteyJ4BJvrmkmeYwhZzvum6/image.png) [Bibhash](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1623743423143-23df3234ae5c?q=80&w=1176&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D) When I was younger, we usually went to my mum's village for the yuletide holidays. There, in the night, whenever the Moon comes out, we will gather in front of the compound and engage in many games, First, it is reading with the moonlight. The adults around will organise the competition in batches, and anyone who emerges as the overall winner will get a reward. Also, for the friendly sparring match or playing boxing, the overall winners go home with rewards. Furthermore, during that time, on a few occasions, we have witnessed this shooting star flying up the cloud at the speed of light and disappearing in a twinkling of the eye. The first time, the adult shouted luck, luck, luck seven times. At that point, I was confused, but I quietly approached my cousin and asked him what that chant meant. He told me that any day and anytime I sighted that shooting star, I should shout luck seven times, making a wish before the star disappears. I nodded my head in acceptance and happily left. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW388FVknH9vXQr63y24EyPB3GZe6hpCt4YJhSdF7GTwW/image.png) [JKalina]( https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1672670958652-4b6e0c59769c?q=80&w=1935&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D) Ever since that time, I have keenly watched out for the shooting star until a few months ago, when I saw it again when I visited my sister's house. Immediately, I started chanting my wish while my sister watched in disbelief. When the star disappeared, she asked what I had just done, and I happily shared my story with her. Shockingly, she told me that what I just did is for a lazy man. We argued about it, but I realised that I didn’t have any proof to back my claims, so I gave up. That was how I dropped that superstitious belief, accepting the fact that I was wallowing in ignorance and being naïve about it. Giving it a second thought, I concluded that if horses were wishes, the world would have been a bed of roses. However, I am not sure about my cousins and other friends who also believed and made the luck chant. I wouldn’t know if it has ever worked for them, but for me, my wish then in the shooting star wish chant was to travel abroad. That wish and dream is yet to come to pass. Feel free to join the contest [here](https://ecency.com/hive-111030/@scifimultiverse/scifi-multiverse-prompt-week-58-edition-1-or-shooting-star-and-a-wish-or) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcs236dZh6y4acuM8qxhc9tV96QidzvDQEJxAmhAjeqwX/1773188605212.jpg)

body.title: Galatasaray sorprende y consigue la victoria en el estadio Anfield [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
> Tarde de mucha emoción en la UEFA Champions League, donde en este punto cada partido empieza a marcar el destino de los equipos que aún quedan con vida y están buscando seguir avanzando en el torneo más exigente del fútbol. En esta oportunidad en la jornada de la ronda de 16, todas las miradas estaban puestas en Liverpool, equipo que recibía en casa a Galatasaray, la cual iba a ser un duelo cargado de intensidad. El estadio de Anfield se preparó para una tarde grande, donde ambos equipos tenían su plan, pero uno terminó dando un golpe importante en la eliminatoria y dejó a todos sorprendidos. >It was a thrilling afternoon in the UEFA Champions League, where at this stage each match begins to shape the fate of the remaining teams vying to advance in football's most demanding tournament. On this occasion, in the Round of 16, all eyes were on Liverpool, who hosted Galatasaray in what was expected to be a high-intensity encounter. Anfield Stadium was ready for a big afternoon, with both teams having their game plans, but one ended up delivering a significant blow in the tie, leaving everyone stunned. ![2CF3F3C6-06B8-44D6-88E5-B7BD46E87A00.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davidpena21/23wMUDLTDQNboUYJ1z2Ep2bJ8F84ykVu2q5nvUZ1PoXyoqp5azY3eT7XNKDMv3v4Cw4y8.jpeg) [Fuente // Source](https://x.com/GalatasaraySK/status/2031458016122307018/photo/1) Al estar jugando en casa desde el primer instante el Liverpool salió con seguridad, dominando el ritmo del balón, manteniendo su estilo ofensivo y apoyado por todos los fanáticos que estaban allí. Mientras que el Galatasaray, apostó por un planteamiento más sólido, con líneas ordenadas y buscando sorprender mediante jugada rápida. Todo cambio para el minuto 7 del encuentro donde el equipo visitante supo aprovechar y conseguir ese primer gol del encuentro para así marcar la diferencia y comenzar a escribir su historia en dicho estadio. El Liverpool, con esa pequeña ventaja les tocó circula mucho más el balón y una presión alta, mientras que el conjunto turco se mantenía firme en defensa. Cada recuperación del Galatasaray se convertía en una segunda oportunidad, aun así una defensa del Liverpool muy bien parada para mantenerse atenta. Durante esos primeros 45 minutos de juego el equipo local también generó algunas ocasiones de peligro, pero la defensa visitante resistía con disciplina y es allí donde ambos equipos estaba haciendo un gran trabajo. El ambiente en Anfield seguía muy tenso y seguían atento con cada llegada del Liverpool, además ambos equipos conscientes de que un solo error podía cambiar el destino del encuentro. >Playing at home from the opening whistle, Liverpool came out confidently, controlling the tempo of the ball, maintaining their attacking style, and spurred on by the fans in attendance. Galatasaray, on the other hand, opted for a more solid approach, with organized lines and looking to surprise with quick counter-attacks. # >Everything changed in the 7th minute when the away team capitalized, scoring the first goal of the match and establishing a lead, thus beginning to write their history at the stadium. With this small advantage, Liverpool circulated the ball much more and applied high pressure, while the Turkish side remained resolute in defense. Every Galatasaray recovery became a second chance, but Liverpool's well-organized defense remained alert. # >During the first 45 minutes, the home team also created some dangerous opportunities, but the visiting defense held firm with discipline, demonstrating the quality of both teams' performances. The atmosphere at Anfield remained very tense, and they were still attentive to every Liverpool attack; both teams were also aware that a single mistake could change the course of the match. ![6CB390CB-BDBA-4B56-85D7-5815169655A3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davidpena21/EoK4uopNyac6iTdoD96PrWTXY3nR1XSp7zoKKMBd5fywxzpVQG7zH23aG5BpH54R133.jpeg) [Fuente // Source](https://x.com/brfootball/status/2031429592880124092/photo/1) Para el segundo tiempo, la historia fue muy distinta, comenzando desde el ritmo de juego que aumentó, más técnico, más movimiento y esas jugadas que parecían terminar en gol. El Liverpool le tocó adelantar sus líneas e imponer mayor intensidad para así al menos igualar el marcador. Sin embargo, el Galatasaray sabía que estaba jugado con un rival fuerte y supo leerlo con inteligencia, para así ellos tomar el ritmo de juego para lo que restaba de tiempo. Los minutos avanzaban con rapidez y el marcador seguía igual 0-1, el Liverpool realizo varios cambios, varios intentos, centros al área y disparos desde media distancia, pero el Galatasaray se mantuvo firme, defendiendo con concentración y sacrificio cada balón, además demostrando porque están en esta etapa. Los minutos finales fueron de mucha tensión, donde el equipo del Liverpool dejo cada de sudor, insistía una y otra vez buscaba, mientras que el conjunto turco defendía su ventaja con orden y determinación. Cada despeje, cada recuperación y cada segundo que pasaba acercaba más al Galatasaray a una victoria histórica. >The second half was a completely different story, starting with the increased pace of play, which became more technical, more fluid, and featured plays that looked destined for goals. Liverpool pushed forward and increased their intensity to at least equalize. However, Galatasaray knew they were playing against a strong opponent and intelligently read the game, allowing them to control the tempo for the remainder of the match. # >The minutes ticked by quickly, and the score remained 0-1. Liverpool made several substitutions, launched numerous attacks, sent crosses into the box, and fired shots from distance, but Galatasaray stood firm, defending with concentration and sacrifice for every ball, demonstrating why they were at this stage of the competition. The final minutes were incredibly tense, with Liverpool giving their all, relentlessly pressing for a goal, while the Turkish side defended their lead with discipline and determination. Every clearance, every recovery, and every second that passed brought Galatasaray closer to a historic victory. ![6AC10614-A954-4686-B5D0-08320F1A3E55.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davidpena21/23wC7mb2u4LMhoJ9zvjDVTAJbSKZmREMDyuy32JoiHUwaoPbiGCjguf2xiWPoEnKEd754.jpeg) [Fuente // Source](https://x.com/GalatasaraySK/status/2031464546452292060/photo/3) El pitazo final confirmó algo único con un marcador Liverpool 0-1 Galatasaray, donde esta victoria le da un paso más adelante al equipo visitante y que demuestra que en la Champions League ningún rival puede darse por vencido antes de tiempo. Este fue un partido que dejó claro que el Galatasaray supo competir con inteligencia y aprovechar su oportunidad en el momento exacto. El Liverpool, por su parte, tendrá que replantear su estrategia para el próximo compromiso, si aún quiere seguir con vida. >The final whistle confirmed something unique with a score of Liverpool 0-1 Galatasaray. This victory gives the visiting team another step forward and demonstrates that in the Champions League, no team can afford to give up prematurely. body.title: Empty-handed?
body.body: <center>[The New Yorker](https://www.newyorker.com/magazine/2025/12/08/the-secret-agent-movie-review)</center>\nNext Sunday, the **98th Academy Awards** (Oscars) ceremony will take place at the famous **Dolby Theatre** in Los Angeles, California. Once again, a team of competent **Brazilian** professionals will be in the running for the coveted golden statuettes. ***The Secret Agent*** is the movie that will try to put the name of Brazilian cinema on top of the world again, but unlike what happened last year with ***I'm Still Here***... The prediction is cautious.\nAlthough there are interesting projections of victories (but all of them always based on the \

published by specialized magazines, which elect their favorite cinematic works in each awards season), the movie directed by **Kleber Mendonça Filho** and starring **Wagner Moura** has been losing momentum over time and may leave empty-handed after its tiresome marketing campaign, in addition to recent defeats at awards ceremonies.\nIn the eyes of millions of Brazilians, this may sound like a \
defeat (due to the movie's favoritism within a \

perspective), but personally speaking, I think this project doesn't represent the best of Brazilian cinema, and if that really happens, not winning any golden statuettes is just a reflection of a work that is indeed good, but not to the point of being at the top of the world as millions of Brazilians insist on \

.\nAs a Brazilian, I will always root for the success of my country's cinema. Gradually, we are experiencing a golden age within a segment that continues to be important for the historical memory of society, but it is not by overvaluing a mediocre work (when compared to some of its competitors) that we will \

all the cinematic quality of what we can do. The world already knows this, but it seems that many Brazilians do not.
---
<center>**¿Con las manos vacías?**</center>
El próximo domingo se celebrará la **98.ª Edición** de los premios **Óscar** en el famoso **Teatro Dolby** de Los Ángeles, California. Una vez más, un equipo de competentes profesionales **brasileños** competirá por las codiciadas estatuillas doradas. ***El Agente Secreto*** es la película que intentará volver a poner el nombre del cine brasileño en la cima del mundo, pero a diferencia de lo que ocurrió el año pasado con ***Aún estoy Aquí***..., el pronóstico es cauteloso.
Aunque existen interesantes proyecciones de victorias (aunque todas ellas siempre basadas en los \

publicados por revistas especializadas, que eligen sus obras cinematográficas favoritas en cada temporada de premios), la película dirigida por **Kleber Mendonça Filho** y protagonizada por **Wagner Moura** ha ido perdiendo impulso con el tiempo y podría marcharse con las manos vacías tras su agotadora campaña de marketing, además de sus recientes derrotas en las ceremonias de premios. A los ojos de millones de brasileños, esto puede parecer una derrota “colossal” (debido al favoritismo de la película desde una perspectiva “patriótica”), pero personalmente, creo que este proyecto no representa lo mejor del cine brasileño, y si eso realmente sucede, no ganar ninguna estatuilla dorada es solo el reflejo de una obra que, si bien es buena, no alcanza el nivel mundial, como millones de brasileños insisten en “proclamar”. Como brasileño, siempre apoyaré el éxito del cine de mi país. Gradualmente, estamos viviendo una época dorada en un segmento que sigue siendo importante para la memoria histórica de la sociedad, pero no es sobrevalorando una obra mediocre (en comparación con algunas de sus competidoras) que “impondremos” toda la calidad cinematográfica de lo que podemos hacer. El mundo ya lo sabe, pero parece que muchos brasileños no. ---
**De mãos vazias?**
No próximo domingo, a **98.ª cerimônia** de entrega dos **Academy Awards** (Oscar) vai acontecer no famoso **Teatro Dolby**, em Los Angeles, Califórnia. Uma vez mais, haverá um time de profissionais **brasileiros** competente na corrida pelas tão cobiçadas estatuetas douradas. ***O Agente Secreto*** é o filme que vai tentar colocar o nome do cinema brasileiro no topo do mundo novamente, mas ao contrário do que aconteceu ano passado com ***Ainda Estou Aqui***... A previsão é cautelosa. Embora haja interessantes projeções de vitórias (mas todas elas sempre baseadas nos “termômetros” publicados pelas revistas especializadas, que elegem os seus trabalhos cinematográficos favoritos em cada temporada de premiações), o filme dirigido por **Kleber Mendonça Filho** e protagonizado por **Wagner Moura** veio perdendo força do longo do tempo e pode sair de mãos vazias depois de sua campanha de marketing cansativa, além de derrotas recentes em premiações. Aos olhos de milhões de brasileiros, isso pode soar como uma derrota “colossal” (devido ao favoritismo do filme dentro de uma ótica “patriota”), mas particularmente falando, acho esse projeto não representa o melhor do Brasil dentro do cinema, e caso isso realmente aconteça, não ganhar nenhuma estatueta dourada é apenas um reflexo de um trabalho que de fato é bom, mas não a ponto de estar no topo do mundo como milhões de brasileiros insistem em “proclamar”. Enquanto brasileiro, eu sempre vou torcer pelo sucesso do cinema do meu país. Gradualmente, estamos vivendo uma fase de ouro dentro de um segmento que segue sendo importante para a memória histórica da sociedade, mas não é supervalorizando um trabalho mediano (quando comparado a alguns dos seus concorrentes) que vamos “impor” toda a qualidade cinematográfica do que nós podemos fazer. O mundo já sabe disso, mas parece que muitos brasileiros não. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/emptyhanded-a1p)

body.body:
![IMG_20260311_075845.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iyanpol12/AJhYKZW37oaJ9B6SvruvvVCwZbLpwbdYouUo7pFFLpJ1RA9EKBNtQZvbmRPDApF.jpg)

### Fed Up
Some people won't talk if they can still handle the pain. They don't want to hurt anyone just in case they speak up. All they wanted is to heal without anyone knowing. It doesn't mean it will stay that way because time will come they'll get fed up, and give up when things are too much. 

That's why we shouldn't take people for granted. Everyone has limits just like us, and so do others. So don't make things difficult for them. Let them heal well than add up insult to injury. 

### Wednesday 
We're still having cold mornings. I'm glad we still have this before summer fully comes. Anyway, around 4am, I heard loud a loud motorcycle slowly driving, and the man cursing and shouted. How could such people disturb sleeping people! Such a nuisance. 

### Tall Trees Around
What I loved about Crosswinds is the tall trees. It's like Camp John Hay, but both has distinct qualities.

body.title: A SHORT TRIP TO THE PAST / UN PEQUEÑO VIAJE AL PASADO  [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
# ENGLISH VERSION:

Hello everyone in this lovely geek community!! ✨ Today I'm going to tell you about a wonderful experience I had during a short visit, as I'm sure many of you will recognize some of these objects and details, and perhaps even reminisce about those good times.

A few days ago, my boyfriend and I were on a mission to find a gift for his father's birthday... And while looking for ideas, we found a very unique place in Lima on TikTok, a kind of museum-shop filled with vintage items from different eras.

![a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/twirilyn/23vsJF9MJCTaDjewcZDcSzfKjAKmNN94nFhpRRbNS2cYHnT7cAN3cuk6JEPJXiR3RaCKj.jpg)

From the moment we entered, we felt like we had taken a little trip back in time; we found everything our parents had told us about their \

.

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/twirilyn/23wgF9LgxvmYceawN75DfEwsZDhBEhTJ5PTuHhAMZqwBqDm1P6YWZ2pjx683Lzcr7N1xy.jpg)

The place was filled with toys, clothes, figurines, and collectibles that defined many years, especially from the 80s and 90s. The person who helped us was very kind and patient, assisting us in finding items we might be looking for as gifts. As they showed us various options that could fit what we had in mind, we ended up exploring the entire place and enjoying every single item we saw. Additionally, it's worth noting that the person guiding us explained that every product is original and that some items are limited editions or hard-to-find versions.

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/twirilyn/23wqe8VrURwoxXoTCggNoHVkhPUZvj6tVsCNQQNw9TUcaRT7bqTZMT7rU6HyNNpsk9NkH.jpg)

Every corner was filled with objects that many of our parents, uncles, or relatives surely remember fondly. Personally (even though I was born in 2000 and most of the things aren't from my time), it was wonderful to discover and learn a little more about this world of entertainment that marked the childhood and youth of our loved ones.

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/twirilyn/23zRzscWYrGT3eWq95WZVns6VCqitHfc75VXZofwPHHuxj4QUVDSrF9djSymFLVq4Wkr5.jpg)

Among the things that caught my attention the most were references to classics like Candy Candy, Topo Gigio, antique dolls, board games, retro games and many other details that evoked nostalgia.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/twirilyn/23xKpQWAv1E1bc6tPBsvDeRnafXFgJjtD6RX63SmvZuuCQQuFb4siWumJX4Cj8aGS3qMV.jpg)

Finally, thank you for reading this far. If any of you are in Lima and this post caught your attention, I definitely encourage you to visit this little place. It's perfect for those who want to relive a piece of the past. The place is called La Vieja and is located in the San Isidro district.

Location: La Vieja - San Isidro

Location📍: Lima, Peru

Photos📸: Photos taken by me

Translation: English translation from Google Translate

![Twirilyn.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/twirilyn/23tbq7c4KcH3FSp4V7vfoYrguQogjRTntD5VbzKBfgph5BTMv5XPXoaoFUnEki8gBWUxg.jpg)





# VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL:

Hola a todos en esta linda comunidad Geek!!✨ El día de hoy les contaré una maravillosa experiencia que tuve en una pequeña visita, ya que estoy segura de que más de uno reconocerá alguno de estos objetos, detalles y quizás recuerde esos buenos tiempos.

Hace unos días mi novio y yo estábamos en la misión de encontrar un regalo para el cumpleaños de su padre... Y buscando algunas ideas, encontramos en Tiktok un lugar muy particular en Lima, una especie de museo-tienda lleno de objetos vintage de distintas épocas.

![a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/twirilyn/23vsJF9MJCTaDjewcZDcSzfKjAKmNN94nFhpRRbNS2cYHnT7cAN3cuk6JEPJXiR3RaCKj.jpg)


Desde el momento que entramos, sentimos que habíamos dado un pequeño viaje en el tiempo, encontramos todo lo que nos habían comentado nuestros padres de sus \

.

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/twirilyn/23wgF9LgxvmYceawN75DfEwsZDhBEhTJ5PTuHhAMZqwBqDm1P6YWZ2pjx683Lzcr7N1xy.jpg)

El lugar estaba lleno de juguetes, ropa, figuras y objetos de colección que marcaron muchísimos años, especialmente de los años 80 y 90. La persona que nos atendió fue muy amable y paciente al ayudarnos a ubicar artículos que podríamos estar buscando para el regalo... Y a medida que nos iba mostrando diversas opciones que podrían encajar con lo que teníamos en mente, terminamos recorriendo todo el lugar y disfrutando de la experiencia con cada objeto que veíamos. Adicionalmente, cabe aclarar que la persona encargada a guiarnos nos indicó que cada producto es original y ciertos objetos son de edición limitada o versiones difíciles de encontrar.

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/twirilyn/23wqe8VrURwoxXoTCggNoHVkhPUZvj6tVsCNQQNw9TUcaRT7bqTZMT7rU6HyNNpsk9NkH.jpg)

Cada rincón estaba lleno de objetos que seguramente muchos de nuestros padres, tíos o familiares recuerdan con cariño. Personalmente (A pesar de que nací en el 2000 y la mayoría de cosas no son de mi época), fue muy bonito descubrir y conocer un poco más de cerca este mundo de entretenimiento que marcó su infancia y juventud a nuestros seres queridos.

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/twirilyn/23zRzscWYrGT3eWq95WZVns6VCqitHfc75VXZofwPHHuxj4QUVDSrF9djSymFLVq4Wkr5.jpg)

Entre las cosas que más me llamaron la atención estaban referencia a clásicos como Candy Candy, Topo Gigio, muñecas antiguas, juegos de mesa, juegos retro y muchos otros detalles que despertaban nostalgia.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/twirilyn/23xKpQWAv1E1bc6tPBsvDeRnafXFgJjtD6RX63SmvZuuCQQuFb4siWumJX4Cj8aGS3qMV.jpg)

Para finalizar, gracias por llegar y leer hasta aquí, si alguno de ustedes se encuentra en Lima y le llamó la atención esta publicación, definitivamente los invito conocer este pequeño lugar, es perfecto para quienes quieren revivir un pedacito del pasado. El sitio se llama La Vieja y se encuentra ubicado en el distrito de San Isidro.

Lugar: La Vieja - San Isidro.
Ubicación📍: Lima, Perú.
