body.title: Green pea croquettes with two secret ingredients [ENG-ESP]
body.body:
>Greetings, dear friends and lovers of vegan food. It's always good to try something different in the kitchen that is both delicious and nutritious. It had been a while since I had made pea croquettes, and I thought they would be great for dinner and to add a little variety to the menu, and why not for breakfast and lunch too? I wanted to eat vegan, croquettes with salad, but these croquettes have two secret ingredients: olives and capers.
![1773181314231.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS3y4LypBvohokDNkRyCkV3EfMXFG7gAoQSzk14bmk7C1/1773181314231.jpg)

>The olives and capers gave the green pea croquettes a delicious flavor, almost completely changing the characteristic taste of the peas. On the other hand, little salt is used because the olives and capers are already preserved in brine and contain salt. It was necessary to use corn flour to help with the consistency and thus be able to shape the croquettes.
## Ingredients
>- 1 cup of green peas, soaked for 8 to 12 hours\n
>- Soybean oil for frying, as needed\n
>- 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil\n

>1.- Prepare the salad ingredients. Peel the carrots and beets, wash them, and slice them. Then, boil them in a pot with enough water until they soften. Let them cool to room temperature.
![1773184915620.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeJJeP11jdJuozhjuw4gTw6nBUouNorsAXkfQFA29t3uc/1773184915620.jpg)
![1773181314428.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaRCx6SB7cCYtiPT3sSVTtUWHrzck82TVwGD443hqTH59/1773181314428.jpg)

>2.-. While the salad ingredients are cooling, remove the skin from the onion, garlic, and chili peppers, wash them, including the green pepper and garlic, and chop everything into piece.
![1773181313934.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXSt6LZjGakGh3zpQsN3HweJZCUxUSkdVHSLqKjHpgLNF/1773181313934.jpg)
![1773181314398.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd1aDNkVQFBhG6jtQ3LPheU6i2mCeKWn8ACk1RubNJqkM/1773181314398.jpg)

>3.- Wash the peas and place them in the blender, then add the chopped herbs, and finally the capers and olives.
![1773181314367.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbUSfcW7gyU8EoUVtkuexW5TJqWFLgX8qaprK6tYjZnpp/1773181314367.jpg)
![1773181313957.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZHKoR8vxCQxrXwgodsudmFwB76JaVNBJ7dU83utuFVGB/1773181313957.jpg)
![1773181314311.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaQTgiWD56R8e8UfUfU3J8tTVaCpPVyX76ZNnGonNoPf7/1773181314311.jpg)
![1773181314283.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmREjB4zd9rwu836r2NNQmbYw3ipynpDtCz4z5ZgLF4HTE/1773181314283.jpg)

>4.- Add the seasonings, salt to taste, dried oregano, paprika, and cumin.<div>

<hr>

<center>


![1773181313986.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUpQFWjgN9asoy1dyLXiSik9UahDxWBkHyQqdTiUvRtPM/1773181313986.jpg)

</center>

<hr>


<div class=\

>5.- Gradually add water and blend until the ingredients are well combined. Then pour the mixture into a bowl and add the corn flour. Mix well and season with salt to taste.<div>

<hr>

<center>


![1773181314029.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWFoQ6fqUh548qWSho8K4otCHKfMBXhNFWHZ5DixJmkmy/1773181314029.jpg)


<hr>

![1773181314257.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbgK7CFhwYJhLFJcs5SsYNKDnVkry2YXwhSknw2F6GwJG/1773181314257.jpg)

</center>

<hr>


<div class=\

>6.- Heat a little oil in a frying pan over medium-low heat, shape the croquettes, and fry them until golden brown on both sides. Repeat the process until all the mixture is used up. As you remove them from the pan, place the croquettes on paper towels.<div>

<hr>

<center>


![1773181314051.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmctw9GHHNPbYiP8c51VSVXkSFc21CjogV9hJ9JCujwBCs/1773181314051.jpg)

</center>

<hr>

<div class=\

>7.- Dress the salad with olive oil, vinegar, and salt to taste. Mix well to combine the flavors.<div>


<hr>


<center>


![1773181314008.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPtPrAqNxqtV3WS9efuu9Kb5oi9PeWo5vAq2gYGd1b9XQ/1773181314008.jpg)

</center>

<hr>


<div class=\

> We serve our dish, a vegan delicacy.
![1773181314084.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYJmUSRqXjchjypiNE32jpj8T7zHkuTZom9qYrPyk7PWu/1773181314084.jpg)
![1773181314140.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP3dX7krUVWRyqE9rK9enxXg7U9tJLgcAsiok2bepEiLD/1773181314140.jpg)
I hope you liked it. See you next time.
All photos are original, taken with my Xiaomi Redmi 9 cell phone. The editions were made with the application [GridArt](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=photoeditor.layout.collagemaker&hl=en_ZA&gl=US).
![1773181951396.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZhzKNp5uTqzutZH9exrk4W84SmFBzg3jgC7tzYbQ4mL3/1773181951396.jpg)
#

>Saludos estimados amigos y amantes de la comida vegana. Siempre es bueno hacer algo diferente en la cocina que además de delicioso sea nutritivo. Tenía tiempo que no preparaba croquetas de arvejas, las creí importantes para cenar y variar un poco el menú, y por qué no?, para desayunar y almorzar. Quería comer vegano, unas croquetas con ensalada, pero estas croquetas llevan consigo dos ingredientes secretos, aceitunas y alcaparras.
![1773181314231.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS3y4LypBvohokDNkRyCkV3EfMXFG7gAoQSzk14bmk7C1/1773181314231.jpg)

>Las aceitunas y las alcaparras le aportaron a las croquetas de arvejas verdes un sabor delicioso, les cambia casi por completo el sabor característico del grano. Por otra parte, se utiliza poca sal debido a que las aceitunas y alcaparras al estar sumergidas en salmuera ya la contienen. Fue necesario usar harina de maíz para ayudar con la consistencia y así poder armar las croquetas.
## Ingredientes
>- 1 taza de arvejas verdes ya remoajdas de 8 q 12 horas\n
>- 6 cucharadas de harina de maíz\n
>- Aceite de soya para freír cantidad necesaria\n
>- 1 cucharada de aceite de oliva extra virgen\n

>1.- Preparamos los ingredientes de la ensalada. Retiramos la piel de la zanahoria y la remolacha, las lavamos y las cortamos en rodajas. Luego, las ponemos a hervir en una olla con suficiente agua hasta que se ablanden. Dejamos enfriar a temperatura ambiente.
![1773184915620.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeJJeP11jdJuozhjuw4gTw6nBUouNorsAXkfQFA29t3uc/1773184915620.jpg)
![1773181314428.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaRCx6SB7cCYtiPT3sSVTtUWHrzck82TVwGD443hqTH59/1773181314428.jpg)

>2.-. Mientras se enfrían los ingredientes de la ensalada, retiramos la piel de la cebolla, los ajos, el tallo y semilla de los ajíes, los lavamos, incluyendo el pimiento verde y el ajo porro, cortamos todo en trozos.
![1773181313934.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXSt6LZjGakGh3zpQsN3HweJZCUxUSkdVHSLqKjHpgLNF/1773181313934.jpg)
![1773181314398.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd1aDNkVQFBhG6jtQ3LPheU6i2mCeKWn8ACk1RubNJqkM/1773181314398.jpg)

>3.- Lavamos las arvejas y las colocamos en la licuadora, luego los aliños que hemos cortado, y por último, las alcaparras y aceitunas.
![1773181314367.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbUSfcW7gyU8EoUVtkuexW5TJqWFLgX8qaprK6tYjZnpp/1773181314367.jpg)
![1773181313957.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZHKoR8vxCQxrXwgodsudmFwB76JaVNBJ7dU83utuFVGB/1773181313957.jpg)
![1773181314311.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaQTgiWD56R8e8UfUfU3J8tTVaCpPVyX76ZNnGonNoPf7/1773181314311.jpg)
![1773181314283.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmREjB4zd9rwu836r2NNQmbYw3ipynpDtCz4z5ZgLF4HTE/1773181314283.jpg)

>4.- Agregamos los condimentos, la sal al gusto, el orégano seco, paprika y comino.<div>

<hr>

<center>


![1773181313986.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUpQFWjgN9asoy1dyLXiSik9UahDxWBkHyQqdTiUvRtPM/1773181313986.jpg)

</center>

<hr>


<div class=\

>5.- Agregamos agua de manera gradual y vamos licuando hasta que se integren bien los ingredientes. Luego, vertemos la mezcla en un bol y añadimos la harina de maíz. Mezclamos bien y rectificamos el punto de sal.<div>

<hr>

<center>


![1773181314029.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWFoQ6fqUh548qWSho8K4otCHKfMBXhNFWHZ5DixJmkmy/1773181314029.jpg)


<hr>

![1773181314257.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbgK7CFhwYJhLFJcs5SsYNKDnVkry2YXwhSknw2F6GwJG/1773181314257.jpg)

</center>

<hr>


<div class=\

>6.- Ponemos a calentar un poco de aceite en una sartén a fuego medio bajo, armamos las croquetas y las ponemos a freír hasta que se doren por ambos lados. Repetimos el proceso hasta terminar con toda la mezcla. A medida que las vayamos retirando de la sartén colocamos las croquetas sobre papel absorbente.<div>

<hr>

<center>


![1773181314051.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmctw9GHHNPbYiP8c51VSVXkSFc21CjogV9hJ9JCujwBCs/1773181314051.jpg)

</center>

<hr>

<div class=\

>7.- Aderezamos la ensalada con el aceite de oliva, el vinagre y la sal gusto. Mezclamos bien para que se integren los sabores.<div>


<hr>


<center>


![1773181314008.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPtPrAqNxqtV3WS9efuu9Kb5oi9PeWo5vAq2gYGd1b9XQ/1773181314008.jpg)

</center>

<hr>


<div class=\

>Servimos nuestro platillo, una delicia vegana.
![1773181314084.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYJmUSRqXjchjypiNE32jpj8T7zHkuTZom9qYrPyk7PWu/1773181314084.jpg)
![1773181314140.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP3dX7krUVWRyqE9rK9enxXg7U9tJLgcAsiok2bepEiLD/1773181314140.jpg)
Espero que les haya gustado. Nos vemos en la próxima oportunidad.
Todas las fotografías son originales, tomadas con mi celular Xiaomi Redmi 9. Las ediciones las hice con la aplicación [GridArt](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=photoeditor.layout.collagemaker&hl=en_ZA&gl=US).

body.title: ¡Mi nombre es Jacinta!./ My name is Jacinta!(Esp/Eng)
body.body:
# Español
# Saludos amigos amantes de la literatura.💁☀️
¡Feliz día para todos!
Detrás de cada nombre, amigos, hay una historia, por lo que hoy , inspirada en el  8 de Marzo, Día de la Mujer, les quiero compartir un pequeño relato, esperando que les guste.

# ¡Mi nombre es Jacinta! 
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260310_195405019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/242NqmDkic9X7pvrCxtqPjhfkv8tBG6U91VkTYHHekXN1oTjCbN1iffPZ9NP7GrM7fSPf.jpg)
</center>
#
#
-Jacinta, ¿aún frente al televisor?, mañana llegarás tarde al colegio.
-Mamá,¡ que no me digas así!, yo quiero llamarme Rosario, cómo la joven de la novela.

Expresaba Jacinta, una joven adolescente a su madre, mientras con su mirada imponente  fruncia  el seño de su frente.

-Así que te gusta hija el nombre de Rosario, me imagino que es por lo de  ser cantante, la protagonista.
-Pues si madre, por eso y porque  batalló mucho para lograrlo, pues era huérfana.

Exclamaba Jacinta a su madre  con su semblante  triste y  con su dedo en  la pantalla del televisor, que reflejaba una pequeña niña vestida  con trapos.

-¡Ven, bobita!,  deja secarte esas lágrimas, eres tan  buena de corazón como Jacinta tu bisabuela.¿Te gustaría conocer su historia?

Una sonrisa deja salir Elena, la madre de Jacinta, al observar como su hija  gesticulando su cabeza diciendo que sí, apagaba el televisor y se acomodaba en el sillón con sus  enormes ojos rojos.

-Pues , mi niña, en el año 1946, toda la  zona de nuestros alrededores,  de los grandes parques, y edificaciones, se encontraba cubierta de marabú.
-¿De marabú madre, no existían calles?
-Existían caminos empedrados, por los que numerosas familias transitaban a diario para irse al trabajo, que para aquel entonces, era la siembra de cultivos, la crianza de animales y el de  servidumbre a  las familias más pudientes.
En ese entorno y en esta casa , que era una humilde choza, nació Jacinta, una hermosa niña, de ojos azules, que sus padres amaron  y cuidaron hasta que cumplió 13 años.

-Y eso madre¿ que pasó?
-Pues resulta que  la madre de Jacinta fallece , y ella, para ayudar a su padre, y a  la crianza de sus cinco hermanos, decide irse a convivir con una familia  adinerada, Los Sumar,  y trabajar como sirvienta.
En este trabajo, duró pocos días, pues sus patrones, como los llamaba,  le cogieron tanto cariño, que le cambiaron su profesión a cuidadora de su pequeño.
Al  cabo de  tres años  Jacinta, logró elevar  con su profesión el nivel  de vida de sus  hermanos y de su padre, que lloraron  de angustia al  verla  partir hacia otro país con esa familia, a la  que se les hacía imprescindible su presencia, pues su pequeño se había encariñado con ella.

-¿Mamá y entonces Jacinta, dejó a su familia aquí?
-Así es hija, con dolor en el alma se fue con ellos para seguir apoyando a sus hermanos, que se encontraban  estudiando, un privilegio para pocos en aquella época.
Al llegar a ese país  desarrollado de grandes edificaciones, Jacinta queda deslumbrada por su belleza, y se enfoca en cada día ser mejor en su trabajo de niñera.

-¡Qué buena esa familia que la acogió, madre!

-Así es mi niña, cada día fue una bendición junto a Los Sumar, hasta que en  la celebración del sexto cumpleaños del pequeño Luis, un invitado de la familia le pregunta al niño,¿ cómo se llama tu mamá?, y el niño Luis, sólo exclamaba sonriente  ¡mamá, mamá! mientras corría a los  brazos de Jacinta.
Los celos, ese sentimiento tan negativo, se apoderaron de la madre de Luis, la patrona de Jacinta, quién  al día siguiente con su corazón  de piedra, le dió un sobre con dinero y le dijo que apartir de ese día, no trabajaba más para esa familia, que se marchara.

-¡Pobre Jacinta!, ¿y ahora, mamá, sola en esa ciudad?

-Pues, al inicio no podía creer lo que estaba viviendo, no sabía cómo regresar a su país, ni a quién acudir, así que mientras  vagaba por las calles un ataque de pánico hizo que estallara en llanto.
Miradas de extrañeza, causó delante de una multitud, quiénes la ignoraban con gesto de desagravio, excepto una monja de una iglesia, que le dijo extendiéndole su mano: ¡Hija mía, calma!,¿ cuál es tu nombre?- Mi nombre es Jacinta....

-¿Mamá,  y entonces que pasó con mi bisabuela?

-Desde ese día Jacinta comenzó a estudiar la palabra de Dios, y ayudar a los vulnerables junto a las monjas, que la acogieron como una más, hasta que-¿Señor, se encuentra bien?
La triste mirada de un hombre de barba , cabello descuidado , vestimenta deshecha capta su atención en un parque.

-¿ Y  quién era el hombre, madre?
-Jajaja, Creo que por hoy cariño, ya es suficiente, mañana te sigo contando.Dale que duermas bien Jaci.., disculpa me dijiste que no te llamará así.
-Bueno, creo que el nombre de Jacinta,  no está de todo mal.
¡Continuará!

Bueno amigos, espero que les haya gustado esta primera parte, de esta historia ¡Mi nombre es Jacinta!, de la que les compartiré su segunda parte  este viernes.
Vibras positivas a todos¡Abrazos!
Escritos propios.

*** 
# English
# Greetings, fellow lovers of literature.💁☀️
Happy day to everyone!
Behind every name, friends, there is a story, so today, inspired by March 8th, Women's Day, I want to share a little story, hoping you like it.

# My name is Jacinta! 
#
<center>
![20255321225591~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/EpGShmZf3a41z3Q31ocipq9Zc7UAukxhH3DQQK89SM1hoyHTrpSdM1oHjNUSX7PaV1o.jpg)
</center>
#
-Jacinta, still in front of the TV?, you'll be late for school tomorrow.
-Mom, don't say that to me!, I want to call myself Rosario, like the young woman in the novel.

Jacinta, a young teenager, expressed to her mother, while with her imposing gaze she frowns the sign of her forehead.

-So you like the name Rosario, I imagine it's because of being a singer, the protagonist.
-Well, yes, mother, that's why and because she struggled a lot to achieve it, because she was an orphan.

Jacinta exclaimed to her mother with her sad face and with her finger on the TV screen, which reflected a little girl dressed in rags.

-Come on, silly girl!, let those tears dry, you are as good at heart as Jacinta your great grandmother.Would you like to know his story?

Elena, Jacinta's mother, lets out a smile as she watches her daughter gesticulating her head saying yes, turning off the TV and settling into the armchair with her huge red eyes.

-Well, my child, in the year 1946, the whole area of our surroundings, of the big parks, and buildings, was covered with marabou.
-Of marabou mother, there were no streets?
-There were paved roads, along which numerous families traveled daily to go to work, which at that time, was planting crops, raising animals and serving the wealthiest families.
In that environment and in this house, which was a humble hut, Jacinta was born, a beautiful girl, with blue eyes, who was loved and cared for by her parents until she turned 13.

-And that, mother, what happened?
-Well, it turns out that Jacinta's mother dies, and she, in order to help her father, and the upbringing of her five siblings, decides to go live with a wealthy family, add them up, and work as a maid.
In this job, she lasted a few days, because her employers, as she called them, took such a liking to her, that they changed her profession to caretaker of her little one.
After three years, Jacinta managed to raise the standard of living of her siblings and her father with her profession, who cried with anguish when they saw her leaving for another country with that family, to which her presence was essential, because her little one had become attached to her.

-Mom and then Jacinta, did she leave her family here?
-That's right daughter, with pain in her soul she went with them to continue supporting her brothers, who were studying, a privilege for few at that time.
Upon arriving in this developed country of large buildings, Jacinta is dazzled 
for her beauty, and she focuses on getting better at her babysitting job every day.

-How nice that family that took her in, Mother!

-That's my girl, every day was a blessing together with The Sumar, until at the celebration of little Luis's sixth birthday, a guest of the family asks the child, what is your mom's name? and the little boy Luis, just exclaimed smiling, Mom, mom! as she ran into Jacinta's arms.
Jealousy, that negative feeling, took over Luis' mother, Jacinta's employer, who the next day with her heart of stone, gave her an envelope with money and told her that from that day on, she would no longer work for that family, to leave.

-Poor Jacinta! and now, Mom, alone in that city?

-Well, at first I couldn't believe what I was living, I didn't know how to return to his country, or who to turn to, so while wandering the streets a panic attack made me burst into tears.
She caused strange looks in front of a crowd, who ignored her with a gesture of reparation, except for a nun of a church, who said to her extending her hand: My daughter, calm down!, what's your name?- My name is Jacinta....

-Mom, and then what happened to my great-grandmother?

-Since that day Jacinta began to study the Word of God, and help the vulnerable with the nuns, who welcomed her as one more, until-Sir, are you well?
The sad look of a man with a beard, unkempt hair, undone clothes captures his attention in a park.

-And who was the man, Mother?
-Hahaha, I think for today honey, that's enough, I'll keep telling you tomorrow.Make sure you sleep well, Jaci.., sorry you told me he won't call you that.
-Well, I think the name Jacinta, it's not all bad.
To be continued!

Well friends, I hope you liked this first part, of this story My name is Jacinta!, of which I will share its second part this Friday.
Positive vibes to all, hugs!

body.title: [Esp./Eng.]   Entre Facciones y la Libertad del Ser.   ||   Between Factions and the Freedom of Being.
body.body:
*** *** #
If you prefer the English version, click on the following link 👉 [**HERE**](#english)
*** ***

> Al recorrer los archivos y el fluir constante de pensamientos en la comunidad de Holos&Lotus, uno percibe un hilo invisible que une a sus autores: la búsqueda de la integridad humana. En este ecosistema de HIVE, se ha explorado incansablemente la diversidad del comportamiento, la gestión emocional y la espiritualidad. Sin embargo, surge una pregunta que parece flotar en el aire de nuestra época actual, una que nos obliga a mirar más allá de nuestras pantallas: ***¿Qué sucede cuando nuestra complejidad interna choca contra las estructuras que intentan simplificarnos?***
# ***
Entre Facciones y la Libertad del Ser
*** Hace una década, la película Divergente (2014), basada en las novelas de Veronica Roth, nos presentó una distopía donde la sociedad se dividía en cinco facciones para mantener una paz artificial —de seguro la recrudecerán—: **Abnegación (altruismo), Cordialidad (paz), Sinceridad (honestidad), Osadía (valentía) y Erudición (inteligencia)**. El sistema funcionaba bajo una premisa letal: ***\

***. Aquel que no encajaba, o peor aún, aquel que poseía atributos de varias facciones a la vez, era etiquetado como **Divergente** (raro, peligroso). Y un divergente no podía ser controlado. Por lo tanto, debía ser eliminado.

Hoy, al observar el panorama global, ***¿podemos decir con total certeza que esa ficción distópica está lejos de nuestra realidad?***

<center>
![![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcvavFG3y4VQqw58RuarHbGXiKLExxFxtdrrLqAkLugzc/ss.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcvavFG3y4VQqw58RuarHbGXiKLExxFxtdrrLqAkLugzc/ss.jpg)
<sup>[TikTok](https://www.google.com/imgres?q=soy%20diferente%20y%20eso%20no%20me%20hace%20mala%20persona.&imgurl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tiktok.com%2Fapi%2Fimg%2F%3FitemId%3D7365855392900926725%26location%3D0%26aid%3D1988&imgrefurl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tiktok.com%2F%40alejandraq0841%2Fvideo%2F7365855392900926725&docid=9ge68Eb35cLuwM&tbnid=LEfFVp09aLIdnM&vet=12ahUKEwiv5LGswZaTAxVKD9AFHVipM_AQnPAOegQIGBAB..i&w=720&h=1080&hcb=2&ved=2ahUKEwiv5LGswZaTAxVKD9AFHVipM_AQnPAOegQIGBAB)</sup>
</center>

***¿Acaso los gobiernos y los sistemas actuales no han creado sus propias facciones invisibles?*** Vivimos en una era de etiquetas feroces. Se nos exige ser de izquierda o de derecha, conservadores o progresistas, científicos o espirituales. Si te atreves a ser un Erudito que cuestiona, pero a la vez posees la Osadía de rebelarte y la Cordialidad de empatizar con el \

, el sistema empieza a verte con sospecha.

La pregunta para tu almohada hoy sería: ***¿Cuántas partes de ti has tenido que amputar para poder encajar en la facción que tu entorno te exige?***

El \

de lo cotidiano —que a veces no es un régimen político, sino el régimen de la opinión pública y el algoritmo— busca la homogeneidad. Un ciudadano predecible es un ciudadano gobernable. La diversidad del pensamiento humano es, por naturaleza, caótica para quien ostenta el poder. La verdadera introspección nos revela que somos seres fluidos, podemos ser profundamente altruistas (Abnegación) por la mañana y fieramente valientes (Osadía) por la tarde. No somos una sola etiqueta.

<center>
![![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8z1WvL3EWb5DLhzUdEUTBRX7iRtBLwYYAJiruj75LR8/dd.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8z1WvL3EWb5DLhzUdEUTBRX7iRtBLwYYAJiruj75LR8/dd.jpg)
<sup>[GooglePlay](https://play-lh.googleusercontent.com/proxy/JGCboGnDVc87dzwfb7TVJFiQ_rAZJk02yl1qRzgn7ER4-W0ms2SHIpyYVnvl1DFSgCrHNo1Pp8cKo9m9B0x49Ta0SeDBgerf-69K2R04kbp4r_XFpDHz3mjG=s3840-w3840-h2160)</sup>
</center>

Sin embargo, en muchos rincones del mundo, la \

de pensamiento se paga cara. Aquellos que no se alinean con el discurso oficial, que mantienen una visión crítica o que simplemente deciden vivir fuera de los márgenes preestablecidos, son desplazados, silenciados o \

de la vida pública. ***¿No es acaso una forma de exterminio la cancelación digital o el aislamiento social de quien piensa distinto?***

Detengámonos un momento..., miremos hacia adentro...

***¿Cuál es tu facción predominante hoy? ¿Es la Sinceridad, aunque la verdad te traiga problemas? ¿Es la Erudición, aunque el exceso de lógica te aleje del corazón? ¿O te sientes, tal vez, un \

, vagando por los bordes de una sociedad que no comprende tu multiplicidad?*** Sí, lo sé, son muchas interrogantes.\n\nEn Holos&Lotus solemos hablar de sanación, pero la sanación más profunda comienza por aceptar nuestra propia divergencia. Aceptar que no somos una sola cosa. La paz que propone la facción de Cordialidad en la película era una paz basada en la supresión del conflicto; pero la paz real, la que necesitamos hoy, es la que surge de integrar nuestras sombras y nuestras luces, nuestras contradicciones y nuestras diversas formas de habitar el mundo. Para los creyentes, somos ***\

***, pero cada uno de nosotros es tan diferente en esencia. ***¿Por qué los sistemas actuales temen tanto al pensamiento divergente?*** Quizás porque el divergente es el único capaz de ver el engranaje completo. Quien solo conoce la Osadía puede ser un soldado ciego; quien solo conoce la Erudición puede ser un tirano frío. Solo aquel que integra todas las virtudes puede reclamar su verdadera humanidad. Te invito a meditar en esto: ***en tu lugar de vida, en tu país, en tu familia... ¿Qué facción te han obligado a elegir? ¿Y qué pasaría si mañana decidieras reclamar tu derecho a ser Divergente?***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTZK7ZHV5z33AYpNteP2MCgy5S1Cbm9gwDnazcDbVU5r1/dd.jpg) [Muxotepotolobat](https://muxotepotolobat.com/vivir-sin-miedo/)
No permitas que el miedo a no encajar te convierta en una caricatura de ti mismo. La diversidad de pensamiento no es una amenaza para la paz, es la única garantía de que la paz sea real y no un simulacro impuesto por un régimen que teme a la libertad del alma. Al final del día, como bien se sugiere en la obra de Veronica Roth, el problema no son las virtudes, sino el uso del miedo para separar a quienes deberían estar unidos. Que nuestra introspección hoy nos lleve a reconocer que somos mucho más que una categoría. Somos el universo entero tratando de entenderse a sí mismo a través de una mirada única. Y esa mirada, por definición, siempre será divergente.
*** ***

> **Creciendo como persona, busca y encuentra lo que necesitas para ser un mejor humano en la Comunidad [Holos&Lotus](https://peakd.com/c/hive-131951/created). De seguro, hay un tema que te llamará la atención.**
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/holos-lotus/245n3ai2B1twdEnyzuYXmYiNoGag22e7ZZQ7uz72NKdqPqaR6PyaDrSeA7EMUq9RuNPHc.png Infografía propia de la Comunidad [Holos&Lotus](https://peakd.com/c/hive-131951/created)
*** ***
🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆

*** *** ##
Dedicado a todos aquellos que, día a día, hacen del mundo un lugar mejor.
*** ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnceTgTBLgAUkErZfdoePC7twytC1CTcqQYDKkU4Lrrd/1024espa_ol8.gif) ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif) ***

*** *** ***

> When browsing through the archives and the constant flow of thoughts in the Holos&Lotus community, one perceives an invisible thread that unites its authors: the search for human integrity. In this Hive ecosystem, behavioural diversity, emotional management and spirituality have been tirelessly explored. However, a question arises that seems to float in the air of our current era, one that forces us to look beyond our screens: ***What happens when our internal complexity collides with the structures that attempt to simplify us?***
# ***
Between Factions and the Freedom of Being
*** A decade ago, the film Divergent (2014), based on the novels by Veronica Roth, presented us with a dystopia where society was divided into five factions to maintain an artificial peace: ***Abnegation (altruism), Amity (peace), Candour (honesty), Dauntless (bravery) and Erudite (intelligence)***. The system operated under a lethal premise: ***‘Faction before blood.’*** Those who did not fit in, or worse, those who possessed attributes of several factions at once, were labelled **Divergent**. And a Divergent could not be controlled. Therefore, they had to be eliminated. ***Today, looking at the global landscape, can we say with complete certainty that this dystopian fiction is far from our reality?***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSsB9XxVuZzLVUYK5H26BrN9gvAy9tWPbtfRCNbRiRQ3r/image.png) [Scontent](https://scontent.fccs9-1.fna.fbcdn.net/v/t39.30808-6/625966499_921148547112968_7577253828061468606_n.jpg?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e06c5d&_nc_ohc=UHREUqbUbsMQ7kNvwGCw1bB&_nc_oc=AdlD0vEd_mKyKoembtoKYmOT4-lwnac7WiA4iGjbdj1v3kMqv4Kpevg85oWRBF5w_SU&_nc_zt=23&_nc_ht=scontent.fccs9-1.fna&_nc_gid=cqBF3uI4UDt_CNpo8li73w&_nc_ss=8&oh=00_Afy1pDd0b64TzsQK4eT0UsDVvzLa6e5Su_Y6hPoM8TLi-A&oe=69B68AF8)
***Have current governments and systems not created their own invisible factions?*** We live in an era of fierce labels. We are required to be left-wing or right-wing, conservative or progressive, scientific or spiritual. If you dare to be a Scholar who questions, but at the same time possess the Courage to rebel and the Kindness to empathise with the ‘enemy’, the system begins to view you with suspicion. ***The question for your pillow today would be: How many parts of yourself have you had to amputate in order to fit into the faction that your environment demands of you?*** The ‘government’ of everyday life —which is sometimes not a political regime but the regime of public opinion and the algorithm— seeks homogeneity. A predictable citizen is a governable citizen. The diversity of human thought is, by nature, chaotic for those in power. True introspection reveals that we are fluid beings; we can be deeply altruistic (Selflessness) in the morning and fiercely courageous (Daring) in the afternoon. We are not a single label.
![![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8z1WvL3EWb5DLhzUdEUTBRX7iRtBLwYYAJiruj75LR8/dd.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX8z1WvL3EWb5DLhzUdEUTBRX7iRtBLwYYAJiruj75LR8/dd.jpg) [GooglePlay](https://play-lh.googleusercontent.com/proxy/JGCboGnDVc87dzwfb7TVJFiQ_rAZJk02yl1qRzgn7ER4-W0ms2SHIpyYVnvl1DFSgCrHNo1Pp8cKo9m9B0x49Ta0SeDBgerf-69K2R04kbp4r_XFpDHz3mjG=s3840-w3840-h2160)
However, in many corners of the world, ‘divergence’ of thought comes at a high price. Those who do not align themselves with the official discourse, who maintain a critical view or who simply decide to live outside the pre-established margins, are displaced, silenced or ‘eliminated’ from public life. Isn't digital cancellation or social isolation of those who think differently a form of extermination? Let's pause for a moment... let's look inward. ***What is your predominant faction today? Is it Sincerity, even though the truth brings you problems? Is it Erudition, even though excessive logic distances you from the heart? Or do you feel, perhaps, like a ‘No Faction’, wandering on the fringes of a society that does not understand your multiplicity?*** Yes, I know, there are many questions. At Holos&Lotus we often talk about healing, but the deepest healing begins with accepting our own divergence. Accepting that we are not just one thing. The peace proposed by the Cordiality faction in the film was a peace based on the suppression of conflict, but real peace, the peace we need today, is the peace that comes from integrating our shadows and our lights, our contradictions and our diverse ways of inhabiting the world. For believers, we are ***‘made in God's image and likeness,’*** but each of us is so different in essence. ***Why are current systems so afraid of divergent thinking?*** Perhaps because the divergent is the only one capable of seeing the whole picture. Those who only know Dauntless may be blind soldiers; those who only know Erudite may be cold tyrants. Only those who integrate all virtues can claim their true humanity. I invite you to meditate on this: ***In your community, in your country, in your family... Which faction have you been forced to choose? And what would happen if tomorrow you decided to claim your right to be Divergent?***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeWwF9F2CkvvJ6MFqrXpaLtoQyM9YRjyrnRc5jTDA7yJf/image.png) [A life without fear](https://www.bible.com/reading-plans/21025-a-life-without-fear)
Do not allow the fear of not fitting in to turn you into a caricature of yourself. Diversity of thought is not a threat to peace; it is the only guarantee that peace is real and not a sham imposed by a regime that fears freedom of the soul. At the end of the day, as Veronica Roth's work suggests, the problem is not virtues, but the use of fear to separate those who should be united. May our introspection today lead us to recognise that we are much more than a category. We are the entire universe trying to understand itself through a single gaze. And that gaze, by definition, will always be divergent.
*** ***

> **Growing as a person, seek and find what you need to be a better person in the [Holos&Lotus](https://peakd.com/c/hive-131951/created) Community. Surely, there's a topic that will catch your attention.**
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/holos-lotus/245n3ai2B1twdEnyzuYXmYiNoGag22e7ZZQ7uz72NKdqPqaR6PyaDrSeA7EMUq9RuNPHc.png Community's own infographic [Holos&Lotus](https://peakd.com/c/hive-131951/created)

body.title: Divided between two worlds...
body.body:
>

In the end, my country and my life need me complete, whole in one piece, and as long as I don't understand it, I could run the risk of looking for me without finding me, maybe believing the story that everything is fine. >It's a sterile fight... In my country Venezuela, things are not being easy, because we are in the middle of the limelight, with a high degree of anxiety about this situation of political, economic, social instability. The fundamental thing is to take care of ourselves, take care of our mind, protect our thoughts in order to continue living within the possible \

. That duality of living in two worlds is exhausting, what to one inside and out. Then something very ambiguous happens to us *One feels guilty if one disconnects, but everything breaks, if we stay hooked*, in the country news. I think that mental health is also resistance, so we must disconnect to recover a little, our mental peace if what we want is to take charge of our life, this is what if we can control. To seek to be well, to surround oneself with people in the same line of thinking as one and to move on without postponing our life waiting for something that we do not control generates a lot of anguish for us. It is necessary to find spaces to breathe and release so much negative stuff. It is also true that each thinking brain is so individual of reality from its perspective (it is a world), and not all people react the same, some are polarized with events, others are more resilient, and although all emotions are valid, what we should not do is fall into hopelessness or get extremely excited either. We have to look for well-being while the situation in my country is taking its course. Taking breaks and detaching, it is necessary to take care of our mind and our thoughts, it is to let go of part of the world from other emotional places and not only from inside the country, which during the last 27 years we have had to live, since things in Venezuela are on another level. The reality is that we Venezuelans are carrying the weight of a country, the responsibility of our own life, our job, the couple, the house, the head 🤯 and looking at a screen full of news that we can not control between hope and fear to get excited, the result is that we are everywhere and in turn in none and that mental wear and tear has a very high cost that is charged and paid with our concentration, in our mood, in how we got to our house, in how we sleep and in how we are with ourselves. It is necessary, to do *social media detox*. Of course, it costs me, but it really is the best decision to return to oneself. At least it's working for me to relieve the burden of so much news about my country. Janitze.🌷

body.title: Sell ​​at a higher price, add value? | ¿Vender más caro, añadir valor?
body.body:
>

<center>**¡Bienvenido a un nuevo post, querido Hiver!**</center>

<div class=\

>

**Anoche buscaba un vídeo para ver. Tengo un canal dedicado a los ingresos online e inversiones [(Zul Mujica)](https://www.youtube.com/@MujicaZul), así que todo lo que vea que sea útil es información que publico en mi comunidad en Telegram. Lo que encontré me dejó pensando sobre algunos temas de negocios.**

Encontré un vídeo al que yo llamaría *\

* sobre creadoras en OnlyFans no son temas que me interesen porque no creo ese tipo de contenido, pero, teniendo en cuenta el crecimiento que tiene este nicho, por así decirlo, vi el vídeo. OnlyFans es una página donde las personas proporcionan contenido para adultos, y, ahora que me entero debido a este video, también algunos servicios como novias virtuales. Así que el objetivo del vídeo era dar tips a chicas que crean este tipo de contenido para vender más y generar más dinero. Lo cual me hizo pensar en el post de @damarysvibra [¿Ajustes particulares al precio de venta?](https://peakd.com/hive-140971/@damarysvibra/ajustes-particulares-al-precio-de-ventaororspecial-adjustments-to-the-sale-price) Porque uno de los consejos del video es: *Dividir tu audiencia en listas, y a la lista de ballenas (tal como en Hive Blog, los que tienen más dinero y poder) darles un precio más costoso sobre algunos productos como packs.* Escuchar esto me voló la cabeza. Porque nunca se me había pasado por la mente el subir el precio de mis productos. Uno de ellos son plantillas en Google Sheet, y por lo general suelo ofrecer un precio más bajo si el pago se hace en bolívares. El valor de mi plantilla de finanzas personales, fácil de usar, es de 4,95 $; si la compras en bolívares; escribiendo a mi WhatsApp, la vendo en 4$. Por lo que, al escuchar el video y leer el post de Damarys pienso: *¿Qué estamos haciendo con nuestros negocios?* Debido a que el problema que plantea es más común de lo que cualquiera se imagina. También vienen a mi mente otros pensamientos... >! [English version available by clicking here] >Last night I was looking for a video to watch. I have a channel dedicated to online income and investments [(Zul Mujica)](https://www.youtube.com/@MujicaZul), so anything I find useful I share with my Telegram community. What I found got me thinking about some business topics. > >I came across a video that I would call \

about creators on OnlyFans. It's not a topic that interests me because I don't create that kind of content, but considering the growth of this niche, so to speak, I watched the video. > >OnlyFans is a website where people provide adult content, and, as I learned from this video, also some services like virtual girlfriends. > >So the video's objective was to give tips to women who create this type of content on how to sell more and generate more money. > >Which made me think of @damarysvibra's post [Specific Adjustments to the Sale Price?](https://peakd.com/hive-140971/@damarysvibra/ajustes-particulares-al-precio-de-ventaororspecial-adjustments-to-the-sale-price) Because one of the tips in the video is: > >*Divide your audience into lists, and give the whale list (just like on Hive Blog, those with more money and power) a higher price on some products, like bundles.* > >Hearing this blew my mind. Because it had never crossed my mind to raise the price of my products. > >One of them is Google Sheets templates, and I usually offer a lower price if the payment is made in bolivars. > >The price of my easy-to-use personal finance template is $4.95; if you buy it in bolivars; I'm selling it for $4 by messaging me on WhatsApp. > >So, after watching the video and reading Damarys's post, I think: *What are we doing with our businesses?* > >Because the problem she raises is more common than anyone imagines. > >Other thoughts also come to mind...
![photo_2026-03-10_19-57-08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/23xek3pNcfRUTXDvqbeTpgmgYvfAAx4RnnLXHs8UkaBR15NLzdhTAYScYqE3uNb4Xj3W7.jpg)

> **Bajar el precio de tus productos y servicios es un error** Creo que cuando se tiene un emprendimiento se piensa más en las personas que en nosotros mismos o en nuestro negocio. Las clases de yoga y bailoterapia no son de primera necesidad; sin embargo, ayudan a mantener buena calidad de vida. Mientras que el agua y los alimentos son de primera necesidad, tienen un precio fijo, así que cuando vas a comprarlos no puedes pedir una rebaja. Entonces, *¿por qué se pide una rebaja a un emprendedor?* Se pueden ajustar los precios con mayor facilidad; sin embargo, al hacerlo, no estamos tomando en cuenta diversos factores, como el tiempo utilizado, herramientas (y su desgaste), el tiempo invertido en obtener el conocimiento necesario para impartir las clases, los servicios que se pagan, etc. En mi caso sería el servicio de internet, el tiempo invertido en crear la plantilla, más el tiempo invertido en aprender a manejar la herramienta, la publicidad en redes sociales y también, nuevamente, el TIEMPO en crear el contenido sobre ella. Si nos damos cuenta, todos estos factores no se pueden poner debajo de una mesa. Porque estamos quitándonos valor a nosotros mismos. Y esto realmente me lo hizo pensar esa chica que crea contenido en OnlyFans. Si ella valora su tiempo, su servicio, sus herramientas en general, *¿por qué los demás emprendedores no?* Es una buena pregunta para plantearse y que ayude al crecimiento de nuestro negocio. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**Lowering the price of your products and services is a mistake** > >I think that when you have a business, you think more about people than about yourself or your business. > >Yoga and dance therapy classes aren't essential; however, they help maintain a good quality of life. > >While water and food are essential, they have a fixed price, so when you go to buy them, you can't ask for a discount. > >So, *why ask an entrepreneur for a discount?* > >Prices can be adjusted more easily; however, by doing so, we're not taking into account various factors, such as the time used, tools (and their wear and tear), the time invested in acquiring the necessary knowledge to teach the classes, the services that are paid for, etc. > >In my case, it would be the internet service, the time invested in creating the template, plus the time invested in learning how to use the tool, social media advertising, and also, again, the TIME spent creating the content about it. > >If we really think about it, all these factors can't be ignored. Because we're undervaluing ourselves. > >And that girl who creates content on OnlyFans really made me think about this. If she values ​​her time, her service, her tools in general, *why don't other entrepreneurs?* > >It's a good question to ask ourselves, and it can help our businesses grow.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/23ywo31B6TqxzXyDQkLKZmAfoVezinDQynJKfpQXw3Vkx2BzVrT97Lpd7zwDS5ApEUNME.png)

> **¿Ser ambiciosa o conformista?** El último consejo que da esta chica en su video es que debes de ser ambiciosa, no conformista. Esto, siéndote sincera, me causa ruido, porque no me siento realmente bien siendo ambiciosa, pero tiene su lógica. Así que veámoslo desde otro punto de vista. Como, por ejemplo, la ambición en trabajar constantemente y no tomando vacaciones al hacer una venta. La ambición de buscar estrategias para mejorar nuestros servicios, sistemas de ventas y demás. Creo que estas son formas que te hacen ver la ambición desde una perspectiva positiva, una que te impulsa a trabajar y dedicar tiempo a lo que haces. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**Ambitious or Complacent?** > >The last piece of advice this girl gives in her video is that you should be ambitious, not complacent. > >To be honest, this bothers me, because I don't really feel good about being ambitious, but it has its logic. So let's look at it from another perspective. > >Like, for example, the ambition to work consistently and not take vacations after making a sale. > >The ambition to seek strategies to improve our services, sales systems, and so on. > >I think these are ways to see ambition from a positive perspective, one that motivates you to work and dedicate time to what you do.
![photo_2026-03-10_19-57-06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/23zkk7VSrK3NAXDTVwz2ru8vwj3W229omQQyFhqLtFxGZwsLNckxKTgEELsasuvhPcnN4.jpg)

> **¿Qué imagen estás dando de tu negocio?** Esta es una pregunta que plantea Damarys, y que también me deja pensando sobre ello. No he sido del todo constante con la creación de contenido debido a algunos asuntos personales. Sin embargo, esto también envía un mensaje. *Inconstante.* Eso pienso cuando no publico por largos periodos de tiempo. En el caso de Damarys, sinceramente, es complejo. Tal como dice, al correrse la voz afectará su negocio. Así que mi consejo sincero de lo que yo haría y que tomaré también para mí misma es: Mantener una tarifa fija, sin importar qué. Creo que es mejor perder un cliente que perder tu tiempo. Porque el desgaste físico es real, el paso del tiempo también. Y al no ser productos de primera necesidad lo que ofrecemos, siento que no existe un motivo que valga para cambiar el valor de nuestro tiempo y nuestro trabajo. Porque con ello no valoramos lo que hacemos, ni tampoco nuestro tiempo invertido. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**What image are you projecting of your business?** > >This is a question Damarys raises, and it's got me thinking too. > >I haven't been entirely consistent with content creation due to some personal matters. However, this also sends a message. > >*Inconsistent.* > >That's what I think when I don't post for long periods of time. > >In Damarys' case, honestly, it's complicated. As she says, word will spread, and it will affect her business. > >So my sincere advice, which I would also apply to myself, is: Maintain a fixed rate, no matter what. > >I believe it's better to lose a client than to waste your time. Because physical exhaustion is real, and so is the passage of time. > >And since we don't offer essential products, I feel there's no valid reason to change the value of our time and work. > >Because by doing so, we don't value what we do, nor the time we invest.

> **Añadirle valor a nuestro negocio** Por otra parte, algo que está tomando bastante terreno es el consumismo. Las personas buscan una experiencia única y consumir más y más. Así que se puede usar esto a nuestro favor, añadiéndole valor a nuestros servicios o productos. Bien sea la atención, proporcionar snacks saludables, tarjetas de fidelidad, toallas personalizadas... Esto ayuda a renovar la imagen del negocio, también a añadir valor. Porque muchas veces las personas no valoran el tiempo. Sin embargo, sí lo hacen con productos tangibles. El cerebro humano funciona de maneras bastante curiosas, por lo que es bueno tenerlo en cuenta a la hora de hacer negocios. Y como verás, aunque sé que es un post bastante largo, espero sea de ayuda a otros emprendedores, como lo ha sido para mí ver ese video anoche. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**Adding Value to Our Business** > >On the other hand, something that's gaining considerable ground is consumerism. > >People are looking for a unique experience and want to consume more and more. So we can use this to our advantage by adding value to our services or products. > >Whether it's personalized attention, providing healthy snacks, loyalty cards, or custom towels... This helps refresh the business's image and also adds value. > >Because often people don't value their time. However, they do value tangible products. > >The human brain works in rather curious ways, so it's good to keep this in mind when doing business. > >And as you'll see, although I know this is a rather long post, I hope it will be helpful to other entrepreneurs, just as watching that video last night was helpful to me. >Texto de mi autoría. > **Imágenes en el post creadas por mi en estos software:** >+ Iconos hechos en Photoshop, usando como referencia los logos de las redes sociales correspondientes. >+ Banners y portada realizados en Canva en la versión gratuita. >+ Todas las fotografías en el post son de mi autoría, las cuales edito con las apps de Lightroom y Meitu.

body.title: Opinion Series Part 5: Which Would You Choose: Your Career or the One You Love?
body.body: > Happy Wednesday Hivers! ## Each company has its own way of implementing policies and managing employees. Some organizations enforce their rules very strictly, while others take a more flexible and relaxed approach. The first company I worked for was extremely strict when it came to attendance, especially tardiness, since it was Japanese-owned. However, when it came to romantic relationships among employees, they were quite open about it. What I mean is that if two employees were working in the same company, they were still allowed to date or even get married. There were no restrictions regarding that matter. However, in the third company I worked for, employees were not allowed to be in a romantic relationship with each other. In fact, this rule was clearly emphasized in their company handbook. Honestly, it’s really difficult to prevent people from falling in love. When you work together every day, it’s natural to become close. Over time, that closeness can slowly develop into feelings that become something special. ## ![1000031179.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/EpnCJiEUfDnQUd8Bt95SE7MoTg7nfGDAqgFXf8JTecakxKKMrobWS8r58BeTWMpcMn8.jpg) ## A newly hired female employee was assigned to the Bohol branch. She was still very young, a fresh graduate, and quite carefree at the time, still learning how to manage her emotions. Then there was a male employee who had just recently separated from his wife. The guy was assigned to train the new employee, so most of the time they were together. It even reached the point where they would still spend time together after work hours. Perhaps the guy also needed someone to talk to since he had just gone through a separation from his wife. At first, everyone in the office thought they were simply close because he was her trainer. However, after a few months, people began noticing that something seemed different. Of course, as adults, it’s not difficult to sense when there is something more than friendship. Even when reviewing the CCTV footage, their gestures and body language suggested that their relationship had become more personal. Because of this, another HR staff spoke with the girl. However, she denied that there was anything going on between them. The HR staff then re-educated her about the company policy that strictly prohibits romantic relationships between employees. Despite several conversations and reminders from HR, the girl still continued. Eventually, the CEO also noticed what was happening and requested HR to issue a Notice to Explain (NTE). It was only then that the girl finally admitted the real status of their relationship. In the end, she chose to resign from the company so she could continue her relationship with the guy. In my opinion, if I truly loved someone, if our beliefs and views in life were aligned, if his life wasn’t complicated, and if I genuinely liked his personality, and if my salary in that company was small, I might choose to leave the company for him. However, if my feelings for him were not that deep and I was earning a good salary, I would most likely choose to stay with the company. Situations like this are really difficult, especially when a company has such strict policies. What if you like the person and you also like your job? Choosing between the two can be very hard. But at the end of the day, if we are employees, we are expected to follow the company’s policies. ##

>

Thank you for reading and see you on my next blog. Cheers!

body.title: Guns Up! Mobile: ¿Mejoras definitivas o preparativos para un cierre inminente?
body.body:
> ![Post Game.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/melan11e/23sUPK6fYjQe8p268wEwPFvgR4hGxCcia3SVhQUrfq7CXNK2E4Hu4ycecVXCkLvX6Mtrk.png) Quede al pendiente de compartirles las actualizaciones que hicieron en guns up, pero que al parecer no significan buenas noticias. > I'll keep you posted on the updates they made to Guns Up, but it doesn't look like it's good news.
**🎮 ━━━━━━━━━━ 🎖️ ━━━━━━━━━━ 🎮**
Hace dos semanas pude volver a retomar las batallas guns up porque estoy en semanas de vacaciones. Sin embargo, uno de esos días que intenté entrar, tuve que instalar una actualización antes de entrar y después de hacerlo, no pude volver a entrar al juego. Así que tuve que esperar al día siguiente. Y ese día, al entrar, me di cuenta que ahora, los premios de las temporadas, la manera en la que esto esta presentado cambio por completo, y daba la opción de poder comprar más paquetes para ir completándolos. > Two weeks ago, I was able to resume my Guns Up battles because I am on vacation. However, one of the days I tried to log in, I had to install an update before logging in, and after doing so, I couldn't log back into the game. So I had to wait until the next day. > > And that day, when I logged in, I realized that now, the seasonal rewards and the way they are presented have changed completely, and there is the option to purchase more packages to complete them. ![76912.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/melan11e/23tSKnG3K9ho9ppkkBGRk53D93GQEdKRYesFUKjzK5QvogjmXijxZHPyLhR8NkDeXzThP.png) Otra cosita que llamo mucho mi atención fue que, ahora las cajas que a veces uno gana en las batallas, estas tienen un tiempo para que se puedan abrir y todo depende de que si cajas básicas o no. Por lo general, las cajas básicas duraban 1hr para desbloquearse, pero ahora duran solo 30 min. Y una de las más grandes debía esperar 8hrs, pero ahora solo debo esperar 1hr 30 min. Lo cual me gusto bastante. De igual manera, ahora mejorar el campo propio es más rápido y más barato, ya no se tienen que gastar tantas unidades de oro ni esperar tanto, como 1hr, sino que lo máximo a esperar ahora son 10 min. > Another thing that caught my attention was that now the boxes you sometimes win in battles have a time limit before they can be opened, and it all depends on whether they are basic boxes or not. Usually, basic boxes took 1 hour to unlock, but now they only take 30 minutes. And one of the biggest ones used to take 8 hours, but now I only have to wait 1 hour and 30 minutes. I really liked that. > > Similarly, upgrading your own field is now faster and cheaper. You no longer have to spend as many gold units or wait as long, such as 1 hour, but now the maximum wait time is 10 minutes. ![76915.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/melan11e/23uExLdmheFvj7GtK849Sbve6NYypD86M3AhtAZ63jWwkQ95wb76oTj59UKm8nzgpBXiK.png) ![76914.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/melan11e/23tbPYQ3hvakgM9Knqnh4JVa82nP6iPLSssihK2hYgqqm8urtud5LFbosHSn5bNTftCyV.png) ![76913.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/melan11e/23tbkyBFRv6dKm1sqQXJNzntUbuzim6ErPRRNA4dB6mfPTcRy7GU8iNwQjaF2PztgedyT.png) Ahora, yo entre en una nueva alianza donde pensaba crecer bastante, y resulta que sí, ayer me subieron a teniente. Cosa que no pasaba en alianzas anteriores, sin importar lo mucho que aportara en ella. Pero, leyendo las conversaciones en esta nueva alianza, estas actualizaciones dentro del juego se deben a que el juego cerrara en mayo. Sin embargo, no me he puesto a leer algo, pero tendría sentido el porque ahora todo es más rápido para crecer. > Now, I joined a new alliance where I thought I would grow a lot, and it turns out that yes, yesterday they promoted me to lieutenant. This didn't happen in previous alliances, no matter how much I contributed to them. But, reading the conversations in this new alliance, these updates within the game are due to the game closing in May. However, I haven't read anything about it, but it would make sense why everything is growing faster now. ![81064.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/melan11e/23t7DBYbcqAgacbVjgRsX9oRspKbYfXmrXZgT1VVHFxYNTEtBpR9j4mTDi9ECyLg9yGyz.png) Y bueno, hasta acá este post. La verdad es que me parece una lástima que eso si ocurra, esperemos que no. > Well, that's it for this post. I think it would be a shame if that happened, but let's hope it doesn't.
**🎮 ━━━━━━━━━━ 🎖️ ━━━━━━━━━━ 🎮**
**Nos leemos en la próxima, pequeñas personitas.** *See you next time, little ones.*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTmZg4dhoUBmqQWMa4bzB8auWR6vKSc1UsCRUhYxSw4Jd/_20260310083131_15_5.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ7TJTrxbk8AspX72MsWVJLv138e9hq4bXEYdvKS1Z3Hd/_20260310083132_16_5.jpg)



來到北山大院, 我們第一件事就是找吃的, 餓了啦, 當然, 一邊找吃的, 同時也可以看到風景, 所以算是同步進行了. 但跟純粹閒逛的不同, 我們還要留意有甚麼好的餐廳去醫肚呢. 不搵, 怎吃呢.

然後, 好搞笑的, 去到某個轉角位, 我突然看到某家店的門口掛了一幅小小的”揮春” 其實昨天的文最後兩張圖都拍到它了, 但我自己都沒為意, 應該一早把那個放大圖也放上去, 今天補一下吧.

登登登登, 那幅”揮春”, 其實並不是甚麼揮春, 只不過是一個梗的掛件來, 就是 “搵條賓周” 啦, 估計我家拉叔 @davidke20見到就好有feel了, 同為廣東人的我們, 加上大家都愛看金魚, 看到這樣東西還不兩眼發光, 嘿嘿.

去到一個打卡點, 一邊走一邊找東西吃其實還挺有難度 (就是我懶哈), 要一邊看現場的店, 還要一邊看手機去找, 加上又不想錯過風景喔, 所以呢, 只好慢慢走, 不要走太快. 然後, 還是湘利害, 她找到一家在大院入面比較多人去吃的日式炸豬排店. 

聽說這家店都多人排隊的, 那就去看看唄, 反正距離我們也不遠, 200多米的距離, 兩三分鐘就到了. 不出所料, 去到門口有幾個人在糾結要不要進去, 最後他們都進去了, 我離遠目測見到差不多坐滿了, 所以馬上也跟著衝進去.

比較幸運的是, 我進去之後拿到最後一桌兩人桌, 我坐下之後, 全店剛好坐滿了, 此時湘的同事給她打電話談一些工作, 所以她先沒進店, 嗯, 自從變回全職之後, 她實在每天都忙, 不過忙一些好啊, 她自己過得充實, 她的錢包比比較充實, 對她對我來說都是沒壞的, 總之她週末可以放假就ok了, 也不影響我們出去玩.

在她談工作的時候, 我先看一下餐牌, 大概我都猜到她要點甚麼的了啦. 那個西多士她應該想點, 還有全出名的豬排飯定食都是必點的, 不用說, 主食的話點一個就好, 多點其他小食吧, 等她進來再看看. 然後, 我們另外加了一份魷魚煎肉餅, 一杯泰式奶茶, 最後她還點了一份青瓜, 夠吃了, 點完菜就等開吃吧.

我們坐下來的時候也沒閒著, 一直在找其他景點, 吶, 都是看看有沒有其他好玩的地方, 這個大院那麼大, 要是也吸引到我們的話, 基本上都不用plan b 的了, 逛到晚上都還行那種, 但我就喜歡always aiming for the best, prepare for the worst, 萬一吃完飯逛兩下覺得這裡沒特別呢?

說時遲那時快, 我們都未決定好plan b 的打卡點, 菜就陸續上來囉嘿嘿. 第一個上的居然是那個西多士, 主菜都未吃就吃甜品啦? 不過也不是不可以, 反正一盤就三塊, 先一人吃一塊, 留一塊在後面大家平分吧, 到時沒那麼熱, 沒那麼好吃而已. 

然後定食, 奶茶, 青瓜都接著上來了, 唯獨那個魷魚煎肉餅沒跟著上, 不過也沒關係, 桌都差不多放不下了, 先清一些東西再算. 我自己呢, 就不是太喜歡吃厚切豬排的, 他們這裡的豬排是厚切, 哎…如果有刀叉給我自己切薄一些會更好. 不過算了, 慢慢吃吧, 將就將就.

我們差不多把桌上的東西都清完, 那個肉餅還沒上, 但因為這裡是先付款的, 所以想取消都不行, 只好去催囉, 確定了店家沒漏單, 只好等, 大約再過五分鐘魷魚煎肉餅也上來了, 兩塊小小的, 不算太油膩啦, 剛剛好. 整頓飯118元, 不算貴, 但也不算便宜, 我心目中珠海的物價應該比深圳便宜啊, 但這裡又沒比深圳便宜好多哈. 飯就吃完啦, 是時候繼續探索北山大院囉, AT OUT

2026.3.11

body.title: 8 de Marzo, Día internacional de la Mujer/ March 8th, International Women's Day
body.body:
<center>  <div class=text-justify>

Saludos comunidad Holos&Lotus!! 
Llegamos a una nueva iniciativa en el marco de la celebración del Día Internacional de la Mujer, donde nos invitan a reflexionar sobre el rol de la mujer en la sociedad, denominada Vulnerabilidad y Contención, profundizando en esos lazos que la sostienen, escuchan y acompañan en momentos de vulnerabilidad, dolor y angustia. 
No hay un modelo único de ser mujer, todas tenemos historias, realidades, personalidades, elecciones y caminos diferentes, algunas se casan, procrean, se quedan en casa ocupandose del hogar otras por el contrario deciden permanecer solas, trabajan afuera, pero todas buscamos y merecemos lo mismo respeto, consideración, derechos y oportunidades. 

>Greetings Holos&Lotus community! We've arrived at a new initiative as part of the International Women's Day celebrations, inviting us to reflect on the role of women in society. This initiative, titled \

delves into the bonds that sustain, listen to, and accompany women in moments of vulnerability, pain, and anguish. There is no single model of womanhood; we all have different stories, realities, personalities, choices, and paths. Some marry, have children, and stay home taking care of the household; others, on the contrary, choose to remain single and work outside the home. But we all seek and deserve the same respect, consideration, rights, and opportunities. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS1Uay58ZM3QKfHRiBUWBrX3gxKaSfQkGefsUqE9dy9oC/1773186816529.jpg) A lo largo de mi existencia me he encontrado con mujeres que parecen invencibles, seguras, que resuelven, sostienen, acompañan, dan, escuchan, organizan y nunca paran, pero que al compartir un rato con ellas puedo darme cuenta que es solo una coraza en su interior suelen ser tan normal y vulnerable como lo soy yo, que cuidan de si misma y también de los suyos, que se equivocan, que sienten miedo pero que fingen una postura para cubrir espectativas ante los demás, les da miedo mostrar su vulnerabilidad, será porque siempre nos han dicho que somos sinónimo de fuerza y resiliencia, en realidad lo somos, desarrollamos más que los hombres esa capacidad impresionante de sosterlo todo. >Throughout my life, I've encountered women who seem invincible, confident, who solve problems, support, accompany, give, listen, organize, and never stop. But when I spend time with them, I realize it's just a facade. Inside, they're usually as normal and vulnerable as I am, taking care of themselves and their loved ones, making mistakes, feeling fear, but feigning a certain demeanor to meet others' expectations. They're afraid to show their vulnerability. Perhaps it's because we've always been told we're synonymous with strength and resilience. In reality, we are; we develop that impressive capacity to endure everything more than men do. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUxie1GmR7SF4jvtXeKF4cKFj7j3dt8cBoK8YdhvJXLGb/1773186836971.jpg) Las mujeres pasamos diferentes etapas hija, hermana, amiga, esposa madre, ver crecer a nuestros hijos, madurar, envejecer, somos capaces de construir un hogar con amor, bondad, palabras, silencios, abrazos, tiempo presente, paciencia, respeto y con propósito, solo esperamos y deseamos reconocimiento de nuestra humanidad con derecho a equivocarnos, a no poder con todo, a decir que no cuando es no, a descansar, a ser amadas a que nos traten como un ser humano con igualdad, nuestra fortaleza radica en reconocer nuestra vulnerabilidad, saber cuando es necesario parar, mostrar lo que sentimos, pedir ayuda, llorar hasta reiniciarnos o simplemente ser nosotras mismas sin filtros. >Women go through different stages: daughter, sister, friend, wife, mother; we watch our children grow, mature, and grow old. We are capable of building a home with love, kindness, words, silences, hugs, the present moment, patience, respect, and purpose. We only hope and desire recognition of our humanity, with the right to make mistakes, to not be able to do everything, to say no when it's no, to rest, to be loved, and to be treated as equal human beings. Our strength lies in recognizing our vulnerability, knowing when it's necessary to stop, to show what we feel, to ask for help, to cry until we restart, or simply to be ourselves without filters. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVBafM6anFdrDcDRgkuDuDWS9me4Su3NfVdQhYvtMqx6i/1773186861757.jpg) Hay momentos que podemos flaquear y necesitamos de alguien que nos sostenga, que nos escuche, que nos digan todo va a estar bien, que nos abracen, en mi casa me apoyo en mi familia, tengo un linaje de mujeres especiales entre hermanas, hija y sobrinas que caminan a mi lado, si me caigo me levantan, nos cuidamos, nos escuchamos, nos apoyamos, nos abrazamos, nos damos palabras de aliento, nos cuestionados sin destuirnos, nos acompañamos, nos quedamos cuando alguna nos necesita, celebramos los triunfos, reímos, lloramos y nos fortalecemos, también en mis vecinas y amigas consigo esa conexión y red de apoyo. En día internacional de la mujer, se busca resaltar el rol que ocupa la mujer en la sociedad, en la familia y en cualquier espacio donde se pare, se reconoce que su presencia no pasa desapercibido, lo transforma y deja huellas, así que niñas, adolescentes, mujeres rompamos barreras sigamos luchando por un mundo justo, libre de violencia y discriminación, que ese ruido que surge cada 8 de mayo sea una revolución diaria, no efeméride más, alcemos nuestra voz. >There are times when we may falter and need someone to support us, to listen to us, to tell us everything will be alright, to hug us. At home, I rely on my family. I have a lineage of special women—my sisters, daughter, and nieces—who walk beside me. If I fall, they lift me up. We take care of each other, we listen to each other, we support each other, we hug each other, we offer words of encouragement, we question each other without tearing each other down, we accompany each other, we stay when someone needs us, we celebrate triumphs, we laugh, we cry, and we grow stronger. I also find that connection and support network in my neighbors and friends. On International Women's Day, we seek to highlight the role that women occupy in society, in the family, and in any space they occupy. We recognize that their presence does not go unnoticed; it transforms and leaves its mark. So, girls, teenagers, women, let's break down barriers and continue fighting for a just world, free from violence and discrimination. Let the noise that arises every May 8th become a daily revolution, not just another commemoration; let's raise our voices. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVxNJp9rVQxLu7hHymAgAuGr1HN2XURa4htmJgxCSNVyw/1773186936203.jpg)
>
_¡Gracias por leer, hasta una nueva oportunidad !_
>
Las fotografías mostradas son de mi propiedad, .
La Versión en Inglés la realicé con el Traductor de Google.
>
_Thanks for reading, until next time!_

body.title: Day of 2026-03-10: yields⏸️ and liquidity 🚶
body.body:
Yields still Halted
-------------------

The yields associated with **LEOSTRATEGY sRWAs** are still halted. More recently, the same pattern appears to be affecting **$SURGE**, which is also late in producing yield.

When yield mechanisms pause simultaneously across related structures, it raises questions about whether the slowdown is temporary or structural. It has to be the later. At the same time, attention from leadership, referred to here as “the chairman”, is focused on promoting additional use cases that appear disconnected from the current operational state.

From a trading perspective, this distinction matters. New use cases can be discussed and promoted, but the primary signal remains the **actual functioning of the mechanism that generates yield**. The diversion by stating these things are not connected, narrow the realm of conclusion possible, but they're not aware of that or don't care.

But let's see when people will see the promised payouts - this time 🙄

Tactical swaps with $SURGE on $Base
-----------------------------------

During this period I executed several swaps involving $SURGE on $Base. The objective was not to increase directional risk but to improve positioning through execution. These swaps resulted in increasing the overall SURGE exposure to **400 units**.

Portfolio Snapshot (8 Mar↪️10 Mar '26)
--------------------------------------

Instead of tracking every movement during the past days, I compared two fixed portfolio snapshots. This approach reduces noise and highlights the **net change in positioning and valuation**.

body.title: El arte de soltar no es olvidar, es aprender en el camino [esp-eng]
body.body:
<center>![1000019054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23xKtQpsaPk7LD8SnYjui6fgvzTSP7TdtQNureVVbruhpyRKjDyPk3yBuiJGXbx3Xtjah.jpg)</center>

### Abrasoles amigos usuarios de @holos-lotus. 

Un día aprendí que soltar las uniones al pasado que atormenta no es realmente olvidar lo que vivimos. No es olvidar ese viejo dolor, ni menos traerlo al presente que vivimos; más bien es anotar en el libro interno de la mente que, tras esa prueba que aún no se comprende, aprendimos una valiosa enseñanza que en aquel momento no vimos ni notamos.

​Aquellas vivencias estrepitosas, desconcertantes, con lágrimas, enojos, furia y hasta rencor, estaban ahí por algo. Y siendo sincera, hasta ahora no sé por qué, pero de algo sí estoy segura: y es que con esos dolores pasados pude sortear mejor lo que venía.

​Entonces, con la vida calmada, con un ritmo distinto, miré a la vida misma como un entrenador que jamás duerme; y hasta a veces pareciera ser una directora cinematográfica dándonos diversos papeles en esta película imaginaria que realmente existe.
​Para cuando logramos darnos cuenta de esta analogía, que quizás suene poética y surrealista, es que logramos ver cómo la confusión se disipa como el humo del asado del día domingo en familia: ese que sube al comienzo fuerte, oscuro, para pasar a ponerse blanco y casi traslúcido, llevando su aroma en el viento.

<center>![1000019056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23t78ngTkz4vXLfoiXDEveMB8xj6cqaebyfRw2LHbLN9pCwwXdx331QQ3opkW1xR7irpc.jpg)</center>


​Escribo sobre esto en esta tarde, tumbada en la cama, con la TV apagada, los sonidos de los juegos de mis hijas de fondo y sintiendo los pies de mi esposo en los míos propios, como un masaje de los que nos centra a la tierra para hacernos sentir seguros.
​A menudo nos dicen que \

, pero ¿es realmente así? Y ahí me digo que ese tiempo para todos es distinto, ya que cada quien se cura a su justo y debido momento.

<center>![1000019055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23z7QetFrLxoEczE7FXW8ZSJ3QxcgMFDv1jz5jPpPX3csLWmHsjZXHeJCWqaAjTRtufrd.jpg)</center> 

​Cuando me siento ante la hoja en blanco del nuevo pasaje de mi propia vida, no busco revivir lo viejo ni preguntar los porqués de todo; solo recuerdo a aquellos que ya no están, pero viven en mi corazón, sabiendo que cada uno de ellos me dejó un legado de fuerza y amor.

​Observo entonces que recordar ya no duele, que sobreviví a esos dolores que enfrenté sin saber cómo; porque aquella que lloró hasta quedarse dormida y gritó al cielo sin tener respuestas, siguió caminando hasta encontrar la luz en ese camino que, por un tiempo, estuvo oscuro.

​Allá atrás quedó esa parte de la que aprendí, tomando más fuerza y más valor interno. Porque esas sombras que tiñeron ese pasado no lo hicieron por maldad; esa intensidad de saber que la tierra se derrumba a mis pies fue la que me enseñó a saltar como gacela a un lugar más alto, buscando mi propio resguardo.

<center>![1000019053.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23wgUDgPPiWFris5LA8i7UKKYU9DD7zDRVhoBVpgdC1gwssarHyZfTgzsofbQpyvic1CD.jpg)</center> 

​A veces me han preguntado cómo lo aguanté, cómo logras calmarte tras la tormenta. No tengo una respuesta clara o certera, ni menos una varita mágica que acabe con ese dolor; solo sé que se empieza dejando de pelear y aceptando que, en esta vida, todo tiene un ***extraño porqué.***
***
### <center>English</center>
***
<center>![1000019054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23xKtQpsaPk7LD8SnYjui6fgvzTSP7TdtQNureVVbruhpyRKjDyPk3yBuiJGXbx3Xtjah.jpg)</center>

### Dear friends and users of @holos-lotus.

One day I learned that letting go of the ties to the past that torment us does not really mean forgetting what we have experienced. It is not forgetting that old pain, nor bringing it into the present we live in; rather, it is noting in the internal book of the mind that, after that trial that is still not understood, we learned a valuable lesson that we did not see or notice at the time.

Those tumultuous, disconcerting experiences, with tears, anger, rage and even resentment, were there for a reason. And to be honest, I still don't know why, but I am sure of one thing: with those past pains, I was able to better navigate what was to come.

So, with life calmer, with a different rhythm, I looked at life itself as a coach who never sleeps; and sometimes it even seems like a film director giving us different roles in this imaginary film that really exists.
By the time we realise this analogy, which may sound poetic and surreal, we can see how the confusion dissipates like the smoke from a Sunday family barbecue: the smoke that rises strong and dark at first, then turns white and almost translucent, carrying its aroma on the wind.

<center>![1000019056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23t78ngTkz4vXLfoiXDEveMB8xj6cqaebyfRw2LHbLN9pCwwXdx331QQ3opkW1xR7irpc.jpg)</center> 

I write about this on this afternoon, lying in bed, with the TV off, the sounds of my daughters playing in the background and feeling my husband's feet on my own, like a massage that grounds us and makes us feel safe.
We are often told that \

, but is this really the case? And then I tell myself that time is different for everyone, as each person heals at their own right and proper time.

<center>![1000019055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23z7QetFrLxoEczE7FXW8ZSJ3QxcgMFDv1jz5jPpPX3csLWmHsjZXHeJCWqaAjTRtufrd.jpg)</center> 

When I sit down in front of the blank page of the new chapter of my own life, I don't seek to relive the old or ask why everything happened; I just remember those who are no longer here but live on in my heart, knowing that each of them left me a legacy of strength and love.

I realise then that remembering no longer hurts, that I survived those pains I faced without knowing how; because the one who cried herself to sleep and cried out to the heavens without answers kept walking until she found the light on that path that, for a time, was dark.

That part of me is now behind me, and I have learned from it, gaining more strength and inner courage. Because those shadows that coloured my past did not do so out of malice; it was the intensity of knowing that the earth was crumbling beneath my feet that taught me to leap like a gazelle to a higher place, seeking my own refuge.

<center>![1000019053.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23wgUDgPPiWFris5LA8i7UKKYU9DD7zDRVhoBVpgdC1gwssarHyZfTgzsofbQpyvic1CD.jpg)</center> 

Sometimes people have asked me how I endured it, how I managed to calm down after the storm. I don't have a clear or accurate answer, let alone a magic wand that will end that pain; I only know that it starts by stopping fighting and accepting that, in this life, everything has a ***Strange reason.***
***
<center>![1000009838.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23tbikLyE8Cv6ctyG8KyiR6HZ7Hd2JSAq7evbE5rrDfvjuHR5TcPBY4D8Jy2bToBZP5R4.png)</center>

body.title: Sailing Dreams in the Caribbean – A Peaceful Morning at Playa Ancón
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP5fBs5fDPGwVRDi4Uuew8ECuoaXeSfZitXBTCgUsRBUB/1773031296176.jpg)

On the peaceful coast of Playa Ancón, time seems to move more slowly. The soft, white sand stretches like a natural carpet along the shore, while the calm water reflects the deep blue of the Caribbean sky. Two sailboats rest gently on the beach, their tall sails waiting for the wind, as if ready to tell stories of journeys and distant horizons. ⛵🌊

In the distance, the mountains draw a soft silhouette on the horizon, reminding us that this corner of the world holds a quiet and authentic beauty. Near the boats, a few people talk and prepare to sail, while the warm breeze slowly moves the sails and the sound of the sea accompanies every moment.

Playa Ancón is not just a place; it is a feeling. It is the calm of a bright morning, the salty scent of the sea, and the silent promise of adventures that begin where the sand meets the water. Here, every moment becomes a memory written between the sky, the sea, and the freedom of the Caribbean. 🌴✨
