body.title: ANNA PLAYED IN THE VOLLEYBALL FINAL INJURED [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
![InCollage_20260310_195025983.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/AJoHdd2LsavDKLS6EZHTd28y7fKksZTgqJ7q2KkqVZ3d2kuTb57mvHjADq4xnjQ.jpg)


***
### <Center>ESPAÑOL</Center>
***

Saludos a todos los que hacen vida en esta comunidad, en esta oportunidad paso por acá a relatarles que mi hija llegó a la final del torneo municipal de voleibol, su categoría fue la única en clasificar, así que toda la escuela, en conjunto con los representantes y las demás jugadoras habían quedado de acuerdo en ir para apoyar. 

La fecha más esperada para el evento salió, era el día sábado 7 de marzo, así que todos estábamos ansiosos de que ese día llegara. 

Anna Paula, mi hija, se había preparado en cada uno de los entrenamientos, prestaba atención, los saques le salían increíbles, recibía el balón de buena manera, realmente habían trabajado muy bien como equipo para estar listas y enfrentar a su rival en esa final. 


![marsMarsterpiece7352748.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23xyV9LrtLDfk9Bem2omPNoBbkVvU7yabAucQLeNK2n48aoWUDZ5ta4SUpwwfE71XEuqS.gif)

![marsMarsterpiece3412672.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23yJBuUjgJAFabBw9Hf6n8WXUEEoDw7pFV9Vti8NtHJf3tLgrNqNYpdktpiqdm2fg1K2t.gif)


Practicaron toda la semana, todos los días y el día jueves informaron que todas las atletas debían descansar el viernes para que el día del evento estuviesen bien. 

Pues el día de descanso llegó, Anna Paula no iba a practicar, se fue a su escuela y en la tarde descansaría... 

Pues todo cambió, cuando el papá la busca en la escuela le informan que la niña se había caído cuando estaba haciendo educación física y que se había lastimado el pie, cuando me van A buscar en mi trabajo, que ella me empieza a relatar lo que le pasó y aunado a ello me dice que le duele el pie, pues me asusté. 

Le dije que se quitara el zapato y que sentada esperara allí por 10 minutos, paso justo lo que pensé, el tobillo se le inflamó, de inmediato llamé a su instructor y le comenté la situación, enseguida habló con unos contactos y consiguió para hacerle una radiografía. 


![IMG_20260306_130545.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23xAZzJcLwwtZfqe4gJ23EhB9e8N72PV69a7rRYUra1iCzMQF6iKE8QjyDFcdK5u3TL96.jpg)

![IMG_20260306_130553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23zGafhzhhLNYWw3n1kJZ8A5sgv7NEtqcgA3cssX5LwD6tCRenU4wTgGScCDsBmNYVybm.jpg)

![IMG_20260306_140438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23tmDE7ngCDDNqP94BdBVmVWf7eY8nxqoYc91puqNnZ8n4J4mfPL5x6fVL2XfrNhSDo3P.jpg)


Apenas salimos de allí la lleve al hospital, la vio el traumatólogo, el diagnóstico fue solo un golpe que no llegó ni a fractura ni a esguince, gracias a Dios, le mando un analgésico y a guardar reposo, pero llegó la pregunta más importante: 

### PODRÁ JUGAR MAÑANA???

La respuesta fue que no debería, pero de hacerlo debía estar de reposo lo que quedaba de día y al jugar que lo hiciera con una tobillera. 

Pues el gran día llegó, Anna Paula Jugó, poco pero lo hizo, sus profesores no quisieron que forzará el pie, prefirieron que se recuperará del todo y, aunque no ganaron quedaron como subcampeona, 2do. Lugar. 


![IMG_20260307_115248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23yJ7wwvUqQVXGRh9bn1VQDmES3gK5vwcehWH64zMbybczdpe1HCPDx2NfmFizjd2URqr.jpg)

![IMG_20260307_121029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23xVF4fyE6NXm52cZTzsysbwMBLXtFE1u1tn83mrY5FPZFuh2VHZYTFrCieaF4SPysyGT.jpg)

![IMG_20260307_103814.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23vsQpvo8wyyMQS6q3zGM2d3KrWzG6E7a8tPAuM3NULhrtXc18qTmYV39w6yb6C7ZekCH.jpg)


A pesar de llorar mucho por no poder jugar de manera completa, entendió y comprendió que ya es un atleta y debe comportarse como tal, antes de correr y saltar libremente debe pensar en su equipo y en cuidarse cada extremidad de su cuerpo para que siga avanzando en su deporte favorito. 


![IMG_20260307_144619_1772978416419.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23xAeRCVYWwgReKdGpyhhs3P5Gugijz5MsJJJeK16ujp4qqXMEGqbtUWAkwr5smqMfWNt.jpg)

![IMG_20260307_144634.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23yTd3zDbosvSPadHYLaoYUtiPkEX1rStVbc9CHrnF83dStZoZmSTUHFzwBUat5m5EvGN.jpg)

![IMG_20260307_144345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23wqiH8gmKduFMX6i8mnHCr3pi4LQiD3ydUY2Z8nVhv7kFtfFWEXhHpWyrZc4zNYrqAZr.jpg)


### Gracias por leer parte de mi, les envío un abrazo cargado de bendiciones. 

***
### <Center>ENGLISH</Center>
***

Greetings to everyone in this community. I'm writing to tell you that my daughter made it to the finals of the municipal volleyball tournament. Her category was the only one to qualify, so the whole school, along with the representatives and the other players, agreed to go and support her. 

The long-awaited date for the event was Saturday, March 7, so we were all eagerly awaiting that day. 

My daughter, Anna Paula, had prepared herself in every training session. She paid attention, her serves were incredible, she received the ball well. They had really worked very well as a team to be ready to face their rivals in the final. 

![marsMarsterpiece7352748.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23xyV9LrtLDfk9Bem2omPNoBbkVvU7yabAucQLeNK2n48aoWUDZ5ta4SUpwwfE71XEuqS.gif)

![marsMarsterpiece3412672.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23yJBuUjgJAFabBw9Hf6n8WXUEEoDw7pFV9Vti8NtHJf3tLgrNqNYpdktpiqdm2fg1K2t.gif)

They practiced all week, every day, and on Thursday they were told that all the athletes had to rest on Friday so that they would be in good shape for the day of the event. 

Well, the day of rest arrived, Anna Paula wasn't going to practice, she went to school and in the afternoon she would rest... 

Well, everything changed when her dad went to pick her up from school and was told that she had fallen during physical education class and hurt her foot. When they came to pick me up from work, she started telling me what had happened and also said that her foot hurt, which scared me. 

I told her to take off her shoe and sit there for 10 minutes. Just as I thought, her ankle swelled up. I immediately called her instructor and explained the situation. He quickly spoke to some contacts and arranged for her to have an X-ray. 

![IMG_20260306_130545.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23xAZzJcLwwtZfqe4gJ23EhB9e8N72PV69a7rRYUra1iCzMQF6iKE8QjyDFcdK5u3TL96.jpg)

![IMG_20260306_130553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23zGafhzhhLNYWw3n1kJZ8A5sgv7NEtqcgA3cssX5LwD6tCRenU4wTgGScCDsBmNYVybm.jpg)

![IMG_20260306_140438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23tmDE7ngCDDNqP94BdBVmVWf7eY8nxqoYc91puqNnZ8n4J4mfPL5x6fVL2XfrNhSDo3P.jpg)

As soon as we left there, I took her to the hospital. The orthopedist examined her and diagnosed it as just a bruise, not a fracture or sprain, thank God. He prescribed painkillers and rest, but then came the most important question: 

### WILL SHE BE ABLE TO PLAY TOMORROW???

The answer was that she shouldn't, but if she did, she should rest for the rest of the day and wear an ankle brace when playing. 


Well, the big day arrived. Anna Paula played a little, but she did play. Her coaches didn't want her to strain her foot; they preferred that she recover completely. Although they didn't win, they finished as runners-up, in second place. 

![IMG_20260307_115248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23yJ7wwvUqQVXGRh9bn1VQDmES3gK5vwcehWH64zMbybczdpe1HCPDx2NfmFizjd2URqr.jpg)

![IMG_20260307_121029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23xVF4fyE6NXm52cZTzsysbwMBLXtFE1u1tn83mrY5FPZFuh2VHZYTFrCieaF4SPysyGT.jpg)

![IMG_20260307_103814.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23vsQpvo8wyyMQS6q3zGM2d3KrWzG6E7a8tPAuM3NULhrtXc18qTmYV39w6yb6C7ZekCH.jpg)

Despite crying a lot because she couldn't play the whole game, she understood that she is now an athlete and must behave as such. Before running and jumping freely, she must think about her team and take care of every limb of her body so that she can continue to advance in her favorite sport. 

![IMG_20260307_144619_1772978416419.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23xAeRCVYWwgReKdGpyhhs3P5Gugijz5MsJJJeK16ujp4qqXMEGqbtUWAkwr5smqMfWNt.jpg)

![IMG_20260307_144634.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23yTd3zDbosvSPadHYLaoYUtiPkEX1rStVbc9CHrnF83dStZoZmSTUHFzwBUat5m5EvGN.jpg)

![IMG_20260307_144345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hexagono6/23wqiH8gmKduFMX6i8mnHCr3pi4LQiD3ydUY2Z8nVhv7kFtfFWEXhHpWyrZc4zNYrqAZr.jpg)

### Thank you for reading part of my story. I send you a hug filled with blessings.

body.title: Creating a better future with tech.
body.body:
![_MG_7590.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mcsamm/23uQtiRW6ougiTiwjMS6KcYQAyE5F6cJroRmN3KKmD1JPDGJ88XmBa6wkyEJURVRyALyY.jpg)


The Hive Tech Conference in Ghana was more than a group of technology lovers. It was an opportunity for young minds looking to learn, grow, and be part of creating a better future. As I walked into the venue, I could sense the excitement and curiosity in the air. Developers, artists, entrepreneurs, and blockchain enthusiasts from all walks of life were coming together to support each other in using technology to empower themselves and their communities.

One of the things that impressed me the most about the conference was the sheer number of young people at the event. Young people came with incredible skills and innovative ideas and were excited to find ways in which emerging technologies would allow them to tap into new opportunities. Seeing students, developers, and digital creators sharing their ideas and thinking about how technology, particularly blockchain, can open up pathways for economic empowerment and social impact in Ghana and beyond was truly inspiring.

The conference sessions were full of interesting discussions and examples of project creation and implementation. Speakers discussed their experiences with building projects, navigating the digital economy, and using blockchain tools to develop solutions. This sparked meaningful conversations and dialogue amongst the participants, and many had never considered the possibilities of decentralised technology before. The collaborative and learning environment created during the conference inspired creativity, collaboration, and bold thinking.


![_MG_7613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mcsamm/23xAc3oeZS5EChXP7Vkn7Bm8sgkLVuc7qonLcvrXioJEaQoLmj3eoBeBWG5sWSred3Jno.jpg)


It was the informal networking that occurred throughout the conference that was one of the most memorable parts of the experience. Groups naturally developed as the participants met to share their ideas, exchange contact information, and even make plans for potential collaborations. Clearly, this was not just an event where the participants listened to speakers. It was an event where relationships were built and a community of innovators who are ready to collaborate on projects was established.

What stood out the most was the passion of the young attendees. Many of them spoke about their desire to use their skills for both personal and societal growth. They wanted to use their skills to develop digital tools, promote blockchain education, and help improve their communities, and this demonstrated to me that technology has the potential to be a transformative force in society if it is put in the right hands.


![_MG_7921.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mcsamm/23xyXHCB3xa5E6PRY11tAbVVLMeVTCsoWxDrqUs7ZAFipCuwZL1WFYLx84HLQbSPTqYNd.jpg)


When the conference finally closed, it did more than leave behind memories. It left behind inspiration and a renewed commitment to creating positive change in their lives and in the lives of others. The Hive blockchain ecosystem continues to demonstrate that technology is not only about innovation, but it is also about people. When young people with talent and a shared purpose come together, they form a community that is capable of developing solutions that empower individuals and contribute positively to society.

title.title: As a Physician, I Tell My Patients to Avoid Kamagra Gold in the United States
title.body: >As a physician, I understand why products like <a target=\

>Kamagra Gold￼ attract attention. Men see a familiar promise, a lower price, and easy online access. On the surface, it can look like a practical alternative. In reality, in the United States, Kamagra Gold and many related “Kamagra” products fall outside the

>FDA-approved system that exists to verify a drug’s safety, effectiveness, quality, manufacturing consistency, labeling, and legal distribution. That is the first point I want the public to understand: “not FDA-approved” is not a minor technicality. It means the product has not gone through the same U.S. review and oversight process that approved prescription sildenafil products must meet.

>

When patients ask me why FDA approval matters, I give a simple answer. Approval is not just about whether an ingredient can work. It is also about whether the tablet contains the right drug, at the right dose, with the right purity, under the right manufacturing standards, with the right warnings, contraindications, and prescribing controls. FDA-approved sildenafil products are evaluated and labeled with specific dosing guidance, including lower starting doses for some older adults and for certain patients with liver or kidney impairment. That kind of controlled framework is exactly what becomes uncertain when people purchase non-approved erectile dysfunction products from outside legitimate U.S. pharmacy channels. ￼ The concern is not theoretical. FDA has repeatedly warned consumers that unapproved erectile dysfunction products sold through unsafe or unlicensed channels may be counterfeit, contaminated, improperly stored, improperly transported, ineffective, or otherwise unsafe. FDA also continues to post warning letters and public safety notices related to unsafe online pharmacy activity and unlawful internet sales of prescription medicines. In other words, the agency’s position is not vague: these products can put consumers at real risk. ￼ Another major issue is hidden or inconsistent active ingredients. FDA has issued many public notifications and recall notices involving sexual-enhancement products found to contain undeclared sildenafil, tadalafil, or both. In several cases, the agency specifically noted that the presence of these drug ingredients turned the products into unapproved drugs whose safety and efficacy had not been established in that form. That pattern matters because it shows a broader market problem: sexual-enhancement products sold outside regulated prescription channels are a category FDA watches closely for hidden pharmaceuticals and unreliable quality control. ￼ This is where the discussion becomes especially important for the general public. Many people assume that if a product “works,” it must be acceptable. Medicine does not work that way. A pill may appear effective and still be dangerous. Sildenafil can interact with nitrates, such as nitroglycerin, and may cause blood pressure to drop to dangerous levels. FDA repeats this warning across multiple safety notices involving undeclared sildenafil. That risk is especially relevant because the same population seeking erectile dysfunction treatment may also have high blood pressure, diabetes, high cholesterol, or heart disease. A patient may believe he is buying a simple sexual-performance product, while in reality he may be taking a prescription-level drug without appropriate screening. ￼ Patients also need to understand why the phrase “FDA-approved sildenafil” is very different from “[Kamagra is basically sildenafil](https://ecency.com/kamagra/@henrymd/ready-in-a-flash-the).” Yes, sildenafil itself is an FDA-approved active ingredient in certain prescription products. But that does not mean every tablet sold online that claims to contain sildenafil is legal, equivalent, properly dosed, or safe in the United States. FDA’s approval attaches to specific products made and distributed under specific regulatory controls. Once a consumer steps outside that system, the reassurance provided by approval no longer travels with the pill. ￼ This is also why I advise patients to be cautious about articles or promotions that normalize “regular Kamagra” as just another casual option. Even if the branding looks familiar, FDA’s broader enforcement history around unsafe online pharmacies and unapproved imported prescription drugs should give consumers pause. The agency’s BeSafeRx materials specifically warn that many internet-based pharmacies claiming to offer discounted prescription drugs may sell unapproved, counterfeit, or otherwise unsafe medicines and may do so without requiring a valid prescription. ￼ For readers who want context on how the product is commonly discussed online, some people still encounter the standard Kamagra conversation through pages such as this overview of regular Kamagra￼. My medical view is more cautious. I do not judge patients for looking for affordable treatment. I do, however, believe patients deserve honesty: when you buy a non-FDA-approved erectile dysfunction product in the U.S. market, you are accepting uncertainty that may involve identity, dose, handling, legality, and clinical safety. That is not a trivial gamble for a medication that can affect blood pressure and interacts with other drugs. ￼ The safer message is straightforward. If erectile dysfunction treatment is appropriate, patients in the United States have FDA-approved options that can be prescribed through licensed clinicians and dispensed by legitimate pharmacies. That route is less exciting than a flashy online product page, but it gives patients something far more valuable than convenience: accountability. You know what drug you are taking, how much you are taking, what the risks are, and whether it is appropriate for your medical history. That is the standard I want my patients to rely on. ￼ My bottom line as a physician is simple: I would not recommend Kamagra Gold or similar Kamagra products for use in the United States. The reason is not ideology or brand loyalty. The reason is that FDA approval, legal distribution, manufacturing oversight, and prescription review exist to reduce preventable harm. Once those protections are removed, the patient absorbs the risk. And in medicine, especially when the drug may affect the cardiovascular system, that is a risk I do not consider acceptable. ￼

title.title: (ENG/ESP) 🎨🎁😇😈 Decorating a gift bag with a \
game theme, using paints / Decorando una bolsa de regalo con temática del juego \
, utilizando pinturas 🎨🎁
title.body:
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello to all members of this community and craft lovers! This time, I'd like to show you a way to make your gifts more special. If what you're giving has a specific theme or character, it's nice if the box or bag it comes in also matches that theme; that way, the wrapping paper becomes something they'll want to keep.
![1000378186.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23x1HuCnTYgtpDGZ8uBJHJFDYQ5tRokKTXQdTUKeDQGHnNfj1zJTroJhe3CeaLTaDEZ39.jpg)

The characters I based the gift on are from the game *Summoners War*. They're colorful little balls with angel or demon wings. There are lots of cool characters in the game, but these are especially adorable.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/242DdNBTTgPW9B7FC6tWGWWtf4d2Wenf8b53B2zhCGkivRNLM671SjH4vFgFKazoMVd6G.png)
[Image source](https://com2ustore.com/products/summoners-war-mid-sized-angelmon-plushie?srsltid=AfmBOop1JgrGUItBwdfrMgn3VapDB9TG53Qu3nidl2W-gp2-3bp506zP)

One of my motivations for painting the bag was that it had a small flaw. It was a gift bag I was recycling, haha, and when someone removed a ribbon, the bag ended up with a small piece missing. Instead of gluing on a new ribbon, I thought it would be better to cover the imperfection with paint. So, I drew the shapes of the characters in pencil and painted them with acrylic paints. Finally, I reattached the handles I had removed during the painting process.
|![1000378065.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wgRzVAs8j7fqkSGf4RGiRpoDPQWKJyDuZMfK4pneYwdrHZG7rhaR4dHUXpMv648UvGQ.jpg)|![1000378068.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wgMv9tP2eXXbAro7yovjdF8L8qvbXEifqXkJUaMdutThdLPG7tBvfohNWshiKrRfEFe.jpg)|![1000378069.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wWvxPCm3rT9oH3iqAZ8SnPteq1MRGAeLadrxivCmbCBXHkwcHTpY19Thp38SeZu1TCF.jpg)| |-|-|-|
I outlined the drawings with black acrylic paint, but if you're not confident in your hand-eye coordination, you can also use a fine-tipped black marker. For the background, simply add some stars and dots. The result is simple yet very pretty.
|![1000378070.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eos1n5TQefS7hDKnwNgT5thdokNkNByMaVc98eKBaN6j5qNZhrwpKYLxqPzs5jkzZyh.jpg)|![1000378071.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xKvVoAqeo4GF6mNRmk1RcKZ7Sg7qKgsMGbVoGVjmKHZUQEguVNg8uQ3j5oxZTLrEsCw.jpg)|![1000378072.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wX11WMRoTBJ8L1BsAetyejJdZVjmZqJkBEe2SXUhMvbBZwuGYzbNMAV5omJDEwj7N47.jpg)| |-|-|-|
It's a relaxing process for us, and I'm sure it will end up surprising whoever receives it, because there are designs that you can't find on the market.
|![1000378080.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/241tfFNauvCs59yYhv48A1PmPcJDhkDXFSbz9EDnnM3q4EvmEXPTFxUdB9ZxXbTTMzGnk.jpg)|![1000378079.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/241tfho2Y66hDktZtCcZWjHL6u9XHVb9qwe69NPt5tJ6FaEuXRnSWVN48cxrw2Xadh7LY.jpg)| |-|-|
As for the gift, I made a sleep mask based on a *Devilmon*, among other things I sewed, so I know the birthday boy will love it from the first moment 💙 If you'd like to make this type of sleep mask, I made a [post ](https://peakd.com/hive-127911/@suezoe/engesp-ideal-for-using-scraps-sleep-masks-ideal-para-usar-retazos-antifaces-para-dormir) about it 😌
![1000378078.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eq38bDYc7j8FGSQkg9QSP73gH7vjHHb5aJdWP4qMm61TiWiakWAvrmuR89VGyHLV3NV.jpg)
As you can see, with just a few materials and a little imagination, you can transform a simple gift bag into something truly original. Next time you give a gift, see if you can customize the wrapping! ✨
If you'd like to see what other Summoners War items I've created, you can do so through the following links:
[😈 Devilmon plush 😈](https://peakd.com/hive-127911/@suezoe/engesp-making-a-plush-devilmon-of-the-game-summoners-war-haciendo-un-peluche-devilmon-del-juego-summoners-war) [✨ Special chest ✨](https://peakd.com/hive-189641/@suezoe/engesp-crafting-a-chest-based-on-the-game-summoners-war-fabricando-un-cofre-basado-en-el-juego-summoners-war) [😇 Angelmon mini plushies 😇](https://peakd.com/hive-189641/@suezoe/engesp-making-some-angelmon-plushies-characters-from-the-game-summoners-war-haciendo-unos-peluches-de-angelmon-personaje)
### ✨ Thank you so much for visiting my post. I hope you found it interesting ✨
![Sticker-hive-corazon.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK9NaQU9qAXpj3XHfJuFuP51PDfBfP12X98dVmWTSaPTVoR2n7vaDfz6sXhAE49.gif)

#
💚 Until next time! 💚

![Separador.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ydCKUob6Veoru2WkSHzGEJYsVaCtXW1faq9AvNDGGoHQ7EK3BnMYaWz3Kvh37TGkuVa.jpg)
#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad y amantes de las manualidades! En esta ocasión, me gustaría mostrarles una forma de hacer que sus regalos sean más especiales. Si lo que van a regalar, es de alguna temática o personaje en específico, es lindo que la caja o bolsa en donde se entregue, también sea de lo mismo; de ese modo, el envoltorio también sería algo que se desee guardar.
![1000378186.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23x1HuCnTYgtpDGZ8uBJHJFDYQ5tRokKTXQdTUKeDQGHnNfj1zJTroJhe3CeaLTaDEZ39.jpg)

Los personajes en los que me basé para hacer el regalo, provienen del juego *Summoners War*, los cuales son una especies de bolitas coloridas con alas de ángel o de demonio. En el juego hay muchos personajes geniales, pero estos son bastante adorables.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/242DdNBTTgPW9B7FC6tWGWWtf4d2Wenf8b53B2zhCGkivRNLM671SjH4vFgFKazoMVd6G.png)
[Fuente de la imagen](https://com2ustore.com/products/summoners-war-mid-sized-angelmon-plushie?srsltid=AfmBOop1JgrGUItBwdfrMgn3VapDB9TG53Qu3nidl2W-gp2-3bp506zP)

Una de mis motivaciones para hacer el dibujo en la bolsa, era porque la misma tenía un pequeño defecto, pues se trataba de una bolsa de regalo que estaba reciclando jaja cuando le quitaron un lazo que tenía, la bolsa acabó con un pedacito faltante. En lugar de pegarle un nuevo lazo, pensé en mejor tapar esa imperfección con la pintura. De esa forma, dibujé las formas de los personajes con lápiz y los pinté con pinturas acrílicas. Finalmente, coloqué las asas que había retirado durante el proceso de pintado.
|![1000378065.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wgRzVAs8j7fqkSGf4RGiRpoDPQWKJyDuZMfK4pneYwdrHZG7rhaR4dHUXpMv648UvGQ.jpg)|![1000378068.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wgMv9tP2eXXbAro7yovjdF8L8qvbXEifqXkJUaMdutThdLPG7tBvfohNWshiKrRfEFe.jpg)|![1000378069.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wWvxPCm3rT9oH3iqAZ8SnPteq1MRGAeLadrxivCmbCBXHkwcHTpY19Thp38SeZu1TCF.jpg)| |-|-|-|
Yo delineé los dibujos con pintura acrílica negra, pero si no confiamos en nuestro pulso, se puede usar también un marcador punta fina de color negro y para el fondo, basta con hacer algunas estrellas y puntos. El resultado es sencillo pero muy bonito.
|![1000378070.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eos1n5TQefS7hDKnwNgT5thdokNkNByMaVc98eKBaN6j5qNZhrwpKYLxqPzs5jkzZyh.jpg)|![1000378071.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xKvVoAqeo4GF6mNRmk1RcKZ7Sg7qKgsMGbVoGVjmKHZUQEguVNg8uQ3j5oxZTLrEsCw.jpg)|![1000378072.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wX11WMRoTBJ8L1BsAetyejJdZVjmZqJkBEe2SXUhMvbBZwuGYzbNMAV5omJDEwj7N47.jpg)| |-|-|-|
Es un proceso relajante para nosotros y estoy segura que acabará por sorprender a quién lo reciba, pues hay diseños que no se consiguen en el mercado.
|![1000378080.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/241tfFNauvCs59yYhv48A1PmPcJDhkDXFSbz9EDnnM3q4EvmEXPTFxUdB9ZxXbTTMzGnk.jpg)|![1000378079.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/241tfho2Y66hDktZtCcZWjHL6u9XHVb9qwe69NPt5tJ6FaEuXRnSWVN48cxrw2Xadh7LY.jpg)| |-|-|

title.title: Mr Money With The Vibe
title.body:
![17731860716952172482085071295021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/AL7PPrU7AbaRT9cZTwoz8SL7nuekmABwnTL3uc42U66nvT8SYxdwRQUGd8WeLA5.jpg)
***
Mr Money with the Vibe, the first studio album of Asake which over time became his mantra is one that I've heard multiple times across the street of Nigeria.
Asake has always been a versatile artist. One that  can have the same fast paced vibe of Burna Boy and then the slow paced retro vibe of Wizkid.
I always knew he was a good artist, but I didn't listen to him much, nor know he had such a loaded discography.
At least not until I saw this yesterday...
https://youtu.be/lIp-OwMozKI?si=wH4_VRNIF0PelJ3-

> I'm a simple man.. I like what I like..
Et al Seki, 2026

And I have to say that I loved this show. The performance was beautiful. The execution was marvelous and the music was just magical.
One hour and nineteen minutes of vibes and fun and you can see it radiate on everyone. The crowd, the guest artists, the instrumentalists and Asake himself.

I watched the performance yesterday, and I have to say that close to 24 hours later, I'm still feeling the vibes.
So we have new tunes for you all today all from the Red Bull Symphonic!

### Sungba ~ Asake ft Burnaboy
This is one song of Asake that I did actually know of before hearing it again in the symphonic.
I remember it being such a blast and Burna's part just being crazy. 
https://youtu.be/7WU__JQuB8g?si=Mh-xhBm3aCVj0ZpH
It was a shame that Burna didn't show in the symphonic but still, the performance by Asake was crazy.
https://youtu.be/T10Uo3La-us?si=l9x3ZX1cIDlgS06X
***
### MMS ~ Asake ft Wizkid
***
The screams at this part was incredible, most likely because Wizkid showed up but I'd like to believe it's because of how beautiful the song was and just how great their voices rhymed for it.
https://youtu.be/iiOHqmmjdGk?si=GrIQf9S8fMxJaTwu
Yes, clearly they used auto tune but the dynamic, the vybes and the flows, you'd know that these are two artists who genuinely love working together.
https://youtu.be/OhkqYbrv7_k?si=DLoD3DxrFvqOYDfE
***
### Peace Be Unto You (PBUY) ~ Asake
***
This was the ending song of the event and it was the one where everybody had the most fun.
https://youtu.be/MefXQvGTYtE?si=Sx5V1N1gZUURKNrE
A fast tracked song from his first album. One that made waves throughout Nigeria and now, I'm sure it's in the head of a few New Yorkers too😂✨❤️
https://youtu.be/-SOe-2NTVXc?si=1WRWw6CVFZWBTy5O
***
***
This Red Bull Symphonic concert with Asake really made my day yesterday as I've begun to lose faith with Nigeria as a country.

Everyday we learn more and more of how our government leaders are failing us, how we are backwards in so many things is no longer a shock, no longer a joke at international lobbies/chats, but more of a means of pity and contempt.
Regardless, if all we have is music, we can boast that it's one of, if not the best in the world😂❤️🔥🇳🇬

@ablaze, how are these tunes in your ears?
These are what I've chosen for #threetunestuesday..

So my fellow readers/listeners...

#### Which is your best?

***
![EoEo5nvDHnUht8Gw4ryE7E9nS23HoHWmGygWc5fXjaGo3xSgiSRM3P8oRKvot13tG7P.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/seki1/EoEjKvABBjsvH2ZREKrtzRoQZ8ywRcjHtb5BJHvFYqW9vgfgY4brv1LhNaMP1KHiKmz.webp)

title.title: Under Harsh Light
title.body:
Actually, I want to take some great photos with my son's toy. This one is actually a beat-up car toy that is usually used; sometimes he could be so rough on this toy, as you can see some of the damage this car has received. And maybe because the quality (very rarely I have a great toy), somehow this car is still intact, at least it can still be used. heheh Ok back to the photo session, while I was assembling my macro gear, I notice that my diffuser is nowhere to be found. I was already a forgetful person lately, and it took me quite a while to try to find it, but still no result. So instead of going for smooth lighting, with the diffuser, I want to improvise with the harsh light from the direct flash, without a diffuser. And here are the results from the photo session. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUaEM9MVygLHYhJdDcHLZ1xrFyN8A5Yv8652vinev67LK/p1010002.jpg) ![separator2.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZMa7EifqXSjKGqGjSzs4d9eNGjhV129o5S1XYGh2hUVQ/separator2.png) The result is rather harsh, as the harsh light and the contrast between those who are under the light and those who fall into the shadow is so great. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSh4tU1hfyiZn9Y4BxwzBeWKGKqkZ1ezY868SJ7PZHEKg/p1010003.jpg) ![separator2.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZMa7EifqXSjKGqGjSzs4d9eNGjhV129o5S1XYGh2hUVQ/separator2.png) A lesson learned that next time I should have put my diffuser in place so that it will be a lot easier for me to get it when I want to use it. but for now enjoy these harsh result from my recent photo session. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZwSfWamutw8WP9KhwtVAUtiFjTxoAKopAvDijtuLPWQj/p1010004.jpg) ![separator2.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZMa7EifqXSjKGqGjSzs4d9eNGjhV129o5S1XYGh2hUVQ/separator2.png) ||| | || |------------|------------| ------------| ------------| ------------| | Photo Style | Macro Photography || Accesory | 50 mm Canon lens + Adapter + Extention Tube | Location | Bali, Indonesia| |Lighting |External Flash| | Gear | Olympus OMD Em5 Mark ii | |Diffuser | none |

title.title: Review: Pacific Rim: The Black - The Post-Apocalyptic Surprise You Must See
title.body:
##
**Greetings, and welcome to all, anime lovers! 💗**
###
***Saludos, y bienvenidos a todos, amantes del anime! 💗***
---
![rytry36436.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessuses1381/23xAVbGLji43Wo8cCbNHtyVcoopZqm3yH4dtW2qLmDokFdWcMtCwVD39QxQZ7z1qxK74W.png)
Created with Canva Pro. [Image source](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/112162/images/posters?image_language=en&language=en-US)

---
Hello everyone! To my fellow Otakus, I hope you're doing super well today. On this occasion, I want to share my thoughts on an interesting series, but I have to tell you, at first, I was terrified of what Netflix might do, and well... today I'm talking about Pacific Rim: The Black. I mean, for me, Del Toro's original 2013 film is sacred, it's untouchable... it's the perfect mix of sci-fi, brawls between monsters and giant robots, and most importantly, it has a huge heart. So getting into this new anime felt like taking a big risk... but man, am I glad I did! First, let's get this out of the way, because I know it's the first thing you'll notice: the animation. It's by Polygon Pictures, the same studio that did Netflix's Godzilla trilogy, and if you've seen their work, you know what it's about... it's this 3D, this CG that sometimes feels a bit... stiff, right? And yes, when I started the first episode, my reaction was, \

\n\nI swear I was worried it would completely pull me out of the story, but let me tell you something: give it a chance. Stick with it for about twenty minutes. What am I saying, twenty minutes! Just get through the opening sequence! The mayhem at the beginning is so intense and focuses so much on the characters that you almost instantly forget that prejudice... at that point, the style starts to work in its favor... it immerses you completely in this incredible post-apocalyptic world: a desolate, sun-scorched Australian desert that feels utterly abandoned. And the way the vibrant colors of the kaijus pop against the gray of the destroyed cities... no, no, it's insane. In the end, you find yourself thinking, \

and you're all in.\n\n>Hola a todos! Amigos Otakus, espero que estén super bien hoy, en esta ocasión les quiero compartir mis opiniones sobre una serie interesante, pero debo decirles que al principio estaba muy asustado con lo que podía hacer Netflix, y bueno.. hoy les hablaré de Pacific Rim: The Black.. o sea, para mí la película original de Del Toro, la de 2013, es sagrada, es intocable.. es la mezcla perfecta de ciencia ficción, madrazos entre monstruos y robots gigantes y, lo más importante, tiene un corazón enorme. Así que entrarle a este nuevo anime se sentía como jugársela.. pero, ¡qué bueno que me animé! Primero, vamos a sacar esto del camino, porque sé que es lo primero que van a notar: la animación, es de Polygon Pictures, los mismos que hicieron la trilogía de Godzilla de Netflix, y si ya han visto algo de ellos, saben de qué va la cosa.. es este 3D, este CG que a veces se siente medio... tieso, ¿no? Y sí, cuando arranqué el primer capítulo, mi reacción fue de \

.. les juro que me preocupaba que eso me fuera a sacar por completo de la historia, pero, les digo algo: denle chance. Aguanten unos veinte minutos. ¡Qué veinte minutos! ¡Aguanten la secuencia de inicio! \n
El desmadre del principio es tan intenso y se enfoca tanto en los personajes, que ese prejuicio se te olvida casi al instante.. ahí, el estilo empieza a jugar a su favor.. te mete de lleno en este mundo postapocalíptico que es increíble: un desierto australiano desolado, quemado por el sol, que se siente totalmente abandonado. Y la forma en que los colores vibrantes de los kaijus revientan contra el gris de las ciudades destruidas... no, no, es una locura, al final, terminas pensando: \

, y ya estás adentro.


---

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessuses1381/23uQpGyXPFLfb23q7BAbUDKww2cyaWaCeC9idg6udJadcWMSeom2aMgb3WzSoJU8bzHrp.png)
</center><center>[Imagen Source](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/112162/images/backdrops?language=en-US)</center>

---

So, what's it about? Heads up, the series gives it a really clever twist. It's no longer about the mega military force fighting a war, but about what was left in the aftermath... of the chaos. The story follows two siblings, Taylor and Hayley Travis, who were stranded in a community in the middle of nowhere when their parents, who were Jaeger pilots, went out on a mission and... well, they never came back. They've been waiting for five LONG years. And one day, out of desperation, they stumble upon a training Jaeger that was just lying around... of course, turning that thing on is like setting off a giant flare to call every kaiju in the area, which causes chaos that forces them to flee and enter \

a huge, super dangerous, and lawless territory. Their journey isn't to save the world, not at all... it's a deeply personal quest to find their parents or, at the very least, a safe place to live.\n\nAnd here, folks, is where the series really shines... it's surprisingly dark and revolves entirely around its characters. I was honestly expecting something a bit more for kids, but boy, was I wrong! This series doesn't pull any punches in showing you how screwed up its world is. There's real danger, real consequences, and they don't hold back one bit in showing you violence or even death. You never feel like our heroes are winning; they are constantly, and barely, trying to survive... this creates a constant tension that hooks you and makes you hit \

without hesitation. You really grow to care for Taylor and Hayley, and their development is very well done... you connect with their motivations and feel the weight of the whole mess that's building up.\n\n>Bueno, ¿y de qué va la cosa? Ojo, que la serie le da un giro bien inteligente, ya no se trata de la mega fuerza militar peleando una guerra, sino de lo que quedó después.. del desmadre, la historia va de dos hermanos, Taylor y Hayley Travis, que se quedaron botados en una comunidad en medio de la nada cuando sus papás, que eran pilotos de Jaeger, salieron a una misión y… pues, nunca volvieron, llevan cinco LARGOS años esperando. Y un día, ya en la desesperada, se topan con un Jaeger de entrenamiento que estaba ahí arrumbado.. claro, prender esa cosa es como lanzar una bengala gigante para llamar a todos los kaijus de la zona, lo que provoca un caos que los obliga a huir y meterse a \

, un terreno enorme, súper peligroso y sin ley, su viaje no es para salvar el mundo, para nada.. es una búsqueda súper personal para encontrar a sus papás o, por lo menos, un lugar seguro donde vivir.
Y aquí, gente, es donde la serie se la rifa.. es sorprendentemente oscura y todo gira alrededor de sus personajes.. la verdad yo esperaba algo un poquito más para niños, pero ¡qué equivocado estaba! A esta serie no le tiembla la mano para mostrarte lo jodido que está su mundo, hay peligro real, consecuencias reales, y no se cortan ni un pelo en mostrarte violencia o incluso la muerte. Nunca sientes que nuestros héroes estén ganando; están todo el tiempo, y a duras penas, tratando de sobrevivir.. esto crea una tensión constante que te atrapa y te hace darle al siguiente episodio sin dudarlo, de verdad te encariñas con Taylor y Hayley, y su desarrollo está muy bueno.. conectas con lo que los mueve y sientes el peso que tienen en todo el lío que se va armando. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessuses1381/23z7LMBNBd1NDayAHkMiZqmko4w7guYdfxUaDBbNTLVDQQEozWkgTNP7ceXZ6y5zS79ku.png)
[Image Source](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/112162/images/backdrops?language=en-US)
--- But hey, let's talk about the real MVP, the one I did NOT see coming AT ALL: the Jaeger's artificial intelligence, named Loa. Look, in the movies, the Jaegers are incredible war machines, but they're just that—machines. But here, Loa gives her Jaeger, the Atlas Destroyer, a personality... she's the one who brings the humor, a super dry, kind of sharp wit that is fantastic. And what's more, she's FULL of fan service, dropping facts and references that will make any Pacific Rim fan smile. She manages to make the Jaeger feel like a third protagonist, a protector, a buddy. You end up caring about this hunk of metal because she gives it a soul... it's a decision by the writers that, wow, is super smart and works spectacularly. For those of us who love to dive deep into the lore, who love geeking out about how this universe works, they do something BRILLIANT with the Drift. You know, that neural connection that allows two pilots to merge to control a Jaeger... well, the series explores this concept in a way the movies never dared to touch. They introduce the idea that with the Drift, a pilot can \

so to speak, the skills and memories of other pilots they connect with. Imagine the potential of that, it's insane!\n\nA pilot with a strong enough mind could connect with a bunch of pro pilots and absorb their fighting techniques, their knowledge of weapons... everything! It's an epic, brutal expansion of the lore! And it also gives you a super badass and logical answer to something fans have always wondered: how could someone like Raleigh or Pentecost pilot a Jaeger alone? I'm not going to spoil the answer for you, but believe me, the way they resolve it is genius. Now, the series isn't perfect, okay? If I have to point out a \

it would be the development of the secondary characters... because look, Taylor and Hayley are super well-constructed, but the other characters that appear feel a bit... cardboard, flat. You're left wanting to know more about them, their past, why they do what they do, but the series, at least in this first season, just gives you glimpses. It's kind of a wasted opportunity, honestly, especially since the world they created is so interesting.\n\n>Pero ojo, vamos a hablar de la verdadera MVP, de la que no me esperaba PARA NADA: la inteligencia artificial del Jaeger, que se llama Lola.. a ver, en las pelis, los Jaegers son unas máquinas de guerra increíbles, pero son solo eso, máquinas, pero aquí, Lola le da una personalidad a su Jaeger, al Atlas Destroyer.. es la que pone el humor, uno súper seco, medio ácido, que está genial. Y además, está LLENA de fan service, tirando datos y referencias que a cualquier fan de Pacific Rim le van a sacar una sonrisa, logra que el Jaeger se sienta como un tercer protagonista, un protector, un compa. Terminas preocupándote por este pedazo de fierro porque ella le da un alma.. es una decisión de los guionistas que, ¡uf!, es súper inteligente y funciona de una manera espectacular.. para los que nos gusta clavarnos en el lore, los que amamos frikear con cómo funciona este universo, hacen algo BRILLANTE con el Vínculo, con el Drift. Ya saben, esta conexión neuronal que permite que dos pilotos se fusionen para manejar un Jaeger.. bueno, pues la serie explota este concepto de una forma que las películas ni se atrevieron a tocar. Meten la idea de que con el Vínculo, un piloto puede \

, por así decirlo, las habilidades y los recuerdos de otros pilotos con los que se conecta. ¡Imagínense el potencial de eso, es una locura!
\nUn piloto con la mente lo suficientemente fuerte podría conectarse con un montón de pilotos pro y absorber sus técnicas de pelea, su conocimiento de armas... ¡todo! Es una expansión del lore épica, ¡brutal! Y además, te da una respuesta súper chingona y lógica a algo que los fans siempre nos preguntamos: ¿cómo es que alguien como Raleigh o Pentecost pudo pilotear un Jaeger solo? No les voy a spoilear la respuesta, pero créanme, la forma en que lo resuelven es una genialidad.. ahora, la serie no es perfecta, ¿eh? Si le tengo que poner un \

, sería el desarrollo de los personajes secundarios.. porque a ver, Taylor y Hayley están súper bien construidos, pero los otros personajes que van apareciendo se sienten medio... de cartón, planos. Te quedas con ganas de saber más de ellos, de su pasado, de por qué hacen lo que hacen, pero la serie, al menos en esta primera temporada, nomás te da pinceladas, es una oportunidad medio desperdiciada, la neta, sobre todo porque el mundo que crearon está bien interesante.


---

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessuses1381/23tbMULVWFsySscTZi8Kzc2XnsBZV6Ncc3KH28ffUjyu6prro6e8Dfuzxa22jguEF8Zcm.png)
</center><center>[Image Source](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/112162/images/backdrops?language=en-US)</center>

---

And then we have the main human villain, a guy named Shane... in something I read, they nicknamed him \

and... honestly, they're not far off. Most of the time, he's just a despicable guy for the sake of it... but hey, he serves his purpose, you know? He brings a different kind of threat to the table, the kind that reminds you that even in a world invaded by monsters, humans can be the worst. What gives him a bit of flavor is how he manipulates people by twisting the Drift technology for his own benefit, altering memories and controlling minds. It's a bone-chilling idea that adds a more interesting layer to his character. The monster designs, by the way, phew, are insane. You can feel Del Toro's touch there; the kaijus are new, different, and look brutal.

There's this detail with their bioluminescence, that glow, which looks spectacular in the dark, destroyed cities. Okay, yes, it loses a bit of logic when you see them shining like that in the middle of the desert in broad daylight, but who cares! They look so badass and beautiful at the same time that you forgive it. Folks, Pacific Rim: The Black is a fantastic and super worthy addition to the franchise. They knocked it out of the park because they took everything we love—the giant robots, the monsters, the music (yes, they drop the iconic theme at just the right moments, and it's brilliant!)—and anchored it in a survival story that is raw, personal, and surprisingly emotional. This is a series with a huge heart beating inside that metal chest. I give it a solid 9/10. I'm docking it a point for the underdeveloped secondary characters and the sometimes-flat human villain... but it earns the 9 for everything else: the fantastic development of the protagonists, the brilliance of Loa, the brilliant way they explore the Drift, the intense and dark tone, and the guts they had to build upon such a beloved world and truly make it feel bigger and richer. Seriously, if you're a fan of the original movie or just want a good sci-fi anime with a story that has weight and emotional heft, you have to watch it... and well... that's it for today's review! Take care! Bye-bye!

>Y luego tenemos al villano humano principal, un tipo que se llama Shane.. por ahí en un texto que leí, le pusieron el apodo de \

, y… la verdad es que no andan tan perdidos, la mayor parte del tiempo, es un tipo despreciable nomás porque sí.. pero bueno, cumple su función, ¿saben? Pone sobre la mesa un tipo de amenaza diferente, de esas que te recuerdan que, incluso en un mundo invadido por monstruos, los humanos pueden ser los peores, lo que le da un poquito de sabor es cómo manipula a la gente retorciendo la tecnología del Vínculo para su propio beneficio, alterando recuerdos y controlando mentes. Es una idea que te pone los pelos de punta y que le da una capa más interesante a su personaje.. los diseños de los monstruos, por cierto, ¡uf!, son una locura. Se siente la mano de Del Toro ahí; los kaijus son nuevos, diferentes y se ven brutales.. hay un detalle con esa bioluminiscencia que tienen, ese brillo, que se ve espectacular en las ciudades oscuras y destruidas.
A ver, sí, pierde un poco de lógica cuando los ves brillar así en medio del desierto a pleno sol, pero, ¡qué más da! Se ven tan cabrones y tan hermosos al mismo tiempo que se lo perdonas.. gente, Pacific Rim: The Black es una adición fantástica y súper digna a la franquicia. Se la rifaron porque agarraron todo lo que amamos —los robots gigantes, los monstruos, la música (¡sí, meten el tema icónico en los momentos justos y es una genialidad!)— y lo anclaron en una historia de supervivencia que es cruda, personal y sorprendentemente emotiva. Es una serie con un corazón enorme latiendo adentro de ese pecho de metal.. yo le doy un sólido 9/10. Le bajo un puntito por los personajes secundarios que se quedaron cortos y el villano humano que a veces es muy plano.. pero el 9 se lo lleva por todo lo demás: el desarrollo de los protas que es fantástico, la genialidad de Lola, la forma tan brillante en que exploran el Vínculo, el tono intenso y oscuro, y los huevos que tuvieron para construir sobre un mundo tan querido y de verdad hacerlo sentir más grande y más rico.. en serio, si son fans de la película original o simplemente quieren un buen anime de ciencia ficción, con una historia que pese y tenga carga emocional, tienen que verlo.. y bueno.. hasta aquí la reseña de hoy! Cuidense mucho! Byebye! ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jessuses1381/23w2soTUfeDfX3EMBpuFDGkVrQfVKpRmqepd6mrmsYhwvXMfywbhKbYPYeownUZvGfBFZ.png)
[Image Source](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/112162/images/backdrops?language=en-US)

title.title: ¿What on Earth are you on about? ...it's my MeMe #255
title.body:
>

For quite some time now, many people on Hive have asked me. Usually on Tuesdays or just a few days after Tuesday. And generally through direct messages on Discord and also through other private communication channels: ¿What the hell I've ingested or what narcotic or chemical stimulant I've been under the influence of when I post and share my customary Three Tune Tuesday playlists? Yeah, my usual handful of tunes!

But what has always caught my attention and what I've always wondered about is: ¿Why the hell they always do it privately and never ask me publicly through a comment in full view of everyone on the post where I shared them? ¿By chance do you know why?

Well, as time has passed and this strange behavior has happened more frequently. I think I have come to develop a good hypothesis or even a fairly accurate theory. I suspect that those who ask me or have asked me this privately, and not publicly, are people who are afraid of being seen interacting with me or worse, of being associated or linked to me in some way for supposedly having consumed and enjoyed my content.

### ¿Could this be a reason? ¿What do you think?

Uhm, but anyway, even though I have often answered their questions privately trying to satisfy their doubts, I am sure they have never understood my reply fully.

I suppose that sometimes it maybe is; because due of my suspicions according my hypothesis and theory, **they** often don't put me in the right frame of mind to answer their doubts and questions with greater eloquence and coherence to satisfy fully their curiosity. Yeah, perhaps because I really struggle a bit to understand and accept that they don't want to ask me publicly. ¿Wouldn't you do the same? *¡WTF!*

Alright! but so, in any case, today I've decided to offer a somewhat more eloquent and coherent explanation to answer all their doubts and questions. Which hopefully and potentially could dispel all kinds of doubts about what **I'm up to** or what I've **ingested** when I publish and share the sort of music I post here on Hive.

So from now on, pay closer attention because I'm only going to do this once, and those who understood, understood. And those who don't, just reread this post and watch, listen to, and analyze in its entirety the music videos I've brought you today in more depth.

title.body:
Your message resonates with the beauty of everyday life, where every scent, every silence, and every choice intertwine to form a symphony of meaningful experiences. 

The citrus scent that fills your home is a tangible reminder of the abundance that the earth offers us, a symbol of gratitude for the simple and essential things in life. By opening that window into your February and March, you invite us to share in the fullness of your being, and that is a priceless gift.

Sometimes, the art of rest becomes a challenge for those of us who live with passion. However, as you rightly point out, in every act of teaching there is a reciprocal learning that nourishes both the teacher and the student. That dance between duty and passion is what gives life to our vocation.

Your walk with your husband illustrates the beauty of flexibility. In the lightness of a seemingly trivial decision, we find profound lessons about life. Allowing ourselves to be flexible in the small things gives us the freedom to face the big things with determination.

Giving up the familiar, as you did in June, is an act of faith that often requires more courage than clinging to the familiar. Your decision reflects a stoic wisdom: to make room for the new, we must let go of what no longer serves us. 

Thus, in the end, we remember that life is not measured in minutes, but in moments. And in those moments, where logic and empathy meet, we find the true meaning of our existence.

title.title: A Light and Comforting Bowl After Cycling Around Kallang
title.body:
One of the things I have noticed about myself is that after a long cycling session, I will almost always crave one of two things: either a very refreshing drink or a nice warm bowl of soup. It really depends on the mood, but both feel equally satisfying after spending hours under the heat. Last Saturday, after cycling around the Kallang area, I found myself stopping by the food center at Lavender MRT station to see if there was anything interesting to eat.


![1000113633.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpQwCyr9ZhiXz8XhVhK3vgQcoUkjpiBLrcTtdUvuFgxhTpgfBcPQWXoEwTBpmEqqsKh.jpg)


That was when **Haus Ban Mian** caught my attention.


![1000113627.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoK6kK1q3xmFRJAs7DbojFArvcJYCYNUWBg7ER3GLZdZkpQQJfg1NRdk3ZiSgFBj9kh.jpg)

![1000113628.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep5nDBQVMRQFfeCGf4eNVJ7eJQZbp5SqehS4SWptpQdQc9Ro8PAmrwYrFPAzGDSWuvx.jpg)

![1000113629.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpCAKSn1CxpAbBsNYgdbwDwCpCCEMwCJSgfcEfh6ommtowPLmkqAn6T5aR4dtzRXWxY.jpg)


There are food places that immediately stand out not because they are flashy, but because you already have a good idea of what kind of comfort they can offer. For me, Haus Ban Mian was one of those places. I already knew that their soup tends to be simple and clean-tasting, and that was exactly what I was looking for at that moment. After a tiring ride, I did not want anything greasy or too heavy. I wanted something soothing, something light, and something that could help me feel refreshed again. The spinach dishes on their menu also made the stall even more appealing to me because it felt like a healthier choice after physical activity.

So I decided to order their **Wanton Spinach Koka Mee**.


![1000113631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpA3xBUnTNJuusmX9bfZsVuCC8A6ZRTpnCsujQS7QHMoicfGgJhUFoMaRdRSkiAzzg4.jpg)


At that point, I really was not looking for a heavy meal. What I wanted most was the soup and the vegetables, and this bowl seemed to offer exactly that. It felt like the kind of dish that is easy to enjoy on a regular basis, especially with the current warm weather. These days, the heat can be quite draining, especially if you are outdoors cycling for hours. Because of that, I actually think a soup-based dish like this makes a lot of sense. It helps me recover in a more comforting way, and somehow it also reduces my craving for sugary drinks after exercise, which is a nice bonus.


![1000113632.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpA4vkmKjDmUphTCytQJEobRHyE3KTx8UF9yGDDDVwySyVv8izo8aGNTfrcXRrJuJ5Q.jpg)

![1000113635.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpJZW8GQgN3FtBB4oVK5esgwGB1TaE3CrKue8htn9CqRwZHsyrahFWLGpsHRpV6Hnuw.jpg)

![1000113636.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpLgQbQYokKCtEk1jb3Qd6ja8uwGcHHLZQomNLLt4v1gboWSFQpXXqprCijmMXnaMHz.jpg)

![1000113637.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EptbVqTbM1YA3tzEnWTyRoMtc2nn6W5nx4MjBGDhFJcxGrZbxjpYBZiyJP52nA53hRx.jpg)


When the bowl arrived, it looked inviting right away. The bright green spinach gave the dish a very fresh and lively appearance, and the clear broth made everything look light and clean. It was not trying too hard to impress visually, but it had that simple charm that can be very appealing when you are hungry and tired.

As expected, the spinach was the highlight for me. It was cooked just right, tender enough to enjoy easily but still with that slight crunch that made it feel fresh. That texture really made a difference. It gave the bowl a refreshing quality that matched the clean and subtle flavor of the broth. The soup itself was gentle and comforting, not overly seasoned, not oily, and not too rich. It was exactly the kind of taste that feels calming after physical activity.


![1000113634.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpLgzu7Fi8xU84AgHq5tMTcEZTyaHGeFjn2FvWAvWeo859S2CdFWzZH6rM4koiD9gTy.jpg)


The wantons were also pleasant. I liked that they were not too heavy, which was exactly what I had hoped for. Sometimes dumplings or wantons can make a dish feel much more filling than expected, but in this case they stayed light enough to suit the mood of the meal. Together with the thin noodles, spinach, and broth, everything came together into a bowl that felt balanced and easy to finish.

That said, the price is probably the one thing that stands out a little. At **SGD 7.30**, it is definitely more expensive than what you would usually find at a regular hawker stall, where a similar dish might cost around **SGD 5.50**. Still, I can understand why. The stall is located close to the MRT station, the setting is air-conditioned, and the whole place feels cleaner and more comfortable than a typical open-air hawker center. In that sense, the price difference feels more justifiable.


![1000113630.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EowH9YWNqBU2ngZYDfQxoUtyxoQkMdY1hGRKUppyLx3vJcnqvtFeQj2xwENmcdzCEJ2.jpg)

![1000113638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoyRrrqhouYpami4fWKJKAmkysdDsRVfafBqy3JCSTRi23C25ciyP4yqt8YVNSQaWHz.jpg)


***Overall, I enjoyed this meal very much. It was light, comforting, and satisfying without being too heavy, which was exactly what I needed after cycling. Sometimes, the best post-ride meals are not the most indulgent ones, but the ones that make you feel restored. This bowl from Haus Ban Mian did exactly that.***

## Bon appetit!

I have two clear ideas, but depending on the aforementioned study. >Cerca de dónde vive mí hija qué es digamos el inicio de un campo algo desolado a unos cuántos metros más está este terreno qué al ir junto a mí nieto aproveché la oportunidad y tomé varias fotos qué sin duda podría ser aprovechado dependiendo después de un estudio previo si se podría utilizar de otras formas yo tengo dos claras pero dependiendo del estudio antes mencionado. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmboDjCgJ4u3aUxQjPpu7mF6msZFBRkyVexM1TQvLgKJmV/1773185783454.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPGvYNso5UEHGpB54kMe4nHksd1DMUg1Hk8zzfFC6wkpX/1773185783594.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaTZpGs2WGe1WsdDWzHe9PMf2GWwbRR188Vadnjdrs8f3/1773185783713.jpg) For example, the first thing to do is to clean it very well, since as you can see there is a large amount of weeds present. On the other hand, if it is negative and there is no water, its use could be changed to divide it in such a way that it is used to the fullest to build some houses since there is a great deficit, but this would help to try to solve it a little. >Por ejemplo lo primero en hacer es limpiarlo muy bien ya qué cómo pueden observar existe una gran cantidad de maleza presente ahora ya una vez hecho ese paso sería conocer si habría la posibilidad de encontrar agua y qué fuera utilizado para la siembra por quiénes viven allí en cambio de ser negativo y qué no exista agua su uso podría cambiar para dividirlo de tal forma que se aproveche al máximo para qué se hagan algunas casas puesto que existe un gran déficit pero así ayudaría a intentar solucionarlo un poco. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUrkh4HwD8PQamaE1HcC9FSekGHKJKfdhFTmuy7Qjv7Fz/1773185801490.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbk3jJAhR6iiQadfD78zR2Ek7XMxChCN1PGTxtC7t9cg4/1773185801618.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdVhHxXkb1er6VAzDFdeHBhEYTaySPp1rJyGmbZHRP8yt/1773185801735.jpg) I'm signing off, but not before thanking everyone for the opportunity to participate in the weekly @qurator community contest, the Qurator's Photo Quest, with the theme: Landscape. title.title: I Am #AliveAndThriving Today! || #IAmAliveChallenge || Daily Off-Grid Jungle Journal Entry: Day #1320 - A Comparison Between Our 3 'We Are Alive Tribe' Pools - GaiaYoga Gardens, Lower Puna, Far East Big Island, Hawai'i - Monday, March 9, 2026
title.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260308_163003927.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tmKrRNGvssopuFooQEKjL52BkNG5KR6yoSE6HLdb7vnAgSUg9HrhC4Vh8ZTMBEmEqh2.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 23.73% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.062 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.853 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.05870942 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.38933520 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00128064 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.117074 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001794 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 70,003.1 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 445.06 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 53.74 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 5,190.00 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 88.08 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #137 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#108 (among active witnesses only)/291.5k HP in votes/42 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 It's been just over two days since I created and set up our new ALIVE:HEARTBEAT pool, and I've got to say that I'm quite impressed by its activity and growth so far. This pool is definitely getting off to a much faster start than our ALIVE:SWAP.HIVE pool, with notably more initial liquidity having been added already. Today I thought that it might be interesting to do a comparison between all three of our pools, ALIVE:ALIVEM, ALIVE:SWAP.HIVE, and our newest, ALIVE:HEARTBEAT. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260308_083205701_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vhyeTvfLbacMGFFzrvd3HUYjgAHpy4ZCLLgWMguJwXgt5NuUp4XvX59AGrPWSoG4Usq.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260308_163309108_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQtex85Zex3YdnxGfRmerDCbN7xQYETJ2gLbQQgHxR5rMHnfrUcpj6MFcayxit6URXF.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I'll begin with our oldest pool (*created by Erik*), ALIVE:ALIVEM. This pool has always been rather modest in swapping/trading volume, with both of our other pools far exceeding it in current activity. Liquidity grows in the other two pools more quickly, in other words. Presently, the ALIVE:ALIVEM pool has a total liquidity of 38,094.546 ALIVE/186.393 ALIVEM (*$204-230.353 fiat-dollar value, based on BeeSwap and Tribaldex*), with 31 liquidity providers, it's earned a total of 671.449 ALIVE/1.866 ALIVEM (*$3.50861 in fiat-dollar value*) for liquidity providers, and it has a total cumulative swap/trade volume of 533,565.711 ALIVE/1,591.435 ALIVEM (*$2,830.321 in fiat-dollar value*). I reactivated liquidity rewards for this pool just after activating them for the first time for our ALIVE:SWAP.HIVE pool. This pool is not fast, but it keeps chugging along. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260308_163347986_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wWxyQNdcTV612N9mMX6oTTRoFMphHFkHJTznKdieW5yMuwEpfFvC1vyojcMGfzEvFGb.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260308_163544928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uFW8QQ8iEc9FdVLbttSnfEcPdG72mp8JJK31gvVftPY8i7GfszdUiJt7SGpvgKgSVny.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Our second-newest pool, ALIVE:SWAP.HIVE, which I only created on October 31 of last year, has a present total liquidity of 21,794.759 ALIVE/1,387.727 SWAP.HIVE (*$162-176.59 in fiat-dollar value, based on BeeSwap and Tribaldex*), it has 31 liquidity providers, it's earned a total of 282.379 ALIVE/15.002 SWAP.HIVE (*$2.10298 in fiat-dollar value*), and it has a total cumulative swap/trade volume of 224,016.805 ALIVE/12,035.987 SWAP.HIVE (*$1,676.704 in fiat-dollar value*). Although it got off to a slower start than our newest pool, it presently has the highest liquidity, with a very-high swap/trade volume. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260308_163643443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC7mazg99fsEePFnFxJW4Pzxk9xLkqT2khJgZBF9t9gyvczaoYcWW26y4MsnDWA5gq9.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260308_163833019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wgQ81u9RjPwtL6YkrH51nvUVnqmtZjBteDJ6VTZoRGbXbYdzKrt5tSSHY9H8GBWoZVB.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Our newest pool, ALIVE:HEARTBEAT, currently has a total liquidity of 7,312.518 ALIVE/18,782.061 HEARTBEAT (*$60-65.204 in fiat-dollar value,based on BeeSwap and Tribaldex*), it has 12 liquidity providers, it's earned a total of 5.089 ALIVE/0.33 HEARTBEAT (*$0.02171 in fiat-dollar value*) for liquidity providers, and after a little over 2 days, it has a total cumulative swap/trade volume of 2,155.416 ALIVE/3,810.113 HEARTBEAT (*$16.013 in fiat-dollar value*), which is quite an excellent start. I don't know how the swap/trading volume compares between this pool and ALIVE:SWAP.HIVE yet, since it's so new, but from the looks of it, it may be at least at a similar level, and perhaps even beyond it a bit. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260308_164113445.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wgKuZomGRXkZie4Mikc4Yeg9iKtwRQ3HhSNhWzXyjSMAU4saxMPJeMKMoQbVjrVHn7Z.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260308_164219933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tH5jjQcimmPUGMb1mBpH9adaT1zKKWH57Ct8TnhKscKqzTVr11TbtT94dUXGsyZ1Ypx.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) As I've mentioned, it's important to assess potential new pools to create based on the greatest possible need, use, durability through time, and the mutual benefits that it might provide. Our new pool certainly seems that it fit the bill in that regard, which is really good to see. I don't yet have clarity on what our next new pool should be, but you can bet that I have several possibilities buzzing around in my mind, that I'm continuing to consider, assess, and explore. Let me know your thoughts on the matter, as I'm very interested to hear. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260308_164425932_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tvegYConRc4MQEHjF5Bzfc7Z3NVprZ8dNEQcjtAxZ7VSNNL1K4sUgCMa85KqY8cYzPB.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260308_164451685.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u5xbBptcVVacrBFKuKdDtT3AEwNgATpL7DHZ9SNeAzKHVpHjZEeCkhSMmNqDdbduRAk.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Monday, I left the Flow House, after finishing up my Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, by a little after 2PM, giving my attention first to some photography for my posts, after which I collected and dumped old/bad coconuts at the upper coco bar, and I tidied up the area a bit. With those completed, I took a quick asset-management break up at the Flow House, then I grabbed my machete to go do some more clearing work up along the front driveway. Upon finishing that up for the day, I took a shower, made myself some food (*a spiced-and-seasoned beef burger, on olive-oil-toasted sourdough, with pepperjack cheese, smoked hot sauce, and Dijon mustard*), and with that and my jar of leftover superfood fire coffee in hands, I headed back to the Flow House to begin my evening Hive tasks. I got everything done by 9PM, and after some asset management, and perusing Qortal and X for a bit, I went to bed by a bit after 10:30PM. I woke up around 7:15AM, having slept well, doing more asset management, going to make my superfood fire coffee in the new kitchen, then returning to the Flow House to write this post. It's now just before 1:45PM, so it's a great time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my few other important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus first on some photography for my posts, and then on jungle-community/land work. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until tomorrow's expression of these posts! ***Always forward, onward, upward, and whaleward, ho, together we go!*** 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260308_164545464.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23ynQDcbe72nz5cxtHradhbFgZfKjx3xEmJpB1pPdvWUw4qsipZWf7yWeZNRuW4oSXawN.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260308_164647636.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wMTsU55UNTtH4qgq6SeSgStm9FFwKXsqCxq36VE7PaT9XALCxgVc9VXJAkJrjw3SJY5.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.) Do regular integral practices again, alone or with others. 2.) Prepare regular batches of my medicinal teas collected from the land again. 3.) Make my plant nursery, and the gardens, beautiful again. 4.) Your message resonates with the beauty of everyday life, where every scent, every silence, and every choice intertwine to form a symphony of meaningful experiences. 

The citrus scent that fills your home is a tangible reminder of the abundance that the earth offers us, a symbol of gratitude for the simple and essential things in life. By opening that window into your February and March, you invite us to share in the fullness of your being, and that is a priceless gift.

Sometimes, the art of rest becomes a challenge for those of us who live with passion. However, as you rightly point out, in every act of teaching there is a reciprocal learning that nourishes both the teacher and the student. That dance between duty and passion is what gives life to our vocation.

Your walk with your husband illustrates the beauty of flexibility. In the lightness of a seemingly trivial decision, we find profound lessons about life. Allowing ourselves to be flexible in the small things gives us the freedom to face the big things with determination.

Giving up the familiar, as you did in June, is an act of faith that often requires more courage than clinging to the familiar. Your decision reflects a stoic wisdom: to make room for the new, we must let go of what no longer serves us. 

Thus, in the end, we remember that life is not measured in minutes, but in moments. And in those moments, where logic and empathy meet, we find the true meaning of our existence.
