body.title: 5 Minutes Free Writing - He ate What?
body.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - He ate What? Hope you enjoy the story.


![61euyn9157L._AC_UF894,1000_QL80_.jpg](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61euyn9157L._AC_UF894,1000_QL80_.jpg)

[Source ](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61euyn9157L._AC_UF894,1000_QL80_.jpg)

Kenneth's mom received a call from his form teacher at 2pm, this timing is odd for the teacher to call Kenneth's mom.

Picking up the call, Kenneth's mom sounds anxious and worry, as she is worried that her son got into some sort of problem in school like fighting with the classmates as a group of 5 years old could easily engage in kiddy style arguments. Or worse some form of accident. 

\
Exclaimed Kenneth's mom upon hearing the first statement from the form teacher.\n\

repeated the form teacher.
Without a second thought, she dashes into the Manager's room to apply for urgent time off and rushes off to the hospital panicked. She called up her husband to tell him what happened and get him to meet her at the A&E department. 

Upon arriving at the A&E department, she met the form teacher who told her Kenneth has just been send to the operating theater for immediate procedure to retrieve the Lego piece. 

After reviewing the security cameras, it was revealed that Kenneth had a fall while holding a Lego pieces and that trip causes him to accidentally push that Lego pieces down his throat. And as a precaution and preventive measures, the school will remove all these small choking parts away from the classroom.

body.title: The Dystopian Future Is No Longer Fiction
body.body:
Every Tuesday I like to drop the needle on three songs that never get old, no matter how many times you hear them. This is not about discovering something new. It is about revisiting the kind of tracks that helped define an era and still hold up decades later.

![F3086E35-D694-46C9-A5C8-93249C1860E6.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdABNnECs5yNi5ajf6SmNA87JkuFgPNx3iBY3SU8rAX8x/F3086E35-D694-46C9-A5C8-93249C1860E6.png)

The late seventies were a fascinating moment for music. Punk was exploding, new wave was beginning to form, and rock was evolving into something more experimental. The result was a period where artists were taking risks and creating sounds that still influence music today.

This week’s picks come straight from that era. Three bands that all had their own identity and three songs that immediately stand out the second they begin. Turn the volume up and enjoy a small trip back to the late seventies.

First up is David Bowie with Heroes. Bowie was never afraid to push boundaries, and this track is one of his most powerful recordings. The song slowly builds with layers of sound while Bowie’s voice grows more intense with every verse. By the time it reaches the famous line about being heroes just for one day, it feels almost cinematic. It is one of those songs that captures both vulnerability and strength at the same time.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lXgkuM2NhYI

Next is The Cars with Just What I Needed. This song helped introduce the band’s signature mix of rock guitars and new wave keyboards. Ric Ocasek’s cool vocal delivery sits perfectly over one of the most recognizable riffs of the decade. The track feels tight, catchy, and effortlessly cool, which is exactly what made The Cars stand out when they arrived on the scene.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z5-rdr0qhWk

The third pick is The Police with Message In A Bottle. Right from the opening guitar riff you know exactly what song it is. Andy Summers’ guitar work carries the track while Sting delivers one of the band’s most memorable vocal performances. The song mixes loneliness with energy, turning a simple concept into a massive anthem that still sounds huge today.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MbXWrmQW-OE

What ties these three songs together is that they all came from artists who refused to stay inside one lane. Bowie was constantly reinventing himself. The Cars blended rock with the emerging new wave sound. The Police mixed punk attitude with reggae rhythms and sharp musicianship.

Another thing that stands out is how recognizable these songs are within seconds. A few notes of guitar or keyboard and you instantly know what you are hearing. That kind of identity is something a lot of modern music struggles to replicate.

These tracks also remind you how strong songwriting was during that period. The hooks were memorable, the production was bold, and the artists were not afraid to experiment with sound and structure.

There is also something timeless about the energy in these recordings. Even decades later they still feel alive when you play them loud. Great music has a way of refusing to age, and these songs are proof of that.

That is the fun of Three Tune Tuesday (BTW it is hosted by @ablaze). It is a chance to revisit the kind of music that helped shape rock history and still delivers every time you press play. So if you have not heard these songs in a while, give them another spin today. Turn the speakers up a little and enjoy three classics from the late seventies that never seem to lose their power.

body.title: Tomorrow: Equal to the sum of our today
body.body:
Everyone believes all futures are great. Many people have preached the songs of better tomorrow. We even rhythm a song in my primary school where we sang a song calling ourselves leaders of tomorrow, and our faith never faint, hoping that tomorrow comes like a prince from a distant land with treasures filled to the brim in an iron chest. But it's never so, not everyone gets to see it and some live for years and there's nothing promising about the tomorrow, only a few make it and they become another point of deceit to the others how tomorrow is pregnant with lots of gold.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZawEpJHf66EcvHGqqrH92pXnghkDn9oTj3G7VQ1ztc33/1773183920420.png)

**Image generated using Gemini AI**

I've come to realize the future is like everyday. It pays you from what you do each day. It loves consistency. Tomorrow takes today's effort and rewards you for it and for some it pays their heir. So tomorrow is not promised, but it never takes effort for granted. While some people consider life to be of luck and chance, it also reward work and deeds

I have heard the story of  people whose life changed all of a sudden. But if traced, there's a record of hard work and consistency. Even the Bible encourages hard work and detest idleness, each has its fruit to bear. Nothing or only a few things are coincidence, the rest are guarded by principles. So whenever an individual's tomorrow looks crumbled and shattered. He should check his “today” and the things that he does. It's not about what tomorrow has for you, it's about what you're feeding to your tomorrow.

. Spotkanie rozpocznie się o godzinie 18:30, a dyskusja będzie prowadzona w języku angielskim. Wstęp wolny, ale jak zwykle można się dobrowolnie opodatkować na rzecz otwartej enklawy.  
 
<center>* * *</center>  
 
On Thursday, March 12 the next meeting of the Practical Philosophy Club will again take place at the Kingdom (Biskupia St. 18/1). This time, we the topic is \

. The meeting will start at 6:30 p.m., and the discussion will be held in English. Admission is free, but as usual, you can voluntarily contribute to the open enclave. 

1) What are advantages and disadvantages of adult content? 

1) Should the state regulate/restrict adult content to protect society from moral degradation? 

2) Can adult content ever involve fully free consent, given economic pressures and power dynamics?

3) Does adult content reduce people to sexual objects, or is objectification sometimes morally acceptable?

4) Does widespread adult content consumption change how men and women see each other?

5) Is adult content addiction real? Does it harm people?

6) If AI-generated adult content uses faces of real people without their consent (DeepFake), is it immoral even though no physical harm happens?

7) Should revenge porn be treated as a form of sexual violence, or as a privacy violation?

8) Why is public nudity taboo in many societies but accepted in others?

body.title: 18 years old birthday photoshoot - Monomad Challenge.
body.body:
![cover.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23viGzQJv5faRgBRsf3EiTxWvPgFga4p4dUu2kBMgKPpDbuJAvxxPZ9yPTSZZcVDByJVN.jpg)



<div class = pull-left>

Greetings to all my friends in this beautiful community I tell you that I had several days without publishing content because I was super busy in the processes of the new studio from the necessary steps for the signing of the contract to the move and the \

of the new studio it was all a race against time to have it ready in time to be able to serve the first client in the new studio. So yes this photo session that I want to show you today is literally the first one I have done in the new studio!! We start by taking a photo with the number 18 balloons to evoke the birthday theme and with the girl sitting so she would feel more comfortable.
Un saludo a todos mis amigos en esta hermosa comunidad, les cuento que tenia varios dias sin publicar contenido porque estaba super ocupado en los procesos del nuevo estudio, desde las diligencias necesarias para la firma del contrato hasta la mudanza y la \

del nuevo estudio, fue todo un corre corre a contra reloj para tenerlo listo a tiempo de poder atender el primer cliente en el nuevo estudio. Asi que si, esta sesion de fotos que hoy les quiero mostrar el literalmenta la primera que he hecho en el nuevo estudio!! Empezamos por hacer una foto con los globos de números 18 para evocar la temática de cumpleaños, y con la chica sentada para que se sintiera mas comoda: ![IMG_5586.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/EoyTSP1qcMkSGkue6uc9iPeFgQGzDzKCPDgjGSjfzpqMZ72rj9kZRUjyxWko8UaaPAw.jpg)
And then I removed the cube to take other photos first with the girl kneeling and then sitting on the floor we liked the result very much!
Y luego quité el cubo para hacer otras fotos, primero con la chica arrodillada y luego sentada en el suelo, el resultado nos gustó muchisimo!
![IMG_5508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/EokhThFEDA6LHHP7vhWmfGTZoNuR1stBxyEWgQ7pyR3iwmSxQmQVmNtFVwmq9K7WQX4.jpg) ![IMG_5525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23wgfDN25Dcj193FsaAwQKcGXQEFq6PA4nN9Jss76AQ5VVo1Te9sKLwZkiyxdmF1qsE1E.jpg)
And now we move on to take some standing photos. At this point we had already \

and the girl had already gained confidence and I was very surprised by how photogenic she was literally there was no photo in which she did not look good!
Y ahora pasamos a hacer algunas fotos de pie. En este punto ya habiamos \

y la chica ya habia entrado en confianza y me sorprendió muchisimo lo fotogenica que era, literalmente no habia foto en la que no se viera bien! ![IMG_5634.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/Eos5jJooisBCgsq5MeLNz4Nh344yNCjhHmWHjnD8qKLEgY8TtztcwnA7yyd7ErH2oJB.jpg) ![IMG_5651.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23wr3KrgdELkky8qyYHfrPLAv6uNdFqWvWnkJBLRjeTLaxDAAjyCH2ef2t82iDhfGNWYd.jpg)
At this point the girl changed her outfit to have more variety in the photographs and we did the second part of this photo session first we started with a couple of standing photos.
En este punto la chica se cambió el outfit para tener mas variedad en las fotografias y hicimos la segunda parte de esta sesion de fotos, primero empezamos por un par de fotos de pie:
![IMG_5404.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/Eoia6EHz166YwbvbgGgRePb4tTt78oxFtBiF9S8M4SWP9ZWkxAGMpfHSGhmGjCiYdps.jpg)
I put a cube on the set so the girl could pose better and she did amazing!
Puse un cubo en el set para que la chica pudiera posar mejor y lo hizo increible!
![IMG_5453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/EopxiHcj4VESi1guyhAAQFUKSkhYi6TiL5R5QHayw6gU9zgLhMEtCG4DF5YP3ZW9h6K.jpg) ![IMG_5461.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/Ep7xzRw4GktvaEMfphxP2Y7kh1Rd1iBvMCgjnYfPwr3hHcqkyerxsMP9p41QryAmmTa.jpg)
And then we took some photos with the girl sitting on the floor first without accessories.
Y luego hicimos algunas fotos con la chica sentada en el suelo, primero sin accesorios:
![IMG_5497.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/Ep5r1FJqKAQGLvTeWeBf8ERU5pzQDgWUoxiXUJANLm5ZaeFzcVB47CuyBUhjcHB3Gxc.jpg)
And the grand finale.
Y el gran final:
![IMG_5467.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/EpEMhuk6ZuXF1yMw83yGxGmtuK85VwxKWiKAE5bvryDzgK7ZAxdwW9kjU2C7D7ZAuuc.jpg)
I took all the photos with my Canon R8 camera a 50mm 4 f lens and two light points. At the end of this photo session we were all super happy with the results and I hope you like them as much as we do!!
Todas las fotos las tomé con mi camara Canon R8, un lente 50mm 4/f y dos puntos de luces. Al final de esta sesion de fotos todos quedamos super contentos con los resultados y espero que a ustedes les gusten tanto como a nosotros!!

body.title: ThreeTuneTuesday || Tres resonancias y una memoria [ESP-ENG] by @edwardstobia
body.body:
> Para esta nueva semana del TTT seguimos dando el giro de 180° para seguir recordando esas canciones que suele escuchar mi madre y de las que sin duda, fueron cómplices para que yo pudiera vivir el arte desde muy chico y es que volver a mirar esos hermosos recuerdos de mi juventud podrias decir sin miedo que no es perdida. Por lo menos para mí ja ja ja… Y es que realmente si me preguntan, la música jamás debería faltar en una casa porque no es necesario tener alguna reunión familiar o con amigos para escuchar y disfrutar del arte musical. >_For this new week of TTT, we continue our 180° turn to remember those songs that my mother used to listen to and which undoubtedly helped me to experience art from a very young age. Looking back on those beautiful memories of my youth, you could safely say that it is not a waste of time. At least for me, ha ha ha... And really, if you ask me, music should never be missing from a home because you don't need to have a family gathering or get together with friends to listen to and enjoy musical art._
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)
Les digo esto porque por ejemplo en mí casa, la música suena desde que nos levantamos y no es que tengamos un escándalo en casa. Solemos escuchar música nosotros no es la idea molestar a más nadie aunque bueno, no puedo mentir, creo que cuando mi estado de ánimo está para escuchar rock sinceramente dejo que los vecinos disfruten conmigo ja ja ja… Si ya sé, a lo mejor a los vecinos no les gusta pero bueno, a veces tengo yo que escuchar de ellos la música que no es de mi preferencia e igual consigo en ella arreglos muy bonitos. >_I'm telling you this because, for example, in my house, music plays from the moment we wake up, and it's not like we're making a racket at home. We usually listen to music ourselves; it's not our intention to bother anyone else, although, well, I can't lie, I think that when I'm in the mood to listen to rock music, I honestly let the neighbors enjoy it with me, ha ha ha... Yes, I know, maybe the neighbors don't like it, but hey, sometimes I have to listen to music that isn't to my taste, and I still manage to find some very nice arrangements in it._
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23uQff3hEbikki1Za9EhL8onoJ1vXJyYoXqq5Ci45351E1r3xx4PB8vHKDm5SeVVPRYua.png)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23y8x31UGx8qBfXNihLEkyf6enJa9qnppWJ8uToUnpdsvyg3YnRCGv1cj33Vambkr5NQm.png No soy nada amante de los escándalos musicales como los carros que están muy de moda en mi país que terminan más como minitecas rodantes que como carros. Es una moda de la que sinceramente no me apetece ser parte. Como les decía, en casa podemos estar estudiando y quizás escuchar a Richard Claydermande fondo o sentarnos a leer Doris y yo y poner música que complemente el momento o quizás podríamos estas teniendo un momento muy cariñoso y porque no, colocar una buena música de fondo. Total, la música vive en cada momento de nosotros porque cuando menos pensamos, estamos haciendo música. UN silbido, un tarareo, una melodía loca o una improvisación mientras esperamos la pizza. En fin, siempre está con nosotros. [Image source](https://mujerypunto.com/nostalgia-positiva-la-musica-pop-de-los-ochenta-es-la-mejor-para-reducir-el-estres/) > _I'm not a fan of musical scandals like the cars that are very fashionable in my country, which end up looking more like rolling mini-discos than cars. It's a trend that I honestly don't want to be a part of. As I was saying, at home we might be studying and perhaps listening to Richard Clayderman in the background, or Doris and I might be sitting down to read and putting on music that complements the moment, or maybe we could be having a very affectionate moment and, why not, put on some good music in the background. All in all, music lives in every moment of our lives because when we least expect it, we are making music. A whistle, a hum, a crazy melody, or an improvisation while we wait for the pizza. In short, it is always with us._ [![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23wMYSbvvwDuVwA2phxhAumdQeuKtrqu1KRvTu6bMoyCi9BGe8eHc8sKeHjkpdndCtEKJ.png)](https://espectaculos-excelsior.com/artistas-y-canciones-mas-influyentes-de-la-musica-de-los-80/)

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwardstobia/23vsQKVBvHdGNT13GNfGvgRovtdWjtKwom4jTCE4HLxKjcJAv3LcGadp66NMV3DnTcqYv.png Hoy compartiré otras de las canciones que gracias a mi madre puedo decir que hoy todavía de 32 años siguen en mi recuerdo y que son portadora del amor que le tengo al arte así que bueno, está son las canciones que mi madre me regaló de niño, empecemos con: [Image source](https://www.sopitas.com/mientras-tanto/antes-del-internet-como-se-compraba-musica-en-los-80-y-90/) >_Today I will share some more songs that, thanks to my mother, I can say that even now, at 32 years old, remain in my memory and carry the love I have for art. body.title: Learning nothing new but trying to improve
body.body:
>

They say you should never stop learning, and that's because no matter how much we learn or how much we grow, there's always room for more. We start learning from the moment we come into this world and can keep learning until the end of life. Sometimes we learn by default, and sometimes we need to make deliberate efforts. When learning is intentional, it requires deliberate effort. I think that, as humans, we need to keep learning new things over time, which is very good for self-improvement. Learning something new can make us confident and help us become better versions of ourselves. Are you curious to know what I'm learning or trying to figure out these days? Let me share. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCtrVwKFbDYFeeX6Vg8XMK6ixEPqquqP39Uphyov9gWn/image.png) [ImgSrc](https://unsplash.com/photos/orange-and-white-eggs-on-white-tray-iMwgWUbXxms) To be honest, after finishing my postgraduate degree, I didn't make much effort to pursue anything new. I was trying to spend some time in a relaxed mood because I knew that once I started working, it would be very hard for me to manage time for the things I want to do. Several months have already passed, and I was just entertaining myself with what I want to do instead of taking care of my daily activities, including making money. Officially, I'm still unemployed, and regarding my online earnings, I don't reveal that to anyone. In such times, many people suffer from depression due to lack of finding a suitable job. Relatives and many other people keep asking about unemployment again and again, and some people try to criticize them for not being capable enough. Not searching for a job immediately after postgraduate studies was intentional for me, but I never shared it with anyone, and naturally, some people have already tried to humiliate me through their words. I rarely contact others, and I didn't expect anyone to bother me with such things. Unfortunately, I found that some people go to great lengths for it. Sometimes people started visiting my home specifically to lecture me 😅, but I'm not sure. Human psychology is interesting to me, and I just try to keep learning new things about it all the time because I'm very curious about it. So I'm considering people as my experimental subjects. It wasn't intentional, but somehow people have become my experimental subjects. There are also some reasons for doing so. I have been isolating myself from socializing, even though I'm capable of doing so. I want to be surrounded by good people. I think it's now important to socialize, and I need to be careful not to be surrounded by toxic people. I'm trying to understand human psychology more and more. In the last few months, I've really figured out many things about human psychology and their behaviors. It was surprising to me to discover some unexpected outcomes from some of my relatives. Again, I also figured out how most conflicts start from silly things. In short, over the last few months, my observation skills have increased, and my analytical power has improved as I've been focusing on understanding human psychology. From a technical perspective, I haven't learned anything new, but my thoughts and understanding of human psychology, as well as my ability to read situations, have become better. I've noticed that I can predict outcomes quite well. It's indeed important and very helpful for me in the days ahead. In short, recently I haven't learned anything new technically. I'm just trying to improve my understanding of human psychology. It's important and, at the same time, it's also interesting.

-----------------------

></center>

-------------------------

links.title: Another day of training for future scaffolders  (ENG - ESP)
links.body: > ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmem3UgD1uCkQgTeaNN6xeLtGnB6E9T48dUNdTQ9c3YBEU/2.jpg) ![BANNER HIVE BIENVENIDA.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ancnoticias/23xoymWQCZ3bfy56X8hW9JkhTFGAjA3gt7HP1nDzG1E83NEPKRqUSg8Q2GxqfcHJAVtPm.jpg) Greetings to all my colleagues in the community. Today I'm sharing another day of activities at my job. Three days ago, I showed you the start of the training for young people who want to begin their internships as scaffolders. I mentioned that, for now, they are familiarizing themselves with everything related to scaffolding equipment: maintenance, storage, material selection, and the different types of components, among other aspects. Today, thank God, I'm feeling a bit better. Remember that during the last training session I was sick and quite discouraged, but we still managed to get the job done. >Saludos a todos los compañeros de la comunidad. >Hoy nuevamente les comparto otro día de actividades en mi trabajo. Hace tres días les mostré el inicio de las capacitaciones de jóvenes que quieren comenzar sus prácticas como andamieros. Les comentaba que, por ahora, están familiarizándose con todo lo relacionado con el conocimiento del material de andamio: mantenimiento, acopio, selección de materiales y los diferentes tipos de piezas, entre otros aspectos. Hoy, gracias a Dios, ya me siento un poco mejor. Recuerden que en la capacitación pasada estaba enfermo y con el ánimo bastante bajo, pero aun así seguimos cumpliendo con la tarea.

> >During this session, I showed them the correct way to organize some of the materials according to their type and size. Specifically, we worked with vertical supports and ladders. However, I didn't just focus on teaching them how to organize them, but also on identifying which materials should be sent to the maintenance department or which are definitely unusable due to damage or major issues. >They are very enthusiastic about their training, and I've noticed that they want to skip some steps to progress faster. This is normal; it's simply the excitement of wanting to start working as soon as possible. However, I gave them a short motivational talk where I recommended that they enjoy the learning process and familiarize themselves with everything related to this trade. En esta jornada les enseñé la forma correcta de organizar parte del material según su tipo y sus medidas. Específicamente trabajamos con los verticales y las escaleras. Sin embargo, no solo me enfoqué en enseñarles a organizarlos, sino también en identificar el material que debe enviarse al área de mantenimiento o el que definitivamente ya no sirve debido a daños o afecciones mayores. Ellos están muy entusiasmados con sus capacitaciones y he notado que quieren saltarse algunos pasos para avanzar más rápido. Esto es normal; es simplemente la emoción de querer ejercer el trabajo lo antes posible. Sin embargo, les di una pequeña charla motivacional donde les recomendé que disfruten el proceso de aprendizaje y que se familiaricen con todo lo relacionado con este oficio.

> I also explained to them that scaffolding work, being at heights, requires adherence to very strict safety standards and protocols. Therefore, it's essential to start from the basics, understanding every detail to avoid future mistakes. In fact, the assembly and use of scaffolding must be carried out by trained and certified personnel to guarantee safety in this type of work. As with any training, there is a theoretical and a practical component, which go hand in hand. However, true learning depends on the motivation and commitment of each trainee, as their future employment, the recommendations they receive, and the possibility of continued growth within this profession depend on it. >También les expliqué que el trabajo de andamiero, al ser un trabajo en alturas, requiere cumplir normas y protocolos de seguridad muy estrictos, por lo que es fundamental comenzar desde lo básico, conociendo cada detalle para evitar errores en el futuro. De hecho, el armado y uso de andamios debe realizarse por personal capacitado y certificado para garantizar la seguridad en este tipo de labores. >Como en toda capacitación, existe una parte teórica y otra práctica, que van de la mano. Sin embargo, el verdadero aprendizaje depende de las ganas y del compromiso que tenga cada practicante, ya que de eso depende su futuro laboral, las recomendaciones que pueda recibir y la posibilidad de seguir creciendo dentro de esta profesión.

>

In this trade, you can work not only as a scaffolder. There are other opportunities such as scaffolding certifier, work-at-heights coordinator, or structural designer, among other areas. It's a profession that offers various job opportunities, and here in Colombia, it's a highly sought-after trade.

The truth is, it was a very educational day. During the activity, I gave them, as we say colloquially in Venezuela, a \

—that is, I left them some intentional errors to see if they could identify them. Some noticed them, and others didn't, but at the end of the day, we had a brief feedback session about what they had observed, and everything became clear and organized. >En este oficio no solo se puede trabajar como andamiero. También existen otras oportunidades como certificador de andamios, coordinador de trabajo en alturas o diseñador de estructuras, entre otras áreas. Es una profesión que brinda varias oportunidades laborales y, aquí en Colombia, es un oficio bastante demandado. >Lo cierto es que fue un día de mucho aprendizaje. Durante la actividad les coloqué, como decimos coloquialmente en Venezuela, una “conchita de mango”, es decir, les dejé algunos errores intencionales para ver si lograban identificarlos. links.title: Introduction to Spherical Harmonics
links.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS2Sk27hYCS2oDHqxKTyv77TSrAjqaFQY84ULiAc2Pd2D/d4b08d2d353de2344d229c681182dd7d)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=mes/cac50999)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=mes/cac50999)


---

In this video, I go over an introduction to spherical harmonics by giving an overview of how they are obtained from the solution to Laplace's equation in spherical coordinates. The general solution to Laplace's equation (which describes steady-state conditions) is called Solid Spherical Harmonics since it involves the radial term, while excluding it yields the Complex Spherical Harmonics. Finally, defining Real Spherical Harmonics such that the imaginary terms cancel out obtains the common equations for spherical harmonics. And radially distorting spherical harmonics proportional to their values on the sphere obtains the common lobes used in their visualizations and graphs.      

#math #sphericalharmonics #calculus #atomicphysics #science 

Timestamps:

- Spherical harmonics are the solution to Laplace's equation in spherical coordinates – 0:00
- Laplace's equation describes steady-state conditions (i.e. in harmony), and solutions are called harmonic functions – 2:00
- Separation of variables can solve Laplace's equation to obtain Solid Spherical Harmonics that include the radial term – 4:21
- Compacted form of the Associated Legendre Function – 7:47
- Angular Laplacian operator excludes the radial terms – 11:28
- Solving angular Laplacian obtains the complex Spherical Harmonics with Normalization Constant to ensure a specific double integral is equal to 1 – 13:00
- Definition of real spherical harmonics, which cancel out the imaginary terms – 16:55
- Normalized real spherical harmonics – 20:16
- Full general solution to Laplace's equation is a sum or series over all possible integers n and m – 22:42
- Visualizations of Real Spherical Harmonics – 24:22
- Can radially distort the sphere proportional to the magnitude of the values on the sphere to get the characteristic lobes – 26:01
- Visualization with lobes and colors – 27:56

La verdad es que algunas partidas estuvieron bastante reñidas, pero en otras me di cuenta de que todavía me falta aprender mejor a usar algunas de mis cartas. A veces uno cree que tiene una buena estrategia hasta que empieza la batalla y todo cambia 😅.

Aun así, cada brawl siempre deja algo de aprendizaje. Poco a poco voy entendiendo mejor las combinaciones y las habilidades de las cartas, así que la próxima vez espero hacerlo mucho mejor.

Al final, lo importante es seguir jugando, aprendiendo y disfrutando del juego.

Hello @creativetruth 

Thank you for thinking of the Inkwell when you write creatively.

We do not accept chapters or serials.  

Besides this rule here is a summary of some community guidelines:


- Be sure to read The Ink Well community rules at the top of the community home page, and check out our [FAQ about The Ink Well](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/important-faqs-about-the-ink-well-dos-and-donts-rules-and-tips).
- We accept two kinds of short stories in The Ink Well: fictional stories and creative nonfiction stories.
- We are all about quality, and we expect writers to carefully review their work before posting. Not doing so will result in low curation rewards or posts being ignored.


Here are some important resources:

- You can see our article on checking your posts for grammar [here](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/writing-tip-of-the-week-30-help-for-the-grammatically-challenged).
- You can find some great articles on story writing in our [catalog of storytelling tips](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/catalog-of-fiction-writing-tips-from-the-ink-well).
- You can find information about what we are looking for in creative nonfiction stories in [this post](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/creative-nonfiction-what-it-is-and-tips-for-success).
- Be sure to review The Ink Well's [treasure trove of tips, reminders and guidelines](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/the-ink-well-treasure-trove-of-tips-reminders-and-guidelines).
- Please be sure to engage in the community by reading and commenting on the work of other community members. We ask everyone who posts in The Ink Well to read and comment on at least two other stories for each one published.

links.title: Phone Photography Contest 103 | Right Now!
links.body:
> Hello! Feli is happy to greet you all again through Hive's Phone Photo Contest! Lately, I've been sharing lots of random pictures I take while walking down the street, like this first photo in the post, which I took a while ago. I just walk along and see a beautiful scene, usually offered by the sky or the trees, and I know beforehand that it could be a good photo... I think right now there's a good combination between the beauty of the city and my passionate way of seeing life.
![IMG_20260227_091350.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/243zbepipxeQaZBjM4DBWsYXJBvTVmckDPZpbNM8dB3MEJvZaz3C3bevG1233rPLNrkeZ.jpg)
¡Hola! ¡Feliz de saludarlos nuevamente a través del Concurso de Fotografías con Teléfono de Hive!. Los últimos días he compartido muchas imágenes al azar que voy tomando mientras camino en la calle, como esta primera foto del post, la cual tomé hace rato. Simplemente camino y veo alguna escena hermosa, generalmente ofrecida por el cielo o los árboles, y sé de antemano que podría ser una buena foto... Creo que justo ahora hay una buena combinación entre la belleza de la ciudad y mi manera apasionada de ver la vida.
![IMG_20260226_123918.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/244xwHrTEE5xaHC63RB2AyXe4N4FEGiGELYLurm8GoaLjNtce1qMQs4QVAaZd9cmSsnnK.jpg)
These photographs are from a normal, ordinary day. Scenes that pass before my eyes and that I find beautiful. Perhaps many might think it's silly, but I walk through the city awestruck by the shapes the clouds draw in the sky, the beautiful architecture of the buildings, both modern and old, and right now I'm especially captivated by this autumnal optical illusion in Caracas, since there are many pink, yellow, and orange bushes, colors that aren't normal, but that aren't caused by a cool autumn, but by the intense heat of these dry months.
![IMG_20260226_112922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/241EtC7qMbADtpQG8jZSiEMPZuJTyvFrRQw4BsSUfXRkwBmoDtUVTGaUzno2VgJPfvwsV.jpg)
Estas fotografías son de un día normal, común y corriente. Escenas que se atraviesan frente a mis ojos y que considero hermosas. Quizás a muchos les pueda parecer tonto, pero sí voy caminando por la ciudad anonadado por las formas que dibujan las nubes en el cielo, la hermosa arquitectura de edificios, tanto los modernos como los más antiguos, y justo ahora me tiene enamorado especialmente esa ilusión óptica y otoñal que hay en Caracas, ya que hay muchos arbustos rosas, amarillos, naranjas, colores que no son normales, pero que no son causados por un fresco otoño, sino por el intenso calor de estos meses de sequía.
![IMG_20260307_110803.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23zRw1Xj5vF9sYEKBRimcDcfUMZQZiJ65Jt85uSZw2P221qe5n97SA2jby8dV8PKUB7PH.jpg)
Humbly, these are the pictures I have for you this week. There's no overarching story behind them, but there is a lot of passion—for life, for enjoying the moment, and appreciating every little detail. My day at work wasn't great, even though I work in music, but it wasn't a wasted day. Peace of mind is within us, and we have the power to see life with our best optimism. Not everyone is having a good time right now, so we have to observe and let ourselves be amazed by what surrounds us, just like the cat in front of our workplace, with which I'll close this post. Sylvester hasn't appeared in this competition for a while 😹
![IMG_20260307_172643.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23vYdWgfbNX2zcAibyYAB9pyx8iUJwFp38Rpf48nVqrQ9XbrbB8TszZBf6hBWaXuHnrN9.jpg)
Humildemente, estas son las imágenes que tengo para ustedes esta semana. No hay una historia que resalte detrás de ellas, pero sí mucha pasión , por la vida, por disfrutar el momento y apreciar cada pequeño detalle. El día en el trabajo no fue muy bueno, y eso que trabajo haciendo música, pero no es un día perdido, la paz mental está dentro de nosotros, y tenemos el poder de ver la vida con nuestro mejor optimismo. No todo el mundo la está pasando bien justo ahora, así que hay que observar y dejarse maravillar por lo que nos rodea, tal como el gato del frente de nuestra sede de trabajo, con el cual cierro este post. Sylvester tenía tiempo sin aparecer en esta competencia 😹
![IMG_20260301_133733.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23y8qjGQCBpbcfmsiY5WBcgS9zYEN4zv8p5rNqt7dAT1CgRWjmjrGkj87pLDtBsGcBt2m.jpg)

links.title: Stitch by stitch, my shawl is taking shape 🧶
links.body: > Greetings and blessings, my dear knitting friends. I hope you are all in good health and spirits. I've been very busy with my knitting needles lately, because I've been knitting the shawl I learned to make on Saturday in my knitting class. Since then, I've been making slow progress, enjoying every stitch, and I like each row more than the last. What I love most are the relief stitches. They have something very special... they make the fabric look textured, alive, as if the shawl had little paths forming as the rows progress. Every time I finish a section, I stare at it for a while because the effect is truly beautiful.

> Saludos y bendiciones, mis queridas amigas de las agujas. Espero que estén muy bien con salud y bienestar. En estos días he estado muy entretenida con las agujas, porque he estado tejiendo el chal que aprendí el sábado en mi curso de tejido. Desde entonces, he ido avanzando poco a poco, disfrutando cada puntada, y cada fila me gusta más que la anterior. Lo que más me tiene encantada son los puntos de relieve. Tienen algo muy especial… hacen que el tejido se vea con textura, con vida, como si el chal tuviera pequeños caminos que se van formando a medida que avanzan las vueltas. Cada vez que termino una sección me quedo mirándolo un rato porque de verdad el efecto es precioso. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23zks2SZBrkRDezVKD69rYQMz5Yeph5jnUPjj7voLWnVuAtsMG1wBV91CnKTrTU4nztuN.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xKvHH32oYvQkXYxHGte6HNp5JpRiEZWhmqQ4v1y3N3i4ZcQbLEFsa3F9iZcKrf85PPF.jpg| |--|--| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png

> Another thing that makes me very happy is the colors I chose. Sometimes choosing colors can be quite a challenge, but this time I felt I hit the nail on the head. The colors combine beautifully with each other and further highlight the design that the shawl is taking on. Seeing how the fabric grows and how the stitches begin to form the pattern is a joy that only those of us who love to knit can understand. Knitting this shawl has also been a moment of pause for me. So much so that I've even put off some of the things I usually do every day without stopping. Sitting down for a while with the yarn in my hands, counting stitches, and watching everything take shape has become a little space of peace and calm for me. Here's a sample of my progress so far. There's still a way to go, but the design is starting to show, and that has me very excited. I'd like to spend the day knitting so I can see it finished in a few days. I hope to be able to show it to you very soon. In the meantime, I'll continue to enjoy every stitch. 🧶✨

> Otra cosa que me tiene muy feliz son los tonos que escogí. A veces elegir colores puede ser todo un reto, pero esta vez sentí que di en el clavo. Los colores se combinan muy bonito entre sí y resaltan aún más el diseño que va tomando el chal. Ver cómo el tejido crece y cómo los puntos empiezan a dibujar el patrón es una alegría que solo quienes amamos tejer podemos entender. Tejer este chal también ha sido un momento de pausa para mí. Tanto, que incluso he pospuesto algunas de esas cosas que acostumbro hacer todos los días sin parar. Sentarme un rato con el hilo entre las manos, contar puntos y ver cómo todo va tomando forma se ha convertido en un pequeño espacio de paz y calma para mí. Por aquí, les dejo una muestra de mi avance hasta ahora. Todavía le falta camino, pero ya empieza a verse el diseño y eso me tiene muy emocionada. Me gustaría pasar el día tejiendo para poder verlo listo en pocos días. Espero poder mostrárselo terminado muy pronto. links.title: USDA $263M Food Program: Supporting Farmers, but Nutritional Diversity Is Limited and Could Challenge Small Local Farms
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSn4ZJhBii2DxwRH1GeYpi8vP5wwNgSzdeDoVFFvsDhK/fe3da6b0_8837_4a8a_ae99_c5206a8a44ef.jpg)
>Bulk industrial foods dominate supply chains, while local farmers bring diversity, quality, and sustainability to the table.
 Image Credit: [ 1 ](https://www.serenityridgemd.com/supporting-local-sustainable-agriculture-and-the-environment/)[ 2](https://www.openaccessgovernment.org/agriculture-highest-death-rate/47881/)

According to reports, the USDA intends to invest $263 million in purchasing dairy products and speciality crops to supply food banks and nutrition agencies. At first glance, it may seem like a noble attempt at assisting consumers and farmers alike; however, on a deeper level, it also raises some questions about the broader impacts on the country’s food system.

Programs like this, which involve large-scale food procurement, can sometimes promote overproduction and therefore create dependency on large scale agricultural operations. Most agricultural subsidies have historically benefited large-scale producers of goods such as dairy, corn, and soybeans over smaller family-run farms because they can produce these commodities with a greater degree of consistency at higher volume. 

This system may unintentionally make it more difficult for small family-run farms to compete with industrial operations and may unintentionally discourage small family-run farms from maintaining their operations due to difficulty in competing against large industrial farms. The reliance on mass-produced food items continues to strengthen the large industrial farming sector, which is detrimental to small family-run farms. So it is worth considering how such large-scale purchases could affect smaller producers in the long term.

By providing communities with the calories they need to thrive, these nutrition programmes are fulfilling an important role in our society. According to the USDA, of the $263 million, over $148 million will be used for buying dairy products, including butter, cheddar cheese, Swiss cheese, and milk. The other remaining portion is allocated to speciality crops, including chickpeas, dried beans, lentils, split peas, pecans, walnuts and fresh pears. While the items above provide protein, fibre and heart-healthy fats, the overall selection offers limited varierty in fresh produce, leafy greens and culturally relevant foods.

Essentially, the programme supports individuals who are facing immediate hunger; however, it does not appear to be adequately providing individuals with a well-rounded diet of nutritious foods that will adequately meet their long-term needs for nutrition and/or tackle the deeper cause of food insecurity, such as lack of access to fresh/locally sourced/culturally appropriate foods.

Programs such as this provide important assistance to both families and farmers. I believe that making an effort to purchase local foods and encouraging people to grow and cook meals from raw ingredients could enrich the many meals consumed within communities. Supporting local producers can provide quality, variety, and diversity while also reducing the need for industrial-scale food production.

This report made me reflect that true food security is more than simply providing food, but it is also creating long-term solutions to support small family farms, protect the environment, and most importantly, strengthen the local community, an approach that can work alongside broader programs to benefit everyone.

References:

USDA, “Secretary Rollins Announces $263 Million Food Purchase to Support U.S. Producers”  [Link](https://www.fns.usda.gov/newsroom/usda-0033.26)

Environmental Working Group, “Updated EWG Farm Subsidy Database Shows Largest Producers Reap Billions”  [Link](https://www.ewg.org/research/updated-ewg-farm-subsidy-database-shows-largest-producers-reap-billions-despite-climate)

The nutritional quality of food parcels provided by food banks and the effectiveness of food banks at reducing food insecurity in developed countries: a mixed‑method systematic review [Link](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35112742/)

links.title: From Slavery to Survival.
links.body: > After years of humiliation as a slave, Eivor seized a moment of distraction to break free from his captors. Following a brutal revolt on a boat, he armed himself and navigated the frozen landscape. With the help of his raven and a chance reunion with Dag, the plan to rescue the remaining crew from their captors was set into motion. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX3tYMDj48kodzpHW3Zj9WqMJM2bKKce81SJySxcHoPGv/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbngAJxAQx5TFGHjuywmZ2qGbWdf7pw8aLW8Z7jdV1Je6/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTUUr8K7jfFR4Pf7F1MXyM1FiuiBxg5hgf93ekrRFrFqT/screenshot_3_.png) It was a prolonged time since Eivor became a man, only to be captured by the killer of his family. He was forced to live as a humiliated slave, intended to face a lonely and frail death far from his home. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmanHKc75jzjMu9h24ABDMvMQ9bu4Bt7DgGmdeDBpxFWRu/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXnmbD64PGXCjAafrjmm1yoUbE56VBEgQv4ssREKkKz2z/screenshot_5_.png) The captors eventually left the area, leaving Eivor to dwell on his fate. He was thrown into a boat with a harsh warning that he would lose his eyes if he even attempted to move from his position. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6biSSi2ZNowmoCGCWFuM7yS19VSM5CfKtGvntPG5uBr/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTCKKVZD7e24LXrPxpLA84389TiCTNPsAX23Bvnziecyf/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYkvkQvgUaoUcG56wFcNiSFiVEQZpBPVX6yHs9xwf6Cqg/screenshot_8_.png) Suddenly, a bird flew above, sparking something inside him. Eivor began attacking the people around him, single-handedly taking them all down before picking up an axe to continue his journey through the chaos. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXWbHboAZ3Ntq9rkFPrMfbprrSagSHodbzJDqXHroTZA6/screenshot_11_.png) I had to find and rescue my crew after that, so I collected food to increase my health for the coming battles. I found a high point to get a better view of the surrounding area and plan my next move. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP3GZZWgAmwRiLGyxkhxg4X4qJSwKcrXCrQWQLvt1bbKV/screenshot_12_.png) I thought I could perform a leap of faith from the height to reach the ground quickly. However, after jumping off, my character just fell into the pit below in a clumsy way, reminding me Eivor still had much to learn. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmetcMpgCfkvfPjbn1YSvH9RuYS39YKQ2AKLcQ7yjD3ERQ/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPQsXwL955uQDaRpK3PdZby6YzF6dSAf5ZhayLeAf3c19/screenshot_14_.png) I encountered an enemy on my path, marking my first real fight. I noticed I didn't have an assassination option yet, so I had to rely on the weight of my axe to kill him in a direct confrontation. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPwAe4LRtdHdm5oyEWXhZxuArjXpCFXgp4pcx1AuF39Yv/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdBcXJtLUcprU2qjxAmUjFU1ytZqThhqvktAszvJpVYVs/screenshot_16_.png) I soon discovered that I have a pet bird, a black raven. I learned I could call upon it to scout the area and help me find specific objectives hidden in the snowy environment. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU2r4cCd9PXZmvmDYCCXJoGPVPZ6LfVkhUqd9EQ724QWP/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSNpAtR1DzqirvxBQxGgP8BQcYQ9p8KP4eDKvXSu6oBuV/screenshot_18_.png) I found two more guards blocking my path. While I originally planned to ignore them and stay hidden, I ended up fighting them anyway and took both down with my axe. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX4YET9H6RE9tUNacceFF7X8DkQgGtsdWNZySxMs86Rpq/screenshot_19_.png) I kept walking toward the area where my crew was being imprisoned. As I got closer, I heard clash of iron and the sounds of a struggle nearby. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS8qwYQmuQ9CUz8RtEhsi9gKtkZMPgBpi9YofeV17UyY9/screenshot_20_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ1NMRsF262c2L5BFnB4dxX3SJGiuyPPydWsBFgVgaPEF/screenshot_21_.png) After getting close, I found Dag, who had just taken down an enemy. He explained he had slipped away during a sword clash; we made a deal that he would prepare the ship while I went to rescue the rest of the crew. That's all for now. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=coooldude/c353c98c)

I noticed I didn't have an assassination option yet, so I had to rely on the weight of my axe to kill him in a direct confrontation. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPwAe4LRtdHdm5oyEWXhZxuArjXpCFXgp4pcx1AuF39Yv/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdBcXJtLUcprU2qjxAmUjFU1ytZqThhqvktAszvJpVYVs/screenshot_16_.png) I soon discovered that I have a pet bird, a black raven. I learned I could call upon it to scout the area and help me find specific objectives hidden in the snowy environment. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU2r4cCd9PXZmvmDYCCXJoGPVPZ6LfVkhUqd9EQ724QWP/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSNpAtR1DzqirvxBQxGgP8BQcYQ9p8KP4eDKvXSu6oBuV/screenshot_18_.png) I found two more guards blocking my path. While I originally planned to ignore them and stay hidden, I ended up fighting them anyway and took both down with my axe. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX4YET9H6RE9tUNacceFF7X8DkQgGtsdWNZySxMs86Rpq/screenshot_19_.png) I kept walking toward the area where my crew was being imprisoned. As I got closer, I heard clash of iron and the sounds of a struggle nearby. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS8qwYQmuQ9CUz8RtEhsi9gKtkZMPgBpi9YofeV17UyY9/screenshot_20_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ1NMRsF262c2L5BFnB4dxX3SJGiuyPPydWsBFgVgaPEF/screenshot_21_.png) After getting close, I found Dag, who had just taken down an enemy. He explained he had slipped away during a sword clash; we made a deal that he would prepare the ship while I went to rescue the rest of the crew. That's all for now.

These kinds of conversations are super valuable for all involved. When I was Lily's age, there was a lot going on and I didn't have anyone to talk about it with for years. It probably (almost very likely) still affects me today. 

My wife and I have tried to develop open conversation with Smallsteps in a similar way and I also lay next to her for a while after reading and we just talk. When we are driving, we talk. When we are walking around, sitting, playing, we talk. There is a lot of talking between us, and I think that she feels safe, because even when she thinks we will be angry about something, she tells us.

As far as my experience tells me from my own childhood, while all the big events have an effect, I think the little things make the biggest impact. Not having someone there to listen and discuss with, is something no child should experience. So I am super happy she opens up to you and you can talk seriously about life.

links.title: Nächte die in Erinnerung bleiben
links.body:
Hallo Freunde,

wisst ihr, es gibt so Nächte in denen man sich überlegt, ob man den Job weiter machen soll. Vor ein paar Tagen war genau so eine Nacht. Es war an einem Wochenende eine klassiche Nachtschicht, bei der man erwartet das man ein paar Besoffene einsammeln wird. Aber ehrlich gesagt, das hatten wir nicht. Wir hatten ein anderes Problem. Es gibt Einsätze die man nicht wahrnehmen will und dazu gehören Kinder Einsätze und irgendwie hatten wir an diesen Tag gleich mehrere dieser Einsätze und nicht jedes der Kinder und Babys hat diese Nacht überlebt. Ich glaube ich habe in all den Jahren die ich in dem Job jetzt schon bin keine so anstrengende Nacht. Im Nachhinein finde ich es spannend wie wir funktioniert haben. Ich meine Kindereinsätze sind nicht ohne und es ist nicht unser Alltag, aber wir haben einfach funktioniert. Die Kommunikation lief gut, wir haben alles besprochen, kommuniziert was wir brauchen und was wir machen. Und dann haben wir es umgesetzt. 

Ich finde es immer wieder spannend wie wir wie eine Maschine funktionieren und in diesem Moment nur zählt zu funktionieren. Ein schnelles Ergebnis zu erreichen und den Patienten zu versorgen ist das A und O das wir umsetzen müssen. Wichtig ist dabei, dass das Individum dabei hinten dran steht und wir unsere Schemata abarbeiten können. Und ehrlich gesagt, ich glaube ohne hätten wir diese Nacht nicht durchstanden. Wir haben irgendwann nur noch funktioniert und nicht mehr gedacht. Wir haben alles hinten angestellt. Am Ende standen wir da und haben uns dazu entschlossen, wir brauchen was zu futtern. Also ging es zur Golden Möwe. Es gibt so Tage wo man aus der Arbeit kommt und sich nur denkt. Fuck ich brauche was zu futtern. Anders kann man es nicht beschreiben. Aber irgendwie funktioniert man doch weiter. 

In dem Sinne, gehabt euch wohl und passt auf euch auf.

links.body:
It was brought to my attention that some witnesses are intentionally sending price feeds that are inflated by 25% (possible to cut the loop on HBD conversion and lead to swift default?)

I have withdrawn my witness votes from all witnesses passing stale or inflated data. I agree that HIVE inflation from HBD conversions is a problem, but messing with the price feeds is not the answer. It just leads to a swift decline in any remaining credibility that Hive has within the broader crypto ecosystem.

Instead of messing with the price feeds, witnesses should be cutting their HBD interest rates, and voting for the DHF blocker proposal.

As a longer term economic solution, we need to cut the debt limit to 20% and set an automatic DHF burn so that HBD in the DHF can never exceed 50% of the total HBD outside the DHF.

links.title: ¿Qué nos hace continuar? Encuentro de Talentos [ES/EN] 📷 🌼
links.body:
> ¿Qué nos hace continuar? Será el café, será la inercia de la vida, serán las letras que penetran el alma y nos dan sentido a la vida, será el talento de nuestros acompañantes que nos motivan a seguir. Qué nos mantiene aquí pegados a pesar de las limitaciones de tiempo y entradas. Será que no perdemos las esperanzas de las subidas y bajadas, será esperando la suerte en la vida o será el trabajo acumulado constante de crecimiento personal que algún día será. Esos serán están allí latentes, esperando resultados. Simplemente lo notamos no están todos los que siempre estaban, parece una formula matemática en lo que vamos en bajada muchos desaparecen. Y claro esta trabajar tanto, aportar tanto y no tener resultados es muy duro para todos.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

What keeps us going? Is it the coffee, the inertia of life, the words that touch our souls and give meaning to our lives, or the talent of our companions that motivates us to continue? What keeps us here despite the limitations of time and income? Is it that we don't lose hope through the ups and downs, is luck waiting in the wings, or is it the constant, accumulated work of personal growth that will one day come to fruition? These things lie dormant, waiting for results. We simply notice that not everyone who was always there is still around. It seems like a mathematical formula: when things go downhill, many disappear. And of course, working so hard, contributing so much, and not seeing results is very hard for everyone.

Pero que sucede con los que se quedan porque es su mejor terapia, es la conversación diaria con su yo interior. Es rellenar de historias que ya no tienes a quien contarle. Es compartir esa taza de café con un buen animo. ¿Porqué continuar escribiendo, porqué continuar compartiendo? Que nos queda de aprendizaje allí. Comenzamos en los espacios de Hive con ánimo de obtener ganancias y mejorar nuestros días. Y si hemos encontrado un espacio donde compartir con otros nuestras historias nos hace sentir muy bien. Donde encontramos unos participantes con nuestras mismas inquietudes y contenidos, en donde coincidimos en sanar a través de las letras.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

But what about those who stay because it's their best therapy, their daily conversation with their inner selves? It's filling their minds with stories they no longer have anyone to tell. It's sharing that cup of coffee in a good mood. Why continue writing, why continue sharing? What do we learn there? We started in the Hive spaces hoping to earn money and improve our days. And finding a space where sharing our stories with others feels wonderful. A place where we find participants with the same concerns and content, where we agree on healing through writing.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQwhMgpC8aftBs7UG8zY9VuJToW7ZdGndXos99K4UYTff/imagen.png) No sabíamos de este mundo y lo hemos ido construyendo paso a paso, ganando lectores y haciéndonos asiduos a diario de lecturas que nos invitan a ser mejores y hasta de contar secretos. Es uno de los pocos lugares donde creemos estar a salvo. Pero no se crean, hay rateros también en estos espacios, logramos detectarlos, esquivarlos; a veces caemos en sus trampas. Simplemente aprendemos y aún a pesar de ellos decidimos continuar.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

We knew nothing about this world, and we've built it step by step, gaining readers and becoming daily readers of books that inspire us to be better and even to share secrets. It's one of the few places where we feel safe. But don't be fooled, there are thieves in these spaces too. We manage to spot them, avoid them; sometimes we fall into their traps. We simply learn, and despite them, we decide to keep going.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUUER5gJuXySWWFxbJm61KuZKP6am7gJhSMt4WFXCteJp/imagen.png) Ya Hive se ha vuelto parte de mi día a día, no contar con este espacio y las comunidades, me dejaría un gran vacío que necesitaría llenar con algo. Como si no me faltaran cosas que hacer en mi día, pero tener la perspectiva de contar lo que hago por aquí me llena de alegría. Compartir mis flores del jardín, mis historias familiares, mi buen animo en las mañanas con mi taza de café y hasta las dificultades en Venezuela forman parte de nuestro quehacer histórico. No me creo una gran escritora, no sigo las reglas estrictas en los poemas, pero disfruto la posibilidad de compartir contenido y ser leída. A veces leo a otros participantes y quedo fascinada con sus habilidades para contar historias. Me los imagino en un futuro no muy lejano compartiendo sus obras y siendo reconocidos por su gran talento.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

Hive has become a part of my daily life. Not having this space and these communities would leave a huge void that I'd need to fill. As if I didn't have enough to do each day, having the opportunity to share what I do here fills me with joy. Sharing my garden flowers, my family stories, my good mood in the mornings with my cup of coffee, and even the hardships in Venezuela are all part of our shared history. I don't consider myself a great writer; I don't follow strict rules in poetry, but I enjoy the opportunity to share content and be read. Sometimes I read other participants and am fascinated by their storytelling abilities. I imagine them in the not-too-distant future sharing their work and being recognized for their great talent.

No me considero valiente por estar aquí, me considero constante, perseverante y buscadora de las verdades de la vida. Agradezco que Hive llegara a mi vida a través de mi hijo, cuando yo no sabía que lo iba a necesitar tanto, llenando un espacio que ellos dejarían. Cada aporte, cada lectura va construyendo un libro sobre mi historia en particular. Un espacio que disfruto mucho acercándome cada día a descubrir que las palabras y frases pueden volverse terapéuticas.
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

I don't consider myself brave for being here; I consider myself constant, persevering, and a seeker of life's truths. I'm grateful that Hive came into my life through my son, when I didn't know I would need it so much, filling a void they would leave. Each contribution, each reading, builds a book about my particular story. It's a space I truly enjoy, getting closer each day to discovering that words and phrases can become therapeutic.

📷

links.title: A Thoughtful Habit
links.body:
>

One of the (many) good things about Hive, is it encourages me to look back through older photos from time to time and see if there is anything suitable to use for a particular article or, to inspire me in some way. It is rewarding, as it brings up those old memories and I think I have a higher appreciation for the various travels. 

> This one is from the flower market in Amsterdam.

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23viLzFaewzThbe3PjJuV3qMT3hgCxDEJ57qdLVkRxQf6Pi8MuBWkok95A7vTWmnw4sJA.jpg)


---

I believe that photos have \

for the most part, because we take so many of them, even when there is nothing much going on. In the past, a photo opportunity had to be worthy enough for the effort and cost, but as the cost came down, the frequency went up until now people can't do anything without taking a photo of it. And while they used to be for memory's sake, now taking a photo is like a default action, almost thoughtless. And the vast majority of the photos taken will *never be looked at again. They will just sit there, taking up a few bytes of space, until the next phone change, a mass delete, or a crash wipes them all. 

> Is it a waste to take them?

*Probably?*

Maybe, maybe not. For me, I tend to think through the photos I take, and I don't mean the composition or the moment. I mean, action of taking the photo itself is part of my thought process, especially now since the stroke. It gives me a chance to slow down, have a proper look at what is happening, and the physical actions stick it all into my memory more firmly. The effort it takes is intentional, and because it takes effort, my brain treats it with a little more seriousness. But I think if it was a default action, it wouldn't have the same impact on my memory, nor would it help me process the moment. 

> Defaults are rarely valuable.

*That is not true.* 

If the defaults are well designed and implemented so they trigger appropriately to provide the right action at the right time, then they are very valuable indeed. But let's face it, most of us are far less intentional with the habits we build, which is why so many of us have so many bad habits that we would like to get rid of, but don't. Instead, we just keep letting the default trigger fire, keep on doing the same thing, keep on getting results we don't want, and then keep on saying that \

- but we don't. Because they are defaults. 

Imagine if one day there was an app that allowed for habits to be turned on and off with a click. The app could follow us around and audit all of our habits, good and bad, and log them into a list that we could then toggle individual events on and off. Once the list is created, we could have a look at what our goals are, work out what habits move us forward, which back, and which create hurdles, and then *clear the behavioural path* in front of us. 

> I think it would be interesting.

And I wonder how we would feel if we were \

a particular habit. For instance, I have a habit of snacking late in the evening while I am writing, even though I am not hungry. However, would I feel different in the moment if I didn't snack? Probably not. I might actually feel better, and think better. However, if I turned off the habit of going to the gym five or more times a week, how would I feel? Of course, while there would be huge benefits to us if all the app did was allow us to turn off bad habits so we did more of the good, we would also want to be able to add habits to our repertoire. For those who don't exercise, they might want to start with three intentional sessions a week. For those who want to eat healthier, add the habit of buying only fresh, healthy food, whilst cutting out the junk. In the past we used to take photos of the big occasions in our lives, and of the people who are important to us. But the thing is, our lives are actually dictated for the most part by our daily habits. All the little things that we do that we don't tend to focus much attention on. Now, the habit of taking photos is almost as automatic as breathing for some people, but still, all of our daily habits go uninvestigated, unaddressed, and fly under the radar. Yet there they are, each day, making impacts on the potential we hold and direction of our lives. The habit app doesn't exist unfortunately, so if we want to change our behaviours, for now at least, we are going to have to do it the old fashioned way. > We are going to have to work for it. links.body: Lustrzanka, nawet niepełnoklatkowa, to znacznie większa pojemność tonalna. Te przepalone chmury to jednak mnie rażą, choć czasem i na dslrze nie da się tego uniknąć. A porównuję 18-letni model lustrzanki z 6-letnim modelem telefonu. To oczywiście też różnica faktycznej rozdzielczości, bo matryca w telefonie, z racji małych rozmiarów fizycznych nie odwzoruje tylu punktów obrazu, co matryca w lustrzance, choćby nawet miała 10x więcej megapixeli. Fizyki tak się nie oszuka. Ale na potrzeby publikacji w internecie wystarczy, a nawet na wydruki 20x30 cm, jeśli się nie przycinało kadru za mocno. Kolejny jest brak wysokiej czułości, co ogranicza zdjęcia w słabym świetle, choć producenci starają się temu zaradzić specjalnymi trybami \

, które działają na nieco innej zasadzie. Ponadto brakuje w smartfonach długich ogniskowych oraz bokehu, tutaj też fizyki się nie oszuka. Ale jak się ograniczymy do fotografii, w której używamy tylko krótkich i standardowych ogniskowych, można nawet czasem zrobić tym kalkulatorem jakieś zdjęcie. Jest też jedna (i chyba jedyna) przewaga smartfona nad lustrzanką. Zawsze ma się go w kieszeni i przez to można uchwycić coś niespodziewanego.

links.title: Good Food vs. bad restaurant || en-es
links.body:
>Has it ever happened to you that you go to a place for which you have a super high expectation, and when you get there you say, 'Is that all?' I hope I'm not the only one, because I don't know if I've become old or if my mind no longer processes novelty, uniqueness, and it seemed like a complete disappointment compared to the place I'm going to tell you about next.
\n\n

>My J.J. is a pizza lover; he can solve all his meals with a slice, and his life improves noticeably. In my city, there are many places that sell pizza, and the best part is that some have a view of the sea, perfect for watching the sunset.
\n\n

>I had seen this place on social media, and we decided to go because they had them at a good price, and the photos, WOW!, we loved them. The place is called Tiki Bar, and it is located in the city of Lechería, Venezuela. Here I share my experience.
\n\n>
>Les ha pasado que van a un sitio que tienen una expectativa superalta del mismo y cuando llegan dicen: \

Espero no ser la única, porque no sé si ya me volví vieja o mi mente ya no procesa lo novedoso, lo único, y me pareció una completa disyuntiva del sitio que les hablaré a continuación.
\n\n>

>Mi J.J. es amante de la pizza; toda su comida la puede resolver con un pedazo y su vida mejora notablemente. En mi ciudad, existen muchos sitios donde venden y lo mejor es que algunos son con vista al mar, listos para el atardecer.
\n\n>

>Yo había visto este sitio por las redes sociales y nos propusimos ir porque las tenían a buen precio y las fotos, ¡WOW!, nos encantaron. El sitio se llama Tiki Bar y se encuentra en la ciudad de Lechería, Venezuela. Acá les cuento mi experiencia.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-02-21 at 6.23.08 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23uFPFhBFVBzuNw8862NARsbpwq3i8hF5DnEmqVoQ62ZAF4mB5Afmq37Z2mn3EjJDDsPZ.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-02-21 at 6.23.32 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23u69cuYyaQ9wqo9hazmS125hVFdGKTfYwicTMLAatjcaDBeqsjCT7KSKt9v7XfvUv1MQ.jpeg) **
The Good
**

>Pizza and beer. Definitely, the pizza is a 10/10. Just the way we like it, with a spectacular and juicy flavor. We ordered a pizza with corn, bell pepper, onion, ham, and black olives. The only size they offer is medium, so it was enough for the two of us.
\n\n

>The food is the only thing that should matter when we visit a place, meaning that it is on time, meets our expectations, and is truly what they advertise on social media. It had all of that, so we were very satisfied with that part 😉.
>Lo bueno >

>La pizza y la cerveza. Definitivamente, la pizza tiene un 10/10. Justo como nos gusta, con un sabor espectacular y jugoso. Pedimos una pizza con maíz, pimentón, cebolla, jamón y aceitunas negras. La única medida que manejan es mediana, así que fue suficiente para nosotros dos.
\n\n>

>La comida es lo único que debería importar cuando visitamos un sitio, es decir, que esté a tiempo, que cumpla con lo que esperamos y sea verdaderamente la oferta que dan en las redes sociales. Todo eso lo tenía, así que muy satisfechos por esa parte 😉.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-02-21 at 6.23.21 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23uQrWbK7Yei628P6xy82zv5vmXnZJ4VdQhdLUiwu6F52ZzaPrzggWQhbstFHDQhr8x7y.jpeg)

>The beer was also good. It was cold and they have variety. I believe that all street food, like pizza, should be accompanied by a good beer. So 100/100 for that part.
\n\n>

>La cerveza también fue buena. Estaba fría y tienen variedad. Yo considero que toda comida de calle, como la pizza, debe ser acompañada de una buena cerveza. Así que 100/100 por esa parte.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23u615hVtEw1SoemyvnnriminnBa5RKR6h3CTvBpRsm3U3etvZTCgxy595amrUhHVWCYB.jpeg
>The tree of life. I liked that instead of destroying it, they took it as part of the decoration, and I didn't miss the opportunity to \

I didn't have time to talk to it, but it is an activity that I try to do more often now.
\n\n>
>El árbol de la vida. Me gustó que en vez de destruirlo, lo tomaran como parte de la decoración y no perdí la oportunidad de \

. No me dio tiempo de hablar con él, pero es una actividad que procuro realizar ahora más seguido.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-02-21 at 6.23.14 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23wzvheiQiMdTN3bHyBwKhkQ7zV8PGZ9w5p3gcUDhg7J8xpw3quDYfziMJ9GDdupxwhQU.jpeg) -----

>Unfortunately, I didn't want to focus on so many negative things, but I left feeling stunned.
\n\n
>First of all, the place. I don't know if it's because electricity is very expensive or that young people nowadays \

but it was so dark that I felt trapped, unsafe, with no sense of trust. Being a fishing area, near the sea, and a house converted into a restaurant, I felt like a spider or the dreaded cockroaches would jump at me. Also, a cat kept jumping and positioning itself all over the restaurant.
>Lo no tan bueno >

>Lamentablemente, no quería enfocarme en tantas cosas negativas, pero salí como aturdida.
\n\n>
>En primer lugar, el local. No sé si es porque la electricidad está muy costosa o los jóvenes de ahora \

, pero era tanta oscuridad que me sentía como atrapada, insegura, nada de confianza. Por ser una zona pesquera, cerca del mar, y una casa convertida en restaurante, sentí que me saltaría una araña o las temidas cucarachas. Además, un gato no dejaba de saltar y ubicarse en todo el restaurante.
-----

>Secondly, the harassment for taking our beers, as if they were charging us for being there. It is true that the more you consume, the more profit for the company, but when you haven't even had half and they are already hovering around you to make you consume more, I found it uncomfortable. When we go out on motorcycles, we can't drink much alcohol; we only go out to enjoy and eat, but I think they didn't understand that part.
\n\n>

>En segundo lugar, el acoso por tomarnos las cervezas, como si nos cobraran por estar allí. Es cierto que mientras más consumas, más ganancias para la empresa, pero que no lleves ni la mitad y ya te anden rondando para que consumas más, me pareció incómodo. Nosotros cuando andamos en moto no podemos consumir mucho alcohol; solo salimos a disfrutar y comer, pero creo que ellos no entendieron esa parte.
-----

>I believe that if I go to someone's house, I should not criticize their manners or decorations, but in this case, instead of taking advantage of nature, they saturated it with totem figures or statues that were frightening; it seemed as if they were dedicating a cult to some deity. I tried to take some photographs; however, I did not feel comfortable.
\n\n>

>Yo considero que si voy a la casa de alguien, no debo criticar sus modos o decoraciones, pero en este caso, en vez de aprovechar la naturaleza, la saturaron con figuras de tótem o estatuas que lo que daban era miedo; parecía como que le estaban dedicando un culto a alguna deidad. Yo intenté tomarme algunas fotografías; sin embargo, no me sentía cómoda.
------

>The truth is that it was an unpleasant experience because the beauty or tastiness of the place was overshadowed by my discomfort with the space and its decoration. I learned that many times it is not the ostentatious or novel things (as they portray on social media), but feeling comfortable where I am and with what I eat.
# Would I go back? No. Although the pizza is worth it. >Conclusiones >

>La verdad que fue una experiencia poco agradable porque lo bonito o sabroso del lugar se vio opacado por mi incomodidad del espacio y su decoración. Aprendí que muchas veces no es lo ostentoso ni lo novedoso (como lo pintan en las redes), sino sentirme a gusto donde estoy y con lo que como. ¿Volvería? No. Aunque la pizza vale la pena.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-02-21 at 6.23.21 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23tvib1ZvDKzFwQR35xbbv5tPyRM4WtfrdB339Tka9S6oBVSzWEgT92kEtYwUK6wjxF1w.jpeg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-02-21 at 6.23.20 AM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23wMUSGQqDxowyXfgPm82cWWdRzBKSjL3Xf1gG6uNGmPyMZuazuKmeGGEvkcazP7VLEck.jpeg)
_The photographs are my property. The cover and the banner I made in Canva. The translator I used was Google Translate._
# Until next time 👩‍🍳 >

>Las fotografías son de mi propiedad. La portada y el banner los hice en Canva. El traductor que usé fue Google Traductor. Hasta una próxima oportunidad 👩‍🍳.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23wrE6CM8aYD9sK9BCSAzpm9fZJh9oWMaq4qjXBCo9KasNqQn3DTG9FaAH7ywupqrx3Vn.png

links.body:
![COVER.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23wMaX5KmBQxbBgeRF2WyWnhwfMszW6M8MDG8ftHpxpWemjpd4QxwfTAHEx15fbCDoXJ3.jpg)

##### Hi everyone :)

Please look closely at this beauty.
A true gem even before starting that real macro photography series focusing on small stones typical of this region in northern Portugal, in a place extensively explored by the Romans hundreds of years ago in an attempt to extract precious ore from the subsoil, and it is still possible to find stones that were extracted from the depths of the earth and now run on the surface along small streams that run through the mountain.

But today, specifically, the focus is on this small piece of local flora, which falls to the ground from the treetops.

---

Among the numerous techniques available for macro photography, this method is arguably the most cost-effective and efficient for individuals possessing a camera with a removable lens. By simply detaching the lens and reversing its direction, and employing an inversion ring, the process becomes more manageable and streamlined.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://img.esteem.ws/qpm6pm12ej.gif

---

##### Let me present today’s model:


![IMG_3639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aleister/23tvVr8KpAwHstyK93iqCmz8MVsqUVqCJXXGCGHC3qfH4XvPVF1hzD2VcW7FFoUpuse5S.jpg)

<center><sub>F-stop: F/5 | Exposure time: 1/350 sec. | ISO speed: ISO 400</sub></center>

---

##### Session Purpose
The goal of these macro photography sessions is to capture images with as much detail as possible within the capabilities of the technique used, always focusing on the meticulous observation and documentation of all visual characteristics and details. Furthermore, I aim to create attractive visual compositions for publication on this blog, seeking to share the beauty and complexity of this work.

---

##### Used equipments
Camera: Canon EOS 600D Digital SLR with CMOS sensor
Lens: EFS 18-55mm with f/5 maximum aperture, allowing shallow depth of field and capturing fine details.
Used inverter ring
Tripod: not used
Lighting: Adjustable LED lights to provide soft, even lighting, avoiding harsh shadows and highlighting the details of structures.

##### Camera Settings
Focus Mode: Manual focus to ensure precision in specific details of the structure.
Aperture: Variable aperture between f/4 and f/5 for adequate depth of field, ensuring all important details are in focus.
ISO: Low ISO setting (400) to minimize noise in images.
Shutter Speed: Adjust shutter speed as needed to avoid underexposure, while maintaining a value that allows you to capture sharp details.

---

To finish, i leave you with some considerations regarding these photo sessions:

> Observing all these pieces through macro photography reveals a fascinating dimension and breadth, full of minute details that ultimately assume significant importance in the visual composition. The complexity of these objects, when viewed from this perspective, takes on a beauty that is often overlooked by the indifference of the eye. The essence of macro photography lies in its ability to elevate ordinary objects to extraordinary levels, offering an intimate and captivating perspective.

The session is closed for today.
Hope you like it :)
