links.body: > Dobry wieczór. Mizernie spałam, ale to nic. Wstałam, ogarnęłam się i pojechałam na terapię. Na terapii płakałam jak małe dziecko. Wyrzuciłam z siebie jakie mam problemy w relacji z przyjaciółką i po prostu zaczęłam wyć, bo bardzo się boję, że to wszystko jebnie jeśli się nie ogarnę, a nie wiem jak mam to zrobić. Nigdy chyba jeszcze tak strasznie nie płakałam na terapii. Wnioski są z jednej strony druzgocące, bo jeśli chcę coś zmienić [a chcę] to czeka mnie tytaniczna praca, ale z drugiej strony jest nadzieja, że mogę być dobrym człowiekiem i dobrą przyjaciółką, nikt mi tej furtki nie zamyka. I jak zwykle ten sam wniosek przy większości problemów, które mam - winna jest matka. Nosz kurwa.. Pojechałam do pracy i dostałam turbodoładowania z radości, że już mogę pracować. Było mi bardzo miło, gdy pracownicy wydawali się realnie ucieszeni moją obecnością. Kilka dziewczyn nawet mi się rzuciło na szyję. Co się działo jak mnie nie było to chyba nie chcę wiedzieć. Na rozpoczęciu zmiany powiedziałam swoje i już miałam rozgonić towarzystwo do pracy, ale moja asystentka wyszła na środek z wielkim prezentem i złożyła mi od całego zespołu życzenia urodzinowe i zostałam obdarowana prezentem. Karta do Empiku, bo wiedzą, że dużo czytam, więc mam sobie kupić książki, krasnoludek pokazujący dwa środkowe palce, przepiękna grająca kartka, słodycze i bluza z wizerunkiem mojego psa. Czaicie? Mam bluzę z wizerunkiem mojego psa!!! ![20260310_225635.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ataraksja/23tbpu3kRcAEaszYRkbwy1iwhNEsrQoGQZefaco4ZY77vCFBsdD5fqFermnpMmE3c2XAY.jpg) *Źródło: fotografia własna* Ale abstrahując od prezentów byłam po prostu realnie wzruszona tym, że moi podwładni lubią mnie na tyle, że zrzucili się i sprawili mi wspaniałe prezenty ukierunkowane tak naprawdę na moją osobę. A oni nie mają ze mną lekko, bo ja raczej twardą ręką prowadzę moją zmianę, a jednak jestem dla nich ważna, bo nie mam poczucia, żeby to było włażenie w dupę. No i mnie wzrusz opętał kosmiczny. Jednym z życzeń było to, żebym się nie zmieniała, bo jestem wspaniałym człowiekiem i liderem i tu już mi aż warga zadrżała, na szczęście się przy nich nie popłakałam. W pracy dużo się działo, ale przez to, że pracowałam 10h to dłużyło mi się i aktualnie czuję się bardzo zmęczona. Wróciłam do domu, poszłam z Pako na krótki spacer, bo naprawdę nie mam siły na więcej [20k kroków na liczniku], popłakałam się znowu i idę zaraz spać. Nawet mi się jeść nie chce, wezmę tylko prysznic i do wyra. Pewnie minie kilka dni aż wpadnę na właściwe tryby z pracą, ale jest ok. Szef szefów dał mi bana na najbliższy czas na wolne, bo była niezła rozpierducha, a pracy przed nami bardzo dużo i to bardzo ciężkiej. Jestem gotowa. Do jutra.

links.title: First impressions from the second season of Monarch:Legacy of Monsters
links.body:
<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23zkkUgVY6h8y7b2vasDUZV4hfkhnE9z4ipXmqneFfyknJCHCRCfEEeJPmM26xzv9iUX7.jpg)
</center>
<center><sub> Poster of the second season at <a href=\

>

  Exactly 11 days ago I finished watching the first season of Monarch and wrote a

> review about it. It was a nice season with the monsters being just the background story. The focus was the convergence of two stories from the same family lineage in different time periods and an impossible reunion due to some crazy space/time travel through a monster world gate. It was creative and I knew that the chances of keeping the creativity for season 2 would be tough, and for now, I was correct.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23tkhmRFK3ayyq6sCXsvmd9Gjwo2HfHSBqUk9TuJzNN46sDdkZQdcL463nQP2NV3M5H7e.jpg)

>This season is just a regular big monsters fight show? [Screenshot from The Movie Database]

  I only watched the first episode of season 2 of this TV show, but it gave me a feeling that now this season would be just a regular monster hunt focus, similar to any Godzilla franchise movie. So it doesn't look like we will have a big creativity around the story. The cast is the same, including Kurt Russel that ofcourse was rescued in the first episode from the Monster Real. His character Colonel Lee Shaw was the only one left there. And Basically the monster that was freed during the rescue mission is going to be the focus of this new season.

  For sure also they will explore a bit the bonds between all Randa family, grandma Keiko, father Hiroshi and the two half brothers Kentaro and Cate trying to find the right balance in their relationship to continue to explore the world of monsters, which since the last scene of the cliff hanger of last season we got also King Kong around. Monarch, for now, is an ally and not a governmental entity with dark secrets.

  The new season surprise would be if they find alive the grandfather Bill Randa, which gone missing after a quest in search of monsters in the first episode of the first season. Do you think that they will try to make a reunion with the whole family? That's the only member who isn't around yet. It would be fun to see John Goodman active, but everything that I read tries to cool down this theory.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/244y6MekRrhDi1JFzXFKc8KF4LJBt11NdqRhDxHSjNSvsTotjfCgdy9HkrWdjKidNyNtK.png)

>The same cast is back, including Kurt Russel. [Screenshot from The Movie Database]

  The new episodes are being released every Friday. I still didn't watch the second episode since I recently started to watch another TV show with my wife called Chad Powers from Disney+. I will watch this new season with skepticism. I have fun watching monster movies. I think I mostly watch all these movies related to the topic, but I would say my feeling is that this new season of Monarch would be the lowest priority to be watched compared to the others that I am watching.

[![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23wMS5Mk5RaoA6EdKv35TPtYzT2oppCtUWD6qwC5GUBMb877AgJ5rGzJeoTew2bGQJQWZ.png)](https://vote.hive.uno/@gwajnberg)
Banner created in canva

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23u5tR8RSXuZFgpjQ6Eiqz8JMMjig1nLZFvxM1sFhvNmiGYA2snkPD7Z4TnmFxxRyih87.png)

 Exatamente 11 dias atrás, terminei de assistir à primeira temporada de Monarch e escrevi uma

>resenha sobre ela. Foi uma boa temporada, com os monstros servindo apenas como pano de fundo. O foco era a convergência de duas histórias da mesma linhagem familiar em diferentes períodos de tempo e um reencontro impossível devido a uma viagem espacial/temporal maluca através de um portal do mundo dos monstros. Foi criativo e eu sabia que as chances de manter essa criatividade na segunda temporada seriam difíceis, e por enquanto, eu estava certo.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23tkhmRFK3ayyq6sCXsvmd9Gjwo2HfHSBqUk9TuJzNN46sDdkZQdcL463nQP2NV3M5H7e.jpg)

>Esta temporada é apenas um programa comum de lutas de monstros gigantes? [Captura de tela do The Movie Database]

  Eu só assisti ao primeiro episódio da segunda temporada desta série, mas tive a impressão de que esta temporada será apenas uma caçada a monstros comuns, semelhante a qualquer filme da franquia Godzilla. Portanto, não parece que teremos muita criatividade na história. O elenco é o mesmo, incluindo Kurt Russell, que, claro, foi resgatado do Reino dos Monstros no primeiro episódio. Seu personagem, o Coronel Lee Shaw, foi o único que restou lá. E basicamente, o monstro que foi libertado durante a missão de resgate será o foco desta nova temporada.

 Com certeza, eles também explorarão um pouco os laços entre toda a família Randa: a avó Keiko, o pai Hiroshi e os dois meio-irmãos, Kentaro e Cate, tentando encontrar o equilíbrio certo em seu relacionamento para continuar explorando o mundo dos monstros, que, desde o final da última temporada, também contou com a presença de King Kong. A Monarch, por enquanto, é uma aliada e não uma entidade governamental com segredos obscuros.

 A grande surpresa da nova temporada seria encontrarem vivo o avô Bill Randa, que desapareceu após uma missão em busca de monstros no primeiro episódio da primeira temporada. Você acha que eles tentarão reunir toda a família? Ele é o único membro que ainda não apareceu. Seria divertido ver John Goodman em ação, mas tudo o que li parece descartar essa teoria.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/244y6MekRrhDi1JFzXFKc8KF4LJBt11NdqRhDxHSjNSvsTotjfCgdy9HkrWdjKidNyNtK.png)

>O mesmo elenco está de volta, incluindo Kurt Russell. [Captura de tela do The Movie Database]

  Os novos episódios estão sendo lançados todas as sextas-feiras. Ainda não assisti ao segundo episódio, pois recentemente comecei a ver outra série com minha esposa, chamada Chad Powers, no Disney+. Vou assistir a esta nova temporada com certo ceticismo. Gosto de assistir a filmes de monstros. Acho que assisto à maioria dos filmes relacionados ao tema, mas diria que esta nova temporada de Monarch será a última das minhas prioridades em comparação com as outras que estou assistindo.

links.title: Kansas Sunrise
links.body:
![Thumb](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRPNbG9TfhiZZczipaR9twnBw6rGkG58gmFogfXTbVVGR/img_9667.jpeg)

I witnessed an beautiful sunrise in Kansas.  Since the clocks fell back this weekend, I was up early and got out with first light.

![Sky](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXNJcNa3U4FMgQqPvDd4JxXRQsnYbAxTG6tiFMZWqJpvL/img_9666.jpeg)

I made a quick trip to visit family in southeast Kansas.

![Street](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQGbu4US2hZMhXxYw67Pqs3GV1ZCi7CxW2xb4dJ37hzHo/img_9663.jpeg)

Big skies made for some nice color.

![Tree](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUXMjvfa2DyT98HwCsGg4SMjKSZQNFF8EQNMgM5PLocCJ/img_9661.jpeg)

There were some thunderstorms starting to develop.

![Pastels](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUqGEN98i1FVXXzUNbTJCfSrf2gDzmzadNxVQKyNqGFXQ/img_9660.jpeg)

Kansas is in tornado alley and we were under a tornado watch one evening.  The tornados went south and east of where I was staying so no danger or damage.  But it was pretty incredible watching the local weather coverage.  They had storm chasers on three sides of the tornado in Oklahoma providing video footage of a tornado on the ground.  Flipping between the different views and repositioning to follow the storm.  Pretty crazy stuff.  Straight out of a movie like Twister.  It was one of those moments when you realize that a movie you dismissed as sensationalized is not that far from reality 😅

links.title: Childhood Rewound
links.body: > It had been a very busy week at the shop, as I bid my last client of the day goodbye, feeling relieved that her dress didn't need any adjusting after fitting, it was already past my closing time, and her call earlier notifying me of her unavoidable lateness for the fitting made me wait the extra time. If she weren't a good and regular client, I probably would have been less patient and told her to book another appointment. Honestly, I was so tired and had to meet with my daughters, who I guess were already anticipating my return.

/>[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-little-girl-making-a-face-while-standing-in-front-of-a-group-of-people-O6g7Rlq_sto)

I had promised them we would be spending the weekend at Grandma's. I needed the rest, and Grandma was perfect at distracting their attention from me. The thought of having a quiet moment, even if just five minutes, was enough to push me through the last few tedious tasks of tidying up my shop, and then I locked the door and headed home.

The drive to Grandma's was less hectic than expected, as the always-busy road was somewhat free today. My parent's house though a bit renovated from the outside with a fresh coat of paint and some modern window frames, the inside still looked same and hold lots of memories from my childhood, my dad made sure it remained the same, so he wouldn't miss us his children too much, as we were all now adults and have houses of our own now. My daughters rushed in with excitement when we arrived, announcing their presence to every nook and cranny of the old house. I stood outside for a minute, overwhelmed with the feeling of nostalgia. I was home, I looked at the now cemented and tiled floor, with only a small portion left for my mum's vegetable gardening. It used to be all dusty, and our very own playground

I remembered how my siblings, our cousins, and friends from the neighbouring compound would often gather here to play, Suwe, ten-ten, clapping our hands and stepping to now forgotten rhythms, and the highlight of it all was stealing vegetables from mum's much bigger garden then to play mother and child, h how we end up ruining her garden most times and get punished later orm it, a smile I didn't know had formed lingered on my lips, as I walked through the door with a fuzzy feeling spreading through my chest, everything has changed now.

The smell of my mum's fried akara(bean-cake) hit me as I walked in, and my daughters seemed to be arguing over who gets to hold their surviving iPad, \

, I said sternly, seizing it from them, much to their dismay. Their world of touchscreens and instant gratification against my childhood of scraped knees, dust, and pure joy. I wanted this weekend to be that for them.

My mum, sensing they were upset as I got their iPad seized, brought them an old box of treasures, with a tray of akara on the side.

That iPad your mum seized is nothing compared to what is inside this box' she said. The box contained treasures from our childhood.

Their eyes widened in excitement and curiosity as they left the tray of akara to dig into the box.

See what I found, Elena screamed in excitement. It was an old doll with some part of her hair lost, and her dress was overly hand-stitched to one side, but that didn't seem to bother Elena.

'That is your mum's first baby before you, Grandma said. I laughed out loud as my first daughter turned to look at me.

Funny, I named her Elena too. I remembered how I cherished the doll like it was a real baby, and did everything I could think of a baby needed to it, fed, bathed, clothed, and most of the time had it on my back tied firmly with a wrapper.

My other daughter got herself busy with Grandma's beads, jewelries and other treasures they found in the box, that they soon forgot about their iPad.

The evening drew by very quickly, as the night fell, we sat outside to feel the cool night breeze, my dad and I leaned back in the two surviving old wicker chairs, its familiar creak a comforting sound. My daughters, now nestled close to Grandma on the mat as their eyelids grew heavy, drifted off to sleep, lulled by the gentle rhythm of her voice. I closed my eyes, and more memories continued behind them.

links.title: La union de dos rios en el paisaje.
links.body:
>Muy buenos días amigos de Hive, les saluda Angélica García, esperando que estén muy bien y sobre todo felices, es un placer para mi traerles esta nueva publicación artística, y la frescura de un paisaje de mi propia autoría, que espero sea de su agrado.
DISFRÚTENLA.
Ficha de identificación de la obra.
>Título: La unión de dos ríos en el paisaje.\n
>Técnica: Lápiz de grafito, acuarela, acrílico blanco y lápiz de colores, sobre cartulina.\n

>Nota: la secuencia de fotografías e imágenes de esta ilustración fueron tomadas con la cámara digital Canon, PowerShot A480, algunos detalles que eran necesarios, para lograr lo que deseaba presentar, fueron realizados con el programa Adobe Photoshop, además las diapositivas fueron pasadas a formato jpg con el programa Power point.

*La unión de dos ríos en el paisaje.*

![Diapositiva4.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd35Qztr2fV3eoLTbNxaSzbTq6JDtTenQ7JhQ8xgtJZQv/Diapositiva4.JPG)

>Bien amigos de hive, la elaboración de este trabajo artístico, es parte de la añoranza de un paisaje fresco y bello, en pleno verano, con la sombra de los árboles, la vegetación, respirar el aire puro, mientras se disfruta de la abundancia del agua de los grandes ríos que en esta oportunidad, se ven reflejados en la ilustración que realice de la siguiente manera. * Primero y principal y muy importante es la elaboración del dibujo (boceto), el cual se hizo con trazos sueltos a lápiz de grafito, el cual remarque y empecé a trabajarlos poco a poco con mis acuarela, tomando en cuenta el principio puro del azul del cielo, para luego ir dando forma más definida al resto del paisaje, como lo muestran las imágenes.
![Diapositiva1.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNWeaiZtSKSyYujMksvZBJ9sugMg11VeANnxnrhTrX5N9/Diapositiva1.JPG)
* Observen bien compañeros, porque mientras trabajaba, reforzaba cada color, hacia muchos detalles, desde los matices del firmamento, reforzar las líneas de expresión de los árboles, el suelo del lugar con diferentes verdes matizados con ocres y marrones que forman la tierra del lugar, más el follaje de los arboles con la variedades de verdes, simbolizando la frescura del bello paisaje, las rocas, y sobre todo el cauce de los dos ríos que se unen en uno solo.
![Diapositiva2.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeX62YyVqTNr344tMiZXytGt3LAZicndkDzWYBrgdBTGk/Diapositiva2.JPG)
* Amigos amantes del arte y la naturaleza, observen como esta quedando este paisaje, realizado con esmero de la añoranza de pasar un buen rato en las aguas cristalinas de un rio, y un buen paisaje, mientras el calor del verano nos observe, así como nosotros lo sentimos.
![Diapositiva3.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUxfdjLyhYj9Tri46Y9jLn6gkjeKydHx9hLfr9aDE3vUy/Diapositiva3.JPG)
• Con un poco de detalles digitales puedo lograr esta bonita presentación de esta obra ilustrada de un paisaje tanto hermoso como fresco, en pleno verana, la cual fue titulada:

*La unión de dos ríos en el paisaje.*

![Diapositiva4.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd35Qztr2fV3eoLTbNxaSzbTq6JDtTenQ7JhQ8xgtJZQv/Diapositiva4.JPG)

>amo la naturaleza y todos sus beneficios, sobre todo la frescuras de sus árboles y aguas del rio, las cuales represento en esta oportunidad por medio de una bonita obra ilustrada, que espero hayan disfrutado.\n\n

>Bien amigos de Hive Blog, espero les haya gustado esta bonita ilustración, agradezco de todo corazón el apoyo ambiental que le puedan dar a la naturaleza, y al arte que represento.
Muchas gracias por su amable atención.
Atentamente:

*Angélica García.*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbhLuyt81ScLNqyt949pHfdVokVWn16NHMRErM2iGeQGE/diapositiva1.jpg)
___________________________________________________________ >
HELLO!, HELLO! And HELLO! >

>Good morning, Hive friends! This is Angélica García. I hope you are all doing well and, above all, happy. It's a pleasure to bring you this new artwork and the freshness of a landscape of my own creation, which I hope you will enjoy. >
ENJOY!
>
Artwork Identification Sheet.
>
>Title: The Union of Two Rivers in the Landscape.\n>
>Technique: Graphite pencil, watercolor, white acrylic, and colored pencils on cardboard.\n>

>Note: The sequence of photographs and images for this illustration were taken with a Canon PowerShot A480 digital camera. Some details may vary. These were necessary to achieve what I wanted to present. They were created using Adobe Photoshop, and the slides were converted to JPG format using PowerPoint. >

*The confluence of two rivers in the landscape.*

![Slide4.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd35Qztr2fV3eoLTbNxaSzbTq6JDtTenQ7JhQ8xgtJZQv/Slide4.JPG)
>

>Well, Hive friends, the creation of this artwork stems from a longing for a fresh and beautiful landscape in the heart of summer, with the shade of the trees, the vegetation, breathing the pure air, while enjoying the abundance of water from the great rivers, which on this occasion are reflected in the illustration I created as follows. >* First and foremost, and very important It's the creation of the drawing (sketch), which was done with loose graphite pencil strokes. I then outlined it and began to work on it little by little with my watercolors, keeping in mind the pure blue of the sky, and then gradually giving more defined form to the rest of the landscape, as shown in the images.
![Slide1.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNWeaiZtSKSyYujMksvZBJ9sugMg11VeANnxnrhTrX5N9/Slide1.JPG)
>* Look closely, everyone, because while I was working, I reinforced each color, adding many details, from the nuances of the sky, to reinforcing the lines of the trees, the ground with different greens tinged with ochres and browns that form the soil, plus the foliage of the trees with its variety of greens, symbolizing the freshness of the beautiful landscape, the rocks, and above all, the course of the two rivers that join into one.
![Slide2.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeX62YyVqTNr344tMiZXytGt3LAZicndkDzWYBrgdBTGk/Slide2.JPG)
>* Friends who love art and nature, take a look at how this landscape is turning out, created with care and longing for a pleasant time in the crystal-clear waters of a river, surrounded by beautiful scenery, while the summer heat watches over us, just as we feel it.
![Slide3.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUxfdjLyhYj9Tri46Y9jLn6gkjeKydHx9hLfr9aDE3vUy/Slide3.JPG)
>• With a few digital touches, I can create this beautiful presentation of this illustrated work depicting a stunning and refreshing landscape in the heart of summer, which is titled: >

*The Confluence of Two Rivers in the Landscape.*

![Slide4.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd35Qztr2fV3eoLTbNxaSzbTq6JDtTenQ7JhQ8xgtJZQv/Slide4.JPG)
>

>I love nature and all its benefits, especially the coolness of its trees and the river's waters, which I represent on this occasion through a beautiful illustrated work, which I hope you enjoyed.\n\n>

>Well, friends of Hive Blog, I hope you liked this beautiful illustration. I sincerely appreciate any environmental support you can give to nature and to the art I represent. >
Thank you very much for your kind attention.
>
Sincerely,
>

*Angélica García.*

links.title: Learning for self and social improvement
links.body:
<div class=text-justify>

![IMG_1957.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/corneliusoke/IMG_1957.jpeg)

The processes of learning and unlearning are processes every human must go through at some point in time because the day you stop learning, you start dying.

Growing up as a child, we used to sing the song \

(Whatever Will Be, Will Be), but I have learned that for whatever would be to be, you have to make deliberate steps. People often times, because they were told that they were going to be great, just sit down and do nothing, and in the end it seems like whoever told them that they would be great lied when in reality they didn't do what it takes to become great. And this is because you don't stumble into greatness or success. Success is not an event, but it is an outcome of systematically following principles. Based on my interest in agriculture, I have reached out to an agricultural organization that is currently into greenhouse setups and smart farm installation for an internship opportunity that will enable me to become grounded in precision agriculture. Something I have also recently learned is the fact that in every field and industry that you are venturing into there are people who have gone ahead of you, and to make your journey fast and scalable, you have to build meaningful relationships with such kinds of people so that you will not make their mistakes. I'm also currently venturing into data analysis for the purpose of gathering facts and data in the agricultural sector to help farmers make informed decisions. As a matter of fact, one of my goals for the year 2026 was learning, and I have come to discover some things for myself, one of them also being the fact that not everybody whom you have been good to will be good to you. I used to think that once you have been good to the person or a group of people or you rendered help to them, then they automatically should render help to you in time of need as well, but I have learned that not everyone you offer help to will help you in return. As for unlearning, I am trying to unlearn not putting my event business out there because I have learned that aside from being good at what you do, you also have to be loud about it and be in the face of your customers. And the aim of all this learning is to make sure I am able to apply the principles and lessons to improve my income and finances and be able to give my family and loved ones the kind of life they desire because I know there are people whose success is tied to mine. At this point I will be signing out until I see you on my next post. This is my response to the #hl-w208e1 prompt. Thank you for stopping by. Image used is mine. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@corneliusoke/learning-for-self-and-social-improvement--kxf)

links.title: A third world war....
links.body: Good evening guys, how are you all doing today? You can participate in the topic by clicking on this [link](https://peakd.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-531c489cc6465) I wasn't aware that there might be a war. I followed the Russia–Ukraine war, or should I say conflict, and I saw how people lost their lives—children, parents, loved ones, and even soldiers. That was my first time experiencing something like that in my life. A war between two countries led to such loss, talk more of a third world war.

/>[img sur](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-man-in-camouflage-walking-through-a-destroyed-building-7F4d_lRolpo)\n\nMany people haven't realized that we might be moving toward a third world war, and such a war could last for a very long time. The situation is almost like something that has been cooking for a while and is now giving off a strong aroma. Some news has been circulating that Israelites are asking the government of Ghana to join the fight. I actually don't know how true that news is, but if it is 100% true, it could mean that the world might be coming to an end. Because if Ghana joins the fight, then Nigeria might also want to participate, and from there many other countries around the world might begin to fight each other. Then the earth will be without peace. I don't want to experience such a thing because it will be heartbreaking. Tears of innocent people will flow across the earth, and about one-fourth of the world could lose their lives just because of war. I'm from Nigeria, and I was told about the war that took place between Biafra and Nigeria, which is similar in some ways to the Russia–Ukraine conflict. The story made me smile and cry at the same time because I was told some funny things about their journey and their encounters with the Nigerian army.

/>[img sur](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-man-holding-a-sign-that-says-make-love-not-war-L3XFDxDSGj0)

It was brutal then, and food shortage was everywhere in the land for several months. Many people died because of the lack of food caused by the war, and others died because of the pressure and suffering during the war. The reason I'm telling you this story is because if things were that terrible in the past, when there was no advanced technology or nuclear weapons, we already saw how many people lost their lives. So what do you think will happen now? Don't you think it will be catastrophic? This makes me think about the Bible. Some people say it's just a fairy tale, while others say it is real and believe in it. Do you know that there is a part of the Bible that talks about many of the things happening today? It's quite surprising. Thank you for reading.

links.title: Cuando dejé de extrañar // When I stopped missing
links.body:
>

Qué grata sensación es poder extrañar y evocar la primicia de esas emociones que llegaron a nosotros para marcar una huella muy especial. Una canción, un lugar o el aroma de un delicioso café que trae a mi presente algo que al recordar también revive en mi un cúmulo de sentimientos. Es como trasladar una escena del pasado a la realidad y ver desde un ángulo espectador aquello que hoy se convierte en un recuerdo, y es que lo que se extraña es lo que se mantiene más allá del tiempo, como si realmente este no pasara mientras añoras vivir nuevamente algo bonito en tu vida. Extrañar es como una especie de reclamo a lo que una vez pudiste vivir. ¿Seríamos capaces de repetirlo? Tristemente no, ya que incluso el día de mañana no seremos la misma persona que somos hoy, así que sería imposible poder calcar un dibujo que va cambiando de manera constante. Lo que si podemos hacer es grabar ese espacio del paisaje que evocamos con mucha intensidad y dejar que las sonrisas y las lágrimas broten por sí mismas. Estoy seguro que muchos podríamos hacer una lista de esos momentos que parecen congelados en nuestro corazón pero con el fuego y las fuerzas que los mantienen tan vigentes como nuestra propia existencia. >What a pleasant feeling it is to be able to miss and evoke the first stirrings of those emotions that came to us and left a very special mark. A song, a place, or the aroma of delicious coffee brings to mind something that, when I remember it, also revives a flood of feelings in me. It is like transferring a scene from the past to reality and seeing from a spectator's angle what today becomes a memory, because what we miss is what remains beyond time, as if time did not really pass while we long to experience something beautiful in our lives again. >Missing something is like a kind of claim to what you once experienced. Would we be able to repeat it? Sadly, no, because even tomorrow we will not be the same person we are today, so it would be impossible to trace a picture that is constantly changing. What we can do is record that space in the landscape that we evoke with great intensity and let the smiles and tears flow freely. I am sure that many of us could make a list of those moments that seem frozen in our hearts but with the fire and strength that keep them as alive as our own existence.

![openclipart-vectors-man-160034_640.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cajiro/23wWuAfG57AaiaTh43VtGA5hjXSHNFGAxBXanJPGUhJYVnvU66a2J7cUX3LvA9x7FKpLQ.png)
[Pixabay](https://share.google/kmPKi0Wy1n8fp6VzR) by [OpenClipart-Vectors](https://share.google/TktgxX9vr2lu1Cry0)
Recuerdo aquel niño que en vacaciones pasaba algunos días con su abuela, y que cada mañana el aroma del café se expandía por toda la casa. Yo no tomaba café, pero disfrutaba de aquel ambiente mañanero que identificaba algo muy especial de mi abuela: su atención. Y es que más allá de su carácter, ella a su manera demostraba un cariño especial tanto por mí como por el resto de la familia. Cuando medito en esto no hago más que añorar siquiera algo parecido a lo que un día fue, y aunque mi mente con suspiros asuma que esto es imposible también hay algo en mi corazón que guarda una bonita esperanza que no escapa de una realidad atada a nuestra naturaleza. Creo que no fuimos creados para extrañar, mucho menos para dar por perdidos a esas personas y esos momentos especiales que alguna vez llegamos a experimentar. ¿Y qué tiene que ver esto con continuar? En algún punto de nuestra vida siempre nos encontramos con esa búsqueda de intención o motivación que nos sostenga sin dejar de mirar al frente. Es como si algo innato en nosotros se niegue a renunciar en un mañana aún cuando el presente se pueda estar consumiendo en llamas. Siendo sinceros no hay persona que no desee que las cosas de algún modo se encaminen para bien, pero el escenario afuera no es sinónimo de algo que siquiera pueda darnos el motivo a la duda. Es como si hoy tuviéramos que escarbar para poder cultivar las cosas que realmente importan, aquellas que en su valor luego serán una bonita razón para extrañar. >I remember that boy who spent a few days with his grandmother during the holidays, and how every morning the aroma of coffee spread throughout the house. I didn't drink coffee, but I enjoyed that morning atmosphere that identified something very special about my grandmother: her attention. Beyond her character, she showed a special affection for me and the rest of the family in her own way. When I meditate on this, I can't help but long for something even remotely similar to what once was, and although my mind sighs and assumes that this is impossible, there is also something in my heart that holds on to a beautiful hope that does not escape a reality tied to our nature. I believe that we were not created to miss, much less to give up on those people and those special moments that we once experienced. >And what does this have to do with moving forward? At some point in our lives, we always find ourselves searching for the intention or motivation that sustains us without looking away from the future. It is as if something innate in us refuses to give up on tomorrow, even when the present may be consumed by flames. To be honest, there is no one who does not want things to somehow turn out for the best, but the situation outside is not synonymous with something that could even give us cause for doubt. It is as if today we have to dig deep to cultivate the things that really matter, those that in their value will later be a beautiful reason to miss.
![stocksnap-wood-2602884_640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cajiro/23xKrZPEpGP77g84zB45hF6KrFwo6XWW7jinzAKr4d3yNsPU2LuYjiBywDG47diLPBUed.jpg)
[Pixabay](https://share.google/H8F6hl22klTWj9CVt) by [StockSnap](https://share.google/wQNiTpW87AWwTk0Bc)
Ahora solo llega hasta mi un pensamiento algo rasgado y roto, como si en algún momento haya dejado de extrañar y aún con toda la inspiración posible todavía no alcanzara para poder plasmarlo a través de una reflexión o un relato. En ocasiones es una simple cita ante el vacío y dejando que el silencio siempre tenga la palabra, mientras una idea vaga en mi mente con hastío y poca orientación. No sé cuándo deje de extrañar, o porqué dejé de encontrar ese destino al cual solemos dirigirnos cuando reflexionamos en el pasado. Por ahora, solo una cita a ciegas con una taza de café es quizás lo que más tengo, pero no lo que podría según el tiempo adelante poder extrañar con la ilusión que una vez tuve frente a mí. >Now only a somewhat torn and broken thought reaches me, as if at some point I stopped missing it and even with all the inspiration possible, it still wasn't enough to be able to capture it through reflection or a story. Sometimes it's a simple appointment with emptiness, letting silence always have the last word, while an idea wanders through my mind with weariness and little direction. I don't know when I stopped missing it, or why I stopped finding that destination we usually head for when we reflect on the past. For now, just a blind date with a cup of coffee is perhaps all I have, but not what I could, in time, miss with the excitement I once had in front of me. ![IMG_20260310_170501_282.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cajiro/23wWtfMHEpnrR3DDqgYEHa7rKppfTbDRoJa1HEKYP5Fb3fQzK2RQzjw3bRdkFGYSWZVof.jpg) --- La última imagen es de mi propiedad// The last image is my property. --- ***Gracias por darle valor a esta publicación con tu tiempo y atención.*** ***Hasta pronto.*** --- >***Thank you for valuing this publication with your time and attention.*** >***See you soon.***

links.title: The Divine Favor
links.body: Greetings, everyone! This morning my spirit was on studying the life of Esther, one of the beautiful characters in the Bible who received favor from the king because of the favor of God that surrounds her and her beautiful character.

/>

I realized that divine favor doesn't come from your background or status; it comes from God to those who don't look like it. Esther had no parents, an orphan but received favor from God.

You may not look like it, but God is watching you and has a good plan for you and your future.

The Bible says that when Esther wanted to go and see the king, she fasted and prayed to God before she entered the king's palace. And God answered her prayers. And whatsoever, she wanted was granted unto her.

Anything you want to achieve in this life, look up to God as the author and the finisher of our faith. See Him as the source of that thing, and have faith that comes with boldness, and it will be granted unto me. God is all-powerful and all-knowing.

He knows better than a man does. He is ever ready to help and take you to another level of Glory.

links.title: Crypto comes home to roost...
links.body:
I've been into crypto since 2017 and in that time I've seen several tokens I've vested in go to near zero and witnessed billions of dollars in value evaporate! 

And now it seems that maybe the risk-on investors are turning away from crypto and looking at prediction-markets.... 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23w2esNDSUq6ZsE3T7NgvMnUYNzSpttdEKrY4a8qpXnbFsegmPkP3aEUfcZmQpcWkLb3X.png)


### The Great Crypto Token Die-Off

According to some analysts over 11 million altcoins basically disappeared last year. That’s about $150 billion in value just gone, gone, gone. For an industry that always brags about innovation and decentralization, that’s a huge rate of failure.

But then again, easy come, easy go, part of the beauty and chaos of crypto is that any old 12 year old in a room with a little resourcing can launch their own token. 

The simple fact is that most tokens fail, and most of those in a very short time frame...

### Speculation Finds a New Home

Of course killing off millions of tokens hasn’t killed off speculation, the risk-on investors have just moved on..... 

Now, prediction markets are the hot spot. Traders are betting on everything—elections, sports, economic data, even the future price of crypto itself.

Platforms like Polymarket and Kalshi are booming, with billions now being traded, or should we just say punted, daily. 

And this confirms what a lot of us thought all along - most of that money going into crypto over the last decade wasn't coming from people motivated by the technology, it was just people trying to get rich quick! 

And prediction markets take that urge and turn it into an actual system, basically they let you trade on almost anything that might happen.

And in a way this is crypto becoming more authentic to its punty-base...

Prediction markets run on blockchain. Smart contracts handle payouts automatically and keep things transparent, so you don’t need some middleman to trust, but it's all just in the name of having a punt!

links.title: COUNTRYSIDE, MORE PHOTOS FROM YESTERDAY -(PHOTOGRAPHY SERIES)
links.body:
![Tcats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AKU6E81F5i2wDm1wVrYomwbtvZVpw7Je6XMPfz1u83WnMR3ALoQ5m9r8YcHuRSS.jpg)

----

**T**his is a selection of photos I took yesterday during a walk through the rural areas north of my town, Montalbán. This time I chose more casual shots, and I think I approached this post a bit like I do when compiling my street photography. These photos today offer something more than just landscapes or a record of nature; most of them tell a small story about life in the countryside and how the human presence interacts there, transforming the natural landscape and perceptibly humanizing it. Today, in this sort of \

I'm showing you just that—human elements—in greater proportion than in the [previous post](https://peakd.com/hive-132248/@jlinaresp/morning-photography-series). I'm talking about things like: makeshift power lines, fields of corn and tobacco, a few dogs watching me on the paths, trees with bare branches, the mountains, the valleys, the birds, or even the fences, gates  and farm implements, as well as an old Ford pickup on a farm and a unaware walker on the road singing while carrying a log on his shoulder... Yes, everything you see in these places adds up and becomes a little story to record and share... So, that's why I invite you to wander with me once again along these country roads that I love so much...\n\n>**E**sta es una selección de fotos hechas por mi ayer durante una caminata a lo largo de los espacios rurales al Norte de mi pueblo Montalbán. Esta vez seleccioné fotos más casuales y creo que hice este post pensando un poco como pienso cuando hago recopilaciones con mis fotos callejeras, pues estas fotos de hoy tienen algo más allá del simple paisajismo o registro de la naturaleza, y la mayoría de ellas cuenta alguna pequeña historia acerca de la vida en el campo y como interactúa la presencia humana allí, transformado la visión natural y humanizándola perceptiblemente. Hoy en esta especie de \

les muestro eso, elementos humanos, en mayor proporción que en la [publicación previa](https://peakd.com/hive-132248/@jlinaresp/morning-photography-series). Hablo de cosas como: tendidos eléctricos improvisados, sembradíos de maíz y tabaco, algunos perros observándome en los caminos, arboles con ramas desnudas, las montañas, los valles, las aves o incluso las empalizadas, los portales y los implementos agrícolas, así como una vieja pick-up Ford en una granja y un despistado caminante en el  camino que va cantando con un tronco cargado al hombro... Sí, todo lo que se ve en estos lugares suma y se convierte en una pequeña historia para registrar y compartir... Entonces por eso, les invito a deambular una vez más conmigo en estos caminos campestre que tanto amo... 


![T01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23sUKEXBYqdf3vSSMDBRL593vTPX2tCJyLA5XWidRnhhiU2h2754WiVFmU81MnXqYS1Vu.jpg)

![T02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/245cceMNU9AaUDocwiQ2mAQJws1Kv2g6UdCQiyEzV1Rs2v6tfejmWbQwaFQSKVpMuiUVj.jpg)

![T03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23r1kmYg4msyq1sB9m6sVXY48wwP1utuREsBcEimKN9gufXLQBnLVicJn47oN8rWFP2JB.jpg)

![T04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23xVErXtbyJKUC7aJodA7qP4Py171DMdNVT5oMhwH4W1KmShWzLQQ8VsriDRotsGYyE3A.jpg)

![T05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/244KT873KD3KLqK1BVWedHdAhdJoJewSkBqRVaQNpThgoxhQxZho7Vook2nQLbGMgwQ4i.jpg)

![T06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23yJM5dgnL7PUJdRu2JwcxDhrVZdqFKBidMYHFcG78jNr75qNZKhdEsXv87KxebVi4zxp.jpg)

![T07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/245cYGGTEfgXBZmrahAVEj6YDvZ3zC916V4n19u9H9cz3J8s8bYZrGzQAJjke3zJH6Rd5.jpg)

![T08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/242hYWNwoJ1QKRunfHQDuBWGq4cp54BFBWrzPFSzhtt8iaEadNZbuaNR1d79KzKvwE2RT.jpg)

![T09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23zkpGwFPUNzkjLuqFkM34ynDdWHqhtzZawnJWhfMCiWGyezUMHHbRdAwvzLtyQBjXFXe.jpg)

![T10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/244y1dVxkxjvqAtxK1wB2riCvP3RihbQjoJdhycyDYHTWFSePD4DDEUrJk7Nc1uD6PEhJ.jpg)

links.title: The Hidden Cost Of Always Being Available
links.body: >In one way or another, it has been drilled into me that it pays to show up or turn up for people. However, what they had failed to tell me was that not everyone you would turn up for, and I had to learn how to say no. Always being available for others was a second nature to me, and I had never thought about its cost to me. Seeing this prompt made me have a rethink, and trust me, a lot of people owe me because, in the business of always being available, I am currently running at a loss and I can’t even think of breaking even. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPeDuhrrqozDCuxKKPyqY6QcAQNZ3fViXeSbGhpL9mpye/1773179862721.jpg) There are so many people we might choose to be available to, but I would be explaining just three: family, friends, and work. Let's start with work. My late dad was a very diligent worker, and he always took his work seriously. I could remember days when he would be called in to work even on his off day. I was having the notion that he was irreplaceable because he was always consulted for one thing or another. Luckily for him, he realized he needed to plan for the future, which eventually led him to buy his own land, but at the cost of his health. Being a factory worker and always being available had affected his health, and he was already discussing retirement plans with me before death took him away. It’s a hard lesson I've learned: everybody is replaceable, and when it comes to work, always find time to rest, or the cost might be deadly. Being overly available for friends is costly, and I got to realize this after my dad died. During this period, I had high expectations that friends would turn up and support me financially, but I was very alone with few close friends. Ever since then, I have decided that I would rather invest in a few close friends than in all my friends, so I have a higher chance of winning. Last but not least is family, hmm, I know they say that blood is thicker than water, but family dey worry. Being the firstborn, I got to shoulder a lot of responsibilities after dad’s death, and I could literally see the nonchalance from some of my siblings. I heard things like “he is supposed to do it as the firstborn,” and these are the same siblings who would run to you when they are broke. I know I might be unable to choose a family at birth, but I can choose peace of mind for myself. The cost of always being available to family was that I was not growing because every means of growth was channelled to them. Immediately, I realized this: I had to prioritize things and tell myself that I was no more today; they would still survive. Things might remain stagnant or very slow, but once I can make my scale of preference, I stick to it. Not all families are the same, but these are my own experiences. Being always available would cost you; it might be time, money, resources, and so on, and the most annoying thing is that it accumulates as humans want repetition (you have done it before, why can’t you do it again), and some even feel self-entitled. My own advice is to be available to those who can treat you the same way. ** ** ** ** Please feel free to leave your comments, reblog, upvote, and share. Thanks @ezemhugo [Image source](https://pixabay.com/photos/open-sign-signage-window-store-8032746/) ** ** ** **

links.title: Just a day at my parents' house, beautiful cats, a tour of the city, a great dinner, and a job interview. (ENG/ESP)
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYd8RwkLbb6xpo6hgjafTTpM1nyQAiKU9Buv8VXXmkyVe/1773178751015.jpg)

Good morning friends, how are you? Here I am again to keep you company this afternoon. After lunch and a bit of rest, I went down to my mother's town for a job interview (it seems to have gone well, I should start in two weeks!) Then, since I've been feeling a bit unwell these days and wanted to relax, I went to spend the afternoon with my mother @silviabeneforti. I really enjoy visiting her. I immediately took the opportunity to take photos of her cats, or rather, Nanny, the older cat, who was showing off some funny and joyful expressions in the sun. The younger cat is still nervous and shy, making it difficult to photograph, but Nanny is a real beauty, and it seems she enjoys being photographed and petted! Luckily, it was sunny today, and on my way back from the interview, I took advantage of the opportunity to take some photos of the streets and take a stroll in a renovated square near my parents' house, which I'll tell you more about tomorrow. I also spent a bit of time in my parents' garden, which always fascinates me because it's full of sculptures and plum tree petals. I can't wait for spring to arrive in full force so I can take some photos of my parents' plum tree.

> Buenos días, amigos, ¿qué tal? Aquí estoy de nuevo para hacerles compañía esta tarde. Después de comer y descansar un poco, fui al pueblo de mi madre para una entrevista de trabajo (parece que ha ido bien, ¡debería empezar en dos semanas!). Luego, como me he encontrado un poco mal estos días y quería relajarme, fui a pasar la tarde con mi madre @silviabeneforti. Disfruto mucho visitándola. Aproveché enseguida para sacar fotos a sus gatos, o mejor dicho, a Nanny, la gata mayor, que lucía unas caras divertidas y alegres al sol. La gata más joven todavía está nerviosa y tímida, lo que dificulta la foto, pero Nanny es una auténtica belleza, ¡y parece que disfruta de que la fotografíen y la acaricien! Por suerte, hoy hizo sol, y al volver de la entrevista, aproveché para sacar algunas fotos de las calles y dar un paseo por una plaza renovada cerca de casa de mis padres, de la que os hablaré mañana. También pasé un rato en el jardín de mis padres, que siempre me fascina porque está lleno de esculturas y pétalos de ciruelo. Estoy deseando que llegue la primavera con toda su fuerza para poder sacarle algunas fotos al ciruelo de mis padres.

I was pretty relaxed after the interview, although I was a little anxious beforehand, partly because it was my first day of my period and I wasn't feeling great. However, the company manager seemed helpful, and the pay was pretty good. We'll see how it goes, but hopefully everything goes well. With the nice weather, it was nice to get out a bit, and even the city streets seemed prettier than usual. Tonight, I didn't even have to cook; I took a break from my household duties and enjoyed my mother's simple cooking: pork loin, a little salad, and seasoned chickpeas—a simple, healthy dinner. Overall, it was a pleasant day!

> Estaba bastante relajada después de la entrevista, aunque antes estaba un poco ansiosa, en parte porque era mi primer día de regla y no me sentía muy bien. Sin embargo, el gerente de la empresa parecía servicial y el sueldo era bastante bueno. Ya veremos cómo va, pero espero que todo salga bien. Con el buen tiempo, fue agradable salir un rato, e incluso las calles de la ciudad parecían más bonitas de lo habitual. Esta noche ni siquiera tuve que cocinar; me tomé un respiro de las tareas domésticas y disfruté de la sencilla comida de mi madre: lomo de cerdo, un poco de ensalada y garbanzos sazonados: una cena sencilla y saludable. En resumen, ¡fue un día agradable!

links.title: Mi rincón de sonido | My sound corner (Poema)
links.body: >Mi rincón de sonido** # Un espacio con vida donde las luces y sombras, abrazan la alta fidelidad, y las válvulas al vacío calientan como brasas. No son simples equipos, es historia, legado y excelencia. Componentes que evocan recuerdos. Sintonizadores que pescan en el aire, las más distantes estaciones, y las cintas magnéticas regalan melodías. No es solo colección, es tesoro para el alma, un rincón donde el sonido, se transmuta en emoción, y cada nota acaricia los sentidos, para endulzar mis días. --- ## **

>My sound corner** # A living space where light and shadow embrace high fidelity, and vacuum tubes heat like embers. These aren't just pieces of equipment, it's history, legacy, and excellence. Components that evoke memories. Tuners that fish in the air for the most distant stations, and magnetic tapes gift melodies. It's not just a collection, it's a treasure for the soul, a corner where sound transforms into emotion, and each note caresses the senses, to sweeten my days. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/PeLEOKBM-Hive10.png

links.title: The Wishing Star And Reality
links.body:
>I am someone who believes in reality and action; anything that has to be hoped for without one necessarily putting in the work often gives me a tough time accepting. Some probably would say, “You don't have faith, you are walking by sight,” and so on, but even in the Bible, there is a portion that says, “Faith without works is dead.” I think we get it wrong when we fold our arms and hope that things work out in our favour. For me, that is laziness and settling for disappointments, because in most cases like that, the result won't be favorable. This is why I have a problem with anything that has to do with wishes. If it's going to happen simply because we wish for it, then it's a fantasy; it may never see the light of day. To be frank, I don't believe in the story attached to a wishing star. I don't have any reason for that, but I believe that everything in life needs work or action to come into reality. The shooting star might be special, its appearance might be something beautiful to behold, but it doesn't give it the power to bring our desires into reality. Of course, sometimes we can wish on a shooting star and miraculously have what we want granted, but it is not guaranteed; it might even be luck or your work that made it a reality. I have never wished on a wishing star, and I doubt if I have seen one; maybe I did, and I didn't know. If you ask me, sincerely, I wish to see it, but when I do, I don't think I'll be wishing on it; I'll just enjoy the view. This is just my opinion on wishing on the shooting star; it is not a law. Everyone has what they believe regarding the matter. They say, “What we believe is what works for us.” So, I can talk for others. If you believe that the shooting star brings wishes to reality, I won't say no, and if you don't believe that mere wishes can make things happen, you are still right, everyone is entitled to their opinion.

Thanks For Reading

I am definitely romanticizing sealife in my mind, but that's why it would be great to try at least once. Maybe I could become a sea captain for the rest of my working years? 

And I didnt know, you can rent 8m2 little storage/seaside hut space there. This is not a sponsored post; I just happened to come across the video when I was looking at maps and videos of the place.

links.title: Unlearn to Earn: Ditching Bad Spending Habits and Embracing AI for an Easier Life
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYdzRBQ32j8SfMB4rU9hAvGRmMVwH4gNxsCFr6KjcUbxL/1000144056.jpg image using Ai.

We should learn new things every now and then with the limited we have but I know most of us are too occupied with other things that finding time for anything else is just impossible.
I know how hardly I find time to spend with family and do rest of tasks on time but it is what it is and we're supposed to learn things somehow. It's not always about learning sometimes you have to unlearn things as well so you can do well, unlearning is good for your own sanity because whatever you've learnt isn't necessarily good for you. These days I'm working on learning couple of things and the priority is something that boomers love to do.

Learning to Type Fast Nowadays

The only thing that boomers love doing is sitting on that office desk and typing emails and stuff on their keyboard. I was quite jealous like how can boomers be the one who can type fast when it should be me. I needed to step up my typing so I started working on it in my free time. You don't know how easy it is until you give it a try. I can type without looking at my keyboard on mobile and easily 2000 words in about 3 minutes But that's the kind of pace I'm trying to find on pc as well. Typing words is technically easy without looking at keyboard on pc but not as fast as I can do it on mobile. I've been using mobile from years so it makes sense, all I'd need is months of practice on pc to get what I want.

Unlearning to spend money

Unfortunately the day I had learnt where to spend money was the day I started bleeding out in a field. Like I've been only spending money on necessities, bills and everyday expenses but inflation kind of making it impossible to stop myself from spending more and saving more. At this point I'm trying to unlearn everything I knew about spending money and start over again so I could worry less about it.

Learning to do things easily

In a era like this you're not supposed to work hard and I'm kind of used to of finding shortcuts for everything I do But now applying ai into real life would make things more easier. Working on training agents and making use of Ai to help myself with work like excel sheets and other stuff that you've to spend hours at work Haven't typed a mail ever since I've been using Claude, haven't stressed about little things that sounds exhausting at the end of the day. Now is the time we all should unlearn doing things hard way and start implementing use of Ai for everything that is possible with it. Embracing tech is far better and good for your own cause those who don't becomes history like Nokia is a thing from past, no one wants to be end up like that. I wonder what are those things that you're learning and Unlearning these days, do share your thoughts in the comments.
that's all folks.

How nice to share again with my creative home today, and hope you are all energized to kick start the new week with lots of expectations. Wishing everyone the best of this new week 😇💕.

Its still spring in my country but it seemed and appeared to be summer due to how hot the weather is becoming. We hope it starts raining ☔️ anytime soon to help bring down the heat. Thanks to nature for all the beauty from the beautiful flowers 💐 🌺🌸 that leaves the environment airy and seasonal fruits 🍌🍎🍊🍉that keeps us refreshingly.

My today’s recipe is inspired by spring. This refreshing fruit salad is sinfully delicious and makes a great snack or even a tasty dessert to help with the weather. My family and I are watermelon 🍉 maniacs in the house and we love citrus 🍊 for its health boost. But this recipe serving is just for two because I made it to freeze it for the road. 

![6B02A29C-7182-4587-A3AF-79CD6414F6A3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243Wm1PkURHjmmanx5vLuMH8H7nyW27w4keopKpmXWnm5FG3CcXsqAM67BDgFWZCL8q8v.jpeg)

Watermelons 🍉 are rich in iron, high in water content and has less calories and oranges 🍊 a good source of vitamin C .These two fruits are a good pair for both refreshing salad 🥗 or drink 🍹. Taste so delicious that you will want to make it over and over.

Below are detailed step by step for this simple but delicious fruit 🍉🍊 salad 🥗.

# INGREDIENTS:

![9ECA341E-9E08-4CE3-BFED-B0EA6563F769.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xKxV8rD8CVmro63erhtfPqby1AKQFFpukVrFXsQwTNKXJ5zJNB4BwttYkgjQYSrQYwH.jpeg)

1/8 of a large fresh watermelon 
1 ball of a medium orange 
1/2 teaspoon of premium sugar
2 tablespoons of water 

# STEPS FOR PREPARATION:
 
Step 1.

![CC1203DE-465D-4701-ADF0-FC161F3F46A0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245codYHUiLW1AsrXwP9rQMeY1s7x9Zrkk4T8kJmr1xVQ6AV9ucRMexHv3mnPQY6nxdVA.jpeg)

![293CE97C-676C-43D1-AF2A-DDD2A5327F17.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xVHDNY1Vds86LqCdmcSasseF9tbLxsHSvP3gGGUEjZaBBn48T3kqacEdmHjkfRigkxA.jpeg)

Simple and straightforward, we start by first peeling the orange .

![A3F9A18F-5CFE-4A0A-BA86-CF8F9B7AAE40.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wgKgyBC4curY1uumbw4JpJjFzD8VHxutW6b6LxJCazDAsMwvcfNrcTqx4kR5YFNZyiz.jpeg)

![963BB8ED-B250-44BF-B538-5964529547DF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ywrvbQfzhmfq6iGiLCCMAzc5kbSzVhGY4dvWTiAp9nSnW3R62N3bkTt7vRoRZSe8JN3.jpeg)

Then we scrape the outer layer of the orange and gradually separate pulps 

Step 2

![6CAB6C05-C8F2-4DEA-92BA-FB05BC771472.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xyVDFFFdf3MU6gwS9efWDq1ynoqCQAZGMUs3n7DVwUZcQd8Meae5G13tGgHrPXFUREx.jpeg)

![6E61271B-85B0-4CCA-ABCD-DB2437DA08F2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ywsBaie3VKPyqyaRDf6ivTiVwEbtL4BaMHKPCt6eyzHbeeZdhe861d9pbkyMFPDvKBb.jpeg)

Next, we will cut open each pulp to remove seed and separate the layer

![BA4A0430-410A-4CEB-A265-BE771A81B012.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244KRQtdQkze21KWWE2k96bmDQkB43kjSLQpCZ7zVB2ezQ3TMMdvJXLjKjBzTiaYxUnB2.jpeg)

![CC239573-75E9-4620-983D-D795BB8A2421.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23sK6tKfeG5bgBfphntwMPw7BfmTZLsD29SAZSvgGF1JaTFtQGKNgPV9V8GtNUTzTJRcq.jpeg)

And we have the pulps readily here above.

Step 3.

![131F269A-07D2-473F-A9D4-28D319CD6170.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/24244KNKqudC1XoVB8db5xQS36CrxAE8aPrcQvBmtZV3TXBU7y6nLvLktGLPWzdgiJLf2.jpeg)

![58E3AF18-9718-44D1-887F-347FBE8EDF9D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2458SnUENUeKgNxYqLGDV84Ts1qjMu85AhMWav5WAwMyprzzH5cTSbzCbnqaduUxF6RTd.jpeg)

![687D9A9E-9A1C-4B6D-B98A-87B300E466B7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244V4XwvsSbKzv8Cqhq1tRkJysj7qssACV5emVLJdEpKDY62v2CjSCZFzxE1gG4uScW6t.jpeg)

Here we cut out the watermelon from the rind , deseed and dice them thinly  

![10EA958D-5745-4C8E-96C0-C648ACFBECAF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wCE1XudZuz56ziYpVLYsbbUdtt57ymDKAZSvwebBnQE6nPwoh9VSTthsY82fLEca95e.jpeg)

We have the two fruits ready 

Step 4.

![48D3391F-6279-4190-8B5D-21EAB4275133.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK9QtyVMTgXfRmntDvjx37nd7KL3w69vn2HPxHR8R6eVbhyVDHT2SrPHi1dnn72.jpeg)

To incorporate them into a delicious fruit salad, we take the sugar into a bowl, add the water, stir.

![25428694-AFA7-4DD3-B9EA-C9654A851812.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wqg8HNyUE1XWJUNWBvudgH9UovRa434Zv3zWhksSLPZ2i54aGoMpzbRWr7urPfbQyPF.jpeg)

![D1DE06F3-E607-48CB-BE22-E7300BCF8B4E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vsFeHDwoGUPSD4CUg7dL4HkLqTpetwwza8DxNA8XEBEg1QKXAiQ8CvwLfWygtrdthMf.jpeg)

![F611C89A-3FD0-437B-A998-1639629A0D4E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vhsCuGyXX5zqjpzxGSsoNYFFQJpqKqS9PpkKaduT4SDL9zL47UQJ5DTUoprgaeoQV5t.jpeg)

We  microwave for 20 seconds 

Step 5.

![A2837B20-2786-4AC0-82FD-0197E63DB789.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xp8dQLFcXRTotDtj4xAweBkBqzLv6UhM5BjEEnuPHVX1GnTxeFtbuTuwJhX6euEk2dc.jpeg)

![02704609-198E-4127-9A52-451C85911691.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xAZytGQm5Le3zhVu7ubMBopV6JGk2i8L9GAFTvevC6SXBj2RSUgzHGeLGfH9eLHqyCw.jpeg)

![5CFE40D4-B4C2-40B9-AC76-75CBFD458AB0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ynWT85E9QuWvSJXzBTQ5PPqH3qA943imobcLsaCyE1xmkPdnjp2neZDxy4sr7iBUhhG.jpeg)

Once it cools, we add the orange 🍊 pulps and the diced watermelon 🍉 

![3BF74B93-C812-47EF-97D7-5305F4F7DBAA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yJP3JVqThugWFLcoYWogY2mSS1ApeSGvVJJAQ7eucn61LSu1CVFtVz89ZUZETNWtB4y.jpeg)

![B30DCA66-F498-4A6A-B2B1-AE704ED78C9E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zbUBU8ELjhzzhv6aaMgM2zVyRGUhK8pHqd4ePuPFTVDqPGqGGCRMahGXPDtYMEBdiWp.jpeg)

We gradually stir to incorporate the sugar into the fruits. Serve and chill as long as necessary 

![E87C8175-EFA7-4B90-850B-4E5FDEE346E3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zGsL9FtFL7HJpnUAtXi8cTUqD9towbWaaeLEdAMTTKTDWE9XHumhdQjJDfWg2YQ4URW.jpeg)

![C9B03FC9-4D28-45FD-9CCF-5E77528BF621.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23z7SPAaX2gbfYBK3f2UTgoQ3w74wJUmP39o4k3vLuHnsdmqEoeJeDv8JjR2PxVCc1AM7.jpeg)

There is nothing that ever beats freshly combined fruits in a salad 🥗. Full of vitamins and nutrition for that healthy immune boost that keeps us on our feet.

![96C0F3FB-AFE5-4704-8A55-2372C1BDE800.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242Nt1zGTJUDfdSjkf7DcoAz8K7KA7eKfzs8yMhReTkdeYxL9wkoaNUrASyYAaHmegM1m.jpeg)

![F7B118F2-911E-40A8-979B-5B1CDD8E92FA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242s9zeNcBZj9SejhsMXYgL8EaQy2A8uPXDuNtPeDdhCX5JPDD7jRkcxzviXFKDVNCGGj.jpeg)

This refreshing fruit salad can serve as a salad 🥗 and at the same time serve as dessert 🍨 . So appetizing with its spring colors that you will eat it up before you know. Enjoy it and keep healthy 😄.

# Saludos, querida gente de Hive 😀❤️.

![15B86C42-C96E-484D-B1A2-5D22823A75AC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK9RoepCFtGVNXhH48xPVhPcmmWJy4U21uXRTALo64TXVxnHW1VGHj3iEDMm2Di.jpeg)

![4A06C001-8006-49DD-B854-6D2B39C3BC33.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2458Wt4gUkcupM3FDGyNBWryhXHNQwz9jhmENwNNbCwrkTHkCuxqxRj5CnSE9fc5X4cfL.jpeg)

![CC520973-4E19-4F29-A602-E02613D903E8.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zGsL9FtFL7HJpnUAtXi8cTUqD9towbWaaeLEdAMTTKTDWE9XHumhdQjJDfWg2YQ4URW.jpeg)

Qué agradable es volver a compartir hoy con mi hogar creativo, y espero que todos estén llenos de energía para comenzar la nueva semana con muchas expectativas. Les deseo a todos lo mejor para esta nueva semana 😇💕.

En mi país todavía es primavera, pero parece que ya es verano por lo caluroso que está el tiempo. Esperamos que empiece a llover ☔️ pronto para que baje la temperatura. Gracias a la naturaleza por toda la belleza de las flores 💐 🌺🌸 que dejan el ambiente fresco y las frutas de temporada 🍌🍎🍊🍉 que nos mantienen refrescados.

La receta de hoy está inspirada en la primavera. Esta refrescante ensalada de frutas es deliciosamente pecaminosa y es un excelente aperitivo o incluso un sabroso postre para combatir el calor. A mi familia y a mí nos encanta la sandía 🍉 y nos encantan los cítricos 🍊 por sus propiedades saludables. Pero esta receta es solo para dos personas, porque la preparé para congelarla y llevarla de viaje.

![6B02A29C-7182-4587-A3AF-79CD6414F6A3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243Wm1PkURHjmmanx5vLuMH8H7nyW27w4keopKpmXWnm5FG3CcXsqAM67BDgFWZCL8q8v.jpeg)

Las sandías 🍉 son ricas en hierro, tienen un alto contenido en agua y pocas calorías, y las naranjas 🍊 son una buena fuente de vitamina C. Estas dos frutas combinan muy bien tanto en una refrescante ensalada 🥗 como en una bebida 🍹. Están tan deliciosas que querrás prepararlas una y otra vez.

A continuación te explicamos paso a paso cómo preparar esta sencilla pero deliciosa ensalada de frutas 🍉🍊 🥗.

# INGREDIENTES:

![9ECA341E-9E08-4CE3-BFED-B0EA6563F769.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xKxV8rD8CVmro63erhtfPqby1AKQFFpukVrFXsQwTNKXJ5zJNB4BwttYkgjQYSrQYwH.jpeg)

1/8 de una sandía grande fresca 
1 bola de una naranja mediana 
1/2 cucharadita de azúcar extrafino
2 cucharadas de agua

# PASOS PARA LA PREPARACIÓN:
 
Paso 1.

![CC1203DE-465D-4701-ADF0-FC161F3F46A0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/245codYHUiLW1AsrXwP9rQMeY1s7x9Zrkk4T8kJmr1xVQ6AV9ucRMexHv3mnPQY6nxdVA.jpeg)

![293CE97C-676C-43D1-AF2A-DDD2A5327F17.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xVHDNY1Vds86LqCdmcSasseF9tbLxsHSvP3gGGUEjZaBBn48T3kqacEdmHjkfRigkxA.jpeg)

De manera simple y directa, comenzamos pelando primero la naranja.

![A3F9A18F-5CFE-4A0A-BA86-CF8F9B7AAE40.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wgKgyBC4curY1uumbw4JpJjFzD8VHxutW6b6LxJCazDAsMwvcfNrcTqx4kR5YFNZyiz.jpeg)

![963BB8ED-B250-44BF-B538-5964529547DF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ywrvbQfzhmfq6iGiLCCMAzc5kbSzVhGY4dvWTiAp9nSnW3R62N3bkTt7vRoRZSe8JN3.jpeg)

A continuación, raspamos la capa exterior de la naranja y separamos poco a poco la pulpa. 

Paso 2

![6CAB6C05-C8F2-4DEA-92BA-FB05BC771472.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xyVDFFFdf3MU6gwS9efWDq1ynoqCQAZGMUs3n7DVwUZcQd8Meae5G13tGgHrPXFUREx.jpeg)

![6E61271B-85B0-4CCA-ABCD-DB2437DA08F2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ywsBaie3VKPyqyaRDf6ivTiVwEbtL4BaMHKPCt6eyzHbeeZdhe861d9pbkyMFPDvKBb.jpeg)

A continuación, cortaremos cada pulpa para extraer las semillas y separar la capa.

![BA4A0430-410A-4CEB-A265-BE771A81B012.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244KRQtdQkze21KWWE2k96bmDQkB43kjSLQpCZ7zVB2ezQ3TMMdvJXLjKjBzTiaYxUnB2.jpeg)

![CC239573-75E9-4620-983D-D795BB8A2421.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23sK6tKfeG5bgBfphntwMPw7BfmTZLsD29SAZSvgGF1JaTFtQGKNgPV9V8GtNUTzTJRcq.jpeg)

Y aquí arriba tenemos las pulpas listas.

Paso 3.

![131F269A-07D2-473F-A9D4-28D319CD6170.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/24244KNKqudC1XoVB8db5xQS36CrxAE8aPrcQvBmtZV3TXBU7y6nLvLktGLPWzdgiJLf2.jpeg)

![58E3AF18-9718-44D1-887F-347FBE8EDF9D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2458SnUENUeKgNxYqLGDV84Ts1qjMu85AhMWav5WAwMyprzzH5cTSbzCbnqaduUxF6RTd.jpeg)

![687D9A9E-9A1C-4B6D-B98A-87B300E466B7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/244V4XwvsSbKzv8Cqhq1tRkJysj7qssACV5emVLJdEpKDY62v2CjSCZFzxE1gG4uScW6t.jpeg)

Aquí cortamos la sandía de la corteza, le quitamos las semillas y la cortamos en cubitos finos.  

![10EA958D-5745-4C8E-96C0-C648ACFBECAF.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wCE1XudZuz56ziYpVLYsbbUdtt57ymDKAZSvwebBnQE6nPwoh9VSTthsY82fLEca95e.jpeg)

Tenemos las dos frutas listas. 

Paso 4.

![48D3391F-6279-4190-8B5D-21EAB4275133.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK9QtyVMTgXfRmntDvjx37nd7KL3w69vn2HPxHR8R6eVbhyVDHT2SrPHi1dnn72.jpeg)

Para incorporarlos a una deliciosa ensalada de frutas, ponemos el azúcar en un bol, añadimos el agua y removemos.

![25428694-AFA7-4DD3-B9EA-C9654A851812.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wqg8HNyUE1XWJUNWBvudgH9UovRa434Zv3zWhksSLPZ2i54aGoMpzbRWr7urPfbQyPF.jpeg)

![D1DE06F3-E607-48CB-BE22-E7300BCF8B4E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vsFeHDwoGUPSD4CUg7dL4HkLqTpetwwza8DxNA8XEBEg1QKXAiQ8CvwLfWygtrdthMf.jpeg)

![F611C89A-3FD0-437B-A998-1639629A0D4E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23vhsCuGyXX5zqjpzxGSsoNYFFQJpqKqS9PpkKaduT4SDL9zL47UQJ5DTUoprgaeoQV5t.jpeg)

Lo calentamos en el microondas durante 20 segundos. 

Paso 5.

![A2837B20-2786-4AC0-82FD-0197E63DB789.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xp8dQLFcXRTotDtj4xAweBkBqzLv6UhM5BjEEnuPHVX1GnTxeFtbuTuwJhX6euEk2dc.jpeg)

![02704609-198E-4127-9A52-451C85911691.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xAZytGQm5Le3zhVu7ubMBopV6JGk2i8L9GAFTvevC6SXBj2RSUgzHGeLGfH9eLHqyCw.jpeg)

![5CFE40D4-B4C2-40B9-AC76-75CBFD458AB0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ynWT85E9QuWvSJXzBTQ5PPqH3qA943imobcLsaCyE1xmkPdnjp2neZDxy4sr7iBUhhG.jpeg)

Una vez que se enfríe, añadimos la pulpa de naranja 🍊 y la sandía cortada en cubitos 🍉. 

![3BF74B93-C812-47EF-97D7-5305F4F7DBAA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23yJP3JVqThugWFLcoYWogY2mSS1ApeSGvVJJAQ7eucn61LSu1CVFtVz89ZUZETNWtB4y.jpeg)

![B30DCA66-F498-4A6A-B2B1-AE704ED78C9E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zbUBU8ELjhzzhv6aaMgM2zVyRGUhK8pHqd4ePuPFTVDqPGqGGCRMahGXPDtYMEBdiWp.jpeg)

Removemos poco a poco para incorporar el azúcar a la fruta. Servimos y enfriamos el tiempo necesario. 

![E87C8175-EFA7-4B90-850B-4E5FDEE346E3.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zGsL9FtFL7HJpnUAtXi8cTUqD9towbWaaeLEdAMTTKTDWE9XHumhdQjJDfWg2YQ4URW.jpeg)

![C9B03FC9-4D28-45FD-9CCF-5E77528BF621.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23z7SPAaX2gbfYBK3f2UTgoQ3w74wJUmP39o4k3vLuHnsdmqEoeJeDv8JjR2PxVCc1AM7.jpeg)

No hay nada mejor que una ensalada de frutas recién combinadas 🥗. Llena de vitaminas y nutrientes para reforzar el sistema inmunitario y mantenernos en forma.

![96C0F3FB-AFE5-4704-8A55-2372C1BDE800.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242Nt1zGTJUDfdSjkf7DcoAz8K7KA7eKfzs8yMhReTkdeYxL9wkoaNUrASyYAaHmegM1m.jpeg)

![F7B118F2-911E-40A8-979B-5B1CDD8E92FA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242s9zeNcBZj9SejhsMXYgL8EaQy2A8uPXDuNtPeDdhCX5JPDD7jRkcxzviXFKDVNCGGj.jpeg)

Esta refrescante ensalada de frutas puede servir como ensalada 🥗 y, al mismo tiempo, como postre 🍨 . Es tan apetecible con sus colores primaverales que te la comerás antes de darte cuenta. Disfrútala y mantente saludable 😄.

links.title: War is not a good thing
links.body:
Namaste to my Indian friends, I am very interested in this topic because innocent souls are badly affected by the war going on around the world.

Just this evening, I stepped out to get food, and the quantity of food I bought for one dollar is now over $1.50. The excuse is the war; the war has affected the price of petrol, and this has increased the price of transportation, which has seriously affected everything in the market.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPbpDnyYEwLHoj3DFH6w4xqmyHh7jMmrC33HGzahApZcW/1773179256852.jpg)


Looking at the effect of this war is just the annoying aspect of it, the masses who are suffering have no connection with this war but they are badly affected by the war.

Just yesterday a friend was telling me that his friend who just came from Dubai to visit his family has not been able to go back to Dubai and from the look of things he might not be able to go back again, that's a big setback for this family.

## The leaders don't care/ The future 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX2KWKCA4mQSYBLbuR8UPDdiKtSZSXvWJjsEUTuicPvJS/1773179301035.jpg)

Personally, I don't think the leaders are concerned about how their actions affect the masses, that's why they make decisions that will ruin the masses and they happily carry out their wishes.

The future can only get better if our Creator intervenes, when you listen to the news or watch television you will see that those leaders are not ready to stop war so that the masses will have their lives back, think about some countries that have fought war for over a decade and they are not concerned about the people so it means that no human will stop war only one powerful being which is the creator of the universe can stop war.


Many people are so anxious to the extent that they have developed serious illnesses and they die as a result, some become so stressed that they have to spend lots of money to take care of their health and that doesn't change anything, so the best thing to do is to keep calm and take just one day at a time hoping that our Creator will come for our rescue.

links.title: Merecer ganar
links.body:
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUtpxQxpuRZ2LHpLMDKDiFRPtyHJP2zm29S5bEe1ufJy8/20260310_173659.jpg)<sub>[X](https://x.com/jit_digital/status/2031330420441157807?s=19)</center></sub>

---

Me froto las manos para que Cuba logre clasificar a la fase de muerte súbita del Clásico Mundial 2026. Después de tantas críticas hechas por mí desde mucho antes que comenzara, lo cierto es que han tenido un buen torneo a pesar que Puerto Rico ayer no permitió que sacaran boleto más temprano.

Todo será dicho mañana, cuando Canadá también presente su candidatura para ser el segundo invitado por parte del grupo A. Será partido de recoge y vete, así que... Me froto las manos. Claro que si Cuba pasa lo más probable es que les toque contra Estados Unidos, y a ese trabuco para ganarle hay que inyectarse esteroides, o tener ciudadanía japonesa, venezolano, o dominicana ( no creo que Puerto Rico pueda resistir aunque podría ganarle a los “americanos” también).

De todas maneras creo que siempre hay que aspirar a tus posibilidades reales, y brindar un esfuerzo extra por un resultado récord.

Pero bien, en el grupo A hay otro equipo que me llenó los ojos por la pasión con la que jugaron. Lamentablemente pasaron en un abrir y cerrar de ojos de tener posibilidades reales de clasificar, a probablemente ser último del grupo y tener que jugar el Pre- Clásico.

Panamá tuvo excelentes juegos de pelota. El único que perdió por más de una carrera fue precisamente contra Cuba, y la diferencia final fue de solo dos carreras. Tuvieron a punto de poner a pedir la hora a los de la isla del encanto y luego frente a Canadá remontaron y retuvieron el resultado hasta el final. 

Luego con Colombia se vieron anulados, pero se revelaron al final y lograron respirar la nuca de sus rivales. Es una lástima, creo que se merecían mucho más, pero el deporte, y sobre todo el béisbol tiene estos sabores agridulces. Fíjense que Colombia prácticamente no logró ofrecer resistencia al resto de rivales, pero contra Panamá se convierten en un grano molesto. 

En el Clásico pasado los canaleros tuvieron muy buena fase de grupo, pero salieron malparados con ese empate de 5 equipos y quedaron en las puertas también. Todavía tienen chance de no quedar último hasta ahora, pero ya no depende de ellos. Ojalá que no sea así.

**This was always a 5 hour 30 minute drive so I have no clue why it is now recommended at a 6 hour 40 minute drive. Trucks do this in a little over 8 hours to give you an idea of how slow anything over 6 hours is.** 





On Thursday we are travelling down to Durban due to the need to have various meetings for the business. I say need otherwise I would not be doing this as I do not like the 6 hour drive knowing the state of the roads and standard of driving skills you have to navigate. The last time I drove this route must be over 5 years ago now or may be even longer. If it was just myself I would be flying, but there are 5 of us and that cost versus a car drive plus hotels is out of budget.

We could make it cheaper and stay with \

which would make it a less fruitful trip due to the short time and the family planning things that you do not have time for. Been there and got the medals to prove it so we would rather pop in and say hello than treat this as a holiday break which it is clearly not.

Thursday evening is the only free time available as we drive back on Sunday morning. This was meant to be on Saturday checking out the hotel but we have an appointment on Saturday now and I know drinking is involved with this one so no chance of an early escape.

I have mentioned in the past about having to find a better accountant that fights your corner and knows or is experienced enough to get a better deal for you. We were told to find an Indian/Muslim or a Jewish accountant because they are apparently the sharpest and we were recommended one who we will see on Friday morning. He is a friend of the family even though we have never met him, but know of what he has made possible. The one relative literally pays very little having a large portion of his bond/mortgage paid monthly plus a whole host of other expenses covered.

The current accountant we have is what I would call a text book accountant doing everything by the book which is fine when profits and taxes are low. We clash heads these days as I do not see any benefits and the business is about to move into a different mode and why the change needs to happen now. I cannot go into detail, but lets say the business has changed over the last 6 weeks and the extras being made cannot all go to taxes. A dream type scenario and this means the current accountant is of no use and needs to go.

We need clarity along with guidance and professional advice on exactly what and how to change things which I have no confidence in the knowledge and experience of our current accountant. It is clear this is the right move and we have 3 weeks to get this done by the end of March. After March things will get messy and more complicated so there is a time urgency.

The other two meetings are important with one being with my packaging business partner on Friday evening. Again this business is about to grow very fast and I need plenty of samples in order to land new clients. With only a handful of clients currently another 20 clients over the next 3 months would make life far easier and what is the target.

Saturday is all about budgets with our main client with some twists which are good twists and why it is an all day affair. Nothing is ever straight forward and the falling into the trap of drinking before the figures are agreed will not be happening as I know this person very well and this is how they prefer do business. An important meeting to conclude what should be a productive 2 days with what should be accompanied by terrible humidity and warm weather so not a pleasurable visit.
