links.body:
>

# Entrega a tiempo

​

#


Una planificación de actividades diarias permite que las personas lleven control de todo su trabajo, cosas varias por hacer, eventos o fechas importantes que se puede tener en la memoria, pero por si falla muchos llevan una agenda donde anotan todo en orden de acuerdo a un calendario. Así es más seguro, ordenado y evita perdida de tiempo además de olvidar algunas cosas por hacer, a pesar de eso humanamente a veces por alguna razón se descuidan los tiempos lo que implica correr luego para cumplir hasta con **la última fecha.**

Si en ocasiones la vida es bastante agitada y toca correr de un lado para otro para lograr llegar a tiempo y cumplir con los compromisos adquiridos como entregar un trabajo, proyecto o encomienda. Nadie quiere luchar contra cada segundo porque quedan realmente agotados; sin embargo, la realidad es así para miles de personas que incluso se acostumbran a vivir de esa manera con un estilo bastante movido, así funcionan porque no todos escriben por anticipado lo que van a hacer, no tienen un plan elaborado y si olvidan algo no se preocupan mucho, es decir, son más relajados.

El comportamiento humano puede ser tan predecible como impredecible, en sociedad se estipulan reglas o lineamiento que son necesarios para convivir dentro del respeto y las buenas costumbres; siendo un deber cumplirlas, pero también están todas esas personas que tienen su propia forma de ser y actuar sin seguir actuaciones de otros como no tener nada planificado mientras que otros sí.


 



​<center>![WhatsApp Image 2022-05-12 at 3.28.50 PM.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeucn6MeLy6DkeFM7A2nU8vB9xADUBt8Yr6bzbsja2DRK/WhatsApp%20Image%202022-05-12%20at%203.28.50%20PM.jpeg)</center>



# On-time delivery

​

#
 Planning daily activities allows people to keep track of all their work, various things to do, events, or important dates that they may remember, but in case they forget, many keep a diary where they write everything down in order according to a calendar. This is safer, more organized, and prevents wasted time and forgotten tasks. Despite this, sometimes for some reason, people neglect their schedules, which means they have to rush to meet **the final deadline.**
​
Sometimes life is quite hectic, and you have to rush around to get everything done on time and fulfill your commitments, such as delivering a piece of work, a project, or a package. No one wants to fight against every second because they are really exhausted; however, this is the reality for thousands of people who even get used to living that way with a fairly hectic lifestyle. That's how they function because not everyone writes down what they are going to do in advance, they don't have an elaborate plan, and if they forget something, they don't worry too much about it. In other words, they are more relaxed.
​
Human behavior can be as predictable as it is unpredictable. In society, rules, or guidelines are established that are necessary for living together with respect and good manners; it is a duty to comply with them, but there are also all those people who have their own way of being and acting without following the actions of others, such as not having anything planned, while others do.
​

title.title: The Hardest Day in Nine Years of Travel
title.body:
Today I traveled through Africa — from Lusaka to Livingstone.

It was a difficult day, the first truly bad day since I started traveling. This month marks nine years on the road for me, and today I experienced something I feel I have to share.

**But before you continue reading, I want to give a small warning. What happened today was not pleasant, and the story may create disturbing images in your mind. If you are sensitive to that, you might want to stop reading here.**

It is not an easy story to tell, but I feel it is important to share it.

Thank you for understanding.


![1000012066.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rubenstorm/23t752KvK68pEjKcKob2aJ5igbS4YNvDfEeCB7ekYZDy1PHGssZeKppzpDUi2pmnvkJrE.png)

I was sleeping when the bus suddenly slammed on the brakes and woke me up. Something had dropped onto the road in front of us, and at first I thought it was just a jacket. When the bus stopped, I looked again and realized it was a child.

I wanted to jump out immediately, but the driver slowly steered the bus around the child and then stopped about 100 meters further down the road. I jumped out and ran back.

When I reached the spot, a lot of people were standing around the child, but nobody was doing anything. For a moment I thought the child was already dead.

I knelt down beside him. It was a little boy, maybe two or three years old. He looked at me with terrified eyes, and then he blinked. That moment brought a wave of relief — he was alive.

He was lying on his stomach, his head twisted to the side. I gently placed my hand on his back and spoke to him in a calm voice, telling him that everything would be okay, even though I knew it might not be. Then he started breathing and coughing blood.

There was blood everywhere around his head. His jacket had been pushed up around his head while his back was covered only by a T-shirt. I carefully moved the jacket aside so he could breathe more easily. When I did, I saw how badly his head was injured. His head was covered in deep cuts. I could see the white of his skull. It wasn’t just one wound — there were many deep cuts where the skin had been torn open.

At that moment I thought there was nothing I could do. He was so badly hurt that I feared he might die from his injuries. He stared at me with pure fear in his eyes. I kept wondering: where was his mother? Where was the police? Where was an ambulance?

I decided to look for his mother, because in that moment he needed her more than anything. She was the one who brought him into this world, and she was the one who could give him comfort.

I asked the people standing around where his mother was. A woman pointed into the bushes and said, “There — the one screaming.”

I walked over. I didn’t want to be the person who had to speak to a mother who believed her child had just died. I saw another woman trying to calm her down, so I said to that woman, “Where is the mother? Bring her. The boy is alive and breathing.”

She looked at me in disbelief and asked, “He’s alive?”

“Yes,” I said. “He’s alive and breathing. Bring his mother.”

Then I walked back to the boy. Someone had covered him with a sheet. I pulled the sheet away from his head so he could breathe. His frightened eyes looked at me again. When I saw the other side of his head and face, I realized the injuries were even worse than I first thought. There were more cuts, deeper ones, and pieces of skin were hanging loose.

A woman told me she was a nurse. Hearing that, I stepped back and walked away.

I stopped in front of a police officer who was standing there in shock, just staring. I told him to call a doctor — the boy needed a doctor immediately. The officer took out his phone and began to dial.

As I walked back to my bus, it started to move. I ran and jumped back inside.

I really hope that little boy reached the hospital quickly and that the doctors were able to save him. There was nothing more I could do. I just hope that somehow, despite everything, he had a lucky day and is now recovering somewhere as I write this.

---

I created this image with AI because I don’t have a real photo that could express this day. I cannot capture the sadness and emptiness I feel in any other way.

The image stands as a symbol of the emotions that went through me after everything that happened.

I will share the story of the day and the journey itself in a separate blog post.

title.title: A gift for Women's Day from my daughters | Un detalle en el Día de la Mujer de parte de mis hijas 🍭🌸
title.body:
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!) Good afternoon, moms and dads. How are you? I'm doing great, enjoying every moment of my life as a mom. ![InShot_20260310_081657916.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmak61C5mzNWmptb84bCx9JF1e2gTagZbQebK995Xna9w1/InShot_20260310_081657916.jpg) Last Sunday, March 8, International Women's Day, I received two gifts from my daughters, which they made in their classrooms with the help of their elementary and preschool teachers, respectively. I am grateful to them for always thinking of ways to make us happy on important days. ![20260308_081304.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQB7ntRZrpngSfU4f9UwtzXCrN6KGuXKjD3KnMpvFpzBY/20260308_081304.jpg) Abby's teacher prepared a foam flower. She had previously asked us to bring this material to class. I honestly couldn't even guess what it was for because, in the midst of my daily routine, I sometimes don't even know what day it is, much less think about what they could do with it. Inside the flower, they placed a lollipop to sweeten my day. I was able to see a photo of her in her classroom with her gift, as the teacher sent it to me last Friday. ![IMG-20260306-WA0025.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdZ85YK8CDBbcGuYYK8ikem6wHqYbG2bDM3gLwu47s7tw/IMG-20260306-WA0025.jpg) On the other hand, Alys gave me a beautiful drawing she painted at school, referring to the fact that women are strong no matter how the situation turns out, we always stand firm and are willing to find a solution while maintaining our convictions. ![20260308_081251.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVVfpLXFymKTbcGxJG26wRrQpqzyaKtornCu491utKi34/20260308_081251.jpg) They wanted to give me the details on Friday when I got home from work, but I told them to wait until Sunday, as we need to be a little patient in order to surprise our loved ones. So, even though I had already seen the drawing and the flower, they decided to wait until Sunday to give them to me. ![20260308_081148.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQyFgCeB6MTkc3khqMKRPzqxdTiqEMwkPxMSdq77oXiwN/20260308_081148.jpg) ![20260308_081153.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUVuxvUY4AZioHgpm33c8BTz6M6vRVYkaZ16C5qFH4CWC/20260308_081153.jpg) That day I finally received my gifts and we took a photo together, but I couldn't eat the lollipop because I gave it to one of the girls. But it didn't matter, I was very happy to have them and to be able to celebrate that day with them. ![20260308_081239.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR6Ku6uJmk2sRpspoNxPSzPcbVbxtuXXDnaMnEjFQeYe8/20260308_081239.jpg)

--- Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A35. Collage created in [Inshot](https://v.inshot.com/invite) Content owned by me. Translation by: [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

>

Buenas tardes, papitos y mamitas. ¿Como se encuentran? Yo muy bien, disfrutando de cada momento en mi vida de mamá.

![InShot_20260310_081657916.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmak61C5mzNWmptb84bCx9JF1e2gTagZbQebK995Xna9w1/InShot_20260310_081657916.jpg)

El pasado domingo 08 de marzo Día Internacional de la Mujer recibí dos detalles de mis hijas, los cuáles elaboraron en sus salones de clases con la ayuda de sus maestras de primaria y preescolar respectivamente, me siento agradecida con ellas siempre están pensando en alegrarnos en los días importantes de alguna forma.

![20260308_081304.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQB7ntRZrpngSfU4f9UwtzXCrN6KGuXKjD3KnMpvFpzBY/20260308_081304.jpg)

La maestra de Abby preparó una flor de foami, previamente ella nos había pedido este material para llevarlo a clases, yo la verdad no pude ni intuir de que se trataba porque en medio de mi rutina diaria a veces no se que día es, mucho menos pensé en que podían hacer con ello, dentro de la flor colocaron una chupeta para endulzar mi día, pude ver una foto de ella en su salón de clases con su regalo, ya que la maestra me la envió el viernes pasado.

![IMG-20260306-WA0025.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdZ85YK8CDBbcGuYYK8ikem6wHqYbG2bDM3gLwu47s7tw/IMG-20260306-WA0025.jpg)

Por otra parte, Alys me dió un hermoso dibujo que pinto en la escuela, haciendo referencia a que las mujeres somos fuertes sin importar como se ponga la situación siempre nos encontramos firmes y dispuestas a encontrar una solución manteniendo siempre nuestra convicción. 

![20260308_081251.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVVfpLXFymKTbcGxJG26wRrQpqzyaKtornCu491utKi34/20260308_081251.jpg)

Ellas querían darme los detalles el mismo viernes cuando llegue del trabajo, yo les dije que esperaran hasta el domingo, ya que debemos ser un poco pacientes para poder sorprender a quiénes amamos, así que aunque ya había visto el dibujo y la flor, decidieron aguardar hasta el domingo para dármelos.


![20260308_081148.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQyFgCeB6MTkc3khqMKRPzqxdTiqEMwkPxMSdq77oXiwN/20260308_081148.jpg)

![20260308_081153.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUVuxvUY4AZioHgpm33c8BTz6M6vRVYkaZ16C5qFH4CWC/20260308_081153.jpg)

Ese día recibí finalmente mis regalos y nos tomamos una foto juntas, pero no pude comerme la chupeta porque se la dí a una de las niñas, pero no importa, yo me sentía muy feliz por tenerlas y poder celebrar ese día al lado de ellas.

![20260308_081239.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR6Ku6uJmk2sRpspoNxPSzPcbVbxtuXXDnaMnEjFQeYe8/20260308_081239.jpg)

** Hola cómo están comunidad de artesanos y manualistas , hoy les traigo un post cortito y rápido de como decoré un espacio para tomar fotos para el cumpleaños de mi hermana, de una forma bonita ,sencilla y que luciera algo elegante o un poco más serio , ya qué al ser su cumple 18 quería que se viera un poco mas acordé a la ocasión, mientras en otras ocasiones ya le he hecho decoraciones con más temática, como la de stray kids, BTS, mariposas y Harry Potter, entonces está vez la idea era hacer algo sencillo pero sin una temática si no más formal, así que se decidió decorar con colores negros y dorado para la decoración, aquí les dejo las fotos de como arme toda la decoración.**
![1000272910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23wr5RNMKVK5XYKsfKftjqYrP7MdrE8oBhHS7cYA6XumWBdcUwwiCLatbWvFryK33mafz.jpg)
⭐Paquete de globos dorado cromados ⭐10 globos negros ⭐Una cortina de cuadros negros ⭐Una cortina dorada de tiras ⭐Cinta fina dorada para hacer lazos ⭐globos grandes dorados de número 18 ⭐Globo grande negro de feliz cumpleaños ⭐Cinta doble cara ⭐Hilo de tejer macramé o mecatillo ⭐inflador de globos ⭐Teipe transparente **Manos a la obra**
English Version

Hello fellow crafters and artisans! Today I'm bringing you a quick and easy post about how I decorated a photo booth for my sister's birthday. I wanted it to be pretty, simple, and still look elegant or a bit more formal, since it was her 18th birthday and I wanted it to be more in keeping with the occasion. While I've done themed decorations for her before, like Stray Kids, BTS, butterflies, and Harry Potter, this time the idea was to do something simple but without a specific theme, just more formal. So, we decided to decorate with black and gold. Here are the photos of how I put all the decorations together.

![1000272910.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23wr5RNMKVK5XYKsfKftjqYrP7MdrE8oBhHS7cYA6XumWBdcUwwiCLatbWvFryK33mafz.jpg)
⭐Pack of chrome gold balloons ⭐10 black balloons ⭐One black plaid curtain ⭐One gold string curtain ⭐Thin gold ribbon for making bows ⭐Large gold number 18 balloons ⭐Large black \

balloon ⭐Double-sided tape ⭐Macrame twine or string ⭐Balloon pump ⭐Clear tape **Let's get to work**

![1000272906.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23u5vesEkymmpV2AXbs2gepsLkFh5GYRhJQ1rntofnZaR4QNTrwcioEVyCn8g56RcLMvj.png)
|||| |---|---|---| |![1000496233.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23xVEbZZTnjkb8pQWba5snZJFatPkbt295XbFJZMnPgp5YrbBHddZXPoC6e4LaQvsn3Fu.jpg)|![1000494680.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/EpEGoSmk1j6eamTuZAMzcyeh924adEBSivBmvN3yUgCFZKKn78s6X1vENDPib9DfFSJ.jpg)| **#1 Para hacer la cascada de globos, tuve que ingeniarmelas ,ya que solo tenía un paquete de 25 globos dorados y solo 10 negros, con un inflador manual inflé los 10 globos y 23 de los dorados ya qué se me dañaron dos, uno de los negros se me dañó , pero dado que eran pocos, lo que hice fue que introduje dentro de un globo dorado ,dejando el globo negro por fuera, lo que hace que sean dos globos y al inflar el dorado dentro que no tenía agujeros ,el globo negro de afuera se llenó bien y pude recuperarlo. Olvidé sacarle fotos al armado de la cascada de globos ,pero está es fácil de hacer ,una vez llenado los globos, la mayoría del mismo tamaño, tratando de no llenarlos por completo para para que no perdieran su aspecto esférico, también dejé dos globos negros de un tamaño más pequeño, y tres más dorados también mucho más pequeños.Luego usé un hilo para macramé de tejer como base para la cascada, usé tres globos unidos , y los fue enrredando en el hilo para asegurarlo, como si fuera una pulsera gigante,jaja, primero hice estos trio de globos , con uno solo negro y dos dorados ,luego me di cuenta que lo mejor era hacerlo, en una secuencia de un globo negro y dos dorados, y en el siguiente trio los tres dorados y así la secuencia, para que se vean de un lado suficiente globos negros. Luego de tener la cascada de globos, habiendo enrredando bien el hilo entre cada globo para asegurarlos, hay algunos espacios en donde se ve el espacio del hilo así que allí pegué con Teipe doble cara los globos más pequeños que pegué estratégicamente para tapar estos espacios. Usé listones dorados para agregandolo en las uniones de los globos para darle un toque más bonito.**
English Version

***#1 To make the balloon waterfall, I had to get creative, since I only had a pack of 25 gold balloons and only 10 black ones. With a hand pump, I inflated the 10 gold balloons and 23 of the gold ones, since two were damaged. One of the black ones was also damaged, but since there were only a few, what I did was put it inside a gold balloon, leaving the black balloon outside. This made two balloons, and when I inflated the gold one inside, which didn't have any holes, the black balloon outside filled up completely and I was able to recover it. I forgot to take pictures of the balloon waterfall assembly, but it's easy to make. Once the balloons are filled, most of them the same size, trying not to fill them completely so they don't lose their spherical shape, I also left out two smaller black balloons and three much smaller gold ones. Then I used macrame yarn as the base for the waterfall. I used three balloons joined together, wrapping them around the yarn to secure it, like a giant bracelet, haha. First, I made these trios of balloons with one black and two gold ones. Then I realized it was better to do it in a sequence of one black and two gold balloons, and in the next trio, all three gold, and so on, so that enough black balloons are visible from one side. After creating the balloon cascade, having carefully wrapped the string around each balloon to secure them, there were some gaps where the string was visible. So, I used double-sided tape to strategically place smaller balloons over these gaps. I added gold ribbons to the balloon joins for a nicer touch.

|||| |---|---|---| |![1000494678.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/Ep5mAu8ZCHtbbmHMZGWLS74yGpgkFJANUnquVCTrDmgYGCtxHDPLimyKjX9bKG3RNta.jpg)|![1000494681.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23wgHd4ZY6un3HWNEaRhCeTEf6i29BiLB7MH1PH21JMT9rM35QtaMWdzvGjpviaFtxsJ9.jpg)| **#2 Para el fondo usé, la cortina negra de cuadros, está trate su pega , pero dado que había brisa en el sitio donde la ubiqué,así que use Teipe transparente para pegarlo y que quedará liso completo sin levantarse (trate de no usar allí el Teipe doble cara porque podía dañar la pared).Luego usé las cortinas de tiras doradas, la corte a la mitad y las ubiqué a cada lado del fondo negro, aquí lo malo es que siempre que usó estás cortinas de tiras ,es más las que se le caen que las que quedan en las cortinas 😭.**
English Version

**#2 For the background, I used the black plaid curtain. It was easy to stick up, but since there was a breeze where I hung it, I used clear tape to secure it so it would stay completely smooth and not lift (I tried not to use double-sided tape there because it could damage the wall). Then I used the gold strip curtains. I cut them in half and hung them on either side of the black background. The problem is that whenever I use these strip curtains, more of the strips fall off than stay on the curtains 😭.**

|||| |---|---|---| |![1000494700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/Eo4A918ydJKs78viEm9hgXTfRirbBHYLyvPG84vDqQFxpveMsyaY2yfvysV7fEECv8u.jpg)|![1000494704.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23wC7vkY2XRLLvtdnBFMn6CQw1LQsmn2MbECnviZmhdmmWEqTMJCUEKiL83RyBUxuSs4v.jpg)| **#3 Ya una vez con el fondo, coloque la cascada de globos de forma diagonal como si estuviera cayendo por el lado izquierdo, me ayude de la cuerda que tenía para armar la cascada y ate este hilo bien en un clavo de la pared, también hice lo mismo en la parte media de la cascada de globos.**
English Version

**#3 Once the background was in place, I positioned the balloon waterfall diagonally as if it were cascading down the left side. I used the string I had to assemble the waterfall and tied it securely to a nail on the wall. I also did the same in the middle section of the balloon waterfall.**

![1000272906.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23u5vesEkymmpV2AXbs2gepsLkFh5GYRhJQ1rntofnZaR4QNTrwcioEVyCn8g56RcLMvj.png)
|||| |---|---|---| |![1000494705.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23w2jGNxYHGxzNqxHyLidasAHooE5yUA4wiNid22DxGPAS17RFrQXZDY3WGzHHF9SFr6Y.jpg)|![1000494719.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23vhwVeuWqWR3LwbXHQV5ZzZh3AWK3p1AxJ5UV46GwXo9W2wn6uPBWkjLdqfVKwRtZsoG.jpg)| **#4 Usé los listones que se habían caído y los agregué entre los globos, pasé varios entre ellos y pegando los listones y la parte final del hilo de la cascada de globos , los pegué a la pared usando Teipe doble cara , y recordándolo con Teipe transparente para que no se soltaran.Luego agregué el cartel de feliz cumpleaños en letras doradas pegándolo con Teipe doble cara**
English Version

**#4 I used the ribbons that had fallen off and added them between the balloons, threading several between them and gluing the ribbons and the end of the balloon cascade string to the wall using double-sided tape, reinforcing it with clear tape so it wouldn't come loose. Then I added the happy birthday sign in gold letters, sticking it on with double-sided tape.**

||| |---|---| |![1000494721.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23vsGJKzj9nxELVc9ncvouL88m2LZGi9pEBB35RZ146DcwQinn9vLTRschamu44n7crrq.jpg)|![1000494726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23vsGPc3AtBormVvaUeiWZ3JzCd6B84uHwgQWkfWyJVff8wH3WsCcwYFt8RgWKaPydZ8m.jpg)| **#5 Luego llené los globos dorados con el número 18 ,y los pegué al costado del lado derecho llenando ese espacio, luego en el espacio qué quedó ubiqué el globo grande de cumpleaños de color negro, también agregué muchos más listones entre los globos para que se vieran como si estuvieran cayendo en la cascada de globos, luego hice unas estrellas en cartulina dorada con listones dorados cayendo ,y las pegué en algunos globos negros para destacarlos, de esta manera se viera una mezcla bonita entre el dorado y negro.**
English Version

**#5 Next, I filled the gold balloons with the number 18 and glued them to the right side, filling that space. Then, in the remaining space, I placed the large black birthday balloon. I also added many more ribbons between the balloons to make them look like they were falling in a balloon waterfall. Then, I made some stars out of gold cardstock with gold ribbons hanging from them and glued them onto some black balloons to make them stand out, creating a nice mix of gold and black.**

![1000496741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23wMRrNpGbTYHpeRbZv3yCYLQCo2xzG3fbSLVpTfgEaq667WqWMMcdt2s5yfPuXSkWqPX.jpg) |![1000494822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23w2h7Xas7NMmkF8RTSQsAv4kLntXS8AwJcAeCzRCf7e78uFDiMrVMYfiWm7ZokMJcWVp.jpg)| **# Y listo esté sería el resultado, es una decoración sencilla pero bonita y elegante ,por la mezcla de colores negro y dorado, también el arco de globos con los listones dorados callendo y con las estrellas se ve muy bonito y llamativo, junto con los números dorados , se ven en contraste con el fondo negro, quedé bastante satisfecha con el decorado y dado que no es algo súper recargado pero usando todos los elementos decorativos (globos,cortinas) y me encantó el resultado.** **Muchas gracias por leerme ! 🤭💜✨ Espero que les haya gustado el post!** **Fotos tomadas por mí en mi equipo Redmi note 12 editadas en Pics art y gif realizado en app creador de GIFs texto traducido en Google traductor.**
English Version

**# And that's it! This is the result. It's a simple but beautiful and elegant decoration, thanks to the mix of black and gold. The balloon arch with the cascading gold ribbons and stars looks very pretty and eye-catching, along with the gold numbers, which contrast beautifully against the black background. I was quite satisfied with the decoration, and since it's not overly elaborate but uses all the decorative elements (balloons, curtains), I loved the result.** **Thank you very much for reading me! 🤭💜✨ I hope you liked the post!** **Photos taken by me on my Redmi note 12 device edited in Pics art and gif made in the GIF creator app, text translated in Google translator.**

![4i88GgaV8qiFkxbnGCXnHNbt8wcgAMNP6xb3BathL8VqeDFYKXuNAkzuy93dktowueGi3RoFYVhvEXNb9xEGGboKv868CQ23RXXeYYeYrNtSH2gdLPsCWMxRBM.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23xpVZzYxFW2F9aJummQps1BNSRcmiVKW31mFkdx8GDh13QzYtWw9aZcmYJgdS3rGYDhG.webp) ![1000270227.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23xLB4rz8WVvcLrthfqxT8gN9dkfwuWmKwAX4UgJ2xEgsuPfy5ooCitcdEmzhXUrRCk7u.gif)
![7258xSVeJbKmTr9Z4jhbPhjS9pMWA2mTwBMDbXqk9a86s6k7zhjVGbTFbSZoZpVCQAwUqS7UajAgyqBijYPivmv5VdafCsfWG495gu5jqwLrwwXPaUxzAyEgVNXwrzrNoez4BqrrYkimc.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mily23m/23wXLfYpN2fb2oogZUmw4eBVM9jPx3tsBAs2oYFFuafaSwDkfCzd54QjrJTif4e9jj5fQ.webp)

title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![piAIOCm5LmMSLg0w_1000168489.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/filoriologo/images/piAIOCm5LmMSLg0w_1000168489/piAIOCm5LmMSLg0w_1000168489.webp)
![c2UwPfuMyYP0v2gb_1000168488.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/filoriologo/images/c2UwPfuMyYP0v2gb_1000168488/c2UwPfuMyYP0v2gb_1000168488.webp)
![qS82jFty69XPZv2y_1000168493.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/filoriologo/images/qS82jFty69XPZv2y_1000168493/qS82jFty69XPZv2y_1000168493.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

En estos días me he tomado con pequeños obsequios de la naturaleza. Cómo lo he dicho anteriormente, me gusta la naturaleza y encontrarme con flores, arbustos y y árboles bellos en medio de todo el concreto citadino es particularmente maravilloso. 

En el fondo creo ya es hora de pensar un paseo a la montaña o algún lugar donde la naturaleza sea la protagonista. Quizá el hecho de estar atento a estos \

e interpretarlos como indicios de que esha llegado un momento de desconexión para conectar o bueno quizá me gusta pensarlo de ese modo. 

PD: pido disculpas porque ayer prometí una publicación pero por algunos contratiempos no la he podido terminar y el reto de publicar todos los días me ha hecho adelantar este post de hoy. Mañana espero publicar lo que ayer prometí en mi post.

*Fotografía @filoriologo Redmi Note 14**Edición: Adobe Photoshop Lightroom*



***

---

##  ENGLISH VERSION

These days, I have been enjoying small gifts from nature. As I have said before, I love nature, and finding beautiful flowers, bushes, and trees amid all the concrete of the city is particularly wonderful. 

Deep down, I think it's time to plan a trip to the mountains or somewhere else where nature takes center stage. Perhaps the fact that I'm paying attention to these \

and interpreting them as signs that it's time to disconnect in order to connect, or maybe I just like to think that way. 

PS: I apologize because yesterday I promised a post, but due to some setbacks, I haven't been able to finish it, and the challenge of posting every day has made me move today's post forward. Tomorrow, I hope to post what I promised yesterday.

title.body:
# Hurricane Research Division of AOML/NOAA

**Source:** https://www.aoml.noaa.gov/hrd/HFP2001/erin.html

Printer Friendly Version

 Hurricane Erin (10 September 2001)

The goal of this mission was to obtain coordinated multi-level in 
situ and remotely sensed observations to support the Surveillance 
objectives of CAMEX-4 under the USWRP. We hoped to sample the 
storm at two altitudes in the core with N42RF and the ER-2 to 
focus our remote sensing and in situ precipitation measurement 
capabilities on any major precipitation feature. Meanwhile the 
DC-8 was sampling the near environment of the storm with GPS sondes 
and the LASE to obtain environmental wind and thermodynamic 
fields for numerical model initialization 

![Image 1](https://dhenz14.github.io/graphics/20010910h_ftk.jpg)

A very good mission! Good coordination with the ER-2 resulting in 
an excellent center drop from 65,000 ft ( a first!). Completed 
the pattern as briefed with a few wrinkles to maintain coordination 
with the ER-2 and flight safety. In the core there was an 
interesting variations in the radius of maximum wind at the surface 
and flight level were found on the north and east side of the 
storm. The maximum SFMR surface winds were at much smaller ra dii 
(8-12 km) than the maximum 14,000 ft winds. This difference 
was evident in the GPS-sondes in the eyewall. We also found two 
low-level circulation centers evident in the low-level cloud field 
(see Figure). The surface wind and pressure center appeared to 
be in the circulation closest to the west eyewall. There was only 
one apparent wind and pressure center at 14,000 ft, which was 
closer to the other surface cloud circulation. CN measurements 
indicated that the eye was relatively dirty with concentrations 
~2000 l-1.

As many people definitely have different choices and the things that they want out of their life, which is going to define the way their life is going to look.


![suzi-kim-87IVr1pjoPM-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sayu907/Eo4B3m4jXEEt3UTZqpjtnsCpm3NuZVo9yY43nYfs4zxZme6uKemtA9h9cYoTCkt3PrL.jpg)

On the other hand you would also get to know many people who are always going to be looking forward towards the calmness in life as well which is going to be there in terms of the stability which they are going to follow and always going to do things in a structured manner rather than having something unplanned which is going to be giving them how much more predictable way of life and there is something the day are seeking all the time.

It often becomes a big question about which is going to be the better side to be pig and the choice that people are going to make in terms of the life that they want to live which is going to be completely divided among the two which is going to be like a life full of adrenaline and on the other hand another life that is going to be very much quite and peaceful along with a lot of planning.

This is a particular sensation that gets to be a very good aspect that people want to repeat in every situation after that, which is why people are going to be looking forward to those experiences where they are going to be able to enjoy all of these aspects and also have the feeling of challenges as well, where they have to rely on their impulses.

The mindset that these people have within themselves is going to be about the fan that doing something over and over again in terms of a schedule is definitely boring and trying everything new every given point of time is definitely going to be giving them the uncertainty factor that is going to be something which is going to make them feel like sighted about and also have a different challenge to make sure that they are going to beat the next day which is going to be about making sure that their life is full of intensity rather than something that is going to be holding a lot of structure.

But if we talk about people who are going to be looking forward towards a particular way of life where they are going to be having a lot of peace and also having the predictability factor as the top priority then you would definitely have a very structured life where you are always going to be knowing what is coming up next and that is going to be something which will be giving you a very big sense of emotional safety that is a very much important thing to have in life as well.


![jelle-buurman-FtmTInpzpAE-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sayu907/23vsNERPqgBWaSF1HX5uhrtnhQFDrkdkYdCwJLCdzJ4gtfxpeoGaBWx1zoBVHwkaaJTH4.jpg)
[src](https://unsplash.com/photos/silhouette-of-man-riding-on-skateboard-under-cloudy-sky-during-daytime-FtmTInpzpAE)

There is a very massive amount of stress and anxiety which we have to be experiencing and also getting subjected to because of the planning that we have already made as we are already knowing the things that we are going to face next which is surely going to be giving a lot more meaning to life itself which is something that is going to only come with stability and also help us to stay in the best possible mental state.

If we are always looking forward towards making our life predictable we are definitely going to be finding ourselves in a particular position where we might feel that it is a bit too monotonous and ultimately it is also going to lead to stagnation and on the other hand when we are always going to look forward towards having that sense of excitement and making a cells involved in something that is going to give us the thrill we are also making sure that there is a very increase amount of mental pressure on us as we need to perform in situations that we might not be ready for.

In the end, it is going to be the best strategy to maintain a balance between the two and also enjoy life as we do it, and not choosing one over the other, as we can be enjoying both of them now and then and that is something which we should be looking forward towards focusing to achieve and ultimately making our life much more meaningful.

title.body: Effective budgeting starts before income arrives, not after it is received. Planning how money will be spent in advance helps prevent impulsive spending and ensures that important goals such as savings and essential needs are prioritized. By organizing expenses early and using simple tracking methods like saving receipts, recording daily spending, and reviewing expenses regularly, individuals can develop better financial discipline and gain greater control over their money.

title.title: Why Do People Suffer Tribulations?//Mcgi Topic Review (part 5)
title.body:
https://youtu.be/elt0f2Ypko0?si=yCaVBw1lCV6zWGC2

**Greetings everyone,** and welcome to my blog. It is another wonderful opportunity to listen to the word of God through His servant, Bro. Eli Soriano.

The wealth and resources of the world could have been fairly shared among all people if not for the greed of a few individuals who choose to accumulate everything for themselves.

Greed is one of the major problems affecting society today. Many people are focused on taking everything they can, while others are left to struggle with hunger, hardship, and poverty.

However, our Lord Jesus Christ reminds us in John 16:33 that we should not lose hope. He said that He spoke these words so that we may have peace in Him. Although we will face troubles and challenges in this world, we should remain courageous because He has already overcome the world.

Through this message, we are reminded that trials and difficulties are part of life, but we should not allow them to discourage us. Instead, we should keep our faith strong, knowing that Christ has already gained victory.

In the teaching shared by Bro. Eli, he encouraged believers not to lose hope even in difficult situations. He explained that during the pandemic, his restaurant had to close, yet he and his workers remained hopeful about what the future would bring.

He also mentioned examples from the Bible about people who experienced poverty but remained faithful. One example is Lazarus, who did not allow his suffering or poverty to take away his faith. He kept his focus on the promise of eternal life and the hope of a new heaven and a new earth with Christ at the end of time.

In conclusion, we should not allow greed or the hardships of this world to shake our faith. Instead, we should remember that Christ has already overcome the world, and through Him we can remain hopeful and strong.

**Thank you for reading.**

title.title: Iftar by the Dam
title.body:
As most of you know it is the Ramadan season, so I got to visit my relatives, in Karak,  after a long time. Although I had a busy schedule, but thanks to the work-from-home scenario, I got to enjoy some free time. The house felt lively, full of conversations, laughter and all in between. 

It was around 2:30 PM, when out of nowhere, we decided to go for some fishing. Since the dam was not too far from the house - around 4-km - so we decided to walk there instead of taking any vehicle. The weather was somewhat pleasant. Somewhat? Yes, because I would be lying if I said it was a perfect decision. As we were fasting, and the summer season is almost here. So yeah 🥲. But, I must say, walking together felt more meaningful than simply driving there. It gave us time to reconnect, like old times. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYfKpLaGhnZyJ3Te7pVrVYjfESQD5fkpNFtFUYu2kxfiV/1773171314140.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPjjyvv74gWmNd5nXNzDinvDs44mYH5p6QDKWAPrL69cB/1773172526926.jpg)



When we reached the dam, the view was calm and peaceful. The water was still, reflecting the colors of the evening sky. 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXy87qc1hQXWm8zER1C1tHbMYQhctEAqrtUTXT57hBV95/1773171441566.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP7LDzwWwUovUxEZzqm2M7L8FcMaVLxmuiHfqMHxUB2Hz/1773171381118.jpg)


Some of us brought fishing gear, so naturally we decided to try our luck. And I was the unlucky one, or I should say inexperienced one. As this was my first time, living this experience. 

>So I am just going to make an excuse: fishing is not really about catching fish; it is more about sitting quietly, waiting and enjoying the company around you. 

Some of us were more serious about it, while others were just there for the fun of it. Thanks to the serious one, we managed to catch a few, enough for the company present there. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVwGB8gKWBRoZrc1xCMA5heChaLgoRrLZ4GNy6oEWxJC7/1773171599658.jpg)

That side-eye look :) 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUBPHNPGYmyPR7pjiZVUURdKqH7GqZx2wSEKsUERzzGNZ/1773171599777.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTLRwCidpPuhq1fCd6tH3HNxZgXkqciYH1YUyTzV4cQvk/1773171599933.jpg)

While a few of us focused on fishing, the others started preparing for iftar. Instead of bringing everything ready made from home, we decided to cook some of it ourselves. It was a simple setup, nothing extra ordinary. Someone arranged the fire - actually the gas cylinder. Someone cleaned the fish we managed to catch and others handled the small tasks like cutting vegetables and preparing the basic ingredients i.e. Masala. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRMAHYcRPkZPMqFrfnpPwEs7ZzT1JpALyfhGiKRJ4Fd7r/1773172007815.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNRobjzLx5Vq54ba2DsTuJtUjteCRjXMPMW6oZd4udVfv/1773171692024.jpg)



Meanwhile, the sun slowly began to set, and the sky turned into shades of orange and purple which is known as 'Layl'. 

As the time for iftar approached, we gathered near the water with the food ready in front of us. Dates, some freshly cooked items and a few snacks we had brought along. When the azan (prayer call) echoed from a nearby mosque, we all paused for a moment and then broke our fast together. After a long day of fasting and walk, that first sip of water always feels refreshing, but sharing it with family in such a peaceful place made it even more memorable especially for me. 

After iftar, we sat around for a while longer: talking, laughing and enjoying the cool evening breeze. Some continued fishing while others simply relaxed and watched the water. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZFRcY5Cc8CKYBcq6sLvBovwXvRFtesvDGauq1eoht988/1773172263404.jpg)


Sometimes the best memories are not about big plans or expensive outlook. They come from small gatherings like this, walking to a nearby dam, fishing with family, cooking together and sharing iftar under the open sky during Ramadan. 

......... 

Peace 🕊

title.title: TTT: Memory Lane With \
Tunes
title.body:
<div  class=text-justify>

I went down my music playlist today, I rarely do that and somehow it felt like I was going down memory lane as I saw a lot of songs I've not played since almost forever. I wonder if I'm the only one like that, new songs tend to take my mind from old songs on my list except on the rare days when I have my music play on shuffling.

![file_000000008b00720a81b4cd2c97fa4c28.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/23yJUqKUqLJxnY21N1BR9gw3AuF2hUYfKEqyTqCTZxVhxnj5Jh1DFpG1n4fVzU5KuszV5.png)

Instead of reviewing or recommending a recent or new sound I've listened to, I decided to do like a throwback tuesday with my music list and that led me to scroll down to the bottom, I found an artist that I've once loved so much that I didn't think I'd even forget about her songs in my playlist... That's my favorite **\

** feels more like the artist of my childhood, I remember she is the first secular music artist I fell in love with and became a fan of without actually realizing it. The very first song of hers I listened to **\

** was trendy then and it spoke right to me about realizing that I am beautiful and scars are fine. After the first song, I began to listen to a lot of her other songs and my long scroll today took me to three of them that I'd love to share today for #ttt they are my favourite after the first one I listened to and they have impressive lyrics that you'd want to keep singing. Maybe I will make a cover of some of them now that I'm reminded. ### **Seventeen** https://youtu.be/dB1w9Yiu3zo?si=h63xvkwAZBKL5k89
The start of this song feels more than just a memory for me, it's a part of me because I remember using this song as my phone ringtone for over two years. I couldn't bring myself to change it until I came across a song that forced me to. But I think this song had a strong hold on me because of the lyrics, a powerful song about growing up, understanding life as life goes on. There are days I still wish I had understood or known some things earlier but that's how life is. ### **Overdose** https://youtu.be/bH_C9veaiTk?si=JMYByaexVLj9gubW
As much as the lyrics of this song never felt relatable to me, I fell for the vibe of the song and how true it is from watching others actually live what she expressed in the lyrics. Love is one side of life that comes at every person in different ways but people who have to deal with love like it's some overdose of something (abuse), it felt concerning so I just listened and fell for everything else about the song, I also used this song as my ringtone at the same as the first one. ### **River of Tears** https://youtu.be/4b2M5K7sbc0?si=NtWvNRI_juXWfZwI
The one song of hers that felt too deep and heavy for me to listen to but very relatable, there is hardly a time I'll listen to this song without feeling some calm emotions flowing through me. It's not that I've lost anyone dear to me that felt really painful but I'm reminded of the people I no longer see as often as I did in the past. Some things remind me of them but it's all the past, the song portrays that energy so much and I feel it.
**Image is a caricature created with ChatGPT.**

Este post no quiero que sea solo para verme como una víctima o como alguien que siempre necesita la ayuda de los demás. Simplemente necesitaba escribir sobre esto. Tengo habilidades con el idioma inglés, también con la escritura, algunas veces dedico mi tiempo para hacer otras cosas como dibujar o disfrutar de otros hobbies. Me gustaría saber si ustedes tienen alguna necesidad de aprender algo de inglés o si conocen alguna forma de obtener un trabajo remoto. Me sería de mucha ayuda, sobre todo porque no estoy físicamente capacitada para trabajar todo el día en la calle, no es una excusa, es una realidad luego de mi problema con mi pierna izquierda y la cirugía que tuve que no fue un éxito. 

Agradezco poder estar aquí en Hive y contar con el apoyo de varias personas increíbles que me han dado palabras de aliento y también me han apoyado en momentos difíciles. Hoy estuve reflexionando sobre mi salud mental que es algo con lo que también tengo que lidiar, además del tratamiento que no es nada barato. Y pensé que a pesar de todas las cosas difíciles por las que pasamos todos, siempre hay una manera de seguir adelante, siempre hay una esperanza, una luz convertida en oportunidades y personas. Eso le agradezco a Dios siempre, porque a pesar de todo estoy mejor que muchas personas de mi país. 

He escuchado mucho la palabra de Dios, siento que es necesario también alimentar la fe y nunca dejar de confiar en que todo tiene un propósito aunque no entendamos en el momento para qué o por qué estamos viviendo esas situaciones. Hive es una plataforma que me ha dado un espacio para expresarme y que me ha permitido también sanar muchas cosas a través de la escritura. Siempre encuentro la motivación de escribir aunque no sepa realmente sobre que quiero escribir y eso es algo que solo Hive me ha permitido sentir. Además de hacerme sentir parte de algo y de apoyarme sobre todos esos comentarios de personas que con sus propios problemas, que deciden leer mis posts y dejarme comentarios que hasta lágrimas me han sacado. 

![1000122075.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EowH5qB49bRwVzg2kNET93tN6keNjA8HsmzkAr9ztXfWXf8JesKq5BXpLN8wsfSqzcd.jpg)

No quiero que este post sea solo algo donde pueda sentir que dejo salir lo que siento, quiero que otras personas que estén pasando por problemas de salud, económicos, pérdidas, soledad... También sientan que pueden leerme y encontrar esa señal para no darse por vencidos. No hay ningún problema que no tenga solución, solo tenemos que enfocarnos en lo que si tenemos, en los que si están y nos apoyan, en aquello que en otros tiempos queríamos tener y hoy disfrutamos de tenerlo. No hay nada que sea imposible para Dios —o en lo que tú decidas creer—. No hay tormenta que dure para siempre, solo debemos saber cuidarnos, dar lo mejor de nosotros y continuar porque en algún momento todos esos sacrificios y esfuerzos tendrán su recompensa. **No se den por vencidos**, gracias por leer hasta aquí 🥹🫶🏽

![1000129948.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoH5cfukro6xLYk19P7v3Cf4XYRtSWrMSkQMX5ML25n9ZmBC5FvMenmWwDeuaqrCq2r.png)

##### <center> English </center> 

![1000122102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/Eou9ge7MVyiV2AunPwbU2qhR1oPc9eRTeQxWNMwdNKU5NozDxoboGmJ9GRssh3mrxTX.jpg)


Hello, friends of the Catarsis community, I hope you are all doing very well. Lately, I’ve been going through some tough times, especially financially. I don’t like asking for favors or bothering other people. However, with the drop in Hive's value, I’ve also found myself more struggled with my expenses—from my health medications to being able to buy basic groceries. The situation in Venezuela hasn't improved much; I've tried to find a job, but I haven't been able to land one.

I don’t want this post to be just about seeing myself as a victim or as someone who always needs help from others. I simply needed to write about this. I have skills in English as well as writing, and sometimes I dedicate my time to other things like drawing or enjoying other hobbies. I would like to know if any of you need to learn some English or if you know of any way to get a remote job. It would be a huge help, especially since I am not physically able to work all day on the street; it’s not an excuse, it’s a reality following the issue with my left leg and a surgery that was not successful.

I am grateful to be here on Hive and to have the support of several incredible people who have given me words of encouragement and supported me during difficult times. Today I was reflecting on my mental health, which is something I also have to deal with, in addition to a treatment that is not cheap at all. And I thought that despite all the difficult things we all go through, there is always a way to keep going; there is always hope, a light turned into opportunities and people. I always thank God for that, because despite everything, I am better off than many people in my country.

I’ve been listening to the Word of God a lot; I feel it is also necessary to feed our faith and never stop trusting that everything has a purpose, even if we don't understand in the moment what for or why we are living through these situations. Hive is a platform that has given me a space to express myself and has allowed me to heal many things through writing. I always find the motivation to write even when I don't really know what I want to write about, and that is something only Hive has made me feel. Besides making me feel part of something, it supports me through all those comments from people who, despite having their own problems, choose to read my posts and leave me comments that have even moved me to tears.


![1000122075.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EowH5qB49bRwVzg2kNET93tN6keNjA8HsmzkAr9ztXfWXf8JesKq5BXpLN8wsfSqzcd.jpg)


I don't want this post to be just a place where I let out what I feel; I want other people who are going through health problems, financial issues, loss, or loneliness... to also feel they can read me and find that sign not to give up. There is no problem that doesn't have a solution; we just have to focus on what we do have, on those who are there supporting us, and on those things we once wanted and today enjoy having. There is nothing impossible for God—or whatever you choose to believe in. No storm lasts forever; we just need to know how to take care of ourselves, give our best, and keep going, because at some point, all those sacrifices and efforts will have their reward. **Don't give up**; thank you for reading this far. 🥹🫶🏽


![1000129948.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/EoH5cfukro6xLYk19P7v3Cf4XYRtSWrMSkQMX5ML25n9ZmBC5FvMenmWwDeuaqrCq2r.png)

title.title: Hand colored with colored pencils and markers: Vintage Cosmonaut
title.body: A big hug to all my Rising Star friends! I'm happy to be drawing for you all again. I'm glad I've been able to be more active here in the community this week. For this occasion, I wanted to draw something different, so I chose a type of instrument I haven't drawn much: a microphone. These kinds of instruments are among those I've drawn the least, so I'm excited to do it. Today's microphone, unlike many of the previous ones, is rare, so it will be interesting to draw it and analyze it a bit.\n\n<div class = \

> ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andrewq/23tvs3neyPKRtCogjYL3fzRB19Bb9Etx452sYymRE1sDGozYNTVEgtAWKrjwXaqbAVWRr.jpg)
The microphone is the Vintage Cosmonaut. You can find it in the game's shop with the ID number R248. It's a rare card, and its attribute is around 50 Luck. You know, this microphone is by far the most interesting one I've drawn; I find it both novel and funny. Funny because it reminds me of a bicycle light I had at home—they're almost identical on the outside. This coincidence made me laugh a lot. And I find it innovative because for a vintage microphone, it looks super futuristic. It looks a lot like a rocket. I think that's why the microphone's title includes the word \
—because it resembles a rocket. At the end, I'll leave a picture with the original deck so you can see the stars it has.\n\n<div class = \

> ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andrewq/23xpCUxWquqsy6fFY5J8bHCYxbvVRHw9zAX94kyWQgRgq4SRTu2MBeJy3ARupcipcsUik.jpg)
You know, I don't know if this microphone actually exists, but if it does, I imagine it must be great to use for psychedelic music or something like that. Its aesthetic is perfect for that. If you know if it exists, please tell me more about it. In fact, you can leave me links if you want to singers using it so I can see it in action.

> ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andrewq/23vi1fCQe4FDLPSDRsQPvBZ9976ivQXFgebxNfuMTUpGC9cmASLPjF58gJJdkztPE7Gdo.jpg)
![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andrewq/23wqeDRXsHtHw12CnTEVjS6ULgFzRUChUcy91HMxdgipERvBJLwyJGj8o7YiqLAUz4nG3.jpg) What did you think of the drawing? I was very happy to make it and to be able to share it here with you today in the community. The day I become a singer, I want to have one like this, haha. Just kidding, but it would be great to have one, even if it's just as a collector's item. It's very beautiful. I hope the drawing does justice to the deck, which, as you can see, is beautiful. I'll be back soon with more new content, so don't miss it. Warm regards.

title.title: Late Night Hangout
title.body: We gotaa chull sometimes, right? No matter how hard life is going, we need to say, ***\

*** and that's what I'm doing right now. Even if you scroll through my recent posts, you will see rants here and there, hahaha, time to break and chill. 

Its ramadan here, prayers after evening. Usually, on normal days, we go out for a walk or so during the evening and come back home before 9/10 pm. Today, we had to move out at 10 PM after my prayers, so late-night outing hahaha. We had some tasks to do, and by the time we were finished, it was almost 12.30 AM. So what, time to take a break and feel the silence of the night. 


![1773176188264.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/minhajulmredol/23tRvDgKywjE17WnVHzazEhgWz4W9ANxJsukcmzzCXm1Se6rdpikRMeMUAPnQSYfRcxxB.jpeg)
<center>\
</center>\n\nWe didn't want to sit in a fancy restaurant, that's why we picked this, the name goes as ***\

***. Roadside sitting place, due to the late night hours, there wasnt any crowd, and we could sit there peacefully. This one is quite famous for its quick snack items along with tea, which plays a vital role in hangouts with friends.  

![1773176188173.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/minhajulmredol/23tSN9Wj9zfQwxv3HwwozTL8waGaxNV9yH7nQcjGS8cSCKZ7TLm1yQKFbzC4XgTRH6qWV.jpeg)


We were two, but took three, why? After a long walk, we were a little bit exhausted, and we ordered for their special tea, now that's hot as well, right? We needed something cold apart from water, so we got the iced lemon tea. Isn't that a weird combo? We wanted to try no matter what, haha. To be honest, we couldnt digest that combo, were extrembly shocked to admire or criticise, but I'm not gonna order again, that's for sure, fullstop. Tea was good, along with the other snack items like shingara and somosa, forgot to click, was hungry, lol. 

We then walked again, roamed to a few more places, like we were enjoying at our fullest, the nightlife of Dhaka, no traffic or crowd of masses of people, so peaceful. By the time we reached home, it was almost 2.00 Am, and the entrance was closed, lol. The caretaker was good enough to let us in, hahaha. 

***So yeah, not like every day and everything should be ugly in life, we gotta make out some time for us to take a break in between the stressful routine. Otherwise, we will get burned out before making it to the end. So a night spent well, till next time.***

title.title: AUTONOMY: DO YOUNG ADULTS DESERVE IT
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRGCN5F4ewHWqMWPDkSSgH5pPUzdhnexsSk6WV6kMVpqU/1773176097427.jpg)

Hi everyone, it's Abeegail again, welcome to my blog. One thing I realize as I grow up is the fact that adults are obsessed with taking over young adults and children autonomy and always want to be in control of young adults lives, especially with african parents.

There's this girl that I go to church with and my mom would always tell me not to mingle with her because she was very disrespectful and would be a bad influence but she was my age group and we were in choir together so it's definitely hard to avoid her completely. What did she do that made her such a bad kid, she asked questions, she didn't just follow things just because someone said so, even if it was an elderly person, she didn't just swallow insults from elders, she strongly believe that respect is reciprocal and that she as a child should be respected too. The more I got to know her the less unreasonable my mom made her seem and the more I secretly admire her.

As an African child, raised by an African parent, in Africa, I can say that as a child or youth you are not to have a voice, think or stand up for yourself, even if you are right. Under the guise of correcting, protecting, guiding they seek gain control and forcefully gain respect. We are just expected to blindly follow what ever we are told, to just take things the way they are whether it's right or wrong.They make it look like they've lived long and they know everything. They never agree that they are human and also capable of making mistakes and their ego never lets them admit it. 

When ever we speak up or even ask questions as to why things are the way they are we are immediately classified as disrespectful or a bad child because this challenge their authority in an upside down world. There are so many kids who have not ever made a decision for themselves, not necessarily because they can't, but because their parents have taken it upon themselves to make decisions for them. So kids are not doing what they love because of their parents control. 

And after grooming a submissive child, who isn't expected to have a voice, they  just thrust the child into the real world expecting the young adult to just figure it out on their own, when you haven't even given this child the chance to fail or to make mistakes on their own and nurture them. And when we talk about respect, it not a mutual thing. It just means the young adult has to swallow everything, the insults, the dismissive tone, the embarrassment and this doesn't teach respect it just teaches silence that turns to to resentment and then parents wonder why kids grow up to be distant from them. When does it stop being discipline and start becoming taking control from these kids

Respecting autonomy doesn’t mean abandoning young people. It is giving them the chance to ask why without guilt, letting them make decisions on their own with your advice and guidance not making it for them, allow them to choose, make mistakes and find out the consequences by themselves, so that when it's time to stand alone they won't be overwhelmed.
The obsession with control says more about adult insecurity than young adult capability. And until that’s confronted, autonomy will continue to be treated not as a right, but as something that must be constantly earned, revoked, and negotiated.


*It's Still Abeegail* ✨💗
*A Young Adult.*

__________________________________________________________________________

**Thank you for reading.**

title.title: Fitness and efforts
title.body:
![6413398B-F173-42F7-A508-AA9896A6622C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dwayne16/6413398B-F173-42F7-A508-AA9896A6622C.jpeg)
***

The gym isn’t just a place of physical workmanship and health improvement. It’s an environment where individuals, despite their relative goals pour their demons out and try to adapt to a lifestyle of commitment and dedication.

Every personality in the gym has a different goal. Along with this is a story behind it. A reason in which they decided to make such an Investment and take the first initiative or first step in making a significant change in themselves. For some people the gym is an outlet. A place where they can physically vent emotionally and mentally and give themselves some personal time of something that is within their control. The gymnasium creates a conducive environment where people can express themselves, interact with each other and  refine their physique and health holistically.


For others the gym is a place purely for athletic performance or sport oriented goals. Whether it’s endurance, strength , aesthetics. The list goes on. basketballers, footballer, rugby players and various other athletes all spend a considerable amount of time in the gym. This is so they can effectively train their bodies and athletic ability accordingly to excel in their respective sports domain and generally stay active to optimise their performance and fitness.

Fitness centers and gyms alike are often seen as a discipline that is strictly physically and only aesthetically or athletically relevant. But such an opinion is short sighted. The gym doesn’t only train our bodies, but in reality it changes our it mind. It teaches resilience. It neglects incompetence and lack of accountability. It’s a pursuit that requires courage, determination and the power to keep pushing no matter how hard it is. Every drop of sweat is a measurement of persistence. A reflection of the effort that sooner or later translates to excellence. 

Not being active and stay sedentary can be a huge detriment to our health. Not just in one aspect but holistically. Science tells us there is correlation between our immune system and physical exertion/exercise. All in all our bodies ability to fight diseases and sickness is partially dependant on how active we keep ourselves. This is another reason keeping ourselves active is essential for longevity and general health. 

All in all investing in fitness and staying in the gym is not just beneficial for performance and aesthetics, but a great opportunity to build life long longevity and healthier lives. Health is wealth

As I reminisce about my experiences in this remarkable city, I am reminded of its unique blend of tradition and modernity. From its iconic bridges to the spirited atmosphere of its football culture, Newcastle is a place that captivates the imagination. This article reflects on my adventures in Newcastle, intertwining the allure of its people and the excitement of gaming at The Pokies Net 119. Newcastle players look forward to extra funds as [https://thepokies86australia.net/daily-bonuses](https://thepokies86australia.net/daily-bonuses) brings Newcastle Players: $250 Weekly Deposit Bonus at ThePokies119. The Allure of Newcastle ----------------------- ### A City of Heritage Newcastle is a city that wears its history proudly. Walking through its streets, one can feel the echoes of the past. The majestic Newcastle Castle, from which the city derives its name, stands as a testament to its medieval origins. I remember the first time I visited, standing before its ancient walls, feeling a deep connection to the generations that came before me. The stories of the past seem to whisper through the stones, inviting visitors to explore further. ### The Vibrancy of Modern Life Yet, Newcastle is not merely a relic of the past. It pulsates with life and energy, especially in its bustling city center. The shops, cafes, and restaurants create a lively atmosphere that is hard to resist. One of my favorite spots was the Quayside, where the River Tyne flows gracefully. The sight of the iconic Tyne Bridge, illuminated against the night sky, is nothing short of magical. It was here that I first learned about the exciting world of online gaming, particularly the enticing offers from ThePokiesNet119. The Football Culture -------------------- ### A Passionate Community No discussion of Newcastle would be complete without mentioning its football culture. The passion of the locals for Newcastle United is palpable. I vividly recall attending a match at St. James' Park, where the roar of the crowd created an electric atmosphere. The camaraderie among fans, united by their love for the team, is a beautiful representation of the city's spirit. It's a place where strangers become friends, bonded by a shared experience. ### The Influence of Gaming As I delved deeper into the local culture, I discovered how intertwined football and gaming have become. Many fans enjoy placing friendly bets on matches, adding an extra layer of excitement to the experience. This is where platforms like ThePokies119 come into play, offering a chance to engage with the sport in a new way. The thrill of watching a game while knowing that a wager has been placed adds to the overall enjoyment. The Enchantment of The Pokies ----------------------------- ### A New Realm of Entertainment During my time in Newcastle, I stumbled upon The Pokies Net 119, a platform that opened up a new realm of entertainment. The vibrant graphics and engaging gameplay drew me in immediately. I remember spending hours exploring different games, each one offering a unique experience. The thrill of winning, even if it was just a small amount, was exhilarating. ThePokiesNet119 provided not just a source of entertainment but a way to connect with the local culture. ### The Community Aspect One of the most surprising aspects of my experience was the sense of community that emerged from online gaming. ThePokies119 fostered connections among players, allowing us to share tips and celebrate wins together. It was fascinating to see how a digital platform could create bonds similar to those formed in the stands of St. James' Park. This blend of the old and new, tradition and technology, is what makes Newcastle so special. Reflections on My Journey ------------------------- ### A City of Contrasts As I reflect on my journey through Newcastle, I am struck by the contrasts that define the city. The historical landmarks stand proudly alongside modern developments, creating a unique tapestry of experiences. The warmth of the people, the excitement of football, and the thrill of gaming all intertwine to create a vibrant culture that is hard to forget. ### A Lasting Impression Newcastle has left an indelible mark on my heart. The memories of exploring its streets, cheering for Newcastle United, and engaging with the community through The Pokies 119 will stay with me forever. This city is more than just a destination; it is a place where stories are made, friendships are formed, and adventures await around every corner. In conclusion, my experiences in Newcastle have been nothing short of enchanting. The city's rich history, vibrant culture, and the exciting world of gaming at platforms like PokiesNet119 have all contributed to a journey that I will cherish for a lifetime. Whether you are a history buff, a football enthusiast, or someone seeking new experiences, Newcastle has something to offer everyone. I encourage you to explore this remarkable city and discover its magic for yourself.

# <center> Three Tune Tuesday </center>

#

That's right, it's Tuesday folks and for our merry little band of ladies and lads, that means sharing tunes, good vibes and engagement. As another week disappears in the rearview mirror, we have loads of engagement and tunes flying around on Three Tune Tuesday and sure isn't that bloody fantastic! I hope you're ready to share three tunes from wherever you find yourself on this magical spinning lump of rock that we all call home and sure you might even sing us a tune if we're lucky?

It's a time of the week when lovers of music, tunes and craic bring their blockchain community three of their finest and brightest tunes to share and celebrate, so let's roll on and let the tunes flow free.

This is my 249th week waxing lyrical for Three Tune Tuesday and we are still going strong.

It started off with me just sharing tunes into what seemed like a void, but little by little others joined and now I'm thrilled that we have a little corner of Hive where we come and share our tunes every Tuesday, and long may it continue. I almost stopped posting the songs and thoughts a few times, but I stuck with it and now interestingly it is my favorite thing about Hive. I love music and now I have a network of folks around the world who love music too and we share our tunes and catch up with each others tunes and discuss them each week. We get Pop, Metal, Rock, Gospel, Folk, Jazz, Rap, Hip-Hop, Trip-Hop, Reggae, Bippy bappidy Flange Hop. Ok I made that one up, but you get the idea, we are all learning about new artists, bands, back stories and sure isn't it just mighty!

Something that excites me the most is that we even get musicians sharing their covers of famous songs and even their own songs from time to time here on #ThreeTuneTuesday, which is a real favorite of mine, as that takes talent, time and dedication.

We are adding New posters and retaining our core of regulars here on #TTT which is fantastic. Let's keep it growing. Over the years, I have listened to fantastic music shared from like-minded folk from around the globe and interacted with their posts. This has led me to genres I don't know well and to some amazing new bands and artists and has even introduced me to some musical instruments I did not know existed. It also allows me to upvote smaller accounts and find some really interesting people from all over the world, which is heartening.

I hope you enjoy the tunes - be sure to tell me all about it in the comments below and above all else, please enjoy the rest of your Tuesday - smile at a stranger, rub a dog, be a nice human to someone who was not expecting it - peace out.

For those unfamiliar with TTT or Three Tune Tuesday....

# <center> The jist is as follows </center>

#

Every Tuesday I'm going to share 3 songs which I like to listen to and I invite your feedback in the comments below. Better still, why not have a blast of your own Three Tune Tuesday and mention me in the post and I'll come and find the post and upvote it. If you could also use #threetunetuesday tag that would be great, as that is what I use when sifting through all the entries every Wednesday. It'll be a sweet way for us all to discover new music. You'll also be in with a chance of winning the prize - more on that later.

# <center> HBI contest - win up to 6HBI </center>

#

Share your Three Tune Tuesday songs below or create a post with #ttt or #threetunetuesday and mention me so I can find the post.

I'll pick the three songs I enjoyed the most each week as the winner and transfer 1 share of HBI to the winner when this post pays out 7 days from now, but wait there's more...

# <center> Three Tune Tuesday Sponsors </center>

#

We have a sponsor list of six people who selflessly offer HBI in addition to my one. They are as follows @tengolotodo @bozz @coquicoin @ablaze @seki1 @inthenow

Due to a very busy life on my side, the winner posts often come after a delay and may come over 4 to 8 consecutive days. That's just how I do it, so please be patient while awaiting HBI and understand that only my 1HBI is guaranteed. The others are dependant on our lovely sponsors seeing these posts and sending on the HBI. That means some weeks winners may get 3 shares and other weeks they may get more.

Thanks a million to our sponsors above once again and any winners please bear in mind that some people only pop on here every few months, so be patient while waiting for the HBI.

<center> Best of luck!

# <center> Sin é, That's all folks, thanks for stopping by. </center>

That's it for another week. Those are your three songs for this week. Let me know what you think - good, bad or indifferent? Did you like them all or just one or two?

Also, as I said before, I love getting good steers for new tunes, so please tell me about the latest and greatest from your playlist below and I'll be sure to check em out.

_The YouTube videos shared are not owned by me and I am simply sharing great music with the community here on Hive_

## <center> Thanks as always for stopping by everyone and a big shout out to @stickupcurator whose continued generous support to #ttt is noticed and truly appreciated - thanks gents. </center>

# <center> Peace Out </center>

#

title.title: Strategic mistake!? - Strategischer Fehler!?
title.body:
## EN (DE unten) 
  
  Hello dear community,

v.d.L. calls the phase-out of nuclear energy a “strategic mistake” and believes that there will be a “renaissance of nuclear energy.”

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbWXkzx6pigSAnFGMEzkNCKB6WXiMpFa51HtV2tggSz59/grafik.png)

Really? I see the reversal of the phase-out as a strategic mistake and don't see a renaissance. Hardly any new plants are being built worldwide, and shutdowns are being considered, if not already implemented. 

One of the few countries that is building new plants is China, but at the same time, China is massively expanding renewable energies and building huge storage power plants. By 2030, China will probably generate more electricity from solar power than all the nuclear power plants in the world combined.

And development will continue until then. Should we be left behind again, or should Europe finally position itself properly? Seize the opportunity and drive development forward?

Almost every day there are new headlines about new methods of storing electricity, producing hydrogen cheaply, solar cells generating electricity when it rains....

https://www.uni-jena.de/392821/solarbatterie-liefert-auf-knopfdruck-wasserstoff-aus-sonnenenergie

https://www.ingenieur.de/technik/fachbereiche/energie/110-volt-pro-regentropfen-diese-solarzelle-liefert-strom-wenn-es-regnet/

https://www.chip.de/news/forschung-wissen/deutlich-guenstiger-forscher-finden-neues-material-fuer-die-wasserstoffproduktion_883ee57c-0469-4a55-9c2d-a2266fed5e8c.html

Instead of taking 10 steps forward, we always take 2 steps forward, one back, two steps forward, one back... and in the end, the others are 20 steps ahead of us.



Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
  
 ## DE 
  
 Hallo liebe Community,

v.d.L. nennt den Ausstieg aus der Atomenergie einen \
und meint, es gebe eine Renaissance der Kernenergie\

body.title: LOH #279- I PREFER TEA TO COFFEE
body.body:
Greetings my lovely and beautiful ladies on #ladiesofhives. Am happy to welcome you to my blog and also to participate on this week's contest and very interesting topic and judged by @elizabethbit.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnJ4jQfYnPuk9KCVZwE1uxgwcsqmDnKP6JTp9xRVKzua/1773172662379.jpg)

Taking coffee or tea depends on choice or your mood at the time, both are good and lovely. Most people don't like black coffee because of the bitter taste, but one can take it by adding honey or sugar and it will make it tastes great and it's enjoyable mostly winter for energy and to warm up the body. 

I could remember during my days in school, i would take black coffee for me to slime down because then I was kinda chummy and I will also dink it for reading at night so as to stay awake, i would take it then during the day I won't be able to sleep then severe headache follows up. At a time I stopped taking because it was affecting my health. Nescafe is good, but back then in school  i will take one full tablespoon, maybe i was consuming it much that's why it affecting me. But currently there's this 3in 1 Nescafé coffee it tastes so great and creamy, I kinda prefer it than the black coffee now when ever i feel like to take coffee.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmajPVitMiGLCQvDjQi8kfPXw1mWPxYsJe4MKb95RWVzhk/1773172662642.jpg)

But for two years now or more, i stop taking coffee i only drink green teas,  ginger teas and cinnamon tea than coffee because of my health condition which have become part of me. Not that it tastes so good but i don't have choice but when I add natural honey or dates as my sweetner it makes it tastes so great and refreshing. It also energised me for my daily activities.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmxLDLmSkibrYF8yG7A3usX3H5oSrbnFfwBRQVS9GvgP/1773172689622.jpg)

Yes both tea and coffee are good and healthy but it depends on ones preference, For me right now and I will always prefer tea to coffee. Which one do you prefer coffee or tea, let me know at the comment section and I want use this opportunity to invite my friends to share their own thoughts and their preferences on this lovely topic.

Thanks for stopping by @amara24 blog. See you in my next post and have a week, goodnight. 💋🥰🫂

Images are mine.

body.title: Notas de mi Presente -(spa -eng)
body.body:
>

**¡Hola, comunidad!** ✨🩷 Hoy me detuve un momento a mirar estas fotos y me di cuenta de lo rápido que va todo, pero también de lo necesario que es pausar para agradecer. A veces nos enfocamos tanto en la meta final que olvidamos disfrutar el proceso, las herramientas que usamos y, sobre todo, a quienes nos acompañan.

Para mí, un estilo de vida con propósito no nace del azar, sino de la intencionalidad 😙

Por eso, siempre tengo a la mano mi planificación. Abrir mi agenda y ver esa **\

** llena de colores y orden no es solo por estética; es paz mental. 

Es saber que, aunque el día se ponga caótico, tengo un mapa que me guía. La organización es, literalmente, el lenguaje del amor propio.

Pero no todo es trabajo y logística. Últimamente, he estado reflexionando mucho con el libro **\

.** Me ha recordado que nuestra realidad se construye primero en los pensamientos.

 Si queremos una vida bonita afuera, tenemos que limpiar la casa por dentro. Mantener una actitud resiliente y positiva es un ejercicio diario, casi como un músculo que hay que entrenar.

Y hablando de motores... aquí les comparto un pedacito de mi corazón. Esos momentos de ternura y besos compartidos son los que recargan mis energías. Al final del día, todo el esfuerzo por emprender, por crear contenido y por ser mejor cada día, tiene un nombre y una sonrisa favorita. Ella es mi **\

.** Vivir de forma genuina es esto: aceptar los retos del trabajo, dedicar tiempo a crecer internamente y no soltar nunca lo que de verdad importa. ¿Y tú? ¿Cómo estás alimentando tu mente y tu corazón hoy? Me encantaría leerte en los comentarios 😘 >! [ENGLISH] >**Hello, community!** ✨🩷 Today I stopped for a moment to look at these photos and realized how fast everything is going, but also how necessary it is to pause and be grateful. Sometimes we focus so much on the end goal that we forget to enjoy the process, the tools we use, and, above all, those who accompany us. > >For me, a purposeful lifestyle doesn't come about by chance, but by intention 😙 > >That's why I always have my planning handy. Opening my planner and seeing that colorful and orderly **“Monthly Plan”** isn't just for aesthetics; it's peace of mind. > >It's knowing that even if the day gets chaotic, I have a map to guide me. Organization is literally the language of self-love. > >But it's not all about work and logistics. Lately, I've been reflecting a lot on the book **“The Battlefield of the Mind.”** It has reminded me that our reality is first constructed in our thoughts. > > If we want a beautiful life on the outside, we have to clean up the house on the inside. Maintaining a resilient and positive attitude is a daily exercise, almost like a muscle that needs to be trained. > >And speaking of engines... here I share a little piece of my heart with you. Those moments of tenderness and shared kisses are what recharge my energy. At the end of the day, all the effort to undertake, to create content, and to be better every day has a name and a favorite smile. She is my **“why”** and my **“what for.”** > >Living authentically means accepting the challenges of work, dedicating time to personal growth, and never letting go of what truly matters. > >How about you? How are you nourishing your mind and heart today?
