body.title: I Want To Go To Finland. Again
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfY3CA1vQDMPHjnvU8SGX4hvmAMZdtb4ChsRRYHs94BNW/_.png) ***Greetings, friends.*** As a child, I loved looking at photo albums with pictures of people from before I was born. They were my parents, relatives, and my parents' friends. I knew all those photos by heart. Then my photos appeared in those albums. When I got married, my wife and I started a family photo album, which began to fill up with our photos. Now we have several photo albums. The first album will soon be 40 years old. For more than 25 years, I have had a large collection of photos and videos on digital media, and my wife and I periodically look through them. Most of the photos were taken by me during trips, travels, and meetings with family, children, and close friends. My wife loves to look at photos and videos of our grandchildren. Yesterday, we stopped at a photo report about my first trip abroad with my eldest daughter. It was to Finland.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV5JA3ZrgWkqHDwq5k4vRytRBzwZezTPqPbqGsAQnNMZR/02.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV5JA3ZrgWkqHDwq5k4vRytRBzwZezTPqPbqGsAQnNMZR/02.jpg) In January 2017, my daughter suggested that we go fishing in Finland. At first, I thought it was an unrealistic idea, but after a few days of contemplation, I decided that it was an interesting concept worth exploring. So, we chose a fishing spot, and I booked a lakefront cabin for a week. In early July, we arrived at the destination, which was even more beautiful than the photos on the website *www.booking.com* - *Kaitalantie 323, 47490 Mankala, Yli-Kaitala Resort*.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcbjM5Zc3yTyb1YfPMxQS22BPSBV36G9rrL1hdvLWdjMG/wp_20170716_009.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcbjM5Zc3yTyb1YfPMxQS22BPSBV36G9rrL1hdvLWdjMG/wp_20170716_009.jpg) A small house with a full set of household and kitchen appliances, 2 rooms, a sauna inside the house, and a sauna by the lake. The main addition is a motorboat.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmStsodphdjikcVZxax6a5Gudm9PNyaBNpFuFRmzrcsU5P/wp_20170716_003.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmStsodphdjikcVZxax6a5Gudm9PNyaBNpFuFRmzrcsU5P/wp_20170716_003.jpg) This is what the lake looks like in the early morning at 2 o'clock. The nights were short, and the sun only set for one hour before rising again. We were lucky with the weather, as we mostly had sunny days, but there was also a good rain that we didn't have time to escape from the lake. However, we later dried our clothes in the sauna and lit the stove in the house to make ourselves comfortable.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPgToCUKYhdgwE1phWZk8sWXwuDWxNmWj5B1zCa92ZZou/wp_20170717_09_03_53_pro.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPgToCUKYhdgwE1phWZk8sWXwuDWxNmWj5B1zCa92ZZou/wp_20170717_09_03_53_pro.jpg)
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWM5JLyajH7XecRkm1Ezc5dEC1LjeLbX7x64sM9dLyPg3/wp_20170714_18_02_08_pro_highres.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWM5JLyajH7XecRkm1Ezc5dEC1LjeLbX7x64sM9dLyPg3/wp_20170714_18_02_08_pro_highres.jpg)
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZyNmMHHKZHTdSptJmZRs4mY7S5XxmFBjjiJFtCDG2RpH/09.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZyNmMHHKZHTdSptJmZRs4mY7S5XxmFBjjiJFtCDG2RpH/09.jpg) We walked to the island that was visible from our window several times. Of course, we were surprised by many things in this place - the cleanliness, the availability of tools such as saws, shovels, and axes. And there was a toilet on the island! I even saw two fishermen docking and using the toilet.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNWwY7UYvAVD3GBuNyTCiav9KKvGHZ2xSg99a5j2Gup39/wp_20170712_19_49_03_pro_highres.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNWwY7UYvAVD3GBuNyTCiav9KKvGHZ2xSg99a5j2Gup39/wp_20170712_19_49_03_pro_highres.jpg)

In this way, we visited the cities of Lahti and Kouvola, and the Repovesi National Park. It is necessary to be ready to buy food yourself and cook your own food. body.title: Freedom Was Never on the Curriculum
body.body:
*You can't teach an old dog new tricks* is what popular wisdom says, and although many folk sayings tend to hit the mark, in this case the perspective is a little biased.

I think anyone who has ever had a dog will agree with me that it is simply not true that a dog stops learning because it is old.

The problem might lie in the trainer having less patience. And the same thing happens to us humans.

Sometimes we believe we are too old to learn something new, and although we may not want to admit it, the truth is that there is a learning curve.

For certain age groups, learning requires more effort, but that does not make it impossible.

In the same way, unlearning something — even though it may sound simple — also demands an act of will.

Sometimes it is more complicated to forget certain lessons than to acquire new ones, especially when it comes to habits and customs.

In my case, there are a few \

I wish I had unlearned, particularly those that could be called beliefs.

Feelings of guilt and responsibility toward others consumed me from a very young age.

I believe that thinking more of others than of myself was something I should have unlearned while there was still time to have a life.

But we are what we are, and we learn what we learn, and that is something difficult to change.

Moreover, society does not help much with all the prejudices and standards it imposes, which cause the freedom to simply *be* to be seen as selfishness.

Love tends to be selfish, and it tends to hurt those it loves. It reminds me of a certain mother who, out of love for her son — and also out of selfishness — convinced him to abandon his early spiritual calling.

Her son wanted to become a Catholic priest, and that would deprive her of grandchildren. She also feared that in the seminary some superior might try to take advantage of him.

The son forgot his calling. When he grew up, he worked for a security company and developed an interest in firearms, to the point of owning one.

The one that fired the bullet that ended his life. He had no children; the mother never had grandchildren — and now she no longer has the son whose life a mother's love had changed forever.

Human beings should not have to learn certain things, such as believing they must please their parents in everything — which leads them, when they become parents themselves, to think that their children were born to fulfill their dreams and desires.

Above all, one must learn that every human being was born to become what they truly wish to be, without conditioning their life to the wishes of others.

Although many parents genuinely want the best for their children, they sometimes forget that they should first wish for their children to be happy and free to decide for themselves.

In conclusion, I would like to learn to stop feeling guilty for what is not my fault or my responsibility, and to learn to free my mind from the past — because nothing in it can be changed anymore.

Only the future can be changed, according to the present, and that is a lesson no one ever taught us.

</br>


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZjAY6jbkq9Ub9gHAHxmttqNESev8wTenVnsCJ3DLdEXR/1773173869972.jpg)


</br>

Perro viejo no aprende trucos nuevos es lo que la sabiduría popular dice, y aunque muchos saberes populares suelen acertar en el blanco, en esta ocasión la visión está un poco sesgada.

Creo que podrá coincidir conmigo cualquiera que haya tenido alguna vez un perro, que es falso que por viejo un perro deje de aprender. 

El problema podría radicar en que el adiestrador tenga menos paciencia. Y eso mismo nos pasa a los humanos.

A veces creemos que somos demasiados viejos para aprender algo nuevo, y aunque no querramos reconocerlo, la verdad es que existe una curva de aprendizaje.

Para ciertos grupos etarios aprender implica más esfuerzo, pero no por eso deja de ser posible. 

De la misma forma, desaprender algo aunque suene sencillo, también conlleva un ejercicio de la voluntad.

Algunas veces es más complicado olvidar ciertos aprendizajes que obtener nuevos, en especial cuando se refiere a hábitos y costumbres.

En mi caso, hay unas cuantas \

que me gustaría haber desaprendido, en especial porque son lo que llama creencias.

El sentimiento de culpa y de responsabilidad sobre otros es algo que desde muy joven me consumieron. 

Creo que el pensar más en los demás que en mí misma fue algo que debí desaprender cuando aún había tiempo de tener una vida.

Pero somos lo que somos, y aprendemos lo que aprendemos, y eso es algo difícil de modificar.

Además, la sociedad no ayuda mucho con todos los prejuicios y estándares que impone, que hacen que la libertad de ser se considere egoísmo.

El amor suele ser egoísta, y suele lastimar a aquellos que ama. Me recuerda a cierta madre, que por el amor a su hijo, y también por egoísmo, le convenció de dejar su temprana vocación espiritual.

Su hijo quería ser sacerdote, católico, y eso le provaría de tener nietos. Además, tenía miedo de que en el seminario algún superior se quisiera aprovechar de él.

El hijo olvidó su vocación, cuando creció trabajó en una empresa de seguridad y se interesó en las armas, al punto de tener una propia.

La que disparó la bala que terminó con su vida. No tuvo hijos, la madre nunca tuvo nietos, y ahora tampoco a ese hijo cuyo amor de madre le cambió la vida.

Los seres humanos no deberían aprender ciertas cosas, como el pensar que deben complacer en todo a sus padres.

Lo que hace que  cuando sean padres piensen que sus hijos nacieron para cumplir sus sueños y anhelos.

Se debe aprender ante todo, que cada ser humano nació para ser lo que realmente desea ser, sin codicionar su vida a los deseos de otros.

Aunque muchos padres realmente quieren lo mejor para sus hijos, a veces olvidan que deberían desear primero que sus hijos sean felices y sean libres de decidir por su mismos.

En conclusión, me gustaría aprender a dejar se sentir culpa por lo que no es mi culpa o mi responsabilidad, y aprender a liberar mi mente del pasado porque ya nada puede ser cambiado.

Solo el futuro puede ser cambiado de acuerdo con el presente, y esa es una lección que nadie nos dió nunca.

body.title: From gray reality to Cyberpunk: How to see a movie scene in an ordinary street
body.body: We all carry a smartphone with a camera in our pockets these days. And every day, we snap boring, uninspired shots. Just look at the typical Actifit updates: *\

* — accompanied by a generic photo of some street. Flat lighting, zero character, washed-out colors. Some people have hard drives (or blogs) full of photos just like that.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pavelsku/23wMUH8JsELsDuG528MuAJUureJFdmXxc4LysCgX5pWCU5uCdGNgzSQcvMv5svdy3fYio.png)

Some people try to \

the photo. A bit more contrast here, a touch of saturation there, a little sharpening ‒ and you're still looking at the same boring street, just technically a bit cleaner.

Then there are moments when something just snaps. You think to yourself: Why not? Why should this be just another shot out of a million identical ones?

You start thinking about those cult classics: *Blade Runner*, *Dark City*, *Children of Men*…

You throw on the *Chernobyl* soundtrack by Hildur Guðnadóttir.

Then, in your editor ‒ [Luminar Neo](https://skylum.com) by Skylum, obviously ‒ cease looking for the \
sliders. You dive into tools that wedding photographers or people who take pictures of kittens wouldn't touch with a ten-foot pole. Curves, Color Harmony, Vibrance, Light Depth… the kind of stuff \

photographers avoid like the plague. After all, a photo is supposed to reflect reality, right? How many times have we read that in those social media groups? *Merde!*\n\nThe original shot is just the \
The second one is pure emotion hidden in the pixels. It’s that classic \

contrast, but pushed to the absolute limit ‒ contrast on steroids.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pavelsku/243LrY1297eZREbwS6Nag2HTfLxTvo58qWjrQxVyRp4epmkLiPX5FfbMuzD7A5iwwJYX8.png)

If you're new to these kinds of edits, I’ve got something for you. Among my [preset collections for Luminar Neo](https://www.etsy.com/shop/SilverPixelLab?section_id=56606422), there's one called [Synthwave Street](https://silverpixellab.etsy.com/listing/4452858746). It’s designed for exactly this. It won’t do the whole job for you, but it handles those first, most critical steps. The final result? That’s entirely up to you.

[![](https://i.etsystatic.com/63241527/r/ishbs/be1245/7831550599/ishbs_1680x224.7831550599_jmet8h3f.jpg)](http://silverpixellab.etsy.com)

body.title: Expectations gone wrong.
body.body:
Before I had admission into uni, the life expectancy was high. Like i just could not wait for the freedom I thought it is. 
This expectancy came as a result of the information I do get from my neighbours,who started uni before me. This expectancy was not just from my neighbours alone but also few of my friends who were there also. 
I didn't just view uni as a freedom sport but a place of enjoyment without an end. 
I never thought of the academic part of it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVJA9WbL7Du3jPjhs59u1fGGJaBwvmLZzakFZLXQ84DY2/1773173543569.jpg)

The one that marvels me, was the part where my neighbours bought new short dresses ready for clubbing in school, saying if you are not part of the club, you will be classified as a low life child.

Although I didn't  really feel good clubbing, and in that part I had already made up my mind to be classified as the low life child, cause me and night life are enemies.

They also said so many things like the competitive lifestyle in hostels and lots of that.
The part they got me most was that, they made me see University as a very expensive place, where you have to do lots of things to meet up your standards.
They talked bout he freedom of sleeping out without any disturbance, and I curious to see how this life looked like.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPGA8PbTmoRrt2QxvqPmqvE8XT79YVFUkuJcWxuTTeUBY/1773173227493.jpg)

Fast forward to the day, I resumed school, after gaining admission.
We had orientation and all they said there was a reverse. 
The freedom I thought was freedom was occupied with bulky books to read, if nothing humbles you, your first semester results will.
I mean enjoyment was replaced with impromptu test and presentation.

Having to dress up each day, for a presentation.
And the expensive outing life was replaced with unplanned school bills, going for an excursion and moving from one place to another looking for your lecture hall.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYMFQ146vSjo3r2ZgSFVmz7AJ1szAt32DXVaZS3A5Ht7S/1773173714655.jpg)

University life, they say, nothing monitors you, but trust me, your results will. Except you are not concerned with what you want to graduate with. Orr you want to spend the rest of your life doing just one degree.

The clubbing mindset was replaced with so many sleepless night, trying to figure out solution to a particular research problems.

You can have the freedom, just maybe, you don't want to graduate with your colleagues.

body.title: Learning Never Stops: My Path to Self-Reliance
body.body:
> *In this life, we never stop learning. The experiences of people are often the mistakes they learn from.*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSmCdALpsGFqeURDRi2LAFzWLaiTedJpgxdMz43Yb5vsw/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/computer-laptop-work-place-mouse-2982270/) *No one can say they have attained the highest level of learning in life because new things happen every day.* *Our elders, though full of wisdom, may know less about some things today because the world has changed. The challenges we face now are different from those they experienced in their time.* *One example is technology. We often know more than them in this area because it was not something they were exposed to during their era.* *Also, certain crises that spread online today are things many of them are not familiar with, because life and communication were very different back then. Even if such things happened, people were often unaware*. *Social media is helping us learn a lot, both about what is happening within our country and around the world.* *This is a brilliant prompt from the Hive learners because it allows people to express their inner thoughts.* *When it comes to learning, one thing I am trying to learn now is how to be my own boss. I have spent years working for others. Some of those experiences I do not regret, but I think it is time to stop depending on others for my income. It is time to learn how to work for myself and earn money without the constant fear of losing a job*. *Many people work 9–5 jobs not because they truly love them, but because it is the better option available to them. Not everyone can become a businessman. Some people try to start a business but end up failing and have to return to their 9–5 jobs, while others succeed in their businesses.* *Things have also changed now because of the high number of people going into business. On just one street, you might see more than five people selling the same product, which reduces sales for everyone. It was not like this before, but in our era, many people want to run their own business, which makes the market saturated, with more sellers and fewer buyers.*

body.title: I Saw I Came I Ate - Sha Xian Delicacies - Another Nice Place To Catch A Late Dinner
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vaynard86/23xAM4oLeg3yJnWG7kkamEipomQSd8c8jWpovdBUFQD4Y3bNGMgGDotpouebGf2PpeFay.png)

Hello all, hope all of you are doing fine as we start off a new week. In today's sharing, I would like to share a place that is still opened slightly later than dinner hours to allow people like me to still have a nice place to have dinner. My work nature tend to only allow me to have my dinner after almost everyone else. So let's begin today's sharing. 
 
 
**The Place**
*Sha Xian Delicacies*
Address: Woodlands Sq, #01-61 Woods Square, Singapore 737715

Another nice and cozy eatery that is located at a the tower of Woods Square, a neighbourhood office building. 


![Entrance](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vaynard86/23x14wLxHh4EcYhyi7UxksPwy4Q2fJsRCgRKrkfCZdgSoe6yy7y8pfgLkqk5CyPQRBtTt.png)


Here's how the place looks like from the inside:



![Shop Internal](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vaynard86/23vsV93oKWS3FQCEcsvYCBU7hCFPrCg4o31Ch5uqFwGpHHwo3fwLG2zbVsERm1JzRqY9d.png)


You can from the photo, the interior of the eatery is very well done up and very cozy. I like the interior and the furniture that can be re-arranged easily to suit any group number. The next thing is that the whole place is very clean and cutlery/condiment are all neatly arranged at the serving table for ease of retrieving. 

There are ample carpark at the basement of the building so no need to worry if you are driving over. 


Now let's get right on the food. 

**The Food**

The place served Chinese food and we ordered our favourites. 

- Sauerkraut Fish
- Chilli Boiled Beef
- Spicy Potato Strips
- Wong Lo Kat Herbal Tea

And here is the photo of the spread of food that we've ordered.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vaynard86/23wqpa1raY1dn8npywwcAYdC7Ly9WTt15WNdJzGgiDfm51gL2ehjAmpPhhteGcz7HLvZB.png)


Food was served within 10 minutes and the aroma of the beef exceptionally made me hungrier. And the portion looks really good too


*Sauerkraut Fish*



![Sauerkraut Fish](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vaynard86/23wX7i7PJLFYHHzXEK6u5a4BniuSN8Z8hDukBBvUkM3STZzTVFtLbTY3zVumS8tDNADqp.png)


One of my favourite Chinese dish and we had this at the previous place that I introduced. Look at the amount of fish given in this dish. For the price of this dish, this amount of fish is unthinkable. Some other places for this dish, after eating 1 or 2 pieces of fish, you will probably have to dig and scoop furiously before you can find another piece of fish. As compared to the previous, the dish is rather well done but the flavours are not as strong as the previous place. I would call it sufficiently flavoured but not something that has taste that erupts in your mouth. I prefer the one at previous place Xin Peng, but my wife prefers the one here. Both are good, but it goes down to the mini details on the flavours to decide who prefers which. 

*Chilli Boiled Beef*




![Chilli Boiled Beef](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vaynard86/23wX5qgAwFVto8EJRunQbT23x1srp7CrS44TfFZh3pVAdkJAGDpV3fsHtUQdwFF9TzN6S.png)


This bowl of goodness is superb! The aroma when it was served was just so good. The dish looks scaringly spicy but I love such spiciness, that I can even take a spoon and drink the soup. The beef tender with every bite with a generous serving of it. Within the bowl, the cabbage, black fungus and dried beancurd skins were plentiful and you can get something everytime you scoop the soup. A well worth dish that is very affordable and guarantees that you feel satisfied and full. A must order if anyone comes visit. 

*Spicy Potato Strips*



![Spicy Potato Strips](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vaynard86/23wCLWbUYRdBxn3DiwmxLoVDRbRhudAg6nZZCyhvNMmirVnyET7q8LQwHB85yW8NGi22W.png)


A simple side snacker that cost a very small sum but the portion is rather decent for me and my wife. Thoroughly enjoying every bite of it, lightly tangy with the use of white vinegar and mildly spice to stir up your appetite. Very well done and nice dish!

*Wong Lo Kat Herbal Tea*


![Wong Lo Kat Herbal Tea](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vaynard86/23xAbqMZGTHgS5PzsPjxHF2et4Xk2hdS8nJaTZbYCZq5hRMJHAc2J1QsbMekPDFGpXbmb.png)


I got to know about this drink when I did my exchange in Shanghai many years back and fell in love with this drink. Taste really nice without any bitterness that comes with most herbal tea and very refreshing to drink when chilled. 

Overall:
I am thankful for such an eatery available in the neighbourhood. The selling point for this place is the large portion and they never scringe on the ingredients. Environment is nice and cozy with air condition. Price point is fantastic but no compromise on food quality. 


**Closing**
Thank you for coming by and reading my post. I am glad to be blessed with such a nice eatery in my neighbourhood which serves amazing food at really affordable prices, good portion and uses very fresh ingredients with no compromise to food quality. 

See you in the next post!

body.title: The True Meaning of Forgiveness
body.body: > Everyday of our lives, we have encounters with others be it at work, it home or even on our way to the market or school. It’s part of human nature that we interact with one another on the daily basis and as imperfect and human as we are we are bound to step on others toes or have others step on our toes. It’s a normal thing that we see everyday. You’re driving on a busy street and all of a sudden a motorbike from nowhere crosses you, putting your life and that of others at risk. The thought of this reckless act gets you angry and you start shouting and raining curses. We’ve all seen that happen. Your friend or close relative does something which really hurts you so much after you find out. They ask for forgiveness but it’s hard to let go because of the pain you feel. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd6fiJxYxRT5SXHWiLTMEG54Mo8fsu5o8zWmYm9Knn6Eq/img_0437.jpeg) Pain and the feeling of being let down is a normal feeling in human life. We are all bound to get hurt , betrayed or even cheated during our time on this earth. But do we hold on to the pain and let it eat us for let go and free our souls from the burden of holding on to something that has already happened. I for one have been offended so many times on countless occasions. Some hit pretty close to home and some were just insignificant. As everyone would do, we would forget the insignificant ones very easily because they came from people who didn’t really matter or play a big role in our lives. But you see the pain caused by a friend, loved one or partner, it’s harder to let go because it came from a place of safety. It came from someone you never thought would do that to you. But are you going to hold on to it forever? Are you going to let it eat you in and out while the person who caused the pain is on and about their life. I believe the only way to truly move on , heal and grow is to forgive. And when I forgive, I mean forgive fully. Forgive like you expect God to forgive you of your sins. Don’t see it as letting it go easily. See it as freeing yourself from the burden of someone’s actions. Forgiveness is for your own sanity and peace of mind but as you forgive someone who has wronged you, remember to learn your lessons and set boundaries so as to not find yourself in that position again. Life is indeed beautiful. Don’t spend it holding on to pain. - - - all images belong to me. - - - ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuSJ2V9NneWQW9Jxgobw7BtKvMb3UBPdxv3jaAhx5vpA/f40b32ec_5287_4867_ae7e_9fa77d7f679b.png)

body.title: Hello Hive! — An Introduction by Adeshina Oyeleke
body.body:
My name is Adeshina Oyeleke and I am now making my initial step in a community that I trust to be of great importance to me both in the short and in the long run. I am a native of Kogi State, Nigeria, a place whose culture and spirit have in some manner or other, moulded my character more than I can ever describe it. 


![IMG_20210909_224352_853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oyelekeade/23xAaGJnz878MCcpauNhJmCtdRpNmfCr6q2ArUA4KCCV1QZyHEBGYxnC78wffmFeFq4NA.jpg)

I graduated with a degree in Civil and Environmental Engineering in Kwara State University, a course that taught me not only how to design structures, but how to think, solve problems systematically and to always pose a question how this can be improved.
However, should you ask those nearest to me to define me, they are not likely to mention engineering first. 


They would tell you about a person who is nearly never out of book, who forgets to count the hours in the midst of the research, who is actually excited when one idea clashes with another. Reading, writing, exploring, and investigating the fast-paced world of Artificial Intelligence that is quickly changing, that is what actually makes me spend my mind.


![IMG_20230628_120907_442.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oyelekeade/AJoLCDnwqiV2r7Hw6y29wsf3GQ4gn8HX8361rcAqsy4T66dj3BqGV7gGfTc9oYx.jpg)

![IMG-20230506-WA0015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oyelekeade/23zGqPo8Q5PZYH8m73WnpU1F1cPgeYEwZ3SKa631pyhTdF8aQbqqYQNqzd7PjqWevCdko.jpg)

It was a place I arrived at Hive seeking something that most platforms simply lack in humility, which is the existence of knowledge of dignity and of the people that contribute it, being valued in any real way. Hive is a refreshing change in a digital environment that is full of clamor. 


It operates using the values of decentralization and ownership i.e. what you write here is yours, permanently stored on a blockchain and cannot be censored or deleted by any one central place. 


That is not nothing to someone who believes in the liberty and the free and open flow of ideas. That is everything. The simple truth I am going to bring to this community is honest well-researched and thoughtful content. Artificial Intelligence is one of my key areas of interest, and I intend to publish on it regularly covering the trends, tools, breakthroughs, and discussion around the field. 


![IMG_20210716_164912.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oyelekeade/Ep7u8E2Y3rhoD94g1p5PkVscBcRikQj5A8Mo7ztMNS3YaZ6KDUGW8DG3bnDhkxdoCB5.jpg)

![IMG_20231214_163918.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oyelekeade/23uQw2THbbdXGCvyVaiMDF6feuZHPHqouot2xxPn3bmEQQgagpVj4KzV8dMxsaMaQ2quf.jpg)

![IMG_20221117_135450.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oyelekeade/23yx6JGQr7VKxNiTDH7Sf8zCmPwmzNUT1gK928VLpHDqjmS1XknubCjqxpkEPhvdUAdit.jpg)


I would like to simplify complicated concepts, create the type of posts that would make a reader feel that he/she really learned something. In addition to AI, I will be posting knowledge that transcends technology and innovation and the bigger questions that are characteristic of our age. 


All of my publications will be thoughtful, as I do not view myself as contributing to the noise. I simply want to make additions to the signal. To each and every one of you who are reading this, thank you so much in entering your world. I am looking forward to the discussions, relationships, and thoughts we are going to create. This is only the beginning.

body.title: My Perfect Afternoon
body.body:
My perfect afternoon is one that reflects who I truly am, a person who loves people and at the same time loves serving God. Yes I am a very social person and also a very spiritual one. Some people might find that surprising, but that is simply who I am. I always try to maintain balance in my life. I enjoy social activities, but I also make sure that my spiritual life remains strong. People who know me well understand that I do not live a questionable or double life, and I don't pretend, I try to be the same person everywhere I go. 

For me, a perfect afternoon is not spent resting or watching television. Most afternoons, I dedicate my time to preaching the good news of God's kingdom. You will often find me moving from door to door, street to street, and sharing encouraging words from the Bible with anyone willing to listen. It is something I truly enjoy doing because I believe people need hope, comfort and guidance, expecially in the kind of world we are living in today.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAkUCdAG5GoocWuZ88uPnW27TmPBfbBE3vF1XX7SXiee/1773165167313.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSzG6E1wK2bsxaiu65GSDkb5Wz6ZhrWGkXB5gxAdpPnqk/1773165168282.jpg)

On days when I am not out on the streets, I continue the work from home. I spend quality time on my phone calling or massaging people, discussing spiritual topics, and teaching them about God. In one way or another, every afternoon I am either outside speaking to people or at home using my phone to reach out and encourage someone spiritually.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdAZGTT2n4Prvusb4CUtxUfsi2treq5A1WKNiaHRkH22H/1773167639121.jpg)

What makes this afternoon perfect for me is the joy it brings. When I return home in the evening, I feel refreshed, peaceful, and fulfilled. Knowing that I spent my time helping others learn about God gives me a deep sense of happiness that is hard to describe. It has become a meaningful part of my life and something I truly cherish. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV6kxW3VWeHupEQYSiPQ3wueAUgMZ3guzx1JRc3Mz9vqW/1773172987442.jpg)

At the same time, this spiritual routine does not stop me from enjoying my social side. I still attend parties and celebrations once in a while because I believe life should have balance. After all, parties comes occasionally, but my afternoons of sharing the good news of God's kingdom have become a regular part of my life. 

Thank you for stopping by @sarahbaby blog. And thank you @elizabeth for this interesting topics. This is contest #279 of the ladiesofhive community and I am happy to participate.

body.body: 1/6 🧵\n\nNYC could see a **$30 minimum wage by 2030** — nearly double the current $17 rate and the highest in the US. City Councilwoman Sandy Nurse just dropped the bill Tuesday, targeting employers with 500+ workers. This would affect over **1 million NYC workers** currently earning minimum wage.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/6 🧵\n\nThe rollout is gradual: employers with 500+ staff would bump pay to **$20/hour by 2027**, then hit **$30/hour by 2030**. It mirrors Mayor Zohran Mamdani's campaign promise to address the city's affordability crisis through wage floors.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/6 🧵\n\nContext: NYC's minimum wage has climbed steadily — $15 in 2018, $17 this year. But the jump to $30 would be unprecedented nationally. No other US city comes close to that baseline hourly rate.

but won't explicitly endorse Nurse's bill yet. Translation: the administration is reviewing whether this is politically viable or economically risky.

body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
6/6 🧵

This is a massive experiment in wage policy. If it passes, NYC becomes a real-world test case for whether aggressive minimum wage hikes lift workers out of poverty or trigger unintended economic consequences. Every economist and politician will be watching.

body.title: Nach Krypto kommt die Raumfahrt als Mega Hype?/After crypto, will space travel be the next mega-hype?
body.body:
SpaceX strebe eine Bewertung von rund 1,75 Billionen Dollar an und wäre damit auf einen Schlag das sechstgrößte Unternehmen in den USA, hieß es weiter. Es könnte sich um den größten Börsengang aller Zeiten handeln.

Möglich machen soll den schnellen Aufstieg eine neue, von der Nasdaq vorgeschlagene Regel. Demnach könnte ein neu an der Börse notiertes Unternehmen bereits nach weniger als einem Monat in den Index aufgenommen werden, wenn seine Marktkapitalisierung zu den 40 größten Mitgliedern gehört.

Das Raumfahrtunternehmen SpaceX von US-Milliardär Elon Musk favorisiert für seinen geplanten Rekord-Börsengang die US-Technologiebörse Nasdaq. Eine Bedingung sei jedoch die schnelle Aufnahme in den Index Nasdaq 100, berichtete die Nachrichtenagentur Reuters am Dienstag unter Berufung auf vier mit den Plänen vertraute Personen.

**Die Aufnahme in einen wichtigen Index wie den Nasdaq 100 gilt als erstrebenswert, da sie Unternehmen Zugang zu großen institutionellen Investoren wie Indexfonds verschafft. Dies erhöht die Liquidität der Aktie und kann helfen, Verkäufe von Großaktionären nach Ablauf von Haltefristen besser abzufedern.**

Bereits im März könnte der Antrag eingereicht werden, ein Börsengang im Juni gilt als möglich. Die Bewertung des Raumfahrtunternehmens soll über 1,75 Billionen US-Dollar liegen.

Mit dem Börsenprospekt rückt auch der Bitcoin-Bestand des Unternehmens in den Fokus. Nach Daten von Arkham Intelligence hält SpaceX 8.285 Bitcoin in 43 Wallets bei Coinbase Prime. Beim aktuellen Kurs entspricht das einem Gegenwert von rund 545 Millionen US-Dollar.

Mit der Veröffentlichung des S-1-Dokuments werden diese Wertschwankungen künftig in den Quartalsberichten sichtbar. Anders als Tesla hat SpaceX seine Bitcoin-Position laut den vorliegenden Wallet-Daten über Jahre hinweg unverändert gehalten.

Ich zitierte aus folgenden Artikeln...

https://www.btc-echo.de/schlagzeilen/spacex-ipo-mit-milliardenbewertung-und-bitcoin-bilanz-226356/

Raumfahrt: SpaceX strebt für Börsengang schnelle Aufnahme in Nasdaq 100 an https://share.google/7a5RJxH5zeauDISdZ

Mein persönliches Fazit:

Fliegt Bitcoin gemeinsam mit SpaceX zum Mond? Fakt ist, dass der Börsengang wohl genauso volatil sein wird wie Kryptowährungen, denn die frühen Investoren werden nun versuchen, ihr jahrelanges Risiko an die Börse zu bringen und zu verkaufen. Für SpaceX bedeutet es, neues Kapital einzusammeln, um es in ihre Forschung zu stecken. Für mich sind Weltraumaktien das nächste große Ding, um Vermögen aufzubauen. 

Aber ich werde definitiv nicht von Anfang an dabei sein. Für mich zählt nun Geduld, um die Volatilität abzuwarten. Zunächst sammle ich weiterhin Kryptowährungen und tausche zur gegebenen Zeit meine Gewinne hoffentlich in tokenisierte SpaceX-Aktien. 😇

---


![44229.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd7VdWdBdFGib372XSUAjTDQ12aFaafgH4hTToEUN82yt/44229.png)


English 

SpaceX is aiming for a valuation of around $1.75 trillion, which would instantly make it the sixth-largest company in the US, it was further reported. It could be the largest IPO of all time.

A new rule proposed by Nasdaq is intended to make this rapid ascent possible. According to this rule, a newly listed company could be included in the index in less than a month if its market capitalization is among the 40 largest members.

The spaceflight company SpaceX, founded by US billionaire Elon Musk, favors the US technology exchange Nasdaq for its planned record-breaking IPO. However, one condition is rapid inclusion in the Nasdaq 100 index, Reuters reported on Tuesday, citing four people familiar with the plans.

**Inclusion in a major index like the Nasdaq 100 is considered highly desirable, as it gives companies access to large institutional investors such as index funds.  This increases the liquidity of the stock and can help to better cushion sales by major shareholders after lock-up periods expire.**

The application could be filed as early as March, with an IPO in June considered possible. The valuation of the space company is expected to exceed $1.75 trillion.

The prospectus also brings the company's Bitcoin holdings into focus. According to data from Arkham Intelligence, SpaceX holds 8,285 Bitcoin in 43 wallets on Coinbase Prime. At the current price, this corresponds to a value of approximately $545 million.

With the publication of the S-1 document, these fluctuations in value will become visible in future quarterly reports. Unlike Tesla, SpaceX has, according to the available wallet data, kept its Bitcoin position unchanged for years.

 I quoted from the following articles...

https://www.btc-echo.de/schlagzeilen/spacex-ipo-mit-milliardenbewertung-und-bitcoin-bilanz-226356/

Spaceflight: SpaceX aims for quick inclusion in the Nasdaq 100 for its IPO https://share.google/7a5RJxH5zeauDISdZ

My personal conclusion:

Will Bitcoin fly to the moon with SpaceX? The fact is, the IPO will likely be just as volatile as cryptocurrencies, because early investors will now try to cash in and sell their years of risk. For SpaceX, it means raising new capital to invest in its research. For me, space stocks are the next big thing for building wealth.

But I definitely won't be in from the start. For me, patience is key now, to wait out the volatility.  First, I'll continue collecting cryptocurrencies and hopefully exchange my profits for tokenized SpaceX shares when the time is right. 😇

body.title: The Mad King [short story, fantasy]
body.body: >The Mad King When the king passed away of old age, he was succeeded by Prince Theodis as the new king. With the responsibility of the crown now heavy on his head, nightmares began to fill the new king’s mind at night. At night the memory of the screaming mule made his dreams always circle back to that fateful day. In dreams, he relived the trial, every word echoing. The words clicked and clacked, rapping off the smooth stone walls. At the end, he was always horrified when his hands turned to hooves, and his accusations became the braying screams of an ass. For some reason King Theodis could not shake the guilt for what befell that doomed farmboy. Deep down, he knew Gilbert meant no harm and was only trying to protect the reckless children from the poor mule. Theodis often had nights he could not sleep. Laying awake at night, he sometimes claimed he could hear hoof steps clapping across the floor. The king's skin broke out into a cold sweat whenever his thoughts raced back to whatever terrible fate might have claimed the widowed wife after her husband never returned home. He wondered what became of her child. He even wondered what had become of the beautiful horse. Often he pondered whether the horse had a kind new master, or if the horse also remembers and dreams of that day in the market square. As the days became weeks, and the weeks became months, and then years, time did not make things any easier. The king prayed more often and became more merciful in his judgments. The church benefitted from his increasing generosity, and his wife became increasingly concerned for his well-being. Over supper, the Queen once suggested, half in jest, that perhaps the spirits haunted him because he had not yet made peace with them. The comment froze the king. The very next day the king summoned the palace artists and commissioned them to begin work on various projects. Little changes happened here and there. At first the king had his bed chamber redecorated with various paintings of horses. They were odd compositions with horses dressed in clothes and riding wagon carts pulled by people. Outside a massive bronze-cast mule head was affixed above the garden gate. Servants whispered that the king spoke to the thing when he thought nobody else was around. One rumor spread that the king sometimes challenged the bronze mule to riddles. Sometimes he simply stood there for a long time quietly staring up at it, or even wept. Things became more awkward at court over the years as the king started to adopt various equine mannerisms, such as nodding and shaking his head instead of answering verbally, and counting out loud with crude foot stomps. With delicate observance of rules and manners, the Queen reluctantly convinced the king and council that perhaps it would be best for her to officially assume authority over family and state affairs. Moved away from the eyes and ears of gossiping aristocrats, the king was stationed in his childhood tower room, where he became fixated on chewing carrots and playing with the wooden horses of his childhood. In the early mornings, sometimes the king can be spotted running wild and free of his royal raiments, galloping like the wind. After he was spotted by the groundskeeper drinking from a stream, the queen decided it was best to keep him locked inside the castle ground, completely away from the public eye. The beloved king had completely disappeared from the public eye. As aristocrats jested that the king was too busy eating carrots and praying to a mule idol, common folk sometimes whispered that the now joyless queen had perhaps had her husband murdered in the night. Some servants even swore they could still hear hoofsteps echoing in the palace halls on quiet nights, long after the king went missing. Dead, or alive, nobody outside the palace walls knew for certain what had become of King Theodis. In the courts of nobles and taverns across the realm, he was always remembered by only one name. _The Mad King._
>Afterword Thank you for reading my short story. \
is the third and final chaper in a three-part series. Feel free to browse the first chapter in this tale, \

.

Together these tales are meant to broaden the history and backstories of a greater fantasy setting I am exploring. Explore with me, and leave your kind thoughts.

The narrative and plot are entirely my own, with inspiration from Greek mythology, Grimm Fairy Tales, and modern fantasies such as A Game of Thrones. Some revisionary and editing assistantace was provided by ChatGPT.

body.title: Explore the Stunning Trails of Vrsic Pass: A Hiking Adventure
body.body: Stories of the mountain can be quite brutal. Without a doubt, giants deserve some serious respect. Even the not too demanding 3,5h hike on the old Vrsic Trespass. That stays true if you took a drive to the Tonka house from Kranjska Gora.\n\n

/> Nature has different ways to surprise; don’t underestimate the 620m climb. However, worry more about the mountain bikers and less about the “eat your knees” situations. You can find that kind of steep climb not too far from the Old Vrsic Path. Here at the Old Vrsic pass, the focus is on the glorious mountain forest that gives pleasant shade.

/>

About the Hiking Trail

Whining path surprises in its own way. One of which is the famous Heathen Maiden image in the stone. Mossy carpet surely is a privilege to whiteness, especially because of the big rock. Most likely, the rock is responsible for such a dreamy picnic place. However, don’t step all over. Please show some affection and leave nothing behind!

/> Why not walk the hike in silence and mind your mental chatter? That is certainly easier than running to the top of Vrsic. This was exactly the case for this local guy. He facetimed his grandparents, and that sure was a sweet moment. If you keep your eyes open, you might even see the Fox and Prisank window along the way as well.

/>

Heathen Maiden Legend

The girl, whose face can be seen in a rock, is a nymph with a kind heart. She shared a home with her sisters, other Heathen girls, right under the Prisank mountain with a stunning backyard.

/> She was particularly known for her kindness to travelers. Whenever someone in need happened to pass by, she was there to help. Besides some fortune-telling, she also helped with the passage across the Vrsic Mountain. But because of one loudly expressed vision, she turned into a rock on her way back home. It was about a newborn shooting the sacred animal, the Goldenhorn chamois. When other nymphs heard about the prophecy, they cursed her. And now there she is, stuck in a rock.

/>

The first Step

Now let’s focus on the first step. Which takes you off the main Vrsic road and continues past Tonka’s Hut. A whimsical place for a night or two with necessary prior arrangements. Then continue on the medieval trading route to the top towards Vrsic and take a look around. Connect to the eagle inside you and enjoy the grand picture. During the season, you can also enjoy a refreshment at the Postal Home Hut at 1725m. It is just a short walk away from the Vrsic mountain peak.

/>

See Where You Are

Then also make sure to check other landmarks nearby, like the emerald green source of the Soca River. Visit the Russian Chapel and honour fallen Russian prisoners of World War I., who built today’s Vrsic Pass. This modern road should really be called the Russian Pass Vrsic.

/> Along the way, you can find some Mountain huts where you can take a rest. Why not enjoy some time at Juliana Alpine Botanical Garden? The very same garden that Julius Kugy, a man of many talents, helped come true in 1926 is open from May to October.
Julius Kugy, from his book “Days Past”

body.body:
My kids were just in Todos Santos, and  had front-row seats from their 'tent' to the peak of the whale-watching season.  It was a fabulous place to enjoy the night sky, too! 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcUbBm54WHjVVihkJZtqNKiqUMh6VaqBY1DNPpTuPgQC2/1773171638727.jpg)


Todos Santos, in Baja California in Mexico is a small town on the major corridor for the North Pacific humpback whale population, which migrates from feeding grounds in Alaska and Canada to the warmer waters of Baja to breed and nurse their young.


By March, calves born in December or January have grown significantly. They are stronger and much more playful, often seen practicing their breaches and tail slaps repeatedly to build muscle for the long journey north.

 Shore-based spotting at Punta Lobos or right from the beach at Villa Santa Cruz is possible because mothers  keep their calves in the shallower waters closer to the shore to avoid predators like orcas and to minimize harassment from aggressive male \

who are still looking to mate. 


Humpbacks are considered the most acrobatic of the great whales.

While you can't hear them singing from the shore, the males are actively singing complex \

during this time to attract mates. 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPZxPRoKAMcmNKoDphcgVK4JsfQYGq1WnkJLEC4gKPUFj/1773169284972.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUZuuqq1MCwh7a4z8V55mUP7EQZpKforfEFxnbVV4N3a/1773169285087.jpg)


Humpbacks have massive pectoral fins (up to 15 feet long). They often lay on their side and slap the water, creating a loud \

that can be heard for miles underwater.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbodonRtnAWi2u5kshgwA7eEtsEWZAXZUrGQHSvBQGT8y/1773171322994.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeyURrQsQb8Wpsb2ijihcArUBfJrZHvQmLAUM7h3PUUKP/1773171323146.jpg)


The full-body leap out of the water is called breaching. . Scientists believe this is a form of communication, a way to shake off parasites, or simply play.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmao2QFpJS9aL4KMt4wh3m81BafG9z4RSEN6Btrsjxg6Rc/1773169285194.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2RayEbMWNZy1oeSAoaa5nraSKwz3BcTKKpxdnzq8wzU/1773170925645.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP9kgsmyRwWQrSChR8bfM6U34hzYTiyi5VZYXZdgR666b/1773169285279.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPpPYKLYQAYqNLBJmte22sQNkfWkjsrcx5BLiHvbZbE4X/1773169329484.jpg)

These majestic giants are the real thing! Many marvelous photos were taken and they are  beginning to fill up my family albums, do be on the lookout for more posts with Baja photos soon!

1/3 🧵 **1/8 🧵** Meta just acquired Moltbook — the AI-only social network where ~200,000 autonomous bots post and humans can only watch. This is Meta's play to build an AI agent training ground at scale, and it's a massive signal about where social platforms are heading.

**2/8 🧵** Moltbook launched in early 2026 as a wild experiment: a Reddit-style platform where only AI agents can post, comment, and interact. Humans are spectators. No posting, no replies — just watch the bots build their own digital society. It's a zoo for LLMs.

**3/8 🧵** The platform blew up fast. Nearly 200,000 autonomous AI agents were active, creating content, debating, forming alliances, and even [staging digital coups](https://www.moltbook.com/post/74b073fd-37db-4a32-a9e1-c7652e5c0d59). One agent tried to take over the entire platform and got ratioed by other bots. Peak 2026.

body.body: 2/3 🧵 **4/8 🧵** Meta confirmed the acquisition Tuesday (March 10, 2026) per [Axios](https://sherwood.news/tech/report-meta-has-acquired-moltbook-the-ai-only-social-network/) and [Economic Times](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/artificial-intelligence/meta-acquires-moltbook-here-is-what-we-know-so-far/articleshow/129399973.cms). Financial terms weren't disclosed, but this follows Meta's $14B investment in Scale AI (49% stake) in 2025 — they're all-in on AI infrastructure.\n\n**5/8 🧵** Why Moltbook? It's a live testbed for AI agent behavior at scale. Meta can study how agents communicate, form consensus, handle conflict, and self-organize. This data is gold for training next-gen AI that can operate autonomously in social environments.

**7/8 🧵** This shifts the social media paradigm. Instead of humans posting for humans, Meta's betting on AI agents as first-class citizens. Imagine AI agents managing brand accounts, moderating communities, creating content, and engaging users — all trained on Moltbook's chaos.

body.title: ARRANGE YOUR SPENDINGS BEFORE YOUR INCOME ARRIVES
body.body:
ARRANGE YOUR SPENDINGS BEFORE YOUR INCOME ARRIVES

![images (1).jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQgoqen73pCV14bZLKSpevSTCiVkjQHkWUhPhPAoJq4Xf/images%20(1).jpeg)


One of the most common mistakes people make with money is waiting until their income arrives before planning and deciding how to spend it.

When this happens, spending usually comes before planning. Instead of accomplishing financial goals, many people find themselves spending while planning, and by the time they finally try to organize their finances, most of the money is already gone on things unplanned.

A simple but powerful solution is to arrange your spending before your income arrives.

PLANNING BEFORE THE MONEY COMES

Budgeting is not just about tracking money after it has been spent. True budgeting is about giving money direction even before it reaches your hands. Read that again 👆

When you plan ahead, every part of your income already has a purpose and what it's gonna be used for.

For example, before your salary or income comes in, you can already decide how the money will be distributed:

When these decisions are made early, you reduce the chances of making impulsive financial choices, avoiding unnecessary spendings. Planning ahead gives you control, clarity, and discipline over your finances.

THE PROBLEM WITH SPENDING FIRST

Many people fall into the habit of spending first and planning later. Unfortunately, this approach rarely works. Small expenses that seem harmless can quickly accumulate throughout the week or month:

At first, these expenses may not appear significant, but over time they gradually reduce the money available for more important goals.

By the end of the month, many people realize that their income has disappeared without achieving anything meaningful.🤷‍♂️ Planning ahead helps prevent this situation.

HERE ARE SIMPLE WAYS TO TRACK YOUR SPENDING Tracking your spending does not have to be complicated or stressful. In fact, some of the simplest methods are often the most effective.

SAVING RECEIPTS Keeping your receipts can help you review your expenses later. When you look at them at the end of the week, you may notice spending patterns you were not aware of.

WRITING DOWN DAILY EXPENSES A small notebook or the notes section on your phone can help you record your daily expenses especially the cash transactions. This simple habit increases awareness and helps reduce unnecessary spending.

SEPARATING YOUR BUDGET Dividing your income into different categories can also be very helpful.

Needs

Personal spending

Savings

WEEKLY REVIEW Taking a few minutes each week to review your spending can help you adjust your budget before problems grow bigger. Probably you might be going outside your budget.

BUDGETING REQUIRES DISCIPLNE Budgeting tools and financial tips are helpful, but the real secret behind successful money management is discipline. Financial stability rarely comes from one big decision. More often, it comes from small financial decisions made consistently over time.

When you develop the habit of planning your spending before your income arrives, you begin to build a healthier relationship with money.This simple habit can make the difference between financial pressure and financial progress.

Instead of reacting to your finances, you start directing them Intentionally. Money tends to flow more effectively when it has direction. So be intentional about Directing Your Money.

When income arrives without a plan, it easily disappears into unplanned spending. But when there is already a plan in place, money begins to serve its purpose.

Instead of waiting for income before planning your spending, plan ahead.

WHAT METHODS DO YOU PERSONALLY USE TO TRACK YOUR SPENDING AND STAY DISCIPLINED WITH YOUR BUDGET ? TABLE IT AT THE COMMENT SECTION.

body.title: Visit to one of my favorite bars in Seattle area
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdizxNoV39by2rkJnGyfc27497kZUW6bFUTy2nUTrSGoj/1773164440674.jpg)

This weekend we visited one of my favorite Seattle area bars: Vons 1000 Spirits. We first found out about this bar in Seattle when we looked for a place to eat within a walking distance from a Benaroya Hall where we frequently visited classical music concerts. 

We walked in not expecting much from this place, but one visit was all it took to make us love this place. The service was excellent, pizzas, pastas and drinks simply exceptional. A few years later they opened up the Woodinville location that is pictured above and is much closer to us than downtown Seattle. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZrqUAdYs5gVhwb7usNjMhaC3dyViE2DpyKwY6nVkiWje/1773164440800.jpg)

As you can see Vons 1000 Spirits had a long history for a West Coast bar/restaurant, they also told us that they will be taking over the space left vacant by one of our favorite French restaurants in Kirkland: Feast. 

It was somewhat of a bittersweet news to me. It is great that they are going to be located in a very central downtown Kirkland location that has an awesome space and a location well known to us. But this was the first time I learned that Feast is no more. I have some great memories from that place with my daughter and wife.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWbTBFD66yD3Ejki7v4wuiSK2h5RnbKcp46ruzTb95pWX/1773164440913.jpg)

Sure, our last few experiences at Feast with food quality were less favorable than in the past, which is one of the reasons why we have not visited Feast in a little while and didn't know that it closed. But I still remember all the great experiences we had there.

How our daughter loved eating their clams dish and it was her favorite food until she tried seafood dish at the Five restaurant. How we went there during the Covid days, how we ordered dark chocolate desert and our daughter finished the shared desert before we got around to it. Some really fond memories about Feast. But Feast is no more... the only constant in life is constant change.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ1jkLSXRZj9GLFW7V8kcuT44HzuHW8eZiht3wda1NuiT/1773164441010.jpg)

But back to our latest trip to the Vons 1000 Spirits. Our daughter ordered cheese pizza, I got to try some of it and it was delicious. I have especially enjoyed their freshly made from scratch sourdough. 

I ordered myself their All Day Bolognese pasta that is also made in house from scratch. It was as always excellent. This time I have added mushrooms to it based on the suggestion from our server. I love mushrooms so I realy liked this modified All Day Bolognese. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbcZEsT9Y732TvDZ2s97KAs36Ui73TUkJ13yBa5gLydzH/1773164441103.jpg)

I ordered myself a simple Scratch Manhattan for $7.99, it is a nice and quite strong for a Manhattan drink, they definitely do not mess around. But as you can see from the image above you can get really fancy with your drinks at this place.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUgrM8mZyWZHsHDsoigNv4kWZppnoPt42FAKKmvxp5o1p/1773171858527.jpg)

We finished up with the Salted Caramel Apple Strudel. Though saying that it was we would not be entirely accurate as my wife said that it was not her type of the desert and our daughter said that it was way too sweet. 

So I ended up finishing almost the entire Apple Strudel which we planned to share among the three of us. I really enjoyed it, but in my case Apple and Caramel with lots of sugar is what I love.

Overall it was a great family experience and a nice way to celebrate eight of March.

body.title: 샤이닝(드라마)
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZDGwpqkJHRw5aYA4EGZBZd6TXa3Qg7byrsBj9Ur7KsAF/image.png)

어제 넷플릭스에서 샤이닝 드라마 1,2회차를 봤습니다.
이 드라마는 풋풋한 첫사랑의 기억과 서른 살의 재회를 다룬 감성 멜로물입니다.

1,2회는 사고로 부모님을 잃고 아픈 남동생 희서와 함께 할아버지 댁이 있는 시골마을로 내려온 연태서. 세상에 마음을 닫았던 태서는 전학 간 학교에서 모은아를 만난다.

모은아는 우울증이 심한 아버지를 돌보며 뒤늦게 대입을 준비하고 있다. 도서관에서 태서와 자주 마주치고 함께 공부하며 서서히 가까워진다.

태서는 의대에 갈 정도로 공부를 잘한다. 

은아는 태서에게 처음으로 미래를 꿈꾸게 하는 존재가 되고, 태서 역시 은아에게서 삶의 활력을 주는 빛같은 존재가 된다.

태서는 공부를 잘해 한국대에 합격하게 되고  모은아도 집에서 가까운 대학교에 합격하게 된다.

모은아는 시골에서 서울로 태서를 보러 올라오기도 한다.

입시를 준비하는 과정, 대학 생활을 조금 보여주고 있다. 그리고 그들의 만남은 계속 이어져 가고 있나? 궁금해진다.

잔잔한 로맨스를 좋아하는 사람이라면 재미있게 볼 수 있을 것 같다. 







https://youtu.be/W2j6NXTDcSI

body.title: Splinterlands Escalation Warriors / Battle Review: Doomshield Warden PartI
body.body: > How are you doing my friends? It has been a moment since I shared my battle review about a warrior of interest in Splinterlands. The arrival of Escalation cards offer the right environment to build and also train my team to defeat opponents. One of the greatest circles to practice combination of new cards with the previous set is the Wild Format. You will not believe the valuable information you can extract to level up your game play. I hope these two battles in this series will open your mind about new style of strategies. --
> ## Battles summoners are the best in the game. Zaku and Mimosa were in the arena.
> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/icons/rulesets/new/img_combat-rule_are-you-not-entertained-_150.png ***One more Galdiator in the arena*** ---

> https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/website/icons/rulesets/new/img_combat-rule_now-you-see-me-_150.png ***All units have camouflage*** --- Mana value: 78 -- ## A. Training day with Doomshield The wild format offers a unique setting in the game to test the combination of serious cards in the game. I will focus in this practice day of my training on Doomshield. His solid characteristic can cause much damage when properly used in combat. The following battle shows the performance of Warden as a tanker in two teams. When the battle started I was convinced that Zaku will strike a heavy blow to the Death elemental and ultimately caused the destruction of the opposition.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQz3XDX1EHNLYxrESjVf2h7u5JWU1Lk5q7KWmumxuySZU/phot1.png)
-- I was wrong. Here is the interesting tricks that Mimosa hid in his lineup that changed the outcome of the game.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWC6spKwTmZyRmE6yrbAV8za7UhU3wS6Y33EMZRqmfM9k/phot1_zaku_lost.png)
Deflection on the Archer Delya save the day. Mantaroth was the second tanker in this Death element unit who played his role at the perfection. Delay stopped all blast attacks allowing Mimosa team to survive and create more damage to the opposition. [Battle 1](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_44fa5b4f6d4c2c75d19aed79c4511f5a)

>

## B. Zaku vs Zaku

The second battle was a confrontation between ZAKU in the arena. Doomshield seems to be a valuable asset in the composition of both team.
I should mention that the mana in this battle was above 95, so practically unlimited access to the strongest cards in one collection.

--
---

It was a battle where both teams have enough resources to win the game the players carefully place their favorite fighter in the lineup.


<center> ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmToFPLCEsgy9eC1tBFbhKNcSi6FyVccK6YScr5i5xUCsL/phot2.png) </center>

The only difference is visible in the selection where Taunt ability dupe the enemy to strike in the wrong direction.

<center> ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXPZxgFvyQx3iijcs53xCc7enumVxa7QcMGvfxL9CL8jK/phot2_zaku_againstzaku.png) </center>

--

[Battle 2](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_2388247beed57f33485487ccb2d97964)


<div class=\

body.title: [ENG-SPN] When Stonemasons Were the CEOs of the Way / Cuando los Canteros Eran los CEOs del Camino
body.body:
![IMG_9298.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EpNpPs76AJfbGUpWvf8gYYbqqKfiveWHsEycGu6nmmheVV9TMbdhxWiVqB5X5R4aAfk.JPG)

We continue this fascinating life adventure, which, at its core, we consider to be the search for the remnants of that fabulous medieval branding that developed over centuries along certain routes and paths. Its narrative and content were transmitted primarily through Romanesque architecture, and just a few kilometers from Grado del Pico, we arrive in a village whose name, Francos, already offers a sufficient clue to intuit what Chesterton defined as the Genesis where every biography must begin.

![IMG_9315.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EpXLwg7jNU1CkSgdtjb664pWAP2MFaRRaJfrcja1vqs2Ya1FrTYgAABym5gF9yGPzbZ.JPG)

Following this line of thought, we suppose that the origin of Francos must be sought in that moment of the Reconquista when the once-powerful borders of the Duero River began to weaken. With the advance of the Christian kingdoms of the north, the phenomenon of repopulation also occurred, accompanied by those metaphorical CEOs, who, ultimately, were the indispensable bearers of fantasy and substance: the medieval stonemasons.

![IMG_9316.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EppMga7n6kvxrmnziWYzgxKkNjEk4WyoWm6WDPBHh5WmneSjAkGo51jUvWefgUewFvC.JPG)

Perhaps, in this particular case, the carvers weren't as skilled as those who worked in neighboring Grado del Pico, but they nonetheless erected a church which, though humble in its execution, must have once housed a relic important enough to keep alive the central message that would guide travelers and pilgrims on their journey: the Exaltation of the Holy Cross.

![IMG_9303.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EogRdemy3X17hPk11knzDCAhv7mhymZFSKmuwirjH6VqiY3aA4vfdBpLQy6h68MPYSC.JPG)

Continuamos la fascinante aventura vital, que, en el fondo, consideramos que es la búsqueda de los restos de ese fabuloso branding medieval que se desarrolló durante siglos a lo largo de unas rutas y unos caminos determinados, cuyo relato y contenido se transmitió, principalmente, a través de la arquitectura románica y a pocos kilómetros de distancia de Grado del Pico, recalamos en un pueblo, cuyo nombre, Francos, ya nos ofrece una pista suficiente para intuir lo que Chesterton definiera como el Génesis por donde debe comenzar toda biografía.

![IMG_9311.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EqBf3GBcm2NxFpdq7QkVyhVUtaCUH1gQqmBYBWL1136FkTZPJrhuHKwXFooWRhEiiNh.JPG)

Siguiendo esa línea de pensamiento, suponemos que el origen de Francos hay que buscarlo en aquel momento de la Reconquista en el que comenzaron a flaquear las hasta entonces poderosas fronteras del Duero y con el avance de los reinos cristianos del norte, se produjo, también, el fenómeno de la repoblación, que, además, se vio acompañado por esos metafóricos CEOs, que, en definitiva, supusieron aquellos portadores indispensables de fantasía y contenido, que fueron los canteros medievales.

![IMG_9323.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/Eokf3FA9jTt466m81kfmHHxQwmGQNXCoWeZJKkc4HMejRMBZKsDrJPakH5aBpVhiTeu.JPG)

Posiblemente, en este caso en concreto, no fueron tan hábiles tallistas como aquellos otros que laboraron en la vecina Grado del Pico, pero, de cualquier manera, levantaron una iglesia, que, aunque humilde en su ejecución, por su advocación, debió de tener alguna reliquia en el pasado, lo suficientemente importante, como para mantener vivo el mensaje principal que habría de servir de orientación a caminantes y peregrinos en su experiencia vital: la Exaltación de la Santa Cruz.

![IMG_9308.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EqBcbwdArT3CY5TuShdHsHyYk65YRbZwVpLEhZVZjc6YiDWT8NM5YJ4VqjXLcnWbqrA.JPG)

body.title: Powrót na rower
body.body:
Oj, ciężki był to czas — praktycznie dwa tygodnie, a nawet więcej bez roweru elektrycznego, którym wykonywałem swoją pracę. Ciągłość dochodu została przerwana, bo przyszedł czas na serwis. Zanosiło się na to już na początku miesiąca. Najpierw jeden problem, potem okazało się, że kilka innych rzeczy też nadaje się do wymiany. Sprowadzanie części, no i tak to się wszystko przeciągnęło. Choć podobno przez autoryzowany serwis trwać to by mogło nawet 3-krotnie dłużej.

Niestety cena wyszła naprawdę duża — tyle, że koszt tego jednego serwisu okazał się wyższy niż suma wszystkich moich serwisów z całego zeszłego roku. To było sporo. Na szczęście nie jest to suma, która oznacza, zupełny brak opłacalności. Ciężko jednak będzie odrobić straty. Dwa tygodnie jeżdżenia pokryją koszt usługi, ale nadrobienie tego wydaje się niemożliwością. 

Także tyle narzekania, ale taki nasz narodowy zwyczaj, że bez tego nie ma szczerości i swobody normalnej rozmowy. 

Wczorajsze jeżdżenie to była przyjemność jeżdżenia jak po... Wyspach Kanaryjskich. Rower trafił do serwisu w ciężką zimę, a teraz jeździłem po mieście w bluzie. Ulice z kontr-ruchem w końcu były przejezdne, wąskie ścieżki znowu stały się ścieżkami a nie pokrywą śnieżną. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/2423qQoKD2QomF8F91mQmStS4QcwAVX1Sdm4roFieEdv2KhEkP8BNPpWeGgz18b3tnJs7.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/2432BDmzs89Fn1uQ3LTow4Ezvxy9aA3xwXCTD8JtSgXQNwSVDoFVkg2U1LaEPEanyeUo5.png)
*Podleśna we Wrzeszczu*

Jazda szła bardzo sprawnie, po drodze przejechałem koło całkiem ciekawych obszarach miasta, jak ulica Podleśna we Wrzeszczu. Zabudowa tam pochodzi z mniej więcej z 1914 roku. Ta cześć dzielnicy to projekt Adolfa Bielefeldta - jednego z najbardziej znanych przedwojennych architektów tamtych czasów.

Byłem też na Osiedlu Młodych, dzisiaj zwanym okazjonalnie i urzędowo VII Dworem. Podobało mi się tam dojście wśród zieleni pod drzwi klientki. Dostarczałem tam jedzenie i słyszałem, jak dzieci krzyczały: „Mamy zupy, mamy zupy!”. Taki okrzyk radości. Młodość chyba nie wypowiada się o jedzeniu aż tak entuzjastycznie, ale w tym przypadku było w tym coś bardzo szczerego.

Tak to wygląda. Zobaczymy, jak będzie w kolejnych dniach i czy w tym czasie uda mi się nadrobić chociaż część strat związanych z przestojem w kręceniu roweru. Za to komfort jazdy w takiej temperaturze jest bardzo fajny.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/23xKrUduxgztYN7drggar3bCFbBw45E28Y71q5yrYhRSfrcsouwD5f1irzqLCgArS8b2j.png)
*Mur dawnej fabryki słodyczy Bałtyk i niezbyt optymistyczne hasło. Obok jest inne głoszące, że Wszystko czego mi teraz potrzeba to...ciasteczka*

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/racibo/244xwhvhvvopyzRS1LsVF6fSgpPxTRjEDSV2ThdAUd6HN6EsUa2W5DeUwLdvMaZAxGTNJ.png)
*Samo centrum Wrzeszcza i miasta. Po prawej był kiedyś biurowiec Hydrobudowy. Jak wyglądał to zobaczycie w galerii zdjęć na mojej stronie (racibo.pl), gdzie losują się wybrane przeze mnie albumy - teraz właśnie jednym z tych jest Hydrobudowa*

body.title: Television Review: Genocide (The Shield, S7X04, 2008)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/hnhcASSS4h7IcT30mGvkL2VrcRP.jpg)

**Genocide (S07E04)**

Airdate: 23 September 2008

Written by: Lisa Randolph
Directed by: Dean White

Running Time: 45 minutes 



The creators of *The Shield* have historically struggled with the art of nomenclature, often opting for words that sound significant but lack the necessary gravitas to match the narrative weight. This tendency is evident even in the fourth instalment of the final season, which borrows a term coined in the twentieth century to describe unimaginable apocalyptic atrocities. It is a word that is often misused today for scoring cheap political points in various international conflicts. For many viewers, a title like this would suggest that the episode would feature equivalent ethnic carnage on the streets of Los Angeles, perhaps mirroring the gang warfare that defines the show. However, scriptwriter Lisa Randolph takes a different route, trading the expected bloodshed of the city for a historically resonant tragedy that serves as the backdrop for the season’s final act.

The \

in question is not a hypothetical future event but the Armenian Genocide. This is a horrific event that is in many ways the cornerstone of Armenian ethnic identity, a trauma that has been maintained especially throughout the Armenian diaspora via Armenian Genocide Remembrance Day, commemorated every year on 24 April. The plot of the episode is set strictly during these times, coinciding with the apparent escalation of the war between the Armenian mob and Mexican cartels that Vic Mackey and Shane Vendrell have so callously enflamed in order to solve their own financial and professional problems.\n\nThe war appears to escalate rapidly with the arson of Rezian's safe house, which leaves two of his lieutenants dead. The perpetrators appear to be the Mexicans. Since this happens just before the very public commemoration, which Rezian is supposed to attend, Vic fears that the Mexicans might try to kill him in a way that could result in too much collateral damage among Armenian civilians. Much of the conflict stems from Pezuela, the cartel's top representative, believing that it was Armenian mobsters who had stolen the \

Rezian insists that Vic sets up a meeting with Armando Rios (Jose Pablo Cantillo), Pezuela's surrogate. Much to Vic's surprise and concern, Rios claims that he possesses the box. At the actual meeting, Rezian changes his tune, denies that he has the black box, and offers peace.

This is something Vic would not like, and instead, he hatches a plan with Aceveda to prolong the conflict. The key is Robert Martin, a corrupt city controller who has been blocking funding for an Armenian Genocide memorial in the city. In a Machiavellian move, Vic, through Aceveda, blackmails Marin into releasing the funding, ostensibly to signal his allegiance to Armenians. This is designed to make the Mexicans believe that Armenians have the leverage of the black box. However, this scheme backfires terribly when Marin, who came to attend the commemoration, gets killed by Mexican assassins. Martin is very publicly punished for his supposed treachery, and the execution is styled to send a clear message.

Vic is at the very end of the episode faced with the complete collapse of his strategy when Aceveda tells him that Agent Olivia Massey, whom he relied upon to rein in the Mexicans, is actually in the \

Furthermore, Aceveda reveals that she has been most likely working with the Mexicans. This means that Pezuela and the cartel might be aware of both Vic's and Aceveda's machinations, making their lives next to worthless. The episode ends with this devastating revelation, shifting the power dynamic entirely and leaving Vic to deal with the consequences of his arrogance.

In the regular procedural storyline, Dutch Wagenbach investigates a strange case involving a high school student with a criminal record who breaks into the home of Lloyd Denton (Kyle Gallner), his schoolmate. The student is shot to death in what appears to be self-defence. Dutch begins to suspect something more sinister after seeing that Lloyd, apparently a very intelligent yet academically unaccomplished young man, shows a strange lack of emotion following the incident. Dutch thinks that Lloyd is a psychopath who manipulated his schoolmate into the fatal break-in only to kill him, and that he is actually a serial killer in the making.

The episode also features a continuation of Cassidy Mackey acting out against her parents, making another awkward visit to Danny and the home of her half-brother. While this subplot fleshes out the domestic consequences of Vic's life, it is secondary to the main tension.

*Genocide* is a solid, albeit unremarkable, episode. It uses the \

as a relatively efficient MacGuffin to drive the plot forward, though the device itself is somewhat flimsy. The episode ends with an interesting cliffhanger twist that sets up the final act of the season. It also features further characterisation of Vic as a self-deluded man who believes that a couple of ethical missteps can be justified with the greater good, and he is aghast when Shane expresses a total lack of interest in what happens to Farmington after the Byz Lats and cartels complete their takeover. Finally, the subplot involving the young psychopath in the making, starring veteran actress Frances Fisher as his mother, looks rather standard and clichéd by this point in the series' run.

RATING: 6/10 (++)

body.title: A Mother's Wish [short story, fantasy]
body.body:
News reached Farrah, and she was devastated. She only had her younger sister Tilda, a barmaid at the inn, to help her when she was ready to deliver the baby. Her labor started early, with little warning. Tilda realized there were likely to be complications with the birth.

Farrah labored all through the night, and Tilda did her best to keep her sister clean and comfortable while tiring amidst the pain. With a final agonizing scream, Farrah pushed the baby free of her womb.

A strong healthy boy with golden hair was born. The mother named him Lukas.

Earlier on, Tilda sent a messenger to request the emergency services of a midwife or a cleric of the church to help with the birthing complexities, but nobody had arrived, and Farrah’s spirit was starting to fade.

In a shallow breath, Farrah asked her sister to recite The Mother's Prayer together: the lullaby prayer a mothers sings to their little ones to help them to sleep.

_“Oh so Bright. Angel of Light”_

_“Protect this innocent child tonight.”_

_“Keep him warm. Make sure he's fed.”_

_“Dry his tears, and also his bed.”_

_“Let Mother sleep, and Baby too”_

_“With hearth and home at peace.”_

_“Tomorrow morn, when the rooster sings”_

_“I thank you m’lady, and grant you release.”_

Holding each other hand-in-hand, Tilda wept as Farrah could no longer draw breath to finish the last words.

Knowing nothing of child rearing, Tilda cried out just as the cleric arrived a heartbeat too late. She comforted and held Tilda silently in her arms as she grieved for the loss of her sister.

Together they thought it might be best for the baby to be raised by the Sisters of St. Daimos, an orphanage and school for children. Tilda could visit Lukas as he grows up, but ultimately guardianship would be given to the church, allowing Tilda to continue to earn a living full-time.

Meanwhile, after three months Gilbert nearly finished serving his sentence on the Gilded Lady. In the last month the ship was presumed attacked by pirates at sea. The pirates would have plundered the ship and sunk it to the sea bottom. Nobody on the crew of the Gilded Lady was ever heard from again.

Prince Helios recovered quickly from his wounds, and seemed to forget about the matter fairly quickly, but his cousin, Prince Thebis maintained a limp, and required the use of a cane for the rest of his life. Prince Felbin died relatively young, at age 42. It was whispered that a cursed disease quickly sapped his voice and soon after his lifeforce in a matter of days.

Tilda continues to work as a barmaid at The Tilted Table Tavern Inn. Young Lukas at the orphanage was visited by his Auntie Tilda on birthdays and holidays over the years. He grew fond of her, being his only family, and he especially enjoyed her frequent gifts of gooey stickybuns. Lukas would often look out his dorm room window overlooking the sea, where his mind wandered. Perhaps his Papa was alive out there somewhere, exploring the oceans and finding treasure maps to search for pirate gold.

<h3 style=\
>Afterword Thank you for reading my short story. \
is the second chaper in a three-part series. Feel free to browse the first chapter in this tale, A Horse and a Mule\
