links.title: Who is the favorite to win the 2025/26 Champions League?
links.body:
The 2025/26 Champions League reaches its most exciting stage. The Round of 16 kicks off this week, on March 10th and 11th, with matchups like Arsenal vs. Bayer Leverkusen, Bayern Munich vs. Atalanta, Liverpool vs. Galatasaray, Barcelona vs. Newcastle, Chelsea vs. PSG, and Manchester City vs. Real Madrid. With the draw now complete and the bracket set, the question is on everyone's mind: who will lift the trophy in Budapest on May 30th?

**Arsenal, the clear favorite**

According to Opta's algorithms, Arsenal is the clear favorite, with almost a 28% chance of winning the Champions League, nearly double that of the second favorite, Bayern Munich. Mikel Arteta's team has had a dream season: they are the most in-form team in all of Europe, haven't lost a single match in this edition of the Champions League, and also lead the Premier League. Their defensive solidity, versatile attack, and, above all, their set-piece prowess are their defining characteristics.

**Bayern Munich and Manchester City, the Chasers**

Bayern Munich is the second major contender. Vincent Kompany's side only lost one league match and is the clear leader of the Bundesliga, with a team undergoing a complete reinvention in which young players are gaining momentum. Harry Kane is the great hope for this knockout stage. Meanwhile, Pep Guardiola's Manchester City is another favorite despite finishing eighth in the league. They are not currently at their best, but have shown an ability to reinvent themselves in crucial moments.

**PSG Defends Title with Difficulties**

PSG is the reigning champion and faces this edition with the ambition of defending their Champions League trophy. However, Opta analysts give them less than a 5% chance of repeating. The Parisians had an inconsistent league campaign and reached the round of 16 as one of the unseeded teams, where they now face Chelsea.

**Real Madrid and Barcelona in the background**

Despite their history, European giants like Barcelona and Real Madrid have dramatically low chances compared to the favorites. Real Madrid faces none other than Manchester City, while Barcelona will take on Newcastle.

Of course, the favorite never wins the Champions League!

links.title: [Eng/Esp]The Symphony of Calm
links.body:
English Version🇬🇧: Absolutely I love being in a beach house. It feels like time stands still, and all that exists is the sound of the waves🌊, the salty breeze and the sand beneath my feet. Waking up to an ocean view, having coffee ☕️ on the terrace as the sun gently warms everything, and ending the day watching the sunset colors reflect on the water. There’s nothing more relaxing than that.

Looking at the horizon where the sky and sea merge in an infinite embrace, reminds us how small our problems are in the vastness of the world. There are no rush, no demands; just the gentle sound of the water, the warmth of the sun☀️ on your skin and the freedom to simply be. The beach🏖 is where the noise of the world fades away and we can finally listen to ourselves.

Breathing in that salty air fills me with energy⚡️ and peace at the same time. There's no better plan than spending the day by the water, reading a book📚 or simply watching the sun hide on the horizon. The beach is life, it's freedom, it's pure happiness.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSdkMqGLErKCztLFPUqdTM4UXzzig1Tbp7ojkqSVepJMf/1773168547226.jpg)


Versión en español🇪🇦 : Me encanta estar en una casa en la playa. Es como si el tiempo se detuviera y solo existieran el sonido de las olas🌊, la brisa salada y la arena bajo mis pies. Despertar con la vista del mar, tomar café☕️ en la terraza mientras el sol calienta suavemente y terminar el día viendo cómo los colores del atardecer se reflejan en el agua. No hay nada más relajante que eso.

Mirar al horizonte, donde el cielo y el mar se funden en un abrazo infinito, nos recuerda lo pequeño que son nuestros problemas en la inmensidad del mundo. No hay prisas, no hay exigencias; solo el suave sonido del agua, la calidez del sol ☀️ en la piel y la libertad de simplemente ser. La playa 🏖 es el lugar donde el ruido del mundo se apaga y, por fin, podemos escucharnos a nosotros mismos.

Respirar ese aire salado me llena de energía⚡️ y paz al mismo tiempo. No hay mejor plan que pasar el día junto al agua, leyendo un libro 📚 o simplemente viendo cómo el sol se esconde en el horizonte. La playa es vida, es libertad, es felicidad pura.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdEgcGmVSUY2bWWZVtDhP5GAZn2erqU22uLFAi13EnSCU/1773168811537.jpg)

‎
‎True believe and faith in God demands we take action. Faith is more of an action or doing word. And the bible says that without faith it is impossible to please God. When we believe that God has heard us then we step outside in boldness to achieve it knowing fully well that God has already heard us and is bringing it to pass. 
‎
‎Some people do so much well in the prayer aspect but leave out from the doing part. It doesn't work like that. It is a two way something. There are somethings that are left for us to do. We shouldn't keep waiting for someone to come and spoon-feed us every area of life. 
‎
‎Whenever e call upon God we should also give a listening ear so as to hear what He is telling us to do. There some cases where there's nothing left to do, and we'll have to depend solely on the Lord's mercy. But it's not always like this. God doesn't want us turning it to be lazy christians.
‎
‎What prayer sure is that it makes that thing we are hoping God for to be possible, but it didn't mean we don't have our own role to play as well. Avoiding them means running away from responsibility.

links.title: Мотивуюча історія повернення Брендана Фрейзера до Голлівуду
links.body: Мені було 45 років, і я сидів на парковці біля супермаркету, сам у машині, їв сендвіч — саме тоді я зрозумів, що світ мене забув.\n\n

/>

Це не метафора. Це була звичайна середа в Лос-Анджелесі. Сонце розжарювало асфальт, а я сидів у своїй старенькій Honda, яку ледве міг собі дозволити, і дивився, як люди заходять до магазину та виходять із пакетами продуктів.

Ніхто мене не впізнавав. Ніхто не дивився вдруге.

Для світу я був просто звичайною людиною.

Але колись усе було інакше.

Був час, коли моє обличчя було всюди: на білбордах, у журналах, в інтерв’ю. Я був героєм пригодницького фільму «Мумія». Хлопцем, що стрибає по ліанах у «Джорджі з джунглів».

Я заробляв мільйони. Жив у великому будинку. І був переконаний, що так буде завжди.

Ніхто не готує тебе до того, як швидко все може змінитися.

Коли я розповів про пережите мною насильство, у відповідь настала глуха тиша.

Двері зачинялися одна за одною. Телефон перестав дзвонити. Мій агент пішов. «Друзі» зникли.

Із «зірки моменту» я перетворився на «проблемного актора», на «того, з ким важко працювати», на «того, хто більше не приносить прибутку».

Тим часом моє тіло почало здаватися.

Сім операцій після травм, отриманих на зйомках: спина, коліна, голосові зв’язки. Хронічний біль.

Я опинився в такій глибокій депресії, що іноді не міг навіть підвестися з ліжка.

Вага то зростала, то зменшувалася. Самооцінка — лише падала.

Мої сини питали: — Тату, чому ти більше не знімаєшся у фільмах? І я брехав: — Я просто обираю хороші проєкти.

Правда була іншою. Ніхто мені не телефонував.

Я почав думати, що зробив щось не так. Що, можливо, заслуговую на забуття. Що, можливо, краще просто зникнути.

Одного дня, прибираючи в гаражі, я знайшов коробку зі старими фотографіями.

На одній із них я стояв на знімальному майданчику «Джорджа з джунглів». На руках тримав свого сина Ґріффіна, якому тоді було два роки.

Ми обоє сміялися. За моєю спиною були прожектори, люди, рух, життя. І я згадав, чому почав зніматися в кіно. Не заради слави. Не заради грошей. А тому, що любив акторство.

Бо коли змушував людей сміятися, відчував, що живу.

Того дня я пообіцяв собі: я повернуся.

Не важливо, скільки часу це займе. Навіть якщо це буде маленький незалежний фільм без бюджету.

Я повернуся.

Через десять років задзвонив телефон.

Це був Даррен Аронофскі. Він запропонував мені пройти проби до фільму «Кит».

Це історія чоловіка з ожирінням, самотнього й пригніченого, який намагається відновити стосунки зі своєю донькою.

Я прочитав сценарій і розплакався. Цей чоловік був я.

Ми зняли фільм за двадцять днів. Мінімальний бюджет. Тільки я, протезний костюм і камера.

На прем’єрі у Венеції зал підвівся. Люди плакали.

І вперше за багато років я відчув, що світ знову дивиться на мене.

Потім прийшов Оскар. У 2023 році я тримав у руках цю золоту статуетку.

Але найважливішим був не сам приз. Найважливіше — що мої сини були там, у залі.

І того вечора, коли ми повернулися додому, мій син обійняв мене і сказав: — Тату, я ніколи в тобі не сумнівався.

Я розповідаю цю історію не для оплесків.

Я розповідаю її для тих, хто сьогодні сидить на парковці, їсть наодинці і почувається невидимим.

Для тих, хто думає, що їхня історія закінчилася. Для тих, хто роками чекає дзвінка, який так і не лунає.

Світ може забути про тебе. Може ігнорувати. Може викреслити.

**Але поки ти сам не забудеш себе, завжди є шанс повернутися.**

* * *

<h4 style=\

>Не важливо, скільки разів ти падаєш.
Важливо лише одне —
чи готовий ти піднятися ще раз.

links.title: Never do Crypto on an Empty Stomach
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYnvPhYoUybY3zDg9ohCWdbVe5TYp2met4nvzLcucT1LU/1000221074.webp 

Anyone who relies on crypto as their only source of income will undoubtedly go broke multiple times. Rug pulls, market crashes, or even wallet hacks can destroy your life’s work in seconds and leave you looking foolish.

Through my experience since I started doing crypto, I’ve learned that it’s not something you can solely depend on as an income source. When the market crashes, you can either fall into depression or be financially ruined. Crypto is enjoyable when you have a stable, real-life income, and you’re just investing in it for the long haul, as a store of value for your retirement or something to leave to your kids as an inheritance.

Making money from crypto can be as sweet as it can be bitter. Just as a coin can multiply your initial investment a hundredfold, you can lose everything you've invested in a single minute. This can have a devastating impact on your health and financial stability. Therefore, you never do crypto on an empty stomach.

The 2021 has been my biggest moment in crypto where I first experience the sweetness of crypto. I made a lot of money that year. I managed to turn a humble $5 into $10,000 worth of assets during the bull run before I was wiped out in rug pulls for some meme coins and by the market crash of 2022, which set me back to zero and nearly pushed me into depression.

When I was making money and seeing numbers go up in my portfolio, I felt I was going to be rich soon and would never lack money. I was putting funds into every new coin that came out, hoping to hit the next big thing and do another 1000x gain like I did before. Some of those coins turned out to be rug pulls, leaving investors with useless tokens and zero value. 

At that point, I had no fallback plan or a steady income source other than crypto. Even if I had wanted to invest in a business in real life, I wouldn't have had the time to focus on it. When you engage in crypto as your primary income source, it can consume all your time, energy, and even your sleep.

I was living solely on the money I was earning from crypto at the time, and as such, I was directly affected by the changes in the market. My wallets were hacked and emptied more than twice, and I was forced to sell the little I had in my portfolio when the market crashed in 2022 because I was broke at the time and had no other source of income to fall back on.

However, despite all these experiences, I did not totally turn my back on crypto and instead chose to just limit my involvement to only those activities that would allow me to earn without having to invest my own money, and that is exactly what I have been doing since then. All I want is peace of mind, and to be able to sleep without worrying about what might happen to my investment.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@thelastdash/never-do-crypto-on-an-empty-stomach)

title.title: France To Lift Six Nations Title This Weekend
title.body: /> [source](https://www.rte.ie/images/0024069d-614.jpg?ratio=1.58) The Six Nations is almost done and dusted with 1 round left to play and this is for the French to lose and Ireland/Scotland hoping for an upset. The big advantage the French have is the points difference so all they have to do is win their game and if they score a bonus point then the title is theirs. This is so hard to look past anything but a French victory as they have the title in their hands and is for them to lose. The French play England in Paris with England having lost their last 3 games in a row so there is always a possibility England play desperate rugby and change their mindset which gives them the hope. The only problem is this is a young inexperienced team and they have not known the situation and pressure they find themselves in now. I have heard some ex England players state they have hit rock bottom, but that is not true. The next two games are France in Paris followed by South Africa in June away at altitude in Johannesburg. This is why The England coach has to go after this weekends game to give them a chance of regrouping because once on a losing run it is virtually impossible to shut down. The last two games England played they had a defensive mindset which is very negative and they do not have the players to change this within one week. The challenge England have ahead of them this week is not just a mountain it is more of an Everest task. The French lost this week and will also be focusing on themselves which makes it doubly hard. The England camp is desperate right now and the players are under pressure to perform and we all know the harder you try the harder the task becomes. I was involved in a team that lost 8 games in a row and if I am brutally honest it was down to mindset because the confidence levels are down. The harder you train the more tired you become and this becomes a dark place with so many emotions. Sport will level you at some point and you have to accept that situation and work through it. The problem is you may not be doing anything that is obvious or wrong and is more of a collective coming together raising the game play by an extra 5%. With negativity and low confidence this is easier said than done and only expect to see an England team winning against Fiji which they should do on the 18th July being played at the new Everton Football Stadium in Liverpool. This will depend on what type of hammering the team received by South Africa the week before as this is what I expect to be rock bottom. Focusing on Ireland vs Scotland in Dublin look no further than an Irish win even though they are not a strong team these days. Scotland threw everything at the French team and won which the style of play caught everyone off guard. Repeating that type of play two weeks in a row would be great to see and not impossible, but highly unlikely. Both teams have serious weaknesses which makes this an even contest and dare I say it a card or a couple of cards could change the game either way. Predictions for the upcoming weekend matches which I normally do not do. Ireland to win by 8 Italy to win by 12 France to win by 19

What a pleasure to greet you. < >The place I'll talk to you about today is relatively close (about three kilometers) from my house, and I was always curious to visit it, until today when I finally decided to go. I took advantage of the proximity and walked there; it also served as my morning exercise. I had always heard rumors about Kuquine. About the secret tunnels, the wild parties, about how the dictator Fulgencio Batista (the last president of Cuba before 1959) planned his misdeeds in a library filled with busts of national heroes (José Martí, Abraham Lincoln, Máximo Gómez, and Simón Bolívar, Gandhi next to Churchill, and Stalin flanked by Rommel and Joan of Arc as if they were his party buddies). A crazy political syncretism. Undoubtedly a man with a very peculiar sense of humor.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQHbApKmiK5ccbGE8sqhmsbQdYLeW4uh79sz8trgEhvJ3/1773167343502.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWkfm6TW9NtUsuUvAYbtWJA2as5LHdLhEEZGqny8Zpw7p/1773167343795.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcpDAPbBYpnFGY8dxBX4CBRc9FSs6n5iHmCGo8i7B9fcG/1773167344196.jpg)

>








Así que esta mañana, armada de mi curiosidad y con la excusa de un reportaje, me fui para allá. La dirección de esta finca de 17 caballerías de extensión, es casi un trabalenguas: al borde de la Autopista del Mediodía, entre la Carretera Central y la carretera de Cantarranas, rumbo al Guatao y muy cerca de Punta Brava, mi pueblo. Kuquine era solo una de las residencias privadas de Fulgencio Batista. Según me contaron los trabajadores del lugar, el nombre de Kuquine viene de su esposa. Dicen que ella le decía \
en la intimidad, y de ahí salió lo de \

. Al parecer el tipo tenía un romanticismo de telenovela.\n\n>So this morning, armed with my curiosity and using a report as an excuse, I headed over there. The address of this estate, which spans 17 caballerías of land, is almost a tongue twister: on the edge of the Autopista del Mediodía, between the Carretera Central and the Cantarranas road, heading towards Guatao and very close to Punta Brava, my town. Kuquine was just one of Fulgencio Batista's private residences. According to the workers there, the name Kuquine comes from his wife. They say she used to call him \

came from. Apparently, the guy had a soap-opera kind of romanticism.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNzFF3fRkRcc8aTdQt9ko9FvteY37DKDfxygxXkC6956Q/1773167495577.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTiFE2T3JfZoaiAxcSo8vyUyJFVhWegQjPc9UtynigsDp/1773167495962.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRp46M7cRcfTVfjVSyjM9wkc7aUhqsF8k68mzdXwtSfsf/1773167496449.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNUjzVqDqCbZEKXsMvbKwC4upswjqaxwFjBgzUTphYTSz/1773167497021.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZSDZqCjSJkKbu7idtZVNrnRgHAaQmqSWdRkBsgaxonrw/1773167497419.jpg)

> Lo primero que ves al entrar es un espejo de agua y una capillita. Aqui se respira aire puro por todas partes. El verde de la naturaleza reina en todo su esplendor. La casa principal es una belleza. Tiene tejas rojas y unos portales con columnas de caoba que son una maravilla. Caminar por ahí es como estar en una película. El tiempo se ha comido los lujos, pero la estructura todavía se impone. >The first thing you see upon entering is a reflecting pool and a small chapel. You breathe pure air everywhere here. The green of nature reigns in all its splendor. The main house is a beauty. It has red tiles and porches with mahogany columns that are marvelous. Walking there is like being in a movie. Time has eroded the luxuries, but the structure still stands imposing.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXRKRm2MMFiYoG6uYUZs1XmCAgHC9gG7GHiLT2eZsHCML/1773167599867.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQUjHrJZvpCbVJPESPSNV5A8LXAv2hXSBVqkEjVD4m8B8/1773167600187.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZre8Rb6oi7pcf5rPPW385Rg2FoNAFRYMztvCM4Mu8zNh/1773167600617.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYKXwKAvwgNGHGnKGX9zgBj5HiuxysvqbNPBv8VwjCfmq/1773167601123.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ1pSeaaNqb24odRWxxTXM6kxpG5ZeTvDLJEJjDd7vSZx/1773167601625.jpg)

y ha tenido más vidas que un gato. Allí dentro hay varias viviendas. Después del triunfo de la Revolución, fue escuela, instituto tecnológico, albergue y, en un giro inesperado, hoy es un centro recreacional. Cuentan los que saben, que hace años, por solo 300 pesos en moneda nacional, uno podía darse el lujo de pasar la noche en la propia habitación de Batista y hasta usar su inodoro. Lastimosamente, ya no es tan barato, ahora cuesta mas de mil pesos la noche, pero el lugar sigue teniendo ese encanto de ruina con pasado glamuroso.\n\n>Today, the estate is called \

(Freedom Community) and has had more lives than a cat. There are several houses inside. After the triumph of the Revolution, it was a school, a technological institute, a shelter, and, in an unexpected turn, today it is a recreational center. Those in the know say that years ago, for only 300 Cuban pesos, one could afford the luxury of spending the night in Batista's very own room and even use his toilet. Sadly, it's not that cheap anymore; now it costs over a thousand pesos a night, but the place still has that charm of a ruin with a glamorous past.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUWPQpJQXdJv9ma1sbrjM7vs2aRLFhP6UYSVTf5W8AsCo/1773167723665.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf7bcgnFNC54onzSAntZKpS1YiZqLwmjra6tjEZ8pnMLS/1773167723919.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUL7iey46QJXEYy6UnH1YB2fLLzTBnDPoWqW7Ed8aDdZM/1773167724166.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTRGLjwgUH5tommdDsKPdTdhPsRKpAB4kWkD19bqkuyKh/1773167724542.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZZMQRcR2aBHbSPGpnuYnH3qQNJe2CAnFrXdA2SYNDquV/1773167724909.jpg)

> Aunque no me permitieron subir (vean que escalera tan preciosa), supe que la mansión cuenta con doce dormitorios, cada uno con su baño, y el único con balcón era la de Batista. La piscina, que era la envidia de todos, sigue siendo el centro del recreo, aunque los que la vieron en sus tiempos de gloria dicen que nada que ver con su estado actual. En el momento de mi visita estaba vacía. La piscina estaba dividida en dos secciones: una para niños y otra para adultos. Más allá, pasando por el puente de estilo japonés que atravesaba la piscina, estaban las cabañas, el merendero, con un bar de madera y reluciente níkel, encontrándose entre los elementos decorativos de los jardines, fuentes y tinajones camagüeyanos. >Although they didn't allow me to go upstairs (look at that beautiful staircase), I learned that the mansion has twelve bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, and the only one with a balcony was Batista's. The pool, which was the envy of all, remains the center of recreation, although those who saw it in its glory days say it's nothing like its current state. At the time of my visit, it was empty. The pool was divided into two sections: one for children and one for adults. Further on, crossing the Japanese-style bridge that went over the pool, were the cabins, the snack bar, with a wooden bar and shiny nickel, all amidst decorative garden elements, fountains, and large Camagüeyan earthenware jars.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcebmJFrYmfZTrQ2HGjmFqgCoPBvL3emAzitERSkJQnKL/1773167833490.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSfyZy3mr2d4sTFFDPLbqeB4jXNtt9ySdfGM7moszQQUC/1773167833751.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYf6vza6x1eM9W5sv46v96uG7TC52C8K1rFepotWWZoQW/1773167833980.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRRFvPHupiEdvxq1uc9b5x1xB7zbMDAMXksHwyYPaKyQy/1773167834347.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPi9QnWVXqqPFoAVkhvsPN8ajFy5kUbiLd8dNUrEgHfoz/1773167834829.jpg)

>







Si hablamos de rarezas, cuentan que Batista tenía complejo de Napoleón. Se refería al golpe de estado del10 de marzo como su \
y guardaba como un tesoro un telescopio y unas pistolas que fueron del Emperador. En una vitrina, sus condecoraciones militares, y en un cuarto secreto, al que llamaban \

, se llegaron a encontrar joyas y dinero por un montón de millones. Muchas alhajas aparecieron en cajas de madera, olvidadas entre libros viejos cuando ya Batista había salido cagando todo lo que pudo el 1ro de enero del 59.\n\n>Speaking of oddities, they say Batista had a Napoleon complex. He referred to the coup d'état of March 10th as his \
and treasured a telescope and some pistols that supposedly belonged to the Emperor. In a display case, his military decorations, and in a secret room, which they called \

jewels and money worth many millions were once found. Many pieces of jewelry appeared in wooden boxes, forgotten among old books, after Batista had already gotten the hell out with everything he could on January 1st, 1959.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZHnBZWjZ9FmX6KGb9Ftee8bKKBerKbp6S8z7f3nxeH49/1773167911758.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZRMxiAqFzJsjbZRCDjZCrQQbHHY7FfEbHCwkCzSi2FEt/1773167912136.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWSZLQXjiGdsxM6u6KiYdwU3ScixzFMCRu3La6iXYnSNr/1773167912592.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT7TmAxAFMB429yL3F6Ak3aF8D9664wSxDZxe5n3aVJvf/1773167913216.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXPJx6BewDHASBVmE5YEHCmaUbBaxxJhxAf1rvZ34coZC/1773167913774.jpg)

> Lo mejor de todo es que, pese al abandono y a las capas de historia que le han caído encima, Kuquine todavía respira misterio. Se rumora, y siempre hay un alma que te lo jura (aunque los trabajadores no me lo confirmaron)que hay un pasadizo subterráneo que conecta la casa principal con la antigua Ciudad Militar de Columbia por donde logro escapar. Serán cuentos, pero mientras paseas entre las columnas de caoba, no puedes evitar mirar al suelo y preguntarte si por ahí no pasaría el dictador huyendo. >The best part is that, despite the neglect and the layers of history that have fallen upon it, Kuquine still breathes mystery. It is rumored, and there's always someone who swears it's true (although the workers didn't confirm it to me), that there is an underground passage connecting the main house to the old Ciudad Militar de Columbia (Columbia Military City) through which he managed to escape. It might be stories, but as you stroll among the mahogany columns, you can't help but look at the ground and wonder if that's not where the dictator fled.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbLBvbtiYhwLuJ8Vw8pJiG4DFA2vhsYJTPdayUsGqdBxR/1773168041041.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWoPFw9NmSwd3YVzy9fPfGro184Q8rLtiGcn1BaRwyk8h/1773168041458.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaqYueCm67yQTKME65EyBBSxctbZ36WZ59JhBSxYWD4Gm/1773168041887.jpg)

>








Al final, me queda la sensación de haber pisado un lugar donde se gestó un golpe de estado, donde un hombre que empezó siendo sargento taquígrafo terminó queriéndose rodear de reyes y emperadores. Kuquine no es solo una finca vieja y medio caída, es un monumento al poder, la trampa y el ridículo, todo en uno. Valió la pena la escapada, aunque sea solo para sentarse en el borde del muro del portal y pensar: \

.


>In the end, I'm left with the feeling of having set foot in a place where a coup d'état was conceived, where a man who started as a stenographer sergeant ended up wanting to surround himself with kings and emperors. Kuquine is not just an old, somewhat dilapidated estate; it's a monument to power, deceit, and absurdity, all in one. The outing was worth it, if only to sit on the edge of the porch wall and think: \

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTCu9AQgdShLz5YndP2J6MwTXYCfH8aLZDMnVjbUgj6ho/1773168135221.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbYZnmdzA8K82jNGdmotGNmLEAw4XrHBCwEBQahezsmWL/1773168135600.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRdsXUxSRUaV5MPwr7rs4to5bmkT2rfnut5UUFnUdFJ81/1773168135992.jpg) https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJDibgVv7QpnG7cFRyL8RrNKwrY4Tkx4636U9mec4jSH/img_8206.gif Gracias por visitar mi blog Texto e imágenes de mi propiedad Thanks to visite my blog Text and imagen are my own https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmftReAUFLd1o6yeBP8wg9ths82CW6Fpu7doGEYgCEWV/img_7269.jpg

![henley-design-studio-XbZgARqXROc-unsplash.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYN68LaR8jZb3HRcxk6bgmcpUBPjeQudeK1pxiUDXQbRV/henley-design-studio-XbZgARqXROc-unsplash.jpg)[source](https://unsplash.com/photos/kid-sitting-beside-round-cake-close-up-photography-XbZgARqXROc?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditShareLink)





I love experimenting sometimes.
I know most of what we have or use now was invented based on experimentation.
Some were mistakes made that led to the invention of something.
So, experimenting can be useful and sometimes dangerous too.
So, I try to mix few things together when cooking, things that are not the usual style of cooking.
It is interesting too to try out things.
Sometimes it comes out well, and other times it does not come out the way I planned.
But either ways, I eat it all the same.
There is this joy you get from eating something you made.
It does not look bad or discouraging at all, I guess it's because you have no choice, you will have to eat your own garbage.
The whole thing is exciting.
I try not to get my hopes dashed when it does not come out the way I hoped, I try again in a better way later on.
Others will be surprised, some might say, \

But it does not bother me because I am happy I tried something new.




You can also participate by clicking [here](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/10-march-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3038-he-ate-what)

Light rain brings that particular feeling of peace. It can be the smell that causes a chemical reaction in our brain, the cooler temperature or just because.

With Cuba's daily and permanent problems, this feeling, although temporary, is appreciated.

AllIt is true that everything is expensive, that we have to foresee, save and reduce consumption. But no one knows when it will go, so, from time to time, to raise the spirit, to accumulate energy, to live even for a while, you have to treat yourself, just because, just in case....in case we die tomorrow. 

---

title.title: Re-Learning about Entrepreneurship and Niches!
title.body:
>

![Re-Learning about Niches.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/23xAc4L7BK7gybpitpCnPyjQ4hmXRvuaRS12rDUYu56UENskpgtJDkTqyPtYxGgXdLUYh.jpg)

It's a great feeling when we manage to learn something by watching content. This happened while watching a live stream about business, where a phrase about \

made me relearn about the concept of niches, through an insight from the conversation. Check it out! I'll be much appreaciated if you **Votes**, **Reblogs** or give any **Tips**. Thanks and have good reading! 🍀 ---

>

## Re-learning about Entrepreneurship and Niches!

<center> ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/23xAVtGGtK9Monpv4fZQCAkH2HpqkN2EaobDcjNxLq82QAD3nwyYtnR8bsfzysrJjEoYs.png) </center>
<center>[Source: ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/)</center>

It's common nowadays that much of the content we watch ends up adding almost nothing to our lives to the point of making us reflect on something. That's why it's so good when you watch something and it makes you think and reconsider some aspect of life. This week I was watching a live stream about business and I managed to extract some great insights and other perspectives on the subject, which I believe will help me re-learn about the topic of Business and about a fundamental part of it, which are Market Niches!

The first insight is quite simple, but in this world of infinite information, if you don't pay attention, even simple information is forgotten, and since it's the basis for everything else, it complicates things a lot. The insight is this: \

o objetivo de todo empreendedor é fazer um business que tenha 3 características, seja escalável, rentável e gere um impacto positivo na sociedade, que são os stackholders do negócio.

Simples não é mesmo? Acredito que qualquer um que busque fazer um negócio buscaria essas 3 características - escalabilidade, rentabilidade e impacto positivo. Mas se é tão simples e fácil de entender, porque é tão difícil de aplicar? Mais uma vez o motivo é o excesso de informação, chega tantas notícias, tantas curiosidades inúteis e memes, que o cérebro não consegue diferenciar o que importa do que não importa.

---

## Qual é o melhor nicho? Nichos Pequenos e Grandes!

<center> ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/2458dTtJk6a68X25VvULWdGyeBTeKiJe2eMzPAk5aKbiYKPwYcTdteJYguKVegBs8dujD.png) </center>
<center>[Source: ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/)</center>

Agora você deve estar se perguntando: O que essas 3 características tem haver com nicho? É justamente aqui que o insight começa a fazer sentido. Quem já pensou em falar sobre algum assunto na internet, já deve ter se deparado com o conceito de nicho de mercado, que seria pegar um mercado e \

e falar sobre algo mais específico. É dito que essa é uma ótima estratégia porque você terá mais engajamento com a sua audiência, mas será que isso é tão bom mesmo? \n\nAgora que devemos considerar a primeira característica \

, se você começa nichado, e foca só naquele nicho específico, por exemplo, falar sobre PETs, mas na verdade você fala sobre Peixes, mas na real é sobre um peixe de água doce específico de uma região. Ao fazer isso, o seu público será extremamente restrito à quem gosta daquele assunto específico. O mesmo vai acontecer se o nicho for um pouco maior, porque quando pensamos no longo prazo e que você vai crescer muito o seu negócio, um pequeno grupo vai acabar te limitando, porque quando atingir todos interessados naquele nicho acabou. Por isso, que em vez de pensar pequeno e restrito por um nicho que tem poucas pessoas interessadas, procure um que tenha uma maior possibilidade de crescimento, para que você queira crescer. Além disso, por mais que a sua intenção seja boa, às vezes pode prejudicar dependendo do seu assunto abordado, então considere um nicho que vá ajudar as pessoas e não prejudicá-las. E claro todo negócio precisa gerar receita para se manter vivo, então analise o mercado e veja como outros futuros concorrentes estão atualmente e se pergunte se estão conseguem se manter de forma sustentável. ---

links.title: Its just Peace we pray for
links.body:
?

Do we really need a war?  This is a punishable act for no reason, on innocent ordinary people. We all know war is never a solution to any key problem.  A peaceful solution for anything can be discussed calmly over a cup of tea. Let it be a day or a month or a year. But kindly avoid war.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPKbRPGh1p2K7hLbJ38gWgB3fNQzMo4CLdCBZvSkS8Yf8/1773167971873.jpg)


[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-bunch-of-signs-that-are-on-a-bed-tcQCdGIjxMY)

Definitely war has a very bad impact on the lives of peoples leading a  normal life. Why only normal people, even the soldiers deployed for this purpose has a family behind to look after.  It is sad when most of them don't turn up and the families have to go through a dark era, henceforth.

The amount of destruction war brings to people, nature and property seems listless. The years taken to build a nation, is just shattered with a single signal. Prices soar up, disturbing the life of a normal person.

To build a nation again, to retreive the smile in one's face, the reunion, the nightmare one goes through, starting everyyhing from scratch - all these are never going to be the same again.

The public elects a leader to protect them from the worst, but when the leader himself behaves worse than expected, the public becomes helpless.  

In general, in my perspective, no leader should stay in his respective position for more than two years. Beyond that, the same leader should never be nominated to stand as a  leader in any of the forthcoming election. Once his term of two years is completed, he should step and give way to the next fresh contestant. 

It is always better to welcome younger generations rather than the old ones. As technology is fast, the youngsters will come with new ideas to promote the goodness of the people and to protect the iinfrastructure of the country.

New turns and new implications happens only in the present generation. They are rather fast in getting things done than ruining other countries.  

Most of us in general expect peace and no longer war.  When two countries are preparing for a war, a second opinion from other countries should be taken into consideration. And this should be for the betterment of peace.  

Never a one man show should be praised,  instead a Global Rights Act should be implemented to step the concerned,  down from his position, in order to retain peace and prosperity of other countries.

links.title: A Clue To My Perfect Afternoon (#279)
links.body:
Describe the perfect afternoon for you. Where would it be? What would you be doing? Tell us the details that would make it perfect!
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQJ5JSWmCu4YNVGBvtDwNrgpZD5aNgXsEEFq1Em31hST5/image.png) Hello #ladiesofhive, happy new week. I trust you are having a beautiful time out there. In this week's prompt, I chose the first prompt: A perfect afternoon for me. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAw6G3hpiwXxQJ6gDaeN9ZRRYC5at3KvC356bMtNvmtc/image.png) [RosZie](https://pixabay.com/images/download/roszie-table-tennis-7415974_1920.png ) Can anything be perfect, so to speak, in this life? I learnt from my recent loss here that nothing is free in this life. There must be a sacrifice or something we give in exchange for that. I have come to this reality to enable me to heal from that loss and quickly move on. Believe me, it is working out super for me. Therefore, a perfect afternoon for me cannot happen for free; I must give something in exchange, like a time-out request from work, or it happens on my Saturdays while I put my chores on hold. I have asked myself several times since I saw this prompt if I do have perfect afternoons, and the answer is maybe when I was a child, but since I became an adult and started earning funds, my afternoons have been a time to work, real work. Even when I claim I am on break, there must be a few things to attend to, either on my phone through calls or messages. Sometimes, I do wish I had all the time to myself. Thinking aloud about my perfect afternoon would be a time out with my friends at the table tennis court, playing and chilling while listening to country or pop music. During my National Youth Service Corps, I played with my team, and we won the silver. I also got a merit certificate for that. After that, I only played occasionally. Recently, I struggled to get approval for an official time-out in my workplace for employee bonding that was nearly perfect. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdiLipNcHaFURRtVHbthUnutzoBxMy8TQw2MKWwivCMmY/image.png) [Michael Ali]( https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1694286066858-462538cd9886?q=80&w=1170&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D) On that fateful day, we went out to a chosen field, formed teams, and played various games at the event place. Danced, ate, and drank to our satisfaction while we also cracked jokes. Did story tellings and closed with an exchange of gifts between employees. It was a great day for all of us. It was also that day that most of the employees found out that I can play table tennis. In conclusion, all work and no play makes me a dull person. So, taking a few times off work in the afternoon and relaxing my brain and system is a kind of unwinding moment that would describe my perfect afternoon. Feel free to join the contest [here](https://ecency.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-279 ) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT66pGVYf4ZESvQddY2iD13s38hzQrtvM9JussceRXdAC/image.png)

links.title: Un viaje ineludible (En-Es)
links.body:
Reciban un abrazo desde la isla, no dejemos nunca de preguntarnos y añadir saberes a nuestra cultura y crecimiento personal.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmPXBp5ewjuDKbU8kQrZXsrR4e7dre6e5z9qw8GJkvHFGt/1773157849401.jpg
Pixabay

Estoy en un funeral y es inevitable pensar en lo seguro que es un final. El término de la vida debía verse como uno de los aspectos más valorados en nuestro propósito para el crecimiento del ser.

A pesar de saber que un día llegará el final de un ciclo para todos, nunca estamos lo suficientemente preparados. Es como el cierre de una factura donde evaluamos costos, sacrificios, beneficios, amor dado y recibido, y es la hora del arrepentimiento y el perdón.

La partida de un ser del plano terrenal nada tiene que ver con religiones o creencias; es un ciclo donde el alma decide o es forzada a dejar su envoltura material para ir a su evolución ante Dios. Ese destino ineludible ha sido, desde el origen de la humanidad, un espejo donde las culturas reflejan sus más profundos arraigos.

Todas las culturas tienen sus puntos de vista sobre el término de una vida y el supuesto tránsito del alma. La palabra funeral significa antorcha y, de alguna forma, es luz.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmVQsDEwi74JCYKmaaMX8m3aRyMWshJBWMadQW2bZ2fCLr/1773158648672.jpg
Pixabay

No puedo verlo sino como un viaje hermoso, sobre todo cuando el alma decide irse. Cuando el error separa el alma del cuerpo sin haber cumplido, cuesta más lograr la resignación.

No es necesario que todos crean o no en la reencarnación; todo lo que sucede antes, durante nuestra vida y después solo Dios lo sabe, es una frase muy recurrente cuando no tenemos certeza de algo. La vida es un misterio, como lo es el final.

Los funerales son el momento de ofrecer flores, luz y compañía de familia, amigos y conocidos. Es un momento de respeto y paz. En Cuba es usual que la noche sea amenizada con historias, anécdotas y a veces hasta hay que dirigir miradas a los que con entusiasmo cuentan los relatos a voz en cuello.

Algunos alegan que el finado les pidió que lo despidieran con un trago y alegría, y aunque el funeral no sea el lugar donde deba hacerse tal honor, también es poco probable evitarlo.

En este funeral donde me encuentro, hay mucho respeto y dolor por un padre que supo unir a una gran familia. Coqui tenía cuatro hijos cuando conoció a Laly, que tenía dos; tuvieron una hija en común que viene siendo el eslabón que une a esta inmensa familia en la que, aún en lugares distantes, corre por sus venas el amor.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmXfKBC3jjT7hBvNsNHg9YiqfFwn2GLdkYKAiTVhs17SU4/1773158139826.jpg
Pixabay

Coqui era un hombre risueño; cuando llegaba a una de nuestras casas decía con mucha alegría: bendigo este hogar, y creo que tenía la capacidad de bendecir la unión y el amor. A su hogar acudirán hermanos, hijos, sobrinos, nietos. Sus 82 años fueron una muestra de lo que es un excelente padre, hombre que se va de esta vida con el amor y los abrazos de todos porque hasta aquí han llegado incluso los que estaban en otros países. Eso solo lo logra quien da amor.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfFnEMCYnFkP4yn3RAjCC5Yi2Bw4pZMYk2wKE2HWeExdE/1739658658260.jpg

<sub>Gracias por visitar mi blog. Soy crítica de arte, investigadora social y amante de la cocina. Te invito a conocer más de mí, de mi país y de mis letras. Texto y fotos de mi propiedad.</sub>

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAxqWjfHD2t6iFUv1FivzQTFzsMmbGqywoexFuT14L8s/1750582840520.jpg

**An Unavoidable Journey**

Receive a hug from the island, let us never stop questioning and adding knowledge to our culture and personal growth.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmPXBp5ewjuDKbU8kQrZXsrR4e7dre6e5z9qw8GJkvHFGt/1773157849401.jpg
Pixabay

I am at a funeral, and it's impossible not to think about how certain an ending is. The end of life should be seen as one of the most valued aspects in our purpose for the growth of the being.

Despite knowing that one day the end of a cycle will come for everyone, we are never prepared enough. It is like closing an account where we evaluate costs, sacrifices, benefits, love given and received, and it is the time for regret and forgiveness.

The departure of a being from the earthly plane has nothing to do with religions or beliefs; it is a cycle where the soul decides or is forced to leave its material covering to go towards its evolution before God. That unavoidable destiny has been, since the origin of humanity, a mirror where cultures reflect their deepest roots.

All cultures have their points of view on the end of a life and the supposed transit of the soul. The word funeral means torch and, in some way, it is light.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmVQsDEwi74JCYKmaaMX8m3aRyMWshJBWMadQW2bZ2fCLr/1773158648672.jpg
Pixabay

I cannot see it as anything other than a beautiful journey, especially when the soul decides to leave. When a mistake separates the soul from the body without having fulfilled its purpose, it is harder to achieve resignation.

It is not necessary for everyone to believe or not in reincarnation; everything that happens before, during our life, and after, only God knows, is a very common phrase when we are unsure about something. Life is a mystery, as is the end.

Funerals are the time to offer flowers, light, and the company of family, friends, and acquaintances. It is a moment of respect and peace. In Cuba, it is usual for the night to be livened up with stories and anecdotes, and sometimes you even have to glare at those who enthusiastically tell tales at the top of their lungs.

Some claim that the deceased asked them to say goodbye with a drink and joy, and although the funeral may not be the place to do such an honor, it is also unlikely to avoid it.

In this funeral where I am, there is a lot of respect and pain for a father who knew how to unite a large family. Coqui had four children when he met Laly, who had two; they had a daughter together who became the link that unites this immense family in which, even in distant places, love runs through their veins.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmXfKBC3jjT7hBvNsNHg9YiqfFwn2GLdkYKAiTVhs17SU4/1773158139826.jpg
Pixabay

Coqui was a cheerful man; when he arrived at one of our houses he would say with great joy: I bless this home, and I believe he had the ability to bless unity and love. Brothers, children, nephews, and grandchildren will gather at his home. His 82 years were an example of what an excellent father is, a man who leaves this life with the love and hugs of everyone because even those who were in other countries have come here. That is only achieved by someone who gives love.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmWgq28rPHaXFgduE7yXQAE8pixHhnDVhpP2H8dgavZuJ1/1771587042134.jpg


<sub>Thank you for visiting my blog. I am an art critic, social researcher, and food lover. I invite you to learn more about me, my country, and my writings. Text and photos are my own.</sub>

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfFnEMCYnFkP4yn3RAjCC5Yi2Bw4pZMYk2wKE2HWeExdE/1739658658260.jpg

All, doing a 5 minute freewrite. Thank you for reading.

<center>
![image.png](https://www.unicare.cz/image/727/36/adobestock_647996942.jpeg)

[Source](https://www.unicare.cz/image/727/36/adobestock_647996942.jpeg)

Larry is someone who loves to eat spicy food and always like to challenge his own limit. Everytime he successfully clear his record of spice, he will start planning for the next. 

This time round, there is a challenge offered by a restaurant with a tiering of rewards should an individual cleared a certain level of spiciness on the food they serve. 

Based on the last item that Larry had cleared without any issue, it was only at level 7 on the list that this restaurant offered. Larry felt determined to break his limit again today and win a pair of return tickets to Tokyo. 

However, little did he know that he overestimated himself and had to be on sick leave the next day. When his supervisor asks his colleagues and they shared with him what happened, he just shouted, \

\n\nApparently, Larry's challenge was to finish a bowl of stewed beef with a concoction of very potent chilli and pepper mix and he ended up with serious diarrhoea that made him unable to report for work.

links.title: A Journey of Kindness and Long Walks: My Bus Ride from Pandi to Starmall EDSA-Shaw, Metro Manila (Part 1)
links.body:
![collage.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/AJoJZ71o2jg83z5bhXVCpyVXDXFGq6wK3bh7T8jYLHWXfL4c4uENpvTudaRfTHF.jpeg)

**Hello Hive Fam! 👋**

I wasn’t able to write a blog yesterday because I had to travel to the National Capital Region. Yesterday was my scheduled visit again to Metro Manila for some important errands. This blog is just Part 1 of my trip, since I want to highlight what happened before leaving Pandi, Bulacan and after arriving at Starmall EDSA-Shaw in Mandaluyong. So here it goes…

My journey started at the Pandi P2P Bus Station. A few minutes after boarding, a young boy beggar handed me a white envelope asking for any amount so he could buy food or even biscuits.

![envelope from beggar.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoAajBfFgsfjCVKCHyHQUNgWRcCkwYJ77An5vmkvcrL37LjXJ7rEK39fyYNuNwDeSEx.jpeg)

I was touched by the words written on the envelope, so I placed ₱100 inside. The boy’s face lit up with happiness. I didn’t take a photo of him for privacy reasons, but I was glad to help in my own small way. Despite my own financial struggles, I always believe that it’s better to give than to receive. That simple act of kindness made my day brighter.

![my selfie in bus.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23vsNbJK8ZUc24hnDPD87LTnpEd5QSfAgGdGjxntNEHUAXZvoiMMwc6YuWPNAr5EQRvhE.jpeg)

After that, I took a selfie inside the bus and captured the view outside the window, staring at the market nearby. The trip went smoothly, and soon I arrived at Trinoma Bus Terminal.

![inside buse looking at massway.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EorznWwfnrgCJZK24GVHqP5v2Y1KFrurfMqyAMi5oXzCiCw6TEKDD3kb56Haeis7o2G.jpeg)

From Trinoma, I needed to walk about 20 minutes to reach the bus carousel station so I could ride toward Ortigas Bus Carousel Station. Along the way, I managed to snap photos of the famous Solaire Building and the road in front of it.

![looking at solaire building.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23x17JakGYHCnfGEkLEhdFc6az3Tmnij8xd9rFsaqD52kp4c6cmoQpsG39bzi3kDMx4jn.jpeg)

![solaire.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoyPRfaPuYGBUy23zran7cRk5bVUjjNGrVJ4rHCPQ8g7mzKttGYr2MtsTAmFw1dHPPE.jpeg)

The bus stopped briefly at Philam Bus Carousel Station in EDSA, then continued until I reached Ortigas. Instead of booking a motorcycle taxi to Starmall, I decided to walk another 20 minutes. Walking is the best form of exercise, plus I saved ₱50–₱70.

![philam bus carousel station.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoAaCuvY91urP9Ctw9ktxmZfpCQ6oWpc159NvpBfFCeVK8K8cMf67QtMLfVJCv8if97.jpeg)

While walking along EDSA, I took a few photos of the road. When I reached SM Megamall, I knew I was close to Starmall. I also captured a photo of a tall building beside SM Megamall, which I assume is owned by SM.

![walking time in EDSA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/Ep3dqZNhhpPBJ5JXfobRQduNPdH8EQWjJFpMYgjjoiydzaHaHNdhvxZsLxYhzATd35P.jpeg)

![walking time in EDSA2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/Eoc6bgPCHdjMt3jgZ8dXwajRhiDFCwevo8ebMUhWtZRWNd5odFpmRaDrCNYHRxmt6om.jpeg)

![looking at tall building beside SM Megamall.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23yTbBtiKKRYnb57ijjCBLvTH9iWaVS8zsRfL3Me1MxiyT2H488CA6ywZzDP4cmgqhsTd.jpeg)


Finally, I arrived in front of Starmall EDSA-Shaw. I took some photos there and rested for about 10 minutes before continuing my journey.

![on my way to Starmall.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/Ep3dpZH89TihrZXdWptnpz1jR4W26AgAtmYjrcWSfb7ZNgEmci5h8cuPdyqiMXW9zJx.jpeg)

This marks the first part of my trip to NCR. I’ll continue sharing the rest of my adventure in Part 2 of this blog. Thank you for your patience and understanding, Hive Fam, as I’m still feeling the tiredness from all the walking and commuting.

![looking at EDSA while in front of Starmall.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EopsziQW1FQH2QS38MTpe5wJHhi3n8GZ7X3ysnHQQPFbzpaJ1iwPUAur3tFjQXePqn6.jpeg)

![looking at EDSA while in front of Starmall2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/Ep5mBfUNjMpuFjkgkdw6JRzdwh5F421UkH6jxQvYaGwmGpnJfSqTqLswKXCRzYp2RvV.jpeg)

As I wrap up this post, I want to take a moment to sincerely thank each of you who has taken the time to read, engage, and support my journey here on Hive. Your encouragement, comments, and presence mean more than words can fully capture. Writing and sharing ideas is rewarding in itself, but knowing that there are people out there who value and appreciate these efforts makes the experience truly special. Every upvote, every thoughtful response, and every quiet read is a reminder that this community thrives because of the kindness and support we give one another. I am deeply grateful for your continued support, and I look forward to growing, learning, and sharing more with you in the days ahead. Until my next post, thank you for reading and supporting my journey! 🙏💙

links.title: ⚽🇮🇹 My Life in Soccerverse #13: Inter walled, Vault on fire/Inter murata, Vault in fiamme 🇺🇸⚽
links.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSMNMjkD6X9MF9Jfe2BxPh7yagb3KqeMmZC13pGMskvvJ/MLIS#13.png</center>

🇺🇸 English | 🇮🇹 Italiano Below

Hello and welcome back to “My Life in Soccerverse”! Chapter thirteen takes us to the round of Saturday, March 7, a matchday made of defensive walls raised against Inter and spectacular comebacks scattered all over the Victory Vault. At the top we struggle to find a way through sides that choose to sit deep and tuck in, while elsewhere in our universe we see big wins, unexpected exploits and important statements in both the relegation battle and the promotion race.

# League Results – Saturday Matchday
🇮🇹 **Inter**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/3195c5768c59dfd0958499c2058419a4731528e8e2bd86091de0fdcb03e5e9b4.png</center>

By now, whenever teams face us the script is almost written: ultra-defensive 4-5-1, compact shape and everyone sitting behind the ball. When the opponent is Bologna, on a traditionally tricky pitch, the chances of breaking through shrink even further and we end up with yet another goalless draw that weighs more than it looks, because it truly feels like we’re smashing into a well-organised wall.

🇵🇱 **Raków Częstochowa**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/61a66294b939829a8e1206b85f40917d33dd56632339b6f1765e8b87d4791a88.png</center>

We host a small side, a newly promoted team that however defends with great discipline and has no intention of playing the part of the victim. We attack, create and keep pushing, but Arka Gdynia sell their skin very dearly and walk away with a draw that feels very much like a missed opportunity for us, especially considering how many attempts we produced to try and unlock it.

🇺🇦 **Viktoriya Sumy**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/03508648c8ef2e7c1bbe53a66d8cb68ead08f8159103e74a87a1e6cd9b37acf1.png</center>

Magnificent Viktoriya, who collect a second consecutive win away at Ruh Lviv in a match where the final scoreline is much more flattering to them than the performance on the pitch. The game is anything but balanced: we dictate play, control the key moments and bring home three points that move us to just three off the top, while remaining fully aware that our real target is survival, and this result is simply another massive step towards it.

🇷🇴 **Bihor Oradea**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/e910b972fb942df1f732651d0faf1b3c3b70f04fb5d5d2f187274f521ce762d3.png</center>

We visit U Craiova 1948, one of the best-equipped sides in the entire league, and they remind us of it straight away by going two up in the first twelve minutes. From there, though, Bihor’s fury kicks in: we crank up the tempo, change gears and completely flip the script with a devastating comeback. Our march goes on and the message to the rest of Romania is crystal clear: we never give up, not even when the match looks already written.

🇷🇺 **Amkar**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/a6abd0346ffffb8b70a3aba1e51525403af84a79d118541b08647b7318c4c08d.png</center>

At home to Tyumen we get almost everything right from a tactical standpoint: we dominate possession, shoot a ton and create a huge number of clean chances. The only thing missing is the final touch, because despite our offensive volume the goal simply won’t come, and we end up with a draw that leaves plenty of regret but also reinforces the image of a solid side that can impose its game on anyone.

🇹🇷 **Denizlispor**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/679edb7f0da71e78131f47770b7c1e3a57de63dfca7944af8fa2236fc8ea17ae.png</center>

We host 68 Aksaray Belediyespor and continue our steamroller run with an authoritative performance in which we control tempo, space and intensity without ever really looking like dropping anything. Another three points safely in the bag and our cushion over fourth place grows again, up to seven points now, making this once unthinkable promotion charge more and more concrete.

🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 **Edinburgh City**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/4cdfa718924ba8e6de7a24e9b1240d6969bd401f5316724ebd53be957022c161.png</center>

Kelty Hearts end up playing the part of sacrificial lambs on our day of resurgence: we approach the game in exactly the right way, push from the very start and quickly steer it in our direction. A comfortable, wide win, very little suffering and an immediate restart in the fight for the top places, where we fully intend to stay until the end.

🇬🇷 **Panachaiki**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/2c27cf4c801300e1a00f1e61e1a3e25314b22f779ca3818e1eddd5676e7ef62b.png</center>

After last match’s painful defeat, we travel to PAOK II with a clear desire to put things right straight away. This time it’s our turn to deliver a comprehensive win, with a clinical and efficient performance that allows us to latch back on to the leading pack and rejoin fourth place, getting our campaign firmly back on track.

🇦🇹 **Krems**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/1ae327ef3437cca07070e2fc5aeec2b6f14c3f8138a077c6cd9e31b4e6152140.png</center>

Five wins in the last six for a Krems side brimming with confidence, who at home get the better of Wiener SC in a scrappy game handled with real maturity. Fourth place is ours and the third spot that grants promotion is still seven points away, but with this kind of pace and so much of the season still to play, dreaming is absolutely allowed.

🇧🇬 **Sayana Haskovo**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/87540a94054de89afe1b5c433eb81e5ed11110e566dc73e0e765fa974b19e6e8.png</center>

Newly promoted against relegated Spartak Varna, on paper the matchup looks heavily tilted against us, especially away from home. Instead, we turn in a gritty, focused performance, stay switched on throughout and just edge it, earning a win that weighs a ton both for our survival hopes and for the squad’s self-belief.

🇭🇷 **Segesta Sisak**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/ddf570fa5bc9827a2e986152420c4afff501c8293b1ea8414a363bcd6befa881.png</center>

We host Nehaj and the game immediately tilts our way: after just four minutes they go down to ten men and from that point on it turns into a one-way symphony. We stay in control, manage tempo and chances, and close it out with a clean, comfortable win that allows us to further consolidate our position in the table.

🇫🇷 **Dieppe**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/5da7dabe7a3d7e5426124cdbfbced4b0048f0e19848a3522e52856748de4c283.png</center>

At home to Bayonne we come out flying and after just over half an hour we have already pointed the match firmly in our direction with a two-goal cushion. From then on the script doesn’t change: we control without really suffering and remain only two points off the two second-placed sides, making sure those above us can clearly feel our breath on their necks.

🇨🇿 **Zlín**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/ef70e6ac547418a08aeadc5a8624cb6ed7d0f233d91613e2730898779c112dc6.png</center>

After the heavy setback against Admira Praha we needed a reaction, and poor Jiskra Domažlice end up paying the price. We dominate them for long stretches, rediscover our flow, goals and good feelings, and collect more crucial points in our push towards a promotion zone that, step by step, is starting to come back into view.

# Balance and outlook
It was a round that’s hard to label with a single word, split between the walls stopping Inter at the top and the explosions of energy produced by our sides in the rest of the Victory Vault. Viktoriya keep building a survival campaign that deserves applause, Bihor pull off a comeback for the ages, Denizlispor and Krems solidify increasingly realistic ambitions, while Panachaiki, Edinburgh City, Dieppe and Zlín all answer the bell after tricky moments. On one hand we’re still struggling to break down ever-tighter defences, but on the other this chapter once again proves that our teams know how to strike hard when intensity, character and the ability to flip momentum are what matter most: the perfect ingredients to make the next chapters of “My Life in Soccerverse” even more thrilling.

🇮🇹 Italiano | 🇺🇸 English Above

Ciao e bentornati a “My Life in Soccerverse”! Il tredicesimo capitolo ci porta al turno di sabato 7 marzo, una giornata fatta di muri alzati contro l’Inter e di rimonte clamorose sparse per il Victory Vault. In alto fatichiamo a trovare la via del gol contro chi sceglie di chiudersi a riccio, mentre nelle altre latitudini del nostro universo fioccano vittorie pesanti, exploit inattesi e conferme importanti nella corsa salvezza e nella lotta promozione.

# Risultati – Turno di Campionato (Sabato)
🇮🇹 **Inter**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/3195c5768c59dfd0958499c2058419a4731528e8e2bd86091de0fdcb03e5e9b4.png</center>

Ormai quando si gioca contro di noi il copione è quasi scritto: 4-5-1 iper difensivo, squadra corta e tutti dietro la linea della palla. Se poi l’avversario si chiama Bologna, su un campo storicamente ostico, le possibilità di sfondare si riducono ulteriormente e ne viene fuori un altro pareggio a reti bianche che pesa più di quanto sembri, perché la sensazione è quella di sbattere contro un muro ben organizzato.

🇵🇱 **Raków Częstochowa**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/61a66294b939829a8e1206b85f40917d33dd56632339b6f1765e8b87d4791a88.png</center>

Ospitiamo una piccola, una neopromossa che però si difende con grande ordine e non ha alcuna intenzione di fare la comparsa. Attacchiamo, creiamo, insistiamo, ma l’Arka Gdynia vende carissima la pelle e porta a casa un pari che per noi sa tanto di occasione sprecata, soprattutto considerando la quantità di tentativi prodotti per provare a sbloccarla.

🇺🇦 **Viktoriya Sumy**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/03508648c8ef2e7c1bbe53a66d8cb68ead08f8159103e74a87a1e6cd9b37acf1.png</center>

Grandissimo Viktoriya, che in casa del Ruh Lviv infila la seconda vittoria consecutiva in una partita in cui il punteggio finale è più bugiardo di quanto dica il campo. La gara è tutto fuorché equilibrata: comandiamo il gioco, controlliamo i momenti chiave e portiamo via tre punti che ci avvicinano fino a -3 dalla vetta, pur restando ben consapevoli che l’obiettivo reale resta la salvezza, verso cui questo successo rappresenta un ulteriore passo importantissimo.

🇷🇴 **Bihor Oradea**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/e910b972fb942df1f732651d0faf1b3c3b70f04fb5d5d2f187274f521ce762d3.png</center>

Facciamo visita all’U Craiova 1948, una delle squadre più attrezzate dell’intero campionato, e ce lo ricordano subito andando avanti di due reti nei primi dodici minuti. Da lì però si accende la furia del Bihor: alziamo i giri, cambiamo ritmo e ribaltiamo completamente la partita con una rimonta devastante. La nostra marcia continua e il messaggio al resto della Romania è chiaro: non molliamo mai, nemmeno quando la partita sembra già segnata.

🇷🇺 **Amkar**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/a6abd0346ffffb8b70a3aba1e51525403af84a79d118541b08647b7318c4c08d.png</center>

In casa contro il Tyumen prepariamo tutto in maniera quasi perfetta dal punto di vista tattico: dominiamo il possesso, tiriamo tantissimo e costruiamo una quantità notevole di occasioni pulite. Quello che manca è solo l’ultimo tocco, perché nonostante la mole offensiva la porta resta stregata e chiudiamo con un pari che lascia tanto rammarico, ma anche la conferma di una squadra solida e capace di imporre il proprio gioco.

🇹🇷 **Denizlispor**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/679edb7f0da71e78131f47770b7c1e3a57de63dfca7944af8fa2236fc8ea17ae.png</center>

Ospitiamo il 68 Aksaray Belediyespor e proseguiamo il nostro percorso da schiacciasassi, con una prestazione autoritaria in cui gestiamo tempi, spazi e intensità senza mai dare la sensazione di poter lasciare qualcosa per strada. Altri tre punti messi in cassaforte e il margine sul quarto posto che sale ancora, portandoci a +7 nella corsa promozione e rendendo sempre più concreta un’inaspettata scalata.

🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 **Edinburgh City**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/4cdfa718924ba8e6de7a24e9b1240d6969bd401f5316724ebd53be957022c161.png</center>

Il Kelty Hearts finisce per fare da vittima sacrificale nella nostra giornata di riscatto: approcciamo la partita nel modo giusto, spingiamo fin da subito e la gara prende rapidamente una direzione chiara. Vittoria larga, poche sofferenze e ripartenza immediata nella lotta per le zone nobili della classifica, dove abbiamo tutte le intenzioni di restare fino alla fine.

🇬🇷 **Panachaiki**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/2c27cf4c801300e1a00f1e61e1a3e25314b22f779ca3818e1eddd5676e7ef62b.png</center>

Dopo la cocente sconfitta della scorsa gara, andiamo sul campo del Paok II con la voglia di rimettere subito le cose a posto. Stavolta tocca a noi firmare il successo rotondo, con una prestazione concreta e cinica che ci permette di ricollegarci al treno delle prime e di riagganciare il quarto posto, rimettendo la nostra corsa sui binari giusti.

🇦🇹 **Krems**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/1ae327ef3437cca07070e2fc5aeec2b6f14c3f8138a077c6cd9e31b4e6152140.png</center>

Cinque vittorie nelle ultime sei per un Krems in piena fiducia, che tra le mura amiche supera il Wiener SC al termine di una gara sporca ma gestita con grande maturità. Il quarto posto è in tasca e la terza piazza utile per la promozione dista ancora sette punti, ma con questo ritmo e tanto campionato ancora da giocare, sognare non è affatto vietato.

🇧🇬 **Sayana Haskovo**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/87540a94054de89afe1b5c433eb81e5ed11110e566dc73e0e765fa974b19e6e8.png</center>

Neopromossa contro il retrocesso Spartak Varna, i valori sulla carta sembrano raccontare una partita tutta in salita per noi, soprattutto in casa loro. Invece tiriamo fuori una prova di carattere, attenta e concentrata, riuscendo a spuntarla di misura e a portare via un successo che pesa tantissimo in chiave salvezza e autostima.

🇭🇷 **Segesta Sisak**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/ddf570fa5bc9827a2e986152420c4afff501c8293b1ea8414a363bcd6befa881.png</center>

Ospitiamo il Nehaj e la partita si mette subito in discesa: dopo appena quattro minuti gli avversari restano in dieci e da lì in poi diventa una sinfonia a senso unico. Giochiamo in controllo, gestiamo ritmi e occasioni, e chiudiamo con una vittoria pulita che ci permette di consolidare ulteriormente la nostra posizione in classifica.

🇫🇷 **Dieppe**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/5da7dabe7a3d7e5426124cdbfbced4b0048f0e19848a3522e52856748de4c283.png</center>

In casa contro il Bayonne partiamo forte e dopo poco più di mezz’ora abbiamo già indirizzato la partita con due gol di vantaggio. Da lì in poi il copione non cambia più: controlliamo senza soffrire troppo e restiamo a soli due punti dalle seconde, facendo sentire in modo molto concreto il nostro fiato sul collo a chi ci precede.

🇨🇿 **Zlín**

<center>https://cdn.publish0x.com/prod/fs/images/ef70e6ac547418a08aeadc5a8624cb6ed7d0f233d91613e2730898779c112dc6.png</center>

Dopo la brusca battuta d’arresto contro l’Admira Praha avevamo bisogno di una reazione, e il malcapitato Jiskra Domažlice finisce per pagarne il prezzo. Li dominiamo per larghi tratti, ritroviamo gioco, gol e sensazioni positive, e mettiamo altri punti fondamentali nella corsa verso una zona promozione che, passo dopo passo, torna ad avvicinarsi.

# Bilancio e prospettive
È stato un turno difficile da etichettare, diviso tra i muri che bloccano l’Inter e le esplosioni di energia delle nostre squadre nel resto del Victory Vault. Viktoriya continua a costruire una salvezza da applausi, Bihor firma una rimonta da urlo, Denizlispor e Krems consolidano ambizioni sempre più concrete, mentre Panachaiki, Edinburgh City, Dieppe e Zlín rispondono presente dopo i momenti complicati. Se da una parte facciamo fatica a scardinare difese sempre più chiuse, dall’altra si conferma una volta di più che le nostre squadre sanno colpire duro quando contano intensità, carattere e capacità di ribaltare le inerzie: ingredienti perfetti per rendere i prossimi capitoli di “My Life in Soccerverse” ancora più avvincenti.

links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWp4Gvj2uFgcFtYT4WH63MwA15y1AcWyx5gMhsFLadRzs/1773167380240.jpg)


https://youtu.be/1VDNco5zYBY?si=tUr7w8t6X_4gY2e2



Hola a todos, hoy vamos a interpretar Misty. Es una canción que es calmada, tiene un ambiente muy particular, porque aunque es suave y tranquila, tiene una melodía que conecta con las personas. No es de esas piezas que necesitan mucho para llamar la atención, más bien todo funciona por lo delicada que es.

La compuso Erroll Garner en los años 50. Según cuentan, nació primero como una idea que él tocó en el piano casi improvisando, y después se convirtió en una de las baladas más conocidas del jazz. Con el tiempo muchos músicos la interpretaron y terminó siendo uno de esos estándares que siempre vuelven a aparecer.

Lo bonito de Misty es que la melodía es muy cantable. Tiene subidas y bajadas que parecen muy naturales, casi como si la canción estuviera hablando en vez de solo sonar. Por eso funciona tan bien cuando se hace con voz, porque la letra encaja muy bien con ese carácter suave que tiene la música y se que le va a gustar, porque la cantante tiene una voz preciosa

  La vamos a hacer en guitarra y voz. La voz lleva la melodía principal y la guitarra acompaña marcando la armonía y el ritmo de una forma tranquila. La idea es que todo suene lo más natural posible.
Esperamos que la disfruten.

English 

Hello everyone, today we're going to play Misty. It's a calm song with a very particular atmosphere because, although it's soft and tranquil, it has a melody that connects with people. It's not one of those pieces that needs a lot to grab your attention; rather, everything works because of its delicate nature.

It was composed by Erroll Garner in the 1950s. The story goes that it started as an idea he played on the piano, almost improvising, and then it became one of the most well-known jazz ballads. Over time, many musicians have performed it, and it ended up being one of those standards that always resurfaces.

The beautiful thing about Misty is that the melody is very singable. It has rises and falls that sound very natural, almost as if the song were speaking instead of just playing. That's why it works so well when sung, because the lyrics fit perfectly with the music's gentle character, and I know you're going to like it because the singer has a beautiful voice.

We're going to play it with just guitar and vocals.  The vocals carry the main melody, while the guitar provides a gentle accompaniment, establishing the harmony and rhythm. The goal is for everything to sound as natural as possible.
We hope you enjoy it.

links.title: Three artists I'm seeing live next week
links.body:
It's been a long time since my last #threetunetuesday and I'm not so active these days on Hive for a couple of reasons, but this is not the space to talk about that.
We are here for the music and I just realized that next week I'm going to see three bands live in Milan, three like our #ttt format! Let's go!

#### THE RUMJACKS

https://youtu.be/OzLEphuP9YI

I don't listen to celtic punk that much but I've been to some festivals with this genre of bands and I assure you, those nights I had the most fun in my whole life. The Rumjacks are the only band I know and listen to frequently and I'll se them live this Saturday.

Light in my shadow is a song stuck in my heart because it reminds me of a very important person I had in my life which I was used to go to all these celtic festivals with. She's the light in my shadow and listening to this song reminds me of those moments of pure happiness, dancing in circles, just having fun together and enjoying the moment like there's no tomorrow. Listening to this song always makes me cry.

#### AIRBOURNE

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8myjtCqI0qw

Basically AC/DC on cocaine, I love Airbourne. They never let me down and I'm never tired of listening to their music. When I need a boost of power and adrenaline, they're my go to band to hype me up.
I already saw them live three times and this Sunday will be the fourth one. Last time I saw them in Milan it's been one of the best concert of my life.
I will never forget the singer Joel O'Keefe coming among the audience, sitting on the shoulders of a man of the staff and hitting a beer can to his head untill it exploded. I was just behind him, getting my beer shower 😂

#### POPPY

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iM4oQWX-AaM

I've already told how much I love Poppy in some old posts. I'm not ashamed to say I'm a total fanboy for her. I hoped her last album Empty Hands was better then it actually is, but I don't really care. It's still a good album and her concert is the one I'm most hyped to see. I even got the super VIP package with the early entry and some signed stuff. I really hope to be in the first line to admire my queen in all her beauty, screaming my face off 😍

links.title: My Actifit Report Card: March 10 2026
links.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gb51e1f468ee385d7d57c36a1ceb9839eb13954c89ce9884c31814b59bc0afbe99bc5e12f2d2f65b48e03dc1af0f57d8a108c76c2e1e38b50b047c31c3f0b7d34_640.jpg)
My last walk was along the South Downs Way, a stunning trail that stretches through the rolling hills of Sussex. I ventured out on a crisp autumn day, the kind where the air is fresh, and the leaves are painted in vibrant shades of red and gold. As I set off from the charming village of Alfriston, I passed by the historic parish church of St. Andrew, which dates back to the Norman period. The architecture is quite striking, with its flint walls and the beautiful yew tree in the churchyard, believed to be over a thousand years old. The path meandered through fields of grazing sheep, and I was treated to some magnificent views of the surrounding countryside. I spotted the iconic Seven Sisters cliffs in the distance; their chalky white faces looked even more dramatic against the blue sky. It’s amazing to think how these natural landmarks have stood for millennia, shaped by the elements. Along the way, I met a fellow hiker named Lucy, who was also enjoying the scenery. We struck up a conversation about our shared love for history and how the South Downs are rich in archaeological sites. We discussed the ancient long barrows and the Neolithic flint tools that have been found in the area. It’s fascinating how this landscape is not just beautiful but also steeped in stories of past civilizations. As we walked together, we shared tips about other walks in the region. Lucy recommended the Cuckmere River route, which is famous for its picturesque meanders and is a great spot for birdwatching, especially during migration season. By the time I returned to Alfriston, I felt invigorated by the scenery and the friendly conversation. It was a reminder of how walking not only allows us to connect with nature but also with other people who share our interests. The South Downs Way is definitely a trail I would recommend to anyone looking for both beauty and history in England! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_
