links.title: Día de pedidos especiales, mucho calor y una cita linda 💫
links.body:
>

¿Cómo se encuentran, queridos lectores? Espero que súper bien 🤍 Por mi parte me encuentro muy bien.

La semana pasada me perdí un poco de Hive y varias cositas quedaron pendientes por publicar, pero estuve tan ocupada que no alcancé a preparar los siguientes posts y mucho menos a editar algunas fotitos 😅. Pero bueno, poco a poco me estoy poniendo al día.

El recap que les traigo hoy es del **14 de febrero, San Valentín** 💌 (sí, casi un mes después se los traigo… me disculpan 🙈). Este año fue muy distinto a los anteriores, porque ahora tengo pareja y tuvimos una cita muy linda, tranquila y con comida deliciosa.

<div class=\

> ![sv 3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rousess/EopuJWeah2pWd52Z7jaCHxMBjHs4VUG6sXSU8qnwUts6VtaLcRs3ePBZ4tLVtBR7P3v.png) Pero antes de contarles qué hicimos ese día, debo mencionar que la mañana comenzó **FULL ocupada** sacando unos pedidos que habían hecho el día anterior. Eran unas **Chips Love Bags**, un nuevo producto que sacamos en **Saikoma**. Este detalle incluía **6 polaroids, 2 stickers y una bolsita personalizada** con una foto, ya fuera de una pareja o de unas amigas. Fue un detalle bastante sencillo, pero muy bonito para regalar en esta temporada 💕. Ese día saqué **tres pedidos de estas bolsitas**, y además preparé otro pedido que consistía en unas impresiones doble cara que formaban una especie de revista. La verdad, me pareció un detalle súper lindo y especial. Después de pasar toda la mañana en eso, a las **11 am** tomé camino hacia **Plaza 4 Caras**, donde estaría Mafer para entregarle los pedidos, ya que ella sería la encargada de distribuirlos 📍. Aproveché y me quedé un rato por allá, aproximadamente **dos horas y media en el stand de Just Dance**. Pero el calor estaba tan fuerte que me afectó bastante 🥵. Tenía muchas ganas de bailar, pero honestamente ni siquiera pude hacerlo decentemente, el calor me dejó completamente sin energía.

> ![sv 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rousess/EqDnwvJmPkBnC5okLRQohzttRkieWMV2GKs2osEk2DU1F3Ee6FUoMsT5vwu4u8aAzkW.png) Después de ese pequeño golpe de calor regresé a mi casa a **descansar, bañarme y arreglarme** para salir nuevamente, porque había quedado con mi novio de ir a almorzar a las **3 pm** (sí, un poquito tarde lo sé 😅). Quería verme y sentirme **linda y coqueta**, y creo que lo logré… lástima que **no me tomé fotos ese día**. ¿Pueden creer que no nos tomamos ni una sola foto? Tan lindos que estábamos 🙃. El restaurante al que fuimos queda en **Playa Cangrejo**. Es un lugar estilo buffet, aunque curiosamente ese día no estaba organizado de esa manera. En lugar de servirnos nosotros mismos, hacíamos el pedido y nos traían las porciones ya servidas. Algo que no estuvo muy bueno fue la atención. Por alguna razón no había suficiente personal, así que esperamos aproximadamente **45 minutos para que nos atendieran** y luego **unos 25 minutos más para que llegara la comida** 😅. Pero bueno, al menos todo estaba **muy delicioso**, así que valió un poco la pena la espera. Como todavía teníamos energía y no queríamos regresar a casa tan temprano, decidimos pasar un rato por **Plaza Mayor**. Estuvimos caminando, compré algunas cositas, y después de eso hicimos una parada obligatoria en **McDonald’s** para comernos unos heladitos 🍦. Y como siempre estaban **divinos**.

> ![sv 4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rousess/Ep3fM372inBQSyERnBe8L33N66T1tC5WxieybhMqYaarWi7PDcAPPXkiBWb8U4eaHiG.png) La verdad es que fue uno de esos días largos, con mucho movimiento desde temprano, pero que termina de una manera tranquila y bonita 🤍. No fue un San Valentín lleno de regalos o grandes planes, pero sí estuvo lleno de momentos simples que se disfrutan mucho cuando estás con la persona correcta. A veces las mejores citas no son las más planificadas, sino las que se sienten naturales, cómodas y llenas de risas. Y aunque no tengamos tantas fotos para recordarlo, me queda el recuerdo de un día sencillo, especial y lleno de cariño 💕. Nos leemos en el próximo post ✨. **English ver.** How are you doing, dear readers? I hope you’re doing great 🤍 As for me, I’m doing really well. Last week I was a bit absent from Hive and a few things were left pending to publish. I was so busy that I didn’t have time to prepare my next posts or even edit some photos 😅. But little by little I’m catching up. The recap I’m bringing you today is from **February 14th, Valentine’s Day** 💌 (yes, I’m sharing it almost a month later… please forgive me 🙈). This year was very different from previous ones because I’m now in a relationship, and we had a really lovely, relaxed date with delicious food. But before I tell you what we did that day, I should mention that the morning started **SUPER busy** fulfilling some orders that had come in the day before. They were **Chips Love Bags**, a new product we launched at **Saikoma**. Each one included **6 Polaroids, 2 stickers, and a personalized little bag** with a photo either of a couple or of friends. It was a simple but very cute detail to give as a gift during this season 💕. That day I prepared **three of these orders**, and I also worked on another order that consisted of double-sided prints that came together like a small magazine. Honestly, I thought it was such a beautiful and thoughtful idea. After spending the entire morning working on that, at **11 a.m.** I headed to **Plaza 4 Caras**, where Mafer was going to be so I could hand over the orders, since she was in charge of delivering them 📍. While I was there, I stayed for a while about **two and a half hours at the Just Dance stand**. But the heat was so intense that it really affected me 🥵. I really wanted to dance, but honestly I couldn’t even manage one song properly because the heat completely drained my energy. After that little heat exhaustion moment, I went back home to **rest, take a shower, and get ready** to go out again, because I had plans to meet my boyfriend for lunch at **3 p.m.** (yes, a little late, I know 😅). I wanted to look and feel **cute and a little flirty**, and I think I achieved it… unfortunately **I didn’t take any photos that day**. Can you believe we didn’t take a single picture? And we looked so nice 🙃. The restaurant we went to is located in **Playa Cangrejo**. It’s usually a buffet-style place, but interestingly that day it wasn’t set up that way. Instead of serving ourselves, we ordered from the menu and they brought the portions already plated. One thing that wasn’t so great was the service. For some reason they were short-staffed, so we waited about **45 minutes to be attended to**, and then **another 25 minutes for the food to arrive** 😅. But at least everything was **really delicious**, so the wait was somewhat worth it. Since we still had some energy and didn’t want to go back home too early, we decided to stop by **Plaza Mayor** for a while. We walked around, I bought a few things, and after that we made a mandatory stop at **McDonald’s** to get some ice cream 🍦. And as always it was **delicious**. Honestly, it was one of those long days that starts with a lot of movement and activity, but ends in a calm and beautiful way 🤍. It wasn’t a Valentine’s Day full of gifts or big plans, but it was full of simple moments that you really enjoy when you’re with the right person. Sometimes the best dates aren’t the most planned ones, but the ones that feel natural, comfortable, and full of laughter. And even though we don’t have many photos to remember it by, I’ll always have the memory of a simple, special day full of love 💕. See you in the next post ✨. **Créditos** - La traducción del texto fue hecho a través
>Cambridge\n- El diseño de la portada fue hecho en
>Canva\n- Las fotos fueron tomadas por mí y otras por mi novio.

links.title: Why Platinum Is Gaining Attention Among Precious Metal Investors
links.body:
**Why Platinum Is Gaining Attention Among Precious Metal Investors** Precious metals have been regarded as the perfect option to diversify your portfolio. While gold and silver attract the attention of investors, platinum is rapidly emerging as a compelling alternative. With the increasing demand for industrial demand, investors mostly turn towards platinum.

**Platinum: A Precious Metal with Unique Value** Platinum is one of the rarest precious metals on Earth, which is more scarce than gold. A large amount of platinum comes from South Africa and Russia. It shows that any geopolitical tension and mining operations can affect supply. The [platinum spot price](https://aubullion.com/live-platinum-prices) reflects the rarity and industrial importance. Investors can monitor the platinum price to identify potential entry opportunities in the market sentiment.

**The Power of Industrial Demand in Today’s Market** Compared to gold, platinum has gained extensive industrial applications. It has been used in various roles, including automotive catalytic converters, chemical processing and medical devices.

**Why Platinum Is Often Considered Undervalued Compared to Gold** Historically, platinum is regarded as a premium asset compared to gold because of its rarity. In recent years, platinum has been priced lower, creating more opportunities for investors. Investors who are looking for long-term market goals can track the platinum cost per ounce.

**Limited Supply Is Strengthening Market Conditions** South Africa produces the majority of global production. When it comes to mint platinum, investors pay attention towards power shortages, labour disputes and operational challenges in mining areas. For this, dealers and platinum investors are guided to follow the [platinum price chart](https://aubullion.com/platinum-price-chart).

**The Growing Popularity of Platinum Among Investors** The rise of online trading platforms has made it easier for individuals to invest in precious metals. Investors will have access to real-time data, including [platinum cost per ounce](https://aubullion.ca/live-platinum-prices/). Transparency while trading will make it easy for investors to analyse market patterns. It may help to make a profitable investment decision.

body.title: The Up Trend | Sports Editorial
body.body:
While we talk about sports, the process by which we participate in it and bring forth the message ; all three of it is equally important thing. There are over 10-15 of sporting events that are hosted by more than 50 countries of the world ; Asia, Europe and America - most prominently. 

But we see less number of them that they get the maximum popularity. Although there are quitr possible reasons of that happening where some of the sports do pop top in the list, the rest of them lag behind. Just as economy and the politics, sports is also the sector which is highly competitive and the race is on to surpass one and the another and be ahead. 

Its quite similar a fact if I point to how FIFA is well ahead of the others and when ICC has a downgraded value and popularity as of football has. Its a matter of branding and the number of sponsors a regulatory authority has where the rest of them fall short of that support. If I ask you why do cricket has lower fan base and quite less number of nations are in the membership tag of the respective regulatory authorities  ? 

Why FIFA has more nations in its entity and ICC has a few nations that hold the prestige of international cricket ? 

Well the question is not tough to answer, but I mean there are other important factors which are liable for the reason. Cricket is naturally an expensive sport and you do hardly see all the other nations have large and sufficient cricketing infrastructure. They really do not have that money or economy invested in the system of cricketing playground. It is also tough a sport to play while cricket comes in front of the context. 

Whatever that is each time Olympic is hosted, I look at the nations that have participated in the different stages. They are many and truth be told we can't even see cricket is played. The main reason is cricket isn’t ready for all the teams to play and global competency is far less than football. 

But comparatively football or soccer is much enjoyable than cricket. Let me share one of my stories. 

It was a time when soccer world cup was going on. I have had a nice arrangements to watch and enjoy the matches of my favourite teams in the giant screen.I ordered the fellow neighbours and friends to arrange the money to hire the giant screen all across the period the world cup would be hosted, from day one to the dayof final. 

Most probably the craziness of football world cup in South East Asia is unmatched to any other non playing nations. This part of the world dont participate in the world cup, as they don’t naturally qualify for the main stage. Yet, the fans are divided into teams, such as : Argentina, Brazil, Spain, Germany & Portugal. 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfDjuKdAo68FuCgbzFdbNP86FZUCw2a1PzTLteMdXxkJf/1773166113948.jpg)
[Src](https://www.pexels.com/photo/multicolored-soccer-ball-on-green-field-47730/)

Flags are hoisted top of the stick pole of the building and the excitements are rare to see most often. FIFA world cup embraces the whole world with harmony and I dont think so anyone left behind to see what happens when the greatest soccer players start to retire and they enthrall the fans with their magical performance . 

Some of the players even marked their names as legends by showing us the events we as a fans never have seen before, yet we dont forget their names in centuries time. I guess  you have your story as well. 

Soccer world cup is a happy memory for us, by think in cricketting infrastructure there are even more to develop and other nations should be made sure that their participations are well guaranteed. If we could do it well, we might see the world to change with sports. 

That time is sure to come in the future.

body.title: A Pleasant Afternoon With a Cup of Coffee | L.O.H #279 (EN-ES)
body.body:
March is considered Women's History Month, and there's no better place than Hive to celebrate and congratulate those mothers, sisters, and friends who are always there to support us. They are wonderful, which is why I want to dedicate this flower 🌹 to every member of #LadiesofHive. Today I'm going to talk to you about what I consider to be a pleasant afternoon and I'll also tell you what I think is the best drink in the world.
![woman-7255683_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/23uQnRWZfCkxm9baehWXG554sXv8ih2HvonNFdkFis7LUDXGWBpyowjkx9SMwRmY2RZ8Z.jpg) [SOURCE](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/mujer-relajante-hamaca-adulto-7255683/)
#### **Describe the perfect afternoon for you. Where would it be? What would you be doing? Tell us the details that would make it perfect!** If I had to describe the perfect afternoon, it would be on a cloudy day with a cold wind blowing like on a rainy day, I would be lying in a hammock, sleeping comfortably without mosquitoes around me. If I woke up, all I would do is sway gently. I would just enjoy the silence, allowing my mind to be freed from worldly concerns. I would be in a peaceful refuge where, for a while, I could fully connect with myself and my surroundings. My thoughts would float like leaves carried by the wind. It is on this kind of perfect afternoon that I find the balance between rest for the body and serenity for the soul.
![cappuccino-756490_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/23wX7QiNxeP2JVVTZ8aoyAfy7yigxMFexFeE3QdswbkvaASexkFHdHMH2ezJ4hm9X3yiB.jpg) [SOURCE](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/capuchino-beber-taza-caf%c3%a9-756490/)
#### **Coffee or tea? Tell which one you prefer and how you like your coffee or tea drink prepared.** For longer than I can remember, I have preferred coffee, especially coffee with milk. It has become the hot drink I need every morning. I have come to think that without coffee, my brain does not function properly. Perhaps I am exaggerating, but I have that slight impression. This drink, which has a comforting warmth, gives you everything you need to start the day. There is something almost spiritual about the way the aroma of coffee with milk is so sweet, and its taste is indeed sweet. With every sip, I feel like I'm waking up from a long sleep, as if each cup offers me renewed energy and mental clarity. That's why I prefer coffee over tea.
![Separa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/48PwZMRqLxxMKLKxytNfynhQzrWAcWzbcD2LYQfU59uX2C7kHETsVr5TPhHe5va3NY.png)
Original version in Spanish Marzo es considerado el mes de la mujer, no hay mejor lugar en Hive para celebrar y felicitar a aquellas, madres, hermanas y amigas que siempre están ahí para darnos su apoyo. Son una maravilla, por eso quiero dedicarle esta flor 🌹 a cada miembro de #LadiesofHive. Hoy les voy a hablar de lo que yo considero puede ser una tarde agradable y también les comentare que es lo que opino de la mejor bebida del mundo.
![woman-7255683_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/23uQnRWZfCkxm9baehWXG554sXv8ih2HvonNFdkFis7LUDXGWBpyowjkx9SMwRmY2RZ8Z.jpg) [FUENTE](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/mujer-relajante-hamaca-adulto-7255683/)
#### **Describe la tarde perfecta para ti. ¿Dónde estaría? ¿Qué estarías haciendo? ¡Cuéntanos los detalles que lo harían perfecto!** Si tuviera que describir la tarde perfecta, seria en un día nublado con en donde el viento que sople sea frió como en un día lluvioso, yo estaría recostado en una hamaca, durmiendo cómodamente sin mosquitos a mi alrededor. Si llegara a despertar, lo único que haría seria balancearmé suavemente. Solo disfrutaría del silencio, permitiendo que mi mente se libere de las preocupaciones mundanas. Estaría en un refugio de paz en el que por un rato puedo conectarme plenamente conmigo mismo y con el entorno. Mis pensamientos flotarían como hojas llevadas por el viento. Es en ese tipo de tarde perfecta en donde encuentro el equilibrio entre el descanso del cuerpo y la serenidad del alma.
![cappuccino-756490_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/23wX7QiNxeP2JVVTZ8aoyAfy7yigxMFexFeE3QdswbkvaASexkFHdHMH2ezJ4hm9X3yiB.jpg) [FUENTE](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/capuchino-beber-taza-caf%c3%a9-756490/)
#### **¿Café o té? Dinos cuál prefieres y cómo te gusta preparar tu bebida de café o té.** Desde hace más tiempo del que puedo recordar he preferido el café, especialmente el café con leche. Se ha vuelto la bebida caliente que necesito cada mañana, he llegado a pensar que sin café, mi cerebro no funciona bien, tal vez estoy exagerando, pero tengo esa pequeña impresión. Esta bebida, que tiene una calidez reconfortante, te da todo lo que necesitas para empezar el día. Hay algo casi espiritual en la forma en que el aroma del café con leche es tan dulce, y su sabor es efectivamente dulce. En cada sorbo, siento que estoy despertándome de un largo sueño, como si cada taza me ofreciera energías renovadas y claridad mental. Por eso prefiero el café en vez del té.

![Separa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/48PwZMRqLxxMKLKxytNfynhQzrWAcWzbcD2LYQfU59uX2C7kHETsVr5TPhHe5va3NY.png)

body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeWERcwEC1PUKc8XbcT2GxtxjAePesSdBVK3tT3MsUse8/1773166717874.jpg)
##### picture is mine 

Learning and unlearning are both essential parts of personal growth. Life is a continuous journey of discovery, and every stage presents an opportunity to gain new knowledge while letting go of habits or mindsets that no longer serve us well. At this point in my life, I am intentionally embracing both processes. 

I am learning new skills, reshaping some of my attitudes, and consciously working on becoming a better version of myself.

One of the major areas I am currently focusing on is developing my ICT skills, particularly in animation. The world today is largely driven by technology, and digital creativity has become a powerful tool for communication, education, and business. Animation, in particular, has gained tremendous relevance across many sectors—from advertising and entertainment to education and ministry. I realized that learning animation can open up new opportunities for creativity and impact. It allows ideas and messages to be communicated in visually engaging ways that can reach a wide audience.
This realization motivated me to invest more time in learning these skills. I understand that technology is constantly evolving, and those who want to remain relevant must be willing to grow along with it. For me, learning ICT skills is not just about keeping up with trends; it is about equipping myself with tools that can enhance my productivity and broaden my ability to contribute meaningfully in different areas of life. I believe that mastering animation and other digital skills will help me communicate ideas more effectively, create useful content, and even empower others who may benefit from such knowledge.

Beyond acquiring technical skills, I am also working on personal transformation. One important lesson I am learning is how to control anger. Anger is a natural human emotion, but when it is not properly managed, it can damage relationships and cloud judgment. I have come to understand that responding to situations with patience and wisdom produces far better outcomes than reacting impulsively. Learning to control anger requires self-awareness, discipline, and the willingness to pause before responding. It is not something that happens overnight, but it is a gradual process of growth and maturity.

In addition to managing anger, I am intentionally learning how to show more love, empathy, and concern toward others. Life becomes more meaningful when we recognize the value of people around us. Everyone carries their own struggles, dreams, and expectations, and sometimes what people need most is understanding and compassion. By learning to be more patient and considerate, I am building stronger relationships and creating a more positive environment wherever I find myself.
Another important aspect of my current journey is the effort to rewrite the story of my life. 

This means making deliberate choices that lead to growth, productivity, and positive transformation. Instead of remaining stagnant or dwelling on past limitations, I am choosing to engage in activities that add value to my life and the lives of others. This includes developing new skills, improving my character, and maintaining a mindset that is open to learning.
I strongly believe that learning should never stop. The moment a person stops learning, growth begins to fade. Continuous learning keeps the mind active, sharpens perspective, and opens doors to new possibilities. Each new lesson learned becomes a building block for a better future.

Ultimately, what I hope to accomplish through this journey of learning and unlearning is personal development and greater effectiveness in life. By gaining new skills, refining my character, and cultivating a mindset of growth, I am preparing myself to live a more impactful and purposeful life. Every step I take in this direction brings me closer to becoming the person I aspire to be.
Thanks so much for reading through my entry.

body.title: The Trend | Sport's Write
body.body:
While we talk about sports, the process by which we participate in it and bring forth the message ; all three of it is equally important thing. There are over 10-15 of sporting events that are hosted by more than 50 countries of the world ; Asia, Europe and America - most prominently. 

But we see less number of them that they get the maximum popularity. Although there are quitr possible reasons of that happening where some of the sports do pop top in the list, the rest of them lag behind. Just as economy and the politics, sports is also the sector which is highly competitive and the race is on to surpass one and the another and be ahead. 

Its quite similar a fact if I point to how FIFA is well ahead of the others and when ICC has a downgraded value and popularity as of football has. Its a matter of branding and the number of sponsors a regulatory authority has where the rest of them fall short of that support. If I ask you why do cricket has lower fan base and quite less number of nations are in the membership tag of the respective regulatory authorities  ? 

Why FIFA has more nations in its entity and ICC has a few nations that hold the prestige of international cricket ? 

Well the question is not tough to answer, but I mean there are other important factors which are liable for the reason. Cricket is naturally an expensive sport and you do hardly see all the other nations have large and sufficient cricketing infrastructure. They really do not have that money or economy invested in the system of cricketing playground. It is also tough a sport to play while cricket comes in front of the context. 

Whatever that is each time Olympic is hosted, I look at the nations that have participated in the different stages. They are many and truth be told we can't even see cricket is played. The main reason is cricket isn’t ready for all the teams to play and global competency is far less than football. 

But comparatively football or soccer is much enjoyable than cricket. Let me share one of my stories. 

It was a time when soccer world cup was going on. I have had a nice arrangements to watch and enjoy the matches of my favourite teams in the giant screen.I ordered the fellow neighbours and friends to arrange the money to hire the giant screen all across the period the world cup would be hosted, from day one to the dayof final. 
Most probably the craziness of football world cup in South East Asia is unmatched to any other non playing nations. This part of the world dont participate in the world cup, as they don’t naturally qualify for the main stage. Yet, the fans are divided into teams, such as : Argentina, Brazil, Spain, Germany & Portugal. 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfDjuKdAo68FuCgbzFdbNP86FZUCw2a1PzTLteMdXxkJf/1773166113948.jpg)
[Src](https://www.pexels.com/photo/multicolored-soccer-ball-on-green-field-47730/)

Flags are hoisted top of the stick pole of the building and the excitements are rare to see most often. FIFA world cup embraces the whole world with harmony and I dont think so anyone left behind to see what happens when the greatest soccer players start to retire and they enthrall the fans with their magical performance . 

Some of the players even marked their names as legends by showing us the events we as a fans never have seen before, yet we dont forget their names in centuries time. I guess  you have your story as well. 

Soccer world cup is a happy memory for us, by think in cricketting infrastructure there are even more to develop and other nations should be made sure that their participations are well guaranteed. If we could do it well, we might see the world to change with sports. 

That time is sure to come in the future.

> In the transition from the Rebellion set to the Conclave Arcana set, I have now chosen to focus on Legendary rarity cards, so that I can add cards to my collection that are generally in demand on the rental market. The first of these cards that I managed to get my hands on is **Zarin the Scorch**, for which I had created a buy order on **Peakmonsters**. A few days ago my offer was accepted and this card became part of my collection, helping me continue my transition into the new set.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arc7icwolf/23wzd1KXSMe8pGYLhKKQtywa6rJfsCg12g55DHpKRDYDXWCGWE2BUR62cL4mYRNvbTTTN.JPG)
Zarin was also immediately rented out, starting to generate a small income in DEC that helps me recover its cost and purchase new cards.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arc7icwolf/Eo8KfdHmoF1HRGHxrq5gtXsTC19vxGPi7JHa43ES3Drr3kBuFJQ5AVJguc6o9XPxt7c.JPG)
At almost 4 DEC per day, the ROI I am getting is very high, in line with what I aim for when buying a card to rent out.
##
A good purchase?
So far I would be very happy with the performance of this card, but there is a “but”. To purchase Zarin the Scorch I spent 3 dollars, equal to a little over 5,125 DEC. Even though only a few days have passed since my purchase, the price of this card — and of all other cards as well — has dropped: at the moment Zarin the Scorch can be bought for about 2.50 dollars, resulting in a net loss for me of 50 cents. At this point, that income of 4 DEC per day looks much less attractive, because right now it is effectively only — and very slowly — offsetting the loss I generated by buying this card... of course the situation would change if the price of this card were to rise again, but these days hoping that the price of anything will go up feels more and more like a utopia!
##
A short pause
For this reason, I decided to cancel the buy order I had created for **Loving the Moo** and carefully evaluate whether it would be better to buy it now or later: I would like to avoid buying another card only to discover, a few days later, that I paid 1/5 more than necessary. On the other hand, by doing so I also risk missing what might actually be a good opportunity... unfortunately I do not know the dynamics of the Splinterlands card market well enough to understand whether buying now is the right move or if it would perhaps be better to wait. My idea is to wait a few days, maybe a week, see what happens and what changes, and only then decide whether or not to purchase this Legendary Archon, which would certainly be a great addition to my collection.

body.body:
![Sky Glows over Paranal Observatory](https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/image/2603/TeleSkyLasers_Looten_1080.jpg)

***

>Are lasers from giant telescopes being used to defend the Earth?  No.  Lasers shot from telescopes are now commonly used to help increase the accuracy of astronomical observations.  In some directions, Earth atmosphere-induced fluctuations in starlight can indicate how the air mass over a telescope is changing, but in other directions, no bright star exists.  In these directions, astronomers can create an artificial star with a laser.  Subsequent observations of the artificial laser guide star can reveal information so detailed about the changing blurring effects of the Earth's atmosphere that much of it can be removed by rapidly flexing a telescope's mirror.  Such adaptive optics techniques allow high-resolution ground-based observations of real stars, planets, and nebulas.  Pictured here, telescopes at Paranal Observatory in Chile study a colorful sky filled with green airglow and the Magellanic Clouds on the left, red airglow on the right, and the majestic central band of our Milky Way Galaxy arching across the center.

body.title: The Quiet Power of Being Fully Supported
body.body:
There is a special thing about being supported when you are trying to do something very meaningful. It is an impact in people's life. Not the loud kind of support where people only clap when things go well, but the quiet type where someone believes in you even when you are unsure of yourself. I didn’t always understand how powerful that kind of support can be until I experienced it in my own life.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaYo8pRYbiBkrjGQBSdLizPs2JGSxP3JAx1EPgsLtyjii/1773165772444.jpg)[source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-man-helping-a-woman-climb-up-the-side-of-a-mountain-7DSOv_1sOBQ)

A few years ago, I was all trying all I could to do something new and special. It wasn’t a big thing to the world, but to me it felt big and risky. I was afraid of failing because of the riskiness, people would laugh or think I was wasting time. My mind kept telling me to forget about it and stay in the safe place I already knew.

But there a person close to me who kept trying to support and encourage me. They didn’t promise success or say everything would be easy. They simply said, “If it matters to you, then it’s worth trying.” That sentence stayed with me more than I expected.

What is the most surprised part was that their support didn’t remove the fear completely. I still had doubts. I make mistakes. But knowing someone believed in me made it easier to continue. It gave me a small kind of courage I didn’t know I had.

Sometimes support doesn't means solving someone’s problems or giving them everything they need. But in reality, support can be very simple and encouraging. Listening when someone talks about their dreams. Encouraging them when they feel stuck. Being patient when they fail and need to start again.

Looking back now, I realize something great, things in life grow because someone believed in the person behind them. Even the strongest people need encouragement sometimes. Nobody moves forward completely alone.

I also learned many important thing from  experience. When you receive support, it slowly teaches you to give support to others too. Now when I see someone trying something new, I try not to be the person who discourages them. Instead, I remember how it felt when someone stood beside me and said, “Keep going.”

Great things rarely happen in isolation. They are often built through small moments of belief, patience, and encouragement from others.

And sometimes, the greatest gift you can give someone is simply standing with them while they try.

body.title: La \
de Banfield / Banfield's “taken house”
body.body:
<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCoc6oXtTKMKGkofBY9DCkHyVUZ5Nv2FdY6sQHGCHyY3/5.png</center>

Cuando decidí perderme de manera voluntaria por las calles de Banfield, me encontré en la entrada del country infantil de esta localidad, un hermoso mural tridimensional que me invitó a cruzar la calle para verlo de cerca.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmUkz1zAi2w32PWCCVy53iTKLCBhEs9HqTDqW9ihHRbBCp/2.png</center>

Un par de figuras femeninas se estiran para tocar sus manos en el medio del espacio, a donde se ve el traspaso de un sueño: una llave que por la forma parece ser de una vivienda, y que se confirma al leer la placa informativa ubicada a un lado.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmfPgnBjhWypvpC6Ux3TemqbUCpWdmp2rqd4TSzSZPR7mm/3.png</center>

Esta obra, restaurada por Fernando Izaguirre y Jorge Gionco, que fuera develada en 2005, nos muestra a dos mujeres con expresiones un poco tristes en lo que pareciera ser retazos de una casa, aunque ellas se encuentran fuera, como con nostalgia de estar dentro.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmW2zpj6K4PeBUbbHRvWu5TABQzibZfTxb6zjxXEPnsxLM/20260309_124109.jpg</center>

Una de ellas se apoya en la fachada de una casa, mirando a la otra de reojo, sus manos no se entrecruzan, sino que están una al lado de la otra, en un acto de compartir la llave, que se muestra arqueada entre ambas, como si se tratara de compartir un espacio.

El detalle del mechero con la luz encendida, refleja esa esperanza que albergamos todos en tener un techo que nos cobije y en el cual podemos sentirnos seguros. Mientras que hay otro aspecto que quizás pase desapercibido a la primera, y es que mientras la mujer apoyada a la casa, hace contacto visual, la otra desvía la mirada.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmac4eW6tDdRGLAjyUT1aVZfpMXy66CBgCfzY27KVL8oLu/1.png</center>

Una obra cargada de colores y formas, además del detalle en 3D que sale del muro, para darle volumen a los brazos, que reflejan el esfuerzo necesario para lograr tener una vivienda propia. 

Y por si no lo han notado todavía, el cabello blanco de una y el teñido de rojo de la otra, nos demuestran simbólicamente las edades de cada una, además de las facciones de ambas, que nos hace pensar que es un traspaso de madre (o abuela) a la hija o nieta, haciendo ver que los bienes realmente no son propiedades, pues al irnos de este plano, quedan en manos de alguien más.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmf5ABEoB8uBFXN8DY7t7WfEhSpCgcq16imHKn6LUw35hN/4.png</center>
<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmRgpze81s3K8EZCoW2uGFsVXv3Dx2y8s9QLYKUFg7WFKJ/6.png</center>

Aunque el nombre de esta obra está relacionado con la novela del escritor argentino, Julio Cortázar (nacido en la provincia de Banfield) que lleva el mismo nombre, en la que evoca una historia completamente diferente, también la podemos contextualizar como reflejo de muchas cosas que suceden en la sociedad actual, sea en líneas generales o la intimidad del núcleo familiar, cuando en algunas ocasiones se pierden los lazos afectivos, en nombre de peleas por sucesiones, bienes o disputas sobre los derechos de propiedad.


<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador_ingles.png</center>

When I decided to voluntarily get lost in the streets of Banfield, I found myself at the entrance to the town's children's playground, where a beautiful three-dimensional mural invited me to cross the street to see it up close.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmUkz1zAi2w32PWCCVy53iTKLCBhEs9HqTDqW9ihHRbBCp/2.png

A pair of female figures stretch to touch hands in the middle of the space, where the transfer of a dream can be seen: a key that appears to be from a house, which is confirmed by reading the information plaque located to one side.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmfPgnBjhWypvpC6Ux3TemqbUCpWdmp2rqd4TSzSZPR7mm/3.png

This work, restored by Fernando Izaguirre and Jorge Gionco, which was unveiled in 2005, shows us two women with slightly sad expressions in what appear to be fragments of a house, although they are outside, as if nostalgic for being inside.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmW2zpj6K4PeBUbbHRvWu5TABQzibZfTxb6zjxXEPnsxLM/20260309_124109.jpg

One of them leans against the facade of a house, looking at the other out of the corner of her eye. Their hands are not intertwined, but rather side by side, in an act of sharing the key, which is arched between them, as if they were sharing a space.

The detail of the lighter with the light on reflects the hope we all have for a roof over our heads where we can feel safe. While there is another aspect that may go unnoticed at first glance, which is that while the woman leaning against the house makes eye contact, the other woman looks away.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmac4eW6tDdRGLAjyUT1aVZfpMXy66CBgCfzY27KVL8oLu/1.png

A work full of colors and shapes, as well as 3D details that come out of the wall to give volume to the arms, reflecting the effort required to achieve home ownership. 

And in case you haven't noticed yet, the white hair of one and the red-dyed hair of the other symbolically show us the ages of each, as well as the features of both, which makes us think that it is a transfer from mother (or grandmother) to daughter or granddaughter, showing that possessions are not really property, because when we leave this plane, they remain in the hands of someone else.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmf5ABEoB8uBFXN8DY7t7WfEhSpCgcq16imHKn6LUw35hN/4.png</center>
<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmRgpze81s3K8EZCoW2uGFsVXv3Dx2y8s9QLYKUFg7WFKJ/6.png</center>



Although the name of this work is related to the novel by Argentine writer Julio Cortázar (born in the province of Banfield) of the same name, which tells a completely different story, we can also contextualize it as a reflection of many things that happen in today's society, whether in general terms or in the intimacy of the family unit, when emotional ties are sometimes lost in the name of fights over inheritance, property, or disputes over property rights.

***

body.body:
<center>

# CUSCO: ETERNAL FRAMES & MOTION
### Urban Geometry · Chapter XVI

---


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVX4p5srkwgWk6EYdTZhXstShM1NM1JN3tbUZ7Jqo43vB/img_9038.jpg)


*“Stone remains, while the walker is but a fleeting shadow.”*
*“La piedra permanece, mientras el caminante es solo una sombra fugaz.”*

---

</center>

### English

***C***usco's walls are more than history; they are perfect frames for those who walk these ancient paths. Today, I took the opportunity to experiment with some of these captures in Photoshop, adding a sense of motion to see how the energy of the city translates visually. Beyond the movement, I want to show you the classic alleys and the iconic arches that cross the streets designed to protect you from the rain. It is a city built to perfection, one that refuses to succumb to the passing of time.

> **\

**

Through my lens, I look for those geometric alignments where the architecture of the past meets the chaos of the present. The textures of the stone and the play of light under the arches provide a depth that only a place like this can offer.

> **\

**

> **< ¡Kachkaniraqmi!** *(Quechua: Until we meet again)*

---

### Español

***L***os muros de Cusco son hermosos y encuadran perfectamente a los caminantes. Hoy aproveché para editar algunas capturas en Photoshop y darles sensación de movimiento, buscando capturar esa energía vibrante de la ciudad. Además, les comparto sus calles y pasajes de siempre; esos arcos que cruzan las vías para protegerte de la lluvia. Es una ciudad diseñada en su perfección, una estructura que no sucumbe con el pasar de los años.

> **\

**

En mi búsqueda de la geometría del caos, Cusco ofrece marcos naturales en cada esquina. Las texturas de la piedra y el juego de sombras bajo los arcos dan una profundidad que solo este lugar posee. Espero que este experimento visual les transmita la mística de caminar por el ombligo del mundo.

> **\

**

> **< ¡Kachkaniraqmi!** *(Quechua: Hasta que nos volvamos a encontrar)*

body.title: The digital revolution in finance
body.body:
> In recent decades, the global economy has undergone an unprecedented transformation driven by the advancement of information and communication technologies. Electronic banking has emerged not only as a practical gadget but also as a key part that is totally changing how banks, customers, and the entire economy are connected.
Now you can manage your finances and manage cash flow from anywhere in the world with a single click, starting a new chapter in how we deal with our money. From a microeconomic perspective, e-banking has made financial markets work better by reducing the costs and time needed to transact for businesses and consumers.
Which means easier access to credit, the possibility of quick payments, this speed drives more action in buying and investing because it reduces the distance and bureaucracy that used to contain the economy. Digital banking accelerates the movement of money in the economy.
The rise of online banking has helped more people access financial services, especially in areas where regular banks are not as common. And insurance increases the number of people in the formal economy not only helps reduce inequality by including those who are often left out, but it also increases the ability of central banks to manage monetary affairs, as more businesses are tracked and controlled.
But let's be real, this revolution has its fair share of pain points and unintended consequences, relying on technology makes the world of money vulnerable to new threats such as hacking, online scams, and instability from technological issues Plus, the rapid growth of online banking raises difficult questions for lawmakers, They have to juggle to foster new ideas while keeping an eye on customer safety and keeping the entire financial system stable.
The digital divide could leave the elderly or those without internet access behind. This is great for making financial services available to everyone and speeding up transactions, So it's super important for growth. But the future growth of this thing will depend on how well we can manage the risks and make sure that everyone has a piece of the digital pie.
The future of banking will be digital but must be inclusive and secure first.

body.title: A Solid Gold Wonka Bar to Kick Off Three Tune Tuesday
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZx1oSji5BwBPPmaTxEM4pGpnnBQdCCfE4Y2BqDTH7ZEv/Screenshot%204785.png 

Every now and again I run across something online that I find incredibly cool. This is one of those! It is a Wonka Bar made of pure gold, a tiny replica of one you could see in the original movie Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory from 1971. Have a look at this beauty:

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcH7G7J62GUiErj6B7quJTHjQhMSLcoR97TXTk21B6S21/image.png 

APMEX.com

It's produced by PAMP out of Switzerland, one of the premier precious metals producers in the world. These are one gram of pure gold, and only five thousand will be produced. That will make these fairly collectible themselves. However, there is a huge downfall... These are priced at $343 which is very expensive for a gram of gold. The current metal value of one gram is around $168, so this has one huge premium, far more than I would ever be willing to pay! As cool as it is, way over priced!

It is a great way to lead into a Three Tune Tuesday though...


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZMQCGyoFxQrqGSMSbYi3B8ZhiRKm6z3pxNFyvTvKYtXh/image.png 
film-authority.com

This classic film starred Gene Wilder as Willy Wonka. It's a true cinematic gem that really couldn't have been done by any other actor of the day. It's a movie I remember loving as a kid and I always assumed it had been a hit since it was first released. I found out later nothing could have been further from the truth!

The film was released on June 30, 1971 and was produced on a budget of $3,000,000. At the time it didn't fare well with most critics and only generated $4,000,000 at the box office.  It was considered a massive failure by Paramount Pictures and after it's initial run in theaters it vanished into cinema obscurity. When their distribution contract expired in 1977 they decided not to renew. The film was subsequently sold to Warner Brothers for $500,000.

In the 1980's the film became a hit as it was replayed on television broadcasts. Before long it had become and in demand film and achieved cult classic status. It turns out Warner Brothers got a deal because since that time they have made a fortune off the film. Original props from the film go for insane prices as well, just take a look at this Wonka Bar:


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZjVpij7f2L4w59FeLvDuGywJxy5EDMBqwXHskh29MTTJ/image.png 
propgallery.com

One of the original prop Wonka Bars from the film is currently on sale for 35,000 British pounds (~$47,000.) Much more expensive than the gold one, but it is one of very few that still exist today. Collectible props from cult classic films can be worth a fortune!

Now for some music! But first off I want to say thank you to @ablaze for starting and continuing to sponsor this fun weekly event where you can share three songs that you enjoy. One lucky participant will win some HSBI units, you can't have too many of those! So if you don't already participate feel free to jump in, just use the tag #ttt or #threetunetuesday and it's never a bad idea to do a shoutout to @ablaze .

I decided it might be fun to share some songs from the film, definitely something very different  from my usual style!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXDnv1L89B5J554DN8mysxVCcxx2RTRpiWeJgGVaTDc89/image.png 


This first song from the film is probably one of the most memorable to anyone who's seen it. This one is called \

:


https://youtu.be/LIYNk4ARUR8?si=FC-thpTuYcVexPH1


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXDnv1L89B5J554DN8mysxVCcxx2RTRpiWeJgGVaTDc89/image.png 

I always loved the Oompa Loompa's in the movie, they were a lot of fun. Here's the first \

song:

https://youtu.be/Tt5B5Uw-u38?si=mTb0wAkL7EPvOeID



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXDnv1L89B5J554DN8mysxVCcxx2RTRpiWeJgGVaTDc89/image.png 

And who could forget the classic from the character Veruca Salt. Not the band, the character from the movie. This is called \

:


https://youtu.be/5wAlQf4WdiE?si=Aej1-cmQVvqsGgmT






 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXDnv1L89B5J554DN8mysxVCcxx2RTRpiWeJgGVaTDc89/image.png 



That will do it for this Three Tune Tuesday, and I hope you enjoyed the gold Wonka Bar as well. I wish I could afford that prop from the film, what a cool piece of movie history. I don't have that kind of cash laying around though!  I hope you're all having a great week so far, and I appreciate all of your support. Please feel free to leave any comments or questions below!

body.title: Blurt.media Radio - Voyageurs 1828
body.body:
by @offgridlife on OGMedia  
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/offgridlife [![Blurt.media Radio - Voyageurs 1828](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/7ee417a0-6b5c-48cf-b4a7-ae6b60273253.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/u8h5jknpxLtdyFjhojeCKS) 
 
 The Migration of Voyageurs From Drummond Island to Penetanguishene in 1828

In 1828, approximately 75 Métis voyageur families and the British garrison migrated from Drummond Island to Penetanguishene, Ontario, following the island's cession to the U.S. after the War of 1812. Led by figures like William Solomon, they relocated to avoid American rule, facing a harsh journey and rebuilding their community on Georgian Bay. 

 
Key Aspects of the 1828 Migration:
Context: The British transferred the military post from Drummond Island to Penetanguishene, compelling the allied Métis families—many of French-Canadian descent—to move.

The Journey: The move involved traversing Georgian Bay in bateaux (flat-bottomed boats). A significant 1828 voyage included the brig Wellington, while another vessel, the Hackett, was lost in a November storm.

Key Families: Prominent families involved in the migration included the Solomons, Labattes, Laramees, and Langlades.

Resettlement: The families settled in Tiny Township, Simcoe County, with some locating in Fesserton and Coldwater. They were later granted land as compensation for their loyalty and losses.
Legacy: The event is extensively documented by A.C. Osborne, based on accounts from survivors who settled in the area. 


A.C. Osborne's \

chronicles a defining event in the history of the Upper Great Lakes Métis Community, capturing its stories, struggles, and resilience.
 
Following the cession of Drummond Island by the British Crown to the United States after the War of 1812, the many Métis families who called the Island home were forced to relocate—with a large number going to Penetanguishene on the southwestern shore of Georgian Bay.
 
Published in 1901, Osborne, “endeavoured to gather this story from the lips of the few survivors who migrated at the time… [who] settled principally near Penetanguishene, in the township of Tiny, Simcoe County.”
 
Through brief vignettes and first-hand narratives by Métis community members who had experienced the relocation from Drummond Island to Penetanguishene—including members of the Métis Solomon, Labatte, Larammee, and Langlade families—Osborne’s meticulously compiled research chronicles the many challenges that the Métis faced during their relocation, including harsh weather, difficult terrain, and the emotional toll of leaving their homes.
 
Osborne's account ultimately showcases the strength and adaptability of the Upper Great Lakes Métis. As the lands and waters they called home were divided by colonial borders, they maintained their ways of life in Penetanguishene, preserving their cultural practices, identity, and community bonds for future generations.

Source: https://www.ontariometisfacts.com/post/drummond-island-to-penetang#:~:text=May%252021%252C%25202025-,A.C.,the%2520Upper%2520Great%2520Lakes%2520M%C3%A9tis.

body.title: Why Hive sites CANNOT be decentralized? (shocked, LIVE reaction)!
body.body:
<center>

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR3JA2hRrNuKT9UZbZW7WvoygaqJKva1K6h7qXJJsmG2J/image.png)

</center>

> Disclaimer: *This blog post is for informative purposes only. I am an active Hive developer and my intentions are not malicious towards any Hive community nor specific project.*

---

## Inspiration

Some time ago @logic started a thread on [Hive Mattermost](https://chat.hive.blue/) asking about ways to handle @propolis-publish app data

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUd4UdsQVVGSYpgyN8a4R2Lb6mYpjz5DDVWronkvVcmVG/image.png) 

I wanted to answer his question briefly: `Just use custom_operation - it can carry binary data pretty well and is not visible to our frontends.`, but then @louis88 asked an even better question:

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQme1inJVtKmx8Uy1nFrn5KTPPg8cYX7LHAmKRzzv2oTUAd/image.png) 

which actually made me wonder - is it really possible to do so?

(TL;DR yes)

## Backbone of Hive

Starting my work at Hive, the first thing I did was block log analysis - that's right - I manually decoded the entire block log scheme (but the testnet one of course 😉). Here are the results:

<center>

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNwdqvJeMcWwivBBiKZCH2BF8P5RyZY4W2yZZeKRBbTvy/image.png)

</center>

So the block you are looking at is of 248B size. But have you ever wondered what are the actual constraints on the block / transaction sizes?

### Block constraints

Most of you already know the Hive block creation interval, which is 3 seconds, but what about the block size?

The minimum block size, hardcoded into the [Hive config](https://gitlab.syncad.com/hive/hive/-/blob/247035b6d03769033fdd4693b255396daf7bd930/libraries/protocol/include/hive/protocol/config.hpp#L365) is 64 kiB ([`kiB`, not `kB`!](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kilobyte#Binary_(1024_bytes))) *minus 121B required for the block metadata & signature*. This used to be true, but the setting is now stale (unused) and refers instead to the maximum block size, configured by Hive witnesses.

The theoretical maximum Hive block size is 2 MiB, but we never actually got into that number. So the current median maximum block size set by Hive witnesses is 64 kiB minus the [*magic 256 number*](https://gitlab.syncad.com/hive/hive/-/blob/247035b6d03769033fdd4693b255396daf7bd930/libraries/plugins/queen/queen_plugin.cpp#L174) plus required block metadata (mentioned 121B) = 65401 B

> - Why not magic number 128B (the power of 2)? - it is closer to the actual 121 B.
> - Block can also hold a dynamic list of extensions, with the largest ones being 8 B (`hardfork_version_vote`). This doesn't mean we can't exceed the 256 B block metadata size threshold, but it is especially hard as they are only used to signal blockchain hardforks by witness nodes, which happens rarely.

**Current REAL block size constraints: min. 121 B - max. 65401 B**

### Transaction constraints

There is no predefined transaction minimum size (even though there is a constant in the Hive config referring to 1 kiB). The transaction itself has to carry some data, including ref block, and signature which results in 79B of serialized data size.

But wait! We are required to have at least one operation inside the transaction! This results in the theoretically smallest possible transaction containing one signature, and one `decline_voting_rights_operation` (*min. 6 B serialized, including op type, account name, and boolean flag*) in total size of 85B.

> A mysterious Hive core dev brought up an idea for even smaller transactions - specifically, signatureless ones! How does that work? The Hive blockchain has certain accounts with \

, such as `temp`. Because of this, the account can execute operations without requiring a signature, it yields the absolute minimum transaction size with `decline_voting_rights_operation` of exactly 20B.

So we have the minimum transaction size. What is the maximum size? The maximum Hive transaction size used to be 64 kB (based on the `HIVE_MAX_TRANSACTION_SIZE` config available in Hive's source code), but thanks to the [great conversation](https://gitlab.syncad.com/hive/hive/-/blob/247035b6d03769033fdd4693b255396daf7bd930/libraries/chain/database.cpp#L561) between two of our core devs, it is now dynamic 🤭. This means that for the maximum transaction size we have to subtract 256 from the maximum block size defined by the witnesses (65280 B).

**Current REAL transaction size constraints: min. 20 B - max. 65280 B**

## Web technologies limitations

Modern web pages usually serve a lot of content (Denser, for example, has to serve ~7 MB, PeakD ~10 MB, Ecency ~31 MB).

<center>

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdTj77MRhJGufh2K1McT49MbiLgdJkuZHfrdACvQrr3hC/image.png) 

</center>

Benchmarked `/trending` webpage.

### Binary files problem

We already have a \

image hosting service, so we can externalize some of the content that takes up the vast majority of the downloaded content size - images and GIFs.

So we are left with a few file types: HTML, CSS, JS, WASM, and fonts (assuming we are only using the [HAF REST API](https://api.hive.blog/?urls.primaryName=Hivemind) and [JSON-RPC Nodes legacy API](https://api.hive.blog/?urls.primaryName=Legacy+Hive+JSON-RPC+API) for blockchain communication).

Fonts are not that critical (assuming we are using native Unicode emojis and SVG for icons), so we can use fonts from the Google Fonts CDN or the default ones.

WASM can be served via library packages using services such as unpkg.com - but it is not truly decentralized at that point.

### Web2 technologies on Hive

We are left with HTML, CSS and JS by this point.

We already know that currently the maximum data we can store on Hive at once is 65280 B, but that is still not entirely true.

So there are 3 main ways for persistent storage on Hive:
1. Hive posts / comments (`comment_operation` body - any utf8 compatible format + json metadata)
2. Custom jsons (must be json)
3. Custom operations (can be anything - binary). I mean `custom_operation`. `custom_binary_operation` is deprecated (never used in the blockchain and temporarily blocked by the softfork).

Of course there are many other ways (such as transfers' memo or accounts' json metadata and posting json metadata), but those are highly inconvenient, and strictly limited regarding their size and format, e.g. mentioned memo - 2 kiB max, and json metadata limited to the single transaction size - ~63 kiB.

---

#### Hive posts case

There is no real limitation on the post / comment body and json metadata size. We are only limited by the transaction size. This means that theoretical size is 65280 B minus transaction metadata (79 B) minus `comment_operation` metadata (author, permlink etc. - ~22 B when optimized for size) = 65179 B.

For the maximum operation frequency, we can look at the [Hive evaluator for social-related operations](https://gitlab.syncad.com/hive/hive/-/blob/247035b6d03769033fdd4693b255396daf7bd930/libraries/chain/hive_evaluator_social.cpp#L208) - one post per 5 minutes.

**Summary: max data size: 65179 B. Max frequency: 5 minutes**

And let's be real - writing multiple Hive posts would drain your RC mana in the blink of an eye 👀.

---

#### Hive comments case

A Hive comment behaves similarly to a Hive post, but we can write comments more often - once every 3 seconds - and have to provide a parent author (-5 B) = 65174.

**Summary: max data size: 65174 B. Max frequency: 3 seconds**

---

#### Custom JSONs case

Based on the [Hive evaluator code](https://gitlab.syncad.com/hive/hive/-/blob/247035b6d03769033fdd4693b255396daf7bd930/libraries/chain/hive_evaluator.cpp#L341), the maximum data size of `custom_json_operation` as of HF26 is 8 kiB (`HIVE_CUSTOM_OP_DATA_MAX_LENGTH` value).

Theoretically, we are restricted to the JSON schema, but this can be leveraged to store JS files inside the JSON, which will later be read and `eval`-ed by other JS files.

There is also a frequency limitation: for a single Hive account, you can publish [up to 5 custom operations per block](https://gitlab.syncad.com/hive/hive/-/blob/247035b6d03769033fdd4693b255396daf7bd930/libraries/chain/database.cpp#L607)

**Summary: max data size: 8192 B. Max frequency: 5 ops / block (~3s)**

This means you would have to create JS/CSS chunks of 8 kiB each. But hey - at least you would not drain all of your RC mana 😅.

---

#### Custom operations case

The custom operation behaves similarly to the custom JSON, but allows saving data of any kind (binary).

**Summary: max data size: 8192 B. Max frequency: 5 ops / block (~3s)**

> Note: 5 ops / block limit refers to no. of `custom_operation` and `custom_json_operation` in block **combined**!

---

### Chunk concatenation

So let's assume we have everything set up and already published to Hive. Now what if we want to add new features, or simply update just one file? This would require broadcasting all the files again to the network, wouldn't it?

Well, we could either:
* Write in vanilla HTML/CSS/JS and maintain all the files manually, splitting them into chunks due to maximum transaction size limitations, and update only those which we edited.
* Create a customized bundler with chunk size limitation and automatic on-Hive publisher script.

For full automation, data redundancy reduction, and ultimately for people on Hive to actually use this method, it would at some point REQUIRE writing the mentioned bundler and script.

| Operation type | Max chunk size [B] | Broadcast interval for single account [s] |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Post | 65179 | 300 |
| Comment | 65174 | 3 |
| Custom JSON | 8192 | 0,6 |
| Custom binary | 8192 | 0,6 |

## THE Actual Implementation

Okay, everything's good, we have chosen our hosting provider (Hive blockchain), we have everything set up, HTML, JS, CSS and all other CDNs are in place, created by our custom bundler, but wait! How are we even going to access our freshly cooked (*vibe coded*) web page?

### API for static HTML webpages

Currently, there is no API for serving static HTML/JS/CSS content with proper [MIME type](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Guides/MIME_types) on Hive. This could be done on top of HAF as a plugin. Ironically that would be the easiest part of the puzzle, so let's skip to the next problem ASSUMING we already have it implemented under `https://api.openhive.network/blog-posts-api` 😋

### DNS limitations

First of all, we have to make our website publicly available to the broader audience. Usually it is pretty simple - we have hosting, we have a domain registrar with a DNS records manager set up.

What remains is connecting a domain to an IP (`A`/`AAAA` record) or another domain (`CNAME` record). Pretty easy stuff - just a one-liner.

But wait! What are we actually going to point our domain to? A Hive node? But that will result in:

<center>

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVQ7euje91cLy2HKFigAaBknPFGvYAGCzThegztWK7GAf/image.png) 

</center>

and we want our web page!

So what about pointing to a specific URL?

### The Solution: Cloudflare Workers

You might be tempted to use simple [URL redirects](https://developers.cloudflare.com/rules/url-forwarding/single-redirects/create-dashboard/), but redirects are terrible for SEO. A 301 or 302 redirect tells Google that your content actually lives at `api.openhive.network`, meaning the API gets all the \

(backlinks, authority) while your domain acts as an empty transit tunnel.

Instead, we can solve this using [Cloudflare Workers](https://workers.cloudflare.com/). By setting up a simple Worker script, it acts as a serverless reverse proxy. When someone visits `myapp.com`, the Worker silently fetches the HTML from the OpenHive API under the hood and serves it directly to the user. To the browser and to Google's crawlers, the content natively belongs to `myapp.com`. The original API URL remains completely hidden, you keep 100% of your SEO rankings, and you don't even need to maintain your own server!

## Conclusion

Sooo.. yes, technically speaking it is *POSSIBLE* to create such a service, but maintaining your web page directly on Hive using any kind of L1 operations would essentially be a pain in your a🍑🍑.

---

Thanks for reading this article. If you have any questions, feel free to comment! I'd love to see someone (suffer) actually implement(ing) this idea 🤤! (No AI images used)

body.body:
![IMG_4786.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfNqPK56am3T1SCBmxEaaJ1htgrMCvT7n9LhEnr1UK1QS/IMG_4786.jpeg) pm
### Our Material World
#

Our world is facing a very tense moment. We often do not have enough accurate information, which can lead to misunderstandings. I believe the concept of “Two-Eyed Seeing” is very important.

> “Two-Eyed Seeing” is a Mi'kmaw guiding principle developed by Elder Albert Marshall, I heard. It means learning to use one eye with the strengths of Indigenous ways of knowing and the other eye with the strengths of Western ways of knowing, and then using both together for better understanding and outcomes, especially in collaboration, education, and health, and more. It promotes valuing diverse perspectives, integrating knowledge systems, and achieving balance for the benefit of all people, fostering respect and preventing one system from dominating another.

I think we need a more holistic view of life, and this kind of whole way of thinking is necessary to move through these chaotic and confusing times. Accepting, waiting, witnessing, changing, moving, and taking action are not always easy, but we need to look at our situation more broadly during this difficult time.

![IMG_4783.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbp29hwsQYsz6beom1ZVXjaQUCZF96KmB2Znv1eDpbqEp/IMG_4783.jpeg)

I saw an interesting sticker on a small Japanese car, which I believe was a Honda. On the back of the car, there were many interesting stickers, including funny, ironic, and unique ones.

This “The beatings will continue until morale improves” sticker looks a bit scary, but it’s actually true. The picture really looks like our world.


![IMG_4784.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPPmTKB8JP4jCa3MEqNRb2kzsQFsbHJFVnXqywEujKzUE/IMG_4784.jpeg)

This sticker is true in a way. Our society often tells us to stay positive even without solid evidence or proof. We keep smiling while ignoring the truth behind us.

I don’t want to realize the truth only after we are already in the mouth of the shark.

Japanese 日本語

![IMG_4786.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfNqPK56am3T1SCBmxEaaJ1htgrMCvT7n9LhEnr1UK1QS/IMG_4786.jpeg) pm
### 私たちの物質的な世界  
#

世界は、今とても緊張した時代を迎えています。正確な情報が十分ではないため、誤解が生まれてしまうことも多々あります。こんな時代は特に「二つの目で見る」という考え方がとても重要だと思います。

> 「二つの目で見る（Two-Eyed Seeing）とは、ミクマク族の長老アルバート・マーシャルによって提唱された指針であると聞きました。これは、一つの目で先住民の知の強みを見て、もう一つの目で西洋の知の強みを見ることを学び、その両方を同時に用いることで、より良い理解と成果を得るという考え方だそうです。特に協働、教育、医療などの分野で重視されているとのこと。この考え方は、多様な視点を尊重し、知識体系を統合し、すべての人のための調和を実現することを促し、どちらか一方の体系が支配することを防ぎながら、互いの尊重を育てるのだそうです。

私たちにはもっと全体的な生き方や視点が必要なのではないでしょうか。そして、このような全体性を大切にする考え方こそが、この混乱し不安定な時代を乗り越えるために必要なのではないかと思うのです。

受け入れること、待つこと、見守ること、変化すること、動くこと、そして行動することは、本当に簡単なことではありません。でも、この困難な時期には、自分たちの状況をもっと広い視野で見る必要があるのだと思います。

![IMG_4783.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbp29hwsQYsz6beom1ZVXjaQUCZF96KmB2Znv1eDpbqEp/IMG_4783.jpeg)

小さな日本車に面白いステッカーを見つけました。たぶんホンダの車だったと思います。その車の後ろには、面白そうなステッカーがたくさん貼られていて、ユーモアのあるものや皮肉なもの、ユニークなものなどがありました。

その中の 「意欲が向上するまで殴り続ける」 というステッカーは少し怖い感じがしますが、どこか本当のことのようにも思えます。その絵は、まるで今の世界の姿のように見えました。

![IMG_4784.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPPmTKB8JP4jCa3MEqNRb2kzsQFsbHJFVnXqywEujKzUE/IMG_4784.jpeg)

このステッカーは、ある意味で本当のことを言っていると思います。私たちの現実は、確かな証拠もないまま前向きでいなさいと言い続けることがよくあります。背後にある真実を無視したまま、何の保証もなく笑顔でい続けているのかもしれません。

サメの口の中にすでに入ってしまい、手遅れになってから真実に気づくようなことにはなりたくはないものです。

Thank you for reading!

body.title: NASA Makes A Heated 3-D Look Into Hurricane Erin's Eye
body.body:
# NASA Makes A Heated 3-D Look Into Hurricane Erin's Eye

**Source:** https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2005/10/051007090048.htm

Hurricane Erin raced across the North Atlantic and along theeastern seaboard in September 2001. She was used as an experiment for astudy to improve hurricane tracking and intensity predictions, allowingmeteorologists to provide more accurate and timely warnings to thepublic. Studies show that temperatures measured at an extremely highaltitude collected from a hurricane's center or eye can provideimproved understanding of how hurricanes change intensity.
HurricaneErin was analyzed during the fourth Convection And Moisture EXperiment(CAMEX-4), which took place from August 16 through September 24, 2001.The mission originated from the Naval Air Station in Jacksonville, Fla.The mission united researchers from 10 universities, five NASA centersand the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. CAMEX-4 is aseries of field research investigations to study tropical cyclones —storms commonly known as hurricanes.
Twenty instrumentedpackages, called dropsondes, were dropped into Erin's eye by two NASAresearch aircraft (the ER-2 and DC-8). The special packages includedinstruments that mapped temperature patterns.
For the first time,researchers were able to reconstruct the structure of the eye in threedimensions from as high as 70,000 feet, down to the ocean surface, ingreat detail. The dropsondes showed Erin's warm core decreasing whileit was rapidly weakening, making the storm more vulnerable to windshear, a change in horizontal winds, which led to the storm fallingapart.
Hurricane Erin's rainfall pattern adjusted quickly tosurprisingly small changes in wind speed patterns in the surroundingatmosphere. Weak horizontal winds rearrange rain and wind structure,which create uneven weather conditions around the hurricane's core.
Observationsfrom the study show the relationship between warm air from the eye ofthe storm is linked to reduction in sea surface pressure, which is thebasic process that drives the hurricane's destructive winds.
Althoughlittle is known about the birth of a hurricane and what causes it tostrengthen or weaken, scientists have made substantial steps towardimproving predictions of where a hurricane will move or make landfall.The ability to forecast intensity change, however, has always been achallenge for meteorologists.
The research done on Hurricane Erinwas important because it could help forecasters understand factors thatcontrol rain intensity and distribution for hurricanes landing alongthe Eastern Seaboard.
Freshwater flooding is the number onekiller from hurricanes in the Western Hemisphere and the study of ahurricane's rainfall pattern could better prepare us for the next bigstorm.
This research paper, titled \

by J. Halverson et al., is going to be published in an upcoming issueof the American Meteorological Society's Journal of AtmosphericScience, CAMEX Special Issue, at the end of 2005.

body.title: Marrying after the death of a spouse - is it allowed?
body.body:
https://youtu.be/5OYmS8syUlo?si=Uc2PufOgZa_CMDbI
‎
‎The bond that exists in marriage is only valid while the two persons involved are still living. Once either of them is dead the person alive is relieved of that bond. There is no place in the Bible where we are told not to remarry after the death of a spouse.
‎
‎If the partner of the deceased decides that he or she does not want to marry again then it is fine and okay. But if peradventure they wish to remarry then there is absolutely nothing wrong with it. It is not regarded as sin. God wouldn't hold it against such an individual if he or she decides to do so. 
‎
‎Death of a spouse is quite an unfortunate incident, but it shouldn't prevent one deny the spouse of the deceased a happy life. We are bound to face obstacles of various kinds in life but this doesn't mean we can't keep going forward in life. Whatever that comes our way life still goes on.
‎
**‎‭Ecclesiastes 9:5 KJV‬**
_‎For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten._ 
‎
‎The living has nothing to do with the dead. It is not an abomination to remarry after the death of a spouse.

body.title: The simple comfort of a cool evening after a long, sunny day🧡🩵🩶
body.body: Greetings lovely members of the community. I hope you all are doing great and enjoying quality time with your loved ones. > समुदाय के प्यारे सदस्यों को नमस्कार। मुझे आशा है कि आप सभी अच्छे होंगे और अपने प्रियजनों के साथ गुणवत्तापूर्ण समय का आनंद ले रहे है। ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPyBnmybpxjxKeoANUQ6VGRqZRNwcCbGTAqb4R2FPsrjV/img_1303.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZdA4rmwDmWmKUMa8aSFcJdFr3uH1QWjsbsvamsahEavx/img_1304.heic) After a long, hot and sunny day, the evening starts to feel like a quiet relief. The harsh heat slowly fades as the sun begins to set behind the hills. The air becomes softer and cooler, and a gentle breeze starts to move through the trees. It feels refreshing after spending the whole day in the warmth of the sun. > लंबे, गर्म और धूप से भरे दिन के बाद शाम का समय एक सुकून जैसा लगता है। जैसे-जैसे सूरज ढलने लगता है, दिन की तेज़ गर्मी धीरे-धीरे कम होने लगती है। हवा हल्की और ठंडी हो जाती है, और पेड़ों के बीच से चलने वाली ठंडी हवा बहुत ताज़गी भरी महसूस होती है। पूरे दिन की गर्मी के बाद यह बदलाव सच में अच्छा लगता है। ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeVkXbqPizZi3BqcDgEc4Mj8zMtRZcWtrwy7HrNBdrg9S/img_1305.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS2jWnhTWcxK2bYajv7tCpHHBF2Ay29qR3XjT2FP2GAjW/img_1306.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU4rY6B9LqRE7h6v93FzqoyqZ821iv9rwa2JRr1odBuxL/img_1307.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYrTqg9mHGmg2bXLtpXR1LyaJxqmT7eoj6Nb47FVVArDa/img_1308.heic) As the temperature drops, everything around seems to slow down a little. The sky begins to change colours, shifting from bright daylight to softer shades of orange, pink, and gold. The light becomes calmer and more pleasant, and the whole surroundings start to feel peaceful. Even a simple walk outside during this time feels much more enjoyable. >जैसे-जैसे तापमान कम होता है, आसपास का माहौल भी थोड़ा शांत सा लगने लगता है। आसमान के रंग बदलने लगते हैं । तेज़ दिन की रोशनी से धीरे-धीरे नारंगी, गुलाबी और सुनहरे रंग दिखाई देने लगते हैं। रोशनी भी नरम और सुहानी हो जाती है, जिससे पूरा वातावरण बहुत सुकून भरा लगता है। इस समय बाहर टहलना भी और ज़्यादा अच्छा लगता है। ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPQhjanNoxiUdSAArpmTHW1XU1XFEb4qAE8hHqA6nNL7X/img_1309.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR8oLTTa9NfB8QcLRYBmgSy2PfMyMp7QPcYX7sQFsZwRh/img_1310.heic) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTCf313MgHptKoz19WzBVHSgLvRmZQAApu17WqS8MoXwe/img_1311.heic) Moments like these make the evening feel special. The cool breeze, the changing sky, and the calm atmosphere bring a sense of comfort after a tiring day. > ऐसे छोटे-छोटे पल शाम को खास बना देते हैं। ठंडी हवा, बदलते हुए आसमान के रंग और चारों ओर का शांत माहौल पूरे दिन की थकान को हल्का कर देते हैं। That's all for today folks. body.title: The Big Feast At The Dwarven Residence ~ God Of War Ragnarok | Give Me God Of War
body.body:
Hello, gamers of Hive. I hope you all are doing well.

![Hive Gaming themed divider with a bears eye and a friendly bear face.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allama/AJmsz1UN3akzYdE4tpjR6bagVFsAQaSWenpapkSjmUGwTMK9Jsgy5G5fMcgQcGj.png)
<center>*GeNeRaTeD tHrOuGh CoPiLoT*</center>

Today, I've progressed a bit further into the story in GOW Ragnarok in this high difficulty and hopefully it would entertain you guys. I must mention I've already progressed further but chose to pace myself slowly in order to not get spoiled.

Without further ado, let's begin.

![Hive Gaming logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allama/23tbwUs9WK4gGiTKdQJxsv2Kjm29CYfCu93cPe837v88HjM4J7xBrHT3dvDugyq8qsuWe.png)

Atreus returns from his visit with the witch and his disappearence did not go unnoticed. He lied by saying he simply went to pee. Sindri came down from his quarters and bid everyone a good morning. 

![Screenshot (902).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allama/23vsFrFL8PgmeebYc2DK2v6njHjRfHmqsoWCf8WwWQHFJUfPvpMwHBP6xtqnBjRMXvJ2X.png)

Kratos set Mimir on the table while Brok and Sindri set the table. Tyr complained about food and asked that he be given the opportunity to cook food. Atreus asked if Kratos wanted to set out again, Kratos told that they were to go to Alfheim to search for more answers as Groa's shrine is there. 
Tyr made some small talks before Kratos got up and was ready for the journey.

![Screenshot (904).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allama/23vsJAGURRVRso8LzU1ukd8J6FSBGAGsf6WsskGggSPQvx9YHQGiWokDDJgpGSmjW2NoV.png)

Before they activated the door, an uncanny rabit took their attention. It grabbed one of the resin crusted thingy out of Kratos's pouch and claimed it to have excellent amber resin, delectable nourishment. He also introduced himself as Ratatoskr, and they have met his astral aspects throughout the 9 realms. He mentioned that this thing was no mere amber resin but a seed og Yggrasil that would be needed for realm travel from **his** tree. Old Durlin did not dupe them.

Before their journey, Ratatoskr mentioned tha the installed a bell that upon ringing would summon him, should he be wanted for an urgent matter. He also informed of Nidhogg, a Lindwyrm with several offsprings that live below the tree. They help chew the extra/overgrown roots and thus create a good balance.

![Screenshot (907).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allama/23wqZg8FgZeQtBMK8jKKANimrbri4ma8UGxPwvZMgDfmKavnJZ8ZQXgYvvRHtday3FK2K.png)

Kratos, Atreus, Mimir, and Tyr entered the realm and found a post-war Alfheim with the light shining ever so brightly. They passed through puzzles and came to the life of Alfheim beneath which was the lake of souls.
___

And that was it for today, I'm certain they are to see a lot more action after they learn of what went down here.

![Hive gaming.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allama/23w2ifjVsuD7preSQUzp6GXk51APDicBCsJdtSX8hxLvKLDoXeqPr6RiUuvrXRyCURvVQ.png)

### **Gameplay Video**

https://www.youtube.com/live/v9aibf-aUoA?si=68nECVS5fDMUicgG

<center>*Thank you guys for reading this far, see you legends on the next one*</center>
