body.title: And he fulfilled them happily [ ENG/ ESP]
body.body:
>
![post hive (28).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23x1KmiF5iJBQrWErFccnHoYDrE6p4MfSZo1Ztw7Z6gAJHyJN5a1ko3npfdJFThXtEKyu.png)
--- Y los cumplió feliz; de eso se trataba, que pasara un cumpleaños diferente, aunque a veces las cosas no salen como uno quisiera, pero ni modo, no podemos controlarlo todo. El Día de la Mujer fue una celebración doble, puesto que también es el cumpleaños de mi mamá, entonces se podrán imaginar; es obligatorio hacer algo ese día, jeje, y como ya es costumbre en mi familia, lo primero que hacemos es darnos nuestro desayuno sorpresa, que, bueno, no es tan sorpresa porque, como dije, es una costumbre. Aunque ese día el desayuno fue improvisado, puesto que no me preparé lo suficiente, porque, como era domingo, nosotras vamos a misa bien temprano, a las 7:00 am, así que se podrán imaginar. Sin embargo, al salir de la misa, el padre dijo que nos tenían de regalo un desayuno, por el Día de la Mujer. Nos dieron una rica arepa; a mi mamá le tocó una con carne mechada y la mía con ensalada de pollo. De igual manera, eso fue muy poco, jejeje, porque era una mini arepa. Al llegar a casa, la cumpleañera tenía hambre; preparé otras arepitas, mi papá compró unas empanadas, y yo había hecho el día anterior mis famosos tequeños saludables.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Ep3hhdwdBWAyYJwxzDPSsWe9yNyoBankeYPSYeW8vt32uVHwn8TF98XysGL8yHN6DK6.png)
![post hive (29).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/246axHJeZN4MPZrsrya5kssW83CVfYdaxDdzwLtWzAgQWpk29HNRUHekinz1KhyJhTGqx.png)
Había imprimido algunas imágenes y, bueno, medio decorado la bandeja, así que sí estaba algo preparada, sencilla, pero lo importante es que pude hacérsela; nos comimos todo, jejeje. Y como ella no quería hacer así gran cosa, sé que quería comer pizza, por lo que mi papá y yo la llevamos a comer. Al llegar a casa, le trajeron su tortita de piña, la cual hace la suegra de mi hermana. Todos los años le dicen para que se la haga, y es que le quedan muy ricas, y esa es la favorita de mi mamá.
![post hive (30).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/243BnnpVP9DbhrskG9NpaLrKJkT5mNAceEiU7NpTeNQ33DbBY2pQeW4xKt4riBMDDw8Mr.png)
![post hive (31).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23ywrw88TcDPH3vzvZrXBjk8r3EfCRbkAAxaqLcpnJz8bF7viutX1VzoirYaDhQJm5vgk.png)
Y como toda cumpleañera sorprendida, es más, todos quedamos sorprendidos. Mis hermanas le mandaron unos mariachis, muy lindo y divertido detalle, aunque a ella no le gustan mucho porque la hacen llorar, jeje, pero igual los disfrutó. Así que sí, este año fue diferente, tranquilo, solo nosotros, y buenos los invitados inesperados, que nunca pueden faltar, como dije, cosas que no se pueden controlar. Fue un buen día, eso es lo importante; mi mamá pasó bien su día, con familia, sus seres queridos; gracias, Dios, por ello. ---
ENGLISH VERSION

And she had a happy birthday; that was the point, to have a different kind of birthday, even though sometimes things don't turn out the way you want them to, but that's just the way it is, we can't control everything. Women's Day was a double celebration, since it's also my mom's birthday, so you can imagine; it's mandatory to do something on that day, hehe, and as is customary in my family, the first thing we do is give each other our surprise breakfast, which, well, isn't really a surprise because, as I said, it's a tradition. Although that day's breakfast was improvised, since I didn't prepare enough, because, as it was Sunday, we go to mass very early, at 7:00 a.m., so you can imagine. However, when we left mass, the priest said that they had a breakfast for us as a gift for Women's Day. They gave us a delicious arepa; my mom got one with shredded beef and mine with chicken salad. Still, it wasn't much, hehehe, because it was a mini arepa. When we got home, the birthday girl was hungry, so I made some more arepas, my dad bought some empanadas, and I had made my famous healthy tequeños the day before.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Ep3hhdwdBWAyYJwxzDPSsWe9yNyoBankeYPSYeW8vt32uVHwn8TF98XysGL8yHN6DK6.png)
![post hive (29).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/246axHJeZN4MPZrsrya5kssW83CVfYdaxDdzwLtWzAgQWpk29HNRUHekinz1KhyJhTGqx.png)
I had printed out some pictures and, well, half decorated the tray, so I was somewhat prepared, simply, but the important thing is that I was able to make it for her; we ate everything, hehehe. And since she didn't want to do anything too big, I know she wanted to eat pizza, so my dad and I took her out to eat. When we got home, they brought her pineapple pancakes, which my sister's mother-in-law makes. Every year they ask her to make them, because they're really delicious, and they're my mom's favorite.
![post hive (30).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/243BnnpVP9DbhrskG9NpaLrKJkT5mNAceEiU7NpTeNQ33DbBY2pQeW4xKt4riBMDDw8Mr.png)
And like any surprised birthday girl, in fact, we were all surprised. My sisters sent her some mariachis, a very nice and fun touch, although she doesn't like them very much because they make her cry, hehe, but she enjoyed them anyway.
![post hive (31).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23ywrw88TcDPH3vzvZrXBjk8r3EfCRbkAAxaqLcpnJz8bF7viutX1VzoirYaDhQJm5vgk.png)
So yes, this year was different, quiet, just us, and good unexpected guests, who can never be missing, as I said, things that cannot be controlled. It was a good day, that's what matters; my mom had a good day, with family, her loved ones; thank you, God, for that.

#### Drawing 28 Bugs - Blog Summary > #### Dibujando 28 Bichos - Resumen del Blog Hello, this is my summary with the more than 28 bugs I drew for the @artofkylin challenge. It was almost a month with bugs as protagonists, taking them into more than one challenge. I had a lot of fun and I think I also improved a little. In addition, I became more familiar with the anatomy of some insects. Thanks to everyone who supported me in one way or another during this month, for your evaluations and comments. > Hola, este es mi resumen con los más de 28 bichos que dibujé para el reto de @artofkylin. Fue casi un mes con los bichos de protagonistas y llevándolos a más de un reto. Me divertí mucho y creo que también mejoré un poco. Además, me familiaricé con la anatomía de algunos insectos. Gracias a todos los que me apoyaron de alguna forma u otra en este mes, por sus valoraciones y comentarios.
🦋🐛🐜🐝🪲🐞🪳🕷️🦟

🐜🌸 The little ant on the flower 🐜🌸 ![](https://images.ecency.com/p/gPCasciUWmEzNYtqbGEDRek5dctwU2EckVZHEGTNY7ip11STJwxe61Bknsxgp3WH7igJ1B94g9WN2vA3fe1ZHhoxCD4hSycyr5Ysf3VbhfC9SjhtRZ6CYdnEga4zoX3JgiwMsJrsNBYLaACyiN?format=match&mode=fit) I also drew a little ant resting on top of a flower, basking in the sun. > También dibujé una pequeña hormiguita que descansaba encima de una flor, tomando el sol. ## 🐝 Bee in Digital Watercolors 🐝 ![](https://images.ecency.com/p/gPCasciUWmEzNYtqbGEDRek5dctwU2EckVZHEGTN7FAvpLkgXu89EinqwiKX772zV9kFGFD23FmPYPk8VyfV2KGdhFaCPPyi3TTyL7DeVd9yKow7e1i7LENA6QuqYHN9EJynTwip552Szar2rJ?format=match&mode=fit) A bee in yellow watercolor. > Una abeja en acuarelas amarillas. ## 🐛 A small caterpillar 🐛 ![](https://images.ecency.com/p/gPCasciUWmEzNYtqbGEDRek5dctwU2EckVZHEGTMrXGpecg9hBfk6hxuc74kwKdgTBjtmatCbgd7JP5mGKURDXUAfwu1TnNnEXnfCxhAeD3QzrE1fGZhEn5FxguNBpBSiuXQX7HNSmeqDUzb18?format=match&mode=fit) A little green caterpillar, a new tutorial, could it be the butterfly from before in its caterpillar phase? > Una oruguita verde, un nuevo tutorial, ¿sería la mariposa de antes en su fase oruga? ## Traté de dibujar una mantis en acuarelas de memoria y este fue el resultado. ## 🐞 Ladybug in the sun 🐞 ![](https://images.ecency.com/p/gPCasciUWmEzNYtqbGEDRek5dctwU2EckVZHEGTN7LFues7akqaEnSWtWvwSJ1e6woguoBaqENUpzxQyrR8WDpXjYFe4JmCBNiPfAcUA83hpwLJtKU1JCLx8a6QNHNNmbAuFxMjiaq3iW2DtNi?format=match&mode=fit) A small ladybug in the sun, on top of a daisy flower, in cartoon style. > Una pequeña mariquita al sol, encima de una flor de margarita, en estilo cartoon. ## 💚🦗Venom ![](https://images.ecency.com/p/gPCasciUWmEzNYtqbGEDRek5dctwU2EckVZHEGTNU2iWUepj7JskHNnqu3JvC2bDizjzKnvYtaA2FGYsG2sgqnDethvTNpaFtN1Z3FzSh3BdMjJNZ5HU3crMJUiv282MqjnfrrCKK6qZEYnTp2?format=match&mode=fit) Inspired by Venom from Holozing, I made this drawing of the character that I liked very much. > Inspirado en Venom de Holozing, realicé este dibujo del personaje que me gustó demasiado. ## body.title: Splinterlands: Possibly the greatest Attacker of the New Arcana Escalation set!🔥
body.body: >Thankfully, I have managed to maintain a ranking above 1000 so far, although climbing past this threshold is proving to be just as much of a struggle as it was when I was hovering between the 800 and 900 mark. This season, I have incorporated several new cards into my deck—cards whose performance I haven't really written much about until now. Featured in today's blog post is one such card from the Conclave Arcana: Escalation set: the Blue Wyrm Travesty. This card has been making waves thanks to its massive melee attack power. Although I have already played numerous battles using this card, I hadn't found the opportunity to write about it until now; however, in today's battle, you can witness its impressive performance firsthand.
>The battle commenced with two specific rulesets in effect: \
ruleset eliminated all cards with an odd Mana cost from the selection pool, while \

granted the Camouflage ability to every card on the battlefield, without exception. Both players opted to battle using the Water Element. Coincidentally, my opponent also possessed a Blue Wyrm Travesty card, and both of us chose to place it on the frontline. This strategic placement was necessary because the card lacks the ability to launch attacks from anywhere other than the front position; furthermore, the Water Element's only card possessing the Flank ability was unavailable for selection due to the \
ruleset. There was, however, one major difference between our respective Archons: I chose Prophet Rosa with the specific aim of further empowering my ranged attackers.🔥

>Since all the cards at the back of my lineup were already protected thanks to the Camouflage ability, I used Archon's powers to grant a +2 Range Power boost to my ranged attackers positioned at the very end of the lineup. The Silence and Slow abilities from my cards weakened the enemy even before <a target=\

>the battle began—and then, the battle commenced. Because the enemy possessed two cards with the Slow ability, the speed of my cards was reduced by 2; consequently, my opponent got the opportunity to perform the first attacks. This actually turned out to be a favourable outcome, for if my card had attacked first—given that the massive melee attacker, Blue Wyrm Travesty, lacks the Piercing ability—that 7-point melee attack would have been entirely wasted on the opponent's armour. Since the enemy attacked first, my ranged attackers were able to destroy the opponent's armor and subsequently inflict damage to their health; finally, when it was my Blue Wyrm Travesty card's turn to attack, the enemy was knocked out with a single strike.

\n\n

>And then, following an attack from another one of my cards, the opponent suffered another knockout. Consequently, the Speed ​​of my cards increased by +1. The result was that, in the next round, my cards could attack first. Once again, this card's explosive melee attack completely flattened the opponent in a single strike. Such is the power of the Blue Wyrm Travesty. Yet, it makes one wonder: why is this merely a Common card? It truly ought to be a Legendary one. Perhaps the reason lies in the fact that—even at its highest level—it cannot perform melee attacks from any position other than the front row. Consequently, this primary attacker in your deck is forced to stand at the very forefront to absorb the enemy's attacks, thereby reducing its chances of surviving on the battlefield. Nevertheless, I have thoroughly enjoyed using this card so far, and in all likelihood, I will definitely be purchasing it.

* * *

>Splinterlands isn't an easy place, but that's what makes it even more fun. A perfect strategy takes into account many factors, including stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and more. That's why it's even more important to consider all these factors when developing a strategy. Add good cards to your deck, but also work on improving your strategies, and strive to win as many battles as possible!🔥\n\n

body.title: Freezed - PhotoFeed Contest Portrait Photography 160
body.body: For the length of time that I've been trying my hands on photography, one thing I've noticed is that candid photography is the most interesting. Like, you're capturing subjects without them knowing or posing, and this often result in natural, unguarded moments. You don't script it, you don't plan it – it just happens. Just one click and you're freezing a moment in time. \n\nAnd you know, most times, such unplanned shots turn out to be the most striking. You go through your photos later, and you're like \

It's like discovering something magical! 
 
**This photo below is just a perfect example.**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZePgSHX54M6uQrgH2FenyZbCrgSXicihUv1qEoX57wXD/1773162297651.jpg)

***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfCh17q5JUjbbusxAzzFbfEWN1LcHmP1qAM5BNHHwmCAL/1773162297987.jpg)

I captured the scene at Azikiwe by Georges' Street, on my walk some days ago. Actually, I was aiming for the roadside oil shop behind him, and had taken the first shot, as the above photo shows. But as I tried to take a second shot, things got interesting. I caught him mid-stride as he was stepping out of the oil shop, with a face that was just as serious as hell. Maybe his transaction at the oil shop didn't go through, or probably it was something else. But his face was giving out \

Lol. 

The intensity on his face tells a whole story – a mix of surprise, and a hint of annoyance. In fact, you'd think he was coming at me, probably because he suspected what I was up to. But, nah, he had no idea I was snapping away, and that's what makes the photo so raw - pure candid moment, and I love it. 😍 

Even the shop owner, who was checking the POS in his hands was unaware that he was being captured. Just like the other guy, I wonder what his reaction would be upon finding out that I'd sneaked a photo of him. Hehehe. 


That's a wrap. Have you captured candid photos before? How did you feel afterwards? I'd love to know. 
***

See you in my next blog. 


***
**Author's Photos Captured With Redmi 14c.**
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZuavB1TQ4H4UZnrridAehLxZjNowSUYK7oFXXXdCBNmQ/1000013948.png)

body.title: Starting over is not failure, It is betting on yourself.
body.body:
Starting over is scary but it can bring growth. Leaving a relationship, changing careers, moving cities, walking away from something familiar of ten feel scary at first. It feels like jumping into the unknown. You don’t know what will happen, you don’t know if it will work, you don’t know if you will regret it. So you stay in what you feel you should leave, not because you’re happy but because you’re afraid. Afraid of failing. Afraid of being alone. Afraid of people talking. Afraid of making the wrong decision. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZSMHd9RbxjaaHBEj8WkJJiKkzsgCtGQn1PxJ3aYvaC6D/1773163211058.jpg)


But the real fear is Waking up five years from now… Still in the same place. Still complaining about the same problems. Still feeling unfulfilled. Still telling yourself, “Maybe next year.” That is scarier. 

Time does not wait for courage. It keeps moving. Five years will pass whether you act or not. The only difference is what you will have to show for it. Regret is heavier than fear. Fear lasts for a moment. Regret can last a lifetime.  

Starting over means growth. It means choosing yourself. It means saying, “I deserve better,” even when your voice is shaking. Yes, it will be uncomfortable. Yes, it may be lonely at first, you might doubt yourself. But staying somewhere you have outgrown will slowly destroy you.  

Comfort can become a cage. Familiarity can become a prison. Sometimes God, life, or growth is pushing you forward… But you are holding on to what is already dead because it feels safe. You cannot build a new life while clinging to an old one. You cannot become a new person while protecting old habits. You cannot meet better opportunities while staying where you are tolerated instead of valued.  

Starting over is not failure. It is bravery. It is betting on yourself. It is trusting that your future is bigger than your fear. Let’s start Over again.

body.body: > Last Saturday I went to the mall with my family. We passed by the amusement park that is set up there this month, and in the end we stopped by a pet convenience store. They have all kinds of things for dogs, cats, birds, and so on, but what I enjoy the most when I go there are the fish, and I always spend some time admiring them. I took a few photos of the things I found most interesting. There is an aquarium right in the middle of the store that gives the feeling that people are walking inside the aquarium, or that the fish are together with the people. You can choose which one. It is so funny that it almost looks like a scene from one of those videos made by AI. >[PT] >No último sábado eu fui passear com a minha família no shopping. Passamos pelo parque de diversões que está ativo esse mês por lá e no final demos uma passada em uma loja de conveniência para pets. Lá tem todo tipo de coisa para cães e gatos, pássaros e etc, mas o que eu mais gosto quando vou ao local são os peixes e eu sempre fico um tempo admirando eles. >Tirei algumas fotos do que achei mais legal. Um aquário bem no meio da loja dá a sensação de que as pessoas estão passeando dentro desse aquário ou que os peixes estão junto com as pessoas, você escolhe. Isso é tão hilário que até parece uma cena daqueles vídeos feitos por IA. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXHiXSbwj1e4F9jANSS4xLx4EH3LhWd6SNRqRi2ysaHSc/image.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd9gD5GFTFNVmLd3v4yJz3NvXRpG5sJ56d3uovwLKGCGZ/image.png) A saleswoman approached me after she saw me taking photos, and we ended up talking for a while about the fish. body.title: Rich cabbage and mushroom soup with baked bread cubes (ENG/ESP)
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTUGHfuajC5wbrpUaP9teuQtX8mRKmzzfaVfwsmQ2BhyB/1773159128294.jpg)

Good evening, blog friends, how are you? I'm a little tired today, both from the move and the first day of my period, and from a stomach ache. So today I needed some peace and quiet and a warm, invigorating meal: an excellent warm soup with an autumnal flavor, which I love in every season.

 For this soup, you'll need: 

* 100 grams of button mushrooms
 * 250 grams of cabbage 
* 250 grams of stale baguette bread 
* 4 cloves of garlic
 * 3 tablespoons of oil 
* 2 tablespoons of white pepper 
* 3 tablespoons of fine salt

 First, let's take care of the mushrooms that take the longest. Rinse them under running water and then carefully remove any soil from them with a cloth. Button mushrooms are usually very earthy; if you have one, you can clean them with a mushroom knife, which is easier to use. Then, cut the mushrooms in half and set them aside for later. Now let's dedicate ourselves to the cabbage, rinse that too with cold water, cut the quantity we need and cut it into medium-sized strips.

🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂

Buenas noches, amigos del blog, ¿qué tal? Hoy estoy un poco cansada, tanto por la mudanza como por el primer día de la regla, y por el dolor de estómago. Así que hoy necesitaba un poco de tranquilidad y una comida calentita y revitalizante: una sopa caliente excelente con sabor otoñal, que me encanta en cualquier estación. 

Para esta sopa, necesitarán: 

* 100 gramos de champiñones
 * 250 gramos de col 
* 250 gramos de pan baguette duro
 * 4 dientes de ajo 
* 3 cucharadas de aceite
 * 2 cucharadas de pimienta blanca 
* 3 cucharadas de sal fina

 Primero, vamos a encargarnos de los champiñones que más tardan en asarse. Enjuáguenlos con agua corriente y luego retiren con cuidado la tierra con un paño. Los champiñones suelen tener mucha tierra; si tienen uno, pueden limpiarlos con un cuchillo para champiñones, que es más fácil de usar. Luego, córtenlos por la mitad y resérvenlos para más tarde. Ahora vamos a dedicarnos a la col, la enjuagamos también con agua fría, cortamos la cantidad que necesitemos y la cortamos en tiras medianas.




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQQAYbWRhRVLB5amY5R2Lpuuwr7dRikxNxmWfoh9bYrLu/1773159146236.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZQkrzkmawvguey878ufqd7QUppzCcMxdEe6Efdo73Kqo/1773159146624.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUc4RgeWmchTRV4YzJ8yjRDebMDyR8SemCupA2J4KgJVF/1773159147026.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdEqaoe7g3X6xbmMz7zY4qRUE6QLdNh7nS7wN2VEv8vpb/1773159147436.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVLU9hyMXYb9pg8pmVZoau5Gq5mD7x6V1Sv2agDgHPijx/1773159147942.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRuVddKABYhsCyXd7aEe8v6Yp7dhnezVhMM6EYtHMrFB5/1773159175669.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPxYoXP9VBTrTadiUKKKKW6rM6SdgMTCBwjUnECY1tnvZ/1773159175969.jpg)



Next, peel and finely chop the garlic. Add it to a pan with three tablespoons of oil and sauté for three minutes. Add the mushrooms and cook, stirring, for about fifteen minutes until they turn a dark brown. Then, prepare a pot of water with salt and pepper. When the water boils, add the cabbage and cook for twenty-five minutes, stirring frequently.

 Then add the mushrooms, already cooked in the pan, and cook everything together for another five minutes. Meanwhile, slice the stale baguette bread. Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Once hot, heat the bread slices for five minutes. Once they're nice and brown, cut them into medium-sized cubes. Serve the hot soup on plates, tossing the cooked bread cubes over the top. It's a comforting, crunchy, heartening soup, delicious.

🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂🍂

A continuación, pela y pica finamente el ajo. Añádelo a una sartén con tres cucharadas de aceite y saltéalo durante tres minutos. Agrega los champiñones y cocínalos, revolviendo, durante unos quince minutos hasta que adquieran un color marrón oscuro. Luego, prepara una olla con agua, sal y pimienta. Cuando el agua hierva, agrega el repollo y cocínalo durante veinticinco minutos, revolviendo con frecuencia. Luego agrega los champiñones, ya cocidos en la sartén, y cocínalos todo junto durante otros cinco minutos.

 Mientras tanto, corta el pan baguette duro en rebanadas. Precalienta el horno a 200 °C (400 °F). Una vez caliente, calienta las rebanadas de pan durante cinco minutos. Una vez que estén bien doradas, córtalas en cubos medianos. Sirve la sopa caliente en platos, echando los cubos de pan cocidos por encima. Es una sopa reconfortante, crujiente y alentadora, deliciosa.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQiMGzi9f5ayvU4V2MqiY2yP2kaxRyiigm5H3bcwutpfM/1773159176347.jpg)

body.body:
>

‎In every human life, the most consistent element is growth. It is not a phase of life or stage, it is something that is definite in every human life. Indeed there are different growth stages in life as we grow older and wiser we become more knowledgeable about life and our surroundings. Through the knowledge we acquire we understand our being like ever before, we discover new parts of our selves. A human being is like shelves of books, at every point in time we discover new things about our selves and it never ends.
‎
‎I have been working on myself a lot lately than usual, I don't know if it is something that comes with aging but I have become more intentional with my actions like ever before, if I'm being honest an attitude of mine prompted it. Have you ever had an attitude that feels honourable but cost you what matters to you the most?
‎
‎What I'm about to say has been going on for years but I became more conscious of it since 2024. If I'm being honest I will say I started paying attention to it in 2024 than any other year but I still haven't gotten full control of it. I was watching a tiktok video sometime ago it was called \

.
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdC73XBQFDVA59yhm9CEcBMoyJWTvzY1vNceundYdPYK7/1773162508125.avif)

‎I have always find it difficult to say no to people even if their request will cost me dearly, it always feels like if I say no I'm letting them down, I suddenly feel guilty like I have committed a huge crime. I always want to be in the position to help people but this is different, it is like a feeling that suddenly overwhelm my mind and all I could think about is the request of the person that has requested for my help no matter the cost.
‎
‎This attitude of mine made it impossible for me to prioritise myself or my peace of mind, I always feel like my needs can wait let me help out this person first, sacrificing every bit of my comfort just to ensure others don't experience discomfort. It is something that comes naturally for me, I feel like people's pain is mine, I was experiencing \

.
‎
‎Empathy is a normal feeling in every human, ability to understand thoughts, emotions and feelings of others. It is like a mechanism that gives us the ability to interpret people's emotions but when it becomes excessive you feel people's pain beyond the usual, so when someone comes to you asking for help, you would always feel inclined to help because you feel responsible for the person.
‎
‎Instead of me having friends, all I had was people I was responsible for. The most annoying aspect of it was when I realised people consider it a tool to manipulate me in getting things done for them. It is not like I want to stop helping people but I want to be in control of who I help. Last year was when I started gaining a little control over it. I said no to a couple of absurd request for help and the number of people in my circle reduced greatly, then I realised that they were not around me because they cared but for what they could take from me.
‎
‎Ever since last year, I kept embarking on the process of learning how to prioritise myself, my peace of mind and learning how to say no when needed. You should see how exhausted I used to feel before, after giving all I have to people and receiving no care in return. I was drained mentally to the extent I became the shadow of myself. It is so tricky how learning to say \

could set boundaries and establish sincere relationships. Our iftar items are different every day. To be honest, I don't like eating the same food every day. We try to have a variety of Iftar dishes, such as special salads, special chops, or different types of kebabs made with chicken, and other dishes made with curd and muri.Overall, I try to bring variety to my meals and my family loves to eat this variety of food. The picture or dish I gave you at the beginning today is a special type of salad made with carrots, mint leaves, and green chilies. A pinch of salt can make a whole salad delicious. ![IMG20260226175701.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmempubG4JBUhyjVqwdEitXoVDDxPzthGRhprcHTHdLRtC/IMG20260226175701.jpg) Here I have made vegetable chops. After a while we will mix them all together and prepare them for eating. Here we have mixed Bundia Jilapi and Beguni Chop. When it was time for iftar, we all started eating these delicious and nutritious foods together. Anyway, this was my plan for today. I hope you liked the food photos I took. body.title: WINGS OF THE TROPICS
body.body:
![Kopia – Observed lives (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23yJVReTsbFQkCUHNuvxb83cFJ4uXTf8ucNXL9Y93KXdxhUka7k1tR3QTMR88XBY3Vc52.jpg)

While going through my photo archive, I have to admit that these are already the last butterfly photos I can share with you from my visit to the butterfly house in Leipzig last year.

I think butterflies are a very interesting subject to photograph because they are very colorful and they present themselves beautifully in pictures. In butterfly houses they are also often more accustomed to people and sometimes even land on them, which makes photographing them easier than trying to capture butterflies that you happen to find somewhere outside.

Of course, it is also a great opportunity to see and learn about different species of butterflies. Unfortunately, there is no butterfly house anywhere near where I live, so I hope that sooner or later I will find another one somewhere along my route. I would really like to show you more photos in the future and maybe discover some new species as well.

Today I would like to present a few species of butterflies that I had the chance to photograph in Leipzig.


---
SIPROETA EPAPHUS is a butterfly from the brush-footed butterfly family, Nymphalidae. It can reach a wingspan of about 7 to 7.5 centimeters. It has a very characteristic wing pattern with wide light green or turquoise bands and spots. The underside of the wings, on the other hand, is somewhat lighter in color with an orange and brown border.

This species can be found mainly in Central and South America, where it inhabits mainly rainforests. It also occurs in gardens and at the edges of forests. 
It is also worth adding that adult individuals do not feed exclusively on flower nectar. They also feed on fallen fruit, the juices of fermenting plants, or even on moist soil. From there they obtain minerals.

This butterfly can very often be found in various butterfly houses around the world. Because it behaves very calmly, it is often possible to approach it very closely and calmly take a few shots.


![20250511_140509.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23tGXhPZYLjt7p4XKmskEEskxKewzSHuXmfCjHNhjVug581WyMjp45f6HMwCLE6QrjmdV.jpg)

![20250511_140527.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23swibWfmBDHp63spFu7WhdknnosKyR13hGdNHQ9c5vnqkm6d8ZMNHKkBumLKyr1hJRab.jpg)

![20250511_140530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/Eo44My8ziMvJQojQjtmeuvrZsQw4nJpRNMVCAuEzZk5AygtzBDLAehc6vDyXiE8B6U6.jpg)

---

DRYAS IULIA is another butterfly from the brush-footed butterfly family. It can be very easily recognized by its intensely orange color. The wings of this butterfly are very slender and have an elongated shape. Its wingspan can reach up to nine centimeters.

This species can be found in Central America, South America and also in North America. It occurs mainly in tropical and subtropical rainforests, but it can also be found in gardens, clearings and meadows.

Dryas iulia butterflies are usually very active. Adult individuals feed mainly on flower nectar. Due to its striking coloration this is also a butterfly that can very often be found in butterfly houses and tropical gardens around the world.


![20250511_141733.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23w2HcPtWwcSTGRB28qxjsFd6YP2vn2N5FJqefVnKPe3wWAoc9KcE9j4FLqjGQd5rCocv.jpg)

![20250511_140954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23u5tdhknwEddZBXDvnzYTVB9ZQa8Q68baoMCQEuSCu6VPz1gBcyWuTXGQbfwvMkoeQYU.jpg)

---

Another butterfly I prepared for today is HELICONIUS ISMENIUS. It is also a tropical butterfly belonging to the brush-footed butterfly family, one of whose characteristic features is elongated wings. This butterfly has very dark wings with a characteristic yellow band, somewhat resembling tiger stripes, which is why it is also called the tiger longwing.

The wingspan of this butterfly usually ranges from 7 to 8 centimeters. This species mainly inhabits Central America and the northern part of South America. It can be found primarily in humid tropical forests, but also in gardens at the edges of forests and in parks.

It is also worth adding that these butterflies feed not only on flower nectar, but also on plant pollen. This allows them to live much longer than many other butterfly species. Because this butterfly is characterized by a calm temperament and an interesting wing pattern, it is also a species that can very often be found in various butterfly houses.


![20250511_141811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23tv8VirD8aLo4TaPQwDYLxgKaFRcidrsagDB3aSS7xxC7idoPwMGZqz2DHBentVmu7jv.jpg)

![20250511_141700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23tSMiZ7WQPtr3joAL8e8LwaK2SCuktDU4XtkiGq6tfFT49urKJqvwW7HycKh4NfD1mXe.jpg)

---

And the last butterfly for today is HELICONIUS ERATO, also known as the Red Postman. The wings of this butterfly are brown or brown-black on both sides and like other butterflies from the brush-footed butterfly family it occurs in Central and South America.

It inhabits rainforests and their edges, but it can also be found in gardens, clearings and meadows. The wingspan of this butterfly usually ranges from 6 to 7 centimeters and the wings are slender and slightly elongated, which is very characteristic of butterflies from this species.

This butterfly, like Heliconius erato, also feeds on plant pollen, and to a lesser extent on flower nectar. Due to its interesting coloration and calm behavior, it is also a butterfly that can very often be observed from a close distance in butterfly houses and tropical gardens.



![20250511_141120.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/Eo6D7MYeDMvFtbRxCoSJ4iiovPjyoBZovD75kyoZPpdXR3FYx6Yk6CFyAjEmuBvz6Yr.jpg)

body.title: LPG Shortage
body.body:
With the war in the West Asia, all yhe other countries are feeling the pressure. The Europe and along with that Asia started having problems with the fuels and the LPG gases. If I talk about India, we are getting the alternative fuels from the Russia but when comes to LPG, we are dependent on yhe Saudi Arabia and because of that there is slight problem. 


![17731624241486675207965217940175.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/codingdefined/23w2jHRosNAdY2UqH1C1azJSfKtjbVKr3njeXVSxJBJQehehTc3iZZ9XDt48WqYkf5gci.png)
PC: Pixabay.com

There is a news came out recently saying that the hotels in Bangalore cannot function properly because of the shortage of commercial cooking gas. And it's gonna increase from here. The hotels all over India and mostly in Bangalore uses commercial LPG gas, now government is prioritizing domestic LPG than commercial. And that's why there is a shortage of commercial gas. If this continues, either the hotel owner have to switch to something else or they have to shutdown for some days.

This is a scary situation all over the world. Pakistan has increased around PKR 50 for the petrol and diesel. Along with that they have done some measures to reduce the fuel usage. And since the fuel prices are increasing, the inflation will continue to rise. With rise in fuel prices all the items prices will increase subsequently and thus inflation will increase. In India, as of now there is no price increase in fuel prices but the LPG price have been increased by Rs 50. So yeah we are seeing the effect of the war in almost every countries.

That's why the middle east is so much important to stay at peace for the world. But I feel every other country wants to go for a war and without worrying about the consequences. We should not hoard the fuels as of now but situation can become bad in coming weeks.

body.title: [ESP/ENG] Pierde Cuba en el Clásico Mundial y peligra su clasificación. Opinión
body.body:
Una introducción necesaria

El equipo nacional de Cuba perdió contra Puerto Rico con un marcador final de cuatro carreras por una, y se encendieron las alarmas dentro y fuera del país. Los seguidores de nuestro equipo saben que ese juego era crucial para las aspiraciones de clasificar a cuartos de final.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaMLTVmDYLtE1yf8yzD3zep2kvGCDPKpwq4nPc4WmJXnx/1773162603484.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/100044207360624/posts/1508711753945722/?app=fbl)







Sin embargo, los problemas que este servidor señaló en publicaciones anteriores persistieron. Ante equipos del gran nivel de Puerto Rico, cometer esos errores es un pecado capital que se paga caro, tal como sucedió.

Es cierto que todavía queda una oportunidad, pero, para este autor, se presenta un poco más compleja que la del día de ayer. Aunque no es un muro infranqueable para nuestra selección, ni mucho menos.




Primera derrota del equipo Cuba

Una entrada bastó para que Puerto Rico clasificara a cuartos de final y obligara a Cuba a derrotar a la selección de Canadá por el último boleto del grupo.

Fue un partido en el que nuestro combinado nacional volvió a cometer los mismos errores de juegos anteriores, pero además adoleció de algo que sí había tenido en sus juegos contra Panamá y Colombia: la oportunidad al bate.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSrMtQZFeomnFNmMC48rjy3xgTRerUVifCqHfZ19zJo4/1773162430786.jpg)[fuente](https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1327056279444652&set=a.408050941345195&type=3&mibextid=rS40aB7S9Ucbxw6v)

Vayamos al encuentro.

El segundo inning fue suficiente para que Puerto Rico se mantuviera como el único invicto del grupo y asegurara su presencia en la segunda parte del evento. En esta entrada se combinaron un boleto de libre tránsito y tres hits; uno de ellos, un doblete de Martín Maldonado con bases llenas, que les reportó tres carreras a los puertorriqueños. Estas anotaciones fueron más que suficientes, aunque después anotaron otra rayita más para ganar el encuentro por cuatro carreras a una.

Las claves de la derrota de Cuba

· El descontrol de sus lanzadores, que otorgaron seis bases por bolas.
· La baja producción ofensiva del equipo. El juego de béisbol se gana por carreras y es muy difícil ganar un juego con solamente dos hits.
· No hubo variantes de juego que permitieran a los jugadores llegar a las bases para intentar anotar carrera, mediante la utilización de la velocidad en función de la ofensiva.
· Faltó oportunidad de los bateadores para aprovechar el descontrol de los lanzadores boricuas.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXfnsZeuG8zrcsiwxEQ4DmNMHMyzS8BiyRZ5dmH4ju9eY/1773162769813.jpg)[fuente](https://x.com/CubanaBeisbol/status/2031009884984983642?t=aaD1n4vDtWW39obU7RisHw&s=08)


A continuación, un inventario de preguntas y respuestas

¿Se puede derrotar a Canadá? La respuesta es sí.

¿Se puede ganar cometiendo los mismos errores? De seguro que no.

¿Qué tiene Cuba a su favor? Contará con Liván Moinelo, Yariel Rodríguez, Joan López y Raydel Martínez, los cuatro lanzadores más efectivos que ha tenido nuestro equipo.
Otro elemento positivo es que Cuba debe ser home club, y esto siempre le da un plus extra a los encuentros.

¿Qué tiene que mejorar Cuba para ganarle a Canadá? El bateo y el control de los lanzadores para que no concedan tantas bases por bolas.

¿Qué otros elementos yo cambiaría? Considero que Roel Santos debe ser movido del primer bate porque no está cumpliendo su objetivo; en tres partidos de clásico no ha conectado hits.
Tampoco han producido los jugadores de más peso ofensivo dentro del equipo, como lo son el 4.º y 5.º bate, por lo que deben hacer los ajustes necesarios y tratar de producir las carreras para ganar este crucial encuentro.

Un comentario final

El juego contra Canadá se presume como una final para el equipo cubano, porque de ganarlo aseguran su clasificación a la segunda parte del torneo y estarán entre los 8 mejores equipos del clásico.

Para alcanzar ese objetivo, muchas cosas deben mejorar nuestros jugadores y nuestro cuerpo de dirección debe buscar las mejores alternativas posibles para alcanzar la victoria. Porque de continuar jugando como hasta ahora, de seguro tendremos que retornar a casa con el mal sabor de haber sido eliminados en primera ronda. Algo que puede pasar por la calidad de los contrarios, pero que es inadmisible para los amantes del béisbol en Cuba.

¿Qué piensa usted?

Nota: Utilicé el traductor DeepL Translate.

 

ENGLISH 


Cuba loses in the World Classic and its qualification is in danger. Opinion

A Necessary Introduction

Cuba's national team lost to Puerto Rico with a final score of four runs to one, and alarm bells went off inside and outside the country. The fans of our team know that that game was crucial for the aspirations of qualifying for the quarterfinals.

! [](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaMLTVmDYLtE1yf8yzD3zep2kvGCDPKpwq4nPc4WmJXnx/1773162603484.jpg)[source](https://www.facebook.com/100044207360624/posts/1508711753945722/?app=fbl)

However, the problems that this server pointed out in previous posts persisted. Against teams of Puerto Rico's high level, making those mistakes is a capital sin that is paid dearly, as it happened.

It is true that there is still an opportunity, but, for this author, it is a little more complex than yesterday's. Although it is not an insurmountable wall for our national team, far from it.

First defeat for the Cuba team

One inning was enough for Puerto Rico to qualify for the quarterfinals and force Cuba to defeat Canada for the last ticket in the group.

It was a game in which our national team made the same mistakes of previous games, but also lacked something that it had had in its games against Panama and Colombia: the opportunity at bat.

! [](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSrMtQZFeomnFNmMC48rjy3xgTRerUVifCqHfZ19zJo4/1773162430786.jpg)[source](https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1327056279444652&set=a.408050941345195&type=3&mibextid=rS40aB7S9Ucbxw6v)

Let's go to the meeting.

The second inning was enough for Puerto Rico to remain the only undefeated team in the group and ensure its presence in the second part of the event. In this inning, a free transit ticket and three hits were combined; one of them, a double by Martín Maldonado with bases loaded, which brought three runs to the Puerto Ricans. These scores were more than enough, although they later scored another run to win the game by four runs to one.

The keys to Cuba's defeat

· The lack of control of their pitchers, who gave up six walks.
· The team's low offensive production. The baseball game is won by runs and it is very difficult to win a game with only two hits.
· There were no variants of play that allowed players to reach the bases to try to score a run, by using speed depending on the offense.
· There was a lack of opportunity for the batters to take advantage of the lack of control of the Puerto Rican pitchers.

! [](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXfnsZeuG8zrcsiwxEQ4DmNMHMyzS8BiyRZ5dmH4ju9eY/1773162769813.jpg)[source](https://x.com/CubanaBeisbol/status/2031009884984983642?t=aaD1n4vDtWW39obU7RisHw&s=08)

Below is an inventory of questions and answers

Can Canada be defeated? The answer is yes.

Can you win by making the same mistakes? Surely not.

What does Cuba have in its favor? It will feature Liván Moinelo, Yariel Rodríguez, Joan López and Raydel Martínez, the four most effective pitchers our team has had.
Another positive element is that Cuba must be a home club, and this always gives an extra plus to the matches.

What does Cuba have to improve to beat Canada? The batting and control of pitchers so that they do not concede so many walks.

What other elements would I change? I believe that Roel Santos should be moved from the leadoff bat because he is not fulfilling his objective; In three classic games he has not connected hits.
They also haven't produced the most offensive players on the team, such as the 4th and 5th bats, so they must make the necessary adjustments and try to produce the runs to win this crucial game.

A final comment

The game against Canada is presumed to be a final for the Cuban team, because if they win it they will ensure their qualification to the second part of the tournament and will be among the 8 best teams in the classic.

To achieve that goal, many things must be improved by our players and our management body must look for the best possible alternatives to achieve victory. Because if we continue playing as we have done so far, we will surely have to return home with the bad taste of having been eliminated in the first round. Something that can happen because of the quality of the opponents, but that is inadmissible for baseball lovers in Cuba.

What do you think?

Note: I used the DeepL Translate translator.

body.title: Normal Life Vs Abnormal Life
body.body:
>

Times are changing and today we consume all manner of contnet and information unfiltered. Many people have fallen into depression because of what they have seen and heard on social media and from content creators. All am trying to say is that as a generation, we have learned so many habits the wrong ways, and it's high time we start unlearning some of them.

|<center><div class=\

>What Am Learning | |----------------------------------------| | | I am currently learning to take my wandering life back to becoming a normal life, hence my name (normalyf). Its funny how I woke up one morning and realized I have not been living my actual life but instead I have been living according to the standard of what I see on social media and movies. For so many years I failed to live in the moment and enjoy the process of life. I compared my life to the ones I see on social media and because of that I always felt I was not trying enough and my best was not good enough. All my little achievements were meaningless to me because I constantly thought they were nothing compared to the happy life I see flaunting the internet.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaPy7RptPfzPTW5BdZRtLvk64jrU67CuSTTzC7FhDSEdD/1773162263704.jpg)
[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/man-face-mask-new-normal-pandemic-7049598/)
But thank God for growth and experience I got to understand that life is full of ups and downs. The people I see living happily on social media and flaunting all manner of achievements all have their unique stories, and it would be wrong to make that the standard of my life. Alot of people show only the happy side they want the world to see. But I have come to learn and understand that behind every successful story, they were days of tears, depression, confusion, doubts, and failures that were not posted for us to see. This has made me realize I wasn't lost after all, I was only experiencing the full package of life. Realizing this fact shaped my life moving forward because I now appreciate my achievements no matter how little and I relax to enjoy every moment of life whether peaceful or chaotic. This is what it means to live a normal life. I used to start my mornings the same way, roll over, grab my phone, and scroll. Within few minutes I would see someone's perfect workout, or a friend's perfect breakfast, or just a stranger's transformative morning routine. Before I even put my feet on the floor, I already felt behind, lol. I had let a highlight reel become my standard for living without even realizing it. It is true that social media didn't invent comparison, but it perfected it, compressing thousands of people's best moments into a feed that feels like a standard we should meet. |

>What Am Unlearning | |----------------------------------------| | | I am in the journey of finally learning to take my life back and for that reason am currently unlearning some habits and behaviors. I was treating my life as content to be curated and validated by others but now I just experience life and enjoy the moment because I might not get it back. I always wanted to take the perfect shot to share on my socials and get validations before I would feel okay. In those days, if I experience something remarkable but didn't take photos to post, I would feel it was all a waste of time, lol.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPntfsHeLwdKPR2noFcRoYk7RHv13Aqjv3oRXbJ7FZ3Ly/1773162112346.jpg)
[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/live-concert-dance-club-disco-laser-388160/)
That's not a normal life, as we were designed to think that way. Now, I am rebuilding trust in my own standards, even when they don't look impressive. Sometimes the unwitnessed moments turns out to be the most memorable to us. I am learning to become more at home in whoever I already am, not less ambitious, not abandoning goals but treating them as directions, not verdicts.

body.title: Ensamble Gurrufío [Esp-Eng]
body.body: > Analizamos la trayectoria del **Ensamble Gurrufío**, la agrupación que elevó la música instrumental venezolana a los escenarios más prestigiosos del mundo, desde el Carnegie Hall hasta Japón.

> We analyze the career of **Ensamble Gurrufío**, the group that elevated Venezuelan instrumental music to the world's most prestigious stages, from Carnegie Hall to Japan. ---  
[English version below!](https://www.google.com/search?q=%23contenido-english)
--- ![Ensamble Gurrufío](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musicavenezuela/AKDgwRGhQLjnmd8Xauzqu1oNeDoCQTtMiVuKFExsL12U6rCV4J5rPsUE6nXjHaf.png) # Ensamble Gurrufío: Virtuosismo y esencia de la música venezolana

> El **Ensamble Gurrufío** representa, sin lugar a dudas, la cúspide de la excelencia técnica y la innovación en la música instrumental de **Venezuela**. Fundado en el año 1984, el grupo nació de la inquietud y la visión compartida de cuatro amigos músicos de formación académica excepcional, quienes se propusieron rescatar y revitalizar la música tradicional venezolana a través de un planteamiento estético y técnico totalmente novedoso. Su propuesta, que combina la improvisación propia del jazz con el rigor de la música de cámara y la esencia rítmica de nuestras regiones, ha transformado la manera en que el mundo percibe los géneros populares como el vals, el merengue venezolano, el joropo y la danza. Los inicios de la agrupación estuvieron marcados por la tenacidad y la convicción. En una época donde las agrupaciones instrumentales de este tipo tenían pocos espacios formales, el ensamble se vio en la necesidad de presentarse en escenarios poco convencionales, incluyendo plazas y espacios abiertos. Sin embargo, esta cercanía con el público permitió que su sonido orgánico y virtuoso conectara rápidamente con la audiencia. Con el paso de los años, esa perseverancia fue recompensada con creces, posicionándolos como la referencia obligada para las nuevas generaciones de músicos y elevando el estándar de la interpretación de instrumentos como la flauta, el cuatro, el contrabajo y las maracas. La proyección internacional del **Ensamble Gurrufío** ha sido una de las más prolíficas y exitosas en la historia cultural del país. Desde 1991, han llevado la bandera de la identidad sonora nacional a los escenarios más prestigiosos de los cinco continentes. Sus giras por **Japón** incluyeron presentaciones en ciudades como **Tokio**, **Osaka**, **Kioto**, **Sado** y **Hamamatsu**, logrando una acogida sorprendente en la cultura nipona. En el continente americano, han recorrido **Brasil**, **México**, las **Antillas Holandesas** y **Colombia**. Un hito fundamental en su carrera ocurrió en 1994, cuando ofrecieron un recital en la mítica sala del **Carnegie Hall** de **Nueva York**, invitados por la **American Composer's Orchestra**, consolidándose como embajadores de la alta cultura venezolana. Su presencia en los **Estados Unidos** no se ha limitado a salas de concierto, sino que ha abarcado un importante componente académico, realizando clínicas y conciertos en universidades de élite como **Stanford**, **Berkeley**, **UCLA** y la **Universidad de Indiana**. Entre 1995 y 1998, el ensamble conquistó **Europa**, llevando el virtuosismo del cuatro y la flauta a **Francia**, **España**, **Inglaterra** y **Alemania**. Posteriormente, continuaron su expansión por el cono sur, visitando **Río de Janeiro**, **Bogotá**, **Santiago de Chile** y **Sao Paulo**. El reconocimiento a su labor ha sido constante. En 1998, se hicieron acreedores al prestigioso premio **Monseñor Pellín** en una mención especial, destacando su inmenso aporte a la difusión de los valores culturales de las regiones venezolanas y su intachable profesionalismo. A través de su discografía y sus colaboraciones con orquestas sinfónicas y solistas de talla mundial, el **Ensamble Gurrufío** ha demostrado que la música de raíz tradicional es un lenguaje universal capaz de emocionar en los teatros más exigentes del planeta. ------

>  ### Ensamble Gurrufío: Virtuosity and Essence of Venezuelan Music **Ensamble Gurrufío** undoubtedly represents the pinnacle of technical excellence and innovation in instrumental music from **Venezuela**. Founded in 1984, the group was born from the restlessness and shared vision of four friends, all musicians of exceptional academic training, who set out to rescue and revitalize traditional Venezuelan music through a completely new aesthetic and technical approach. Their proposal, which combines the improvisation typical of jazz with the rigor of chamber music and the rhythmic essence of our regions, has transformed the way the world perceives popular genres such as the waltz, Venezuelan merengue, joropo, and danza. The beginnings of the group were marked by tenacity and conviction. At a time when instrumental groups of this type had few formal spaces, the ensemble found itself needing to perform in unconventional settings, including squares and open spaces. However, this closeness to the public allowed their organic and virtuous sound to quickly connect with the audience. Over the years, that perseverance was richly rewarded, positioning them as the mandatory reference for new generations of musicians and raising the standard for the performance of instruments such as the flute, the cuatro, the double bass, and the maracas. The international projection of **Ensamble Gurrufío** has been one of the most prolific and successful in the country's cultural history. Since 1991, they have carried the banner of national sound identity to the most prestigious stages across five continents. Their tours of **Japan** included performances in cities such as **Tokyo**, **Osaka**, **Kyoto**, **Sado**, and **Hamamatsu**, achieving a surprising reception in Japanese culture. In the Americas, they have traveled through **Brazil**, **Mexico**, the **Netherlands Antilles**, and **Colombia**. A fundamental milestone in their career occurred in 1994, when they offered a recital in the mythical **Carnegie Hall** in **New York**, invited by the **American Composer's Orchestra**, consolidating themselves as ambassadors of high Venezuelan culture. Their presence in the **United States** has not been limited to concert halls but has included an important academic component, conducting clinics and concerts at elite universities such as **Stanford**, **Berkeley**, **UCLA**, and **Indiana University**. Between 1995 and 1998, the ensemble conquered **Europe**, taking the virtuosity of the cuatro and flute to **France**, **Spain**, **England**, and **Germany**. Subsequently, they continued their expansion through the Southern Cone, visiting **Rio de Janeiro**, **Bogota**, **Santiago de Chile**, and **Sao Paulo**. Recognition for their work has been constant. In 1998, they were awarded the prestigious **Monseñor Pellín** prize in a special mention, highlighting their immense contribution to the dissemination of the cultural values of Venezuelan regions and their impeccable professionalism. Through their discography and collaborations with symphony orchestras and world-class soloists, **Ensamble Gurrufío** has proven that traditional root music is a universal language capable of moving audiences in the most demanding theaters on the planet. #

body.title: Delicia de guayaba | Guava delight
body.body:
Un saludo muy caluroso a todos mis amigos de Hive Food. Hoy  les traigo una receta fabulosa que les va a encantar.

La guayaba es una de mis frutas preferidas y siempre estan presentes en mi lista de compras. Bien sea para comerlas directamente o prepararlas de distintas maneras.

Es muy comun hacer la torta fria con galletas remojadas en leche, colocando en un recipiente capas de galletas y capas de pudin.

> A very warm greeting to all my friends at Hive Food. Today I bring you a fabulous recipe that you are going to love.
>
> Guava is one of my favorite fruits and is always on my shopping list. Whether to eat them straight or prepare them in different ways.
>
> It's very common to make a cold cake with cookies soaked in milk, placing layers of cookies and layers of pudding in a container.

En esta oportunidad se me ocurrió preparar un pudin de guayaba y como no tenia galletas en la alacena prepare tortitas caseras de vainilla.

Las tortitas caseras de vainilla las he comido desde pequeña. Mi mamá las prepara con cambur, auyama, chocolate o solo con vainilla. Yo les decia tortitas a la mami mami.

> This time, I decided to make guava pudding, and since I didn't have any cookies in the cupboard, I made homemade vanilla pancakes.
>
>I've been eating homemade vanilla pancakes since I was a little girl. My mom makes them with banana, pumpkin, chocolate, or just vanilla. I used to call them \

pancakes. ![IMG-20260310-WA0000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/23xpMVz3r3qZWsPqcja7CcsTzSkVdrE32f1KFX3HHU1gdbWB7wBptKa9R6S73KoLKiYzt.jpg)
**Ingredientes para las tortitas:** - 400 grs de harina de trigo leudante. - 250 ml de leche. - 1 huevo. - 2 cucharadas de vainilla. - 100 grs de azucar.
**Ingredients for the pancakes:** - 400 grams of self-rising wheat flour. - 250 ml of milk. - 1 egg. - 2 tablespoons of vanilla. - 100 grams of sugar.
![IMG-20260309-WA0004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/23wCGTmkTA8zJWPVoZmpxGh8wSADbtHA8UytrsmfHZ9NSvfmf65rVkGQezBxzmqBDv9TS.jpg)
**Ingredientes para el pudin:** - 4 guayabas grandes. - 150 grs de azucar. - 160 grs de fecula de maiz Maicena.
**Ingredients for the pudding:** - 4 large guavas. - 150 grams of sugar. - 160 grams of cornstarch.
![IMG-20260310-WA0019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/23vi62CJnCjQ36fpvAiGB77ZjB9sAiDyZ5MU4JoZNTJHAV4C3zooCRKWKwZEmdo6CrtA8.jpg) **Preparacion:** Para preparar las tortitas se bate primero el huevo con el azucar para luego ir agregando la harina alternada con la leche y la vainilla. Batir hasta que quede bien cremosa. >**Preparation:** >To prepare the pancakes, first beat the egg with the sugar, then add the flour alternately with the milk and vanilla. Beat until creamy. ![IMG-20260309-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/23wqnnp9jptriqKzUh6vUxqBSjtRJFcsmLM4gmrBJwUFqzp3bx5Wh3nfJyHiFPaeWLATP.jpg) ![IMG-20260309-WA0007.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/23uQy27WCtPRs9htaNxowNgW5HWhAXWHSyUTDruCvTgu7GrxE3ZuadGrHM1shX9eA1dwv.jpg) En una sarten bien caliente con poco aceite se echan unas tres cucharadas de la mezcla formando una tortita que debe quedar delgada. Se deben cocinar a fuego lento para que no se quemen y deben salir unas 5 tortitas de buen tamaño. >In a very hot pan with a little oil, pour about three tablespoons of the mixture to form a thin pancake. Cook over low heat so they don't burn. This should make about 5 good-sized pancakes. ![IMG-20260309-WA0008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/23vsUmNojGxDsxsCEmKoi3GVQaeG5zdzkWxGV4JQyDSNdbg9HNgyUaR2uiUVpVL9CVRgs.jpg) Por otra parte, para preparar el pudin, se deben pelar las guayabas, se pican en trozos y se licuan con agua y azúcar. El jugo debe quedar espeso y con el dulzor deseado. En mi caso lo hice bien dulce para que al cocinarse y compactarse con los demas ingredientes quedara con un buen sabor. Despues de colar el jugo se vierte una parte en una taza para mezclarlo con la fecula de maiz y el resto se echa en una olla para ponerlo a hervir. Una vez que este hirviendo se agrega poco a poco la taza con la fecula de maiz que se mezclo con el jugo. Se cocina a fuego lento hasta que espese. >On the other hand, to prepare the pudding, peel the guavas, chop them into pieces, and blend them with water and sugar. The juice should be thick and have the desired sweetness. In my case, I made it very sweet so that when it was cooked and mixed with the other ingredients, it would have a good flavor. After straining the juice, pour some of it into a cup to mix with the cornstarch, and pour the rest into a pot to bring to a boil. Once it is boiling, slowly add the cup with the cornstarch mixed with the juice. Cook over low heat until thickened. ![IMG-20260309-WA0011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/23vi47L71TMYVrAyxRW256VusVsy5soWTXm5dYXFRo82M4HLPdZSqdNYCjRfxbrYcSaTb.jpg) En un envase se coloca una capa de tortilla y una capa de pudin aun caliente. En mi caso, el envase era cuadrado y al ser las tortillas redondas tuve que cubrir las esquinas con pedacitos de tortita, haciendo unas cuatro capas de tortita y cuatro capas de pudin. >Place a layer of tortilla and a layer of warm pudding in a container. In my case, the container was square and, as the tortillas were round, I had to cover the corners with small pieces of tortilla, making about four layers of tortilla and four layers of pudding. ![IMG-20260309-WA0015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/23wMh6TH2mWvHig9xJQaV3oet4bHiBowJjEAZZ7866fNpVHCokg5ZVQTqtgcFwL9vcV4C.jpg) ![IMG-20260309-WA0001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/Eoc8zvM6r2HixUq9y979S4DFe9ads945yYVTjBn4FEg9Fjbf6wTZWJuwJzv8JS4cbMA.jpg) Se mete al refrigerador por unas 4 horas y luego a disfrutar de esta merienda tan deliciosa. >Place in the refrigerator for about 4 hours, then enjoy this delicious snack. ![IMG-20260309-WA0012.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/23wgQHBKe8meFBbHxZJEpP3YeStEuYnXGgkAsoYSWYcu8b9oZh5ke1b5RBSpg8HpzqMWM.jpg) ![IMG-20260310-WA0015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/23viEZBDz3LqQNr7SMJKbZoHCA67ipbrJ3VFQr8mFN3N35C5XdCD8gzYz7JXMCnyDx7rj.jpg) Espero que les haya gustado esta receta tanto como a mi. >I hope you enjoyed this recipe as much as I did. ![IMG-20260310-WA0018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/48UHWr5RBFCrm1VmPmofuCaDwHe3Ydi9zUtDrsnqiuw2b5fu4xqb7r6tDQ52C7p3nH.jpg) - Fotografías tomadas desde mi celular Redmi Note 13. - Banner realizado en https://www.canva.com/ - Footer realizado en https://www.canva.com/

100% agree one shall know what to invest into.

I do wonder why people want to go in and out of such fund so quickly. I mean, it is high risk because it funds private businesses, those with a higher risk level for the reasons you given, because - for instance - a bank would not have given money. When going for high risk funds, I would assume: 1) go in for the longer run, 2) enter with only a 'little' part of the investment portfolio not needed for the short/mid term. Since most of us already learned/know, going in and out too quickly without being an expert trader, usually means: Leaving all the profits to others.

I must admit, I learned this myself the hard way! Thought I was a trader, based on a combination of charts and fundamentals and a great gut feeling plus a super logical and rational mind. But then, I learned my emotions are part of the equation as well, as greed was. For so many, this is the same. While the hobby traders sell when prices go down, institutionals and other professionals usually buy. Unless it wasn't a sound investment at all, but then again, institutionals and professionals wouldn't have invested in the first place 😉

Anyways, enough about me. I agree with you and join your call: \

links.title: Adiós, papá |Relato de Ficción (ESP-ENG)
links.body:
> **Este es un texto original escrito en español y versionado al inglés en Google Translation.** ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme5g6UZHFvtHDozUAcKCLgLy285isrrTJhb38yXfJmxuS/1773109490812.jpg) [Fuente](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/foto-de-paisaje-del-empire-state-building-de-nueva-york-5omwAMDxmkU)
***

> —¿Seguro que no quieres que te lleve al aeropuerto? —Segurísima. El taxi ya está aquí. Además, así no tenemos que hacer la despedida larga en la terminal. —La despedida larga... como si esta no lo fuera. —Son dos años, papá. No dos siglos. —Para mí van a ser dos siglos. Oye, ¿y si nieva allá donde vas? —Pues haré muñecos de nieve. Y te mandaré fotos. —¿Y si no encuentras trabajo? —Buscaré hasta encontrar. —¿Y si te sientes sola? —Tendré la música. Y tus llamadas. —¿Y si... —Papá, para. Respira. Todo va a salir bien. —Es que desde que se fue tu madre, solo nos tenemos nosotros. —Por eso mismo necesito hacer esto. Ella siempre decía que había que vivir aventuras. —Lo sé. Tu madre era así. Yo siempre fui más de quedarme en casa. —Y gracias a eso yo tuve un hogar. Pero ahora necesito construir el mío. —El taxista ya está harto de esperar. Mira, ha puesto la música. —¿Qué canción es esa? —Ni idea. Pero suena a despedida. —O a comienzo. Depende de cómo se mire. —Tienes razón. Siempre has sido más sabia que yo. —No soy más sabia. Solo más joven. Y tú me enseñaste a ser valiente. —¿Yo? Si yo tengo miedo hasta de cambiar la compañía del teléfono. —Me enseñaste a estar cuando importa. Eso es lo más valiente que conozco. —Ay, hija. Mira la nieve. Como cuando jugabas en el parque y yo llegaba tarde a buscarte. —Y me comprabas un chocolate caliente para compensar. —Y te contaba cuentos de viajes. Mira tú. —Ahora me toca a mí vivir esos cuentos. —Prométeme una cosa. —Lo que sea. —Que si algún día estás triste y sola, me llamas. No importa la hora. —Te llamaré. Y tú me pondrás esa canción que siempre cantabas cuando era pequeña. —¿Cuál? —Esa que habla de una niña que mira las estrellas. —No me acuerdo de la letra. —No hace falta. Solo de la melodía. —Oye, ¿y el cassette que te di? —Lo llevo aquí, en el bolsillo del abrigo. —¿Todavía funciona? —No lo sé. Pero es tuyo. Eso es lo que importa. —Eres una sentimental, como tu madre. —Ella decía que los sentimientos no estorban. Que solo hay que saber llevarlos. —Y tenía razón. Como casi siempre. —Bueno, papá. Tengo que irme. —Ya lo sé. Déjame pagar yo el taxi. —Ni hablar. Este viaje lo pago yo. —Pero... —Nada de peros. Es mi aventura. La pago yo. —Vale, vale. Como quieras. —Un abrazo. —Ven aquí. Que no sea el último. —Que sea el primero de los nuevos. De los que nos quedan. —Te quiero, hija. —Te quiero, papá. Voy a estar bien. Feliz. Como tú siempre quisiste. —Lo sé. Anda, vete. Que el taxista ya debe estar pensando que somos una familia de película. —Pues sí, un poco sí. —Oye, ¿y si no puedo dormir pensando en ti? —Pones la radio. Seguro que suena una canción bonita. —¿Y si suena una triste? —La cambias. O la escuchas y piensas que la tristeza también es parte de la vida. —Demasiado sabia para tu edad. —Demasiado joven para dejar de aprender. Adiós, papá. —Adiós, hija. Que el viento te lleve siempre a buenos puertos. —Gracias. Te escribo cuando llegue. —Allí estaré. Esperando. —Como siempre. —Como siempre. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVDUKVA6YugQdRrhGACmnps8ddBkV8W6UwGEo9DwaNQxF/1768408479017.jpg)

> **This is an original text written in Spanish and translated into English using Google Translate.** ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme5g6UZHFvtHDozUAcKCLgLy285isrrTJhb38yXfJmxuS/1773109490812.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/foto-de-paisaje-del-empire-state-building-de-nueva-york-5omwAMDxmkU)
***

—Anything. —If you're ever sad and alone, call me. No matter the time. —I'll call you. And you'll play that song you always sang when I was little. —Which one? —The one about a little girl looking at the stars. —I don't remember the lyrics. —It doesn't matter. Just the melody. —Hey, what about the cassette I gave you? —I have it here, in my coat pocket. —Does it still work? —I don't know. But it's yours. That's what matters. —You're sentimental, just like your mother. —She used to say that feelings aren't a problem. You just have to know how to handle them. —And she was right. Like almost always. —Well, Dad. I have to go. —I know. Let me pay for the taxi. —No way. I'm paying for this ride. —But... —No buts. It's my adventure. I'm paying for it. —Okay, okay. Whatever you want. —A hug. —Come here. Let it not be the last one. —Let it be the first of the new ones. Of the ones we have left. —I love you, daughter. —I love you, Dad. I'm going to be okay. Happy. Like you always wanted. —I know. Go on, go. The taxi driver must already be thinking we're a family straight out of a movie. —Well, yeah, kind of. —Hey, what if I can't sleep thinking about you? —Turn on the radio. I'm sure a nice song will come on. —What if a sad one comes on? —Change it. Or listen to it and think that sadness is also part of life. —Too wise for your age. —Too young to stop learning. Goodbye, Dad. Goodbye, daughter. May the wind always carry you to safe harbor. Thank you. I'll write to you when I arrive. I'll be there. Waiting. As always. As always. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSCBMLrCe1r8x98QE2vRuUp6seGUjji2vAArciyFkjC8N/1768407559541.jpg)

links.title: ThreeTuneTuesday: 3 musicians who fled fame
links.body:
![ThreeTuneTuesday.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/EoGvxYYEfTzA9fckP8yvphgZufFniDB8yJDWuhWSxVs9nMPni61592pQiNXhFFpc5zL.jpg)
In my first and last post on #TTT #ThreeTuneTuesday, I talked about three songs about fame, performed by [three famous musicians](https://peakd.com/hive-193816/@cryptoreforma/three-tune-tuesday-3-songs-about-fame-performed-by-3-famous-artists). 

<div class=\

>Today, I reveal three musicians who fled fame like the devil flees the Christian cross. Syd Barret (Pink Floyd), Mark Hollis (Talk Talk), and Lauryn Hill. Media scrutiny, physical and mental exhaustion, and the pressure of fame led these artists to retreat into total or partial isolation. ﾠ Being constantly in the spotlight, with the unbearable invasion of privacy, is not for all artists. Escape into anonymity is the only possible way out. The film “Last Days,” directed by Gus Van Sant, is an introspective work about Kurt Cobain, who isolated himself in a mansion to avoid managers, friends, and his own identity as a “rock star.” It is an accurate portrayal of the isolation caused by fame.
https://pauloabrantes.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/music-1.png
### 🎧 Syd Barret (Pink Floyd) ![©Rollingstone.com.br.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23wqiCpEmWJzrhjjscrEQT9do1LdSrPHAXi8Gt2nUSuGmxj6T6wBmB17c9h4bfBBTfPkB.jpg)

>He was there at the birth of Pink Floyd and left them in 1968. He made two more solo albums and went to live anonymously with his mother in Cambridge, devoting himself to gardening and painting. Until his death in 2006, he refused contact with former bandmates and the press. ﾠ Excessive drug use and mental health problems, in addition to the enormous difficulties of dealing with the pressure of success, took this pioneer of psychedelic rock off the scene. https://youtu.be/H6ci4pAYiUw?si=jrqaRGmnHFtQRtkd
https://pauloabrantes.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/music-1.png
### 🎧 Mark Hollis (Talk Talk) ![© picture alliance : Photoshot_Mark Hollis.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23ynYcQ81Kxs18PyJ3iLqhAfikG1cJF78JHonkPMhWbqTWssgysysYqWahdGnSEqn1ETW.jpg)

>Unlike other musicians who isolated themselves due to mental health issues, addiction, or pressure, the Talk Talk frontman withdrew in a conscious, almost philosophical way, based on a search for silence. He was perhaps the most authentic example of someone who used success to buy the right to never be famous again. ﾠ In the 1980s, several hits elevated the band Talk Talk to stardom. Hits such as “It's My Life” and “Such a Shame” flooded the radio with Mark Hollis' distinctive voice. Without repeating formulas, the albums Spirit Of Eden and Laughing Stock were almost experimental, full of empty spaces and jazz sounds. For Hollis, tours and promotional interviews were distractions that contributed nothing to what he wanted to achieve. In addition, he began to despise the commercial structure of music. He stopped in 1998 with the release of his only solo album of the same name, a minimalist record to end his career and leave in a brilliant way. He devoted himself to his family, and for two decades he gave no interviews, performed no shows, and released no new music. He passed away in 2019, leaving behind an aura of genius and a legacy that influenced bands such as Radiohead and Sigur Rós. https://youtu.be/Pdf--O5WWrU?si=3auYt8acC_gbOW5M
https://pauloabrantes.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/music-1.png
### 🎧 Lauryn Hill ![Lauryn Hill.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/EoEjDPJ9rA87r2jbVSCaZFop6UTKMjh39szswM6VaNPXomvSCcR2rRgAcqCvxRT2SRv.jpg)

>She became one of the biggest stars on the planet, winning five Grammys in 1998 with the smash hit The Miseducation of Lauryn Hill. According to her, she felt watched and became unhappy with the music industry. She devoted herself to spirituality and her family, staying out of the spotlight for years. ﾠ She described fame as a “golden cage” and since 2003 has virtually disappeared from public life. She focused on raising her six children and became involved in religious studies and spiritual mentoring to live the “real” life she aspired to. She began to gain a reputation for being difficult to deal with, reflecting her contempt for the norms of the music industry, demanding to be addressed as “Ms. Hill.” Although she released only one studio album, in 1998, she continued to perform. She did not retire from music entirely, but she shed the “character” Lauryn Hill that the world expected her to be. https://youtu.be/W5Apq2T-Fok?si=h5cMFNJNIG7VKg1S
https://pauloabrantes.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/music-1.png
![cryptoreforma Banner animated 1440x510, 10fps.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptoreforma/23tbRgmvUr2wnjV51FoK5G5vd3jCNyqru4LAdQRxZhWEHbTTXWn8xF7i7Kq7kddaBJCfc.gif)
