links.title: The oldest Museum in Puglia region (South Italy)
links.body:
>
ENG
Hello dear Hivers and welcome back to my blog. The **Sigismondo Castromediano Archaeological Museum** is the oldest museum in the Puglia region, and I was fortunate enough to visit it during my last stay in Lecce. It's a gem for all tourists who want to discover the **Messapian and Roman roots of the Salento area**.
ITA
Buongiorno amici Hivers e bentornati sul mio blog. Il **Museo Archeologico Sigismondo Castromediano** è il più antico museo della regione Puglia e ho avuto la fortuna di visitarlo durante il mio ultimo soggiorno a Lecce. È una perla per tutti i turisti che vogliono scoprire le **radici messapiche e romane della zona del Salento**.
![hive dividers-02.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23swpjp3K9usTpjZpcGEgSWJyy64LDu48Kiqqpo9XdwH4KrnjbgAnNc1kSKsUhn568CLw.png)
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23tH9oMpvGkHVqNmcaF4JfMHJoSe4eyfXb76St7jUxP1UR5GAfDzJNn8hCSBQRF1WCjZA.JPG https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23uQvrkR1AWjSdpPmiqeYizzPWRGpVv8H6ijfg3tSe32wWd2qcDZegoqsGwSmVm4Lpi6N.JPG
![325f.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/244e1ynCVmzwB6ZkRnKuhtsk5TXVpVyEXngSisE24n8bZUJg2e7YDcAWzothxjNtRaLDx.JPG) ![325g.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/245wFpbnR9Su9BdMmxQQsrQ9n9niDVTGxjtuQkgKKUD4kTj1BgNDdV7q16R15zUQV1Vke.JPG) ![325e.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23tbwQXxbiniB6LDoRWSvJZBpkaHJoAkBz3JFnywNLhAxjNvAkxer1L1xPYWsc6RzkLeX.JPG)
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23wWkiQ5dKY6C9jqCvRTaiojr2RGRUJro2ePy4xvz4d82FteKvmzEHrdCqwweGMrFxjtk.JPG https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23vi1zwnM7oFSEUxfAcW91FnR4rovqfABGGZGrmX38gSi5qZHqEdaEVFVbnZcbTVzt1tW.JPG
![325c.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/242DSbbN1vUxZEp69Sy3qKSZaC2TNzHbe5YRGuPqwJWbuFgwFF7FQDaMTRR6ocVpXxMA7.JPG)
This museum's unique name comes from the patriotic duke who founded it in **1868**. What struck me most was the **atmosphere** that surrounds the walls of this building; it truly feels like stepping back in time. The collection of artifacts begins in **prehistory** and continues through the Messapian and Roman periods.
Il nome particolare di questo museo si deve al duca patriota che lo fondò nel **1868**. La cosa che mi ha colpito di più è l’**atmosfera** che circonda le mura di questo edificio, sembra di stare davvero in un altro secolo. La collezione di reperti inizia dalla **preistoria** e prosegue con l’età messapica e l’età romana.
![hive dividers-02.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23swpjp3K9usTpjZpcGEgSWJyy64LDu48Kiqqpo9XdwH4KrnjbgAnNc1kSKsUhn568CLw.png) ![325d.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23wX1U5L8apvwThqT3KTB9kW9UyUkWm1xSJFBvekP1mWhGcT4SxYEmPqTaSsCNEMnuH4K.JPG)
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23zkphTj86sWqiF7Sampbxw2buLgDWNaG69dLq39hAfG54HSQBBeD2kR5ib16Ggg3ccqt.JPG https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23y8svXMhyz6rFTR8A71DbYd4eBX5oxRPE2kPse5rn3krAayYZLXcCLGH6ZMg9v13ALyD.JPG
![325i.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23uQpeDjxeY2B4wLN96Gk8wgqWjpsNhENmxAn3mTijpL6BkwfffRJCC3hpFXoTuSgZdqv.JPG) ![325k.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23z7BQATUJcgDZpMWBLrTapPQ4GaD9s2BnzcP2xVnh4LuaAgVXjfUMsb1FZuDK9iv329q.JPG)
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23tvkT1EBS1JpApv36ZpsddthWPpBfWUT7boeHGQBSfdCpiZhWwMg1ZynRpusETyH25oL.JPG https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/244UqdJJz8Suurj5Tk2n6oRvz8JYD9YYbYQ1B4qkFt7ruQRcxdqrCt6UzXNQXAyWAT6o2.JPG
![325za.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23tvkSbcZFeFH1XFU1QH6353oMGJBEZapfhXvo581tuEdXUaVPBrVwWjU9G1MPfqCz1wF.JPG) ![325l.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23tm6rSo5YSSqZkoR8mLKsXe5pCZyzNXZYTSTWVqF9z5NwBP5s3VoGYxR4RmTEndUqH7h.JPG) ![325t.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23tbuWC3n7499dgLFff29SnSG95SKjPhwPdhkWVaT39RJHv5jJFdnCGdQAJNKE9SvaRFF.JPG)
The main highlights are the **Attic and Apulian vases**, made of ceramics with black and red figures that tell the stories of myths and heroes. These vases bear witness to the **commercial and cultural exchanges** that took place **between Salento and Greece**. You can also admire numerous Messapian **inscriptions** that describe a language that still remains a mystery to scientists today.
I protagonisti principali sono i **vasi attici e apuli**, costituiti da ceramiche con figure nere e rosse che narrano le storie dei miti e degli eroi. Questi vasi testimoniano gli **scambi commerciali e culturali** che avvenivano **tra il Salento e la Grecia**. Si possono ammirare anche numerose **iscrizioni** messapiche che raccontano una lingua che al giorno d’oggi è ancora misteriosa per gli studiosi.
![hive dividers-02.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23swpjp3K9usTpjZpcGEgSWJyy64LDu48Kiqqpo9XdwH4KrnjbgAnNc1kSKsUhn568CLw.png) ![325zh.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23uQtFLWAR9Vrsx5AqYURkdhYe7WkefqLd8TbHewFUhdsh7kVjkUiBctLRxompwwyuA7s.JPG) ![325zc.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23xKxqrhxPNVmS3z3wGDggA2tACN8CQpi9inYaKnQcr6kqBi95jWs4ZBrBxA2PrNgUXc9.JPG) ![325q.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23wMYHXDpTTfc1mDXZF6wUAQYYp7y7nLdHaPyAdc9g6FCqcZppuyeWGJ7yKm5jsBpsgBe.JPG)
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23z7Fb3umGJZa2Ye4U3TWXyR7AbryskR78W28AdSPUygde71An48wF6Cb5jBdQAqvL2mD.JPG https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23wC9nCHZpG2jACyact59bXNJSuZhtPKLUbwHRCYZP45ZYKhzTBTm33KFuPHjQyPJKeuR.JPG
![325zk.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/delilhavores/23u62xCANSpEr4JMKqSdsV7iX5CcJ9TZhuaGaHEVUcKZy5uahcAtyY7C64Z2diJbyVePZ.JPG)
The tour concludes with **Roman statuary**, particularly the splendid marbles that decorated the city's ancient theater and amphitheater. Upstairs, there is also an **art gallery**, with more modern works and examples of Lecce Baroque. I am very happy to have visited the heart of Apulian history and hope I have been able to convey the beauty of this museum. **Thanks for following me**! See you next time, *Delilha*
Il percorso si conclude con la **statuaria romana** e, in particolare, gli splendidi marmi che decoravano l’antico teatro e l’anfiteatro della città. Al piano superiore è anche presente una **Pinacoteca**, con opere più moderne ed esempi di barocco leccese. Sono molto felice di aver visitato il cuore della storia pugliese e spero di essere stata in grado di trasmettere la bellezza di questo museo. **Grazie per avermi seguita**! Alla prossima, *Delilha*

links.title: Find Your Inner Compass
links.body:
>

Many high achievers live trapped in a constant cycle of urgency. They are productive, disciplined, and successful on the outside, yet internally they feel disoriented. They move fast, but without a clear compass, making decisions based on what is immediate and loud rather than on what truly matters.

>Mucha gente de alto rendimiento vive atrapada en un ciclo constante de urgencia. Son productivos, disciplinados y exitosos hacia afuera, pero internamente se sienten desorientados. Avanzan rápido, pero sin una brújula clara, tomando decisiones basadas en lo inmediato y lo ruidoso en lugar de en lo que realmente tiene verdadero sentido.

The first step to regaining direction is to slow down enough to clarify what truly matters. When values are defined intentionally, they become the foundation for every decision, priority, and leadership choice.

>El primer paso para recuperar la dirección es reducir el ritmo lo suficiente como para clarificar lo que verdaderamente importa. Cuando los valores se definen con intención, se convierten en la base de cada decisión, prioridad y elección de liderazgo.

Over the years, I have accompanied individuals, teams, and leaders, and I have seen that most operate with only a vague sense of their values. It is not until they name and clarify them intentionally that their decisions begin to align with the person they want to be and the kind of leader they want to become.

>A lo largo de los años he acompañado a personas, equipos y líderes, y he visto que la mayoría opera con solo una noción vaga de sus valores. No es hasta que los nombran y los clarifican de manera consciente que sus decisiones comienzan a alinearse con la persona que desean ser y con el tipo de líder que quieren llegar a ser.

When values are clearly defined, they become an inner compass. Leaders experience greater peace, clearer focus, and a sustainable path for growth that supports both personal fulfillment and authentic, confident leadership.

>Cuando los valores están claramente definidos, se transforman en una brújula interior. Los líderes experimentan mayor paz, un enfoque más claro y una forma de crecer que es sostenible en el tiempo, fortaleciendo tanto su plenitud personal como un liderazgo auténtico y seguro.

links.body: > Dia Domingo entrenamiento largo de la semana.Hoy celebro el día de la mujer con 14K, disfrutando al máximo de la bendición de ser mujer, ser runner ha sido la herramienta que me ha llevado como mujer a otro nivel, donde los miedos y limitaciones se convierten en obstáculos superables , y pequeños rivales antes nuestros sueños,ser runner mujer me ha hecho entender que lo que no me aporta soltarlo,que lo que no se da es por mi bien los que están son los que deben estar,y lo mejor de todo administrar mis energías que son vitales para alcanzar la Meta, ya sea de una carrera un proyecto ya que así no abandono a mitad del camino --- Hoy durante mi entrenamiento largo con un clima agradable con la mejor compañía mi esposo celebró ser mujer activa,cuidando mi mente y mi cuerpo. Hoy más que nunca disfruto de esta pasión que se ha hecho parte de mi esencia como mujer . >Greetings and blessings.! >

Being a female runner has made me understand that what doesn't contribute to me, I let go of, that what isn't given is for my own good, that those who are there are the ones who should be there, and best of all, to manage my energy, which is vital for reaching the goal, whether it's a race or a project, so that I don't give up halfway through. --- >Today, during my long training session in pleasant weather and with the best company, my husband, I celebrated being an active woman, taking care of my mind and body. links.title: Cheap Food Price Spike Up Near Eid Al-Fitr Day
links.body:
Hello Asean Hive Community

For the last running month I haven't posted anything about one dollar lunch saga... yet... The reason is very simple, it is Ramadhan month, people are fasting here. Islam is the majority religion in Indonesia, so when Moeslim are fasting, we can say Indonesia is having a mass fasting. The result? Many food stalls and restaurant are closing, or limiting their open hours.

So only a few which are open, and they have less competition and higher cost. Like it or not, they raise their food price. It is the main cause why most Cheap Food are sold higher than usual.


This post is about a lunch that should be a dollar, or maybe less, but right now it is around 1.1 USD. I do not mind about the rise in the price, because they need that money too for the Eid Al Fitr day. They need to pay more to their workers as holiday allowance. It is a custom and it is also the law here, else you can be sued for not respecting religious activity and breaking employment law.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/Eos3JeXhsqHPxVX95vkHcXsXdxkhuGYKjaB5NzVWaXZAkAqY6Mt5rMwRCJmgk6Q8ZbT.jpg

So this was what I should have on a dollar but not. white twirl , yellow twirl and a flat dry towel lol. For Asian and especially south east asian, you can already guess what they are. But for people from other continents, this looks like that, twirl and towel lol.

My dish was a mix rice, a white rice with omelet and stir fried mushroom with an extra of fried chicken intestine. I did not know whether this should be called as junk food or not, a junk food for having chicken intestine, but outside of it, everything looked healthy.

In a glance, both chicken intestine and mushroom looked a bit similar but they were not...

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/EoiXhsk1xk2VhabG93BeQRDqAJhENSXwg8KagVU3zJvPwtZoLmqbTiR126mbivkrMkU.jpg

This was the mushroom. It was one of my favorite too. We called this one as Stir Fried Oyster Mushroom. It was easy to make this one, you could search for the recipe on google and you would get tonnes of it. This one had green beans for the dressing, ya we called it dressing because the beans were limited and usually they put some green veggie just for the look.

So that's for today foodie post, Sorry if I make this short, I only want to point out the condition of price raise. See you next time!!

---

Thank you for coming and reading my post. I live in Jakarta, Ex-Capital City of Indonesia.  I used to live by making money online, that's why I like being here, on HIVE, and in #PIMP - (Paper In My Pocket) community. Feel Free to leave any comment below

links.title: Photography of the Day. || Night time City Market.
links.body:
> ![IMG20260309225237~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVauFZiZsXh7qkV24qahv7jzTHrr24WGVrwTaTpbPdhSy/IMG20260309225237~2.jpg) I'm starting my today's event by wishing everyone good health. Actually, I love taking pictures because I try to take pictures whenever I find them. Eid is very close to us now. As you all know, Eid is one of our biggest festivals. Everyone is currently very busy with Eid shopping. I am also trying to do Eid shopping with my family. Yesterday I went to the market with my family and took some great photos for you on the way there. The first picture you see here is a vendor sitting on the sidewalk trying to sell his wares. ![IMG20260309225132~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNYsXJqvcbdsQDsRYG9p7k8VwJpnwiRzmFAsHuYVVvMmV/IMG20260309225132~2.jpg) ![IMG20260309225136~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmShshiHPJmKBuEh46Jwswz73sGAR2seeZcqA2iSRG6pUD/IMG20260309225136~2.jpg) This picture shows some young boys setting up their shop on the side of the road to sell various types of cosmetics items. In these stores, you can buy various kinds of goods at very low prices. People flock to these shops to buy things at low prices. Everyone tries to buy cosmetic items from these small shops so that they can be purchased at low prices. ![IMG20260309225144~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeKwvbZJxAZpLTgMrCwkn8dVA6oGTx1NbqfivYEUgNkCL/IMG20260309225144~2.jpg) ![IMG20260309225145~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUNJVvQ9SC6WKJG9kxfckHDZ3ML1WZXmsMRMoJ21HAAHw/IMG20260309225145~2.jpg) Pickle shops are very popular with everyone. People always try to buy and eat these pickles from these shops. They are very tasty, but since they are located next to the sidewalk, they can be unhealthy. I personally discourage my family members from buying pickles from here because they are often unhealthy. ![IMG20260309225154~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbvrH1YD2PnwgpAcvpZdrKMKgiYEpScA7THNGJB39QRCS/IMG20260309225154~2.jpg) ![IMG20260309225154_01~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWC3p5V3zpvnfAyTZNAPvd72DW2urzYKRuvB2F17SmiLw/IMG20260309225154_01~2.jpg) I took this picture from a small cloth shop on the side of the road. In the morning, I was still enjoying some downtime, sleeping sweetly at home. After several days of busy activities, my body really needed some rest and refreshment. Adequate sleep makes my body feel lighter and my mind calmer as I start the day. As the afternoon approached, I returned to my usual routine: sewing prayer caps (peci) for worship. This work has become a part of my daily routine. With great patience, I began preparing the fabric, thread, and sewing machine. The constant sound of the sewing machine seemed to accompany my work throughout the day. Sewing requires precision and focus to ensure neat and comfortable results. Each piece of fabric must be arranged properly before being sewn into a complete cap. Although it seems simple, this task still requires patience and perseverance. I worked slowly but surely, until several caps were completed. Time continued to tickle into the afternoon. After sitting sewing for a while, I felt the need to refresh my mind. So I decided to go to the rice fields not too far from home. This place is often my favorite spot for a leisurely stroll and appreciating the natural surroundings. Upon arriving at the rice paddies, the atmosphere felt so calming. The expanse of green rice paddies was a sight to behold. The gentle afternoon breeze added to the comfort. I strolled along the edge of the rice paddies, enjoying the pristine scenery. ![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png) ![IMG_20260303_155606.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRxLAso86c3s6bWUNFZeEvBsUvGzF19mnC56RRCj16Jwa/IMG_20260303_155606.jpg) ![IMG_20260228_160719.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmedZt1xjJ58oMFUFPdNa3Htx6g8yiQGMWj1t4gzAjiq4U/IMG_20260228_160719.jpg) ![IMG_20260212_131112.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSQHtH6mx1rQ7U4xZXHBEAuHe2RFkDG9mY7uSdBQr8EZi/IMG_20260212_131112.jpg) ![IMG_20260308_001828.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUJT4NPctspiws6YmYA575rM5umcGpPSCf82ZusdWSMQM/IMG_20260308_001828.jpg) ![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

links.title: Poison Power of HANV That Destroyed the Opponent Lineup
links.body:
![Loving the MOO The Healer That Keeps Your Tank Alive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23vhq7utPhNyxcKkHR2XFJzs3XYTbEirg9PnHyH4zAMEHpLCeKg8tAtxHLruQ56hQx2TN.png)


Todays battle was very interesting for me and I got a great victory in it. Whenever I get a match where the strategy works correctly and the team combination is perfect then the game becomes much more enjoyable.

This was a 47 mana battle which comes in the mid to high mana category. I always like such battles because in these battles there is a good chance to select monsters. In low mana battles the options are often limited and sometimes the strategy cannot be implemented properly. But when the mana is high then a player can build a team according to his planning.

My personal experience also says that whenever I get a mid to high mana battle then my win rate automatically increases. Compared to low mana battles I get more wins in high mana matches because strong monsters and support cards can be used in them.

In this battle I got the chance to select 7 monsters. The interesting thing was that my opponent also made a full team of 7 monsters. Because of this the match became even more interesting because both sides had strong lineups.

![Screenshot 2026-03-10 121848.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tRtDTE7yK6nnrKxwD1qZWkiFCHH1tiEMVbcwo3ZHfatcE38hZJu1g1ywQKp9JBFNEtn.png)

Before the battle started I thought a little and made a plan. My idea was that if I place 2 strong tank monsters in the front line which have high health and defense and place support monsters in the backline that keep giving continuous damage or support then a balanced team combination can be created.

I followed this same strategy. For the frontline I selected strong and high health monsters and in the backline I placed the best support monsters. Along with this I also arranged the positioning of the monsters very carefully so that every monster could perform its role properly.

As soon as the battle started I quickly realized that my strategy was working properly. My frontline monsters kept absorbing the opponents attacks and because of their high health they survived for a long time.

On the other side my backline kept giving continuous support and damage. This combination proved to be very effective. Slowly the opponents monsters kept getting eliminated and in the end the whole enemy team was defeated. In this way I got a clean and satisfying victory in this battle.

In todays battle the monster that impressed me the most was HANV. This monster belongs to the poison element and its abilities are very interesting. Its poison based ability keeps giving damage to the opponent over time which makes the battle easier.
![Screenshot 2026-03-10 121816.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/Eo8TNc3oSY5MJrdsS2dz6twZzHBT6cUXkAwHSLvNQcXrr7Sww44ksqNFVqV4X4Vc1ru.png)

Another good thing about HANV is that it helps to create extra pressure on the opponents team. When the opponents monsters are already facing frontline attacks and at the same time they are also receiving poison damage then it becomes difficult for them to survive.


But like every monster HANV also has some weaknesses. If the opponent has a strong magic attack or an ability that can counter poison then the impact of HANV can become a little weaker. That is why it is important to use this monster with the right team combination.

Have you ever used this monster in your battles? Can you tell about its any ability? will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.

I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

links.title: Ich habe gehoert, das meine Landsmaenner sich nicht in die Iran Geschichte einmischen wollen...
links.body:
aber ich glaube ihnen erst, wenn es vorbei ist.

Was ich als fuer mich sprechender hier noch stehen lassen moechte ist folgendes. 

Ich lasse mich nicht so einfach beeirren in meiner Meinung, das Menschen, egal wo die Wohnen, und was die so machen, auch so aehnlich sind, wie die Menschen, die ich kenne.

Mindestens!

Die bauen alle Haeuser, machen Geschaefte, lieben lachen und hassen sich.

Ich hatte immer ein gutes Bild vom Iran und habe auch hier in meinen fruehen Jahren in meinem Blog viel darueber geschrieben, das der Iran Weltpoltisch betrachtet ja auch ein Problem fuer den Vorherrschenden ist, wegen der Lage und allem was jetzt sicher sowieso jeder Interessierte weis.

Und ob das ein kleiner Kuestenstreifen, ein rießiges Feldland, oder ein starkes Volk wie der Iran, fuer mich die Perser, sind, ist es mir nie recht, wenn Raketen durch die Gegend fliegen und Dinge und Menschen Bombadiert werden.

Das macht man einfach nicht, wir leben im 21 Jahrhundert ihr Langweiler.

So ein bisschen muessen wir in der Geschichte nicht nur damit rausstechen, das wir Glueck hatten, in unserer alten Denke so viele Spielzeuge auf dem Weg erschaffen zu haben, aber uns im Selbst, im Kopf und im Geiste, sowie in alledem was das angeht, keinen Zentimeter weiter entwickelt haben im Vergleich.

Wir sind wie Kinder, die mit Feuer spielen...

Ich weis auch nicht wie euer morgen aussehen soll, aber ich kann ja anfangen, euch zu beschreiben, wie verdamt lange ich noch dafuer brauchen werde, den ganzen bloedsinn zu bauen und auszudenken, den ich mir habe einfallen lassen, weils irgendwie, aus meiner Denke, vielleicht einfach auch moeglich waehre, mal was anders zu machen und sich trotzdem auf das gute alte gelernte zu stuetzen dabei.

Bruecken bauen, nicht Hangars und Flugplaetze Bomardieren. :-)

Salve

Alucian

title.body:
>

Heyyyy, good morning, my dear readers and members of the #Hive artistic community. Happy Tuesday! I hope you are all doing great and, of course, having an excellent week. Once again, your friend Manuel here is super happy to share a new artistic post for my blog with you. >*Heyyyy, muy buenos días mis queridísimos lectores y lectoras de la comunidad artística de #Hive, feliz martes, espero que se encuentren super bien, y que, por supuesto se encuentren pasando una excelente semana, por aquí los saluda una vez mas su amigo Manuel super feliz de poder compartirles un nuevo post artístico para mi blog.*

![42.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK9QCvP1DnU7QLsz5SsJ2uxCpeKqaNLmKr7Q7EU48reD4Zza1Hb56pFWyYYVhFv.jpg)
This time, I bring you an illustration that I have been working on since last Sunday night. It is a piece in which I wanted to create something like a magical entity that I named Farmigha, which, despite its calm and feminine appearance, hides great power within it. Originally, Farmigha was born as a creature of good, using her magical powers to do good, to heal warriors and troops badly wounded during battles, until one day her power became a very valuable resource, and at the same time a serious problem, since all the kingdoms wanted to capture her to take advantage of her great power and tried in every way possible, until one day (Farmigha) got fed up with them and confronted them, her powers that were once healing became terrible and relentlessly destructive: >*En esta oportunidad les traigo una ilustración en el cual estuve trabajando desde la noche del domingo pasado, se trata de una obra en la cual quise crear algo así como una especie entidad mágica a la cual llamé por el nombre de (Farmigha), la cual a pesar de su tranquila y femenina apariencia esconde un gran poder dentro de ella; originalmente (Farmigha) nació como una criatura del bien, la cual utilizaba sus poderes mágicos para hacer el bien, para sanar a los guerreros y tropas mal heridas durante las batallas, hasta que un día su poder se convirtió en un recurso muy valioso, y al mismo tiempo un grave problema, puesto que todos los reinos deseaban capturarla para aprovecharse de su gran poder y lo intentaron de todas las formas posibles, hasta que un día (Farmigha), se hartó de ellos y les hice frente, sus poderes que antes eran curativos se volvieron terrible y implacablemente destructivos:* ###
PROCESS / PROCESO
![0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJg7T114ztTYfUSjVNtubNgH2ezhgTVeCEC2GRQ1krxXLgFuNxnbYWnxosRutKJ.jpg)
Well, I decided to start with my idea for this character (Farmigha), creating a good sketch, in which I basically set out to create a pose in which my character stood with both arms slightly raised, palms facing upwards, as if channeling her terrible powers to use them against someone who dared to tread on her domain. Once I finished my line art, I moved on to painting and constructing lights and shadows. At this stage, I like to use shades from my own color palette, and in this case, I used a couple of medium brown tones as a base, and then with my watercolor brush, I took care of forming what would be the details in areas such as the bust, arms, fingers, face, and so on. >*Bueno, decidí empezar con mi idea para este personaje de (Farmigha), construyendo un buen boceto, en el básicamente me propuse crear una pose en la cual mi personaje se encontrase con ambos brazos levemente alzados, con las palmas mirando hacia arriba, como si estuviese canalizando sus terribles poderes para usarlos en contra de alguien que se atrevió a pisar sus dominios. Una vez culmine con mi line art me pase al apartado de pintado y construcción de luces y sombras, en esta etapa me gusta usar tonalidades de mi propia paleta de colores, y en este caso use un par de tonos marrones intermedios como base, y luego con mi pincel de acuarela me encargue de formar lo que seria los detalles en zonas como el busto, los brazos, dedos, rostro y demás.*
![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK7x1xuYvYq46tTDRFEuJQjTCSP74ig8o63k4mZ4yFbHbg1SkKwu86ksAqmdZmU.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK7wzqvBkij6HYbsoqR8dkxDyiN97YAbyBSYy9aJf2JKp66JZ7mvHGREcSwHnzy.jpg) ![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK7wz7xqUvwWRyxYvAAAE5X7CajFKRYUXjyxoL6dTuKmbDZDiVQtj2Wpesbdew1.jpg)
In the second stage, I moved on to working on my character's gaze and expression. I like to pay special attention to this aspect, as it is ultimately what conveys the personality and essence of my creations. For the eyes, I wanted to use intense violet and purple tones to give Farmigha a slightly more unique style. Then, for the mouth, I used red tones and tried to sketch a subtle, somewhat cold smile, which would give the impression that Farmigha is no longer the kind and good-natured person she used to be. For the hair, I used a color palette ranging from pink to orange. My idea here was to create strands of hair waving in the air to represent how the character's magical powers produce this reaction in her body. >*En la 2da etapa me pase ya al trabajo de la mirada y expresión de mi personaje, me gusta darle especial detalle a este apartado ya que es el que al final transmite la personalidad y esencia de mis creaciones, para el trabajo de los ojos quise usar unos tonos violetas y morados intensos para darle un estilo un poco más único a (Farmigha); luego para el trabajo de la boca use tonos rojos y trate de esbozar una sutil sonrisa, un tanto fría, que diera un poco la idea de que (Farmigha) ya no es la persona amable y bondadosa que solía ser. En el caso del trabajo del cabello use una paleta de colores entre rosada y naranja, mi idea aquí fue la de cree mechones de cabello ondulándose en el aire, esto para representar un poco que los poderes mágicos del personaje producen esta reacción en su cuerpo.*
![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK7wz7xqUvwWRyxYvAAAE5X7CajFKRYUXjyxoL6dTuKmbDZDiVQtj2ja8xrFdwA.jpg) ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK7wySXFcRQN9jFBfTHTsVi1uiXu9B1Xxf6BfzoAZCwMfYVmacEyRSpeyn4yqNZ.jpg) ![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AKApAthupGBCjMDBCcg1R5UQwQwdXY1yLM6WfY9QSy51uoU9H86rtWr3Ynmg6zD.jpg)
For the clothing, I started with intermediate red and brown tones, creating a kind of soft fabric on the sleeves, and with the reds, a kind of corset for her torso. Here, I tried to use slightly rougher brushes to replicate a texture similar to leather. Then, for the shoulder, chest, and waist areas, I created details with a slightly stiffer and thicker leather texture, which I thought would complement her outfit a little more and give her a more unique style. Finally, using pale pink tones, I formed a kind of magical aura around the hands. The first step was to create the structure by slightly lowering the opacity, then using my detail brush to add a little more volume and texture to the outline, giving it a magical feel. Finally, using the same brushes, I highlighted her eyes. >*Para el trabajo de la vestimenta comencé con un tonos rojos y marrones intermedios creando una especie de tela suave en las mangas, y con los rojos una especie de corsé para su torso, aquí trate de usar pinceles un poco mas rugosos para replicar una textura similar a la del cuero; después para la zona de los hombros, pecho y alrededor de la cintura cree detalle con textura de cuero un poco mas rígida y gruesa, esto me pareció que complementaria un poco mas su atuendo y le daría un estilo más único. Finalmente, con tonos rosados pálidos fui formando alrededor de las manos una especie de aura mágica, lo primero fue crear la estructura bajando levemente la opacidad, luego con mi pincel de particular detalle un poco el contorno dándole un poco mas de volumen y textura la magia; y al final con los mismos pinceles iluminé sus ojos.*
![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AKApAtc28X736849xWGqBxwZKiEKXLfEs9m34itNaZwagLfedKdWApnwZkFZEu9.jpg) ![27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AKAoYCeHWZpzXFqhqYUDVauC8A3uNVSfvLh2KFLSf8zGVznuSw6FD3mFk14qyEY.jpg) ![31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJixx8eqnSAFi1weMbGnwgUKkFkQGqUeyQbZ2ywcSwWXBogLkdt4PESnBhCvv8x.jpg) ![37.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AK7xHhwcavmKidTBB8x1rAG47rJPEHps3fW313J9UZBqttkhmayruVMkr5rDEvn.jpg)
###
MATERIALS / MATERIALES
- Sai Paint Tool Program - Huion inspiroy h610 v2 tablet >- *Programa Paint Tool Sai* >- *Tableta Huion inspiroy h610 v2*
![PROCESS.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJg7PNfcbykXFKWEmKmwSKsQWhZtSQiXb2jvMfFa9xNkTqrfqYVCdbi72i2r1ew.gif)
Well, folks, that's all for today. Thank you all so much for sticking with me, for reading, and I hope you really liked the final result of my illustration. If so, please don't hesitate to let me know in the comments below. I hope you continue to have a wonderful day, and we'll see each other again in my next post... See you later!😉. >*Bueno mi gente, esto ha sido todo por el día de hoy, muchísimas gracias a todos por haber llegado hasta aquí, por leerme, y espero que el resultado final de mi ilustración les haya gustado muchísimo, y si fue así por favor no duden en hacérmelo saber abajo en los comentarios. Les deseo sigan pasando un maravilloso día y ya nos volveremos a encontrar en un siguiente post…hasta luego!😉.*

Do you believe, truly believe, that you can bend the human spirit to your will with the flick of a thumb? That a downvote—a mere digital gesture, weightless as air—can coerce, can compel, can force obedience from those who dare to speak?

You are mistaken.

Bullying works on the fearful. It works on the uncertain. It works on those who have not yet discovered the strength that lives in their own voice. But it does not work on all. It never has. It never will.

Not by us alone, but by the ledger itself. The blockchain does not forget. It does not forgive. It simply *records*—every coordinated downvote, every ghost account moving in synchronized patterns, every delegation of millions in voting power to vessels holding less than ten dollars of their own stake.

You cannot bully truth into silence. You cannot downvote reality into oblivion. You cannot force the world to accept a lie simply because you hold the power to punish those who speak otherwise.

## **A Call to the Bully**

To those who wield the downvote as a weapon:

**Wake up.**

The power you hold is borrowed from the community you are driving away. The influence you wield is temporary. The fear you instill is fleeting.

But the truth? The truth is eternal.

You can keep weaving your fictions, but deep in the marrow of your bones, you know: *this is not why we built blockchain.* This is not the freedom we promised. This is not the community we envisioned.

## **A Call to the Silenced**

To those who have been buried under waves of downvotes:

**You are not alone.**

Your voice matters. Your truth has value. Your departure is not defeat—it is discernment.

Find sanctuary. Seek platforms where your voice matters more than your voting power. Build anew. The future belongs to those who create, not those who control.

title.title: Is War Doing Crypto Harm or Good?
title.body:
In times of war, there’s no doubt that people lose their lives, economies are destroyed, infrastructures and important things, however who benefits from it? Is it crypto ecosystem or the stock market? Because if you look at it, war creates fear in the system, especially the financial markets because it creates fear and greed in the market. Investors would want to pull out from the crypto market with the fear of it crashing due to volatility and invest their assets in somewhere safe such as buying gold and other governments bond on the stock market.

  https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNhffDTjyAmPLk858A8m9k2m9jC5PtG3NnmwFkkPApyvs/image.png 
[Source](https://www.barrons.com/articles/bitcoin-crypto-washington-economy-financial-system-c072e362)

On the hand, crypto has also proven useful in war because it has been used to quickly gather funds, donations because it’s fast and reliable. An example of it was the crisis during the Russia-Ukraine conflict where donations was sent to Ukraine using crypto, which was also a means of putting crypto on the map, highlighting it’s potential for humanitarian and financial aid for emergencies.

War appears to have a mixed impact on cryptocurrency, because there are pros and cons to it or however, it has both short-term and long-term impact. The short-term impact involves market instability, crypto dipping and experiencing bearish state, while the long term involves increases in awareness of decentralized financial systems and its ability to function when the normal or traditional system cannot.

Hey there, fellow crypto enthusiasts! If you've been keeping up with the markets, you're probably wondering what hit you yesterday (or was it today?). I'm here to break down what happened in crypto today and offer some insights on what might be driving the volatility.

**The Numbers Don't Lie**

In the past 24 hours, Bitcoin (BTC) plummeted by over 10% to around $35,000, while Ethereum (ETH) lost around 12% to trade at $2,300. Other altcoins weren't spared either, with many experiencing double-digit declines. The crypto market's total capitalization has taken a hit, dropping by over $100 billion since yesterday's highs.

**Is It a Correction or a Crash?**

Now, I know some of you might be thinking, \

Well, let's take a closer look. The sudden drop in prices might be a sign that the market is taking a breather after a strong run-up. However, the sheer magnitude of the losses suggests that something more is at play.

**Analysts Weigh In**

Some market analysts believe that the current downturn is a result of over-leveraging by traders, who were caught off guard by the sudden price drop. Others point to the ongoing struggles in traditional markets, such as the US-China trade war and the COVID-19 pandemic, as factors contributing to the crypto market's volatility.

**My 2 Cents**

As a crypto enthusiast, I'm always fascinated by the market's unpredictability. While I wouldn't call this a crash (yet), I do think that the market is sending us a message: it's time to take a step back and reassess our investment strategies. With prices fluctuating wildly, now is a great time to diversify our portfolios, reduce leverage, and focus on long-term growth.

In conclusion, the crypto market is never boring, and today's price action is no exception. While the short-term outlook might be uncertain, I believe that the long-term prospects of cryptocurrencies remain bright. If you're in it for the ride, buckle up and stay informed – we're in for a wild ride!

title.title: The Fed’s Dilemma
title.body:
Today I want to talk about an economic data point that… quite honestly, nobody expected.

Because on Friday, the latest data on the labor market in the United States was released, and the surprise was huge.

Analysts were expecting the economy to add around 60,000 new jobs. Instead, the American economy actually lost 92,000 jobs in a single month.

Yes. Minus 92 thousand.

And that was enough to shake markets, analysts, and of course the Federal Reserve. Suddenly, the largest economy in the world is sending a very strange signal.

On one side, inflation is still above the Fed’s target. On the other hand, the labor market is starting to show signs of weakness. And this contradiction is exactly what makes things extremely difficult for the Fed right now.

### The Labor Market

According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, the so called nonfarm payrolls, which measure jobs outside the agricultural sector, fell by 92,000 in February.

So while the market was expecting an increase, what we actually saw was a sharp drop.

In fact, this is the third decline in jobs in the last five months.

At the same time, the unemployment rate rose to 4.4 percent from 4.3 percent.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbYmW4QnP8KqE7CV8bC3GSVnW8Nska7dKdczWVsmJAngs/img_7076.png)

That might sound like a small change, but in the markets, movements like this are watched very closely.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY3qUJUeMzQ6Z4ob51bfPyYpbQMy4xsj2kZrtCuLrbsHk/img_7077.png)

So where did all these jobs disappear?

The truth is that several major sectors saw declines.

For example, the healthcare sector lost around 28,000 jobs, partly because of a large strike in hospitals.

The technology sector lost about 11,000 jobs, something many people link to cuts related to artificial intelligence.

Manufacturing lost roughly 12,000 jobs, the federal government lost another 10,000, and even sectors like transportation, warehousing, and construction saw job losses.

In other words, the decline is not limited to just one sector.

At the same time though, there is a strange paradox. While the labor market appears to be weakening, wages continue to rise.

Average hourly earnings increased by 0.4 percent during the month and about 3.8 percent on an annual basis.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcaCehaewe3pbcxybBGfvrJyqkn2SFY9d7iUGHH3bRM9s/img_7078.png)

And as if all that were not enough, there is another factor to consider.

Energy prices.

With the war in the Middle East pushing oil prices higher, Brent crude has reached around 90 dollars per barrel.

And that is once again adding pressure to inflation.

### The Fed’s Dilemma

All of this data, combined with the war in the Middle East that is pushing oil prices close to 90 dollars per barrel, is increasing inflationary pressures.

And this is exactly why the Federal Reserve finds itself in a very difficult position once again.

The Fed has two main goals: keep inflation low and maintain a strong labor market.

But right now, those two goals are colliding.

That is why there is now a huge debate about what the Fed should do next.

According to the FedWatch Tool, markets right now are roughly fifty fifty on what the Fed will do in July. There is almost an equal probability that interest rates will stay where they are, or that a new cycle of rate cuts could begin.

### The Different Views

As expected, analysts and officials have already split into different camps.

Fed governor Stephen Miran believes monetary policy is already too restrictive. In fact, he said something quite interesting. He argued that the Fed is chasing what he called “phantom inflation”.

In other words, inflation that may not actually be as strong as policymakers think.

He also argues that the weak labor market, especially among young workers and recent graduates, suggests the problem is not the supply of workers but the demand from businesses.

Simply put, companies are not hiring enough. And according to Miran, that means interest rates are too high.

On the other hand, there are also more cautious voices.

For example, Mary Daly, president of the San Francisco Fed, said that the labor market report is certainly concerning. At the same time, she warned that it is dangerous to draw conclusions from just one month of data.

The labor market often shows a lot of volatility, so the Fed needs to see more data before making major decisions.

At the same time, David Kelly from JPMorgan has a more pessimistic view.

According to him, if you look at the data from the past few months, the labor market has essentially frozen. Some companies are hiring, others are laying people off, and in the end the overall result is almost zero.

Finally, the research firm TS Lombard argues that the strong job growth we saw in January was probably a false alarm. A statistical effect that made the market believe the economy was accelerating. But according to them, the real picture of the labor market is that it remains stuck.

title.title: [Esp/Eng] ✨Delicioso arroz con coco.  // Delicious coconut rice.✨
title.body:
>

###### ✨¡Hola amigos amantes de la comida!✨ Espero estén pasando un gran día.

Espero que todos hayan tenido una excelente semana y que se preparen para un fin de semana de verdadero descanso. En esta ocasión, quiero compartir con ustedes una receta que me transporta a nuestras tradiciones: un delicioso arroz con coco. Sé que en muchas regiones suelen prepararlo utilizando leche, por no decir en su mayoría, porque no estoy segura del todo, la cual le da cremosidad, pero en otros estados de Venezuela, el ingrediente estrella está en el uso del papelón, que le aporta ese color oscuro y un sabor único. Como tenía todos los ingredientes a la mano, no quise dejar pasar la oportunidad de preparar esta delicia que, en lo personal, me fascina, especialmente cuando se le agrega su respectivo toque de canela espolvoreada.

**🔸A continuación, los dejo con el paso a paso:**

> ###### ✨¡Hello food loving friends!✨ I hope you are super well on this day. 

> I hope everyone had a wonderful week and is looking forward to a truly relaxing weekend. This time, I want to share a recipe that takes me back to our traditions: a delicious coconut rice. I know that in many regions it's usually prepared using milk—if not mostly, as I'm not entirely sure—which gives it a creamy texture. But in other states of Venezuela, the star ingredient is papelón (unrefined cane sugar), which gives it that dark color and a unique flavor. Since I had all the ingredients on hand, I didn't want to miss the opportunity to prepare this delicacy, which I personally love, especially with a sprinkle of cinnamon.

**🔸Next, I leave you with the step by step:**
 
---

<center>![portada defi.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Eoc7zhjgz5doNQnFXMHPnpgzM3Q2ChxAqYMPiZTZwVc8gwMBHsUYbBRgSG1967CfS6V.JPG)</center>

---

**♥️Espero les guste. ¡Comencemos!**

**♥️I hope you like it. Let's get started!**

---

<center>![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)</center>

# 🍶 *INGREDIENTES* | 🍶 *INGREDIENTS*

<center>![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)</center>

<div class=\

> - 1 kilo de arroz. - 1 coco. - 4. 800 L de agua. - 250 g de papelón/panela. - 600 g de azúcar. - 3 cdas de canela molida. - 15 clavitos de olor. - Pizca de sal.
- 1 kg of rice. - 1 coconut. - 4.8 L of water. - 250 g of papelón. - 600 g of sugar. - 3 tbsp of ground cinnamon. - 15 cloves. - Pinch of salt.
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)
![IMG_20260221_090155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Eoc6xqkwohhCX6GsKw15BRUfns2mPeWCnpBvrgA1J9Pyg1aH3BU8ta4pJq2PtuLuCKs.jpg)
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)

> ### ✨PASO 1: Lo primero que debemos hacer es lavar el arroz para deshacernos del exceso de almidón y así obtener un arroz más suelto y menos pegajoso. Lo vamos a lavar hasta que el agua no se torne blanca. Luego de esto, colamos y agregamos a una olla con 4 litros de agua, 1 cucharadita de canela en polvo o en rama, revolvemos y llevamos al fuego hasta que el arroz esponje o aproximadamente unos 30 min a fuego medio.
### ✨1 STEP: The first thing we need to do is wash the rice to remove excess starch, resulting in looser, less sticky rice. We'll wash it until the water runs clear. After that, we drain it and add it to a pot with 4 liters of water, 1 teaspoon of ground or stick cinnamon, stir, and cook over medium heat until the rice is fluffy, about 30 minutes.
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)
|![IMG_20260221_091349.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoErWnXHRMu71tyLXgiPH9pdsMTpjEjcfHrGFkckNjA8kapx3xrz8LQv7hzbK3VK7UY.jpg)|![IMG_20260221_091932.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Eo8UmkwiAqsRPyZADgbCQnVLY9QCEw2a3v61Aqhpych8PWPspNxdhMGcA7uVAnEKjGP.jpg)| |-|-|
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)

> ### ✨PASO 2: Por otra parte, vamos a ir añadiendo a otra olla 800 ml de agua, los 250 g de papelón o panela y llevamos al fuego, hasta que el papelón se disuelva por completo. Llegados a ese punto, colamos, vertemos en una olla más grande y añadimos los 15 clavos de olor, junto con 2 cucharaditas de canela en polvo.
### ✨2 STEP: Meanwhile, in another pot, we'll add 800 ml of water and 250 g of piloncillo (or brown sugar) and cook over medium heat until the piloncillo is completely dissolved. Once dissolved, we strain it, pour it into a larger pot, and add 15 cloves and 2 teaspoons of ground cinnamon.
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)
|![IMG_20260221_092251.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Ep7ud9ichm4Kam5NK2Wk5zNNLwJkiYTC8W1Sb9XU8LqtsqaZ6o2x4LfbEbkGG5hL3gG.jpg)|![IMG_20260221_094244.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoeEvhn66Ch2cJMbbQk3rnKrNxqdTDFXxApDcD1RZmPWgBjBh9jgJcDWWnwzRAr3Gac.jpg)|![IMG_20260221_094348.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoptPsg2GdofRD9uFBsgAKYVNAtrZqyc6TkiEj15G7MbMstEdBDjHj7nsDKkETvQnXq.jpg)| |-|-|-|
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)

> ### ✨PASO 3: Seguidamente, cortamos el coco, retiramos la concha al gusto y comenzamos a rallar por la parte gruesa del rallador; lo añadimos a la misma olla del papelón e incorporamos.
### ✨3 STEP: Next, we cut the coconut, remove the shell as desired, and grate it using the coarse side of a grater. We add the grated coconut to the pot with the piloncillo and stir it in.
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)
![Picsart_26-02-23_12-34-17-398.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/AKAqTN3YgezSJd6FQF9cCu6bn1dxKyzXAugidbBMKDv5DYEDiqQpLeLjEJ8cfrj.png)
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)

> ### ✨PASO 4: Al estar listo el arroz, colamos, lo vertemos a la misma olla con el resto de los ingredientes, los 600 g de azúcar e incorporamos muy bien, para luego llevarlo al fuego aproximadamente unos 10 min.
### ✨4 STEP: Once the rice is cooked, drain it, add it to the same pot with the rest of the ingredients, including the 600g of sugar, and mix well. Then cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes.
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)
|![IMG_20260221_100718.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoeFsBjyzqjSaQJNybZCD81VyaRADQDWnoJzF5n9nwCkx9wXutn6ziNsT83RTZYew7A.jpg)|![IMG_20260221_100853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoK6o8ZiuWPiUWXjLYdGT55Li5X5SEmbXxsn5wpXJhF5XBbaSt7qbxSZVzCbCbpD1W1.jpg)|![IMG_20260221_101034.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoCjWxq3nHW6rhuJAnJsDLf7Zeda8PL2PxmDiStzkyEZ2DUHZY9njvqfV2iWvMtPv5g.jpg)| |-|-|-|
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)
✨ Y listo, amigos, así es como pueden preparar este delicioso arroz con coco, pero con papelón. Más adelante les haré uno de arroz con leche, pues hace mucho que no lo preparo y ya se me antoja, jaja. Cuéntenme en los comentarios cómo lo preparan ustedes y si les gusta. Espero que les haya gustado el paso a paso y se animen a preparar esta deliciosa receta. ❤️Hasta la próxima publicación. > ✨ And that's it, friends! That's how you can prepare this delicious coconut rice with piloncillo (unrefined cane sugar). Later, I'll make a rice pudding recipe, since it's been a while since I've made it and I'm craving it, haha. Let me know in the comments how you prepare it and if you like it. I hope you enjoyed the step-by-step instructions and are inspired to try this delicious recipe. > ❤️Until the next post.
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)

title.title: Error.
title.body: > Lately, one thing that I have been learning and also unlearning at the same time Is the habit of trying to please everyone around me, so for a very long time, I did not even realize how much I was even doing it, i always wanted people to feel comfortable, happy, and satisfied with me, even if it meant that I was ignoring what I actually wanted or how I truly felt. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUx7duX1onD5vEr8MKVEqSXMRGgjBcDQE69G1vgkEipxq/1773159475602.jpg) So i used to think that making everyone happy at my own expense was the right thing to do, if someone came and asked for help, I would immediately say yes without thinking twice, If someone expected something from me, I would try my best to meet that expectation, even when it would be very inconvenient for me, so in my mind then I felt that if I disappointed people, they might think that I am a bad person. But over time I started noticing that constantly trying to please everyone was actually very exhausting, I See sometimes I would agree to things that I really did not want to do, and other times I would now decide to stay quiet about my own opinions just so there would not be any conflict, on the outside everything looked fine, but inside I sometimes felt drained. The truth is that it is almost impossible to make everyone to be happy all the time, see eh .. no matter how hard you try, someone somewhere will just still have a different opinion or expectation, It took me a while to really understand that. So now I am slowly learning to change that mindset, I am learning that it is okay to say no sometimes, seriously it is okay to choose what works best for me without feeling guilty about it, at first it felt a little uncomfortable because I was not used to it, when you spend a long time putting other people first, it almost feels strange when you start thinking about yourself too. But then the more I think about it, the more I realize that setting boundaries is actually very important, it does not mean I do not care about people, it just means I also care about my own time, energy, and well being. I am also learning that the people who truly respect and value you will understand when you set limits,Real relationships should not depend on you constantly sacrificing yourself just to keep everyone satisfied. Of course, this is still something I’m working on, sometimes my old habit still shows up and I catch myself wanting to automatically agree to things, but now I pause and ask myself a simple question, Is this something I really want to do, or am I just trying to please someone? that small moment of reflection helps me make better decisions. What I believe learning this will accomplish for me is a healthier and more balanced life and when you stop trying to please everyone, you free up a lot of mental space you just stop worrying so much about what people might think and start focusing more on what actually matters to you. I also think it will help me become more confident in my own choices, Instead of constantly seeking approval from others, I can learn to trust myself more. At the end of the day, I am realizing that it iis okay if everyone doesn’t always agree with me or like every decision I make that is just a normal part of life, what matters more is being honest with myself and living in a way that feels true to who I am. So right now, this is what I am earning, to care about people, but not lose myself in the process of trying to please everyone and honestly, that feels like a very important lesson for me. *Image Is Mine* ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png)

title.title: StakeHouseDen || I Tried My Old Strategy Again || The Result Surprised Me
title.body:
![Easy Hotsauce Generation Without Investment.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23vi1sfUpk5qpVXCDoyQ5WYatCAA7UxJiiFK48AWzne1565q88JbpkVy1zgVyNMMgv3FA.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)


Today was my 7th day when I checked in on StakeHouse and continuously claimed daily rewards. In these 7 days just because of regular login and claiming rewards I have collected 950 Hotsauce. This is very good progress for me because in the beginning even I did not think that so much Hotsauce would be collected so quickly.

In this game Hotsauce plays a very important role. The more Hotsauce you have the higher the chance that you can win Colony rewards. That is why I try every day to collect as much Hotsauce as possible and use it in a smart way.

Basically there are two ways to earn Hotsauce. The first way is with investment and the second way is without investment. For people who do not want to invest money then this game also gives a good opportunity. 

![Screenshot 2026-03-10 115627.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyUur4RkFe7M4gRyMBWfnDNjfpNdSoQB1GcHGRfr6Xj2joBAy4ABB5hCKE6QWpG1tgf.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

The without investment method is available for every user. In this you only have to log in daily and claim the free rewards that you get. If a user keeps doing this work with consistency then slowly a good amount of Hotsauce can be collected.

Today I played the game in StakeHouseDen using my old strategy. This strategy worked again and my win rate was 66%. In simple words I played 3 rounds and out of which I succeeded in 2 rounds and failed in 1 round.

After winning each round I kept getting about 6.9 Colony reward. In this way today I got 14 Colony rewards in total. If I combine all the rewards I have won so far I now have 81 Colony rewards in total. All these rewards were won through the game which is a good achievement for me.

![Screenshot 2026-03-10 115910.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23u5xNamL4jYBtuTSsF27CR21ZmYFUv1JprY9rNeYmFf8rXyW5fppHUQ2Tvk9oc2DX3vW.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

Now if I talk about my main strategy, I place around 300 Hotsauce bet in one round. Along with this I select 28 numbers. I use this method because when more numbers are selected, the probability of winning also increases. It means the chance becomes higher that one of your numbers will match.

Because of this strategy today again I succeeded in winning a good amount of Colony rewards. I think that if the game is played with planning and patience then a good result can be achieved.

I also have another strategy which I use when I have less Hotsauce. This strategy is a little high risk. In this the chances of winning are a little lower but if the reward is won then a very big reward can be received.

![Screenshot 2026-03-10 120023.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tbMTWZGc9UVAw6L651Wen8cPJyfuZEDzs6x9RHvJ5hnDYCmHqJr6nNJXvyt4QBHLej4.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

I will discuss this interesting strategy in my next post in detail so that you can also understand how the game can be played in a smart way even with less Hotsauce.

Till now enjoy and learn reading this post. Its a good strategy, you may also give a try.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

title.title: Envisioning the new XBOX and the future Console War - what we can expect
title.body:
Gracias por pasar, version en español abajo https://static0.gamerantimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/wm/2025/10/green-xbox-logo-emblem-on-red-abstract-background.jpg?w=1600&h=900&fit=crop --- This time I must admit that my curiosity about the new generation has gotten the better of me. I feel like this one, which is now nearing its end, has been quite strange. We haven't had many compelling titles, or most of them have been released for both consoles. We're not seeing the rivalry that used to exist, and I think there's a good reason for that. Every time people start talking about the next Xbox, you feel that strange atmosphere that always appears before a new generation of consoles. It's not just technological curiosity; it's also that feeling that something big is coming for gaming. Since Microsoft started dropping hints about the future of its hardware, many are already imagining what the successor to the Xbox Series X might be like. --- https://www.vice.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/12/Next-Gen-Xbox-Will-Be-a-Premium-Steam-Machine-According-to-Leak.jpg --- There aren't too many official details yet, but if you look at how the industry has evolved, several things seem almost certain. The next Xbox will likely focus even more on raw power. Not necessarily because current games need it right now, but because consoles are always designed with several years of development in mind. That means faster loading times, larger worlds, and above all, smoother gameplay experiences. --- https://www.enter.co/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/xbox-vuelve-a-presentar-fable-si.jpg --- Another thing we'll surely see is even deeper integration with digital services. Xbox Game Pass has already become a central part of the Xbox ecosystem, and it would be surprising if the new console didn't take it even further. Perhaps with faster downloads, more integrated social features, or even new ways to discover games within the service. --- https://assetsio.gnwcdn.com/HaloCE_Wallpaper_Desktop-4K_3840x2160_RGB-d4e38f6e57db5ab9a7e2.jpg?width=690&quality=85&format=jpg&dpr=3&auto=webp --- There's also a lot of anticipation surrounding storage. Current consoles already use very fast SSDs, but the next generation may push that even further. Not so much to boast about technical specifications, but to enable things that were previously complicated, like switching between games almost instantly or loading huge areas of the map without loading screens. These kinds of things aren't always noticeable in trailers, but they definitely make a difference when you're playing. --- https://www.nme.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Xbox-Game-Pass-Key-Art.jpg --- As for the console's design, Microsoft has shown that it's not afraid to experiment a bit. The Xbox Series S, for example, opted for a smaller, more accessible form factor, while the Series X went for a kind of minimalist tower. It wouldn't be surprising to see something different again, perhaps a design that integrates better into the living room furniture or that prioritizes ventilation to keep the hardware cool even with very demanding games. But in the end, what truly defines a console is never just the hardware. It's the games. And that's where the next Xbox has an interesting opportunity. In recent years, Microsoft has acquired several major studios under the Xbox Game Studios umbrella, which means that sooner or later we'll see big projects designed specifically for its new hardware. --- https://retrododo.com/content/images/size/w1200/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/best-selling-original-xbox-games-of-all-time-1.jpg --- One can imagine new installments of well-known franchises, but it would also be a good time to see entirely new IPs. Games that not only look better, but do things differently. More vibrant worlds, more interesting artificial intelligence, or stories that feel more dynamic depending on the player's actions. I also hope that the next Xbox makes better use of modern multiplayer. Not just the typical competitive online, but shared worlds where people can drop in and out without too much hassle. Something that blends the social with the narrative, something that feels like a natural evolution of what already exists. --- https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/NkCWmWx3nAxy4GdKTzXgre.jpg --- And then there's the issue of cross-play. It's quite common these days, but it would be great if the next generation treated it as completely normal from day one. Playing with friends regardless of whether they're on console, PC, or even the cloud. That kind of thing ends up being more important than graphics over time. Ultimately, the next Xbox won't just be a more powerful box under your TV. It's going to be Microsoft's attempt to define the next stage of gaming. It might not change everything at once, but it will surely bring small advancements that, together, will make gaming feel a little different.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/ggrhZUdPYrIAAAAC/fable-jack-of-blades.gif)






### Español
https://static0.gamerantimages.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/wm/2025/10/green-xbox-logo-emblem-on-red-abstract-background.jpg?w=1600&h=900&fit=crop --- Esta vez debo admitir que me ha ganado la curiosidad por la nueva generacion, siento que esta que estamos viviendo y que esta viendo sus ultimos años ha sido una bastante extraña, no hemos tenido demasiados titulos convincentes o la mayoria ha salido para ambas consolas, no estamos viendo esa rivalidad que antes habia y creo que hay una buena razon para eso ada vez que se empieza a hablar de la próxima Xbox se siente ese ambiente raro que siempre aparece antes de una nueva generación de consolas. No es solo curiosidad tecnológica, también es esa sensación de que algo grande viene para el gaming. Desde que Microsoft empezó a soltar pequeñas pistas sobre el futuro de su hardware, muchos ya están imaginando cómo podría ser la sucesora de la Xbox Series X --- https://www.vice.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/12/Next-Gen-Xbox-Will-Be-a-Premium-Steam-Machine-According-to-Leak.jpg --- No hay demasiados detalles oficiales todavía, pero si uno se fija en cómo ha evolucionado la industria, hay varias cosas que parecen casi seguras. La próxima Xbox probablemente va a apostar todavía más por la potencia bruta. No necesariamente porque los juegos actuales lo necesiten ya mismo, sino porque las consolas siempre se diseñan pensando en varios años hacia adelante. Eso significa mejores tiempos de carga, mundos más grandes y sobre todo experiencias más fluidas. --- https://www.enter.co/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/xbox-vuelve-a-presentar-fable-si.jpg --- Otra cosa que seguramente veremos es una integración todavía más profunda con los servicios digitales. Xbox Game Pass ya se convirtió en una pieza central del ecosistema de Xbox, y sería raro que la nueva consola no lo lleve todavía más lejos. Quizá con descargas más rápidas, funciones sociales más integradas o incluso formas nuevas de descubrir juegos dentro del servicio. --- https://assetsio.gnwcdn.com/HaloCE_Wallpaper_Desktop-4K_3840x2160_RGB-d4e38f6e57db5ab9a7e2.jpg?width=690&quality=85&format=jpg&dpr=3&auto=webp --- También hay mucha expectativa con el tema del almacenamiento. Las consolas actuales ya usan SSD muy rápidos, pero es posible que la siguiente generación empuje eso aún más. No tanto para presumir números técnicos sino para permitir cosas que antes eran complicadas, como cambiar entre juegos casi instantáneamente o cargar zonas enormes del mapa sin pantallas de carga. Ese tipo de cosas no siempre se notan en los trailers, pero cuando juegas sí se sienten. --- https://www.nme.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Xbox-Game-Pass-Key-Art.jpg --- En cuanto al diseño de la consola, Microsoft ha demostrado que no le importa experimentar un poco. La Xbox Series S por ejemplo apostó por un formato más pequeño y accesible mientras que la Series X se fue por una especie de torre minimalista. No sería raro ver algo diferente otra vez, quizá un diseño que se integre mejor en el mueble de la sala o que priorice la ventilación para mantener el hardware frío incluso con juegos muy exigentes. Pero al final lo que realmente define a una consola nunca es solo el hardware. Son los juegos. Y ahí es donde la próxima Xbox tiene una oportunidad interesante. En los últimos años Microsoft ha comprado varios estudios importantes bajo el paraguas de Xbox Game Studios, lo que significa que tarde o temprano veremos proyectos grandes pensados directamente para su nuevo hardware. --- https://retrododo.com/content/images/size/w1200/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/best-selling-original-xbox-games-of-all-time-1.jpg --- Uno puede imaginar nuevas entregas de sagas conocidas, pero también sería buen momento para ver IP completamente nuevas. Juegos que no solo se vean mejor, sino que hagan cosas distintas. Mundos más vivos, inteligencia artificial más interesante, o historias que se sientan más dinámicas dependiendo de lo que haga el jugador. También espero que la próxima Xbox aproveche mejor el multijugador moderno. No solo el típico online competitivo, sino mundos compartidos donde la gente pueda entrar y salir sin demasiadas complicaciones. Algo que mezcle lo social con lo narrativo, algo que se sienta como una evolución natural de lo que ya existe. --- https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/NkCWmWx3nAxy4GdKTzXgre.jpg --- Y luego está el tema del juego cruzado. Hoy en día ya es bastante común, pero sería genial que la próxima generación lo trate como algo totalmente normal desde el primer día. Jugar con amigos sin importar si están en consola, PC o incluso nube. Ese tipo de cosas terminan siendo más importantes que los gráficos cuando pasa el tiempo. Al final la próxima Xbox no solo será una caja más potente debajo del televisor. Va a ser la forma en que Microsoft intente definir la siguiente etapa del gaming. Puede que no cambie todo de golpe, pero seguro traerá pequeños avances que juntos harán que jugar se sienta un poco diferente.

title.title: Tenerife Uncovered: A Walk Through Puerto de la Cruz And Sea Stories
title.body:
One in a while I fade crypto and leave the Metaverse unattended, as I go away to touch some grass! I don't disconnect 100% because you know a true Chad can't go Out Of Office for too much time... it's just impossible! 

Tenerife is the largest of Spain’s Canary Islands, and my holiday destination for a while! It is a remarkable destination that offers a striking mix of natural wonders, cultural richness, and culinary delights.

I took you for a tour of the island, showed you the beaches, the volcano, and we had some food! You've seen the magnificent Loro Parque and now you will enjoy street art! Read the previous article!

[**Tenerife Uncovered: Volcanoes, Beaches, and Culinary Delights**](https://www.publish0x.com/paul-tourist/tenerife-uncovered-volcanoes-beaches-and-culinary-delights-xywkdjq \
)\n\n[**Reporting Live from Tenerife - Touch Grass, Touch Sand, Stay Chad**](https://www.publish0x.com/paul-tourist/reporting-live-from-tenerife-touch-grass-touch-sand-stay-cha-xdqdrjz \
)\n\n[**Tenerife Uncovered: Porto De La Cruz Street Art**](https://www.publish0x.com/paul-tourist/tenerife-uncovered-porto-de-la-cruz-street-art-xywqynk \

)


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZN33JSDedYdgJpwfTYRZViLG8FSf1DLkeL2EcW5PcFDB/image.png)


There’s something quietly captivating about Puerto de la Cruz. It doesn’t shout for attention like the bigger resorts in Tenerife but it unfolds slowly through weathered harbour stones.

There are small details that hint at centuries of life shaped by the sea. Start at the old harbour, where the rhythm of the town still feels tied to fishing boats and tides.

Here stands the beloved statue known as _La Pescadora..._ the fisherwoman. She strides forward with purpose, a basket balanced on her head and fish in hand, mouth open mid-call as if selling her catch.

This is a tribute to the women who once carried the backbone of the town’s economy, working just as hard as the men at sea. You can almost hear the echo of a marketplace in her stance.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfKRzwScHbD2cnKyPEDA5HipJZACtKUU7zpAMjFGB5aMR/image.png)


Just steps away sits Casa de la Aduana, a modest but meaningful building dating back to the 17th century. Once the town’s customs house, this was where goods arrived from across the ocean.

Casa de la Aduana looks like a typical Canarian house, with its wooden balconies and slightly faded, sun-worn charm. But behind that modest exterior lies more than four centuries of history.

Built around 1620, it is the oldest surviving civil building in Puerto de la Cruz, and for much of its life it stood at the very center of the town’s connection to the outside world.

The building has taken on a quieter but more varied role. Inside, it has been repurposed into a mix of cultural spaces that give it the feel of a small, evolving museum rather than a single, defined exhibition.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVhMjYko5s2qLbtZajxfHxiVYK1yc5notv22mhF7MKeza/image.png)


Upstairs, it houses the Museo de Arte Contemporáneo Eduardo Westerdahl, one of the earliest contemporary art museums in Spain. Its collection brings together works by Canarian artists such as Óscar Domínguez and César Manrique.

The contrast is striking as you step in from the harbour, with its fishing boats and sea air ... and find yourself surrounded by modern artistic expression. Downstairs, the atmosphere shifts again.

The ground floor is more informal, often hosting local crafts, artisan displays, and rotating cultural exhibitions. It is a space that feels closer to everyday life in the town, occasionally used for talks, small events, and community gatherings. 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRzidmLx9s6grw6u7BXr7cqJzerw48z2meHVCEwRaEihP/image.png)


The building functions as the main tourist information center by the harbour, making it both a cultural stop and a practical starting point for exploring the old town.

The building itself carries the weight of centuries... of trade, migration, and fishing life. It stands just steps from where ships once docked, and near the remains of old coastal defenses such as the Batería de Santa Bárbara. 

Visiting it today is a subtle experience rather than a grand one. Outside you have the sea breeze, the fishermen, the presence of the town’s daily rhythm. Inside everything becomes cooler and quieter! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbFSbVCWJf8e6vRpshkVHkCT974C2HevRTPL8TPLfRfqD/image.png)


The town gently invites you upward. The path leads to one of its more unexpected features... a set of painted steps dedicated to Agatha Christie, and each step carries the title of one of her novels.

It’s a surprising tribute, until you learn that Christie stayed here in 1927 during a difficult chapter of her life. In the calm of Tenerife, she found space to recover and to write. This simple climb is a literary journey. 

At the top, the walk opens out to Mirador de La Paz, a viewpoint overlooking the ocean and the Martiánez coastline. Palms swaying, waves breaking below, and a sense of stillness that feels unchanged from Christie’s time. 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaLry2RzUcfmMKsHUp9PUS9ji7veCyPm5B39gM6JrQNvB/image.png)

title.title: Un corazón en aprietos [Es-En] A heart in distress
title.body: Hola, comunidad y amigos. Hoy no tengo reparos en pedir ayuda cuando la necesito, aunque en el pasado he cometido el error de luchar solo hasta el agotamiento, con consecuencias que lamentar, pero sabiendo ser agradecido y solidario, no dudo en devolver el favor o ayudar a quien se cruza en mi camino. En esta ocasión se trata de mi hermano, quien fue diagnosticado con una condición cardíaca compleja (insuficiencia valvular aórtica con dilatación de la aorta), por la cual debe someterse a una cirugía cardiovascular mayor (reemplazo valvular con tubo y bypass coronario). Su necesidad supera nuestras posibilidades económicas, por lo que él y yo, al enterarnos, recurrimos a todas las puertas posibles y estamos compartiendo en todas las redes sociales el anuncio que aparece al final de la publicación. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdL8gmgH3o6FMdSPT6cHXXUFpSVbQ3HLHtmFgzgJvoNZ4/image.png) Aquí estoy junto a mis hermanos en la que puede ser la última foto y ocasión en que los tres compartimos. Hoy sumamos 194 años entre los tres y, aunque unidos emocionalmente, en lo físico nos separan miles de kilómetros. Cuando nos tomaron la foto, los tres estábamos en Cumaná, Venezuela, pero hoy Ramón, el del medio en la foto y en edad, vive en Caracas; Fernando, el menor, a la derecha, en España, al cuidado de una de sus hijas; y yo, el mayor, en Buenos Aires, donde primero emigró mi hijo y ahora mi hija, mi esposa y yo residimos en esta tierra generosa con todos. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX4yLSEdBVpmk9qm1mL8hapKGiqww6a2Zdi6bdMmZmjH3/image.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVAmoHeeN9pTT8y3yCAfz1JByfRzsUyAAfbUBhJFPRLfo/image.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTYq2rwaGvMrxYRefY5Hww6fByPZ8NFwKt3BdiApr7VnY/image.png) Les comparto algunos recuerdos de nuestra lejana infancia junto a nuestros padres que ya partieron de este mundo tan diferente al de ellos, tan solo por recordar momentos felices en medio de esta vida agitada y llena de incertidumbre. Consciente de la situación económica de la mayoría, solo les pido que compartan el enlace en sus redes sociales, ya que la ayuda llega siempre de donde menos lo sospechamos y, bueno, cualquier cantidad es buena y se agradece. https://gofund.me/e11e80ee3 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRTQvr9Pjej6TN3xbxvBEQCyfSXZHwgRscb6GhdEwLC2s/image.png) En el enlace del GoFund hay más detalles acerca de su padecimiento y otros detalles acerca del diagnóstico y tratamiento. Gracias. Muchas gracias. # A heart in distress Hello, community and friends. Today I have no qualms about asking for help when I need it, although in the past I've made the mistake of fighting alone until I was exhausted, with regrettable consequences. But knowing how to be grateful and supportive, I don't hesitate to return the favor or help those who cross my path. This time it's my brother, who was diagnosed with a complex heart condition (aortic valve insufficiency with aortic dilation), for which he must undergo major cardiovascular surgery (valve replacement with a conduit and coronary artery bypass). His need exceeds our financial means, so when he and I found out, we explored every possible avenue and are sharing the announcement at the end of this post on all social media platforms. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdL8gmgH3o6FMdSPT6cHXXUFpSVbQ3HLHtmFgzgJvoNZ4/image.png) Here I am with my brothers in what may be the last photo and occasion we all shared together. Today, we are 194 years old between us, and although we are emotionally connected, thousands of kilometers physically separate us. When the photo was taken, the three of us were in Cumaná, Venezuela, but today Ramón, the middle one in the photo and the oldest, lives in Caracas; Fernando, the youngest, on the right, lives in Spain, caring for one of his daughters; and I, the oldest, live in Buenos Aires, where my son first emigrated and now my daughter, my wife, and I reside in this land so generous to us all. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX4yLSEdBVpmk9qm1mL8hapKGiqww6a2Zdi6bdMmZmjH3/image.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVAmoHeeN9pTT8y3yCAfz1JByfRzsUyAAfbUBhJFPRLfo/image.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTYq2rwaGvMrxYRefY5Hww6fByPZ8NFwKt3BdiApr7VnY/image.png) I'm sharing some memories from our distant childhood with our parents, who have already passed away from this world so different from theirs, simply to remember happy moments amidst this hectic and uncertain life. Aware of the economic situation of most people, I simply ask that you share the link on your social media, as help always comes from where we least expect it, and well, any amount is welcome and appreciated. https://gofund.me/e11e80ee3 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRTQvr9Pjej6TN3xbxvBEQCyfSXZHwgRscb6GhdEwLC2s/image.png) The GoFund link has more details about her condition and other details about the diagnosis and treatment. Thank you. Thank you very much.
