title.title: Learning Boundaries.
title.body: > Lately, one thing that I have been learning and also unlearning at the same time Is the habit of trying to please everyone around me, so for a very long time, I did not even realize how much I was even doing it, i always wanted people to feel comfortable, happy, and satisfied with me, even if it meant that I was ignoring what I actually wanted or how I truly felt. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUx7duX1onD5vEr8MKVEqSXMRGgjBcDQE69G1vgkEipxq/1773159475602.jpg) So i used to think that making everyone happy at my own expense was the right thing to do, if someone came and asked for help, I would immediately say yes without thinking twice, If someone expected something from me, I would try my best to meet that expectation, even when it would be very inconvenient for me, so in my mind then I felt that if I disappointed people, they might think that I am a bad person. But over time I started noticing that constantly trying to please everyone was actually very exhausting, I See sometimes I would agree to things that I really did not want to do, and other times I would now decide to stay quiet about my own opinions just so there would not be any conflict, on the outside everything looked fine, but inside I sometimes felt drained. The truth is that it is almost impossible to make everyone to be happy all the time, see eh .. no matter how hard you try, someone somewhere will just still have a different opinion or expectation, It took me a while to really understand that. So now I am slowly learning to change that mindset, I am learning that it is okay to say no sometimes, seriously it is okay to choose what works best for me without feeling guilty about it, at first it felt a little uncomfortable because I was not used to it, when you spend a long time putting other people first, it almost feels strange when you start thinking about yourself too. But then the more I think about it, the more I realize that setting boundaries is actually very important, it does not mean I do not care about people, it just means I also care about my own time, energy, and well being. I am also learning that the people who truly respect and value you will understand when you set limits,Real relationships should not depend on you constantly sacrificing yourself just to keep everyone satisfied. Of course, this is still something I’m working on, sometimes my old habit still shows up and I catch myself wanting to automatically agree to things, but now I pause and ask myself a simple question, Is this something I really want to do, or am I just trying to please someone? that small moment of reflection helps me make better decisions. What I believe learning this will accomplish for me is a healthier and more balanced life and when you stop trying to please everyone, you free up a lot of mental space you just stop worrying so much about what people might think and start focusing more on what actually matters to you. I also think it will help me become more confident in my own choices, Instead of constantly seeking approval from others, I can learn to trust myself more. At the end of the day, I am realizing that it iis okay if everyone doesn’t always agree with me or like every decision I make that is just a normal part of life, what matters more is being honest with myself and living in a way that feels true to who I am. So right now, this is what I am earning, to care about people, but not lose myself in the process of trying to please everyone and honestly, that feels like a very important lesson for me. *Image Is Mine* ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png)

title.title: Avancemos con buena vibra|Let's move forward with good vibes
title.body:
>


<center>![IMG-20260308-WA0069.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbHigNRjC5yjPJgLTEZJPyAugWxF73icmZmvrwe44jyCc/IMG-20260308-WA0069.jpg)</center>






¡Hola queridos usuarios!

Mi apellido es perseverancia, también tengo mi segundo apellido que decidí adquirir...Fortaleza. Con este tema de la semana mi mente se llenó de alegría para regalar, siempre he sido una persona muy positiva llena de muchas risas para compartir. Tenemos situaciones que nos pueden llegar a paralizar, pero de verdad es bueno reposar para luego levantarnos con más energía. Vuelve a mi mente una frase de mi prima: \

.


Siento que muchas personas han tenido momento fuertes de mucha angustia, pesares, dolores fuertes que cuando los comparten pueden llegar a afectarme mucho, situaciones que parecen sacadas de historias de terror, de verdad que no se como han podido levantarse, pero han quedado llenas de muchas dudas, dolores, decepciones se han quedado en ese pasado.

Con el ejemplo que nuestra amiga @angelica7 nos da al poner a hive en la palestra, me quedé pensando un buen rato, hive es mi gran amigo virtual, siento que hive ha sido un gran espacio para poder recrearme, vaciar mi mente, organizar mis pensamientos y recibir esa ayuda que solo hive sabe, son de esos amigos que te invitan a escribir, sacar ese dialogo interno de tantas emociones que solo hive sabe organizar. En estos momentos parece que estamos distantes, alejados, pero hay algo más profundo que se llama agradecimiento, ese agradecimiento que nos hace mantenernos firmes.

>Hello dear users!

>My last name is Perseverance, and I also have a second last name that I chose to adopt...Fortaleza (Strength). This week's theme has filled my mind with joy to share. I've always been a very positive person, full of laughter to share. We all face situations that can paralyze us, but it's truly good to rest so we can rise again with more energy. A phrase from my cousin keeps coming back to me: \

>I feel that many people have experienced intense moments of anguish, sorrow, and deep pain that, when shared, can affect me deeply. These situations seem like something out of a horror story. I truly don't know how they managed to get back on their feet, but they're left with many doubts, pain, and disappointments that remain in the past. >With the example our friend @angelica7 gave us by bringing Hive into the spotlight, I spent a good while thinking. Hive is my great virtual friend. I feel like Hive has been a great space for recreation, for clearing my mind, organizing my thoughts, and receiving the kind of help that only Hive can provide. They're one of those friends that invites you to write, to bring out that internal dialogue of so many emotions that only Hive knows how to organize. Right now, it seems like we're distant, separated, but there's something deeper called gratitude, that gratitude that keeps us going. He podido avanzar en la vida en primer lugar gracias a Dios, luego el poder darme el tiempo para organizar mi vida, hacer esa línea de vida que me ajusta a mi realidad, poder vivir desde otro punto de vista, quizá con algún declive, pero sin quedarme sumergida en esas realidades que nos toca vivir. Escucho mucho odio, dolor y en ocasiones decepciones que se han quedado en el cuerpo hasta convertirse en un modo de vida, personas que pasan parte de su vida estilando mala vibra, en algunos casos sin ser conscientes que han salvado el resto de su vida. Sigamos avanzando, sigamos creyendo en ese mundo mejor que soñamos cada día, en ser esa persona vitamina que tanto necesita el mundo, no te rindas descansa y sigue dando lo mejor de ti. >I've been able to move forward in life, first and foremost thanks to God, and then by being able to take the time to organize my life, to create a path that fits my reality, to live from a different perspective, perhaps with some setbacks, but without getting stuck in the realities we all face. I hear so much hatred, pain, and sometimes disappointments that have taken root in people, becoming a way of life—people who spend part of their lives spreading negativity, sometimes without realizing they've saved the rest of their lives. >Let's keep moving forward, let's keep believing in that better world we dream of every day, in being that vital person the world so desperately needs. Don't give up, rest, and keep giving your best.

title.title: 10 March 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3038: he ate what?
title.body:
/>[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/bird-feathers-coal-tit-8312424/)

“he eat what?”

The query blurted out before anybody could moderate it. It carried surprise, disbelief, and a little bit of curiosity all mixed together. Few heads turned slowly around the table, yearning for the undoubtedly forthcoming justification.

Apparently, he had wandered into a little roadside eatery with a menu that was more of a recommendation than a constraint. Spice permeated the air, while on the stovetop pots simmered as silent secrets. Rather than inquired about the ingredients of the cuisine, he just indicated one dish and said he would take it

“He ate what?”

The reaction spread quickly. Some people laughed. Others looked slightly horrified. One person leaned back in their chair as if the information alone could reach their own stomach.

And that is why, hours later, people were still shaking their heads, repeating the same amazed question with half a laugh and half a gasp.

“He ate what?”

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: März 10 2026
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/DF3CBC73-2A1A-4DD6-B3D7-97AA797CFB2F1773159193.445345) During a walk I noticed this dog. Lying quietly behind a gate. Only the nose and part of the face visible below the wood. Watching the world through a narrow gap. I stopped for a moment and spoke to him. Asked him if he was bored. No barking. No movement. Just lying there and looking. Sometimes animals don’t need many reactions. Just observing. Maybe waiting for someone to return. Maybe simply enjoying the sun and the passing moments. A calm scene. A curious nose pressed close to the outside world. And for a short moment two walkers sharing the same path. One passing by. One staying behind. Observed while moving. Left unfinished.

title.title: A thief named Autumn.
title.body:
A thief named Autumn. Going outside and looking around, I involuntarily recalled a moment from my life, when in childhood, in a crowded bus running between the city center and the sea coast in a resort town, I caught a pickpocket red-handed, who with the help of a coin sharpened to a razor-sharp point cut my mother's bag and tried to pull out my wallet. Yes, only later I realized how dangerous it was, but it happened at the moment the bus stopped at another public transport stop and the thief broke free and ran away, getting lost in the crowd. But, I remember his look, in which there was no feeling, no regret, no fear... although, you could say that there was reproach in this look. It's strange, a person who commits a crime reproaches another person for being vigilant and not letting himself be deceived. So, today, autumn, which behaves like a thief, looked at me reproachfully, perhaps. Judging by the yellowed, fallen leaves, autumn has already managed to steal some of August from us and, although it is still summer on the calendar, it is no longer possible to hide the presence of autumn. If autumn wanted to hide its presence, it did not succeed. Moreover, autumn is a rather greedy, insatiable thief, which is ready to steal part of summer from us and will not disdain a piece of winter, so, in recent years, this thief has been especially active and, sometimes, even at Christmas, the atmosphere around is no longer winter, but autumnal. ![108wertDSC06503.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmTwhELEVVe3BHmN8v46Bz9Y2SDeUmZvXBzHsYuwXDmgsi/108wertDSC06503.png) --- Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. title.body:
Hi! I am learning how I can communicate with others.  From my early age I have always been an extrovert but I can not communicate with others. Can not express my wills in my family.  Also in my calsroom I never asked any question even I did not understand the lectures of my teachers.  People were not interested to talk with me. I noticed I could not communicate properly and communication system is not same to all. 

It was too difficult to understand human psychology for me. I noticed that psychology differs from man to man. A businessman and a teacher have never same psychology. Talking with an illiterate person and an educated person is diffrent. There are also some jealous persons who never suggest anything well for others. Some people never help others without their benefits. So if anyone wants a safe movement in any society he must have a good communication skill. 

When I was younger some shopkeepers tried to give me the bad products. They knew that I would never return that product because they thought I did not have  too much courage to return those products. In my day-to-day life I face many problems like this in different sectors. So I am trying to develop my communication skill. 

I am learning water color painting for my pleasure recently. Here is an evening scene painted by me in water  color.

title.title: Summer in March
title.body: Where are youu the lovers of summer, only summer, and absolutely not the cold and wet winter? 😁 I cannot really place myself in that category, especially because I started loving summer, strong sun and heat a few years ago. Now I like all seasons equally. Maybe that kind of realization comes with age. It is like when you are a child and you only like max two things to eat for lunch, and then you grow up and become a lover of all kinds of food, both traditional dishes and all the world cuisines that exist. So if another season suddenly appeared, I would probably love that one instantly as well. I am thinking now about how that would look, without connecting it to the four seasons we already have. Do not know. I cannot imagine anything so unusual and different that it would earn its place among these twelve months. Even we who used to have the regular four seasons seem to be moving toward having only two, and here I am dreaming about introducing a fifth one. Silly me. xD

/>This beach is ours. I know that by law a few meters from the riverbed belong to the state, and that nearby properties sometimes change as the river slowly changes its course. But the access to this beautiful sandy river beach goes through our land, so for a long time people have called it Janicko. The name means that it belongs to someone named Jana and Jana was the grandmother of my great grandmother - my great great great grandmother. It has always had this lovely fine sand, just like at the sea. Now the recent rainfall has raised the river and brought even more of it just in time for the swimming season (in june). I am talking as if summer is already here and we will be splashing in the water tomorrow. 😁

/>In earlier years, many people used to go there. They would come even from nearby villages and towns. Everyone, from grandmas and grandpas, to young people, to the youngest little kids. One year, I think it was 2016, at one moment we counted more than 100 people there, which was really fascinating. We would always bring sunflower seeds, some fruit, peanut snacks, something that keeps you full when the water and swimming make you tired, and then we would share everything with each other. Sometimes we would light a small fire too. When the young corn arrives toward the end of summer, we pick some from the nearby fields. I will not say we steal it, we just help ourselves a little, haha. Then we roast it and everyone eats together. It was always fun there. We played cards, chased each other around the beach, built a small jumping platform from bags filled with sand, and one year some groups even got together and made a really good volleyball net, so we also played beach volleyball. 🏖️

/>I will not lie to you and say the water is clean, because it is not. But those of us who grew up on the banks of this river and learned to swim here were never really disgusted or afraid of it. But I am sorry for that... people in Serbia generally do not have much awareness about protecting the environment. Not because of some magical idea of \

, but simply so that the place where we live can be nicer and more pleasant for us. All of these photos were taken last week when I went for a walk with my sister and our dog Maza. ❤️ That is usually our route. We go down near the river, walk along the path where our beach is, and then from below, across the railway, we reach our weekend house, the old house of my great grandmother that I often write about here. The land where the house stands is just above the road and the railway, right above this beach. Which makes sense, because all of that used to be one single property owned by one person, one of my ancestors.

/>The way I set out that day in my winter boots and a sweater, I immediately started shedding layers as soon as we arrived and sat on the steps in front of the house. Coffee brewed on a mini gas stove, the sun gently touching our skin and revealing every little blemish, making them even more visible xD, the two of us enjoying that lovely day, well, pardon me, three of us, I must not forget Miss Maza, who spent the whole time running around the yard and catching lizards (she is an excellent hunter; no lizard or mouse can escape her notice).  \n  \n<span class=\

title.title: I Was So Scared of Failing That I Forgot to Actually Live   \
title.body:
![My post on ](https://iili.io/qRmL8v9.png)
``This Image is Created By Canva``
So let me say this clearly; I am not a writer. I have never really sat down to write about my feelings before. But here I am, doing just that, so I guess life is full of surprises. 

Anyway, let's get to it.  

This week’s topic is about what we are learning or unlearning, and when I read that, one thing immediately came to mind: fear of failure. My old best friend. My most loyal companion. The one thing that has been with me longer than most people I know.  

Honestly, I used to think that being scared of failing meant I was being smart. I thought I was protecting myself. Why jump into something if there is a real chance it could blow up in your face? That made total sense to me at the time.  

But then I looked up one day and realized something kind of embarrassing. I had not actually tried anything in a while. Not because I was busy. Not because the timing was bad. I simply kept waiting for that perfect moment when I felt completely ready and confident, with zero fear. Spoiler alert: that moment never came. I was just standing still while everything around me kept moving. That realization hit me harder than I expected.  

# So what am I learning?  
I am learning that fear does not actually go away before you do the thing. It goes away while you are doing it. Sometimes even after. But it does not politely step aside and let you through first. You have to walk right through it as if it is not there.  

That is deeply annoying, and I won’t pretend otherwise. But it works. I have started doing small things that scare me. I am putting myself out there in tiny ways. Yes, sometimes it feels uncomfortable and awkward, and things do not go perfectly. But nothing catastrophic has happened either. The world did not end. People did not point and laugh. Life just continued, normally.  

It turns out that most of the disasters I feared existed only in my head—rent free—for years. Absolutely wild.  

# And what am I unlearning?  
The belief that if something fails, it means I am a failure. Those two things are not the same, and it took me embarrassingly long to figure that out.  

An experiment that does not work does not mean the scientist is stupid. It just means to try a different method. That is literally how things work. But somehow, I missed that lesson growing up and turned every small setback into a whole identity crisis. Clearly, that was a very efficient use of my time.  

I am slowly unlearning that now. It is a process. Some days are better than others. But I am getting there.  

# The bottom line:  
Fear of failure is really just fear of being human. Every human fails sometimes; it is part of the whole experience. The goal was never to avoid failure. The goal is to not let it stop you from even showing up.  

I am still figuring things out and probably will be for a while. But at least I am moving now instead of waiting on the sidelines for courage to magically appear. That feels like progress to me. And for now, that is enough.

by Hilaricita on Hilaricita 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/hilaricita [![Tesoro Naranja](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/441a6726-f5f9-495a-aec8-d452043c95ee.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/rkX2vwqQFKMDFqXYLmcJZV) 
 
 ![Versión español.png](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/hilaricita/0c2eef4b843038ffa91c5c76126870fbaa369559.png)

Martes 10 de marzo, 2026

Al observar una zanahoria, lo primero que llama la atención de quien ha trabajado el campo es que no se trata simplemente de una raíz engrosada, sino de un órgano de reserva sofisticado perteneciente a la familia de las apiáceas, antiguamente conocidas como umbelíferas. Esta planta, cuyo nombre científico es Daucus carota, muestra en su estado silvestre una rusticidad envidiable, pero la versión que llega a la mesa ha sido moldeada por siglos de selección humana hasta convertirse en esa estructura cónica y carnosa de color naranja intenso, aunque es un error común pensar que siempre fue así. De hecho, las primeras variedades domesticadas en la región que hoy conocemos como Afganistán presentaban tonalidades púrpuras y amarillas, siendo el naranja un desarrollo posterior, probablemente impulsado por los cultivadores holandeses en los siglos XVI y XVII, quizás como un guiño a la Casa de Orange, aunque botánicamente ese color es simplemente el resultado de una acumulación masiva de betacarotenos.

Lo curioso de este cultivo es su ciclo de vida bienal, un detalle que a veces se pasa por alto en la agricultura intensiva. Durante el primer año, la planta dedica toda su energía a formar esa raíz pivotante gruesa y a almacenar azúcares y nutrientes, preparando el terreno para el invierno. Si se deja en la tierra o se guarda adecuadamente, al llegar la segunda primavera, la zanahoria utiliza esas reservas para lanzar un tallo floral que puede superar el metro de altura, desplegando unas inflorescencias en forma de paraguas compuestas por cientos de pequeñas flores blancas. Es en esta etapa cuando se revela su parentesco con plantas tan distintas como el perejil, el apio o incluso la cicuta, compartiendo esa arquitectura floral tan característica que atrae a una gran diversidad de insectos polinizadores.

Desde una perspectiva agronómica, la textura y el sabor de la raíz dependen críticamente de cómo se maneje el suelo; una tierra compactada o con piedras provoca que la raíz se bifurque o se deforme buscando el camino de menor resistencia, mientras que un sustrato profundo y arenoso permite ese crecimiento recto y uniforme que tanto se valora comercialmente. Además, existe una particularidad química fascinante: los compuestos aromáticos que dan ese olor terroso y dulce característico no están solo en la raíz, sino que también se encuentran, aunque en menor concentración, en las hojas plumosas, las cuales son completamente comestibles y tienen un sabor que recuerda a una mezcla entre perejil y zanahoria, aunque a menudo se desechan por desconocimiento.

Otra curiosidad que suele sorprender es la relación de esta hortaliza con la temperatura. La zanahoria necesita cierto frío para iniciar su fase reproductiva, un mecanismo de supervivencia que asegura que no florezca antes de haber pasado el invierno. Sin embargo, si se cosecha tras una helada ligera, el sabor mejora notablemente porque la planta, como defensa natural contra el congelamiento de sus tejidos, transforma parte de sus almidones en azúcares simples, actuando como un anticongelante biológico que endulza la carne de la raíz. Este pequeño truco de la naturaleza es el mismo que hace que las zanahorias de invierno o las guardadas en frío tengan ese punto dulce tan apreciado, demostrando una vez más cómo la fisiología vegetal responde directamente a los desafíos del entorno.

Cuando un chef se enfrenta a la zanahoria, deja de verla como ese acompañamiento naranja y anónimo que suele aparecer en el fondo del plato para reconocerla como una protagonista con un rango de expresión sorprendente. En la cocina profesional, este tubérculo es un camaleón capaz de transitar desde lo terroso y dulce hasta lo sofisticado y complejo, dependiendo enteramente de cómo se trate su textura y se concentren sus azúcares naturales. Una de las preparaciones que mejor revela esta dualidad es la crema o velouté, donde la zanahoria no solo se cuece, sino que se carameliza ligeramente antes de añadir el caldo, potenciando ese sabor a tierra mojada y sol que la caracteriza. Al triturarla con un toque de jengibre fresco o unas semillas de comino tostadas, se logra un equilibrio donde la dulzura vegetal se corta con un picor aromático, creando una sopa que conforta pero que también despierta el paladar, lejos de ser esa mezcla insípida que a veces se sirve en comedores institucionales.

Sin embargo, es en la transformación de lo simple en algo inesperado donde la zanahoria brilla con luz propia, como ocurre en los postres. El clásico pastel de zanahoria no es solo una excusa para usar verduras en la repostería, sino una lección de química culinaria: la humedad de la raíz rallada mantiene la miga del bizcocho jugosa durante días, mientras que sus azúcares reaccionan con las especias cálidas como la canela, la nuez moscada y el clavo. Un buen chef sabe que el secreto no está en ocultar el sabor a zanahoria, sino en celebrarlo, utilizando un frosting de queso crema acidulado que contraste con la dulzura profunda del interior, logrando que cada bocado sea una experiencia de texturas donde lo crujiente de una nuez tostada se encuentra con la suavidad húmeda del cake.

Más allá de lo tradicional, la cocina contemporánea ha rescatado técnicas antiguas para elevar este ingrediente a la alta gastronomía, siendo la fermentación y la confitación ejemplos claros de esta evolución. Las zanahorias fermentadas en salmuera con hierbas desarrollan una acidez láctica vibrante y una textura crujiente que las convierte en el acompañamiento perfecto para platos grasos, cortando la pesadez de una carne de cordero o un pato confitado con una frescura punzante. 

Al observar los hábitos alimenticios de quienes incorporan la zanahoria de forma constante en su dieta, se nota una mejora sutil pero significativa en varios marcadores de salud, empezando por esa protección invisible que ofrece a la vista. No es un mito popular sin fundamento; el aporte generoso de betacarotenos, que el cuerpo transforma eficientemente en vitamina A, actúa como un escudo para la retina, ayudando a mantener la agudeza visual y protegiendo los ojos del desgaste natural y de la luz intensa. Quienes la consumen regularmente suelen reportar menos fatiga ocular y una mejor adaptación a los cambios de luminosidad, un beneficio que se vuelve crucial con el paso de los años pero que comienza a construirse desde los primeros bocados.

Más allá de la visión, el consumo habitual de este tubérculo establece una relación muy positiva con la salud de la piel y el sistema inmunológico. Los antioxidantes presentes no solo combaten el estrés oxidativo que acelera el envejecimiento celular, sino que otorgan a la dermis ese tono dorado y luminoso que a menudo se confunde con un bronceado saludable, aunque en realidad es el reflejo de una buena nutrición interna. Al mismo tiempo, la vitamina C y otros fitoquímicos refuerzan las defensas naturales del organismo, haciendo que el cuerpo responda con mayor vigor ante agresiones externas, reduciendo la frecuencia de resfriados comunes y acelerando los procesos de recuperación cuando el sistema inmune necesita trabajar extra.

Desde la perspectiva de la salud digestiva y metabólica, la zanahoria se comporta como un aliado versátil y equilibrado. Su fibra, especialmente la pectina soluble, actúa como un regulador suave del tránsito intestinal, evitando tanto el estreñimiento como la diarrea, y contribuye a mantener estables los niveles de glucosa en sangre al ralentizar la absorción de azúcares. Esto la convierte en un alimento ideal para personas que buscan controlar su peso o gestionar la diabetes, ya que aporta saciedad con una densidad calórica muy baja. Además, estudios recientes sugieren que el consumo regular puede ayudar a moderar los niveles de colesterol, ya que estas fibras tienen la capacidad de unirse a los ácidos biliares y facilitar su eliminación, obligando al hígado a utilizar el colesterol circulante para producir más bilis.

Finalmente, hay un aspecto preventivo a largo plazo que merece atención: la presencia de compuestos como el falcarinol, un pesticida natural que la planta produce para defenderse de hongos, parece tener propiedades anticancerígenas prometedoras, especialmente en la prevención de ciertos tipos de tumores. Aunque no es una cura milagrosa, incluir zanahorias en el plato diario suma una capa más de protección celular. Lo interesante es que estos beneficios se potencian cuando se consume cocida con un poco de grasa saludable, como aceite de oliva, ya que esto maximiza la biodisponibilidad de sus nutrientes liposolubles. En resumen, quien hace de la zanahoria un compañero fiel en sus comidas está invirtiendo silenciosamente en una vejez con mejores ojos, una piel más resistente, una digestión tranquila y un sistema defensivo más robusto.

Como ya casi se acaba el número de caracteres de la caja de información, les dejo con la canción que le pedí a SUNO, esperando que esta publicación les haya servido, no solo como entretenimiento, sino que les haya aportado un poco, una chispa de contenido que genera valor.

Esta fue una canción y reflexión de martes.

Que tengan un excelente día y que Dios los bendiga grandemente.

title.title: Friends Should be there for You
title.body:
‎It is very important that we know little things that matter in life. The people who are with you when you start small are those people you need to hold so close to your heart. You do not need to look outside to know your friends; you need to think very smart and also use your eyes to check.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmV4ehXVxQ4pUnF1m9AnmaGmG4LWFT959VMP2kovSuLDCR/IMG-20260309-WA0034.jpg 


‎In your humble beginnings, there are those people who encourage you, those people who give constructive criticism and those people who are there for you in any pains you are going through.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbxh4juyLosSCzPFuuwy1ET7Hj16x3tn9MEM6D9fPXuSg/IMG-20260309-WA0011.jpg 


‎There were times that I was not always doing very well, and I had people whom I used to trust and hold in high esteem, but to my greatest shock, those were the people that actually discouraged me. I mean, there is this feeling you have when the people you actually thought would help you or maybe encourage you are the people trying to tell you to stop what you are doing.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUYj4CgzWYkZ7iDkB7nBtqVdUHWLXMbfjnpRWenwtUaSD/IMG-20260309-WA0023.jpg 

Those kinds of people would always want to shut you up and make you feel you should not do what you are supposed to do; those people would always want themselves to be heard in any conversation you are having with them. They will actually say things that are not aligning with what you are saying; they would always want to advise and not suggest what you have to say. They will always say that you are proud if you do not listen to them or take their advice; they just want you to be quiet while they say what they have to say. In my opinion, it is better that you are not my friend because those kinds of people don't see you as a friend, but they are only there in your life to take from you and look down on you.
True friendship is one which makes you comfortable and okay; your friend should think of you even more than himself. He is not supposed to do anything that will hurt you. 
‎Your friend is supposed to be there with you in hard times; you are supposed to trust your friend because you know that he will not hurt you.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVyZASZSoENc5MFQ9QNs5pFxvKhXXdQjzGD5EvfjL7tCq/IMG-20260309-WA0041.jpg 


I organized a yearly hangout, and something got me where we were there. I invited people because I thought that they were my friends, but to my greatest surprise, they were not there, not because they were busy but because they think that they are supposed to be there. These people I gave short notice to came around, and that taught me a lot of things. It is very bad to trust humans because those people you really put your hope in can actually disappoint you. It is better to have a lot of people who are acquaintances than to have people you call friends who are not actually your friends. You may be their friends, but on the other hand, they are not your friends, so it is better you stick to people who are there for you in hard times than people who are waiting for you to fail before they can come close to you.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVxyXeTKLjabGackrUqoLorWm7TUSfZcmPv5kCY2Vp91L/IMG-20260308-WA0010.jpg 


‎A friend would always see to it that you succeed and not wait for you to succeed, and when you succeed, you should not forget those friends too, because they can actually tell your story.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaxZbHJVvrzK78PDXoRvT1wQz91Q6wTcjzSkS4Pbk8Wbr/IMG-20260309-WA0054.jpg 


‎What's Your Own Definition Of True FRIENDSHIP?

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@somuchgrace/friends-should-be-there-for-you--lfy)

title.body:
<center>![binary-2175285_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23uEwyohBDLkNsCd5dM83TipN5znr3zedRzPThoP2QYZneWFCxrRE4XMyxDMoh8PAETsV.jpg)</center>

Grint wandered down the slick city streets. Pendulous hands swinging at his side. Blood dripped from purple knuckles as he stared at the neon signs flickering in the biosphere. The distant glass of the dome concordant with his mental state, transparent. Emotions dissipated in him like an intravenous drip, nothing to hold on to, thin blood made thinner in the reflection of dark skies behind his eyes. He lifted both hands in front of his face and stared at the knuckles. Tiny hairs caked one sausage finger where his knuckle had broken skull. They bristled in his sight as the sour breeze from the processing plant wafted through gangret district. Diseased trees lined the street like penitent soldiers back from the war, desperate leaves curling in on themselves in vain hopes of water. Death permeated these streets like the ebony ash in the air. His feet ached as he turned into the stink of the alley that led to his apartment building.


<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23tkfpapvSkWhZVRX3sVrAXADzJtgUpa3XT8kbqythgWvJ3AYpnh6q6Uw5JFu8USW2SDc.jpgSomething moved in his periphery. He spun in a whirl of adrenal glanding as time unfurled like ticker-tape, slow deliberate descent into madness. He saw the Sawblade, heard its mechanical wiring as its wielder danced slow-mo in a spinning move out of a bad martial arts film. Grint pondered him in the slow build of the adrenal overdrive. He wore a black leather trench coat right down to his ankles which concertinaed out like a second skin flayed from his shoulders. Dark eyes flashed from beneath a wide-brimmed hat and needle teeth gleamed silver in the reluctant light which spilled from the distant street. A psydrone. Dull recognition played an old tune along the synapses firing in his hippocampus. It was time to speed things up.
Grint surged forward in the final vestiges of the slow time slamming a giant fist into the stranger's chest with a satisfying crack which hurled the psydrone a full 15 feet to slam into the bricks of the alley wall. Sawblade clattered to the floor as the drones voice system sputtered confused words into the sultry simmer of the city. ```\

``` Grint walked over to the droid and picked up the Sawblade and eyed its friction-less mechanism. He switched it to standby and slipped it in his pocket. Fucking good blade he thought as he turned and opened the door to his apartment lobby. ```\

```

He whirled in one lightning movement, flicked the blade to 'on' and hurled it into the psydrone's throat. The voice unit died in a low bleed of conflicting frequencies as he retrieved his new weapon.

___


<center>![police-2070771_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23tRt93ysANKMnkcTJ2c78FrkG4v9RHH4PChuR7jKzwaFe1fhjawFtjN5Mf1wjgtnSMmJ.jpg)</center>

\

The crowd of cops huddled around the holomonitor clapped and cheered as Lucy Barker looked up at the chief, smiling.
\n\n\

Chief Mahoney's mustache wriggled along his top lip as he cracked a rare smile and Lucy got up to perform a mock bow.
\n\n\

Mchoney waved his arms barking at them like he was shoeing away a rat.
\n\n\

He nodded at Lucy as lieutenant Mike Cotes sauntered over from where he had been leaning.
\n\n\
\n\nThe chief stormed up to him, mustache bristling. \

Mike leaned back as the chief bellowed in his face.
\n\n\
\n\nMike slowly shook his head, a sly grin on his face as he goaded the chief. \
>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23uRHwgD5mJ3J2bgb7yW1s7KY5DPhcePWZg7EywEGi6krqoEXkKGimkPGBmRjw5ZA2gXz.pngThe chief slammed his fist on the desk in front of Lucy. \

\n\n
The chief droned on, the usual story. One the whole precinct had heard over and over. Lucy leaned over and hissed, \

Mike doffed an invisible hat with a flourish and mouthed the words, 'you're welcome.'
\n\n\

Lucy pulled up the board as the chief stormed off. ___
![clouds-2517653_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23wqZcJLX3SFbYoGCvBCg7vsA4AChCFnQnA5MESzacRfg4i15asreDsEYGbVNgfwkbaHo.jpg)
Grint piloted the transport over forests of towers, speckled with pinpoints of luminous neon in the evening mist. Lurid tendrils of shifting vapor caressed purple fingers around the domiciles of the rich of metropolis district. Grint sighed as he plunged the vehicle into a nose dive around these concrete gravestones. Memories flared to life past his neural blocks. Blood running through his fingers as he stared at the twitching stinger erupting from his chest, moss drenched moors shooting by at break-neck speed. A carpet of soft emerald dreams as he plunged in and out of consciousness. Drops of venom dripped from the stinger to plummet down as he found the cushioning fuzz of blackness. He shook his head and pulled to the side sharply, narrowly missing a sleek red Skydriver sports model seven. He wheeled the transport vertically up the side of tower 259, lights merging into rainbow cacophony in the front window. He landed the vehicle on the tower's roof and stepped out into the purple night. ___ Crystal reflected rainbow beads of light through the champagne as senator Collins eyed this pretty little thing through the same crystal glass. Her form warped into unimaginable contortions as she danced. He imagined warping her to his own twisted whims later and he glanded another hit of StayHard, the needles sting like the sharp release of sex. ___ Grint looked at these huge double doors of antique mahogany and shrugged. He kicked the doors hard and watched them sail through the window of the room beyond. A lithe girl in pink chiffon bodice screamed as the conditioned air rushed out of the apartment and a weazly man stared at Grint slack-jawed.

Grint ignored him as he pulled up Andre in a neural feed `is this guy for a beating or more?`His own thoughts echoed disconcertingly through the emptiness behind his eyes.
`The boss said to liquidize the asset. His debts are too great and it's just not worth the effort. Let him know what is going to happen to him first though, I will be watching`.
Grint grunted and walked toward the man. His erection comically making a tent of his silken dressing gown as terror shone madness in his eyes. \
He stepped closer to the man whose erection had subsided now as a slow puddle of urine grew around his feet.\n\n\

The woman screamed past him and nearly made it, damn she was fast. He shot his hand out and grabbed her face, enveloping her skull with his massive hands before crushing it like an over-ripe pear.
The Senator gibbered as Grint closed in. ___
![warehouse-768763_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23wqXqg5ENsyqR4GQ8d5Rw4H5rkHGuKyj5X3BF25fWuCTZ9mV2LSnCQsiKQZdYFBHGUXu.jpg)
Lucy moved uncomfortably in the tight confines of the police augmentation suit. As she shifted in her crouch, she felt the smart-tech loosen and tighten around her flexing muscles, reacting to the pressures of friction. It gave her the creeps, it sort of felt like a deep tissue massage but with a modified AI in control. She peeked over the lip of the crate at the monstrous figure entering the warehouse, two black sacks of something suspiciously human shaped over each shoulder. She nodded at Mike as she com'd him through the suits internal feed.

```Remember the plan. We wait until he's in a position where there is no chance of peripheral vision. This guy can move faster than sound when needed, if he sees us, we're done for.``` Mike nodded as they crept around the side of the crate and darted to the next cover. ___ Grint prized the lid off one of the plastic barrels and dumped the girl into the hissing liquid. Her organs were no good to him, too small. She wouldn't provide enough adrenaline for one hit. It just wasn't worth the bother, this sack of shit though, he had died with just the right amount of fear and hope to provide a decent quality product.
He deposited the body on the table next to the processing conveyor and whistled a tune as he pulled out the Sawblade and flicked it to the 'on' position. The sawblade's low rhythmic thrum added a base beat to his whistling as he dived into the loose flesh around the senator's mid-section. The slight acrid smell of blood lingered in the air as he felt about in the cavity for the kidneys. Bingo, there it was, big and juicy, just above the major organ. Carefully, he worked the blade into the space between forefinger and thumb which pinched the top of the gland closed and cut it from the corpse. He gingerly placed the quivering pink mass in a cryo-flask before going to work on the other side. He extracted the second gland grinning from ear to ear. Grint knew he would get top dollar for these from the runners if he handed them down the chain, or better yet, the boss might take them for personal use and kudos was worth much more than money.
He heard a scuffle behind him and wheeled about to see... nothing. He scanned the warehouse from top to bottom, nothing moved. Must have been a mouse.
He turned back around and prized the lid off the second barrel, lifted the corpse in his arms before dumping it into the sizzling acid bath. \

He laughed and felt a sharp pain in the back of his neck. He spun as he felt something shimmy down his spine like drops of dew down a tree trunk. His knees felt weak and his head started to ache as he felt up the back of his neck to pluck the small silver dart out of his flesh. Two figures emerged from behind the conveyor at the far end of the warehouse and walked toward him, weapons pointed. ___ Lucy approached cautiously as the giant quivered strangely and her partner flanked her to the left, gun aimed at Grints head. Something seemed wrong. The big man's veins were pulsating red with livid blood rushing through his body as adrenal overdrive took hold.
\

Grint roared and rushed forward impossibly fast, slamming Lucy off her feet and up into the air. Her suit took over, guiding her limbs for maximum drag as she saw Mike slam two bolts from his pistol into the big man's chest. She landed in a painful roll. The pain subsided as the suit caught up to its computational trajectory and cushioned the various areas of impact as she bounced to a halt twenty feet away. She raised her own weapon, Grint had hold of Mike by one arm flailing him around like a rag doll trying to counteract the damage limitation of the suits mechanism. She fired at the big mans head, *fuck non-lethal force*. He dodged one bullet and the other raked a scarlet line across the side of his face taking of a portion of his cheek for good measure. The lump of sticky flesh fwapped against the wall in a sickening bloody halo.
She leaped to her feet and ran toward the man as he lifted Mike on high and grabbed one leg and one arm in each hand. Her suit engaged augment and she darted, impossibly fast, but not fast enough, as a crunch of bones echoed through the open space and Mike's jagged hip bone jutted from his pelvis like a white whale breaching a sea of blood.
She barreled into Grint as he tossed her twitching partner aside. Tears streamed from hot ducts as a fire raged in her mind. She knew she couldn't win. The big man scooped her up into a bear hug as she slammed into him, knocking him slightly off balance. He was grinning, gums and teeth shining surreal through the hole in his cheek. She head-butted him with all of her and the suit's combined strength. She felt him topple as her bones seemed to pop in her ears.
A deafening his enshrouded her as smoke blinded her eyes and she felt the pressure lessen. She kicked away into a somersault and landed in an aching heap. She lifted her head to see Grint convulsing in a growing pool of sizzling liquid. He tried to pull himself up as the second barrel spun wildly on its circumference before teetering and toppling in a cloud of crackling red smoke. **The end.**

title.title: 🌼 Noticing What I Used to Miss
title.body:
I had the professionals come out again to do routine floor maintenance. They parked their van in the middle of my garage, so I had to leave my car on the street. ![IMG_9408.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EqUc1cbx81mMp2rmHxwGpq6t9iSnqSonfKRSjHLbfmP9296R2f63bVMSpvpnteW87qx.jpeg) I noticed a California poppy growing by the sidewalk. It stopped me for a second because the color was so bright. Those orange petals really pop in the sun. It’s the state flower, so it is kind of cool to see it just growing there on its own. ![IMG_9361.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EpA3uDz6KZHb1jLMV8UFkjR2s5WMQ2p4kKxuDyKfaSysiBJQ3Crb8sMmwimKt2oGZrs.jpeg) It made the very short walk to the house nicer. I wasn’t expecting anything interesting on such a quick walk. The fiery color really brightened things up. ![IMG_9362.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EokeZp8vtbUdZ6VnTd6oADwVCyith6jQqJBktY7rjG2r1TTbgo5UCD4BYsnhLqZ6EJn.jpeg) I was still feeling that little lift in my mood as I got closer to the house. That’s when I noticed all the yellow flowers I’d been walking past without a second thought. It honestly felt like they’d been waiting for me to finally look down and notice them. ![IMG_9363.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/Eou9cGr1c51ySvnUYA6Uy1iBgwWV2kvtFkNEyLiyrwK8yDoXfpmaPHL68hfFFwtDy1v.jpeg) Look... the yellow color even matches the fire hydrant. I don’t know why, but that little detail made me smile. It’s like everything decided to coordinate just for me. ![IMG_9364.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EonmuQwRb9chGNtD7m91yrWoPEu7NoRKxsBL4KmpkkrE3ueNvRutcYYDZHr3qNWtA9v.jpeg) I caught myself staring and thinking, I wonder what flowers these are. They have this easy charm about them. Now, I'm curious! I wasn’t expecting to care, but I am completely drawn in. ![IMG_9365.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EoiVo8hqSdWd1LJMKuZeAco3UXhH7hQAJHmEngiuDf4bAbkjgvGVXTihjtJfUUfzrVJ.jpeg) ####
These flowers feel like a small surprise waiting on the sidewalk.
And it adds a nice bit of joy to the day.

title.body: after a few days journey we were returning home on a night bus from Pune. the road was bumpy so we didn't get much sleep. early this morning the bus dropped us on the Goan side of the highway near the Terekhol river that forms the border between Maharashtra and Goa. we had to cross the bridge to get a rickshaw to drive us the rest of the way home. the foggy dawn views from the bridge were subtle and delicate and soothing to my sleepy eyes which were first drawn to this small slender pram anchored just off the riverbank. it stood out nicely in the low light and the neutral still gray water\n\n
/>this minimalistic shot is my contest entry

Palestina nunca fue una nación, se trata de un territorio muchas veces ocupado por otros donde habitaban distintos pueblos y donde en distintos momentos se levantaron algunos estados a menudo hostiles entre ellos.
En épocas pasadas allí hubo reinos como los de Israel y Judea entre otros.
Pero en tiempos más modernos Palestina fue parte del territorio del Imperio Otomano y después un dominio británico.
Era una región no un país determinado y vivían allí distintos pueblos.
Pero desde finales del siglo XIX se fue expandiendo la ideología del sionismo que promovía la creación de un Estado de Israel en los territorios históricos ocupados por el pueblo judío; esta idea era debido en gran parte a que los judíos solían ser perseguidos en muchas naciones algunas de las cuales eran abiertamente antisemitas como Rusia zarista.
Los judíos compraron tierras en Palestina y se crearon asentamientos que a menudo eran atacados por árabes palestinos incitados por el mufti de Jerusalén.
Todo cambió después de una de esas matanzas de judíos conocida como la Masacre de Hebrón (1929) a partir de lo cuál los judíos también empezaron a organizar grupos paramilitares para defenderse a menudo usando los mismos métodos terroristas usados contra ellos.
En vista del empeoramiento de la situación en la ONU llegaron a la conclusión de que era necesario dividir la región y crear dos estados, el Estado de Israel y el Estado Palestino.
Israel creó su Estado y los palestinos se negaron a hacerlo y junto a una coalición de países árabes atacaron a Israel.
En esa ocasión Israel ganó y ocupó más territorios lo que se repitió varias veces.
En esa época los palestinos negaban que pudiera haber un Estado de Israel en la región, luego grupos como Hamás continúan propugnando la idea de erradicarlo, a menudo exterminando a los ciudadanos de Israel y de otras partes del mundo.
El 7 de octubre de 2023 Hamás incursionó por aire, mar y tierra en territorio Palestino ocupado por Israel, lo cual en sí mismo no está mal dado es territorio ocupado, pero en su incursión Hamás asesino a 1200 civiles desarmados muchos de los cuales no eran israelíes y secuestró alrededor de 200 personas algunas de las cuales posteriormente fueron asesinadas.
Todo eso lo hizo Hamás de acuerdo con su principio de exterminar a los israelíes y provocó una respuesta que sufrió principalmente el pueblo palestino dado Hamás gobierna en Gaza.
En tanto no exista un Estado de Israel y un Estado Palestino y ambos se respeten mutuamente nada se va a resolver allí.
Pero a lo largo de los años muchas naciones ven en eso prejuicio para sus intereses porque ambicionan ese territorio para sí mismas.
En la época de la fundación del Estado de Israel, si mal no recuerdo Gaza era ocupada por Egipto.

周末的时候来大湾鸡奥体嘉年华玩耍。上个月春节的时候从老家回来就听说了这个新开的地方，趁着人少赶紧吃一波螃蟹。

4号线黄村D口出来很方便，直接就看到园区入口了。免票无需预约，只需要过个安检就行。

院里到处都是大湾鸡。此外都是一些常见的儿童娱乐项目，旋转木马喝夹娃娃机这类的。特色项目是鳌鱼表演和大湾鸡迅游。鳌鱼因为“受伤了”在检修，没能看到。

不知道是不是春节小朋友们都玩得太开心了，这个周末都在家里重新适应开学状态，园子里没什么小朋友在玩。

等到大湾鸡出来的时候，所有的小盆友才一股脑凑上来。不得不说，这只鸡还是需要现场观看才能感受他的可爱啊！

title.title: One Crisis After Another
title.body: The petrol saga currently in my country is so frustrating. Ever since I was born, this is the first time I have seen petrol and diesel prices hike this much. And with the current fuel prices, our household budgets are already altered drastically; the situation has already pushed the cost of transport and food prices on the increase, and manufacturing is now so expensive, including me producing sachet water. Each day, the different materials we use increase by 70% of their former price. Our drivers complain bitterly that they can no longer carry the water at the factory price unless it is reduced. Meanwhile, we are spending high while the cost of water hasn't received an increase. The drama currently is real. School buses are sending mail to parents over additional fees, and office workers are crying that the transport is eating deep into their salary and it's not healthy for this present economy. ![20260310_150151_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/243M7SjfbXgfkHmK3F7JAE3DPsFshjTuneRtdeWU98Wp3t8eUNppiZvfyCdKATfKNjEfc.png) ***** I think I lack words to describe what we are going through currently. From the news I read, I discovered that what we are going through currently has to do with the Iran war, and I couldn't stop screaming at this reality. Whatever, I am still waiting for our government to act on this; the reality is so harsh and unfavorable. Imagine waking up to see that the bad situations we have been managing are getting worse each day. Can you imagine that? Soon, we might reach our elastic limit, and that would be terrible to experience. ***** Nigerians are known for their resilience in nature; we always navigate through tough times, but I am scared at these current happenings. Will this be temporary? I hope this doesn't last long because if it does, I am scared. My family too aren't finding it easy currently; we are just trusting God to see us through, but then, the situation is not helping matters. We need help in this country; it's always from one trouble to another. ![20260310_150415_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nkemakonam89/23wWrUyjidB6TsyXANFxWwXZUMJoQ2QcJz5obcAd4nNFjAU3Txq6mYA8bq17vFZocJUkG.png) ***** I stepped out this morning and found out that INEC is conducting voter card registration. Only a few people are there registering, and I wouldn't blame anyone because after all the registering and voting, will our vote count? That's the question. I am always voting, and I will still vote come 2027 for our next presidential election because all we need is teamwork to see that the right people are elected into the government. ***Images were taken from canva***

title.body:
Of course acting based on emotions can lead to disasters, almost everyone knows that. The problem is cultivating the ability to set emotions aside and act logically in every situation. 

For me, our emotions are powerful forces that can shape our lives, for good or for bad. We can make our emotions work for us by allowing logic and reason to preceed it, not the other way round. 

When we've reasoned that something is the right course of action, we should then allow ourselves to feel strongly enough to follow that course. 

Mastering our emotions and feelings is the primary aspect of self mastery.

Die Datei, welchen Pool du nehmen willst musst Du editieren, also oeffnen mit dem Editor und dann, dort die Adresse aendern fuer den Pool. Das ist fuer Solo wie fuer Pool das selbe. Das Unterscheidet sich nur nach dem Ort auf dem Du minest. 


Hier nochmal die Website wo du einen guten Ueberblick uber moegliche andere Pool Adressen hast:

https://miningpoolstats.stream/

Wenn Du da auf Monero klickst zum Bleistift, dann siehst Du in der Mitte so Namen wie Solo und Pool, oder PPS und so weiter solche Abkuerzungen. Da kannste dir dann was aussuchen, wenn nicht sicher, einfach mir schicken die Seite ich sag schon ob ok oder nicht und so weiter.

Kannst mir auch hier die Editor sachen schicken, dann markiere ich dir wo was geandert werden muss. 

Solo und Pool, ist eigentlich das Selbe fuer eine Blockchain. Die kennt nur Hash gefunden oder nicht, der ist egal, wie viele Computer unter gleicher Belohnungsadresse darauf laufen.

Stell dir des so vor, ich gebe dir meien Adresse, oder Du mir deine und dann arbeiten wir einfach beide auf diese Adresse, zack ist das Poolmining geboren. :-) Nur das Du da halt noch bisle Weniger Arbeit mit den Zugaengen bei anderen hast.

Solo minen ist halt einfach nur einer auf die selbe Adresse. Pool teilen sich viele Miner eine Adresse, weil nur die Adresse zaehlt, welche einen block gearbeitet hat also \

hat und damit die Belohnung kassiert.

Das wir uns dann selber mit dem Aufteilen beschaeftigen muessten, ist klar, deswegen nehmen wir das als Dienst von anderen in Anspruch, wenn wir das nicht selbst machen koennen oder wollen. 




Ich habe einen zu großen, vieel zu großen Karton haha und lauter gute zu kleine. Aber bau dir einfach einen. :-)

这两天在参加免费的无人机培训。
说实话，这两年这样的培训有很多，主要是为了缓解就业压力，然后让更多人学到技能，增加工作薪资的一个机会。
前两年也参加过其他的培训，总体感受下来觉得还挺不错。
当然，这种东西说白了，就是一个基础，而且培训出来也不可能给你包就业包分配什么的。
别说这种免费的培训，哪怕是市面上付费成千上万的课程，学出来也没谁敢和你说是能包就业的。
或许有合作的公司，能给人介绍进去，但是进去是一回事，能留下来还是得看个人。
所以一开始我就对这种培训不会抱有太高的期待。
这就相当于是一个基础，所谓师傅领进门，修行在个人。
最终能不能靠它吃饭，还是得不停的去钻研。
其实别说是新人去一个领域是这样，哪怕是在一个行业深耕十几二十年的人，也得不停的学习。
没办法，现在这AI时代，你不学，AI就学了，所有人都被AI追着跑。
所以我如果有时间的话，对这种免费培训还是比较热衷的，因为能多学点东西嘛。
当然了，像我朋友和我的想法就不是一样。
我那时候看到报名的时候，想着叫一下朋友一起去。
结果问他的时候，他就问这种培训有什么好处。
我就说，就是一个免费培训，然后最后考下试的话会有个技能证书。相当于以后如果你要从事这个领域，就少考一个证书。
但是我朋友就说，费劲巴拉的，又没啥好处，有啥必要。
当然了，在经过社会多年毒打后的我，秉持的一句话的就是：改变自己的是神，试图改变别人的是神经病。
所以遇到这种事情后，我觉得朋友也能参与的，那我就会分享一下，至于说他要不要去，那都是成年人，都有自己的考虑。
正如大家都知道抽烟不好，抽烟伤肺，这些东西是个人都知道。
但问题是那又如何呢，该抽烟的人不还是抽嘛。

title.title: Food Porn
title.body: After my [Flower Porn](https://peakd.com/hive-194913/@erikah/flower-porn) post, here comes the food porn post. I don't do this often and initially my plan was to do a restaurant review, but things changed when we got to the venue. Sunday we had a big family day as we had a lot to celebrate. Three birthdays, two name days (yes, we have name days in my country and not only in my country) but first of all, International Women's Day as it was the 8th of March. It's a nice way to celebrate everything together and we do this every year. Being the 8th of March, which is quite a bit event in my country, meaning people don't go crazy on gifts and celebrations, but you can expect restaurants to be fully booked in advance, which is why we made our reservation on Monday I believe. ![Food Porn.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/48WhkTXp856M3YyqCjBcSMjAdt1UrcjDXhH3zWM2YjwWTBsL5G2sGan6sSyFDLj8WP.jpg) When we arrived, the place was already packed, the terrace too, although it wasn't summer weather at all yet, and quite a few were waiting for a table to free up. Upon arrival, we were escorted to our table and a big bucket of water was placed on the table right away. Why? Because they say we brought flowers and they were ready to assure every single table has a bucket (nice, stylish one of course) or a vase as everyone was gifting flowers on Sunday. When I saw the whole place is packed, knew I'm not going to be able to do a proper photo shoot about the venue, without violating some (many) people's privacy and looking like a Fb or TikTok idiot (I'm neither by the way), so the decision was made, I take photos of the dishes and that's all and that's what I did. This is why this post is a food porn post and not a review of the venue. Maybe next time. After sitting down, we were handed the menu and before we could even decide what to have, the waiter lady brought us a glass of Proseco each, along with an appetizer, consisting in a piece of bruschetta (Italian toast) with cheese cream and a small portion of caviar, along with a piece of grape flanked by two cheese pieces. All on the house, for the special occasion. Honestly, we were not expecting anything, but were grateful for this nice gesture on their behalf. ![20260308_133700a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23u5zYtqSas8SiABH3FyfFgpKM5e7qgRaQnPygKBN5CqcWWPBKL1TwCXKgZ9THnSxEAoj.JPG) Now let's get to business and let's start with the beer. As you may know, I hate beer, so these two bottles were not for me, but as these were kind of in front of me, could not ignore the labels. So many times I admire the beer posts on Hive, not because of the beer, but because of those lovely beer cans and then I see these really disappointing labels. They say the beer was really good and I know these two brands are widely liked, so all I can think of is that these labels have a connection with history, maybe these are the old, traditional labels. Anyway, let's move on to the dishes. ![20260308_134308a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23w2oGjNRBXgYSSDDgjH9xBYfEkGxyFnc5TTgo39GDkfooMRnBpTBCHXahup3QGjCZCfD.jpg) This soup, at first glance seems to be a pumpkin soup, but in fact it was a creamy vegetable soup, with pumpkin seeds. ![20260308_134319a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/Eokd2V3fLLaMMXF8SR6dxFgLkdETWWBniaFzBSF4WTghFjcz4ciqRYyKZz4Tgi8GHpg.JPG) I'm still on diet, so I had to be smart in choosing my menu and maybe it's not visible on the photo, but this is from the kid's menu 😂 Yes, I knew I have to watch my calorie intake on one hand and that I can't eat as much as restaurants serve these days. We all know portions are oversized and a single soup can knock my calorie intake off the chart. So shamelessly (I don't care what anyone thinks) I ordered a kid's soup. It was really good though and enough for me. ![20260308_134329a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xpAuSUwrQJAD649EK9V57SwuJnkuT5cfSdLGQxBJpFb8HQidr5PP3Jqa5oJP7JgjRJB.JPG) This was a tripe soup, which is a famous one in Romania and I would have had it as well, if it wasn't for the diet. Now, I suppose I would have had my stomach full with the soup alone. ![20260308_134354a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wCGHi9cz4zaJz1Pxam663zxdn1bLdyryQk5NswcoW17VRVTCZe78effy4rqzj3YZkXh.JPG) This was a beef and vegetable soup, also very good and one of my favorites when I'm not on diet. ![20260308_140508a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wqnnFbQdFfxPB1t8YbEVMUTj1333Q8UMHkNT6SGUsLwtBzDSZjJEFsnLXXGhzaCD4aF.jpg) Pork knuckle with sauteed cabbage, a very good dish, but this exceeds my calorie intake approximately two or three times, co maybe one day I'll have half and take home half for next day. ![20260308_140515a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23w2oGk36NGf3VkshJcbEpGpki8TgnzCj4naMG5GDCNFFUA2CsMAuhQ2WgEf7BeaHzmQ6.JPG) Slightly spicy mixed meat stripes. Another dish I would like to try out, but they only have the spicy version, which is a no for me. Otherwise it would be perfect. ![20260308_140532a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23w2sLvUj7S2J9yP9MvU6puKnCxDCpNXuCXngPPTFuL1BYN4Qfa3eXyoFiXPeXHWKdCNv.jpg) Specialty of the house, grilled chicken breast, mushrooms, chicken ham, cheddar cheese, cooking cream. This would also be a good choice for me, but it was huuuuuge. Maybe (most likely, or definitely) my stomach got smaller from the diet, but I know these portions are huge. ![20260308_140557a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wqkdxmtNgJsgqaDjNZM1F94PYrmQwMW9GnY4nvDHtZj2P2v3eVngV6qoNhh4umHMoRm.JPG) Smoked pork neck slices, with some sauce. Looked really good, so it's on my list for next time. Before I go on to the dessert, I have a confession to make. Choosing my menu was not easy, but not because I could not resist temptation. Today we have the luxury to check the menu in advance and make a decision and that's exactly what I did. I had the chicken soup, which was good and plenty, even though it was just half portion. After that, I decided to go with a simple Wiener schnitzel, which is deep fried, but I only have it when eating out, which doesn't happen often. When I got the Wiener schnitzel and saw there were two bit schnitzels, knew I'm not going to be able to eat both and leave room for the dessert. So I had one with only a fresh cabbage salad. It was really good. ![20260308_144157a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23uQr4eQNWFXXscAMcNUVNnb7i54vzgpPPK6vArLgXFuYUKMd5KjaNDaUHUy3kZosJ4TE.JPG) Ice cream with chocolate dressing and a hive designed something that looked plastic 😂 Ok, joking, it was really tasty and not plastic at all. ![20260308_144206a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23uFXuyWLwSRoHxzWLAqLhTQGKYWDGGXjfG7Qpq83CUAAWNkd5UJiV888PsVUuXoMaSrX.JPG) ... aaaand, drum roll, dish I was here's the waiting for. It is called papanași, it's one of my favorites, but I'm only having it when eating out. >Papanași is a Romanian and Moldovan traditional fried or boiled pastry made from fresh-cheese (brânza proaspătă or urdă) dough. It is usually served topped with cream (smântână) and fruit confit. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Papana%C8%99i) All in all, it was a very nice day and the dishes were great. For me, it was a bit too much though as I could not eat anything all day after lunch. Now let's see, what would you like from here? 😜

title.title: Learning to Believe in Myself, The Hardest Lesson of My Student Life   Hive Learners
title.body:
There's a quote I found a while ago that has stuck with me:  
\

Friedrich Nietzsche  


![t 1](https://iili.io/qRDLjhx.png)
`This Image is Created By Canva Pro and Ai``

I didn't completely get it when I first read it. Life has a way of helping you understand things when you're ready.  

I am a student. One thing no one warns you about before entering this phase of life is how much your own mind can work against you. The assignments, the deadlines, the comparisons—all of that is one thing. But the real battle? It happens silently inside your own head, every single day.  
For a long time, I doubted myself. Not in an obvious way. From the outside, I probably looked fine. I would show up, submit my work, and participate when needed. But inside, there was always that quiet voice saying, \

And honestly? I listened to that voice for too long.  

**What I Am Learning...**  
I am learning to build self-confidence, and trust me, it's not as simple as people claim. You can't just wake up one morning and decide to be confident. It doesn’t work that way, at least not for me.  
What has actually been helping me is something much smaller. I started noticing the tiny wins. The assignment I submitted on time, the question I answered in class even when my heart raced, the day I decided to keep going even when everything felt heavy. I used to ignore these small things completely. Now I am learning to count them, reminding myself that they matter.  
I am also realizing that comparing myself to others is one of the most unproductive things I’ve done with my time and energy. Everyone around me is running their own race and facing their own silent battles. The person I compared myself to yesterday is probably struggling with something unseen.  
The moment I shifted my focus to my own path—slowly, gradually—something changed inside me. I can't fully explain it, but I feel a bit lighter. A bit more sure of myself.  

**What I Am Unlearning...**  
I am unlearning the habit of shrinking myself.  
There have been many times when I had something valuable to say but stayed quiet. So many opportunities I passed up because I thought someone else would do it better. So many times I apologized for simply being in a space where I had every right to be.  
Unlearning this is painful. These patterns have been with me for years. They feel like second nature now. But just because something feels familiar doesn't mean it helps you.  
I am unlearning the belief that confidence means having no fear. I have realized that real confidence is doing something even when fear is present. Showing up even when you feel small. Speaking even when your voice shakes a little.  

**The Journey Ahead...**  
I won’t pretend that I have it all figured out. I am still very much in the middle of this process. Some days are better than others. Some days that old voice returns, and I have to consciously remind myself of all the work I've been doing.  
But the difference now is that I am aware. I believe awareness is where real change begins.  
To anyone else out there quietly fighting the same battle—I see you. You are not alone in this. And you are far more capable than that voice in your head suggests.  
Keep going. Slowly. Steadily. At your own pace.

title.title: 📷 Epic Sunset at Dean Village [EN/DE]
title.body:
![_DSC7815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelshots/23uaHF46nKkYNvPjdGiJx8Gm66t6n49k4D5aQ1ic47sxwBPmekpRDzyBXQCi5a2nbKbWA.jpg)

Sunsets are among the subjects I have photographed very rarely in recent years. That wasn't always the case. Six to eight years ago, the golden hour was my favorite time to take photos. I even wrote a book about photography during the golden and blue hour. If you are familiar with my photos, you know that I now prefer the gloomy atmosphere of rain or fog. But when I was walking across Dean Bridge in Edinburgh and saw this beautiful sunset, I wanted to capture the moment, of course. It's incredible how quickly the weather changes in Scotland. Did you see my fog photos from yesterday's post? These sunset shots were taken just a few hours later.

*Sonnenuntergänge zählen zu den Motiven, die ich in den letzten Jahren sehr selten fotografiert habe. Das war nicht immer so. Noch vor sechs bis acht Jahren war die goldene Stunde meine liebste Zeit zum fotografieren. Ich schrieb sogar ein Buch über das Fotografieren in der goldenen und blauen Stunde. Wenn ihr meine Fotos kennt, wisst ihr, dass ich inzwischen die düstere Stimmung bei Regen oder Nebel bevorzuge. Doch als ich in Edinburgh über die Dean Bridge spazierte und diesen wunderschönen Sonnenuntergang sah, wollte ich diesen Moment natürlich auch festhalten. Wie schnell sich das Wetter in Schottland ändert, ist wirklich unglaublich. Habt ihr meine Nebel-Fotos vom gestrigen Beitrag gesehen? Diese Sunset Shots entstanden nur wenige Stunden später.*

![_DSC7813.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelshots/246G79DiHaajnTwejBQxPsiJimAD5twYYuCwyLSjQS6TDCQmq6JEukejbvXy8VnuZoDjJ.jpg)

See you soon!/*Bis bald!*
Stefan

title.title: Sejarah dan Evolusi Konflik USA-Iran
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYBandUHaw9JajzJDJXBTEENeqtaES4GtRJ97QtLcBpNG/1773156704643.webp)

​Untuk memahami impak hari ini, kita perlu melihat akar umbi persengketaan yang telah berlarutan selama lebih empat dekad.

​1. Titik Tolak: Revolusi Islam 1979
​Sebelum tahun 1979, Iran adalah sekutu rapat Amerika Syarikat di bawah pemerintahan Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi. Namun, Revolusi Islam 1979 mengubah segalanya. Kejatuhan Shah dan krisis tebusan di Kedutaan AS di Tehran menamatkan hubungan diplomatik kedua-dua negara. Sejak itu, AS menganggap Iran sebagai ancaman kepada kestabilan Timur Tengah, manakala Iran melihat AS sebagai \

yang mencampuri urusan wilayah mereka.

​2. Dekad Ketegangan dan Perjanjian Nuklear (2015)
​Hubungan ini semakin parah apabila Iran memulakan program nuklearnya. Pada tahun 2015, di bawah pentadbiran Barack Obama, perjanjian JCPOA (Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action) ditandatangani untuk menyekat keupayaan nuklear Iran sebagai pertukaran kepada penarikan sekatan ekonomi. Malaysia pada waktu itu mula melihat peluang perdagangan yang lebih luas dengan Iran.

​3. Penarikan Diri AS dan Dasar \

(2018)
​Namun, pada 2018, Donald Trump menarik AS keluar daripada perjanjian tersebut dan mengenakan sekatan ekonomi yang sangat ketat. Ini membawa kepada kronologi peristiwa yang membawa kita ke ambang perang:

​Januari 2020: Pembunuhan Jeneral Iran, Qasem Soleimani, oleh serangan dron AS di Baghdad. Ini adalah kemuncak ketegangan yang hampir mencetuskan perang terbuka.

​Krisis Kapal Tangki: Serangan ke atas kapal-kapal tangki di Selat Hormuz yang sering dituduh dilakukan oleh proksi Iran, menyebabkan harga insurans perkapalan dunia melonjak.

​Analisis Kronologi Impak Terhadap Rakyat Malaysia

​1. Kesan Segera: Panik Pasaran dan Harga Bahan Api
​Apabila berlaku serangan atau ancaman perang (seperti selepas kematian Soleimani), pasaran saham Bursa Malaysia biasanya akan jatuh (merah) dalam tempoh 24 jam pertama.

​Kronologi Impak: 
Berita perang keluar -> Harga minyak mentah dunia naik -> Kerajaan Malaysia terpaksa menanggung beban subsidi petrol yang lebih tinggi -> Dana yang sepatutnya digunakan untuk pembangunan (sekolah/hospital) terpaksa dialihkan untuk menampung subsidi.

​2. Impak Jangka Sederhana: Sekatan Perdagangan
​Malaysia mempunyai hubungan perdagangan dengan kedua-dua pihak.

​Eksport Minyak Sawit: Iran adalah pembeli besar minyak sawit Malaysia. Sekatan ekonomi (sanctions) oleh AS menyukarkan proses pembayaran transaksi perbankan antarabangsa. Rakyat yang bekerja dalam sektor perladangan akan merasai kesannya apabila permintaan dari Iran merosot atau terhenti.

​Industri Halal: Malaysia yang sedang memacu industri Halal global kehilangan pasaran besar di Iran akibat ketidakstabilan ini.

​3. Impak Jangka Panjang: Geo-Politik dan Keselamatan Tenaga
​Jika perang besar berlaku, Selat Hormuz mungkin ditutup.

​Rantaian Bekalan: Malaysia mengimport bahan kimia dan produk petroleum tertentu. title.title: First time in the lodge
title.body:
And when it comes to concerts, apparently the last one...
**Because the party is on the ground floor 🙂**


This weekend, on March 8, I had the opportunity to provide tickets for Marija Šerifović's concert as a gift for the holiday to the women in my life.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVkz9u7WkacFWU6As1jGyxgprx785WhFhMzmgmTgY9Jpz/1773155748451.jpg)

I don't know who of you had the opportunity to hear about this extraordinary singer (silly but she sings well), but she is also known outside the region, because she was the winner of the Eurovision Song Contest in 2007 (and who had the opportunity to listen to her live, I believe she enjoyed it).

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR31xKDDi6bdFdf9wru8FCg8WqNhYYebcyWu2fVXPcgsK/1773156600501.jpg)


An additional surprise was that these were tickets for the lodge.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZbnGWMhJoQ2BK2tdbzBJQADxyA676P5q4cMnUZkuEDXx/1773155788985.jpg)

A total of six of us, a welcome drink awaited us in the box, chilled Prosseco, with which we toasted while enjoying the spectacle on stage.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdtKDFj1UD39aa4C9gCM23Y38uCssS27BFo9wNzZcBUCu/1773156003390.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSWC7RnbF6Kt8rFwHrQKLwoByP3jnqG3xQmKoLE1eZ6CS/1773155981524.jpg)

There was enough space in the lodge for dancing, however, the experience was not like when we were at Maria's concert a few years ago, a few rows away from the stage.

But the stage is crowded, so if you want to sit and enjoy the music, it's almost impossible, because when someone gets up from the seat in front of you, you also have to get up to see the stage...


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfU98U5DDj75EJN2rjZqEAE1nB4hejrog2Uwq3a9BgqLF/1773156670474.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNiWaDaHvt3Z6s77bscgWjPQpn25AQ8dJbx3TK9ajCNrH/1773156670700.jpg)



That's why for concerts where there is dancing, I like to choose an event that has a standing floor, not comfortable armchairs.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmejhQrcQzsGG6NVuZgLaTxas9ovSFWzWBjg2o82jsQjSm/1773156115544.jpg)

This time, we enjoyed from the lodge, with a glass of chilled Prosecco wine, and the spectacle of song, music, lighting and other accompanying elements (artificial smoke, fire, sprinklers and confetti).

A great experience, which I share with you in this #weekend-experiences community, and I also share a video for #saturdayselections.

<center>[![](https://ipfs-3speak.b-cdn.net/ipfs/bafkreic3bnsxobtm2va6j3i6v44gc2p2wazi4iuiqqci23tdt7eba5ad5e)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=duskobgd/zsuganplvh)</center>

Songs, according to my choice, something for foreigners, who know the songs that Marija performed, two songs known in the region, and finally two of her songs, with which she closed the concert.
I hope that the recording can evoke at least a fraction of the atmosphere and that you will enjoy Marija's performance, as it did for me.
**Cheers!**

title.title: Слов'янськ у вогні: черговий авіаудар росіян забрав життя чотирьох людей, серед поранених – діти
title.body: >Сьогодні вранці я прокинувся від повідомлення друга з Донеччини. Просто коротке: «Слов'янськ знову». І все. Без деталей, бо й так зрозуміло. Знову ракети, знову бомби, знову люди під завалами. А потім почалися цифри – чотири загиблих, спочатку сімнадцять поранених, потім двадцять. І серед них двоє дітей – 2011 та 2016 років народження. Маленькі цифри в новинах, а за ними – чиїсь сини, доньки, мами, тати, які просто пішли вранці по хліб чи вигуляти собаку.

>Росіяни скинули три авіабомби прямо на центр міста. Не на якісь військові об'єкти – на звичайні житлові квартали, де люди живуть своїм життям, наскільки це можливо під постійною загрозою. Багатоповерхівки, приватні будинки, адміністративна будівля, двадцять автівок – все це перетворилося на купу бетону, цегли та скла за лічені секунди.

>Я бачив фото, і в горлі стоїть клубок. Ось п'ятиповерхівка, стіна якої просто зникла, ніби хтось величезним ножем відрізав шматок будинку. Вікна вибиті, балкони висять на соплях арматури, а на землі – уламки меблів, дитячі іграшки, шматки одягу. Люди в цивільному бігають, хтось кричить, хтось просто стоїть, дивлячись у нікуди.

\n\n
>Рятувальники розбирають завали, поліція фіксує, медики намагаються врятувати тих, хто ще дихає. Голова ОВА Вадим Філашкін пише в Телеграмі, що наслідки ще встановлюють. Але вже ясно – це не просто \

. Це теракт проти цивільних. Чотири життя забрані, двадцять покалічених. Двоє дітей серед поранених – хлопчик 9 років і дівчинка 10 років. Якби не війна, вони б зараз готувалися до школи, гралися у дворі. А тепер – лікарня, біль, страх, який залишиться назавжди.

>Я не можу перестати думати про тих, хто вижив під завалами. Уявляєш, як це – чути вибухи, відчувати, як будинок тремтить, а потім темрява, пил, тиша. І чекаєш, чи прийдуть по тебе. Чи ні. Багато хто чекав довго. Хтось не дочекався.

>Слов'янськ вже давно не в тилу. Місто постійно під ударами – то артилерія, то дрони, то КАБи. Але кожен новий удар – як перший. Бо щоразу гинуть люди, які просто хотіли жити. Не герої, не військові – звичайні українці. Бабуся, яка йшла на ринок. Чоловік, який ремонтував машину біля під'їзду. Діти, які бігали по вулиці.

\n\n

>Чому я це пишу? Бо звикати до таких новин – не можна. Кожна смерть – це не статистика. Це чиясь донька, чиясь мама, чиясь дитина. І коли ми просто скролимо далі – ми потроху вбиваємо пам'ять про них. А пам'ятати треба. Щоб світ не забув. Щоб після війни хтось відповів за кожну зруйновану квартиру, за кожну втрачену дитину.

>Поліція Донеччини вже підтвердила: 20 поранених, двоє дітей. Філашкін додає деталі про пошкодження. Але за цими рядками – крики, сльози, запах диму. Я не там, але відчуваю цей запах через екран. І мені соромно, що я в безпеці, а вони – ні.

>Ми маємо говорити про це голосно. Ділитися фото, відео, іменами, коли вони з'являться. Бо якщо мовчати – то завтра буде ще один Слов'янськ, ще один Краматорськ, ще одна Маріуполь. І хтось знову скаже \
>Але це про нас усіх. Про кожного, хто дихає вільним повітрям сьогодні. Бо завтра це може бути наш двір, наш будинок, наша дитина.
>Тримаймося, Слов'янськ. Ми з вами. І ми не забудемо.
