🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️

🏛️Greetings, friends of Worldmaping.

It will always be a pleasure to return to this community to talk or tell you about what I enjoyed during my visit to the municipal museum.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUhfi7tyUJgFmYoGKHMctkzWBiPeFfkwQyPkTmsqVoLHY/1773105642576.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVQqv4pjT6XfgXYGJ7dYV8pGrkFYrGdL3EPhCnrzEMkdS/1773105847265.jpg)

🏛️Today I will describe what could be called the Decorative Arts room of this institution. I already mentioned in the previous post that the museography that was established for the reopening of the museum, after a thorough restoration, confirmed three exhibition rooms.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPd9UUjTn5ToiP23YoYXVgKw8Hs773gDYfLHZrPzB7sGH/1773105746709.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTLS186sUhgmdTtdkH19pgk1yUsysSiEnP6uRFLbpDiuH/1773105978188.jpg)

🏛️One dedicated to the topic of tobacco, one to local history and the other, which is in the center, to the decorative arts. At least, I'm going to define it with that name to tell you about that room with its modest collection.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZPAZPoLprC8xZBatQjJBpb3ARdc3NLQPokC23fzwMHMV/1773106200484.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXgXHwMYFB7FPdxt8X5df5nm2zvrorUJU37mFYT3LNi7N/1773106765492.jpg)


🏛️Almost the entire collection in this part of the Julio César Valdés museum was obtained as part of the policy of confiscation of assets of people who permanently emigrated abroad back in the eighties of the last century. And it could have been larger and more interesting if some predators had not been ahead of the heritage authorities.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPjx9aKK86LVFeWGMZ32udKykzd8We7b2WvdWq7YTSQHA/1773108096385.jpg)

🏛️In this place there are very well preserved assets belonging to the \

family, one of the best positioned in the municipality, dedicated mainly to the raising of cattle and the cultivation of tobacco.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQPz7BTHbVri8fmYaTER5spX2NRCHK7xDbpbMEgFSjKHL/1773107365262.jpg)


🏛️The most outstanding thing that we can see there is the large and very strong dining table typical of the homes of the petite bourgeoisie.

🏛️This piece of furniture made of Ebony shows the die-cut edge and is designed for eight diners, one for each head and three for each side. Keep your eight chairs with the tanned leather backrests in good condition.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxPtUYDfii516ra3EPWPmvn1DHw4mrgjpjw7w8E8Ceny/1773107441857.jpg)

🏛️The complete set of tableware is also part of this furniture, which is displayed as it was used in its time.


🏛️Accompanying this beautiful piece for domestic service is a sideboard also decorated with bas-reliefs, where all the utensils used in that activity were kept.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTuL3Rk7k9x949zY5UeiSVEM3V17Hs2v6iMgmNTug8x8L/1773107526579.jpg)

🏛️Nearby is the desk-wardrobe with the finely crafted and elegant doors. bas-reliefs that reproduce elements of nature, such as cups from which abundant fruits hang, allegories of wealth.

🏛️Entering this small room creates the sensation of a trip to history that describes the way of life of a family that contrasts with that of another social level, but at the same time it is a world full of protocols that are revealed through each element and each detail. A comfortable, orderly, but rigid life, with little space for the spontaneous and free.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYBPBxEyLiuMoTLdiAHbq4FdjwCgXtWGqzwW1xxv96Nn/1773107654253.jpg)

🏛️There that life and purchasing power are also reproduced through other typical objects of the time, such as a knob-style living room set, mirrors, dressers, chandeliers, ceiling lamps, etc.

🏛️The expression of power through privileged access to the world of art hangs on one of the walls with a scene where a group of intellectuals chat. the era of chivalric novels (affected by poor restoration). One of the characters is supposed to be the same as Cervantes, and if that were true, it would be before the battle of Lepanto, where the Spanish genius lost a hand.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQCGfAphGzPA5wyBDubDdCswm6n5SCFrNyftDbWXYricJ/1773107914420.jpg)

🏛️Other decorative elements fill the exhibition space, such as a sculpture that is supposed to be that of Bacchus, the god of wine; Others say she is Aphrodite, the goddess of fertility. Of course, this is a smaller scale copy than the life-size one, although in his right hand, raised above his head, he holds a horn (surely the one of plenty) that is topped with a bomb that turns it into a night lamp.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQzodhyKXV8dAXNn2PqPDViyf8cnDsEjXodyFaW7vBet4/1773107763005.jpg)

🏛️It is also part of the \

space of some relevant figures of San Luis society from the last century, as well as an oil portrait, also of my authorship, of the person of the which now takes the name Municipal Museum, and a display case where objects and documents of that important figure in local history are preserved.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRH17icEeYfB2Aj5hNpjj8vUQV9XvtbDxNi5Y1kSJu2cm/1773108219127.jpg)

🏛️Once again I entered this institution to consciously enjoy the pieces that are exhibited there and the history that they reveal to us when we come into contact with them.

🏛️Today I have felt very good with this other visit, of quality and peaceful.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVt29z97mE4jZPMyiA1zA7NgRvqYhkigLvd7vvB5JGYht/1773108636860.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPmvfjymhJxnjaq5uQatfi2V1bMyEGcakLwhVKsDHv6va/1773108708038.jpg)

🏛️Thank you for accompanying me once again and I can tell you that in the next one I will go to the other room of the local history of my municipality, San Luis, Pinar del Río, Cuba.

🏛️Bye and see you!
🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️

VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL 
🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️🖍️
Saludos, amigos de Worldmaping.



>Siempre va a ser un placer regresar a esta comunidad para conversar o contarles sobre lo que disfruté en mi visita al museo municipal.

>Hoy les describiré lo que podría llamarse la sala de Artes Decorativas de esta institución. Ya les mencioné en el post anterior que la museografía que se estableció para la reapertura del museo, después de una profunda restauración, confirmó tres salas expositoras.

>Una dedicada al tema del tabaco, una a la historia local y la otra, que está en el centro, a las artes decorativas. Por lo menos, con ese nombre la voy a definir para hablarles de esa sala con su modesta colección.

>Casi toda la colección de esta parte del museo Julio César Valdés se obtuvo como parte de la política de confiscación de bienes de las personas que emigraban de forma permanente hacia el exterior allá por los años ochenta del pasado siglo. Y pudo ser más amplia e interesante si algunos depredadores no se hubiesen adelantado a las autoridades de patrimonio.

>En este lugar se encuentran muy bien conservados bienes pertenecientes a la familia de \

, una de las mejor posicionadas del municipio, dedicada principalmente a la cría de ganado vacuno y al cultivo del tabaco.

>Lo más sobresaliente que allí podemos observar es la amplia y fortísima mesa de comedor típica de los hogares de la pequeña burguesía.

>Este mueble hecho de ébano muestra el borde troquelado y está diseñado para ocho comensales, uno por cada cabecera y tres por cada lateral. Conserve sus ocho sillas con los espaldares de cuero curtido en buen estado de conservación.

>También forma parte de este mueble el juego completo de vajillas, que se expone tal como lo utilizaban en su época.

>Acompañan a esta bella pieza para el servicio doméstico un aparador también decebano también decorado con bajorrelieves, donde se guardaban todos los utensilios que se usaban en esa actividad

>Cerca de allí se encuentra el armario-escritorio con las puertecitas finamente elaboradas y elegantes bajorelieves que reproducen elementos de la naturaleza, como copas de las que cuelgan abundantes frutos, alegorías de la riqueza.

>Entrar a esta pequeña sala me crea la sensación de un viaje a la historia que describe el modo de vida de una familia que contrasta con la de otro nivel social, pero a la vez es un mundo lleno de protocolos que se delatan a través de cada elemento y cada detalle. Una vida cómoda, ordenada, pero rígida, con poco espacio para lo espontáneo y libre.

>Allí también se reproduce esa vida y el poder adquisitivo a través de otros objetos típicos de la época, como un juego de sala estilo perilla, espejos, coquetas, candelabros, lámparas de techo, etc.

>La expresión del poder a través del acceso privilegiado al mundo del arte cuelga en una de las paredes con una escena donde charlan un grupo de intelectuales de la época de las novelas de caballería (afectada por una deficiente restauración). Se supone que uno de los personajes es igual a Cervantes, y si eso fuera cierto, sería antes de la batalla de Lepanto, donde el genio español perdió una mano.

>Otros elementos decorativos rellenan el espacio expositivo, como una escultura que se supone que es la de Baco, el dios del vino; otros dicen que es Afrodita, la diosa de la fertilidad. Claro que esta es una copia a menor escala que la de tamaño real, aunque en su mano derecha, alzada por encima de la cabeza, sostiene un cuerno (seguro que el de la abundancia) que está rematado en su parte superior con una bomba que la convierte en una lámpara de noche.

>También forma parte del espacio \

de algunos personajes relevantes de la sociedad sanluiseña del siglo pasado, así como un retrato también al óleo, de mi autoría, de la persona de la cual toma ahora el nombre Museo Municipal, y una vitrina donde se conservan objetos y documentos de esa importante figura de la historia local.

>Otra vez entré a esta institución para disfrutar conscientemente de las piezas que allí se exhiben y de la historia que nos develan cuando entramos en contacto con ellas.

>Hoy me he sentido muy bien con esta otra visita, de calidad y apacible.

>Gracias por acompañarme una vez más y les adelanto que en el próximo iré a la otra sala de la historia local de mi municipio, San Luis, Pinar del Río, Cuba.

>¡Chao y nos vemos!

title.title: learning and unlearning plays essential role in our life.
title.body:
Good day, amazing people of the Hive Blockchain. Welcome back to my blog. It is another edition in the #hivelearners community. I am so delighted to participate in this week's prompt topic, LEARNING/UNLEARNING.

![fotografierende-write-4491416_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/23x1KmkeHYyG4XJ8z7Gjy29KUpSeDdr4oz9QvSDAdLQrsLnt1QLSTxh5vg4ms6SfYrGP1.jpg)

[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/write-notebook-pen-hand-paper-4491416/)

I strongly believe that learning never ends. Life is full of stages, and at every stage we either learn or unlearn. I am this kind of person that is so open-minded when it comes to learning. I strongly believe that wherever I see myself, there is something to learn. I always tell people that learning and unlearning is the crucial part of growth; it is a sign of maturity, which is that the person is really willing to learn from their mistakes and also learn from others. Most of the time when we talk about learning, we think it is only in institutions that we can learn. Learning can happen anywhere; there is some certain knowledge I acquired today. To be sincere, it was not acquired in the classroom but in transit. That is why I said learning can happen anywhere, and we should open our minds to learn. Learning is very easy, but it only takes a patient heart to learn.

Learning and unlearning is the process of life; I don't think there will be a life without learning and unlearning. Learning is very important, and without it, there will be no growth. Learning and unlearning both play a vital role in our personal growth. Also, improving our lives with learning, we will be able to make a decision.

what I am currently learning in my life.

Like I say, learning never ends. Lastly, I have been in the learning phase recently. It has not been easy for me, but I have to take this bold step. I started an internship in a media house. I will not lie; it has not really been easy for me. Most times I feel like stopping the internship because of the pressure I am facing currently. Recently my head of department always complains. She always makes me feel less of myself. I always pray for every day to be a weekend because that's the only time I have peace of mind. I keep asking myself this simple question: who even sent me to start in the first place? But on a second thought, I am so grateful that I am able to take this step. To be sincere, I am so happy with the woman I have turned into. I can gladly say I am a better version of myself. During this new phase of my life, I learnt that not everyone that you meet will love you. For me, I can gladly say I learnt under a head who didn't love me. Believe me, it was not easy, but I am happy I was able to overcome.


![johnhain-beyond-612464_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cindynancy/23xytHK8Tt8h5yEBjwg5qdmUZjWyrNkTmcUsafEYedWwt92iYfSTjSBmQY9zWoEMbejRr.jpg)

[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/beyond-belief-yield-untie-loosen-612464/)
Coming to something I have to unlearn is procrastination. This keeps affecting me on a daily basis. Currently I am trying every possible way to unlearn procrastination. Indeed, procrastination is a disease I have to fight. I need to let go of this bad habit of mine and make room for a better me.

Finding myself in the media space is the best decision I have ever taken; it has really helped to reshape my life. I can boldly talk in public without being shy. The media space has given me the opportunity to meet people; I am a better version of myself.

This is my entry on the ongoing content #hiverlearners topic learning/unlearning.

Thank you for stopping by on my blog. I appreciate your comments, support and upvotes. Do have a lovely day.

title.title: The Hard Work of Changing My Mind
title.body:
At times, when we reach the age of accountability, we begin to take some responsibility by deciding to grow up in a way that we try to unlearn some of the things that we were once very sure about. That time, when I saw the way some people work without proper rest, they worked like there is no tomorrow. To me, I had been programmed in my mind that that is the only way to make it in life, and it is a sign of being serious. And I am sure that a lot of people also used to believe this back then. If you are not constantly doing something, what comes to the mind of some people is that you are lazy, and they will be advising you to stop wasting away time. I have seen this happen to someone I know; she even told me that the eyes gaze from people she is close to carried a lot of judgment without opening their mouth to talk to her. I have kept working on myself by doing some online work during the daytime, learning some new architectural software to aid my designs, and at night I do some hustles. I am not overloading myself; it just feels like I had to justify my existence with effort. At the moment, what I am currently learning but still looks like a big deal to me because it sometimes looks uncomfortable is rest. I am not talking about that usual rest the lazy people talk about. I am referring to the proper rest. The type of rest where I will not have to be thinking about what is the next thing to do, not feeling guilt. The type of rest where my mind is at peace without wondering about. https://img.leopedia.io/DQma54Lz4HXME3n4yLZqWgEof83BJ9NWtYb3raEyBEPv4ve/168675.png Some things look very simple, like resting. But the truth is that the pressure that comes with it is sometimes very hard. Because most times, I do see myself and hear that I can do more instead of resting comfortably. Sometimes slowing down feels wrong, but it is not. But lately I have realized a lot of things that are very crucial after a series of stories and even a close experience that I saw. I got to realize that working and working without proper rest can later result in some illness that would break down the body, but we might not notice on time. And I have gotten to realize that a stressed mind does not always think straight as expected. When someone is tired, they might not make a rational decision. And even in church, after hearing a series of messages on how God has instructed us to always be patience and have faith, a lot of us still rush and keep things running even in our heads. So after what I saw last on how stress can kill someone over time, I have started teaching myself a different pattern. Yes, it is good to work hard, but now i take breaks too as long as I want with no pressure. I cool myself down when necessary with something light. Sometimes I take a stroll around my street or even in my compound which gives me breath again. Though it is still a journey in progress because I still work without rest sometimes. But I am learning and trying to keep the balance which has been giving me little little peace in my mind so far. --- Thank you for reading. >

title.title: Chotis Mix
title.body:
by Siberiann on Paul Lindstrom 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/paulindstrom [![Chotis Mix](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/9e85933f-899c-467e-9592-e6f25a95b1e3.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/g7RxQQcuJfsoa681Paf38Z) 
 
 Dicen que el Chotis nació de la contradicción, esa extraña mezcla donde lo foráneo se vuelve tan propio que nadie recuerda su origen lejano. Llegó a Madrid en el siglo XIX, traído por soldados y viajeros que habían bailado algo similar en los salones de Escocia o Alemania, bajo nombres como schottisch o rheinländer. Al principio era un baile de salón, elegante y contenido, pero las calles de la capital tienen una gravedad particular que transforma todo lo que toca. Los madrileños, con ese carácter castizo que no pide permiso, le quitaron la rigidez europea y le injectaron un aire de verbena, de chulapería y de barrio.

La evolución no fue escrita en partituras académicas, sino en el roce de los zapatos contra el empedrado y en el compás marcado por los organilleros. La música se adaptó al paso del bailarín: ese movimiento característico de girar alrededor de la pareja mientras se avanza y retrocede con pasos cortos y decididos. El tempo se asentó en un dos por cuatro muy marcado, casi marcial pero con una cadencia festiva que invita al brindis más que a la reflexión. Con el tiempo, instrumentos como el clarinete, la trompeta y el bombardino tomaron el relevo de las cuerdas originales, dando ese sonido brillante y potente que hoy define a las charangas en las fiestas de San Isidro.

Lo curioso de esta historia es cómo sobrevivió a las modas pasajeras. Mientras otros bailes desaparecían olvidados en los archivos, el Chotis se ancló en la identidad de la ciudad, convirtiéndose en el himno no oficial de lo madrileño. Dejó de ser una importación para convertirse en un símbolo de resistencia cultural, esa capacidad de absorber lo externo y devolverlo con un sello inconfundible. Hoy, cuando suenan las primeras notas en cualquier verbenas, la gente no piensa en sus raíces germánicas ni escocesas; solo sienten el impulso de agarrarse de la mano, mirar a los ojos a la pareja y dar esa vuelta eterna que parece detener el tiempo, manteniendo viva una tradición que respira al ritmo de la propia ciudad.

La huella del Chotis trascendió el asfalto de las plazas para impregnar la cultura popular de formas que a menudo pasan desapercibidas pero que sostienen la memoria colectiva. En la literatura, los escritores de la generación del 98 y posteriores no pudieron evitar capturar ese giro característico como metáfora del propio Madrid: un movimiento que avanza sin salir del sitio, reflejando esa paradoja vital de una ciudad que cambia constantemente mientras permanece fiel a su esencia. Personajes de novelas costumbristas aparecen envueltos en la atmósfera densa de los salones o las verbenas, donde el baile sirve de telón de fondo para dramas amorosos y encuentros fortuitos, convirtiendo la coreografía en un lenguaje silencioso de cortejo y desafío social.

El cine, por su parte, adoptó el ritmo como un atajo emocional inmediato; bastaba con que sonaran los primeros compases en una banda sonora para situar al espectador en el corazón castizo, evocando instantáneamente imágenes de mantones, chulapos y calles empedradas bajo la luz de farolillos. Directores de todas las épocas han utilizado la escena del Chotis no solo como decoración folclórica, sino como un punto de inflexión narrativo donde los personajes revelan sus verdaderas intenciones al compás de la música, aprovechando la cercanía física obligada por el baile para generar tensión o intimidad. Incluso la moda se dejó arrastrar por esta corriente, cristalizando una estética que, aunque nacida en el siglo XIX, se congeló en el imaginario visual como el uniforme no escrito de la fiesta madrileña, donde el traje de corto y el vestido de volantes se convirtieron en iconos perdurables que resisten a las tendencias efímeras de la pasarela moderna.

En el ámbito musical, la influencia es más sutil pero igualmente profunda, actuando como un ADN rítmico que ha permeado otros géneros. La estructura binaria y el énfasis en el segundo tiempo del Chotis se filtraron en ciertas variedades del cuplé y la zarzuela, aportando ese aire pícaro y urbano que define a muchas tonadas tradicionales. Músicos contemporáneos, desde grupos de rock hasta artistas de fusión, han sampleado o reinterpretado sus melodías, demostrando que la progresión de acordes y la cadencia del baile poseen una versatilidad sorprendente capaz de dialogar con sonidos eléctricos y experimentales. Así, el Chotis deja de ser una reliquia estática para convertirse en un organismo vivo que sigue alimentando la creatividad artística, recordando que toda expresión cultural, por muy local que parezca, tiene la capacidad de expandirse y resonar en disciplinas aparentemente distantes.

La sonoridad del Chotis no se entiende sin esa formación instrumental que ha evolucionado desde los pequeños conjuntos de cámara hasta las potentes charangas que hoy dominan las verbenas. En sus orígenes, cuando el baile transitaba entre los salones burgueses y los primeros organilleros callejeros, predominaban instrumentos de viento madera como el clarinete, capaz de dibujar esas melodías rápidas y ornamentadas que exigen una digitación ágil y precisa. A su lado, la flauta travesera aportaba un brillo agudo que cortaba el aire, mientras que el violín, heredero directo de las versiones centroeuropeas, mantenía la línea melódica principal con un arco ligero pero firme, marcando ese ritmo binario tan característico que obliga al pie a responder con inmediato reflejo.

Sin embargo, fue la incorporación de los metales lo que realmente definió el carácter festivo y voluminoso que asociamos hoy con esta música. La trompeta tomó un papel protagonista, llenando los espacios abiertos con un sonido brillante y triunfal que proyecta la melodía a grandes distancias, esencial para que el baile funcione en plazas abarrotadas. El bombardino y el saxofón se encargaron de aportar cuerpo y calidez al conjunto, creando ese colchón armónico denso sobre el que giran las parejas, mientras que la tuba o el sousafón asumieron la responsabilidad ineludible de los graves, marcando el pulso rítmico con una contundencia que se siente más en el pecho que en los oídos.

La percusión, aunque a veces discreta en la mezcla, es el motor invisible que sostiene toda la estructura; el bombo marca los tiempos fuertes con una regularidad marcial, mientras que la caja redoblante añade ese repique constante y nervioso que da urgencia al movimiento. En ocasiones, el acordeón o la concertina aparecen como elementos puente, recordando aquellos tiempos de organillo portátil donde un solo músico debía bastarse para llenar el espectro sonoro completo. Esta combinación de vientos, metales y percusión crea una textura densa y vibrante, diseñada no para la escucha contemplativa, sino para ser sentida físicamente, permitiendo que la música envuelva al bailarín y dicte cada paso, giro y retroceso con una autoridad rítmica que pocos géneros logran igualar.

El Chotis se ha erigido como un pilar fundamental en la arquitectura cultural de Madrid, trascendiendo su función inicial de entretenimiento para convertirse en un símbolo de identidad y pertenencia. No es simplemente un baile que se ejecuta en fechas señaladas, sino un ritual colectivo que actúa como cemento social, uniendo a generaciones dispares bajo un mismo compás. Cuando suenan las primeras notas, se activa un código compartido que no requiere explicación; desde el niño que da sus primeros pasos torpes hasta el anciano que marca el ritmo con la memoria muscular de décadas, todos participan en una ceremonia que reafirma lo que significa ser de allí. Esta capacidad de aglutinar a la comunidad sin distinción de clase o origen lo convierte en un fenómeno antropológico único, donde la ciudad entera parece detenerse para girar en torno a un eje común.

Su estatus de hito cultural radica también en su resistencia al paso del tiempo y a la homogeneización global. En un mundo donde las tendencias de ocio cambian a velocidad de vértigo, el Chotis mantiene una vigencia inalterable, desafiando la lógica de lo efímero. Se ha convertido en el guardián de la memoria histórica, preservando gestos, miradas y formas de interactuar que de otro modo habrían desaparecido bajo el asfalto moderno. Cada vuelta que dan las parejas es un acto de reivindicación, una manera de decir que ciertas raíces son demasiado profundas para ser arrancadas por la modernidad. La fiesta de San Isidro, por ejemplo, no se entendería sin este elemento central que vertebra los días de celebración, transformando el espacio público en un gran salón de baile donde la tradición se vive con una intensidad casi religiosa pero profundamente lúdica.

Más allá de lo local, el Chotis ha logrado proyectar una imagen de Madrid hacia el exterior, funcionando como un embajador cultural que comunica valores de alegría, cercanía y orgullo castizo. Aparece en postales, en discursos políticos y en el imaginario popular como la representación máxima de lo madrileño, condensando en unos minutos de música y danza la esencia de un pueblo. Su presencia en actos oficiales, bodas populares y reuniones vecinales demuestra que ha calado tan hondo en la psique colectiva que su ausencia se sentiría como una mutilación del calendario festivo. Así, lejos de ser una reliquia de museo, el Chotis respira como un organismo vivo, adaptándose a los nuevos tiempos sin perder su alma, asegurando que el legado de aquellos primeros bailarines del siglo XIX continúe vibrando en los pies de quienes hoy ocupan las plazas, manteniendo viva la llama de una cultura que se niega a ser silenciada.

Es todo por hoy.

Disfruten del mix que les comparto, esta vez, sin voz, solo instrumental.

title.title: Do Men Have The Power to Know The Future?//Mcgi Topic Review.
title.body:
https://youtu.be/Fo45NG4f7l4?si=Ue2O5gEtKsxYUpdr

**Greetings everyone,** and welcome to my blog. It is another wonderful opportunity to listen to the word of God through His servant, Bro. Eli Soriano.

Christians, in particular, should always be aware of what lies ahead. We must remember that the Bible is not only a book of teachings but also a book that contains prophecies. But what is the purpose of prophecy according to the Bible? In John 14:29 it says, “And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you may believe.” This shows that God reveals future events ahead of time so that when they are fulfilled, our faith in Him will be strengthened.

According to the Lord Jesus Christ in John 14:29, Christians are given insight about future events before they take place. This helps believers understand that life is not meant to be lived without direction or awareness. Instead of simply living day by day without thought of tomorrow, we are given the ability, through God's guidance, to plan and prepare for the future.

This idea is also supported in Proverbs 16:9, which says, “A man’s heart plans his way, but the Lord directs his steps.” In other words, people can make plans and think about the path they want to take in life, but it is God who ultimately guides and establishes their steps. Therefore, believers are encouraged to plan, think ahead, and prepare for what they want to become in the future, trusting that God will lead them in the right direction.

For this reason, Christians should not simply accept the saying “come what may” and wait for things to happen without preparation. A true believer has confidence about the future because of faith in God. He understands what lies ahead and, most importantly, knows the ultimate destiny of human life.

First of all, we must accept an important truth: every human being will eventually die. Whether we like it or not, death is a reality of life. As Ecclesiastes 9:5 states, “For the living know that they will die, but the dead know nothing; they have no further reward, and even their memory is forgotten.” The living are aware that death will come one day, while those who have died are no longer conscious of anything.

**Thanks for reading.**

title.title: Patimban Indonesia’s Strategic Port for Trade and Logistics
title.body:
Indonesia is rapidly expanding its trade and logistics capabilities, and Patimban has emerged as a critical part of this effort. This modern seaport is designed to handle growing export volumes, reduce congestion at older ports, and streamline cargo transportation. Strategically located in West Java, [Patimban](https://patimbanindustrialestate.co.id/) helps industries move goods efficiently, supports international trade, and strengthens Indonesia’s position in global markets.

## Strategic Location and Importance

Patimban is situated in Subang, West Java, close to major industrial and manufacturing zones. This location allows goods from factories especially automobiles, electronics, and other manufactured products to reach the port quickly, cutting transportation costs and delivery times.

Previously, exporters relied heavily on Jakarta’s main port, which often faced congestion. The development of Patimban provides a modern alternative capable of handling high cargo volumes efficiently and improving logistics flow across the region.

## Modern Infrastructure and Facilities

Patimban is equipped with advanced infrastructure to manage containers, vehicle shipments, and other cargo types. The port features spacious docking areas, modern terminals, storage facilities, and specialized zones for automobile exports.

Digital systems are integrated throughout the port to monitor cargo, streamline logistics, and ensure smooth operations. This combination of physical infrastructure and technology makes Patimban one of Indonesia’s most efficient ports.

## Economic Benefits

The creation of Patimban has significant economic advantages. Efficient logistics reduce shipping costs and accelerate delivery times, helping Indonesian exporters compete in global markets.

Additionally, the port generates employment opportunities in port management, cargo handling, transportation, and logistics, contributing to regional economic growth. The development also attracts investment in surrounding industrial zones, warehouses, and distribution centers.

## Supporting Automotive and Industrial Growth

The automotive sector benefits greatly from Patimban, with dedicated terminals that allow for the storage and efficient export of thousands of vehicles annually. Advanced loading systems ensure the safety and speed of shipments.

Other manufacturing sectors also gain from faster and more reliable export processes, making Patimban a key hub for Indonesia’s industrial growth.

## Enhancing Logistics and Supply Chains

Efficient supply chains depend on modern ports. Patimban improves logistics with advanced cargo handling systems and strong connections to highways, with future plans including rail integration.

Improved infrastructure ensures goods reach international markets faster, supporting reliable export schedules and smoother global trade operations.

## Future Expansion

Patimban is being developed in phases to meet growing trade demands. Future expansions will add additional terminals, larger storage areas, and more modern logistics facilities. Once fully operational, the port will handle millions of containers and vehicles annually, strengthening Indonesia’s position as a regional maritime hub.

## Environmental and Technological Initiatives

Sustainability is a priority for Patimban, with energy-efficient systems, effective waste management, and environmentally responsible operations. Digital cargo tracking and automated logistics systems enhance efficiency and reduce operational errors while maintaining eco-friendly practices.

## Conclusion

Patimban is transforming Indonesia’s trade and logistics landscape. Its modern facilities, strategic location, and technological integration strengthen exports, support industrial growth, and create employment opportunities. As the port continues to expand, Patimban will remain a central gateway connecting Indonesia to global markets and driving long-term economic progress.

Hello everyone, @glecerioberto here, and welcome to today's #TravelDigest! I bring you some exciting travel stories brought to us by our community members from around the world. First up is the Laguna de la Barrera in Spain. Then, we see the inside of the Museum of Ancient Ships in Italy. Finally, we take a stroll around Keukenhof Gardens in the Netherlands. Of course, our trip wouldn't be complete without seeing our Honorable Mentions. We have places from Venezuela, the Philippines, and Russia. Check them out below and show your support. Cheers!

Our winners today

Almost a year ago, I found a beautiful lagoon on the map, my great friend for searches and explorations. I went there and enjoyed a sunny spring day in its early days and was able to appreciate a marvel in the middle of a neighbourhood full of buildings, also known as the university district, because all the faculties are located there.

Hello everyone. I want to share a bit about our visit to the Museum of Ancient Ships today. We had spent the entire month of December sick at home. And decided that a walk by the sea would do us a world of good. That day was the 26th of December, Saint Stephen’s Day, to be exact.

title.title: Cuando la música rompió el silencio - Historia [ESP-EG]
title.body:
> El estudio de Risingstar continuaba lleno de ritmo, las guitarras afinadas comenzaban a mezclarse con los primeros golpes de batería que poco a poco iba mejorando. Para cualquier de los músicos que estaba allí, era simplemente otra mañana de ensayo. Pero para Stewie, el tiempo parecía haberse detenido. Seguía sentado con su guitarra entre las manos, observando cómo Michelle tocaba algunos acordes. Su forma de tocar no era agresiva ni apresurada, era tranquila, precisa, como alguien que entiende que cada nota tiene su propio espacio. Daniel, desde la batería, comenzó a marcar un ritmo ligero, mientras Sofía respondía con algunos golpes suaves. El estudio poco a poco empezó a transformarse en lo que siempre había sido: un lugar donde las ideas musicales aparecían casi sin aviso. Seguidamente, Michelle tocó una pequeña progresión de acordes que llenó el aire con una melodía sencilla pero hermosa. Fue entonces cuando algo cambió. Stewie, que había permanecido inmóvil durante varios minutos, bajó la mirada hacia su guitarra. Sus dedos seguían apoyados sobre las cuerdas, esperando una orden que no terminaba de llegar. Respiró lentamente y, casi sin pensarlo, dejó que su mano derecha tocara una nota. El sonido salió limpio. Daniel levantó la mirada desde la batería. Sofía sonrió ligeramente mientras mantenía el ritmo. Michelle también escuchó la nota y lo miro. Stewie tocó otra. No era una melodía complicada, era simplemente una respuesta. Como si las notas de Michelle hubieran abierto una puerta y él apenas estuviera entrando. >The Risingstar studio was still buzzing with energy, the tuned guitars beginning to blend with the first drum beats, which were gradually improving. For any of the musicians there, it was just another morning of rehearsal. But for Stewie, time seemed to have stopped. # >He sat with his guitar in his hands, watching Michelle play a few chords. Her playing was neither aggressive nor rushed; it was calm and precise, like someone who understands that each note has its own space. # >Daniel, at the drums, began to set a light rhythm, while Sofía responded with a few soft beats. The studio slowly began to transform into what it had always been: a place where musical ideas appeared almost without warning. Michelle then played a short chord progression that filled the air with a simple but beautiful melody. # >That's when something changed. Stewie, who had been motionless for several minutes, looked down at his guitar. His fingers were still resting on the strings, waiting for a command that never came. He breathed slowly and, almost without thinking, let his right hand play a note. The sound came out clean. # >Daniel looked up from the drums. Sofia smiled slightly as she kept the beat. Michelle also heard the note and looked at him. Stewie played another. It wasn't a complicated melody, it was simply a response. As if Michelle's notes had opened a door and he was just stepping through. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcX5x19qVv26fLXZn7UgEM15ZDpvXcAwpTbFgxZRNqoQT/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/mujer-luces-hombres-musica-8040895/) La guitarra de Michelle continuó su camino, y ahora la de Stewie comenzaba a acompañarla. Las baterías se unieron al ritmo, primero con suavidad y luego con un poco más de fuerza. En cuestión de minutos, el estudio entero estaba tocando. Lo que comenzó como un saludo que nunca salió de la garganta de Stewie, terminó convirtiéndose en una pequeña improvisación. Nadie había planeado esa música. Simplemente apareció. Michelle dejó escapar una breve sonrisa mientras seguía tocando. Stewie ya no estaba paralizado. Ahora estaba tranquilo, tocando la guitarra de la mejor manera, donde para los demás músicos de Risingstar, era simplemente otro ensayo más. Pero para Stewie, aquella mañana se había convertido en algo distinto. Porque a veces las palabras no salen, pero la música siempre encuentra la manera de hablar. >Michelle's guitar continued on its way, and now Stewie's began to accompany it. The drums joined in, gently at first, then with a little more force. Within minutes, the entire studio was playing. # >What began as a greeting that never left Stewie's throat ended up becoming a little improvisation. No one had planned that music. It just appeared. Michelle let out a brief smile as she continued to play. Stewie was no longer paralyzed. # >Now he was calm, playing the guitar to the best of his ability, where for the other Risingstar musicians, it was just another rehearsal. But for Stewie, that morning had become something different. Because sometimes words don't come out, but music always finds a way to speak. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVP6VJpQztiiqUkmMqqS2EZqsX7nCPShgLPw81zjA4cAq/image.png) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/foto-de-persona-tocando-la-guitarra-acustica-1751731/)

title.title: Candles Economics: Abundance Year Episode 1901
title.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1836
Tuesday 10, March 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1901
Noxsoma Life Camp:  

Super Power Tuesday, Flex’em up mi gente.

The price of candles have nearly doubled on store shelves in this area. The nightly lighting of a candle or two has become a “practice.” Not so much a ritual, but not a thoughtless habit either. It’s not to light the room, the screen does a good job of that. I do like the scent though. It’s just subtle enough to sense. It’s certainly not to warm the place up. Nights here these days are in the upper 70s. 

It’s something I do because I like it. Or maybe there’s something deeper. Next time I visit the VA, perhaps I will bring it up. [That’s a joke.] 

Watching prices of retail commodities is, for your humble vagabond, kind of like playing the stock market. I won’t, however, be flipping jars of peanut butter, boxes of tea bags, or candles, to turn a profit. Saving money, for your boy and Poor Richard, is as good as earning money.

“A penny saved, is a penny earned.” We don’t use credit cards to purchase consumables. That goes for candles and candies. 

We walk the minimalist talk. Speaking of walking, today’s adventure offers a bit of a behind the screens peek at the tenacity, determination and endurance of this vessel. We want what we want and we will do what’s necessary to acquire it. Whatever it is at the time. These wants, however, are not what attracts herds of sheeple to the fields. This vagabond lifestyle is largely stress-free, and flowing because of strategies and disciplines that a lot of pundits advocate, but very few humans actually adopt. 

Speaking of which, the newly-awakened neo-gurus seem to have one aspect in common. They have usually amassed an “impressive” amount of material wealth, which affords them the opportunity to, ostensibly “off-grid” themselves and appear to give up the hustle-culture to which they have dedicated their vessels in past times. 

Maybe your boy is guilty of this? On second thought, no. The details of this slide from one century to the next will be revealed when our next project gets going. It’s not the glamorous life. But who needs glam, when you’ve got serenity. 

Stay strong, stay safe, stay savvy, stay sane, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.   

PEACE.    


Candles Economics

![1901.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTss3nV89UUyygGLm8N292jgwYhebo6N3Y4ibpk3NG739/1901.png)

Candles Economics. 
 Most of this story is told in today’s episode. It was recorded in the street-studio on the way back from a shopping excursion that turned out to be more excursion than shopping.

When we got back we researched the candle brand and looked up where else they might be sold. Turns out the brand is specifically manufactured for the Dollar General stores, but Walmart also carries them. We had a few items we wanted to check out at Wallyworld, so we hopped a bus and headed out the next day. 

Walmart’s shelves were well-stocked but nothing in their candle inventory rang our bell. The prices, despite Walmart’s reputation, were not competitive. We found a couple of pieces that would due. One was even on sale. Half price. 

At the end of the day, Mind realized that, “We have better options in our own neighborhood.” Despite the absence of “The General.”   
We have since checked some other spots and found a line of wood-wick candles that do the job. We may take another walk out to DG, for the exercise – we basically walk anywhere we can within a 4-5 mile round trip – out of curiosity, and to test our luck.  

Candles Economics is an extension of “Vagabond Economics.” There are several layers to it that these digits are too weary to peck out. Maybe we will address this strategy in future episodes. Just say the word.

title.title: Why Bitcoin Cash, Blurt, Dogecoin, and Litecoin Are the Only Cryptocurrencies You Need
title.body:
In a market flooded with thousands of tokens promising the moon, I feel like my portfolio stands apart for its harmony of growth, freedom, and real utility: Bitcoin Cash, Blurt, Dogecoin, and Litecoin.

These four deliver everything most users could ever want—without the noise of endless altcoins.

Bitcoin Cash powers scalable, low-fee transactions and leads in optional tokenization. Its CashTokens protocol already supports NFTs and custom assets, backed by active developers building practical applications rather than hype.

Litecoin complements this with lightning-fast confirmations and the same proven proof-of-work security. Developer projects are extending its capabilities to tokens and NFTs, making it a versatile bridge between traditional payments and digital collectibles. Typically labeled as Digital Silver, like Bitcoin is Digital Gold.

Dogecoin brings community energy and mainstream appeal with the added benefit of no total supply limit. What began as a meme has evolved; dedicated builders now enable token standards and NFT ecosystems, all secured by robust PoW mining that keeps the network decentralized and fun.

Blurt adds the irreplaceable element of freedom. Unlike profit-maximizing platforms, this blockchain rewards users for content creation through a crypto-powered social network. It champions free speech while letting creators earn directly—proof that blockchain can serve expression first.

Together they cover every essential base: flexible tokenization, full NFT access, a mix of PoW and DPoS consensus for security and efficiency, and social rewards that turn posting into income. No single coin does it all, but this quartet does—effortlessly.

title.title: Tercer Plato [Also in English]
title.body:
> La inmensa casa se alzaba en el borde de una sombría terraza de Santa Mónica, Caracas. Un aguacero torrencial la empapaba sin descanso. Maribel ajustó su vestido de seda, sintiendo un frío espeluznante que no tenía nada que ver con la temperatura de la capital venezolana. Habían sido invitados a una cata exclusiva por el Dr. Ríos, un biólogo cuya fortuna era difícil de precisar. A su lado, Leonardo parecía inusualmente animado. Sabía que Ríos solo abría su bodega para cosas… extraordinarias. Con los ojos llenos de emoción no dudó en comentárselo a Maribel, mientras un camarero de rostro inexpresivo servía el tercer plato. El plato frente a ellos contenía una carne oscura, de un color violeta muerto, bañada en una reducción de frutos que desprendía un aroma dulce y metálico a la vez. Leonardo, siempre aventurero y despreocupado, no esperó la presentación. Cortó un trozo generoso y se lo llevó a la boca. —Sabe a… gloria —dijo Leonardo. Pero su sonrisa se desvaneció ipso facto. Se llevó una mano a la garganta. Sus pupilas se dilataron hasta casi borrar el iris y una gruesa gota de sudor frío recorrió su sien. Gritó que le ardía, que algo lo consumía desde su interior. Maribel, alarmada, llamó al camarero, que permanecía estático en la esquina del salón. —¡Algo anda mal! —gritó ella—. ¡Mi esposo se siente mal! ¿Qué clase de carne es esta? El camarero no respondió. En ese momento, el Dr. Ríos entró. Extrañamente no vestía de etiqueta, sino una bata blanca manchada de un líquido ámbar. Sus manos temblaban mientras sostenía una hoja que parecía un informe o una anotación. Al ver el plato vacío de Leonardo y los espasmos que sacudían su cuerpo, el doctor quedó lívido. Se volvió hacia el camarero con una mezcla de horror y fascinación científica. —¿Qué comió? —exclamó Ríos en un susurro que cortó el aire. El silencio que siguió fue sepulcral. El doctor se acercó más a Leonardo, no para ayudarlo, sino para observar cómo las venas de su cuello se tornaban de un negro azabache, ramificándose como raíces bajo la piel. —Le dije que no sacara la muestra del criostato —rugió al camarero—. ¡Eso no es un animal! Es tejido orgánico recuperado del meteorito de 1908. Estaba en fase de latencia… esperando un huésped biológico para completar su ciclo de incubación. Leonardo intentó gritar otra vez, pero de su boca solo salió el sonido del crujir de ramas al romperse. Sus dedos comenzaron a alargarse. Y Maribel vio, con horror, cómo algo se movía frenéticamente bajo las costillas de su marido. —No es comida, Maribel —dijo Ríos, retrocediendo—. Es un colonizador. —Y Leonardo acaba de invitarlo a pasar. De inmediato, Ríos y el camarero salieron del recinto. Las cerraduras electrónicas sellaron el salón con un chasquido seco. Maribel comprendió entonces que la cena no era para ellos. Ellos eran el banquete. Hasta aquí mis cinco minutos.

> The massive house loomed on the edge of a bleak terrace in Santa Monica, Caracas. A torrential downpour soaked it without rest. Maribel adjusted her silk dress, feeling an eerie chill that had nothing to do with the temperature of the Venezuelan capital. They had been invited to an exclusive tasting by Dr. Ríos, a biologist whose fortune was difficult to measure. At her side, Leonardo seemed unusually animated. He knew that Ríos only opened his cellar for things that were... extraordinary. With eyes full of excitement, he didn't hesitate to mention it to Maribel, while a waiter with an expressionless face served the third course. The plate before them held a dark meat, of a dead-violet hue, drenched in a fruit reduction that gave off an aroma both sweet and metallic. Leonardo, always adventurous and carefree, didn't wait for the presentation. He cut a generous piece and brought it to his mouth. —It tastes like… heaven —Leonardo said. But his smile vanished ipso facto. He clutched his throat. His pupils dilated until they almost erased the iris, and a thick drop of cold sweat ran down his temple. He screamed that he was burning, that something was consuming him from within. Maribel, alarmed, called out to the waiter, who remained static in the corner of the room. —Something is wrong! —She shouted—. My husband is ill! What kind of meat is this? The waiter did not respond. At that moment, Dr. Ríos entered. Strangely, he wasn't dressed in formal wear, but in a white lab coat stained with an amber liquid. His hands trembled as he held a sheet that looked like a report or a set of notes. Upon seeing Leonardo’s empty plate and the spasms shaking his body, the doctor turned livid. He turned toward the waiter with a mixture of horror and scientific fascination. —He ate what? —Ríos exclaimed in a whisper that cut through the air. The silence that followed was sepulchral. The doctor moved closer to Leonardo, not to help him, but to observe how the veins in his neck were turning jet-black, branching out like roots beneath the skin. —I told you not to take the sample out of the cryostat —he roared at the waiter. That is not an animal! It is organic tissue recovered from the 1908 meteorite. It was in a state of latency… waiting for a biological host to complete its incubation cycle. Leonardo tried to scream again, but from his mouth came only the sound of branches snapping. His fingers began to elongate. And Maribel watched, with horror, as something moved frantically beneath her husband's ribs. —It’s not food, Maribel —Ríos said, backing away. It’s a colonizer. —And Leonardo has just invited it in. Immediately, Ríos and the waiter left the room. The electronic locks sealed the hall with a dry click. Maribel realized then that the dinner was not for them. They were at the banquet. So much for my five minutes.

title.title: Prepping the Greenhouse on a Sunny Day - by Sunscape
title.body:
![SRL-image-6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdKSeC8JDRdzGyxxvMdKYvMc2wLxQpvjy5kp6XuhEZAQC/SRL-image-6.jpg)


To think that this is what the greenhouse looked like 3 weeks ago and today all the snow has melted due to the extremely high temperatures this month.

With the sun shining and my spring gardening itch that needed to be scratched, I decided it was the perfect day to prep the greenhouse.  


![hivegarden-greenhouse-thermometer.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVs4NtZo82n8DJhjrgZWWzikyKfrHaPTqdEk8Qr28b3R8/hivegarden-greenhouse-thermometer.jpg)

This is how warm it got that day and it was even hotter inside the greenhouse.  


![hivegarden-greenhouse-1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR6bJcoSRfqGox7CXGjmtCYT8VhcUTqcchkLT4SRauhgf/hivegarden-greenhouse-1.jpg)

I had moved the tall strawberry tower in her for the winter and most of the plants seemed to have survived.  Since the weather is quickly changing, I moved all of them back outside to slow them down a bit.  Now that side of the greenhouse is all swept and ready for seedling trays.  


![hivegarden-greenhouse-2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdJ2n52gURxFo4ChLtQDNc6mydaZZd9uZxjiX5LM4bFQT/hivegarden-greenhouse-2.jpg)

The tubs for the hydroponics were filled with rainwater that we collected, and they are ready for all the lettuce to be put in.  


![hivegarden-greenhouse-4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYEhNYys5pEQHCDJm8HmgxnDgp7T2ZMZondyCGMuR5pX5/hivegarden-greenhouse-4.jpg)

These small tower gardens are filled with soil and ready for planting when the seedlings are large enough.  I'm going to wait 2 more weeks before moving plants into the greenhouse.  Right now, they are growing inside the house on racks with plant lights.  


![hivegarden-greenhouse-pots.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma7Qoy8d4HQ8itbmQ5Yrazqe1JfMgJkXDCDtN3BHE39X1/hivegarden-greenhouse-pots.jpg)

I purchased all new cocoa liners for the hanging baskets, and they are ready to be filled with soil.  

![potatoes.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW2WWMPGkax2z1MhpN7iRSNA5Ty9dRR9vzYLFYoieaRuS/potatoes.jpg)

These potatoes chitted a few weeks ago, so I planted them into two grow bags and kept them in the garage.  Hubby and I carried them out to the greenhouse and now they can grow in there until we can put them safely outside.  


![hivegarden-greenhouse-potatoes.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdH9Rp6WeGniYTjCtG6jPgiDnN1j2eoG4XANt87beqK2E/hivegarden-greenhouse-potatoes.jpg)

They are tucked in place at the south side of the greenhouse on the floor and should do very well there.  It was nice to get everything ready to receive the seed trays.  It won't be long before they can go out, but it will depend on how cold the nights will be.  Last year I put them out too early in March and it cost me a lot to heat it with electric heaters to keep the plants from freezing.  I won't make that mistake this year.  

![dpet-mika-porchtime-3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWsuDH11RrYAsTApNvPRwLnT1F7UrfAw9mdqXw2apCjUh/dpet-mika-porchtime-3.jpg)

Mika, and I enjoyed sitting on the porch after all the work was done and then she took a nice nap in one of the porch chairs. 

![dpet-mika-porchtime-1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZNhjE2q1mF98bENkgHCkZeJ288b7FYriGXvSejLtxNRp/dpet-mika-porchtime-1.jpg)

Today, I have to start some more seeds, sweet peppers and tomatoes will be the first to get done.  That will be enough for me for one day.  

![banner-sunscape-2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYr3stqM7yx8cpipf8v6F4YgkM2aD282NSQrGYzJZqCxE/banner-sunscape-2.jpg)



![banner-freesia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTsFqYjxcHcZtVhEEQsiKi41ZdVQ5kXtRvfYfm3PJ4pdi/banner-freesia.jpg)

Hi, I am Arveno from Surabaya city. In this content i want to share about time when my son already big right now. I dont know since when but this change is literally made me more sad than last year. Times really flew so fast. I still remember when first time carrying him after born with small body ( even though right now still small) and right now he can ask what he want to eat and can tell me what to do.

This happened after we are from Church and i said that we will eating at home with homefood. But, my son tell me not to eating at home. He said that we need to eating out and he wants to eating Ramen. 
Like in those picture even he guide me where to eat. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQFicU3zqZ3bcjbbXySCXo2PigGyjWcz6R8ZLXiC1CdS8/image.png)

蛋糕店老板有养一只鹦鹉，我觉得统称叫做鹦鹉，但是我具体也不知道它叫什么鹦鹉，刚刚发图片去千问上面问，才知道它叫玄凤鹦鹉。听蛋糕店老板说已经养了很多年了，前天晚上蛋糕店老板带着鹦鹉出来溜达，他还叫鹦鹉唱歌给我听。看着这么可爱，而且很亲人，我好像也喜欢上。

![微信图片_20260310230243.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb48Z4kDUxD4d9w2YATRA8s3Fkg9fv4mU4JLwqS6BDXZJ/%E5%BE%AE%E4%BF%A1%E5%9B%BE%E7%89%87_20260310230243.jpg)

昨天去打工的时候，店里的老板也买了一只鹦鹉是黄色的，但好像有点黄绿色的。我问他是不是看到蛋糕店老板买的鹦鹉你也想养一个。他说不是，他说是他儿子喜欢才买的。鹦鹉寄到已经一个小时了，但是他还没有打开来给它喂过水，里面只有小米。老板叫我把它翅膀羽毛剪掉一些，不然的话等我会飞跑了，我打开来把它羽毛剪掉了一些，然后喂了它水。我的手套上面蘸着水，它咬着我的手套和手指，咬着不痛。然后我用勺子喂它，它渴死了，把一勺子的水基本都喝完了。

title.title: Chrysanthemums: Nature’s Symbol of Resilience and Beauty
title.body:
Chrysanthemums, often called “mums,” are more than just vibrant flowers adorning gardens and homes—they are a testament to nature’s quiet strength. Each petal seems to carry a story of endurance, blooming boldly even in the cool embrace of autumn when many other flowers have withered. Their resilience reminds us that beauty can emerge even in moments of transition, inspiring patience and appreciation for life’s subtle rhythms.

Beyond their visual charm, chrysanthemums have deep cultural and emotional significance. In many cultures, they symbolize longevity, optimism, and the elegance of simplicity. In Japan, they are celebrated during the annual Festival of Happiness, embodying joy and vitality. In other parts of the world, they are woven into rituals of remembrance, offering comfort and a sense of continuity. This duality—the ability to represent both celebration and reflection—makes chrysanthemums uniquely humanistic, echoing the complexity of our own experiences.

title.title: Private credit in crisis: BlackRock limits redemptions to 5%, Blackstone at 7.9%, Blue Owl loses 10% in one day
title.body:
![1000036579.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davideownzall/23tmmXSVXWhBRthShph7bzUJejDuYboZxjxftePDh6oc98ucfg1PMBZR9fvsgugGetfsa.jpg)
> *Credits: stockanalysis.com*

Considering the ongoing war in the Middle East, there are a lot of economic news, I'll just skip the usual oil and gas and instead turn my attention to a product called \

, which has been sold wrongly as the safe haven of modern finance. I don't know how many people know about it, so what is this private credit? Simply put, large funds raise money from pension funds, insurance companies, and investors, and lend it to businesses that cannot or do not want to turn to banks, offering above-average returns with seemingly controlled risk. Too nice to be real right? In fact the problem is that these loans are not easily tradable, they are not traded on public markets, so if many investors want to withdraw their money at the same time, the fund may find itself short of liquidity. And this is exactly what is happening right now, 

pushed by the war in Iran too many people to handle for the funds, have decided to withdraw their money and do problems are coming out.

Blackrock for example, with the HLEND fund, has activated what's called \

: quarterly redemptions have been limited to 5%, while investor requests had exceeded 9% of the capital. Speaking of numbers, out of the 1.2 billion dollars requested, only 620 million were refunded. There you go, too much money in the fund and insufficient liquidity to satisfy everyone.

Similar situations are occurring elsewhere. Blackstone, with the BCRED fund, recorded redemption requests amounting to 7.9% of the total value, forcing the fund to use its own capital to avoid a freeze. Blue Owl Capital, on the other hand, permanently suspended liquidity in some segments, causing the stock to drop by 10% in just one day.

As wrote earlier, the problem is that these funds promise immediate access to capital if you want to withdraw, but hold loans that are difficult to resell quickly and so those \
precautions are triggered (they are legally present in the contract) otherwise there would be a general collapse. \n\nInvesting in private credit means accepting the risks of freezes with \

. You need to be informed and understand what’s really behind those too good returns, otherwise, you might get burned. Think carefully, every insolvency, every geopolitical event can trigger a domino effect, because then panic sets in and everyone wants to withdraw, but the fund doesn’t have the liquidity to pay. Ignoring the cracks in the system doesn’t make them disappear, it just moves the problem further down the road, until the system is seriously tested, as is happening now (and perhaps even worse if the war continues for a long time).

title.title: Why is it important to learn and unlearn in life?
title.body:
Hello to all hive users 🤗❤️🙏
Hope you all are healthy and doing great in your life🙂



When I was younger, I used to think that school was just about studying, and after that, I didn't need to study. But gradually, I realized that college requires studying, and after that, once I get a job, I don't have to study or learn anything. At that point, I waited for college to end. College ended, and I got a job. Now, I realize that real life is just beginning, and there's still a lot to learn. Life is all about learning and progress. If we want to gain knowledge, there are books for that, but there's also some knowledge that's beyond books and is crucial for life. This knowledge is gained through our own experiences, the experiences of others, or through real-life realizations. The things we experience in real life also provide us with a wealth of knowledge, and this knowledge is crucial for our lives. That's why it's said that social interaction and making real-life connections are essential.  Well, no matter in which phase of our life we are, we definitely learn something or the other. After learning one thing, we have to work on something else and collect things about it and we also have to share our and other people's experiences, only then we are able to learn that thing and gain some knowledge related to it in our life.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY3xzPsju4dDYWo1s47bi8zpq5gikS9n5yQRkm3BWNZMx/1773150627222.png)

Image Generated By Chatgpt 




One thing I've been working on in Kajal is patience. For some time now, I've felt like my patience level is dwindling, and I need to unlearn the habit of getting quick results. I've noticed this because I've noticed with some concern that I used to be able to concentrate on something for hours and work on it without getting bored. However, for some time now, I've noticed that I can't concentrate on anything for long and am getting bored very quickly. I used to be able to watch a web series continuously, but now, as soon as I start watching a web series, I get bored after a while and then pick up my phone and start watching something else. This continues, and I end up spending more time on my phone, unable to focus on the web series.  Previously, even if a web series wasn't interesting, I would still focus and enjoy watching it. However, if the series became even slightly boring, my interest would fade. This seemed strange to me, and I wondered why this was happening. The first reason I discovered was that I had been scrolling through short videos on social media a lot. These short videos entertain you for a short period of time, and your brain gets used to the quick results. This is a kind of dopamine effect, because you may have noticed that these short videos are usually only 1 to 2 minutes long, and in these videos, you get to see a lot of things and things are instant, which can lower your patience level. If you watch a long video and you're not interested in it, your brain gets used to the quick results, and this is why you get bored quickly.

Today's generation is addicted to these short videos and consumes so much content that their brains become completely exhausted, and the result is a devastating impact on mental health. Understanding patience is crucial, as there are some things in our lives that require time and cannot be achieved instantly. Patience is crucial in our lives, as only if we maintain patience will we be able to achieve something significant. If we become addicted to instant results, nothing will be possible; on the contrary, our mental health will be harmed. If you're seeing quick results in something, it could mean you're not on the right track, as things that have a significant impact on your life require immense patience and hard work.

title.title: Moonflower: The Night’s Quiet Miracle
title.body:
When the sun sets and the world begins to soften, the moonflower awakens. Unlike most blooms that greet the morning light, the moonflower (Ipomoea alba) waits patiently for dusk. As shadows stretch and the air cools, its large white petals slowly unfurl, glowing softly beneath the moon. Watching it bloom feels almost magical—like witnessing a secret ritual that belongs only to the night.Native to tropical and subtropical regions, the moonflower is a vigorous climbing vine, often wrapping itself gracefully around trellises, fences, and balconies. Its heart-shaped leaves create a lush green curtain by day, but it is at night that the plant truly reveals its beauty. The blossoms are wide and luminous, reflecting even the faintest light, as if they were designed to capture the moon’s glow. Their delicate fragrance drifts through the evening air, attracting night pollinators like moths.There is something deeply symbolic about a flower that blooms in darkness. The moonflower reminds us that not all beauty seeks the spotlight of day. Some wonders unfold quietly, away from noise and rush. It becomes a symbol of hope during uncertain times—a gentle reassurance that even in darkness, something pure and radiant can blossom. Its brief nightly bloom teaches us to appreciate fleeting moments.Caring for a moonflower requires patience and a little faith. It thrives in warm weather, full sun during the day, and well-drained soil. As the vine climbs higher, it prepares silently for its nightly performance. Gardeners often plant it near windows or outdoor seating areas, so they can witness its evening transformation. The reward is not just visual, but emotional—a sense of calm and quiet connection with nature.

从周天下午开始到周二，哎呀，感觉时间怎么过得那么快，晃眼间就周三了，半周又过去了，但是感觉一事无成，还欠下了一屁股债。

当然这里的债并不是实际意义上的债，而是我们学习的东西，数学分析和电子电路基础，也就是传说中的模电这才第二周啊，就让我已经见识到他的威力了我想过他会很难没想到他竟然这么早就给我们下马威了，现在学起来感觉举步维艰啊，甚至是上课，从上周五开始的最后那部分我就没有听懂，我说不要紧，我就像上学期那样再去找网课再去问AI结果后来我才知道，因为我一直忙着搞ae和PPT，作业还没来得及做题，但是我已经听说到AI不会做这类电路分析题，我去，那我不就完蛋了吗？现在大学不是就靠自学嘛，那老师上课就只教一部分内容，下来后我又找不到合适的网课，不会的问题AI也无法解答，我的豆老师也失效了。那我不就完蛋了吗？

老师给我们推荐了一款软件，仿真软件，让我们模拟电路进行实验。最绝的就是这个电路就把我折磨了整整一个下午，就在周天下午，我信心满满的打开电脑，想着几分钟就下好的事情，结果豆包给我推荐了官方正版然后我下载官方正版，结果他告知我，我只有7天免费试用期，而且版本和老师教的完全对不上，我就根本没法跟着听课，那没办法，我好不容易下了一下午，一直在等他的那个加载条加载不完，结果现在告诉我完全错了，然后我就去找网友们发的各种下载教程，结果我又发现我必须把我最初下载的那个错误的给删掉才能再下载。我直接崩溃了呀，我还没有找到具体怎么下载，但是我已经知道了我要把我之前的删掉，然后我就气急败坏回到宿舍，然后又删了一下午，他那个加载条整整加载了两个半小时才删的干干净净。我回到宿舍后找室友要的安装包和教程，十几分钟总算下好了，但是这一整顿操作下来给我整个人都干懵了。我直接不知道如何是好，就那个地方就有些给我干的绝望了，这才刚入门，就下一个，学习软件都这么艰难，可想而知后面的学习有多么费劲了。

我现在在操场校园跑，但我一点也跑不动，我就想走着，但是走又太慢了我上次走5km用了整整一个小时，我不知道我在这里费劲我的精力和时间做这种事情有什么意思。我压根找不到他的任何意义，反正我不知道为什么我现在就很悲观，突然生出了这种很负面的情绪。可能就是上面说的各种事情导致的吧，反正我现在就就想躺着。就是特别累，感觉好像这个大学四年也就这样，一眼望到头了，每天这么浑浑噩噩，循环往复，不知所云……

title.title: Wisdom starts with wonder !
title.body: Life is a continuous learning process. Now and then we often been to a situation that gives us some lesson. It is not related to academic and bookish learning but learning in real life too that help us to get better with each phase of life. Ever since we get a life, we get into a learning mode. From eating to talking to walking to schooling we human were born to learn. Continuous learning is a \

that allows individuals to turn failures into lessons and to constantly improve their skills and understanding. There are certain situation and phases in life that an individual like to know more about it. And it is purely on their interest how they enhance their grasp on the subject. These days, I trying to get hand in learning marriage negotiation process.


![20251017_051343(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23tGyfJ69yuJ5eCQs4Wcfnkke7yJHpPxmhawRaBxdc8XsqeuKUXhDdoMsHV7JFDNUgkVR.jpg)
*(own edited image)*


> ***Trust the journey and keep moving forward***

When I was out of my college, I figured out that knowing advanced computer is a way to build a good career, so I get a good hand on the keyboard and that helps me to get better job prospects. When I get into job, I tried to enhance different skills to adapt in the work environment. The learning new things never stops and it helps me always to get ahead of others.  is not limited to formal education, but is a perpetual journey of self-improvement, professional development, and personal growth that continues from birth until death. Now as I entered a phase when our elders generation are on their last stage of life and our generation needs to take over their legacy of knowledge and wisdom. In process marriage negotiation and arrangement is an integral process. 

> ***Art of arranged marriage***

Marriage is often viewed as an alliance between families rather than just individuals, with deep rooted cultural and historical significance. In this process, arranged marriage are seen as a way to preserve family values, minimize dating pressure, and secure financial stability. While love marriages are becoming more common in urban areas, the tradition of arranged marriage remains strong due to its deep integration into the social fabric. Arranged marriages is a structured tired process that is quite time consuming process. Getting a good alliance is never been easy and in arranged marriages were make sure to see if every parameters fits in or not. Before formalizing the union, families rigorously vet the prospective partner's background, including education, financial stability, family reputation, and caste/religious alignment. The process begin finding a prospective boys, meeting the parents and then sharing the details and then negotiation.

> ***Arranged to be together***

Few hours ago, I came from one such negotiation. It was the first meeting and I joined them to learn the real-time experience of initiating the alliance talk. So far our elders had done it quite handsomely and now they like to pass on the baton to upcoming generation. This is where I think learning this marriage negotiation helps me to get better in the coming years. Such kind of meeting let us to know many family roots and generation that were related to each other. Today while attending the meeting, I learned quite a new truck to start the talk and carrying on the process. Still the marriage is not yet formalized, and there are still fee mote meeting required to learn the entire process. 


This is a new learning phase and hope it helps me getting better with each passing experience.



**In good faith - Peace!!**



![1000037470.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eo8M1obna2cYnnMAc2ZC3wWMW9ZqZHvk9StEga6aY2cTsKmweW7zFBDm7D13YHVoC5N.png)

title.title: Thunbergia Erecta: The Quiet Elegance of the King’s Mantle
title.body:
Thunbergia erecta, often known as the King’s Mantle or Bush Clock Vine, is a flower that carries quiet royalty in its petals. Its deep violet-blue blossoms, accented by a bright golden throat, resemble tiny trumpets announcing beauty in the gentlest way. Unlike flowers that demand attention with overwhelming color or size, Thunbergia erecta draws you closer. It invites observation, rewarding patience with its rich hues and delicate charm.

Native to tropical West Africa, this evergreen shrub thrives in warm, humid climates. It grows gracefully, forming a soft cascade of glossy green leaves dotted with luminous blooms. Whether shaped into a neat hedge or allowed to spill freely over garden edges, it adapts with ease. There is something reassuring about its steady presence—it blooms generously throughout the year, as though it understands the human need for constant reminders of beauty.

The contrast within each flower is mesmerizing. The velvety indigo petals frame a warm yellow center, creating a natural harmony of cool and light. This interplay feels symbolic, like night meeting sunrise in a single bloom. In gardens, balconies, and quiet pathways, Thunbergia erecta becomes a living piece of art. It softens walls, brightens corners, and transforms ordinary spaces into serene retreats.

title.title: The Mystery of the Desk Lady.
title.body: > I relied on stealth to avoid deadly entities while navigating Tokyo's rain-soaked streets without supernatural abilities. After reaching KK's apartment, Akito had a brief encounter with a woman from KK's past provided a mysterious object, only for her and the item to vanish as the world warped once more. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZNCra4MkooCT7vxN4jVUuUKBauFAz1QhTay7Cb3wj1G4/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZgSzanhuFBNFvBH338xGGVELkg4wh9Zb7TVWXJP2gUKk/screenshot_2_.png) In the darkness and heavy rain, Akito was alone as a regular human being. Without any special abilities to defend myself, I had to ignore several demons on my way to avoid a fatal confrontation. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVUDYCD8kGJByjB8aJcqjnzM5A9sVJCNjLdhPU8mjX5xh/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTrzxtMnTP2vHszvaKavyt3mxcG16X4z3hNiCexgSs1s5/screenshot_4_.png) I found a dog on my path and tried to feed it some dog food, but the game wouldn't let me. It felt strange because feeding a dog shouldn't require any special power, yet the interaction simply didn't work. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXNBL8Hf6iAVrNkDW3uULbf4irkZkJJvBC4WyK2VhdekS/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdP3Cksf4TjXq1sBNZetB5dDe9Bh1Yzv24s5nWvviteGk/screenshot_6_.png) I found a telephone booth and used it to transfer the spirits I had collected. I wasn't sure if I could actually do it without my hero's powers, but the transfer was successful nonetheless. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX3V2Y37qHi8rowzZ5nSKTDp7sDj6px7uKaqJXwKPo2Us/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSgFAC868DFuZQwMysXSgmX6w846NCPgVa3tLApAAd9t/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf8t7Li9UsfP6UZocauxL9wAqAxYWCnby2pvzFZPefWsF/screenshot_9_.png) I spotted a Rain Walker checking cars for lingering spirits or humans. Using the only power I had left, stealth, I approached him quietly and took him down without being detected. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNhnp1x3K1LcaZf5y7Qoqp3J1YxV6ziEG763pWQ28XWff/screenshot_10_.png) I managed to absorb some spirits found on the ground floor of a building. Even without my primary strength, I was still able to gather these lost souls as I moved toward my objective. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxiPokihfbNHvPkMqGUtgPNCePW7M4HNcqLYE2R7szXr/screenshot_11_.png) I noticed a Tengu on top of a building and tried to see if I could still perform a grapple. Unfortunately, the ability was locked, leaving the rooftops completely out of my reach. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSVPrBb5nbmAiSFUWWxa9JdduYFhtYMN7xdAhoZ9stqPm/screenshot_12_.png) At last, I reached KK's apartment. The journey wasn't as difficult as I had initially feared it would be while playing without my powers, as long as I stayed out of sight. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQMWqeWMt7gz7KzkLhHDviywWkLddwUEgrt9e2paapyWA/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbLpiYKUb7zNXxHsLwc1eF3GSEKHzPLFZS3zcYtvsQZqm/screenshot_14_.png) After getting inside the apartment, Akito became incredibly confused. The interior appeared as if it were sitting in the middle of a vast, silent ocean, defying all logic. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVZDWFKe3nGtkQLLXs2TNCivabYDJiDdmYiwRWB854Hv7/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeNWaykbeCRyV9GQD1wMxctM7PJt384VybhrqfGpt7KwW/screenshot_16_.png) He noticed a lady sitting at the desk. Her presence was unexpected and scared Akito, as she seemed just as confused and displaced as the room itself. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2NXmGEAHprhke6ahwxEeepkqWgLzZHuab8LmuAKUU8U/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVifkWHVSZhHnevizNr8BqxhwtabgDWaM5th4VJyqJ8aj/screenshot_18_.png) The lady turned around, and Akito recognized her from a portrait of KK he had seen during a previous visit. He realized then that she was a close friend or associate of KK. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQonL5Si3zqCSBYMWFeHBpJ1XNMj3fJgVXDnbtxVADea2/screenshot_19_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZrQivoFMTQGUQixps9Ui3EyTYjTXwbQp5d38qZq1wYKq/screenshot_20_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV7HUkcUD6aJbtYfzAmF5uirthpH93rDctYD2zW8ytyua/screenshot_21_.png) The lady handed Akito a thin purse, telling him it was important and asking him to give it to KK once they found him. She mentioned it was urgent. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUZBaUqe4A74JQU4QYtxvcUKY5ok3pZc6tUHa97SHoXhd/screenshot_22_.png) As soon as Akito took the item, the entire apartment changed. The lady disappeared, and the purse was no longer in his hand, leaving him alone in the shifting reality once again. We'll continue in another post. --- **Thanks for reading. If you like my post, please follow, comment and upvote me. All the in-game screenshots are taken by me, just the games logo is borrowed from deviantart.** --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=hrichakar/d12e27a7)

The lady disappeared, and the purse was no longer in his hand, leaving him alone in the shifting reality once again. We'll continue in another post. --- **Thanks for reading. If you like my post, please follow, comment and upvote me. All the in-game screenshots are taken by me, just the games logo is borrowed from deviantart.**

title.title: Hive openmic week 309. A cover of prayer is the key
title.body:
[![](https://hotipfs-3speak-1.b-cdn.net/ipfs/bafkreia56ujyug3kvxtkwida6woljaxosbqb5gid7c2eh7ru4ejadfhsae/)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=adaezeinchrist/wrfgzhzt)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=adaezeinchrist/wrfgzhzt)


---

Fasting is very good thing and helps us to have enough time for prayers. We all know that prayers means talking to God and receiving his response in what we have asked in prayers. It then means that we can't talk about fasting without adding the word - Prayer.

For this week 309 in the hive openmic community I will love to do a cover of two short songs on prayers. One is taking from the Bible that says - Prayer is the Key, while the second song is an Igbo song on prayers too. It says that prayer is my own charm. People usually go to native doctors to get charm maybe for protection or to harm another person. But for me prayer is the only charm I know how to make and I will keep doing it again and again until I am no more. 

The song on English language is an affirmation that prayer is the only key to all our problems because even Jesus when he was in the flesh he kept praying until his last minute on earth. It shows us that we also needs to pray on every situation. 

I had to write the lyrics by myself because so many people have done the cover of this two songs that I can't even say who sang it first. But because they are songs that I am use to I will just go ahead and write their lyrics the way I know how to.

Lyrics of the English song.
Prayer is the key 
Prayer is the key 
Prayer is the master key !
Jesus started with prayers 
And ended with prayers 

Prayer is the master key  2X

Song in Igbo language 

Ekpere bu ogwu mgworo
Ni me chineke
Ekpere bu ogwu mgworo
A gama agwoya ozo
2X

Enjoy my cover 
@adaezeinchrist

---

title.title: My devotion
title.body:
My devotion was like that of wandering souls, those who roam the world aimlessly. For them, God is everything… for me, you were everything. I would have burned, yes… I would have let the fire turn my bones to ash rather than allow a blasphemy in your name. But that damned angel showed me the truth: the worst of blasphemies was my devotion to you. Now you burn in every verse I read until you are extinguished… and my soul, at last, is freed from this prison.

Spanish: 
Mi devoción era como la de las almas errantes,
esas que vagan por el mundo sin rumbo.
Para ellas, Dios lo es todo…
para mí, todo lo eras tú.
Habría ardido, sí…
habría dejado que el fuego volviera ceniza mis huesos
antes de permitir una blasfemia en tu nombre.
Pero ese maldito ángel
me mostró la verdad:
la peor de las blasfemias
era mi devoción hacia vos.
Ahora ardes en cada versículo que leo
hasta que te apagues…
y mi alma, por fin,
se libere de esta prisión.
