title.title: A Summer Garden's Crown Jewel
title.body:
Among the true jewels of the summer garden, the Delphinium stands tall, literally and figuratively. Known also as Larkspur, this captivating perennial is cherished for its majestic stature and vibrant, often breathtaking, colours.

Its iconic tall spires, laden with densely packed blooms, are a sight to behold, creating a stunning vertical accent that draws the eye upwards.

While famous for its intense shades of sapphire and cobalt blue – a colour rarely found in such purity in the plant kingdom – Delphiniums also grace gardens with enchanting purples, delicate pinks, and pristine whites.

title.title: Easy rural style recipes for iftar [Chicken 🍗 Fry]
title.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP7Bcv9t9Ez4ah6eDEhRXkYJfsHAy8QdaHTXkm8AJ7q7F/24cb2f0a3766a1c108030053013423c6)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=suraiyaaktar/7cf8871b)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=suraiyaaktar/7cf8871b)


---

Hello food lovers, welcome to the food blog.Today I have made an item which is very simple.It costs money to eat the item in a restaurant but can be made very easily at home.This is a chicken fry.When we go to eat it in a restaurant, it is also known as grill kebab.This recipe is prepared by young people on various occasions to celebrate special occasions.Traditionally, this dish is prepared in various ways in our region.

![IMG-20260310-WA0009.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcyXSbqGoDWaTCqULswdXBFuJ2Tidwt8QmrNraZRX5Y1j/IMG-20260310-WA0009.jpg)

![IMG-20260310-WA0008.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeWtQq9jz4wndgJFzWaWmmpEiLMKdMWeBkmv4FKAVpkiS/IMG-20260310-WA0008.jpg)

At various birthday parties or Thirty-First Nights, I see young people cooking this chicken fry in different ways and they prepare it in different ways in advance.

![IMG-20260310-WA0006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeg8r9VraCQ2UzdoJUeEkszL9ZaBsnW54qHLWQwsZ94gQ/IMG-20260310-WA0006.jpg)

![IMG-20260310-WA0007.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU4LZAYWsFDvobCRQEcAtAjzhbbozHSBw3DMxC23aQ3C5/IMG-20260310-WA0007.jpg)

But today I made it in a completely rustic style, in just 20 minutes.Currently, we are in the month of Ramadan and we are celebrating this month of Ramadan according to religious customs.During the month of Ramadan, we are fasting all day and breaking our fast in the evening.We have various food arrangements during Iftar.Everyone is waiting for iftar.

![IMG-20260310-WA0004.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRyoNakZJefNuaPYosMB8M3SpSpxuQg1UfkL6rHymZsTZ/IMG-20260310-WA0004.jpg)

![IMG-20260310-WA0005.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXTLXW1PLu8MhoPkZtaogyRQpb5nxgSyYWi4sMTegxtbx/IMG-20260310-WA0005.jpg)

Different people prepare different meals during Iftar.However there is no specific one, one can prepare food according to one's wish.Although according to tradition, it is customary to eat fried food during this time, but again, it seems that sherbet and fruit are the most effective at this time.

![IMG-20260310-WA0003.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNf5EQ8JMTSDAcZsQPBCVw7icK7ryuH5CCRryW3GcGx3r/IMG-20260310-WA0003.jpg)

![IMG-20260310-WA0002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUqFQDyAD2Ws2cqyxc93h9tAYtqKhb87QuUJqmzpiHKhq/IMG-20260310-WA0002.jpg)

Today for iftar I made chicken fries in a completely rustic style and it requires less effort.I made this chicken fry for Iftar with very little effort and very quickly, so I'll share it with you.To make this I only need chicken leg pieces and oil.I need turmeric powder, dry chili powder and cumin powder.Mix the spices together and prepare the chicken for frying.

![IMG-20260310-WA0001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbuPJxMNwLRxwq1k7j3FbSTRSuRt95NFQhi3tjBXwouzg/IMG-20260310-WA0001.jpg)

However I have tried to show every moment of making this completely rural style chicken fry recipe in the video, so watch the video.I wish you well.

Thank you...

Love from @suraiyaaktar

---

Evergreen ocimum which is also known as clove basil, African basil, and in Hawaii as wild basil, is a species of basil in the family of Lamiaceae. It’s native to Africa, Madagascar, Southern Asia & the Bismarck Archipelago & naturalized in Polynesia, Hawaii, Mexico, Panama, West Indies, Brazil & Bolivia.

It’s used in the treatment of various diseases such as diabetes, cancer, inflammation, anaemia, diarrhoea, pains, and fungal and bacterial infections.
This is not a medical advice, always consult your physician before using.

Recent research has shown that ocimum gratissimum is used as medication for persons living with AIDS & the Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) (Ugbogu et al., 2021). Scent leaves can be used to stop tomach aches, dysentery, diarrhea, and vomiting.
It also helps in prompt food digestion

title.title: [ENG/ESP] Autumn magic in Castrelos Park: a paradise of trees 🍂🧡 | Magia otoñal en Parque Castrelos: un paraíso de árboles 🍂🧡
title.body:
<center>

The popularity of autumn is well known for the emotions generated by its beautiful color palette 🍂🧡 Today we are going to enjoy it by looking at these beautiful photos of **Castrelos Park**, in the city of Vigo, Galicia. Its main focus is the beautiful trees along its paths, where many people gather to take walks, go running, and play with their dogs. The landscape is dressed in ochres, yellows, oranges, and touches of green, creating the autumnal backdrop that we fall in love with after the heat of summer bids us farewell.

>La popularidad del otoño es bien sabida por las emociones que genera su hermosa paleta de colores 🍂🧡 hoy la vamos a disfrutar al mirar estas hermosas fotos del **Parque Castrelos**, en la ciudad de Vigo, Galicia. Su principal punto de enfoque son los lindos árboles entre sus caminos, donde muchísimas personas se reúnen a dar paseos, a realizar running y salir a jugar con sus perros. El panorama se viste de ocres, amarillos, naranjas y toques de verde, creando así la tela otoñal que nos enamora luego del calor del verano que se despide.

![00 portada.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPC6tF397jQi543UHcry8oyPPmdM9WAWLySmxCeXAsaCC/00%20portada.jpeg)

This first photo is the perfect example of what I described above ⬆️ All those beautiful colors are concentrated in the duck lake, which has a small island with a very beautiful and well-crafted little house for them to take shelter in. It's one of the lovely details that surprise you as you take the tour.

>Esta primera foto es el perfecto ejemplo de lo anteriormente descrito ⬆️ Todos esos hermosos colores se concentran en el lago de los patos, que tiene una pequeña isla con una casita muy hermosa y bien elaborada para que tengan refugio. Es uno de los lindos detalles que te sorprenden al realizar el recorrido.

![01.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNPeF3EsiT39uAvWRn9P9nGYFDcRkhM8E3HmAMn6Cfh3g/01.jpeg)

![02.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTm1Hforq19EddQCSJS7rq4cVo56HxsCXtzixYSZH3vDn/02.jpeg)

The park was a ranch donated by its owner to the city. It covers more than 20 hectares of land, and both its gardens and infrastructure are beautiful. It is one of those places that can be enjoyed in any season of the year, with beauty everywhere you look. 

>El parque fue una hacienda donada por su dueño a la ciudad. Cuenta con más de 20 hectáreas de territorio, y tanto sus jardines como su infraestructura son bellísimos. Es de esos lugares que se disfrutan en cualquier estación del año, tiene belleza por doquier. 

![03.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQCVCQxmAA1QyQkaVex2DtFxbgApDK9bXKS2bYRuZb4Rd/03.jpeg)

![04.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTSfZad2b1m58vZMpNXmkVPKnUWMdru4aq8KXLBRef7fk/04.jpeg)

And this is where I focused today's post ⬇️ The diversity of trees. They definitely hold an important place in my heart, and I love looking at them. I love how they adorn the city. In this park, I found them in many colors and types, and they look beautiful.

>Y acá es donde puse el foco para el post de hoy ⬇️ La diversidad de los árboles. Ellos definitivamente ocupan un lugar importante en mi corazón y me encanta mirarlos. Adoro como adoran la ciudad. En este parque los encontré de muchos colores y tipos y se ven preciosos.

![05.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU755WrA51CsBEiEYZ5LyrPSjKf22QavkZM6GLTsfQij5/05.jpeg)

![06.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmapXBPVeeUWRVmaAqhDnNdxyv2cdnYxC7T82fKRXZ3UTj/06.jpeg)

![07.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNNfnRiq4i6xDM66CegqVMKLZeHhRXaC9eAvzkAaU8zyf/07.jpg)

![08.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSc5RMNzJZvnf1RxHVyqrXz3itUKEiPDRso9p4zSgsNAy/08.jpg)

A nice detail to end today with is seeing how diverse mushrooms grow among its roots. Details everywhere: made by God and by human hands, between nature and the construction of the park.

>Un lindo detalle para culminar por hoy, es ver como la diversidad de setas crecen entre sus raíces. Detalles por todas partes: hechos por Dios y por la mano del hombre, entre la naturaleza y la construcción del parque.

![12.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRPZqqoSTg7YrAswc1LXEN7LZnWCaP55vzcciFw18d8fE/12.jpg)

![10.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd5tGnRY6pDQhpf6LTUAQmBhh4UPGXwa5KXfMAUHWMMjd/10.jpeg)

![11.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW9J6YpfbK54hQvrgZZ4LKKfKzef1JneEWf7U3B8RFD8W/11.jpeg)

![Separadores-56.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUDa6NwZYs4ogdhufyY7gmwXToG8fvGE9PCYJBZnGAhZv/Separadores-56.png)

title.title: Easy Dinner Rolls
title.body:
Learn how to make amazing homemade dinner rolls from scratch with just a few ingredients. IF you love dinner rolls you will love this [soft no knead dinner roll recipe](https://www.inthekitchenwithmatt.com/soft-no-knead-dinner-rolls). 

**Ingredients**
- 1 Tbsp of yeast 8.5g
- 1/2 cup of water 120ml
- 1 cup of milk whole, skim, 2%, 1% (240ml)
- 4 1/2 cups of bread flour all-purpose will work (570g)
- 1/4 cup of white granulated sugar 50g
- 1 1/2 tsp. of salt 8.5
- 4 Tbsp. of unsalted butter 58g
- 2 eggs
- 1 – 2 Tbsp. softened butter for brushing 14 to 28g

**Instructions**
1. Begin by combining the milk and water (or use all water) in a bowl and heat it up to 100 to 110 F (40 to 43 C). Use the microwave or a pot on the stovetop. Add a pinch of the sugar to the liquid as well as the yeast. Mix in the yeast with a fork or whisk, then allow the mixture to sit for 5 to 10 minutes until it gets foamy/frothy.
2. Melt the butter until just barely melted, make sure it isn't very hot. Pour the butter in with the yeast mixture. Then whisk the eggs up in a separate bowl and then add those as well.
3. In a medium bowl whisk together the flour, salt, and sugar.
4. Add half of the flour mixture in with the yeast mixture. Mix together with a wooden spoon. Then add in the rest of the dry ingredients, stir until just combined. The dough will be a bit sticky which is perfect.
5. Cover the bowl of dough with a damp towel or plastic wrap and set in a warm place to rise for 2 to 2.5 hours until the dough has nearly tripled in size.
6. After the dough has risen, place it on a floured surface roll it out into a long loaf and divide it into 20 equal pieces using a knife or dough cutter.
7. Form each piece of dough into a ball and place in a parchment paper-lined 13×9 baking pan. Spray the tops with kitchen spray or lightly baste them with melted butter. Then cover with plastic wrap and allow to rise for 45 minutes to an hour.
8. Remove plastic wrap and bake, in a preheated oven at 375 F (190 C), for 15 to 20 minutes until nice and golden brown on top. After the dinner rolls come out of the oven baste the tops of them with butter. Allow the dinner rolls to cool before serving. So yummy!

Lately this has become a very popular and quite famous place. In fact, if you come here during the weekend it is a problem not only to walk along these paths, but also to find a parking space to leave the car, because we are inside this regional park of the Euganean Hills. And this area is famous precisely because all these trees turn pink and white in color and in reality I have noticed that we are not yet in the phase of maximum splendor, which will probably be around the month of March. Even if this year it seems to me that the climate has anticipated the times a little, because fortunately it hasn't rained for a long time and the temperature is a little higher than average.

There are several panoramic white roads as you can see, the one I did with my friends was about 8 km long, there was very little difference in altitude and we did it in about two hours, you can also visit the village of Arquà Petrarca which is located nearby or even the Villa Beatrice d'Este which is a historic villa with a museum, I think I had already shared a post in the Borgo here, however walking here is free and free and that's the beautiful thing about this that usually the simple things are always the best, See you soon.

title.body: para aprender un idioma o que simplemente \

para las matemáticas? La ciencia tiene una excelente noticia para ti: tu cerebro tiene la capacidad de cambiar físicamente cada vez que aprendes algo. A esto lo llamamos Neuroplasticidad.*

## 🛠️ ¿Qué es exactamente la Neuroplasticidad?
Imagina que tu cerebro es un bosque denso. Para ir de un punto A a un punto B, primero tienes que abrirte paso entre la maleza. La primera vez es difícil, pero a medida que caminas por el mismo sendero una y otra vez, se forma un camino despejado.

En tu cerebro, esos caminos son las neuronas conectándose entre sí. La neuroplasticidad es la habilidad del cerebro para:

- Crear nuevas rutas (nuevas conexiones).

- Reforzar las rutas existentes (hacerte más rápido en algo).

- Eliminar rutas que ya no usas (lo que no se usa, se debilita).

## ⚡ El \
Celular: La Sinapsis\nCuando aprendes un dato nuevo o una habilidad (como tocar la guitarra), tus neuronas se envían señales eléctricas y químicas. Imagina que dos neuronas se dan un \

.

- Al principio: El apretón es débil y torpe.

- Con la práctica: Ese apretón se vuelve un vínculo sólido. Los científicos dicen que \

.
https://www.panamaamerica.com.pa/sites/default/files/styles/article/public/imagenes/2020/05/16/manos_saludo_0.jpg?itok=Gq8jVS21[](https://www.panamaamerica.com.pa/variedades/adios-al-saludo-con-apreton-de-manos-1163628)

## 🏗️ ¿Cómo sucede el cambio físicamente?
No es magia, es ingeniería biológica. Cuando el aprendizaje es constante, ocurren tres cosas principales:

- **Cambio Químico:** A corto plazo. Es cuando recuerdas algo por unos minutos (memoria de trabajo).

- **Cambio Estructural:** El cerebro cambia físicamente su forma. Se crean nuevas ramificaciones (dendritas) para conectar más neuronas.

- **Cambio Funcional:** Áreas enteras del cerebro pueden cambiar su función. Por ejemplo, en personas ciegas, la parte del cerebro que normalmente procesa la vista puede empezar a procesar el sentido del oído o el tacto.

## 💡 3 Tips para \

tu Neuroplasticidad
Si quieres que tu cerebro aprenda más rápido para tus proyectos en Hive o en la vida, aplica esto:

#### Repetición Espaciada: 
No estudies 5 horas un solo día. Estudia 20 minutos todos los días. La repetición constante refuerza el \

en el bosque.

#### Sal de la zona de confort: 
El cerebro solo cambia cuando se enfrenta a un reto. Si algo es \

, no hay plasticidad real.

#### Duerme bien: 
Durante el sueño es cuando el cerebro \

las nuevas conexiones que hiciste durante el día. Sin sueño, no hay fijación de conocimiento.

title.title: منصات المراهنات الرياضية عبر الإنترنت: عالم من الإثارة والتحدي
title.body:
في عصر التكنولوجيا الرقمية، أصبحت منصات المراهنات الرياضية عبر الإنترنت وجهة رئيسية لملايين المستخدمين حول العالم الباحثين عن الإثارة والتشويق. توفر هذه المنصات فرصة فريدة لمتابعة الأحداث الرياضية المفضلة والتفاعل معها بشكل أعمق، من خلال توقع النتائج ووضع الرهانات على مختلف البطولات والمباريات.

تتنوع الرياضات والبطولات التي تغطيها هذه المواقع بشكل كبير، لتلبي اهتمامات جميع المشجعين. فمن كرة القدم العالمية بمختلف دورياتها الكبرى مثل الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز والدوري الإسباني، إلى كرة السلة الأمريكية والتنس في جميع بطولاته الكبرى، وصولاً إلى رياضات أخرى مثل الكريكيت والرياضات الإلكترونية التي تزداد شعبيتها يوماً بعد يوم.

إحدى الميزات الأساسية التي تقدمها هذه المنصات هي خاصية المراهنات المباشرة، حيث يمكن للمستخدم وضع رهاناته أثناء سير المباراة نفسها، مع تحديث الاحتمالات بشكل فوري بناءً على مجريات اللعب. هذا يضيف بعداً جديداً من المتعة والتشويق، حيث يتطلب متابعة دقيقة ورد فعل سريع. وتتكامل هذه الخاصية غالباً مع خدمة البث المباشر، مما يتيح للمستخدم مشاهدة الحدث واتخاذ قراراته وهو يتابع الأداء لحظة بلحظة.

لجذب مستخدمين جدد، تقدم منصات مثل (1XBET) وغيرها مجموعة متنوعة من العروض الترويجية والمكافآت، أبرزها مكافأة الترحيب على أول إيداع. هذه المكافأة تمنح المستخدم رصيداً إضافياً لبدء رحلته، ولكن من الضروري جداً قراءة الشروط والأحكام المرتبطة بها، وخاصة متطلبات التداول التي تحدد عدد المرات التي يجب فيها المراهنة بقيمة المكافأة قبل أن يصبح من الممكن سحب أي أرباح ناتجة عنها.

بالإضافة إلى ذلك، تهتم المنصات الموثوقة بتوفير بيئة آمنة وشفافة لمستخدميها. ويظهر ذلك من خلال استخدام تقنيات تشفير متقدمة لحماية البيانات الشخصية والمالية، وتقديم خيارات دفع متعددة وآمنة تناسب مختلف المناطق، بالإضافة إلى توفير أدوات للمساعدة في اللعب المسؤول مثل تحديد حدود للإيداع أو فترات توقف مؤقتة، لضمان بقاء التجربة ممتعة وفي إطار السيطرة.

في النهاية، يمثل اختيار المنصة المناسبة خطوة مهمة لأي شخص يرغب في خوض تجربة المراهنات الرياضية عبر الإنترنت. ينصح دائماً بالبحث والمقارنة بين الخيارات المتاحة، واختيار المنصة التي تجمع بين السمعة الجيدة، وتنوع الخيارات، والأمان، وسهولة الاستخدام، لضمان تجربة ترفيهية آمنة وممتعة.

title.title: The Money Circle
title.body:
Money tends to flow more easily for those who already have it, and in my country, it's no different.

For those who have money, double surnames, important social contacts, and studied at top schools and universities, making money is very easy.

In fact, making money is so simple for those who belong to the right circles that they even invent and direct public tenders.

As happens in the case of the President of Paraguay, whose brothers and son benefited from multimillion-dollar tenders of dubious legitimacy, making money is so easy that envelopes containing several thousand dollars even appear and disappear.

On the other hand, for those who don't have a surname and high social and economic standing, it's very difficult to make money despite whatever academic merits they may have.

Salaries also tend to vary according to social reasons rather than capacity and academic training.

It's often said ironically, but no less truthfully, that Paraguay is the country of friends. If you have the right friends, whatever businesses you start will be successful and profitable.

Of course, there will be success stories of people who manage to earn a lot of money on their own, but that tends to be extremely unusual.

The country's largest business holdings were born from the illegal \

that the powerful of the day granted to people they favored. The smuggling of goods, cars, and drugs had a green light directly from the top of power.

Some of them managed to launder their fortunes and today they form companies with a greater degree of legality, but with practices we could call unethical at best.

So making money in this country is not simple, it's not achieved through honest effort, sacrifice, and studies, but rather something society tries to hide by yielding a few positions to people who are not part of the circles.

title.title: He Ate What\t? When Hunger and Curiosity Meet
title.body:
Strange incidents often astonish people. Sometimes we hear about someone eating something unimaginable and the phrase he ate what slips out. This phrase is actually used to express surprise and astonishment.
Food plays a significant role in human life. Generally people eat what's considered healthy and acceptable. However food habits vary across regions and what seems normal in one place can be unusual elsewhere. This is why unusual news often leaves people astonished.
Sometimes people eat unusual things out of desperation. Poverty, hunger or hardship can force someone to consume whatever it takes to survive it's no longer about preference but about staying alive.
Besides some people try new and unusual foods out of curiosity or adventure wanting to taste local cuisines and explore different cultures. While it might astonish others for them it's an exciting experience.
A person's food is closely linked to their needs and circumstances. When we say he ate what in astonishment we're actually marveling at the diversity of human habits and situations it's this difference that makes the world fascinating.

title.body:
> Atónito, Brandon observa la fotografía de su bisabuelo William Lizardhard. Seguramente su vida había sido toda una aventura. Recién llegado de España, sin dinero y con problemas del habla, había trabajo incansablemente hasta que enfermó, y solo cuando se detuvo fue cuando empezó realmente a vivir. El medico le había dado solo dos meses más de vida, pero la vida tenía una historia mucho larga y prospera de lo que el había imaginado. Cansado, enfermo y derrotado decidió cambiar la vida de una mujer abandonada, pero terminó siendo ella quien cambio la suya. Ahora, casi un siglo más tarde, el apeido que un día se inventó para encajar en el nuevo mundo, aún esencia de trabajo y superación corría por las venas de sus descendientes que aunque no llevaban su sangre, llevaban su espíritu.

这次展览汇聚了本土多为女性艺术家的精品力作，涵盖了油画，中国画，木刻画，版画，水彩画等等，多种艺术表现形式。这些女性作家们用自己独特的细腻的视角，温柔笔触和敏锐的感知，勾勒出了生活百态，人间温情与精神世界。 
***这几个老师在讨论这幅作品，比较专业！***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaKF1mnTD2o1ntRZFBe35AoNGrBikRZBf1V9REum3Epbp/_.jpg)


因为得天独厚的地理位置，每天美术馆都有很多人来参观，美术馆也有很多的志愿者在这里为大家服务。 漫步展厅，有书法，有画展，还有石头美术作品，作品精彩，让人赞叹。 

有表现人物的， 自然的，生活，动物等等，这些精彩的作品背后是女性们不可小瞧的在艺术上崛起的动力！

作品在一楼和二楼都有展出，总共是三个展厅和一个长廊，其中有几个人还评论说，一楼的作品质量最高，而在我看来每幅画的质量都是高水准。她们都是女性中的佼佼者，王者！

我还是比较喜欢人物风格的，画的比较传神，细腻，更有着丰富的内涵。例如下面这几幅，手法细腻，温柔，坚韧，容易和作者达成共情。

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzUnXVqzrXt6jYB4R6i8P1cPhNWmKVjN8XHMt38SPBV/_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYvEgc9YziTxuJasVvvaX4JmQgjoCEmSrGsejAMyZedMb/3.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdb3DG9dvQtwPQa3PPtSgz8bEBfKcLvBUem8c4VjLFGMe/_.jpg)

下面这个中国画线条细腻，表现力极强。 两匹优雅的马！

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYXoPKX7gyaicaYq1nNsczyYTWwx436hKb13iFd2QEDzv/_.jpg)
***小女孩牧羊的疲惫跃然纸上！***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZW18fMtXdC9HniPXxHGQS1xHpQkXRjdBQP1cz8zHkRFj/_.jpg)
***最传神的猫！栩栩如生，像真的 一样，尤其是皮毛画的太逼真了！我认为是最成功的作品！***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY2zp5cNdAoCkH5a7Ca4QDb44CPc4HmKEUEZqy1bcMMM6/_.jpg)
***最有活力的鱼！***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRNqGCtVMYoA5r92wGMyv6BFgYUdE65RyC3nadJ28L8uD/_.jpg)
***最美的白天鹅！起飞的情景！***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZXJPUimRt6igx5wE5j33UFAS6BtjXuW2Rjtpfz2YsMnZ/_.jpg)
***靠海吃海，各种海鲜 干货！***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZwYJjiJA8zGg7a8KQ2og8F2HnGFMvYXXDiYKLj59eYox/_.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTkq4tK2v1Xm55jPg8DrNJ1N8av6n93svM1wogGuNtRj1/_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU89CuhjFJyUv7DadHQsWGwUBAEC4qqUbG5uDkFiFBUon/_1.jpg)
***这幅意境深远！***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVD7KGzs9Ezx8Q5NT7jbdRqmWUnp1FqF6UvobNtGEwXvQ/_.jpg)
书法的娟秀与大气！
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcx9YiBvvGcQ7hutG5X85qjjCie8oSGdyzhjXHfCM5xtG/_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdSx2MPJRWsTdEK6eyqsDnTN3KZCxfdRoBJ6QGXCyFTVm/_.jpg)
自然风光，熟悉的渔人码头和海港！
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcVKkLbNk4Jiaqvx3HJuC1Df6u9byoPAJCntW5zLRFs3k/_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS816tzVwfSoPJWMvcsMsTBq3hozMH6qSfk9hfGF3Xcgv/_.jpg)

本次的作品展出了不下百余幅，看过之后，心中是满满的震撼与感动。丹青芳华很好的展现了这次画展的主题，这些女性艺术家们用自己手里的画笔，以丹青为媒，以热爱为笔，笔下绽放出最美的芳华。

她们用自己的视角，书画出对生活的理解和热爱，让我们通过这些艺术表现形式，感受到生活中的美和力量，一幅幅的画中，展现了女性艺术家们的智慧。这场艺术上的邂逅，如春日暖阳，温暖而绵长。让我在流连忘返中难以忘怀，我想这就是她们“心怀热爱，自有芳华” 的女性魅力吧！

title.title: Lake Saif ul Malook Pakistan
title.body:
Lake Saif-ul-Muluk is a very beautiful lake in Pakistan.
This lake is situated near the area known as Naran in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa region.
Lake Saif-ul-Muluk is situated in the middle of high-altitude mountains, and the view is very attractive.
This lake is situated at an altitude of 3,224 meters.
Many tourists come to visit this beautiful lake in the summer season.
The color of the water in this lake is very clear and blue in color.
A very famous story is linked with this lake regarding Prince Saif-ul-Muluk and the fairy Badi-ul-Jamal.
The snow-covered mountains are situated near this lake, making this lake very beautiful.
It is one of the very famous tourist spots in Pakistan.
Lake Saif-ul-Muluk is a beautiful gift from nature. 🌊🏔️🇵🇰

title.title: Cute European Robin Bird
title.body:
The European robin belongs to the Muscicapidae family, the Old World flycatchers, though for many years it was grouped with the thrushes. It is a small passerine, measuring about 12.5–14 cm in length and weighing approximately 16–22 grams. Its most striking feature is the reddish-orange face and chest, bordered with grey, set against a brownish back and pale belly. Males and females are identical in appearance, a rarity among songbirds, and even juveniles—though initially brown and speckled—grow into that distinctive crimson bib.

title.body:
한국에선 네일 예약 잡는 것도, 가서 받는 것도 일이다.
근데 여기도 마찬가지.
설날을 앞두고 예약이 다 차서, 뒤늦게 겨우 빈 자리 하나 났다고 연락이 와서 냅다 가겠다고 했다.

봄맞이 무슨 디자인을 할까 고민을 하다가 디자이너에게도 추천 받고, 나도 디자인을 좀 골라봤다.
봄맞이라 하니 하늘하늘 핑크핑크~
예쁘긴 했지만 금방 질릴 듯 하여, 최근에 빠져 있던 드라마 이사통에서 차무희가 모으던 네잎클로버로 결정!
네잎클로버를 찾기는 어려우니 손에 똭!!
나에게도 행운이 필요하니까! (했으니까!, 아니 늘 필요하지!)

네일 디자인을 골라가면, 슥슥 그려주는 건 한국이나 말레이시아나 똑같은 모양이다.
다들 숙련된 전문가들이라 그런지 한 번 보고 슥슥~
한국보다 속도도 빠른데 퀄리티도 나쁘지 않은 느낌.
오히려 빨라서 좋다.
대화없이 집중해서 후닥해서 그럴지도.

![IMG_8750.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmezLNVpTcTdwT6y1s8RZfvEUTkv2SYrvfB14Qm374cGRt/IMG_8750.jpeg)

그래서 완성된 두번째 말레샤 네일 작품!
디쟈인은 한국꺼지만, 그대로 예쁘게 나왔다~!

가끔 이렇게 손발 관리를 받으면 기부니가 좋다.
또 집에선 케어가 안 되는 부분을 관리 받는 것도 좋은 것 같고.
다음 네일은 말레샤에서 받을 수 있을까? 아님 한국에서~?!

어쨌든, 이제서야 이 곳 현지에 적응한 느낌이다.

title.title: Encuentro de Talentos: Continuar es un acto de fe cuando la brújula se rompe
title.body: >Saludos, hivers talentosos, feliz martes para todos. Siempre hay un tema que nos toca el alma y que nos cae como anillo al dedo en un momento dado; el tema para esta semana siento que me hace bien hablarlo y claro, escribirlo; para que llegue hasta ustedes. ¿Cómo continuar?

>
Greetings, talented Hivers, happy Tuesday to all. There's always a topic that touches our souls and feels like a perfect fit at a given moment; this week's topic feels good to talk about and, of course, write down, so it can reach you. How to continue?

>Dicen que la vida es bella, y en esencia lo es, pero a veces me pregunto si esa belleza no es más que un horizonte que se aleja mientras nosotros nos enredamos en la maleza del camino. Tengo la firme convicción de que somos los seres humanos quienes complicamos la existencia con estructuras injustas y silencios prolongados, pero saberlo no quita el peso de encima. A veces, esas complicaciones dejan de ser conceptos abstractos para convertirse en muros reales que nos envuelven, nos atrapan y nos roban el impulso necesario para avanzar.

>
They say life is beautiful, and in essence it is, but sometimes I wonder if that beauty isn't just a horizon receding while we become entangled in the undergrowth along the way. I firmly believe that we human beings complicate existence with unjust structures and prolonged silences, but knowing this doesn't lighten the load. Sometimes, these complications cease to be abstract concepts and become real walls that envelop us, trap us, and steal the momentum we need to move forward.

>Hoy me encuentro en ese punto muerto, navegando en un mar de sentimientos encontrados que no sé cómo nombrar. Se cumple exactamente un año desde que me suspendieron el sueldo, trescientos sesenta y cinco días de una incertidumbre que se siente como una sombra constante. Ha sido un año de \
, de estirar lo inexistente y de encontrar fuerzas en lugares donde ya no quedaba nada, todo con el único fin de no permitir que el mundo me vea derrumbarme.

>
Today I find myself at that impasse, adrift in a sea of ​​conflicting emotions I don't know how to name. It's been exactly one year since my salary was suspended, three hundred and sixty-five days of uncertainty that feels like a constant shadow. It's been a year of gritting my teeth, stretching what was nonexistent, and finding strength where there was none left, all with the sole purpose of not letting the world see me crumble.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmfYjqg9xxtFarMnKDkYDNSdcceohyAD7JB1ih1iDPEmar/image.png

>Es extraño y doloroso mirar hacia atrás y ver todo lo que he tenido que sortear para llegar a este aniversario que nadie quiere celebrar, he sobrevivido, sí, pero el cansancio de sostener esta fachada de fortaleza empieza a pasar factura. Siento que estoy en una encrucijada donde el deseo de seguir adelante choca de frente con la realidad de un sistema que parece haberme olvidado. Hoy no busco respuestas heroicas, solo el espacio para reconocer que, aunque sigo en pie, el camino ha sido increíblemente duro.

>
It's strange and painful to look back and see everything I've had to overcome to reach this anniversary that no one wants to celebrate. I've survived, yes, but the weariness of maintaining this facade of strength is starting to take its toll. I feel like I'm at a crossroads where the desire to keep going clashes head-on with the reality of a system that seems to have forgotten me. Today I'm not looking for heroic answers, just the space to acknowledge that, although I'm still standing, the road has been incredibly hard.

>Mis días han sido grises, pero también de color de rosa, como dice la canción, porque, a pesar de las adversidades, he tenido la dicha de estar rodeada de personas que realmente me aprecian y eso me hace sentir bendecida, ya que he podido contar con el apoyo de ellos. A pesar de que mi rostro refleja entereza y mucho temple, debo confesar que soy de las personas que se quiebran fácilmente aun cuando nadie lo note. A medida que van pasando los años, nos volvemos más sentimentales y, cuando se trata de situaciones que nos sacan de nuestra zona de confort repentinamente, es más difícil asimilar la situación.

>
My days have been gray, but also rosy, as the song says, because, despite the adversities, I've been fortunate to be surrounded by people who truly care about me, and that makes me feel blessed, as I've been able to count on their support. Even though my face reflects strength and composure, I must confess that I'm one of those people who break down easily, even when no one notices. As the years go by, we become more sentimental, and when it comes to situations that suddenly take us out of our comfort zone, it's harder to cope.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmZoP24iCNsUzm8UeDyPqDxqrcDGR5QyxjG1eiPtNACfGQ/image.png

>Hace un año mis planes eran otros muy diferentes a los de ahora; realmente ahora siento que no tengo planes, mi rumbo no tiene camino definido. Es que ni siquiera he pensado, porque me siento en un laberinto sin salida que me tiene agobiada, porque estoy estancada y no sé cómo continuar, después de tenerlo todo planeado, calculado y hasta soñado.

>
A year ago, my plans were very different from what they are now; I truly feel like I have no plans at all, my path is adrift. I haven't even thought about it, because I feel trapped in a maze with no way out, overwhelmed by the chaos. I'm stuck and don't know how to move forward, after having planned, calculated, and even dreamed everything through.

>Parece mentira que un día podamos estar medianamente bien y al otro día estemos tan mal, pero así es la vida, muchas veces cruel y otras llena de miel. Ahora no tengo ni la más remota idea de cómo continuar porque mi mente justo hoy está demasiado abrumada reviviendo momentos que deseo olvidar, pero por ahora debo enfrentarlos para poder continuar. Sé que existe una salida y, aunque por ahora no la vea, llegará ese momento en el que podré libremente continuar.

>
It seems unbelievable that one day we can be doing reasonably well and the next day we're feeling so awful, but that's life—sometimes cruel, sometimes sweet. Right now, I haven't the faintest idea how to go on because my mind is completely overwhelmed today, reliving moments I wish I could forget. But for now, I have to face them so I can move forward. I know there's a way out, and even though I can't see it now, that moment will come when I can freely move on.

>En medio de este laberinto de incertidumbre, he descubierto que mi único escape seguro, mi verdadera trinchera, es #Hive. Es el lugar donde finalmente puedo despojarme de las máscaras, ser yo misma sin juicios y drenar cada una de las emociones que me habitan a través de mis letras. En esos momentos donde siento que he perdido la brújula y la realidad me asfixia, escribir se convierte en el acto de resistencia más puro que poseo; es la forma de llenar mis pulmones de una energía positiva que el entorno me niega.

>
In the midst of this labyrinth of uncertainty, I've discovered that my only safe escape, my true refuge, is #Hive. It's the place where I can finally shed my masks, be myself without judgment, and release every emotion that dwells within me through my writing. In those moments when I feel I've lost my way and reality is suffocating me, writing becomes the purest act of resistance I possess; it's how I fill my lungs with the positive energy that my surroundings deny me.
https://images.hive.blog/DQmQui1ppBktmSEnmnBHGx3Fr1fh4MGSTquepTuYCuwJQPz/image.png

>Soy consciente de que mi motivación ha caído a niveles que rozan lo caótico, y que la chispa que antes me impulsaba hoy se siente apenas como una brasa tenue. Sin embargo, me niego a apagarme. Sigo aquí, escribiendo y compartiendo mis pequeños proyectos, no por compromiso, sino porque es la manera más real y tangible de mantenerme activa. Cada publicación es un recordatorio de que sigo presente, de que mi capacidad de crear permanece intacta a pesar de que el sueldo se haya detenido.

>
I'm aware that my motivation has plummeted to near-chaotic levels, and that the spark that once drove me now feels like little more than a flickering ember. However, I refuse to be extinguished. I'm still here, writing and sharing my small projects, not out of obligation, but because it's the most real and tangible way to stay active. Each post is a reminder that I'm still here, that my capacity to create remains intact even though the paycheck has stopped.

>Publicar es, en esencia, mi ejercicio diario de esperanza. Aunque no siempre sepa hacia dónde me dirijo, sé que mientras mis dedos sigan sobre el teclado y mi comunidad esté del otro lado, estoy construyendo un puente hacia algo mejor. Sigo compartiendo lo que hago para alimentar esa pequeña luz interna, confiando en que, poco a poco, esa chispa volverá a convertirse en la llama que me guíe con claridad hacia un nuevo comienzo.

>
Publishing is, in essence, my daily exercise in hope. Even though I don't always know where I'm headed, I know that as long as my fingers are on the keyboard and my community is on the other side, I'm building a bridge to something better. I keep sharing what I do to nurture that small inner light, trusting that, little by little, that spark will once again become the flame that guides me clearly toward a new beginning.

title.title: Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time Sega Dreamcast Preview Posted
title.body:
Decompile projects are wonderful projects. They allow wild things such as porting console games to PC or other platforms without emulation. This means better overall performance. It also allows for modding the games in ways the original publishers and developers never intended. In the last week there have been two Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time announcements. This sone is for the Sega Dreamcast, the other was for [the original PlayStation console]( https://hive.blog/hive-140217/@triverse/zelda-ocarina-of-time-port-to-sony-playstation-a-reality-somewhat).

Ocarina of Time Running on the Sega Dreamcast

Of course, back in the day no one thought this would ever be possible. Yet, here we are. As you can see from the embedded video below, Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time runs quite well on the Sega Dreamcast. There are some graphical glitches, which is to be expected with these types of things. It is an unofficial port of a game that was unofficially decompiled (which can produce errors in the code). This is not a source code port which would possibly work even better. Then there are mods that are possible. Fans could theoretically create their own quests for Link. Replace Link, or any other character/object with something else and just have fun. The options are endless with these types of ports. Things that emulation just would not allow. Plus, the host platform can offer better graphics than was originally possible. This is evident with N64 game ports to PC where things are just cleaner looking, and HD graphics packs (something some emulators could offer) help as well. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j2JTcDY9LI4

What a Decompile Project Can Do

Decompile projects basically do as the name suggests. They decompile game code and make it readable by a person. Most games are developed in C++ or C#, some programmers can understand machine code and prefer it, for most that is above their capabilities, or time to learn. Once the program is back in a readable format it can then be ported to other platforms. This is how we are seeing various Nintendo 64 games get ports to Sega Dreamcast, PC, etc. Emulation is an option but it slows things down as the emulator has to convert everything to what the host platform can understand. This means lower frame rates on consoles such as the Sega Dreamcast when playing N64 games. Also, it is impossible to play N64 on the original PlayStation. Unfortunately, there is no information on the developer of this port. TheSegaGuru stated he knows who it is but the developer has asked to remain anonymous. There is also no build available, it seems we will have to look from the outside in on this port.

title.title: How Yoga Sculpt in NYC Combines Strength Training and Mindfulness
title.body:
![Music Driven Yoga.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/1aa1be97ea17c950ab788be2ae9bb4740c2058a15103b04f680bf5847fd90c5f)

If you’re in New York City, especially, where everything is go-go-go, it’s easy to forget that health and wellness isn’t just about how strong and toned you are physically. [Yoga Sculpt in NYC](<https://www.verayoga.com/
>) is one such new trend that’s become quite the fitness fad, combining the effectiveness of intense strength-training with the meditative, soothing poses of classic yoga. Not only does this blend assist in lean muscle growth and muscle recovery, but it also provides practitioners with a fuller connection to their body.

## The Essence of Yoga Sculpt NYC

Yoga Sculpt NYC is a dynamic approach to fitness by blending power yoga, light free weights, and cardio. Unlike typical yoga classes, which just use experience of flexibility and breathwork, Yoga Sculpt uses hand weights, resistance bands, and body weight exercises to lose cellulite, tone your muscles, and metabolism. The exercises are created to work as many muscle groups as possible at once, while adhering to yoga’s essential rules of slow, thoughtful motion and proper breathing.

 

This hybrid workout meets a common fitness desire: how to develop strength and stamina without giving up mindfulness. The integration of strength-building moves means that the body is pushed out of its comfort zone, with yoga elements that promote concentration and mental equilibrium. Such balance is especially crucial in a city such as New York, where stress is a birthright and time is luxury.

## Mindfulness Meets Muscle in Every Session

One of the beautiful aspects of Yoga Sculpt NYC is maintaining focus on the training itself. Students are encouraged to continue to focus on the breath, alignment, and muscle engagement. This emphasis prevents injury and makes the most of each move.

 

Mindfulness in Yoga Sculpt is not only about being in the moment while working out, but also holding onto that during the other 23 hours of the day. For instance, controlled breathing, which you learn in class, can help you handle stress and boost concentration when you’re out of the studio. Mindfulness can be combined with strength training to give you a complete fitness experience by doing good to both your body and soul.

## The Role of Breath and Alignment

Yoga Sculpt NYC does not lose sight of the importance of breath work. Every workout is synced to the rhythm of breath, which increases oxygen flow to the muscles and improves overall performance. This technique resembles what you would do in a normal yoga class, where breath helps you move and concentrate.

 

You should also have the right kind of alignment. Whether in a plank, lifting your weights, or moving through your yoga shapes, controlling your form helps muscles engage safely and effectively. This small detail helps reduce the possibility of injury and furthers the effectiveness of your resistance training workouts.

## Combination of Yoga and Strength-building

In NYC's competitive landscape of fitness, Verayoga provides a more sophisticated style to the practice of Yoga Sculpt, focused on the integration of strength and the spirit. The teachers at Verayoga are known for their ability to challenge students of all levels to work harder and get stronger while finding mental balance.

 

Providing all-encompassing health benefits, both physically and mentally, Verayoga’s “ Yoga Sculpt” classes are perfect for those looking to combine traditional yoga with modern strength training. The practice doesn’t only create toned muscles, it also fosters resiliency and calmness — both must-have traits for succeeding in New York’s high-stress landscape.

## Benefits Beyond the Physical

The physical benefits of Yoga Sculpt NYC are immediate—muscle toning, endurance, flexibility, but the mental benefits are even greater. Regular sessions help to decrease anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and bring emotional stability.

 

There’s also a mindful element to Yoga Sculpt that can teach you patience and self-love. These attributes extend to life beyond the surface, enabling individuals to better respond to challenges with style.

## Who Can Benefit from Yoga Sculpt NYC?

Yoga sculpt is appropriate for a broad range of fitness levels and goals. Whether you're seeking to supplement your current yoga practice with an alternative form of strength-training or you're searching out a disciplined workout regimen that requires nothing more than a mat and two weights, Yoga Sculpt brings on an effective, results-oriented workout at home.

 

For beginners, lighter weights work best, along with basic postures that can be intensified as strength (and confidence) builds. Meanwhile, more experienced enthusiasts may create challenging schedules and use heavier resistance to keep developing.

## Conclusion

Yoga Sculpt NYC isn’t just another fitness fad: it’s a balance of strength training and mindfulness in one. Combining the two means that practitioners achieve a workout that not only shapes the body but also nurtures a healthy mind.

 

Especially in a city that is famous for its pace and chaos, Yoga Sculpt provides a channel to re-align, feel strong, and experience deep stillness. Whether it’s in studios like [Verayoga](https://www.verayoga.com/tribeca/) or elsewhere in New York City, this meditative workout is changing the game, showing us that strength and mindfulness can harmoniously live together.

title.title: The Lost Cosmonauts
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYHEcgUmseHW4gXVZMFb7XZYEaNuAnt7SkYJoobAS3KwL/bubble_6_.png)

I believe that there are certain stories that the governments do not want to be known to ordinary people. And when I read the theory of the Lost Cosmo-nauts I had a very unpleasant sensation that sat long in my chest. It does not appear as a conspiracy theory to me. I think it is the story of human beings who might have sacrificed their lives and lived to do something great and it was just erased out of history as though they never existed. 


The two nations were in need to show that they were superior and more superior than each other. In 1961, the Soviets had already stunned the world by launching the first satellite then the first human being Yuri Gagarin into space. However, there is a theory that there were other cosmonauts that had been launched into space before Gagarin and they had not returned. And Soviet government following this theory just erased them out of all records.

What made the theory more serious was due to two Italian brothers by the name Achille and Giovanni Judica-Cordiglia. They were amateur radio operators and were intercepting radio signals in space at that time and had constructed their own listening station in Turin. They testified that they have intercepted some disturbing transmissions. Among these recordings they said they had obtained were those of a heart beat of a human being which had died away. The other was supposedly the voice of a woman speaking the Russian language and growing more and more agitated as though she was of great distress. They thought these were messages of lost Soviet cosmonauts who had lost their hope of being rescued as they were dying alone in space.

I have heard some of this recordings and I would be honest to say that it influenced me in a manner I did not anticipate. I cannot say exactly whether they are real and not. Yet the fact that a living human being was drifting in the emptiness of the universe, making a distress signal which nobody was coming to save is something that I cannot easily get rid of. I suppose the majority of the folks would feel the same had they actually given the thought a little time.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYG6qpyhDNoydzoJQAzMdRaUG9Y8LtzugX4crBiLTe7MU/bubble_7_.png)


The Soviet government never gave a nod. They insisted that Yuri Gagarin was the first human to travel to space and that all their missions to space were explained. These claims were examined by numerous researchers and historians over the years and the majority of them came to the conclusion that there is insufficient evidence which could support the fact that the cosmonauts were being lost and concealed. When the Soviet Union fell a lot of classified documents were declassified and no concrete evidence to show missing cosmonauts was discovered within these documents.

I believe that the lack of evidence is not necessarily identical to the evidence of the absence. Governments have concealed inconvenient facts in the past and they will do the same. The Soviets were also known to Photoshop individuals out of the pictures and rewrite history to their liking. Had they been able to do that then concealing the deaths of a few cosmonauts would not have been so hard on their part.



The politics and the space race do not have the same effect on me about this story. It is the human part of it. In the event that a single individual was launched into space with the knowledge of the dangers and then he/she lost their life and was wiped out of history, he/she deserved an improvement. They had the right to be remembered. Their sacrifice should have been recognized.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYcWwC1LyuMbu97ncWnmVMEbGrAwTxPZbB7k73tqEFT2x/bubble_8_.png)


To tell the truth I do not know whether or not the Lost Cosmonauts existed. But I can tell that the thought of dying in the dark and the world forgetting you was one of the most lonely I ever had.

title.title: Del Reflejo Digital al Refugio del Alma: Un Viaje Entre Versos y Distancia/ Julio Pratts/julioe007.
title.body: # Del Reflejo Digital al Refugio del Alma: Un Viaje Entre Versos y Distancia ✍️✨\n\n**[\

]** 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTuQsgCyEQqg4Y8Ac1tV77PcVdgg1L8ZNx9mg5ADQCrSL/1773110770583.jpg)



### Introducción
A veces la distancia se mide en kilómetros, pero la cercanía se siente en cada palabra compartida. Estos dos poemas nacen de esa espera y del puerto seguro que encontramos en la persona amada, incluso cuando un océano intenta separarnos. Dedicado con todo mi sentimiento a **Julieta**, quien es mi guía en este camino.

Hay amores que no se explican con mapas, sino con latidos que atraviesan la pantalla. Esta nueva entrega es un testimonio de la paciencia, una promesa escrita en el aire digital que espera convertirse, muy pronto, en piel y presencia. Para Julieta, el norte de mi brújula y el motivo de mis versos.
---

**[ \

- La videollamada en el celular]** *Visualización artística de nuestra conexión digital.* ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfDiXHyqyDd7TSoZjvBAth1uMzNsA7c4nhvBCzd7MaMQd/1773110510014.jpg) ### 1. Reflejos de un Mañana Compartido
En el marco digital de un instante,
se detiene el mundo y la distancia,
no hay frontera que sea tan gigante
como el peso de tu dulce fragancia.

Tus gafas guardan un brillo de aurora,
y en tu sonrisa, el mapa de mi hogar,
eres el centro de mi ahora,
el puerto donde quiero descansar.

Un océano nos separa en el mapa,
pero en este cuadro somos uno solo,
el tiempo entre nosotros se escapa,
mientras unimos de norte a sur el polo.

Falta muy poco para el primer abrazo,
para que el cristal deje de ser frontera,
estamos tejiendo con fuerza este lazo,
viviendo una eterna y feliz primavera.
--- **[S \

- Pareja en el sofá con la manta]** *El rincón exacto donde el tiempo se detiene.* --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6KfL2Zr9iaFQFNrNac61mSEHS8V3eNg8nrLro4aMx6b/1773110578044.jpg) --- ### 2. El Refugio de tu Pecho
En el silencio de este mundo ruidoso,
mi cuerpo ha encontrado, por fin, su destino:
ese rincón exacto entre tu hombro y tu calma,
donde el tiempo se detiene y la vida cobra sentido.

Eres la paz que le sigue a la tormenta,
el puerto seguro donde mis dudas se duermen.
Al sentir tu frente apoyada en la mía,
entiendo que no hay lugar en la tierra
donde mi alma esté más completa que aquí,
envuelta en el círculo sagrado de tus brazos.

No necesito palabras cuando cierras los ojos,
porque en el latido que compartimos,
te digo todo lo que el corazón no sabe callar:
que eres mi casa, mi luz y mi descanso,
y que entregarte mi vida es el acto más libre
que he realizado jamás.
--- **[\

- Primer plano de las frentes unidas]**
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUCVYnXaqss3CWaPmsLRnnJoGqGcWefRYZfW8Jopxs8r2/1773110678797.jpg)


### 🌹 Dedicatoria Especial
> **Para Julieta:** El mapa de mi hogar y la dueña de mis silencios. Aunque hoy el mundo nos separe, estas letras son el puente que mis manos construyen para llegar a ti cada noche. Eres la prueba de que el amor no necesita presencia física para ser real. Te amo, hoy más cerca que ayer.

>**Porque eres la calma en medio de mi tormenta y la luz que atraviesa cualquier frontera. Si el mundo nos puso distancia, fue solo para demostrarnos que nuestro vínculo es capaz de conquistar el espacio. Estas letras son los ladrillos de la casa que habitaremos muy pronto. Te amo en cada píxel y en cada silencio.
---

### 🎨 Nota sobre el Arte Visual (IA) 👀
Las imágenes que acompañan este post han sido co-creadas mediante **Inteligencia Artificial Google (Gemini)**, buscando materializar visualmente nuestra historia:
* En **\
**, plasmamos cómo la tecnología se convierte en un portal, rompiendo la barrera del cristal para unir dos polos.\n* En **\

**, la estética se centra en lo sensorial: tonos cálidos y texturas que evocan la paz de un abrazo real, eliminando el ruido del mundo exterior.

---

title.title: Lessons Beyond the Ring — How WOO Preserves Wrestling Wisdom
title.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

As the final post in this series, it feels fitting to step back and reflect on what Perry Saturn’s candid discussion and WOO’s platform itself truly offers to fans and aspiring wrestlers alike. Through Saturn’s lens, we saw how vulnerability, humility, and resilience intertwine with the athleticism, showmanship, and drama that define professional wrestling. This final instalment explores the lessons that extend beyond the ring, the role of WOO in amplifying these insights, and the personal reflections that fans like me take away.

>*Watch WOO's very own Perry Saturn and his latest \
video over at [THIS LINK](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x2axwPQ3FPM). The theme for this latest video production is \

*

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23uQpCEKY9b1ovQMD5kxZYraHKvzmBEwoSThhRmwRSkqmbwWRiEWURVyZQDMz9XsyekvX.png)

---

## The Power of Honest Storytelling

Saturn’s honesty was striking. From discussing past drug use to physical decline and emotional volatility, he left nothing off-limits. But there was no attempt to seek pity or excuses. Every admission was framed with accountability and self-reflection.

This is the kind of storytelling fans rarely get from standard wrestling media. Most highlight reels and “legend interviews” emphasize victories, memorable promos, and championship moments. While entertaining, they rarely reveal the human cost or the learning that occurs behind the scenes.

WOO provides that rare, unfiltered perspective. By giving veterans a platform to speak openly, the organization ensures that the full narrative, triumphs and struggles alike, is preserved. For fans, this is not only fascinating, it is educational. It allows us to understand why wrestlers behave the way they do, what drives them, and how their careers shape them as people.

---

## Resilience as a Core Value

One of the most prominent themes throughout Saturn’s discussion was resilience. He described homelessness, physical deterioration, drug struggles, and the challenges of aging, yet he emphasized gratitude and personal growth.

This narrative serves as a reminder that success in wrestling, and in life, is rarely linear. Mistakes, setbacks, and failures are inevitable, but how one responds defines character. Saturn’s story embodies resilience. He faced his lowest points without giving up entirely, and WOO ensures that his lessons reach a broader audience.

---

## Physical Costs and Lessons Learned

Saturn’s candid discussion of his injuries, metal hips, shoulders, and elbows, illustrated the physical toll wrestling exacts. These are permanent markers of dedication, risk, and sacrifice.

For aspiring wrestlers, this is a critical lesson. Physical preparation is essential, yes, but equally important is understanding the long-term impact of repeated stress on the body. Saturn’s story highlights that recovery, maintenance, and smart decision-making matter as much as talent or charisma.

---

## Emotional and Mental Preparedness

Another insight that stood out is the psychological preparation Saturn undertook nightly. He described evaluating locker room dynamics, considering potential conflicts, and preparing responses. While intense, this mental exercise was part of his survival strategy.

This aspect of wrestling is rarely documented. Fans witness only matches and storylines, not the emotional labour that keeps the environment functional, competitive, and safe. WOO captures that complexity, showing that mental preparedness is as critical as athletic skill.

---

## Mentorship: Legacy Beyond Personal Glory

Perhaps the most inspiring part of Saturn’s reflections was his emphasis on mentorship and teaching. While he can no longer perform at the same physical level, his impact continues through the younger wrestlers he guides.

Mentorship creates a legacy beyond championships and matches. It ensures that knowledge, technique, and professional ethics are preserved and transmitted. WOO’s platform amplifies this aspect, highlighting that a wrestler’s influence can extend far beyond their in-ring career.

---

## Gratitude Amid Hardship

Saturn’s reflections were tempered by gratitude. Despite past struggles, he emphasized the privilege of having pursued his dream, travelled the world, and built relationships. This perspective is both grounding and inspiring.

It reinforces the idea that life in wrestling, though challenging and often punishing, also offers unique rewards. WOO’s documentation of this duality, hardship and fulfilment, adds nuance to the narrative of professional wrestling. It reminds fans that the people behind the personas experience life fully, with both joy and adversity.

---

## WOO’s Role in Preserving Cultural Memory

Across all ten posts in this series, a pattern emerges: WOO functions as a cultural archivist. It does more than entertain; it documents, contextualizes, and preserves the wisdom of wrestling legends.

By capturing honest reflections, WOO ensures that the stories behind the spectacle endure. These stories inform, educate, and inspire. They demonstrate the human element of wrestling in ways highlight reels never could.

---

## Final Thoughts: Wrestling as Life Lessons

Watching Saturn reflect on his career through WOO has reinforced an important lesson: wrestling is more than scripted matches, storylines, and championships. It is a lens through which to examine resilience, accountability, mentorship, and personal growth.

The platform’s commitment to honest storytelling transforms these narratives into lessons we can all carry beyond the ring. For fans, it deepens appreciation; for aspiring wrestlers, it provides guidance; and for the industry, it ensures that the human experience behind the spectacle is preserved for posterity.

This episode, and WOO’s broader approach, underscores that the legacy of wrestling is not measured solely in victories, belts, or accolades. It is measured in lessons passed down, struggles endured, and humanity preserved. That is the kind of content that inspires fans, sustains cultural memory, and sets WOO apart as more than a platform — as a true steward of wrestling’s story.

---

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

title.title: The freaky red fish (oil on paper)
title.body:
Hello hivers, an happy Tuesday to you all! Another sunny day here and after a couple of windy hours now the floor of my backyard is totally white thanks the petals fallen down from my plum tree. My little furry friend Bimba is sleeping under the brancjes of the tree and so there are many white petals on her body too. 😁 Yesterday, in the afternoon, I teached art to the kids. Now I have 4 students from 7 to 10 years old and even if it's not so simple to focus their attention on their drawings, they are all very friendly and sweet little boys and little girls. I use to teach them in a funny way, following their interests and talking with them while they work on the paper with the pencils. I know they like to draw with me, because at the end of the lesson they ask to their parents to stay with me for more time and it's really a sweet sweet feedback for me (even if after 2 hours with all of them my ears need to rest for a little 😃 ). ❤️ Today I worked on a new idea for a painting and so I worked on the following scene: ![DSCN9285.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EogPoQhcy61D7e9wUfqJbGuYQeWRk9Akg7pVTWY2eRGxY8bCC7awNExo3fdpWGX48Mx.JPG) ![DSCN9286.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EpA4ueZJ7FAy1jF1pRmKokaWQPCZ6eDN8rHhJqxPTwFRwt5mSPrhmYB5C5VrH7jUKRg.JPG) It's a freaky red fish with a tiny scenes about a paper boat on the body. I like the final result, so I 'll work on a new similar scene as soon as possible. It's an oil colors painting on 200 gsm paper in A4 size and, like I use to do when I share a new piece with you, I took some pics while I was painting it: ![DSCN9280.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoEqVW7wiRyS4nUZLyYCVbRjHVQd3X1Jef4QJVm8jdsznxv9cFo2VMhQtAK1geR5NnF.JPG) ![DSCN9281.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/Eoc7WWNZUAWFpgwtMYgVvfwnFMUB3i5mncjNUjWPtzhPJ63KsNtnXmjLC4tMyiHcRbv.JPG) ![DSCN9282.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/Eokd4N7jLqwQBfbBGmmdCzEQHmx7r4zaxq7Jt4P3PATqbQtwKDaQMHTi1Rk2tSxjpT4.JPG) ![DSCN9283.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/Eokd6DNmZeWHCXB9hsKdGyXqxKpmfQUp5UF8YbNFHD5i8GMGEhW1te9wuyXsNAnnGxT.JPG) I hope you like it! title.title: Mostly Laundry and Mud - March 9, 2026@goldenoakfarm
title.body:
![Laundry supervisor crop March 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EoEqVb91S9ASfjpJo1aoGpYNt3FU4nNHemP7PaVhraHwWx7ZP8qfvcH8Ko9SPPZrYVU.jpg)

On Monday morning I sure wasn’t moving too fast. I was up at 5AM and got laundry started so I’d have something to wear to exercise class. I was closely supervised because he’d decided it was breakfast time. It wasn’t, not for an hour.

By 8AM I had decided it wasn’t brilliant to go to class, then to an event, then PT, then do a estate class in the evening. So I called my neighbor and said I wasn’t doing exercise.

I spent the morning getting my post up and doing lots of laundry. I’d decided to do all the bedding so I had lots of loads.

![Mole tunnels crop March 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EopsugBz6AsJmszgw8NdgDzDByYDfHf4C7HmTNqHKRa7baCjH4dNJaGUZE9Qq6ixKh6.jpg)

*Mole tunnels from under the snow*

![Winter Ducks March 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23u6Q5VSm8mbWwN5Gd8eKZxYPuLfytzowJvaee5aV4Krh79benrrFQxVhLXnUnfHpoGgg.jpg)

The event was Winter Ducks and she had nice photos of males and females and taught us to look for field marks when trying to identify birds. From there I went to PT where I worked hard because I’d skipped exercise class.

![Mud and snow collage text crop March 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/243WVXLeP1f4nEbYzw5FHkwPA47EiLTRuB6aS9Y38yXQqHAmNQ6nKjSVtu9iopAum5Wsm.jpg)

The driveway is just a mess of mud and snow but it’s nowhere near as bad as when we first moved here in 1983. Back then we had to walk in the mud to the barn in the spring because it was so deep we couldn’t drive. All the 100 lb grain sacks were carried up the driveway as we had horses back then.

By the time I got home the snow had mostly melted from the South garden. That’s a protected area facing south. But the big gardens are still deep in snow.

![South - snow nearly gone collage text crop March 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EpA4rqquLjr3exQMMFbp2kvujH8wQQUruNokuY85TZRM3fMUReC6FXUwN2jEN7qT69Y.jpg)

![Gardens in snow collage text crop March 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Eopwko7QLbbkEZSTwYV2NUgJLpX6yeVgqeiFKQhkysCvjSy5hDc97i9tY3AaWRhhDv1.jpg)

I sat down and rested a while then made supper and got the shades pulled early and the fires laid. Then we got the laptop working for the estate class. That went really well and I got 2 pages of notes.

They also sent a copy of the slide show and a recording of what the business advisor said.

![Back Porch garden crop March 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23zbS37YdH1ysLgcwmmRWiLrCXbAJ71Mur36S6ofMbPQA42wjnCfy7LbNwtij83EEhm92.jpg)

The Back Porch garden has been mostly clear for a while, so maybe I’ll get to that in the next couple days.

![Liars collage text crop March 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xpEvo671wi5DR6QXV6VNJTWfQbqYxaxSV8yLDp1EbmVn52kVMa7ACvW6xVAmPME5r5f.jpg)

I checked the temperature at 6PM and that’s what these 2 read. I think the north one was probably correct for a change. (Both of these are new!)

I finally got to bed at 9:30PM once the stoves were going well. I had nearly finished all the laundry washing and drying.

On Tuesday it’s to hit 70F so I am hoping to get out in the gardens again and clean out at least the South garden. My helper friend is coming for 10:30AM and he has errands and chores and watering house plants to do. I’ll probably be outside. I have an appointment late afternoon.

I’ll have to light the stoves again and I hope I can get to bed earlier.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

title.title: So much for having the surgery scheduled
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQmMms4492fD5FR8wF81pCGQFLmC3gFxLAtar5BHZV5Ai/a_cartoon_illustration_of_a_menacing_pod_l7dd_osrthsvjirvvqohsa_ysohplgpqp_wxtcwncksfq.jpeg)

Image created with ideogram
I am beyond livid and just..exhausted and defeated.

Don't worry the PIXYDUST launch s still happening as scheduled, I'm just not getting my surgery.


This is Johns Hopkins supposedly one of the best hospitals in the world. Let me tell you how it's been going.

I do want to say the doctor himself was excellent but his staff is completely incompetent and I don't say that lightly.

I try to give everyone a second chance. We all make mistakes, but there were 3 major fuck ups I've been dealing with. Let's start a the beginning.

Keep in mind I have received no pain care even though the #1 symptom of this tumor is..pain. Mine is more complicated than usual and is  damaging my nerves, bones and tendons. All verified via x rays and MRI. I was under the impression the surgery was supposed to be done late  mid-February.  


1. They \
to schedule the biopsy I needed before surgery. Yes ,\

is a direct quote.That's right we waited 2 weeks for a phone call from  the department that does biopsies only to find out the ortho office never bothered to send the referral..to the office downstairs from them.It was supposed to be sent STAT. That cost several weeks delay. Weeks of excruciating untreated  pain.

2. They scheduled the surgery without a consult . i was told after the biopsy I'd get a telehealth  or phone call ot go over the surgery, make preparations, ask questions and possibly schedule it that day too.  We need some paperwork for my husband to take leave from work and that was supposed to be discussed then too.

That appointment never happened. They scheduled the surgery without even asking if the date worked for me. What the actual F?

Just for reference this is borderline if  not outright malpractice here in the US. This is not standard  or care. I have never in my life heard of a surgery being scheduled without the patient's input or a consult. This is a major , complicated surgery.


3-  I was even willing to forgive that under the assumption I would still get a pre op appointment with  the doctor before the surgery. I am that desperate for this to be over.But that's a while other issue. It's not happening.

They gave me  3 weeks notice on the date. I need to have a pre op screening/clearance from my primary care doctor before surgery. It is required and not negotiable. So we scrambled to get the one opening he had.

Guess what? The ortho office never sent us the required paperwork. Not only did I have to cancel the appointment with my primary care doctor I also had to pay a cancellation fee because of the other office's incompetence.


It gets worse. Somehow.

My husband called to get the pre surgery paperwork (not the patient's responsibility. this should have been taken care of by them and sent to my  primary care doctor) and he was then told they \

and that's why the surgery was just scheduled  without even talking to me. This makes no sense as the scheduler is not the doctor and after surgery consults sometimes you get same day scheduling but usually the scheduler calls you in the next few days if they were not available that day.

Are you fucking kidding me? You are telling me John's Hopkins doesn't have phones or computers or a set up for telehealth? (they do, obviously) . I would not have done the biopsy or continued with  the surgical plan if I knew they wouldn't provide telehealth. It's a disability accommodation required by law. Also the opposite of what the doctor told me and my husband at the first appointment. (the hospital  is in downtown Baltimore .Not easy to get to for a healthy person )

The woman at the office  never sent the paperwork for my other doctor and I had to cancel the morning of and I was charged a  cancelation fee.

Now not only do I not have a surgery date i need to start over with another surgeon. Months wasted in severe pain for nothing.

If they can't do the basics of their job, tasks they do every fucking day how the hell am I to trust them to do the surgery? It's also now impossible for me to get surgery on the selected date because there is no time for the pre op check from my PCP(I still don't have the paperwork anyway).

So now I am just here suffering more every day, the tumor is growing and is causing permanent damage and these delays have already caused harm.  It will  likely be at least 2-3 months for me to get the surgery I need  at the absolute earliest if I can find another surgeon. It will probably be closer to 6 months to a year with how slow our medical system is here.

I...am devastated. I...just can't anymore.

title.title: Maize Field Update: Smart Use of Urea, Humic Acid and Sulfur for Strong Crop Growth
title.body:
‎ ‎
‎ ‎
‎AssalamuAlaikum & Greetings Hive Family! ‎It's me @amjadsharif
‎ ‎Maize Crop Update | Water, Urea, Humic Acid and Sulfur Application in My Field ![1000197795.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amjadsharif/48XfS6yXwg6FtKMLUs6Zck2SbGdfxitSMMm2TSS5M5PGhPHthfR86avjeU4G1xMqfw.jpg) Agriculture is not just a profession for me but also a responsibility. When we sow seeds in the ground, we also sow hope that after a few months, this same land will give us a good yield. That is why I take special care of my crop at every stage and keep sharing its updates from time to time. Today I want to share with you the current situation of my maize field and the fertilizers and water application in it in detail. ---
Maize Cultivation and Seed Information
I cultivated this maize using a drill. The advantage of cultivating using a drill is that the seeds are planted in a straight line and the distance between the plants is also appropriate, which makes it easy to care for the crop and water it. At the time of cultivation, I also added a sack of DAP fertilizer to the soil using a drill. The aim was to ensure that the plant gets good nutrition from the beginning and its roots can become strong. In this field, I have used the hybrid maize seed DK 6321 Maize Hybrid. This variety is quite famous for its good yield and strong growth and is also liked by the farmers of our area. ---
Waterings Applied So Far
![1000197520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amjadsharif/23wqnfXPMkMJ71iHJk5bAGfMUkr3Gcf4s5ffStkrTrukq8xvN5bqR1fr9E4jM4BLP5G6P.jpg) ![1000197519.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amjadsharif/23wCDiM3dBBjpuRi46kzbtHjcwaoLCYyNsQ4cs7GbXTDfv5DhMCsprP3ofCB3qEs1CKCd.jpg) So far, this crop has received four waterings and, thank God, the condition of the crop is looking quite good. Timely watering is very important in the maize crop because lack of water can affect the growth of the plants. After each watering, I inspect the field thoroughly to know the condition of the plants and what else they need. ---
Using Fertilizers with the Last Two Waterings
In the last two waterings, I used different fertilizers for better growth of the crop. First, I used a bag of urea fertilizer which was divided into two parts. Half a sack of urea was added with one watering, while the remaining half sack was added with the next watering. Along with this, I also used four liters of humic acid so that the soil condition improves and the plants can easily absorb nutrients. Similarly, I also added one kilo of sulfur so that the soil fertility remains good and the nutritional needs of the plants can be met. Along with all this, I also sprayed to prevent the attack of caterpillars so that the crop can be protected from damage. ---
Application of Fertilizers with the Current Watering
Recently, I have given my field another watering and added some important nutrients with this water. ![1000197516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amjadsharif/Eo8TH9BwKcx5LQAR2GMmCBUGdGRBHH5JEmPqPhMtAHT2k9qwKpHj9BaRwicRdFMHFD5.jpg) This time I have used one sack of urea fertilizer. Along with this, eight kilos of granular humic acid were also added to further improve the fertility of the soil. ![1000197515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amjadsharif/EoeFuFZBJsbqqwyzkNPTcWMu2trR1gu7qd2AQDMkgEF22bcpRMHx8WS7HeBMZbNmv6j.jpg) Similarly, two kilos of sulfur were also added. ![1000197517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amjadsharif/23w2ikVVBq7uuyH4EbMbTtutQdoGxFEbcbWhx4nJq9mFWwTGcgtNNNYzHQBLXE1m2KS4b.jpg) ![1000197518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amjadsharif/23vsQXwVAUuwqvowJ6fMofxFTsFo3QvNu4EAF35w9E3SgktAKNyVsyLBQCvDF2tHVwp2V.jpg) I first mixed all these things with water in a drum to prepare a solution and then released this solution into the field through water. In this way, the fertilizer spreads easily throughout the field with water and the plants get uniform nutrition. ---
Weeds and Herbs in the Field
![1000197449.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amjadsharif/23wqgD3a8ZAiCQQh85FpLVQ6FYRwr6tg14kDYH4HeorB7zQQap9EG4noUCGoppnMEwpnR.jpg) ![1000197450.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amjadsharif/23zGaZvwDmLwXEqK4AFrwKfqZ2jLZBrrjRVFJDFHAgprBSjRDK3QTa5nPDDyEHkLWj25i.jpg) You can see in the pictures that some wild grasses and herbs are also visible in the field. If this grass grows too much, it starts competing with the crop and also uses more nutrients and water from the soil. For this reason, I have decided that in the coming days, a spray will be done to eliminate the weeds. I will share complete information about this spray and its results in my next post. ---
Current Condition of the Crop
![1000197700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amjadsharif/241tWqaXYMqBjFvHB7DYMYB9Bzdd6HD6KcbkKRNEDxjzdTu1uNUABhKZiN261YkU6fGT3.jpg) ![1000197701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amjadsharif/23uFXvYWBvrta7ywgqnTwRMhY9hoCBsB7Wasdfr5KiRaUYWp6PPQgi4g6ZKj9xJotS4Ac.jpg) Alhamdulillah, the condition of the crop is looking quite good at the moment. The leaves of the plants are green and healthy and the growth is also happening at a reasonable pace. ![1000197704.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amjadsharif/Eq5Ex3akF8jEcg7CqcKX2R9rCPtjGwgF4nsH9VLPue6sRiGxTbzgFaUFRhprMK5FNnD.jpg) If timely water and fertilizers are used in the same way, it is hoped that this crop will improve further in the coming days and yield good yields. ---
Conclusion
Hard work and patience are very important in the life of a farmer. After sowing seeds in the ground, we constantly take care of it and hope that Allah Almighty will reward us well for this hard work. I will continue to share my crop updates with all of you in the same way so that the farmer brothers who read this post can also benefit in some way. ‎

body.title: A Simple Beer Date With My Husband At Wacky's Restobar!🍻
body.body:
**Hello my dear beer lovers all around the globe!**👋😍 

**Hello to all of my friends and hivers here in this wonderful @beer community!**🍻

**How are you all today? I hope everyone is happy and doing fine right now. This is @lj1728 and it is actually my first time posting here and I am so excited to share my simple beer stories with you all!**🤎

![Beer date @ wacky’s.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23u6HwRQdEUjGmwHjWDoKmFXqXeiwPTeh6xV4HAgodCpWtqPJfQ9Smm6reaR6XpnRXaWZ.png)

Today I want to share a simple yet special moment when my husband invited me on a beer date. Sometimes the best dates are the ones that are unplanned and effortless. Late in the afternoon, he casually asked if I wanted to go out for a drink. Of course, I said yes right away! because it had been a while since we had a quiet moment together outside the house.

![IMG_0470.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wX1AkaYzxxuB9Jvodb7kTh8HzmcgQBvUoxp2khVaJD5svgibUUtYc4kfdLaurxGNZ1F.jpeg)

We decided to go to Wacky’s Restobar, one of our favorite spots near home. What we love most about this place is that it's just within walking distance. There's something nice about being able to take a short walk together, especially when the weather is good and the afternoon feels calm and relaxing.

![IMG_0460.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23z7NJ72NDF8M3BweVVzFEjKCsbqebiyztuKyaMdXm1hzBqUXhohbzXkV1rXiRtsGNrhC.jpeg)

![IMG_0443.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23zGm6ABvhZ9rptXCyh8nqEMmN8Z75gqrTHbbaCDFhWn9uNyTEAniDgPWcGGAWHnaKPWF.jpeg)

We arrived there around 5:30 in the afternoon. The place was already lively but not too crowded, which made the atmosphere perfect for a simple date. As usual, we ordered our favorite drinks. My husband chose his favorite beer, Red Horse, while I ordered San Mig Apple. I really like the sweet and refreshing taste of San Mig Apple, especially when I just want to enjoy a light drink.

![IMG_0459.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23u66viZ4YgMunKqTkqpM6ABXAPVVGojK5R34CthbV9ySM8pbLyFxG7JrXAUrZjRxftUA.jpeg)

![IMG_0453.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23x1FkPg7KfarbHaEMhu2NxtoTXYHwbpZYsqT9HLrd4nedwrE31HnMxbU1wQHqRoFVyL4.jpeg)

Of course, the beer date would not be complete without some delicious food. We ordered fried tungol, which is one of our go-to dishes whenever we visit the place. It was crispy, flavorful, and perfect to pair with our drinks. We spent time talking about random things like our day at work, plans for the coming weeks, and even funny little stories we remembered from the past.

![IMG_0448.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23tmQA3v7BYJj2SZXR5XUAoUoVirC3bMtDEWzjfsr2c9Wofw2oGVt1x37Jg5pH4w6GRfG.jpeg)

![IMG_0451.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23xVPfYx9aBqetp8ov7sVktKbzSZUejebJqixGSeczDTQ5VU4WDyBXN3dsDaB2URAWweK.jpeg)

We stayed there for a while, slowly finishing our drinks and savoring the quiet bonding time. Before we knew it, all the bottles were already empty. After settling our bill, we simply walked back home together. It was such a simple beer date filled with love and connection. 

**And that's it for today's blog!** 😍

**Thank you so much for dropping by and taking the time to read my simple life story.** 📖✍️

**This means a lot to me! I hope you enjoyed it and see you on my next one. Have a nice day ahead to all of us.**💞

**These photos were mine and taken with my iphone13pro and the lead image was edited through Canva.**👩‍💻

**Lots of love,
LJ**💗
