body.title: Built an Intelligence Platform to Map the PizzaGate Network — pizzagate.online
body.body: **Ad coelum or a caelo usque ad centrum**\n\n

>Nobody asked me to do this. 😱 I invited myself. 🎊 Over the past weeks, I've been working with AI (Claude by Anthropic) to systematically transform (@mes) Mathiew Estepho's 32-part PizzaGate research series into an interactive network intelligence platform. Mathiew, known as MathEasySolutions (MES), spent 13 months between December 2016 and December 2017 producing one of the most thorough, critically sourced, and methodical investigations into institutional pedophilia, intelligence blackmail systems, and media complicity ever compiled by an independent researcher. His work doesn't shout. It documents. Court records. Sworn witness statements. Police files. Federal filings. Audio recordings. Search trend data. And he was careful — flagging unverified claims as unverified, questioning even sources that supported his thesis, and dedicating an entire part (Part 7) to teaching his audience how to research critically and spot disinformation. >

>
That work deserved better than being scattered across

>32 PDFs that most people will never read.

\n\n

>What the Platform Does 🗽 **The application is a fully interactive network analysis tool** — the kind of thing you'd see in an intelligence briefing, not a Reddit thread. It maps 79 entities (people, organizations, concepts) connected by 107 documented relationships across 54 chronological events, all sourced with Part and page number references back to the original documents.

>Network Graph — Every entity is a node. Every documented connection is an edge. You can zoom, pan, filter by cluster (Podesta/Clinton, McCann Case, Intelligence, Media, Pedophiles, Whistleblowers, Organizations, Occult, and Concepts), filter by Part number, search by keyword, and toggle to show only critical links. A force-directed layout option lets the topology speak for itself. An evidence heatmap overlay color-codes nodes by verification level.

\n*
>Concept Nodes — This isn't just about people. The platform maps systemic patterns: the weaponization of the \
term (Google Trends show it rising simultaneously with \

— not after), the intelligence blackmail system (confirmed by Ken Livingstone's audio about MI5 filming child abuse at Kincora for political leverage), the posthumous exposure pattern (Freud, Savile, Heath — all exposed only after death), platform censorship coordination, pedophilia normalization in academia and media, and psychological operations including controlled opposition.

\n*
>Google Trends Visualization — A chart showing the \

search curves overlaid, based on the Part 13 and Part 24 analysis. The simultaneous spike — not sequential — is one of the strongest pieces of evidence that the counter-narrative was pre-planned.

\n*

>Timeline with Swimlanes — 54 events from 1970 to December 2017, viewable as a standard chronological list or as parallel swimlanes showing McCann, Podesta, Intelligence, Media, and other tracks running simultaneously. This reveals connections invisible in a linear view.

\n*

>Witness Credibility Matrix — 8 key witnesses rated across four dimensions: professional credentials, independence from involved parties, corroboration with other evidence, and potential motives. From the Gaspar couple (two NHS doctors, CONFIRMED) to Ronald Bernard (single-source, UNVERIFIED).

\n*

>Financial Flows — Documented money trails: the $850K Brock/Grey blackmail payment, Eichenwald's $2,000 check that directly funded child pornography production, $53M in federal funds to ACORN, £12M spent on Operation Grange, and more.

\n*

>Geographic Distribution — 12 key locations across 7 countries. The network spans Washington DC, Praia da Luz, London, Belfast, Hollywood, Haiti, Dundee, and beyond.

\n*

>Part 31 Integration — Previously missing from the dataset. 127 pages covering the Harvey Weinstein saga, the NYT's suppression of Sharon Waxman's 2004 exposé, Hollywood victims (Feldman, McGowan, Witherspoon, Elijah Wood, Terry Crews), Dan Schneider, and Roman Polanski's standing ovation from the same industry that later erased Weinstein.

\n*
>Path Finder — Select any two entities and trace every documented connection path between them. Works for concepts too — you can trace the path from \

and see the chain of documented links.

\n*

>Complete Parts Index — All 32 parts with dates, page counts, and node/edge counts. Every claim in every dossier entry is referenced with [Part X, pg Y-Z].
Full PDF Archive — A download link to the complete 32-part PDF archive on Proton Drive is embedded throughout the interface.

\n\n

>Why Switzerland 🇨🇭 I live in Switzerland. The [Swiss intelligence service](https://www.vbs.admin.ch/en/intelligence-service) (NDB — Nachrichtendienst des Bundes) didn't ask me for any of this. I'm volunteering it. **Here's my reasoning:** this material documents a system that operates internationally. The UK (MI5/Kincora), the US (CIA/Vault 7/Epstein), Portugal (McCann), Haiti (Clinton Foundation/UN), France (Rothschild/Macron), Hollywood — these are not isolated national scandals. They are nodes in a transnational network that uses the same documented methodology everywhere: **identify compromised individuals, record their activities, use the recordings as leverage.** **Switzerland sits at the intersection of international finance, diplomacy, and intelligence.** If this system exists as documented — and the evidence ranges from court convictions to audio recordings of a former Mayor of London — then Swiss intelligence should at minimum be aware of its structure. I'm not an intelligence operative. I'm not an investigator. I'm someone who read 32 documents totaling over 1,000 pages, used AI to build a tool that makes the connections visible, and decided that the appropriate thing to do is **make it available to people whose job it is to evaluate this kind of information.** >

>
If it's nothing, they'll know. If it's something, they should know.

\n\n

>About the Original Research 🕵️ All credit for the underlying research goes to Mathieu Estepho (MathEasySolutions / MES). His 32-part series was published between December 4, 2016 and December 30, 2017. The PDFs are available for download through the application. ** What makes his work different from most PizzaGate content:** *

>He rates evidence levels (Confirmed, High, Moderate, Low, Unverified) and is transparent about what is speculation vs. what is documented in court records

\n*

>He dedicated Part 7 entirely to research methodology — how to avoid disinfo traps

\n*

and focuses on the systemic patterns rather than any single location

\n*
>He questions his own sources — noting when claims from allies may be \

despite WikiLeaks being the source of the emails that started the investigation

\n\n>

>That intellectual honesty is rare in this space, and it's what made this work worth building a platform for.

\n\n
>The Technology 📡 Built as a single React JSX file (~1,500 lines) using Claude AI as a development partner. Seven major versions, each adding layers: *

>v4: Core data, concept nodes, Part/page references, Proton Drive links

\n*

>v5: UX overhaul — background deselect, mobile touch, breadcrumb navigation, keyboard shortcuts, URL deep linking, edge hover tooltips, sticky filter bar

\n*

>v6: Data expansion — Part 31 integration, witness matrix, financial flows, geographic data, Weinstein/Hollywood nodes

\n*

>v7: Visual enhancements — Google Trends chart, force-directed layout, mini-map, evidence heatmap, timeline swimlanes

\n\n
>The AI didn't write the analysis. It organized, cross-referenced, and built the interface around human research. Every data point traces back to Mathieu's original PDFs.

>PDF Archive (Parts 1-32): Also available via download button in the application 🕵️

Nobody asked. I showed up anyway. Because when you see a system documented this thoroughly and you have the tools to make it visible, staying quiet is a choice that can fill an empty grave. * * * Tags: #pizzagate #investigation #intelligence #switzerland #hive #openintelligence #networkanalysis #ai #whistleblower #pedogate #research #transparency

body.title: Chilly, Sunny, Pedals, 18.75 Mile Bike Ride, PRs, Graupel, Frozen Ground - Monday
body.body:
Rather nice sunrise yesterday morning as the clouds were getting blown away quickly. It didn't take long before the sky was clear for much of the morning. ![IMG_20260309_073244.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/242DG4obZNWqgv5TDemq69M6gjRBNr6wrVcxXGxfgQRJWCrvgVwqsGXZC8sysiAuoK1FT.jpg) ![IMG_20260309_074135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23zGcimyzpXMePyhHxn8t8WNNR4dtU1UJWJNvBa4kqot98gLH33g5raT3dbTY3qswo83f.jpg) Did a quick print of the base for the Q5 brake light I got for my bike. This will allow me to attach the light much easier. ![IMG_20260309_103029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23u62k993aVoF5SbmCsB9CgsMRWxC8i6KKviFMUqZgsUjGnZS1AJt7tFK78Vf6aaZmNXr.jpg) ![IMG_20260309_103944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23uFPqSxpSZVYy4gh56qpWo8RHR15wGC9JU6oe7wL4iVRYnnFxLzQKq1vMxoo6MhfFc2q.jpg) I had headed to the garden mid morning to see about tilling more but found the soil still hard and not nice and loose and tillable. I lobbed a bunch of the rocks that were exposed over the fence and went back to the house. My pedals finally arrived around noon and I got them swapped out quickly. They are killer having the dual sides so I can ride normal or with my cycling shoes. ![IMG_20260309_123827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wX1BFD46bAUdweoUKaNqvQzjh8AxJ5F1eCzdw1eMj4GUN6XCnagK6H4t4ZgrQaWfC6M.jpg) It took me a bit to figure out how to clip in to them and the tension had to get adjusted badly, likely still needs more... ![IMG_20260309_123835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wWyKDc6LinKuCaqGUa3B7iHgHasA3uF5ws8nWbE98mU2Gk3i7rWLVDeZpCCV4dEq6ko.jpg) So I got ready and headed out for a ride after evening my tires out at 50 psi each which makes the ride a good bit faster. Can go up to 60 psi but that removes any cushioning the tires might give on bumps. I chose the path as I went and the shoes/pedals make the effort feel a bit different, easier in a number of ways. ![IMG_20260309_131058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wCBsCnXUo4cJm4k69BW31PFDxL2PquzsnjnfNWjefdoDq83pLQLm2xmthe6S4mW8ue9.jpg) I am able to apply more power to each pedal stroke now that I can use the other 180 degrees of motion. ![IMG_20260309_131105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wgKZGbxz9cE5wJUrdjuoV4UcSCGVviQf5nZCFkfo3kgDGaTzkQTnRW8RY2wFdeBFQTe.jpg) Over 9 miles into the ride I began getting pelted by little tiny snowballs falling from the sky. You can't quite see them but they were there. At first I got hit in the face by one and thought it was a bug until I saw more falling. This was riding along Deer Park/Milan rd which made me want my bike helmet which was delivering. ![IMG_20260309_133849.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wgHkjBAmsFsmubBsk6CjRwP56gU7FPPw1tY8Fqzr4dJeMd1C7phmipKF4XvaZoi6e3a.jpg) Headed south on Perry then west on Westmoreland to Cedar where I headed south to Owens. The clouds were a lot thicker and the little cells were streaming across the region. ![IMG_20260309_135047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/2423wZxvYoG3cQPGtnMK8irNnCYt4tTK9rz19mFQcJR5hKd9ZDskB9eBLYygQdnCZC7tg.jpg) ![IMG_20260309_135121.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/243frUz2cqWnRhkeo1tZbT1oFWmiG5N4M7jmRZkDXdtZKYtFcFwv2FAJmhA7x1oB7o7Q7.jpg) It worked perfect, I was riding back down our road as Amazon was delivering. 18.75 miles in 1h30m was rather good. ![bike 3-9.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tkjm2QdEaxLuGUkG5XkMXHuzBxvLBW5c5xPGXaW1ykNsmPCS5nyQSNJ2N7VaqJrLw8E.JPG) I even managed a few PRs. 5 mile, 10 mile, and 30k. The 5 mile was the end of my ride with the most downhill... It makes me want to go do laps on the Perry straight mile to see if I can get down to the 15-ish minute range for 5 miles. ![bike 3-9 prs.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/EpC3a1ctiJKrt8oFXLxFY2oAq72KKgz17YVmTcYaV9cRuBQXPYXhy3BUMomuAi2vxhn.JPG) I've got my eye on a bike trainer that will allow me ride inside when the weather is utter shite. I am willing to spend the $175 for one that doesn't require a subscription and will connect to my Garmin watch with the Ant+. The new brake light for my bike is really nice and really does well at night, when I am less likely to be riding much. Daytime it is still quite visible and will help for my rides amongst traffic. ![IMG_20260309_190617.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23uFMapHojYi8J9XLP3uj1j1fjYGqB8QfbzPdcahhSyLQPavFK2eFiD5imRXS86diCigK.jpg) I wish these weren't such one-offs in the session. Trying to get more consistency in the visits. ![IMG_20260309_201743.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vsL5eGWWXMRKjR9tTzFg2hJEVCyRsxJ9JjEYLnrfemSye5aQGxcgU43sUsGkVLzh4MF.jpg) 26F this morning but clear so should warm up a bit this morning. Boys to school soon, weekly session in a couple hours, will get a ride in, work in the garden, dailies/practices, roll a bale to the sheep, and reset mouse traps around the house. ---

body.title: El poder del orden/Como es adentro es afuera (Esp/Eng)
body.body:
>



![ Brown Floral Vision Board Photo Collage_20260309_231925_0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmStzHLFpA8xmH52AaPYDtpPKk7XGHc7rKMTPmquSMnmwg/%20Brown%20Floral%20Vision%20Board%20Photo%20Collage_20260309_231925_0000.jpg)

#

### Saludos amigos de Holos&lotus 

#

Despues de leer  la publicación de @damarysvibra sobre el poder del orden, me parecio muy acertado  lo que ella señalaba en relación a la importancia no solo de mantener un orden en nuestro entorno sino también en nosotros mismos, internamente. Y es que ambos estan relacionados.

Y para analizar  este tema, lo relacioné con esta  frase  **Cómo es adentro es afuera** la cual  tiene un significado espiritual pero también físico y mental. 

Según  la ley de la correspondencia, \
[Jung,1929], hay una interrelación entre el plano físico, mental y espiritual que es lo mismo,  que entre el cuerpo físico, mental y espiritual.\n\nEn otras palabras, \

.

Atraemos lo que pensamos y esto se manifiesta en nuestro entorno.    La comprensión de estas relaciones, nos lleva por tanto a tener un mayor control de nuestra vida, para un mayor bienestar. 


![Ingredientes_20260110_153742_0001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSZ8MuTunutemsgPkYcwWG9wbyGDqa8Ac5pkdz6jv5xC2/Ingredientes_20260110_153742_0001.jpg)


Aun cuando en determinados momentos puede haber un desorden tanto en la mente como en el entorno, el hecho de que esto se haga permanente y se acepte como  lo normal,  tiene consecuencias en el equilibrio cuerpo-mente-espíritu. 


<center>![20251226_093508.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT6Gpzg6kuZ8rosmcTm9W1DwChMFNibgnJitngHr6yrxc/20251226_093508.jpg)</center>


Por ejemplo en la convivencia con otras personas.  En ocasiones he tenido que convivir con personas que no le dan importancia al orden y la limpieza y esto me he generado conflictos.  Ahora he comprendido , que esto es muchas veces  el reflejo de una problemática  familiar y a veces debido a desequilibrios emocionales que se reflejan en el  descuido del entorno. 

#### Porque el cansancio y la falta de energía puede estar influyendo en el orden tanto interno como externo.

#


La convivencia de personas con diferentes habitos con respecto al orden del lugar donde habitan, puede llegar a ser intolerable. La persona que considera el orden muy importante para su bienestar,  se sobrecarga de trabajo tratando de mantener su espacio ordenado y se agota física y mentalmente,  al tratar  de que la otra persona cumpla con los mismos hábitos. 

 La otra persona se fastidia de que le llamen  la atención constantemente  y  aún cuando pudiera cambiar, puede ser que no  lo haga porque se ha acostumbrado a vivir así y posiblemente mantenga esa costumbre,  a menos que de esto afecte fuertemente su bienestar y estabilidad y se vea obligada a hacerlo.

Mi hija tuvo esa experiencia por varios años cuando vivía en un apartamento con habitaciones en alquiler.  Tenía una lucha permanente con las otras personas por mantener el orden, porque ella es una persona  muy ordenada, hasta que tomó una decisión pensando en su bienestar.  Se mudo. 


![Ingredientes_20260110_153742_0001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSZ8MuTunutemsgPkYcwWG9wbyGDqa8Ac5pkdz6jv5xC2/Ingredientes_20260110_153742_0001.jpg)



El orden mental tiene un gran poder en nuestro equilibrio y bienestar y se  manifiesta  en la salud física, mental y espiritual o viceversa, el orden espiritual mejora el orden mental y físico. Todo está conectado. 

Me sucede que cuando no me siento bien  por algún problema que me esté afectando, el orden de mi entorno me ayuda a mejorar. Me dedico a  limpiar y a organizar la casa. Cuando la veo ya ordenada y limpia me siento mucho mejor, es como si de alguna manera estuviera organizando mis pensamientos y emociones.  

Por el contrario el desorden en mi entorno puede afectar mi estabilidad. Siento que mi energía disminuye y hasta emocionalmente me afecta y me pongo de mal humor. 

***

<center>![IMG-20260111-WA0069.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUh7mjW9hkcrFhWHLnjHZNqibjdd4oQjnnAme8nT9rVGU/IMG-20260111-WA0069.jpg)</center>

#### Estas son algunas actividades que me ayudan a retomar mi orden interno cuando por alguna razón se desequilibra. 

#

🌸La meditación y los minutos de silencio porque me ayudan a controlar los pensamientos. 

🌸Hacer ejercicio aunque sea en la casa cuando no haya tiempo de salir. 

🌸Las oraciones diarias de agradecimiento. 

🌸Pintar mandalas me ha ayudado mucho a concentrarme y a tranquilizar la mente. Pero además desarrolla la creatividad. El jugar con los colores y las formas es una actividad donde también prevalece un orden. 

🌸Hacer listas de tareas pendientes me ayuda a organizarme.

🌸El contacto con la naturaleza. Cuando vistamos un lugar natural donde no hay la intervención del hombre, allí no vamos a encontrar desorden. Cada árbol,  roca,  hierba, y cualquier otra forma de vida está donde debe estar. Hay  un equilibrio  y eso nos proporciona una gran sensación de bienestar. Nos sentimos de maravilla y nos recargamos de buenas energías. 


<center>![IMG-20260310-WA0021.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYrRCRCts89k2mB8rWZvP6j3KKDps3MUFRakkouRD4kn5/IMG-20260310-WA0021.jpg)</center>



#### El orden natural 

#

Hay un orden en todas las formas de vida,  en la materia y a mayor escala también en el universo. 

En la naturaleza nada está fuera de lugar, cada uno de sus elementos guarda un orden establecido por  un poder superior y  los cambios que se suceden,  obedecen a las fuerzas que se activan para mantener el equilibrio. 

Este ejemplo lo traigo para que nos ayude a comprender que el orden en nuestras vidas tambien puede establecerse basado en los cambios que experimentamos, no debe ser tan rígido, sino que debe permitir que las normas que nosotros mismos nos hemos establecido, varíen en función de nuestro bienestar y el de las personas que conviven con nosotros.

![Ingredientes_20260110_153742_0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXzmGnv9jVDz8aMkc4eM3youZE6wEgPKaF87bCw198N1T/Ingredientes_20260110_153742_0000.jpg)


Agradezco mucho que hayan llegado hasta acá y con mucho gusto leeré sus comentarios. 


![Ingredientes_20250417_141236_0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYUZEPZuFZqR1f927oXPmcGYx48zHBGE6uHM3GBG3AeNx/Ingredientes_20250417_141236_0000.jpg)

***

The power of order/ What is inside is outside. 

I was reading @damarysvibra's post about the power of order and what she pointed out regarding the importance of not only maintaining order in our environment but also within ourselves, internally. 

And to analyze this relationship that exists between our interior and exterior in relation to order, I turn to this phrase, “What is inside is outside,” which has a spiritual meaning but also a physical and mental one. 

According to the law of correspondence, “one of the Seven Hermetic Principles, which are based on the teachings of ancient Egypt and Greece but were formalized in the Kybalion, a book published in the early 20th century,” there is an interrelationship between the physical, mental, and spiritual planes that is the same as that between the physical, mental, and spiritual bodies.


In other words, \
It really shows how careful planning and the operator’s role can make the results more accurate and useful.

body.title: 为什么穷人永远完不成原始积累
body.body: 底层穷人为什么始终完不成原始积累，为什么一辈子都挣扎在基本生存线？ 我们会发现很多人，即便工作几十年，仍旧没有存款，很多甚至还负债累累。难道是他不想存钱吗？不是，难道是他工作不努力吗？也不是，难道是他一直没运气赚到钱吗？也不是，，

/>

那是什么原因导致，底层的我们这么穷？ 《稀缺》这本书对这个问题有一个论证，底层人群难以完成资本积累，不只是收入低，而是长期稀缺让他们始终被迫处理短期生存，没有足够的心智带宽去维护长期增长。 资本积累需要剩余、耐心、规划、试错空间和抗风险缓冲，贫困者最缺的恰恰就是这些。

今天学到一个新词叫带宽，长时间工作的人是没有机会发财的，因为每天的劳动时间就压榨了大脑的开发，也没有尝试的想法。 当一个人工作就已经耗尽了心力，那么他是没有勇气去学习新东西的，当然也对新机会视而不见。

当一个人为了下个月的房租，生活费发愁的时候，他是没有其他机会的，他首要是解决眼前的生活。 所以我们需要提升，孕育一个生命只需要十个月，那改变自己，十个月也未尝不可。前一篇说的，提升自己的单位时间价值，让自己变的更值钱，从事更高价值的工作，带来更高的回报，让自己有更多结余，然后投资到伟大的公司。

富人为什么越来越有钱，本质的原因是钱在为他工作，电影1942，老张说，即便我身无分文，给我放到一个地方10年我还是东家。 这也算是社会的底层逻辑，大家的起步有高低，但是成就可以很高，起点可以很低，但结果可以美好。 史记有云，无财作力，少有斗智，既饶争时，十二字箴言，每个人都应该铭记于心。

body.title: Why Is It Called Military Beach?
body.body: [Yesterday I told you about the cheeky little thieves](https://ecency.com/hive-194913/@russia-btc/a-monkey-robbery-at-the) we met on the beach and promised to explain why this place is called **Military Beach**. The beach itself is officially known as **Sai Kaew Beach**. It is located about **25–30 km south of Pattaya**, in the **Sattahip** area, and the drive from the city usually takes around **30–40 minutes**. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNpssxLomK6nbkZEkgLj5MKz36ASxRjEkcCYtxSGcDLuJ/dsc04525.jpg) The name “Military Beach” comes from the fact that the area belongs to the **Royal Thai Navy**. The beach is located on the territory of a naval base, and for many years it was used mainly by the military. Even today the entrance to the area is controlled through a **checkpoint**, so every visitor has to pass through the gate before reaching the beach. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeARm8BMa8ghFCMGL5kdWoBQJ7r8ei9UcCjEndnzbVhN2/dsc04502.jpg) Because the territory is managed by the navy, the beach has remained **much cleaner and quieter** than most of the beaches in Pattaya. The water here is clearer, the sand is lighter, and the surrounding hills covered with tropical trees create a calm and relaxing atmosphere that is quite different from the busy city beaches. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP3FgyiBZ5WHugKojP4uPt1rF93pcn5JSUcjE7cBvPKio/dsc04503.jpg) There are also a few simple rules for visitors. The entrance costs about **100 baht**, and sometimes you may be asked to show **an ID or passport** at the checkpoint. Visitors are also asked to keep the beach clean and avoid loud behavior. Thanks to these rules — and a bit of military discipline — Military Beach is considered one of the **cleanest and most beautiful beaches near Pattaya**. --- ## A Small Photography Experiment This time I came prepared. I brought **three different lenses** with me and decided to experiment a little with my camera settings. To be honest, not every photo turned out the way I imagined. But that’s part of the process. ||| |-|-| |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXR6M5ujev8mH294JQwh83PXx8eL29FiSdyNzGvngD5KY/dsc04533.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ9to34b4gZJeCbQnywsPsiGaYDvxYoFmftkEzimBJb8R/dsc04546.jpg)| I tried shooting in different conditions — under the bright tropical sun, in the shade of the trees, portraits, full-body shots, and a few spontaneous frames in between. The funny thing is that when you're standing there on the beach and looking at the tiny camera screen, it’s not always easy to understand whether the shot is really good or not. Everything looks more or less fine at first glance. ||| |-|-| |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdkvgCTMdEB6MFtu3vMitdJ9XYqNxCr8LUKXoMSzN9Smc/dsc04549.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRHyxwkxTaJgPYjYMMW9hVnMsmyjp67fcPpxkCeQHzp1j/dsc04555.jpg)| ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXTzkix9BTWYnfhyn3qjwHCcW194qB23D8S2nNSiRdJnw/dsc04552.jpg) Only later, at home, when I start sorting through the photos on a big screen, I begin to see the mistakes — where the light was too harsh, where the composition could be better, or where I should have chosen a different setting. ||| |-|-| |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ5V4d5WJEVj42K1UpjTviRcFcVLERcX6rqwXEQ7dnrHw/dsc04557.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmercpEJfPSxzNezWuJKd7XntAXxdarwWFPJPKikxCVXfQ/dsc04558.jpg)| But that’s exactly how experience appears. The more you shoot, the more you start to understand what works and what doesn’t. ||| |-|-| |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVhj14j7NU9d2MUhXhc1Cj2xn6AWmbRYdfxBsxS1JRGMb/dsc04568.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNtJ9w6CttUY5oDSHtJwsDCFHky5HUT2K9RpothNF4zLT/dsc04579.jpg)| Photography has honestly become **one of the most fascinating hobbies I’ve ever had**. ||| |-|-| |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQGaDs2vHYrpDU3q42AgucU36uX2TwLKVcp8JNS8fBSrN/dsc04581.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSp1Tp46v9mCWrzGXaW36jEDQvxc127BgZejJRsMDstTs/dsc04582.jpg)| So if you enjoy taking pictures too — **don’t be afraid to experiment.** Sometimes the most interesting shots appear when you simply try something new. ||| |-|-| |![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWQyhQodrbjwGpTG7JhqRzUGwqCWX8iyFWFzd4qEvAZA2/dsc04588.jpg)|![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmadnTCEAzjw3DZLSHKXHUyT4CQnCfGtoua8fqYja92R4s/dsc04589.jpg)| Thank you for your likes, your comments, and your time. It never goes unnoticed. * * * _I write my texts myself, correct mistakes and translate via ChatGPT (which is not a violation on Hive)! All photos were taken by me personally - I am a beginner photographer, so I ask professionals not to judge strictly._ * * * **_Thank you for sharing these moments with me! body.title: When Dark Doesn’t Mean Bad
body.body:
There are times when I look back at the photos I took and feel like they turned out extra dark. At first, I used to think that meant I messed up the shot. Like I didn’t capture the “right” light. But over time, I realized something: dark doesn’t automatically mean bad. For me, as long as the contrast feels right, a darker image is still okay. Sometimes the shadows are what give the photo its mood. The highlights don’t need to be loud if the dark tones are doing the work, holding the frame together, directing the eye, and making the subject stand out. In black and white, this becomes even more obvious. The world turns into light and dark tones, and everything depends on balance. That’s what I noticed in these photos. The small plants, the leaves, and even the tiny details like a droplet hanging from a wire, these moments feel stronger when the contrast is emphasized. The dark background makes the subject feel more focused, like it’s stepping forward while everything else fades away. It’s a quiet kind of drama, and I’ve grown to appreciate it. And honestly, it feels similar to how life works. Life is filled with challenges, and there will be days that feel heavy, uncertain, or “too dark.” But just because a season feels dark doesn’t mean it’s a bad season. Sometimes it’s the contrast that helps you recognize what matters. Sometimes the struggle makes the small victories shine brighter. For every dark tunnel we go through, there is always a light at the end of it. The important thing is not to stop moving. Keep moving. Have a good day ahead. *** ![1000105798.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoGr85TjXfiKdm1p8L3ZV982Q1vzLCJupspbntvcvLH4BFDPnr2x69QtfLAt9zWEs1s.jpg) ![1000109975.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/EoCgG96GjB5C5zUAJXNSGAb9MYmkqW4w5C2uFmjRbBUusonPmxSKeDhmcStMEMegmbn.jpg) ![1000109962.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo1xuu4c91yWgUt7TW3suxFuNjABVsdQPPijHLQCaW1FFSL7MgupsMgsi77fxkfxbTb.jpg) ![1000106211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/funtraveller/Eo1vNTV65LbPeeGeEtDZga3hd3QbueBh7yq57nhWkCzwSAF5wLZ2mpr9FZw6mb6dRFj.jpg) ***

”To see in color is a delight for the eye, but to see in black and white is delight for the soul.”

*~ Andri Cauldwell*

How this Works

Unlike those communities in the incubation program where curation is focused, this curation initiative is spread out. This will help find undervalued posts from smaller communities that deserve support.

This song shows us the other side of love, which can often become dependent and therefore painful. It was popularized by Jimmie Davis in the 1930s and has been performed by a wide variety of artists, who have done everything from children's versions to emotional ones like Christina Perri's, who took it to another emotional level. In most cases, it is sung in major keys, but its melodic structure tends to descend, evoking the sadness related to the lyrics, even though it is sung in an affectionate tone. This, among other details, allows the song to be used as a lullaby for a child, a promise to a lover, or a lament for someone lost, relating the universal human experience of love to the fear of losing a loved one. Its ability to evoke such emotion with such simple words makes it a masterpiece of popular music, a tune that lingers in the hearts of those who hear it.

body.title: Ube Donut Handmade Clay Keychain
body.body:
![Ube donut.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EouA7rWwy421hcDMxwLnF8v12fjiTgQhC2ciiTWAvSt74BpKX4EjfTKnp2bN4RKBNi6.gif)
Hello, how are you? When I was young, ube flavor or ube in general was not my type of food, but as I grew up experience alot of food, not bad.. and it is good for digestion because of its fiber, my mom always buys one and boils it, and just peels the skin and is ready to eat. One time, my mom came home with donuts because I think she bought or someone gave them to her, and I took a bite, wow, ube is good actually hahaha. Mind you, as a kid, I always ate halo halo and never realised ube is one of the main ingredients LOL. So I am going to make a donut clay keychain in ube flavor. -----
Materials I Used:

>
  • Polymer Clay
  • Glass Sheet
  • Weighing Scale
  • Brush
  • Gum Container Lid
  • Tree Brush Tool
  • Needle Tool
  • Soft Pastels
  • Makeup Brush
  • Eyepin

>
  • Liquid Clay
  • Palette Knife
  • Silicone Mat
  • Oven
  • UV Resin
  • UV Lamp
  • Disposable Gloves
  • Mask
  • Keychain
  • Pliers
-----
Craft Time!

> ![3.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eo8SsTuj2DzPHR2oiXty1QdbHXowJrqHT4Tdrd1VfEL28HSzVr2YmjucEQosLHLimg9.JPG) To condition the clay, I knead it using my hands, and when it is soft enough, I am going to weigh it. This part is optional. -----
> ![5.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpGQg9YW1m1Bhpx5V2h1RGmgZ9yQSYwzatsHe6LqDoyfQ8zRtfHgJ5J1LWHCZ7c8zxu.JPG) Then I shape it into a ball. -----

> ![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoyPZAuXq9jfrj53Gh53ZXH15qdxvGLAkZLTArheTA3a6TpUGfnhQrTw5HEG3UPSPqQ.JPG) And then I place the ball clay onto the gum container lid and use the tip of the brush to make a hole in the middle of the clay. -----

> ![11.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpJY9wkfjDPuLrb9PakeNyU3mNfeU2Dz8cFiyCTYbPGSC2TxY5p8y9ZCzD1ViCpGR3f.JPG) And then to add texture, I use the tree brush tool and then the needle tool. -----

> ![13.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowH8Z2VkajSFaHAcPTXPbpKwn9WfLa1qxYmqk5wauj6uzif5auHh6J7C272K41TsAx.JPG) To add shades, I use soft pastels and then brush, starting with a light color and then layering it more darkly. -----
> ![15.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eos2K5RDo2FV9xHAwA4MiBX2vYyav2dzqBEkDVAnnkW59TDXu98MHERSqZK3k7hYjZu.JPG) And then I added the eyepin. -----

> ![17.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoyP6zES4UssBuH8PR2haQuAQDeFtteBXV4QWoeMYDEj1uMxvKdHECetxXY59o7PJrh.JPG) To make the ube glazing, I mix liquid clay and soft pastel using a palette knife. -----
> ![19.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep1XvwkGqXncZ43sNuzx2M2GadwNAPYvaykCfZxq4UJ2xCmdhStNWzPfCRCM1ptvHmg.JPG) Use the palette knife to apply the mixture. -----

> ![22.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep3erwKJ2Cs4mtk5nA2mZtFfxBLQBE8pjkiLQBuPGxpvNye3sQrnvJ9LdtTxqJ3id3C.JPG) I should dry the first glazing because I did add the lighter glazing earlier, because it flattened onto the first glaze LOL. -----

> ![24.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogMpXCBsi6VKq77TfTx6kKcgsvHFCpnzZVMSRnFRKFopVdPtYYfXyfbL2JZFsV1Mkj.JPG) And then I bake it on pre heated oven and then set the timer and temperature as instructed on the packaging. After baking, I let the clay cool down first. -----
> ![26.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eos1ingUpPF82LPMnwwzAUv5Au58tkYVFd8uuz8rqAjh1fyESxa6XjDpSVVumF9p9Ck.JPG) And then I am going to apply resin onto the clay. -----

> ![28.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoptRcn1pPAkf4VqPs3kfxWniNr9oXeG9PNNyzD5f78T7dkeWgxCHpffUKsoe4eH6Ha.JPG) And then apply it using a brush. Make sure to wear disposable gloves and a mask. -----
> ![30.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowH9ZaJcwCaJVtXyVWYEk5yuQPu7TbnaKei7BsoiFDc8dTcDdg5KFdUQi31y8R8gk1.JPG) Then cure it under a UV Lamp for a few minutes. -----

> ![32.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpXLV1uXGMMn9cZ68Sij6j7zRLdGNj7N54tSeNE99mfSbN1e9UbqPZGAUNvpWqiws3f.JPG) To add the keychain, I inserted the jump ring along with it. -----

> ![34.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EouAEYiGAjjdef3V5KPaj5Fuyeiq63EyeMG4o26Wxv9me4eQzbrHqaejk6f7opH7AK9.JPG) Then lock it using two pliers. ------ ![IMG_6248.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eos2fqYARSiU1MfM8ESte7Zxx2X5Rz6B9jX4WGbtJykJh6dkYcLmkgX9AJkr5TkYgBr.jpeg) ----
Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))
---

body.title: How to Get a Full Office Transformation With Artificial Ceiling Plants and Faux Vertical Gardens
body.body:
/>

You know that feeling when you walk into a space, and it just feels alive?

That’s exactly what this project was about. The client wanted to take their commercial indoor area from a blank, functional space to a warm, welcoming, and full-of-life area. And with a few smart ideas and a will to execute them, they managed everything without stressing over watering schedules, sunlight, or wilting leaves.

This was all thanks to top-notch artificial plants.

This commercial client considered many options for the space before settling on artificial plants. The space was big, but the potential was even bigger, and they determined exactly what to do with it.

The Problem The client had a great indoor commercial spot from the start. But, even though the space was good, it wasn’t great. And since the staff would spend most of their day here, the owners wanted to make the area feel warmer and more inviting.

After speaking with a few interior designers, they determined that adding greenery would be their best bet at beautification.

They had already tried real plants before, but that didn’t go as well as they thought it would: the plants died, the room had light issues, and nobody knew if the plants had been watered or not. It was more trouble than it was worth.

So after a bit of research, the client realized that artificial plants could give the same lush, green vibe without all the headaches. And lucky for us, they ended up on our [comprehensive artificial vertical garden collection](https://designerplants.com.au/product-category/vertical-garden-green-walls/) and immediately saw the potential.

They then reached out to our team for a free consultation and a quote, and told us they’re doing a full fit-out. It was the perfect project to show how artificial greenery can transform a commercial space.

During the Process artificial hanging ceiling plant panel officeOnce we understood the client’s vision, it was all about making it happen in a way that looks real and effortless.

The client briefed us that they wanted greenery visible from multiple angles, not just tucked in corners. The challenge at the beginning was to find the perfect artificial plants that look real, feel lush, and require no maintenance at all.

We went through the project together, discussing:

Which plants would work best for the ceiling vs. planters How to create layers of greenery to make it look lush What colours and textures complement the space The client was hands-on but open to our suggestions, which made the process smooth. Our North Star was to achieve a balance of looks and practicality.

You can check the solution on this [link](https://designerplants.com.au/blog/how-to-transform-an-office-with-ceiling-plants-and-green-walls/).

body.body:
> Hello everyone, how are you doing today? Hope you are having a great time. This will be *Week 208 Edition 01* of our Weekly Featured Content. ![1000022457.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kronias/23zH3ihhxgjN5Ydxs9LGWWgZQUHDtgcBQZCamdrWRF3q1gTuLu6JsEXJYFCKhzJEwFpYZ.png)
Made With Canva
So, last Saturday we had our hangout as usual, and it was just so much fun that we did not want it to end. We are currently on the second topic for this week, which is “LEARNING/UNLEARNING”. But before we proceed with the details of the topic, let us take a look at the winners of the last topic, which was “A SIMPLE EDUCATION”. This topic was geared toward each member of the community, telling us their thoughts on the educational system of today and its highly competitive nature. The school environment should be conducive for everyone, not just physically, but also mentally. If students have to put themselves through intense stress just to make their grades, then it can’t be all that conducive, can it? We got to see that indeed, the main focus of a school should be imparting knowledge to the students, from academic to financial and social, the necessary knowledge that is needed to survive in today’s world. However, when everything is made to be a competition, and classmates are turned into rivals, it stops being about learning and becomes more about besting each other. And that’s only toxic. ***
> For this topic, we went through every entry post, and that is every post with the #hl-exclusive & #hl-w207e3 tag. And with the number of wonderful posts out there, it was quite difficult to make a selection. But eventually, we did just that. And so, the posts that will be featured not just for their exceptional content, but also for their level of engagement with other authors, will be listed below. ![hl_footer.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnAnsqHA4KMYRqnS9QzWMpQUxM71wRhKabXz7paozHKJ/hl_footer.png)

*This author told us that competition is always a good stimulus for getting better results. While students put themselves through the most stressful situations just to make good grades, it can’t really be considered a victory when the price that gets paid is in physical and mental health, and other lasting damages. The best way to tackle this is by finding a healthy balance.*

The struggle for top grades only leads to disastrous consequences, hence the need for a more balanced educational system that focuses also on the all-round well-being of the students.”

Such activities always end up leaving a mark.*

These posts were selected because of their special attention to detail and how they followed the topic. There were a lot of good ones out there, but we just could not pick them all. Honorable Mention

body.title: UNDERRATED
body.body: I do not think people talk about campus life enough. We only get to hear like 30% of what actually goes on in there because the remaining 70% can not be expressed in words. If it could I am sure it would have been exposed already. A lot of the time students are even too tired or too engaged to talk about the things really going on day to day. For the serious students, every day is an experience and for the unserious ones they can only escape a handful of that experience.\n\n

/> Photo by [ARTO SURAJ](https://unsplash.com/@artosuraj?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditCopyText) on [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/man-in-black-t-shirt-and-red-cap-sitting-on-black-chair-on-green-grass-field-02syzlcot1c?utm_source=unsplash&utm_medium=referral&utm_content=creditCopyText) I remember back in the day, my parents did not know half of the things I go through on campus. Perhaps because it was one thing to realize that telling them will only make them panic and there will be nothing done about it at the end of the day. As long as you live on campus as a student you are already exposed to a way of life that only you can explain and most of the time you do not even know how to begin to explain it. Asking for money is already enough for some students and the majority will agree that even that gets tiring at a point. It just dawns on you that you are alone here, and you must grow up to survive. I mean how much of the threats and abuse can you actually begin to talk about. A point comes when you just understand it is a system and unconsciously create your coping mechanism for it. You then begin to adjust to the whole thing and find your happy space because another truth is that it is not all that bad. In the process of trying to be positive you find a way to have fun, your fellow comrades in that hell become those you form bonds with and you all begin to look strong together. You leave campus and you just know you survived at the end of the day. > THIS IS MY RESPONSE TO HIVE STUDENT WEEK 33 [PROMPT](https://peakd.com/hive-109584/@hivestudents/hscpwk33-new-prompt-campus-life)

body.title: ¿Te has preguntado si tu cepillo dental es el indicado?Have you ever wondered if your toothbrush is the right one?
body.body:
![FXprLGAq0vohqIt2_1002554324.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/FXprLGAq0vohqIt2_1002554324/FXprLGAq0vohqIt2_1002554324.webp) ![NWUCkWgtFVHvlTAG_1002554322.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/NWUCkWgtFVHvlTAG_1002554322/NWUCkWgtFVHvlTAG_1002554322.webp) ![peRrXpExV3Pruz56_1002554319.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/peRrXpExV3Pruz56_1002554319/peRrXpExV3Pruz56_1002554319.webp) ![1Z4IxjFHhL3ZOMBs_1002554327.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/1Z4IxjFHhL3ZOMBs_1002554327/1Z4IxjFHhL3ZOMBs_1002554327.webp)
Amigos aquí les traigo un tip ya de adulta funcional jajaj en otro caso diría de señora, pero realmente es de persona que se preocupa por si mismo, hace unos días fui a traki, quienes están en Venezuela saben que hablo de una tienda donde venden ropa, cositas del hogar y demás que por cierto estoy por mostrarles lo que ese día compre Lo cierto fue que vi este trio de cepillos de dientes y no pude resistirme, desde hace un tiempito vi un video de mi odontologo donde da las recomendaciones de como debería ser un cepillo dental y los porque, es todo lo contrario a lo que conocemos y lo comercial que se consigue en las mayorías de tiendas y farmacias, obviamente tenía mis expectativas pero realmente era imprecible el hecho de sentir alguna diferencia
Friends, here's a tip from a functional adult, ha ha ha. In other words, a lady, but really someone who takes care of herself. A few days ago, I went to Traki. Those of you in Venezuela know that I'm talking about a store that sells clothes, household items, and other things. By the way, I'm about to show you what I bought that day. The truth is that I saw this trio of toothbrushes and couldn't resist. A while ago, I saw a video by my dentist where he gives recommendations on what a toothbrush should be like and why. It's the opposite of what we know and what's commercially available in most stores and pharmacies. Obviously, I had my expectations, but it was really impossible to feel any difference.
Por ejemplo los cepillos deben ser de cerdas suaves sin ningún tipo de plásticos a los lados o en medio como comúnmente son, las cerdas deben ser prolija es decir de un mismo tamaño, el cabezal debe se pequeño y redondo para pueda llegar din mucha dificultad a la parte de atrás de las muelas, muchas veces he visto cepillos gigantes, con un montón de cosas y colores super llamativos pero realmente es lo que necesitamos? Les puedo decir que no será quizás la mejor opción pero el cambio en la sensación y como se siente es 10/10, es absolutamente increíble delicioso cepillarse, de hecho mi hija que detesta hacerlo, ahora le gusta, literalmente puedo decir que es relajante, si están en Venezuela y pueden ir a comprarlos, háganse un favor y luego me cuentan! Solo tienen un costo de 4 dólares, son los mejores 4 dólares invertidos, de hecho si vuelvo a pasar los volvería a comprar para guardar y reponer en unos meses
For example, toothbrushes should have soft bristles without any plastic on the sides or in the middle, as is commonly the case. The bristles should be neat, i.e., all the same size, and the head should be small and round so that it can easily reach the back of the teeth. I have often seen giant toothbrushes with lots of features and bright colors, but is that really what we need? I can tell you that it may not be the best option, but the change in sensation and how it feels is 10/10. It is absolutely incredible and delightful to brush your teeth. In fact, my daughter, who hates doing it, now likes it. I can literally say that it is relaxing. If you are in Venezuela and can go buy them, do yourself a favor and then tell me about it! They only cost $4, and it's the best $4 you'll ever spend. In fact, if I go back, I'll buy more to keep and replace in a few months.

From Honkai, we have Chipa, a streamer from the new planet, and from Zenless Zone Zero, we have Area, an idol.

> We start with Honaki, as a new character we have Spark, a fire element character who follows the path of Exultation, is the senga character of this path. Spark is a DPS from the new Path who possesses some very interesting abilities.

>

As a character of Exultation, Spark's main characteristic is empowered attacks. Her basic ability consumes all skill points to perform a charged attack and activate the additional attack, and her ultimate ability deals significant area damage.


<div class=\

> Spark is coming to be the DPS for the new path, which is quite interesting. Personally, I won't be going for her since I'm still saving up for Cyrene's return, so the rest isn't something I'm worried about.

>

Aria is a DPS who attacks with slams. Her basic ability charges her slam bar, and when it's fully charged, she can execute the action. Ariea's slams inflict Abloom on enemies, causing their health to drop rapidly.

Her ultimate deals ethereal damage and makes Ariea's slams more powerful and destructive.

<div class=\

> And as a bonus, if you previously obtained Sunna and both are on the same team, they can perform a dance animation together. In conclusion, Aria is an excellent DPS, highly recommended, especially if you previously obtained Sunna.

body.title: Daily activities continue in my garden
body.body:
> Yesterday was a very satisfying day of gardening. I walked around all the plants I had transplanted, and so far, everything is progressing satisfactorily.
![20260309_083619.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23xKt8XmCwa4HXYhP5m6CLH5KtteNmRQ8EZ23xFYZgpBHjHkigHiKPSFzEUnWhpb6nE1A.jpg)
My favorite gift is plants, and the lady who helps me clean my house gave me a bunch of Vicarias. I'm very excited. I planted them in black bags with enough soil for their size. That will be their permanent home. The best part is that they have roots, so they will soon be producing more leaves and flowers.
![20260309_102539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23uFRuyQa1Z51AQLS3SK1AfKQBrXKrP8e5v5SA2ygtwMimobPv5U5o66acjuaUqU9mtdb.jpg)
I prepared three bags and placed two plants in each one. Later, I will see if I can remove any or simply prune them to replicate them.
![20260309_102505.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23xKrQCVScJt5PGUvV8WEbZt3kKMjn6QDqzrRygfi3kLB82x2L8MJiTNP1qcwEUG96jjH.jpg)
![20260309_102931.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23w2jBdm74iagrQxXGr78yVgpqF5PQ6Uf1fnogxuScJPR7JcpaXq95yAEMXB9daeCXUDZ.jpg)
I decided to dry some tomato seeds, and today I placed them in a recycled container that previously held food. Now I have placed tomato seeds in it, since only one tomato seedling has germinated in the red plastic seedbed.
![20260309_083726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/241tZVL4uBCQ7ActmudEZC29D5JhZ61NVLisyvSTdiMwpmYbXxyrm2pYN299fVYEzvKqM.jpg)
![20260309_101403.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/EoyRPfLKcWcTdp9qF9kUA87NxcgGM1h6tpHohxFSbNSKR7r3BvUsZsvr9wxJjkGUYDQ.jpg)
The sunflower seeds have not yet germinated. Before sowing them, I placed them in water for 12 hours, and the next day I put them in this plastic seed tray, but they have been there for more than 15 days and have not germinated. I don't know what is wrong with my sunflower seed sowing techniques; they are not germinating.
![20260309_101120.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23tHBozz2zCLUcXNzggzqwzApc7637ckjhsSSNcsiDC1wHPvijc65fbqxKhCV9thB7Qp2.jpg)
The pomegranate seedlings, which germinated late, continue to grow. At some point, I will transplant them to one of the bags with substrate for them.
![20260309_101124.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23wCBsCT3wtdDpRjvgPJ6GAyKJS99ZgAE46JPJSQ5KCjvBhUD87iMnKsx5hirgambo1kL.jpg)
The pomegranate seeds that germinated early are already very tall and leafy. They are in the bags with substrate, their final location. Until they are more leafy, I will put them up for sale.
![20260309_101045.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23xVGvdeedGSzjC8hrXRvQiWGfCgGLnPGdmkomP4HxCdHSBF5T727qMftPRg4zLaPvYeU.jpg)
I have transplanted my cucumber seedlings to their final location, and they are very leafy and have responded very well to where I placed them. They get enough sun to develop flowers and fruit.
![20260309_100855.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23wqkoCdqZfRdLxFubnqX6dAwZvToFx6c36Ys5m3K3XGNySkgJcAh22iPfvqwWUhEaPDh.jpg)
The squash plant continues to twine and wants to take up more space to grow. I have it rolled up in one place and cut off the main tip so that it develops its flowers and does not waste its energy on continuing to grow. I rescued some bromeliads that were exposed to the sun and did not tolerate direct sunlight. I placed them on new substrate and today they are responding well. I still have anthuriums, lilies, and Lady in the Night, in a cool spot under my ferns. I'm waiting for them to build me a bench so I can put them all in their final location.
![20260304_114948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23wCDrvi594DsXwyR25V8NnDMYNHet9F34oZsUg7CEFP7zjayKAZW5SM4CxCKGpHSdSYw.jpg)
For now, these are my efforts for the day in the garden. The banners are made with Canva. The photographs are taken with the Samsung Galaxy S26. ![separador2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gertu/23tkk3SwUkSt8XG3RGn8mFEmJYbHbzkW4eDcpJZiQBuXASQ6Uo37LW3toT1F1ieSXFy9J.png)

body.title: What I Let the Noise Decide
body.body:
![17731511489527705615241207313196.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/23wgQCkS9uaz9our6P6xDYcs4FwZJ2YY4D2Uk8LchzHq8jTLZBmrao4i9xaKNU2BhnsMR.jpg)






![topfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/jVIY8Tx5-top-feather.png)








<center>There is a fury that lived in me like a season that could not find the right weather to break into, turning inward when it had nowhere honest to go,
There is a fury that lived in me aimed at outcomes and yet I kept aiming as though volume and feeling would eventually matter,
There is a fury that lived in me aimed outward which was the gap between what I needed and what the world around me was willing to offer,
How many hours have I spent directing real energy at circumstances that were never going to respond to me the way a person who really cared about me even if I never ask,
There is a fury that lived in me only to find the target unmoved and the anger now living entirely inside with nowhere left to go...



<center>I have given the most faithful attention to moments that had already closed their doors and left me in the middle of a feeling they were never going to come back,
I have given the most faithful attention and called it to be honest about this pain, when what I was actually doing was using this as a reason to avoid the harder work underneath it,
I have given the most faithful attention so many times that I have started to confuse the intensity of the feeling with the validity of the grievance,
If the circumstance that I keep re-living in my chest could it actually hear me back and would it change anything about how I am spending the energy I keep pouring into,
I have given the most faithful attention and found that the situation was unchanged and the time was gone and I had to pay the price for how hard I felt it...



<center>There is a truth about myself that I have worked very hard and it deserved more protection from me than I gave it before I sent it out to be encountered,
There is a truth about myself that I kept returning every doubt that felt like a failure it is the faithfulness of that returning is the bravest and most overlooked thing I have ever done,
There is a truth about myself that I know, regardless of how confident that voice sounds when it speaks about what I have made, you cannot please everybody,
Can I actually locate in my body right now the difference between a response to that I genuinely need to hear or only agreeing with every doubt in myself,
There is a truth about myself that was alive and does not require their consensus to remain true even on the days when their voices are louder than my own...



<center>I have let the noise decide what the quiet already knew, remember what I actually believed before I handed the deciding over to a voice that was never inside the real maker
I have let the noise decide around the confidence and called it growth when what it actually was was surrender dressed in the language of being open-minded,
I have let the noise decide so many times that the original version of what I thought has become difficult to locate beneath all the layers of other people's reactions I piled on top of it,
What would I actually think about what I have made if I could sit with it in complete silence without a single outside voice arriving to inform me what my real opinion should be,
I have let the noise decide too often and stayed too long, but the quiet truth of what I knew never stopped being true just because I stopped listening. It waited. It always waits. And I am finally quiet enough to hear it again…



<center>Watchwords:
Fury aimed at what was never listening,
The reaction cost only me in the end,
My truth lived before their opinion arrived,
The noise decided what the quiet already knew,
The original truth is still waiting under there...





![bottomfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/bYIitQga-bottom-feather.png)

***

<center>Here is Tikatarot, who dares you to answer the question, *“Who am I?”..*</center>


***
***

<center>As and will always be reminding you to dream:</center> 
<center>*“As you are still the Master of your destiny and the maker of your dreams…”*</center>



![tikatarot sign.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/cUPh7Abd-tikatarot20sign.png)

body.title: Still in Old Havana / #monomad challenge / [ING/ESP]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ5npxuFqCxJhf35FS4aXo5o4czP1uJnd89njw8fNhAbX/_dsc0021_copia.jpg)


* * *

The photos 📸 are my entry to the #monomad contest from @monochromes and @brumest.

* * *

Greetings hivers.

Continuing through Havana as a good walker, observing everything and photographing every interesting scene. As I have mentioned many times before, Old Havana is great for photographing the Havana street life.

Among its narrow streets, old buildings and the constant coming and going of people, a different story always appears in front of the lens. Sometimes it is a spontaneous gesture, other times a play of light between balconies and the afternoon shadows. Walking here with a camera in hand feels like moving through a living gallery, where every corner offers a unique scene that only lasts a few seconds before disappearing.

Thank you very much for stopping by and accompanying me on another photographic walk. See you in the next post.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQhvWyof7nnYAo6Ay3Wd3woh2MrSScAUH3gvxQZ3oE6TQ/_dsc0020_copia.jpg)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVniR2JXJqAdD7YeGUmt1mJhYvCHsL8LKj4CZpjvVcCvS/_dsc0030_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfRCuyysSnWHC5BPTdc1C1NTfaFtw51udDRgfyDe6JFtp/_dsc0032_copia.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUEN3C4ij4YLsWd7AYCUvFE1B4dTo7FocNnUoPaaTtrsD/_dsc0086_copia.jpg)

Saludos hivers.

Siguiendo por La Habana como buen caminante, observando todo y fotografiando cada escena interesante. Como he comentado ya muchas veces, La Habana Vieja es genial para fotografiar la calle habanera.

Entre sus calles estrechas, edificios antiguos y el constante ir y venir de personas, siempre aparece una historia diferente frente al lente. A veces es un gesto espontáneo, otras veces un juego de luces entre los balcones y las sombras de la tarde. Caminar por aquí con la cámara en mano es como recorrer una galería viva, donde cada esquina ofrece una escena única que solo dura unos segundos antes de desaparecer.

Muchas gracias por pasar y acompañarme en otra caminata fotográfica. Nos vemos en el próximo post.

body.title: Crafting My Own NFT Instruments: A Guide to Rising Star Custom Shop
body.body:
Hello everyone! Today, I want to talk about one of the most creative features in Rising Star, which is the Custom Shop where you can craft your very own NFT instruments. Instead of just buying a finished card from the market, this feature allows you to build a unique instrument from scratch by collecting individual parts. It adds a whole new layer of strategy and personalization to our gaming journey, especially as we reach higher levels like Level 107 where boosting our Luck and Skills becomes essential.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbs73jfVx3tvHCT7mhhb9im4LM9TwCYzTa4PigcF85Tx1/1773146249747.jpg)


​အားလုံးပဲ မင်္ဂလာပါရှင်။ ဒီနေ့မှာတော့ Rising Star ရဲ့ စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားစရာအကောင်းဆုံးအပိုင်းတစ်ခုဖြစ်တဲ့ Custom Shop မှာ ကိုယ်ပိုင် NFT တူရိယာတွေ ဖန်တီးတဲ့အကြောင်းကို ပြောပြပေးချင်ပါတယ်ရှင်။ ဒီအပိုင်းကတော့ Market မှာ အချောထည်ကတ်တစ်ခုကို ဝယ်လိုက်တာမျိုးမဟုတ်ဘဲ တူရိယာတစ်ခုရဲ့ အစိတ်အပိုင်းလေးတွေကို တစ်ခုချင်းစီ စုဆောင်းပြီး ကိုယ်တိုင် ပြန်လည်ပေါင်းစပ်ကာ NFT အသစ်တစ်ခုအနေနဲ့ ထုတ်လုပ်ရတာဖြစ်ပါတယ်ရှင်။ ဒါက ကျွန်မတို့လို Level 107 ရောက်နေပြီဖြစ်တဲ့ ကစားသမားတွေအတွက် Luck နဲ့ Skill တွေကို မြှင့်တင်ဖို့ တကယ့်ကို ထူးခြားတဲ့ နည်းလမ်းကောင်းတစ်ခုပဲ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်ရှင်။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbtWN3Hnh9otDg3TR88cANrLUTA5BPZjrhirfoiwZkryw/1773146303714.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYUBtzv5RoPit9EnMWHH1YiapTGp3wq3MQX3mMjqnyGDY/1773146303822.png)


​To start crafting, you need to understand that every instrument is made up of four main components such as the body, strings, pickups, and machine heads. For example, if you want to craft a guitar, you’ll need to find a specific guitar body, some quality strings, the right pickups, and machine heads to tune it. Currently, I have managed to collect a set of silverstrings, and now I am on the lookout for other parts like a rare guitar body and chrome pickups to complete my masterpiece. It is like being a real luthier in the digital world, and the satisfaction of minting your own card is truly amazing.



​ဒီလို ကိုယ်ပိုင်တူရိယာတစ်ခု ဖန်တီးဖို့ဆိုရင် အစိတ်အပိုင်း လေးမျိုးကို အရင်နားလည်ဖို့ လိုပါတယ်ရှင်။ အဲဒါတွေကတော့ တူရိယာရဲ့ ကိုယ်ထည်၊ ကြိုး၊ ပစ်ကပ်နဲ့ ကြိုးညှိတိုင်တွေပဲ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်ရှင်။ ဥပမာအားဖြင့် ဂစ်တာတစ်လက်ကို ကိုယ်တိုင်လုပ်ချင်တယ်ဆိုရင် သတ်မှတ်ထားတဲ့ ဂစ်တာကိုယ်ထည်၊ ကြိုးတွေ၊ ပစ်ကပ်တွေနဲ့ ကြိုးညှိတိုင်တွေကို စုဆောင်းရမှာပါရှင်။ အခုလောလောဆယ်မှာတော့ ကျွန်မဆီမှာ ငွေရောင်ဂစ်တာကြိုး (silverstrings) တစ်ချောင်း ရှိနေပြီဖြစ်လို့ ကျန်တဲ့ Rare ဂစ်တာကိုယ်ထည်နဲ့ ခရုမ်းပစ်ကပ်တွေကို ထပ်ရှာဖို့ ပြင်ဆင်နေပါတယ်ရှင်။ ဒါက တကယ့်လက်တွေ့လောကမှာ တူရိယာတစ်ခုကို ကိုယ်တိုင်လုပ်နေရသလို ခံစားချက်မျိုးပေးစွမ်းနိုင်ပြီး ကိုယ်ပိုင်ကတ်တစ်ခုကို ထုတ်လုပ်နိုင်တဲ့အခါမှာလည်း အရမ်းကို ကျေနပ်စရာကောင်းပါတယ်ရှင်။

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTNnEXFgRhCJDGSPzPPwaVJs79c9gdYhzCFBtLuEUnjSi/1773146303924.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXeSWqXTKq2enUvmuzWr8iM5XTG5g3eKxFM553CLfWpDa/1773146304018.png)


​One of the best things about the Custom Shop is the ability to create Seasonal and Limited Edition items. By clicking on the festive tabs like Valentines or Halloween, you can discover unique parts that are only available during those specific times of the year. These seasonal instruments often have higher Luck stats than common cards, which is a huge advantage for our music lessons. Higher Luck means a better chance of earning more Skill points, which helps us manage our Ego levels effectively as we grow in popularity and fans.



​Custom Shop ရဲ့ နောက်ထပ် ကောင်းကွက်တစ်ခုကတော့ ရာသီအလိုက် အထူးပစ္စည်းတွေကို ဖန်တီးနိုင်တာပဲ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်ရှင်။ Valentines ဒါမှမဟုတ် Halloween လိုမျိုး ခလုတ်လေးတွေကို နှိပ်ကြည့်ခြင်းအားဖြင့် အဲဒီကာလတွေမှာပဲ ရနိုင်တဲ့ ထူးခြားတဲ့ အစိတ်အပိုင်းတွေကို တွေ့နိုင်မှာပါရှင်။ ဒီလို ရာသီအလိုက် တူရိယာတွေက ပုံမှန်ကတ်တွေထက် Luck Stats ပိုများတတ်တာကြောင့် ကျွန်မတို့ရဲ့ Music Lesson တွေအတွက် အရမ်းကို အကျိုးရှိပါတယ်ရှင်။ Luck များလေလေ Skill Point တွေ ပိုရနိုင်လေလေဖြစ်ပြီး ဒါက ကျွန်မတို့ရဲ့ ပရိသတ်တွေ တိုးလာတဲ့အခါမှာ Ego မတက်အောင် ထိထိရောက်ရောက် ထိန်းချုပ်ပေးနိုင်မှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်ရှင်။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcS28rGmvNSvmSLdZcSQZjpvLn2q6PXZWQmw3v7krK7Tv/1773146351486.png)


​You can obtain these parts either by completing the Guitar Fair missions in the Custom Shop zone, which costs about 1000 STARBITS per try, or by purchasing them directly from the market if you want to skip the wait. While the missions give random parts, the market allows you to pick exactly what you need to match your style. Building your own NFT is not just about gameplay; it is about creating a legacy in the Rising Star universe and showing off your unique collection to the community. I encourage all fellow players to explore the Custom Shop and start building their dream instruments today!


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeGhTcSocMxdNM5HY9mFHm1zpCMLLkASHuaH9NhpP6KdE/1773146367008.png)


​ဒီအစိတ်အပိုင်းတွေကို ရရှိဖို့အတွက် Custom Shop ဧရိယာက Guitar Fair mission တွေကို တစ်ခါဆော့ရင် ၁၀၀၀ STARBITS သုံးပြီး ဆော့နိုင်သလို အချိန်မစောင့်ချင်ဘူးဆိုရင်တော့ Market မှာ တိုက်ရိုက်ဝယ်ယူလို့လည်း ရပါတယ်ရှင်။ Mission ဆော့တဲ့အခါမှာတော့ အစိတ်အပိုင်းတွေကို ကျပန်းရရှိမှာဖြစ်ပေမယ့် Market မှာတော့ ကိုယ်နှစ်သက်တဲ့ ပုံစံမျိုးရအောင် စိတ်ကြိုက်ရွေးဝယ်နိုင်ပါတယ်ရှင်။ ကိုယ်ပိုင် NFT တစ်ခုကို တည်ဆောက်ရတာက ဂိမ်းဆော့နေရုံတင်မဟုတ်ဘဲ Rising Star လောကမှာ ကိုယ်ပိုင်အမှတ်အသားတစ်ခုကို ဖန်တီးတာလည်း ဖြစ်ပါတယ်ရှင်။ ဒါကြောင့် သူငယ်ချင်းတို့လည်း Custom Shop ကို လေ့လာပြီး ကိုယ်ပိုင်အိမ်မက်တူရိယာတွေကို ဒီနေ့ပဲ စတင်ဖန်တီးကြည့်ဖို့ တိုက်တွန်းချင်ပါတယ်ရှင်။

Entitlement seems to pop up imcreasingly more when I agonize the human condition. Maybe agonize is just an emotional word for my emotional response though. 

Swinging from thinking our feelings don’t matter to them being the only thing that matters seems like opposite ends of bad.  Emotion can trump logic but it is a balamce as we probably should not logic our emotion completely away. 

I like the counterfactual angle though. I have seen some folks rewrite their history in their favour in an attempt to shoft blame off themselves as a way to cope with their failure, even deny it. That is more fake mews than anything. We don’t learn from our mistakes. We learn from revisiting that failure in an attempt to come up with aoutions to avoid the mistake in the future. Thats where counterfactual thinking helps us as long as we don’t stew too long.

body.title: [ESP/ENG] a day as a guide for my family visiting different places in our region.
body.body:
> Qué tal mis queridos amigos de estilo de vida siempre buscando una manera de compartir con ustedes mis momentos favoritos, dentro de mi estilo de vida está mi familia los seres que amo y son importantes en mi mundo de esta manera siempre es importante tener esa oportunidad de brindarnos tiempo de calidad para compartir para salir y realizar las cosas que realmente nos llena el corazón de alegría, tuve la visita en mi hogar de mi hermana cuñada y mis dos sobrinas así que estábamos totalmente dichosos y decidimos salir un rato a compartir. > Hello my dear lifestyle friends, always looking for ways to share my favorite moments with you. My lifestyle includes my family, the people I love and who are important in my world. It's always important to have the opportunity to spend quality time together, to go out and do the things that truly fill our hearts with joy. I had a visit at home from my sister-in-law and my two nieces, so we were absolutely delighted and decided to go out for a while.
![IMG_20260214_213428_915.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/Eonj8SDgVKRiHv3UdETcEUUqiECBCYCtb2Hq7wBvxrrTVTPGmbMephAHHBg1DkCxo8q.jpg)
![IMG_20260214_222149_057.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/EoGwYwTWJPCSVFuJV2qyH7zuLMoidjewUiXjzKFNqbPZ2jJ5nBpwAcRmM7t1mWHYQPA.jpg)
Lo primero que hicimos fue visitar diferentes lugares de nuestra ciudad dándoles a conocer un poco de nuestra región ya que ellos no viven aquí viven en Caracas y vienen en temporadas especiales solamente, así que luego de dar un paseo por las playas de San Luis, visitamos el monumento fuimos a comer, pues salir con ellos no es nada fácil ellos por la hora ya tenían ganas de comer y fuimos a unos locales de comida rápida donde degustaron perro calientes hamburguesas y allí ellos se entretuvieron un rato jugando. > The first thing we did was visit different places in our city, showing them a little bit of our region since they don't live here, they live in Caracas and only come during special seasons. So, after taking a walk along the beaches of San Luis, we visited the monument and went to eat, because going out with them isn't easy at all, they were already hungry because of the time, and we went to some fast food places where they enjoyed hot dogs and hamburgers, and there they entertained themselves for a while playing games.
![IMG_20260214_202941_015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/Ep7u9rGgxn4uGnPAaWNPVWxucpYBMEEMxdyBxw24TPw2yPBBVagKHBYjxy4JoL5J4Ps.jpg)
También aprovechamos de pasar un tiempecito juntos tomándonos unas cervezas para tocar temas de conversaciones de nuestro agrado y ponernos un poco al día en cuanto a nuestras vidas personales, muchas veces no importa el lugar, importa las personas que te rodean, este espacio teníamos música estamos al aire libre y la estábamos pasando bien que de eso es que se trata estás salidas. > We also took the opportunity to spend some time together having a few beers, discussing topics we enjoyed, and catching up on our personal lives. Often, the place doesn't matter, it's the people around you that do. In this space, we had music, we were outdoors, and we were having a good time, which is what these outings are all about.
![IMG_20260214_221951_528.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23vhsGJ6i4PPYVAHq2wtq945UJ35snMMzfvmjed11XLWUBcjcWmhQGpzysYVyqjjd6r8b.jpg)
![IMG_20260214_231059_963.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23yTeuWE6dMsXSekdDDGVHzhtjPYwmNN2KTCT2CY5bKDPa9vLQTyVPGzNQoYZC9wUtGnn.jpg)
Finalmente los adultos pedimos para picar una salchipapas y luego de un par de horas regresamos en la casa satisfechos contentos y felices por cada momento que nos brinda la vida para compartir juntos. > Finally, the adults ordered some salchipapas for a snack, and after a couple of hours we returned home satisfied, happy and content for every moment that life gives us to share together.
![IMG_20260214_231249_552.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/23yd1iKQ2jBPt2ABPT4EuGNig3p4Ki84yxaHMrjy6i14xy9sXjqurSbSu3wbC3VpYLp6p.jpg)

body.title: A Culinary Adventure at Yakimix: Exploring Flavours with Wonderful Friends
body.body:
Spending quality time with friends while exploring good food is always a memorable experience. Recently, we had the opportunity to enjoy a delightful food adventure at Yakimix, located inside Ayala Malls Harbour Point in Olongapo City. Our visit turned out to be more than just a meal—it became a wonderful bonding moment filled with laughter, delicious food, and unforgettable memories with my amazing food buddies.

![Grey & Beige Aesthetic Vision Board Photo Collage.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/48KbwVCB2q5yhZrCKWkNg13dVkmoY8gRhQS7gXsT5Vwfah5NvDbUR62YomGyGoKrTA.jpg)

From the moment we arrived at the restaurant, we were welcomed by a warm, inviting ambience. The elegant interior design, soft lighting, and spacious dining area created a relaxing atmosphere perfect for enjoying a meal with friends. The place felt lively yet comfortable, with families and groups of friends happily sharing meals and conversations. The friendly staff greeted us with warm smiles and guided us to our table, making us eager for the culinary experience ahead.

![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EoeETPLoC2Tiv1ptHJtUANKfiKGpV6NZJ4aUApFfpM1eR5C6CqvhmfYbGDauAyYRLxg.jpg)

One of the things that makes Yakimix truly special is the wide variety of dishes available in their buffet. As we explored the food stations, we were amazed by the different kinds of cuisines offered. There were Japanese, Korean, Chinese, and Filipino-inspired dishes, all beautifully prepared and ready to be enjoyed. Seeing the colourful, appetizing display of food made our mouths water and made it hard to decide where to begin.

![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/Eoc75xKYYD7Y5snXi9Uxr8uafVP2iS4J4hL6BZWbL38MNcqnfFRXNjUuairjoe9Hf26.jpg)

Of course, one of the highlights of Yakimix is the grill and hot pot experience. Each table has its own grill where diners can cook their selected meats and seafood. We excitedly picked different ingredients, including marinated beef, chicken, pork, shrimp, squid, and various vegetables. Cooking our own food at the table made the experience interactive and fun. As the meat sizzled on the grill, the delicious aroma wafted through the air, making us even more excited to taste the freshly cooked dishes.

![99.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/Eokd4LvQh8b2Xjdytf3gw3NpAirbtHm7AE7ZMdLLWNf8HVGFTcdjhJi4mJh88CYkNoB.jpg)

![19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EoErR8UpeFkyv2izfdeEHZYvmJnfho3R1V6skFk9Cqyf1WnMnmcmQwMrxFuYkELZmZt.jpg)

Aside from the grill items, we also explored the sushi and sashimi station. The sushi rolls were carefully arranged and looked almost too beautiful to eat. There were different varieties, each with unique flavours and ingredients. Some of my friends were particularly excited to try the sushi, while others enjoyed the tempura and other Japanese dishes available in the buffet line.

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/Eoc7VKKJKbQx4K8nzcC7Bu6q2Vc3rpopqd6jgsxaRDHZuDJTvUz9dhWRCihW8WJphDN.jpg)

![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EoChbvM1v1oW9wesXJ5xQGUDaVprqFoHzvzWUpxArQYWyYbrjeAFAGKvCkFduqrw7A2.jpg)

The cooked food section was also impressive. There were flavorful stir-fried dishes, noodles, fried rice, and various meat and seafood recipes that showcased Asian culinary traditions. Each dish had its own distinct taste, and it was exciting to sample a little bit of everything. It felt like travelling across different countries through food without leaving the restaurant.

![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EokdbLpjabcDprqbEwXipWeALYGaXLeE398vq13bEvApWNqwAgm3fJuxjukRTVSat3B.jpg)

What made the experience even more special was sharing the moment with my wonderful friends. Food always tastes better when enjoyed with people who make you laugh and feel comfortable. We spent time talking, joking, and even helping each other cook the food on the grill. Every few minutes, someone would say, \

as they passed a newly discovered dish. Our table was filled with plates of various foods as we continued exploring the buffet.

![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EoiVCimbo2GdcToSKDk9t2mvMgY3zFT78rZBtfzpkrp1H6PYi1GFG2DQkEB53Bhe4k7.jpg)

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EoeGQCdT3zcutJ1RHcanVuXQSGvQA8Mh9CCysYhrAq8Nxt7VTZb4yzDu6DVn2nftCsY.jpg)

Another highlight of our dining experience was the dessert section. After enjoying so many savoury dishes, we were excited to check out the sweet treats. The dessert station had cakes, pastries, fruits, and ice cream.

![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/Eokd5DNuHV49ad7W7Se71JqXxmDpXb3GHdevc94cm1D8Hq3ywrCqRQ633rhcn3eFmaE.jpg)

The colourful presentation made the desserts look irresistible. Some of us chose cake slices, while others enjoyed ice cream topped with sweet syrups and sprinkles. It was the perfect way to end our meal.

While enjoying dessert, we paused to appreciate the entire experience. Dining at Yakimix was not only about eating delicious food but also about celebrating friendship. The laughter around the table, the excitement of discovering new dishes, and the relaxing ambience made the evening truly unforgettable.

![14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23uFTgiufjxT3cbD2AycLpxEja1tipWf2p52UqyzgEvwVYtvnMHaKL8HSEQcsy4WiPA6Z.jpg)

The restaurant's atmosphere also played a big part in making our visit enjoyable. Despite being a popular dining spot, the place remained comfortable and organized. The staff consistently refilled the buffet trays and ensured that everything was clean and presentable. Their excellent service added to the overall positive experience.

As our dining adventure came to an end, we all agreed it was truly worth it. Exploring different flavours and cuisines allowed us to appreciate the richness of Asian food culture. More importantly, it gave us a chance to slow down, relax, and spend meaningful time together.

![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/EoiWG5wXBQsSysCZpMM6WvSvFVPm83VVX4wri2RLg6LMgdN28Lz1RtxMgD4Mjfx3qGB.jpg)

Our food exploration at Yakimix in Harbour Point became a memorable culinary journey filled with delightful tastes and joyful moments. Experiences like this remind us that food is more than just nourishment—it is also a way to connect with others and create happy memories.

***Indeed, our wonderful experience at Yakimix will always be remembered as a day of good food, great ambience, and the priceless company of amazing friends.***
