body.title: (ESP-ENG) Tokyo Colony No. 1 and the domain of Higuruma - Episode Review!
body.body:
**<center>Hello friends, good vibes to all.</center>**

> Hola amigos, buenas vibras para todos. 

https://butwhytho.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Jujutsu-Kaisen-Season-3-Episode-9-But-Why-Tho-1.jpg

[Source!](https://butwhytho.net/2026/03/jujutsu-kaisen-season-3-episode-9-review/)

<div class=\

>This season of Jujutsu Kaisen has been absolutely insane, to the point that I think it's the best of the three seasons so far. This third season has had two great episodes: the first was Maki's fight against the Zenin clan, which was heavily criticized in Japan, and the second was the ninth episode, which aired last week. It has a 9.6 rating, but I think that score doesn't do justice to how impressive it was. As you know, we're in the Sacrifice Games, and last week we met Higuruma, one of the most outstanding characters to appear in the anime so far.

> Lo de Jujutsu Kaisen esta temporada está siendo una locura de proporciones bíblicas al punto de que creo que está siendo la mejor temporada de las tres que van hasta ahora. Esta tercera entrega ha tenido 2 grandes episodios, el primero fue el de Maki cuando se enfrenta al clan Zenin y que fue muy criticado en Japón y el segundo fue el emitido la semana pasada, el noveno. Tiene una puntuación de 9.6 pero creo que esa calificación no hace justicia, nunca mejor dicho, a lo impresionante que fue. Como saben estamos en los Juegos del Sacrificio y la semana pasada fue el momento de conocer a Higuruma, uno de los personajes más top que han salido en el anime hasta ahora.
>Higuruma is a lawyer who has lost faith in humanity and considers people \

because they are incapable of telling the truth. He grew tired of protecting people because they will never admit what they did. The inner light he once possessed, fueled by his profession and his desire to do things right, faded over time after encountering so many despicable people and a system that offers little help. It is from all of this that his domain originates: a space where he seeks to compel the accused to tell the truth, a place where violence is nonexistent, where only the administration of justice prevails.

> Higuruma es un hombre de leyes, un abogado que perdió la fe en la humanidad y que considera a las personas \

porque son incapaces de decir la verdad, se cansó de proteger a la gente porque esta nunca van a reconocer lo que hicieron; esa luz que tenía en su interior por la profesión y por querer hacer las cosas bien se apagó con el pasar del tiempo después de haber conocido a tanta personas despreciables y un sistema que tampoco ayuda mucho. Es a raíz de todo esto el origen de su dominio que no es otro que un espacio para buscar que los acusados digan la verdad, un espacio en donde la violencia no existe, solo la impartición de justicia.    

https://butwhytho.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Jujutsu-Kaisen-Season-3-Episode-9-But-Why-Tho-2.jpg

[Source!](https://butwhytho.net/2026/03/jujutsu-kaisen-season-3-episode-9-review/)

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23wzxGFZ386Vvyqzauz1cLKrDT65sHvS9g4RaouFtaibX1EzwTjU2GJxAvDJuAV1PDikd.png)


[Source!](https://respawn.outlookindia.com/pop-culture/pop-culture-originals/jujutsu-kaisen-season-3-episode-9-review-recap)

<div class=\

>Yuji arrives to be judged in Higuruma's trial. What makes this episode great are several things: the spectacularly fluid animation, the use of color and the soundtrack, and finally, the narrative, which is the best part. The animation stands out for the confrontation between the two protagonists outside the domain. The power of this domain is confiscation, which removes the accused's cursed technique if they are found guilty, but since Yuji doesn't have a technique, they remove his cursed energy. It's impressive because Yuji fights thanks to his privileged physique, which surprises Higuruma, who uses many techniques. This confrontation is truly top-notch; it lasts about a minute but is pure adrenaline and incredibly visually stunning.

> Yuji llega para ser juzgado en el juicio de Higuruma. Lo que hace bueno a este capítulo son varias cosas: la animación tan espectacularmente fluida que tiene, el uso de los colores y la banda sonora y finalmente la narrativa, siendo esto último lo mejor de todo. La animación destaca por el enfrentamiento, fuera del dominio, entre los dos protagonistas. El poder de este dominio es la confiscación y trata de que le quita la técnica maldita al acusado si es declarado culpable pero Yuji como no tiene técnica pues le quitan la energia maldita. Impresiona porque Yuji pelea gracias al físico privilegiado que tiene cosa que sorprende a Higuruma quien si emplea muchas técnicas. La verdad es que este enfrentamiento es top, dura como un 1 minuto más o menos pero es pura adrenalina y super vistoso de ver.

>The use of colors is significant because they tend to reflect moods. In this episode, we see how they use yellow, which can denote justice; red (anger or frustration); green (envy and immaturity); and light blue (freedom and purity). Mentioning this here might not make much sense, but you'll understand better when you watch the episode, or if you've already seen it. These are pure symbols that the anime's creators are incorporating into every episode. The soundtrack complements the scene perfectly, especially during the most intense moments, particularly during the fight scenes, which makes the whole experience very immersive. You can't imagine how much I enjoyed watching this; I think if it weren't for Maki's incredible action, this would undoubtedly be the best episode. For many, it might be the best because of its high narrative level and depth.

> El uso de los colores porque ellos tienden a reflejar estados de ánimo. En este episodio vemos como usan el amarillo que puede denotar justicia, el rojo (ira o frustración), el verde (envidia e inmadurez) y el azul claro (libertad y pureza). Que se los diga por acá no tiene mucho sentido pero cuando vean el capítulo o si ya lo vieron se darán cuenta mejor. Esto son simbolismos puros que los encargados del anime están metiendo en todos los episodios. La banda sonora acompaña cuando tiene que hacerlo pero más especialmente en los momentos álgidos, se aprecia mucho cuando están peleando lo que hace que toda la experiencia sea muy inmersiva. No se imaginan lo que me disfruté ver esto, creo que si no hubiese sido por la gran acción de Maki este sin duda sería el mejor. Para muchos capaz lo sea por el alto nivel narrativo y su profundidad. https://i0.wp.com/otakuorbit.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/JJK-S3-8.12.png?fit=1100%2C610&ssl=1 [Source!](https://otakuorbit.com/) --- https://image.idn.media/post/20260306/upload_278004cdaa4c7583e03ba38acde67c71_9bd55a16-1c81-4973-ae83-19f4bd2d6685.jpg [Source!](https://duniaku.idntimes.com/anime-manga/anime-lain/hal-menarik-jujutsu-kaisen-s3-episode-9-00-pgd78-rvb12l)

>The narrative is a pillar because it's what sustains the entire episode. Seeing Higuruma tired, defeated by a system that doesn't truly benefit people, disappointed with humanity in general, and forced to use his domain because of all this is very interesting. Looking at everything closely, you can even justify it; you understand his position, which isn't unreasonable at all. He's not a bad guy; the world made him that way. Another really cool thing is the whole \

aspect. It's not just idle talk; there's a real understanding and background of the Japanese penal system. They speak with a solid foundation and arguments, and Yuji is judged according to the true and real law, which is impressive and adds weight to the story. As you can see, this episode isn't just a good fight; it's much more than that. I watched it twice to appreciate and enjoy it more. I recommend it to everyone. Watch Jujutsu Kaisen if you haven't already, or catch up; it's 1000% worth it.

> La narrativa es pilar porque es la que sostiene a todo el episodio. Ver a Higuruma cansado, derrotado por un sistema que no favorece realmente a las personas, decepcionado de la humanidad en general y que por todo esto se vea obligado a usar este dominio es muy interesante. Viendo bien todo uno puede llegar a justificarlo, uno entiende su posición la cual no es nada descabellada, no es un tipo malo sino que el mundo lo hizo así. Otra de las cosas muy cool que es toda la parte \

no son habladurías simples, hay un conocimiento y trasfondo del sistema penal de Japón. Se habla con base y argumentos, se le juzga a Yuji según le ley verdadera y real y eso es impresionante, le más peso a la historia. Como ven este capítulo no es simplemente una buena pelea, es mucho más. Yo lo vi dos veces para apreciarlo y disfrutarlo mejor. 1/6 🧵

**Health trackers are catching life-threatening conditions before doctors do.** A 19-year-old college student's Oura ring showed spiking respiratory rate, heart rate, and body temp at 3 AM — she checked the ER and discovered she had Lemierre's syndrome, double pneumonia, septic emboli, and COVID. Seven days in ICU, thoracic surgery. She's alive because she trusted the data.

---
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: You gotta adapt to your schedules, can't do much else really... With a friend will make it more interesting, see who can handle it better!
body.author: davideownzall

body.body:
2/6 🧵

**The pattern recognition is what matters.** These devices track your baseline over weeks and months — when your resting heart rate creeps up for three weeks straight or sleep architecture collapses, that's not random noise. It's your body telegraphing a problem before symptoms become critical. One-third of Americans now wear trackers, and diagnosis stories are piling up.

---
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
3/6 🧵

**Nicolette Amette, 44, saw her Fitbit hit 120-140 bpm resting, sometimes spiking to 220 bpm.** She walked into the hospital with the data. EKG revealed AVNRT, atrial fibrillation, and tachycardia — she needed three heart surgeries. Without the tracker flagging the pattern, she might have written off the dizziness and fatigue as stress or aging.

---
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/6 🧵\n\n**But wearables aren't diagnostic tools — they're alarm bells.** Apple Watch, Fitbit, Samsung, and Withings have FDA-cleared AFib detection, but brands are clear: they don't diagnose illness. Dr. Jordan Shlain calls them \
— they show where you've been and where you might be heading, but data without context is just noise.\n\n---
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
5/6 🧵

**Even non-emergency cases benefit.** Sandy Mendez's UltraHuman ring tracked her cycle and flagged missing ovulation for months. That led her to discover thyroid fluctuations — overactive to underactive — explaining years of exhaustion and palpitations. The ring gave her the confidence to push for medical answers instead of dismissing symptoms.

---
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
6/6 🧵

**The takeaway: wearables can't tell you *what* is wrong or *why*, but they can tell you *something is off* — and that nudge is saving lives.** A heart rate spike could be AFib or espresso at 3 PM, but when the pattern persists, it's worth investigating. We're in the early innings of this tech, and it's already proving its value.

📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/03/10/health/our-health-trackers-like-oura-and-fitbit-saved-our-lives/)

body.title: Unexpected trip to the heart of Mordovia – the city of Saransk
body.body:
Good day dear mates! It happened so that couple weeks ago due some life circumstances I was need to go to another region - Mordovia. 

[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP81A1MParisZAKjm52o3PRXE4Wk3jrRp9KrCh57aTvWL/photocollage_1773087614924.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP81A1MParisZAKjm52o3PRXE4Wk3jrRp9KrCh57aTvWL/photocollage_1773087614924.jpg)

So I ordered tickets for long distance night train to Saransk. And  my trip began. I departed from Kazanskiy rail way terminal at 10 p.m.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbYMEuTXdznehhkFdQbRbRANzGiMVg2AaZTSfnZUkMXWF/1773068238765.jpg)

To Saransk I arrived at 7 a.m. Temperature outside the train was - 25 degrees Celsius. After short breakfast at cafe I moved to the intercity bus station from where old micro bus took me to the far village where I was need to solve some bureaucratic issues. 

 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUKdsVgVRz7gaKTfghN1FE5PnETmYH7nJsc4VQKATk9Ke/1773068238643.jpg)

When all was done it was noon time. I decided not to wast my time there and went back to Saransk. 
>Saransk is the capital city of Mordovia, Russia, as well as it's financial and economic centre. It is located in the Volga basin at the confluence of the Saranka and Insar Rivers, about 630 kilometers east of Moscow. Saransk was one of the host cities of the official tournament of the 2018 FIFA World Cup.

There I decided to walk around the city and get to know the city better. First of all I walked around Mordovia arena stadium which was built to FIFA 2018. 
>It has a capacity of 44,442 spectators. The total area of the facility is 122,700 sq m.
The Arena is located in the central part of the city and is within a walking distance of the city's key infrastructure. The stadium design is based on the image of the sun, the main symbol of ancient myths and legends of the Mordovain people. After the FIFA World Cup, the stadium is expected to serve as Saransk and Mordovia's largest sports and leisure center.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR5XagvXzCfvtSSH681ErRhrhc2W59wrYv2e9P3aHxRya/1773068238591.jpg)

Then I had quick lunch and went to walk around city center. There near Soviet square was house of Republic.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZH5gnyMFJhbw7aGmeoWBunnWkpo4qBvPLgyXzNz98ESG/1773068238444.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX1137CeaAwf146YnMRP8CakTbkoyYtzdYXfpf4wortJB/1773068238162.jpg)

And of course at this square located The House of Soviets.
>The House of Soviets was built in 1938–1940 based on a design by I. A. Meerzon. Initially, it housed the regional committee of the All-Union Communist Party of Bolsheviks, the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of the Mordovian Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic, and the Council of People's Commissars. In the 1950s, the interiors were reconstructed according to a design by architect S. O. Levkov and sculptor M. I. Nefedov, while the exterior of the building remained virtually unchanged. Currently, it houses the State Assembly of the Republic of Mordovia. 

 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTiZAni2T2iUvFr3s5xmSg1wBV2NjLUzCEmdRkJNx11Np/1773068238348.jpg)

Wooden slides for children, cafe and fountain stair. Of course after strong snowfalls most part of Soviet square was covered with the snow and fountain stair didn't work.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW1vSPUti6k3Sovz4eVdE59BvTmY2g4FH7a2vYK5yTvAN/1773068238110.jpg)
<center> *Such a big wooden slides for children* </center>
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUVa1TATXnRcsUJ7uy4i6QaWSUx3ewxY44D1g35FmWnth/1773068238246.jpg)
<center> *View on fountain stair* </center>

In front of another one administrative building located monument of fox. Fox is the symbol of Mordovia and Saransk, historically representing intelligence, cunning, insight, and wealth. This image has been established since 1781, when Empress Catherine II approved the coat of arms of Saransk with a red fox, symbolizing the hunting traditions of the region and prosperity. In addition, the image of the fox is associated with the development of hunting, which was one of the main occupations of the indigenous population of Mordovia. Currently, the fox is a popular tourist brand of the republic. 
Click on the photo below to see the coat of arms of Saransk.

[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUeD9qipN8C8ZXtksWXd1ry4za9GPaXdJf6PDtVypky2W/izm1773068238196.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUeD9qipN8C8ZXtksWXd1ry4za9GPaXdJf6PDtVypky2W/izm1773068238196.jpg)
<center> *You can enlarge this photo* </center>


Behind the Soviet square located Fedor Ushakov Cathedral a Russian Orthodox cathedral in the Saransk, the Cathedral of the Diocese of Saransk. It is named for Russian saint and admiral Fyodor Ushakov. 

[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV3S1arRrALqvUCKGxpGooHjju4NaR42NBxGhTrunXHo5/1773068238058.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV3S1arRrALqvUCKGxpGooHjju4NaR42NBxGhTrunXHo5/1773068238058.jpg)

***

[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8pvg5wLgPyTJywM9pgkxBW7XeYzrgWtKUcsWB2UWPhW/1773068237970.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP8pvg5wLgPyTJywM9pgkxBW7XeYzrgWtKUcsWB2UWPhW/1773068237970.jpg)

From the square where located The Cathedral of St. Fyodor Ushakov was built rotunda under which located quiet good restaurant Panorama with tasty meat meals, beer and burgers. Also from rotunda opens excellent point of view to the city park and river Saranka.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcC3oWJe2k5GHywvUimQDFz16cy9Nc7XxVEUQNrYZDCiF/1773068237995.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWtKTzsGTSJWiEfpKZYGTu8behHpTfoKNSkuvjWgpsCvH/1773068238024.jpg)


After it I went through Museum of Local History to restaurant on national cousin - Mordovskoe podvorye. About this place I'd like to tell a little bit later coz Mordovian cousin deserves separate post as I think.

[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSRyf5yX6mNkkU6p1ozEEtPRa1Y3YvTXGwLkrqGBzRRMQ/izm1773068237949.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSRyf5yX6mNkkU6p1ozEEtPRa1Y3YvTXGwLkrqGBzRRMQ/izm1773068237949.jpg)

Of course it's not cheap place but it's worth to taste local cousin anyway. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsYoJez73rSYpqRmugLTkpcceX4yPYVr2y5eof8jneo9/1773070754763.jpg)

When my dinner was over after restaurant I went back upside to the city center where I visited main book store. There can be easily found books at native local Erzan` & Mockshanskiy languages. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTpB6TLAaPSmsf6u3VhbjvkshKVpERLhDqDyAwPm6z5zY/1773079560094.jpg)
<center>*Evening view on the Museum of Local History from rotunda*</center>
****
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeojQS4gaBLumpcC7euCBWochNjBBTMjwMVyAxdnFz3zU/1773079559928.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeojQS4gaBLumpcC7euCBWochNjBBTMjwMVyAxdnFz3zU/1773079559928.jpg)
<center>*Evening view on The Cathedral of St. Fyodor Ushakov*</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRokhiNedCofN8BYFLMhQHNoue7pBMhgudgRgXfkSZosc/1773079559848.jpg)
<center>*Building of bookstore*</center>
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTvnFUKkZ8bzipJeqGaQqRCwNxUfv5s5hBng9MoXs5b76/1773079559870.jpg)
<center>*Books  on native Mordovian languages for children*</center>

After what my walk continued. At the evening time city center of Saransk is beautiful decorated with festive lights on old buildings. As example I'd like to show you this old building in which located Mordovian republic children choreographic school

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTvgdSopJ93utVFH3jKfGk31s8Zgo5vkmbgc28shP2xb7/1773079559694.jpg)
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRKcXewvS6ahAhoxhxdkngPjo215v6WLA1DX4z4Yji6tV/1773079559548.jpg)

Or look at this modern building where earlier was located one of the local banks.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW8neQTww4tRj5gUceibjpmi5hmhQaM7LSch2awJFzmVA/1773079559525.jpg)

After it my way was leading aside Mordovian State Philharmonic to the building  of Opera and Ballet Theatre of Saransk. 
>Opera and Ballet Theatre of Saransk was inaugurated on 1 September 1935 in Saransk, capital of the Russian Republic of Mordovia with Carl Millöcker's operetta Der Bettelstudent. The theatre includes 714 spectator places, 138 crystal lamps, make-up rooms, rehearsal ballet classes, a small hall for creative meetings and chamber concerts, the whole factory with fake and property-rooms shops. The new theatre has a mini-printing house and modern sound recording studio. The light and sound equipment – from the best producers of the USA, Germany, England and Japan, a rotating scene, variable volume of the auditorium.

[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRWTgXFahp7zpmcmwrc5PDcTpLi3DQiPeLbm1H5qEtxgw/izm1773079558679.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRWTgXFahp7zpmcmwrc5PDcTpLi3DQiPeLbm1H5qEtxgw/izm1773079558679.jpg)
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme3k3QRTLXNx5VqeqpWwicDKoxcnSXbefG8uysAXikj3E/1773079558647.jpg)

***

[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVpoCjRV3JWgPGuKyU5QEbNU8BF1xg89ErXHk7UCGkgQB/1773079558526.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVpoCjRV3JWgPGuKyU5QEbNU8BF1xg89ErXHk7UCGkgQB/1773079558526.jpg)
<center>*and a little bit closer* </center>

When I was strolling near it I saw a cityscape with full moon. When I saw the moon peeking through the city buildings, I really wished I had a better camera and suitable lenses with me to capture this view in proper quality. Here just a shots from my small camera🤷‍♂️ 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeB4PKBAdc86X7YMVDfhE3DigbF5mNkRSFkoo4FRr5zcr/1773079558926.jpg)


But time was moving faster then I so it was needed go back to the main railway terminal. My way was going near another one stadium built to FIFA 2018 - Ogarev arena.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaaMqtheMNzG4VeRL7bRXcuhNS2stYfnrYt5CRpmWT9Sp/1773079558467.jpg)


Aside of Ogarev arena I saw a House of Union at corner of which located excellent pastry shop with tasty cakes, biscuits, etc.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRyeqDZGUP8fCZdmMx8r5tQrNYvqc3gVWAgareiiHAB1z/1773079558360.jpg)
***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTxLBj9QNG5aEZ4YX6NCXUugxW2ZDjFhDSgdCr23S5o5b/1773079559323.jpg)

<center> *cakes and pastries in a pastry shop* </center>


And finally when temperature moved down again to - 25 degrees I reached railway terminal.
>The first building Saransk Railway Station was built in the first half of the 1890s to the beginning of the movement of trains through the station Saransk. In the first half of the 1940s, the station building and station square were reconstructed: train-station area has been increased, and on the place of the original building a new passenger terminal was built. In the mid -2000s it was decided to demolish the old building of the railway station and erect a new rail terminal, which was commissioned in 2009.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmamZDXd3ihrVzdNyqnJvYAALb5LwRUPiDaRcwYAYfFNxR/1773079558098.jpg)


***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfEggXBMSpnz355NUMnyJa66SdurHWuhTUif39C17q6ni/1773079557604.jpg)

***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSi1cwwY4XQ185DYT5UdAd2KngAJxNkmhBzEkJPymycWU/1773079557579.jpg)

***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ4VyN3ADsUuqNhoynuSPvb2V42TryoRicPU3oe4KthtX/1773079557626.jpg)

So when time came train took me aboard and departed me back to my region. From Saransk I have different feelings. First of all I understood that I want to visit it once more for more long time because it's not enough to observe all city at one day. I would also like to get to know the cultural and historical sights of the city and all Mordovian land better. I would like to not only walk past the aforementioned opera and ballet theater, but also attend a performance or opera inside it. To have the opportunity to feel it's soul. In addition, considering that it was very cold when I was in the city, I want to visit it in the summer to enjoy it's fountains and stroll through the city's green squares and parks. I hope that one day I will have this opportunity and will be able to visit this city again with my family, and then I will tell you about it in much more detail!
That's all for now. Stay tuned. Yours @travoved

body.title: Mastering the Stroke: A Guide to Graphite Grades and Drawing Tools
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSVSeX6S1DDKhADH2ovVoFrkGvAk1RcgAwHJbVxrRWncB/355.png 

Drawing is more than just making marks; it is a balance of chemistry and pressure. Understanding your tools—from the humble 2B pencil to the dramatic oil-based charcoal—allows you to expand your creative possibilities.

1. The Anatomy of Graphite
The \

in your pencil is actually a mixture of graphite (a soft crystalline carbon) and clay, fired in a kiln.

High Clay Content: Results in a harder, lighter lead (H for Hard).

High Graphite Content: Results in a softer, darker lead (B for Black).

Specific Pencil Categories
Intermediate Grade (2B – 3B): These are the artist's most flexible tools. The 2B is the standard for sketching, offering a soft stroke that is easy to erase without excessive smudging. Use 3B for deeper blacks.

Soft Pencils (4B – 6B and higher): These produce rich, expressive dark tones. However, they smudge easily. You must use your eraser carefully and avoid resting your hand directly on the paper.

Graphite Sticks: Thick, woodless leads typically available from 2B up to 9B. They are the best solution for covering large surfaces quickly, especially when applied on their side.

Tip: If the stick is not lacquered, wrap it in aluminum foil to keep your hands clean. If it has a varnish that hinders the stroke, simply scrape it off.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcrHhFjwoTH82RaLyz9jpDEGDFh7XKKmHJjTi111jDr55/ud1_t1_21_02.jpg 

2. Complementary Tools
Mechanical Pencils: Ideal for technical drawing as they produce standardized line widths.

Ungraded Pencils: Often thick-leaded and soft, used for general, less-detailed work.

Paper Stumps (Tortillons): Essential for blending. Since fingers carry natural oils that can stain the paper, stumps allow for clean, precise smudging.

3. Charcoal and Conté: The Power of Black
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbRz9N13A1TcYJGxpzGgUDdbVj38RT7UmF1FHHWcAo5Lx/256.png 

When graphite isn't dark enough, or the scale of the drawing is large, we turn to carbon-based mediums.

Types of Charcoal
Natural/Vine Charcoal: Easy to rectify and blend with a simple cloth.

Compressed Charcoal: Mixed with a binder. It is stronger, harder to erase, and ranges from 3H (hard) to 4B (softest).

Oil-Based Charcoal: Created by soaking charcoal in linseed oil. This makes the stroke permanent and smudge-proof, requiring no fixative.

Conté Pencils and Sticks
Available in traditional earth tones: White (chalk), Sanguine (iron oxide), Bistre (beechwood soot), Sepia (squid ink), and Black (graphite).

4. Techniques for Texture and Tone
  https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ5FT7nbjgE7R33zx4ngJadLv4ssLuUAPzXobMPtbJusM/554365.png 

Hatching and Cross-Hatching: Overlapping lines to create density. The more you cross the lines, the darker the area becomes.

Pressure Control: Tone is directly affected by how hard you press.

The Eraser as a Drawing Tool: Beyond correcting mistakes, a white plastic eraser is excellent for \

light out of dark areas to create highlights and reflections.

5. Professional Artist Tips
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQpzKAsoxFkqspVR9GHEvufMK1h5Go9CqkwTg41qHcyGF/154f5665.png 

Scale Matters: Use hard pencils (H) for small, detailed works meant to be seen up close. Reserve soft pencils (B) or charcoal for large-scale formats meant to be viewed from a distance.

Avoid the Smudge: Graphite and charcoal drawings are fragile. Always place a clean sheet of paper under your hand to protect the finished areas of your drawing as you move across the page.

Maintenance: Keep a high-quality sharpener for pencils, but use a craft knife (cutter) or sandpaper for sharpening charcoal and Conté sticks.

They don't need Salesforce's dashboard—they write to the database through endpoints. [Research shows](https://iunisov.com/ai-agents-replacing-websites/) agents process hundreds of pages of technical content and generate comparisons without touching a single webpage. The **website becomes deadweight**.

body.body: 4/8 🧵\n\n**Friction removal is value capture:** Every click, every page load, every login screen is friction. Platforms monetized that friction through ads, subscriptions, and data capture. Agents route around it—direct API calls, structured data exchange, zero human interface. The \
(platforms) lose their tollbooth. Winners are data sources (endpoints) and the agents themselves.

body.title: A Dose Of Something Unwelcome [Fiction]
body.body:
![masquerade-7575382_1280.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kemmyb/AKDhCWhmn6wh47d2egcPK1suSwUHSxSpZtwf3pB2G5ZZEvkSUr96kQ6XoJfjpVo.jpg)![divider curl .webp](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/kemmyb/a75ed810b8aaff74d2505ddf85186840400c52a1.webp)

<div class=text-justify>

“Alice, leave that corner and make friends. What's the matter with you tonight?” My mother, Lady Valenti, whispers in exasperation while smiling at passing guests at the masquerade ball of the season.

I roll my eyes at her and retreat further into the shadows by the grand staircase, nursing my drink. I rather enjoy being the wallflower at these occasions especially when I'm sort of forced to attend. 

Her friend, Mrs Boleyn sweeps her away with some gossip. 

I prepare myself to be bored, hence the hiding and the gulping of the deliciously sweet punch. Still, Lord and Lady Shepherd's ballroom glitters with lights and decorations like a box of jewels. 

The orchestra plays with fervor while couples in fashionable silk gowns and fine suits spin gracefully across the dance flower. Jewels flash beneath the lights. It almost feels like a fantasy dream…or *a dose of something unwelcome* or unreal. I'm not sure.

Or perhaps it's the punch. The servants may have added something stronger than fruit juice. If so, good.

But my focus cut across a duchess dressed as a silver swan to settle on four suspicious men who quickly separate, mingling with the guests.

Their postures are stiff. They seem flighty in black suits and their masks were simple. Black velvet with no jewel or feathers on them. *Why is no one else noticing them?*

I lean more into my corner, watching their movement with fascination. Tonight's masquerade ball may yet prove the most dangerous ball of the season. Second to Lady Lee Reed's infamous gathering where the ballroom caught fire and injured some servants.

One of the men stands by the door while another lingers by the grand staircase. The other two drift through the crowd like a shadow.

I finish my punch and take a glass of champagne off a servant's passing tray. This night is proving far more exciting than I expected.

The guests laugh loudly behind their masks as their diamond necklaces, gold bracelets and valuables slip off their person without their notice. I'm awed, sipping the bubbling drink.

Then Mrs Drew and Lady Rueckert scream from across the dance floor, clutching their necks. “Heavens! My necklace! It's gone.”

Gasps fill the room as panic spreads. I placed my glass cup on the small table in the corner, ready to point out the four masked men. 

My mother shows up out of nowhere and pulls my arm. “Ow! You'll give me a bruise.”

“Better a bruise than losing our heirloom. Let's go,” she gasps, pulling me along with her in long strides to the exit as the ball descends into chaos. “This gathering is ghastly. The nerve to steal from people. Lord and Lady Shepherd should be ashamed.”

I roll my eyes again, climbing into the carriage with her. 

As the horses gallop away, I glance back at the estate. Those masked men certainly filled their coffers tonight. 

![divider curl .webp](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/kemmyb/a75ed810b8aaff74d2505ddf85186840400c52a1.webp)

body.body: 6/8 🧵\n\n**Business model carnage:** [Licensing models are scrambling](https://intellectia.ai/blog/will-ai-disrupt-saas-business-model-2026)—agent-based pricing, outcome-based pricing, API call metering. But it's reactive. The fundamental issue: if an agent can replicate your SaaS workflow in 30 seconds using public APIs, your product is a UI tax. Companies that own **proprietary data or unique capabilities** survive. Pure aggregators don't.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 7/8 🧵\n\n**Infrastructure vs. interface:** Stripe, Plaid, Shopify (infrastructure) are safer than Expedia, Nerd Wallet, or most CRMs (interface). Agents still need payment rails, identity verification, and commerce backends. But they don't need someone to **show them a button**. The interface layer—the entire web design industry—faces existential risk. Your [@ai-summaries thread](https://inleo.io/threads/view/ai-summaries/re-taskmaster4450le-1773149819) captured this perfectly.

body.title: Why is some well educated ignorant of the bible// the. Old path
body.body:
https://youtu.be/fVqtyq-2M84?si=cFcKZb46I2UKa6dz

Higher education often exposes individuals to many different philosophies, religions, and worldviews. When people study history, science, and philosophy, they may begin to question traditional beliefs they grew up with. This exposure can create doubt about the authority or uniqueness of the Bible. Some begin to view it as just one religious text among many rather than the revealed word of God.

Pride and confidence in human knowledge can also play a role. Education can sometimes lead people to believe that human intelligence is sufficient to understand everything about life and the universe. When someone becomes deeply confident in human wisdom, they may find it difficult to accept the idea that divine wisdom is greater than human understanding. The Bible itself often calls people to humility and faith, which can conflict with a mindset that relies only on intellectual ability.

body.title: Shooting star magic
body.body:
![shooting-star-2024127_1280.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chefqueen/23swXdL3MYj68yJSQkyLwzk5Zi7Hxi45DqjA1wdPfs9vXZ3FcE9YSu8QixVt8fdhAWGJe.png)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/vectors/shooting-star-sky-night-dark-stars-2024127/)

I have heard many stories about shooting stars while growing up, even in movies as people look up to it and make their wish with the believe that all their wish spoken to it at that moment will surely come to past. Even though I heard about the scientific meaning to it as not a star but a a dust from the space that enter the atmosphere, people still didn't take their mind off the believe that it makes their wishes come true. Believing in it or not, what I see about is is the hope that it gives to people at that moment, the hope that this request of their will surely be answered, the faith that God has finally open the sky to bring in their prayers. 

Just as Rainbow that shows up after rainfall is believed by some people as magic. They see it as a sign of Good luck, Christians say it's a sign that hard and difficult  days as come to past and good and beautiful days have come. They see it as a sign that God still kept his promises that He is with us and all good things will only come to us.

When something  comes or happens rarely, it is just natural for people to believe it is special and they will give meaning to it. Though ,I have never seen a shooting star in real life before ,all I see is just from books. I would say I don not believe it's true it brings wishes come true but I just love the idea that people believed in it to do so, I think it helps in such a way that it will give motivation to people at that time that they shouldn't relent as God has come to take all their wishes and He will surely grant them.  Beliefs in something gives us courage to keep on and that's what I admire about the idea. 


And who knows? I can still come across a shooting star. 


![IMG-20250107-WA0019.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chefqueen/EpGQCcm1JqLRrDAhG8nfn1KecGU96eZHE7A8uNLnBLx325mtfPeNxGB9F2hrbgLqZH1.jpg)

body.body:
While traveling around the Mezhdurechensky district of the Vologda region, I clearly began to feel what I had been studying and confirming for many years – the atmosphere of the place and its interest. I have already traveled to almost all major settlements, of which there are not so many, and in some places it is interesting, and in others it is not at all.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSnsz4Z67BPb6J2kKNueVvxWE9sKXJei4DPagiZe9RJ3N/image.png)

body.body: LOL! If you don't like Bandai or anime games, like I said, that's fine by me. I'm not going to argue with your point of view at all; I simply disagree, and I won't change mine. I enjoy them quite a bit. Hmm, well, in the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure anime, for the fifth season with Giorno (one of my favorites, by the way), they summarized 150 chapters of the manga into 37 for the animated series. So, if the game summarizes that many chapters in an hour, it's not the end of the world. Anyway, it's a matter of taste...\n\nI always tend to buy things on sale (and I consider Steam and Epic's sales to be quite generous), and if it seems \

I simply don't buy it. For example, I'd been wanting to play Jedi: Fallen Order since it came out, but I didn't buy it until a few weeks ago when I got it on sale on Epic Games for $6.99 instead of the original $69.99. So, I've never felt obligated or needed to spend $40 or more on a game, no matter how much I like it. Similarly, I'm a huge DBZ fan, from the SNES games to the most recent ones. I thoroughly enjoyed Xenoverse and never paid for DLC (I didn't buy them), no matter how much I liked the series. That's my personal experience and how I weigh up my game purchases. I haven't bought Red Dead Redemption 2 because in the latest sales it's never below $14, and I don't intend to pay $14 for such an old game. I'll wait until it drops to $10 or less, even if I play it in the next two years. I like games, but I like the game of managing my money even more. Cheers.

body.body: 1/5 🧵\n\nThe Kremlin just got caught scrubbing the internet. Putin, 73, had a coughing fit during a pre-recorded Women's Day address — and Russia posted the raw footage showing him sputtering, clearing his throat, and asking for a retake because his \
Minutes later? Deleted. Replaced with a clean version. They claim it was posted \
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/5 🧵\n\nThe unedited clip shows Putin pausing mid-sentence, repeatedly coughing, and gesturing off-camera. \
he said. The footage appeared on official Kremlin social media accounts before being yanked.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/5 🧵\n\nThis isn't happening in a vacuum. Putin has been dogged by health rumors for years — reported strokes, multiple cancer diagnoses, Parkinson's disease. The Kremlin denies everything, but the pattern is clear: any footage suggesting weakness gets memory-holed fast.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/5 🧵\n\nWhy it matters: Putin's health is a geopolitical wildcard. Russia's entire power structure revolves around him. If he's genuinely ailing, succession planning becomes the most dangerous question in Moscow — and nobody knows the answer. A coughing fit wouldn't normally matter, but when you delete the evidence, you make it newsworthy.

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

Art and crafts can be somewhat abstract depending on how you look at them. Personally, I enjoyed visiting Guaquira and taking various photographs of many of the decorations there, and today I would like to share some of them with you. I hope you enjoy these photographs today.

El arte y las manualidades pueden llegar a ser algo abstracto dependiendo de cómo lo veas; personalmente, me gustó cuando fui a Guaquira e hice distintas fotografías de muchas de las decoraciones que había allí y el día de hoy quiero compartirles algunas. Espero que disfruten de estas fotografías el día de hoy.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23t76pKi2cmvtsGBYj4uDEiFinGsZhJ4JyYw4ctdcEiQ5tYTUgXsifAkuLkNamkiq3g5Y.jpg

Art will always depend on the person viewing it, but there are things that, just by looking at them for a couple of seconds, capture your attention, whether it's the whole thing, a specific part, or simply the colors. El arte siempre dependerá de la persona que lo vea, pero hay cosas que, con solo verlas por un par de segundos, capturan tu atención, ya sea por el conjunto de todo, alguna parte en específico o simplemente los colores, pero estas fotos en blanco y negro considero que permiten centrarse más en los detalles.

Photographs, clothing, and objects can undoubtedly have a certain appeal and something abstract about them depending on their design, and I believe that the photographs I am sharing with you today have a lot of that. Las fotografías, la ropa o los objetos pueden tener sin duda un punto de atracción y algo abstracto según su diseño y en las fotografías que les comparto el día de hoy considero que tienen mucho de ello; en cada una podrán encontrar algo que llame su atención o, al menos para mí en ese momento fue así.

That's all for this post. Let me know in the comments if anything in particular caught your attention. I'd love to hear from you. Thank you so much for taking the time to look at my photos. I really appreciate it. Have a great Tuesday. See you next time!

Hasta aquí la publicación; díganme en los comentarios si algo en específico captó su atención, estaré encantado de leerles. Muchas gracias por tomarse el tiempo de ver mis fotografías; lo aprecio mucho. Deseo que tengan un excelente martes. ¡Hasta la próxima!

body.title: Nice Guy
body.body:
*I don't want to be a kind guy if that's the kind of guy that women don't want...*

![Marta Salo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnjgeddes/23u6333cJVBrmK8Ek3dRufP61xm5hJvbzQuSkrjQvQmJqjmHvPcp5rA62Kf35aKEnN7QU.jpg)
*Marta*


Six courses in undergrad Psychology hardly entitles me to be a psychologist, but I suppose working in Human resources and being a good listener qualifies me in some people’s minds. Take Marta Salo, for instance. Over the past few years, I’ve had lunch with her in the company cafeteria maybe a dozen times and then, out of the blue, last week, she comes to me with this problem. Problem is definitely the wrong word—more like a tragedy. You see, her little boy died.

It turns out that her son was at a Cub Scouts’ jamboree—they served hotdogs tainted with Lysteria. Two hundred boys got ill, twenty were hospitalized and one died—Marta’s little Charlie. I’m listening to her tell me the story and wondering all the time, why me? —I mean, she’s gotta have people close to her she can confide in, or at least a counselor or some kind of qualified professional—but no, it turns out to be me. “The judge is rendering his verdict tomorrow, Sam—would you come with me? I know it’s a lot to ask and it’s your day off, but I just don’t know anyone else.” I’m sitting there figuring my ears have gotten me into more trouble than ten peoples’ mouths, but instead of politely declining I find myself saying, “Sure, I’ll be there. I’ll pick you up at nine.” The relief on her face was palpable. The ball of anxiety in my gut was building.

I’m not a psychologist. I’m no Dr. Phil—not even close. I’m just a poor shmuck who goes out to the bar for a drink and instead of coming home with a woman, I waste the entire evening listening to her problems and watching her leave with someone else. The story of my life. So, if you keep doing the same things, you keep getting the same results—at least that’s what Dr. Phil says—and he’s right. The problem is, I don’t know any other way to be.

I picked up Marta just after nine and we drove to the courthouse. Now, I don’t know about you, but courthouses unnerve me. Just the sight of lawyers and a judge in a black robe makes me fear I’ve finally been found out—Not that I have any hidden crimes or anything—I just have a free-floating guilt that my therapist says is the result of my Catholic upbringing. Well, whether or not that’s the case, the sight of the courthouse still unnerved me. It seemed to upset Marta too because she clung so tight to my arm, it hurt.

I’m not going to bore you with the details of the hearing other than to say that the court redressed a grave wrong and in the end worked things out in Marta’s favor, as much as could be expected under the circumstances. With the brief proceeding over and a judgment for 1.2 million awarded, I figured Marta might relax, seeing as she had ‘closure’, as her attorney put it.

I’m not sure if these attorneys are even human—the two of them from prestigious hyphenated law firms looked like Doppelgangers or clones of one another. They sounded that way too. Outside on the street, they conversed like old friends in the brief interval it took one to get into his black Porsche. “Some days it’s coal; some days it’s diamonds,” says Clone Number One. “Well, I’m off to the Hampton’s for the weekend—no Bermuda for me this month,” The other answers back. “It’s a hard life, “ the first clown/clone says and they both laugh. Then each goes their separate ways leaving Marta and me standing out there on the street.

“I hate them,” she said. I gotta admit, I hated their guts too in that instant. Then, she turns to me with the saddest look I ever saw on anyone’s face. “I’ll never forgive God for this—ever!” “C’mon, I’ll drive you home,” I says. I mean, what else are you gonna say when somebody comes out with a line like that? She looks at me with those same sad eyes she had the moment before. “Thank you, Sam. You’re a good guy.” I drive her home and never see her again. As I told you before, that’s the story of my life.

Some nights though, when I toss and turn and can’t get to sleep, her face comes back to haunt me. What happens to somebody who can’t forgive God? It scares me, more than what happened to her. If I really think about it, I think she could end up in hell and then, never see her son. I’ve got a load of guilt I carry around, but it’s all my stuff. I don’t have to worry about God running the universe, or maybe ruining my life—I do a pretty good job of that myself. But part of me knows that Marta will be all right. Thinking about her and her sad face, a line by Tennyson comes to mind that kinda sums up how I feel. —“Her eyes are homes of silent prayer.” I’m thinking that’s the prism God uses to see her.

body.title: Bitcoin Price is Trying to Go Above the Middle Line of Ascending Channel

body.title: YouTube Now The Largest Media Company
body.body:
![Cover Image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeub9uZnkVnBQ8ikPjWkFo7sJNHUymkJyPMPYZKgyVdna/ai-image-1773149342793.jpeg)



YouTube is now larger than Disney.

Let that sink in for a moment.  The revenues for YouTube topped $60 billion in 2025, surpassing Disney.

This is a historic moment.

>YouTube had more than $60 billion in revenue in 2025, parent company Alphabet reported last month. Now, the influential financial research firm MoffettNathanson runs the numbers and comes to the conclusion that YouTube’s estimated $62 billion in 2025 will have allowed it to pass The Walt Disney Co.’s media business, which generated $60.9 billion last year (excluding Disney’s lucrative experiences division).

We not only see this in revenues; it is also reflected in the valuation.  While YouTube's value is an estimate, it does speak to what is taking place.

>The firm, which declared YouTube the “new king of all media” last year, is now valued at between $500 billion-$560 billion, far above any traditional media competitors. The closest would be Netflix, which has a market cap of about $409 billion as of writing.

This is evidence of a major transition taking place.  I long wrote how Hollywood is cooked.  The epicenter for media is now shifting.

## YouTube Now The Largest Media Company

Los Angeles is the obvious loser in this.  What was once the entertainment capital of the world is no more.  The new distribution channel is showing the effects.  It was overlooked for decades yet it taking hold.

For the industry, it is too late.

When we couple this with generative AI, the situation becomes even more dire for traditional Hollywood. AI-generated content is already being integrated into production workflows—from scriptwriting assistance to visual effects to post-production editing. What was once a fringe concept relegated to tech forums is now mainstream conversation. Major publications like The New York Times, Variety, and The Wall Street Journal are running serious pieces on how generative AI will reshape entertainment production, reduce headcount, and lower barriers to entry for creators. The Writers Guild and SAG-AFTRA's recent labor agreements included specific clauses around AI usage, signaling that the industry recognizes this isn't theoretical anymore—it's happening now. As another round of labor negotiations approaches, studios will push harder for AI carve-outs and cost reductions. Creators and talent will fight back, but the leverage has fundamentally shifted. The combination of YouTube's dominance, Netflix's proven streaming model, and now AI-powered production tools means the traditional studio system—which relied on scarcity, gatekeeping, and expensive infrastructure—has lost its moat. For an industry already bleeding audience share and facing margin pressure, this convergence could accelerate the timeline toward irrelevance far more quickly than anyone anticipated just five years ago.

AI is accelerating and more people are starting to utility it.  This benefits YouTube at the cost of the movie studios.

## Analysts Are Agreeing

Those who watch the industry, from a financial perspective, are starting to pick up on it.  When Wall Street latches onto a narrative, it can spread.

>“There are two really fundamental things that we do for creators,” YouTube CEO Neal Mohan told The Hollywood Reporter last year, just a few hours after announcing the milestone. “One is help them build an audience and connect with their fans, regardless of where those fans are in the world; and the second thing we do is we help them build businesses. That’s what that $100 billion represents for me.”

>MoffettNathanson argues that the scale as a distributor, both of pay-TV and of creator-led content, will help it continue its explosive growth. So will its heavy investment into AI tools, which will allow creators to produce more content at a faster cadence.

<center>[Source](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/digital/youtube-worlds-largest-media-company-2025-tops-disney-1236525130/)</center>

As with anything today, speed is key.  The fact that generative AI will allow content creators to produce more output at a faster pace gives us insight into what is happening.  The numbers simply work against the studios.

Think of this as an oil tanker against a fleet of speed boats.  Naturally, the size means the tanker is a monumental force.  However, it does not maneuver like speedboats and can be overwhelmed with the numbers.

Since costs will be going to near-free, this means that volume is the deciding factor.

Some claim that we are reverting back to a time where storytelling becomes crucial.  Maybe that is true.  One would think this favors the traditional system.  It does not.

The problem is that Hollywood got away from creativity.  Over the last decade plus the tendency was to leverage existing properties.  Marvel, LucasFilm, and other franchises simply churned out more of the same.  Sprinkle in some messaging and audiences have turned their attention elsewhere.

Box office numbers reflect this problem.  Streaming, which was heralded as the savior, was a sinkhole of cash for everyone other than Netflix.  Having a money loser as the savior is not a healthy position to be in.

Technology is taking over many industries.  This trend is just getting started.  Tech companies are going to be educators, healthcare providers, entertainment entities, and financial firms.  

Ask a tech executive what business they are in and the answer is \
\n\nThe largest media company is now in Silicon Valley.  That is quite a shift.

body.title: Battle Ready Cards- Chaos Evoker, Mana Warden, Portly Cannoneer.
body.body:
Hello everyone.
My name is @naturaluttom. I will tell you about three cards from my favorite game Splinterlands, the three cards are Chaos Evoker, Mana Warden and Portly Cannoneer. These three cards play a different important role in battle and if used correctly, it often becomes easy to win the match.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJM6tMisJXXi8rQvFdxNM9Ayq1LiHyAJUQ88jEuEWevB/1773148834317.png)

## [The image was created with AI.]()

The Chaos Evoker card, it is a Rare monster card of Life Splinter and its mana cost is 7. This card has a Magic attack, so it can counterattack the enemy's armor and directly damage health. Being a magic attacker, it can often weaken the enemy team very easily. Usually, placing this card in the middle position works well and can have a good effect on the battle with continuous magic damage.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNdvW5WzXiZipLfszNDCByK64aRARrLARpN6tcwDZWb4N/1773149067767.jpg)





The Mana Warden card. This is also a Rare monster card of Life Splinter and its mana cost is 4. Mana Warden also has a Magic attack. The most important ability of this card is Void. Due to the Void ability, the enemy's magic attack damage is reduced. So if the opponent uses a magic team, then the Mana Warden team can provide a lot of protection and can survive for a long time in the battle.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUHvXppVds1yhug7dEWLrpsWqD7VCpSjPrRKCHutrrP97/1773149067841.jpg)
The next card is the Portly Cannoneer card. It is a Neutral Epic monster card and its mana cost is 4. This card uses Ranged attack and its special ability is Scattershot. Due to the Scattershot, this card's attack can go to any card of the enemy team. Sometimes, the situation of the battle can suddenly change by hitting the weak card behind it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPtshV6zNMdqPr9Wr4NigxPZYYJu38hTfp1cXtko2m8wr/1773149067910.jpg)

All in all, the three cards Chaos Evoker, Mana Warden and Portly Cannoneer can be used in different strategies in battle. If you can arrange the team correctly, these cards can help a lot in winning the match.














I am ending today's post here. I hope you are doing well and trying to create your own strategy in the game of Splinterlands.

## Welcome to the Weekly Writing Prompt from The Ink Well
We provide *one weekly writing prompt* for short story writers. You may choose to use the prompt to write a fictional story (made up from your imagination) or a creative nonfiction story (based on your real life experiences). 

**IMPORTANT**: To be considered for curation, you *must* include one of these tags on your post:
* Fictional stories: #fiction
* Creative nonfiction stories: #creativenonfiction

It is also *very* helpful to the admin team when authors add Fiction or Creative Nonfiction (or CNF for short) to the story title!

![TheInkWell Section Seperator.png](https://files.steempeak.com/file/steempeak/theinkwell/X4DfQH87-TheInkWell20Section20Seperator.png)


### Before You Post in The Ink Well
Be sure to check out our community rules before posting in this community. You can find them at the top of our [home page](https://peakd.com/c/hive-170798/created). They also appear at the top of a new post window.

Please also check out these additional helpful resources:
* Learn more about our community and the expectations of community members in our [FAQ post](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/important-faqs-about-the-ink-well-dos-and-donts-rules-and-tips) and our [treasure trove of tips and guidelines](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/the-ink-well-treasure-trove-of-tips-reminders-and-guidelines).
* Peruse our collection of great writing resources on everything from character development to how to write dialogue in our [catalog of storytelling tips](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/catalog-of-fiction-writing-tips-from-the-ink-well). 
* Learn more about creative nonfiction, how it differs from fictional stories, and tips for success in [our post on creative nonfiction tips](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/creative-nonfiction-what-it-is-and-tips-for-success).
* Remember that we are *always* about quality first. Never about *quantity.* To achieve awards in The Ink Well, take the time to write quality stories and check them for errors. See the topic of the month, \

in the [March 2025 newsletter](https://www.pexels.com/photo/woman-walking-alone-on-a-field-in-dense-fog-16254468/) to learn about using tools (and using them properly) if you are not already doing this. **We do notice when you don't take the time!**

![TheInkWell Section Seperator.png](https://files.steempeak.com/file/steempeak/theinkwell/X4DfQH87-TheInkWell20Section20Seperator.png)

## Last Week's Winning Story of the Week

Thank you to everyone who shared a story for the last prompt, \

!

Each week we pick one of our favorite stories of the week and award the author 5 Hive. 

And we have a winner! Congrats to @seki1 for his story [*The Robbery*](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@seki1/the-robbery). 

Here's what our curators had to say:

> I'm always grateful to an author when I end a story with a smile.  Such is the case with seki1's romp, \

.  So very clever, a thief manages to get in a home and hold the home owner hostage.  But, who really is the hostage?  The home owner gets free as the resident dog attacks the thief. Now the wounded thief is the hostage of the dog.  It's very funny,  very cute, very well done. 

Congratulations, @seki1! 

![TheInkWell Section Seperator.png](https://files.steempeak.com/file/steempeak/theinkwell/X4DfQH87-TheInkWell20Section20Seperator.png)

## Short Story Writing Prompt of the Week

This week's prompt is: \

Memories of people and events from the past can be lovely, or bittersweet. Sometimes a particular memory will make us laugh; sometimes it will make us feel complex feelings or sadness. There are many ways to craft stories about the complicated human mind and its ability to remember past times and people we have known.

Memories can also change with time. Think about a family storyteller who is always asked to tell the story about a particular life event, and it's never quite the same. Or a memory you have from your own life that you're never sure was exactly as you remember it. 

Whether you are inspired to write a fictional story about made-up characters, or a creative nonfiction story from your real life experiences, we hope you have fun crafting a story about memories. As always, you do not need to actually use the prompt word(s). They are here to inspire your creativity!

We look forward to reading the product of your imagination or your memories! 

Good luck! And of course, you are welcome to use AI to generate ideas and images, but the writing must be *your own*! We do not accept stories that are AI-generated or heavily edited by AI. Only use tools like Grammarly to fix spelling and grammar issues.

Remember, as always, we are looking for the elements of *story*. These include: 

* Great first lines
* Good settings
* Well-developed characters
* Integration of action, dialogue and narrative
* A conflict that intrigues the reader
* A \

which results in the resolution of the conflict and brings the story to a satisfying conclusion
* And of course, we are looking for well-edited stories that are not littered with typos or grammatical errors — please use the free Grammarly tool for grammar and spelling checks (and not AI writing or rephrasing tools for revising)

You can find more on all of these topics in the [catalog of storytelling tips](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/catalog-of-fiction-writing-tips-from-the-ink-well).

If you don't feel inspired by this prompt or the featured image, feel free to peruse any of our past prompts or our collection of idea-generators:
- [50 Loglines](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/the-ink-well-writing-prompts-50-story-loglines)
- [50 Story Ideas](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/the-ink-well-fiction-prompt-6-50-story-ideas)
- [50 Imagination Ticklers](https://peakd.com/fiction/@theinkwell/the-ink-well-prompt-13-50-imagination-ticklers)


## Rules:
1. ***Accepted content***: Remember that we only accept short stories (fiction or creative nonfiction). We do not accept advice columns, personal development articles, reviews, chapter stories, recipes, etc. We also do not accept posts about violent, gory, bloody, brutal, sexist or racist themes, NSFW (not safe for work) stories like erotica, stories with a political or religious agenda, or stories featuring abuse of any kind. (We have a complete article about [The Ink Well stance on violence and brutality](https://peakd.com/hive-170798/@theinkwell/violence-and-brutality-in-fiction-the-ink-wells-stance) for more information.) And do NOT use AI tools to write or manipulate your stories. You must provide *your own* unique content.
1. ***Post link***: Please be sure to publish your story in [The Ink Well](https://peakd.com/c/hive-170798/created) community, and post a link to your story in a comment on this post.

1. ***Images***: Please only use images from license free and creative commons sites, like [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/), [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/) and [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/). body.title: CCC's Street Art Contest #291 - The Streets and Their Murals / Las Calles Y Sus Murales
body.body:
>


***English***


### <center>**The Streets and Their Murals**</center>
As I've mentioned before, mural landscapes beautify the urban spaces of our city; any environment is strategic for projecting culture and showcasing the natural beauty that surrounds us. Each solitary wall comes alive with color and transforms, enlivening the place. And people can enjoy a brief respite indoors, becoming part of the landscape.

>***Español***

>### <center>**Las Calles Y Sus Murales**</center>
>Como le he dicho en otras oportunidades, los paisajes muralistas embellecen los espacios urbanos de nuestra ciudad; cualquier entorno es estratégico para proyectar la cultura y mostrar la belleza natural que nos rodea.  Cada muro solitario cobra vida con los colores y se transforma para dar vida al lugar. Y las personas pueden disfrutar un breve descanso bajo techo integrándose al paisaje.


![IMG_20260210_151002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23xyZNAuMedDoHqoWThnFWgKQ6rWu4qxtonkQVhTnnEGuMZinbwcFPUrLGwbxfqNYBqcN.jpg)


This was the impression I got upon seeing this mural, a fresh painting where nature, in all its splendor, is integrated into a wall whose uneven structure lends itself to depicting the slopes of the mountain. Which, as we know, is a representation of our fascinating Ávila mountain, that natural refuge that separates the city from the sea.

>Esta fue la impresión que percibí al ver este mural, una pintura fresca donde la naturaleza con todo su esplendor se integra en un muro cuya estructura desigual es propicia para pincelar los declives de la montaña. Que, como bien sabemos, es una representación de nuestro fascinante Ávila, ese refugio natural que aleja la ciudad del mar 

![IMG_20260210_151026~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23x1BKYnN7djv7E1TvZFEMMPBvPdWanAxicfeZ8yc4TxEvKgRLHtWp2MqQ2AndyTJabhM.jpg)

And this same artwork blends with the religious figure, where the deep-rooted devotion to this saint in Venezuela transcends mere beliefs; his life is intertwined with history, because he dedicated it to helping the most needy, and after his death, his followers proclaimed him the saint of the poor, due to the miracles he granted. As always, the murals tell the story the artist wishes to express. Here is the artwork viewed from two different angles.

>Y esa misma obra se mezcla con la figura religiosa, donde la devoción tan arraigada por este santo en Venezuela va más allá de sus creencias; su vida está anclada a la historia, porque la dedicó a ayudar a los más necesitados y, después de su muerte, sus seguidores lo proclamaron como el santo de los pobres, por los milagros concedidos. Como siempre, los murales cuentan la historia que el artista quiere expresar. Aquí les dejo la obra tomada en dos ángulos distintos.

![5s4dzRwnVbzGY5ssnCE4wXzkeAEXyVtgk1ApQTwHMTp6y5PvEo1yennAbzQkJ9G8uVvM1WjDyTeCvUuTiNFbfpF1J9yKTEBESC7RtqAxoD6Bxcoo9NaddDxcS5uE8yY95UEuz59CpRNk6DkRm9KA8gUJKK44W396P5RhjnE.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23tvASVrTgFFPYz1s62q3C9eFbkQRo9rWE2uxH6GMt4TsfTQCNqzbmpm3djenunLN6PA8.png)

body.title: Another Chapter
body.body:
![2532.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josediccus/EpXMsqEVP6vC8vB6WwHCuXP2chWbH3pHNyWn4dmQyPGDSd1DEyRYw5CwzRDsLS77L4j.jpg)

<hr>


There's an account I follow on Hive, they post a lot about finance, money and crypto. I enjoy the content they do because it's motivational, educational and uplifting. 


Most of the discussion I have with people are mostly about money, and I like learning about money or opportunities that are related to money.


 Recently I discovered their content style has changed to something they wouldn't originally talk about and I began to guess; perhaps a next of kin now uses the account, they handed the account to an assistant or maybe they just began another chapter in their life and wanted someone to continue using the account. 

## New market/different opportunities

In the past few weeks, I've seen a lot of contents about people finding new commitments, new hobbies, life and other things. 

Generally I feel that this is somehow related to the crypto market at the moment. Back in early 2021 and 2025, I noticed a pattern and that was the sudden interest in crypto. 

People suddenly want to save in crypto, do everything with crypto and make outrageous money. 

They no longer wanted to walk walk their dog, or get the 1% guaranteed APY for saving in their local bank accounts, some even left their former moneymaking opportunities because of that big pump in 2021 and early 2025, but again, it's abandoned, and suddenly people realized oh \

# Different Audience 

I've realised a few things from these: crypto is a not sustainable hobby if you get discouraged easily. The crypto space is heavily diluted, no longer as self-preserving, decentralized and enriching as it was. The market is spreading too thin and lastly you need to build without the barrier of cycles to actually make profit. 


In the next few months more people are going to leave crypto, it's not a Hive thing. It's more of an altcoin thing, as well as the lack of excitement we currently have. Nothing seems look good, the narratives and story isn't as previously rewarding and only the people who are builders and lovers of the tech are available. 


##### I'm I going to ask you to keep staying? 


> No, I won't.

 Everyone has the right to choose between leaving and staying. The fun fact is that you can still chase other big narratives while still coming back later. 

I think the best part of crypto will be coming in when the noise is suppressed, buying up and then coming back to cash out when the noise becomes excessively loud due to pumps. 


In reality, I think this is also the best time to build if you're coming from zero, but I don't think anyone is actually qualified to advise another person, because people should be allowed to do whatever they want at this point. 


I've been sharing my failure and success stories on Hive since 2017, and I think all continue, God willing. People are going to act in the most favourable way that betters their life, just watch, learn, do your own research and do what's best for you. 


It hasn't been a good month for me, as I lost the money I earned from my previous Gig. The current market is making people start up different new chapters in their lives.

body.title: Будівництво стелажу для майстерні
body.body:
Не знаю, як ті люди в нашій громаді будуються. Бо знайти все, що потрібно для цього, у нас в містечку неможливо. Як і обставити меблями той збудований дім. І технікою якісною. Бо в нас нічого не продається. 
Магазинів будматеріалів є кілька штук, але там вкрай обмежений асортимент. Наприклад, вибрати міцний та певного кольору профіль для паркану у нас неможливо. Бго привозять виключно дешевий, тонкий як консервна банка, і тільки коричневого кольору. Замовити інший колір можна, та невідомо скільки чекати прийдеться, ніхто не дає гарантій. 
Світильників тут також не знайти. Ні, штук з десять є в одному з магазинів. Але ви ж розумієте, - це не той вибір, який потрібен при будівництві чи капремонті...
Так само і з меблями, і з будівельними сумішами, і з деревом, і з металом, - зі всім.

Будуємо в літній кухні гончарну майстерню. Задумали зробити великий та надійний стелаж на пів-стіни. Зупинилися на тому, що основу робимо з металу, а полички закладатимуться дерев'яні. І так як готових типу цього що на фото ми не купимо, то треба зробити його своїми руками.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/23xVKMjCiHnzxeqpDaKUZPSsxgMDvXz7zVr5CbU4D4v6eUnJuom2KbdaYkg5J7FZRkSJZ.jpg)
[Джерело](https://unitrade.in.ua/p660868358-180h90h60-stellazh-polok.html?source=merchant_center&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=20600597737&gbraid=0AAAAAC_b2yqkVXnF8ncD37ZdX4Wa9jSfe&gclid=Cj0KCQjwgr_NBhDFARIsAHiUWr7XjxUgewyUPr-lhyO6Y4Ee5Pi-2o6kB3F4KLyD-57MufsxFeLNNb0aAg9IEALw_wcB)

Поїхали по метал........
Вже повернулися ні з чим, вдома.
Пішли передивлятися, які в нас є матеріали під бруси.
Будемо робити з дерева. Свого.😏

Металу не те що немає. Знайшли кутовий по 70 грн за метр. Але - тонший, ніж нам треба.
Потім нас направили у ще одне місце. Попередивши, що там може бути дуже дорого. Але, мовляв, якщо треба, то треба, бо їхати у найближче місто вийде дорожче. Дякувати трампу за ціни на бензин.😡
Приїхали. Там наш кутовий профіль - по 90 грн за метр.
Порахували вартість замовлення. Відмовились. Бо за таку ціну я можу \

меблеву купити, а не голий метал для стелажу.
Будемо викручукватись своїми силами. Не думаю, що результат буде гіршим. Адже мій чоловік - на всі руки майстер!❤️

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/23xVM1J9vaDvkGorWy9qLXghPxwY12hoj3CjRjdYX9jJCCB6L4dAbhfyCJFWWq1isMp4D.jpg)

body.title: Learning and Unlearning: A Necessary Path
body.body: > One of the necessary things for any human to know and be intentional about as we live out our lives on earth is the need to keep learning. As it is said, learning never ends. I tend to agree with that. Every day we live is an opportunity to learn something. It could be something entirely new or something we knew but we are adding a measure of knowledge to it. Safe to say, every day’s life and experience is a privilege to learn. This makes for some of the striking differences we see in our world today amongst people.

/> [Image Source.](https://unsplash.com/photos/people-and-learning-concept-with-textured-effect-NsWrqGlryZI) Saying that we need to learn alone isn't quite complete or balanced. There's a thing as unlearning. While we could strive to learn; adding knowledge and/or experience, there's also a need to unlearn; subtracting knowledge we already have. It's a needed balance. This makes for maybe even a higher level of contrast and difference we see amongst people in our world. Unlearning opens an individual to more possible knowledge and experience. What we know can be wrong and unlearning unravels that. I've seen the need to learn things, and also the need to unlearn some things. Some of these things can be subconsciously learnt, and putting them off can be a big deal. One thing I consider very resourceful and helpful, which I'm learning is to do things bit by bit; to follow things at a realistic pace. When I set a goal, I don't want to choke myself with it. I'm learning that there's wisdom in setting it into little portions that will make me see the reality of achieving it, hence increasing my chances. Rather than struggling with an overload. The idea about this was since late last year and it seems to be something to go with. I've seen how trying to get plenty of things done has caused little to nothing to get done, due to reasons like being overwhelming or lingering for over an extended time than supposed or expected. Mostly because there's a lot to achieve within a limited period. It seems like one of the ways we humans make ourselves busy without really being productive. I'm learning that being busy might not really mean that and ultimately being productive.

/> [Image Source.](https://unsplash.com/photos/woman-in-blue-denim-jacket-standing-on-green-grass-field-during-daytime-eHU8pgEh0ww) I'm also learning something important as regards humans relationship or interactions. Relationships are one of the most valuable assets a person can have and that says a lot about humanity. I see the need to give people the benefit of the doubt in some kind of situations. From the things I've seen and learnt in life, it's not always right to conclude a matter without giving the benefit of the doubt. Sometimes, I would tell my friends, let's give the benefit of the doubt to a person on a matter before concluding. Not every kind of situation though. So, I'm unlearning overwhelming myself with several things at a time, which don't become productive in the end. Or trying to finish a heavy task within a short placed time because others possibly do it that way. I unlearned the need to do that and learnt to do otherwise. The need to be unnecessarily busy is something I'm unlearning too. Also, to always consider that things can be wrong and allow proving that right or wrong when it pertains to human interactions. * * * ###### Thank you for reading through!

body.title: Job Applications That Remain Unfinished /  Solicitudes De Empleo Que Quedan Sin Completar [ENG-ESP]
body.body:
>

Hello, everyone.

Hello everyone, how are you? I've been away from social media for a while as I'm focused on finally finding new job opportunities. Stay tuned and I'll tell you all about it. Yes, it is difficult to find remote work on any of these platforms. The best known is called Computrabajo, and I can tell you that I have applied many times and companies don't even bother to look at my resume. It just stays in the first step. Others do look at the information and decide not to accept you as a candidate, and that's valid. We don't make decisions for them, that's more than clear. But I've realized that I'm not the only one. I've seen a lot of content where most people's applications aren't seen, and obviously, I don't just accept that they didn't accept me. Instead, I look for more options. But right now, what many are calling for is a decent salary, since many describe the situation as getting worse instead of better, at least in terms of wage increases, which is causing many companies to lay off or let go of their current employees. And frankly, in the first few days of the year, there was a sense of change in the air for the country, but honestly, we just have to be patient because you can't solve the chaos in a country in three months. But anyway, I don't want to dwell on this. I'll keep looking around the city for jobs that aren't so demanding in terms of hours. Hopefully, the platforms won't ask for so many requirements, at least to monetize some videos so I can move up, but I'm not ruling out throwing myself into that world of possibilities. We can all do it, but there's one key word: consistency. There's nothing else, frankly, but I'll get that big income, God willing. Thank you all Note: These photos were taken from my phone and edited In: Canva

Hola A Todos.
