body.title: My opinion about the movie \
// Mi opinión sobre la película \
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![1000218952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/Eou7kU5sadPfBM14ugXE1NofvoDtp77BDhw95pFazF4gMi7xTAqG77d7qfRQjpCVhFh.jpg)

<Center>[Sources](https://www.google.com/search?vsrid=CL-S9Zyl0OzSrgEQAhgBIiRmMjk2YmVlMi1iNzFlLTRiN2QtYTg1My1jYzJiOThiMDQyMjkyeyICcncoB0JzCi5sZmUtZHVtbXk6OWE0YzU0Y2ItZDkyMS00N2FjLWI4YTktMzYzN2Y5YzA5YmU4EkEKPy9ibnMvcncvYm9yZy9ydy9ibnMvbGVucy1mcm9udGVuZC1hcGkvcHJvZC5sZW5zLWZyb250ZW5kLWFwaS82MjiU-d2trpSTAw&vsint=CAIqDAoCCAcSAggKGAEgATojChYNAAAAPxUAAAA_HQAAgD8lAACAPzABEOEBGOABJQAAgD8&udm=26&lns_mode=un&source=lns.web.gisivli&vsdim=225,224&gsessionid=jGtFljri18Y5QgFImOVuWkiY-4LJPkMDms5451JU-ZV4YvHFzue14Q&lsessionid=4E8vRy1kjVQC7j_TJgd1MtHUCjEAL49vRvy-wDcf57OhJ94WcOee6Q&lns_surface=19&authuser=0&qsubts=1773112379681&biw=360&bih=662&ved=0CBsQh6cGahcKEwiwpcP7rZSTAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQQg&tbnid=d8eoXU8cl_4GeM&ictx=2)</Center>




Hello, friends of #hive, and especially the Movies&TVshows community. As always, I hope you are all well, along with your family and friends. Today I'm here to talk to you about a movie that I really liked and happened to see last night. I'm talking about \

a film released in 2013, directed by Martin Scorsese and starring an unbridled Leonardo DiCaprio.



This is one of the most controversial and energetic films in contemporary cinema. With a running time of almost three hours, this criminal biography disguised as a satirical black comedy mercilessly immerses us in the rise and fall of Jordan Belfort, a stockbroker who turned greed into an extreme lifestyle. It is based on Belfort's own memoirs and is not intended to be a moralizing documentary, but rather an overwhelming sensory experience that forces us to look squarely at the most grotesque and seductive side of the savage capitalism of the 1980s and 1990s.


![1000218955.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/EoK4RZB1UucRSP4Y98jSTVSUpVzFFJDg5xe4jebhBTwWLVm4HnwYuux1MGj7eoXzpX7.jpg)


<Center>[Sources](https://www.google.com/search?vsrid=CL-S9Zyl0OzSrgEQAhgBIiRmMjk2YmVlMi1iNzFlLTRiN2QtYTg1My1jYzJiOThiMDQyMjkyeyICcncoB0JzCi5sZmUtZHVtbXk6OWE0YzU0Y2ItZDkyMS00N2FjLWI4YTktMzYzN2Y5YzA5YmU4EkEKPy9ibnMvcncvYm9yZy9ydy9ibnMvbGVucy1mcm9udGVuZC1hcGkvcHJvZC5sZW5zLWZyb250ZW5kLWFwaS82MjiU-d2trpSTAw&vsint=CAIqDAoCCAcSAggKGAEgATojChYNAAAAPxUAAAA_HQAAgD8lAACAPzABEOEBGOABJQAAgD8&udm=26&lns_mode=un&source=lns.web.gisivli&vsdim=225,224&gsessionid=jGtFljri18Y5QgFImOVuWkiY-4LJPkMDms5451JU-ZV4YvHFzue14Q&lsessionid=4E8vRy1kjVQC7j_TJgd1MtHUCjEAL49vRvy-wDcf57OhJ94WcOee6Q&lns_surface=19&authuser=0&qsubts=1773112379681&biw=360&bih=662&ved=0CBsQh6cGahcKEwiwpcP7rZSTAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQQg&tbnid=d8eoXU8cl_4GeM&ictx=2)</Center>



The story begins in 1987 with a 25-year-old Jordan Belfort, played by Leonardo DiCaprio, entering the world of Wall Street full of ambition. His first mentor, Mark Hanna, played by Matthew McConaughey in a brief but unforgettable appearance, teaches him the true religion of the profession: money is for yourself, drugs help you cope with stress, and sex is just another form of power. After losing his job in the Black Monday crash, Jordan reinvents himself in the world of penny stocks on Long Island, where he discovers that his gift for aggressive sales and manipulative charisma can generate quick fortunes through the classic scheme of artificially inflating the price of cheap stocks and selling them before the collapse, leaving investors with devastating losses.




With money flowing freely, Jordan founds Stratton Oakmont, a firm that becomes synonymous with excess. The film shows, without filters, how he recruits an army of equally ambitious and unscrupulous salespeople, among whom Jonah Hill stands out as Donnie Azoff, his partner, with a big ego, a comic sidekick, and also somewhat pathetic, ha ha ha. The offices are transformed into a mixture of casino, brothel, and circus, with orgies, dwarfs thrown like human darts, massive drug use, endless parties, and a complete disregard for any ethical or legal norms. Jordan marries Naomi Lapaglia, played by Margot Robbie, a model who embodies the perfect trophy of his success, although their relationship becomes a toxic battlefield filled with infidelity, violence, and drugs.



![1000218953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23xp8qTqjQWZ4ir3cpacZyCsenj3qz86gNvdHPSB4uN7o7QM4sQNyABRhg6J3C6HkF2G7.jpg)


<Center>[Sources](https://www.google.com/search?vsrid=CL-S9Zyl0OzSrgEQAhgBIiRmMjk2YmVlMi1iNzFlLTRiN2QtYTg1My1jYzJiOThiMDQyMjkyeyICcncoB0JzCi5sZmUtZHVtbXk6OWE0YzU0Y2ItZDkyMS00N2FjLWI4YTktMzYzN2Y5YzA5YmU4EkEKPy9ibnMvcncvYm9yZy9ydy9ibnMvbGVucy1mcm9udGVuZC1hcGkvcHJvZC5sZW5zLWZyb250ZW5kLWFwaS82MjiU-d2trpSTAw&vsint=CAIqDAoCCAcSAggKGAEgATojChYNAAAAPxUAAAA_HQAAgD8lAACAPzABEOEBGOABJQAAgD8&udm=26&lns_mode=un&source=lns.web.gisivli&vsdim=225,224&gsessionid=jGtFljri18Y5QgFImOVuWkiY-4LJPkMDms5451JU-ZV4YvHFzue14Q&lsessionid=4E8vRy1kjVQC7j_TJgd1MtHUCjEAL49vRvy-wDcf57OhJ94WcOee6Q&lns_surface=19&authuser=0&qsubts=1773112379681&biw=360&bih=662&ved=0CBsQh6cGahcKEwiwpcP7rZSTAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQQg&tbnid=d8eoXU8cl_4GeM&ictx=2)</Center>



Scorsese films everything with a nervous, dynamic, almost manic camera, dizzying zooms, frenetic editing, and 80s pop and rock music that contrasts brutally with the moral decadence. It is as if the director wants the viewer to feel the same addictive adrenaline that consumes the characters. DiCaprio delivers possibly his most physical and uninhibited performance, screaming, gesticulating, writhing under the effects of drugs, dancing ridiculously, and making us unwitting accomplices to his misdeeds. I must say that it is hypnotic to watch him; his Jordan is charismatic, repulsive, brilliant, and pathetic all at the same time. Ha, ha, ha, he's a real gem.



This film generates debate because it offers no explicit moral judgment. There is no redeeming hero or didactic condemnation at the end. Belfort narrates his own story as if it were an epic adventure, and Scorsese seems to revel in the exuberance of chaos. Some critics accused it of glorifying criminal behavior. Others defend it as a fierce satire, arguing that by showing unbridled excess, the film exposes the absurdity and emptiness of that life. We don't need the film to tell us \

; it's enough to see these men turned into spoiled children with unlimited power to understand the rottenness.



![1000218954.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23uFRzMKFcVHnwwDnkadMV7YAakzvfHEJSMKKK4q4wZAVAjESgQi3CX4cztJWLKKS7X2r.jpg)


<Center>[Sources](https://www.google.com/search?vsrid=CL-S9Zyl0OzSrgEQAhgBIiRmMjk2YmVlMi1iNzFlLTRiN2QtYTg1My1jYzJiOThiMDQyMjkyeyICcncoB0JzCi5sZmUtZHVtbXk6OWE0YzU0Y2ItZDkyMS00N2FjLWI4YTktMzYzN2Y5YzA5YmU4EkEKPy9ibnMvcncvYm9yZy9ydy9ibnMvbGVucy1mcm9udGVuZC1hcGkvcHJvZC5sZW5zLWZyb250ZW5kLWFwaS82MjiU-d2trpSTAw&vsint=CAIqDAoCCAcSAggKGAEgATojChYNAAAAPxUAAAA_HQAAgD8lAACAPzABEOEBGOABJQAAgD8&udm=26&lns_mode=un&source=lns.web.gisivli&vsdim=225,224&gsessionid=jGtFljri18Y5QgFImOVuWkiY-4LJPkMDms5451JU-ZV4YvHFzue14Q&lsessionid=4E8vRy1kjVQC7j_TJgd1MtHUCjEAL49vRvy-wDcf57OhJ94WcOee6Q&lns_surface=19&authuser=0&qsubts=1773112379681&biw=360&bih=662&ved=0CBsQh6cGahcKEwiwpcP7rZSTAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQQg&tbnid=d8eoXU8cl_4GeM&ictx=2)</Center>





The supporting cast is impeccable, with Jonah Hill providing grotesque and tragic humor, Rob Reiner lending paternal warmth to Jordan's father, Jean Dujardin appearing as a corrupt Swiss banker with an exaggerated accent, and Kyle Chandler playing the FBI agent who patiently pursues Belfort. Rodrigo Prieto's cinematography and Thelma Schoonmaker's editing maintain a pace that almost never slows down, although the three hours may feel exhausting for some viewers. Ultimately, \

is a visceral cinematic experience that entertains, unsettles, fascinates, and repulses in equal measure.



It's not Scorsese's best film, but it is one of his most daring and contemporary. It shows us how the American dream can turn into a nightmare when greed becomes a religion. Jordan Belfort ends up losing everything—money, family, freedom—but he leaves prison as a motivational speaker. The irony is brutal: the system that condemned him now rewards him for telling his story. So if you're looking for a movie that will make you laugh out loud and leave you with a knot in your stomach at the same time, this is it. If you prefer films with a clear moral and redeemable characters, you may find it excessive and unbearable. Personally, I think that's precisely its greatest strength, as it forces us to look in the mirror and ask ourselves how much of that \

we all have inside us.

‎ Hola Amigos de #hive y en especial a la comunidad de Movies&TVshows, como siempre espero que se encuentren bien al igual que sus familiares y amigos. En el día de hoy paso por acá para hablarles de una película que me gustó mucho que vi casualmente ayer en la noche, les hablo de \
o como su nombre original lo indica \

, película estrenada en el año 2013, la cual está dirigida por Martin Scorsese y protagonizada por un desatado Leonardo DiCaprio.



Esta es una de las películas más controvertidas y energéticas del cine contemporáneo. Con una duración de casi tres horas, esta biografía criminal disfrazada de comedia negra satírica nos sumerge sin piedad en el ascenso y caída de Jordan Belfort, un corredor de bolsa que convirtió la codicia en un estilo de vida extremo. La misma está basada en las memorias del propio Belfort y esta no pretende ser un documental moralizante, sino una experiencia sensorial abrumadora que nos obliga a mirar de frente el lado más grotesco y seductor del capitalismo salvaje de los años 80 y 90.



La historia arranca en 1987 con un Jordan Belfort de 25 años, papel que desempeña Leonardo DiCaprio y entrando al mundo de Wall Street lleno de ambición. Su primer mentor, Mark Hanna papel protagonizado por Matthew McConaughey, en una aparición breve, pero inolvidable, le enseña la verdadera religión de la profesión, el dinero es para uno mismo, las drogas ayudan a sobrellevar el estrés y el sexo es solo otra forma de poder. Tras perder su empleo en el crash del Lunes Negro, Jordan se reinventa en el mundo de las acciones de bajo valor en Long Island, donde descubre que su don para la venta agresiva y su carisma manipulador pueden generar fortunas rápidas mediante el esquema clásico de inflar artificialmente el precio de acciones baratas y venderlas antes del colapso, dejando a los inversores con pérdidas devastadoras.



Con el dinero fluyendo a todo lo que da, Jordan funda Stratton Oakmont, una firma que se convierte en sinónimo de excesos. La película muestra sin filtros cómo recluta a un ejército de vendedores igual de ambiciosos y sin escrúpulos, dentro de los cuales destaca Jonah Hill como Donnie Azoff, su socio, con alto ego, un bis cómico y también algo patético ja, ja, ja. Las oficinas se transforman en una mezcla de casino, burdel y circo, orgías, enanos lanzados como dardos humanos, consumo masivo de drogas, fiestas interminables y un desprecio absoluto por cualquier norma ética o legal. Jordan se casa con Naomi Lapaglia, papel interpretado por Margot Robbie, una modelo que encarna el trofeo perfecto de su éxito, aunque su relación se convierte en un campo de batalla tóxico lleno de infidelidades, violencia y drogas.



Scorsese filma todo con una cámara nerviosa, dinámica y casi maníaca,zooms vertiginosos, montaje frenético, música pop y rock de los 80 que contrasta brutalmente con la decadencia moral, es como si el director quisiera que el espectador sienta la misma adrenalina adictiva que consume a los personajes. DiCaprio entrega posiblemente su interpretación más física y desinhibida, grita, gesticula, se retuerce bajo los efectos de las drogas, baila ridículamente y nos convierte en cómplices involuntarios de sus fechorías. Les cuento que es hipnótico verlo, su Jordan es carismático, repulsivo, brillante y patético al mismo tiempo ja, ja, ja toda una joyita.



Esta cinta genera debate porque no ofrece un juicio moral explícito. No hay un héroe redentor ni una condena didáctica al final. Belfort narra su propia historia como si fuera una aventura épica, y Scorsese parece deleitarse en la exuberancia del caos. Algunos críticos la acusaron de glorificar el comportamiento criminal. Otros la defienden como una sátira feroz, al mostrar el exceso sin freno, la película expone lo absurdo y vacío de esa vida. No necesitamos que el filme nos diga \

; basta con ver a estos hombres convertidos en niños mimados con poder ilimitado para entender la podredumbre.



El reparto secundario es impecable, Jonah Hill aporta humor grotesco y trágico, Rob Reiner da calidez paternal al padre de Jordan, Jean Dujardin aparece como un banquero suizo corrupto con acento exagerado, y Kyle Chandler interpreta al agente del FBI que persigue a Belfort con paciencia. La fotografía de Rodrigo Prieto y la edición de Thelma Schoonmaker mantienen un ritmo que casi nunca decae, aunque las tres horas pueden sentirse agotadoras para algunos espectadores. En última instancia, \

es una experiencia cinematográfica visceral que divierte, incomoda, fascina y repugna a partes iguales.



No es la mejor película de Scorsese pero sí una de las más audaces y contemporáneas. Nos muestra cómo el sueño americano puede mutar en pesadilla cuando la avaricia se convierte en religión. Jordan Belfort termina perdiéndolo todo, dinero, familia, libertad, pero sale de prisión convertido en conferencista motivacional. La ironía es brutal, el sistema que lo condenó ahora lo premia por contar su historia, así que si buscas una película que te haga reír a carcajadas y al mismo tiempo te deje con un nudo en el estómago, esta es. Si prefieres cine con moraleja clara y personajes redimibles, quizás te resulte excesiva e insoportable. Personalmente, creo que esa es precisamente su mayor fortaleza, ya que nos obliga a mirarnos al espejo y preguntarnos cuánto de ese \

body.title: Superalimentos para la vista y la memoria: Nutriendo tus sentidos y tus recuerdos.
body.body:
<div class='text-justify'>

<center>https://elvenezolano.com.pa/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/Super-696x545.jpg</center>
<center>[Fuente](https://elvenezolano.com.pa/appetito24-diversifica-el-mercado-del-delivery-onoce-lo-que-prefieren-los-panamenos/)</center>

A menudo pensamos en la vista y la memoria como facultades que simplemente \
con el tiempo. Sin embargo, la ciencia nos dice que el cerebro y los ojos son dos de los órganos con mayor actividad metabólica de nuestro cuerpo; son, por así decirlo, los que más \

de alta calidad consumen. Al elegir alimentos específicos ricos en antioxidantes y grasas saludables, no solo estamos comiendo, estamos realizando un mantenimiento preventivo para seguir viendo el mundo con claridad y procesando nuestros recuerdos con agilidad.\n\n## La Vista: Protegiendo el \

de tu Vida
Nuestros ojos están constantemente expuestos al daño oxidativo de la luz solar y las pantallas. Para proteger la retina y prevenir problemas como las cataratas o la degeneración macular, existen dos pigmentos mágicos: la luteína y la zeaxantina.

**¿Dónde encontrarlos?** Los vegetales de hoja verde oscuro, como las espinacas, la acelga y el brócoli, son verdaderos escudos para tus ojos.

- El huevo: No lo descuides; la yema de huevo es una de las fuentes más absorbibles de estos pigmentos. Un huevo al día es un regalo para tu agudeza visual.

##  La Memoria: Alimento para tus Neuronas
Para que la memoria funcione correctamente, necesitamos que las neuronas se comuniquen entre sí sin interferencias (\
oxidativo). Aquí es donde entran los flavonoides y los ácidos grasos.\n\n- Los Frutos Rojos (Arándanos y Fresas): Son conocidos como los \

. Ayudan a limpiar los desechos celulares del cerebro y mejoran la plasticidad neuronal. Un puñado al día puede marcar la diferencia en la rapidez con la que recuerdas un nombre o una fecha.

- Nueces y Semillas: Tienen forma de cerebro por una razón. Son ricas en vitamina E y grasas saludables que protegen las membranas de tus neuronas, manteniéndolas flexibles y activas.

##  El Plato del \

: Una Regla Sencilla
No hace falta aprenderse nombres científicos complicados. Una regla de oro para la nutrición sensorial es la variedad de colores. Cada color en un vegetal representa un fitonutriente distinto:

- Naranja (Zanahorias, Calabaza): Ricos en betacaroteno para la visión nocturna.

- Morado (Uvas, Berenjenas): Protectores de los capilares cerebrales.

- Verde (Aguacate, Espárragos): Vitamina K para la salud cognitiva.

En resumen, cuidar tu vista y tu memoria empieza en el carrito de la compra. Al llenar tu plato de colores y nutrientes vivos, estás asegurando que tu ventana al mundo permanezca nítida y que tu almacén de recuerdos siga siendo fácil de navegar.

## 🗣️ ¡Tu turno de elegir!
Ya sabemos cómo nutrir los sentidos. Para nuestra tercera publicación, ¿en qué área te gustaría que nos enfoquemos?

***A) Salud Ósea y Articular:*** El plan de alimentación para fortalecer tus huesos y \

tus articulaciones. ***B) Cocina con Sabor (y sin Sal):*** Trucos y especias para que comer sano sea una verdadera fiesta para tu paladar. _¡Déjanos tu opción (A o B) en los comentarios y sigamos alimentando nuestro bienestar!_ # Referencia: 10 alimentos para mejorar la vista y la salud de tus ojos[](https://salauno.com.mx/10-alimentos-para-mejorar-la-vista-salud/) Salud visual y alimentación: ¿Cómo afecta la comida a la vista?[](https://fernandez-vega.com/blog/alimentacion-salud-ocular/) Alimentación y salud cerebral: cómo influye lo que comes en tu mente[](https://unamglobal.unam.mx/global_revista/alimentacion-salud-cerebral/)

body.title: A Coffee For Afternoon Tea
body.body:
> ### **A Coffee For Afternoon Tea** I will never tire of repeating that coffee is one of those versatile drinks that simply adapts perfectly to any occasion in our lives; That's why we find a cup of coffee in the most elegant moments, the most cheerful spaces, in circumstances that bring sadness to the soul, and on weekend afternoons when the rain falls incessantly, the cold seeps through the cracks in the windows, and company is always welcome. ![Post de Instagram Recuerdos de viajes collage azul.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iscrak/AKDiDahms93CAzaryCwSxdGCMWEvhuayJF72inpq4CnLmVSnJYzRHiFVhdhD5Nr.png)
*Design Made with Canva*
Coffee not only helps us ward off the cold and drowsiness typical of these wintery environments, but also helps us glide through a sea of flavors, where we find bitter notes, sweet touches, and a truly indescribable aroma. Venezuelan coffee is undoubtedly positioning itself as a first-rate product internationally, but we are still a little-known country in this area, even though we have an abundance of excellent coffee brands, which are marked by the characteristics of these lands and the love of the farmers who give their best in every task to harvest a product of excellence. ![1-WhatsApp Image 2026-03-10 at 8.50.43 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iscrak/2423sdsKx3ZbheiLLaEY8ZH4t3fCgV7EpKvnXNXm8taDZu6xm5RNqxuwDVcfoxqm45siK.jpeg) ![2-WhatsApp Image 2026-03-10 at 8.50.42 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iscrak/23ywif33eQjgopdAKDJ1bo2dVCGAHLFfFmD5SjhADv8h3piSySxn2TmmShV3QDAiji7R8.jpeg) ![3-WhatsApp Image 2026-03-10 at 8.50.42 AM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iscrak/24241scDDRvFaRL6jeBzq1iXAa9S6f36eEEyvGSMujhxTQUiTfr3sdK7A78xVrmpbcyNV.jpeg) ![4-WhatsApp Image 2026-03-10 at 8.50.42 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iscrak/244KLfhMJNCV3wwBGKPmrAwxxLEAMJYsinz8bRVRVAyCc4AoTzbiaRGoesxg59vL29Axx.jpeg) With a good cup of coffee, we can reflect, dream, and immerse ourselves in a deeply personal world, where many images pass through our minds and where memories sometimes become parallel realities, which can directly interfere with our mood. It is for this reason that this drink becomes a powerful elixir capable of stirring all our senses. ![1-WhatsApp Image 2026-03-10 at 8.50.41 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iscrak/242DG4obYuYiqd8mJLMvUov92WHZhsUTFgPBLi8eJp7hTgL7sy9ateh4W8AYkFdk7hEJB.jpeg) ![2-WhatsApp Image 2026-03-10 at 8.50.41 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iscrak/23uQn8bsyKUcUxPL5AKgNMDxbE8cUC92ZaRZrrqHjLQ7296jDx54D5pW19ZNh2gEJHhDS.jpeg) ![3-WhatsApp Image 2026-03-10 at 8.50.39 of a friend's visit, whose stay was prolonged due to the weather, I set out to prepare a different but flavorful snack, where we would find some alfajores, cookies, and sweet bread, all accompanied by body.title: Hive Philippines Street Photography #1121 - by Allmonitors
body.body:
#1121 - Street Scenes in Monochrome for Tuesday. 

Happy Tuesday dearest Hive friends! I hope you are enjoying this week with a fresh mindset and a hopeful heart. May your day be productive and your smile be bright. Let's make this day a fantastic day together😉. 

Moving now to our daily shots in monochrome we got here an old man wearing full gear on a cold afternoon. He was also wearing a kefia round his neck. He's with his people, probably his wife and daughter while spending their quality time together. 
![1000017649.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tvaH8jfQmdKHnauew61wpDxhaZGomFxK7ziYFcr4BXkCg6ruCwrh8yD8snSzKdkmPPN.jpg)

Here's a dark shot of a meatshop by the roadside with its butcher and assistant slightly visible. There's light coming through by the ceiling. The prices varies depending on the parts of the meat or pork but it's somewhat cheaper here in the highlands than in the Metropolitan Manila. 
![1000017605.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23swnK5LzzmKbyet1hwhHU3ofn43vzoiJTu9YGWGuomJ6QZ8dyWJwhBC6BrLkytPRPQoX.jpg)

Here's a car suddenly came out of the frame while I was supposed to take a photo of a young boy carrying a plastic basket, he was walking on the opposite side of the road. I think he was selling or offering something from that basket he was carrying. 
![1000017620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23yThVLqfgnjj2zh99DBouY2MR4wnMKYimNSHH1nvx7EjHBVwZsTD5vhbCH93LZGrpjEF.jpg)

Lastly, we got here mature people here also enjoying their bike ride like kids. Who says it's only the young ones who are having a good time. Even us adults are having a moment especially if there are little ones with you. It's a moment to remember. 
![1000017641.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tGcJ1jWjuuU8NS7e32KCNePeU4peukefBCitGzc9K9YebsMxcY5a4Zbt8edHRMHqKWP.jpg)

Follow me on my street travels.
Shot taken in Baguio City, Philippines.

<center>Image/s were shot using Panasonic Lumix ZS110. ~rex</center>

body.title: Trekking to Seceda in the Dolomites - MONOMAD CHALLENGE [ENG//PL]
body.body:
*** # Trekking to Seceda in the Dolomites. ***
**Hello Black And White Community!** The Dolomites are mountains that attract like a magnet. The number of incredible sites in these mountains is phenomenal. One such destination, a must-see for many tourists visiting these majestic mountains, is Seceda. This peak, approximately 2,500 meters high, is part of the Odle group and the easiest to climb in the entire massif. My wife and I visited Seceda during our trip to the Dolomites in 2022. Given that this peak is higher than any other Polish mountain range, we were certain the climb would be long and demanding. However, this wasn't the case. In many places in the Dolomites, driving to significant heights is possible, so conquering these more popular peaks isn't difficult at all. From what I remember, in this case, the journey from the parking lot to the summit took us about three hours. And those three hours were a hike, accompanied by truly spectacular views. > Dolomity to góry, które przyciągają jak magnes. Ilość niesamowitych miejsc w tych górach jest zjawiskowa. Jednym z takich punktów, który należy do obowiązkowych dla wielu turystów odwiedzających te majestatyczne góry jest Seceda. To szczyt o wysokości około 2500 będący częścią grupy Odle i najłatwiejszym szczytem do zdobycia w całym masywie. > Secede odwiedziłem z żoną podczas naszej podróży w Dolomity w roku 2022. Biorąc pod uwagę, że wysokość tego szczytu jest wyższa od wszystkich polskich gór, byliśmy pewni, że podejście będzie długie i wymagające. Tak jednak nie było. W Dolomitach w wielu miejscach samochodem można podjechać na znaczną wysokość, dlatego zdobywanie tych popularniejszych szczytów wcale nie jest trudne. Z tego co pamiętam w tym przypadku z parkingu na szczyt nasza droga zamknęła się w około trzech godzinach. I całe te trzy godziny to wędrówka, której towarzyszą naprawdę spektakularne widoki. ![bnw.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23t6zsny35YcJ1HbmgsdTgAAdRFDg5nkzovenFhgYo3wVbLkhrMtYFFvyKGXCptT7SCYC.png) ![PSX_20260310_130818.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wgN4QkP5cFhqcGcxpNcfwPHpyKNVVrorK5wqMj6uEzokPQJ5SqjbeRJJB79URQgMGyg.jpg) When visiting various locations, I often look for distinctive landscape features. Those that make a particular impression and clearly dominate the landscape. In this case, one such feature is the mighty Langkofel massif. It's the same majestic massif that can be seen from [Alpe di Susi.](https://peakd.com/hive-142159/@inmyframe/a-set-of-photos-from-alpe-di-susi-monomad-challenge). On our trail, we only lost sight of it for short stretches through the forest. You'll see it in the center of the frame in the photo above, and in several others throughout this post. > Odwiedzając różne miejsca bardzo często wyszukuję wyróżniających się elementów krajobrazu. Takich, które robią szczególne wrażenie i wyraźnie dominują krajobraz. W tym przypadku jednym z takich elementów jest potężny masyw Langkofel. To ten sam majestatyczny masyw, który można zobaczyć z [Alpe di Susi.](https://peakd.com/hive-142159/@inmyframe/a-set-of-photos-from-alpe-di-susi-monomad-challenge). Na naszym szlaku traciliśmy go z oczu jedynie w krótkich odcinkach przez las. Zobaczycie go na środku kadru na zdjęciu powyżej, oraz na kilku innych w tym poście. ![PSX_20260310_130746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/242DTCA9avF2NN1igThMW2xfebRPjPXmrTxSFDkonAB1phe1kbUKKGQZ23hdK7ZpkxM4K.jpg) The next photo shows the moment we leave the forest part of the hike. The mighty Odle group immediately comes into view. Seceda is somewhere on the left end of the massif visible on the horizon. From here, the whole thing is already impressive. > Na kolejnym zdjęciu widzimy moment opuszczenia leśnej partii wędrówki. Od razu ukazuje się nam potężna grupa Odle. Seceda znajduje się gdzieś na lewym końcu widocznego na horyzoncie masywu. Już stąd całość robi ogromne wrażenie. ![PSX_20260310_130800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/242s1FZCwwNDk1AnjGjz6Smu1T1F4HApYazpDvcEbjfF144WcuV4LR2T4HtjqtvFZQQzf.jpg) The trail is very well-maintained, and its line was a truly remarkable element of composition for me. I used it to create depth in many of my shots. > Szlak jest bardzo dobrze przygotowany, a jego linia była dla mnie wręcz kapitalnym elementem kompozycji. W wielu zdjęciach wykorzystałem ją do budowania głębi w kadrze. ![PSX_20260310_130726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/242YAJeYyp9B6ycQeZa1XJP7ciZ9PnMQk3Pj7qb4sPHuSKF73RhfgjYUZkfb4KuSiHRYZ.jpg) The undulating and uneven terrain surrounding us as we gained height was begging for photos. In fact, I went on a photography spree. The number of photos I brought back from this trip is enormous. > Pofałdowany i niejednorodny teren, który nas otaczał w trakcie zdobywania kolejnych metrów wysokości aż prosił się o robienie zdjęć. Prawdę mówiąc wpadłem w szał fotografowania. Ilość zdjęć jaką przywiozłem z tej wyprawy jest ogromna. ![PSX_20260310_130707.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wqnW2ebm9VSDiALoP3BGF48YZpu18GeuYD72PtCYjZBLpe82zMPF7U9iiBDXPgChXUH.jpg) The higher we go, the more the Odle group reveals its vastness and power. From this point, it's already clear how formidable these peaks are. > Im wyżej, tym grupa Odle coraz bardziej ukazuje swój ogrom i potęgę. Z tego miejsca już widać, jak groźne są te szczyty. ![PSX_20260310_130636.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/24246EeXfpZGX1FjPHkEXYrbeMD8WkudWLJGu1XGdE8vCdqLtBGYFjCYNLzHsDfDkbaes.jpg) This area is surrounded on all sides by mighty peaks and massifs. It's actually difficult to decide which direction to look. It's best to sit for a moment and contemplate these landscapes. > Teren ten z każdej strony otoczony jest przez potężne szczyty i masywy. Właściwie ciężko jest się zdecydować, w którą stronę skierować wzrok. Najlepiej usiąść na chwilę i przyglądnąć się w skupieniu tym krajobrazom. ![PSX_20260310_130613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/242DT2bfyuwGYF9HxvyY74Eu3V6pYa4FynfnKeuzXnCTS8nq2erUCmnyhZ1xkDs2aJsi8.jpg) There are also a lot of wooden buildings here, most of which are probably tourist attractions of some kind. However, I've never delved into this topic in any great detail. > Sporo tutaj także drewnianych budynków, które w większości są prawdopodobnie różnymi obiektami turystycznymi. W ten temat jednak nigdy się szczególnie nie zagłębiałem. ![PSX_20260310_130557.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23yx3neKiejVnYqQt5qtAn3pdsBGCCVcmqc6k6P66USJvrdAST5SidCepLgcDwJwnDkeN.jpg) ![PSX_20260310_130538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/EpNrGQmTcFs1gCeaY9v8f6syv25yZRpLSSkFMriZWF9FTevfULiEvDRQme7L3BXRVt6.jpg) Two more shots featuring the Odle Group. Impressive, isn't it? > Kolejne dwa ujęcia z Grupą Odle w roli głównej. Prawda, że robi wrażenie? ![PSX_20260310_130516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/241tffNcA936MqeJEKvjvZPJm5PjbYwoZF4uxERAGxJggoiGEWfJ9Vh4U8iujN7VG3R6b.jpg) This architecture, combined with the rugged mountain landscape and vast meadows that cover the relatively flat slopes of this part of the massif, made a huge impression on me. However, I will show this in more detail in another post from the Seceda summit area. Those landscapes definitely deserve their own. > Ta architektura w połączeniu z surowym górskim krajobrazem i rozległymi łąkami które pokrywają dość płaskie zbocze tej części masywu zrobiły na mnie ogromne wrażenie. To jednak bardziej szczegółowo pokażę w innym poście z okolic szczytu Secedy. Tamte krajobrazy zdecydowanie zasługują na własny. ![PSX_20260310_071620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/242hcZE9T3CvuEdLHNsLTaCw6DLRiYawbyHmGRkihaRa3bDpVLyUvwpbZCHifS2WJ6BmS.jpg) Finally, a shot from the final stretch of the ascent to the summit, with the Langkofel (Sassolungo) massif towering over the entire scenery. > Na koniec ujęcie z ostatnich partii podejścia na szczyt. Z masywem langkofel (Sassolungo) górującym nad całą scenerią. ![bnw.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23t6zsny35YcJ1HbmgsdTgAAdRFDg5nkzovenFhgYo3wVbLkhrMtYFFvyKGXCptT7SCYC.png) I decided to show these landscapes in black and white for a specific reason. I've been thinking a lot about my photography over the past few days. Photos taken in harsh daylight have never been my favorite, and I rarely post them. Truth be told, I mostly use them on Hive for travel-related posts. However, something has changed in my approach. In black and white, even in such unfavorable, harsh lighting, the situation looks completely different. I no longer feel that light is more harmful than helpful. I'd even go so far as to say that in photos without color, harsh light is an asset, creating the drama that black and white brings out in even the simplest of frames. > Zdecydowałem się na pokazanie tych krajobrazów w czerni i bieli z konkretnego powodu. Sporo myślałem przez ostatnie kilka dni nad moją fotografią. Zdjęcia zrobione w ostrym świetle dziennym nigdy nie należały do moich ulubionych i rzadko je publikuję. Prawdę mówiąc głównie na Hive do postów typowo podróżniczych. Coś jednak zmieniło się w moim podejściu. W czerni i bieli, nawet w tak niekorzystnym ostrym oświetleniu sytuacja wygląda całkowicie inaczej. Nie odnoszę już wrażenia, że światło bardziej szkodzi niż pomaga. Powiem nawet, że przy zdjęciach pozbawionych koloru, ostre światło jest atutem budującym dramaturgię, którą czerń i biel wydobywa z nawet najprostszych kadrów. ![bnw.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23t6zsny35YcJ1HbmgsdTgAAdRFDg5nkzovenFhgYo3wVbLkhrMtYFFvyKGXCptT7SCYC.png)
***
*This is my entry for #monomad challenge by @brumest and @monochromes*
***
📸 Photographed using a Nikon Z6 with a Nikkor Z 24–70mm lens. 📸
Edited in Adobe Lightroom Classic + Photoshop

![bnw.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23t6zsny35YcJ1HbmgsdTgAAdRFDg5nkzovenFhgYo3wVbLkhrMtYFFvyKGXCptT7SCYC.png)
All photographs are my own work. The text was written by me and translated into English using a translator. Thank you for taking the time to visit and read my post.

body.title: It only exists in the movie.
body.body: > The superstition that works but only in the movie, because I have never seen or heard anyone talk about shooting stars. Greetings, great people of this community; I hope I meet you all well. Thank you for stopping by my blog. This week's first edition theme says shooting stars. There is something called a superstitious belief, and to be honest, I have seen that at work; people who practice that and believe in it always have their results. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVZ5xEHkSj47ZwAFfUWhr5i8vM6ELwW6AyvhNyqWd3e3Z/1773148359511.jpg) Shooting stars is something I've seen a thousand times in a movie, and the way it works in that movie is so, so real magical and interesting; someone like me could always wish I can have such a privilege to make a wish and watch it come to pass too. But unfortunately, it only happened in the movie. I have seen something like that in real life, but we as children; then we were meant to believe that it wasn't a shooting star but rather a witchcraft plane🤣🤣 It sounds funny, I know, as the African people that we are, and as kids we believe what we were told by the elders. Do you believe the wishes made on shooting stars come true or not? I don't believe that there is something called shooting stars in real life because I have never heard or seen anyone talk about it; these things only happen in the movie. If at all someone have make a wish on something called shooting in this life and it come to pass, I can boldly say that, it might just be a coincidence but definitely not a shooting stars 🤩, forgive me for sounding that way, but it just the truth. I have never seen a shooting star, and I don't believe it exists. Thank you for stopping by. See you next time.

body.title: K2 Mountain
body.body:
K2 is the highest mountain in Pakistan and the second highest mountain in the world.
K2 is located in the Karakoram mountain range in northern Pakistan.
K2 has an altitude of about 8,611 meters.
It is one of the most difficult mountains in the world.
Every year, adventurers from all over the world try to climb this mountain.
K2 is also known as the “Savage Mountain” because it is very difficult and dangerous to climb.
It is a symbol of the natural beauty and grandeur of Pakistan.
The areas around the mountain are full of snow and have many glaciers and other wonderful landscapes.
K2 is visited by people interested in tourism and adventure activities.
K2 is also important because it represents the geographical importance of Pakistan.

Dust spots sometimes look like cracks but disappear after careful cleaning. Check HDMI cable ports and wall connections for loose fitting wires. Never press hard because screens remain delicate and expensive parts. If lines remain visible test picture settings through television menu options.

Reset display settings to factory mode and restart device slowly. Many picture problems disappear after simple reset steps at home. body.title: A Few Thoughts on War
body.body:
![frame 1 war children.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/244eEbVZbhtBK9qfxQ1ZiEf2HhSfkQPrjEvhQU9eisMFJkR5H6HaiRnDUfs3KTGjhj2ha.gif)

My president held a brief press conference yesterday afternoon to update the public on the state of war.  That is, the war he, along with Israel's Benjamin Netanyahu, has waged these past days against Iran.  

During his presentation the president called the war an excursion. There is no way to tell how many people have died so far in this war. There is no way to calculate the destruction of infrastructure this war has caused--so far.  There is no way to judge the toll on the world economy this war has taken.  Or the ecological impact of the war.

I speak in the past tense. But this war is not over, although it seems my president is already weary of the 'excursion'.  He said at one point in the press conference that the war was 'complete'.

In what universe does he operate? Is it a universe where people bend to his whims? Where he rarely hears the word 'no'?  Where he is praised, for anything? For nothing? 


Does he believe he can raise his hand and grandly say, \

?  He does not even remotely grasp the forces he has set in motion.  He can see only his part of this conflict.  His will. 

My president is rather pampered, so it seems he expects that war, like everyone around him, will bend to that will.

When Donald Trump regards other people he apparently projects onto them his own motivation. The president is consistently described as 'transactional'. By that I believe people mean, for him, everything is a negotiation. It's a dynamic of *What can I get, what can you get, what kind of deal can we make that profits both of us?*

It apparently has not occurred to the president that Iranians may be willing to lose a great deal in order to protect their idea of sovereignty and their autonomy as a nation.  For the Iranians, transaction may not be about any material thing the president can offer them.

So far, my country has lost seven soldiers to this war.  Donald Trump assures that there will be more fatalities. It's pretty clear my country bombed a school and [killed](https://www.nbcnews.com/world/iran/iran-school-strike-us-tomahawk-missile-minab-video-munitions-experts-rcna262391) about 170 people, most of them children. 

Anybody can start a war. It's pretty easy--just start bombing. Ending it...now that can be a bit of a challenge.  This war has spread. It involves not only Israel, but also Lebanon and most of the Gulf region.  It has gone beyond the Gulf region.  Each one of the entities affected has a will, has its own idea of a just resolution. 

And then there are all the other entities, those who feel profoundly wronged by the assassination of the Iranian's Supreme Leader.  We see disquiet in Iraq, in Pakistan, in any country that has a significant Shia population.

And what about those so-called 'sleeper cells'?  Cadres of actors who will, or want to, inflict terror across the world.  Will these elements be motivated now to strike, to inflict more harm because of Donald Trump's 'excursion'?

I'm not an analyst. I'm just a woman who is watching world events and who has read about wars from time immemorial.

I remember WWI, which was suppose to last a few weeks.  That war swallowed two empires, redrew the map of Europe and killed many millions. The war that was supposed to last weeks became known as the Great War.

If only my president knew more about history.  If only more people said no to him, so that he could be comfortable with opposition. If only the enablers who surround him found courage, somewhere, somehow, to offer resistance.

I hope I'm wrong about the war.  I hope the obvious is not true.  I hope this war is different from all other wars, that it does not have a will of its own.

Even if I am wrong, though, what has the war cost us already? How much of our national treasure has been spent on Donald Trump's military adventure?  How much good will have we lost?  How will other nations deal with our increasingly mercurial leader? Where does this military episode us on the world stage?

As always, I end my blog with the wish that the U. S. war with Iran will end, and I wish for peace.  May there be peace here, in my country, and everywhere.





**The Collage**
This was inspired, obviously, by ongoing events.  I borrowed elements from Pixabay.  I used GIMP to create some effects (fire, smoke, etc.).  Anyone on Hive who feels moved to create a collage for this community, as I was moved this week, may do so at any time.  The rules are provided on our prompt posts, like this [one](https://peakd.com/hive-174695/@lmac/lets-make-a-collage-a-contest-for-all-creatives-on-hive-round-245-41-hive-in-the-prize-pool).

body.body:
https://youtu.be/R4h_YNdELBQ?si=6pjUNh0jXOyUAwdW

One way the Bible shows believers can deal with suffering is through faith and trust in God. When people rely on God during difficult times, they often find peace and hope even when their circumstances are painful. 

Faith helps a person endure hardship without losing direction in life. It teaches patience, humility, and the understanding that challenges can shape character and spiritual growth.

The Bible also encourages believers to live righteously and follow God’s teachings. Living with love, forgiveness, self-control, and kindness can reduce many forms of suffering that come from human conflict, sin, and selfish behavior. While righteous living does not remove every hardship, it creates a life that is more peaceful and aligned with God’s will.

body.body: > The journey into the mountain depths revealed a luminous cave system filled with water and ancient wreckage. The treasure was finally located alongside a somber burial site. The escape through the waterfall's source ended in a tragic miscalculation during the final descent. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNrZuCggwFhnyjG6NiKu9K8rb6KYgZhoQgEFC3x9Udoi1/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPUMAvweZ7DKnR25koCk6AADR7sVGW3cSY7Ybrwd6eN4A/screenshot_2_.png) The deeper I went inside the cave, the more mysterious the environment became. I was forced to perform even more swimming as the tunnels narrowed and dipped further beneath the mountain's surface. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV7ghud3oK2ZpGEkk88z4zvSdeWsnyYQTgUxFaUyz9LM6/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVRDTyTHgLQ7REfyqA1LsnoHHHaRkL36Z2UMorX6BqeVb/screenshot_4_.png) At this point, the entire cavern looked like a fairy place, illuminated by thousands of tiny lightings that glowed along the walls. I had to swing across several gaps to keep moving forward through the enchanted atmosphere. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTWXjybUooZqPr5s86ocy1zT6Ezh2scAGDS1nPbb1NFfM/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR5vWNgGBd89rj1Cx1BKqzNLGfVDVKjqcmzoWV9vydkk5/screenshot_6_.png) Without warning, the ground beneath me collapsed entirely. I plunged into a pool of clean water on the other side, which fortunately broke my fall and allowed me to continue the exploration. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYqsURG6FS22RVGYXeonQFexVDfxoDe14nCsxRUGT3rjA/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd18u1BY387sZjhVjzyFdKUeSLrHq5aHaTPvmf7cvXEXe/screenshot_8_.png) After swimming back to the surface, I discovered something bizarre: several wrecked cars were lodged this deep inside the cave. It was strange to see such heavy machinery so far from any actual road. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZuQNq5L1vGakvm75AAHjivY2HFBQ6dBaSap1FougTxkB/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWk88wC5Ud46FAXz4j9wNDi4pkaNt5wEWZ7gJZFRM2Mrt/screenshot_10_.png) At last, I found the treasure waiting at the far end of the cave. It was tucked away in a quiet corner, marking the end of the long and dangerous hunt through the dark. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPgLnwaopUk5dyPn8bgt1ipzA7oa3UV6VCDG1iarc1wpi/screenshot_11_.png) Near the treasure, I found bodies or skeletons buried under piles of rocks and tree branches. I set them on fire to provide a proper burial for the fallen, adding a somber tone to the discovery. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSH3C6ShEEXyYwFH4Y479BsqPrdDAnhVvz9uieBciCLUc/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNh9LS8i7QTy7irbXWW32F6cwbNWw6ftNvtWEYKYW9N5G/screenshot_13_.png) I began swimming toward the other side and eventually found the exit. This opening turned out to be the hidden source of the waterfall I had seen earlier from the outside. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTMksG6uJ2M3AHjeXAw8Taw8GaE2xwBkWjVDtVusnyuds/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeidVNGE3C4xjQwyAcEgTMfdGv3SygdAe86M4hHyjeEnf/screenshot_15_.png) I jumped off the edge of the waterfall, hoping to glide down safely. Sadly, I couldn't manage to open my parachute in time, and the fall ended my journey right away as I reached the ground. How about we continue in another post? --- Thanks for reading my post. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=artchef/1e544971)

body.title: Юрій Йосифович - Заповіт (уривок)
body.body:
В честь вчорашнього Дня народження нашого Кобзаря, видатного українця Тараса Шевченка, складено багато пісень. А на його вірші - багато композицій та навіть відеокліпів. 
Вчора привернув увагу наш крутезний український співак Юрій Йосифович. Хто не в курсі, - цей хлопець родом із Павлограда, що на Дніпропетровщині. Він займається відродженням маловідомих автентичних пісень із різних регіонів України. В результаті отримуємо в його виконанні чудове гармонійне поєднання народної пісні з його особливим автентичним голосом та мінімалістичною електронікою.

. Вірніше, уривок з нього. І це вийшло досить цікаво та запам'ятовується з першого ж прослуховування.

body.title: Where The Mountains Breathe: A Weekend At Paharuhay Campsite
body.body:
![Copy of Copy of Copy of Brown and White Simple Travel Collage Instagram Pos_20260310_170935_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/AKzCEfA6LCUM5YL7RPdqAtiYiiRgXo8V3o9wdfEB44rLMbfW7NQ4pdipAcaNqp8.png)
<center></center>*<sub><center>Lead image  created using [ CANVA](https://www.canva.com/design/DAG4XqLPHZk/zEFLzmmPErnISEOtfB8PGA/edit?utm_content=DAG4XqLPHZk&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=sharebutton)</center></sub>*


<div class=\

>Paharuhay Campsite was one for the books and was such a perfect escape with my friends after a long week. This campsite allowed us to breathe deeply, freeing us from frustrations and expectations, connecting again to nature like our ancestors. If you missed the first part of my Paharuhay Campsite experience, you can read it here and follow the trail just like other readers. You can read in it the relevant information about this campsite, its amenities, and prices, as well as see the beauty of different viewpoints through my shared photos.

![Messenger_creation_917677733.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EoK4Twf5ZXWrKhZ5jrk35rWniWe4ZaCy8mQK9Ma9F15LyzMXkbcExhJGWUWRfUCNXxo.jpeg)

![Messenger_creation_917670600.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xVAhwZvy3YJ3akedYBBKc96175beuiepSVWSvuesqmE2QHfjLLZVxYRo5hVappUz7hN.jpeg)

![Messenger_creation_917655392.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EoJyaXrBWzd2KZKmNPyhNdQKRjd9MmDSWZZfkFWvefZWEadEQxQDV2fnab12Kkt9nob.jpeg)

From the first step following the trail to the peak, setting up camping tents, watching sunsets, and bonfiring at night while having the most memorable conversations, everything was perfect and valuable to be kept in my mind. It was not an expensive trip, but it was quality and deserving of recollection, almost like an elegant and expensive stay in a deluxe destination. What I liked about this campsite was the green and panoramic viewpoint of the mountain ranges of Tabogon. At sunset, the sun would hit you right on your face, caressing it gently as the day ends.

![Messenger_creation_917664987.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EoMBjPjQJtdNr8gJGhRwjGzKGt2H1nkM1T7fHqefK9sH1gVsorCLE7T5xK5jNz82o2G.jpeg)

Among my favorites of the Paharuhay Campsite experience, one stood out the most: its striking and majestic mountain ranges. When I saw them, I remembered how far Tabogon has become known. They carry wide biodiversity, healthy mountain ranges, endemic species of plants and animals, as well as rich tourism just like this campsite, cold springs, and hidden caves. For someone who loves retreat, this destination is the most perfect and suitable. The reach was not just on the peak, it was also in the top happiness it could give us as we spent a night on its hallowed ground.

![Messenger_creation_917674517.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/2449xTFB2pdyNfcSxoPQEMgqLMCYUVsvcBRBfjWLdpJBXRDUHeN6XQs5Jj29nQ3mV3Gek.jpeg)

![Messenger_creation_917671550.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xyJTY5YHqYJuuxK2X6DADhf7sW22PaptWKGrz7GCqJY4F5D9MzX2iW7YwASDsAUoeqW.jpeg)

To conclude, here are some photos during our stay at Paharuhay Campsite:

![Messenger_creation_917672534.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23wzv5rvX7ru3rMBoYZcGveLarG5P4YBEEjjci3qfhJWm7KPUEpB2izRtmZsFwfdZ9wnk.jpeg)

![Messenger_creation_917673434.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23tRt4pMrsoYfcWyZN8ypFXRGVnkBRVhVA5HnEy1x7g2zycUKcUZJi49N5M7EaJJuvioS.jpeg)

![Messenger_creation_917669601.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EoAaHdEWAnQnvZHhEqAqw6jxz2JCg6rPT9PWotuGj2KXhkaPUR7wWU1wixCBkPdWJMp.jpeg)

![Messenger_creation_917678816.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23vhUE42nPWPqsgXq3B5itBLdp4V58onVbpwNhR5JqjF6vgG4MX9EEvy3dqRJVE2qYA1x.jpeg)

![Messenger_creation_917666818.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EoyM8CdsT5dFHjx4WsxqVFobbvLJaXYEtdFVnpC2zF4dmXduvJcEn4bswa1odGfP4Gp.jpeg)

![Messenger_creation_917668553.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EoCarNhpy6CBLdiwdA4WkYtWTbEU74dYJ1fYJ8cxM9YPnXHC4LWepihtR7CmSK7mxWb.jpeg)

![Messenger_creation_917666102.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EowFAmzcSbjBjGkGJp9qBsRR7jz7JKf2QgoJk4Muoj7MqoTSSSogvAtpPjZJjNzsEJ7.jpeg)

![Messenger_creation_917658639.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EokWtfg3gnMHmFb8PA91GHYQNsmyShoAkeFrzV2FNGMvKdYKjuYht3fYXvqtVwuiYzB.jpeg)

![Messenger_creation_917656670.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/Ep1WRUP5vBFTcnf7mWQapZY5KDZCQqU5CmbsmrJSmbPNUiFQeK5HnNdAcRCPpse3A6r.jpeg)

![Messenger_creation_917659510.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EqqsPKwN4GdoTexGLZEVEA95qzCnHpyQJAhGSpE9rpipa9dv88NgJ1ikSpqFXh2XXk2.jpeg)

And as we packed our tents and slowly left the trail behind, I realized that the true beauty of Paharuhay was not only in its mountains and sunsets, but in the quiet moments it gave us to pause, breathe, and simply be present. It was a simple trip, yet one that will stay with me for a long time.

**How to Get There:**

Assume you are at the North Bus Terminal in Cebu City, where most tourists start their trip towards the north. Search for a bus that is labeled \
The bus will take you tonthe north and once you arrive in Tabogon, just say you'll stop at \

and tell the exact place or the name of the campsite, which fortunately drivers know where this place is. And welcome, you arrived home. [//]:# (!worldmappin 10.928551 lat 123.956165 long ...another chapter of my Paharuhay Campsite experience. d3scr)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kungfukid/23y8qHhYLfSQzCi28KTMViiGcyuMFh11sCbTx3E7LVZ5cbEVCdAap1RsdaJbPNe3JHBny.png)


When we visited Two Lovers Point in Guam, it was still morning—but the sun was already blazing. The heat wrapped around us like a heavy blanket, and the bright light made every shadow sharp and clear on the ground.

Most people around me were busy taking selfies and group photos, trying to capture the beautiful ocean view stretching endlessly toward the horizon. The deep blue water and the high cliffs were certainly worth photographing. But for some reason, my attention kept drifting downward.

The sunlight was so strong that the shadows of the railings stretched across the brick floor like long black lines. The shapes were crisp, almost like drawings made by the sun itself. Even my own shadow appeared tall and distinct, standing quietly beside the railings.

While everyone else captured smiles and poses, I found myself capturing shadows.

Thank you @melinda010100 for initiating this Shadow Contest

Thank you for reading everyone have a nice day!

body.body: I get that. It's a fundamental limitation of Hive itself and as you point out, there's no L1 system in place for this kind of thing. You build on Hive, but you can't build within it. That's where chains like Ethereum have an edge, although there's no shortage of poorly written smart contracts that have led to millions in ETH being stolen or hacked.\n\nWorth noting though, the apps I build are essentially read-only applications that work on the basis of custom JSON and transfer operations, streaming blocks and looking for specific operation types. So if someone were to somehow get into the site, they'd find a front-end and a Node.js backend with Postgres or MongoDB storing site-specific data. There's no keys, no wallets, no funds to extract (those all live on Hive). The hosting is cloud-based too, so there's no server anyone can SSH into from the outside. Nothing is perfect, but considerations are made at a design level.

body.title: Waves of Response
body.body:
>


As a birthday present, I woke up to a plate of assorted fruit in the fridge for breakfast. I didn't eat it for breakfast though, because I had a coffee instead. But it did make a good lunch. We also went out to dinner last Friday and I received a booking for a massage at a pool centre, where we will swim together afterward. It is a few weeks away. 

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23x12or7CxwAD7HyJWnzB4rU6vwBbPxuMuRgmMQ1aey4631fbBdtNMpwczDgmKkHnfnRZ.png)


---

Birthday's are normally a reminder of life, but I also almost died on my birthday when I drowned in a pool as a kid, when I was eight. It was the second or third near death experience I had had by that time, with the first being a severe fever as an infant (my earliest memory) and being electrocuted, which I think was a few months after the drowning, but it might have been a bit before it too. There have been several other near-death events and conditions since. So yeah, my birthday is also a reminder of the alternatives. 

Counterfactuals (not to be confused with alternate truths) is imagining what *could have happened,* but didn't happen in the past. For instance, if I had died as a baby, or in that pool, or been electrocuted, everything past that point in the timeline would have been different. For me, I wouldn't have existed past there, but for others, they would have been affected in various ways. Those who knew me like family would be affected in one way, but then there are all the people who would never know me, and therefore be unaffected by me. However, because I didn't die, those people were affected and the experience shifted as it did. 

And while we can't go back and change the past, counterfactual thinking is a pretty brilliant piece of machinery we have, as it allows us to simulate and predict multiple outcomes. Even though they didn't happen, it can inform us and teach us lessons for the future. However, it is also a broken system that can have negative effects, because we can \
history within ourselves and perhaps negatively influence the takeaways. \n\nBeing able to go back and \

our behaviour mentally, where we reimagine saying and doing something different is probably a process we use to reconcile the past and also heal ourselves from various harms. But as you can *imagine,* if we rewrite it in some ways, we can actually create more internal conflicts and more harms that were not consequences of the actual event. We can amplify the negative impacts, rather than disperse them, widening the wounds and creating a larger pile of baggage to carry around with us through life. 

But the better use of the counterfactual is when we use them to mitigate the damage of the past and overcome the damage we might have taken, so that we become stronger for the experience, not weaker. Instead of being victims of circumstance, we can take responsibility and be agents of change in our own lives, choosing to act toward being the kind of person we want to be, rather than being forced to be the kind of person we feel pressured in being. 

While each person is free to react on their emotions as they please, there are always consequences to our actions. We have created a culture where people are hyper-sensitive to their current emotional state and feel entitled to act based purely on emotion without thought, as if it is the truest, most authentic version of ourselves. But I do not think that our emotions are anything other than guides that point to issues we should explore, rather than facets we should act upon. Especially when they are negative emotions, we should use them as pointers to improvement, not buttons to launch reactions. 

It is hard though, especially when we feel strong negative emotions, because they flood our bodies with a whole range of chemicals that make us more reactive, and far less thoughtful. Rather than looking at the alternatives of the situation and ways to respond, we act based on some simple mechanism of feel this way and act uncontrollably, often doing harm to others and ourselves in the process, creating more instances that have to be reconciled, that raise more negative feelings, like guilt and regret and disgust. 

Sometimes I think acting on negative emotions are like getting caught in a rip at the beach. The body gets swamped by the wave, panics and starts to swim in the opposite direction toward the beach it is being pulled from. It seems like the sensible thing to do. However, what should be done is to swim across the rip, because swimming against it is a losing battle that will tire the body until carried far out to sea. The \

of the reaction to the feeling, is not logic at all. Actual logic would be to understand the situation first, and then choose a course of action. Emotions make actual logic difficult to apply.\n\nHowever, if we can put our emotional response on hold for a little bit, then we can \

and work out what kind of responses are appropriate for the situation. If this isn't possible in the moment, we can go back later and reflect on our actual response and discuss ways we could have alternatively behaved so that next time, we are a bit more prepared. All of our experience can prepare us for the next moment, but if we aren't willing to learn from what we experience, or if we only experience indirectly, then what ends up happening is our emotional response takes over, because we haven't practiced how to delay reaction. A lot of life is lived theoretically from behind screens now and while when things are calm we think we are in control, once a situation comes into play that causes panic, we often find our control is lacking. But, we then believe that we are entitled to behave that way, that we did the best we could, that the situation warranted it, because we felt so strongly. > We are justifying being unprepared. Life and death are two sides of the same coin. Keep flipping the coin and life might come up time and time again, but death only need show its face once. body.title: CAMPUS LIFE: EXPECTING A MOVIE, ENDING UP IN THE TRENCHES
body.body: The period I got accepted into the university was the best time of my life, everything about me changed, I was so excited having imagined what my life was going to be like in school, you see my father had asked me what I wanted him to buy for me when I passed all my exams and gained admission to the university and my simple request then was a power bike, I love the power bike so much then that It was the only thing I wanted, I had thought of how I was going to be riding my power bike to the school, and around school, picking up girls to parties and for road trips that I never thought of how stupid my request was, I was barely 16 and all I knew how to ride was a bicycle. Maybe if I had asked for an electric bicycle, rather than a power bike, I would have gotten it. But it’s been a few years since school, and my dad and I have never spoken about it.\n\n

/> My vision about school then was not a place I will go to learn in classes, yes classes was part of it but the out door activities surpassed the classroom activities, in my head, I was going to party hard every night and live the time of my life during that period, it was about the clothes I will buy, the food I will eat, mostly it was about how free I will be to choose what I wanted to eat, when I wanted to, having no one to decide for me about that. I had imagined living off campus, with my girlfriend visiting me on weekends, just the two of us. I had imagined living in a very comfortable apartment, with everything I needed, so my stay would be as comfortable as it could ever be.

/>

All these were short-lived when it was time to resume school. My father's friend lived close to the school which forced me to stay at his place during my registration and the process of looking for where to stay, since my dad had promised me a power bike, I felt like he was going to get me the most comfortable and safe place that I could keep the power bike safe, but few days into the registration, my father had me meet another friend of his who was working at the university to get me a space at the school hostel, it was a disappointing news because I never imagined that I was going to be living at the school dormitory during my time at school. Since there were no rooms available at the time, I had to stay in a hall that housed legal occupants, legal scatters and also some illegal scatters. School became boring even before I had gone deep into my first semester. This made me look forward to finishing school and starting the next phase of my life.

Although school turned out to be fun in the end, as I met a few friends who became like brothers to me. We did everything together, had those friends we went to class together with for lectures, those we go for studies together in the library and at the halls at night, those we went to parties with, those we had our little secret adventures of trying everything for the fun of it and also the experience.

My name is @rishagamo, and this is my response to the Hive student week 33 prompt. TITLE: IS CAMPUS LIFE OVERRATED?

All images are mine.

body.title: Forgiveness Of Sins. My Review
body.body:
https://youtu.be/oAcMa8zhQgY?si=KCsK0UANrrL3J7js

Sin separate us from God. It makes us unacceptable before God. We have been separated from God from the beginning when sin entered into the world by the first man that ever existed. This is why we should look for a way that we reconnect us back to God. The Lord Jesus Christ came into the world to help us out of this calamity. It is through our Lord Jesus Christ that forgiveness of sin is preached. The sacrifice of Jesus Christ on the cross of Calvary pays for the sins of all humanity. There is now salvation available for as many as will come to God through Jesus Christ.

Without the remission of sin, there will be no salvation. Everyone of us needs to receive this offet of salvation. We can only be forgiven of our sins if we confess them to them. Therefore, we should always confess our sins. He who covers his sins shall not be forgiven. Because that person cannot receive mercy. The price for our sins has been paid by our Lord Jesus Christ. There is forgiveness available for us if we turn to God in repentance. 

There are sins which we should not play with. As those who have been washed by the blood of Jesus, let us keep ourselves from all forms of impurities. Let us look up to Jesus Christ the author and finisher of our faith. Let us keep ourselves from sins. A believer in Jesus will not be justified by daily continuing in sin. We are saved from sin so that we will not continue in it.

今天我沿着城市的公园步道散步，感觉特别不错。阳光明媚，微风轻拂，真是个适合外出的好日子。 在我走的路上，遇到了一位热爱摄影的老人。他正坐在长椅上，认真地调整相机，准备拍摄园中的花朵和小鸟。我和他聊了几句，得知他已经拍摄了几十年的照片，记录了无数美好的瞬间。他分享了几个他最喜欢的拍摄地点，这让我对下次的散步增加了新的期待。 此外，我还看到了一群孩子在草地上放风筝，五彩斑斓的风筝在蓝天中翱翔，欢声笑语不断，他们的快乐感染了周围的每一个人。这样的画面让我感到生活充满了活力与希望。 今天的步行让我不仅享受了自然，还感受到了人与人之间的温暖，真是一次愉快的体验！ _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.title: Organoid Intelligence: Living Brain Computers Are Already Learning
body.body:
# Organoid Intelligence: Living Brain Computers Are Already Learning

![Hero Image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/REBEmpire/BPR-D/main/content/hive_posts/images/biocomputing-organoid-intelligence-hero.png)


**Domain:** Technology / Future Forecast

The line between biological and digital computation is dissolving faster than most people realize. In laboratories across three continents, clusters of human neurons — grown from stem cells into structures called brain organoids — are now performing computational tasks that would have seemed like science fiction five years ago.

## What Are Brain Organoids?

Brain organoids are three-dimensional clusters of human neurons, typically grown from induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs). Unlike flat cell cultures, these structures self-organize into layered architectures that mirror aspects of actual brain tissue. The most advanced organoids now contain millions of neurons forming functional synaptic networks.

The key breakthrough wasn't growing them — it was connecting them to silicon. Using multi-electrode arrays (MEAs), researchers can both read neural activity and stimulate specific regions, creating a bidirectional interface between biological and digital computation.

## DishBrain and Beyond

The landmark 2022 DishBrain experiment by Cortical Labs demonstrated that neurons in a dish could learn to play Pong. But the 2025-2026 follow-ups have been far more significant:

- **Cortical Labs' DishBrain 2.0** achieved stable learning across 30+ days, with neurons forming persistent memory traces
- **Johns Hopkins' Organoid Intelligence Initiative** demonstrated organoids solving simple pattern recognition tasks 10x more energy-efficiently than equivalent digital neural networks
- **FinalSpark's Neuroplatform** launched the first cloud-accessible biocomputing platform, allowing remote researchers to run computations on living neural tissue

## The Energy Argument

This is where it gets economically interesting. A human brain operates on roughly 20 watts — less than a light bulb. Training GPT-4 consumed an estimated 50 GWh. Even accounting for the vast difference in capability, the energy efficiency gap is staggering.

Current organoid computers consume approximately 1,000x less energy per equivalent operation compared to silicon-based neural networks. As organoids scale from millions to billions of neurons (projected by 2028), this efficiency advantage could reshape the economics of computation.

## Ethical Frontiers

The uncomfortable question: at what point does an organoid become conscious? Current organoids show spontaneous oscillatory activity resembling sleep-wake cycles. Some exhibit responses to stimuli that parallel early developmental brain patterns.

The NIH's 2025 guidelines established a framework requiring:
- Continuous monitoring for markers of sentience
- Mandatory ethics board review for organoids exceeding 10 million neurons
- Prohibition on growing organoids beyond cortical complexity thresholds without special authorization

## What This Means

We're watching the birth of a new computing paradigm. Not one that replaces silicon, but one that complements it — handling tasks where biological computation's strengths (energy efficiency, adaptive learning, pattern recognition in noisy data) outperform digital approaches.

The first commercial biocomputing services are projected for 2028. The regulatory frameworks are being written now. The ethical debates are just beginning.

body.body:
> Hace unos días compartí con ustedes el paso paso de un [brazalete](https://peakd.com/hive-189504/@rlathulerie/brazalete-black-and-white-black) al que decidí llamar black and white, ya que estaba trabajando con piezas blancas y negras de cristales de swarovski, y en vista que el brazalete me gustó muchísimo decidí hacer unos zarcillos para crear un set, y esto es lo que quiero compartir hoy con ustedes, el tutorial de los **aretes black and white en cristales de swarovski.**
A few days ago, I shared with you the step-by-step process of making a [bracelet](https://peakd.com/hive-189504/@ rlathulerie/black-and-white-bracelet), which I decided to call black and white, since I was working with black and white Swarovski crystals. I liked the bracelet so much that I decided to make some earrings to create a set, and that's what I want to share with you today: the tutorial for **black and white Swarovski crystal earrings.**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXeX2Tgjw7HepWSj18X8JQY7b4jVVBzAh3iBBwKDNyRB9/1773146676366.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX21n72UoXmkoii2SyaPFm1NNLmzfNYaLYTfdqAiA1Qte/1772812834834.png) Para la elaboración de estos zarcillos utilicé, por supuesto, los mismos materiales que para el brazalete, y para que el set tuviese un *match* perfecto, decidí que tuviesen un diseño similar al colgante que hice para la pulsera y el resultado me encantó. Es una combinación de cristales de swarovski, negros y blancos y balines dorados. Y sin más vueltas vamos con el paso a paso y los materiales.
To make these earrings, I used the same materials as for the bracelet, of course, and to ensure that the set would match perfectly, I decided to give them a similar design to the pendant I made for the bracelet, and I loved the result. It is a combination of black and white Swarovski crystals and gold beads. Without further ado, let's get started with the step-by-step instructions and materials.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbU5x6wpMpzijgjFe3Zsft1fsoMVUfh1LMtPcQK4AWHfR/1773145672592.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX21n72UoXmkoii2SyaPFm1NNLmzfNYaLYTfdqAiA1Qte/1772812834834.png) # Materiales Ganchos para aretes Cristales de swarovski pequeños en forma de rombo en colores blanco y negro Cristales de swarovski medianos en forma de rombo en color blanco Balines dorados Alfileres de ojo Argolla pequeña Tenaza Pinza de punta plana Pinza de punta redonda
# Materials Earring hooks Small diamond-shaped Swarovski crystals in black and white Medium diamond-shaped Swarovski crystals in white Gold beads Eye pins Small ring Pliers Flat-nose pliers Round-nose pliers

# Paso a paso/Step by step Para para la elaboración de estos aretes vamos a utilizar dos piezas, y por supuesto nuestro gancho para el arete que en este caso es en forma de anzuelo, y la primera pieza que vamos a necesitar va a estar formada por una pieza de cristal blanco unida a un balín dorado. Para su elaboración, vamos a necesitar un alfiler de ojo, un balín dorado y un cristal de swarovski blanco, y lo que haremos es pasar el balín dorado por el alfiler de ojo seguido del cristal blanco. Y en este caso como vamos a conectar una pieza a esta, cortamos el excedente del alfiler de ojo dejando un espacio de aproximadamente un centímetro o un poco menos de un centímetro y vamos a crear nuestro ojito en ese extremo y lo haremos con ayuda de la pinza redonda.
To make these earrings, we will use two pieces, and of course our earring hook, which in this case is hook-shaped. The first piece we will need is a piece of white crystal attached to a gold bead. To make them, we will need an eye pin, a gold bead, and a white Swarovski crystal. What we will do is thread the gold bead onto the eye pin, followed by the white crystal. In this case, as we are going to connect a piece to this, we will cut off the excess from the eye pin, leaving a space of approximately one centimeter or a little less than one centimeter, and we will create our eye at that end with the help of the round-nose pliers.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRX9abyLmbtWVaGfWj3W4CxdE5St4CQ2sHe6StffYUWJb/1773145673291.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRTpnevCN9cG1QVws8R3KirsjpWbVQzFE9P2fqWhfHj7Q/1773145673885.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXiffxMckrvscNWNZHyuuZJ22igQUgqeh1sjj6p1BZQHG/1773145674439.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPHbHhjTfRvV8TA9nSUw6hrTWrm2PmeNUYkkKqNrbgMp2/1773145674980.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX21n72UoXmkoii2SyaPFm1NNLmzfNYaLYTfdqAiA1Qte/1772812834834.png) La segunda pieza es básicamente un colgante que vamos a crear con una argolla mediana y cristales de swarovski en colores blanco y negro, y la pieza de cristal va a estar elaborada únicamente con un alfiler de ojo y un cristal de swarovski en los colores con los que estamos trabajando. Para elaborar esta pieza, lo que vamos a hacer es comenzar con los cristales utilizamos un alfiler de ojo y lo que hacemos es pasar nuestro cristal por el alfiler, y en esta oportunidad como no vamos a conectar otras piezas a ella lo que hacemos es cortar el excedente del alfiler de ojo con una distancia de medio centímetro aproximadamente, doblamos hacia adentro con ayuda de la pinza redonda y cerramos con la pinza plana. Vamos a necesitar seis cristales para cada arete, tres blancos y tres negros, así que en total vamos a elaborar 12 piezas de cristales blanco y negro.
The second piece is basically a pendant that we are going to create with a medium-sized ring and black and white Swarovski crystals. The crystal piece will be made using only an eye pin and a Swarovski crystal in the colors we are working with. To make this piece, we will start with the crystals. We will use an eye pin and thread our crystal onto the pin. Since we are not going to connect any other pieces to it, we will cut off the excess eye pin, leaving approximately half a centimeter, bend it inward with the help of the round-nose pliers, and close it with the flat-nose pliers. We will need six crystals for each earring, three white and three black, so in total we will make 12 pieces of black and white crystals.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX21n72UoXmkoii2SyaPFm1NNLmzfNYaLYTfdqAiA1Qte/1772812834834.png)
Una vez tenemos listas todas las piezas de cristales de swarovski lo que haremos será incorporarlas a la argolla que tenemos, y en este caso vamos a abrir el ojito de las piezas de cristales de swarovski y las conectamos a la argolla. Recuerden que son seis por cada argollita. >Once we have all the Swarovski crystal pieces ready, we will attach them to the ring we have. In this case, we will open the small holes in the Swarovski crystal pieces and connect them to the ring. Remember that there are six for each small ring.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX21n72UoXmkoii2SyaPFm1NNLmzfNYaLYTfdqAiA1Qte/1772812834834.png) En este punto tenemos listas las dos piezas que conforman nuestro arete, así que vamos a pasar al armado que es bastante sencillo, y lo primero que hacemos es tomar nuestro gancho para aretes y la pieza de cristal de swarovski blanco y la conectamos. Para ello simplemente abrimos un poco el *\

* de la pieza de cristal blanco, dejando el balín hacia arriba y la conectamos al gancho para nuestro zarcillo y cerramos.

<blockquote>

At this point, we have the two pieces that make up our earring ready, so let's move on to the assembly, which is quite simple. The first thing we do is take our earring hook and the white Swarovski crystal piece and connect them.

To do this, we simply open the \

of the white crystal piece slightly, leaving the bead facing up, and connect it to the hook for our earring and close it. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX21n72UoXmkoii2SyaPFm1NNLmzfNYaLYTfdqAiA1Qte/1772812834834.png) El último paso es conectar la pieza con los cristales de swarovski blanco y negro, y para esto solo tenemos que abrir el extremo inferior de la pieza de cristal blanco y hacer pasar la argolla pequeña por ella y cerrar. The last step is to connect the piece with the black and white Swarovski crystals. To do this, simply open the bottom end of the white crystal piece, thread the small ring through it, and close it. Now our black and white earrings are ready, making a perfect set with our bracelet.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX21n72UoXmkoii2SyaPFm1NNLmzfNYaLYTfdqAiA1Qte/1772812834834.png) Como pueden ver es un trabajo bastante sencillo, quizá un poquito tedioso porque hay que crear doce piezas pequeñas, pero la verdad es que vale la pena, ya que como ven es un accesorio súper lindo fácil de combinar y además estamos haciendo un set que podemos utilizar con una gran cantidad de otfits. >As you can see, it's a fairly simple project, perhaps a little tedious because you have to make twelve small pieces, but it's really worth it, because as you can see, it's a super cute accessory that's easy to match, and we're also making a set that we can use with lots of different outfits.

Foreigners should know our culture and the roots that make us Venezuelan. What better way to start than with the senses, with the colors, smells, flavors, and textures all together in a single dish? With our typical Venezuelan dish, our pabellón criollo, I told him what I've heard throughout my long life: the rice, our European heritage; the black beans, our African roots; the shredded beef, representing our indigenous people who never submitted to the Spanish conquest—they are our ancestors; the fried plantain slices, the sweetness and joy that characterize us. body.title: Trust yourself everything else is unpredictable
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZmERayAYMTgUQV7SCnSsGsF4mML7JhSnvaD1W5mhxZ2U/1773146105729.png)


> Thumbnail made using OpenAi

I think people put a huge value on stability, and want the ground they're on to feel solid, permanent and stable. Here in Accra, the so called best road has potholes in it from who knows when. The power often goes out when you're in the shower and your body covered in soap, you can be left standing in the dark without knowing if the problem is the bulb or the electrical system. We had power outage from last night and it was just about an hour ago that the fixed the problem.

A bird is able to sit on a branch and know that the branch could break, but it's able to use its wings to fly away if or when that happens. I have a chair in my house that has had a loose screw for the past 3 months, but I've not fixed it yet because I've simply forgotten to pick up the right tool to complete the job. So what do you rely on? Wings, figuratively speaking of course.

Using your wings should be the only thing that makes any sense when everything around you is so unpredictable. You fly and you have at the back of your mind that the branch you land on is nothing but a stopping point until your next flight.

I see that so many people wait until someone else tells them good job prior to taking action. That's a waste of time if you ask me. I had a small argument with a mechanic last week regarding a fan belt and he was rude as hell. But I'm on a spiritual growth journey of self control so I had to let it slide and it's good because I didn't embarrass myself by talking back. The most important thing is that you must know your own mind. If you don't trust your own legs, then you won't cross a bridge when it appears too old to use. Sometimes the bridge really is old, but in order for you to make it to the other side of the bridge, you have to cross over it anyways.

body.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
