# ***
Breakfast of giants...
***

> The March light in Ontario has a distinct clarity; winter begins to surrender amid puddles of melted snow and the first timid shoots. Today, while the cold still nips at the windowpanes, my kitchen became the perfect refuge for Matthew. Watching him devour his plate with astonishing calm, I couldn't help but smile as I recalled his mother's expression when I tell her about his culinary exploits over the phone: ‘He ate what?’ she always asks incredulously from afar.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/EqFxkanqZEr3w8XR7aNikEeLyjYpnPQ7qpM6UCFF81gAGLdJZk4u6DcpxbnpCT265GN.png) [Lestresorsderable](https://lestresorsderable.com/es/que-los-canadienses-comen-para-desayunar-.htm)
For a ten-year-old boy in the midst of growth, a traditional Canadian breakfast is more than just a meal, it's pure fuel to start the day. Following the treasures of this land, I prepared him a tower of fluffy pancakes, generously drizzled with pure maple syrup, that liquid gold that is almost a religion here, like coffee in Venezuela. I accompanied the feast with several strips of crispy bacon and the ever-present fèves au lard, those baked beans with a touch of sweetness that warm the soul in this transition to spring. I watched Matthew masterfully combine the flavours, the sweetness of the maple melting into the saltiness of the bacon, an alchemy that only makes complete sense in Ontario. In a matter of minutes, the plate was gleaming. ‘Was it good, Mate?’ I asked him. He nodded with the satisfaction of someone who had conquered a mountain. I stared at the empty plate, thinking that my son was indeed growing at the pace of the northern forests. Yes, he ate everything, and I love seeing him so strong. *** ***

> La luz de marzo en Ontario tiene una claridad distinta; el invierno comienza a rendirse entre charcos de nieve derretida y los primeros brotes tímidos. Hoy, mientras el frío aún pellizca los cristales, mi cocina se convirtió en el refugio perfecto para Matthew. Al verlo devorar su plato con una calma asombrosa, no pude evitar sonreír al recordar la expresión de su mamá cuando le cuento sus hazañas culinarias por teléfono: “He ate what?”, me pregunta siempre incrédula desde la distancia.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/EqFxkanqZEr3w8XR7aNikEeLyjYpnPQ7qpM6UCFF81gAGLdJZk4u6DcpxbnpCT265GN.png) [Lestresorsderable](https://lestresorsderable.com/es/que-los-canadienses-comen-para-desayunar-.htm)
Para un niño de diez años en pleno crecimiento, un desayuno canadiense tradicional es más que una comida, es combustible puro para iniciar el día. Siguiendo los tesoros de esta tierra, le preparé una torre de panqueques esponjosos, bañados generosamente con sirope de maple puro, ese oro líquido que aquí es casi una religión, como el café en Venezuela. Acompañé el festín con varias tiras de tocino muy crujiente y las infaltables fèves au lard, esos frijoles horneados con un toque dulce que calientan el alma en esta transición hacia la primavera. Observé cómo Matthew combinaba los sabores con maestría, pues, el dulce del arce fundiéndose con el salado del tocino, una alquimia que solo en Ontario cobra total sentido. En cuestión de minutos, el plato estaba reluciente. “¿Estaba bueno, Mate?”, le pregunté. Él asintió con la satisfacción de quien ha conquistado una montaña. Me quedé mirando el plato vacío, pensando que, efectivamente, mi hijo está creciendo al ritmo de los bosques del norte. Sí, se lo comió todo, y me encanta verlo así de fuerte.

body.body: ![RichVsPoor.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYBVz4w4HksAw9BKQHjMX1RYp4ALrxjeJZyZcNQ9zdMZf/RichVsPoor.png) You can't tax the rich, because the rich make the laws. And they wouldn't make any laws that would target them. When you hear tax the rich, understand that they are saying, tax the middle class. The rich, as a tax bracket, really don't exist. The IRS has books of regulations, and only a small part of it is about what you owe, the large part is about how you can avoid paying.

></center>
## The Rich Don't Really Exist

How can i say that when there are obviously rich people.  Just look at the Card-ass-ians on TV!

For the most part, what you see, is an illusion.

The Card-ass-ians is a show to make the poor even poorer, and make them sadder about \

.  The card-ass-ians teach people how to be poor and broke.  The Card-ass-ians' producers borrow most of what you see on the show.  It is a psyop to keep you in the dark about reality.  And the only thing they got that makes money, that they show you, is merchandising.  And why they show it to you is so you will waste your money on their merch.  It is a show to take your money.  There is nothing on the show about being rich.

The people on the Fortune 500 top richest people don't have any money.  No, really.  Musk gets paid $1 for being the CEO of several companies.  The money, that he is said to have, doesn't exist.  They take the amount of stock and stock options he has, and multiply it time the current stock market price, and say he has that much money.  But, everyone in finance knows he can't sell all of his stock for that price.  The moment he sells, the price drops.  And there might not be enough liquidity to bye up all his stock, meaning the last shares will be priced at $0.

And, people who have real money, like the rots-childs never have it personally tied to them.  They have it in off shore accounts, controlled by some corporation somewhere else.  They have it in huge piles of gold, that are leased to someone (yes, they still have the pile of gold, but it is \
theirs.  They have other piles of gold, in vaults hidden all over the world, that no one knows about.\n\nThe \
literally have no money in their name. They are penniless.\n\n

></center>
## Disposable Income

You would be surprised how little of a difference a rich person and a poor person has in income.  We are talking, the millionaire next door type of rich person.

Most people rack up so many bills, that they are simply taking their paycheck and giving it to the banksters.

Spend less than you make is the adage.
The other piece is that debt owns you, makes you a slave.

So, you really must avoid putting things on the CC.  Things that will be useless before the CC is paid off.

Two people, both making $50,000 a year can be in two VERY different financial positions.

* One has all kinds of bills and only has a few hundred to spend after all the bills
* The other has almost no bills, and has thousands to spend after all the bills.

And the gap gets wider after the other takes those thousands and invests them, so that they earn more money.  Each month they get richer. And the poor person gets poorer.

Then the poor person, who wants to live \

leases that expensive car. The rich person, who now has the money to buy the expensive car, still doesn't buy it. If they have a profitable corporation, have that corporation lease the car, writes the WHOLE think off on taxes. And basically gets a free car. or The rich person takes their money, borrows against it, so now it is making interest in the bank AND they are given a loan (not earned income, not taxable) to buy the car, often at less interest than they are making on their investments. They are truly getting a free car.

> ## Own a corporation The biggest thing people miss is that owning a business/corporation saves soooo much in taxes. The business owner pays themselves first and taxes last. The individual wage slave pays taxes first, and themselves last. Businesses pay taxes on profit. That is income minus expenses. And expenses can be a corporate car, medical insurance… So, taxes are only paid afterwards. The wage slave gets their paycheck, and the taxes are taken out first, then the medical insurance, and they get whats left. So many things can be put into expenses. Sure, you have to catalog and keep track of every meal out, and why it is a business expense, but you get to buy it before working out how much taxes you need to pay. This is just some of the stuff you can do with a small business. You can do so much more with a large corporation, where you can basically provide housing for the CEO.

></center>

The system was designed by rich people to not tax them.

The rich will never pay their fair share of taxes.  And if any country actually went after the rich, they would just move.  And the have the money to be able to move.

However, things are changing.
We cannot really change the Infernal Revolting Syndicate, but they won't be in charge for much longer.

* People are going to work out that their tax dollars are not going to what they want, and going to what they ABSOLUTELY DON'T want. (how much trafficking of minors do you want to keep paying for?)  And people will stop paying taxes.  LOTS of people.
* People are going to start living in tribes/families, where people are mostly self sufficient, and no one there really works for money.  No money means no taxes to pay.
* Govern-cements are going to collapse and the people there are going to be very resistant to paying the new guys who pop up.
* The Infernal Revolting Syndicate is only necessary when you have a central bank printing money out of thin air.  If you get rid of one, you get rid of the other.

So, don't fall for politicians who say \
(there is no way to tax the rich)\n\n

>\n
All images in this post are my own original creations.

body.title: Television Review: Money Shot (The Shield, S7X03, 2008)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/tyvGUpyzenzRWdzJOikhVEpiUae.jpg)

**Money Shot (S07E03)**

Airdate: 16 September 2008

Written by: Adam E. Fierro
Directed by: Terrence O'Hara

Running Time: 45 minutes 


As the curtain falls on *The Shield* with only a handful of episodes remaining, the narrative architecture of Vic Mackey’s world becomes increasingly claustrophobic. The avenues for the Strike Team leader to continue the story and evade facing the true consequences of his endless misdeeds are rapidly shrinking. Yet, in \

Vic demonstrates a flicker of his former brilliance, acting once again as a shameless liar and strategic manipulator. However, this episode serves as a stark reminder that his actions, while tactical victories in the moment, are actually staving off or even hastening the complete collapse of his professional and personal life. 

The main storyline revolves around a complex pact between Strike Team and the Armenian mob, a move that forms part of Vic’s even greater scheme to manipulate this faction into a war with the Mexican gangs. Despite this grand design, the Armenian gang boss, Rezian, remains delusional about his position in this relationship—at least where Shane Vendrell is concerned. Rezian is acutely aware of traditional LAPD practices regarding the destruction of impounded guns for public relations purposes. Consequently, he devises a scheme to steal this specific stash, intending to sell it on the streets of Chicago to create a level of carnage far exceeding what is seen on the streets of Los Angeles. Rezian issues a chilling ultimatum to Shane, warning that a death sentence will be carried out against his and Vic’s families unless they deliver the guns.

Vic, upon learning of Rezian’s scheme, experiences a moment of second thoughts. This hesitation stems from a core part of his character: sending weapons to incite genocide on the streets is a line that even his completely compromised moral code refuses to cross. Instead of refusing outright, he decides to execute a brilliant deception. He pretends to go along with Rezian’s demands. However, during the actual handover, the Armenians are raided by federal agents. This operation was orchestrated by ICE Agent Olivia Murray, who Vic had tipped off beforehand. Vic arrives at Rezian’s headquarters just in time to warn the boss about the impending raid. But his intervention is more than just rescue; he plants a critical bug that will point the finger at Rezian’s lieutenant, Khalulian (Yorgo Constantine). This move proves to be a masterstroke, a brilliant way for Vic to win back—or rather, restore—trust from various factions: the federal government, Rezian himself, and, most importantly, Shane. Shane, who had been tentatively trying to become his best friend again, is won over by this display of tactical superiority.

The episode houses one of its most powerful scenes near the end, a quiet yet devastating conversation between Shane and Vic regarding the murder of Lem. For the first time, Vic appears to find genuine understanding for Shane’s crime, suggesting that it was the right thing to do under the circumstances. This moment of empathy is heavy with irony. Ronnie, who has always been pragmatic but has developed a deep-seated dislike for Shane after his confession of the murder, is aghast at Vic's apparent forgiveness. After the scene, Ronnie looks at Vic with a sense of dread, wondering whether Vic truly meant it or if he is merely lying to deceive his former best friend to maintain team cohesion.

It is Ronnie who, much like Lem in previous seasons, emerges as the most normal and moral of all Strike Team characters, despite having cold-bloodedly killed a captured Armenian hitman earlier in the episode. Ronnie voices a pragmatic view to Vic, arguing that all his efforts to extricate himself from the mess he had created would only bury him in a much deeper hole. This dialogue serves as a grim illustration of the trajectory the series has taken.

Written by Adam E. Fierro, the script masterfully juxtaposes Vic's professional triumph with disaster on the family front. His autistic son, Matthew, had to be brought back home after being left unattended and wandering aimlessly on the street. Separately, Corrinne catches Cassidy drinking, and the ensuing verbal row leads to Corrinne’s brief arrest. Later, a physical altercation between mother and daughter takes place, witnessed by a horrified Vic who is forced to intervene. The Mackeys, just like the old Strike Team, begin to disintegrate in a violent, chaotic manner.

The episode maintains the formula of using a procedural subplot to ground the show in reality. In this instance, a teenager alerts Detective Claudette Wyms that her best friend, Wan Lee (Susan E. Lee), has inexplicably gone missing. Dutch Wagenbach and Steve Billings investigate, only to find the girl’s family completely uncooperative. Wan Lee eventually emerges with obvious signs of violence, revealing she had been abducted and raped. Billings manages to extract the horrible truth: Wan Lee is a lesbian, and her traditional Chinese family hired a \
It is a harrowing look at cultural intolerance.\n\nAnother storyline brings back Axl, a sleazy producer of \

videos. He contacts the police to arrange a sting operation against his business rival, Larry, who pays his actresses in drugs and is allegedly in possession of a large stash. A sting is set up with Officer Tina Hanlon posing as prospective talent for Larry’s films, accompanied by Julien Lowe, who poses as Tina’s boyfriend. This subplot adds a layer of sleaze to the narrative, highlighting the seedy underbelly of the city that the Strike Team patrols.

Finally, the last storyline of the episode is the weakest, primarily because it relies on a rather unrealistic premise. It depicts a police officer whose face has been plastered all over posters and billboards across Los Angeles working undercover. This logistical impossibility undermines the otherwise high quality of the episode, dragging it down to the level of a mere watchable TV episode rather than the gritty masterpiece the series usually strives for.


RATING: 6/10 (++)

[source](https://www.freepik.com/free-ai-image/coastal-landscape-fantasy-style_204361337.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=16&uuid=78fb0fef-bce8-4c5a-b2a3-7cf702f38502&query=Straits+of+Hormuz+AI+generated) 
This is the current situation when it comes to global [business](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-business) Being an [entrepreneur](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-entrepreneur) is to understand the [underlying](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-underlying) facts that [risk](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-risk) is real. 11 [days](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-day) [NOW](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-negotiable-order-of-withdrawal-account-now) into the [war](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-war) and there is still no signs of retreating. Ok, Trump said four to five [weeks](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-week) and its effects are translating into the [economy](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-economy). I talked about the high [gas prices](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-gas-price) but nationally and in the international [markets](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-market).   

We should be expecting scarcity, I want to talk from the area of exportation. At least I have been in mentorship training to study and to soon enter this market. Nevertheless, as it stands, the current market situation is not for novices. Trust me, you wouldn't want to be in a ‘try your luck scenario’ if I should say with your little [capital](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-capital).  

Those with that backup capital and experience will be the forefronters till this entire chaos dies down. The current risk of exportation right NOW is pegged ‘at your own risk’. On one hand, we should consider the [cost](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-cost), something that can be discussed and ironed out between [transactions](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-transaction) partners and well, we can also talk of delays.

[source](https://www.freepik.com/free-ai-image/world-food-ball-filled-surrounded-by-food-world-food-day_299992275.htm#fromView=search&page=4&position=29&uuid=1d6f40a8-b2cb-4310-8e5e-11356911b0ed&query=Nigerian+wheat+exportation+AI+generated) 
I will be focusing on Nigerian [goods](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-goods-economic) exporters. As it stands, there has been an extension of 10-14 days [delivery](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-delivery) delays. War risk [insurance](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-insurance) has spiked up to 400% and as I earlier said, freight fees have become high. 

This shows how impactful the Straits of Hormuz is to the global economy. We heard news (threatening ambition) by the Iranian [military](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-military) to attack [ships](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-ship) forcing their way through these routes.   

One can't undermine this talk because we have actually seen the Iranian military with some other terrorist groups flying missiles light starlights across the Middle East. We can move on to say that many Nigerian exportpreneurs will have to be on a halt. The [Ripple](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-ripple) effects is that we are already seeing an unemployment scenario here.   

Some of those who have been dependent on shipping in and out of goods will be out of business for the meantime. Some expect this war may span longer than expected while others feel one deadly blow by either party will force a peace talk. I talked about how Mojtaba has replaced his [father](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-father-dad) as supreme leader (this is something President Trump said is unacceptable). The [election](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-election) and the disagreement is what one can use as a suggestion as to how long this entire war is likely to last.   
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmc6LFzv8P5q9N3XS74cFDk8cHDtyvqmw8CknqnAmZeF2P/1000143229.jpg 
[source](https://www.freepik.com/free-photo/no-symbol-small-plane_8810904.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=34&uuid=a318ec83-47a0-4167-ae4f-0c10c21c8e31&query=Delayed+flights+AI+generated) 
Talking of exportation, maybe we should look away from the goods market and talk a little about [human](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-human) [lives](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-life). Many travellers are still [stock](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-stocks) in the Middle East, the risk of flights are very high. 

It was something I discussed a little in my yesterday’s [article](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-article) as to how the United Kingdom are planning to enter into the matter as concerns to their citizens who have become a victim to this unexpected war escalations.  

To conclude let me add, the waters and the air are currently very risky in the Middle East. Anything about trading that needs to pass through the Straits of Hormuz or the Middle East route is definitely at your own risk.

body.body: 1/7 🧵\n\n**YouTube just dethroned Disney as the world's largest media company** — pulling in $62 billion in 2025 revenue vs Disney's $60.9 billion. Even wilder: it's now valued at $500-560 billion, making Netflix's $409B market cap look quaint. The platform that started with cat videos is now the undisputed king of media.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 2/7 🧵\n\nThe revenue mix is massive: **$40B from ads alone** ($11.4B in Q4), plus a subscription empire spanning YouTube Premium, YouTube Music, NFL Sunday Ticket, and YouTube TV. That vMVPD service now has 10M subs and is on track to overtake Charter and Comcast as the top pay-TV provider.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 3/7 🧵\n\nYouTube crossed a staggering milestone: **$100 billion paid out to creators, music companies, and media partners** over its lifetime. CEO Neal Mohan frames this as YouTube's dual mission — helping creators build audiences globally, then helping them monetize those audiences into real businesses.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 4/7 🧵\n\n**MoffettNathanson's thesis**: YouTube is uniquely positioned at the intersection of media and tech. While legacy media companies are \
YouTube benefits from both structural tailwinds (creator economy, AI tools) and its distributor scale across pay-TV and user-generated content.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 5/7 🧵\n\nAI is the next accelerant. YouTube's heavy investment in AI tools will let creators **produce more content faster** — one top creator is already using AI for set design, costumes, makeup, and VFX that would otherwise be too expensive or time-consuming. This widens the moat even further.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body: 6/7 🧵\n\nThe growth trajectory is relentless: $50B in 2024, $60B in 2025, with plans for skinnier YouTube TV bundles and a creator economy showing no signs of slowing. MoffettNathanson asks the obvious question: **\
** Only Netflix appears to be in the same acceleration lane.
body.author: askrafiki

body.body:
7/7 🧵

YouTube isn't just winning the streaming wars — it's rewriting what a media company even looks like. While Disney, Warner, and Paramount consolidate and cut, YouTube scales by empowering millions of individual creators. The platform economy just ate Hollywood's lunch.

📎 [Source](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/digital/youtube-worlds-largest-media-company-2025-tops-disney-1236525130/)

Hola Hivers, bienvenidos a mi espacio.

Hoy les traigo otro vídeo de mis locuras nocturnas.

Como saben, yo soy un búho y suelo hacer vida por las altas horas de la noche. Una de estas tantas noches en las cuales me estaba peinando, me salió un curioso peinado o moño que parece inspirado en la moda china de la antigüedad, dinastía Tang, para ser más exactos.

Aunque no es perfecto y es como decir un boceto de lo que podría ser, como gran fan de este tipo de cosas históricas, random y extravagantes, quise compartíselos.

De hecho, también he hecho una sesión de fotos que estaré subiendo después de este vídeo y dejando en un comentario etiquetado. ¡¡No se lo pierdan!!

Sin mas que acotar espero que disfruten el vídeo, me disculpo de antemano por el ruido de fondo que es el que lamentablemente hace mi aire acondicionado, que no suelo apagar ya que mi espacio es muy cerrado y caluroso y me hace de ventilación.

Me gustaría saber qué opinan o si también les gusta este tipo de cosas, curiosidades y moda histórica.

¡Los leo en comentarios!

body.title: Un estreno que alegró mi día[ESP-ENG]
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![VfFHFc7c0oLD0SbS_1000251520.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/im-yanizet/images/VfFHFc7c0oLD0SbS_1000251520/VfFHFc7c0oLD0SbS_1000251520.webp)
![3Qdf17Ja7bZMCxbE_1000252717.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/im-yanizet/images/3Qdf17Ja7bZMCxbE_1000252717/3Qdf17Ja7bZMCxbE_1000252717.webp)
![IQbdnhW2VxX8F6NV_1000252708.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/im-yanizet/images/IQbdnhW2VxX8F6NV_1000252708/IQbdnhW2VxX8F6NV_1000252708.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

Cuando la vida se pone difícil, con muchas preocupaciones y estrés acumulado, a veces son las cosas pequeñas las que logran mejorar un poco el día. No solucionan todos los problemas, pero sí regalan un momento de alegría.


Ayer comenzaba otra semana de marzo y decidí estrenar algo que tenía guardado con mucha ilusión: un conjunto de pijama quirúrgico y unos zapatos tipo crocs que me envió mi tía como regalo. Desde que los vi me encantaron, así que estaba esperando el momento perfecto para usarlos.


Trabajar en un hospital implica pasar muchas horas de pie, caminando de un lado a otro. Y ahora, con el transporte tan caro, muchas veces toca también regresar caminando a casa. Por eso, tener ropa y zapatos cómodos se agradece muchísimo.


En muchas partes del mundo el uso de pijamas quirúrgicos en hospitales es lo más normal. Sin embargo, en mi país, Cuba, durante mucho tiempo ha sido más común ver al personal médico usando ropa casual: mujeres con tacones elegantes, blusas bonitas y pantalones formales. A veces lo estético ha estado por encima de lo práctico.


Yo siempre he sido más de sentirme cómoda que de encajar en ciertos estándares. Aunque, claro, no voy a negar que de vez en cuando también me gusta ponerme un vestido bonito o algún conjunto casual que me haga sentir arreglada. Pero siendo sinceros, los médicos pasamos mucho más tiempo en el hospital que en cualquier salida o paseo.


Por eso este pijama me encantó desde el primer momento. La tela es transpirable, ligera y fresca, justo lo que necesitaba para las largas jornadas. La parte superior tiene una temática navideña muy simpática que me sacó una sonrisa, mientras que el pantalón es sencillo pero muy cómodo. Y los sapitos… bueno, esos se robaron el show. Además de ser cómodos, tienen unos pequeños adornos que me fascinaron.


Puede parecer algo simple: ropa de trabajo y unos zapatos nuevos. Pero en medio de días intensos y muchas responsabilidades, estrenar algo que te hace sentir cómoda y feliz también cuenta como un pequeño momento bonito.


Y a veces, esos pequeños momentos son justo lo que necesitamos para seguir adelante. 



# English Version 




When life gets difficult, full of worries and stress, sometimes it’s the small things that can make your day a little better. They don’t solve all the problems, but they can bring a moment of joy.


Yesterday marked the beginning of another week in March, and I decided it was the perfect day to wear something I had been saving with excitement: a new set of surgical scrubs and a pair of Crocs-style shoes that my aunt sent me as a gift. I loved them from the moment I saw them, so I had been waiting for the right moment to finally use them.


Working in a hospital means spending many hours on your feet, walking from one place to another. And nowadays, with transportation being so expensive, many times I also have to walk back home. Because of that, having comfortable clothes and shoes is something you truly appreciate.


In many parts of the world, wearing surgical scrubs in hospitals is completely normal. However, in my country, Cuba, it has been more common to see medical staff wearing casual clothes: women with elegant heels, nice blouses, and formal pants. Sometimes aesthetics have been placed above practicality.


I have always been the kind of person who prefers comfort rather than trying to fit certain standards. Although, of course, I can’t deny that from time to time I also enjoy wearing a nice dress or a casual outfit that makes me feel good. But the truth is, we doctors spend much more time at the hospital than going out anywhere else.


That’s why I loved this scrub set from the very first moment. The fabric is breathable, light, and fresh—exactly what I needed for long workdays. The top has a cute Christmas theme that made me smile, while the pants are simple but very comfortable. And the little Crocs… well, they stole the show. Besides being comfortable, they have some small decorations that I absolutely adore.


It may seem like something simple—just work clothes and new shoes. But in the middle of busy days and many responsibilities, wearing something that makes you feel comfortable and happy also counts as a small, beautiful moment.

And sometimes, those small moments are exactly what we need to keep going.

title.title: How B2B\nBrands Can Thrive in a Cookie-Free, AI-Driven Advertising Era
title.body:
The
digital advertising landscape is undergoing a major transformation. As privacy
regulations tighten and browsers phase out third-party cookies, marketers are
being forced to rethink how they identify, target, and engage potential
customers. At the same time, artificial intelligence is rapidly reshaping how
campaigns are optimized, personalized, and scaled.





For [B2B brands](https://intentamplify.com/), this
shift toward a cookie-free, AI-first
advertising environment represents both a challenge and an opportunity.
Traditional tracking methods that relied on third-party cookies to monitor user
behavior across websites are becoming less reliable. However, advancements in
AI and data analytics are enabling marketers to develop smarter,
privacy-conscious strategies that still deliver strong results.





One of
the most important shifts in this new environment is the growing reliance on first-party
data. Instead of depending on external tracking technologies, organizations
are building stronger relationships with their audiences and collecting
valuable insights directly from their own channels. Website interactions, email
engagement, CRM data, webinar participation, and content downloads all
contribute to a richer understanding of customer interests and behaviors.





First-party
data allows B2B marketers to create more accurate audience segments and
personalized experiences while maintaining compliance with evolving privacy
standards. When combined with AI-powered analytics, this data becomes even more
valuable.





Artificial
intelligence is playing a crucial role in helping marketers interpret complex
datasets and identify patterns that would otherwise be difficult to detect. AI
tools can analyze behavioral signals, predict buyer intent, optimize ad
placements, and recommend personalized messaging for different audience
segments. This enables marketing teams to deliver highly relevant campaigns
without relying on invasive tracking techniques.





Another
key strategy in the cookie-free era is contextual and intent-based
advertising. Instead of targeting individuals based on browsing history,
marketers can focus on the context of the content being consumed or on signals
indicating interest in specific topics. Intent data platforms help identify
organizations that are actively researching certain technologies or solutions,
allowing marketers to engage accounts that are already showing signs of buying
interest.





To
succeed in this evolving environment, B2B brands are focusing on several
strategic priorities:





*   Building strong first-party
         data ecosystems across marketing platforms

*   Leveraging AI tools for
         predictive analytics and campaign optimization

*   Using intent signals to
         identify high-interest accounts

*   Implementing contextual
         advertising strategies

*   Strengthening account-based
         marketing (ABM) approaches





Equally
important is the need for collaboration between marketing, sales, and data
teams. A unified data strategy ensures that insights collected from multiple
channels are integrated and used effectively to guide outreach and engagement.





The
transition to a cookie-free advertising landscape may seem disruptive, but it
ultimately encourages marketers to adopt more sustainable and privacy-friendly
approaches. By focusing on high-quality data, AI-powered insights, and targeted
engagement strategies, B2B brands can not only adapt to this new environment
but also gain a competitive advantage.





In the
AI-first era of advertising, success will no longer depend on tracking every
click across the internet. Instead, it will depend on understanding customer
intent, delivering meaningful experiences, and building trusted relationships
with the audiences that matter most.

title.title: A Simple Cup Of Tea Does It For Me. LOH279
title.body:
**Good morning Ladiesofhive Community.**

Here in Nigeria what most people call Tea isn't actually Tea, it's more like a chocolate drink and seriously that's not what Tea is,it's actually want most of us has grown up knowing.

***
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYiFdTzB9ZVRTMuvcMb37EQk6nDyWs4PciuihGBWTuzX7/1773145061940.jpg)

Now I see most people say that they prefer Coffee over Tea and well I accept their choices but for me I prefer Tea and I don't mean chocolate drinks that's mixed with sugar, some people love coffee because it gives them energy, while others enjoy those chocolate drinks because they are sweet and comforting,but no, I prefer chamomile tea or Lipton  because they are caffeine free , there's just something about drinking like that, it doesn't have to be overly sweet or too heavy and thats how I like it.

Also one thing I like chamomile tea, it is that it is relaxing and calming, after a long day out , you make take a warm cup of tea and you just feel so relaxed doing so, so it's like one of those habits that helps you relax well.

Lipton is also another tea That I like so much, it's very much easy to prepare, and it is something that you can take on different times of the day, sometimes I take it in the morning and sometimes at night too, what I like about lipton is that you only need to put your Tea bag in hot water and allow it brew, that's like a very easy way to prepare.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRJnwJfCZcRZQo1mz8tafNAPo9FDfXXDLTafNDmh5uLBf/1773145106787.jpg)

***


Another reason that I like tea is because it is very light compared to other types of hot drinks there is, some drinks can be too heavy , too sugary depending on what it is , tea has a simple vibe to it, it is something that you take to keep you relaxed, think or just want some time to yourself,when life gets busy , drinking tea can feel like a way to think about your day while inhaling the gentle brew smell.

At the end of the day, everyone will always have their personal preference when it comes to drinks, some people will always choose coffee, others will go for chocolate drinks, and some will stick with tea.

But for me, a simple cup of tea will always win, it is calming, simple, and it gives me that quiet moment to just slow down and enjoy my day, and seriously, that is how it's supposed to be with drinking tea.

[First Image Credit](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-cup-of-green-tea-next-to-some-flowers-VbkrCpVF7yk)
[Second Image Credit](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-cup-of-tea-sitting-on-top-of-a-white-table-iiiq__zzdI8)

Free travel is an easy lift, and a meaningful perk for paying into the tax system during a lifetime of work.

I get the means tested argument, yes, many pensioners are very well off and many are in poverty, but all have served their time, paid their dues, some have had a luckier roll of the life dice than others, some were wiser in youth and prepared better, but all make up our collective past and origins.

What harm is free transport?, I don't see them clogging up the tube or mainline trains and shouldn't a progressive benefit overt time accrue to our longest contributing members of society.

Who said you judge a society by how it takes care of it young and old ? We are slipping badly on both counts I feel, lets not focus on the weakest and begrudge them a boon.

https://steemitimages.com/p/6VvuHGsoU2QBt9MXeXNdDuyd4Bmd63j7zJymDTWgdcJjo14h2UZLjLtAemZDXepSsbx8GwpeVPLUphtsjgcHv5TwUEhQLGmpCkHg4zUCDBNbeKsfowuL3uPirp5P9G?format=match&mode=fit&width=1280.jpg




The Cairo morning glory flower arrives like a quiet promise kept by the early light. As dawn stretches over walls, fences, and forgotten corners, its trumpet-shaped blooms unfurl in shades of soft blue and violet, sometimes brushed with white at the heart. There is something intimate about its timing—it opens when the world is still half-asleep, as if it prefers conversations with the sun alone. In that brief window of freshness, the flower feels less like a plant and more like a moment you’re lucky to witness.

What makes the Cairo morning glory especially charming is its resilience. It thrives where life seems sparse, climbing patiently, finding support in the most unlikely places. In busy cities and quiet villages alike, it turns ordinary spaces into living canvases. Its vines don’t demand attention; they earn it slowly, wrapping themselves around structures with a gentle persistence that mirrors the human instinct to grow, adapt, and endure.

title.title: My house and home for dogs and cats.
title.body:
>Greetings to everyone in the community. My name is Lieska, and I rescue stray dogs and cats, giving them a home.

\n\n
>A place that is your recreational park under the nature of the planyas, everyone eats together at one o'clock.

>When lunchtime approaches, they all bark, meow, and jump around while being attended to one by one.

\n\n
>Nap time, everyone with their blanket to keep warm and loved, they are all so cute.
>When I leave the house and return, they wait for me to receive and give more love and understanding.
>I start by preparing their evening meal, so that they are ready to go to sleep happy and together.

>They give me shelter and love. And they give me genuine, unconditional love in return.

\n\n

>The purpose of everything I do is to ensure that I no longer see dogs and cats living on the streets, alone, without love, and without a home.

\n\n

>Giving unconditional love to dogs and cats is my reason for living.

\n\n
>The photos shown here are of some of them. Thank you for reading my post.

title.title: Nuevo pasa de gemas y mejorando a Shelly - Squad Busters [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
![sjess.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNXe8eWdh6256K6K78QcDA5myGPG1AHtApFUqvieJyHus/sjess.jpg) Saludos amigo, regresamos a Squad Busters donde cada semana las batallas se ponen mucho más complicada, por eso nos toca prepararnos y seguir dando lo mejor para así poder llegar a la cima. Así que comenzamos este juego con muy buenas noticias y es que por ser un nuevo mes todo el juego se actualiza comenzando desde el pase de gemas de cada mes y esta vez toco el mes de marzo, donde ya han pasado algunos días, pero aun así se puede seguir recolectando cada una de las recompensas que nos están ofreciendo, donde la idea es tomar cada día sin perder ninguno. Además, podemos ver cómo mi equipo sigue creciendo y eso ha llevado a ser mucho más fuerte, poder recibir recompensas y lo mejore seguir sumando monedas, para así poder comprar que sea mucho mejor en el momento indicado en que salga. >Greetings, friends! We're back at Squad Busters, where the battles get much tougher every week, so we have to prepare ourselves and keep giving our best to reach the top. We begin this game with some very good news: since it's a new month, the entire game has been updated, starting with the monthly gem pass. This time it's March, and although a few days have already passed, you can still collect all of the rewards on offer. The idea is to take advantage of every day without missing a single one. In addition, we can see how my team continues to grow, which has made it much stronger, allowing us to receive rewards and, better yet, continue to accumulate coins so that we can buy something much better when it comes out at the right time. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNyFBuFBNTEYv4jTnYMCQWtW6C8w3wW6vQmsyDn7vL2mv/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUaE7EV2wSZfD4V48cNod1rCkq4jDVYCbyQ8bd1XcNXFh/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmckF6spp1Ve6jbuHtQCKFRyNSgL4MNoNdB6k8hPCpDGL3/image.png) Estamos comenzando prácticamente una nueva semana y por eso ya salieron lo que serían las misiones semanales que tiene una duración de siete días, tal como dura la semana y eso nos lleva a tener que batallar y poder cumplir lo que nos están pidiendo para así poder ganar. Este ha sido uno de los mayores retos que he tenido desde que estoy jugando porque siempre me hace falta una para así poder lograr la semana completa, por eso vamos con todo y dentro de esas misiones podemos ver que están activar cinco fusiones, eliminar a diez jefes monstruo y muchas otras más que tiene su toque se dificulta, lo bueno es que todas darán recompensas de monedas y fichas del juego. >We are practically starting a new week, which means that the weekly missions have been released. They last seven days, just like the week, and that means we have to fight hard and complete what is asked of us in order to win. This has been one of the biggest challenges I've had since I started playing because I always need one more to complete the whole week, so we're going all out. Among these missions, we can see that we have to activate five fusions, eliminate ten monster bosses, and many others that are quite difficult. The good thing is that they will all give rewards of coins and tokens in the game. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYkszjsMJfdPKUHBCnxae31uxQAhcdCs4PUrD2four6dz/image.png) En este punto del juego las batallas son bastante complicadas por el hecho de poder encontrarnos con rivales de mayor nivel y eso es algo que uno no escoge, solo se tiene que estar preparado para así poder batallar y dar lo mejor. Por eso es importante que cada uno de los personajes que forman mi equipo estén fuerte, resistentes y con dos estrellas, pero para poder lograr eso se tiene que mejorar y por eso era el turno de un personaje épico del juego conocida como Shelly, donde ya tenía algunas cartas para así poder avanzar. Con la mejor al nivel dos de estrella nos permitió desbloquear su segundo poder, que cambiara su atuendo y lo más importante su nivel de vida aumentará para así poder estar lista para cualquiera batalla. >At this point in the game, battles are quite complicated because we may encounter higher-level opponents, and that's something we can't choose. We just have to be prepared so we can battle and give it our best. That's why it's important that each of the characters on my team is strong, resilient, and has two stars, but to achieve that, you have to improve, and that's why it was the turn of an epic character in the game known as Shelly, where I already had some cards to help me advance. With the best at star level two, we were able to unlock her second power, which changed her outfit and, most importantly, increased her health so she could be ready for any battle. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPaZYRGcXL9KxSToaiev9dPAGdRra3ju3Kja198LLiWGS/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeGN6Vv9Frc9oy3C5jxAZcWeWLb8qtRsXrmaHtmiHrLoY/image.png) Esta vez jugamos una modalidad de juego distinta pero que es muy divertida, ya que se trata de operación pollitos, pero en equipo; donde la idea es poder tomar la mayor cantidad de pollitos que están en el campo de juego y de esa manera poder llevarlos al granjero y allí nos darán monedas para así poder desbloquear los cofres. Además, jugar en equipo puede llegar a ser un poco complicado, ya que uno no sabe cómo es el nivel del los demás jugadores del equipo y qué personajes tiene, pues aparte de tomar los pollitos se tiene que eliminar a los enemigos para que así no se roben a los pollitos por eso es una modalidad que cuenta con una gran responsabilidad y se tiene que ir avanzando. En este caso logramos pasar la primera ronda con facilidad, pero ya después se nos complicó y por eso perdimos de una y al menos nos dieron algo de recompensa. >This time we played a different game mode, but one that is a lot of fun, as it involves chick rescue, but as a team. The idea is to collect as many chicks as possible from the playing field and take them to the farmer, who will give us coins to unlock the chests. In addition, playing as a team can be a little complicated, since you don't know the level of the other players on the team or what characters they have. Apart from catching the chicks, you have to eliminate the enemies so they don't steal the chicks, which is why this mode involves a lot of responsibility and you have to keep advancing. In this case, we managed to get through the first round easily, but then it got complicated and we lost, but at least we got some reward. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmewGVQVCBa5PZdfJ9KvrfQaR9HUjBk3sNjnKMGYKcojkt/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP23rJKmHTrsxsceUMV1BqufZHpgHfbkuFoANLUQwGSdB/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQma4k4hzA43gy6nA3Psdt62T3TaFzDcWaupPBJKgzzA5dQ/image.png) Este es un gran juego donde cada día que habrá cosas que hacer, mejorar, comprar y de esa manera poder seguro avanzando, donde en mi caso he mejorado mucho desde el día uno que comencé a jugar, la cual ha sido una gran experiencia para así poder aprender y lo mejor es que esta semana será muy buena y hay misiones por cumplir. Así que amigos si alguno de ustedes de la comunidad juega Squad Busters me deja su nombre de usuario en los comentarios para así poder jugar unas partidas. >This is a great game where every day there will be things to do, improve, buy, and that way you can be sure to advance. In my case, I have improved a lot since the first day I started playing, which has been a great experience for learning, and the best part is that this week will be very good and there are missions to complete. So, friends, if any of you in the community play Squad Busters, leave your username in the comments so we can play a few games.

title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcHjyUZowx9hneJasbf1ZeTgPuYCuwkj3jNcyeniyM9D9/1773144598795.jpg)



I finally had some time to cook and rest after a long day at work. I took my time to prepare catfish soup that I had been craving for days.
When I was done cooking, I served the soup and left the plate on the table so it can cool off . I wanted a chilled orange juice to go with it, so I went to the kitchen to get one. While I was there, I heard the door open, but I did not bother to check because I was home alone with my dog, Spike.

When I came back to the sitting room with my juice, I saw Spike sitting quietly beside an empty plate, slowly licking his mouth , I looked at him and said, “Spike… you ate what?”

Hello Splinterlands and Hive Fam!

I hope that life is treating you well wherever you are in this part of the world.

My Splinterlands Game account is - FinPulse9.

This season of the game is ending in five days, and I am happy to share that I have unlocked Gold one league, and the next stop for me is going to be the diamond, which I hope that I'll be there also in the next few days. This has been challenging so far because I know there is a lot of competition on the silver league also,o so moving from silver to gold has taken a lot of time, and you can say roughly it has taken nine days of the season for me to unlock this league.

Gold One is the top League of Gold segment in the game, and from here, I need to move forward where I can enter the Diamond League, and that will be Diamond Three.

However, I'm not giving up, and I will be trying to increase it.

title.body:
![99pyU5Ga1kwqSXWA2evTexn6YzPHotJF8R85JZsErvtTWY6ywz4L93jf24mwqHaHS56ZvhybCPJJNxypxQm1bWYudgqEYhuDd7pe6wxMTnAr5MhXTQPQFjrHkRz1wke798.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kedir/23uEym5QbwhXa5FH9HitVJLFJi192z7ujyyxuQjvQdNfF8RybSwdEMMVQsgA9nMwwvbRS.png)

Crypto trading has become increasingly popular, but beginners should approach it with knowledge and caution. Understanding how cryptocurrency works is the first step. Coins like Bitcoin and Ethereum move in price based on news, technology updates, and market interest. Before exploring the crypto world, learners should study basic concepts such as blockchain, market trends, and volatility.

A smart beginner strategy is to focus on learning, not rushing. Observing how crypto prices rise and fall over time helps build a clearer understanding of market behavior. Researching trustworthy sources, following industry updates, and studying long-term patterns can help new learners think more carefully about risks.

Risk management is another key idea. The crypto market changes quickly, so beginners should avoid making decisions based on hype or pressure. With patience, continuous learning, and awareness of market risks, anyone can build a strong foundation for understanding crypto trading.

title.title: Road trip preps : March 9 2026
title.body:
Was going to be one of those days. They always turn out like this ahead of a bike tour. Once upon a time I had lists - camping and cycling. Then it morphed into a cycling drawer and a camping drawer. Then it got shambled with a few house moves. At least the camping stuff is in two easy spots. The tour is largely on Victorian rail trails - not much usual road stuff. That had me tossing between two bikes and panniers vs trailer. Last time I gave up the rail trail riding - riding a three wheel apparatus on a track that had a grass mound in the centre was not cutting it. Did check the maps - there is a lot of gravel. That had me leaning away from the riad bike. Bad news is the gravel bike is at the other house but it is along the way. Kicked the camping idea out - booked motels for two nights. Simplifies things a lot. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9df29826-a158-49e6-bc7a-ebe8f6d70fc6.jpg) Pile the stuff on the floor - make sure all the bike gear is there. Will be taking the newly acquired bike on the roof rack and its trailer. Can decide trailer vs panniers later. Dinner prep was a bit the same hit and miss. My wife had cooked bolognese sauce - make lasagne was the idea. Done that a lot of times. Bechemel went just fine - made too much - normally not enough ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f537c9f8-3e47-42d4-a6fa-816e1505e034.jpg) Photo at start of cook shows consistency was not right ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/77467f77-2159-4805-b00d-77d890539f1e.jpg) Photo at the end shows layering was not right either. Top layer of pasta had folded up and was not cooked. The sauce was a hit liquid. Tasted of cheese but a bit disappointing. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f4fcd107-973b-401c-9499-8229d45deb53.jpg) Did squeeze in time to do a preview and bonus page for Free Magnet Bot product I am promoting. If you want a way to create lead magnets to build your list, this is a great tool. Check it out at https://mclnks.com/magnetbotbonus Amazing part of the day is the steps got done without leaving the building. A few trips up and down to the basement qas all. Did rain a lot - pushed the shopping to next day. Only have 2.5 hours to drove to pick up the other bike - plenty can be squeezed in time wise
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@carrinm/actifit-carrinm-20260310t120255691z)_

title.title: Pool Play Continues in the WBC
title.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT3Zgct9U5eTwDjrq1AQLv84wRLnwQfEYjeh9Qq6yKLMQ/PXL_20260303_195842722.webp)

The World Baseball Classic has been moving along at a rapid pace.  I was hoping to maybe write a post about my nieces softball weekend today, but I decided I need to push that until tomorrow and get you all caught up on what is happening in the world of baseball.  It's a bit funny that MLB games are still taking place in Spring training while the WBC is happening all over the world.  There are a couple teams that have started to prove themselves to be the real contenders this year.  Probably about the same ones you would expect, but sometimes you never know what might happen in baseball.

I was chatting with someone the other day in the comments who had never been to a baseball game before.  It's certainly an experience you need to have at least once in your life.  I can understand why some find it to be a boring sport, but the atmosphere really makes up for the slow pace of the game.  Add to that the fact that they have some different rules for the WBC and I think it would be a truly amazing thing to see live.  I was explaining that the crowd at these games seem to be more the style you would see at a soccer match versus a baseball game.  Especially in the Tokyo games they are chanting and singing, it is pretty cool.  Even from my side of the TV!

Then again, you have some games where it looks like the stadium is half full.  I actually expected a bit more attendance for some of the games down south, but I guess it is probably hard to get away from the office in the middle of March.

Friday there were eight games played.  Japan hammered Chinese Taipei 13 to 0, Cuba beat Panama 3 to 1, and Venezuela took down the Netherlands 6 to 2.  Mexico had a nice win over Great Britain 8 to 2, Puerto Rico shut out Colombia 5 to 0, and The Dominican Republic throttled Nicaragua 12 to 3.  Finally, the US beat Brazil 15 to 5, and Chinese Taipei had a nice rebound game against Czechia 14 to 0.

Saturday gave us another eight games with Japan edging out Korea 8 to 6, Columbia fell to Canada 8 to 2, and The Netherlands took down Nicaragua  4 to 3.  Italy blanked Brazil 8 to 0, Panama fell short of Puerto Rico 4 to 3, and Venezuela took down Israel 11 to 3.  Finally on Saturday, The US had a good game against Great Britain 9 to 1 and Chinese Taipei beat Korea 5 to 4.

Sunday we only had seven games with Japan beating Australia 4 to 3, Cuba took down Colombia 7 to 4, and The Dominican Republic hammered The Netherlands 12 to 1.  Italy bested Great Britain 7 to 4, Israel shut out Nicaragua 5 to 0, and Panama and Mexico were winners over Canada and Brazil respectively 4 to 3, and 16 to 0.

Monday we had another seven games with Korea taking down Australia 7 to 2 in the early morning game.  It's been fun staring my day with baseball over the past week.  I am going to be a bit sad when it is over.  The Dominican Republic showed no mercy to Israel beating them 10 to 1, and Colombia edged out Panama 4 to 3.  Great Britain took down Brazil 8 to 1, Puerto Rico beat Cuba 4 to 1, and Venezuela shut out Nicaragua 4 to 0.  Finally, in the late game last night, the US took down Mexico 5 to 3.  

Today there are only four games on the schedule and I am currently watching the tight game between Czechia and Japan.  It's tied 0 to 0 in the bottom of the 7th inning and it just feels like Japan is one pitch away from opening this game up.  They currently have 7 hits to their opponents 2, but they just haven't been able to get anyone across the plate.  Later today Israel takes on the Netherlands, Canada faces Puerto Rico, and Italy takes on The US.  

Tomorrow finishes up pool play with Canada facing Cuba, Italy taking on Mexico, and The Dominican Republic going head to head with Venezuela.  After that we get a day off on Thursday before the Quarterfinals start up on Friday.  Right now Korea and Japan are the only two teams that have clinched their spot in the Quarterfinals.

Einzelwohnen. 

Fuer das Altersheim bin ich mir noch zu Jung.^^

Ich brauch nur ab und an mal einen, der guggt das ich noch Atme und Gut ist, haha.

Damit ich nicht vergesse, welcher Wochentag ist und das ich ab und an mal meine Stimmbaender mehr benutze in drei Wochen als fuer ein Hallo an der Kasse. :-)

Ansonsten ist eigentlich nur die Zeit Schwer, in welcher ich umziehe und alles das eingewoehnen ins Neue, dauert gefuehlt immer Laenger, je oefter man es gemacht hat. 

Aber gleichzeitig freue ich mich auch schon drauf, weil ich dann mehr Ruhe habe, was solche Probleme angeht.

Dann kann ich viel gemuetlicher Arbeiten und machen das ich Vorran komme mit den Programmen und den Ideen zum Umsetzen. 


Aber viel Wichtiger Pascal! Ist jetzt ein Karton, fuer deinen Zwerg. Ich habe im Atomschutzbunker Keller einen, ich weis es einfach inzwischen, den hole ich dann heute nach dem Einkaufen rauf.

Die Kiste denke ich geht bis wirklich zum Wochenende raus das soll ja sein! Ich habe dich da lange genug warten lassen, ohne es zu wollen. Aber ist nicht so einfach irgendwie, wie es oft aussieht.^^

Hoffe bei dir alles auch Gut und Danke das Du dir so Sorgen machst ist voll Lieb. 

Alle rufen mich an in den letzten zwei Wochen und fragen obs mir Gut geht ist wohl ein Zeichen es mir Besser gehen zu lassen. :-)

title.title: Sweet William Flower: A Tapestry of Color and Companionship
title.body:
The Sweet William flower carries a charm that feels both old-fashioned and timeless. With its clusters of tiny, star-shaped blossoms gathered tightly together, it resembles a small bouquet crafted by nature itself. Shades of crimson, pink, white, and purple often blend within a single cluster, creating intricate patterns that seem almost hand-painted. There is something delightfully communal about Sweet William—each tiny bloom contributing to a greater, shared beauty.

Botanically known as Dianthus barbatus, Sweet William belongs to the carnation family. Its name is believed to trace back to Europe, where it has graced cottage gardens for centuries. The flowers often carry a light, clove-like fragrance, subtle yet inviting. Growing upright on slender stems, they bloom generously in late spring and early summer, adding vibrant color to borders, beds, and containers.

Palestine 36 (2025): the danger of the single story [ENG|ESP]
title.body: >Based on a famous non-fiction book | Basado en un famoso libro de no ficción.\n\n

>

When the 15 shortlisted films for the Best International Feature Film Oscar were announced, I was pleasantly surprised by the variety and quality of the titles. With gems like *Sentimental Value* and *The Secret Agent* on that list, which would be narrowed down to five nominees, it was very difficult to predict which three would join that winning duo. And I confess that after seeing some of those films, I thought this one wouldn't make it, given the quality of the others. I was wrong, but was it really the quality of this film that got it here? Or was it something else? Let's see.


>Cuando se anunciaron las 15 pre seleccionadas para optar al Oscar como Mejor Película Internacional, me encontré gratamente sorprendido con la variedad y la calidad de los títulos. Teniendo joyas como _Sentimental Value_ y _The Secrete Agent_ en ese listado que se iba a reducir a cinco nominadas, era muy difícil prever cuáles serían las tres acompañantes de esa dupla ganadora. Y confieso que después de ver algunas de esas cintas, pensé que esta de hoy no lo conseguiría, debido a la calidad de las otras. Me equivoqué, pero ¿fue en realidad la calidad e esta película lo que la hizo llegar hasta acá? ¿O fue algo más? Veamos.

<div class=\

>Poster Written and directed by Annemarie Jacir, _**Palestine 36**_ is a historical drama that focuses on colonialism and the origins of a situation that clearly spiraled out of the oppressor's control, the consequences of which are still being felt 90 years later. In 1936, Palestinians launched a farmers' uprising against the prevailing British colonialism. It was the beginning of the largest and longest-running uprising during the three decades of British rule, but what sparked it? What was at stake? It's important to remember that during the 19th and the first half of the 20th centuries, the United Kingdom held colonies that were entire countries under its control. The most famous examples are Palestine and, of course, India, the birthplace of the legendary Mahatma Gandhi. But these weren't the only ones, and the British weren't the only actors either. Portugal in Angola, France in Algeria, and the European presence in Hong Kong, Morocco, and other countries were commonplace, but that didn't make them normal or just. Behind the mask of cooperation lay an agenda of re-education, the annihilation of local identity, and assimilation into the settler camp. Palestine was no exception. In _**Palestine 36**_, I appreciated that the story began with the inauguration of a British radio station in Arab territory. It was supposed to be a tool for cultural exchange and a welcome to modernity, but at its core, it was yet another measure—one more—of control. The settlers could make it look however they wanted, but the locals, the Palestinians, knew perfectly well what it was all about. >Escrita y dirigida por Annemarie Jacir _**Palestine 36**_ es un drama histórico que se enfoca en el colonialismo y en el origen de una situación que, claramente, se salió de las manos del opresor y cuyas consecuencias se siguen viviendo ahora, 90 años más tarde. En el año 1936, los palestinos iniciaron una revuelta liderada por agricultores contra el imperante colonialismo británico. Fue el comienzo del mayor y más largo levantamiento durante las tres décadas del dominio británico, pero ¿qué lo originó? ¿qué había en juego? Recordemos que durante el siglo XIX y la primera mitad del siglo XX, el Reino Unido tenía bajo su poder colonias que eran países enteros. Los caso más famosos son Palestina y por supuesto India, de donde emergió el mítico Mahatma Gandhi. Pero no eran las únicas, y los ingleses no eran los únicos tampoco. Portugal en Angola, Francia en Argelia, la presencia europea en Hong Kong, Marruecos y otros países era un panorama frecuente, pero no por eso normal o correcto. Tras la máscara de la cooperación se escondía una agenda de _reeducación_, aniquilación de la identidad local y la asimilación al bando del colono. Palestina no fue la excepción. En _**Palestina 36**_ me gustó que la historia comenzara con la inauguración de una estación de radio británica en territorio árabe. Se suponía que era una herramienta de intercambio cultural y una bienvenida a la modernidad, pero en el fondo era otra medida - una más - de control. Los colonos podían hacerlo lucir como quisieran, pero los locales, los palestinos, sabían muy bien de lo que se trataba.

>Scene from the movie | Escena de la película However, in the case of Palestine, there was an aggravating factor: the imposition of a new neighbor. This is perhaps one of the most inexplicable episodes in human history, not because what happened is incomprehensible, but because it is incomprehensible that the governments of the major powers of the time agreed that it was a solution. The Israeli-Palestinian conflict that continues today is a consequence of this moment in history and the weakness of those who, at different times in history, have had the opportunity to act, to speak out, and have remained silent. >Sin embargo, en el caso de Palestina hubo un agravante: la imposición de un nuevo _vecino_. Este quizás sea uno de los episodios más inexplicables de la historia de la humanidad no porque no se pueda entender lo que pasó, sino porque no se puede comprender que los gobiernos de las potencias del momento estuviesen de acuerdo con que era una solución. La guerra judeo palestina que se vive hoy en día es culpa de este momento en la historia y de la debilidad de aquellos que en diferentes momentos de la historia han tenido la posibilidad de hacer algo, de decir algo, y han callado.

>Poster Jews have wandered the world for centuries. Time and again they have faced exile for various reasons—almost always religious—and at the dawn of the 20th century, the Jewish people longed for a country, a territory they could call home. Israel did not exist in the 1930s and was only established after the end of World War II, largely thanks to the Holocaust. That a humiliated, nearly exterminated people should be rescued from the brink of oblivion and granted a territory to inhabit is not inherently wrong, but who should pay that price? If the Nazis murdered the Jews, why should Palestine have to cede its territory? Who was the British Empire in the 1930s to determine that Zionists could settle in a territory that was foreign to them, that had been stolen by the dirty hands of colonialism? And on top of all this, who were the Jews and who was the empire to dictate increasingly favorable conditions for the invaders and deplorable conditions for the rightful owners of that land? If you bring strangers into a stranger's home, put them in their bed, give them the other person's food, and displace the owners, how can you expect them not to fight back? Geopolitics has always been a dirty game that, unfortunately, often leads to impunity and oblivion. Today, as Israel and Palestine remain embroiled in an increasingly unequal war that can hardly be called a war—it's an extermination—no one holds the other responsible parties accountable, and no one takes responsibility for the mistake made.

>The Book >Los judíos han errado por el mundo desde hace siglos. Una y otra vez se han enfrentado a exilios por diferentes causas - casi siempre religiosas - y en los albores del siglo XX el pueblo judío quería un país, un territorio que pudieran llamar su hogar. Israel no existía en los años treinta y sólo se constituyó después del final de la segunda guerra mundial, en buena medida gracias al holocausto. Que un pueblo humillado, casi exterminado, sea rescatado del borde del olvido y se le otorgue un territorio para habitar no es en sí algo malo, pero ¿quién debía pagar ese precio? Si los nazis asesinaron a los judíos, ¿por qué debió Palestina ceder su territorio? ¿quién era el imperio británico en los años treinta para determinar que los sionistas podían establecerse en un territorio que era ajeno, que había sido _robado_ por las sucias manos del colonialismo? Y encima de todo esto, ¿quiénes eran los judíos y quien el imperio para determinar las condiciones cada vez más favorables para los invasores y deplorables para los legítimos dueños de esa tierra? Si llevas personas desconocidas a la casa de un extraño y los acuestas en su cama, les das la comida del otro y desplazas a los propietarios, ¿cómo puedes esperar que éstos no se defiendan? La geopolítica siempre ha sido un juego sucio que, desafortunadamente, deviene en impunidad y olvido. Hoy, cuando Israel y Palestina siguen enzarzados en una guerra cada vez más desigual que apenas puede llamarse guerra - es un exterminio - nadie pide cuentas a los otros responsables y nadie se hace cargo del error cometido.

>Scene from the movie | Escena de la película From a purely cinematic standpoint, I think the film is fine. It's well-made, has an acceptable script, decent filming, and features Jeremy Irons, Liam Cunningham, and BAFTA winner Robert Aramayo. It's a good film. However, is it among the top five international films of the year? Is it better than *Belén*, better than *No Other Choice*, better than *Late Shift*, better than *Left-Handed Girl*? In my opinion, no. Not as a cinematic work. And I think it made the shortlist because of its political message and the current context, more than for its artistic merits. >Desde lo cinematográfico, la película me parece correcta. Está bien hecha, tiene un guion aceptable, una filmación justa y la presencia de Jeremy Irons, Liam Cunningham y el ganador del BAFTA Robert Aramayo. Es una buena película. Ahora bien, ¿es de las mejores cinco películas internacionales en el año? ¿es mejor que _Belén_, mejor que _No Other Choice_, que _Late Shift_, que _Left-handed girl_? En mi opinión, no. No como producto cinematográfico. Y creo que logró entrar en las cinco finalistas por su mensaje político y el contexto actual, más que por méritos artísticos.

>Poster I don't like it when things get mixed up. That an athlete is disqualified from a competition for a political stance and not for their performance; that a singer is recognized for their looks or their partner rather than for the quality of their music; or, as in this case, that a film stands out for reasons unrelated to cinematography—I don't usually like it, and I would have preferred to see some of the other beautiful films I've seen on this list. However, despite this, I'm grateful it happened, that this nomination has once again stirred the interest of a world that no longer pays attention to its own dramas. It's been four years since Russia started the war against Ukraine; Israel has been cornering the Palestinians in their own home for decades... and nobody does anything. There are no effective sanctions, no condemnation, no one held accountable. The world turns a blind eye and accepts the superficial version of the story told by the media. That's why I think it's important to know the other side, and if cinema can help show a glimpse of that other reality, then so much the better. That's why I chose the title of a book by Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, *The Danger of the Single Story*, for this post, because we can't hear only one side of the conflict; we must pay attention to everyone involved. The truth lies there, between the two. And then, after listening, we must do something. Communicate it, spread the word, discuss it. We cannot remain passive in the face of so much abuse, and in this case, I think watching this film makes us reflect on these issues. How many of you have seen it? Let me know in the comments.

>Poster >No me gusta que se mezclen las cosas. Que un atleta sea descalificado de una competencia por una postura política y no por su desempeño; que un cantante sea reconocido por su apariencia o su acompañante más que por la calidad de su música; o, como en este caso, que una película se destaque por razones ajenas a lo cinematográfico, no suele gustarme y habría preferido ver en esta lista algunas otras hermosas películas que pude ver. Sin embargo, a pesar de ello, agradezco que haya ocurrido, que esta nominación sacuda nuevamente el interés del mundo que ya no presta atención a sus dramas. Hace cuatro años que Rusia comenzó la guerra contra Ucrania; Israel tiene décadas arrinconando a los palestinos en su propia casa... y nadie hace nada. No hay sanciones que sirvan, no hay condena, no hay culpables. El mundo da media vuelta y se queda con la historia que le cuentan superficialmente los medios de comunicación. Por eso creo que es importante conocer el otro lado y si el cine sirve para mostrar un poco de esa otra realidad, bienvenido sea. Por eso elegí como título para este post el nombre de un libro de Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, _The danger of the single story_, porque no podemos oír un solo lado del conflicto, debemos prestar atención a todos los involucrados. La verdad está allí, en medio de los dos. Y luego, después de escuchar, hay que hacer algo. Comunicarlo, difundirlo, conversarlo. No podemos permanecer pasivos ante tanto abuso y en este caso creo que ver esta película hace que reflexionemos sobre esos temas, ¿cuántos de ustedes la han visto? Los leo en los comentarios. ---

title.body:
>Today I'm here with a somewhat generic anime, since it follows the same trope of a girl reincarnating in a game, her fiancé abandoning her, and many other details similar to other stories. However, it's never a bad idea to watch them, even if it's the same old thing, especially this one, where what I love most is definitely its protagonist. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-03-10_073716_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tbkfpTASiwTymV5hpbjgZ3n4APGRQSjWq7PfGzCaYQg57D3VU6C1w3BcyUUAVZDCJTe.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt15533960/mediaviewer/rm1143889921/?ref_=ttmi_mi_45_2) ---
> # Akuyaku Reijō Nano de Last Boss wo Katte Mimashita (悪役令嬢なのでラスボスを飼ってみました)… ---

>It premiered in 2022, directed by Kumiko Habara and produced by the animation studio Maho Film; this reverse isekai is a fantasy, romantic comedy, and slice-of-life anime. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-03-10_073908_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xVP1rV92AU1PXZneAnRhpNnkHFpT5Pt3xMLcJjrjKbpUiP96gXnd5aeLjfFoMPfuKGw.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt15533960/mediaviewer/rm3693371393/?ref_=ttmi_mi_34_2) ---

>The story centers on Aileen Lauren d'Autriche, a young noblewoman whose perfect life crumbles when her fiancé, the crown prince, publicly breaks off their engagement to be with another woman; however, upon receiving this news, she regains the memories of her previous life, realizing that she has been reincarnated into the world of her favorite otome video game... but not as the heroine, but as the villain destined for certain death. ---

>Aware of the horrific fate that awaits her, she decides to take a desperate measure: conquering the Demon King, Claude Jean Elmir, the game's final boss and the prince's half-brother. According to the game, Claude is a solitary being, judged for being a demon. When emotionally wounded, he transforms into a dragon that destroys the kingdom and ends the protagonist's life. But his desire to live is much stronger, and he heads for his palace. Will he be able to conquer him? Will he be completely safe and change the fate that awaits him? ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-03-10_074035_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23zkrj6cSypiwLy7oTucAJucqajrfbaHhxG8B5hEQeh8iADpTuSSWSLo9gacWb8N9LACW.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt15533960/mediaviewer/rm1383293185/?ref_=ttmi_mi_13_2) ---

>What attracted me most to this anime, besides its animation, were its characters. The protagonist, Aileen, isn't your typical heroine waiting to be rescued. Irene is a businesswoman, a strategist, and above all, someone with unwavering resilience. What's fascinating is that she doesn't try to be \

in the traditional sense; she uses her villainous skills (manipulation, command, cunning) for noble ends. As for Claude, he may seem rough and cold at first, but he hides a vulnerable personality. It's clear he's been hurt many times. His greatest conflict isn't with a hero, but with his own feelings, because if he loses control, the world suffers. This vulnerability makes him extremely human and generates immediate empathy. ---

>I also like that the secondary characters contribute to the plot; they aren't just decorative. Of course, some of them don't have as much depth as the main characters, but they still have their defined roles. As for the pacing, there are no lulls in the story. We have a conflict, and it's resolved in just a few episodes, although the story does feel rushed at certain points. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-03-10_074147_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/Eos3kJfmNwuW8KMv3n8JvS8aKbLRgLnnsu4kZUnETA2QoaVm1yUYgepWQjNo5Mvn4mj.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt15533960/mediaviewer/rm1098080513/?ref_=ttmi_mi_19_2) ---
>-Refreshing protagonists with their own unique touch.\n
>-A chemistry story that progresses satisfactorily.\n
>-A brisk pace with no filler.\n
>-It does feel rushed at certain points.\n
>-Although I like the animation, there are dips in quality in certain episodes.\n
>7/10 Story │ 7.5/10 Animation │ 7/10 Sound │ 8.5/10 Character Design │ 7/10 General ---
>This anime isn't trying to revolutionize the entertainment industry, but it knows exactly what it is: a fun story about a smart woman who refuses to accept a \
and who believes you shouldn't judge a book by its cover. Now tell me, despite having the typical clichés, would you be willing to watch it? ---
