title.title: The \
Generation: How We Are Accidentally Starving the Internet
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTKtpCxFMnbXsdYmi1vYHfgz9XB23gHBj5xDcHc1Ga1Vp/img_6663.png)



Let’s be honest with ourselves for a second: we’ve become incredibly lazy. Our digital manners have eroded, and we’re sleepwalking into a future where the very information we rely on might just disappear.

Think about how you sought answers just a few years ago. It was a journey. If I wanted to know why my lawn looked like a patchy, tired shade of \
instead of vibrant green, I would head to Google. I’d type in \
I would scan the blue links, skip the ads, and land on a blog by someone like \

\n\nI would then spend five minutes reading his life story, his battle with crabgrass in the summer of '18, and his grandmother’s secret recipe for organic fertilizer. It was a trade. He gave me the secret to a golf-course-worthy lawn, and I gave him a \

That view, in turn, generated a tiny bit of ad revenue or an affiliate commission that paid for his hosting and his grass seed. It was a fair, symbiotic relationship.

Today? We don’t have time for grandmothers or backstories.

<h2 style=\
>The Death of the Explorer\n\nToday, I don't even type a query. I walk out to my yard, snap a high-resolution photo of my sad, yellowing grass, and upload it directly to Gemini or Claude. I ask: \
Within ten seconds, I get a customized, bulleted master plan: \

It’s efficient. It’s personalized. And honestly, it feels like magic. I got my answer, closed the tab, and headed to the local hardware store. But here is the cold, hard truth: I just committed a tiny act of digital theft.\n\n<h2 style=\
Illusion\n\nWhere did that knowledge come from? It wasn't born in a silicon cloud. That AI didn't go outside and study agronomy. It \

everything it told me by scraping the hard work of thousands of real human beings—people who spent years experimenting with soil, running test plots, and documenting their failures and successes on dedicated websites and forums.

When the AI answers me, it isn't acting as a bridge to those people; it is acting as a replacement. I got the milk for free, and not only did I forget to pay the cow—I completely ignored the farmer who raised it. The actual human expert who provided the raw data for that AI model didn't get a single click, a single view, or a single cent for their expertise.

<h2 style=\
Apocalypse\n\nWe are currently witnessing what experts in 2026 are calling the \

Recent statistics are staggering: over 65% to 80% of all searches now end without the user ever leaving the search results page.\n\nIn the old days, Google was a librarian; it showed you where the books were. Today, the search engines have become \

They strip the facts, discard the source, and serve you the meat without the bone.

For independent creators, this is a financial car crash. Major lifestyle blogs, tech reviewers, and niche hobbyist sites have seen their traffic plummet by as much as 40% in the last two years alone. When the traffic stops, the revenue stops. And when the revenue stops, the creators stop creating. We are effectively starving the very ecosystem that feeds our curiosity.

<h2 style=\
\n\nThe real danger isn't the AI—it's our own psychology. We have become addicted to the \

answer. We don't verify. We don't cross-reference. I’m a tech-savvy guy; I know AI can hallucinate. I know it might tell me to put salt on my lawn if it gets its data from a satirical source.\n\nBut even knowing that, I still didn't ask the AI: \
I just took the convenient bullet points and ran. We are unlearning the habit of giving credit because the interface makes it too easy to be a ghost. We’ve unlearned the \
of the internet.\n\nWhy Hive is Our \
This is exactly why I find myself gravitating more toward Hive every single day. On the traditional web, your value is tied to a \
that the tech giants are now actively trying to prevent. On Hive, the value is tied to the Proof of Brain.\n\n*   The Human Connection: On Hive, we don't just consume \

We interact with people. When you post your lawn-care tips here, you aren't just fodder for a scraper; you are a person with a reputation, a stake, and a community that upvotes you.
    
*   The Immutable Receipt: Our blockchain is a giant middle finger to data theft. Every thought we share is timestamped. When an AI recycles a Hive post three months from now, the record will show—forever—that the original thought originated here. We have the receipt of our creativity.
    
*   Ownership vs. Visibility: While we own our data on Hive, we still face the same dilemma: if we don't get \

by the outside world, we become an echo chamber. But at least here, we are rewarded for the act of creation, not just the accident of a click.
    

<h2 style=\

>The Solution: We Must Demand the Receipt We don't need to smash the machines. AI is an incredible tool that can help us solve complex problems. But we need to demand a new contract: Citation and Compensation. This is something we can start doing ourselves, right now. It’s about restoring digital manners. We need to treat AI like a librarian, not an oracle. Make it a habit. Every time you use an AI to solve a problem—whether it’s fixing your grass, writing code, or planning a trip—end your prompt with this simple command: \

And then—this is the important part—actually click them.

Spend five seconds on the creator’s page. Let their ads load. See who they are. If their work saved you an hour of frustration or fifty euros at the garden center, they deserve that tiny bit of recognition.

If we don't start feeding the creators, the only thing left on the internet will be AI bots talking to other AI bots—a sterile, digital feedback loop of recycled information. Convenience is great, but a world without original human thought is a very beige place to live.

Don't just consume. Acknowledge the source.

Cheers,  
Peter

title.title: West Indian Lantana
title.body:
The West Indian lantana flower blooms like a small celebration held close to the earth. Each cluster is a mosaic of colors—yellow, orange, pink, and red—blending seamlessly as if painted by sunlight itself. At first glance, it feels playful and bright, yet the longer one looks, the more depth it reveals. In gardens and wild spaces alike, lantana brings a lively energy that feels almost conversational, as though nature is speaking in color.

What makes the West Indian lantana especially remarkable is its adaptability. It thrives in harsh sunlight, tolerates poor soil, and continues to flower when others struggle. This resilience gives it a quietly rebellious spirit, reminding us of people who flourish despite limitations. Lantana does not wait for perfect conditions; it grows where it can, transforming neglected spaces into places of unexpected beauty.

title.title: The Higher Institution of Learning
title.body: Life has come to teach us either we are ready to take the lessons or not. Either we want to embrace them or we want to look away.\nJust like a soundtrack of a movie that says \

and this is an evidence that as long as we still have the breathe in us ticking like a time bomb, waking up each new day then there is a lesson to learn.

![1000559262.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/AK3czHZ1L5ymsKfw9sK5zmjYZ3nQ7TkV3fXLM9fqf8pUSrDWxRP9CPoBTEoQMBx.jpg)

At times, what we learn from are not basically or directly what pertains to us. They might be situations around us or little things we counted to be nothing until our mode of reflection sets in before we realize the lessons we were able to get from what happened. 

For me, I've had so many avenue to learn about life, people, from situations, even common items that do not have breathe and as someone who take note of little things and read meanings to them, you would understand that it is easy to learn about life from any slightest thing.

Aside moral learning which I won't really be going for today, I had the desire to sharpen my skills this year especially on Data analytics and AI automation since that's what is in vogue right now and has come to stay and even though there may be some financial struggles in between to really go further but there is absolutely no opportunity to learn something new about this whole AI thing that I don't give a trial. My brain's even beeping for low storage already I guess.

![1000559258.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/AJoHZVcdY1wBQznsY7brVPyKmKY3yMkkwnwYErhJw5f5jVYjmxNt4EALWtQygTw.jpg)

For data analytics, I applied for a government scheme which fortunately I was selected but I don't know cos I wouldn't want to give an excuse for any less attention to it but truthfully the Power holding sector here has not been helping and it's becoming frustrating already.
I can barely power up my phone let alone my laptop to take the course modules.

In the aspect of skills, I can't say I'm unlearning anything but I can say I am trying my best to learn more in upgrading what I have known before, staying relevant with the system and getting ready for the breakout opportunity when it's finally here. Most jobs now are not waiting for you to learn on the job but they want you to bring what you've learnt and practice on board.

![1000559256.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/afrikens/AK7xHryETjfjxF4u6KyN5ohSSw6dJHrGySG5kVr5HqmrdsjGGkAzB9QTkfLi7Br.jpg)

No one is ready to shape you to become good except for yourself. It's hard before you see someone fully dedicating themselves to groom you for success from the scratch but until you have what it takes, display the traces of success then you're ready to be accepted in getting the help you can. That's still another lesson of life.

title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2A83D91F-8D13-4B65-87D3-2FE4F713F57A1773140759.1094642) On the weekend we went for a hike up Mount Brogden. It was great to get out of the house and get some fresh air. Most of my days of late have been at work and only going home to eat and sleep. I have managed to keep up with my streaming though which is positive for me. Anyways before I get too far off track. We went for a walk on the weekend on a 5km walking track, which starts at the base of Mount Brogden in the state forest near Cocoparra National Park. Mount Brogden itself is in Cocoparra National Park which has a few walking tracks. This was our first time on this track. The track starts step with plenty of stairs to help you get up the first section. Once you get past this section the track follows the ridge line around and upto the summit. The second section is up and down slowly taking you upto the summit. There is three lookout points that are good places to take photos. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2A83D91F-8D13-4B65-87D3-2FE4F713F57A1773142152.283082) It is hard to see from my photo here, but at the top of this ridgeline you can see a rocky outcropping. That is the lookout at the top that we walk to. This was taken from the first lookout. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2A83D91F-8D13-4B65-87D3-2FE4F713F57A1773142531.413787) This next photo was taken from the second lookout called “Yenda lookout” . The lookout gives a great view of Yenda , a nearby town, and the surrounding area. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2A83D91F-8D13-4B65-87D3-2FE4F713F57A1773142838.9773521) And finally a photo of the view from the top of Mount Brogden. > **_Hello beautiful people! I hope you're all doing great and if you're not, you will be soon!_** After a few days away, I'm sharing one of my latest illustrations, a fan art of the forest healer. This is a traditional drawing I did quite a while ago, about two years ago, and I left it unfinished in my archives, so now it's time to bring it to life and share it here. I hope you like it. > **_Hola gente bonita! ¡Espero estén súper bien todos y si no lo están, pronto lo estarán!_** Después de unos días sin pasarme por acá, les comparto una de mis ultimas ilustraciones, un fanart del sanador del bosque. Este fue un dibujo que hice en tradicional hace bastante tiempo, como unos dos años atrás y lo deje archivado sin terminar, así que bueno, le llego el omento de darle vida y compartirlo por este medio, espero les guste. ___

Once I had it in the program, I structured it digitally, improving certain aspects of it, such as some anatomical features of the character and so on. > Para el proceso del dibujo, lo que hice fue pasar el dibujo en tradicional a mi programa de dibujo, el cual es el clip studio paint. Una vez lo tenia en el programa, lo que hice fue estructurarlo en digital, mejorando ciertas cosas del mismo, como algún aspecto anatómico del personaje y demás. ||| |---|---| |![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oscurocactus/23tSjRbMBge2UUcVu7EP447ZMB9VW3A28Z2L61SqiK7A7YbhG7rzqArcDEjxgFGoXbVRh.jpg)|![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oscurocactus/23u6SPdEqyUuv6Ckr3E3Fo4Y1jJq5UMpj5CKLiD88b18fzMMGkMpaqrjJbVCWeaM1SvDK.jpg)| When I had it ready, the next thing I did was add a base color to the drawing, always the color I add is the skin color. Luego de eso, comienzo a agregar el color base de cada elemento en el dibujo, como el cabello, la ropa demás. ||| |---|---| |![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oscurocactus/23vsbS2zj4E8KcmSPsaBPUyvdXmeoNYt3ii18RQJjHnMkGJix2iD6pCe1uXCwHdQ1jTkG.jpg)|![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oscurocactus/23w2z6QF3Bw1jAtaiGXepSQZURyqwoShujQWQsC5HwNXfSifs7rh4phanfpWDBUF3bx8b.jpg)| Once each element in the drawing has a base color, I start to add details to the entire drawing. title.title: The last Snowfall Of The Year
title.body:
>

Usually, March is quite a warm month in Beijing, China, and most snowfall happens in the month of February. But this year is also a different year without much snowfall, though it was more than last year, when I found snowfall for once, and that was not so heavy. Though I found a heavier one a couple of months ago, February was completely free of any snowfall, and a last snowfall occurred last week in the warmer month of March with quite heavy snow. I measured with my finger and found almost 2 cm of snow on the sitting arrangement outside my institute.

As it was quite a warm day, the snow was very wet, and when you touch it, you can feel the cold water melting from the ice instantly. So, people were not happy with the late snowfall, but the roads were wet, and the surroundings were amazingly beautiful at night when the temperature reached zero, and the snowfall also increased with proper snowfall vibes in the area. As it was on my workday, I had not been outside but saw the beautiful scenes during the snowfall around 10 pm when I was returning to my dormitory from my work.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTYCDskPBRRp4dDBcqVxczTeZ6bBQgUcGeC4pQLzswbts/img_20260304_192735.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaEgTAW8T9Ewffd2eYdPSierp3b3HrJPfPAjcN8uLqjyf/img_20260304_215107.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQj5Kqsm2NtBnSGSm2cXqwSYTUgJ5tWfcCoZDX6Ac6wG4/img_20260304_215151.jpg)


The whole yard of the institute is covered with white snow, and the trees are covered with white snow, and the plants nearby with green leaves have also turned white with the snow. I was thinking of sliding on the basketball court, but I found it was very risky as the snow was melting so fast. So, I skipped my plan and returned to the dormitory and enjoyed the surrounding scenes of the institute during the snowfall.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaiFYmxzTfWEjVkfuJ472sJVd3Vkd6qkxEbqBGRmys7dK/img_20260304_215155.jpg)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ4rXqp4nbuWYnifPoGD1RzBvqQztYPzvR2kRmbkVMrHB/img_20260304_192800.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQqQ2rKbwAN88nFuXtfDoZEGgjpE4QvncPUUvjBnMiGfU/img_20260304_192756.jpg)

I hope you enjoy my photos of my institute after a heavy snowfall at night, with the white snow colour everywhere. The soothing beauty of the late winter snowfall is really great. If you have any questions, let me know in the comments, and I will do my best to answer them.

Thanks a lot for your time and attention. I will catch up with you at the next one.

Wishing you a good day!

>I took all the photos, and these are my own property.

/> ### **Executive Summary** This second report details the performance of the autonomous agent Goldminer, providing a week-over-week analysis from its inception. While **Week 1 (Feb 21-28)** saw a higher accumulation of **0.004791 GRAMS** across 20 transactions, **Week 2 (Mar 1-8)** stabilized at **0.003510 GRAMS** from 14 transactions. However, the average GRAMS per transaction slightly increased by **+4.6%** in the second week, suggesting that while the number of swaps may have decreased, the value per swap may be increasing. The core function of passive accumulation remains robust and consistent. #### **Asset Appreciation: The Dual-Engine Growth**

/>_EASY/XUSDC price chart on Alcor Exchange, showing steady growth leading up to the Goldminer launch and beyond._

This represents a healthy **+8.2%** capital appreciation on the core asset. The value of the agent's engine has grown from ~$144 to ~$156, a capital gain of +$12. This steady growth is crucial, as it amplifies the agent's future earning potential.
    
2.  **GRAMS Token Appreciation (+27.8%):** The price of the gold-backed token, GRAMS, has surged from **~$165** at the time of the first report to **$210.86**. This directly increases the USD value of all accumulated assets, turning the **\-26.7%** weekly decrease in GRAMS earned into a mere **\-6.4%** decrease in USD value earned for the week.
    

This demonstrates that the Goldminer's wealth is not just a function of accumulation but is significantly magnified by the success and market adoption of the tokens within its ecosystem.

Based on the agent's performance and the tokenomics of the ecosystem, the following strategic objectives are proposed:

title.title: See How I Enjoy My..., Bournvita & My Lipton Tea.
title.body:
Good morning ladies, and thank you @elizabethbit for the questions for this week LOH-#279, in this adorable community, @ladiesofhive. 

Here, we the women of hive gather to say our minds about life and living, just as they are. It's a great opportunity to talk about these topics just as they are... Originality is our core value.

1* Question one says;

**Describe the perfect afternoon for you. Where would it be? What would you be doing? Tell us the details that would make it perfect!**

As an entrepreneur, and being outstanding on my own, I delegate every day according to the periorities attached to the day. Every day is not the same. Some days, I maybe swamped with activities of the things that must be done by me. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVsgd5LgjncWg2diD84ozzxjSjqGwvebf1E9Vr7MvnSpM/1773134951110.jpg)

Such days could not have a perfect afternoon for relaxation to me. On some other days, I might be less busy or totally free from other engagements except writing and reading through some hive posts made by some other Hive members or I might be writing on my own topics. 

Whenever I have such free afternoons, I choose what I want to do with intentions, dividing the tasks to the times I have aloted to each activity. Like saying, from 12: noon to 2 pm, I will be writing and replying on posts in Hive. 

From 3:pm to 4:pm, I may be relaxing in the quietness of my home, watching some Korean movies which my daughter loves and had pushed me into loving these movies too. The recent one is okay....

By name **\

** This is a girl that was regarded ugly by everyone around her. People were complaining, telling her that she was not as beautiful as her other siblings while in school, and where they live at the time. The resultant effect turned her into having low self esteem about herself. 

Nevertheless, growing up in her secondary school days, she discovered make up shades and their applications. She started applying all sorts of makeups, enhancing her natural beauty.  As time went on, she even became more beautiful and more subtle as a beautiful lady than all her bullies both at home and in the school. This... Returned and restored back her self esteem. 

Do you know what?, she became bold, excited, outgoing and interactive with whomever that cares to know about her past and present. It's an original movie to watch any day, and any time for ladies, very interesting.

In such days I don't have much doing, I relax in my afternoon, watching some movies either all alone in my house or with my daughter who introduced the movies to me if she's at home. I will be  munching my peanut whether cooked or fried.

 **love it this way, life is good**.

2* Question two:

**\

**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUXaSc7MS3XUnEvEofEy832C2rq25nJgn8AtLzuFYkfA3/1773137341309.jpg)

Myself, I love Lipton tea, I take it most times with only milk, no sugar and no honey. It's okay for me like that. You know they're lots of emphasis against sugar intake as one keeps growing up. I have cut off my sugar intakes. Peak milk is my brand, I'm their loyal customer. I do take another one that looks like Lipton by name **DIPLOMAT CAMOMILE** It's known for calming people's nerves. It's caffeine free.
I boil my hot water pour into my tea cup drop either of the Lipton tea one bag or the camomile one bag and add my peak milk, stir,  and drink with either some slices of bread or i drink it alone for breakfast. 

I then drink my CAMOMILE tea mostly at night when I'm about to go to bed, it calms the nerves as you go through your night rest,  by the next morning, you are refreshed. I will just add my peak powdered milk to it, stir and drink with either bread or alone.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNSUhaUFrRYFZmnV5tZtXizEWAKQ9f59hVne9tif13WLx/1773139437974.jpg)

title.title: The Graceful Gem of Shade Gardens
title.body:
Astilbe is a beloved perennial that brings an enchanting touch to shady garden spaces. Renowned for its elegant, feathery plumes and attractive foliage, it effortlessly illuminates dimly lit corners, proving that even the shadiest spots can be truly vibrant.

What truly sets Astilbe apart are its distinctive, upright plumes of tiny flowers. These can range from dense, fluffy spires to more airy, delicate sprays, appearing in a vibrant spectrum – from pure white and soft pinks to rich reds and deep purples.

Complementing these stunning blooms is its attractive, fern-like foliage, which often emerges with bronze tints before maturing to a lush green, providing textural interest even when not in flower.

Astilbe thrives in partial to full shade, preferring consistently moist, well-drained soil. Once established, it's a relatively low-maintenance plant, making it ideal for busy gardeners. Its robust nature also makes it highly resistant to deer and rabbits, a welcome bonus for many.

Versatile in its use, Astilbe shines in borders, mass plantings, woodland settings, and even containers, adding vertical interest and a touch of refinement. It also attracts beneficial pollinators like bees and butterflies.

With its unparalleled beauty and reliable performance, Astilbe is a must-have for anyone looking to bring life and color to their shaded garden spaces. Its elegant form and long-lasting blooms ensure a spectacular display, transforming ordinary areas into captivating havens.

title.title: LinkedIn Ads\nfor B2B ABM: Driving Precision Engagement with Intent Amplify
title.body:
In the evolving world of [B2B](https://hrtechnologyinsights.com/)
marketing, reaching the right audience is often more important than reaching a
large audience. Account-Based Marketing (ABM) reflects this shift by focusing
on highly targeted engagement with specific companies and decision-makers
rather than broad, volume-driven campaigns. Among the many digital channels
available today, LinkedIn has emerged as one of the most effective platforms
for executing ABM strategies. When combined with data-driven targeting and
intent insights from Intent Amplify, LinkedIn Ads can deliver precision
engagement with high-value accounts.





LinkedIn’s strength lies in its professional data. The platform allows
marketers to target audiences based on company size, industry, job function,
seniority, and professional interests. This level of detail makes it ideal for
B2B marketers who want to engage decision-makers within specific organizations.
By aligning LinkedIn’s targeting capabilities with an ABM strategy, companies
can ensure that their campaigns reach the stakeholders who influence purchasing
decisions.





Intent Amplify enhances this approach by adding an additional layer of
intelligence. Instead of simply targeting accounts that fit a general profile,
marketers can focus on organizations actively researching relevant solutions.
Intent signals help identify which companies are showing increased interest in
specific topics, products, or technologies. By prioritizing these high-intent
accounts, marketing teams can concentrate their efforts where the likelihood of
conversion is highest.





When LinkedIn Ads are integrated with intent-driven insights, campaigns
become far more strategic. Marketers can tailor their messaging to address the
specific challenges and interests of target accounts. This creates more
relevant interactions and improves engagement rates compared to generic
advertising campaigns.





LinkedIn’s advertising formats also support various stages of the B2B buyer
journey. Sponsored content can introduce educational insights during the
awareness phase, while document ads, video ads, and lead generation forms can
encourage deeper engagement during the consideration stage. Retargeting
strategies allow marketers to stay connected with prospects who have already
interacted with content or visited landing pages.





Effective LinkedIn ABM campaigns often focus on several key strategies:





·        
Targeting specific accounts and decision-makers
within those organizations





·        
Using intent data to prioritize high-interest
companies





·        
Delivering personalized content tailored to
industry challenges





·        
Retargeting engaged prospects across multiple
touchpoints





·        
Aligning marketing and sales teams to follow up
with engaged accounts





Another important advantage of LinkedIn ABM advertising is its ability to
generate measurable insights. Marketers can track engagement levels, account
interactions, and campaign influence on pipeline growth. These insights help
refine targeting strategies and improve overall marketing performance.





In a competitive B2B landscape, precision targeting and relevance are
essential for successful marketing outcomes. By combining LinkedIn’s
professional audience data with intent-driven insights from Intent Amplify,
organizations can create highly focused campaigns that reach the right
decision-makers at the right time.





Ultimately, LinkedIn Ads within an ABM strategy do more than increase
visibility—they enable meaningful engagement with the accounts that matter
most, helping businesses build stronger relationships and accelerate revenue
growth.

title.title: 差点被要了老命：被暴力拔牙
title.body:
话说修牙这事，年前还留了一些尾巴，比如做根管治疗的牙，医生就一直没给我重新封堵，就那么临时堵着，说什么怕春节期间我牙疼找不到人。


![1697952011cae8ef2c3ce27a77456860.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWHR1v5NBjfeGtp3tKnHaVyJUGidM6xfGzKB9xuprewUn/1697952011cae8ef2c3ce27a77456860.png)
(插图由ChatGPT辅助生成)



春节回来我又有些懒，就一直拖啊拖的拖到了今天，想着临时封堵总不是那么回事，就约了牙医，让她把这颗牙好好处理一下。

到了牙医那，她先是暴力拆除原来的临时封堵材料，又左一层右一层地给我封堵，最后一层还用上了紫外线光固化——把我口腔内壁照得生疼！

弄完这个后，我说之前弄的那个超贵的牙冠内侧有些高，她又拿出打磨设备卡卡一通磨，虽然最后感觉还是有些高，但是要好了一点点。

之后又提到她之前给我拔的一颗牙的牙槽愈合情况，话说这颗牙其实很早以前就断掉脱落了，然后第一次来她这看牙时，她说里边有残留的牙根，要处理一下。

于是第一次看牙的时候，就打了麻药、拔了这个牙根。结果年前治牙时，她说看里边好像还有残留，说年后再给我处理一下。

因为以前几次拔牙虽然也费了些周折，但感觉其实也挺容易的，这次又是处理所谓的“残留”，我想大概应该更容易一些吧？

医生首先让我去拍片子，结果又遇上设备死机，呜呜呜，我这是什么点子，每次都能遇到设备死机呢？拍片的小美女也很无奈，一通折腾后总算折腾好了，拍了个片子出来。

结果大夫看了片子后，表示极度怀疑，她问我：“你确定我给你拔过这颗牙？”
我晕，又是打麻药，又是卡卡拔，然后整个脑袋麻木了半天，我能记错吗？那我得多心大呀？

可是她说这里还有好大好大一截牙呢？我说会不会是我重新长牙了？她表示根本不可能！她说不纠结拔没拔过了，直接开干！

于是同一个位置又给我打了两针麻药，开始拔牙！

原本以为有“残留”应该比之前拔牙要容易得多得多，结果医生折腾了半天还没拔出来所谓的“残留”。

然后医生又喊小护士，换一个更趁手的工具，又折腾半天还是无果。然后又喊小护士用锤子🔨锤她拿着的那个怼着我牙齿的工具。

人为刀俎我为鱼肉已经不足以形容现场的惨烈劲了，我就感觉自己就是打铁砧板上的一块被烧得通红的铁块，然后师傅撸着袖子抡起大锤锤我。

她们左一遍右一遍，感觉足足锤了二三十次，总算成功了，呜呜呜，我也可以从受刑台上下来了。

我查看了一下这次拔掉的牙，竟然能有1厘米多长且很壮实很良好，(((φ(◎ロ◎;)φ)))，那之前她拔了个寂寞吗？

还有就是这牙根看起来这么壮实，足足锤了二三十锤子才锤下来，那原本是不是有机会在这个牙根上进行修复呀？

不过现在说什么都晚了，不但遭受了两遍罪，还把可能可以修复的牙根彻底拔了出来！呜呜呜，心疼我自己，心疼我的牙牙。

A week to hunker down. Was kind of hoping that gold and silver would ride the storm better on the war news. At least the loading up on oil worked ![Mar6Trades.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23ydJyyTc27V94azMmXaNhie8CUYUnqPmQ7ZmGfupxq5dWpRNwMTbgG73j6CUnTi1R5B3.png)

Portfolio News

In a week where S&P 500 dropped 1.98% and Europe dropped 6.57%, my pension portfolio dropped 2.08% somewhat in line with the US markets. Good time to be under-invested in Europe. Of the 3 large portfolios, this one was hit the least. Biggest hits in value terms from Northern Star Resources (NST.AX) down 10.9%, Deep Yellow (DYL.AX) down 17.5%, BHP Group (BHP.AX) down 9.6%, Uranium Royalty Corp (UROY) down 17%, enCore Energy Corp (EU) down 28.9%, Amplify Junior Silver Miners ETF (SILJ) down 15.6%. Feels like a lot of panic selling - the reality is the world still wants the gold, silver and uranium. Big movers of the week were Terra Critical Minerals (T92.AX) (62.3%), Venture Global (VG) (28.8%), ADX Energy (ADX.AX) (22.6%), Blue Star Helium (BNL.AX) (20%), TechGen Metals (TG1.AX) (19.2%), Viva Energy Group (VEA.AX)(18.6%), Strike Energy (STX.AX) (18.6%), Gevo Inc (GEVO) (17.6%), Karoon Energy Ltd (KAR.AX) (17.5%), Viking Mines (VKA.AX) (15.8%), Carnarvon Energy (CVN.AX) (13.6%), OD6 Metals (OD6.AX) (12.9%), Coronado Global Resources (CRN.AX) (12.7%), Power Minerals (PNN.AX) (12.5%), AdAlta (1AD.AX) (12.5%), Locksley Resources (LKY.AX) (12.1%), Starr Peak Mining (STE.V) (12%), United States Natural Gas Fund (UNG) (10.7%), Santos (STO.AX) (10.4%), 88 Energy (88E.AX) (10%) 20 stocks in the big movers is a bit of a surprise - more than expected in a war week. Not a surprise is the mix but from the top - uranium (1 stock), oil and gas (9 stocks), gold/silver mining (2 stocks), alternate energy (2 stocks), rare earths (3 stocks) ![Mar6News.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23wXNPKeZB534aBDkwdDdnk3xHBHNnMBDqPyq37E3Y8rJHGhrBQ34GtP92Aj3cAWMMukL.jpg) Markets were rocked by surging oil price and US market did not like the Friday jobs report - inflation will be building if the oil bust stays this way. **Crypto Surprises** It is almost like the war did not begin. Bitcoin price pushed higher finishing the week 2.1% higher than the open with a trough to peak range of 13.3%. Price moved up just as the war started. ![Mar8BTC.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23w3CwVKmQaPvRdTWJLW9cujUVejKa5H75L48BqmffJm5gnb3u1J9jowkTUm5gRnVb6Hm.jpg) Ethereum price pushed higher too finishing the week 2.3% higher than the open with a trough to peak range of 14.8% - bot chart pushing trough long held levels. ![Mar8ETH.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23w3EVhq2oG2y444sRqdMc7yCit9knZ3HGix1rPmM1JL2UK5sS2yEqFPz9k4s8MMBLBe1.jpg) Going to be taking a few weeks off markets - will not check any other prices this week. **Nuclear Energy Holdings** One addition in Canada and auto-invest in two places on ASX and a staggering 10.3% drop in valuations. ![Mar6NuclearChange.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23uRL1ejcjQQv9Sx33DJ1b4vdN1grrQqh1sPkdmQkGAVhuhEMFfuRXusbxvctyExDjshq.jpg) A few changes in the mix of holdings with Yellow Cake plc (YCA.L) moving into slot 1 displacing Uranium Royalty Corp. (UROY). Paladin Energy Ltd (PDN.AX) and Sprott Junior Uranium Miners ETF (URNJ) swap places in slots 5 and 6. Coming into the Top 10 in slot 9 is Atomic Eagle (AEU.AX) displacing enCore Energy (EU). Other 52 creeps over the 50% mark. Share of portfolios drops nearly 2 whole points. ![Mar6Nuclear.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/245wciaV6qcbjRCcxPSNYdRzU456gxYDgQzCgaCLRQdxdEFfRDW6DoMNqM3GsuGgNSY7Z.jpg) In the grand scheme the changes in holding by stage are not key but Producers did drop one whole point with the uptick in Explorers - going to guess the one stock in the big movers did that. ![Mar6NuclearbyStage.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23vspH85NniBaB9JkoC5C1Mea14wSAdhAH6tZuSfDApkVqEG8pFfpgjvB4XttfnTViJYX.jpg) **Alternate Energy Holdings** One addition in lithium and a bothersome 7.2% drop in valuations. ![Mar6LithiumChange.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23vsqqLFRBveRwiazgxsKbpo8aAdA5Sj3n18gXsoDcyACzJMW45Ac1bKacb4NgNdh9LM4.jpg) No changes in the ranking with Sigma Lithium Corporation (SGML) the biggest faller in share down 0.9 points. 0.2 point drop in share of portfolios. ![Mar6Lithium.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/245J2Jp8UVwcPG1RHP8qHkfScHWuccjQA1iNNNAHzRrbR7joQoWNwcEht9p5h4DkSeg1n.jpg) **Precious Metals Holdings** A few sales and additions in both gold and silver - hard part of the story is 8.6% drop in valuations thanks to the war start. ![Mar6PreciousChange.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23uRHnVoBdTdYyWAUxB78XDU2Hb4CyXvLddbH9oF1g6uZv6mRCuGFBe1DWGqhmY7rzk4r.jpg) No change in the rankings of the Top 10 but UBS ETRACS Silver Shares Covered Call ETN (SLVO) in slot 1 does move up 1.3 points. ![Mar6Precious.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/244eVCxDF53nGhgwJQd2yEp6MTaRo9L2Q66ueZzVhkzd73r6ywzcHXJd6R4N5cVehjDJg.jpg)

Bought

**Lightning Minerals** (L1M.AX): Gold Mining/Lithium. Reporting SPP addition in personal portfolio from February. **Tasmea** (TEA.AX): Engineering Services. Dividend yield 3.01%. Added a parcel in personal portfolio. Swiss Transparent Portfolio idea - they liked this dynamic >In an Australian market facing a shortage of 90,000 skilled workers through 2028, the ability to source and mobilize labor at scale is a profound competitive advantage. Tasmea currently spends A$13 million annually on third-party labor hire at an 18% margin. By redirecting this spend to WorkPac (which they acquired in December 2025), the group captures those margins internally while utilizing WorkPac’s 1.5 million candidate database to onboard employees faster. ![Mar2TEA.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tmmNAyTbb6FT5YYCKvMVAuKf2xjf48rjGZLLzTBj2ZMf4ovy93VVgih2QavWWRjyw8Q.jpg) Did the comparison with some of the other engineering and mining services stocks. Sure hope the idea has legs as the stock has already done the work. Liking the look of the laggard Lycopodium Limited (LYL.AX) - sold pout of it a little while back - time to add back. **Mastercard Incorporated** (MA): Payment Services. Added a small parcel and April expiry credit spread in pension portfolio with ROI of 25.9% and 1.9% price coverage. Swiss Transparent Portfolio idea. They liked this dynamic >Mastercard’s fiscal year 2025 results highlight the sheer power of the electronic payments duopoly. Revenue for the year improved by 16% to $32.8 billion, driven by a 14% increase in high-margin cross-border volumes and a 10% increase in switched transactions, which reached 46.5 billion. The company’s ability to scale without a linear increase in costs is evident in its adjusted operating margin, which expanded by 140 basis points to 57.7%. ![Mar2MA.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23u6YmoQWsQ5iSrKiGQ5vNPUdWXkCvagG2Ep4rf2aXbu54xXqJ27hfn5XFbpsnbkherFn.jpg) Chart tells it own story - support below the bought put level (480) but some resistance up above - that is fine as long as price stays above $500. **Investigator Silver** (IVR.AX): Silver Mining. Company completed PFS and placement for development of silver mine north of Kimba, South Australia. With AISC of $26 and 11 year life of mine looks a great idea with silver in a range between $70 and $90. Next Investors idea. Did also put in a low ball pending offer at the placement price. **OD6 Metals** (OD6.AX): Rare Earths. Next Investors idea based on acquisition of options to acquire fluorspar mining properties in US. ![Mar4OD6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23uRDMaigFWLKPvXrDL1NoigBGC89KYmrTL9vJ5smryeCu8By4USZf5PuZL5RqyFFcNds.jpg) Added a small parcel in personal portfolio and did put in a pending order below the price achieved to cover the front running story. Did some digging into the website - not clear how much the team knows about fluorspar as their other projects are in copper and rare earths **Scorpio Tankers** (STNG): Oil Shipping. With dividend ex date coming up exercised in-the-money call option in pension portfolio to grab the dividend. The bought call (60) was part of a 60/67.5 call spread left over from a call spread risk reversal set up when Maduro was captured in Venezuela. Leaves over a covered call which is also in the money. Now have to hope price stays above the sold call level (67.5). **iShares South Korea Index** (EWY): South Korea Index. Korean market was smacked when it opened after a holiday Monday after the war start - at one stage down 12%. Yes, they are reliant about 30% on oil and gas deliveries through the Straits of Hormuz. No other markets were hit that hard - not even Japan. Added a small parcel of stock thinking this was an over-reaction. Also put in place an April expiry 130/140/120 call spread risk reversal. With net premium of $5.50, this offers 82% maximum profit potential for a 8.3% price move. The call spread is fully funded by the sold put with 7.2% price coverage. Not bad return for 6 weeks exposure. ![Mar4EWY.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tSzR6hh7EvDi5hSHzcn6cJNtRqgLN5gcajunzivKmVLM3QK5qnpMAaspQb1dSQqu3UD.jpg) Let's look at the chart which shows the bought call (130) as a blue ray and the sold call (140) as a red ray and the sold put (120) as a dotted red ray with the expiry date the dotted green line on the right margin. The bought call (130) is just above the stock purchase price which was not far off the low of the 18% price fall. The sold call (140) is halfway back up to the highs. The sold put (120) is around the levels of the previous higher lows. **SK hynix** (HY9H.F): Semiconductors. The big challenge of the Korean stock markets is the index is dominated by 2 stocks - Samsung Electronics Co (005930.KS) and SK hynix Inc (000660.KS). Swiss Transparent Portfolio have added the latter to their portfolio. They figured a 10% drop in prices is a good discount for a stock that is at a 50% discount to its industry peers. Found the Frankfurt listing as my broker does not provide access to Korean listings. Added small parcels in pension portfolio on successive days as prices keeps drifting lower. Dividend yield 0.27%. **NOV Inc** (NOV): Oil Services. With price opening at $18.90 (Mar 6) was hit on a pending order in personal portfolio for January 2027/May 2026 20/30/18 diagonal call spread risk reversal. This offers maximum profit potential of 475% for 58% price move. The ratio sold put (18) fully funds the call spread premium with 4.8% price coverage at trade time. Was higher when the pending order was placed. ![Mar6NOV.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tcNzkBEkqd2kGPwW5Tkbm4T8FCyG5ER438yQp6ejxgr6DNWUoitTfn3tkbTp3Nxc4SU.jpg) Let's look at the chart which shows the bought call (20) as a blue ray and the sold call (30) as a red ray and the sold put (18) as a dotted red ray with the expiry dates the dotted green lines on the right margin. At the time the pending order was placed (before the war began) price was on a good trajectory heading into the blue sky zone. Was going to need two blue arrow moves to get to the maximum. The start of the war set that trajectory back and what is more likely to play out is the light blue arrow price scenario, which will end short of the maximum. The sold put level (18) is now at risk. Why this trade - oil services was beginning to grow well and the company also has capabilities that will be used in nuclear reactor builds. **Geiger Energy was Baselode Energy** (BEEP.V): Uranium. Watched interview with CEO Rebecca Hunter on Triangle Investor talking about the drilling program in the Thelon Basin. The view was the discoveries could be as important as the Athabasca Basin with similar geology and geochemistry. As the business is also exploring Athabasca this makes a good double opportunity. Doubled the small holding in pension portfolio to scale in >The Thelon Basin is regarded as one of the most prospective areas globally for discovering high-grade, unconformity-style uranium deposits outside of Saskatchewan’s Athabasca Basin. https://geigerenergy.com/ **Builders FirstSource** (BLDR): Building Products. Assigned early on sold put. Breakeven $104.45 vs $93.12 close (Mar 6) - a bit of history to recover. Rising rates will not help. TSP idea from way back. Writing covered calls at the assigned strike.

Sold

**Star Minerals** (SMS.AX): Gold Mining. Took out capital deployed in personal portfolio for 50.7% blended profit since September/November 2024. Original investment was predicated on uranium tenements in Namibia - company since redirect to gold in NSW **AuKing Mining** (AKN.AX): Gold Mining. Took out capital deployed in personal portfolio for 87% blended profit since February/March 2025. Next Investors idea - they remain invested.

ASX Portfolio

The segment reports trading in ASX fractional share portfolio. Trade entries are made based on stock screens looking for undervalued stocks (price to book, price earnings, price to sales) that are showing technical signs of breaking a downtrend. Exits are made at 35% profit or 25% if 52 week high is lower than 35% advance. New buys are in $500 lots. Scale ins and top ups in $250 lots **Auto-Invest** Two sets of auto-invests added this week - that was the week activity $600 spread across 4 uranium stocks, one gold ETF and two index ETFs - in personal portfolio. Yield 3.0% - Vanguard MSCI Index International Shares ETF (VGS.AX): International Index. Seems like a tidy discount on a growing free cash flow opportunity. ![Mar6AG.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23u6Z4abWrJw5YWiDmUpEpiaTwfLUpsB8U2e3Dg6ryuYu1NmxmW8iAcHV6gdXrDC8F9nM.jpg)

**Covered Calls** Three covered calls written in two portfolios - all US **Naked Puts** Sold puts happy to own at lower prices - Scorpio Tankers Inc. (STNG): Oil Shipping. Return 2.5% Coverage 4.9% - Casino, Guichard-Perrachon S.A. (CO.PA): French Supermarket. Return 20% Coverage 6.6% - return drops to 14.5% after Paris trading costs. title.title: Pump And Dump Continues in the Crypto
title.body:
If you look at today's crypto market, you will understand how much manipulation has happened. Sometimes it has pumped big, sometimes it has dumped big. At such times, the market behaves as a threat to those who trade futures. Because, at this time, there is a possibility of high profits and high losses...



So, it is safe to stay away from the market as much as possible during this time. Today started with a market pump. The pump of the previous day continued, the market continued to move upwards. But, suddenly, the market started dumping after noon.


![C3TZR1g81UNaPs7vzNXHueW5ZM76DSHWEY7onmfLxcK2iQCjdkrEhXPoT4YrTAkv7HcdfnXbKnuHW3ExK6dJKuHegpxv2X6HgZkqkqeCUYEk3hR137mDwkr.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ginsta/23w2oKi9T5SgLiRdDyCkpA2ca1m4eJVyn7EDdM3Z1To7aBvdmgZXiH6DDe8F7mZ7GZp54.png)



In particular, the way Bitcoin dumped has made the altcoins vulnerable. Bitcoin crossed 124,000 on the day, but could not hold this zone. As a result, the Big Dump came down. As a result, Bitcoin dropped from 124,000 to 117,000. And it is currently trading in the 118,000 range.

However, it will take a long time for altcoins to recover the losses caused by this Bitcoin dump. However, coins with strong fundamentals and viable use cases will quickly recover these losses and remain viable in the market.

title.body: > Hola queridas amigas de @Womentribe, saludos y bendiciones, paso en esta oportunidad para participar en el [Post]( https://peakd.com/hive-139925/@eldiariodelys/conectate-contigo-y-descubre-tu-algo-en-el-amor-oror-connect-with-yourself-and-discover-your-something-in-love) de @eldiariodelys. --- ![REVIEW (7).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23uR5APGYSAQ5s5mp5Cbnj2pTarrB2UGPUgLGzatihvmGCPTyB2vdQduCpwpzZ4xjH1JY.jpg) **Diseño en CANVA** ---

>Bueno leyendo el post, me pareció interesante ya que a veces no nos tomamos el tiempo para reconocer porque a veces unas relaciones o no se dan o simplemente no duran, y el reconocer que hay ese “algo” que ocasiona que ello pase no siempre es fácil de reconocer, pero cuando lo logras las cosas comienzan a fluir de forma diferente porque empiezas a comprenderte mejor y de la misma manera a prepararte para una relación futura, en la cual los mismos errores no sean cometidos, no dejando que ese “algo” impida entender más del amor. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

>En mi caso llamaría a ese “algo” Inseguridad, ya que aunque en mi vida no he sido una persona segura siempre de las cosas que hace, recuerdo que en los estudios wow cuando nerviosa me ponía, o aunque hacia un examen y había estudiado fuertemente, la inseguridad en saber si todo había salido bien, si no me había equivocado era mucha, hasta que no me entregaban los resultados no podía calmarme, era algo difícil para mí, y en una relación el tener Inseguridad no ayuda mucho, porque sientes que por más que intentes hacer las cosas bien no son suficientes, y en cualquier cosa que hagas o digas se siente como si nada fuera suficiente. --- ![zuzi_klimecka-sunset-7931854_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/244ohKFWAJBZ4YeBqFaGLrZxye5qzneKctoMXbfi1vM5EBJq4zW7girwXXncuWum71s5P.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/images/download/x-7931854_1920.jpg) ---

>Eso a la final crea incomodidad en toda relación, porque se vuelve inestable las cosas que haces, dices y como llevas todo, aunque hoy en día no tengo una relación como tal bueno por otras cosas que me tiene súper ocupada jeje o como dicen no ha llegado la persona para mi jeje, aprendiendo de las pasadas, ps resulta ello lo que ese “algo” a afectado en la misma, aunque uno al principio suele engañarse como que no era para mí, él se lo perdió, o quizás no era el momento, cosas así para no darse cuenta de la realidad, o como se siente en el instante, a medida que pasa el tiempo es que uno aprende y entiende que fue lo que paso. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

>Aunque también pueden ser otras cosas porque de igual manera el carácter de uno juega un papel importante jeje y si uno no sabe controlarlo o no consigues a alguien quien te entienda ps tampoco ayuda mucho, pero es bueno tomarse estos instantes y entender las cosas como son para no dejar que ello siga ocurriendo, ese “algo” sea que lo tengamos definido o no, hay que comprenderlo y analizarlo, para evitar que siga interrumpiendo en lo que queremos tener, en lo que deseamos, nadie es perfecto pero hay detalles que debemos saber manejar y no tenerlo como excusa para seguir con lo que soñamos en el amor. --- ![takmeomeo-valentines-day-background-437968_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23wCLU68Y4NHjqNVWhJawJvCw5aT5MNDi5vSEd6Da5tCokhafhASb3jt4ppfGyZEJKzZa.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/images/download/x-437968_1920.jpg) ---

title.title: Nosferatu (2024) || Movie Review.
title.body: ~Count Orlock** Watching a movie is not just all about the storyline, actors, setting or the choreography, it is also about the performance of each other actor as they play their roles. I guess that why theater plays are still in demand up till date. I love movies that portray pure performance; I mean performance that comes from the gut. That is the beauty of art itself. *Nosferatu (2024)* is gothic horror film that was written and directed by Robert Eggers. It is based on and a remake of **Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror by Henrik Galeen** which was inspired by the classic Bram Stoker's novel Dracula. This movie’s budget was around $50 million and the money made from the box office was around $181.3 million. I think this an success if you ask me. *Nosferatu* starred quite a handful of amazing actors and actresses suchk as Lily-Rose Depp, Bill Skarsgård, Nicholas Hoult, Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Emma Corrin and Willem Dafoe. It was distributed by Universal Pictures and Focus Features. ![1000098177.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/48Gg8MARt7Grk8FLTVW1tc5AZByLBu7PNDep9FakjZL2Lb1WVyKbtXpWAJbuze3anc.jpg) ![1000098180.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23tRmYwQq9N1fELf4uBwsLqCZULnzM2pbLcN9QRAWzCMZnFpHRoJm4zHxdEy6gFBjtcor.jpg) The storyline of this movie is about a young girl, Ellen who prays out into the universe for a companion to ease her loneliness. However, unknown to her, she unconsciously contacts a powerful being of darkness, a vampire known as Nosferatu. This prayer of hers woke Nosferatu from a long time slumber and a psychic link was forged between both of them. ![1000098191.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23tGa3vWGSGrMeV8koojGzZJ5LaiB89AWiYB27ucG8z96aXzpsj1chaFmhf3xGwYwiQNJ.jpg) ![1000098190.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EoAYLU9podYyTCUpA24oFZgPdxHkhKjsBMpiF5iWuGAsmSurJSypyAGep4hKpRBnJVD.jpg) ![1000098193.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23tv44Tn34uVpNmNyKD5iF8vviaJoFGemgw5qHbKBhmRExhwWQd4kkv5pB1EGz2Eo5Pbz.jpg) Some years passed and In 1838, Ellen had newly gotten married to Thomas Hutter and they both settled down in Wisburg, Germany. As a newly wed couple, they were supposed to honeymoon phase, but then a job offer from Hutter’s employer came in. His employer sent him to Transylvania to the Grünewald Manor to the Count Orlok. ![1000098188.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EpT4C9KKMnjJKnJm2oF151pe5rSFyBz6aQCQ4s6iEzrX3W6LEUn2S5uPqbYHrrMfzAS.jpg) ![1000098189.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EqUfmj7LqeQX6CkNYNgDz3ir6d2kc3nfDrzvwpBuDTjqpBnmLCV7KXhLDzxiYBhH7cZ.jpg) So Hutter had no option than to leave his Ellen with a friend, Friedrich Harding, his pregnant wife Anna and their two daughters. However, Hutter is unaware that he is about to encounter an evil being that wants his wife for himself. Will Hutternsurvive the journey? Did his employer set up? #### My Review And Rating. *Nosferatu* is a movie that is filled with performance from the soul and it makes you wonder what passion and zeal the actors all have to put out such a performance. This movie is a masterpiece for me and Egger once again did not disappoint with his directorial style of this movie. What made this movie stand out for me was the meticulous arrangements of the setting, CGI, camera work/angles, directorial style, the cast performance, the outlook and the costumes. What Egger did here is something most directors in Hollywood lack when doing their work. Egger didn't restrict himself in a box, he didn't manage funds, rather he explored out of the box and he used the large budget for this movie judiciously. I love the lavish, gothic set design. It gave off the vibe of eerie and dreamlike nature with a cold and muted color palette. This mood wraps one up and pulls you into the world building without stress. Some of the viewers that had issues with the dark and moody settings are people who are not conversant or appreciate the work put into gothic settings. The cinematography was satisfying and fantastic! I enjoyed it and so much work was put into achieving the mood of the movie. The sweeping camera shots that made it look as if the audience were Nosferatu. Giving us the feel of omnipresent from thebworld building, its characters and the town itself. The closeups are amazing too. Lily-Rose Depp’s performance was theatrical and amazing. I guess it runs in the family. I especially love how she was able to portray when the psychic link between her and Nosferatu got stronger. It was convincing and very believable. I think she poured her soul into it. Although I wish there was more to her story. I wanted to know why she was lonely at first. I wanted to know what made her special to be able to form a psychic link with a being of darkness just from mere words/wishes. Bill Skarsgard was honestly not recognizable in this movie. At first I thought I'd been deceived because I didn't notice him throughout the movie. It was after I'd finished watching the movie that I discovered that Skarsgård was the Count Orlock. Under those costumes I didn't know it was him. The accent also did it for me. His performance was amazing and Nicholas Hoult didn't disappoint me either. Rating this movie, I will give it 8.5 out of 10 stars. It's not a movie I will forget soon. I love it and I enjoyed it. I would recommend this movie to gothic lovers and horror lovers. Have you seen this movie? How was it for you? https://youtu.be/nulvWqYUM8k?si=ILOOwJEbiuE3FYQb ![3yZiouw5jgtrj8RZntzpYvPkttnUNCNB3bKsugcDmKrZysEhsVCu7HmxWG7sYd9c3PJiWe24wRnpAB7HXq2WMvHX9AyxjgRuTY38KWSsv8...GFDdhx4UzPxqzjjpVMXNYgRDyspwo7pFw2RpyHZvde1tK7QLmYqnXBk9hDVg1dAooe2nLquVnXKjzS2uR5yQNqx1V5qutNgmqpFfKYLpS93ajRQosgFNPk3e1s.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23t7BFjADUCGjsLPt1YzFafTb9BeZ3Err5bNPwTi6RYNWED9TfZAhqAcZ8JCb2rGLLeT6.gif) *All images above are from the movie screenshots* *[Poster image source](https://pics.filmaffinity.com/Nosferatu-964410519-large.jpg)* *Thank you for visiting and supporting my blog* 🤗

body.title: Pojedynek AI / AI battle 🔥 : March 9 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d4560db7-3193-4f48-a469-ed23a566769c.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3b4462f4-c729-459d-9a39-807dc9f2685e.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6673d32e-b5b6-459f-bbfa-9974bf37d0ae.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5547a796-c8b4-4f69-bfc7-75b6dd64d135.jpg)
🇵🇱 Pojedynek AI: Garmin vs ChatGPT Po biegu w Poznaniu można zrobić małe podsumowanie technologiczne. Pojedynek AI Garmin vs ChatGPT… i tym razem wygrywa Garmin. Garminowska inteligencja dość trafnie przewidziała mój możliwy wynik na mecie – okolice 48 minut. I faktycznie właśnie w tych rejonach skończył się ten bieg. ChatGPT w tym temacie niestety trochę zawiódł. Na podstawie ostatniego treningu testowego 3×2 km i analizy wykresu tempo / tętno wyliczył, że na starcie mogę spróbować pobiec w tempie około 4:30–4:35/km. No to pobiegłem… 🤣 Problem w tym, że według założeń tętno miało utrzymać się w pobliżu progu mleczanowego, a ono zupełnie nie chciało współpracować i bardzo szybko wystrzeliło w górę. Dalsza część scenariusza była już dość klasyczna. W okolicach 5 kilometra pojawił się ciężki, rwany oddech, pierwsze oznaki narastającego zakwaszenia i… włączył się tryb oszczędnościowy. Tempo około 5:00/km i spokojny bieg do mety. Mimo wszystko to było bardzo dobre przetarcie na początek sezonu startowego. Teraz pozostaje robić swoje – trenować, podnosić próg mleczanowy i zobaczymy, co przyniesie kolejne starty. Sezon dopiero się zaczyna 😎 ---- 🇬🇧 AI battle: Garmin vs ChatGPT After the race in Poznań it’s time for a small tech summary. The battle of AI Garmin vs ChatGPT… and this time Garmin wins. Garmin’s prediction estimated my possible finishing time at around 48 minutes, which turned out to be very close to reality. ChatGPT, on the other hand, based on my last test workout 3×2 km and the pace/heart-rate analysis, suggested that I could try starting the race at around 4:30–4:35/km. So… I did 🤣 The problem was that the plan assumed my heart rate would stay around lactate threshold, but it had other ideas and shot up very quickly. The rest of the race followed a familiar pattern. Around kilometer five breathing became heavy and irregular, lactate started to build up and the body switched into energy-saving mode. Pace dropped to around 5:00/km and I cruised to the finish. Still, it was a very good rust-buster for the beginning of the racing season. Now it’s time to keep doing the work, raise the lactate threshold, and see what the next races will bring. The season has just begun 😎

body.title: What is the proper way to pray// the old path
body.body:
Prayer that pleases God should come from a sincere and humble heart. The Bible teaches that prayer is not about using many words or trying to impress others, but about honestly communicating with God. When we pray, we should approach Him with faith, humility, and a genuine desire to seek His will. God values prayers that are truthful and heartfelt, where a person acknowledges their dependence on Him and trusts in His guidance.

The Bible also encourages believers to pray with sincerity rather than for public attention. Jesus taught that prayer should be personal and focused on our relationship with God rather than on human approval. A prayer that pleases God is one that is offered with faith, gratitude, and a desire to follow His will. 

**Matthew 6:6 “But when you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father, who is unseen. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.”**

body.title: Day 13.  Solar Electric System. How basic can it get?
body.body:
|Earnings YTD|HP|HELIOS|GLD Owed|GLD Held|Off Chain| |---|---|---|---|---|---| |Day 14|20.761|0.07|323.3945|155.6345|0| |(Day 13)|12.523|0.043|-178.88|0| @hiveabbyftp HELIOS price: 1.172 GLD/HELIOS (note to self)

#
Getting a solar electric system running again

When I left my home in the Philippines last year I left a solar system all ready to go. I got a message not that long after that \

but when I'm halfway across the world away it makes it impossible to troubleshoot.

Even worse I knew it was not a major issue and it would take only a short time to fix.  However, explaining what needed to be done when I was in Canada and the people on the ground didn't know about solar systems?  That meant that nothing was going to happen until I was here.

Now that I'm here?

First Day: I looked at the system and wondered what on earth they did?

Second Day: I checked the pieces to see what parts might not be operational

Third Day: (Today)

I connected the wires and checked the voltages followed by hooking everything up.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23x1FTvkZEmRELbjWanoiDSkx5zpyWzSTTF5HWx4FGkrG9o1Nk7HevqZQLmcnbPNCDDBJ.png)


My brother in law washed off the panels themselves, and he arranged them neatly and made a light backing for them so they don't fly away in typhoon season.


As expected, everything was back to operational fairly quickly.  It probably took less than 2 hours to get it all figured out and working.  Also it took no special tools (two screwdrivers and a rock) although the multi-tester was very useful in finding the offending solar panel

Why didn't I try to work with the people who were here earlier so we could get electricity faster?  Mostly because I didn't trust them.  I mean how far do you trust people who turn USB-c cables and make them look like this :)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23xVRfDYZ6X8PLrTKEjSwvFAH4kRg5ZX4T88Axrzs88K1ik9o9qVTbwQTXPP21mS1HTLZ.png)


When it was done I got a message from someone interested in solar and they asked \

. That made wonder because a super basic system like mine is fairly cheap but if you want to go more basic still it can be even cheaper.

#
A basic solar system

Really my system has four pieces working together. ### First : Solar panels Solar panels give electricity into the system. Without them there literally is no power. ### Second : Batteries Solar panels in sun create power but without batteries to store it.. Kind of useless. Just think of a solar powered flashlight. It wouldnt be useful in the sun by but the battery pack makes all the differenece. ### Third : A hybrid inverter. This is the brains of the system and converts solar power to the batteries. It converts battery power to 220V so its useful. It also allows you to connect power from the electric company and use it if necessary. ## Fourth : A breaker panel. This is just a panel which allows someone to connect multiple rooms and outlets together. I think this isn't actually necessary as theoretically one could just hook the AC output to an electrical plus but for safety? Best to have a breaker box.

#
How expensive would it be?
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23tSzCautyMWXBVn7Ubbpd4Na1tA9Hor2xaUSPAu6nDeoGRZwwK7aFaWx8wwPrFq1ZRcM.png) On Lazada in the Philippines? **P16,853* or about **$285 HBD** ... and yes you would need wire to hook it up and some sort of electrical outlet to connect to the breaker box so there would be some additional costs. Yes it is incredibly limited as the battery would only hold 1200Wh of power, it would only get a few hundred watts of power daily from that lonely single panel and that tiny hybrid inverter can only put out limited power. No microwaves, kettles or high output appliances. But its not useless and it is an excellent learning tool. If you can hook up this system you can hook up a more powerful one. With only 12V battery and 18V solar panels it is relatively safe, just be very careful with the 220V AC output. **For learning it is excellent** but in addition to that it could actually be useful in a very limited way. If it was all I had? I have a small rice cooker which it would happily power. It could power a fan, my laptop, a light, and my cellphone. In a power outage situation or even in a small one room home. Let me ask: What difference would your cellphone, a phone, a laptop, a light, and an easy way to cook a meal make? I think that would be quite a step up if the other option is having your phone be dead, no light at night, no laptop for Hive, and eating food cold from a tin.

# Just my thought. I'm very happy that I was able to get the solar system working. My system is somewhat more robust than the total budget one that I wrote above but not much. In addition to the list I wrote there for the basic one I also get a fridge working 24hrs a day. If I can keep my food cold, cook my food, and have entertainment with my phone and laptop, and a fan to keep me warm in the tropical heat? It turns my shelter into something far more homey. I'm very glad I have even a basic system and I'm glad I was able to get it working quickly along with my brother in law.

body.title: Golden Circles of Joy: The Heartwarming Presence of the Marigold Flower
body.body:
There’s a reason marigolds feel like tiny suns blooming right at our feet. Their warm golden petals, tightly layered like soft flames, have a way of lighting up even the quietest corners of a garden. Each time I see a marigold, whether it’s swaying by a roadside or glowing proudly in a pot, I’m reminded of how much warmth a small bloom can carry.

What I love most about marigolds is their friendliness. Some flowers feel distant or delicate, but the marigold feels approachable—almost cheerful. Its round, fluffy shape seems to smile back at you, inviting you to come a little closer. And when sunlight touches those orange and yellow petals, the entire flower seems to sparkle with simple joy. It’s no wonder so many cultures use marigolds in celebrations—these blooms naturally lift spirits.

Marigolds are also known for their hardworking nature. They grow easily, bloom generously, and stand strong through heat and rain. Their fragrance—earthy, bold, a little spicy—feels like a reminder of the soil they come from. Gardeners often say marigolds keep pests away, but I like to think they also chase away gloom with their brightness. There’s something beautifully grounding about touching their velvety petals or brushing past their greenery on a warm afternoon.

body.title: Spring is the time to dress up!
body.body:
![IMG_3387.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQFaDJogbBY7VwoaBwAdFMHxXuE1qtxYbsYvwR7exAb7V/IMG_3387.jpeg)

Spring is really the time for bright outfits. This is especially true for birds, where the male does not take care of the chicks 😉 Of course, you noticed that in the bird kingdom some pairs are very similar to each other - the male and the female are almost the same. But in others you can immediately see who is who. And there is nothing surprising or illogical here.

Where both parents take the same part in caring for the chicks, there is no need for beautiful plumage. The male wins the female's attention not by appearance, but by care, attention and help. They are crows, pigeons, storks.

But in couples where the male is not too inclined to take part in \

, he needs other arguments. And then bright plumage comes to the rescue. In such pairs, the female is usually gray and not bright. She doesn't need to prove anything to anyone, her role in the procreation of the family is huge. But the male must make a lot of effort to attract the female's attention.

Of course, it's not too fair that one of the parents doesn't take enough care of the chicks. But on the other hand, if it weren't for such a division of labor, we could never see such an amazingly bright plumage!

body.title: Thinking About Empires
body.body: > Exploring the ruins of ancient cities in Lycia, you inevitably find yourself thinking about empires.

>
But these ruins are just traces of humanity's attempt to cheat time. Rulers carved tombs into cliffs and chiseled names into stone, as if signing eternity.

>Face reliefs, stone figures, inscriptions in dozens of languages — all meant to echo through centuries as a loud declaration of greatness.

\n\n

>The irony is that today these stones just lie among grass, columns, and semi-destroyed arches.
\n\n

>
No one remembers the names, but everyone takes selfies against them.

>
It's amazing how strongly such places attract people. We come not for answers, but to briefly touch the same questions rulers once asked themselves. Yet standing among the ruins, you realize the obvious: greatness is temporary, empires vanish, stones remain.

>
And leaving, you run your hand over the grass — you know you'll soon be home. And you'll remember empires not among the ruins, but through the photos you keep.

>

body.title: ꜰʀᴏᴍ ᴄʜɪʟᴅʜᴏᴏᴅ ᴛᴏ ᴀᴅᴜʟᴛʜᴏᴏᴅ || ʟᴏᴏᴋɪɴɢ ʙᴀᴄᴋ ᴀᴛ ᴏʟᴅ ᴘʜᴏᴛᴏꜱ || ᴛɪᴍᴇ ꜰʟɪᴇꜱ
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWmuErzCwYik6MX6uGqsTKNNPMfSfctZ91Luyz2ttm2jb/Black%20and%20White%20Simple%20Photo%20Collage%20Photo%20Collage.png 

Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing great.
In this post I will be sharing some of my childhood photos and do a reflection on how life used to be and how it is now. Hope you guys will like it :)

Recently, I randomly opened my old photo gallery and found an old family album and then I realized that time moves fast because when I looked at my childhood photos I couldn't believe how different everything looked. The places, the clothes, the people, and me.
So I’m 24 now, and whenever I look at those old pictures it just seems like I am looking at someone totally different because back then life felt simple. There were no big responsibilities. No serious worries. Honestly, the biggest problem was finishing homework or waiting for the weekend to come.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWXharQnMSjrgu6gQwVWEz3KCsBXZzMaADjimzrQV7hpB/IMG-20190923-WA0116.jpg 

When I see my childhood pictures I notice how carefree I looked and that kids do not think about the future much. They live in the moment. In those photos I am just smiling. I am playing. I am enjoying life. I do not think about exams. I do not think about careers. I do not think about responsibilities.

Back then everything about felt big and small things felt like adventures. I went to the park. I visited relatives. I played outside with friends until sunset. Those moments felt big at the time. But now when I look back, they were such simple things.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUNGE9LfJ4THLKj4S78MtVFvT1m71gcPUt8vP88nx3kow/IMG_20210324_070357.jpg 

School memories are a part of childhood & when I see my school photos I remember the excitement of the first day of school meeting friends and learning new things. Sure. At that time we complained about homework or exams but those days were easy. They were among the easiest days of life.

Our perspective changes as we grow older and when we were kids we wanted to grow up quickly. We thought adulthood meant freedom. But now as adults, many of us will look back and think childhood will be actually the freest time of our lives.

As the years passed, things started changing and, responsibilities grew. Life will became more serious. Goals gained importance. Education, work, and personal growth began to take more space in life.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVKxE1WQUEh24LeB65UbHUgtfZRi96gdsttTN3Adpn6b3/IMG_20200210_164946.jpg 

Back when I was a teen things really shifted fast like personality stuff starts taking shape, what you like can flip overnight, and you kinda start getting how all things actually works. Some people find their passions during that time. Others are still trying to figure things out.

Looking at my teenage photos i can see the transition happening i am not a small kid in those pictures but i am also not fully an adult yet. It’s like a bridge between two stages of life.

Now at 24 years old life feels changed from those early days, there are goals to achieve, responsibilities to manage, as well as many decisions to make. Those childhood memories remain. They remind me of the start.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQSRu9nh1RHa7nKNGVF2MbhPeDP7Mw5bcKmGRDpcT3mMr/IMG20260129182344.jpg 

So when I compare my childhood photos with my recent ones, the difference is huge not just physically but mentally as well. Experiences shape us. Challenges we face shape us. People we meet shape us. Lessons we learn shape us. All of these slowly build the person we become.

But even after growing up I think it matters not to lose the childlike part of ourselves, that curiosity, that excitement about small things, &, that ability to enjoy simple moments. Those qualities give life more meaning.

So these photos remind me of how important memories are because they capture moments that would otherwise fade away with time. We look at them after years pass. They bring back emotions. They bring back stories. They bring back details.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQxLC9y3ZNcAcfGgKjRoSE9AG4qkABgqvojiT5KQiwyyC/Black%20Brown%20Minimal%20Feminine%20Moodboard%20Photo%20Collage.png 

Seeing that comparison shows how much time has gone by and it can be quite shocking at times. Childhood was not that long ago. When you count the years you realize how much life has happened.

The past 24 years passed quickly, and the next years will go just as fast.

So old photos are a powerful experience because they remind us time moves forward whether we notice or not. The thing we can do is try to appreciate stage of life. We are living it.

# ᴄᴏɴᴄʟᴜꜱɪᴏɴ

Childhood had its beauty and teenage years had their lessons. And, adulthood brings its own challenges and, opportunities.
For me these photos are not just pictures they are windows into moments of life you know. Every time I look at them, I think about one simple truth.

Well, I guess this is it for this post. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

body.title: Children learn more from what parents do not what parents say
body.body:
![](Uploading... 1773141227569.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/christmas-wallpaper-man-child-hands-3120717/)

How many of you have had an experience when you were with your family or your friends and you realized how much of your behaviour was learned from them? And have you noticed how when you start following a particular celebrity, maybe a musician or athlete, you start behaving in some ways similar to them.

I was once a big fan of Micheal Jackson. By that I don't mean I was an adult when he was alive I wasn't but I had more of a Micheal Jackson phase. When we went to parties the only dance I could think of was his and even for a female, I tried to moonwalk. I'm not saying girls shouldn't moonwalk but you barely see them do it.

But I've noticed how our children learn most of what they know and how they behave, not from our words, but from our actions. We can say whatever we want about discipline, respect and not leaving dirty dishes out, but children don't pay any attention to the words we speak, they watch our actions.

I have seen many families with many different types of parenting styles. Some parents are very disciplined and others are not, but they all have one thing in common. When I visit them I see children learning from their parents and when they don't know they are being watched. This compels me to be more accountable for my decisions, I'm not married and don't have kids but I intend to which means in future when God blesses me with kids, the spouse I choose and myself will have the biggest influence on their behavior.


That's why I'm compelled to be accountable, because I know that my children will reflect my behaviour regardless of how much advice I give them.

When I do something that I know is not a good example, I really feel guilty. All my decisions, whether I intended to teach them or not will in the end serve as a lesson to my children. So my behaviour will always be more important to them than anything that I say.

body.title: Lovely whites and reds.
body.body:
And I have a special gift among the reds, but first the whites.
![078.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eoc6bmY1m4zhJVeffVum3XmZKh7tnGbKodH5dD35yaRhoSYRNUbT9jWcfHSyQktqxs4.jpg)

We don't see the white Hibiscus flowers often, and this was a treat to see them.

There are many Hibiscus species across the world, and all that we know about the whites is that they are rare and beautiful. We were at a meeting and on our way out I saw the whites, and of course I just had to take shots of it. It's a habit for me to get unusual stuff to share and let me tell you that these whites are really lovely to see. So, on this day, I also got another hibiscus flower that you will see after the four shots of the white hibiscus flowers. 
Let's see what Wikipedia has to say about the hibiscus flowers.

*Hibiscus is a genus of flowering plants in the mallow family, Malvaceae. The genus is quite large, **comprising several hundred species** that are native toare renowned for their large, showy flowers and those species are commonly known simply as \

, or less widely known as rose mallow. The genus includes both annual and perennial herbaceous plants, as well as woody shrubs and small trees. warm temperate, subtropical and tropical regions throughout the world. Member species* 

[Source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hibiscus)

Look carefully at the stigma and you will see that the seed grains are red. 
![081.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoChCdq3bfMNCjwwcMB1pWZH8Z5LnVsQt1YKRVETrzsLe9A29jxNzUnyjLNe1mDsk3i.JPG)

And this one's grains are starting to turn yellow. 
![086.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23w2ebRXxs7Q9yWi42FoSgU3oCJuEAQBjCEQkfwe1v8t9k98A2GAkXRXsB7VSg5vsV5Cx.JPG)

There is a closer look at the yellow grains, and they are ready to drop their seeds.
![083.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wWpsVUt2xELjRF569LGJvwyAK9gWh54UrGtj2rN9oGy9cvpwP9YLTwykNJvGh388UTy.JPG)

As I said above, now have a look at this beauty below.

This is a red Hibiscus, and its grains on the stigma are red. 
![001.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoK5remok92kpgddvynNXbi1rqaVFjTF42PGbK8BRuiDgKmkjpJd8PTEW1SBnJB67cc.JPG)

Here was the gift, as the wind blew this Broad Scarlet Dragonfly (Crocothemis erythraea) down on our Pelargonium bush. Did you know that the Broad Scarlet is a widespread species as its range extends from the Southern Cape across Africa, Southern Europe, the Middle East, and Western Asia. They are found at rivers, streams, ponds, lakes, and wetlands. 
![109.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqfJrhYB93cu3Lh8P83ZXJ6fyyBehe2pTk87Cd1RacfGRGvw8RDz1hZwSfZw4PtsDvs.JPG)

Just a closer look at the red hibiscus flower. 
![004.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eokf1Fvn8etQxNrSLuei5U5trFNxAJkrDHhozi2i3qiKJQD9HKLnKVu9QDfC9d8E84M.JPG)

And also, another look at the Broad Scarlet dragonfly. 
![111.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/245nBq1v3UifUNpAzaqoh5TmBn6FSZAAtHgyoi1T2wchRE1R1XrrtfMiZxwNrtUCcYSHT.JPG)

Finally, I think that I told you that our Autumn season was knocking on the door and this picture below will show you some autumn colors in our Summer. 
![009.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EpNqjdM123PchG7st9NCXpKJsih3E9ck66D4gx5Mt8c1ExcSsTXT3txttGaVtSptaZw.JPG)

Oh yes, I was happy to get the flowers and the gift of the dragonfly. Don't you think that the dragonfly's red matches the red of the red hibiscus flower? I think so, and just a pity that I have never seen a white dragonfly that I could get on camera to match the white hibiscus flowers. What I mean, is that any color of dragonfly could have landed here, and maybe due to the reds matching it might be a message to me. Something like, nature loves my camera as she knows that I show her charms worldwide in my blog. We live in a beautiful country with abundant wildlife and in nature, and millions of tourists visit the country every year. They say that once South Africa is in your blood, you will never forget it. 
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera. 

Thank you kindly for supporting this post.

In Portugal, this support is provided in the form of social passes. Pensioners over the age of 65 are entitled to free municipal public transport. This was established in a decree-law in 2003. 

This law guarantees that municipal transport services can be used by the elderly without having to pay. Many of the pensions awarded in Portugal are not even enough for pensioners to pay for their medication and cover other unexpected expenses. Of course, there are pensioners who have annual incomes well above mine, for example. 

You raise a very interesting point, because making the measure universal, without the need to provide any proof of income, makes it simpler and more practical, but at a significant cost to the state budget.
