title.title: Exploring a hidden passageway overlooking the lagoon 📷 Malaga – Spain
title.body:
> --- >Natural spaces often contain hidden places within them, places that are not visible at first glance, but by exploring we can find great beauty and incredible views. --- ![20260309_234718.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vi3jgrFSqeSJZUuzpsKuxk56oeNU7cRQx3MR6vk4ax3aJrL3kGJZYdgWqNniWVoYk1t.jpg) --- Almost a year ago, I found a beautiful lagoon on the map, my great friend for searches and explorations. I went there and enjoyed a sunny spring day in its early days and was able to appreciate a marvel in the middle of a neighbourhood full of buildings, also known as the university district, because all the faculties are located there. >But the wonderful thing was the experience I had and brought back here, but on that occasion there was a place I didn't visit. A large staircase descended too far and I didn't know where it ended. I promised myself I would return to explore that place, on a walk that I left unfinished but wanted to experience. So a few days ago, I set out on the journey again, taking a bus to the place on a completely cloudy day and praying that it wouldn't rain. When I arrived, I realised that everything had changed because the landscapes in that place now looked very different in winter. The flowers were beginning to appear, the bushes that were once green were now red, waiting to sprout, and the colours of the entire landscape were very different in the absence of sun. --- ![20260226_182949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23r1gzANtB9EQEfefkEH5yzJD9V14opoLCvR8hU6jQvJeteVSZ1aR42LA7P1v6hhAoNd7.jpg) ![20260226_183001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zRvo1pnQ6VJZvmezpmhmjxEWCjUPrL6r2E1XvRpRCPyAQ9iSvygHY1xdBgk85pV9uKb.jpg) ![20260226_183401.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgFgecsHe3KcvvJDx41FnW9f1TdnkM99bYfc7WeqNdwMzKHx5VvPminoerDLXvGTTsU.jpg) ![20260226_183033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23u6BGncB6LHRusgbdJJxPDWZgTxx87VpdFEmeoymJgciBQpyPhJVpZEdgVjZZoQ33MEY.jpg) ![20260226_183358.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23uFMG1ioLzPcQaKp3rJvR8Zo6QZyXDjuY8KnYyXNCku3DH2hdCCv784SfU2zXR9TvcxS.jpg) ![20260226_183714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/246atEXLQkh4rCmPCRkJSMehqKgGpudyJ1ezZYR19eXGoqiSXXZhpcRJLiB1x7SmsHmWN.jpg) --- I set off towards the northern end of the lagoon, remembering that the staircase was somewhere around there. I passed through areas with lush vegetation that I had never seen before, such as a large number of olive trees laden with fruit, many of which had fallen to the ground. --- ![20260226_183726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245wFDzx5gHazG1a7tYq7szgdrppgkpj6jDmVZPus9cVAEBSyghPnSuimcD7VxDcay38j.jpg) ![20260226_183835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zRrCw1RfmeeSXVTfrBFNkaaxVeBLNXmkGTjEtAoojKrMUt6fLfyc9m8xMxzxnRtoqed.jpg) ![20260226_183822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tveJP9UnaFvfrgaSNGVjiqxe3E9KmjXe6se6ZkTQgQHzB7p7QWcgHJSJ61krzdDMVKF.jpg) ![20260226_183909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMUEmMoFRTdupNj26H3c9S6GKbDoCTG3HNYH28LKDTfiqg45naMi5d7NTvmkMdszSHw.jpg) --- Without the sun, the shades of green had a grey tint, but that didn't stop me from reaching the spot to explore and find out what was in this magnificent place. The views from above were spectacular, and I wanted to know what it was like to be at the water's edge of the lagoon. --- ![20260226_184009.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242DBfpZrGU9TkmANGu6dXwUZpJevFb5T7tZAKvSDp5MN1aBvjUWSxzi7VqnicPEpGnVc.jpg) ![20260226_184043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vi8LAx4BHoBYqNVf39sPXM2NS6KSGf9pAQeLjCAXPDc1dJ98fpxnikYcCw729X4Per8.jpg) ![20260226_184137.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242Ncf4ka16Z7eCeTCiNTJNLEN5KK23QhRhKmYCy6VxLhM2HupFQ8q5D1AabHH5LryGnt.jpg) ![20260226_184054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wC7rREqYLs4gwM2T3uJctRwttBFToCjbdvd3GCwk5QMcsTG7EfYnhWbNKBvvpEX2R7E.jpg) --- In the distance, following the marked path, I spotted what looked like a column or row of pine trees and knew I was close. They are located on both sides of the large stone staircase. From that perspective, I really had no idea what to expect when I got to the bottom. As I looked at the staircase, it became narrower and narrower, and I set off down the path. ---
![20260226_184209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23s9MPQGpiYkwgMMpPGi4KQmJne9swSvsqhs8ymRrAGJv2CHFKq5tNt3XXRbYHaN52UWF.jpg)
![20260226_184217.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244xshWUyGoU5nLBE4UQcgYoxx3ebRiX4Us4PkiM5XGx9vrph9vAbzqwTjMyrb74RDSzA.jpg) ![20260226_184214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241tSXjJp87fh4KKNQsTxhWCtPZXjp86uFBsCswTdGZLRiRHXugcFghA1Zk3TTwZSuUVK.jpg) --- As I descended, I saw other paths leading away from the site and running through green areas to my right and left. I could see pine trees on either side of the staircase, descending further and further. ---
![20260226_184306.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243M31PtybmFwD8KfSW3qVYT86sEMtUkeAxaeCt1gNiJh4zJq7bwvVT5mAoLsRLTmEnhy.jpg)
--- Abundant lavender plants that gave a very special aroma to the environment, along with the scent of pine that I love. From time to time, I looked up at everything I had descended and could no longer see the path I had walked on at the beginning. --- ![20260226_184309.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23rB3VgtyLhYCqUvXRR1bEPTWCxKdAjmaSSacrFDTYNQv1VCPzdb4yzUyicTvnFRim5nt.jpg) ![20260226_184439.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244UfLakTXh42W2n5koGPxBdbV7RU75BXv6rzuoUFEeGhEsZbTmPDCzU4ZxhPHttPP38N.jpg) ![20260226_184442.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sdbK6t1yud4bgRnwmZueZv2iALCg3ufY6xqrX7r8VGHy6UcJ3PpaH46RrKhaGu9fPyz.jpg) ![20260226_184453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23x16ooMPG8xN8ux8z6xixD8XMRwMxcvuWYLfnpPgYtkFqpzc91YBMEoouuVS1D8AsDSY.jpg) --- There was a wide variety of vegetation, bushes, trees and many paths running through the place, but I stayed on that huge, long staircase trying to take in everything around me. --- ![20260226_184523.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/246G9Rt8NeNFGLPVrkqs1F6kLUbcGxEPDgkRt5UG9TfmPDpv1KPyME3u4eneWvr2XdzBD.jpg) ![20260226_184527.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23v4R5ra3gpABuy3NERHbNZetqEgVRBanFHqafUPBgHZDk1QXLH4zUbHjhXZMmg8NPLMc.jpg) ![20260226_184553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKt8XRMmCxxmhHq5qGmttHXsto6Kp9LeRHuntCUVyNS5QvD85SfWqN6P8WCYhjSrsd9.jpg) ![20260226_184615.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vi4AHowXQUNiqeSt7fq6LB9rit6WcSwm4yfacoFJQokEPR6WX8LmqVGN9gaGM2fTv1u.jpg) --- There were wildflowers of different colours along the edge of the path and also a playful kitten that came out from among the trees, talking to me in its language and asking me to follow it, but I was going in the opposite direction. It was very friendly. --- ![20260226_184706.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgDBbPfVPemUCeX1JRYY6X8AFtY9Q5ZYuCD4ii2NLWi36NzPVCBwQv6dPrzpCmcen6u.jpg) ![20260226_184737.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244KGtN2XU91RQLWi84zReq3WZphJNppUcWSLrFBuseESMao2UAEzog22ncuMzzCfQ4n1.jpg) ![20260226_184749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y8mGn8wRTc967zE3VR64BaYMB2CjxtbyLRGfhManv1rmzoLBas6ixujNx5b5PTW8PtR.jpg) ![20260226_184818.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242NaLAqCoSX9nVEuCjMW1VpmxFs8eZfhK2PQsWm5JQEpkVpj7vBCECcGHRW39CKKKEWD.jpg) ![20260226_184827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23s9PTxDKJZ7co4RPCdiVcgKm5HTL52jMSLPKAkP1dTACgCwrKACRKFPVuKAQ8ZGQiXnM.jpg) ![20260226_184729.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243BY6bZEnBAGAdbr4NpugVPDDVvpV6pbLw5svy7JdRpQxy98h1R5n8VJv2Vfyy7cwMhb.jpg) --- When I finished descending the staircase, I came across tall plants through which I could see the beautiful lagoon. I do not know the name of these plants, but they looked like reeds and created beautiful landscapes. --- ![20260226_184844.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242NYnx2mVQcndyDUppsfgkTdoxyGvnS5nDDxnYgU3jpnjVWqPL6iFY6pKupubjuzkGTT.jpg) ![20260226_184922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2449z6iDu3Zznt9D4W295fa7PUAQv6S2tr8eQGqEDSFwntUivFEnHTYz9wxeu45xtuJtK.jpg) ![20260226_184925.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2458Hv76BWMK73DcCobQ4LAQahTnymTL9sKe2bR1m1D2YofgdHcWJaxWYAH6kmncPwGmr.jpg) ![20260226_184943.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23rB59CETnX2mUfGYcZxpmBsYXb8bYSNFNepdjbMvpL8FAysh3QEkNU9PHR8583NJE72V.jpg) ![20260226_185010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243WPoizysJmYsBiTVftqkM1j2V6C5f42zGfwK1YE2KpszKPfuE1ZjNxTfY5kpKfmZ5rD.jpg) ![20260226_185015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243WKW6aPnggojdm7Cp4ZeSH5SjQp5uSfr3ZJFDgi279RCYn8TvhHZnPkrMfFxiJ3ZQfC.jpg) ![20260226_184831.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xedj21U3i5YzmCWwLi95DoJX7k3fRprFDvsS19JCMi9SWg8CP6csT8qYhWtKDY7Hff5.jpg) --- Meanwhile, I continued walking along the path, turning around and circling the lagoon. The landscapes were different from what I usually see, especially with the absence of the sun, although a little light could be seen on the horizon. The sun was already setting in a beautiful sunset. There were some spots along the way where I could see the lagoon better and the reflections of the trees and pines on the other side of it. --- ![20260226_185041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tSSNQ2w21J8CuBs2dWTsnpb9Zt3KKLXEppVSBHz518srDpsc9mqR7WLAU6MnFpjYSg8.jpg) ![20260226_185047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tvW8vvNSxkPzY9N4bEaQTVD3MJXxB419VJCqZx6CE8MwWzN9UNGBdttELrVeuTq7Gnx.jpg) ![20260226_185208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vYbMmgPqUppRh8sQAHdELeD4mfbN26HiEwkuv6mNNYQUqUswEf4xp1ZLHrp6RV8BBEA.jpg) ![20260226_185211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244UhLLYvK5pnKgzHFdwj1iPsLpZTx7pErw2XBJm1xYigsCtLRXs15FRqhHvjudVDNgd6.jpg) ![20260226_185022.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yTb7dm8ypqmjVJVcM5wgPdFnihm7w8bUYmH2gcLMYDjiCudDMzWei9oAjjKcF8BMG1e.jpg) ![20260226_185215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23tmDH8S1Z6VoGPyiPfrUzepL2qSFYNd6qesdHyVAfRrpNAeUskr4h2xfa9dcMhbSBcvR.jpg) --- The path zigzagged, and the exploration so far had been wonderful. I also came across bushes with small white flowers, which were beautiful. As I moved away from the path, the lagoon was left behind among those tall plants. I began to climb a path to leave the place. Tiny wild blue flowers they were on the way --- ![20260226_185255.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242hKUABS2aSkBYGfokaS4gjSZNovTVorFNTntyvEVq4MDUtyhcARNXNiwmB2Z2Hnf7Ft.jpg) ![20260226_185333.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243zUwtHPCEYagCsuEfoedrc88pk3xrKzA6T6epJAEEfzmje12cK8DwTEH9mx3GXCiSEb.jpg) ![20260226_185352.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zbKpf3GNaT3wGWUCyH2hXmPDd5kz3EC6KCNZwCDtsxn9aS181uGKVdiDQE36DSbesFh.jpg) ![20260226_185502.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242NajoY5MBoxJLYWh2V38RyqV65BFuhxYMHMttZN5VPzZiH3K8v6DVTMvheAgteVFvBh.jpg) --- The landscapes change so much from one season to another, but they all have their charm and beauty. It is a perfect place for walking, exploring, picnicking, and being in touch with nature. Look at the views... They are so beautiful. --- ![20260226_185522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wWrpjb3DsMwodXt7kc3EieDMuaM9qbkvMaWo9hr9fVUamxT6vGhQBnbjWSLmCepW43k.jpg) --- I moved further away from the lagoon, always accompanied by bushes and plants with brightly coloured flowers, indicating that spring is very close. --- ![20260226_185615.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zS2xioRZ2C1aJMMbs87F7bedC7CNus2XNDsUeiX2wBsZicExD4Ej5HAP4PeR1YqTjgA.jpg) ![20260226_185545.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245HgRkuhdayiDYBQALifiqiHZiuByaBCgyMvxQj7gtu8VZN6YNmwEAkCJaSrQMKTYCeL.jpg) --- I looked up and saw dozens of birds flying through the skies, everywhere I looked, as if greeting me from above. It was a great experience and I discovered this hidden place that was new to me. Thank you very much for joining me today, I send you my best regards. See you soon. Amonet. --- ---

title.title: Learning a Skill While Unlearning Anger.
title.body:
>
![20260310_095715.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oluwa-tosin/23yJEXJDtfjSWTdTD8aN1VHTCeeFpZnov5zSSV6eWxVfRnjFawGtfwVAqLtRwjDNfgbDa.jpg)
Good day, people of Hive! Welcome to my blog. Today's topic is from Hive-Learners which says:**Learning/Unlearning**. So let's dive in. Honestly, Lately I have been thinking about some things I am trying to learn again in my life and also some things I am trying to change about myself. The truth that people don't know is that life is like a journey where we keep learning every day, that's why we see some people still furthering their education because they want to keep learning, and sometimes we also need to unlearn certain habits in our lives so that we can become a better people. One of the things I am currently learning again is **fashion designing**. Before I gained admission into the university, I was already learning about fashion designing, how to sew. I really enjoyed it because I love when I see people putting on different type of designs clothes and I love how they always create the design with their creativity and I love the idea of making clothes. I was learning how to measure body parts, how to cut fabrics, and other basic things about sewing.
But when I gained admission into the university, I could not continue with it. School activities took most of my time, and I was not always at home where I could practice. The only time I usually go home(**my hometown**) is during December, and that period is always the festive season when everyone is busy. Because of that, I didn’t really get the chance to continue learning properly. Another problem was that I didn’t have access to a sewing machine while I was in school. Because I was not practicing everyday, I started forgetting some of the things I had learned before. At some point, I felt bad about it because it is something I really want to learn well.
![20260310_095804.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oluwa-tosin/23y8sb8G1Hh665M5cA6sGG7A3KSNhxTE2rC8aZvRC1BSnoqDUMr67YyRaEYbfovDjQExa.jpg)
So, last month, I decided that instead of waiting and wasting my time doing nothing, I should try to help myself. So I started downloading fashion designing videos from YouTube and watching them from the beginning again. The videos I downloaded explained things like how to measure body parts correctly, how to cut fabrics, and other basic steps in sewing. Even though I don’t have a sewing machine to practice right now, watching the videos is helping me remember the things I had forgotten which I'm happy. I believe that when I finally get the chance to continue learning with a sewing machine, it will be much easier for me than me wasting my time doing nothing.
Another thing I am also working on in my life is my **anger isssue**. I noticed that sometimes I get angry easily, especially when someone does something that annoys me a lot. It is not as bad as before, but I still know that it is something I need to work on for my own betterment. One thing that makes me happy is that I can see some changes in myself already compared to before which I'm grateful for. Though there are still times when someone makes me angry, but I try to control myself and not react immediately. I try to think first before responding because if I respond without thinking I know it will make the matter even more worse. It is not always easy, but I keep trying because I know it will help me in the future. I believe learning these things will really help me in my life. Fashion designing is a skill that can help me stand on my own one day and maybe even become a source of income for me in the future because that's what lot of people are doing for a living. At the same time, learning to control my anger will help me have even better relationships with people. In conclusion, for me, this is part of growing in life. I may not be perfect, but the effort I make to improve myself is what really matters. Every small step I take now is helping me become a better person which I'm thankful for. **This is my entry for the Hive Learners Featured Content Week 208 Episode 01.** **Thanks for reading💞💞💞💞💞.** **Images are mines.** Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@oluwa-tosin/learning-a-skill-while-unlearning-anger-hcn)

title.title: Professional Law Assignment Help for Australian University Students
title.body:
Studying law in Australia means engaging with one of the most intellectually demanding disciplines in higher education. Students must develop advanced skills in legal research, critical analysis, precise writing, and structured reasoning — often under considerable time pressure. Targeted assignment support has become a widely used resource for those aiming to meet high academic standards while managing the full scope of law degree requirements. Common Pressures in Australian Legal Education Several recurring challenges lead students to seek expert assistance:

Extremely dense reading loads involving lengthy judgments, complex statutes, and detailed secondary sources. Difficulty consistently transforming legal rules into clear, fact-specific applications. Requirement to produce tightly structured answers using frameworks such as IRAC, FIRAC, or the Australian-preferred ILAC approach. Frequent overlapping deadlines across multiple subjects, often combined with practical commitments like legal clinics, internships, or paid work. Expectation of sophisticated critical evaluation, original insight, and flawless adherence to the Australian Guide to Legal Citation (AGLC).

Professional [law assignment help Australia](https://www.ozessay.com.au/law-assignment-help/) allows students to maintain performance across these competing demands.  
Most Frequent Types of Law Assessments  
Australian law programs assess students through a range of carefully designed tasks:

Problem questions / issue-based scenarios — Spot legal issues → state relevant rules → apply law methodically to facts → reach defensible conclusions. Case notes / judgment critiques — Extract the ratio decidendi, analyse judicial reasoning, distinguish obiter, and evaluate precedential importance. Research essays and seminar papers — Sustained critical discussion of legal questions supported by primary Australian authorities and academic commentary. Contract, tort, equity, and remedies problems — Detailed doctrinal application, consideration of defences/remedies, and policy-aware analysis. Reflective journals and portfolio entries — Professional reflection linking classroom theory, skills development, and ethical awareness.

Each format strengthens different dimensions of legal competence. Main Areas of Law Typically Covered Support is available across the foundational and advanced subjects that form the Australian law curriculum:

Criminal law & criminal procedure — Actus reus, mens rea, defences, burdens of proof, and key Commonwealth/state legislation. Contract law & commercial principles — Offer & acceptance, consideration, vitiating factors, discharge, and remedies in commercial settings. Corporations & business law — Corporate personality, directors’ fiduciary and statutory duties, share capital rules, and external administration. Australian constitutional law & administrative law — Commonwealth powers, implied freedoms, grounds of judicial review, natural justice, and proportionality. Torts, negligence & equitable remedies — Duty of care, breach, causation, defences, equitable doctrines, and trust principles. Employment law, family law, migration law & specialised electives — Statutory frameworks, rights & obligations, procedural fairness, and emerging legal issues.

All assistance prioritises current Australian materials and correct AGLC referencing. Key Value Provided by Expert Legal Writers Qualified support offers several important advantages:

Writers hold recognised Australian legal qualifications and possess up-to-date knowledge of local case law and legislation. Strong focus on analytical depth, logical coherence, critical engagement with authorities, and persuasive legal writing. Complete jurisdictional accuracy — using only relevant Australian precedents, statutes, and citation conventions. Strict confidentiality for student identity, assignment details, and all correspondence. Reliable performance on short-notice and high-priority deadlines without quality compromise. 100% original content, verified through plagiarism detection software and fully referenced.

These features help produce work that closely matches university expectations. Standard Step-by-Step Process The typical service flow is student-friendly and transparent:

Upload or enter full assignment instructions (topic, length, due date, required sources, rubric/marking guide, lecturer preferences). Place secure order and payment. Matched with a suitable legal expert; direct messaging available for questions, clarifications, or progress updates. Receive completed assignment → review thoroughly → submit revision requests within the allowed period if needed.

This clear structure minimises stress and maximises alignment with requirements. Responsible and Effective Use of Assignment Support Professional help is best understood as a high-quality academic learning aid: an exemplar of excellent legal reasoning, structure, referencing, and expression. Ethical providers normally guarantee:

Plagiarism-free work with originality reports Generous free-revision windows Strong data protection policies

When students actively study the provided material — analysing structure, argument flow, use of authority, and writing style — they strengthen their own legal analysis and academic writing abilities over time. Ultimately, specialised law assignment assistance enables Australian law students to better manage the intense demands of their degree, produce higher-calibre work across diverse assessment types, and build greater confidence in handling complex legal problems and sophisticated academic writing.

title.title: The Expensive Fried Rice That I Have Ever Eaten
title.body:
>

Hi buddies...


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmafaPMs5udukrcRj5aYz11nAFwVQTqQJagoKeNVTiLGmv/img_4517.jpeg)

As the title suggests, this is indeed the most expensive fried rice I've ever eaten in my life. It's seafood fried rice sold in the courtyard of Bangkok's Platinum Mall. A friend of mine who's been to Bangkok told me the food there is indeed expensive. Even though it's street food, it's understandable that it's expensive, because seafood is expensive.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZgoeSc8YQzYfiyWLkdDcsYL74gsvpVnQpWyfWAMUBcAZ/img_4523.jpeg)



So I ended up eating this seafood fried rice on my first night in Bangkok. I hadn't eaten rice the day before, so I had to buy it with the last of my cash. I regret only discovering this street food after I ran out of cash. Bangkok still uses cash.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd24eggWgKHPi4RGvY8VDKBh9CA4JPTafNKXbcFAbWNxq/img_4520.jpeg)

------

https://images.ecency.com/DQmV71YTF5ZX5BncAC23Jo54KWjWjkF423H1tnFtbBBvA5R/img_4527.jpeg 

It's no wonder this fried rice is priced at 200 Bhat, which is about 100,000 Rupiah. Considering the contents: an omelette, quite a lot of shrimp, and quite a bit of squid, it's no wonder this fried rice is so expensive. Besides, this fried rice is halal. So I didn't regret spending 200 Bhat for a portion of fried rice.

| https://images.ecency.com/DQmW2dAwq4BfhgMCMbpsAiFYfE1qQMuiEr4CNxwhHgTUoma/img_4522.jpeg | https://images.ecency.com/DQmbE6ENhdVMfjCTT8xLJxRZaWg1Wf2BsBP1hUJov9xhbj5/img_4525.jpeg |
| ----| ----|


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaHWDr6jQhMYXRJkSkZfEpbHE5XAdfKHxnUmkJ1vBss9y/img_4519.jpeg)




I initially thought I wouldn't finish it, but it turned out to be quite a portion. Maybe it was because I was so hungry. I remember it was around 8 PM. I was so tired of looking for proper food, so I stopped at this courtyard. After spending quite a while finishing this fried rice, I returned to the hotel by online taxi. I felt like lying down.

Hasta La Vista...

Buying a car can be a big financial decision, but it doesn’t always have to be expensive. Many people today prefer buying second-hand vehicles because they are more affordable and still reliable. If you are searching for [**cheap used cars for sale in Melbourne Victoria**](https://www.njmotors.com.au/), you will find many options that suit different budgets, lifestyles, and driving needs. Melbourne has a large and active used-car market, making it easier for buyers to find quality vehicles at reasonable prices.  
In this blog, we will explore where to find cheap used cars in Melbourne, what types of vehicles are popular, the benefits of buying used cars, and useful tips to help you make the best decision.  
Why Buy Cheap Used Cars in Melbourne Victoria?  
There are several reasons why people look for cheap used cars for sale in Melbourne Victoria instead of buying brand-new vehicles. The main reason is affordability. New cars lose value quickly during the first few years. When you buy a used car, the previous owner has already taken most of that depreciation, allowing you to get a better deal.  
Another advantage is the wide variety available. Melbourne’s car market includes thousands of used vehicles from different brands, years, and price ranges. Whether you need a small car for city driving, a family sedan, or a work vehicle, you can easily find something that matches your needs.  
Used cars are also ideal for first-time drivers, students, and people who want a reliable car without paying high monthly payments.  
Average Prices of Cheap Used Cars in Melbourne  
The price of cheap used cars for sale in Melbourne Victoria can vary depending on the vehicle’s age, condition, mileage, and brand. However, buyers can usually find good deals within the following price ranges:  
$2,000 – $5,000: Older cars with higher mileage but still suitable for daily use.  
$5,000 – $10,000: Reliable vehicles with decent features and moderate mileage.  
$10,000 – $15,000: Newer used cars with better technology and safety features.  
Many buyers prefer the $5,000 to $10,000 range because it offers a good balance between price and reliability.  
Popular Cheap Used Car Models in Melbourne  
When searching for cheap used cars for sale in Melbourne Victoria, some models are more popular because they are known for reliability, fuel efficiency, and lower maintenance costs.

1.  Toyota Corolla The Toyota Corolla is one of the most reliable cars in the world. It is fuel-efficient, affordable to maintain, and widely available in the used car market.
    
2.  Mazda 3 Mazda 3 models are known for their stylish design and smooth driving experience. They are also quite affordable in the second-hand market.
    
3.  Honda Civic The Honda Civic offers good fuel economy, comfortable interiors, and strong reliability, making it a great choice for used car buyers.
    
4.  Hyundai i30 The Hyundai i30 is another popular option because it provides modern features and good value for money. These models are commonly found in Melbourne’s used car listings and are considered safe choices for budget buyers. Where to Find Cheap Used Cars in Melbourne Victoria If you want to find cheap used cars for sale in Melbourne Victoria, there are several places where you can start your search. Online Car Marketplaces Many buyers begin their search online because it allows them to compare multiple vehicles quickly. Popular websites include car listing platforms, classified ad websites, and automotive marketplaces. Local Dealerships Used car dealerships across Melbourne offer a wide range of vehicles. Buying from a dealer can sometimes provide additional benefits such as warranties, inspections, and financing options. Private Sellers Some people prefer buying directly from private owners because prices can be lower than dealerships. However, buyers should carefully inspect the vehicle and verify documents before purchasing. Car Auctions Vehicle auctions can also be a good place to find cheap cars, but they require experience and quick decision-making. Important Tips Before Buying a Used Car Finding cheap used cars for sale in Melbourne Victoria is easier when you follow some important tips. These steps can help you avoid problems and ensure you get good value for your money.
    
5.  Check the Vehicle History Always review the car’s history report to check for previous accidents, damage, or outstanding loans.
    
6.  Inspect the Car Thoroughly Look for signs of wear, rust, or mechanical issues. If possible, take a qualified mechanic with you for a professional inspection.
    
7.  Test Drive the Vehicle A test drive helps you understand how the car performs. Pay attention to braking, steering, engine noise, and overall comfort.
    
8.  Verify the Roadworthy Certificate In Victoria, a roadworthy certificate is required when transferring ownership. This ensures the vehicle meets safety standards.
    
9.  Compare Prices Before making a final decision, compare prices of similar cars in the market. This helps you understand whether you are getting a fair deal. Final Thoughts The market for cheap used cars for sale in Melbourne Victoria is large and full of opportunities for smart buyers. title.title: THE ART OF SURVIVAL…
title.body: > _The illiterate of the 21st century will not be those who cannot read and write, but those who cannot LEARN, UNLEARN, and RELEARN_… - _Alvin Toffler_…\n\n

/>_It wouldn’t have been easy entering a topic as crucial as this without any introductory punchline or a catchy phrase, which was why i had to toss this in to be able to blend in quickly and smoothly. Moreover, i haven’t been here in a long time because my academics have been taking more of my time than usual. It’s the final lap of the first phase, which means more workload, less time to get them all done…_ _Honestly, not being here for quite a while has made me a bit rusty. I didn’t know this until some minutes ago when I tried diving right into this topic without a leading edge, I realized I needed a bigger push for my writing skills to surface once again, and just like that i got it all back in no time. I guess it’s true when they say; the moment you stop doing that which you are good at or abandon it for some reason, it starts to leave you bit by bit until it becomes forgotten. To reclaim such knowledge once again will need an extra push, and for me, that phrase right up there was the push I needed. Anyways, that’s that about that, i’m here now and that’s all that matters. Now, let’s dive right into what I’ve got for you all today on the aspects of learning and unlearning…_ _Learning is hard, and unlearning is harder. Oh yeah, that’s the raw truth, and because I’m talking from experience. The goal of learning any particular thing in life to attain a whole different level of perfection. Now imagine how extremely difficult it would be to unlearn that particular thing it took you months or years of sacrifice and different levels of hard work to achieve. I don’t think it would be easy to do such, which is exactly why i said earlier that learning is hard and unlearning is harder…_ _If it was easy to unlearn things, then we would be living in a crime free society right now…_ ### _THAT ONE THING I’M LEARNING IN MY LIFE AT THE MOMENT…_ _Survival! Oh yeah, the_ **_art of survival_** _is that one thing I’m learning right now in my life. Apart from this, I don’t want to learn anything else. If possible i’d like to unlearn so many other things right now, but then this so many other things are essential to me, they will be needed at some point in my journey through life, and that is exactly why i can’t unlearn them yet lol…_

/> _The art of survival is deeper than you think. If you haven’t experienced it firsthand, you won’t be able to understand the in-depth meaning. There’s more to surviving than walking, talking, and doing all sorts of things. Although, the end result of survival is to stay alive, regardless the circumstances and conditions. But then the requirements to live and survive are just what’s lacking. Imagine you breathing and not having either funds or foodstuffs as a student to live by, is that any different from being dead? Lol. And that is exactly why i say there’s more to survival than just breathing. You can be deadly alive, oh yes that’s very possible lol. You should see the movie walking dead to understand that phrase better…_ _Honestly, i’m so so tired of this guiding and unguiding cycle. The last time I experienced this cycle was about two years ago, and right now I’m experiencing that cycle again. What a deja vu!_ _Last year wasn’t as tough as this, even as a student. But then since this year started, it’s been a lot of bumps here and there, both virtually and in the real world, and that’s where I decided to incorporate the art of survival into that which I’m learning right now, or else a lot of things is going to go wrong 😂…_

/> _Honestly, if I eventually learn this skill 😂, i might never have to be in this position again for a third time, and that’s the fact…_ _In summary, learning the art of survival is very crucial at this point in time. It is going to go a long way after this phase is successfully over. It’s somehow each and everyone of us would have to learn at some point in our life. Some come sooner, while for others it will be later. I guess mine came sooner, and just as you know, the earlier the better…_

This is my post on #freewriters3037 #dailyprompt without suspicion hosted by @marinnewest's.
The orange glow of the sunset over Uyo cast long shadows across the red earth of Oron Road. Aniefiok and Ekemini walked side-by-side, the silence between them heavy not with tension, but with the comfortable weight of twenty years of shared secrets.
​In a city where gossip travels faster than a Keke Napep, their bond was an anomaly. People whispered that Ekemini’s sudden promotion at the ministry was \

or perhaps something darker. But Aniefiok never asked. When Ekemini returned home late with a brand-new laptop and a weary smile, Aniefiok simply placed a plate of steaming Afang soup in front of him.\n​\
Aniefiok joked, his eyes bright with genuine warmth.\n​\

Ekemini replied, exhaling a week’s worth of stress.\n​There was no peering into locked drawers, no checking of phone screens left face-up on the table. Their trust wasn't a conscious choice; it was the atmosphere they breathed. When Aniefiok needed capital for his startup, Ekemini handed over his savings without a receipt or a timeline. He didn't see a risk; he saw his brother.\n​As the streetlights flickered to life, illuminating the bustling stalls of Ibom Plaza, they shared a roasted corn from a roadside vendor. In a world built on \

they chose to close theirs and simply lean on one another. Between them, suspicion wasn't just absent—it was an impossible language they had never bothered to learn.\n​Would you like me to expand this into a longer short story with more dialogue between the brothers?

Dear friends, wishing you all a very wonderful day. A refreshing drink made from Sri Lankan small oranges is a natural and revitalizing beverage that captures the bright citrus flavor of this wonderful fruit. Known for its pleasant aroma and rich vitamin content, oranges make the perfect base for a homemade drink that is both delicious and energizing. It is an ideal choice for hot days when you want something cool, light, and naturally refreshing.

Small oranges 10.
Some ice cubes.
A pinch of salt.

title.body:
![JvFFVmatwWHRfvmtd53nmEJ94xpKydwmbSC5H5svBACH7yFQMrK3qvDAr6tHq9rS5sgVCcwQFeZAmS865ge52Za66yM5Ge5B1TdbzzdHDK4H79d7oaUuNoWZtvsQpTNtaPT5fKNsrW.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fadio/23vho8icEUM3JrfeDAxrzxpDSonkZa1trZR625DPKbCqc3rctHFE8i28wEUWSFiJQKxiL.jpeg)

Swertia japonica, often known as the Japanese Swertia, is a striking and medicinally valuable herb that has long been cherished in East Asia. Belonging to the Gentianaceae family, this plant is known for both its captivating beauty and its role in traditional herbal medicine. Found mainly in Japan, Korea, and parts of China, Swertia japonica thrives in moist meadows and mountain slopes, where its delicate purple-blue flowers add a gentle charm to the natural scenery.

The plant itself is a small, upright perennial that typically grows up to 40 centimeters tall. Its narrow, lance-shaped leaves form a neat rosette at the base, while its slender stems bear clusters of star-shaped flowers. Each flower displays a mesmerizing combination of pale purple petals adorned with greenish veins and a dark center, giving it a distinctive and elegant appearance. The bloom of Swertia japonica is not only visually captivating but also a symbol of purity and resilience in Japanese culture.

Hello hi everyone how are you greetings to all of you and welcome to my another recipe blog. I hope you guys all are well and enjoying yummy food. As always today I am also here for sharing a new recipe with all of you which is **Super tasty crispy potato Pakora**. Today I cooked it in new recipe also using new ingredients and techniques. I want to share with all of you so let's start the process. 

**Ingredients**

One kg potatoes 

Green chillies 

Green coriander 

All purpose flour 

**Spices**

Salt 

Chilli flakes 

Black pepper 

Dry grind coriander 

Garam masala 

**Process**

First I took potatoes peeled with knife then washed under water very well. Then I crushed whole potatoes on grater. I pressed crushed potatoes and took out extra water. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWLNA48VehqZR85RNMVMexgCfWbPRQg6G42ggLkcZ5kWQ/1773130206896.jpg)

Then I added whole required spices like salt chilli flakes black pepper and garam masala. After this I added green chillies green coriander and all purpose flour then mixed well

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXvvyVQhnwgrBv1pwRTgZxcmSQkoM3nbS8p2GtAUi1fVo/1773130326426.jpg)

I made shape in round balls then deep fry in the oil. First I fried in higher flame then at the last I fry at low flame so it cooks well also inside.

I fried till the colour change into golden brown shade. And Pakora also cooks crispy.

**Final look**

Those old typewriters really do have their mysteries, and I love them too. You've created a fantastic story with it. You see them in antique shops, and I wonder if any of them have stories to tell like yours.

They say you can't change the future when it comes to things like death, although you can with some other things because they're a matter of energy. Your story is excellent. That was going to happen even if the machine hadn't written that your friend would die. It's like premonitory dreams, which often leave details to be revealed. Thank you so much for participating! Hugs!🤗

>Esas máquinas de escribir antiguas si que tienen su misterio y a mi también me encantan. Has creado una historia fantástica con ella, se ven en las tiendas de antiguedades, me pregunto si alguna de ellas tendrá historias que contar como la tuya.

>Dicen que no se puede cambiar el futuro en cuanto a temas como la muerte, aunque en algunas otras cosas si, porque son un tema de energías. Tu historia es excelente, eso iba a pasar aunque la máquina no escribió que amiga moriría, se parece a los sueños premonitorios que muchas veces dejan detalles por desvelar. Muchas gracias por participar!! Abrazo!!🤗

title.title: 20,000,000 Bitcoin have been mined, historic milestone, next having will be around April 2028
title.body: Gestern hat die Bitcoin Blockchain einen historischen Meilenstein erreicht, mit dem Block #939999, der von dem amerikanischen Mining-Pool \

gemined wurde, wurde der 20 Millionste Bitcoin geschürft.

Damit wurden bereit 95% der Total Supply von 21 Millionen geschürft, wobei sich die Mining-Rate alle 4 Jahre halbiert. Das nächste Halving findet bereits in ungefähr 2 Jahren statt, damit befinden wir uns im Moment so ziemlich genau in der Mitte zwischen zwei Halvings.

Derzeit werden pro Block 3.125 (3 Komma 125) Bitcoin gemined, die Fees machen dabei nur weniger als 1% der Block Rewards aus, wenn es gut geht, das wären ein paar Tausend Dollar pro Block an Fees.

Niemand weiß im Moment genau, wie sich das mit den Fees in den nächsten Jahren für die Miner entwickeln wird, Fees werden allerdings langfristig das Mining finanzieren müssen.

Vor diesem Hintergrund werden immer neue Use-Cases für Bitcoin gesucht, wie das Einbetten von NFTs oder weiteren Tokens in die Bitcoin Blockchain, um mehr Nachfrage nach Transaktionen zu schaffen.

Denke aber, dass das gar nicht notwendig sein wird, sondern das einfach mit der steigenden Adoption als Reserve-Währung und durch die stark limitierte Blockgröße, die Fee-Einnahmen automatisch ansteigen werden.

Manche denken sogar, dass man durch die Vergrößerung der Blocks, insgesamt die Nutzung erhöhen könnte und dann ebenfalls mehr Fee-Einnahmen für die Miner generieren kann.

Eine andere Möglichkeit wäre, dass Börsen oder große Player Hash-Power spenden und selber Mining-Pools betreiben könnten, um die hohe Security des Bitcoin-Netzwerks zu erhalten, sollten die Mining-Rewards zu stark fallen.

Denke insgesamt, dass die Mining-Problematik gelöst werden kann, bzw. sich an die sich veränderte Reward-Situation anpassen wird und die Fee-Einnahmen mit wachsendem Preis und Adoption deutlich steigen werden.

Was sagt ihr dazu?

## Bitcoin crossed 20,000,000 Bitcoin mined

![gemini-bitcoin-20m-1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vikisecrets/EoASZedKSRZLQnx1mdbvdCpgWGiSvAjG5PSTWLNDKsvbm6qSqCVnkPUn62VLtRWViJe.jpg)

*AI-generated illustration (Nano Banana 2)*

https://x.com/Cointelegraph/status/2031002962428846564

https://x.com/SimplyBitcoin/status/2031009554125947298

## Next Halving Countdown: April 2028

https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/bitcoin/bitcoin-halving

## English

Yesterday, the Bitcoin blockchain reached a historic milestone: block #939999, mined by the U.S. mining pool “Foundry USA,” marked the mining of the 20 millionth Bitcoin.

This means that 95% of the total supply of 21 million has already been mined, with the mining rate halving every 4 years. The next halving will take place in about 2 years, so we are currently pretty much halfway between two halvings.

Currently, 3.125 Bitcoin are mined per block, with fees accounting for less than 1% of the block rewards. If all goes well, that would be a few thousand dollars per block in fees.

No one knows exactly how fees will develop for miners in the coming years, but fees will have to finance mining in the long term.

Against this backdrop, new use cases for Bitcoin are constantly being sought, such as embedding NFTs or other tokens in the Bitcoin blockchain to create more demand for transactions.

However, I don't think this will be necessary at all, but rather that fee revenues will automatically increase with the growing adoption of Bitcoin as a reserve currency and due to the severely limited block size.

Some even think that increasing the size of the blocks could increase overall usage and thus also generate more revenue for miners.

Another possibility would be for exchanges or large players to donate hash power and operate their own mining pools in order to maintain the high security of the Bitcoin network should mining rewards fall too sharply.

Overall, I think the mining problem can be solved, or rather, it will adapt to the changed reward situation and fee income will increase significantly as adoption and the price grows.

What do you think?

title.title: Visiting Sucre Square in Valencia [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
![Pink Grey and Yellow Modern Work Life YouTube Thumbnail.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23wqrog4Q3TqXqXZddKSqiTHw19BRDjk6BZq63HBUnivUF8C8DAnf3oXZgUM68SscEZ3v.jpg)
Made with Canva Editor >Imagen editada en Canva

This time I'd like to show you Sucre Square in Valencia. This square has had different names in the past, during colonial times, but regardless of its name, it has always been a meeting place, a place to relax, and a recreational area for the people of Valencia. It has always been a beautiful square, but it's currently even more beautiful than I've seen it before—very clean, with well-maintained green spaces, and even antique-style lampposts that give it a special, vintage touch that blends with the colonial essence of the historic center. >En esta ocasión me gustaría mostrarles la plaza Sucre de Valencia. Esta plaza ha tenido diferentes nombres anteriormente, en los tiempos de la colonia, pero sin importar que nombre tuviera siempre fue un centro de encuentro, descanso y recreación para los valencianos. Siempre ha sido una plaza muy hermosa, pero actualmente está mucho más bonita de lo que la he visto en otras ocasiones, muy limpia y con areas verdes muy cuidadas, incluso con faroles de corte antiguo que le dan un toque especial y vintage que combina con la esencia colonial del casco histórico.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-01 at 10.37.13 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EogNo5EipRFDQ4hY19SSYCMzYo7m83BPduLHZvsQYKJ8ajVi4J8yLySiFkS3Ywsyr57.jpeg)

In the middle of the plaza stands a bronze statue that gives the plaza its name: Antonio José de Sucre, also known as the Grand Marshal of Ayacucho, an illustrious military leader who contributed greatly to the liberation of Venezuela from the Spanish Empire. One of the plaza's former names was Plaza Guzmán Blanco, in honor of the then-president, Antonio Guzmán Blanco, and a statue of him stood in its center. However, in 1889, the statue was toppled and dragged into the Cabriales River by citizens dissatisfied with the government. The plaza was subsequently renamed Plaza Sucre, and a statue of the national hero was erected there to replace the previous one.

>En medio de la plaza hay una estatua de bronce que le da nombre a la plaza, me refiero al prócer Antonio José de Sucre, o Gran Mariscal de Ayacucho, como también se le conoce, ilustre militar que contribuyó muchísimo con la liberación de Venezuela del imperio español. Uno de los nombres que tuvo la plaza alguna vez fue: Plaza Guzmán Blanco, en honor al entonces presidente: Antonio Guzmán Blanco, y allí en medio estaba una estatua en honor a él, pero en 1889, la estatua fue derribada y arrastrada hacia el río Cabriales por los ciudadanos que estaban descontentos con el gobierno, y posteriormente fue rebautizada con el nombre que tiene actualmente: Plaza Sucre, y pudieron allí una estatua del prócer para reemplazar la anterior.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-01 at 10.37.19 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EpLf26VuP7bZbFAtGii7vAK4X5sRGvFzAPFx1cbGoFjj46hvVco4VLCXh34HwD9WQ59.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-01 at 10.37.17 AM (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/Ep3dqZ6xhhce8VBVGfvxcWm2JkbEYgphQtjnUX7w3noLtRyF65ip9uNyVYSZRAfpSL8.jpeg)

The plaza is surrounded by iconic and historically significant landmarks. For example, in the photo below, you can see the former law school of the University of Carabobo, although I understand it was a convent during the colonial era. Next to it is the Church of San Francisco de Asís (the oldest church in the city after the cathedral).

>La plaza está rodeada de lugares icónicos e históricos muy importantes, por ejemplo en esta foto que les muestro debajo de este texto se puede ver en primer lugar la antigua facultad de derecho de la Universidad de Carabobo, aunque durante los años coloniales tengo entendido que fue un convento. Al lado está la iglesia San Francisco de Asís (la iglesia más antigua de la ciudad después de la catedral)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-01 at 10.37.08 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EprTApgfNFprDCPtkB1hXyugN4njoDWF8TMQQczomvBvLAvjWG7hAgvLFFqJW2nrWB7.jpeg)

Directly ahead is the state capitol (the governor's seat of power); I understand it was once a convent, but of a different order. You can see the chapel's dome in the background.

>De frente está el capitolio del estado (lugar de mandato del gobernador) según tengo entendido también fue un convento alguna vez pero de otra orden. Allá al fondo se puede ver la cúpula de la capilla.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-01 at 10.37.20 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EpJZXrbY9Wx9daqXbgWZNfmCT7AyaEiqAfwC2KPUabtjoXw5JtuTUiwg6BxLAg7anLU.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-01 at 10.37.18 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/Ep7ueEuwoqSxv8aRUewY78FY12DnGntkV9mE5dbRcptkCYrtdLy4n1dpwgo4Q6EakcM.jpeg)

Behind it stands an old colonial mansion that, sometime in the 1920s or 30s, was a convent school for young ladies, and later, in the second half of the 20th century, it became the Ramón Zapata School of Theater, which continues to operate there today. The Nina Nikanorova School of Classical Ballet also operated there for many years.

>Detrás está una vieja casona colonial que por ahí en los años 20 o 30 fue un colegio de monjas para señoritas, y después, ya para la segunda mitad del siglo XX hasta la actualidad comenzó a funcionar la escuela de teatro Ramón Zapata. También funcionó allí por muchos años la escuela de ballet clásico Nina Nikanorova.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-01 at 10.37.17 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EpA2WKbVjE7iMVoefsfytGowi9ynB8F8fXhiptpwWtaQvMRfubbHpDc5qUTthYsv7YL.jpeg)

This square brings back many memories from my youth, as does Bolívar Square, because it was my meeting place with friends, the spot where the bus stop used to be where I caught the bus to school. But later it became the place where I would sit and rest with my sister while our daughters were at ballet class.

>Esta plaza me trae muchos recuerdos de juventud, al igual que la plaza Bolívar, porque fue mi lugar de encuentro con amigos, el lugar dónde antes estaba la parada en la cuál tomaba el autobús para ir al colegio. Pero luego fue el lugar en el cuál me sentaba a descansar junto a mi hermana mientras nuestras hijas estaban en clases de ballet.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-01 at 10.37.19 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EpNnxJw4qNGcr1rEFMebEfNUm96M6US8KchzgPM6efsXDWUD2gKgyk6ASW1pGBKPzhJ.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-01 at 10.37.18 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EpC9sZUXaN9iVXoAWE2ptiorzpsxscKizZWTDgrgp195ZpV2zGgUeqb8F9NyiNRtX1c.jpeg)

That day, my eldest daughter and I were out shopping, so we stopped for a while to rest in the plaza before heading back home. But not before cooling off with a delicious ice cream because, honestly, the heat was unbearable that day. The sweet taste of the ice cream, the well-deserved rest, the beautiful view, and the coolness of the trees were all necessary to revive fond memories and recharge our batteries. That's why I think it's always necessary to preserve these spaces that are so important to the city; they're part of our identity.

>Ese día mi hija mayor y yo andábamos de copras, así que nos detuvimos por un rato a descansar en la plaza antes de retomar el camino a casa. Pero eso sí, no sin antes refrescarnos con un delicioso helado porque la verdad es que el calor estaba insoportable ese día. El sabor dulce del helado, el descanso merecido, la hermosa vista y el frescor de los árboles fueron necesarios para revivir bonitos recuerdos y recargar energías, por eso pienso que es necesario siempre preservar estos espacios que son tan importantes para la ciudad, es parte de nuestra idiosincrasia.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-01 at 10.37.19 AM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23vsSbyBMrLUE7yUFsky7pSgKZaRq17aoji2E8UFmBsTJyBu5HDNwwxfVuEJc6YkVzwbY.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-03-01 at 10.37.20 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/EonmUwTmNAfVVBpTdhszczxk5BEBv85yesaTgW4xkWgLbuwuSD7PHhu8ELe6Y7nc8Xa.jpeg)

Well friends, I'm saying goodbye, but not before sending you, as always, virtual kisses and hugs full of blessings 😘 🤗

>Bueno amigos me despido no sin antes enviarles como siempre besos y abrazos virtuales cargados de bendiciones 😘 🤗
![_Miniatura de Youtube Procrastinación Simple Dorado y Crema.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/245n5WzTfDjt8QuC1CfX1iGPu5crq9bsYhnHjwPHUAnBL93vKUMEPGEND9gUCyLLvHj4k.jpg)

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: March 10 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gc268742f5889cefcaa442ec49a1586b48a397690291e38b643798ec4eafcdf19e9ea6d6a0e1b3c15a15460d41a633380_640.jpg)
Hoy fue un día perfecto para caminar por la ciudad. El sol brillaba y la brisa era fresca, lo que hizo que cada paso fuera agradable. Mientras paseaba por el parque central, conocí a un hombre mayor que se sentaba en un banco. Tenía una sonrisa amable y me contó que solía ser fotógrafo, mostrando algunas de sus fotos más memorables en su viejo álbum. Sus historias sobre la ciudad eran fascinantes y me hizo apreciar aún más los rincones que estaba viendo. Más adelante, en una pequeña plaza, vi a un grupo de niños jugando con una pelota. Su risa era contagiosa y me recordaron la pureza de la infancia. También había una artista pintando un mural colorido en una pared; su trabajo era impresionante y estaba plasmando la energía vibrante de la ciudad en cada pincelada. Estos pequeños encuentros hacen que cada caminata sea única y me llenan de inspiración. ¡Definitivamente, volveré a ese parque! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Look at the lovely piece of women's hair wear. This is called a turban cap and I have made this lovely piece out of recycled clothes.
I'm sure you won't believe that a women skirt can be transformed into caps or something else with much usefulness. 



![1000160798.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23ynaeSXDPH3H2PJzidw2ywgR4m7Tdf7RpDgHE9CCZjLCdKwcgg3SbmfQZ1Uz6eE5HohH.jpg)


Lately turban caps, berrets and fascinators have been trending in the women fashion world and I love how all of these just sit well and beautifies a woman's head. I equally got tired of tying scarfs on my head all the time and wanted to wear this caps instead. A turban cap us very comfortable, especially when you have used a soft fabric to sew them.



![1000160723.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23zS9qGB6ijS8BRnbAoqjvbcyzznuatAw6qFuvdDAFie1KbUgf6WvCYyYKHv1cNSdhYJW.jpg)

I have this skirt here which I got tired of wearing and still doesn't feel like throwing away the fabric pieces yet. The fabric is torn in some places but still maintained it's bright color, I'm just not ready to dispose this yet as it will be useful to me for a good while. 


![1000160732.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23y94nQyBW5yf8rePH3wEqyGNYnQ7M8REk2xnK3MGN1PYjBzFDGG1JXXa6yegZQgSGhj6.jpg)

I cut of the torn parts and started construction. I didn't know the style of turban cap I desired so I checked up YouTube for some tutorials. From there I was able to get the cross designed which I loved and determined to replicate.





![1000160738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Eokci2ZuUsfWvuAKVzpwGYuRyaEsVYte2793ipZMXbkTzYcADCAuvSwWLwax97PUV2t.jpg)

The making process is simple. Once you get some piece of fabric of your desired length about 20\

length and width separately arranged as seen 

![1000160750.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23vsFsKW36gyKv1iN2AzE7EtFfqC5stwLAY619HtMkLqfk1mzUoUkyQUXQup3QwZDpQEZ.jpg)

Using a needle and thread, create a gathers of both joining them at the midpoint like this 



![1000160753.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23vhq39NUtAx8bnF12k51wMRBunktJQs6ViWcsHu2fAL9Ey9xs3pkpoFU1jCL3bkDu7Pe.jpg)

Next you cross each side against each other as seen.


![1000160759.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23uQkGczCyoHCfBnpgsEw4eG2vmBWWwCwba2QnUyjfzanGDcHwr7FxXYnh5SLH4R7bNpi.jpg)

Open them up and stitch together 

I had to stitch them up with a piece of paper over the surface of the fabric as the fabric is a kind difficult to sew unless with some form of lubrication. Needles doesn't bore through this fabric easily. 



![1000160765.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23tbnkDL1uH84ipgmAyJN6NhuenATYkovw7Pc1T2j2Ep11vuCX5eKSYsmFWxCvTiPPiAe.jpg)


That was done and this is the beautiful outcome of my turban cap.


![1000160777.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23zkjuPtugCFYp8CndX84JxgU7cekVPinQpvjWng7KWhjfh199S3Bgd8qHYEXwuLqjuig.jpg)

Majority of the turban making process was done with hands and needles making it an easy tutorial for anyone to do even if they do not have a sewing machine. 


![1000160813.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23zky6QetLg2xAUnSNsdZsXeAM6Bw7917SzREWURKfJjchnka4m2J5LoTvWbLrMTz5vHr.jpg)

----

![1000160789.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xyZZm7oeorqCqo4HYwS61Mzz5tFdvS6rFA7Bjgz5ty8P1bhp5BoisogZkDcb7cHF8WR.jpg)

You can reach out for the link to the tutorial page if you desire to replicate something like this for yourself.

title.title: Items Found- A General Cleaning Fulfilled at Last!
title.body:
We have long thought of having a general cleaning at home. Yet, many times it has always been postponed. But because were expecting visitors the next days, we have agreed to finally execute it. I'm not really sure if I sounded forced or motivated. Haha. With the help of my two younger brothers and mom, we started cleaning up as the sun shone. Also grateful for the fine weather.

![20260307_183941_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23w2wwXCSSJgb4juK1GwXjnvtHfx5KPYKsVWrLD3toeasg5iLzJ3frcYXUh9rQ7KPLLXZ.png)

Even before starting, I already felt confused where to begin with. There are lots of boxes and plastics we needed to sort. I even felt sad to discover that some of my valued documents and pictures were already damaged by mold and insects. Some were testpapers and projects I kept during my college years which was 10 years ago. I was still happy to see my test papers with high scores and that really made me reminisce how dedicated I was as a student, the sleepless nights I spent to finish making the projects that ended as a pile of junk now. They have not been touched for many years. Sadly, we threw a lot of books and stuff that were no longer readable.

![IMG_20251004_063349_060931.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23y8wfPY4iSPBCnuYSbWvbKBWHfQbnmNjV1DwQEmW1VGjU4Qy5FYSBSfD5RQXKbKzrTVz.jpg)

Few minutes after starting, we felt hungry. Timely, mom has finished preparing breakfast. She prepared fried rice mixed with some left over sausages and some cheese. It was yummy. We really ate a lot. After eating, all of us focused in continuing the work. 

![IMG_20251004_080310_055747.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23xAVU3igi8o4dNceXWNCjXvt84ekYPpw6QvoSQkWmMXgbC9Bk5KithA3ek8k34nZW6AE.jpg)

![IMG_20251004_072926_060026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23wC1UGAsyK46kjb6BcUZ87HTi9HGiHVqrHucWSXKvpWRW74Rt8E6sQudx9QHirVGuBGU.jpg)

I am so happy to see both of my brothers helping each other and dedicated to work as I just usually often see them fighting and too focused on their phones. They were able to take a break from screen today. They really played a big role in carrying heavy stuff and cleaning the walls and floors while mom and I were organizing and sorting things. Imagine sorting clothes, books and documents in a box after another.

![IMG_20251004_071155_060810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23wCFwRXYPrMzx33FRPXmHzXj2sXtKMiXS1iVx1FkBXejwo9SH6nMMQYRncryTdKtfZLt.jpg)

![IMG_20251004_075839_055853.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/Ep3gBqhXRiKv2Eyy8LSo7M72MS3EymvP5uCPKN9VeXdmap4MpQEpvPEQDy7QdTvJXUj.jpg)

![IMG_20251004_082350_055446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23wqpjeLTkFm8QQVzi8nmX7yPxToQZbDRZEphRwgmTCS8PZQ43byJViqPpS364xUoggpi.jpg)

I may have felt sad for some of my items that were already damaged but I also felt happy because I found some of my things that I have been looking for a long time. I was happy to find my favorite clothes which I thought were already given away. I hoenstly found a sack of my favorite clothes. I also found some usable slippers, shoes and bags that have some coins inside. I also found our very old family pictures, they maybe stained but they really brought back memories of my very young self. So I already found myself immersed in looking at old pictures that I forgot we need to finish quickly. Anyway, these finds actually made the cleaning worthwhile, fun and exciting.

We may felt really tired from the whole day cleaning. It took us late night buw we still were not done. We still have to finish few things the next day. Still, we felt accomplished and happy with the teamwork. Because of everybody’s hard work, we deserve a yummy dinner.

Thanks for taking some time to read. Until next time. Love Nes.

Pictures are mine and edited with Canva

title.title: Reasons / Five-minute daily message
title.body:
> We live surrounded by reasons. We seek them to justify our actions, to understand the world, and above all, to convince others and ourselves that our decisions have a solid foundation. Reason is the anchor we cast in the turbulent sea of ​​emotions, the attempt to bring order to the chaos of existence.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMDf3ZkrRwMzC4QDgvWfprmooBp2CShdQcs9Ssc9bajv/question_1136238_1280.webp)[fuente](Reasons / Five-minute daily message) From a young age, the question \

becomes our mantra. We want reasons for everything: why the sky is blue, why we should take a nap, or why someone left and never returned. This search is the engine of knowledge. Science, philosophy, and law are nothing more than colossal systems built on reasons, attempting to explain how reality works and regulate our coexistence. A court ruling, for example, is invalid if it is not justified, if it does not explain the reasons that support it. Without reasons, power would be pure arbitrariness.\n\nHowever, not all reasons are logical or universal. Some are emotional, deeply subjective. What reason can explain why we love one person and not another? We try to rationalize it, we list qualities, but deep down, the ultimate reason is usually something intangible, a \

that beats in our hearts. These reasons of the heart, which the intellect doesn't always understand, are often what move us most powerfully. Sometimes, paradoxically, the greatness of being human lies in acting without an apparent reason. In forgiving when the reasonable thing would be to punish, in being generous when logic dictates keeping to oneself, or in hoping against all hope. In those moments, we transcend the cold logic of cause and effect and enter the territory of freedom and compassion. Ultimately, reasons are the guide with which we try to navigate, but they shouldn't be confused with the territory itself. They are essential tools, but they don't exhaust the mystery of life. Because in the end, reasons help us live, but it is often the acts without reason that remind us why it's worthwhile. Credits: The image is my own. The translator used is Google Translate.

title.body: Greetings everyone! Last time we did talk about a mana cost, so today I played a battle where I was available with only 4 mana cost at last and one monster get fit in that. But before choosing him, I choose all my primary monsters which I need in the battle. It was easy for me to win but let's focus on the game and deck building.
/> Today's ruleset was STANDARD:- NO MODIFICATION. In this ruleset as usual you can use any monster and summoner with any ability you want.

/> Well the game was about 39 mana cost so you can say the mid-mana game. So I choose my strong monster firstly who can attack and defend the opponent moves. Of course lord and roc will be my primary monster I have choose them. after that I put melee monster in ahead to attack and defend. At last I left with 4 mana cost and I was having a option to select one monster so I choose Grand Consul Minion randomly he was very weak, but maybe he can help in game. Because he was fitting in my deck and even in the mana cost. Now let me share you the battle.

/> So as you can see every monsters fit equal to mana cost, and when game starts lord took out the first move and attack on opponent first position monster after that even opponent monster attack on dread but still he heal himself in this round and attack back again, while roc and lord both together make weak opponent monster and before this round ends dread attack on him and eliminate him from the battle. Well in this round even my last monster made a move but still let's see in the ahead rounds.

/> So as round starts lord attack on opponent first monster and after that roc attack on opponent monster so they both together again make monster weak. But after that opponent roc attack on dread and eliminate him from this round. But the best move I have seen, like my last monster helped little bit. He attack on opponent current first monster and eliminate him with his attacking power, well monster was also weak and he was standing on last health. But before this round ends opponent roc attack on my last monster and eliminate him from the battle. Well I was not having high expectations from him.

/> So now we both have roc and I have lord in the game, as this round starts lord attack on opponent roc and make him weak, after that even roc attack on opponent and eliminate him. Both together were doing a great job. So now there is only last monster left with opponent. Now the game is 1v2, and I know at this position I have won the game because he cannot single handedly eliminate my both strong monster.

/> So the last round and monster of the battle. As round starts my monster attack on him one by one and eliminate him from the battle without giving a single chance. Both lord and roc did a great job together and I really enjoyed this battle. Here I won the game from my opponent. Well at last i want to say that even though my last and week monster of the deck was present but he made a good move in between, generally all such type of monsters are been used to waste the opponent monsters move and take advantage. \*\*BATTLE LINK\*\* [https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl\_e4fba5f3f7ca906592125dd91c9f4683?ref=chinay04](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_e4fba5f3f7ca906592125dd91c9f4683?ref=chinay04)

title.title: Why Multi-Container Pod Patterns Are Difficult in the Linux Foundation CKAD Exam
title.body: The Linux Foundation CKAD exam is a hands-on certification exam that evaluates a developer’s ability to design, deploy, and manage applications in Kubernetes environments. Unlike cluster-focused exams, the Certified Kubernetes Application Developer exam is developer-oriented, focusing on application design, configuration, scaling, and troubleshooting. Candidates are tested through scenario-based tasks that reflect real-world challenges, making understanding complex Kubernetes concepts essential for success. If you want to excel in the CKAD exam, understanding multi-container pod patterns is critical.\n\n<h2 style=\

>Multi-Container Pod Patterns One of the most demanding topics in the CKAD exam is multi-container pod patterns. These pods allow multiple containers to run within a single Kubernetes pod, sharing network, storage, and resources efficiently. While widely used in real-world applications, they can be confusing for exam candidates due to the complexity of inter-container communication, lifecycle management, and proper configuration. Grasping these patterns not only helps in the Certified Kubernetes Application Developer exam but also prepares developers for real-world cloud-native projects.

>1. Understanding Multi-Container Design Patterns Candidates must understand different multi-container pod patterns to deploy applications effectively. Sidecar containers enhance or extend the main container’s functionality, such as logging or monitoring. Init containers perform setup tasks before the main application starts, ensuring the environment is ready. Ambassador containers act as proxies to external services, enabling communication between pods and services. Scenario-based [**Linux Foundation CKAD exam dumps**](https://www.pass4future.com/linux-foundation/exam/ckad) often test candidates on implementing these patterns, so clarity is essential to avoid misconfigured pods or failed deployments.

>2. Container Communication and Coordination Proper communication between containers in the same pod is a common challenge. Candidates need to configure shared volumes, environment variables, and ports correctly to allow seamless coordination. Communication errors can cause application failures and make troubleshooting more difficult under exam time constraints. Grasping these concepts ensures candidates can handle real-world microservice interactions in Kubernetes, which is a core skill validated by the Kubernetes Application Developer exam.

>3. YAML Configuration and Best Practice Writing accurate YAML specifications for multi-container pods is another frequent pain point. Candidates must manage nested structures, volume mounts, secrets, and environment variables for multiple containers simultaneously. Additionally, setting resource requests and limits for each container ensures the pod runs efficiently. Even minor syntax errors in YAML can prevent a pod from starting, which is why practicing YAML scenarios is essential for the Kubernetes Application Developer exam success.

>4. Observability and Troubleshooting The CKAD exam emphasizes practical skills in troubleshooting multi-container pods. Candidates must inspect logs from individual containers, check pod status, and identify misconfigurations in sidecar or init containers. Regular practice not only helps during the Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) exam but also strengthens a candidate’s ability to resolve real-world Kubernetes deployment issues efficiently. Using CKAD practice questions and labs can significantly boost confidence and problem-solving speed.

>How Linux Foundation CKAD Sample Questions Help Understand Multi-Container Pods Pass4Future provides Linux Foundation CKAD sample questions that are scenario-based, pushing candidates to apply their knowledge in practical contexts rather than memorizing theory. By working through these [**CKAD multi-container pod sample questions**](https://www.pass4future.com/questions/linux-foundation/ckad), learners improve their understanding of pod deployment, resource optimization, and YAML best practices. Practicing these CKAD exam questions identifies weak areas, enhances confidence, and prepares candidates to solve real-world application deployment challenges efficiently.

>Professional Value of Linux Foundation Kubernetes Application Developer Certification Achieving the Linux Foundation Kubernetes Application Developer Certification demonstrates that a developer can design and deploy complex, cloud-native applications in Kubernetes environments. Employers value CKAD certification as proof of practical skills, problem-solving ability, and readiness to manage multi-container pod deployments and other advanced application patterns. Grasping these concepts not only improves CKAD exam preparation but also enhances career opportunities in Kubernetes-focused development roles.

>Final Thoughts\n\nUnderstanding multi-container pod patterns is one of the most challenging yet rewarding aspects of the Linux Foundation CKAD exam. These concepts test a candidate’s ability to design, configure, and troubleshoot real-world Kubernetes applications. By understanding container patterns, communication, YAML best practices, and troubleshooting, candidates improve their chances of passing the Kubernetes Application Developer exam while gaining highly valued professional skills.

title.title: What Are the Safety Standards for Car Elevators in India?
title.body:
###

![CAR ELEVATORS (1).jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/e6883164f75ff4be1be73cf7a6128c235ed17e4c8887d6cd197e02b75ba3345f)



Car Elevators are becoming an important solution for modern buildings in India, where parking space is limited. These systems help move vehicles vertically between floors and are commonly installed in residential apartments, commercial complexes, and luxury homes. Because vehicles are involved, strict safety standards are essential to ensure reliable operation.

In India, elevator safety is generally regulated by state lift acts and guidelines from the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS). A Car Elevator must include essential safety features such as overload protection, emergency stop buttons, door interlocks, and advanced braking systems. These features help prevent accidents and ensure smooth operation during vehicle transportation.

Another important safety aspect is regular inspection and maintenance. A modern [Auto Elevator](https://atticoelevators.com/our-products/automobile-elevator/) should be serviced periodically by trained professionals to check cables, motors, control panels, and safety sensors. Routine maintenance significantly reduces mechanical failure and improves system lifespan.

Additionally, many modern buildings use a Vehicle Elevator with fire-resistant materials, alarm systems, and emergency communication devices for enhanced safety. Some projects also install a Parking Elevator with automatic controls and power backup to ensure uninterrupted operation during power outages.

By choosing certified manufacturers and following proper installation guidelines, building owners can ensure safe, efficient, and long-lasting elevator performance.

\#carelevators #carelevator #autoelevator #vehicleelevator #parkingelevator #elevatorsafety #smartparking

Lo que hace que esta presentación sea tan significativa para mí, es que el tema es de la autoría del Maestro Ramón Páez, quien además me acompaña en esta ocasión, pero esta vez dándonos una cátedra en la ejecución del arpa. Interpretar una obra frente a su propio creador siempre es un reto que se asume con mucho respeto y cariño. Decidimos trabajarla en el tono de Re Mayor, una tonalidad que permite que la melodía del arpa brille y que yo pueda expresar cada palabra de esta letra tan nostálgica y profunda. Es una canción que, como su nombre lo dice, nos invita a abrir esos recuerdos que guardamos en el alma. Tener al Maestro Ramón Páez en el arpa es un verdadero privilegio su sensibilidad para marcar cada nota hace que la interpretación fluya. Espero que puedan percibir esa conexión que logramos en esta sesión. Agradezco de corazón a todos los que se toman un momento para escuchar mi música, por sus comentarios que siempre me motivan a seguir mejorando y a la comunidad de Music por ser un espacio tan cálido para nosotros sin más que agregar, los dejo con este humilde aporte a nuestra cultura. Espero que lo disfruten tanto como nosotros al grabarlo Les envío un fuerte abrazo y todo mi agradecimiento. Con cariño, su amiga @Yoxibeth.

/> >Hello, dear Music community and friends of Hive. I hope you are having a great week. Today I feel very special because I want to share with you a gem of our folklore entitled El álbum de mis recuerdos (The Album of My Memories). What makes this presentation so meaningful to me is that the song was written by Maestro Ramón Páez, who is also accompanying me on this occasion, but this time giving us a master class in harp playing. >Performing a piece in front of its creator is always a challenge that is undertaken with great respect and affection. We decided to work on it in the key of D major, a key that allows the melody of the harp to shine and allows me to express every word of these nostalgic and profound lyrics. It is a song that, as its name suggests, invites us to open up those memories that we keep in our souls. Having Maestro Ramón Páez on the harp is a real privilege; his sensitivity in marking each note makes the performance flow. >I hope you can feel the connection we achieved in this session. I sincerely thank everyone who takes the time to listen to my music, for your comments that always motivate me to keep improving, and the Music community for being such a warm space for us. With nothing more to add, I leave you with this humble contribution to our culture. I hope you enjoy it as much as we did recording it. I send you a big hug and all my gratitude. With love, your friend @Yoxibeth.

## Hubert Kah - NDW

Ich bin jetzt kein Produzent, nur Amateur DJ gewesen in den Love Parade Early Days (andere Mucke), aufgewachsen mit Metal / Hard Rock - Schlager musste ich ertragen daheim - die NDW ebenso - aber da gab es schon gute Projekte- Kraftwerk war ja bereits davor Vorreiter für Techno - Hubert Kah galt immer als naja, aber die Sounds / Lieder sind meines Erachtens am besten produziert was Neue Deutsche Welle angeht und auch international kompatibel. 


https://youtu.be/j1lnVn-O2Cc?list=RDj1lnVn-O2Cc

## Was meinen die alten Säcke die das noch kennen?
Mit Engel07 konnte er damals sogar in den USD Charts landen, das hat sonst nur die NENA mit 99 Luftballons geschafft. 

https://youtu.be/Krr2nWif65Q

## NDW Songs die man kennt
Während ich schreibe denke ich nur, keiner von Euch weiss was das ist, noch weiss jemand was NDW war :-)? 

Bekannt ist er für Rosemarie (1982):

https://youtu.be/eoxN2UUA5ZI?list=RDeoxN2UUA5ZI

https://youtu.be/bhd21MwBOdk?list=RDrFW6eXc9NK4


## Nach NDW hat er einiges mehr produziert
Nur ist er einfach bekannt für NDW -  nicht sicher wer sich das anhört, leider schade, da es durchaus gut ist.

Mehr im Folgenden via Wikipedia:


## Über Hubert Kah


*[Quelle Wikipedia](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hubert_Kah)*

Er ist ähnlich wie ich nicht mehr der jüngste - hoffe es geht ihm gut! Künstler sind anders wie Blockchain Coder oder Fiannzgenies.
