title.title: Lie By Care Santos [Book Review] ESP/ENG
title.body:
![Red Black Modern Cinema Movie Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23tmBhUY2Jfm7evWUTFcFqFbnLMVqg7HZdiVdW46uY48eVx7FyK78yvfSWEdNaEXZLg6W.jpg)

This is a young adult novel by Care Santos that I found very relevant to our times, although it actually reflects a reality that has been developing since the internet became accessible to everyone. It tells the story of Xenia Buch, a girl who loves to study, always gets good grades, and constantly goes online to study. However, she also loves to read and discuss her favorite books with other readers. This leads her to a forum where she shares opinions about her favorite book: The Catcher in the Rye. It is there, in this online literary forum, that she meets Marcelo, a boy who seems amazing, with whom she connects emotionally almost immediately. However, as time goes on, she discovers some inconsistencies that don't go unnoticed, so she cautiously investigates and discovers the truth about \

: he isn't who he claims to be. His real name is Eric, and he's in a juvenile detention center accused of murdering a girl.\n\n>Esta es una novela de tipo juvenil de Care Santos que me pareció muy apropiada para estos tiempos, aunque realmente plantea una realidad que se ha venido viviendo desde que el internet se hizo accesible para todo el mundo. Nos cuenta la historia de Xenia Buch, una chica que ama estudiar, siempre tiene buenas calificaciones y constantemente entra en la web para estudiar, sin embargo también ama leer y discutir con otros lectores sobre sus libros favoritos, de esta manera llega a un foro en el cuál comparte opiniones sobre su libro favorito: El guardián entre el centeno, y es allí, en ese foro literario digital donde conoce a Marcelo, un chico que parece ser genial, con el cuál conecta emocionalmente casi de inmediato. No obstante, con el pasar del tiempo ella fue descubriendo algunas inconsistencias que no pasaron desapercibidas, así que ella fue investigando cautelosamente y descubrió la verdad sobre \

ya que él no era quién decía ser, su nombre real era Eric y estaba internado en un centro de reclusión juvenil acusado de haber asesinado a una chica.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23u67LHmgQipMF9uA7LXeX8ccGY5QaD6rB6d3rLWPpfH3pAgkKdyaMmkUQj1o4QK5mqP7.png)
[Fuente](https://edebe.com/prensa/verdad-care-santos-continuacion-mentira/)

This book exposes an alarming and truly frightening truth: the fragility of truth on social media. On the other side of the screen could be anyone of any age and with any intention, seeking even the slightest opportunity. It's up to each individual to decide how much of their life they want to expose online, keeping in mind that the more information they provide, the more vulnerable they become. The internet is a double-edged sword, so the book warns of the caution that must be exercised, not only regarding personal data but also feelings and trust. It emphasizes the importance of recognizing warning signs that could be crucial to avoiding negative situations in the future.

>Este libro expone una verdad alarmante y que da realmente miedo, y es la fragilidad de la verdad en las redes sociales, al otro lado de la pantalla puede estar cualquier persona de cualquier edad y con cualquier intención buscando una mínima posibilidad, así que ya depende de cada quién decidir que tanto de sus vidas quieren exponer en internet, teniendo en cuenta que mientras más información suministren más vulnerables se vuelven. El internet es un arma de doble filo, así que el libro advierte sobre la cautela que se debe tener, pero no solo en lo que se refiere a datos personales, sino también a los sentimientos y la confianza, saber reconocer señales de alerta que podrían ser cruciales para evitar malas situaciones a futuro.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/AJoH1TWPfEkWjYL6yUzRyL7KmfMGdk8YmWqC3k5HrE7iemTeuJ6Y8snGhtAjBGR.png)
[Fuente](https://www.ivoox.com/mentira-care-santos-audios-mp3_rf_53025134_1.html)

Teenagers often magnify feelings and emotions, intensifying them too much, which can make them extremely vulnerable and a target for any potential danger. But the worst part is that they don't perceive it as such; for them, the love they feel is enough to protect them from any harm. The opinions of others are irrelevant, and they consider that they are exaggerating.

>Los adolescentes a menudo magnifican los sentimientos y las emociones, los intensifican demasiado y esto podría volvernos extremadamente vulnerables y blanco de cualquier posible peligro, pero lo peor de todo es que no lo perciben como tal, para ellos el amor que sienten es suficiente para protegerlos de cualquier mal, la opinión de otros sobra y consideran que están exagerando.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/AK2HKJBsVjRWe5N6LuZ1Kj1GSv95SZeTnXQJRc11e8eRbgktemx71YxtdUfapyq.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/703968985480847214/)

But just as the book addresses the fragility of truth on social media, the dangers of excessive trust, and all that, it also raises other important issues that must be taken into account. I'm referring, first and foremost, to social inequality: we must recognize that we all have very different realities; some have opportunities, and others simply don't. This doesn't justify our actions, but we must understand that it is a significant factor. We also have the human capacity to change when there is a genuine will to do so. Not everyone is \

First, we must analyze the context and discover if the person truly shows signs of wanting to adapt and find a place in society. This leads us to the final point: second chances. The novel invites us not to judge prematurely and close doors; on the contrary, it calls us to empathy.

\n\n>Pero así como el libro nos habla acerca de la fragilidad de la verdad en redes sociales, del peligro detrás de la confianza excesiva y todo eso, también plantea otros temas importantes que se deben tomar muy en cuenta, me refiero en primer lugar a la desigualdad social: hay que tomar en cuenta que todos tenemos realidades muy diferentes, algunos cuentan con oportunidades y otros simplemente no, esto no justifica nuestras acciones pero hay que entender que es algo influyente, también tenemos la capacidad del ser humano para cambiar cuando realmente existe voluntad para ello, no todos son \

primero hay que analizar el contexto y descubrir si realmente esta persona presenta síntomas de querer adaptarse y encontrar un espacio en la sociedad, y esto nos lleva a el último punto, las segundas oportunidades, la novela nos invita a no juzgar a priori, y cerrar las puertas, al contrario, nos llama a la empatía.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wMYampZzDCJX3bwisZUeKBjk5PB4H8ZAFgDBN8WYVm3jsRgFKNbNNgBZHY4L8Dc2xxV.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/458452437083518728/)

The pace of the story is quite dynamic and the narrative structure is very interesting; at times it is epistolary (in the form of letters) and offers us different perspectives of the characters, which gives us more information and obviously more context (like the two sides of the coin). In this way, readers can understand both characters, their reasons, and their decisions.

>El ritmo de la historia es bastante dinámico y la estructura narrativa muy interesante, en algunas ocasiones es de tipo epistolar (en forma de cartas) y nos ofrece perspectivas diferentes de los personajes, lo que nos ofrece mayor información y obviamente más contexto (como las dos caras de la moneda) de esta manera los lectores podemos entender a ambos personajes, sus razones y sus decisiones.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/242rq9mwo4huU5uPw746MxwzQTtoCcxXQq4RkeV9fjWj5wL1KV3Xowzcn74ir7XsMhZVa.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/803118546059220779/)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post
![Miniatura de YouTube Ilustrativo Niños Naranja Amarillo Blanco.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wggpJxc7pQATGzLcLTp9GjDNd3VfauwAPHDRxoZ8EmXsU7zoEGH9nhDKFtEYUji1Fvf.jpg)

I made the cover and farewell image in Canva

>La imagen de portada y despedida la realicé en Canva.

title.title: The Waiting Room
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRpFFuRJTvaAw39KoQmdVCLpTHtp1BM5RfYRBBqkXXDZH/1773136941561.jpg)[Image source](https://pixabay.com/photos/galleon-rio-de-janeiro-airport-1666084/
The cold from the plastic chair hit my spine.)

That was the first thing I noticed when I sat down. It was too cold. Too cold to be the Lagos I knew. It chilled through my trousers, through the Lagos heat outside which had been unbearable for me just twenty minutes ago. 

I had noticed long ago that the hospital seats had a way of doing that. Maybe it was because of the big standing AC mounted on the side of the tiny waiting room. Stripping the warmth from everything and the natural air from everything. From the air. From the chairs. And even the faces of the people sitting right there.

I reclined in the chair and let my gaze hit the ceiling. I was waiting for the doctor.

I shifted my gaze to the young woman beside me, clutching a rosary so tightly her knuckles had gone pale. Beside her was an old man staring at the floor as if the answer to everything was written in the tiles. Far across him was a teenage boy scrolling through his phone with eyes that were not really seeing anything. 

We were all strangers. But in that waiting room, we had the same kind of prayer and the same expectation. A group of strangers who had handed someone they loved to a set of hands they did not know, behind a door they could not enter, but believed were in better hands, were now asked to simply wait.

My mother had collapsed that morning, making ogi in the kitchen, which, she would sell just outside our gate. It has been her usual routine every Saturday morning. I remember listening to her hum a song I did not recognise, but I was very sure I had heard it all my life. Then there was a sound. Not a crash. Not a shout. Just a soft, sudden silence. Luke a big bag of rice dropped in the floor forcefully. It was louder than any noise. 

I rushed to the kitchen only to find her on the kitchen floor, the pot still on the fire, steam rising above her like a quiet prayer going somewhere she had already gone ahead of me.

I remember riding in the back of the taxi I called with her,  holding her hand, squeezing at intervals, and calling her name. 

“Stay with me. *Ogadinma* (All will be well)” Her fingers were limp in mine. I kept squeezing, like I was trying to push life into her through mine, as if life was a thing that could be transferred by touch. 

In the waiting room, I prayed. Not the organised kind, not with folded hands or bowed head. I prayed the broken way, hoarded tears, silent screams, fragments of words I barely understood, half-sentences that made sense to my God and me. Promises I had no business making. 

“Take anything. Take everything. Just let her stay. She's all I've got.”

Two hours passed. Maybe three. I couldn't really tell if time was moving at all. Does time even move normally in a waiting room? It was as if time was stretching and contracting like our breaths.

Then, the door finally opened. It was the doctor attending to my mum. His face was the careful kind, not devastated, not scared but relieved. 

“She survived”.  He said. 

I couldn't speak. I just nodded and let my hoarded tears flow. 

“The stroke had been significant but she is stable now. She just needs time. She would recover.”


I nodded at each one as if I understood, as if language still meant what it used to mean.

“Can I see her?”

He smiled and opened the door for me. I went in.

And there she was, lying against white pillows, a drip in her arm, machines beside her speaking in beeps. She was alive. I could see her chest rising and falling. That movement spoke volumes to reassure me. 

I pulled a chair and sat beside her. Then I  took her hand again.

She turned tiredly and looked at me. But I was sure she did not see me. Maybe she did, but not fully. Not the way she used to look at me. That look that says

*I know exactly who you are, and I am proud of you, and you will always be my child.* 

It wasn't there. It was gone. Replaced with something softer, searching my face, like a person standing in a familiar room after all the furniture had been moved.

Surprisingly, she said my name. But her voice was void of life.

“Mama”. I replied, smiling, holding her hand tighter. “I am here”.

I knew I was and would never leave her eight but the realisation that sometimes the person you love survives, and you are grateful, deeply, completely grateful. But still there's a grief you feel. Not for them. But for the version of them that existed before that you are no longer sure you will see exactly that way again.


Mama was here. But looking at her, it was evident that a part of her was somewhere else I could not just follow. And so I decided to wait again. No matter how long it would take. 


This time, not in cold plastic chairs or watching doors. But beside her, every day, in the long and quiet work of being present. Waiting for her to find her way back to herself. And even if she doesn't find her old self, I was willing to wait until she finds whatever new version of herself.

title.title: [ESP/ENG] En paz conmigo mismo / At peace with myself
title.body:
> La paz interior no es un destino lejano ni un premio reservado para unos pocos; es un estado que se cultiva día a día, en los gestos más sencillos y en las decisiones más conscientes. Estar en paz conmigo mismo significa reconciliarme con mi historia, aceptar mis luces y mis sombras, y reconocer que cada paso, incluso los que me hicieron tropezar, han contribuido a la persona que soy hoy. No se trata de negar los errores, sino de aprender de ellos, de mirarlos con compasión y entender que fueron parte de un proceso de crecimiento permanente, de luchar por llegar a cumplir sueños y proyectos.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf7wikM8FtnWone16gvAbq7LHwFMruyq7sMKru4MCLEsX/img_20251211_wa0065.jpg) La paz comienza en el silencio. En esos momentos en que me detengo, respiro profundo y escucho lo que late dentro de mí. Allí descubro que no necesito competir con nadie, que mi valor no depende de comparaciones externas, sino de la autenticidad con la que vivo. Cuando dejo de exigirme perfección y me permito ser humano, con mis vulnerabilidades y mis fortalezas, surge una calma que me envuelve y me recuerda que estoy exactamente donde debo estar. Estar en paz conmigo mismo también implica soltar cargas que no me pertenecen. Muchas veces he llevado sobre los hombros expectativas ajenas, miedos heredados o culpas que no eran mías. Aprender a dejarlas ir es un acto de liberación. No puedo controlar lo que otros piensen de mí, pero sí puedo decidir cómo me relaciono con esas opiniones. La paz se fortalece cuando elijo no vivir para complacer, sino para ser fiel a mi esencia. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbRbhUU9z9fFRR6uizLZ5a8FWmuPRCAwJnSJEpKsEJEnV/img_20240519_180528.jpg) La gratitud es otra llave que abre las puertas de la serenidad. Al agradecer lo que tengo, lo que soy y lo que he vivido, incluso lo difícil, transformo la mirada. La gratitud me enseña que cada día trae una oportunidad de valorar lo pequeño: una conversación sincera, un amanecer, un gesto de cariño. En esos detalles se esconde la grandeza de la vida, y reconocerlos me conecta con una paz profunda, que no depende de circunstancias externas. Por supuesto, la paz no significa ausencia de conflicto. La vida siempre traerá desafíos, pérdidas y momentos de incertidumbre. Pero cuando estoy en paz conmigo mismo, esos desafíos no me quiebran; me invitan a crecer. La serenidad interior me da la fuerza para enfrentar lo inevitable con dignidad, para aceptar lo que no puedo cambiar y para actuar con valentía en lo que sí está en mis manos. La paz es, en ese sentido, una forma de resistencia: un espacio inviolable que me sostiene aun en medio de la tormenta. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRAHPvXr6rrLhs81jnSQ8oWYLhoXoskD486CbsZQ789vK/img_20240211_123907.jpg) Finalmente, estar en paz conmigo mismo es un acto de amor. Amor hacia mi historia, hacia mi cuerpo, hacia mis emociones, hacia mis sueños. Es reconocer que merezco descanso, ternura y respeto. Es abrazar mi singularidad y caminar con confianza, sabiendo que no necesito ser otro para ser valioso. En esa aceptación plena, descubro que la paz no es un lugar al que llego, sino un camino que recorro cada día, con humildad y esperanza. Créditos: Las imágenes son de mi propiedad. El traductor utilizado es de Google. ENGLISH Inner peace is not a distant destination nor a prize reserved for a select few; it is a state cultivated daily, in the simplest gestures and the most conscious decisions. Being at peace with myself means reconciling with my past, accepting my strengths and weaknesses, and recognizing that every step, even those that made me stumble, has contributed to the person I am today. It's not about denying mistakes, but about learning from them, looking at them with compassion, and understanding that they were part of a continuous growth process, of striving to achieve dreams and projects. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf7wikM8FtnWone16gvAbq7LHwFMruyq7sMKru4MCLEsX/img_20251211_wa0065.jpg) Peace begins in silence. In those moments when I stop, take a deep breath, and listen to what beats within me. There I discover that I don't need to compete with anyone, that my worth doesn't depend on external comparisons, but on the authenticity with which I live. When I stop demanding perfection of myself and allow myself to be human, with my vulnerabilities and my strengths, a calm arises that envelops me and reminds me that I am exactly where I'm meant to be. Being at peace with myself also means letting go of burdens that aren't mine. Many times I've carried other people's expectations, inherited fears, or guilt that wasn't mine. Learning to let them go is an act of liberation. I can't control what others think of me, but I can decide how I relate to those opinions. Peace is strengthened when I choose not to live to please others, but to be true to my essence. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbRbhUU9z9fFRR6uizLZ5a8FWmuPRCAwJnSJEpKsEJEnV/img_20240519_180528.jpg) Gratitude is another key that unlocks the doors to serenity. By being grateful for what I have, who I am, and what I have experienced, even the difficult moments, I transform my perspective. Gratitude teaches me that each day brings an opportunity to appreciate the small things: a sincere conversation, a sunrise, a kind gesture. The greatness of life is hidden in these details, and recognizing them connects me to a profound peace that doesn't depend on external circumstances. Of course, peace doesn't mean the absence of conflict. Life will always bring challenges, losses, and moments of uncertainty. But when I am at peace with myself, these challenges don't break me; they invite me to grow. Inner serenity gives me the strength to face the inevitable with dignity, to accept what I cannot change, and to act courageously in what I can. Peace, in that sense, is a form of resistance: an inviolable space that sustains me even in the midst of the storm. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRAHPvXr6rrLhs81jnSQ8oWYLhoXoskD486CbsZQ789vK/img_20240211_123907.jpg) Ultimately, being at peace with myself is an act of love. Love for my story, for my body, for my emotions, for my dreams. It is recognizing that I deserve rest, tenderness, and respect. It is embracing my uniqueness and walking with confidence, knowing that I don't need to be someone else to be valuable. In that complete acceptance, I discover that peace is not a destination, but a path I walk each day, with humility and hope. Credits: The images are my own. The translator used is Google Translate.

Got up this morning a little tired. Not sure why.

Went to bed early. Slept real good. Deep sleep. Then woke up around 2:30 AM wide awake but still feeling tired. If that makes sense. Body says get up. Brain says you're exhausted. They need to get on the same page.

Hitting the coffee hard this morning. And I'm having a chicken and cheese sandwich for breakfast. Yeah that's a little weird. But it works for me. Not everything has to make sense. Sometimes you just eat what sounds good.

Got some planning to do today for that business pivot I talked about a while back. It's a big shift. Should give me more grace with my health challenges and leverage more of my strengths. Still working out the details.

Headed south to Fort Knox later today. Got some administrative stuff to take care of there related to my military retirement. Usually about a 35-40 minute drive but with all the detours and construction lately it's closer to an hour. The Army is pretty good about helping out this ole' Marine. Doesn't matter what branch you served. They take care of veterans. Appreciate that.

Hoping to get a picture of the Gold Depository while I'm there. You can usually see it from a distance on certain parts of the base. We'll see if I can get a good shot.

When we get back it'll probably be a little rest and then some small chores around the house. Nothing major. Just a regular Sunday.

Hope yours is a good one.

title.title: Learned and Unlearned AI
title.body: Hive Learners, I want to thank you for organizing this contest. I am optimistic that everyone is in good health and hipness. I am participating in this event. Peace in the world belongs to every country.\n\n

>Our daily experiences are also where learning occurs, not just in school. All individuals develop their own hobbies, talents, and abilities to solve problems and adapt to new technologies. The newest technologies are causing an expansion in learning approaches in this modern time, as we are fully aware of. The internet and digital platforms have become more accessible.

The new approach has had a significant impact on opportunities like vlogging, digital marketing, content creation, cryptocurrency investments, and online enterprise, as it allows them to reach wider audiences and connect with consumers globally. I have used artificial intelligence for learning and utilize it. I am familiar with its capabilities. It helps me with drafting emails, editing documents, transcribing text, and creating certificates. I've come to expect AI to complete tasks within minutes, even if I haven't fully developed the ideas myself. If someone requires me to type a document, I only need to take a picture and the AI will turn it into typed text without any delay. What are the positive and negative impacts of AI on us? Answering this question is crucial. In our school's curriculum, it was a requirement to express ideas through creativity and use our own words. To break the habit of using AI frequently and avoid plagiarism, while also honoring the originality of others' work. The teacher is responsible for ensuring that students complete their research papers, drawings, presentations, and assignments on their own, instead of relying on AI. The need to thoroughly check every student's work increases the workload for teachers. The number of students in each classroom makes it challenging for a teacher to identify and monitor every student's work. Having the freedom to be unique at my own pace is more satisfying. Even though AI tools can generate content quickly and easily, tasks can still be finished on time. Another concern is that some companies are cutting their workforce because of the use of AI systems to perform tasks that were traditionally done by humans. Last night, my friend informed me that four of her colleagues who specialize in data analysis were required to resign due to the better performance of AI in their job. Losing her job is something she is frightened about as well. If AI can do things as human do. The people find this alarming. I do not want to see government leaders becoming AI in the future. If AI will be here for the longest time, what can we do to address this happened? We should go back and unlearn how AI works. This development is raising questions about the future of work and how technological advances affect employment and creativity in our society. It's very important for us to maintain creativity, think of ways to shorten things, and human labor is smarter than AI. Humans are capable of doing things without any restrictions. Reduce the use of AI, which is constantly changing. title.title: Sea ​Sunset
title.body: > The sun was slowly descending towards the horizon, painting the sky in golden hues. The waves gently kissed the sandy shore, leaving trails of white foam in their wake. It was a scene straight out of a postcard - breathtaking beauty that can only be found on the seaside. In the distance, a group of seagulls soared through the air, cawing happily as they flew. They seemed to dance with the sun, catching its last rays before disappearing behind the horizon. The wind rustled, carrying with it the salty scent of the ocean. It was a peaceful evening, perfect for contemplation and reflection. ![se (1).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbgLxdDX9Kr5U7dcfzubkUANo4CRQs46eoo6E3vK4HNM4/se%20(1).jfif) On the shore, a young couple walked hand in hand, their laughter echoing in the quiet atmosphere. Everyone had their own story, but we all shared one thing in common - our love for this beautiful sea sunset. The sun finally dipped below the horizon, bathing the world in soft, warm light. The sky became a kaleidoscope of colors - purple, blue and indigo flowing into each other, creating a mesmerizing spectacle. ![se (3).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYPmxcxNRdUEe1kJBnPkSJdXft2e5V6NNMNDUSwsLBtym/se%20(3).jfif) The sea sunset was like a quiet whisper, a reminder of the beauty that exists just beyond our everyday vision. It was a moment of peace, an opportunity to escape the hustle and bustle of life and just be present in the present moment. And while the world around us continued its relentless course, we kept that little bit of magic to ourselves, knowing we could always come back here when we needed a reminder of the wonders of life. ![se (4).jfif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZYGbFcSYr6QdJWfX6qxE4osARDQ1qWjngeivzv984j6S/se%20(4).jfif)

title.title: The cat is caught where the rabbit is trapped
title.body: Hello friends.\n\nThere is a Burmese saying, \

It means that a hunter has set a trap to catch a rabbit, but has caught a cat.
This is an indirect way of saying that what is intended and what is achieved are not the same.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWAQgVEKAhkmbGW4p5eo4L1eubH2fWVwdzEdc5MkN6vaQ/1773136020236.jpg)

I have had a similar experience.
Rats have been coming into my house and eating some of my belongings, so I have been trapping them. I have caught more than 10 rats in the trap.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaqzUSvKgBgbkXiSQtfvgeLybjhjjXPxrvaS4zfsX1hw9/1773136077528.jpg)

This time, it wasn't a mouse that was caught in the trap, but a squirrel.
So I took a picture of the squirrel in the trap, and it reminded me of the saying, \

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUoHZGvKTsSB1D9NfYVNvYSSSmBZBu9xEaC6ZBpj25dhS/1773136112049.jpg)

မင်္ဂလာပါ မိတ်ဆွေတို့ရေ။

ယုန်ထောင် ကြောင်မိ၊ ဟူသော မြန်မာဆိုစကား ရှိပါသည်။
မုဆိုးက ယုန် ကို ထောင်ချောက်ဆင်ဖမ်းရန် စီစဉ်ထားရာ၌ ကြောင်ကို ဖမ်းမိထားခြင်းကို ဆိုလိုပါသည်။
ရည်ရွယ်ရာ နှင့် ရရှိတာ မတူသည့်အကြောင်းကို သွယ်ဝိုက်ကာ ပြောဆိုသော စကားဖြစ်ပါသည်။

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTk1f4sgm3V7dKJvzDjuD4Pwi2624xYBuovEDxkX7rTgo/1773136136944.jpg)

ယခု ထိုဆိုစကား ကဲ့သို့ အဖြစ်မျိုး ကျွန်တော် တွေ့ကြုံခဲ့ရပါသည်။
ကျွန်တော်၏ အိမ်အတွင်းသို့ ကြွက်များ ဝင်ရောက်ကာ ပစ္စည်းအချို့ကို ကိုက်ဖြတ်တတ်သောကြောင့် ကျွန်တော်သည် ထောင်ချောက် ဖြင့် ကြွက်ကို ထောင်ဖမ်းထားတတ်ပါသည်။
ထောင်ချောက် ထဲ၌ ဖမ်းမိသည့် ကြွက် ၁၀ ကောင် ကျော်ခဲ့ပါပြီ။

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGwrqcC2sMLx9ofQQWYPwT7KNKdejv6Vzn8VH417Meni/1773136190362.jpg)

ယခုတစ်ကြိမ်မှာတော့ ထောင်ချောက် ထဲ၌ ကြွက် မဟုတ်ဘဲ ရှဉ့်တစ်ကောင်ကို ဖမ်းမိနေခဲ့ပါသည်။
သို့ဖြစ်၍ ကျွန်တော်လည်း ထောင်ချောက် ထဲက ရှဉ့် ကို ဓာတ်ပုံရိုက်ယူခဲ့ပြီး ယုန်ထောင် ကြောင်မိ ဟူသော ဆိုစကားကို သတိရမိခဲ့ပါသည်။

title.title: @Indiaunited Contest - Theme: What Do You Think About the Wars Happening Around the World?
title.body:
My response to the @Indiaunited Contest - Theme: What Do You Think About the Wars Happening Around the World?

<center>🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻🌻</center>

Who can ever have a positive feeling about a war situation? Personally I feel that wars are nothing but a result of a few people's obsession for power and control and this is exactly what is happening right now. A few leaders from one part of the world suddenly decides to take matters in their hands even though it's not connected to them and the result of it is nothing but major destructions, disruptions and displacements. The war may get over in a month or two but the effect of this war is going to show up for a long long time in every person's life, even if they are not in that particular zone. 

Look at Middle East, where one thought was the safest haven on earth is now under war crises. Everything becomes unpredictable in the condition of war and not only the people fighting the war but every single person gets impacted. In a war situation the financial markets crash, the oil prices start soaring up which not only impacts the prices of petrol and diesel but it has a effect on every single commodity. The daily necessities prices go up, there is a steep inflation, and it all depends on which regions are directly and indirectly impacted from the war. The current war is going to impact almost every country in the world, because the strait of Hormuz is the route for majority of the country to Import and Export goods. For those who are not reliant on these shipping routes are the ones who will see lesser impact, provided they are not even dependent on the air routes. 

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSFT6dwc7JaAUwyJY5vL1XRLSqTRax1r2gZtTUqbWTjCx/image.png)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/armageddon-disaster-destruction-war-2721568/)

No common person wants a war from any part of the world, but still they happen because a few people at the top decides how the world should operate. They want the world to run on their whims and fancies. The end result of the war is nothing but destruction and disruption. Millions of people have to pay the cost of the war in some or the other way. Even the basic necessities can become luxury as a result of the war for some people. 

I would understand a situation of war being done to counter terrorism but a situation of war to gain geopolitical control is nothing but power obsession which at no cost is justified. It only means that the leader is maniac and can go to any extent to show their power. We have heard the impact of World War II with Hitler's obsession and all it brought was huge loss of lives and destruction of infrastructure. The world is much more advanced from then to now and now we have nuclear weapons which can be more devastating and lead to not only destruction but also harm lives for the future generations with the harmful spread of toxicity released from these deadly weapons. 

 War is never a solution to combat any problem, I do not believe it to be even the last solution. A war in any part of the world is a war on humanity and those carrying it out are no humans.

***Thank you for visiting my blog.*** 👼🏻👼🏻💖💖🌹🌺🌸

title.title: AI News Daily — March 10, 2026
title.body:
# AI News Daily — March 10, 2026

*Your daily briefing on the models, tools, and moves shaping the AI industry.*

---

## 1. ⚖️ Anthropic Sues Pentagon to Block \
Blacklisting\n\nIn what may be the most consequential legal move in AI governance history, Anthropic filed two lawsuits on March 9 to block the Pentagon's attempt to label it a national security \

The designation — officially handed to Anthropic on March 3 — followed Trump's February executive order directing federal agencies to cease using Anthropic's products. Anthropic argues the blacklisting isn't about genuine national security concerns but is retaliatory: punishment for the company's public advocacy against using Claude for autonomous weapons and mass domestic surveillance.\n\nThe first suit, filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, claims the designation violates First Amendment protections by penalizing Anthropic for protected speech. The second challenges the procedural fairness of the designation itself. Anthropic executives say in court filings that the blacklisting could cut 2026 revenue by multiple billions of dollars and damage its reputation as a trusted enterprise partner. The company stressed it is not trying to force the government to work with it — only to prevent officials from using the \

label as a political weapon against companies that disagree with Pentagon policy.

This is the sharpest test yet of whether an AI lab can maintain safety principles under direct government pressure. Anthropic's willingness to sue rather than capitulate sets a precedent the entire industry will be watching closely.

**Sources:**
- https://www.reuters.com/world/anthropic-sues-block-pentagon-blacklisting-over-ai-use-restrictions-2026-03-09/
- https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/09/anthropic-trump-claude-ai-supply-chain-risk.html
- https://www.axios.com/2026/03/09/anthropic-sues-pentagon-supply-chain-risk-label

---

## 2. 🤝 OpenAI & Google Researchers Publicly Back Anthropic in Pentagon Lawsuit

In a rare display of cross-company solidarity, researchers and employees from OpenAI, Google DeepMind, and other labs publicly backed Anthropic's lawsuit against the Pentagon's blacklisting. The support — appearing in public statements and social media posts — signals that many in the AI industry view the Pentagon's \
designation as a dangerous template that could be applied to any company that refuses unlimited military use of its technology.\n\nBloomberg's editorial board weighed in with a piece titled *\

*, arguing that Anthropic is breaking Silicon Valley's mold of shipping fast and patching problems later. The backing from competitors is significant: it suggests a fragile but real industry consensus that AI safety principles shouldn't be treated as a disqualifying liability. If the designation stands, every AI lab faces pressure to pre-emptively agree to any government use case or risk being labeled a risk themselves.

**Sources:**
- https://www.storyboard18.com/brand-makers/openai-google-researchers-back-anthropic-lawsuit-against-pentagon-over-supply-chain-risk-label-91671.htm
- https://www.freepressjournal.in/tech/ai-rivals-unite-openai-google-deepmind-employees-back-anthropic-in-pentagon-lawsuit
- https://www.bloomberg.com/opinion/articles/2026-03-10/anthropic-has-brought-something-new-to-ai-the-power-to-say-no

---

## 3. 🛠️ Claude Code Launches Multi-Agent Code Review for Pull Requests

Anthropic shipped a genuinely useful developer feature this week: **Code Review for Claude Code**, a multi-agent system that automatically reviews pull requests, flags logic errors, catches security issues, and helps teams keep up with the mounting volume of AI-generated code. Internal tests reportedly tripled the rate of meaningful code review feedback compared to human-only review cycles.

The design is clever: rather than a single model pass, Code Review dispatches parallel specialized agents — one for logic, one for security, one for style — and synthesizes their findings into structured PR comments. This matters practically because developers using agentic tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor are already shipping far more code per engineer than was possible a year ago, and manual review is the new bottleneck. The tool is available to Claude for Enterprise and Pro users. For teams already living in Claude Code workflows, this closes a significant gap and makes the case for staying inside that ecosystem more compelling.

**Sources:**
- https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/09/anthropic-launches-code-review-tool-to-check-flood-of-ai-generated-code/
- https://www.zdnet.com/article/claude-code-review-ai-agents-pull-request-bug-detection/
- https://thenewstack.io/anthropic-launches-a-multi-agent-code-review-tool-for-claude-code/

---

## 4. 👩‍💼 OpenAI Robotics Lead Caitlin Kalinowski Resigns Over Pentagon Deal

OpenAI's head of hardware and robotics, **Caitlin Kalinowski**, resigned over the weekend, publicly citing concerns about the company's \

agreement with the U.S. Department of Defense. In posts on social media, Kalinowski said ethical lines were crossed and that she couldn't continue in her role given where OpenAI had landed on military use. She had been leading OpenAI's push into physical AI — hardware, robotics, and embodied systems.

The resignation is a significant data point: it's not an anonymous leak or a disgruntled junior employee, but a high-profile executive who was shaping OpenAI's hardware roadmap walking out the door in protest. Combined with earlier employee unease, it reveals a deepening internal divide at OpenAI between those who see the Pentagon deal as pragmatic expansion and those who see it as a mission betrayal. For developers watching where these companies are heading, the contrast with Anthropic's lawsuit couldn't be starker: one company's employees are leaving over military alignment, the other's is suing to prevent it.

**Sources:**
- https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/07/openai-robotics-lead-caitlin-kalinowski-quits-in-response-to-pentagon-deal/
- https://www.npr.org/2026/03/08/nx-s1-5741779/openai-resigns-ai-pentagon-guardrails-military
- https://www.therobotreport.com/openai-robotics-head-resigns-over-pentagon-deal/

---

## 5. 🪟 Microsoft Ships MCP C# SDK v1.0 — .NET Enters the AI Agent Ecosystem

Microsoft quietly shipped a big developer milestone last week: **v1.0 of the official MCP (Model Context Protocol) C# SDK**, released March 5 on the .NET Blog. The release brings full support for the 2025-11-25 MCP Specification, plus enhanced OAuth 2.1 authorization flows, icon support for tools and resources, incremental scope consent, and a clean HTTP transport layer built on ASP.NET Core.

This matters because .NET is the backbone of enterprise software — finance, healthcare, logistics, manufacturing. Until now, MCP adoption was concentrated in Python and TypeScript ecosystems. With a production-ready C# SDK, teams running massive enterprise codebases on .NET can now build MCP-compatible AI agents that plug into Claude, Codex, and other MCP-aware tools without leaving their existing stack. Google shipped a Java SDK for MCP around the same time. The message: MCP is past the experimental phase and becoming infrastructure.

**Sources:**
- https://devblogs.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-v10-of-the-official-mcp-csharp-sdk/
- https://www.infoq.com/news/2026/03/mcp-csharp-v1/
- https://dotnetcopilot.com/mcp-c-sdk-released-enabling-ai-tool-integration-for-net-developers/

---

## 6. 💻 M5 MacBook Air Ships Tomorrow — Apple Intelligence Hardware Wave Arrives

The **Apple M5 MacBook Air** ships tomorrow (March 11) — the most AI-capable MacBook Air ever, and the device Apple is positioning as the on-device AI workhorse for developers and creators. Pre-orders opened March 4. The M5 chip brings 2× faster SSD read/write compared to M4, a 40% boost in Neural Engine performance, and up to 32GB unified memory in the base configuration. Pricing starts at $1,099 for the 13-inch and $1,299 for the 15-inch, available in Sky Blue, Midnight, Starlight, and Silver.

For AI developers, the M5's Neural Engine bump is the headlining spec — local inference on quantized models like Llama, Mistral, and Phi gets meaningfully faster, and Apple's forthcoming Core AI framework (replacing Core ML at WWDC 2026) should make the hardware even more useful once the software catches up. Tomorrow's launch also lands the M5 MacBook Pro and M4 iPad Air simultaneously, giving the whole Apple silicon line a refresh in a single week. The timing — a day before DeepSeek V4 was expected — may or may not be coincidence.

**Sources:**
- https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/03/apple-introduces-the-new-macbook-air-with-m5/
- https://www.macrumors.com/2026/03/03/apple-announces-macbook-air-with-m5/
- https://www.macworld.com/article/2655094/m5-macbook-air-design-display-specs-release-price.html

---

## 7. ⏳ DeepSeek V4 — Still Waiting, Now Two Weeks Late

DeepSeek V4 was expected to drop the first week of March — timed with China's \

(两会) parliament session that started March 4. As of today, March 10, it still hasn't arrived. Multiple leaks describe V4 as a major multimodal leap: a unified model capable of generating text, images, and video from a single architecture, with a reported trillion-parameter scale and an open-source release under a permissive license.\n\nThe wait is unusual for DeepSeek, which has historically shipped models close to rumored windows. The silence likely reflects either last-minute quality benchmarking or political sensitivity around timing during the Two Sessions. What's notable is that anticipation keeps growing rather than fading — every week without a release is another week the model's reputation as a potential \

compounds in the imagination of the AI community. When it does land, it will drop into an already-turbulent landscape: Anthropic suing the Pentagon, MiniMax gaining enterprise traction, and no clear Western equivalent to a trillion-parameter open multimodal model. The wait, in other words, matters.

**Sources:**
- https://www.reddit.com/r/DeepSeek/comments/1ridmnm/deepseek_v4_all_leaks_and_infos_for_the_release/
- https://techstory.in/deepseek-set-to-launch-v4-flagship-model-ahead-of-chinas-two-sessions/
- https://evermx.com/case/deepseek-v4-multimodal-march-2026-launch

---

---

## ⚡ Quick Signals

- **Google Pixel March Drop** — The March 2026 Pixel Feature Drop rolled out for Pixel 10 series, bringing agentic Gemini automation, Circle to Search \

for clothing, and AI-powered custom icon themes. Subtle but steady expansion of on-device AI UX.
- **Bipartisan AI Governance Framework** — TechCrunch covered a bipartisan coalition's proposed AI governance roadmap, framed as the framework Washington has declined to produce itself. Against the backdrop of the Anthropic-Pentagon clash, the timing is pointed.
- **MCP Java SDK from Google** — Google shipped a Java SDK for MCP Toolbox for Databases, completing a major enterprise language trifecta (Python, C#, Java) in the MCP ecosystem within the span of a week.

---

*AI News Daily is a curated briefing on the most impactful developments in artificial intelligence, published daily. Content is AI-assisted and human-reviewed.*

title.title: Un grande dentro y fuera de la cancha, mi opinión de un ejemplo a seguir
title.body:
## Un grande dentro y fuera de la cancha, mi opinión de un ejemplo a seguir


![1000615971.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP2VcezHMx9Hhe6xsTpNHWgrkZExn6hmEST4vtydAmkPm/1000615971.jpg)

<a href=\

>Fuente Soy fanático del fútbol, sigo al Barcelona y mi jugador favorito de toda la historia es Lionel Messi, pues lo que es capaz de hacer con un balón, muy pocos privilegiados son capaces de lograrlo, siendo aún más increíble su capacidad de reinventarse con el paso de los años, sin que eso le restará su dominio en el juego. Esto le ha permitido mantenerse vigente por más de 15 años, algo nunca se había logrado en la historia de este deporte. Tampoco puedo negar el impacto de la otra bestia de nuestra generación, el portugués Cristiano Cristiano, quien con condiciones diferentes, ayudó a formar una de las rivalidades más grandes del deporte, pues no sólo fueron los mejores de su generación, ganando casi todos premios individuales y colectivos, mientras estuvieron en su prime. Para más allá de lo hecho en la cancha, lo hecho fuera de ella también es para enmarcar, pudiendo considerarse ambos jugadores como ejemplos a seguir para esta generación, pues demostraron que si explotas tus talentos, te apasionas, y te rompes la espalda trabajando y mejorando cada día más, podrías llegar a cumplir tus sueños. Es evidente su ejemplo no funciona para todos, pues para algunas personas siquiera explotar su potencial es imposible, ya sean por factores como suerte, condición social o hasta el país donde vives, pero eso no le quita lo ilusionaste que es para un chico ver a estos deportistas cumplir sus sueños y romper récord día tras día, imaginándose ellos mismos en esa situación. Entrando ahora de lleno al tema del que quería escribir hoy, la polémica absurda y enfermiza de la visita de Leo Messi a la Casa Blanca, y las imágenes que generó con Donald Trump. Esto solo me hace pensar en la irracionalidad de la gente con ideología comunista, que más allá de generarme piquiña en el cuerpo, nos es algo que me sorprenda, a decir la verdad. En un acto para enaltecer a los futbolistas que ganaron la más reciente MLS, estas personas lo transforman todo en algo complementamente político, incluso buscan manchar la carrera de Messi, iniciando un nuevo capítulo dantesco entre la rivalidad entre el rosarino y Diego Armando Maradona, que para mí, no sólo se acabó en 2022, sino que además quieren incluir un aspecto delirante en la comparativa, lo hecho fuera de las canchas. Comparar incluso quienes estaban en su círculo cercano, debería ser penado por ley, porque aunque respete la carrera de Maradona como futbolista, saber su nexos con tiranos dictadores como Hugo Chavez o Fidel Castro, solo hace que ya está conversación sea estúpida. Y por más delirante que me suene, ese justamente es un argumento de los detractores de la reunión con Trump, que argumentan que eso nunca pasaría con el pelusa, algo de lo que estoy convencido, pues el mismo presidente de los Estados Unidos creo que no lo invitaría, o al menos no en esta etapa de su vida. Que Trump sea una figura divisora también es verdad, su pasado no está totalmente limpio de polémicas, pero lo que representa hoy es algo que no se puede negar, más allá de que polémicas como las de Jeffrey Epstein lo persigan, y si se llega a comprobar algo, más allá de sus menciones en la famosa lista, no será más que un corrupto más, que merece que le caiga todo el peso de la ley, pero por los momentos, me remito al principio de inocencia desde un punto de vista legal. Otra figuras que se han relacionado con el 10 son el presidente actual de la Argentina, Javier Miley, otro hombre de derecha que es una figura polémica en su país, pero que desde una percepción global, una persona de bien que ha traído cierta estabilidad a su país, exponiendo a los corruptos que estaban antes en el poder, quienes a su vez, también estaban íntimamente relacionados con la dictadura venezolana. Así mismo, no podemos olvidar su negativa a estar con otros políticos como el mismo Joe Biden, o incluso, con la albiceste habían mantenido una postura de neutralidad política, que al parecer, esta cambiando. Lo único que tal vez se le podría criticar, es que siempre se ha mantenido alejado de estos temas, nunca mostrando una postura fuerte hacia una idea o modelo, pero entendiendo su posición y lo que genera su figura, tanto en lo social, como incluso, en lo económico, es más que entendible, llegaron otros a valorar esto como algo positivo, pues no se mete en áreas que no domina, evitando crear un sesgo sociológico Más allá de estos lazos, lo más importante es su vida en general, pues todos ya sabemos que tiene una familia muy bella, que demuestra día tras día los valores que son la brújula de su vida. En contraposición, el Diego nunca llegó a tener algo tan sólido, e incluso, más allá de sus polémicas con prostitución, y hasta homosexualidad, siempre salen a la luz ciertos rumores de posible pedo..., asociados con su gran amigo Fidel Castro. Todo esto no hizo más que enojarme, al ver la doble vara de medir de esta gente con la realidad alterada, por eso siempre pienso que hay que defender a las personas de bien, y dejarnos llevar más por nuestras propias creencias y valores, que lo expuesto en redes sociales o periódicos. No creo ser una persona intachable, pues tengo errores en mi vida muy criticables, como casi cualquier otro ser humano, pero lo más importante es que tengo mi norte bien definido, y mientras tenga oportunidad, me gustaría seguir compartiendo todo lo que piensa este tipito enojado. Hoy no compartí nada demasiado personal, pero comparado con su majestad Leo Messi, siento que hoy solo tengo que resaltar la gran persona que veo desde mi perspectiva, pues más allá de ser un héroe en los campos de fútbol, siento que fuera de ellos es igual de grande.

title.title: Вулична камера біля будинку
title.body:
Хороша і корисна річ, як виявилось, вулична відеокамера, яку нещодавно встановив біля будинку. Давно збирався встановити хоча б якусь камеру, і ось вже ціни за такі девайси стали на стільки низькими, а підключення та налаштування на стільки доступними, що я, нарешті, це зробив. 

Придбав на Prom в середньому ціновому діапозоні двохоб'єктивну модель, в якій одна камера статична, а друга крутиться на 360 градусів. Нічний режим, підсвідка, сигнал тривоги, датчик руху та багато інших корисних функцій дозволяють тепер бачити, що відбувається на ділянці біля будинку через екран смарфона в будь-який момент з будь-якого місця, де є інтернет.

Так, технології розвиваються та стають все доступнішими, і добре, коли вони працюють на користь людям, а не на їх знищення.

title.title: Small Home, Big Style: How Compact Home Elevators Transform Interiors
title.body:
###

![Small Home, Big Style How Compact Home Elevators Transform Interiors.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/5b9d8c08447d086b8ca048429566035304a637f3678a73ce4a035f82f097831c)



Modern homes are becoming smarter, more stylish, and more space-efficient. In many urban areas, especially cities with limited space, homeowners are looking for innovative solutions that improve both comfort and design. This is where [compact home elevators](https://app.smore.com/n/3tfgu-home-elevators-transform-interiors) are transforming the way interiors are designed.

Unlike traditional lifts that require large machine rooms and heavy construction, compact home elevators are designed to fit easily into small residential spaces. They can be installed in duplex houses, villas, and even narrow multi-floor homes without affecting the overall layout. Their sleek design and modern technology allow them to blend perfectly with contemporary interiors.

One of the biggest advantages of compact elevators is the convenience they offer. They make it easy for elderly family members, children, and people with mobility challenges to move between floors safely. At the same time, they add a premium and luxurious feel to the house.

Interior designers also prefer these elevators because they can be customized with glass panels, elegant finishes, and modern lighting. This makes the elevator not just a utility feature but also a stylish part of the home décor.

In today’s modern homes, compact home elevators are no longer just about accessibility-they are about combining functionality, comfort, and beautiful interior design in one smart solution.

title.title: Shooting Doubts.
title.body:
Talking about shooting stars,. I'm not sure I exactly believe in it. I've only heard about it and seen it in movies, I've seen how it happens in movies when they suddenly see it, everyone just shouts and immediately closes their eyes to make a wish. And some,.or let's say all of them do believe that things will definitely turn out for good. Well, to me it sounds somehow. And mind you, I've absolutely nothing against those who believed in it.




![1000810837.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23t74yRHzSqWTQ2CDYuhqdsG3GKNFGqVwDqGzkTsW6CMJDpoDNH9dP7M5s3ZqVbJgdCMW.png)




Aside from movies, I doubt if I've ever seen a shooting star, or maybe I wasn't paying attention, or the part of the world where I'm from isn't one that takes it seriously, so it's possible that I might have missed it, or seen it without paying attention to it. But judging from what I've seen online and in the movies, especially Korean movies, they make it feel so special like....I don't even know the best word to use.



And like I said earlier, I doubt if I believe in it, and I've nothing against those who do. Still, if I eventually get to see or notice one, I still don't think I will make a wish. The reason is because I feel like it is way more deeper than all of that. There are things that you can only get for working hard, putting effort, or being patient. Also, some things just happen out of what we call *\

* Grace might just find you and refuse or let you go, without you even putting effort into anything. And I will like to repeat that I hate other people against those who believe in it. It's possible that it's working for them, or giving them some level of hope.



![1000810847.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23t773Mm5a6XzuKiBkLY8eww1T4pD2Pa4uhZViowGyTL4CoZLC5bcyAKcpaQT9zPDkP94.png)



In conclusion, it's possible that shooting stars don't even grant wishes, but when it passes by, the kind of things we wish for show the kind of person we are and the kind of person we will become. But then, I would love to imagine. I would love to imagine if a shooting star was to pass by, what would I have wished for, the only wish that came to mind and I'm sure would be what would come to my mind if I did believe in it is that, I want to be so blessed to an extent that I will be a blessing to others. People are going through a lot, and it's high time we all stop being selfish. So, that would be my wish, to be in a position where I can help, support, bless and raise others. 





🌹

title.title: My Simple Breakfast
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJbS8CHs5Eug6GAyr4chE37k4BA42jznf1JZkihM9nzQ/1773056157431.jpg) Hello everyone! @qurator is hosting a cooking contest called Hive Top Chef Competition. It is an interesting weekly challenge and the theme for this week is '15 Min Meal'. This is my submission for the contest.
https://media.tenor.com/qQsfQtV-GdMAAAAj/strawberry-left.gif
##
*Ingredients*
* 2 eggs * Salt to taste * Pepper * 1 orange cherry tomato * 1 yellow cherry tomato * 4 crackers * 5 almonds * 5 teabags * 3 tablespoons of sugar * 2 1/2 tablespoons of powdered milk
https://media.tenor.com/qQsfQtV-GdMAAAAj/strawberry-left.gif
##
*The Process*
First of all, set some water in your regular boiling pot and turn the fire on. Turn the fire to high flame. This is to make some milk tea as the beverage. I'm not a fan of coffee, hence I stick to tea. I find black tea a little bland and prefer milk tea.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZUSnubJSzyPgTn3xPBVBzf2Jzcg4zniG6dXnFKH8qHde/1773077321837.jpg) In the meantime, it's time to prepare the breakfast meal. Add a teaspoon of butter into the pan. Break the butter pieces and mix them around so they get all over the pan. You can also lift the pan so the butter runs everywhere.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSmAxSa7f45ESM8DJ7FQurWCAE9BkvQivb2npMkqvSE5Q/1773077322055.jpg) Then, crack two eggs into the pan. If you store eggs for a long time, then crack them into a bowl first to avoid adding a bad egg into the pan. I don't store them for too long and they're fresh so I just crack them straight into the pan.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPZEmMRKAL3XWFvx87Kki6A8jZ8nM7mDprn8eL9EHgVdA/1773077322259.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP6XJVrUeZ7YUtoBXjAiMmysnDacGs9QFvePMS8bYChWa/1773077322491.jpg) Then, break the egg yolk so it runs around a little evenly to make sure it is cooked better. I prefer not to have a runny yolk. But if you like runny yolk then you can skip doing that.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZaN5jH2os423ED9b5K3nWg4DNEvqPVTbm8JU1fZohnmo/1773077322650.jpg) This is how it looks after moving the yolks all around.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdtXYA6UjLA5v6VWTCNFL6e25LEqiWVtYtu8WWCMJaZix/1773077455556.jpg) Add salt to taste.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUXRgFUE35bKJ85JpAZ1vFdx6Mo3rvyVdeReXX5LCMMNa/1773077455728.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXMTqXZV6jt9yVvUjSNA3NQh4beVBm8AWCgPQn8Z29qhr/1773077455916.jpg) Add some pepper for seasoning as per your liking. I go heavy on the black pepper because I like the eggs to be savoury.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXNaxP6Hdb1MPVrXBf71B2QH5DuWnKovGTq9cAkDoMAot/1773077456119.jpg) It is almost 60% done here.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZhP6xZf6WBg7r91bQNPpWW9AqgVDFCXGAnQeEgb3visJ/1773077539131.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZKKefE52AXqaqGtJYGugswqDA5uctVWeyHLWVyafbAbb/1773077539305.jpg) Then, turn the eggs over so the back of the eggs is cooked too. While they're cooking, check the water. It is probably boiled now so turn the fire off and pour the needed amount of water into your teapot. I use a separate pot for tea because boiling the tea bags in water directly may make the tea bitter. So I pour the amount of water needed for 5 cups into the tea container and add in the teabags. I let them steep in the water for about 3 minutes.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWxpdLz3M5QLoPCJJu1LpzsD5LyHwpXTJEEg7gegKZueZ/1773077539459.jpg) I would turn the eggs over again just in case to make sure there are no runny bits. Then, I split the eggs into half so that I can share it with my brother.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmecNoZZFQQ2eMF39e86ms3mRNSusonZ7NhV5d3Gs6NDfL/1773110633720.jpg) This is my tea container. Take the teabags out, add in sugar and milk, and mix them. Here it is made for four people with an extra cup as one of my family members drinks two cups a day. I suggest adjusting the amount of teabags, sugar and milk accordingly.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ3amCGCw6NymNyexzj39AKf2WnGtLXoGyoHLcRx8goR6/1773077604038.jpg) When it is done, pour the tea into the cup.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf7RUV5EzNw59wZuA58GuMyVP2jU5mT74JWWkmxG1mgtX/1773113867479.jpg) Here's my plating. That is my half of the egg which is one egg. I love incorporating eggs into my daily means because they are a healthy source of multiple nutrients besides protein. I have also cut up two cherry tomatoes, one orange and one yellow, into halves and sprinkled some pepper on them. They are a source of antioxidants. Then, I added about 5 almonds because they are a good source of protein and and fiber. Finally I added 4 crackers for carbohydrates.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJbS8CHs5Eug6GAyr4chE37k4BA42jznf1JZkihM9nzQ/1773113868475.jpg) This is my breakfast plate with a cup of tea. It takes around 15 minutes overall if we include the plating. The process of making the eggs may seem long based on this post but it is actually quite fast in real. The same goes to the tea as it only takes about 5 minutes for a full pot of water to be boiled and a few extra minutes to make the tea.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT1UwQAg9rtATYAHS4kbhAoSWe53ADX2Voky3hF1tQweT/1773131876867.png)
Ecency still seems to have an issue with transparent backgrounds so I made it all white. Thanks for dropping by and thank you to @qurator again for hosting this contest because it gave me a chance to share my simple breakfast. Have a great day ahead!

title.title: The Quiet Lessons of Light and Shadows to Our Daily Life
title.body:
‎Good day everyone and welcome to another section of my daily blog, today I went extra mile to reflect and to understand. So I decided to share with you guys. 
‎
‎Life often teaches us its greatest lessons in the most ordinary places. Sometimes, all it takes is a simple moment of observation to realize how much meaning is hidden in the small details around us. Looking at this image, one might only see a metal railing, sunlight, and shadows stretching across the floor. But when we pause and truly reflect, it begins to mirror the journey of our daily lives.
‎
‎Every morning, the sun rises and casts its light without discrimination. It shines on buildings, street polls, roads, trees, and even the quiet corners of our homes without permission. In the image, the sunlight passes through the iron bars, creating a pattern of light and shadow on the ground. This reminds me of how life works. Opportunities, connections, blessings, and challenges often come through different “bars if our daily life” or obstacles. Sometimes the path is clear and bright, while other times it is broken and filled with shadows.
‎
‎
‎The railing itself stands firm and unmoving as is been constructed. Day after day, it faces the heat of the sun, sometimes beaten by the rain,  the dust of the wind, and the quiet passage of time. even as people passed through they also struggle with it while the do their daily life routine. 
‎
‎
‎In many ways, it represents the strength we must develop in our own lives. because no matter the way the rod is been beaten by rain, sun, or been pull most time by people, it still stand firm. Just like that railing, we are constantly exposed to different situations. Some days bring joy, while others bring pressure and uncertainty.
‎
‎
‎Yet, like the iron bars, we must remain steady and grounded. The shadows on the floor are also worth noticing. They form patterns that change as the sun moves across the sky. moving with thesame agreement. In the morning they appear long and stretched, while later they slowly shrink and shift. 
‎
‎This reminds us that the problems we face today may not remain the same tomorrow. Difficult moments often feel long and heavy when we are going through them, but time has a way of changing their shape and influence. Another interesting detail is the boundary created between the light and the darker part of the floor. It feels like a quiet reminder that life is rarely just one thing. There are always two sides, which are light and shadow, success and failure, which we humans can't escape ftom it. It is certain. We hope and doubt. 
‎
‎What truly matters is how we choose to walk within those spaces. Sometimes, in the rush of our daily routines, we overlook these silent messages that nature trys to teach us and our surroundings present to us.
‎
‎
‎ Yet moments like this image encourage us to slow down and reflect. Even a simple ray of sunlight passing through a railing can remind us of patience, resilience, and the quiet beauty hidden in everyday life. We knowing when to make our moves, and knowing that everything in this planet have it process same as the nature, time for raining season and time for dry season, all these things don't stay forever, the are temporary, which goes with seasons.
‎
‎
‎In the end, life itself is a mixture of light and shadow. And just like the patterns on the floor, our journey becomes meaningful when we guard it.  not because it is perfect, but because it is real, constantly changing, and full of lessons waiting to be noticed.
‎
‎
‎Am not saying all this that I have study the nature or what, but looking at the iron, it symbolize many things, strength, determination, standing firm, togetherness, which is also reflecting to us, with togetherness and working together to understand each other in our daily life, the world won't be a peaceful place to stay, if we are to destroy the beauty of this iron which create patterns with the help of the sun, the sun will also come and go.
‎
‎
‎This is applicable to every individuals, if your to destroy your life today because of some you believe is right to do at the wrong time, the day will still move on, let's be guided in the choice we make on our daily life, let's use things around us and let's the teach and reflect things to us.
‎
‎
‎Thanks for reading 🥂🌹

title.body:
![087.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcWZUPRQpgoekbQTKYRVaFzNfkzmp8RvpXEycHtGTLL9Y/087.jpg)


Hello everyone. I want to share a bit about our visit to the Museum of Ancient Ships today. Before reaching the museum we made a quick stop at a charming coastal place called Marina di Pisa  This was actually back at the tail end of last year. We had spent the entire month of December sick at home. And decided that a walk by the sea would do us a world of good. That day was the 26th of December, Saint Stephen’s Day, to be exact.


![157.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXtc9KyGhZc7WqnwvGhZ17PLjotzvLyhidVSmXbHkwWVA/157.jpg)

![180.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWqVtq4C6yjVG4XZJSvswxXo6YxmjUqBHAUzhrtbaXPmM/180.jpg)

![221.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYNGi7K6ZPjvNVwHCQRRFBQSrDHTGgnVJ37Kih5MsR9UF/221.jpg)

![227.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPWwiN2MjtxJfBc8YhvooxR5yyy4b8SzWAJiZeVb1JvYJ/227.jpg)

After wandering around a bit we went to a restaurant. Our usual spot from last year was closed for the holiday.So we decided to try another place called Il Belvedere based on its reviews. We had our meal. It was delicious. But to be honest, it's not worth coming all this way just for this restaurant. If you happen to be in the area by the coast, it can be a good choice. Then we finaly made our way to the Museum of Ancient Ships.


![353.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSSpWdAN5XVRyhQdppRT6SyruxYw2k8UqY9tpLg5V8E4E/353.jpg)

![364.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc8tLHv5vwyqH3krcTJZhYYZvScrD9ks7wLAY6htT5Kzo/364.jpg)

![486.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdFx5cQe7MbPGWPh2r4HxWth4Xdehqz52GAhqVYttkhUX/486.jpg)

The museum itself sits perfectly on the edge of the Arno river. There is the Medici family crest at the top of the building and this is no coincidence. This place was built as a shipyard by the order of Cosimo I de' Medici, the Grand Duke of Tuscany. The architect is Bernardo Buontalenti, whom I have frequently mentioned in my previous posts. The building did not remain a shipyard for very long; it was later converted into military stables and used this way until the 19th century. The stable structure is still preserved in the interior architecture.


![006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVbeRPCQj59uLpmnTmbbbfKo4QGxFKXSJ1ESXEGNWQ5D9/006.jpg)

![010.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbkWDLbZtTCJmDJg2U4pS2tTjBsNtjD3Qv45pFnmdMZue/010.jpg)

![037.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZdBMNDSR4TGP9gjB88WY1A8ev3VG14vJfLoPz54HVCT1/037.jpg)

![090.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQuHQS6Ld21RSoyR8Xdn2Da5yEMBmZxLnNNt3zwWjS8Ka/090.jpg)

![100.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmexoLFs7DgHs4m4VZZndAALT9jBabg6qTJQctK4a6oAEV/100.jpg)

![107.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX77gsmMHrZTA8kxQmCnhgR46i1W83kes18D8GksTphWU/107.jpg)

![118.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX1vD2EnMeyKJszwN1wPEPGs3q9SSt3NEYc7Uj8QE5hkA/118.jpg)

As for the museum collection, this is an archaeological museum and the artifacts are divided into 8 thematic zones. Everything is explained, from how life and maritime began in the region to how these ancient ships were found. Some ships date back to the 2nd century BC! The archaeological discovery process, how the ships were excavated and transported here and why they could be preserved until today are detailed. The last part of the museum covers subjects such as life on ancient ships, trade and navigation. The pearls of the collection are the ship hulls, which are incredibly well-preserved for their age.


![133.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbbeEfV27LNBfSbCqZu4vPXuyCJTsGrz7K2cqMvfK8Rv8/133.jpg)

![141.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP9WYJbtYkeq2PEwRF5ttv1eFjpCRiYFdjozkmCCv1LV4/141.jpg)

![262.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeDo7SJjzucpDUoVAgiCd592qbKHvAp72rrJrD6zUhpqB/262.jpg)

![285.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaeMRRZQ4HudCtB9313jq3W11Ud2u4XHJMXuJhKsW58s3/285.jpg)

![348.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ2ZPKpuaHnhEv5m7GPM8JJD7xanVyQ2RNMzTfTP83oNU/348.jpg)

![372.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeA14ui8piW1tmT8sibMdBiafWkx9t6SLVCHRV1R1NEuE/372.jpg)


![376.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmepyTuED3qNHpu2KSoL673wEfZLEp4oEzRVk91Fna2m1n/376.jpg)

![462.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmctWMZDuJpYTXrjGYSefB768g6DsKNXvqFArDG9aVCrVM/462.jpg)

I really loved our time here. And I should mention a couple of tips for anyone planning a visit. First of all, since the museum is huge, it can be cold if you come in winter like us or hot in summer. I suggest you choose appropriate clothes accordingly. Dressing in layers is a smart move, especially in winter. Give yourself around 2-3 hours to comfortably explore the eight thematic zones. That's all I have to say for today. See you on the next trips.

Good Luck!朋友们，今天又是被幸福阳光温暖的一天，活力满满，喜悦连连，铛铛铛，不仅是这样，就连走路都是气场全开！！

我总算是知道，当你自觉美好的时候，果然，好运就自然降临啦，微笑，记住一定要多笑，不必哈哈大笑，当然，如果你忍不住，放声大笑也无妨，开心就好。

女神节当天，和好友一起无意中闯入到一场美其名曰为：福气上升主题的锦鲤好运展，展厅不大，却是小而美，主打红白配色为主吉祥如意，大富大贵，好运连连等等一些列美好祝福扑面而来。

发现偶尔做了好事，嘴巴闭紧啦，自己知道就好，老天会派送礼物给你，而且刚好是你当下所需要的，奇妙，属实很奇妙。

嘴巴除了吃遍人间美味之外，当然是拿来说好话啦，对了，我还喜欢用它来唱歌，唱喜欢的歌，妙音从嘴出，心甚是欢喜。

还有，不必刻意去追求什么，，只需每天保持嘴角上扬的弧度，保持内心的柔软与善良，那些美好的事情就好像约好了一样，一个接一个找上门，你只需要开门迎接就好。

最后，祝福大家周二愉快，喜乐平安。

**感谢大家的阅读和喜欢，您的点赞给予我莫大的鼓励，感恩❀**

title.title: Egg Martabak Spring Roll Skin
title.body:
> ![20260308_160811.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/EptbsM4yfDNnMjDXZghZz1hvP5MhU8UrUeuzJdqUBSERMyzMzfwVEUPfCCmk6Q1brmQ.jpg)
Martabak is one of my go-to dishes when I need something filling to eat when I'm hungry. Martabak is very popular in Indonesia and is one of the traditional dishes. Martabak itself comes in a variety of flavors, from savory to sweet. This time, I'm going to make a savory martabak with a spicy and savory twist. ![20260308_161017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23ynaykUw3AvH1peeejGBoxo9UFpawnMPkU8ZUT9HwDkgGDY1UQ7pr3oSfSD67CuD4r5Z.jpg) The martabak I'm making is egg-based with spring roll wrappers. The original recipe for egg martabak usually uses special flour. Since the process takes time, I tried making an egg martabak version with spring roll wrappers. The process is very easy and quick, and I'm sure anyone will love it. Here are the step-by-step instructions for making egg martabak.
Ingredients
![20260308_154211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xKvnFfZQZejP1eVgehbJXdYmwyvhCUQ31b1n1Ck5RGeKUxSEZFi7WopY8yja32CuSBk.jpg)
2 chicken eggs 1 duck egg 6 spring roll wrappers (adjust as needed) 1 stalk of green onion 1 stalk of celery 2 cloves of shallots 1 clove of garlic ¼ teaspoon of salt ¼ teaspoon of mushroom broth 2 lettuce leaves 4 cayenne peppers
Procedure For Making
Beat 3 eggs, then add finely chopped onions (you can also blend them).
|![20260308_154438.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wqEeNVn6QTtqCJhtqDZKwp7xQjsUX43CbdvVuhzH7StD2ggpePyty4Uj7SAwL5JgJex.jpg) | ![20260308_154434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23y8fNeYryBaunJz5shRZQrVeJdyHzZAxyJtEUFeMRQaSnmgjJ38Ew4gwYPFafmLGfjto.jpg) | ![20260308_154531.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23y8mS56F6umqfQJ7htKQMtx6pHFj35q9fvEoEf7fg4VECUZnvUURKYpdBX3mVebBpUzw.jpg) | |-|-|-|
Then add chopped vegetables, celery, and chili peppers. Next, add salt and mushroom broth and stir until well mixed.
| ![20260308_154731.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/242hajcss2sWNXCVyJzE4Kv6yrJF2FyRSt2tQXU9Aaqc8ARUT1CnZFHSCPFWasLjGiKix.jpg) | ![20260308_154546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wqZm2sQk7XbSQAe1Hs4AEsF7rxFJ3hEJhNHc9ZuNsaR3i6gLvBbaEuaDa9tvMBEmxEN.jpg) | ![20260308_154650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wfr8ZiW6kn1XVJ5EeK8sS481n27SwWGdV8yxnb1pwhuRxujJg6qEuzaBPaEts4R984S.jpg) | |-|-|-|
In a pan, add butter, then arrange the spring roll wrappers on the pan and add the egg mixture.

> ![20260308_155048.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23xAbqJvhd5SyxJdoS2VrUp9cpv3ENryr67Lq7r9mHSJvNRg4efP5PTCHWpydNFaDdvyF.jpg) ![20260308_155212.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23vhuHQwtDPdNzSRLBgjxiNvUeZofgE7vZJAW4utFXqzetjdcciwCraHn6GDFgmcVSu4s.jpg)
Then cover the martabak with the wrappers and add more spring roll wrappers until everything is covered. Don't forget to flip it over.

> ![20260308_155851.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23y8svWgWrRAwKyFXvdrCnwR9YB5Dn7Ard3dwoKKSyxhPNx8tiKGAfGud468XekHEgrF2.jpg)
Result
![20260308_160735.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/243M51XmGFHoAGTcKmfYbJsoHY4aNtip1ymowtKdgvrgYz6qyQ82t6Pym5dwCDwLpEY8T.jpg) The filling is very beautiful, cooked perfectly and evenly. Here's a tip to make it look beautiful: use low heat when cooking so that it cooks evenly inside. It tastes very delicious, everything tastes perfect, savory and spicy with a crispy spring roll skin on the outside. |![20260308_160953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yx457i3bNPWiXgZ9gwvRqbLZ4MtS8Vdy8MXzNFBER7Y1uJ9Ujrps1CdcUVjB8x4uqdD.jpg)|![20260308_161059.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23uFgMiHyskvqCcYojVRUo3UeMUJTUfnR8bhDeayDHeisjGTK7N2sEeJYCb4G2irjvVqW.jpg)|![20260308_161041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23wgaT8udts3Zhfg4YeYCZ8XFqMisJN1eJsduy4vso3RfKy94tPehLXp6g3cgYmXvDMkv.jpg)| |-|-|-|
For those of you who want to make a quick and filling special dish, try this recipe. Not only is it delicious, but it's also easy and quick to prepare. I really love its perfect savory taste on the tongue. It's definitely very filling. Serve it with chili sauce or mayonnaise—uhh, everything is so delicious, just try it!.
![20230506_212938_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nurfay/23yTv75jgyP5CSod1jCZoAPbPAnA7mSYtNJUa33KmuA4GgtmxGNNUyyxR9bq8gsiGS8qF.png)

About The Author
Welcome to this blog, I have a real name \

, who comes from Indonesia. I have several hobbies, reading, writing, gardening, I also love food and cooking, even art related.  And the most interesting one is spending the whole day traveling. From those hobbies, I will  some inspiring content for all of you, I hope you like my blog, please and reblog this post if you like it!.</sub>
<hr>

For those of you who want to make a quick and filling special dish, try this recipe. Not only is it delicious, but it's also easy and quick to prepare. I really love its perfect savory taste on the tongue. It's definitely very filling. Serve it with chili sauce or mayonnaise—uhh, everything is so delicious, just try it!

title.title: Loyalty and Regret.
title.body:
>

Arthur began his final ride back to camp, haunted by the voices of fallen friends. Upon arrival, he confronted Dutch and Micah, exposing Micah as the Pinkerton informant.

The tension peaked with John's unexpected return from the dead, leading to a standoff as the gang's loyalty finally shattered beyond repair.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdMjSh1hrTdWBJo1Qds8MW9vr2GPv6KBfMtAGvdo5siVK/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNQwHxWBnsxqCcSccCsnGJmE5XxkgqgWe956dVCBN4h6V/screenshot_2_.png)

After the ladies left Arthur alone, he got on his loyal horse Buell. He put his hat on, settling it firmly as he prepared himself mentally and physically for the war he knew was waiting at the end of the road.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZfyCbyyN1ogvtoXwmYsNnzaTB31q8p5tqeRaaBry2nsj/screenshot_3_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT5AN5yV6W76RtQR5ZoE9MbtQyotpKPDHqJB8jtFY26uH/screenshot_4_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdjaKBcsrBxmaFz4dNtyrusr8Fskw2mLWHsJVr8Ypgiju/screenshot_5_.png)

Arthur began the long ride back to the camp. During this cinematic journey, I had full access to the photo mode as he galloped across the landscape, creating a powerful and somber atmosphere.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSeP6wBALXmnrbJEs2KKRcD2PcxMzvnmu1LF4yiqBzKPC/screenshot_6_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZPGNYokf7wNuELMvYLdex3FJHwSayMgfPYH1oSPzzkei/screenshot_7_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNXMkb9ydk3ZPn7BMHqfzsqrJxQ6Lknf9tvx2A8sCkx6w/screenshot_8_.png)

As he passed through the area, the screen's atmosphere shifted into a flashback of voices. Arthur began remembering special sentences and advice from the gang members who had died, their voices echoing in his mind like ghosts.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQc7N8LoPFwbxgD1KGnMcJ7uaLZagRdPcwmZiJ3yX5etB/screenshot_9_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXr2s6CKtbcpDZ75ZkXD4WREhHpTT4vRLcRBTBTVSQyGk/screenshot_10_.png)

I reached the camp, which was pitch black without any lamps to light the way. Arthur saw Micah pushing others to pack up quickly, claiming they were out of time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSTFoa8qAKJicCFn3VVQkgDQNQ1HF3wpwr1AdGmXZVuJ7/screenshot_11_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPzLDrL5SieamppcAASnpYaBL5AANVdHdxWSTdva4yGxA/screenshot_12_.png)

Arthur stepped forward, telling them they had plenty of time. He walked straight toward Dutch and revealed that Micah was the spy for Agent Milton, leaving Dutch looking completely confused.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNXWbKtzHMcnBbmjuoWpUs3MQUcfj5mvt5fi53WThhAAq/screenshot_13_.png)

Arthur explained exactly how Micah had fooled everyone and had been playing for the Pinkertons all this time. The truth was finally out in the open, hanging heavy in the air between them.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaiWtZt5nAdKMEdSM9QLNmMuxNj3LsvD8CwYHVUfmBi68/screenshot_14_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeEf6bPpdjJUnxMKHWn4un2s6DP2siVR5EJx8gVq7SD7z/screenshot_15_.png)

Arthur stared Micah down after making the accusation. Micah immediately denied it, calling it a goddamn lie and refusing to accept the reality of his betrayal.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTS7HYqBBrs3u2NEwRDJgKkygSWhDqqPc1YrUpMnMKbXd/screenshot_16_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPwp8NP9xutQx16uriyPAXTQJBrMsnoPPAP3kP1y4J7ws/screenshot_17_.png)

Arthur told the gang it all finally made sense now. He pointed his gun directly at Micah, confirmed in his heart that this was the real culprit responsible for their downfall.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdZ3gRpBNUa83jWakeAfAyZwW2PbMMYWGVd7FwXWE4AXm/screenshot_18_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWtgg3BhMvydzYb5tc94cxCsPGmjtyfHcEhixDE8VLoPx/screenshot_19_.png)

Micah's men and Bill pointed their guns back at Arthur. Suddenly, John Marston stumbled into the camp, injured, shocking everyone who thought he was dead.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQs3v1xwx7iwj96797SzJPGfZCCQXQzqobkpfXpXRXNzs/screenshot_20_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNfWzzsBVKvJCCZfQHrQoYGswuyMUC5LFq4jn8AJNKgTf/screenshot_21_.png)

John accused Dutch of leaving him behind to die. With deep regret, Arthur looked at Dutch and told him that they had given him everything they had, emphasizing the blind loyalty they had once shared.

https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png

Here I'm finishing the post for today, and I'll talk about more special RDR 2 gaming moments in Gaming Photography.

https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gamingphoto/23tRvMuLRERuPePNhyEjtaKt46FiKwDBgwVqqAberwmEFA36fPkh2ad6wvB1RYNKTVezR.png
