title.title: Busy Evenings at Mineral Water Filling Stations
title.body:
![IMG_20260309_223226.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbTy9x4meTbn1T5Sj6kDbfvw11HJVQQv1T6BT5a23zHwh/IMG_20260309_223226.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
Evenings are often quite busy at mineral water filling stations. After a long day, many people begin to come to refill their water gallons. The bright lights inside create a lively atmosphere, even though it's already dark outside.

That night, the atmosphere at the mineral water filling station was simple yet bustling with activity. Several gallons of water were neatly arranged on the floor, waiting to be filled. Some had just arrived with empty gallons, while others were ready to take them home after filling them. This activity may seem ordinary, but it actually plays a vital role in meeting people's daily needs.

Mineral water is a basic necessity for many families. Therefore, water filling stations like these are often visited by local residents. The process may seem simple, but it still requires precision. The gallons must be cleaned before being refilled to ensure the water remains clean and safe for consumption.

Colorful lights installed above the room create an interesting impression. Green, red, and blue lights illuminate the white walls, creating an ambiance unlike any other water filling station. Although simple, the touch of light makes this place seem more lively and comfortable.

In the corner of the room, you can see several pieces of equipment used in the water filling process. Each piece of equipment plays a specific role in ensuring the quality of the water produced. This activity may seem like a routine task, but for those who carry it out, it represents effort and hard work to earn a living.
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

title.title: A Simple Day on Our Farm with Calamansi Harvest, Roaming Animals, Coconut and Food from our Mini Fishpond
title.body:
![1000187421.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/AKNKvHdYWWdqnLnMcju4CPMifJiJguBMZQ3Js5wgrw2gzV7mwzq2afVKv8itPNo.png)


Life on our farm is simple, but every day is full of real work and blessings. Early in the morning, the fresh air from the fields wakes us up. The farm is quiet, and the only sounds we hear are the birds singing and our chicken  moving around the yard. 

![1000187400.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23u5zZPRWeLQD79iZMyhZZfkAfs1FYWc7PwuaoYQeQTpQjU57K8Rh7pRCh1boNXKLenCp.jpg)

![1000187403.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wMWJhApT71Sbw5PQfEuwGa8qfHfLvNvbfytMySDRU8mREqAZ6EpkcqawRSjwXusUR7a.jpg)


![1000187395.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23w2ieKuTTNwUuzsu3KBesizBsLVwFNy8RNSun9CLT78YWSLKzFdvbKUVDcVtfgSrDSnn.jpg)

Near our house, we have several calamansi trees. One morning, my child and I decided to harvest some calamansi. We filled a small basket with the fresh green fruits. My child was happy helping me pick them from the tree. We planned to make fresh calamansi juice because it is good for cough and helps the body feel better. It is always nice to use something natural that grows in our own farm.



![1000187404.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23y8qHdoh1hykFUiwPv6sb2dKvC78SWd91rqu8jtM5mywwhbU5JGzTGTteWxLX4J2YvBu.jpg)

Not far from our house is our rice field. When the wind blows, the rice plants move slowly like waves. Looking at the rice field always reminds me how important patience is in farming. Crops take time, care, and hard work before they can be harvested. We will harvest this rice soon because it is already ripe. Ready to harvest. 

![1000187402.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uQhgmASqatCWYdxr4AcYK61CsLFeJSYtNgVrT3GqzYvCxWSXNsZvDLVjizMATgUn5MA.jpg)


![1000187398.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xeZDGVxsDATC5VoXZGhaYYJQ31p191RBinzADo123ABuPKBPHjq7Eua9KpE7b1gmYPJ.jpg)

Around the farm, we also have coconut trees with different varieties. These tall trees stand quietly around our land, giving shade during hot days. Sometimes we harvest coconuts to drink the fresh coconut water, which is very refreshing.



![1000187399.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23tm7QGtLFNaVSN98ENBCNjeMr2ndpJuibmov4LT36bwvTYf6k4rpYCbHGiM7DJcTX5FD.jpg)


![1000187390.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23ycsVeJubrfF3hr2D2jEVmpLRJvyzFZW6pay5UrSNUcWDCRZV7tDiMZrqxHoMXXqsiZe.jpg)

Our animals are also part of our daily farm life. Our chickens freely walk around the yard, scratching the ground and looking for food. We also have a goat that quietly grazes on the grass at the side of the farm. It simply walks around, eating grass and enjoying the open space.



![1000187413.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23vhsGou5PkeG4Eds8wWfe5pFkoe7KuPjJuvaxqzLYuPQ6G8fvjDyLWe3e6szSdzKBwyX.jpg)



We also have a small fishpond. It is not big, but it helps us when we need food. When we run out of choices for our meal, we catch a few fish to cook for our family. Sometimes we harvest a little and sell it to buy other things we need.



![1000187416.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/243MN49Kr9wuUnuzf5dEckgCScXSZxPuJwXa43pXTyCKzHJdgNCjkzoMFgVfyF7cdb86k.jpg)

Thank you for supporting and reading my story! This is my owned picture, edited in Canva. This is our real farm life peaceful, and full of gratitude for what the land provides. Have a nice day!

title.title: Three Tune Tuesday ~ Emeli Sandé ~ Birthday Girl #81 [Eng-Pt]
title.body:
### Welcome to my #TTT #ThreeTuneTuesday entry!
Good morning, everyone! Today, another Tuesday, another birthday girl! And today I bring you one of those artists who, despite her age, seems to have a much older, stronger presence than her 39 years might suggest... Emeli Sandé was born on March 10, 1987, in Sunderland, England, and grew up in Scotland. Her intense voice and passionate lyrics, sung with emotion and passion, accompanied by musical arrangements that elevate them even further, combine with her voice to give anyone goosebumps. At the age of eleven, she wrote her first song for a talent show at her primary school. She remembers that moment as the moment she thought to herself that she could be a songwriter. Despite everything, Sandé completed her master's degree in medicine at the University of Glasgow, and after obtaining her clinical degree, she specialized in neuroscience. She always fought for support and always wanted to study, because she believed that if she didn't succeed in the music world, she would have an outlet that gave her the stability she needed. Today, I'm sharing three of her songs that are absolutely fantastic and will leave anyone starstruck and with goosebumps! What do you think of this fantastic artist's voice?
Bom dia a todos! Hoje, mais uma terça, mais uma aniversariante! E para hoje trago-vos uma daquelas artistas que apesar da sua idade, parece ter uma presença muito mais antiga, mais forte do que os seus 39 anos podem parecer... Emeli Sandé, nasceu a 10 de Março de 1987 em Sunderland, Inglaterra, e cresceu na Escócia. A sua voz bastante intensa, e as letras apaixonantes, cantadas com emoção e com uma paixão, acompanhadas por um arranjo musical que as eleva ainda mais a um patamar, que em conjunto com a sua voz deixa qualquer um de pele arrepiada. Aos seus onze anos, escreveu a sua primeira canção, para um festival de talentos na sua escola primária. E ela recorda esse momento, como um momento em que pensou para si mesma que poderia ser compositora. Apesar de tudo, Sandé completou o mestrado em Medicina, na Universidade de Glasgow, e após ter obtido o grau em clinica, especializou-se em neurociências. Ela sempre lutou para que tivesse um suporte, e sempre quis estudar, pois acreditava que se não conseguisse vingar no mundo da música, teria uma saída que lhe dava a estabilidade que precisava. Hoje partilho aqui três canções dela que são absolutamente fantásticas, e que deixam qualquer um esterreado e com pele de galinha! E você o que acham da voz desta fantástica artista?

Hello, Ram Ram, Namaste, Sastriyakal, to all Hive users. Today I'll tell you how I manage to play sports during exams. My annual exams of 9th standard are going on, but I am also managing sports in the evening. I love to play sports, and those who are reviewing my posts from the date I joined mean regularly because since I have joined Hive, one single day has not gone by in which I have not published my blog.

So, if you are reviewing my blogs from the beginning, then you already know which sports I love to play, which is football and when I play football, I do not realise when the time passes because Elbert Einstein has once said that \

And that's the reality. When I play football, I don't realise the time, and similarly, as I edit a blog about the topic of football, I also don't realise how fast my words are exceeding.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWL4n6vHiidvtpkrpWLmJuUzEGcCBkCStvfw9PzLAboS1/rtgdhnm.jpg)

 As I love football, I can't wait for the exams to get over, and I go to play football on the ground daily during exams, and my feet automatically start working, and I can't control myself, and I wear studs and rush towards the playground. В доповнення до живопису, образ Карпат представлено також в експозиції фарфорових фігур та майоліки відомих українських скульпторів. 

Експозиція складається з творів колекцій Національного музею \

, та робіт з приватних колекцій. 

Сьогодні, 10 березня відбудеться презентація виставки з вступним словом від кураторів та спеціальною екскурсією.

title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g5f32f526acc4efcdc1ef763e3420b81d78d7bfbef5c069b787d25762ec9b82a8bbdbeb5aacd841528a4ae2aa5165217ec11cabf496bd33e9c03c3a373ee9792d_640.jpg)</center>

***

當然可以！以下是一個關於自然的部落格文章範本，使用 Markdown 格式撰寫：

```markdown
# 自然的奇妙世界

自然是我們生活中不可或缺的一部分，它不僅提供了我們所需的資源，還為我們帶來了無窮的靈感與美的享受。在這篇文章中，我們將探索自然的不同面向。

## 1. 自然的美

### 山脈與湖泊

山脈和湖泊是自然界中最壯麗的景觀之一。無論是高聳入雲的喜馬拉雅山，還是碧波蕩漾的湖泊，它們都讓人感受到大自然的偉大與壯麗。

### 森林的魅力

森林是地球上最重要的生態系統之一。它們不僅是許多動植物的家園，還為我們提供了氧氣和清新的空氣。在森林中漫步，聆聽樹葉的沙沙聲，感受微風拂面，讓人心靈得到平靜。

## 2. 自然的生態

### 生物多樣性

自然界的生物多樣性是維持生態平衡的關鍵。每一種生物都有其獨特的角色，從微小的細菌到巨大的藍鯨，它們共同構成了地球的生命網絡。

### 環境保護

隨著人類活動的增加，自然環境面臨著前所未有的挑戰。保護自然環境，維護生態平衡，是我們每個人的責任。通過減少塑料使用、保護野生動物棲息地等行動，我們可以為未來的世代保護這片美麗的土地。

## 3. 自然的靈感

### 藝術與文學

自然一直以來都是藝術和文學創作的重要靈感來源。許多畫家和詩人都從大自然中汲取靈感，創作出無數動人的作品。無論是梵高的《星夜》，還是泰戈爾的詩歌，都是對自然的讚美。

### 心靈的慰藉

在繁忙的生活中，走進自然可以讓我們找到內心的平靜。無論是登山健行、海邊散步，還是靜靜地坐在公園裡，與自然親密接觸，都能讓我們感受到生活的美好。

## 結論

自然是我們最好的老師，它教會我們珍惜生命、尊重環境。讓我們一起愛護自然，保護這片美麗的土地，讓未來的世代也能享受到自然的奇妙與美好。

---

> **參考資料**
> - [世界自然基金會](https://www.worldwildlife.org/)
> - [聯合國環境規劃署](https://www.unep.org/)
```

title.body:
This morning i brought the wife to work , she starts at 07:00 AM and after that i drove back with my cameras and tripod knowing i might be able to catch a bit of sunrise  today .


The sky looked promising a bit of clouds the photos i'll post today are made with my old camera the Sony A7II + Laowa 15mm f4.5 1:2 macro lens .

This is my contribution for this weeks @qurator photo quest landscape : 


Capturing this mornings sunrise and dew drops on the grass, a little different kind of landscape .

You can find all the info about the contest here : 
https://ecency.com/qurator/@qurator/qurators-photo-quest-or-landscape


And now the story of how i got to make this photo.

12 )
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXA8met4p439JiYQgauQXUpHxdv1Peg8MXyerh1EKSAYc/dsc09423.jpg)

title.title: A Lifestyle Built on Sharing, Learning, and Growing
title.body: Back with my lovely keyboard at home, I felt like my motivation to write is back! \n\n<div class=\

> ![20260301_164712.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23xp8LWGB6aTcPXV184W7vkf8KkvYtQh85YKhU16GVUn5hkB2VQ8gfXKUyF9r6GhuqpHi.jpg) I don’t know but a solid keyboard has always motivated me to write but also made me write faster than a keyboard from my own laptop. Maybe it’s the novelty that I craved but hey, I am finally reuniting with it and would certainly bring this everywhere I am going now; so next time I crave that novelty, I can easily switch. So, today I’d love to talk about my journey back to online tutoring. For as long as I remember, teaching and coaching others has always been my way of channeling stress. It’s probably odd, I know but I’d go crazy if don’t share tidbits of things I learn to a person or more than a person. The last time I taught a group of people was around seven years ago, when I tutored kids who study at an international school. To be honest, teaching kids wasn’t really my thing but because I needed extra money at the time, I took the job. From that simple gig I had back in college, it taught me patience but also to never ever teach kids ever again. Long story short, because I had a good offer and different job that pays me better, I quit that job and moved on to another thing. Since then, I never really thought about teaching/coaching anybody or making it a profession. Until about a couple months ago, a friend of mine wanted some help with interview and such. It wasn’t formal coaching and teaching; it was more like a hobby than a job. I was happily helping my friend, and I had doubts about my ability to teach. The idea came back again around 2 months ago because I was stressed and one of the healthy ways to distress me was teaching others or doing social causes. I find that energizes me knowing that I can share my knowledge but also learn something new in return. In fact, I told my friend that I would do it for free if I had to but he advised me to charge a small fee for it. Typically, when I don’t charge a small fee that won’t last too long. But now, that it is paid, I have everything fully customized and ran like a business model. At first, I didn’t think I’d have students but apparently, I got 8 students and some people missed out on my announcements that they are waiting for the next session to start. Since I don’t really like too long of a commitment and would rather work within a couple of weeks at most, I made the class have a sweet spot of 6 weeks with T&C that they can schedule/book a private session with me whenever they need it. I am happy doing it and that has given me some time to destress whenever I feel too stressed about work or life in general. Although the downside of that is basically, I have to manage my time carefully but as long as I am happy doing it, actually it isn’t such a bad deal. ||| |-|- ![NTy4GV6ooFRmaCXZ8UYgPhoud1kjiNX8QokLEZtbBKLuLWQ9yt7K3o4PG7qiS2SfyUvr6dYces7DWJ8xfHhq8PVtQPrvofyP72KL3ppdRxeugWvBfxeBRgtHv4FSStZc4YZ6Tzt1Pm995NNPZRyGjU7WNd7xvdEv2qtUNXuG.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23t77FQVTCGtEBi1QzCfnjLFZ3BpB57ocvnKWNZbybVoNT2WGNztX9UKrTyCVdjXyPVch.jpg)|

title.title: Beautiful Paper Hat with Paper Bow, How to Make it
title.body:
Hello Everyone!

Today, I made a paper hat. There are many ways to make paper hats and beautiful designs. The hat is decorated with a paper bow. This is made only with colored paper.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSg8orvSz1jhg9Zg47RhbW7ThqZdVThYzCM8pTc6DFgL8/1773132073109.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRu96gN8yRnGT8bzGRVYPb9sKMGSjP6mz4FrMKq8c5j4Z/1773132107495.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmewTKuQjsKDDYqrF4MEM58ePJe7Ly3CERVdoYaM2McQEg/1773132107910.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQqdaUiETsCHskeHg7YGsfNUkfHJaLE3mxhS9yTGRzU9z/1773132108290.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaRLNKtxSFiap57nDsXA7vJDwqxdqwGaVLMDavPTpwcHP/1773132108734.jpg)

In the first step, I glued two sheets of purple A4 paper together. I folded the paper as three equal parts and glued them together. I rolled it as a circle shape and glued the two edges together. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd8hzQ8fzUVN2CNSoU3DVda5D95hBkCQhzwYF2tUrvnHF/1773132168892.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdTuD6om86BJ8uBFDYB5aGLRJAJotJwe6UrwPAr81RnwX/1773132169305.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZgP5yWV5BFZ6vaymxKvtyBt2kEsYv4L5mTvvK1t6T4tX/1773132169689.jpg)

I drew a pattern for the visor on the pink paper. After cutting it, I placed it on the orange paper because I wanted it to be thicker. I cut it and cut small pieces on one side. I applied glue to these small pieces and joined them with the purple paper together.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfABt2soWSLUqBpSfXRakQGJkrKQVy5LJZHrJCdFdNuJU/1773132431670.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUFpvvmd5wbqudKs2aEBxVdqpoF7cz2sVoLmcntiYVfzA/1773132432160.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZWVR4MVV9VX2hneuXdrwvxUPXKuHpowH2MBee78mVzoV/1773132432540.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPC5SwjAdjf7SugBC4shuFzDyDEDoSh11Eow41JsybMxn/1773132432935.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVW17rdq4DP9QH6hte5RX1nrRVRzb3twvMzQ6iyk3D3Zi/1773132433359.jpg)


In this step, I cut the orange paper with 14cm, 6cm. I cut this paper as shown in the picture and then cut two smaller black paper pieces. I glued them together.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNQFAcCCaHwgnEqByznWJ9u9UPbncWwFCvTWhHSFeH9kN/1773132472341.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYrRQGZ5FWGz9JxQGKRBjxvCMTodxNkp9WzkhmVpa5XQw/1773132472789.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaycfM38e8nK8CH2M6RFr61kdbXN5am49NTaxTf14b4qE/1773132473195.jpg)

For the paper bow, I cut the black paper with 21cm, 5cm. I continued to cut this paper as shown in the picture and folded the two edges to the middle and glued them together.  Cut a piece of pink paper and tied it in the middle. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNPt1x6F8ga8E91fG5ZsoLVRS7UBsx5FryXEYB1V6KFs/1773132539002.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTAfjB7QdcuRMBP4yJdjNRShFPffk5GTam4fp2wTwHqZn/1773132539505.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTjLHcjkavf3hEEB2xGvtTPV3WUoN8KQj7V6emSns6MpX/1773132540014.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX1TGnZMKXoBvm6pV2a8h6i4B8AqhdQpyzfJWzYNLGLU7/1773132540496.jpg)

Decorated the hat with two ear-shaped paper pieces and paper bow as shown. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeB4Bo3gmZADpHZ8G1k4c62drf7Dbic7mNKb2TEnmeYax/1773132591985.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmexdHkWW8uWxaRhosbYM1gtrLbk7Pw6FcBcgtWGL3T9ef/1773132592398.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWSZkEXSRC4x67GWwNCEaNkxvYN19y8mhr5zUERaNfCPF/1773132592794.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQX2vVzE69wtPXkhLLS4GCmFfEpd26TN56bQYnc4oaprW/1773132593255.jpg)

I like this hat because it looks beautiful after I make it. Thank you so much for your reading my post to the end.

title.title: [Literature] Charles Dickens:  DOMBEY & SON #12/471
title.body:
One of my little boys is a going to learn me, when he’s old enough, and been to school himself.’

‘Well,’ said Mr Dombey, after looking at him attentively, and with no great favour, as he stood gazing round the room (principally round the ceiling) and still drawing his hand across and across his mouth. ‘You heard what I said to your wife just now?’

‘Polly heerd it,’ said Toodle, jerking his hat over his shoulder in the direction of the door, with an air of perfect confidence in his better half. ‘It’s all right.’

‘But I ask you if you heard it. You did, I suppose, and understood it?’ pursued Mr Dombey.

‘I heerd it,’ said Toodle, ‘but I don’t know as I understood it rightly Sir, ‘account of being no scholar, and the words being—ask your pardon—rayther high. But Polly heerd it. It’s all right.’

‘As you appear to leave everything to her,’ said Mr Dombey, frustrated in his intention of impressing his views still more distinctly on the husband, as the stronger character, ‘I suppose it is of no use my saying anything to you.’

‘Not a bit,’ said Toodle. ‘Polly heerd it. She’s awake, Sir.’

‘I won’t detain you any longer then,’ returned Mr Dombey, disappointed. ‘Where have you worked all your life?’

‘Mostly underground, Sir, ‘till I got married. I come to the level then. I’m a going on one of these here railroads when they comes into full play.’

As he added in one of his hoarse whispers, ‘We means to bring up little Biler to that line,’ Mr Dombey inquired haughtily who little Biler was.

‘The eldest on ‘em, Sir,’ said Toodle, with a smile. ‘It ain’t a common name. Sermuchser that when he was took to church the gen’lm’n said, it wam’t a chris’en one, and he couldn’t give it. But we always calls him Biler just the same. For we don’t mean no harm. Not we.’

‘Do you mean to say, Man,’ inquired Mr Dombey; looking at him with marked displeasure, ‘that you have called a child after a boiler?’

‘No, no, Sir,’ returned Toodle, with a tender consideration for his mistake. ‘I should hope not! No, Sir. Arter a BILER Sir. The Steamingine was a’most as good as a godfather to him, and so we called him Biler, don’t you see!’

As the last straw breaks the laden camel’s back, this piece of information crushed the sinking spirits of Mr Dombey. He motioned his child’s foster-father to the door, who departed by no means unwillingly: and then turning the key, paced up and down the room in solitary wretchedness.

It would be harsh, and perhaps not altogether true, to say of him that he felt these rubs and gratings against his pride more keenly than he had felt his wife’s death: but certainly they impressed that event upon him with new force, and communicated to it added weight and bitterness. It was a rude shock to his sense of property in his child, that these people—the mere dust of the earth, as he thought them—should be necessary to him; and it was natural that in proportion as he felt disturbed by it, he should deplore the occurrence which had made them so. For all his starched, impenetrable dignity and composure, he wiped blinding tears from his eyes as he paced up and down his room; and often said, with an emotion of which he would not, for the world, have had a witness, ‘Poor little fellow!’

It may have been characteristic of Mr Dombey’s pride, that he pitied himself through the child. Not poor me. Not poor widower, confiding by constraint in the wife of an ignorant Hind who has been working ‘mostly underground’ all his life, and yet at whose door Death had never knocked, and at whose poor table four sons daily sit—but poor little fellow!

Those words being on his lips, it occurred to him—and it is an instance of the strong attraction with which his hopes and fears and all his thoughts were tending to one centre—that a great temptation was being placed in this woman’s way. Her infant was a boy too. Now, would it be possible for her to change them?

Though he was soon satisfied that he had dismissed the idea as romantic and unlikely—though possible, there was no denying—he could not help pursuing it so far as to entertain within himself a picture of what his condition would be, if he should discover such an imposture when he was grown old.

title.title: My belief about shooting stars.
title.body:
> 


## Hello, everyone.
I welcome you to my blog. Growing up, Disney introduced us to a lifestyle and left us with so many wishes that even they and our parents combined cannot make happen, trust me. As kids watching Disney cartoons and cartoons from other cartoon companies, it really did make us think that life is a bed of roses; it is where you wish for things and they just happen, and it is where you go to a waterfall to cry because of the ill treatment from people around, and then your fairy godmother appears and makes all your needs available without asking for anything in return. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWGBaxTGTaGkmGa6a5bSD9qbcmrzgqZovjSx57qNpkzhN/1773118535950.jpg)

[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/silhouette-of-man-standing-on-hill-during-starry-night-C6duwascOEA)

Disney made life look so easy; if you want to go from being an Ogre to being human, all you need is a fairy godmother to cast a spell or give you a potion, and problem solved, you can go from being an Ogre to a handsome man or beautiful lady. In Disney World everything you wish for, whether big or small, can come to pass; most of the time all you need is a fairy godmother, a wizard, or a witch to just cast a spell or say some magical word like \

and all you wish for will be made manifest; no hard work needed, you don't need to undergo any form of stress, and you just get what you want.

Growing up to see that life is not the way Disney painted it to be was quite disheartening; in real life everything you need and wish for, whether big or small, requires a lot of work, so much consistency, and having to show up every day to make sure it happens. No fairy godmothers are coming to make sure all that you wish for is made manifest, and no witch or wizard gives you a potion to make life any easier for you; you just have to survive each day by any means necessary. 

<center>

<div class=\

> Do I believe shooting stars make dreams come true? ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTj6fqdzuj7XykEWpwX1oSkAWGUij2RonMDFjitYq9PaV/1773118536031.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/shooting-star-on-sky-lUx3wMl_ML0) No, I do not believe that making a wish under a shooting star actually makes dreams come true; I believe it is just one of those fairytales from Disney making life look so easy. I have never made a wish under a shooting star, and I have never heard someone say that they made a wish under a shooting star and then it came to pass.

title.title: E132 RSF Toy Synth, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
title.body:
![1773065096851.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/23yJQgsTnFeYQdBpPoCDyQT915RBXH3wcMNiXoPnW3Fc2mgVReM1m1mzwXoin6hBpSYdM.jpg)

Blessings once again, everyone! Today I'm going to show you my latest drawing, dedicated to one of the beautiful cards in the game. For today, I've chosen card E132 RSF Toy Synth. This card represents the synthesizer instrument in a toy version. I don't know if you've read or seen some of the drawings I've done of synthesizers in the past, but in case you haven't, I'll remind you that I've mentioned that these types of instruments are my favorites—not this one specifically, but all synthesizers. It's by far the type of music I listen to the most and the one I most enjoy watching being played.

I often watch YouTube videos of musicians playing them; I like to see how they create the effects. Sometimes I find it mesmerizing. That's why I find it so much fun to draw and paint this instrument for you today. Before we get into it, I'm going to leave you with a video of a musician playing a synthesizer so you can hear what they sound like.

https://youtube.com/shorts/3s6fIdU5plc?si=Dm0vv3AlyKidRUZO


See how beautiful and entertaining it is? In the case of this one, which represents the card, it's a toy, so it's limited in functions and you can't do as many things as with professional synthesizers. Even so, it's ideal for learning to play in this world, and many children use them for that purpose. Many adults even use them in professional music because you can often achieve fun retro effects with them. Now let's move on to the drawing so you can see how I did it. To begin, I drew the inner frame; see how it turned out.

<div class=\

> ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTFhWm5FgY3dTrZBQErNU44hReQRadfwuYRNYCcj3P2pV1t7hMhn6gMEf5.jpg) After drawing the frame, I created the general outline of the instrument's body. It's completely rectangular. It was easy to do. Next, I drew some lines inside to create 3D edges and some internal divisions to place an element that comes in the next step. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTVXcrQVDnTaBUm9b7esz8r7NzZDzuh7QbWW5cwmKLg7Q2W5nEmMMJpPn3.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo6S6U3zkTDdsw3tTQRKrYZwHnibpcz9tLCXx7w4PBkvgaEhiEeyMRZcGudWFKSmsxy.jpg) What followed was drawing the keys of the small synthesizer. These are what create the effects, which can imitate many different instruments. Since this is a toy, it lacks more advanced controls like memory buttons and touch controls. Even so, it looks really cool. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoAh3TUaSE28QPEMKMryezt1kyShKAE4P9w5XrRX88WPWdi2Sm4j7jPgRrqML2T34ap.jpg) Now comes the painting. As always, it's the most fun part to watch. I started by painting the background a light pink, using this pink as an example from the original card, which has it on one side. The interior background is blue. I painted the piano light blue and various shades of gray and black. See how I did it all. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JmxvCAQpYbe9Tj8uqUaS8qjmbEMZWvt4efCExr3SnfZpvczj4E2dYDpPEDx6J1V8.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EoPQ3WqPbg9d4CuuvhEJoCCAHZ3wD4hxCWbS1W9hpCzpddXSYwDrZGM8Dz9o7XLGziY.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqqwPHSsYUvN348VzCZ4arNNrw4AR79Kd4sJ7WQNKY4FkqLXXFfpnhBQX2KiyYMeU7h.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqqwMCohjECQ39G6awgcCCp9sxqqSU1nYzQrCuV24BV1rgXQ2J9Eoe2LTfMAeyjRGPm.jpg) In the almost final step, I added the small holes that allow the internal speaker to release the audio to the outside. I also added the trim and the other missing controls. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqqwMCt3i9qLLTCGzy9gtyaobntkUi8KFCPN3StLYQCXPFkNURuijcKTVTAWGMj6NvM.jpg) And to finish, I'll show you the final result. See you in the next drawing. Blessings to all. ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/244Kg6XGnCULjuaPM4sK67uEYpb2ohWsQGFQugxL4iTed3bE8K491KYR7UMJkefA7S59T.jpg)

**Bitcoin (BTC) Snapshot**

Currently trading around $67,000 – $68,000

Major support: $65,000

Resistance to watch: $70,000 – $72,000

Institutional players are slowly creeping back in, which might help stabilize BTC a bit. But don’t get too comfortable — the market can turn fast, and patience is key.

**Ethereum (ETH) Outlook**

ETH is hovering near $2,000

Key breakout to watch: $2,100

title.body:
> ![1000578334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EowJ636buDGMcBKj2m1PCam4AGibmQBL6Vc6iKDKmiuncutRnKv3s38QMWXw8qvp33L.jpg) *** *** *** Today I will make a very delicious spicy and sweet shrimp chili sauce recipe, shrimp is a special menu in my opinion because shrimp is also very popular with many people in the area, this shrimp menu is also often made at certain events at my house. That's why today I deliberately bought shrimp at the market to make stir-fried shrimp with oyster sauce. That's the name of the dish I made. So for shrimp lovers, please come and let's cook this special shrimp together with just... ![1000578329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpNoSWVWEPewczWsB68TUMHahbhywvj5nso9bxy2y14Bf42E8gE18n9XewwkVv4XAGF.jpg) With a sweet, spicy, and salty taste mixed together, that's what makes this dish special. Usually, I only cook plain fried shrimp or mix it with flour. However, this time I will make this shrimp a little different from usual so that we can taste different dishes every day. ![1000578330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23yTcc1UiLnaVpnKrvy32ix3FiLg7rhPT6sRW4VVPkkoLbXwtJryETexTS3HpA5EzUTU9.jpg) The key to cooking delicious and savory shrimp is the oyster sauce, because oyster sauce is capable of making any food delicious, whether stir-fried or soupy.So don't hesitate to add this oyster sauce to your stir-fry. And if you are also curious about my cooking, just follow the steps that I will share in my post today. *** ###
Materials used
### *** ![1000578262.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23ywykyFTy2Qj5poHKi3RtRxLJrj3vsDrEzmQMk7vjTvtVpkoDseR41hWJPCX4yURYuFq.jpg) ***
250 grams of shrimp 1 tablespoon of oyster sauce 5 red chilies 5 green chilies 5 bird's eye chilies 1 tomato 1 shallot 1 clove of garlic 1 stalk of spring onion Salt to taste
*** ###
Manufacturing procedure
### ***
**First**
*** First, I marinated the shrimp with salt. Then, for the spices, such as chilies and onions, I blended them until smooth. |![1000577489.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpLipvzEQgmq39j2oziC3QoBQv81SD8A6SpkeqKuBvpZbjC886X1bUNzdc1P4o4GtAe.jpg)|![1000577488.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23w2cteUHUKbtLAhEYDDEAcRERHtnFtGSeqW4M9iHquGqV3wbh2ZMSKP8J5eGC5Ff183e.jpg) |-|-| |![1000577481.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23wC7vnC2UXGRf8n8rmzXXLhrs2TGojBGwCEcqfjxj8h4ZCnibg35NvAnGpUw79UCBxxG.jpg)|![1000577490.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EonjyEbPB91MTg1mBf7DK6Ufw3djWMnJJNCEeno7wMWUTHQzwz5QhTcbabUGTdRJoUe.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Second**
*** After that, I stir-fried the spices in hot oil for a while. When I put in the shrimp, I continued cooking them with the spices so that the shrimp were cooked through. |![1000577491.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoiWgZWr7RB5xxDLFe7ZEurgozpyDtqSV2SmjpdbffMSqABNXXXDv7L2VwTUnGoKW6t.jpg)|![1000577493.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EorzucC3BZwx6dtg2xTs3U9MqLepD5Bn7nhAwfZSD2uZdCSywWjyfG7Hiw2zA3BUzj3.jpg) |-|-| |![1000577494.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EogNNbxEw8ZnzTCtGvF7Uy9u1ReJsCZg17xwnYJJVFofWTwhqNcdfGdiCEfAHT3dTdP.jpg)|![1000577495.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpA15dvQCWZWPY6oXTccF6wU78PjVyeZVkjnMixngZnamh289vXWF2DHRvmuSDyAAhx.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Third**
*** Next I cut the tomatoes and spring onions, then I put them in the pan. |![1000577497.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EppLeJ6FCQ79CU3djzJHfHPk8KwBdrfg4YMaTkVQiRR3VvjotzvoCYvd9svZSaB4QAe.jpg)|![1000577499.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EpNnNTcV9gvFvqqw84v9ZLuBHbZLYaUvWWkdp3idqCBKszsqASrhmsAHMg7hP3ZbWgw.jpg) |-|-| |![1000577501.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Eopsps7XnK1Z4QrnZq9kcv3DNUgy8TcnFcedgdqjawL4kzw4afjU6hx2v2oXE3bQubf.jpg)|![1000577500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/Ep1WWP7ySGW1pFvzH1DHDBR5aKgf6UjYUSVMmU4W2nRGzLa8ZumEsHvgvFaXPc3wyLK.jpg) |-|-| ***
**Four**
*** Next, I added a spoonful of oyster sauce, a little water and continued cooking until the shrimp were tender and cooked. |![1000577504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EoK6KxNCFBgkh6br7UsWx3xYHWMNfL7dt6Yez7MZwHPdxzvJWMSkLW41MzprP2n6DoE.jpg)|![1000577503.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/EopsSP6PabHMq3UF9PDUYo3T366y5D67MTw5qJagJj3eWJGrLvwTFLVwNmYRg3qomXz.jpg) |-|-| |![1000577502.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23yTapNCz2ABznuSmFciatkV2trEC6kesiLrLBRBvAavhL1s9UEPEU4XTrz7kZeQ2Js13.jpg)|![1000578330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ryanaa/23yTcc1UiLnaVpnKrvy32ix3FiLg7rhPT6sRW4VVPkkoLbXwtJryETexTS3HpA5EzUTU9.jpg) |-|-| *** ###
RESULTS

title.title: Where’s the money gone?
title.body:
![question-questions_answers_4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrfahrenheit211/243qWBLMzoyTPbCV1CNds7uJ1xZbRvWDwwRk8Vux5F5QNJTom2qFWcYuSNL3GNzpaVM92.jpg)



I look at the state of Britain, my nation and home and I despair.  I observe the hollowed out Royal Navy, the crumbling infrastructure, the filth on the streets that takes for ever (if ever) to get cleared up, the lengthening wait for parents with mentally ill children to get help, the health services that are a quality lottery, the under-resourced police forces, the ambulances that fail to arrive in a timely manner, the schools that look as badly maintained as they were when I was a teenager many decades ago and much else and it makes me wonder.  It makes me wonder just where the massive amounts that Britons pay in taxation has gone? 

Britons are extremely heavily taxed.  We are taxed on our income then taxed again via Value Added Tax when we purchase most goods.  We pay council tax to councils that can’t do what councils thirty or forty years ago were able to do which is collect rubbish bins weekly.  We pay tax when we buy a home, tax when we buy fuel, tax when we buy alcohol, tax on hot food, tax on tobacco, tax to use and insure our vehicles and those sectors of our economy that actually work, the SME’s and the self employed are taxed when they make a profit. 

Britain pours an awful lot of resources into the tax maw but the average Briton can often see very little in return.  When we try to make use of the nationalised healthcare system we might be lucky and get excellent treatment or we might be among the millions of unlucky ones who get treated like absolute shit. When we ask for help from the state for our families we either get told ‘there’s no resources for you’ or what support we do get is to say the least, lacklustre.  When we sign up and patiently wait for social housing we get told that there’s not enough properties to go round and when our people who have put their lives on the line in our Armed Services leave the military, there’s little in the way of help to help them navigate the very different world of Civvy Street.  

We pay so much and get back so little that we should ask ‘where’s the money gone?’

It can’t all have been spent on welfare and the NHS.  It can’t all have been spent on ‘essential services’.  It can’t all have been spent on housing invaders who came by small boat or large plane. So where is all the massive amount of money that the State garners from the taxation of the individual and businesses gone? 

Has it all been wasted on fripperies and nothingburgers or are we and our institutions more corrupt than we give them credit for?  We used to laugh at nations who built roads to nowhere and bridges that crossed nothing because the decisions to build such wasteful were made by corrupt politicians and administrators who signed off on these projects in order to receive a cut of the funds but now it appears that we could have similar problems here.  For example, who benefited from the disaster that is the UK’s High Speed Rail system that cannot even manage to get the rails to end up at its planned final destination and which is now ending up with too many trains that are now too long for the platforms at the stations on this truncated rail line? I tell you what, it’s certainly not the taxpayer or the potential users of such rail services. 

Where’s the money gone because it is clearly not reaching those who need the services that this money should be funding? 

I’m not naive, I’m not a minarchist, I’m not in favour of the state doing nothing (where would we be without food safety standards monitoring and enforcement for instance) and I know that many services are expensive, but there must be oodles of waste that occurs that is not even being remotely tackled.  But the money that the Treasury gets off of individuals and businesses doesn’t seem to be spent on the things that the nation needs in order to defend itself, keep the nation healthy and ensure that poverty and despair is not on every British person’s menu. 

So I ask again: Where’s all the money gone? We’ve given it over to the State under threat of imprisonment but we rarely see the sort of services that this money could give.  We still have crumbling housing estates that are increasingly filled with despairing and left behind people but very little money seems to be being spent on changing that situation. 

We are beset by robbers who are robbing the British people blind but these robbers do not jump out on us from dark alleyways but instead wear suits and live far beyond the concerns of the bulk of the country in London SW1.  

This is not a situation that we should ignore or tolerate much longer.  There is only so far that a State can squeeze its citizens before the State is not seen as a partner in society but a parasite that lives off of it.

title.title: Root Causes vs The Art of the Deal
title.body:
![1000166561.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/melrod97/23xVTbWVNy6FS8Tc7aFn3QAxDBSfm7VSSPdcA6uoYgnuNPniPUP3SZqhq3cH5gTCCT7gQ.png)
Why are so many Latinos voting for or supporting the “evil orange man”?

Maybe it’s not because they love him.
Maybe it’s not because they dream of the American lifestyle.

Maybe it’s because they’d actually like their own countries to be livable so they don’t have to migrate in the first place.

Back on June 8, 2021, Kamala Harris gave a beautiful speech about addressing the “root causes” of migration in Latin America. The words were fantastic polished, thoughtful, compassionate… almost poetic.

She said:
“Most people don’t want to leave home. And when they do, it is usually for one of two reasons: either they are fleeing harm or to stay home means they cannot satisfy the basic needs of their families.”

And you know what? She was absolutely right.

Across Latin America people aren’t asking for luxury. They’re not asking for yachts, Teslas, or beachfront penthouses.

They’re asking for the basics:

• Electricity that doesn’t disappear like a magician’s trick

• Grocery stores that actually have food on the shelves

• Streets where you’re less likely to get robbed or killed

• Water that runs every day, not every third Tuesday

• Jobs that pay enough to feed your kids

That’s it. No miracles required.

If a country becomes even 20–30% safer and more stable, millions of people would gladly stay home with their families instead of risking their lives migrating.

Because migration usually happens when life becomes impossible when corruption runs everything, jobs vanish, crime explodes, and hope packs its bags and leaves town.

But don’t worry. We’ve had decades of beautiful speeches about fixing all that.

Amazing speeches. Historic speeches. Award-winning speeches.

Just a tiny shortage of actual results.

So maybe just maybe some Latinos aren’t voting for Trump because they like him.

Maybe they’re voting for him because after a lifetime of hearing elegant promises and inspirational speeches… they’re curious what it looks like when someone actually does something.

The Bible teaches that God created human beings with a clear purpose: to have a relationship with Him and to reflect His character on earth. Humans were created in God’s image, meaning they were designed to show His nature through love, righteousness, and holiness. From the beginning, God desired fellowship with humanity, which is why the first humans were placed in a peaceful environment where they could live in harmony with Him and take care of His creation.

Another important purpose for our creation is to worship and glorify God through the way we live. The Bible shows that our lives should bring honor to God by obeying His will and serving others. When people live according to God’s teachings showing love, kindness, humility, and faith they fulfill the purpose for which they were created. In this way, human existence is not accidental but part of God’s plan for fellowship, service, and bringing glory to Him.

title.title: Growing Up Alone After Early Loss, Working Any Job to Survive – Then Discovered Unexpected Blessings and Found Where I Truly Belong (My Introductory Post)
title.body:
![1000030778.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/EoGzRFqCjrfhtQF7L4YtmY1ZVKqUePNt2QvyQbE4H2BhWSfw1FrerbzBa5bno4NUwAf.png)


Hi everyone! I am Levie Baltazar, 36 years old, originally from Luzon. Today i want to share a glimpse of my humble life story one that has been shaped by loss resilience and the incredible gift of human connection.
 

![1000030779.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/EpC9WNebo32YKAGcMb8GoqDt4gJgV2i1cVW22G9wEfmqBuRbNdnyTB98nBLbq6wTFH9.png)

I lost both my parents at a young age leaving me and my siblings to face the world far sooner than any child should.
 

![1000030781.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/EoGwQwSABgnMtnA5e5uZ1frTmMUDyACQMtUBKchiAYBNhNYVFgdC9ijH34KmYpKbaqZ.png)

Back then each of my brothers and sisters had already started building their own families so i found myself learning to fend for myself.
 

![1000030782.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/EogLqAWKu6QoNnYGjxkeutyxdir62hF9LLhUpZrwe5FRjRLG95hZ5cBBntXQz7A8SM5.png)

I took on whatever work i could find just to get by there were no easy paths only the determination to keep moving forward.
 

![1000030780.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/EoK5H1teycUoZ1eaXs4rF68CGXT1fzPvywsR3edNf4TNb87fHMCK8fphH9mQybu1x7R.png)

Every photo you see here holds a special place in my heart they feature my cousins friends and partner the people who stood by me through every struggle who became my chosen family when i needed it most.
 

![1000030784.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/EpNpGZQQRNDKKLREhTWEGaPtKtTnMNfRiY6kG7srGBQs3n2pNoQo65kzfcMToqziUku.png)

In their smiles and warm embraces i found the strength to keep pushing to believe that better days were possible.
 
![1000030783.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/Ep3fpLALyMZyYnar4SpwzjB8qchmPQL21QArNoW6DrqyA3fG2KEsFYqm4p2cYgZpxWV.png)

Life has a way of bringing unexpected blessings and mine came through one of my siblings. They saw how hards i was working to build a life on my own and recognized that i needed more than just work to feel whole. With kindness that touched my soul, they invited me to join this amazing community. I am thankful and grateful that i was able to become part of this hive through @olang23.
 

![1000030786.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/EoK4r1jZhghYNGas9wrMDroW2nZsmHLPhby3NW8BEwyauD3y4phG4MSdXo4w368hNT9.png)

At first i was nervous opening up to new people felt daunting after years of relying only on myself. But from the moment  stepped in i was welcomed with open arms. I have had the chance to meet wonderful new friends who share my values who lift me up when  feel low and who remind me that no one should have to walk through life alone.
 


![1000030782.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/levieshome/EogLqAWKu6QoNnYGjxkeutyxdir62hF9LLhUpZrwe5FRjRLG95hZ5cBBntXQz7A8SM5.png)


This community has become more than just a group of people it’s become my second home. Here i have learned that family is not always defined by blood sometimes it’s the bonds we forge with those who choose to stand by us. Every laugh we share every challenge we face together strengthens the ties that hold us close. And with that i will end my story here thank you all so much for accepting me.

title.title: Power and traditions passed through generations
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVPghtAN1mpdu75wqfAL8TgoHt8By9Tkfc3ezrXyQLwjh/1773132434223.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/bullets-shells-bullet-shells-2166491/)

In the kitchen of my house, my grandmother's radio will receive strange signals at the time of year when the air is extremely dry and I'm guessing it might be from the effects of a strong blow of the harmattan wind. Today as I was doing the laundry, and preparing to make my breakfast, I heard the news on the radio and it was about Iran, the radio was not too clear but because of what was being said I took my phone and searched what was going on.

Apparently, Mojtaba Khamenei has officially succeeded his father, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, as the Supreme Leader of Iran. His son has followed in his father's footsteps. Hezbollah has sent its expressions of connection. The transition between the two generations looks to have gone smoothly without the conflict I thought was going to happen, so for anyone watching, your guess is as good mine, that the train continues to move in the same direction, Iran might not change in the their culture and politics at all.

I wondered what Trump is going to do about this one. Well he did say he never gets bored. Iran now has a ruler who sees Trump and America as the people who killed his father. What do you think will happen?

This power was passed down through arrangements and deals made in closed door meetings held in rooms that we will never see or know about. Let me give you a small example and see where your mind goes about the situation. My next door neighbour owns a store that sells only purified water in packages. When her daughter becomes a woman, she will not inherit anything with the exception of the expertise regarding the capacity of making frozen drinks with cold drinking water using the same purification process as her mother's has used.

Until a greater influence changes perception  the system will not stop, it will only change its face.

title.body:
> Hello!! Good evening @diyhub family, lovers of DIY and crafts. Today, I'm going to teach you how to make a really fun keychain or pendant dedicated to fans of Patrick Star, using moldable foam (foam clay). I hope the creation is liked by the entire community, and I'm super happy to share my experience with this flexible material. Join me!
Hola!! Buenas Noches familia Diyhub, amantes de los trabajos manuales y artesanías, el día de hoy les enseñaré a realizar con foami moldeable (foam clay) un llavero o colgante bien curioso, dedicado a los fanáticos de Patricio Estrella. Espero les guste la creación, a toda la comunidad en general y yo súper contento en presentarles mi experiencia con este material flexible. ¡Acompáñame!

>
Let me tell you a bit about who Patrick Star is and the show he stars in. He hosts his own talk show where SpongeBob also appears, with the support of his entire starfish family. He's always coming up with funny antics. I really like this animation, and it was very well-received in its time I 100% recommend it. Here's a craft I made with foam clay; I know it's not much, but it's my way of expressing myself through art.
Hablado un poco de quién es el personaje Patricio Estrella y el show que protagoniza, pues narra su propio espectáculo de entrevistas donde también sale Bob Esponja, con el apoyo de su familia estrella en general. Se muestra todo el tiempo haciendo divertidas ocurrencias. Este animación me gusta mucho y a sido muy aceptable en su momento, la recomiendo al 100%. Aquí les dejo una manualidad hecha con foami clay, sé que no es mucho, pero es mi manera de expresarme mediante el arte.

>
Next I will show you step by step the realization of my work. To begin with, I will mention all the materials used: >A continuación les mostraré paso a paso la realización de mi trabajo. Para empezar, mencionaré todos los materiales utilizados:

>

Materiales / Materials

  • Foami moldeable Rosado / Pink foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Verde / Green foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Violeta / Violet foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Blanco / White foam clay
  • Foami moldeable Negro / Black foam clay
  • Accesorios para llaveros / Keychainaccessories
  • Herramientas para pasta foami / Kit of foami

>

STEP/PASO 1

In the initial phase, I start by taking a portion of pink clay to make the body of the cartoon character. Then, with my hands, I mold it into a ball shape, giving it a curious finish.
En la fase inicial, comienzo tomando una porción de arcilla en color rosado para realizar el cuerpo del animado. Luego, con las manos moldeó en forma de bola, dándoles una terminación curiosa.

>

STEP / PASO 2

Next, I develop the parts of the body in the little figure: its head, its star-shaped torso, its lime-green pants, its legs, its hands, its eyebrows, and the beginning of the eyes, always giving my best.
Seguidamente, desarrollo las partes del cuerpo en la figurita, su cabeza, su torso en forma de estrella, su pantalon verde-limón, sus patas, las manos, sus cejas y el comienzo de los ojos, siempre dando lo mejor de mi.

>

STEP / PASO 3

Finally, we add the details to the eyes, the pants with flowers, and the final touch-ups on the face, using black, violet and white for the little character's shine. This design is a bit more complex, as the parts to be molded and attached to the metal are smaller. Creating this keychain or pendant in foami clay was a lot of fun, family, because its complexity in terms of vibrant colors was spectacular; it presents a lovely appearance as a clothing accessory.
Ya por último, realizamos los detalles en los ojos, pantalón de flores y retoques finales en la cara, utilizando los colores negro, violeta y blanco para el brillo del muñequito. Este diseño es un poco más complejo, pues son más pequeñas las partes a la hora de moldear y enganchar al metal. Crear este llavero o colgante en foami clay fue muy divertido familia, porque su complicidad en cuanto a colores vivos era espectacular, presenta una bonita apariencia en cuanto a accesorios de prendas.

>

Final result / Resultado final

It is worth mentioning that this idea was found on Pinterest; however, the creation of the animated character in the form of a keychain was done by me, with dedication so that they look even nicer in your home, as an accessory, or in your bedroom.
Cabe destacar que está idea fue buscada en Pinterest; pero la realización del animado en forma de llavero es hecha por mí, con dedicación para que luzcan mas bonitos en tu hogar, accesorio o dormitorio.

>
If you liked it, don't forget to leave a comment and follow me for future posts. I'd love to know your opinion and ideas for the next one. Regards
Si te ha gustado, no olvides dejar tu comentario y seguirme para próximas publicaciones. Me encantaría saber tu opinión e ideas para el siguiente. Saludos

**Strong points:** The energy-as-security model is real—[1 Zettahash is genuinely unprecedented](https://www.kucoin.com/blog/tr-bitcoin-hashrate-in-2026-latest-trends-mining-difficulty-network-security-analysis), making 51% attacks astronomically expensive. The metaphor connecting energy expenditure to immutability is conceptually sound.

**Weak points:** Energy cost ≠ value guarantee. Hash rate can shift (as [community threads note](https://inleo.io/threads/view/brennanhm/re-leothreads-rurwqwi5), privacy coins or AI-optimized mining could reallocate hashpower). Also, the argument conflates *network security* with *asset value*—a secure ledger doesn't automatically create wealth if adoption stalls. Energy proves the past is tamper-proof, but doesn't prove future demand.

(Note: This thread is about Bitcoin, not Hive—did you mean to ask about Hive's value argument instead?)

title.body:
openAI最新的大模型gpt-5.4出来了，我这两天用了下，感觉挺不错，说说自己的感受。

在gpt-5.4出来之前的前几天，不知道是怎么回事，我在用chatGPT网页版本的时候，明显能觉得性能比之前差许多，给出的回答质量显然无法跟先前相比，只是我最近用网页版较少，就没太在意。

嗯，跑题了，说说gpt-5.4吧，我这里主要谈其code和推理能力，个人感受比先前的5.3要好一点，但要说好很多，显然这话我说不出口，事实就摆在那里嘛，我甚至怀疑这gpt-5.4是openAI放出的专门针对calude的“无奈之举”吧。囧

当然，gpt-5.4在合规方面似乎放松了些，至少我在用的时候，发现不像5.2和5.3时动不动就收到不合规的信息，我用的是cursor客户端，不知道是不是跟在cursor提示词做了优化有关，这个只是我的一些猜测。

我用的cursor客户端，使用claude 的optus 4.6 和 gpt5.4消耗的token太大了，随便一个问题提过去，几美刀就不见了，弄得我现在感觉一天小心谨慎，完全没了之前使用大模型那种“洒脱”，隔一阵子就刷新看下usage，看下有没哪次请求过大导致消耗token太多？尽管我如此“省吃俭用”，这个月才过去了1/3不到，我看了下账单已经有67刀了，

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmULyJ63MJdsSp1otxX8XHYhCLGqijMzq3WEK1f3vYr7RK/image.png)

有朋友推荐说有OpenCode,我尝试安装了下，用的是openrouter的api，



初开始，虽然能用默认大模型，但像optus等用不了，后来发现问题是OpenCode默认走的是本地网络，需要强制其使用VPN端口流量，如，

>set http_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:7890
set https_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:7890


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb9hHX44ze7NLPJvG6CR2PhoxMoVBqLQi3bxaX2ds1uTU/image.png)


尝试用了下，发现如果只是做一般的工作，还可以。但是如果较为频繁的使用，就会发现稳定性很不友好，时不时会出现中断，这既影响效率，又影响心情。

显然，OpenCode目前还有不少的问题，等到日后稳定了再考虑吧。

claude 在国内是被禁止使用，是这家企业不给我们用。网上有一些折中的方法，但是我觉得不是很好，如果能直接使用其官方订阅，是非常不错的。

可惜，官方订阅需要个国外手机号码验证，我没国外的手机号码，没法做这个验证，只能眼睁睁看看。

大（强）模型好用，就是太贵。何况像optus这种，你想付费给对方钱，人家还不收。。。

title.title: Beyond the Short-Term: Fiscal Realism in Public Policy
title.body:
I remember some time in 2014 when a respected professor of mine, who happened to be a pastor of an influential senator in the country, gave advice about teachers' salary increases. As I retrieved my files, I stumbled upon my reply:

> That's true, sir. Corruption is part of the inherent nature of bureaucratic management. To completely eradicate it is an impossible task. Minimizing it is a worthy goal, and that's why we have been advocating for the legislation of FOI to provide a built-in mechanism for transparency and accountability.


> Concerning the salary increase for teachers, this may appear good as a short-term solution for a particular sector in society. And add to it the fact of increasing prices of goods and services, and we cannot but sympathize with the economic struggles of our public teachers. However, I am thinking of its economic impact in relation to other sectors of society and from a long-term perspective. What about if other sectors of society clamor for similar increases? How about if soldiers, doctors, nurses, police, firemen, barangay tanod, janitors, construction workers, street cleaners, garbage collectors, embalmers, midwives, social workers, and everyone else ask for an additional P10,000? Where shall the government get the funds to provide for all of this? Is it even achievable? The logic is clear: not everyone will benefit from a law similar to this. In the long run, instead of reducing the purse and the size of the government, it gets bigger, and citizens are increasingly more dependent on it.

Today, I didn’t do much: only seven small ALIVE put into stacking.

I also have an appointment with a doctor to renew my recognition as a disabled worker. This process has to be done every year, as if a disability could suddenly disappear as time goes by.

In reality, this system mainly allows the state to regularly check files and identify possible fraud. Unfortunately, some people manage to obtain disability cards or related benefits without truly being entitled to them. Corruption can exist everywhere: in administration, among some doctors, or through falsified medical documents. I personally find that quite shameful.

As for me, the process has become almost routine. Every year, I schedule an appointment with my general practitioner, who then refers me to a specialist. The specialist signs the documents, and I submit them to the Departmental House for Disabled Persons.
After all these years, I know the whole process by heart.

title.title: Autism Treatment Adults: Effective Support and Therapy Options for Better Living
title.body:
When people hear about autism, they often think about children. However, many individuals continue to need guidance and support well into adulthood. [Autism
treatment adults](https://ocl.ca/programs/) focuses on helping autistic individuals improve daily living skills, communication, emotional regulation, and independence. With the right therapies and support systems, adults on the autism spectrum can lead fulfilling and productive lives.Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) affects how a person communicates, interacts socially, and processes information. While autism cannot be “cured,” many treatments and supportive strategies can help adults manage challenges and build stronger life skills. Today, there are several approaches designed specifically for adults that focus on
practical development and personal well-being.



![autism treatment adults](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/585777a542486bdc5614effd719e85d495a963e979a474a325d087f5612e376a)

## Understanding Autism in Adults

Many adults with autism may havebeen diagnosed during childhood, while others only discover it later in life.Adult autism can appear differently from person to person. Some adults may struggle with social interactions, maintaining relationships, or adapting to change. Others may experience sensory sensitivities, anxiety, or difficulties
in workplace environments.Because every individual’s experience is unique, autism treatment adults is usually personalized.Treatment plans often focus on strengthening existing abilities while providing support for areas that may be more challenging.

## Common Autism Treatment Options for Adults

## Behavioral Therapy

Behavioral therapy is one of the\ most widely used approaches in autism treatment. Techniques such as Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) help individuals understand behaviors, develop positive habits, and improve communication skills.For adults, behavioral therapy often focuses on practical life situations such as workplace interactions, managing stress, or improving social confidence.

## Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)

Cognitive Behavioral Therapy is commonly used to help autistic adults manage anxiety, depression, and emotional challenges. Many adults on the spectrum experience mental health struggles, and CBT helps them recognize thought patterns and develop healthier coping strategies. This form of autism treatment  dults is especially helpful for those who want to better understand their emotions and reactions in everyday situations.

## Social Skills Training

Some adults with autism find social situations confusing or overwhelming. Social skills training helps individuals practice communication, body language, conversation skills, and relationship building.These programs often involve guided practice and role-playing exercises to help adults feel more comfortable in social environments such as workplaces, community groups, or family gatherings.

## Occupational Therapy

Occupational therapy helps autistic adults develop independence in daily tasks. This may include managing time, organizing routines, handling responsibilities at work, or improving sensory regulation.For example, an occupational  therapist might help someone create a structured daily routine that reduces stress and increases productivity. This makes occupational therapy an important
part of autism treatment adults.

## Support Groups and Counseling

Support groups allow autistic adults to connect with others who share similar experiences. These communities can reduce feelings of isolation and provide practical advice for navigating daily life.Individual counseling can also be helpful. A therapist can provide guidance on relationships, self-confidence, and personal goals.

## The Role of Lifestyle and Support Systems

Beyond therapy, lifestyle support plays a big role in effective autism treatment adults. Many adults benefit from structured routines, clear communication, and supportive environments.Family members, caregivers, and employers can make a positive difference by understanding autism and encouraging inclusive practices. Small adjustments—such as flexible work environments or quiet spaces—can help autistic adults thrive. Self-care strategies like mindfulness, exercise, and stress management can also improve emotional
well-being.

## Building Independence and Confidence

One of the main goals of autismtreatment adults is to help individuals live more independently. This caninclude learning practical life skills such as financial management, transportation, cooking, or job preparation.Many community programs now focus on helping autistic adults gain employment skills and workplace confidence.
With the right guidance, many individuals on the spectrum succeed in careers,
relationships, and personal growth.

## Conclusion

Autism does not disappear in adulthood, but with the right support, adults on the spectrum can live meaningful and successful lives. [Autism treatment ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zN5bQmaNxhgfTV8QA)adults includes a variety of approaches such as behavioral therapy, cognitive therapy, occupational support, and social skills training.Every person’s journey with autism is unique, which is why treatment should always be personalized. When combined with understanding families, supportive communities, and effective therapies, autistic adults can build confidence, independence, and a strong sense of belonging in the world around them.

title.title: Too Much Too Young at 250!
title.body:
>

### Hello hello silver bloggers, music lovers and Hello hivers! 

How are you doing? I am loving these longer days now! They have me in a good upbeat mood, which was topped up by listening to one of my all time favourite bands since I got up at 5 this morning.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/Eo6DZg1bF9Lwgu7hHfxHxkLYFG7DT72MMwtKwsDf5cJ4ackTMCrsihkundwwxiLwwtD.png)


We are going back to my Silver Chronicles post of a few weeks ago [My Soundtrack for the 80s my favourite decade](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@tengolotodo/my-soundtrack-for-the-80s)


Quite a self-explanatory title and it is my inspiration for the next few posts on ttt!

### I never saw these guys live in any of their lineups.

If you know me I love my horn section and of course sax so they would have been awesome to see!

***
It is Tuesday and that of course means that it's #ttt or #threetunetuesday and so it's time to share some tunes with you!
***
@ablaze started #ttt **250** weeks ago! Go check out what it is all about on his latest post [Radiohead's \

for Three Tune Tuesday - Week 249 - win some HBI](https://peakd.com/hive-193816/@ablaze/radiohead-s-kid-a-for-three-tune-tuesday-week-249-win-some-hbi)

Do go support @ablaze as without him we would not have this mental fun musical activity that you can win HSBI from! I am happy to be one of the SIX sponsors and it is kinda fun checking out music from all over this global village of ours!

### Long live #ttt 😁🎼 and #threetunetuesday




![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tbREoadfKSsGzyuSnsFLq1mrjfW2mLAeRPZ5DB4jRPgi9K1U3x6qGyEsbyUibDr2s7P.png)


### The Band - The Specials

The Specials were the undisputed fluffing leaders of the 2-Tone movement. Quite possibly my most favourite genre of music that fused the upbeat rhythm of 1960s Jamaican ska with the raw energy and political \

of British punk. 

Based in Coventry the home of 2-tone, they were more than just a band, they were a multiracial statement of unity during a very divided time in the UK.

All three of these tunes were released in 1980.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tbREoadfKSsGzyuSnsFLq1mrjfW2mLAeRPZ5DB4jRPgi9K1U3x6qGyEsc1VG2rdwmPg.png)


### Tune 1 - The Specials - Too Much Too Young

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rdu8VOWk3pg

Released in January 1980 as the lead track of The Special A.K.A. Live! EP, this song rocketed to number one. 

It’s a fast-paced, cautionary tale about teen pregnancy and getting married too early. The live energy on this recording is legendary, and at two minutes and four seconds it remains one of the shortest songs ever to top the UK charts.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tbREoadfKSsGzyuSnsFLq1mrjfW2mLAeRPZ5DB4jRPgi9K1U3x6qGyEsbyZ88cAchjQ.png)

### Tune 2 - The Specials - Rat Race

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AmkMEoVb6rA

Released in May 1980 this track perfectly captures the band’s social commentary. 

It’s a scathing look at the \

and the middle-class university students of the time who the band felt were playing at being rebellious before joining the corporate world. Funny they still do it today those posers, I could of course call them something else 🤣


It’s got a great, driving brass section that really gets you moving.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tbREoadfKSsGzyuSnsFLq1mrjfW2mLAeRPZ5DB4jRPgi9K1U3x6qGyEsc1VG2rdwmPg.png)




### Tune 3 - The Specials - Stereotype

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vdkuG9D1fU8

Last up we move to September 1980 and the first single from their second album **\
**. \n\nYou will notice a shift in their sound, moving into a \
almost lounge-music territory. \n\nThe lyrics describe a \

night out gone wrong and the empty cycles of modern life. It’s a bit more experimental but still carries that unmistakable Specials edge.

I saw this comment on YouTube which sums up Stereotype perfectly ...

#### Tuneful, tragic and hilarious. A total classic!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tbREoadfKSsGzyuSnsFLq1mrjfW2mLAeRPZ5DB4jRPgi9K1U3x6qGyEsbyZ88cAchjQ.png)


### So there you have it 3 songs released in 1980 from The Specials this week with my [80s Soundtrack post](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@tengolotodo/my-soundtrack-for-the-80s) as the inspiration!


Which was your favourite tune? Or have you never heard of them?



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tengolotodo/23tbREoadfKSsGzyuSnsFLq1mrjfW2mLAeRPZ5DB4jRPgi9K1U3x6qGyEsc1VG2rdwmPg.png)

***Note**: The 3 YouTube videos that I have shared are not owned by me, I am simply spreading great music on Hive.*

I wish that you all have a brilliant happy fun and terrific Tuesday until we meet again enjoy your tunes 🎶🎵🎶

### Thanks for visiting!

The images were were created by AI and Rafiki in InLeo from my prompts as @mmonline and ramblings are also from me with some assistance from gemini, the mad Scotsman TengoLoTodo unless otherwise stated.

title.title: feelin' like a pirate
title.body: well, a pirate with a seering headache, but that's a pirate on an average tuesday, innit? hopefully they's gonna put it back before i actually got need of it. the left side of my head. until then, small words and plenty of sunlight. very strange, the way we structure our lives, the indebting, the un-freedoms. something trivial to talk about in such difficult times, i know, but isn't that the way we typically move past terrible things? it beats dwelling on the shock that has been death this past long year. i was talking about indebting. my friend's in a position where her current job only requires her to work one week a month for the next year or so. pretty lucky turnout, no? still, when she first started here, she couldn't shake the guilt, the feeling of laziness associated. she wanted to take on a second job. yesterday, hanging out in the sun, taking a long noon walk together, we were talking about it - why not just enjoy it, though? this freedom that's not gonna be here always? you've been given a sliver of time, use it. says she will, and i hope she does, honestly.

>


i know well what that privilege is, the abundance of time, the small luxury of being able to go for a long walk or a coffee at noon on a monday, during office hours. she says to me, she's been thinking about me, how this is my life always, and i think yeah.
but at the same time, isn't it a tad strange that it's such a luxury, and that so much shame comes with it? talking to people with traditional office hours, you always feel a bit guilty, all this abundance of time on your hands - aren't you privileged. i don't know. i've said before, there's a lot of uncertainty, of unknowing that comes packaged with this kinda life. a lot of luck, for sure, but a lot of us are lucky in some way. we just often focus on not being lucky in the same way as x or y and somehow prioritize that. strange.

i'm not a fan of feeling guilty or bad about the life i've built for myself. not really. i don't see the point in feeling guilty over being able to take a long walk in the sun as opposed to being stuck in some dusty office somewhere, or behind a screen. why would i. and isn't it more weird and fucked up that that's the structure for so much of our western world? that we live in a society where we don't prioritize time in the sun, in the open air, a connection with the earth, time with our families, reading, a healthy development of our ongoing education and hobbies, to make us into more well-rounded people?

might that not be healthier for us as a society?

i just think it's kinda messed up for someone to feel bad over having time enough to maybe relax, work out, focus on her hobbies, spend time in nature and all that. i think it's messed up that we somehow think we can section these off into narrow time slots. for my friend, it's a year. for most people, it's weekends and holidays. the occasional day they finish early. to think, only, that we could structure the working day in such a way that people could earn their living in 4-6 hours, and still have time enough for all these things that are paramount to the healthy development of personality and relationship.

personally, i don't see much point feeling bad about your life and your \

. when the system's fucked up, maybe the thing to do is somehow change the system, not apologize for not blending into it. me, i'd rather take uncertainty over the illusion of security that is traditional employment. i might not be able to always, but as long as i can, i will, and focus on my art instead. because this fucked-up world sure ain't gonna heal from having more aimless gray paper-pushing pumped into it. i think it's a tragedy of our world that we've been left such a cruel small sliver of time for art and beauty and all those things which are meaningful and that actually have some chance to right the wrongs. on the other hand, the more i delve into my world, the more i meet people like me who try to find a way to live outside the system, to dedicate themselves to art, to beauty, to doing good, to nurturing not only their own souls but those of people around them. i think maybe there's hope. i think it starts with nourishing your own soul. well, why not through music? here's my contribution to #threetunetuesday. https://youtu.be/S7meg5BrZyg?list=RDS7meg5BrZyg https://youtu.be/GvC_ENMhJq8?list=RDGvC_ENMhJq8 https://youtu.be/_msb9W1s8no?list=RDS7meg5BrZyg
