links.title: I'm trying to control my emotions
links.body:
## Hello everyone!!!! 
### I hope so you all are fine and happy 😀 

Life is a school and we keep learning about thing's till the last day of our life. It doesn't mean that you only learn from the school while you learn the biggest lesson from the life as your own experiences is your best teacher but if you really want to learn and if you don't want to learn and do whatever thing's are like after making mistakes then it's also your decision. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcUM6vJ739GxQXJew7kZn9UymZL8LQwzYKeaP3Aa3P2px/1773125751351.jpg)
#### Image by <a href=\

>Pixabay ## Playing with my emotions!!!! 2025 was the year with biggest lost in life and after that i was trying to move on but something still inside me it's not the regret but it's the emotional balance which is totally disturb and my biggest goal this year to control on emotions. I know it's hard to play with emotions of ourselves as it's not the habit of mine but it's a change after some incidents in life and i just need to take a U-turn and try to be what I'm really because i know this is a mask on my personality which i can remove. ### Learning one thing!!!! Life is so uncertain that we never imagine such things can happen to us really but we start to face these things. I was a calm girl before 2025 but then such things happen in life that so much change inside as they effected my emotions too. I'm a very conscious person about health and i always try to sleep early at night but then i was starting to having nightmares and i can't sleep after those nightmares. I've fear's about many things in my mind which i need to control, things passed in real life or in reality as that era passed but leave imprint on my mind and now I'm having nightmares. I try to do many things to control on these nightmares as i know it's not in my control but then i think it's in my control just i need to control on my brain, thoughts and need to calm myself and for that i did meditation nowadays. ### Unlearning one thing!!!! Just like starting have nightmares i start to do become aggressive on little things happen around as you can say i can't tolerate bad thing's in life and I react to them immediately and after sometime mean after immediate reaction i start to think that i shouldn't say this or shouldn't give this reaction. On something's i control myself and be quiet that I'm in the process to control on anger emotion's. Sometimes i think my anger emotion's increases just because my mind can't take a proper sleep and then i feel irritated or disturb all the day and then i acted like which i shouldn't but sometimes i feel good as i can control. But poor Lesly is trying to control on her emotions nowadays. > That's all for today and it's my entry in this week hive learner contest in #hl-exclusive for the topic of #hl-208e1. * Thank you for your time and support 🙏

links.body:
I can't agree with that. Almost every game based on an anime license I've played (or any friend I've ever played with more than a few times about games) has been mediocre at best. There are games, like FighterZ, that are actually on par with Tekken/Mortal Kombat (meaning, very good titles in their category – my friend, a Tekken pro who hates DBZ, praises it because he knows Arc System Works), but that's not always the case.

Games based on licenses are usually cash grabs based on the simplest of instincts and consumer ignorance. The single-player campaign in Kakararot or JBA ASB (Jojo Bizzare Adventure AllStarBattle) is pathetically short, and the DLC is the biggest abomination (high price, extremely short content). The aforementioned Jojo game cost me a fraction of the full price at CEX (I think you paid 40 pounds for a new AAA title back then), and I was still disappointed. They condensed several manga chapters into... an hour? Maybe 1.5? Besides, the gameplay was so boring that if it weren't for my fascination with the third part at the time, I'm not sure I would have finished the whole thing.

Basically, most anime-based games can be summed up like this:
- cash grab.
- poor or at least disappointing graphics from before the 1st or 2nd generation of consoles (and sometimes worse).
- short single-player campaign, little multiplayer content.
- triple-A price.
- if you're unfamiliar with the series, you won't understand its plot due to the chaotic narrative.

And Bandai is (according to people who know this subject better) the epitome of ripping off the customer.

Sometimes you find yourself on the streets and you want to shoot photos, but the light is flat and grey, this is a problem for a person who relies on deep colours and harsh shadows for his street work. it is then that you have to shift to black and white.

links.title: Project Bike: Suzuki Thunder 125 - Valve clearance and no compression
links.body:
I have a 2010 Suzuki Thunder 125 that I bought second hand and abused. I managed to make it run in the past but as usual, life happened.

The bike was left at the farm exposed to the elements for about two years.

No I finally have the time (and more especially funds to buy parts) so I went back to fixing it. #realmechanic

**Disclaimer**: I am not a mechanic nor do I claim to be. Everything I do on my bike is a combination of hearsay on forums, YouTube tutorials, and advice from my good old friends ChatGPT and Claude.

I checked for spark. Initially there was none but I managed to fix the wiring and replaced the CDI which went bad so...

- Spark (electricals) ✅
- Fuel (tank + carb + air-fuel mixture)
- Compression

Next up, was fuel. I removed the carb and disassembled it, cleaned it, and reassembled it. I've done this multiple times in the past so I'm confident that fuel is going into the combustion chamber now.

- Spark (electricals) ✅
- Fuel (tank + carb + air-fuel mixture) ✅
- Compression

Unfortunately, when I checked compression, I had a reading of 50psi. Which is too low for this motorcycle. It should be at least 120psi. And that's still bad as it is the lower range.

One of the first things I check for low compression is valve clearance. The rocker arms could be pushing the valves open thus compression becomes impossible.

The first problem came from removing the crank shaft access cover bolt. It was exposed to elements so badly it welded itself onto the left crank case cover.

I tried everything. The hex/allen key that's originally designed for the cover bolt just rounded the hole. I tried a slightly oversized torx key. Same thing.

Finally I tried a bolt remover. Initially it didn't work, it just made the hole larger. But when I used a size bigger than what did it, it finally cracked the head of the bolt allowing me to turn it and take it out.

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQme3FvwcQPDvZy59wBmUMELq41PeA6AonCMXLsTDi5GFqr/IMG_0826.jpg)
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbkLgcUT6s5byUE2nzH7psfYzqb4fhZf7vz2YgLeyUWcz/IMG_0825.jpg)
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYDgE8V6khxHhvRtiddf8nBBGA1wbh9vqiaENpn7A9G3d/IMG_0827.jpg)

I was finally able to access the nut/bolt thingy that will turn the crank shaft.

**Note:** Specs and tutorials always said 17mm for this, but the actual size for my bike is 14mm. Weird but okay. If you encounter inserting a socket wrench key in there and nothing fits, try 14mm.

I turned the crankshaft so that the piston is at the TDC position and adjusted the valve clearances against the rocker arms. The intake valve didn't have any space at all and I ran out of adjustment screw. I had a bad feeling about it but I still continued and closed everything up.

But, I still had no compression. I can still easily push the kick starter by hand. I didn't even bother taking out the compression testing tool as it was too soft.

- Spark (electricals) ✅
- Fuel (tank + carb + air-fuel mixture) ✅
- Compression ❌

I was sad but I got to move on. Tomorrow I'll pour some engine oil and gasoline into the spark plug hole to remove any carbon build up and give the piston rings a bit of lubrication and filler for any gaps in one go.

If this doesn't work, I might have to do a top overhaul which I have never done before.

links.title: Квіткове задоволення
links.body:
Як же ж все таки іноді мало треба доя настрою. От стоїть букет свіжих евітів на столі, і так затишно одразу. Як же ж все таки приємно, що весна  наповнена свіжим цвітінням, і хоч це лише початок, та в дворах де не де прогулькуються красиві підсніжники, ледь підіймаючи свої білі голівки над ще холодною землею. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7ZqJTRJq4hN9r1YzFk2mQuHBD9DmyA2vtHXLDMsfWym/1773120185585.jpg)

І взагалі, дуже гарно, коли свіжа хоч одненька квіточка тішить око. Я вже не можу дочекатись, коли від сну прокинуться мої сплячі взимку вазони. Я забула їх вчасно дістати на сонечко і вони ще сплять. Лишається тільки сподіватись, що ті цибулинки взагалі прокинуться, минулого року в цю пору вони вже квітли на підвіконні, наче найкрасивіший букет.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU5zSqCUgoga4aWFYsAcJ5EBJe4n5GAxZiC8Wc6p1WpSF/1773120185785.jpg)

 Цього ж року по традиції хоч якусь живу квітку треба було принести додому, щоб весняна гармонія знову заграла своїми барвами і прогнала зимову хандру геть.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZgniXaa6xXyrsWLbNPMSFQ164eLPWCVYy7V3h3811Zgu/1773120185944.jpg)

links.title: My Hive Goals for 2026 Week #10
links.body:
I have decided to start posting a weekly update on my progress toward [my 2026 goals](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@jfang003/my-hive-goals-for-2026-lma) here on [Hive](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-what-is-hive). It helps me stay on track, and I can realize if I am behind on a goal at any point in time. It's the third month of the year so far, and there is plenty of time left in the year. Also, for everyone's note, the Saturday Savers has ended, but the Slothly Savers Club has started in its place. 

## Progress
![graph.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23w3EdqcgyNdgQhxZFjwa7PkKeicD7msfpa7NnakPuBTkdaCkG4MCEF99kX8CKmtaCQQU.png)
Above are statistics that I have gotten from [HiveStats](https://hivestats.io/). This week is looking a bit better than last week, and it all adds up over time.

### HP
I earned 103 [HP](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-hive-power-hp) earned throughout the week. I am checking this through the difference between the two endpoints on the graph on Hivestats. The numbers are looking decent. The numbers are looking good, and its even better than last week where I also participated in HPUD.

### HBD 

![HBD.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tkfuT2J3Szxd61FydTFkuiQVtufDYRfBYZTum7ACAFMtEc8o1KFj7xpvQCF49sMqkpr.png)
I earned 0 [HBD](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-hive-backed-dollar-hbd) this week. With the price of Hive lower, we have hit the debt limit. This means that we will be earning Hive instead of HBD. I won't be able to add to my HBD savings for a while, but the interest will help me towards that goal. When the Hive price is above the debt limit, I'll add to my savings. There isn't much I can do here, but at least that interest will add up. It looks like my interest will be coming up soon as well, and it's over 42 HBD.

## Conclusion


![goal progress.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tmmEVQaCP8XsrJ8i55p5oYvkoficWpJN6XYmSRsSVwhoZmK2CwAAibbJi8AM9WsJjQm.png)

My progress is looking decent for now. I need around 2% per week, so this week I met that standard. HBD is ahead of where it needs to be right now, and interest really adds up. However, without any HBD being earned, it might not be enough if that doesn't change by the end of the year. Other than that, nothing much has changed, and I am just slowly grinding away at my goals.

Do you have any goals for 2026? What is the progress towards your own goals? 

Feel free to leave a comment if you read my post. If you have any questions, feel free to ask, and I will do my best to answer.

links.body:
The success of the Arcane Conclave packs has been cemented by massive purchases of the packs in recent days. First, the Alchemy packs sold out, then the Legendary packs, and finally, even the last Standard packs sold out. Now, officially, there are no more packs available in the main Splinterlands store. You can still purchase packs on the secondary market, but at much higher prices than those offered by the company. But that's not yet the case!

Attention is now turning to the ESCALATION miniset packs. After the fast-start of the Presale, the miniset continues to be purchased, and currently, fewer than 180,000 pieces are available! This excellent result testifies to the health of the game and the community's continued support from its players.

Escalation has brought in approximately 60 million SPS to spsdao, plus additional revenue from CREDITS, crypto, and cash. I'm fairly certain the miniset will be sold out before its August availability date. But we'll get there in time. I'm rather pleased with the very positive climate Splinterlands has been experiencing for a year now, and it bodes well for the near future.

In primis il sold out dei pacchi Alchemy, poi i Legendary ed infine anche gli ultimi Standards sono andati esauriti. Ora ufficialmente non ci sono più pacchi disponibili nel negozio principale di Splinterlands. È possibile invece acquistare pacchi dal mercato secondario ma con prezzi molto più elevati rispetto a quelli messi a disposizione dalla società. Ma non è finora qui!

![1000060239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/claudio83/23w2FXvHnWyQYovqZJbw1Bstd3nu8dAFbXRvMo18rij2EcE8pPKyTe42nVnZCWfGyj3ar.jpg)

Escalation ha portato nelle casse di spsdao circa 60 milioni di SPS, più altri introiti derivanti da CREDITS, crypto e cash. Sono abbastanza certo che il miniset sarà SOLD OUT prima della data di disponibilità di agosto. Ma ci arriveremo con il tempo. links.title: Just perceive - Monomad Challenge
links.body:
![IMG_2880.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wilfredocav/23xedu8ayiz6jDem4XWhyJuR6NTaWwe1jtszUaxf1ikGLo95NQ8qzQz4sxuxyVyfAD7Ag.jpg)

It's not about a specific theme; it's about trying to show the vision one can have of this world from different perspectives. Sometimes, the environment itself, or the chaos generated by humankind, creates a perfect contrast for composition. That's how I see it, and that's what I try to capture. An example is the first photograph, which is of a statue of Simón Bolívar. It's not the figure itself that catches my attention, but rather how it contrasts with what we can see, like a tree with flowers. From that angle, I was drawn to take that photo.

![IMG_2887.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wilfredocav/23uFKXpfcAmRtGMDKsEGdJv4Bn1cc7rKvt2hUfVsDiviVdb4JFkK3uX95YCuxARXLTMq7.jpg)

![IMG_3001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wilfredocav/23xKr7R7cBA3VLNVDwRGcZh3Lz3LGxqEJ3vRiNesMDnZ2E38a37m5hHKcXq4xabjnt8UK.jpg)

And so we can see this whole visual code, as we can also see in other photographs where the composition of light is more prominent. Well, it's not that I manipulated the composition; it's simply the way it is at that moment, where the sunlight influences some areas more intensely while others are hidden in the shadows. That's what it's all about when taking these kinds of photographs.

![IMG_2858.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wilfredocav/23u5vsT66Qa9L8nf33CPHEucadkWyZ3mTTzLPM7o9jsJ4un9jb2fG5HD1bftuYvaMp3cy.jpg)

![IMG_3103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wilfredocav/23vsDreHJ85KNPbRrvyLp9mNVh9qqCcwjD1CL1r7QDkFjtcK4XSs4wQTHsCZxrfozqiae.jpg)

While in other shots I focused on details and closer framing, where I sought to highlight the forms that define the object, person, or living being, because that's the best way I find to achieve harmony in the composition. Ultimately, it's all about how to fit the forms within the frame, or at least that's how I usually perceive it.

![IMG_2975.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wilfredocav/23tbyicPomjA4TyHFQ2mrzzhGS8fFevdFdEmowa9ZgQNdz7MEq4FzLVKrjReqm2n3vwXC.jpg)

links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![Nwiy2Q3QHzAtf67B_IMG_20260222_111258.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/Nwiy2Q3QHzAtf67B_IMG_20260222_111258/Nwiy2Q3QHzAtf67B_IMG_20260222_111258.webp)
![E0MzCXo3GDP4a3aR_IMG_20260222_112459.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/E0MzCXo3GDP4a3aR_IMG_20260222_112459/E0MzCXo3GDP4a3aR_IMG_20260222_112459.webp)
![PwiYdNQ2Zw0fysvY_IMG_20260222_121133.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/PwiYdNQ2Zw0fysvY_IMG_20260222_121133/PwiYdNQ2Zw0fysvY_IMG_20260222_121133.webp)
![kZPJ6Gfzk3gywdLe_IMG_20260222_121841.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/kZPJ6Gfzk3gywdLe_IMG_20260222_121841/kZPJ6Gfzk3gywdLe_IMG_20260222_121841.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

春节放假前，老婆筹划了一场旅行。

按我近年的状态，实在没有太多心态去玩。不过老婆想出去玩的意愿很强，我也没有过多的挣扎。以我多年的抗战经验：如果不答应，这整个过年都可能会家庭不和谐，吵架之类的。

这种情况有点类似，说老婆坐月子，如果没弄好，可能一辈子就记着你。

所以，我们还是愉快的出发了。带上了小孩，还有外婆。

我们从武汉直飞的云南。我曾经去缅甸，到云南中转过飞机，所以，我对云南的最直接印象就是云南的机场。其他的都是网上看到的。包括“云南四季如春”这样的出印象。

报的团，这次我是完全的拧包就出发的，我没有做攻略也没有详细了解行程，到了就玩哪。

第一天主要就是坐飞机到云南，然后入驻酒店。第二天开启了我们的行程，云南石林。

云南的石林分为大石林和小石林，都是典型的喀斯特地貌。大石林最先抓住你眼球的就是石林上的那些字，又都是一些历史人物弄上去的。这背后又有很多的趣事。本来只是一处自然景观，但是因为很多的历史人物，这些自然景观又产生了一些新的故事。

石峰密集、气势磅礴。跟我在恩施看到的石林很像了。这些都是亿万年前的大海，后来的造山运动变成了陆地。石林群都可以看到一个整齐的，像是被劈了一刀的，那就是以前的海洋层积的位置。

小石林又叫阿诗玛景区，有一段关于阿诗玛和啊黑哥追求和争取抗争自由恋爱的故事。我发现，特别是在80年代早期，流传了很多这样，关于自由恋爱的故事。也有一块像阿诗玛和啊黑哥的石头。当然，还有一些转运，发财的石头，会让你去摸。

哈哈，非常熟悉的中国景区的味道。特别是跟团游的，导游也会乐于跟你讲很多跟景区相关的风水迷信甚至八卦的事情。

走马观花，了解了一些故事，体会了不一样的景。第一天的大概就这样了。

---

links.title: SHORT STORIES - (PHOTOGRAPHY STORIES)
links.body:
![Ccats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AK2EirkzpBWM5M2fmnomn1Dzaca9b2qUvh8gcSJpZL8zpeoQBYMkX7YJMo5oECp.jpg)

----

**T**his afternoon I did what I love most: I sat down at my computer, browsed through my files of unprocessed, unedited, and unshared photos, and then worked on them while remembering what they mean to me. And then, as I always do and love to do, I'm sharing them with you here on #Hive...

>**H**oy en la tarde hice eso que tanto amo hacer: Sentarme en frente de mi PC, recorrer mis archivos de fotos sin procesar, editar ni compartir, y entonces dedicarme a trabajar en ellas al mismo tiempo que voy recordando lo que significan para mi. Y entonces, tal como siempre hago y amo hacer; las comparto con ustedes aquí en #Hive... 

----

![C01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23vsayzWtKqD8jjtqgvRoy1hBFq8v96Wfg2dcNPcfJWVtPUvgMZtFQ9SHcsMwZDmHFA24.jpg)
**📷 01 - \
... </sub>**\n\n**T**his old dog is usually at the taxi stand almost every day, and the taxi drivers who wait there for passengers have nicknamed him \

because they say he's unlucky: they say he's been hit by motorcycles three times, and he also has a partially damaged eye from a fight with other dogs. On top of all that, he's also in a terrible mood. But it's not all bad luck for \
because the taxi drivers have adopted him as a pet and give him food and fresh water. They also let him sleep inside the small office of the taxi company, although \
continues to growl when they try to touch him...\n\n>**E**ste viejo perro suele estar en la parada de Taxis casi a diario, y los taxistas que allí esperan pasajeros le han nombrado \

pues dicen que tiene mala suerte: Le han visto ser atropellado por motocicletas tres veces según cuentan, también tiene un ojo parcialmente dañado debido a una pelea con otros perros. Además de todo eso, también tiene un pésimo humor. Pero no todo es mala suerte para \
, pues los taxistas le han adoptado como mascota y le dan de comer y agua fresca, también le permiten dormir dentro de la pequeña oficina de la línea de Taxis, aunque \

continúe gruñendo cuando intentan tocarle...  

----

![C02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23yd7s2Bcr57Q2asrghHRw1VKW8XLrLx8s9Er8QD3bZbwFhvFL3P2hcYDg8JUBLcqPMwU.jpg)
**📷 02 - Where \

... </sub>**\n\n**T**here, in that old little house with its rusty corrugated metal roof, and through that equally old wooden door, was the only place where anyone could buy liquor illegally in the mid-80s, even kids like me and my high school classmates, who were probably only 14 or 15 years old at the time. The liquor was sold by a chubby old man with ruddy skin whom we all simply called \

(The Andean). But one day the old man died, and we, even though we were older and could buy liquor legally anywhere, I think that day we cried a little and drank a few shots in his memory...\n\n>**A**llí, en esa vieja casita con techo de laminas metálicas oxidadas, y a través de esa pequeña puerta de madera también vieja, era el único lugar en donde le vendían licor ilegalmente a cualquiera a mediados de los 80, incluso a muchachos como yo y mis compañeros de secundaria, quienes a lo sumo tendríamos 14 o 15 años por aquel entonces. El licor lo vendía un viejo regordete y de piel enrojecida a el que todos simplemente llamábamos \

. Pero un día el viejo murió, y nosotros, aunque ya mayores y pudiendo comprar licor ya en cualquier lugar legalmente; creo que aquel día, lloramos un poco y bebimos algunos tragos en su memoria... 

----

![C03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/243qPt1Byv5AwYHpUEcWYKPzEP2nKtBQ8jYMm4YiFqZCzQNUcUBg5RthaxwgkfyHHANpo.jpg)
**📷 03 - Emilio wrote: \

... </sub>** \n\n**O**ne moonless night last December, Emilio was riding his old bicycle home, quite drunk. Just a couple of blocks from his house, the power went out (they're very frequent here), plunging the street into complete darkness. In his drunken stupor, Emilio crashed spectacularly into a lamppost. The next day, as a way of giving thanks for not killing himself and only ending up with a huge bump on his head, Emilio wrote \

at the base of the post. Although the gossips in town say it was his wife who wrote it, because ever since that night, Emilio only gets drunk during the day and on foot... 😂\n\n>**U**na noche sin luna del pasado Diciembre, Emilio iba de regreso a su casa en su vieja bicicleta e iba muy borracho. Y Emilio tuvo la mala suerte de que justo un par de calles antes de llegar a su casa, hubo un corte de electricidad (son muy frecuentes aquí) y la calle quedó absolutamente a obscuras. Y Emilio, en plena borrachera, terminó dándose un sonoro porrazo contra un poste de alumbrado... Al día siguiente, como acción de gracias por no haberse matado y haber terminado solo con un enorme chichón en su cabeza, Emilio escribió al pie del poste: \

. Aunque las malas lenguas del pueblo, dicen que quien lo escribió fue su esposa, pues desde aquella noche del porrazo, Emilio ya no se emborracha sino de día y andando a pie... 😂 

----

![C04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23tSWg8ax4tLXK28G5vyWHfCy3rjYu4HfnrPtHwVkPas6nckxrCrh4eLPfNL3SvqpYc8f.jpg)
**📷 04 - The Lottery Ticket Kiosk... / <sub> El Quiosco de billetes de Lotería... </sub>** 

**I** remember it perfectly: It was 2017, one of those years of great shortages, one of those years when even with money in hand you couldn't buy anything to eat because there simply wasn't any... And then, at that small green tin kiosk, where in better times everyone went to buy lottery tickets, that \
happened: you could buy coffee, sugar, cigars, and even \
... Today the kiosk is closed, its owners left town like so many others, but the people who are still here remember that \

when they pass by and see the little sign with the list of products...\n\n>**L**o recuerdo perfectamente: Era el año 2017, uno de esos años de gran escasez de insumos, uno de esos años en los que ni siquiera teniendo el dinero en la mano se podía comprar algo para comer porque simplemente no lo había... Y entonces, en aquel pequeño quiosco de latón verde, en el cual en tiempos mejores todos iban a comprar boletos de lotería; ocurría ese \
de poder comprar: Café, azúcar, cigarros e incluso \
... Hoy el quiosco está cerrado, sus dueños se fueron del pueblo como muchos otros, pero la gente que sigue aquí, sigue recordando aquel \

cuando pasa por allí y mira la pequeña lista de productos...  

--- 

![C05.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23xAeLre8qxUM4t47e1ynxQqeXSTdsHjrxsjrGcpNZBnC51kQr9yXJZe7ZJHuJbngjz1D.jpg)
**📷 05 - Enrique... / <sub> Enrique... </sub>**

**T**his is a really short but incredibly brave story: When he was just 15 years old, Enrique lost one of his legs in a car accident that nearly cost him his life. But since then, Enrique has been an example of optimism, spirit, and courage. He's never seen idle; he's always working, and he only uses his prosthesis to go to Mass on Sundays because he says he can move faster without it.

>**E**sta es una historia realmente corta, pero muy valiente: Cuando contaba apenas 15 años, Enrique perdió una de sus piernas en un accidente de tránsito el cual casi le cuesta la vida. Pero desde entonces Enrique ha sido un ejemplo de optimismo, de espíritu y de valentía. Y nunca se le ve sin hacer nada, siempre está trabajando, y solo usa su prótesis para ir a misa los Domingos, porque dice que puede moverse más rápido sin ella... 

----

![C06.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23u6FnzoA8Hp6xNerfTzc21RQ884HCxU3FTYeTZGUKzUnQbRBjgrj8URgyyTX5ywsDzVT.jpg)
**📷 06 - Last night there, two people talked... / <sub> Anoche allí, conversaron dos... </sub>**

**T**here's this street in the village where, at dawn, old iron chairs are always arranged differently each time. It's as if, at night, people—the neighbors, I mean—gather to chat and then go to sleep, leaving the chairs there, and sometimes even a small table... But for this photo, it seems that last night \

...\n\n>**H**ay esta calle en el pueblo, donde al amanecer siempre hay viejas sillas de hierro colocadas de manera distinta cada vez. Es como si por las noches las personas, los vecinos quiero decir, se reunieran a charlar y luego se fueran a dormir dejando allí las silla e incluso, a veces, una pequeña mesa... Pero para esta foto, parece que anoche allí \

... 

----

![C07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23wqy3iCdch9ikni6eSBmWEi9ckKCftyh5e5NfNkXiQ97etPPsH5ndyZbYMmhXk2Wk22Z.jpg)
**📷 07 - This guy who always ignores me... / <sub> Este que siempre me ignora... </sub>**

I don't know if this is exactly a story. But it's simply that this dog, when he's around, ignores me when I take pictures of him, even when I lie down in the street to take a portrait like this. It's as if he's playing a game of ignoring me, because when I stop pointing my camera at him, he turns his head towards me and watches me, and when I raise the camera, he looks away again... 😕

>Esta no sé si es precisamente una historia. Pero se trata de que, simplemente, ese perro, cuando está allí, me ignora cuando le hago fotos, incluso cuando me tumbo en la calle para hacerle un retrato como este. Es como si jugase a ignorarme, porque cuando dejo de apuntarle con mi cámara, entonces voltea su cabeza hacia mi y me observa, y cuando levanto la cámara, vuelve a mirar hacia otra parte... 😕

links.title: [ENG/ESP] Delicious and easy lunch with stir-fried chicken and cabbage😋 - Delicioso almuerzo fácil con un pollo salteado de repollo😋
links.body:
![Post para redes sociales gracias por tanto apoyo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maria27/AJoKCTvjoyyXr6NEpLKnGXS7wFuM5vaQNwdmFzxLoXFaJptU3g5AfjNV3THcQJN.jpg)


Hola, cómo están? Espero que estén bien. En este post les compartiré una receta fácil y rápida para nuestros almuerzos inspirados en comidas asiáticas pero a mi estilo.
Espero que les guste.

*Hi everyone, how are you? I hope you're doing well. In this post, I'll share a quick and easy recipe for our lunches, inspired by Asian cuisine but with my own twist.
I hope you enjoy it.*

![26uUsAjKTsXCDw7zixZR182JbFKvgzJ9YwsFpTVcRaGCmsqhA1unTgpqwjykKrrC3MtcX6irdQWS5fVFMtf4G4yS6tTQTzYSeyFpzQ2gZodQyBgxzTwQZ7JJxNXkL8mNTknvY8Xwx6hfr4UKi4un2CeVa5sGrp5yPDmfWW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maria27/23w28j1Yt8MN2qNSaE9Lr7EUfZYJobh4qbj3TXSDoiq5kSmjjyaKUHWbLzxsPYPiwuh36.png)

# INGREDIENTS/ INGREDIENTES

- Pollo/ *Chicken*
- Cebolla/ *Onion*
- Pimentón/ *Bell pepper*
- Repollo/ *Cabbage*
- Salsa de soya/ *Soy sauce*
- Pimienta negra/ *Black pepper*
- Ajo/ *Garlic*
- Sal/ *Salt*

![IMG_20260308_140322_105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maria27/23wWwQmg3oFnyt7VijaooxyWD8mbPspa7Mdtckij5cVAQdX6tUsEnWyeqzb9qHgrDuk9M.jpg)

![26uUsAjKTsXCDw7zixZR182JbFKvgzJ9YwsFpTVcRaGCmsqhA1unTgpqwjykKrrC3MtcX6irdQWS5fVFMtf4G4yS6tTQTzYSeyFpzQ2gZodQyBgxzTwQZ7JJxNXkL8mNTknvY8Xwx6hfr4UKi4un2CeVa5sGrp5yPDmfWW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maria27/23w28j1Yt8MN2qNSaE9Lr7EUfZYJobh4qbj3TXSDoiq5kSmjjyaKUHWbLzxsPYPiwuh36.png)

# PROCEDURE/ PROCEDIMIENTO

Para empezar, pondremos a freír en una bandeja con un poco de aceite la cebolla y pimentón en tiras hasta que la cebolla estén blandas.

*To begin, we will fry the onion and paprika strips in a tray with a little oil until the onion is soft.*

![IMG_20260308_140446_109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maria27/23ywry3byvQUoFNzHo7Yaq8jShPhY9TtDQoGvB18Rr5wqPzGbWmJvQGV84QUvoCmKBjGd.jpg)

Por otro lado, prepararemos el pollo cortado en cuadros dándole sabor con pimienta negra y sal al gusto.

No nos olvidemos de unas gotas de salsa de ajo o salsa inglesa (opcional).

*On the other hand, we'll prepare the diced chicken, seasoning it with black pepper and salt to taste.
Don't forget a few drops of garlic sauce or Worcestershire sauce (optional).*

![IMG_20260308_140553_321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maria27/23tveaGZ1KRCD2Z388i2Jg4uKdZjzPnQDsf7Hi1rXneTz9tP9PX5kstM3Si4Lf5WZQjyJ.jpg)

![IMG_20260308_140651_667.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maria27/23w2qGTRXk9RfbjjzuxQBfFNcZCoeaVL6GANVWWZk3A6UwkAVK5uqwDtXFzgZRZSpcMwe.jpg)

Pasados los minutos, uniremos el pollo con la cebolla y pimentón juntos.

*After a few minutes, we will combine the chicken with the onion and paprika.*

![IMG_20260308_140740_259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maria27/23u6Fn26KmTF3rbeZnaWDWp235wauNNdvvVEVTVGmXtQ7evLNaTEZfDYiiChTeV2DZfqY.jpg)

Pasados unos 2-3 minutos aproximadamente para así poder agregarle el repollo en tiras.

Dejamos cocinar.

*After about 2-3 minutes, add the shredded cabbage.
Let it cook.*

![IMG_20260308_141248_691.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maria27/23xAXkfq4q76XEYo2B6fu1jnSn6JDWiAheR7cqNfuidfqmBcQrsoqQu1kmS9E3PtSRtxG.jpg)

Para terminar, mientras se cocina nuestro salteado podemos agregarle unas gotas de salsa de soya.

Dejamos cocinar hasta que el pollo esté en su punto. A comer!

*Finally, while our stir-fry is cooking, we can add a few drops of soy sauce.
Let it cook until the chicken is done. Enjoy!*

![IMG_20260308_141423_390.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maria27/23tmHRDMuMcNp76oCHqJFcnLAbZ6RmswYcZAqyRMLqfKjr2dmoNAjV73Cp1jwfZ6SP2r5.jpg)

In other words, most of my teas are made up of natural ingredients such as ginger, cinnamon, cloves, turmeric and so on other times it can be a more bitter herbal mixtures such as bitter leaf tea scent leaf tea, guava leaf tea and so many more. In essence, my choice of either coffee or tea with definitely be tea because there are several variants that are healthy for our body system and can be available whenever and wherever. This is easily prepared by boiling all your helps together and drinking it warm.

Es waehre einfach nur eine Art anderer Datensatz, den Du da gebaut hast.

Wir muessten dafuer dann \

Wissen, was die moeglichst falsche erste Frage auf dein Werk waehre, in welchem es sich selber Beluegen wuerde sozusagen.

Das waehre dann eine Art Uebersetzer, fuer eure Arbeit wenn er Fertig ist. body.body:
> 

![Black Blue Futuristic Cyber Security Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23ywGoqjgoe7TKhiq2m9Df2592NHd28Y3wZzZzNihQaGi8qgnws71DJvqaM4fW3Jun5JH.jpg)

# 🔐 Cyber Security Daily News | 10.03.2026

Codzienny przegląd ciekawszych wiadomości ze świata cyberbezpieczeństwa, do poczytania przy porannej kawie, podzielony na kluczowe kategorie.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uQNo2ZNdmyEDPLbmL62DcUKF9ytXn43wpY9fRtv2vxLKrB2b5d1tFx2X9PwLHq8YrxG.jpg)

-----

## 📰 1. NEWS

---

### ***Ericsson ujawnia naruszenie danych po ataku na dostawcę usług***

Amerykański oddział Ericssona poinformował o incydencie bezpieczeństwa, do którego doszło za pośrednictwem zhakowanego zewnętrznego dostawcy usług. Atak dotknął dane powiązane z klientami korporacyjnymi firmy, choć Ericsson na razie nie podał dokładnej liczby poszkodowanych osób. To kolejny przykład tzw. ataku łańcucha dostaw – gdzie hakerzy nie uderzają bezpośrednio w dużą firmę, lecz w jej słabiej zabezpieczonego partnera biznesowego. Tego typu incydenty są coraz częstsze, bo duże korporacje inwestują w swoje zabezpieczenia, ale nie zawsze kontrolują poziom bezpieczeństwa swoich dostawców. Ericsson zapewnił, że współpracuje z organami ścigania i prowadzi dochodzenie wewnętrzne. Klienci, których dane mogły zostać ujawnione, mają zostać indywidualnie poinformowani.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tkmzKRy6xWqniLjBD7AVEKX45nhvzdJwL9ppkenp6ZDq57uX2fkVbYBom9KU6fXJCf8.png)

*Źródło: [Bleeping Computer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/ericsson-us-discloses-data-breach-after-service-provider-hack/) [EN]*

---

### ***Wielka Brytania tworzy nową jednostkę do walki z cyberprzestępczością i oszustwami***

Brytyjski rząd ogłosił powołanie dedykowanej jednostki mającej na celu zintensyfikowanie walki z cyberprzestępcami i oszustami działającymi w sieci. Nowa struktura ma łączyć zasoby policji, służb wywiadowczych i sektora prywatnego, by skuteczniej ścigać sprawców przestępstw finansowych w internecie. Wielka Brytania od kilku lat boryka się z gwałtownym wzrostem liczby oszustw online, które kosztują obywateli i firmy miliardy funtów rocznie. Władze podkreślają, że samo reagowanie na incydenty już nie wystarczy – konieczne jest proaktywne rozbijanie grup przestępczych, zanim wyrządzą szkody. Jednostka ma być operacyjna jeszcze w tym roku i współpracować z partnerami z Unii Europejskiej oraz USA.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/Eoe7fu6La8sSgyaSkTAfDym6dWUe5wdp5XKKjFbkgWUSyzv6VSgaxX7Dpyfb52onym5.png)

*Źródło: [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/uk-new-crackdown-unit-cyber-fraud/) [EN]*

---

### ***Ponad 13 tysięcy podejrzanych z zarzutami cyberprzestępczości***

Międzynarodowe służby policyjne podsumowały zakrojone na szeroką skalę działania wymierzone w cyberprzestępców – łącznie z zarzutami usłyszało ponad 13 tysięcy osób podejrzanych o różne formy przestępczości w sieci. Operacja objęła dziesiątki krajów i koordynowana była m.in. przez Interpol oraz Europol. Wśród stawianych zarzutów znalazły się: phishing, oszustwa inwestycyjne, handel danymi osobowymi i ataki ransomware. Zatrzymania miały miejsce na kilku kontynentach, co pokazuje, że cyberprzestępczość to dziś globalny problem nieznający granic. Eksperci oceniają, że to jeden z największych jednorazowych wyników w historii walki z przestępczością cyfrową. Służby zaznaczają jednak, że samo zatrzymanie tylu osób to dopiero początek – postępowania sądowe mogą potrwać latami.

*Źródło: [CRN Polska](https://crn.pl/aktualnosci/13-tys-podejrzanych-z-zarzutami-cyberprzestepczosci-cyberprzestepczosc/) [PL]*

---

## 🚨 2. INCYDENTY

---

### ***Cyberatak na Wojewódzki Szpital w Szczecinie – placówka przeszła na tryb papierowy***

Szpital Wojewódzki w Szczecinie padł ofiarą cyberataku, który zmusił placówkę do tymczasowego wyłączenia systemów informatycznych i powrotu do pracy na papierowych formularzach. Incydent zakłócił m.in. obsługę pacjentów, dostęp do historii leczenia i planowanie zabiegów. Szpital poinformował o zdarzeniu odpowiednie służby i uruchomił procedury kryzysowe. Na szczęście nie doszło do bezpośredniego zagrożenia życia pacjentów, choć personel musiał zmierzyć się ze znacznym utrudnieniem codziennej pracy. To kolejny niepokojący sygnał, że polskie placówki medyczne wciąż pozostają atrakcyjnym celem dla cyberprzestępców. Eksperci od dawna alarmują, że sektor ochrony zdrowia jest szczególnie narażony ze względu na wrażliwość przetwarzanych danych i często niewystarczające nakłady na cyberbezpieczeństwo.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23uFMJsrspc1DpgiXiweoZS3U5Eprt2DoqBaKtaVBFEk2KQcZyFswQvf6HQy1koKb6nWk.png)

*Źródło: [Sekurak](https://sekurak.pl/wojewodzki-szpital-w-szczecinie-zhackowany-placowka-przeszla-na-papierowy-tryb-pracy/) [PL] | [Cyberdefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/cyberbezpieczenstwo/cyberataki/zhakowano-polski-szpital) [PL]*

---

### ***Incydent bezpieczeństwa w wojskowym szpitalu – dane pacjentów mogły zostać naruszone***

Wojskowy szpital w Polsce stał się miejscem incydentu bezpieczeństwa, w wyniku którego mogły zostać ujawnione dane osobowe pacjentów. Szczegółowe okoliczności zdarzenia nie zostały w pełni upublicznione ze względu na wojskowy charakter placówki. Wiadomo jednak, że podjęto działania zaradcze i wszczęto dochodzenie. Dane medyczne należą do najwrażliwszych kategorii informacji – ich wyciek może mieć poważne konsekwencje zarówno dla pacjentów, jak i – w przypadku personelu wojskowego – dla bezpieczeństwa operacyjnego. Incydent wpisuje się w niepokojący trend ataków na infrastrukturę sektora zdrowia i obronności. Władze szpitala zapewniły, że wdrożono dodatkowe środki ochrony, a poszkodowani zostaną poinformowani zgodnie z przepisami RODO.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23xAXcwxqJ7YqFqhB8YPR2Nhgdq59fkCWFEJhMdC7rmrcD7A6s42M93dTqWeiodzQ6EoW.png)

*Źródło: [Cyberdefence24](https://cyberdefence24.pl/cyberbezpieczenstwo/incydent-w-wojskowym-szpitalu-narazono-dane-pacjentow) [PL]*

---

### ***Wyciek danych 3,4 miliona pacjentów dostawcy usług medycznych Trizetto***

Firma Trizetto Provider Solutions, należąca do giganta IT Cognizant, potwierdziła wyciek danych dotyczący ponad 3,4 miliona pacjentów. Skradzione informacje obejmują dane osobowe, numery ubezpieczenia społecznego, a w wielu przypadkach również szczegółowe dane medyczne i ubezpieczeniowe. Atak uderza szczególnie boleśnie, bo Trizetto świadczy usługi dla podmiotów z sektora ochrony zdrowia – co oznacza, że hakerzy jednym atakiem dotarli do bazy danych klientów wielu różnych placówek. Jest to jeden z poważniejszych wycieków danych medycznych w ostatnich miesiącach. Poszkodowani mają zostać objęci bezpłatnym monitoringiem kredytowym. Incydent po raz kolejny pokazuje, jak ryzykowna jest konsolidacja danych pacjentów w rękach zewnętrznych dostawców technologicznych.

https://i0.wp.com/securityaffairs.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-35.png

*Źródło: [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/189149/data-breach/cognizants-trizetto-provider-solutions-data-breach-impacted-over-3-4-million-patients.html) [EN]*

---

## 💡 3. CIEKAWOSTKI

---

### ***Dlaczego tradycyjne audyty haseł pomijają konta, które hakerzy atakują najchętniej***

Standardowe audyty haseł w firmach koncentrują się zazwyczaj na kontach aktywnych użytkowników, tymczasem przestępcy celują często w tzw. konta sieroty – czyli aktywne konta pracowników, którzy już dawno odeszli z firmy, lub konta serwisowe zapomniane przez administratorów. Takie konta rzadko podlegają regularnym przeglądom, bywają zabezpieczone słabymi, niezmienianymi od lat hasłami, a ich kompromitacja może długo pozostać niezauważona. Eksperci podkreślają, że samo sprawdzenie siły hasła to za mało – równie ważna jest inwentaryzacja wszystkich kont i weryfikacja, czy są one nadal potrzebne. Atakujący wiedzą o tej luce i aktywnie jej wykorzystują, bo przejęcie zapomnianego konta serwisowego z wysokimi uprawnieniami to dla nich główna wygrana. Artykuł apeluje o zmianę podejścia do audytów bezpieczeństwa i uwzględnienie pełnego obrazu środowiska tożsamości w organizacji.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23tux3LPXRfmKNc1QAmsSYL6ztUA9J5Msrty7enLbu5xESH7QobpiWnKGmPKYNnEESFai.png)

*Źródło: [Bleeping Computer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/why-password-audits-miss-the-accounts-attackers-actually-want/) [EN]*

---

### ***Bezpieczeństwo podmorskich kabli – niedoceniany element globalnej infrastruktury***

Podmorskie kable światłowodowe to kręgosłup internetu – przesyłają ponad 95% międzykontynentalnego ruchu danych, a mimo to temat ich ochrony rzadko trafia do mainstreamu. Najnowsze analizy wskazują na rosnące zagrożenie ze strony sabotażu, zarówno przez podmioty państwowe, jak i zwykłe wypadki (zakotwiczające statki uszkodziły już niejeden kabel). Naprawienie pojedynczego kabla może trwać tygodnie i kosztować dziesiątki milionów dolarów, a całkowite zniszczenie kilku kluczowych połączeń mogłoby odciąć całe regiony od globalnej sieci. Eksperci wskazują, że dotychczasowe regulacje prawne i mechanizmy ochrony są daleko niewystarczające wobec współczesnych zagrożeń geopolitycznych. Coraz więcej rządów zaczyna traktować bezpieczeństwo kabli podmorskich jako element strategicznej obrony narodowej. To jeden z tych tematów, który długo był ignorowany, a teraz staje się pilnym priorytetem dla NATO i Unii Europejskiej.

https://img2.helpnetsecurity.com/posts2026/cable-650.webp

*Źródło: [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/03/09/ocean-submarine-cable-security/) [EN]*

---

### ***Office EU – europejska alternatywa dla Microsoft 365 i Google Workspace nabiera kształtów***

W Europie coraz głośniej mówi się o projekcie Office EU – ambitnej inicjatywie stworzenia suwerennej, europejskiej platformy biurowej, która mogłaby stanowić alternatywę dla dominujących produktów Microsoftu i Google'a. Projekt wpisuje się w szerszy trend europejskiej suwerenności cyfrowej, napędzany obawami o prywatność danych i zależność od zagranicznych dostawców technologicznych. Choć na razie to wczesny etap, zainteresowanie projektem rośnie – szczególnie w sektorze publicznym, gdzie przetwarzane są wrażliwe dane obywateli. Twórcy projektu stawiają na otwarte oprogramowanie, szyfrowanie end-to-end i przechowywanie danych wyłącznie na serwerach w UE. Krytycy wskazują jednak na ogromne wyzwania związane z budową ekosystemu zdolnego konkurować z zakorzenionymi od dekad rozwiązaniami gigantów technologicznych.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23ydP8WJvXEqZsoSFRm1s4kivb5gwKKvjo7PFDiPg6RwtxG888THaEnG2E7Y2ceuvJXNq.png)

*Źródło: [Instalki.pl](https://www.instalki.pl/news/software/microsoft-doczekal-sie-europejskiej-konkurencji-oficjalna-premiera-office-eu/) [PL]*

---

## 🎣 4. OSZUSTWA, SCAMY, EXPLOITY

---

### ***Globalna sieć oszustw inwestycyjnych wykryta w reklamach Meta***

Badacze z Bitdefender zidentyfikowali rozbudowaną sieć oszustw inwestycyjnych, która do dotarcia do ofiar wykorzystuje płatne reklamy w serwisach Meta (Facebook i Instagram). Kampania obejmuje dziesiątki fałszywych platform inwestycyjnych, podszywających się pod renomowane instytucje finansowe i znane osobistości. Mechanizm jest klasyczny: ofiara widzi reklamę z obietnicą wysokich zysków, rejestruje się na fałszywej platformie, wpłaca pieniądze – i nigdy ich nie odzyskuje. Skala operacji jest imponująca – kampania działa w wielu krajach i językach jednocześnie, a twórcy błyskawicznie zakładają nowe domeny po zamknięciu poprzednich. Specjaliści podkreślają, że reklamy tego typu są trudne do odróżnienia od legalnych, bo przestępcy inwestują w profesjonalny wygląd i dopracowane materiały wizualne. To kolejny sygnał, że platformy społecznościowe muszą zintensyfikować weryfikację reklamodawców.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23vsQYXaScPoebi9UzoKVntkwq5jf2F7nhdF35tvBhyvcgo875kqTquCfpmyoXkF9nhpN.png)

*Źródło: [Bitdefender Labs](https://www.bitdefender.com/en-us/blog/labs/global-investment-scam-network-using-meta-ads) [EN]*

---

### ***Fałszywy Empik w kampanii phishingowej – ostrzeżenie CERT Orange***

CERT Orange Polska ostrzegł przed nową kampanią phishingową, w której przestępcy podszywają się pod popularną sieć Empik. Ofiary otrzymują wiadomości z fałszywymi informacjami o nagrodach, promocjach lub problemach z zamówieniem, które przekierowują je na spreparowane strony łudząco przypominające prawdziwy serwis Empiku. Celem jest wyłudzenie danych logowania, informacji o kartach płatniczych lub pobranie złośliwego oprogramowania na urządzenie ofiary. Kampania jest szczególnie niebezpieczna, bo Empik to marka rozpoznawalna i obdarzona zaufaniem przez miliony Polaków. Eksperci przypominają, że przed kliknięciem w link warto zawsze sprawdzić adres URL oraz unikać logowania przez linki z e-maili czy SMS-ów.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23u6De61DJmDC32eZgGojTTyyBrZoeMRWjrruKunJEsFUi74tuPfRsneMMspTUxnTjstB.png)

*Źródło: [Dobreprogramy.pl](https://www.dobreprogramy.pl/falszywy-empik-ostrzezenie-cert-orange,7262465702754496a) [PL]*

---

### ***Fałszywe strony instalacyjne Claude Code infekują komputery złośliwym oprogramowaniem***

Cyberprzestępcy stworzyli fałszywe strony internetowe podszywające się pod oficjalną stronę instalacyjną narzędzia Claude Code – popularnego asystenta programistycznego. Użytkownicy systemu Windows i macOS, którzy trafili na te witryny i pobrali „instalator\

lub kampanie podszywania się pod znane marki – przestępcy liczą na to, że użytkownik nie sprawdzi dokładnie adresu strony. Skradzione dane mogą obejmować hasła, ciasteczka sesji przeglądarki, dane portfeli kryptowalutowych i inne wrażliwe informacje. Malwarebytes apeluje o pobieranie oprogramowania wyłącznie z oficjalnych, zweryfikowanych źródeł i korzystanie z menedżerów pakietów zamiast stron trzecich.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23xVksfiJYrWQtripToz5qEKS8X3CJ5RqyLporrqDn1brmDPqHRtcC1NSDSFBqHotctxf.png)

*Źródło: [Malwarebytes](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/news/2026/03/fake-claude-code-install-pages-hit-windows-and-mac-users-with-infostealers) [EN]*

---

## 🌐 5. DEZINFORMACJA, CYBER WOJNA

---

### ***Rosyjscy hakerzy atakują konta Signal i WhatsApp zachodnich urzędników***

Grupy powiązane z rosyjskim wywiadem prowadzą aktywną kampanię wymierzoną w konta Signal i WhatsApp używane przez zachodnich urzędników, dziennikarzy i pracowników organizacji pozarządowych. Ataki polegają m.in. na phishingu, przejęciu sesji i technikach socjotechnicznych umożliwiających dostęp do zaszyfrowanej korespondencji. Szczególnie niepokojące jest to, że hakerzy opracowali metody obchodzenia zabezpieczeń aplikacji uznawanych za bezpieczne – co podważa powszechne przekonanie, że samo korzystanie z szyfrowanych komunikatorów gwarantuje ochronę. Kampania ma charakter długotrwały i precyzyjnie targetowany – ofiary są starannie dobierane pod kątem ich roli i dostępu do wrażliwych informacji. Eksperci zalecają włączenie weryfikacji dwuetapowej, ograniczenie liczby aktywnych sesji i regularne sprawdzanie połączonych urządzeń w ustawieniach komunikatorów.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm2/23w2wQEv5q7emwEfua9hSE1neptkfrWRQSQyXyx1CE2R94mAZwy1ofs7oiZD8spKYC9ie.png)

*Źródło: [CRN Polska](https://crn.pl/aktualnosci/rosyjscy-hakerzy-atakuja-uzytkownikow-komunikatorow-signal-oraz-whatsapp/) [PL] | [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/03/09/signal-whatsapp-accounts-russian-hackers/) [EN] | [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/189156/intelligence/russia-linked-hackers-target-signal-whatsapp-of-officials-globally.html) [EN]*

body.title: I have an eye twitch
body.body: > Today was my day off, so I decided to sleep in a little longer. I woke up late and instead of working out early as usual, I went to the gym later. I thought it would be a normal workout, but during the exercises I started feeling strange, nauseous, and ended up feeling dizzy. It wasn't my best day physically, and I think it's because I'm close to my period. There's something else that's been bothering me all week a small twitch in my eye that appears every now and then. I was told it might be due to stress or fatigue. There are days when you want to keep up the pace and do everything perfectly, and that's what I thought today would be like, but your body also has its own signals, like accumulated fatigue. Even so, I went, I worked out, and I tried, which in the end also counts. The night ended much more calmly, watching Game of Thrones again and having a burger for dinner. It wasn't a particularly productive or perfect day, but it was one of those quiet, simple days to slow down a bit, I need to listen to my body and rest.

> Hoy fue mi día libre, así que decidí dormir un poco más. Desperté tarde y en lugar de entrenar temprano como de costumbre, fui al gimnasio más tarde. Pensé que sería un entrenamiento normal, pero durante los ejercicios empecé a sentirme rara, con ganas de vomitar y al final terminé mareada. No fue el mejor día físicamente y creo que es porque estoy cerca de mi ciclo. Hay otra cosa que me ha estado torturando toda la semana, un pequeño tic en el ojo que aparece de vez en cuando, me dijeron que es posible que sea por el estrés o cansancio. Hay días en los que uno quiere mantener el ritmo y hacer todo perfecto, así pensaba que sería hoy pero el cuerpo también tiene sus propias señales. Por ejemplo del cansancio acumulado. Aun así, fui, entrené y lo intenté, que al final también cuenta. La noche terminó de una forma mucho más tranquila. Viendo otra vez Game of Thrones y cenando una hamburguesa. No fue un día particularmente productivo ni perfecto, pero sí fue uno de esos días tranquila, simple, para bajar un poco el ritmo, tengo que escuchar a mi cuerpo y descansar.
![IMG_8676.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYJjmWzT8sptj6yvx81q5f6sNLwwLTxch4xNikdfE5ifq/IMG_8676.jpeg)

body.title: How Can AI Transform B2B SEO and Search Visibility?
body.body:
![How Can AI Transform B2B SEO and Search Visibility?](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/bd70f528f9919d32efa2105cfaae304e592b5b45c737d707daf4af38ce234207)

Search engine optimization has always been vital to B2B [digital marketing](https://intentamplify.com/digital-marketing/). Yet businesses' approach to SEO is rapidly changing as Artificial Intelligence (AI) reshapes how search engines interpret content, user intent, and relevance.

Traditional SEO relied heavily on manual keyword research, static content strategies, and basic analytics. Today, AI-powered technologies allow marketers to analyze massive datasets, uncover deeper insights into buyer behavior, and optimize content strategies with greater precision. For B2B companies seeking to enhance search visibility, attract high-intent prospects, and generate qualified leads, [AI-driven SEO](https://intentamplify.com/blog/ai-search-and-seo-for-b2b-visibility/) has become a significant competitive advantage.

By integrating AI into their SEO strategies, organizations can gain a deeper understanding of what their audience is searching for and deliver highly relevant content that aligns with modern search engine algorithms.

### The Growing Role of AI in Modern SEO

Search engines are smarter thanks to AI and machine learning. Modern search systems interpret user intent, meaning, and content quality, not just keywords.

For B2B marketers, this means SEO strategies must move beyond keyword stuffing and focus on creating valuable, informative, and intent-driven content.

AI helps businesses analyze search patterns, identify emerging topics, and optimize content structures that align with how search engines evaluate relevance. With AI-powered insights, marketing teams can develop more strategic SEO campaigns that drive consistent organic traffic and higher-quality leads.

### How AI Improves B2B Keyword Research

Keyword research is the foundation of every SEO strategy, and AI tools have dramatically improved how marketers discover high-value keywords.

AI platforms analyze search trends, competitor performance, and user behavior to uncover long-tail keywords and niche search queries that are often overlooked by traditional methods.

These insights help B2B marketers:

*   Discover high-intent keywords used by decision-makers

*   Identify emerging industry topics before competitors.

*   Understand the context behind search queries.

*   Create topic clusters that improve search authority.

By targeting the right keywords, businesses can attract audiences that are actively searching for their products or services.

### AI-Powered Content Optimization

Content remains the backbone of SEO, but AI is changing how content is created and optimized for search engines.

AI tools can analyze top-performing pages in search results and provide recommendations for improving content relevance, readability, and structure. This allows B2B marketers to develop [content](https://intentamplify.com/content-marketing/) that is more aligned with search engine expectations.

AI can assist with:

*   Identifying content gaps in existing articles

*   Recommending keyword placement and semantic variations

*   Optimizing headings, metadata, and internal linking

*   Improving readability and user engagement

With these capabilities, companies can produce content that not only ranks well but also provides meaningful value to readers.

### Predictive SEO: Anticipating Future Search Trends

One of the most powerful benefits of AI in SEO is its ability to predict future search trends. Instead of reacting to search demand after it appears, AI can analyze historical data and identify patterns that indicate upcoming industry topics.

Predictive SEO allows B2B organizations to:

*   Create content around emerging topics before competitors.

*   Position their brand as an industry thought leader.

*   Capture early organic traffic for new search queries.

*   Maintain long-term search visibility.

This forward-looking strategy helps businesses stay ahead in highly competitive digital markets.

### AI and Personalization in Search Experiences

AI also enables a more personalized search experience for users. Search engines increasingly deliver results based on user behavior, preferences, and contextual signals.

For B2B marketers, this means content must address specific industry challenges, audience segments, and buyer personas.

AI-powered tools can analyze audience engagement data to understand what types of content resonate most with target audiences. This allows companies to create highly relevant content that speaks directly to the needs of decision-makers.

[Personalized](https://intentamplify.com/our-specialities/) content improves engagement, increases time spent on site, and strengthens overall SEO performance.

### Key Benefits of AI-Driven SEO for B2B Companies

body.title: Long-term Benefits Of Exercise
body.body:
> Exercise is among the best investments you can make on yourself. This is not just about the immediate gains, like weight loss or to make you appear better, but also about the long-term benefits. Having regular exercise does not only improve your body for today, but it also prepares you for the future; for a healthier, more fulfilling, and stronger future. If you take a look at someone who does regular exercise and then compare them to someone who does not, over time, you will see that the difference will be clear. Exercise is not particularly reserved for gym. Even from your house, you can have an exercise routine, like jugging, morning walk, push ups, planking, etc. These are part of what make you healthier.
![20260309_182104.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmPuKNo5WxDYF38HKuGboJmfJWajcWjjYRon2GdvVEFvZ5/20260309_182104.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/wake-up-and-workout-slogan-on-light-box-among-sports-equipment-4397840)
I have come to realise that a very significant long-term benefit of exercise is improved health. Medically, it has been proven times and again that being physically active helps to strengthen the heart, improves circulation of blood, and ultimately keeps your body functioning properly. One of our family friends who is a cardiologist once said that people who regularly engage in exercises have lower risks of developing serious heart disease, and even high blood pressure. This means that you do yourself a great honour by being active. When you are exercising, you are not only doing it for today, but you are protecting your health for many years to come. Some years back, I observed something that thought me some vital lessons about being physically active. In the place where I lived, two women within the neighborhood were retired from active service when they clocked 60 years. They both worked in federal government parastatals but in different ministries. When they were retired, one of them got a part-time teaching job down the street, while the other one was just staying at home enjoying her benefits, gratuity, and pension. Both of them were paid well though, so they had enough to live on. When the other woman who was doing part-time job was asked why she decided to do that, she just responded that she has been active all her life, and that she does not want to stay idle. After a while of retiring, the other woman who was always staying at home and living a sedentary lifestyle started to be sickly. She gained so much weight, she started looking older than she was in just a matter of months. But the other woman was still agile and going about her normal duties. After about 1 year, the difference between both of them was so much that you would not believe they are almost the same age. It was then that I got to find out that the difference might just be in their level of physical activities. When you exercise, you keep yourself fit and also help your body stay healthy.
![pexels-ketut-subiyanto-4473622.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmYBmPiSPjUMiu1tzjavMcNX2b9p5wagfhVoK578vFzopA/pexels-ketut-subiyanto-4473622.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/woman-exercising-with-her-daughter-4473622)
Exercise also has a way of strengthening the bones and muscles. When people grow old, they naturally tend to become weaker, with the bones even losing their strength. However, for people who exercise often, they tend to build stronger muscle, and they also maintain good bone density. This will help them to remain independent even when they are old. They will not have to struggle with mobility, but they will remain active and independent. The exercises you do now does not only affect you in the present but it builds you up for the future. Exercise is not what you do once in a while, rather it should be a lifestyle for you. It is worthy to note that physical activities have ways of reducing stress, depression, and anxiety, which also improves the mental health. I once read from a medical journal sometimes ago that when you exercise, the body releases chemicals that can help improve the mood and make the person happy. Over time, this makes the person build mental resilience, and makes the person to go through life better. So as much as exercise is good for your physical body, it is also good for your mental health. If you know that it is good, then it is wisdom to engage in it. Invest in keeping yourself fit and your body will thank you. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

body.title: Do you Want to practice mindfulness?
body.body:
Then start collecting evidences against your thoughts.The world does not always need grand gestures.Sometimes, it just needs small lights in many places.And maybe, if each of us decides to become a small lamp in our own way, the darkness around us will slowly begin to disappear. 

A mind free from unnecessary clutter possesses immeasurable power. It sees solutions,while others see problems.It moves forward in life instead of struggling.It will not get caught in the same cycles of suffering but will flow like a river, always fresh, always new. But clarity is not something you acquire once and keep forever.It must be cultivated daily.Just as you cleanse your body, you must cleanse your mind. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTQRVnx7wbieYM3VW8iewmn8HiptDCsRYqe5LUDfFYSuD/1773121147392.jpg)

Every year,when the air becomes a little cooler and the evenings start feeling calm,I find myself returning to this place again. It has almost become a personal ritual. The scene may look simple to many people passing by but for me it carries a deep sense of history,culture and quiet reflection.


In front of me are stacks of clay lamps that are small, humble and beautifully imperfect.Some are new, some are already darkened by fire. A few of them are burning gently and their small flames dancing in the evening breeze. 

Beside them is a bottle of oil, waiting to give life to more lamps.The smell of oil mixed with the earthy scent of clay creates an atmosphere that feels strangely peaceful.These clay lamps are not just objects.They are part of a tradition that has existed for centuries across the subcontinent. My city is a historical place and is almost 4000 years old.Long before electricity lit up our cities, these small lamps were the light of homes, streets and sacred places. They symbolized hope, guidance and warmth. 


Even today,despite all the technology around us,their meaning has not faded.Whenever I stand here and watch these flames,I often think about how such a small light can push away darkness.A single lamp may not seem powerful but when many lamps burn together, the whole space becomes bright. Maybe this is why our ancestors valued these lamps so much. They quietly remind us that even the smallest act of goodness can create a big difference.


People pass by while I am standing here in devotion.Some walking quickly,some are talking, some lost in their own thoughts.Most of them probably do not notice these lamps at all.But every year, I stop here for a few moments. I myself light a lamp,watch the flame for a while and think about life.


For me, this visit is not just about tradition. It is about connection with the history, with our culture and with our society.These simple clay lamps carry stories of generations before us. They remind us that our roots are deep and meaningful.


At the same time, they carry a message for today’s society.We live in a time where people are often busy, impatient and sometimes disconnected from one another.But the lesson of these lamps is simple that is to be a source of light for others.Just like these small flames,a little kindness, patience or honesty can brighten someone’s day.Every year when I come here,I leave with this same thought in my mind.


I believe when our mind is filled with unnecessary noise, we can't perceive reality as it truly is. Instead,we see things through the filter of our past experiences, opinions and biases,distorting everything.

Therefore,we must dedicate time each day to cleaning the mirror of your mind.Observe out thoughts without becoming entangled in them. The moment we begin observing your thoughts, rather than identifying with them, we create a distance between ourselves and them. That distance is freedom. And the more we practice this, the more we will benefit.

body.title: Music, family and Friends / Música, familia y amigos - LOH contest week #279 (eng-esp)
body.body:
Hey girls!

If you ask me what my perfect afternoon would be like, @elizabethbit, I don't have to think twice. I'm a guitarist, so music is part of my life, my work, and also my moments of enjoyment.

That's why an ideal afternoon for me would start with a guitar concert. It could be soloists, duos, quartets, or guitar orchestras, or a mix, but always guitars.

Of course, not to play myself, but to listen. To sit among the audience and let myself be carried away by the notes of some great performer, one of those who make you forget where you are and only the music exists.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdWZcUFYaWkLUgXioEQmR4XUmbsu4THTvPzuQ69deuP6U/1773073901048.jpg)

But I wouldn't go alone. It's important for me to share this with my family. I would go with my husband and my two children. Since they are guitar students, they always understand my passion for the guitar, at least not in the way I feel it. So I want them with me. I want them to see how excited I get, to hear what I hear, to share that experience. My husband is already used to it. My children occasionally ask questions, and I like that. It means the music resonates with them.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSoP4JXSL9Duvqn8Z6Hiv3hMpX4HvJbVAVjnnx5vVKsLZ/1773073901211.jpg)

After the concert, the afternoon would continue in a more down-to-earth way. We would go for pizza and spaghetti. It's not fancy food, but it's what my children like. And I like seeing them happy. I love that noisy table where they argue over the last piece, where my husband and I laugh at their antics. After the music, comes the family bustle. And I enjoy it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf7VZYD5hrChHUnZhP7G5wSQBvFDrCo2k8sLJjG2jQDax/1773074124785.jpg)

But the afternoon wouldn't end there. The final part would be with our friends. We'd arrive at someone's house, or perhaps some outdoor spot, and sit down to talk. To talk about everything and nothing. About the children, about work, about life. We'd put on some background music, the kind that doesn't demand attention but accompanies the moment. And we'd drink some beers or wine, depending on our mood. Like that, without rushing, until the sun set and night found us still chatting.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNM5SVcUVDkqTmR9urtD699AFN83WkMuJKBEeou96L7ju/1773074125086.jpg)

That's my perfect afternoon. Music, family, food, and friends. Nothing extraordinary, but all together it's exactly what I need.

***
**Versión en español**
***

Hola, chicas!

Si me preguntan cuál sería mi tarde perfecta, @elizabethbit, no tengo que pensarlo demasiado. Soy guitarrista, así que la música es parte de mi vida, de mi trabajo y también de mis momentos de disfrute. 
Por eso, una tarde ideal para mí comenzaría con un concierto de guitarra. Puede ser de solistas, dúos, cuartetos u orquestas de guitarras, o mixto, pero de guitarras. 
Por supuesto, no para tocar yo, sino para escuchar. Para sentarme entre el público y dejarme llevar por las notas de algún gran intérprete, de esos que hacen que olvides dónde estás y solo exista la música.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdWZcUFYaWkLUgXioEQmR4XUmbsu4THTvPzuQ69deuP6U/1773073901048.jpg)

Pero no iría sola. Para mí es importante compartir esto con mi familia. Iría junto a mi esposo y mis dos hijos. Ellos, la ser estudiantes de guitarra, siempre entienden mi pasión por la guitarra, al menos no como yo la siento. Así que los quiero conmigo. Quiero que vean cómo me emociono, que escuchen lo que yo escucho, que compartan ese espacio. Mi esposo ya está acostumbrado. Mis hijos, de vez en cuando, preguntan cosas y eso me gusta. Significa que la música les llega.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSoP4JXSL9Duvqn8Z6Hiv3hMpX4HvJbVAVjnnx5vVKsLZ/1773073901211.jpg)

Al salir del concierto, la tarde continuaría de una forma más terrenal. Iríamos a comer pizzas y espaguetis. No es comida sofisticada, pero es lo que les gusta a mis hijos. Y a mí me gusta verlos contentos. Me gusta esa mesa ruidosa donde ellos discuten por la última porción, donde mi esposo y nos reímos de sus ocurrencias. Después de la música, viene el bullicio familiar. Y lo disfruto.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf7VZYD5hrChHUnZhP7G5wSQBvFDrCo2k8sLJjG2jQDax/1773074124785.jpg)

Pero la tarde no terminaría ahí. La parte final sería con nuestros amigos. Llegaríamos a alguna casa, o quizás a un lugar al aire libre, y nos sentaríamos a conversar. A hablar de todo y de nada. De los niños, del trabajo, de la vida. Pondríamos música de fondo, de esa que no exige atención pero acompaña. Y beberíamos algunas cervezas o vino, según el humor. Así, sin prisas, hasta que el sol se fuera y la noche nos encontrara todavía charlando.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNM5SVcUVDkqTmR9urtD699AFN83WkMuJKBEeou96L7ju/1773074125086.jpg)

Esa es mi tarde perfecta. Música, familia, comida y amigos. Nada extraordinario, pero todo junto es exactamente lo que necesito.

body.title: A Different Kind of Marigold in My Terrace Garden
body.body:
**Hey Everyone 👋🏻**

Gardening often surprises us in ways we never expect. Sometimes we carefully plan what to grow, buy seeds, prepare soil, and wait patiently for the plants to grow. But other times, nature decides to grow something on its own, and those unexpected plants become the most interesting ones in the garden.

Recently, something similar happened in my terrace garden.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP9njcqdzExkCcPjBZ3fZch5STjQX9KnAS7NaWW1gtUXJ/1773057845984.jpg)

A different variety of marigold has grown there completely on its own. I never planted seeds for this plant. It actually grew from the waste flowers that were thrown into the soil after being used. As those flowers dried and decomposed, some seeds must have fallen into the soil, and after some time a small plant started growing.

At first, I did not pay much attention to it. In gardens, many random plants grow and disappear after a few days. But this plant kept growing stronger day by day. Slowly it developed leaves and stems, and eventually it started producing flowers.

When the flowers bloomed, I noticed something very unusual about them.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNZKsaLHmXNhpmptdB7Z3mShPJb3X6dmwa5ZKvchvrXid/1773057872740.jpg)

These marigolds look completely different from the usual marigolds we commonly see. Normally, marigold flowers are full of dense, zigzag petals that cover the entire flower head. Because of these thick petals, the center of the flower and the pollen are usually hidden.

But this plant is different.

Instead of being filled with layers of petals, these flowers have very few petals around the edges. The petals spread outward, leaving the center completely visible. And that center is the most fascinating part of the flower.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcJHE53eMMs82WnZLECKEiC1rjNWkKRGfSB21XBT45rsj/1773057846252.jpg)

The middle of the flower is very thick, round, and prominent. It is packed with pollen structures that create a beautiful pattern. When you look closely, the center almost looks like a tiny artistic design made by nature. The texture and structure of the pollen create an interesting illusion that instantly grabs attention.

In fact, the center becomes the main highlight of the flower rather than the petals.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZZ75D6b2Q54QMpiMTSSLbmxnZbHXsmAXPF97ctqzEJqS/1773057846535.jpg)

Another beautiful aspect of these marigolds is their colors. The flowers appear in two bright shades — one in a cheerful yellow and the other in a vibrant orange. Both colors look stunning against the green leaves of the plant.

The orange variety has a deep, warm tone that looks bold and striking, while the yellow flower appears softer and brighter, giving the plant a fresh and lively look. When both colors bloom together, they create a very pleasant visual contrast in the garden.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaPvZz9cMq5R55bwSCeYabQHB5EEYGkb5wdZVTdhjZ4F2/1773057846812.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXxmVeCMJQR5iJYhBvu7ZyrjvNVR1ZzDURcj8MY4JrHYK/1773057847063.jpg)

Observing these flowers closely has been a wonderful experience. The shape, color, and structure of the flower are quite unique compared to the marigolds we usually grow. It feels like discovering a hidden variety that quietly appeared without any effort.

What makes this experience even more interesting is that this plant grew entirely on its own. There was no planning, no seed buying, and no special care involved. It simply emerged from the discarded flowers and found its way to grow in the soil.

Moments like this remind me that gardening is not always about control or planning. Sometimes nature works quietly in the background and brings unexpected beauty into our gardens.

This small marigold plant has added a unique charm to my terrace garden. Its unusual flower structure and bright colors make it stand out from the other plants around it.

It also makes me curious about how many other hidden seeds might be waiting in the soil, ready to grow when the conditions are right.

Gardening always has a way of surprising us, and this little self-grown marigold is a perfect example of nature’s quiet magic.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karishmasingh711/23t7YWoN4zG1GjdYHrDZynHrrY4RMLRFLWvoYkwxsq4JTJyhMSCYrMnDP5ZM9GF74o2mf.png)

<Center>
### Thank you♥️ for being here
**Your presence means more than you know🤗**
**Until next time ⁠(⁠.⁠ ⁠❛⁠ ⁠ᴗ⁠ ⁠❛⁠.⁠)**

**Stay kind 🌸**

body.title: Why manual Hand Weeding is preferable for your Vegetables Field. Engaging rigorous manual veggies Weeding.
body.body:
# Hello Hive 




![1000161808.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Eopstbk7XiZMJDpn3cZ2o6Vwwc8ZKfZfM6VnXDBNPT8r3nq6QsjgYWrJSEyCiFccDCD.jpg)



Manual weeding is one of the most tedious exercise we often carry out in our vegetables field, it has never been easy but we do not have a choice. Had it been that hoes can be used for this exercise it will make the work faster and easier but that is equally not possible.



![1000161796.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23vsJJUrLeVwsVT9HDGbTMnpY1fTq577TdEWBNnzvetr5zBGCUKDG4Qbvtwt6tmMMPYhP.jpg)


The challenge here is this, vegetables are not planted like corns or pepper which are often planted in row with some gaps in between them. Vegetables are planted by spreading them across the fields on their own beds. Both the vegetables and grasses often germinate and grow together. When vegetables are in their very tender age within days after planting you cannot not engage them in any form of weeding if at all there is grasses in the farm. 

![1000161805.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EoK6KwH6QNSmqzK4CvbeYpM3RFHyzJGKRx7HDiF7S7ZcT56HrPdK8gCN1EUCjoykcdm.jpg)

While trying to pull off the grasses vegetables you may end up getting pulled off as well. And since they are not some sort of plant that can be transplanted they wither away as soon as their roots is off the ground 

The vsat 
![1000161820.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/EoiVDuomahHrYjXY8CLT6Xxy3n4B2SXMxpgyfC7LSMYfDcX2sDgMzEdbCizkzXAJEkV.jpg)

The best solution to all of these is by planting your vegetables in such a way that grasses will not overwhelm them. To do this you have to ensure that you deploy enough grasses prevention methods before planting the veggies. Weed every grasses, till the soil properly and sometimes apply a little of non hazardous herbicides to the soil. 

![1000161796.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23vsJJUrLeVwsVT9HDGbTMnpY1fTq577TdEWBNnzvetr5zBGCUKDG4Qbvtwt6tmMMPYhP.jpg)


When this is done before planting, it takes a good while before grasses will germinate in the fields where vegetables have been planted. 

![1000161802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/Eokci39C632dG3nLCkmYDmQbVtffNeC4cVuCpCqVxLtnHy9Bp35Njfh8nc2oXLoam85.jpg)


While the veggies are in their tender stage you allow them to grow to at least 3weeks before attempting to pull up any grasses that may have grown with the veggies.
After  we harvested some veggies for soup on Sunday I realized that the field is bushy already and was already calling attention . Since yesterday we have engaged inanual weeding to clean up the veggies farm so that the ones remaining in the field can continue to grow properly.
