title.title: Why Passive Intent Signals Are Crucial for B2B Lead Generation
title.body:
In today’s highly competitive B2B landscape, identifying potential buyers at the right moment is more important than ever. Traditional lead generation methods often rely on direct actions such as form fills, demo requests, or newsletter signups. While these are valuable indicators of interest, they usually appear late in the buyer’s journey. To stay ahead, modern B2B marketers are increasingly turning to [passive intent signals](https://intentamplify.com/lead-generation-services/https:/technologyaiinsights.com/ai-revolutionaries-transformative-trends-reshaping-businesses-in-2026/)—subtle digital behaviors that reveal a prospect’s interests long before they make direct contact.

Passive intent signals are becoming a critical component of data-driven marketing strategies because they help businesses identify potential customers earlier, personalize outreach, and improve conversion rates.

Understanding Passive Intent Signals

Passive intent signals refer to behavioral data points that indicate a prospect’s interest without requiring them to explicitly express it. Unlike active signals, which involve direct engagement such as downloading a whitepaper or requesting a quote, passive signals are collected through indirect interactions.

Examples of passive intent signals include:

*   Visiting specific product or pricing pages on a website

*   Spending extended time reading industry-related content

*   Repeatedly searching for certain solutions online

*   Engaging with relevant topics on professional platforms

*   Viewing competitor comparisons or product reviews

These actions may seem small individually, but when analyzed collectively, they provide powerful insights into a prospect’s interests and potential buying intent.

Early Detection of Buying Interest

One of the biggest advantages of passive intent signals is their ability to reveal buying interest early in the decision-making process. B2B buyers typically conduct extensive research before reaching out to vendors. By the time they submit a form or request a demo, they may already be close to making a decision.

Passive intent signals allow businesses to identify these prospects while they are still in the research phase. This early visibility enables marketing and sales teams to nurture leads proactively, providing relevant information that influences the buyer’s journey before competitors have the chance.

More Accurate Lead Qualification

Traditional lead qualification often depends on limited information such as job titles, company size, or industry. While these factors are useful, they don’t necessarily indicate whether a prospect is actively considering a solution.

Passive intent signals add an additional layer of intelligence. By analyzing behavioral patterns—such as which topics a prospect is researching or how frequently they engage with certain content—companies can better determine the likelihood of a purchase.

This data-driven approach helps teams prioritize high-potential leads, ensuring that sales resources are focused on prospects who are most likely to convert.

Personalized and Timely Engagement

Another major benefit of passive intent signals is the ability to deliver highly personalized marketing experiences. When businesses understand what topics or solutions a prospect is exploring, they can tailor messaging accordingly.

For example, if a potential buyer is frequently researching cloud security solutions, marketing teams can deliver targeted content such as case studies, comparison guides, or webinars related to that topic. This level of personalization not only increases engagement but also positions the company as a helpful resource rather than just another vendor.

Timing also plays a critical role. Passive signals help marketers reach prospects when their interest is strongest, increasing the chances of meaningful interaction.

Improved Marketing and Sales Alignment

Passive intent data also strengthens collaboration between marketing and sales teams. Marketing can use these insights to create more targeted campaigns, while sales teams can use the same data to approach prospects with greater context and relevance.

Instead of cold outreach, sales representatives can initiate conversations based on the prospect’s demonstrated interests. This approach leads to more productive discussions and higher-quality interactions.

As a result, the entire lead generation process becomes more efficient, reducing wasted effort and improving overall conversion rates.

Gaining a Competitive Advantage

In many industries, multiple vendors compete for the same group of potential buyers. Companies that leverage passive intent signals gain a significant advantage because they can identify and engage prospects before competitors even know they exist.

By understanding early-stage research behavior, businesses can position themselves as trusted advisors throughout the buyer’s journey. This early relationship-building often plays a decisive role when prospects finally make their purchasing decisions.

Conclusion

Passive intent signals are transforming the way [B2B organizations](https://intentamplify.com/solutions/by-function/sales/) approach lead generation. By capturing and analyzing subtle behavioral data, businesses can identify potential buyers earlier, qualify leads more accurately, and deliver personalized engagement at the right time.

In an environment where timing, relevance, and insight are critical, companies that effectively leverage passive intent signals will be better positioned to attract high-quality leads, build stronger relationships, and ultimately drive sustainable revenue growth.

Read More: <https://intentamplify.com/blog/why-passive-intent-matters-more-than-you-think-in-b2b-lead-gen/>

title.title: NEEDLEWORKMONDAY-La resistencia al hacer. [The resistance to doing.]
title.body:
> Hola needleworkers espero que se encuentren muy bien el día de hoy, hace mucho que no me pasaba por acá, pero voy a intentar estar de vuelta, últimamente no vengo haciendo muchas cosas de costura, o muchas cosas creativas en general, pero en este último tiempo tuve que hacer algunos arreglos, lo que me lleva a pensar porque no me gusta hacer arreglos jaja, encontré una gran resistencia al hacer cosas de costura en general, pero los arreglos me paralizan mucho más jaja, tuve este pantalón en mi lista de pendientes más de dos meses jaja y el tiempo que me tomo fue bastante pequeño en comparación, pero por suerte encontré la fuerza mental para hacerlo.
Hello needleworkers, I hope you're all doing well today. It's been a while since I've been here, but I'm going to try to get back into it. Lately, I haven't been doing much sewing, or many creative things in general, but recently I've had to do some alterations, which makes me wonder why I don't like doing alterations, haha. I find sewing in general quite difficult, but alterations paralyze me even more, haha. I had these pants on my to-do list for over two months, haha, and the time it took me was quite short in comparison, but luckily I found the mental strength to do it.

> Para empezar, arreglar una prenda suele tener mucho trabajo, hay que ver el arreglo necesario, desarmar la prenda, hacer un molde para el arreglo y coser, esto ya toma un tiempo, y muchas veces no se puede desarmar la pieza por completo, o hay que prestar mucha atención a la forma del armado, muchas veces las prendas tienen reducido el margen de costura, así que hay que ver con mucho cuidado toda la prenda antes de desarmarla y después. Un amigo me pidió reparar los bolsillos de su jean, ya había hecho esto hace un tiempo para otra persona y mi experiencia no fue nada buena, pero decidí volver a intentarlo, había que reemplazar la tela de ambos bolsillos.
To begin with, mending a garment is usually a lot of work. You have to assess the necessary repairs, take the garment apart, make a pattern for the alteration, and sew. This already takes time, and often you can't completely disassemble the piece, or you have to pay close attention to how it's put back together. Many times, garments have reduced seam allowances, so you have to examine the entire garment very carefully before and after taking it apart. A friend asked me to repair the pockets on his jeans. I had done this for someone else a while ago, and my experience wasn't great, but I decided to try again. The fabric in both pockets had to be replaced.

> Sacar el molde no fue tan difícil, pero tampoco es un molde tan exacto, el problema son los remaches del bolsillo, no los pude sacar y tampoco los podía reemplazar así que simplemente saqué esos cm del bolsillo.
Making the mold wasn't too difficult, but it's not a very accurate mold either; the problem is the rivets on the pocket. I couldn't remove them and I couldn't replace them either, so I just took those centimeters off the pocket.

> Use una tela resistente de algodón, que es este lienzo, esto va a ayudar a que duren un tiempo más, si bien contrastan con el pantalón lo importante acá es la funcionalidad. Una vez moldes listos y cortados los cosí por el borde con overlock.
Use a sturdy cotton fabric, like this canvas; this will help them last longer. While they do contrast with the pants, the important thing here is functionality. Once the patterns were ready and cut, I sewed them along the edge with an overlock machine.

> Coserlos al pantalón costó un poco porque había que usar lo que había, no hay márgenes de costura, así que tuve que ser cuidadosa, pero resultó bien, creo que debería aprender el famoso remiendo japones, se llama sashiko, y es una técnica de bordado que se usa para arreglar prendas, pero en este caso no era útil, la tela estaba super rasgada, ya que en general la tela de los bolsillos no suele ser muy gruesa o de buena calidad.
Sewing them onto the pants was a bit of a challenge because I had to use what I had; there were no seam allowances, so I had to be careful. But it turned out well. I think I should learn the famous Japanese mending technique called sashiko, an embroidery technique used to repair garments. However, in this case, it wasn't useful because the fabric was extremely torn, as pocket fabric is generally not very thick or of good quality.

> Estos pantalones tendrán un poco más de vida ahora, pero estoy segura de que no quiero hacer otro cambio de bolsillos jajaja todos los arreglos llevan bastante tiempo y el costo que se puede cobrar es a veces más alto que la prenda, por eso también tengo tanta resistencia a los arreglos, no es algo en lo que se gane mucho dinero, entonces no tiene tanto sentido para la gente pagarlo, pero esto fue más de favor para mi amigo que por dinero, quizás vuelva a hacer prendas, tengo cosas en mente, aunque ningún plan para llevarlas a cabo, pero eso lo veremos a lo largo del año, hasta la próxima.
These pants will have a little more life now, but I'm sure I don't want to do another pocket replacement, haha. All alterations take quite a bit of time, and the cost you can charge is sometimes higher than the garment itself. That's why I'm so resistant to alterations; it's not something you make much money doing, so it doesn't make much sense for people to pay for it. But this was more of a favor for my friend than for money. Maybe I'll do clothes again; I have some ideas in mind, although I don't have any plans to carry them out. But we'll see about that throughout the year. Until next time.
> Hasta la próxima ❤️ Yowi. See you next time ❤️ Yowi.

>

title.title: 地下车库堵车风波
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![MPn2mdu3QDmzBwNT_40614.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrpointp/images/MPn2mdu3QDmzBwNT_40614/MPn2mdu3QDmzBwNT_40614.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

上周的一个晚上，已经快9点了，我们一家人吃完饭回到小区，停好车。从地下车库的停车位走向电梯厅的路上，我看到前方几个人正激烈地争辩，走近后才看清是一名保安和两位业主。
 
我本就不是爱看热闹的人，没有驻足围观，只是在经过他们的十几秒钟里，听清了争执的缘由。车位的主人情绪激动，语气十分强硬：“我今天就是要堵着他，等他下来的时候当面给我个说法！哪怕我明天早上上班不开车也行，反正我就得堵着他。”
 
随后，我留意到一辆车直直地停在过道右侧，把另一辆停在车位里的车堵得严严实实。结合他们的对话不难推断，这位堵车的车主，正是因为自己的车位被占，才做出了这样略显极端的举动。
 
说心里话，我能理解他的愤怒，甚至并不觉得这个行为是错误。因为我也曾有过类似的经历，有一次我的车位被占，恰好着急出门。照对方车上预留的号码打电话，对方却说不是自己在用车，还要再联系其他人。一来二去，我至少被耽误了十几分钟，当时心里也是很烦躁的。
 
但我向来以和为贵，算是个好说话的人。而且现在网上特别流行“幸福者退让”，更让我觉得，没必要为了这样的小事与人大动干戈。毕竟当下社会，每个人的压力都不小，情绪管控越来越难。

谁也说不清，对方是否正徘徊在崩溃的边缘，一旦激怒了对方，即便他最初理亏，也可能不管不顾，到头来只会让矛盾愈演愈烈。
 
再说到物业，车位是否被占，本就属于物业的管理范畴。既然业主每个月都按时缴纳车位管理费，物业就不该只负责打扫卫生，更要加强车位的管理。
 
其实加强管理并不难，占车位的情况也不是时刻都在发生，物业只需每天定期巡逻，发现车位被占的情况后，及时联系车主处理，就能避免很多矛盾。这样既维护了业主的权益，物业也不至于总因为这类事情被业主骂。

也不知道这件堵车风波后来怎么样了，这倒是让我感到好奇…

---

title.body:
![paulmp-portfolio-632.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/paulmp/23vPXjiJ5oThEFiwGQmPnx8zLNj4nWUJLG6WafpSyLvxkLNdAQEuF7fwaYvZ7cgXkLgTk.jpg)

In 2020 and 2023 I worked on some photography projects in Japan with their national tourism organisation, as well as running some photography tours. For part of the tours we visit an area known for its wild snow monkeys, both the very popular mountain location in the old onsen, but also another area close by where nobody visits. 

I personally prefer photographing animals in the wild, not captivity, the snow monkeys at Jigokudani are wild in that they have no fences or any restrictions in their movements, but they have become habituated with people and being fed over winter. Which is why I have sought out other places near by where the monkeys are more \

and less used to having humans around.

Here are some photos from my time exploring and photographing the monkeys.

title.title: REBEL PHASE?
title.body: >En estas ultimas semanas he notado que mi gato está comiendo muchísimo mas que antes, asi que para que no engorde demasiado (porque ya me paso antes con mis anteriores gatos) decidí racionarle la comida, obviamente no dejo que muera de hambre pero si le sirvo poca cantidad en ciertas horas del día y no cada vez que lo veo vacío como hacia antes. > In recent weeks, I've noticed that my cat is eating much more than before, so to prevent him from getting too fat (because it happened before with my previous cats), I decided to ration his food. Obviously, I don't let him starve, but I do serve him small amounts at certain times of the day and not every time I see him hungry, as I did before. ![Corazón banner (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFgAbHNHepcyH3o8wH15M4pR8K7Jsf3tw4TsSj65zyY1UyQpKRK2L9tGpjABj48Qxzb.png)

>Y he notado que se ha vuelto bastante mas obsesivo y manipulador, pero no solo eso tambien hace “rabietas” cuando no obtiene lo que quiere, me impresiona demasiado las técnicas tan astutas que tiene este gato para llamar la atención- > And I've noticed that he's become quite obsessive and manipulative, but not only that, he also throws “tantrums” when he doesn't get what he wants. I'm really impressed by this cat's clever techniques for getting attention. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/EoeFPzZTDkY2aVYXxZ6tuuo2SysW86pvcZk8WNpyev4gAWenwX8HaxoSA7SoUNFPUn9.png)

>Cuando lleva 5 minutos sin comer se desquicia y se hace la victima comiendo basura, literal cualquier basura o pelusa que consiga se la come, incluso ha llegado a hurgar en el bote de basura de la cocina, realmente eso es molesto porque no tiene necesidad de hacer eso y solo lo hace por drama y querer llamar la atención para que le demos comida. - Pero lo peor paso hoy por la mañana cuando mi hijo se sentó a desayunar panquecas, Tommy nunca ha sido un gato que quiera robarte tu comida o que te pida de lo que estas comiendo, asi que siempre sirvo la comida de mi hijo sin preocuparme demasiado, me fui a la cocina a fregar y cuando escucho a mi hijo gritando, si, Tommy se estaba comiendo sus panquecas. > When he hasn't eaten for five minutes, he freaks out and plays the victim by eating garbage—literally any garbage or lint he can find, he eats it. He has even rummaged through the kitchen trash can. It's really annoying because he doesn't need to do that, he just does it for drama and to get attention so we'll give him food. But the worst thing happened this morning when my son sat down to eat pancakes for breakfast. Tommy has never been a cat who wants to steal your food or beg for what you're eating, so I always serve my son's food without worrying too much. I went to the kitchen to do the dishes, and when I heard my son screaming, yes, Tommy was eating his pancakes. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23xARayYFfrPG3cFFJakSuuBK651chun1L6bopYwoe3pdaiXAjvJnEt7wsKpveW4h9mSi.png)

>Tuve que correr detrás del gato para que se bajara de la mesa, ahora comemos con miedo de que se monte a robarnos la comida, jajaja no me lo tomo a mal porque amo a mi gato pero si me llama la atención los comportamientos tan manipuladores y malvados de Tommy cuando no le dan lo que quiere en el momento que quiere. > I had to chase the cat off the table, and now we eat in fear that he'll jump up and steal our food, ha ha ha. I don't take it personally because I love my cat, but I am struck by Tommy's manipulative and mischievous behavior when he doesn't get what he wants when he wants it. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23xKt856tnqyhdqVqjKUL6ZQJM1p2efozANHdF1RGLXLyXDdAZZEGCTgbSBZnG1JSkoBF.png)

>Pero no cambiare mi decisión, seguiré racionando la comida porque no quiero que tenga obesidad, a veces pareciera que solo come por comer y no porque tenga hambre. > But I won't change my mind. I'll continue to ration his food because I don't want him to become obese. Sometimes it seems like he only eats to eat and not because he's hungry. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23wqnVznvFhfBjyV1L6ynCXX9zULAGi8ZxeeEfiwFpcwBj9xzBp6SWRryTRXZefezwBRz.png)

title.title: Entry to the Shadow Hunter Contest Smash
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUFV7sSjTSJpL6tWyy7xs9gn7nwHrMXZCPCEunhDxPaU7/img_20251006_100959.jpg)

I snapped this photo right by the museum, where the shadow of a nearby tree stretched across a sculpture. Something about that moment caught me — simple, quiet, but full of character. The shadow seemed alive, almost telling its own story, and I wanted to share it here as part of the contest.  

---
Entrada al Shadow Hunter Contest Smash 
Tomé esta foto al lado del museo, justo donde la sombra de un árbol se proyectaba sobre una escultura. Me gustó ese instante sencillo, silencioso, pero lleno de carácter. So now Donald Trump is talking about a “peaceful takeover” of Cuba.

Whenever a man who sounds like he walked straight out of The Godfather starts talking about peace, people naturally pause for a second.

You know… just to make sure the cameras are rolling.

Trump says the U.S. could end up with a “friendly takeover” of Cuba and that Secretary of State Marco Rubio has been negotiating with Havana.

At the same time, Trump threatened tariffs and penalties on countries sending oil to Cuba. One of those countries Mexico suddenly paused shipments.

Official explanation: “sovereign decision.”

Unofficial translation: Nobody felt like starting a fight with the world’s largest economy this week.

Trump also explained why Cuba is suddenly willing to talk:

“They have no money… they have no anything right now.”

Translation:
They’re broke.
They’re cornered.
And Uncle Sam just walked in with a contract and a pen.

Cue the music from The Godfather:
“I’m gonna make him an offer he can’t refuse.”

Now before anyone imagines Marines parachuting into Havana followed by Starbucks managers and Miami condo developers yelling “Where do we build the beachfront resort?”, a “peaceful takeover” in politics usually means something a lot less cinematic.

1️⃣ The system collapses on its own.
Economic crisis, protests, internal power fights… the government cracks.

2️⃣ Negotiated transition.
Lift sanctions, open trade, bring investment.

Translation: You want access to the biggest economy on Earth? Great.
Here’s the rulebook.

3️⃣ The soft takeover.
No invasion. No revolution. No tanks.
Just economic gravity. American companies move in. Tourism explodes. Money flows.

Cuba stays independent on paper…

…but eventually the island starts speaking fluent dollar with a Miami accent and a Starbucks every three blocks. 💵😏

title.title: Bur Birah Panyang Peak and Pendemun One-One Village
title.body:
![IMG_2547.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EqYqh3jg1Qs2u1VcpJ4SHC5DXb7XCsL5pGXZYUUDnoKGFi5NaAZ35Dm47yDW6AL8byM.jpeg) Hello Hive friends, especially to the members of the Photography Lovers community, may God always bless us all. I'm so happy to be back in this beloved community to share a post about photography. I'm not a skilled photographer; all of these images were taken using my iPhone 11. The weather was clear at the time, so all the objects in the images are clearly visible, especially the nature and landscape as the main focus. So, I think everything looks good. I only took photos from a few angles, and they look good with the natural light. It was nearing noon, and the sun was directly overhead, so I had the advantage of not encountering blacklight. Because the object I photographed was positioned to the east, where the sun rises. If I had taken the photo in the morning, I would likely have had to fight against blacklight, which would certainly not have been as good, especially since I was shooting with only a phone camera. The object seen in this image is a natural view from the peak of Bur Gayo. I took this photo while visiting the peak of Bur Telege some time ago. I walked from the ticket booth to the top. Before I reached the summit, I found a viewing platform. This viewing platform was made of wood, with several supports anchored to the ground, supported by large nails. So, I thought it would hold me up. It seemed sturdy, even though I was moving around on it. These viewing platforms are often used as photo spots and are often found in tourist attractions offering the sensation of natural scenery. There are several other interesting viewing platforms with beautiful natural backdrops at the top of Bur Telege, but this time I focused on the viewing platform at the ticket booth. The view from this viewing platform is the peak of Mount Bur Birah Panyang and the atmosphere of Pedemun One-One village, a tourist village near the lake. Meanwhile, the lake in view is a view of the lake surrounding Teluk One-One, a village not far from the Renggali Hotel. This village is typically home to many villas, guesthouses, and restaurants selling grilled fish and seafood. At another point, I also found a spot to photograph from a different angle and found a different subject. This spot showcased the natural scenery and the densely populated city atmosphere, but several pine trees growing around the photo spot obscured part of the city from the subject. Meanwhile, on the other side, a dense pine forest was visible, blocking the view of the lake. The pine forest, on the other hand, also grew densely and towered tall, creating a natural and beautiful forest atmosphere that was pleasing to the eye. ----- ![IMG_2551.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/Eqd65wEtivK5ndGHup9FFPoK4Kz8kJBawo1cfPRBAVB8LSnVEZHwgGgfzYrtAaog43i.jpeg) ![IMG_2548.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/Enua8aNZVthJDcPpHEU25nyRBGmZCgQqcyj5ECLXkLaghusubsLHWkBEpYFCmCvsczF.jpeg) ![IMG_2521.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EnYNZVspAGTSnx27xKebMiZELW648Ptmw4qujmPYwLR1pNwo825zx1AsinJojzwF41M.jpeg) ![IMG_2523.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EnYNWmUhUTKrvvNnqeH6qDLwxveY66Q17bkTt9JENRic4xeVnPs6yBtZJGd1KHYHPEx.jpeg) ![IMG_2550.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EnoCVsom7iwsMgjvULLwfMhkBcfB99CQVc3tJU6FoshDqA6KNarnQvj6anD2SjeZcNx.jpeg) ![IMG_2549.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EpZPydMxibxmcpWgT5ZrqtaYX7U9uRL8Hsz3pzip7k3AtyKq1mGwri3spyGQpsuFuYX.jpeg) ------ ------- ### INDONESIA ![IMG_2547.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EqYqh3jg1Qs2u1VcpJ4SHC5DXb7XCsL5pGXZYUUDnoKGFi5NaAZ35Dm47yDW6AL8byM.jpeg) Halo sahabat Hive, terkhusus untuk para anggota komunitas Photography Lovers, semoga tuhan selalu memberkati kita semuanya. Senang sekali saya dapat kembali di komunitas yang kita cintai ini untuk berbagi postingan tentang photo. Saya bukanlah ahli photography yang handal, semua gambar-gambar ini saya ambil menggunakan kamera Iphone 11 milik saya. Pada saat pengambilan gambar cuacanya cerah, semua objek di dalam gambar terlihat dengan jelas, terlebih objek yang menjadi fokus utama adalah alam dan bentuk landscape. Jadi, menurut saya semuanya terlihat bagus,saya hanya mengambil dari beberapa sudut saja dan itu terlihat bagus dengan dukungan cahaya alami. Hari menjelang siang, matahari tepat akan berada di atas, jadi keuntungannya adalah saya tidak mendapati blacklight. Karena posisi objek yang saya poto adalah di arah bagian timur, dimana tempat matahari terbit. Jika pada waktu pagi saya ambil gambar, kemungkinan saya akan melawan blacklight, sudah pasti hasilnya tidak bagus, terlebih lagi karena saya mengambil gambar hanya menggunakan kamera ponsel. Objek yang terlihat di dalam gambar ini adalah pemdangan alam dari puncak Bur Gayo, poto ini saya ambil ketika saya pergi mengunjungi kawasan puncak Bur Telege beberapa waktu yang lalu. Saya berjalan dari lokasi pos tiket menuju ke atas, di atas yang belum sampai ke pucak saya menemukan sebuah anjungan pandangan. Anjungan pandang ini terbuat dari kayu, beberapa kayu penyangga yang ditancapkan ke tanah telah ditambah dengan dukungan paku yang berukuran besar. Jadi, saya pikir anjungan pandang ini dapat menahan saya untuk berdiri di atas ini, ya anjungan pandangan ini terlihat kokoh meskipun saya bergerak-gerak di atasnya. Anjungan pandang ini biasanya menjadi sebagai sebuah spot untuk berfoto dan akan sering kita temukan di tempat wisata yang menawarkan sensasi pemdangan alam. Di atas puncak Bur Telege ini juga masih terdapat beberapa lagi anjungan pandang yang menarik dengan latar pemandangan alam yang indah, tetapi untuk kali ini saya fokus pengambilan gambar pada anjungan pandang di pos tiket ini. Yang terlihat dari anjungan pandang ini adalah puncak gunung Bur Birah Panyang dan suasana di desa Pedemun One-One, sebuah desa wisata yang dekat dengan pinggir danau. Sementara itu, danau yang terlihat merupakan pemdangan danau yang berada di sekitar Teluk One-One, sebuah kampung yang tidak jauh dari Hotel Renggali, biasanya di kampung tersebut terdapat banyak Villa, Penginapan dan Resto menjual ikan bakar dan seafood. Di titik lain, saya juga menemukan spot untuk memotret dari sisi yang berbeda dan menemukan objek gambar yang berbeda. Dimana posisi tersebut memperlihatkan pemandangan alam dan suasana kota yang padat dengan rumah penduduk, namun beberapa pohon pinus yang tumbuh di sekitar spot poto membuat sebagian area kota tertutupi dari objek pengambilan gambar. Sementara itu, di sisi lain juga terlihat hutan pinus yang melebat hingga menutupi sudut pandang ke arah danau. Di sisi lain hutan pinus juga tumbuh dengan lebat dan menjulang tinggi, membawa suasana hutan yang terasa begitu alami dan indah memanjakan mata saya. ------ ![IMG_2551.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/Eqd65wEtivK5ndGHup9FFPoK4Kz8kJBawo1cfPRBAVB8LSnVEZHwgGgfzYrtAaog43i.jpeg) ![IMG_2548.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/Enua8aNZVthJDcPpHEU25nyRBGmZCgQqcyj5ECLXkLaghusubsLHWkBEpYFCmCvsczF.jpeg) ![IMG_2521.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EnYNZVspAGTSnx27xKebMiZELW648Ptmw4qujmPYwLR1pNwo825zx1AsinJojzwF41M.jpeg) ![IMG_2523.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EnYNWmUhUTKrvvNnqeH6qDLwxveY66Q17bkTt9JENRic4xeVnPs6yBtZJGd1KHYHPEx.jpeg) ![IMG_2550.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EnoCVsom7iwsMgjvULLwfMhkBcfB99CQVc3tJU6FoshDqA6KNarnQvj6anD2SjeZcNx.jpeg) ![IMG_2549.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ponpase/EpZPydMxibxmcpWgT5ZrqtaYX7U9uRL8Hsz3pzip7k3AtyKq1mGwri3spyGQpsuFuYX.jpeg) ------ ![PONPASE HIVE BLOG.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZLeugLNC75cRqWVaaN4atbDZrDw1wtGr19wzQxTC4CwN/PONPASE%20HIVE%20BLOG.png) ####

title.title: Data-Driven B2B Marketing: Stop Guessing and Start Growing
title.body:
In today’s competitive business landscape, B2B marketing can no longer rely on assumptions, intuition, or outdated tactics. Companies that depend on guesswork often waste resources on campaigns that fail to generate meaningful results. The solution lies in data-driven [B2B marketing](https://intentamplify.com/lead-generation-services/https:/technologyaiinsights.com/ai-revolutionaries-transformative-trends-reshaping-businesses-in-2026/)—a strategic approach that uses analytics, customer insights, and measurable performance indicators to guide marketing decisions. By leveraging data effectively, businesses can improve targeting, optimize campaigns, and drive sustainable growth.

The Problem with Guess-Based Marketing

Traditional B2B marketing often relied on experience and broad assumptions about customer behavior. Marketers would launch campaigns based on what they believed might work, then wait to see the outcome. This approach leads to several problems:

*   Poor targeting of potential customers

*   Inefficient use of marketing budgets

*   Difficulty measuring campaign performance

*   Missed opportunities for growth

Without data, marketing strategies are often reactive rather than proactive. Companies end up repeating the same tactics without knowing whether they actually influence buyer decisions.

What is Data-Driven B2B Marketing?

Data-driven marketing uses real customer data, analytics, and performance metrics to plan, execute, and refine marketing strategies. Instead of relying on intuition, marketers analyze information such as customer behavior, engagement patterns, and conversion rates to guide their decisions.

This approach helps businesses understand:

*   Which marketing channels generate the best leads

*   What type of content attracts decision-makers

*   How prospects move through the buying journey

*   Where campaigns need improvement

When marketing decisions are backed by data, businesses gain clarity about what works and what doesn’t.

Key Data Sources in B2B Marketing

Successful data-driven marketing depends on collecting insights from multiple sources. Some of the most valuable data sources include:

Website Analytics:
Tools like website analytics platforms track visitor behavior, page engagement, and traffic sources. These insights help marketers understand what content attracts prospects and where users drop off.

Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Systems:
[CRM systems](https://intentamplify.com/solutions/by-function/sales/) store detailed information about leads, prospects, and existing customers. By analyzing CRM data, businesses can identify patterns in buying behavior and improve lead nurturing strategies.

Email Marketing Metrics:
Open rates, click-through rates, and response rates provide valuable feedback on how well email campaigns resonate with target audiences.

Social Media Insights:
Engagement data from professional networking platforms and social channels helps marketers identify topics and formats that capture attention.

Benefits of Data-Driven B2B Marketing

Adopting a data-driven approach offers several significant advantages.

Improved Targeting
Data allows businesses to segment audiences more accurately. Instead of targeting broad groups, marketers can focus on specific industries, job roles, or company sizes that are most likely to convert.

Higher ROI
By understanding which campaigns produce the best results, companies can allocate budgets more effectively and eliminate underperforming strategies.

Better Customer Experience
Data helps marketers deliver personalized content and relevant messaging throughout the buyer journey. This builds stronger relationships with potential customers.

Continuous Optimization
Marketing campaigns can be adjusted in real time based on performance data. This ensures ongoing improvement rather than waiting until a campaign ends.

Building a Data-Driven Marketing Strategy

Transitioning to data-driven marketing requires a structured approach.

First, businesses should define clear marketing goals, such as generating qualified leads or improving conversion rates. These goals guide which metrics should be tracked.

Second, companies need the right analytics tools and platforms to collect and interpret data. Marketing automation systems, CRM software, and analytics dashboards play an essential role in this process.

Third, marketers must focus on testing and experimentation. Techniques like A/B testing allow teams to compare different messages, designs, or campaigns to determine which performs better.

Finally, organizations should build a data-focused culture where decisions are supported by insights rather than assumptions.

The Future of B2B Marketing

As digital channels continue to evolve, the importance of data-driven marketing will only increase. Artificial intelligence, predictive analytics, and advanced automation tools are making it easier for businesses to analyze large volumes of data and uncover actionable insights.

Companies that embrace data-driven strategies will gain a competitive advantage by understanding their customers more deeply and responding faster to market changes. On the other hand, businesses that continue relying on guesswork risk falling behind.

Conclusion

Data-driven B2B marketing transforms how organizations approach growth. By replacing assumptions with measurable insights, businesses can create more effective campaigns, deliver better customer experiences, and achieve higher returns on their marketing investments. In a world where information is readily available, the smartest strategy is simple: stop guessing and start growing with data. 📊🚀

Read More: <https://intentamplify.com/blog/stop-guessing-b2b-marketing-campaigns-build-with-data-not-assumptions/>

title.title: Tối ưu không gian nhà xưởng với hệ thống quạt ly tâm thông minh
title.body:
#

Trong các nhà xưởng hiện đại, không gian luôn là yếu tố quý giá. Việc bố trí máy móc, hệ thống hút bụi và thông gió hợp lý không chỉ giúp sản xuất hiệu quả mà còn đảm bảo an toàn cho công nhân. Quạt ly tâm, với vai trò trung tâm trong hệ thống thông gió và hút bụi, cần được thiết kế và lắp đặt một cách thông minh để tận dụng tối đa diện tích nhà xưởng.

Xem thêm: [Phú Đạt Vượng – Giải pháp quạt công nghiệp chất lượng cao hiện đại](https://baohungyen.vn/phu-dat-vuong-giai-phap-quat-cong-nghiep-chat-luong-cao-hien-dai-3187215.html)

## 1. Lợi ích của việc tối ưu hệ thống quạt ly tâm

Một hệ thống quạt ly tâm được bố trí hợp lý mang lại nhiều lợi ích:

*   Tăng diện tích sử dụng thực tế: Giảm không gian thừa do lắp đặt ống gió không hợp lý.



*   Duy trì hiệu suất hút tối đa: Không gian bố trí hợp lý giúp đường ống ngắn hơn, ít khúc gấp, áp suất và lưu lượng ổn định.



*   Dễ dàng bảo trì và vệ sinh: Bố trí khoa học giúp kỹ thuật viên tiếp cận quạt và bộ lọc nhanh chóng, giảm thời gian dừng máy.



*   An toàn lao động: Giảm nguy cơ va chạm hoặc vướng mắc với các thiết bị khác trong xưởng.



## 2. Nguyên tắc bố trí quạt ly tâm thông minh

### a. Đặt quạt gần trung tâm hệ thống

[Quạt ly tâm](https://www.facebook.com/quatcongnghiepphudatvuong/posts/qu%E1%BA%A1t-ly-t%C3%A2m-c%C3%B4ng-nghi%E1%BB%87p-gi%E1%BA%A3i-ph%C3%A1p-th%C3%B4ng-gi%C3%B3-t%E1%BB%91i-%C6%B0u-cho-s%E1%BA%A3n-xu%E1%BA%A5t-hi%E1%BB%87n-%C4%91%E1%BA%A1iqu%E1%BA%A1t-ly-/122125549718986307/) nên được đặt ở vị trí trung tâm, gần các điểm hút chính để giảm chiều dài đường ống. Điều này giúp:

*   Giảm tổn thất áp suất



*   Tăng hiệu quả vận hành



*   Giảm chi phí đầu tư cho ống dẫn và phụ kiện



### b. Tránh các khúc gấp thừa

Mỗi khúc gấp trong hệ thống ống dẫn đều làm giảm áp suất và lưu lượng. Thiết kế đường ống theo hướng thẳng hoặc uốn cong nhẹ sẽ giúp quạt ly tâm vận hành ổn định.

### c. Phân khu theo từng khu vực sản xuất

Trong các nhà xưởng lớn, nên chia hệ thống hút bụi thành các khu vực riêng, mỗi khu vực có quạt ly tâm phù hợp với lưu lượng yêu cầu. Điều này giúp kiểm soát hiệu quả bụi và khí thải, đồng thời tiết kiệm năng lượng.

## 3. Kết hợp quạt ly tâm với hệ thống tự động hóa

Hệ thống quạt ly tâm thông minh có thể kết hợp với:

*   Cảm biến áp suất và bụi: Điều chỉnh lưu lượng tự động theo nhu cầu thực tế.



*   Biến tần điều chỉnh tốc độ: Giảm tiêu thụ điện khi lưu lượng yêu cầu thấp.



*   Giám sát từ xa: Phát hiện sớm các sự cố và giảm thời gian bảo trì.



Kết hợp các công nghệ này không chỉ tối ưu hiệu suất quạt mà còn giúp quản lý nhà xưởng hiệu quả hơn.

## 4. Tối ưu diện tích nhà xưởng – hướng tới sản xuất bền vững

Việc thiết kế hệ thống quạt ly tâm thông minh giúp nhà xưởng vận hành gọn gàng, an toàn và tiết kiệm chi phí. Hệ thống thông gió hiệu quả còn giúp cải thiện chất lượng không khí, giảm bụi và nhiệt độ, nâng cao điều kiện làm việc cho công nhân.

Các doanh nghiệp có thể cân nhắc hợp tác với các đơn vị có kinh nghiệm như Quạt Phú Đạt Vượng, để được tư vấn giải pháp tối ưu theo từng diện tích và đặc thù nhà xưởng.

Tối ưu không gian nhà xưởng không chỉ là bài toán bố trí máy móc mà còn liên quan trực tiếp đến hệ thống quạt ly tâm. Thiết kế hợp lý giúp quạt vận hành hiệu quả, giảm chi phí điện năng, hạn chế sự cố và tạo môi trường làm việc an toàn.

Đầu tư vào một hệ thống quạt ly tâm thông minh là bước quan trọng để nâng cao hiệu suất sản xuất và hướng tới mô hình nhà xưởng hiện đại, bền vững.

Xem thêm: [Những sai lầm phổ biến khi lựa chọn quạt ly tâm cho nhà xưởng](https://magic.ly/phudatvuong/Nhung-sai-lam-pho-bien-khi-lua-chon-quat-ly-tam-cho-nha-xuong)

title.title: Traveling Rome / Paseando por Roma / contest week #279 (eng-esp)
title.body:
Greetings, everyone.

There are perfect afternoons that don't need company, although it's always welcome. There are perfect afternoons that are all about the place, the city, the atmosphere. One of those, for me, dear @elizabethbit, would be an afternoon strolling through Rome.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPsm9zEfQSgSc16M9hdoRJKXNsxkUUC4htrq45R8AjhPa/1773073126538.jpg)

I've done it before and I would do it again without hesitation. An afternoon stroll in Rome is, quite simply, a perfect afternoon. You don't need a set itinerary or a guide. Just walk aimlessly, letting the city lead you. Rome has that quality: every corner, every alley, offers you something.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6RyvE8jEDATcPTW4ZduPzqWuYmAi2ZeW9gVXtYWvHWb/1773073173174.jpg)

The first thing I enjoy is the architecture. I'm not an architect, nor do I know much about styles, but it doesn't matter. You can walk through Rome and feel history in every stone. The buildings aren't just structures; they're witnesses to centuries. They stand there, imposing or modest, but always with a story to tell. I like to look at them, imagine who passed through, what they saw, what they experienced.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSs1ifiZchRLTqwDRiEDssQcciAvjNDPGwHsWFWKJCiZ8/1773073173602.jpg)

Then there are the iconic sites, those you only see in movies until one day you're standing right in front of them. The Colosseum, the Trevi Fountain, the Pantheon. When you see them in person, something changes. They're not just images, they're real. And you feel part of something bigger, of a story that doesn't end with yourself. It's a strange but rewarding feeling.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfWNajBSdNJwDJYyc7k2UUv4CrExH9k1Ss2juTSQTjjuU/1773073174010.jpg)

And I can't forget the food. Because an afternoon in Rome is also an afternoon of flavors. A coffee on a terrace, an ice cream while you stroll, pasta at the end of the day. Eating in Rome is part of the experience, not just a necessity. It's another way to get to know the city, to enter its daily life.

The best part is that Rome never gets old. No matter how much you walk, there's always something new to see. A square you didn't know existed, a hidden church, a market with a life of its own. The city invites you to get lost and, at the same time, to find yourself.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdKd4oxFWWk7BZ51B6NLhPmQ5NiF4gaSzcFPPzYDqCjwi/1773073174425.jpg)

That's why I say that an afternoon stroll in Rome is a perfect afternoon. Because it combines history, beauty, flavor, and that certain something that cities with a rich history possess. An afternoon like that is unforgettable.

***
**Leer en español**
***

Saludos, estimadas.

Hay tardes perfectas que no necesitan compañía, aunque siempre se agradece. Hay tardes perfectas que tienen que ver con el lugar, con la ciudad, con la atmósfera. Una de esas, para mí, estimada @elizabethbit, sería una tarde paseando por Roma.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPsm9zEfQSgSc16M9hdoRJKXNsxkUUC4htrq45R8AjhPa/1773073126538.jpg)

Lo he hecho alguna vez y lo repetiría sin dudar. Una tarde de paseo en Roma es, sencillamente, una tarde perfecta. No hace falta un itinerario cerrado ni un guía. Basta con caminar sin rumbo fijo, dejando que la ciudad te lleve. Roma tiene esa cualidad: cada esquina, cada callejón, te regala algo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf6RyvE8jEDATcPTW4ZduPzqWuYmAi2ZeW9gVXtYWvHWb/1773073173174.jpg)

Lo primero que disfruto es la arquitectura. No soy arquitecto ni entiendo demasiado de estilos, pero no hace falta. Uno puede pasear por Roma y sentir la historia en cada piedra. Los edificios no son solo construcciones, son testigos de siglos. Están ahí, imponentes o modestos, pero siempre con una historia que contar. Me gusta mirarlos, imaginar quiénes pasaron por ahí, qué vieron, qué vivieron.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSs1ifiZchRLTqwDRiEDssQcciAvjNDPGwHsWFWKJCiZ8/1773073173602.jpg)

Luego están los sitios icónicos, esos que solo ves en películas hasta que un día los tienes delante. El Coliseo, la Fontana di Trevi, el Panteón. Cuando los ves en persona, algo cambia. No son solo imágenes, son reales. Y uno se siente parte de algo más grande, de una historia que no termina en uno mismo. Es una sensación extraña pero gratificante.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfWNajBSdNJwDJYyc7k2UUv4CrExH9k1Ss2juTSQTjjuU/1773073174010.jpg)

Y no puedo dejar de lado la gastronomía. Porque una tarde en Roma también es una tarde de sabores. Un café en una terraza, un helado mientras caminas, una pasta al final del día. Comer en Roma es parte del paseo, no solo una necesidad. Es otro modo de conocer la ciudad, de entrar en su vida cotidiana.

Lo mejor de todo es que Roma no se agota. Por más que camines, siempre hay algo nuevo que ver. Una plaza que no conocías, una iglesia escondida, un mercado con vida propia. La ciudad te invita a perderte y, al mismo tiempo, a encontrarte.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdKd4oxFWWk7BZ51B6NLhPmQ5NiF4gaSzcFPPzYDqCjwi/1773073174425.jpg)

Por eso digo que una tarde de paseo en Roma es una tarde perfecta. Porque combina historia, belleza, sabor y ese no sé qué que tienen las ciudades que han vivido mucho. Una tarde así no se olvida.

title.title: We should be grateful.
title.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/324658/pexels-photo-324658.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/woman-looking-at-city-in-winter-324658/ ) We meet many people in our life, some of whom we know for a short time and some of whom we have known for a long time. If we pay attention and look at the pages of our memories, we will remember that we have had many brief acquaintances with some people in our life who have helped us a lot through this brief acquaintance. Or maybe because they helped us at that inconvenient time, we have created that brief moment of memory with them and we have met each other. And we could not forget that brief moment for the rest of our lives. And somewhere in our mind a thought arises that if that person ever gets into any problem and if we have the power to solve that problem, then we will definitely solve that problem and get him out of it. This may be our feeling of gratitude towards them. In addition, we have our long-known relatives, friends, and some loved ones besides you who are always there for us in times of trouble and we also try to always be there for them in times of trouble. Being by their side builds a beautiful relationship with them and us with them and creates a sense of gratitude. In fact, gratitude can never be explained in words. If someone helps us in any trouble, if we tell them that we are grateful to them, it is just a word, but there is a lot of emotion and love hidden in it. But it is not enough to just say it. We should be by their side at their inconvenient times. In fact, the feeling of gratitude does not come to everyone, there are many people who, no matter how much we take care of them or stand by them in their difficult times, even if we do everything for them, they never acknowledge their gratitude. In fact, we should always stay away from these ungrateful people. Because no matter how much we do for these ungrateful people, they can never acknowledge their gratitude. No matter how much we do for these ungrateful people, it becomes less for them. However, when such ungrateful people do not always value the help of people or do not acknowledge their gratitude, and even say that no one helps them, no one is there for them at their worst, due to these behaviors, everyone gradually starts moving away from that ungrateful person. In fact, if people are not given the fruits of their suffering, then they do not want to cause any suffering in the future. Similarly, if a person goes through hardships for someone and tries his best to keep him well but does not pay any attention to himself, and if that person does not show any gratitude towards him and on the contrary, like an ungrateful person, starts blaming his work as worthless, then that person also starts moving away from him gradually. Everyone gradually starts moving away from ungrateful and selfish people and they may become completely alone. And no other people like these ungrateful people and do not like to have relationships. Therefore, we should always be grateful to those who are always there for us at our worst and take care of us by working hard for us. Just as gratitude improves relationships, so too does our relationship with the people around us, our relatives, friends, and loved ones, become very deep and long-lasting. Being grateful does not harm us in any way, but our mind is definitely good and we can interact with everyone with a clear mind. If we are not ungrateful to our beneficial people and express gratitude, others will also express gratitude to us, and future generations will learn to express gratitude based on our example or our education. Gratitude helps in many ways to build a beautiful mind and beautiful relationships. To build our life beautifully, we must express gratitude to our beneficial people. If we are ungrateful, we will never be able to become a good person. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ainun37/we-should-be-grateful-2u1)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbeZjJRZvWjNnbHHQ6kJhr9GLvn1M85m9gxsgQ5zDrLs6/1773111551960.png)

আজ আমরা যেখানে এসেছে এটা মূলত একটি বই মেলা।এই মেলার অবস্থান সোহরাওয়ার্দী উদ্যান, ঢাকা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, ঢাকা, বাংলাদেশ।ঢাকা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় প্রতি বছর একুশে বই মেলা অনুষ্ঠিত হয়।বই মেলা প্রতি বছর ফেব্রুয়ারি মাসে এই স্থানে অনুষ্ঠিত হয়।
>***Where we have come today is basically a book fair. The location of this fair is Suhrawardy Udyan, Dhaka University, Dhaka, Bangladesh. Dhaka University holds the Ekushey Book Fair every year.The book fair is held at this location every year in February.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUMJEZ3ocswaMfkSjQQQ9J9WCCw3mJGR7rHR763hJS2mP/1773111877302.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTH1H1dXqrowhndNpp3XfgW3mmkpFrELqXoCMf1WQ1zpi/1773111877841.jpg)

গেট দিয়ে প্রবেশ করার পরই দেখতে পারবেন, বাম পাশে রয়েছে তথ্য কেন্দ্র যেখানে আপনারা যেকোনো তথ্য এখান থেকে নিতে পারবেন।যেকোনো প্রয়োজনে তাদের সহযোগিতা নিতে পারবেন।
 >***As soon as you enter the gate, you will see that there is an information center on the left side where you can get any information. You can seek their help for any need.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfLRuiMPbgToFKNZbQSXc3ZmZf9ft4eTvrZhbsSEmRhRu/1773112410535.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTWbtUfF8EqWrKJKKFjDdq1gWRvFtTQFiuTWYYB6DV3qW/1773112411015.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP6siAs2h1zv3hTFUpLcTiTDMEF5EMg3kuSYFJC1qZsZE/1773112411510.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUqVues4ctyaRroW3jc5QCzeUxqXheBAptgS1BEgcrMd5/1773112412024.jpg)

বই মেলাতে নানান ধরনের বই পাওয়া যায়।যারা বই পড়তে ভালোবাসেন তাদের জন্য বই মেলা অন্যতম জ্ঞান অর্জনের সুযোগ।কেননা আপনারা আপনাদের পছন্দের বই খুব সহজেই এখানে পেয়ে যাবেন।
>***Various types of books are available at the book fair. For those who love to read, the book fair is one of the best opportunities to gain knowledge. Because you can easily find the books of your choice here.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdb3BanmZz5QhnYh1FNXhjCmTgvLcSgBHacRmnQvEqWud/1773112556069.jpg)

এখানে বাচ্চাদের জন্যেও রয়েছে সুন্দর সুন্দর শিক্ষণীয় বই।
>***There are also beautiful educational books for children here.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV737uzjsPKMXBk48Kx9KA4bTQkogBH7NWZHcYe8DQtoz/1773112745664.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSa3zuePVK8dCEPyyKyWuD4zEqzoENfzLKQG9R36fT7aJ/1773112746159.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTmjWWWnbrrB3ByMU9zncoAxCzERFLN2N9oCumoL6RLiW/1773112746628.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdoGaX3xyY6PHp3qaZMn47TrfGGe6xXvRCL8gZQ2tdneX/1773112747121.jpg)

বই মেলায় বিভিন্ন ধরনের, বিভিন্ন আকৃতি সুন্দর্য্য দিয়ে সাজানো হয়েছে,বইয়ের দোকান গুলো।এখানে আসলে মনটা ভালো হয়ে যায়।
>***The book shops at the book fair are beautifully decorated with different types and shapes. It really makes you feel good here.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWL75Zv5MW5sEKueB296NsbjBKU1Z33XfVnPBNsN6rvjA/1773112843872.jpg)

বই জ্ঞান অর্জনের অন্যতম মাধ্যম।তাই বেশি বেশি বই পড়লে যেমন জ্ঞান অর্জন হবে।তেমনি বই মেলায় ঘুরতে আসলে মনটা ফুরফুরে হয়ে যাবে এই নানা রকম সাজ সজ্জায়।তাই যারা বই পড়তে ভালোবাসেন চলে আসেন বই মেলায়।
>***Books are one of the means of acquiring knowledge. So, just as the more books you read, the more knowledge you will gain. Similarly, when you visit a book fair, your mind will be filled with joy at the various decorations. That is why those who love reading books come to the book fair.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeP9a2GEDTN8DWydumqnBU5VVZS5N8xHvVNv8kha2YzRi/1773112970703.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdJTkQk9AvUhr2buoAuXfQPWPapivtKx14d9gfAyS3C8W/1773112971231.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSvESNV4dve1qgofs3aj4Yiaumu1LcwJkrotXAeXDkXXi/1773112971690.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTut6CDXQh37DPebqPSGk4zAzJoq3tij5TMrjTmrqfvPF/1773112972226.jpg)

বই মেলায় আইন-শৃঙ্খলা রক্ষা করার জন্য রয়েছে পুলিশ কন্ট্রোল রুম এবং RAB কন্ট্রোল রুম।মেলায় আসা পর্যটকদের নিরাপত্তা নিশ্চিত করতে সব সময় বাংলাদেশ পুলিশ বাহিনী সতর্কতা অবলম্বন করছেন।
>***There is a police control room and a RAB control room to maintain law and order at the book fair. The Bangladesh Police Force is always taking precautions to ensure the safety of tourists visiting the fair.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdyZLRJCnzCh7vMLmcU99KHqeF6jPWTtnrwBAvHRyT5p6/1773113036899.jpg)
আরো রয়েছে মাদকদ্রব্য নিয়ন্ত্রণের জন্য, মাদকদ্রব্য নিয়ন্ত্রণ অধিদপ্তর। 
>***There is also the Narcotics Control Department for drug control.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQZaxCHD9AL91b1daDCKU2mFrE5PaJEvY8vyVG1njAKhE/1773113093547.jpg)
মেলায় থাকা কোনো দোকান বা আশেপাশের স্থানে যদি আগুন লাগে, সেই আগুন নিয়ন্ত্রণ করার জন্য সার্বক্ষণিক তদারকিতে আছেন ফায়ার সার্ভিস নিয়ন্ত্রণ কক্ষ।
>***If a fire breaks out in any shop at the fair or in the surrounding area, the fire service control room is on constant surveillance to control the fire.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZcmGVgnQKmD34mHu6Yi8Rxe2fbwPibM9Z4RcLEUhmP3J/1773113218156.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVQqWefojTEdRGQVRQvFcsBnJFzzyZUaX7tQ5vngnBcat/1773113218736.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT5nY6qyhZYkwKVBEnRwp9xcZU6UxHRKexTPxMRvg5AZ9/1773113219179.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYwGjcM49adp4V29VaoBFNjDSXgn6M46bSZjpDgFWQzY3/1773114399011.jpg)

বইমেলায় বইয়ের দোকানের পাশাপাশি রয়েছে বিভিন্ন ধরনের খাবারের দোকান। যেখানে আপনারা আপনাদের ক্ষুদা নিবারনের জন্য পেয়ে যাবেন বিভিন্ন ধরনের খাবার।
>***In addition to bookstores, there are various food stalls at the book fair, where you can find a variety of food to satisfy your hunger.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXk9v4uhXBpGraefhM5ysyW5A7FnkaPKYeGJdzWkhhnmw/1773113422075.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQKwkGUgBp5BxeGauJYLFK1XUdoYLcgtHCccC5rw76yxD/1773113422698.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUps1rbfr6Yq78zHHXfGXvH1tEWt51EN4FxEmkRqufqDW/1773113493838.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVFntcAxUey67VY4ufABS9ZgHbH2KsfRbVgvgcv4fBqxM/1773113423799.jpg)

বাচ্চাদের জন্য রয়েছে বাচ্চাদের পছন্দের বিভিন্ন ধরনের আইসক্রিম ও জুসের দোকান।
>***There are various ice cream and juice shops for children.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTPsUEvwr1gfqpb9vwQqeJKM7ezbC4LGoQk8c9uaayAeH/1773113549487.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd4Mrv4hAYd9tGHm7NiMCqPoiSHF3i5tvdk3XAtwG2ka2/1773113550085.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaA6b6UQv5he6NkTXp6Pt41MY8Xqr7P88wrmmwRR1qzRV/1773113550593.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRbMRW4zo5fcLLqCS1UiNjPQm6m2zprSXzspEVwagx9RN/1773113551084.jpg)

আরো রয়েছে বাচ্চাদের খেলা সুব্যবস্থা।যেখানে আপনার বাচ্চারা আনন্দের সাথে খেলতে পারবে এবং ভালো একটা সময় উপভোগ করবে।
>***There is also a children's play area where your children can play happily and have a good time.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZh8UF8ZBUraEKA7uydgezW1AYYAdDVDwXoVWf13sNm65/1773113784320.jpg)

যারা নিজেদের ছবি অংকন করতে চান, তাদের জন্য ছবি অংকনের ব্যবস্থাও রয়েছে। 
>***There is also a photo-drawing facility for those who want to draw their own pictures.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUk1Tt77jvv6sLEWEokYMU3cZWu5C4BGz2F4T56JLFTxU/1773113625044.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdMD5FTJW1j4X8tBJzrE3i69NMCoeTGdHVYKZuBiS5HzG/1773113625591.jpg)

বই মেলায় অন্য পাশে সন্ধ্যার পর এখানে আসা পর্যটকদের মনোরঞ্জন করার জন্য পুটুল খেলার মাধ্যমে সাংস্কৃতিক অনুষ্ঠান করা হয়।যা সত্যিই অসাধারণ। 
>***On the other side of the book fair, a cultural program is held through puppet shows to entertain the tourists who come here after the evening, which is truly extraordinary.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcikr1Nn26b9Y9k3ha3AG9RaNrHqwHoEPmfgxkNuN91x3/1773113867174.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVjkzVTkcqV68sDqLhGXJ5ArHWLQ2bn168Qsvzjc1HR96/1773113867629.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdU3UgEjGxy7cH9UHTsayRvhuTPWkHyzA4tfYR5Rwx82Y/1773113868111.jpg)

বই মেলায় দিনের চেয়ে রাতে আরো সুন্দর লাগে।কারন রাতে বিভিন্ন ধরনের ঝাড়বাতি দিয়ে দোকান গুলো সাজানো থাকে। যা রাতের সুন্দর্য্যকে বাড়িয়ে তুলে।
>***The book fair looks more beautiful at night than during the day. Because at night, the shops are decorated with various types of chandeliers, which enhances the beauty of the night.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTWbtUfF8EqWrKJKKFjDdq1gWRvFtTQFiuTWYYB6DV3qW/1773114019474.jpg)
সত্যি বলতে বইমেলায় এসে আমার অনেক ভালো লাগেছে।তাই যারা বই পড়তে ভালোবাসেন।এবং বিভিন্ন বই কিনতে চান,,তারা চলে আসেন বই মেলায়। সবার দাওয়াত রইলো।আশা করি আমার লেখা এবং পোস্ট আপনাদের ভালো লেগেছে। আবারো আপনাদের সাথে কথা হবে নতুন কোনো ভ্রমন কাহিনী নিয়ে। সেই পর্যন্ত সবাই ভালো থাকবেন।আল্লাহ হাফেজ। 
>***To be honest, I really enjoyed coming to the book fair. So, those who love to read books and want to buy various books, come to the book fair. Everyone is invited. I hope you liked my writing and post.We will talk to you again about a new travel story. Until then, everyone stay well. May Allah protect you.***
---
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd7sXZaxV6mR6PsfiqK2xGfEK8tZtSUHKvBjsnax2FJeE/1773114045888.jpg)
বই পড়তে কে কে ভালোবাসেন?এবং যাদের বই ভালো লাগে।তারা কমেন্ট করতে ভুলবেন না।
>***Who loves to read books? And those who like books, don't forget to comment.***
---
---
**আমি একজন বাংলাদেশী তাই বাংলাদেশ সহ বিভিন্ন দেশের মানুষ আমার লেখা যেন বোঝেন,সেই জন্য বাংলা ভাষার পাশাপাশি ইংরেজী ভাষা ব্যবহার করা হলো।সবাইকে জানাই ধন্যবাদ।**
>***I am a Bangladeshi, so people from different countries including Bangladesh can understand my writing, so I used English along with Bangla.***
---
---
<center>
**Thank you everyone**
</center>

title.title: Review Nước Hoa Unisex Byredo Pulp – Sự Bùng Nổ Của Trái Cây Chín Mọng
title.body:
## Giới thiệu về thương hiệu Byredo

Trong thế giới nước hoa niche cao cấp, Byredo là một thương hiệu rất được yêu thích bởi những người đam mê mùi hương độc đáo. Thương hiệu được thành lập vào năm 2006 tại Stockholm, Thụy Điển bởi Ben Gorham, một nghệ sĩ có niềm đam mê đặc biệt với việc kể chuyện thông qua mùi hương.

Điểm khác biệt của [nước hoa Byredo](https://theperfumes.vn/nuoc-hoa-byredo/) so với nhiều thương hiệu nước hoa truyền thống nằm ở triết lý sáng tạo. Thay vì chỉ tập trung vào việc tạo ra những mùi hương cầu kỳ, Byredo hướng đến việc tái hiện ký ức, cảm xúc và những trải nghiệm cá nhân thông qua mùi hương. Chính vì vậy, mỗi dòng nước hoa của hãng đều mang một câu chuyện riêng.

Ngoài mùi hương, thiết kế của Byredo cũng rất đặc trưng. Các chai nước hoa thường mang phong cách tối giản kiểu Scandinavia với thân chai thủy tinh trong suốt, nhãn trắng đơn giản và nắp đen hình vòm. Sự tối giản này giúp sản phẩm trông thanh lịch và hiện đại.

Trong bộ sưu tập của Byredo có nhiều mùi hương nổi tiếng như Gypsy Water, Mojave Ghost, Bal d’Afrique, Blanche và Pulp. Trong đó, Byredo Pulp được xem là một trong những sáng tạo táo bạo và cá tính nhất của thương hiệu.

## Giới thiệu về nước hoa Byredo Pulp

Byredo Pulp ra mắt vào năm 2008 và nhanh chóng gây ấn tượng trong thế giới nước hoa niche nhờ phong cách trái cây cực kỳ đậm đà và khác biệt. Nếu nhiều mùi nước hoa trái cây thường mang cảm giác tươi mát và nhẹ nhàng, thì Pulp lại đi theo hướng hoàn toàn khác.



![276070168_4617937394984750_97481.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/e12e94cfa1eda9594fa2a309489c5b0ad4ec02d97a2f015c143313163ce43956)



Theo mình, Pulp giống như một rổ trái cây chín mọng đang ở thời điểm ngọt nhất, nơi các loại trái cây hòa quyện với nhau tạo nên một mùi hương vừa ngọt ngào vừa sống động. Chính sự đậm đà này khiến Pulp trở thành một mùi hương rất cá tính, không phải ai cũng dễ dàng làm quen ngay từ lần đầu.

Pulp thuộc nhóm hương Fruity (trái cây) nhưng không đơn thuần chỉ là mùi trái cây tươi. Nó mang cảm giác trái cây chín, hơi lên men nhẹ, rất đậm và đầy năng lượng.

## Đánh giá Thiết kế chai nước hoa Byredo Pulp

Thiết kế của Byredo Pulp mang phong cách tối giản đặc trưng của thương hiệu.

Chai nước hoa được làm từ thủy tinh trong suốt, giúp người dùng nhìn thấy dung dịch bên trong. Nhãn chai màu trắng chỉ in tên thương hiệu và tên mùi hương bằng kiểu chữ đơn giản. Điểm nhấn của chai nằm ở phần nắp đen hình vòm, tạo cảm giác hiện đại và sang trọng.



![images (1).jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/e7177b767b79911ee31c4d1e168ed93de2e1b8974339a54af5f4d1faf28a4314)



Theo mình thì thiết kế của Byredo Pulp không quá cầu kỳ nhưng lại rất tinh tế. Nó giống như một món đồ trang trí thanh lịch trên bàn trang điểm hoặc kệ nước hoa.

Sự tối giản này cũng phản ánh đúng triết lý của Byredo: tập trung vào trải nghiệm mùi hương thay vì những chi tiết trang trí phức tạp.

## Cảm nhận về Hành trình hương thơm của nước hoa Byredo Pulp

Điều khiến Byredo Pulp trở nên đặc biệt chính là hành trình mùi hương rất sống động. Mùi hương phát triển theo từng giai đoạn rõ rệt, giống như một ly cocktail trái cây đậm vị.

**Hương đầu – bùng nổ trái cây chín mọng**

Ngay khi xịt Byredo Pulp, mình cảm nhận được ngay sự bùng nổ của các loại trái cây như cam bergamot, táo, quả sung và lý chua đen.

Theo mình thì lớp hương đầu của Pulp rất mạnh và rất “juicy”. Nó giống như mùi của một rổ trái cây chín mọng vừa được cắt ra. Mùi hương này ngọt, đậm và có phần hơi hoang dại.

Điều thú vị là Pulp không phải kiểu trái cây tươi mát như cam chanh. Thay vào đó, nó giống trái cây chín rộ vào cuối mùa, khi hương thơm trở nên dày và đậm hơn.



![images.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/632e245df496346d083cbc301080b9bfdebaa98356d8f62e51b4bc834932feff)



**Hương giữa – mềm mại và cân bằng hơn**

Sau khoảng 30 phút, mùi hương bắt đầu chuyển sang tầng giữa với hoa Tiare và hoa nhài.

Hai nốt hương hoa này giúp cân bằng lại sự ngọt đậm của trái cây. Theo mình thì đây là lúc mùi hương trở nên mềm mại và tròn trịa hơn.

Hương hoa không quá nổi bật mà chỉ đóng vai trò làm dịu lại tổng thể mùi hương, giống như những cánh hoa trắng nhẹ nhàng hòa vào rổ trái cây chín.

**Hương cuối – ấm áp và quyến rũ**

Khi mùi hương dần khô lại, gỗ tuyết tùng, hoắc hương và vanilla bắt đầu xuất hiện.

Lúc này mùi trái cây vẫn còn nhưng đã trở nên nhẹ nhàng hơn. Vanilla mang lại một chút ngọt ấm, trong khi gỗ tuyết tùng giúp tổng thể mùi hương có chiều sâu hơn.

Theo mình thì lớp hương cuối của Pulp giống như dư vị ngọt ngào còn lại sau khi uống một ly cocktail trái cây, rất dễ chịu và hơi gợi cảm.

## Độ lưu hương và tỏa hương của  Byredo Pulp

Theo trải nghiệm của mình khi dùng Byredo Pulp:

Độ lưu hương: khoảng 6–8 giờ

Độ tỏa hương: trung bình đến khá

So với nhiều dòng nước hoa niche khác của Byredo, Pulp có độ tỏa hương tốt hơn. Khi mới xịt, mùi hương khá rõ ràng và dễ nhận ra.

Sau vài giờ, mùi hương sẽ trở nên mềm mại và gần da hơn.



![byredo_pulp_3-jpg-1618479692-150.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/833fc779f049d9dd7f2f536605a587c1f1eb901e2ac005c21a3e4cb40f5a748f)



## **Phong cách và đối tượng phù hợp với** Byredo Pulp

Theo mình, Byredo Pulp là mùi hương dành cho những người yêu thích sự khác biệt.

Đây không phải kiểu nước hoa trái cây nhẹ nhàng hay an toàn. Nó mang phong cách đậm đà, cá tính và rất nổi bật.

Pulp phù hợp với:

Những người yêu thích mùi hương trái cây mạnh mẽ

Người làm trong lĩnh vực sáng tạo hoặc nghệ thuật

Những ai muốn tạo dấu ấn riêng trong đám đông

Mùi hương này đặc biệt hợp với mùa xuân và mùa hè, khi không khí ấm áp giúp các nốt trái cây trở nên sống động hơn.

Theo mình, Pulp rất hợp để dùng khi đi chơi, gặp gỡ bạn bè hoặc tham dự những sự kiện mang tính sáng tạo.

## **Bảng đánh giá tổng quan về nước hoa Byredo Pulp**

Tiêu chí        Đánh giá

Mùi hương        8.8/10 – trái cây chín đậm đà, rất khác biệt

Thiết kế        8.5/10 – tối giản nhưng sang trọng

Độ lưu hương        8/10 – khá lâu

Độ tỏa hương        8/10 – dễ nhận ra

Giá trị thương hiệu        9/10 – thương hiệu niche nổi tiếng

Tổng thể        8.7/10

## Nước hoa Byredo Pulp có đáng mua không?

Theo mình, [Byredo Pulp](https://theperfumes.vn/byredo-pulp/) là một trong những mùi hương trái cây độc đáo nhất của Byredo.

Điểm mạnh lớn nhất của Pulp nằm ở sự khác biệt. Nó không giống những mùi nước hoa trái cây tươi mát thông thường, mà mang cảm giác trái cây chín mọng, ngọt đậm và rất sống động.

Nếu bạn thích những mùi hương cá tính và không ngại nổi bật, Pulp chắc chắn là một lựa chọn rất thú vị.

Byredo Pulp là một mùi hương trái cây rất táo bạo trong thế giới nước hoa niche. Nó giống như một bức tranh đầy màu sắc của những trái cây chín mọng – đậm đà, ngọt ngào và tràn đầy năng lượng.

title.title: The first DNA data storage system
title.body:
> When we began to explore the universe on microscopic scales, we discovered something curious, nature itself already has extremely efficient systems for storing and processing information, long before computers existed, life already did it, and now scientists are trying to use exactly that mechanism to store digital data.


The evolution of data storage always followed the same path, floppy disks became CDs, CDs became hard drives and today almost everything is stored in gigantic data centers spread across the planet, but some scientists believe that the future of information may lie within molecules. Researchers at the University of Missouri in the United States announced the creation of the first DNA data storage system that can be rerecorded, functioning in a similar way to a digital hard drive.


The idea may seem like something out of a movie, but the concept has existed since 1959, with physicist Richard Feynman suggesting that information could be stored on a molecular scale, the reason is simple, since DNA is one of the densest storage systems that exist in nature. While traditional computers use sequences of zeros and ones, DNA stores information with four chemical letters A, C, G and T, the bases that form the genetic code.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcWhG963YKk4mWydoSPi3AXkL3b3bM4d4tUsDH4DASfrU/image.png

> By converting digital data into these molecular sequences, researchers manage to store files within chains of synthetic DNA and the capacity is impressive. In theory, all the data produced by humanity could fit inside a single shoebox if it were stored in DNA. In addition, the material can remain stable for thousands of years in suitable conditions, consuming practically zero energy, unlike current data centers that require enormous amounts of electricity to keep servers running.


The big problem until now was that this type of storage was permanent, once the data was recorded in the DNA, there was no way to edit it or reuse the molecule, that made it a useful definitive file, only for long-term conservation, it was exactly that limitation that the new research tried to solve.


The team developed a method that allows information stored in DNA to be erased and overwritten, transforming this biological medium into something similar to a rewritable hard drive. To recover the data, the researchers use a molecular sensor called a nanopore. When the DNA strand passes through that microscopic detector, it generates small electrical variations that the software interprets, converting the chemical sequences back into zeros and ones and finally into the original digital file.


https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmWRyZTuDjPVTHoGDwhzxnvg89dQhwrXCAaoW2GWW7vrDT/image.png

> According to scientists, the goal now is to miniaturize the entire system. In the long term, they imagine a molecular storage device the size of a pen drive. If that happens, the impact could be enormous, because instead of huge data centers consuming energy and occupying entire buildings, perhaps in the future our digital memories can be stored inside something much smaller, a molecule.


These investigations show that innovation does not always emerge only from large laboratories or research centers, it often appears when someone needs to solve a very specific real-life problem.

title.title: A Garden Discovery: Spotting a Bracket Fungus
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWA12RrUDn99je4cZ6WHo38ieAZnivzL2vEdFZMsJ5AdJ/1773115671290.png)

‎Yesterday, while Aiden and I were outside playing at my parents' place, I noticed a collection of fungi growing on a decaying log.
‎
‎It's in my mom's garden, and partly hidden.
‎
‎I didn't notice it at first, but because of its shape and color, it stood out against the background.
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQzseJCCFDaWkLG2Sv1PW7Ly1493pytzqVirRZ3zkKvbc/1773115706751.jpg)

‎When I took a closer look, I noticed that it's quite different from the typical ones that grow on soil. 
‎
‎This one was flat and attached to the wood.
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPdepcvCT6jFsuLS6PFRTWLeGsZDphHtYdgkqMAKWid1k/1773115735709.jpg)

‎Its cap had a rusty-brown color, that blended well with the old bark around it.
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYQEToj2GiFJyVzauHUWSgTaznGgLWyWirwLgE53tTm2b/1773115755260.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPevDWK8as4PVBduevTMFhQC9aAAHBTKkvwGM4QbXgTVt/1773115755594.jpg)
‎
‎And when I touched it, the texture felt tough and leathery rather than soft or spongy.
‎
‎It has this firm structure, like it was well adapted to growing on wood.
‎
‎I also observe it from another angle.
‎
‎I looked at its underside and was surprised to find that it has these tiny pores and a sponge-like surface. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUvbKXvHhJSQm7WoF7DdoPFLZW86PaQ56Dr2GN5CyvYPd/1773115781452.jpg)

‎Seeing that detail made the mushroom even more fascinating to me, and it made me appreciate how unique this fungus can be.
‎
‎I also decided to check it on Google Lens, and the results said that it might be a type of bracket fungus, possibly a turkey tail. 
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNoxt8hykgGoSuihCLMqKfCzx3DgFdaqes1V5iqDQPiCB/1773115803465.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXJQbRZh6myT5rUau1P3SS5UqBCfd1rnP7AuP3gwbcF46/1773115803943.jpg)

‎It may not be a perfect identification, but it was still exciting to learn that this little mushroom I spotted in the garden could belong to such an interesting group of fungi. 🍄‍🟫
‎
‎This discovery became a learning moment for me.
‎
‎It may look like a rotting piece of wood, but it's a natural cycle where fungi help clean up and renew the environment. 
‎
‎Until my next nature appreciation...
‎
‎**Thanks for the visit! Have a lovely day. Buh-bye. 💗🌸**
‎
‎*All images used in this post are my own unless stated otherwise.*

title.body: />\n\n_Just a moment, please._ Okay, all good. Thought I heard my coaches from Mountain Workshops yelling _\
_ but it may have just been some weird bluetooth interference.\n\n

/> Anyways, these are some moments that caught my eye but didn't quite fit into the story being told at the time. Here a musician performing at the community market last summer comes over to include a little one in the performance.

/> _Just like old times._ Antonio Brown addresses a demonstration in Injustice Square Park protesting Renee Good's death while backlit by spotlights that LMPD put up in 2020 to shine on people protesting Breonna Taylor's death. _Here we go again._ Please pardon the grain, sometimes you just got to shoot at ISO 5000.

/> _Breewayy!!!_ Robbey Taylor gets the cast on his broken hand signed by an old comrade from the [Breewayy](https://www.courier-journal.com/story/news/local/breonna-taylor/2020/09/14/new-signs-around-downtown-louisville-form-breewayy-to-honor-breonna-taylor/5792893002/?gnt-cfr=1&gca-cat=p&gca-uir=true&gca-epti=z117624e1171xxv117624d--84--b--84--&gca-ft=178&gca-ds=sophi) days of 2020. _Maybe signed is the wrong word, it was all slogans from those days._

/>\n\n_Had to save my favorite for last._ State Senator Gerald Neal, who was my Kentucky History professor in college, enjoys a hearty laugh at the introduction for the man standing beside him, Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear. The governor has recently been doing a good imitation of a man preparing for a run for president, and Executive Director of the Fairness Campaign Chris Hartman was having a good time with that as he introduced him during the annual Fairness Rally at the Capitol in Frankfort.

title.title: Honor's first humanoid robot
title.body:
>the 2026 Mobile World Congress in Barcelona, ​​a company decided to attract attention in a very different way. Chinese manufacturer Honor took the stage and presented its first humanoid robot. And the demonstration was anything but discreet. The robot entered the stage along with human dancers and performed a complete choreography to the rhythm of Imagine Dragons.


During the presentation, the machine performed synchronized movements with the performers, including a perfect MoonWalk and the famous step immortalized by Michael Jackson, but the moment that really impressed the audience came at the end, the robot executed a completely controlled backflip, drawing applause from the audience before shaking the hand of Honor CEO James Lee.


Despite the impact of the presentation, company one disclosed technical details of the robot, nor information about price, availability, but the demonstration is part of a larger company plan. Honor revealed that it intends to expand its operations beyond smartphones and build a complete ecosystem of smart devices with built-in artificial intelligence.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_87_wBpXfJM
https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png

> This project is part of the so-called Alpha Plan, a strategy that combines three pillars, Alpha Phone, a new concept of device capable of physically interacting with the environment, Alpha Store, a platform where different smart devices will be able to connect, share information and research in new hardware technologies, including advanced batteries, new materials and robotics.


According to the company, the idea is to create what they call a carbon silicon civilization, a future where machines, devices and artificial intelligence work together as a single system. In short, Honor wants to take artificial intelligence beyond screens, transforming software into physical machines that interact with the real world.


If this vision really materializes, presentations like the one at the Mobile World Congress may be just the beginning, because robots that appear on stage today to impress the public could tomorrow be walking, working and living together in our daily lives.



https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcM9vDyChXWWfaBhnqxXD5scZn7pnHcZrWiwyZ8HMwmbX/separador%201.png


Sorry for my Ingles, it's not my main language. The images were taken from the sources used or were created with artificial intelligence

links.title: Nam và nữ tuổi Mão 1999 hợp xe màu gì theo phong thủy?
links.body:
Khi mua ô tô, nhiều người thường quan tâm đến yếu tố phong thủy để lựa chọn màu xe phù hợp với tuổi và bản mệnh. Theo quan niệm ngũ hành, màu xe hợp mệnh có thể giúp chủ xe cảm thấy yên tâm hơn khi sử dụng, đồng thời mang ý nghĩa thuận lợi và may mắn trong cuộc sống. Vậy [tuổi Mão 1999 hợp xe màu gì](https://geely.vn/tin-tuc/tuoi-mao-1999-hop-xe-mau-gi/) theo phong thủy? Hãy cùng tìm hiểu chi tiết dưới đây.



![1999-hop-xe-mau-gi.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/3610f7613d5e9ebc1b68774a4b78bef033a75af9701e89fd01a0819feaba3c56)



***

## **1. Tuổi Mão 1999 thuộc mệnh gì?**

Người sinh năm **1999 (Kỷ Mão)** có:

*   **Ngũ hành:** **Thành Đầu Thổ** (Đất trên thành)

*   **Mệnh:** **Thổ**

Do cùng năm sinh nên **nam và nữ tuổi Mão 1999** có cách chọn màu xe hợp phong thủy giống nhau.

***

## **2. Nguyên tắc chọn màu xe hợp phong thủy cho tuổi Mão 1999**

Theo quy luật ngũ hành:

*   **Hỏa sinh Thổ** → màu thuộc hành Hỏa mang ý nghĩa tương sinh

*   **Thổ hợp Thổ** → màu bản mệnh giúp tăng sự ổn định và cân bằng

Vì vậy, khi chọn xe, người tuổi Mão 1999 nên ưu tiên **màu tương sinh trước**, sau đó đến **màu hợp mệnh**.

***

## **3. Tuổi Mão 1999 hợp xe màu gì?**

### **3.1. Màu tương sinh (nên ưu tiên)**

Các màu thuộc hành Hỏa giúp hỗ trợ tốt cho người mệnh Thổ:

*   **Đỏ**

*   **Cam**

*   **Hồng**

*   **Tím**

Những màu này mang ý nghĩa năng lượng tích cực, tạo cảm giác tự tin và nổi bật khi sử dụng xe.

***

### **3.2. Màu hợp mệnh Thổ**

Các màu bản mệnh giúp tăng sự ổn định và hài hòa:

*   **Vàng**

*   **Nâu đất**

*   **Be**

*   **Vàng cát**

Đây cũng là những gam màu khá phổ biến và dễ lựa chọn khi mua xe.

***

### **3.3. Màu có thể cân nhắc**

Một số màu không xung khắc mạnh nên vẫn có thể sử dụng:

*   **Trắng**

*   **Bạc**

*   **Ghi xám**

Những màu này hiện khá phổ biến trên nhiều dòng xe hiện nay.

***

## **4. Tuổi Mão 1999 nên tránh xe màu gì?**

Theo phong thủy ngũ hành:

*   **Mộc khắc Thổ**

Vì vậy, người tuổi Mão 1999 nên hạn chế các màu thuộc hành Mộc như:

*   **Xanh lá cây**

*   **Xanh lục**

Ngoài ra, các màu thuộc hành Thủy như **đen hoặc xanh dương** cũng không được khuyến khích nếu xét theo phong thủy.

***

## **5. Gợi ý nhanh cho người tuổi Mão 1999**

✔ **Nên chọn:** Đỏ, cam, vàng, nâu đất

✔ **Hợp mệnh:** Be, vàng cát

✘ **Nên hạn chế:** Xanh lá, xanh dương

***

## **Kết luận**

Vậy **tuổi Mão 1999 hợp xe màu gì theo phong thủy?** Người sinh năm Kỷ Mão 1999 nên ưu tiên các màu **đỏ, cam, vàng hoặc nâu đất**. Những màu sắc này phù hợp với mệnh Thổ, giúp chủ xe cảm thấy an tâm và thuận lợi hơn khi sử dụng xe trong thời gian dài.

---

[Posted](https://waivio.com/@waivio_geelyvietnam/3wdxbw-nam-va-nu-tuoi-mao-1999-hop-xe-mau-gi-theo-phong-thuy) by Waivio guest: [@waivio_geelyvietnam](https://waivio.com/@waivio_geelyvietnam)
