links.title: Bad news for the neighborhood and Nadi gets adventurous
links.body:
You may recall that recently the vacant lot opposite my apartment building was being cleared and hit had me worries because this could mean that a large construction project was going to be creating noise pollution for a very long period of time. 


I was a bit hopeful that perhaps they were just clearing the land because it was overgrown with weeds and therefore harboring rats and other vermin.  It took a few days for this question to be answered but I went and took a closer look today and the prognosis is not good.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gooddream/23wqeLeFZNB1Wowzs2TdM6ph6oa3454hNApvS78XkhEE3PnNyYB6dx6jBxDjsyu2hxzWP.png)
</center>

While there is nothing going on right now it is not good to see these materials here.  I don't know a huge amount about construction but I now that these are some sort of rotary something or other that is meant to dig holes straight down.  They are in pieces because they are meant to go quite far down.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gooddream/23tveHsTKdcG4vrPDzijwKibQJYDRjJssyCH3SSoWDy5UGxqSDbi2ZWUuxfSupGATk9gy.png)
</center>

Another thing that is being stored on site is even more worrysome.  You have to look pretty close but there is an \

or cross-shaped tool there right next to the orange tarp.  This I have seen in action up close and personal-like and it is attached to a rebar machine in order to make squares that are inserted into cement columns for vertical support of the building.  The larger one of these things are, or I suppose the longer they are across, the taller the building is going to be.  That thing is about a meter across and that is the same size as the support beams in the building that I currently live in.  Our building is 11 stories tall so I think we can say that they have plans to make something of similar height.   

This is going to introduce a lot of bad things during the construction phase but once they are done it also means that what little remains of my view is going to be kaput and also whoever moves into that place on the higher floors is going to have a straight shot looking directly into my living room, which will be very strange.   

I guess we'll focus on the good since there is nothing I can do about it.  

<center>  
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gooddream/23tbq7D7fn6JmSNCRjEbWjgeFLT43rKRwX4casAv2oYmuf4A5dJmE3P5hFFXNvnvYv8AU.png)
</center>

Since this area has only recently been all mixed up and cleared, there were a lot of very interesting smells over there for Nadi.  She might not be so easy to spot since her coat is about the same color as the dirt.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gooddream/Eo24aAiDdy5EHSxNPLMonP6TBo8hrNnX2jPzbZH9cAT7ynfsGaLVqwwQaiinxLVMs6G.png)
</center>

She really enjoyed running around and sniffing everything and even climbed up that pile of dirt in the middle, which strangely made me kind of proud.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gooddream/23tSS2EWdXuuXwvn6j8pC8F5rRAs3etrHRA5ngrTsWSfcBmAY11WML14hBnyjVbXBfewd.png)
</center>

There's a wonderful shot of her butt as she climbs up to become Queen of the Hill.   Nadi can't see so well anymore, so any sort of doing anything like this is a slow moving process.   She also seems to be losing a bit of her hearing so she took her sweet time coming back to me even though I was calling her.  I don't think she was ignoring me, she just didn't know anyone was calling her.  I left her to it since I wasn't interested in getting my shoes all muddy.  

It's just a matter of time before this things gets into full swing and there's already a lot of chatter in the building about people moving away which I already know is probably mostly idle chatter.  I suppose if one good thing can come out of this it will be that once construction starts, the owner of the building I live in will abandon any potential ideas they might have about raising the rent because the rent has been going up a lot in my neighborhood lately and she knows she can charge more as well.   That changes quite a bit once there is 12 hours a day construction noise to contend with.

Nadi and I will take it is stride I suppose and just live most of our lives with the windows closed.  We'll get by.  She can barely hear anything anyway so it will only be bothering me.

links.title: 💜Bratz inspired necklace 💋 - Handmade💜 [ES/EN]
links.body: >Las Bratz marcaron una estética muy característica en los años 2000: colores vibrantes, accesorios llamativos y mucha personalidad. Con este collar quise capturar un poco de esa esencia dosmilera y llevarla a un diseño sencillo pero lleno de pequeños detalles. \n\n>

>Bratz dolls established a very distinctive aesthetic in the 2000s: vibrant colors, eye-catching accessories, and lots of personality. With this necklace, I wanted to capture a bit of that Y2K essence and translate it into a simple design full of small details.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmUcHCmhW6E57ns1Hw9ye87eFsXbkok4hhrC9Bt5sDP1nF/separador.png

>Para el collar elegí una combinación de morado y blanco. El morado, en especial, es un color muy asociado al universo de Bratz, ya que aparece con frecuencia en su logo y en muchos de sus diseños. Desde el inicio sabía que quería que ese color fuera uno de los protagonistas. \n\n>

>For the necklace, I chose a combination of purple and white. Purple, in particular, is a color strongly associated with the Bratz universe, as it frequently appears in their logo and many of their designs. From the beginning, I knew I wanted that color to be one of the main features.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmUmgVoDjx2UAjm9runCCgPqi1y7hDsgpd68ie3F5Z7KT2/img_20260210_145951_877.png

>Encontré también estas cuentas moradas que me parecieron perfectas. Este tipo de cuentas era muy popular en los años 2000, tanto en accesorios como en adornos para el cabello, así que encajaban muy bien con la estética que estaba buscando. \n\n>

>I also found these purple beads that I thought were perfect. This type of bead was very popular in the 2000s, both in accessories and hair ornaments, so they fit very well with the aesthetic I was going for.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmUcHCmhW6E57ns1Hw9ye87eFsXbkok4hhrC9Bt5sDP1nF/separador.png

>Uno de los elementos más importantes del collar es el dije de labios, ya que los labios son uno de los símbolos más representativos de las Bratz. \n
\n
>Para hacerlo utilicé masa flexible, lo moldeé a mano y luego lo pinté cuidadosamente. Finalmente le apliqué una capa de barniz para proteger la pintura y darle un acabado más brillante. \n\n>
>One ​​of the most important elements of the necklace is the lip charm, since lips are one of the most representative symbols of Bratz.\n\n>

>To make it, I used polymer clay, molded it by hand, and then carefully painted it. Finally, I applied a coat of varnish to protect the paint and give it a shinier finish.
https://steemitimages.com/800x550/https://images.ecency.com/DQmPrYRBhHmmsUCJYBbFqusdRf6csncs2u24vPzzUNsqoSA/img_20260210_151730_917.png

>Una vez listo el dije, comencé a armar el collar combinando los colores y distribuyendo cada elemento. \n
\n

>En uno de los lados añadí cuatro pequeñas estrellas que representan a las protagonistas principales: Cloe, Jade, Sasha y Yasmin. Cada estrella tiene el color más representativo de cada una de ellas, lo que añade un pequeño guiño para quienes conocen a las Bratz. \n\n>
>Once the pendant was finished, I started assembling the necklace, combining the colors and arranging each element.\n\n>

>On one side, I added four small stars representing the main characters: Cloe, Jade, Sasha, and Yasmin. Each star is in the color most representative of one of them, adding a little nod to those familiar with the Bratz.
https://steemitimages.com/800x550/https://images.ecency.com/DQmQp3mPXS8u1hrTXUzgrrmkTN1DFy3HZoRU8Jdh7fFrRWM/img_20260210_152831_658.png
>Personalmente, uno de los detalles que más me gustó del diseño fue justamente cómo las estrellas le dan un toque especial a uno de los lados del collar. \n\n

>Personally, one of the details I liked most about the design was precisely how the stars give a special touch to one side of the necklace.
https://steemitimages.com/800x550/https://images.ecency.com/DQmQCt3NM37C8wfszkzkhNLxrV46EqqiPzcPEmLm2fdfkmx/img_20260210_154311_257.png

>Para el toque final decidí añadir un pequeño detalle más. Compré una letra “B” de Bratz y un aro dorado para convertirla en un colgante. Coloqué el aro sobre la letra para recrear un detalle del logo original, donde la B suele tener una pequeña aureola encima. \n\n>
>For the finishing touch, I decided to add one more small detail. I bought a Bratz letter \

and a gold ring to turn it into a pendant. I placed the ring over the letter to recreate a detail from the original logo, where the B usually has a small halo above it.
https://steemitimages.com/800x550/https://images.ecency.com/DQmTSrApKJYD5xuisRztpmczNjnrXWZXjdAeqkdNvpau2Ds/img_20260210_155208_500.png
https://steemitimages.com/800x550/https://images.ecency.com/DQmebRJQWvtpqKL932DCiz1rzfB9dciiW9XtRYbnkTgPDVi/img_20260210_161012_799.png

>Después colgué este dije en el lado opuesto del collar, creando un pequeño equilibrio visual entre ambos lados del diseño. \n
\n
>El resultado final es un collar simple, pero con varios guiños a elementos icónicos de las Bratz, mezclando nostalgia dosmilera con un toque artesanal. \n\n>
>Then I hung this charm on the opposite side of the necklace, creating a subtle visual balance between both sides of the design.\n\n>

>The final result is a simple necklace, but with several nods to iconic Bratz elements, blending early 2000s nostalgia with a handcrafted touch.
https://steemitimages.com/800x550/https://images.ecency.com/DQmZZXVf6i6Yv5Q9agKgoshVG9Doig1vGLsdAJ2FdZkds5T/img_20260210_163512_442.png
https://steemitimages.com/800x550/https://images.ecency.com/DQmQepVxnt6Q9cdzJSoPwQ6QaifAEQrCuviWcB1n1wK68RJ/img_20260210_162019_105.png
>💜 Espero que les haya gustado este pequeño proyecto inspirado en Bratz. \n\n>
>💜 I hope you liked this little project inspired by Bratz.

links.body:
>
###### Hello, my dear friends. Welcome back to my kitchen! Today, lunch was quickly sorted at home! I used one of the tomato sauces from the “Ole” brand, which can be used not only for pasta but also to prepare other recipes with protein, such as these chicken thighs. When it comes to practicality in the kitchen, these sauces are my best allies.
#

>

<div class=pull-right>



###### Hola mis queridos amigos. Bienvenidos de nuevo a mi cocina ¡


¡Hoy el almuerzo se resolvió rápido en casa! usando unas de las salsas de tomate de la marca \

, que no sólo pueden usarse para pastas sino también para preparar otras recetas con alguna proteína, como por ejemplo estos muslos de pollo. Y es que cuando se busca practicidad en la cocina, estas salsas se convierten en mis mejores aliadas. ![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png) ###
Ingredients - Ingredientes
#####
2 servings - 2 porciones
![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png)

>



2 muslos de pollo sin piel 
1/2 Cebolla mediana
Una rama de cebollín 
3 dientes de ajo 
Salsa de tomate \
1 taza de agua Aceite vegetal Orégano- comino y sal al gusto

>


2 skinless chicken thighs
1/2 medium onion
A sprig of chives
3 cloves of garlic
Olé brand \

tomato sauce 1/2 cup water Vegetable oil Oregano, cumin, and salt to taste
![photo_5001467177311341458_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/EoAceEZRwxNokFNAqKxYPxDCYhY9guNnRdaWkdPFCu3CKqv8E5KN3xdb24LVh44ji13.jpg)
![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png) ###
Preparation | Preparación
![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png)

> Comencé condimentando el pollo con comino, sal y orégano. Luego, dejé reposar en la nevera un buen rato para que tomara sabor. #
I started by seasoning the chicken with cumin, salt, and oregano. Then, I let it rest in the refrigerator for a while so that it would absorb the flavor.
---
![photo_5001467177311341459_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/EoEr2WXtxwBCUp1umgC5rmdqhXixmNnYKZ6fcuYScxeB7Fzdkgk4Twvdy36BBfmR5uY.jpg)
![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png)

> Llevé los muslos de pollo a una sartén con un poquito de aceite, cuando se doraron, bajé el fuego y dejé cocinar unos minutos más. #
I placed the chicken thighs in a pan with a little oil. When they were browned, I lowered the heat and let them cook for a few more minutes.
---

> Mientras el pollo se doraba, fuí por los vegetales: corté media cebolla en julianas, piqué el cebollín y machaqué los ajos. En la misma sartén donde sellé los muslos y con la misma grasa, sofreí los vegetales hasta que la cebolla estuvo transparente, para luego añadir la taza de agua, removiendo con una paleta para integrar todos los sabores que quedan adheridos al sartén.

> While the chicken was browning, I prepared the vegetables: I julienned half an onion, chopped the scallions, and crushed the garlic. In the same pan where I seared the thighs, using the same fat, I sautéed the vegetables until the onion was translucent, then added the cup of water, stirring with a spatula to incorporate all the flavors that had stuck to the pan. --- |![photo_5001467177311341467_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23xVGvabvCDXLFdCNMu4qpwn41XV8yFcvR3WsksoRgQEqmW5pMx5giry1QT3QGmx54N98.jpg)|![photo_5005773762493877133_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23wMcMACafx2XF635ZpYZr729unzQsoQYQgQ5KThc9cV4eEMKbrXb2WFtNtiGnJ8UoUZm.jpg)|![photo_5005773762493877134_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23wCDwGfZ33PhMT65ooGby3AyMRAZNqaNRYuXpYeCENHzCocWtZ5AJAjHwCxSZcC34tTT.jpg)| |-|-|-| ![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png)
>\n\nEs momento de echar la salsa de tomate \

; para estos dos muslos usé sólo la mitad del empaque de 340 gramos, La otra mitad la guardé para aprovecharla en otra receta. Así que mezclé y regresé los muslos al sartén. Tapé y dejé cocinar a fuego bajo por 30 minutos.
It's time to add the “Finas Hierbas” tomato sauce. For these two thighs, I used only half of the 340-gram package. I saved the other half to use in another recipe. So, I mixed it in and returned the thighs to the pan. I covered it and let it cook on low heat for 30 minutes.
---
![photo_5005773762493877157_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/EowJZ9K1dU8HZBrLczp2KA84cNxuxoYWXNBwQby9FhHh5wB9bvNVCG27wbNEV4fGpVd.jpg) ![photo_5005773762493877178_y(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/EoGxsi3gbVD8sNo7maKHmp8jcs3HCuhrgtFn8dj1oni5JLLBdsMABNLdqZa34sANtsF.jpg)
![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png)

> Siempre estuve vigilando el pollo para que se cociera bien, removiendo de vez en cuando con la salsa. Añadí solo una pizca de sal y deje que la salsa espesara. Para terminar decoré con cebollín picadito.
In a pot, I added a tablespoon of butter and sautéed the garlic, onion, and green onion. (I also added a little bit of the bacon grease.) Then I added the chicken broth and potatoes. I let it cook until the potatoes softened.
![photo_5005773762493877179_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/Eoc8uyUwJX7S9iEeYh46Y3aX4dMsbmHWXEfJYbq2eunJT7ZyVQFSXfUDmrugXPgpSAb.jpg) ![photo_5005773762493877184_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/EoK6mCWKyqM4rNsoJ6CWDXTgEGn7yjrEDePciMkTebx68nHdkk8mqWa3HRBDovdwHCk.jpg)
![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png)
>\n\nSolo quedó servir y acompañar con unas \
para mezclar con la salsa y así compartir un rico almuerzo con mi hijo.

>
<div class=pull-left>

All that was left to do was serve it and add some \

to mix with the sauce, and then I could share a delicious lunch with my son. ---
![photo_5003521962680191887_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23xyZSXWsXRhnvi8sBtbws9KGE4vJeUV5Vsog2uPJo3rRacaC2nT2sfbzPUBCV9bajnqZ.jpg) --- ![photo_5005773762493877186_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/EonmYeXRLrYT78u9jApviE7mHYqU8SKwTCMZjn1conUqGyjrjviGHsdtD7dQPMggwDA.jpg)
![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png)
See you in another recipe, thanks for reading. And tell me, have you tried these sauces? What's your favorite flavor? ❤️

> Nos vemos en otra receta, gracias por leerme ¿Y cuentáme han probado estas salsas? Cuál es tu sabor favorito? ❤️ ![Separador rojo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mergusa88/23swdzZ4rsUhGPBtdPqLiDR363DG8CUpA2fhKxeHhosBi3QXqvDzjwsVzMZ657cfNaW6x.png)

links.title: Social Selling Strategies That Drive B2B Leads in 2025
links.body:
In 2025, [B2B marketing](https://intentamplify.com/lead-generation-services/https:/technologyaiinsights.com/ai-revolutionaries-transformative-trends-reshaping-businesses-in-2026/) is no longer driven solely by cold outreach, email campaigns, or paid advertisements. Decision-makers now spend significant time researching solutions on professional social platforms before ever speaking to a salesperson. This shift has made social selling one of the most effective strategies for generating high-quality B2B leads. Companies that leverage social networks strategically are building trust earlier in the buyer journey and converting prospects more efficiently.

Why Social Selling Matters More Than Ever

Modern B2B buyers prefer self-directed research. Before engaging with vendors, they explore industry discussions, read thought leadership content, and evaluate brands based on their digital presence. Social platforms enable companies to participate in these conversations and position themselves as trusted advisors rather than aggressive sellers.

Social selling helps businesses build relationships with potential buyers through meaningful interactions, relevant content, and consistent engagement. Instead of pushing products immediately, successful organizations focus on providing insights that solve real problems for their audience. This approach nurtures trust and naturally generates inbound leads.

Optimize Professional Profiles for Credibility

A strong social presence begins with well-optimized professional profiles. Buyers often evaluate individuals before they consider the company behind them. Sales professionals and company leaders should ensure their profiles clearly communicate expertise, industry knowledge, and value.

Effective profiles include a professional headline, a compelling summary, and a clear explanation of how they help clients solve challenges. Sharing achievements, case studies, and customer outcomes strengthens credibility. When prospects view a profile that reflects authority and authenticity, they are far more likely to initiate conversations or respond to outreach.

Share Insight-Driven Content

Content remains the backbone of social selling. In 2025, generic promotional posts rarely capture attention. Instead, decision-makers engage with educational and [insight-driven content](https://intentamplify.com/solutions/by-function/sales/) that helps them understand trends, solve problems, or improve performance.

Organizations should focus on publishing content such as industry insights, data-backed reports, expert opinions, and practical tips. Short thought-leadership posts, informative videos, and carousel posts explaining complex topics often perform well on professional networks.

Consistency is key. Posting valuable content regularly helps build authority and keeps a brand visible within the target audience’s feed. Over time, prospects begin to associate the brand with expertise, making them more receptive to conversations about solutions.

Use Social Listening to Identify Opportunities

One of the most powerful aspects of social selling is the ability to monitor conversations happening across networks. Social listening tools allow businesses to track keywords, industry topics, and relevant discussions.

By observing these conversations, sales teams can identify prospects expressing challenges or looking for recommendations. Instead of pitching immediately, they can join discussions with helpful insights or resources. This approach feels natural and supportive rather than promotional.

Social listening also helps companies understand emerging trends, competitor activity, and customer sentiment, enabling more relevant engagement with potential buyers.

Build Relationships Through Genuine Engagement

Successful social selling focuses on relationships first and sales later. Engaging with prospects by commenting on their posts, sharing their insights, or congratulating them on professional milestones builds familiarity and trust.

Meaningful engagement demonstrates that a company values the relationship beyond a simple transaction. When sales professionals consistently contribute thoughtful comments and insights, they become recognizable figures within their industry community.

Over time, these interactions create opportunities for private conversations, meetings, and eventually business partnerships.

Leverage Employee Advocacy

Employees can significantly amplify a company’s reach on social platforms. When team members actively share insights, comment on industry discussions, and promote company content, the brand gains credibility and visibility across multiple networks.

Encouraging employees to participate in social selling does not mean forcing them to promote products constantly. Instead, companies should empower their teams to share expertise, personal perspectives, and valuable knowledge related to their roles.

Employee advocacy humanizes the brand and allows potential clients to connect with real professionals rather than a faceless organization.

Combine Social Selling with Data and CRM

In 2025, successful B2B teams integrate social selling activities with CRM systems and analytics tools. Tracking engagement, lead interactions, and content performance provides valuable insights into which strategies generate the most qualified leads.

Sales teams can identify warm prospects based on social interactions, prioritize high-interest leads, and personalize outreach accordingly. This data-driven approach ensures social selling efforts translate into measurable business outcomes.

Conclusion

Social selling has evolved from a supplementary tactic into a core B2B lead generation strategy. Businesses that focus on authentic engagement, insightful content, and relationship building are gaining a competitive advantage in today’s digital marketplace.

By optimizing professional profiles, sharing valuable insights, leveraging employee advocacy, and using data to refine their approach, companies can turn social platforms into powerful engines for B2B growth in 2025 and beyond.

Read More: <https://intentamplify.com/blog/social-selling-for-b2b-lead-generation-strategies-that-work-in-2025/>

---

links.title: A PICTURE IS WORTH A THOUSAND WORDS: The chickens determination and resilience.
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTqW39fAkhZ3w8kDrLHpRiqVagkbUgP9zGVSFnFMM2RoZ/1773114061649.jpg)











[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/chicken-smoke-chickens-10007444/)





***Here's my candid take on this image***
**What I see**
Three chickens stand calmly in a snowy winter scene.The star is a plump white hen right in front, her feathers speckled with black like delicate ink dots. Her bright red comb and wattles pop vividly against the pure white snow. Slightly behind her to the left is a warm reddish-brown chicken gazing ahead, while a darker, striped brown hen stands close on the right. They’re all grounded on thick snow with soft, blurred bare branches in the background, giving the whole photo a peaceful yet rugged farmyard vibe.The contrast between their soft, fluffy feathers and the cold, crisp landscape is striking.


**What I feel**
This image fills me with a mix of amusement and quiet respect. These birds look so unflappable and cozy in the freezing cold, feathers puffed up like they’re casually shrugging off winter,no drama, just pure chill. 

It makes me smile, but it also stirs real admiration for everyday resilience. Here in Warri, Nigeria on March 10, 2026, we’re at the tail end of the hot dry season with heat rising and no snow in sight, so this scene feels almost surreal and inspiring.Life doesn’t pause for discomfort,sometimes strength is just staying warm and steady.The old saying really hits,one picture sparks a thousand feelings.

Thank you for reading my post. Yours truly,@zusi78 signing off.

links.title: 每天的微訓練
links.body: >Unsplash 前陣子提到我腰酸背痛的事，雖說沒有痛到想去看醫生，但的確也是坐立難安，後來決定作一些棒式，加上彈力繩伸展，其實兩項動作都花不了多少時間，前後加起來可能5分鐘左右而已。 做了一陣子後感覺有點效果，肚子在平常會比較常無意識的內縮用力，比本來預想的有用，之前提到就是腰椎過度彎曲，可能是少了腹部出力支撐，所以現在也許多了一份支撐力量。 棒式要做得久，對我這種沒在運動的人是比較困難的，我也很怕自己做了一陣子都在做錯的動作，所以有多參考別人的經驗，但其實也還是很難確定自己有沒有做錯的地方。 自己歸納的重點應該就是，腹部必須出力，腰部不能下塌，雙腳要打直不能彎曲，這樣做個10-20秒，其實就會開始微微發抖，做個1分鐘差不多就到了我的極限，但也別為了貪做得久，變成用腰去受力，那樣的確能撐比較久，卻沒達到訓練的目的。 腰痛最近有感到改善，稍微有點感覺的時候，就提醒自己腹部出點力，也不要過度正坐，上半身盡量放鬆別刻意挺胸，算是有解決了坐立難安的困境，如果沒有做棒式，可能會沒辦法讓身體想起腹部出力的動作要怎麼使用，所以在做的時候也盡量去記憶出力的方式。 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@azazqwe/3g88ox)

links.title: Beer Saturday - Golfus Mortis Carbonus
links.body:
![beersaturday8 (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/23wCE1eVfLLmgzAavTV7sAg1Bz3w2nGvysmVhB2msvDhFoitfsnUjdr1Qd5QmmX7Xa3DT.png)
A little late for #beersaturday week 453 so I have created a new title image for your enjoyment. It is never really too late to join the party and the gang at https://peakd.com/hive-187719/@detlev/beersaturday-453 will welcome your post about beer. In this 453nd edition, I am enjoying a golf pint, sampling a collab and popping into the brewery.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
https://images.hive.blog/DQmPax7RZo64uXdeV5w5Nsb7uyNvDQZpbuca4r8qR15updR/potw.jpg
![IMG_8259.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/Eoke4ZWz6iwDS2UQX9xAhM6meiqfgDzcvHTsptcMaLShzuFEUfGpyiUdLMaJeQ49KvX.JPG)
Everyone here can probably agree that pints are great. I think they are even better when enjoyed at a pub or gathering spot with others. Hence, the pint of the week. This week, we are back at the best indoor golf joint in town, [Fore Everyone Golf](www.foreeveryonegolf.ca). The pints in the foreground are a new Amber ale they have just brought in and the background is the brew master who happens to love Amber. Golf pints are among the best.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
# Great Lakes Brewery!
![IMG_8213 (1).JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/EogG6JbWMVSdBXvoRJKqUkQCJLLk8whhyHhdyVyVcDW4g33kdemWifX2SfmdsWyrD4F.JPG)
I had the chance to hit the big city to play in a couple hockey games so I dropped by my favourite brewery [Great Lakes Brewing](www.greatlakesbeer.com) to raid their bottle shop.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
![IMG_8214 (1).JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/23wC3Qb1Zt3ei52apzP4VgRfB8htDn6TSXN6s7eJT9C2jXj4CXCjcS28q1gR1EUqf4ASt.JPG)
There are quite a few seasonal or limited run batches that don't make it out to our stores a couple hours down the road. Not sure if [Lacus Mortis West Coast IPA](https://untappd.com/b/great-lakes-brewery-lacus-mortis-glb-x-third-moon/4629708) is on our shelves but you can't get it any fresher than right from the brewery.
![IMG_8215.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/23wqbpcM8bjV91jpUTcWtiLoDhj7M5HbmSnjM5BUNR96RtwriE6mBL6i5Sw9wYXrFzyz7.JPG)
It is neat to find a West Coast IPA on the shelves when the sweet hazy East Coast IPAs are all the rage. Even more special when it is a collab brew with another solid brewery [Third Moon Brewing](thirdmoonbrewing.com) Some notes of GLB as you would expect using their equipment and many of the same ingredients. Love the distinct difference in hops character and enhanced bitterness that brought me back to the days before NEIPA. ![blockchainbeerologist2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/AJefXiLr5PKbQgdY7t1163StXa3mxegjD9XE5cBjrYzAWS6ysC9SjpNd3eeoeXS.png) Solid effort and wonderful collab beer gets the vaunted seal of approval.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
# Back in the Brewery
![IMG_8226 (1).JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/23xAVXYCF8sGazJJa1GgPejtoth1bo88M5fQLw8HBvniLGpktdiFFMh7N27TNs4GSqMKb.JPG)
Last week, people seemed to get a kick out of seeing our drill-powered grain grinder in our garage brewery. So, I present our new carbonation system. We used to carbonate our beer by pumping 35PSI of CO2 into the keg, shake the shit out of it, and wait a day or so for it to settle down. IN an effort to have a little more controlled brightness to the beer, we have started using this quick carb system. 35 pounds of CO2 through a stone with beer cycled to and from the keg for 45 minutes and BAM! Ready to drink. This is our amber darker in the one tube and lighter as it is getting fizzed up in the other. Once you get it all tightened up and RTFM, it seems to work pretty well and the extra aeration might activate more flavour in the beer.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
# #BEERSaturday!
![623472420_1481301094005307_5838137751585630119_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/23ydT7wSDqSPK4BvueCBRjev85qLSHYMhNdZLM395jUYFPdjyNgrwgkeFqWv71PbxqrDR.jpg)
This is the type of prayer I could get behind. Now it is time for you to join me, @detlev , and these other beerologists because there is always room for more beer bloggers at the Beer Saturday gathering... https://peakd.com/hive-187719/@detlev/beersaturday-453 Cheers to beers no matter what the season!

八筒被送到乡下，转眼已是半个月。

起初，我们都笃定这是它的幸福新生活开始，同学的妈妈时常发来视频，画面里的八筒在乡间肆意溜达，撒欢奔跑的模样，让我们所有人都松了口气——原以为，这便是为它寻到的最好归宿。

可世事总难尽如人意，平静的日子没过多久，问题就来了。养斗牛犬的麻烦，就是它的皮肤本就娇气，稍不注意便容易出问题，再加上前些年长期被关在笼子里，免疫力低下。到了乡下，彻底释放了天性，整日在柴火堆干草堆里打滚，这下惨了，它的腿上冒出了许多红点，疑似皮肤病。同学的妈妈十分担心，三番两次发来照片询问。起初，我们只让她帮忙擦拭碘伏，可症状丝毫没有减轻，我又嘱咐阿姨带它去镇上的畜牧站检查，结果确诊为皮肤病，需要擦药和服药。

更令人揪心的是，医生透露了一个可怕的消息：这种皮肤病可能会传染给免疫力低下的人。这可急坏了同学的妈妈，她连忙打电话给我同学，希望能尽快处理。我完全理解她的顾虑，毕竟是老人家，身体抵抗力弱，容不得半点风险。

于是，工作间隙，我安排司机专门将八筒送到了宠物医院。带着它做完镜检后，医生给出了明确诊断，就是由真菌和细菌混合感染引发的皮肤病，且确实存在传染给免疫力低下人群的可能。

那一刻，满心的忧虑涌上心头：八筒今后该何去何从？若再送回农村放养，极有可能再次诱发皮肤病，可若不送回朋友家，它又能在哪里？

眼下容不得过多纠结未来的安置难题，当务之急是先治好它的病。这家宠物医院的年轻医生检查完毕后，便为八筒办理了住院。住院费每天50元，药浴另算，单单是镜检和初期开药，就花了300多元。初步估算，这次治疗大概需要近千元。

本想让八筒在乡下拥有一个自由自在的快乐老家，未曾想竟引发了这样一场风波。不仅要自掏腰包为它治病，未来的安置问题还毫无头绪。此刻，我真是后悔死养狗这件事情！

links.body: # Milanesa de pollo cuatro quesos, ensalada cesar, tostones y plátanos dulces [ESP/ENG]\n\n<div class=\

>

Hola amigos de la comunidad de @hivefood, espero que hayan pasado un día genial. Yo por acá me encuentro  bien gracias a Dios por los momentos vividos el día de hoy cuando el señor me ha regalado un ño mas de vida. Les invito a visitar mi blog.

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23z7LDZbfHaf2YpymEDYXf1TPmnx9Wfstx2Ajt6L1fLyr4vypyjYsHjDS2YAF9AXkQQb1.jpg)

Hoy fue mi cumpleaños, el cual lo disfrute al máximo. Mi hija y mi esposo desde hace unos días a tras estaban buscando un restaurante que fuese bonito, que prepararan comida deliciosa y que a su vez no fuese tan costoso para ir a almorzar en mi cumpleaños que fue el día de hoy. Visitamos un sitio llamado garaje chilen, el cual me encanto .

![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tbnxKztXQzG98q4sP2NFKQwK395Z7NE2dkWgrpQwQmNA3cfBXX21b1mxi1vtkyLE6PF.jpg)

Llegamos a las 12 del medio día, nos atendieron muy bien, nos acomodamos, de inmediato nos trajeron la carta para ordenar nuestro pedido. cada uno hizo su pedido; en mi caso ordene una milanesa cuatro queso, acompañado con ensalada cesar, tostones inflados y platanitos dulces, el cual estaba super delicioso tanto el pollo como los contornos.

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23x1B2YwVF8Kf2pvuSRHL9BnVo9pS16isi8DxzxQqYyP8cLXusAaf4ZuvZ1QkUP7XA6eP.jpg)

Es un restaurante que me dejo abismada por la cantidad de comida que sirven, es bastante, su sabor demasiado rico, la milanesa  cuatro queso estaba brutal, la ensalada cesar deliciosa, los tostones inflados crujientes y jugosos a la vez y los platanitos dulces super ricos, con una textura increible, venían bañados con una salsa dulce acompañada de miel, se pueden imaginar lo rico que estaban. 

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xAa7AUzeHhc2A3rVNXJpPJ79WaB1H9t22qf6hpJT9MgArFmU9AAy5jmN1F88V7c4nd2.jpg)
 
Mi experiencia que tuve el día de hoy en el almuerzo, al visitar junto a mi familia este restaurante fue increíble, este sitio es la primera vez que lo visito, siempre había pasado por el frente pero no sabia que preparaban comida tan rica y que estuviese al alcance de la gran mayoría de las personas jamás me imagine que era costoso. No siendo así, los platos asilan entre 8, 9, 10 y 13 dólares, me parece super económicos por la cantidad que sirven y calidad, mejor imposible, sin dejar a tras que todo los platos vienen con su bebida incluida, nos ofrecieron jugo de durazno y mora, en mi caso ordene el de mora y estaba muy rico y espeso. este sitio lo recomiendo en un 100%.

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uQtWHBgzgFd3bv1tygU8ZyBFfv1ivGCAFb38HHBs6YeoeaisiwwFb8VgahpmrYESBxm.jpg)

la comida que pidió mi familia al igual que la mía super deliciosa, así que los invito a que lo visiten y no se arrepentirá. Esta ubicado en un buen sitio de la ciudad, al este muy cerca del Sambil, como sus paredes son de vidrio desde adentro se observan algunos edificios cercanos a la zona, la decoración de las mesas muy linda, masque todo las paredes están diseñadas con tubos de hierro pintados en negro. toda la decoración es en negro y blanco con grama artificial.

![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/241tUkx591SGzSyuxWqMvs7rk1td1NPNE6pMMFuWJRu3bFSeM1MfKjq5GXkApCta8Hpfp.jpg)

![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xyUofcawXhBnX5QmZ8mYZfH3y1712uopM5Stcs6nvcgUV3KFaAgwTWpCkpR9JFukdwa.jpg)

La atención en todo los sentidos excelente. Es un sitio pequeño pero muy acogedor, sin embargo cuenta con 3 espacios, el área de terraza, el área central que cuenta con aire al igual que el área del segundo piso, de verdad me gustaria volver muy pronto, me encanto..

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EogNn7DWMQJaeGbKAevwAjMur3v5fMMkVhpn9rDjSMERqkmPYwBd72NGNgqHWR9nGwQ.jpg)

![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23x1BXacx1RAzYhAAm3Tg7TxCJKb29PXjvid5obtncxr4s91aae1XkKdtnKVcmG9Fi1ZX.jpg)

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23w2o81dKunTjnSuURbhiSaiwmEQdxAjEnYz5qSBg5aTpyQRUo7cRmC6MBQ9AYrrb23QD.jpg)

Buenos mi queridos amigos  me despido de ustedes, les dejo algunas fotografías para que puedan conocer el sitio, nos seguimos leyendo y escribiendo por este medio, chao…chao…chao… hasta una nueva oportunidad, esperando que mi contenido haya sido de su agrado.

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus
* Portada diseñada con Canva

<div class=\
> # English Version # Four-cheese chicken cutlet, Caesar salad, plantain chips, and sweet plantains.

> Hello friends of the @hivefood community, I hope you've had a great day. I'm doing well here, thank God for the moments I've experienced today, when the Lord has given me another year of life. I invite you to visit my blog. ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23z7LDZbfHaf2YpymEDYXf1TPmnx9Wfstx2Ajt6L1fLyr4vypyjYsHjDS2YAF9AXkQQb1.jpg) Today was my birthday, which I enjoyed to the fullest. A few days ago, my daughter and husband were looking for a nice restaurant that served delicious food and wasn't too expensive for lunch on my birthday, which was today. We visited a place called Garaje Chilen, which I loved. ![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tbnxKztXQzG98q4sP2NFKQwK395Z7NE2dkWgrpQwQmNA3cfBXX21b1mxi1vtkyLE6PF.jpg) We arrived at noon, were treated very well, got comfortable, and were immediately brought the menu to order. We each placed our orders; in my case, I ordered a four-cheese milanesa, accompanied by a Caesar salad, tostones inflados, and sweet plantains, which was super delicious, both the chicken and the sides. ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23x1B2YwVF8Kf2pvuSRHL9BnVo9pS16isi8DxzxQqYyP8cLXusAaf4ZuvZ1QkUP7XA6eP.jpg) This restaurant left me amazed by the amount of food they serve. It's quite a lot, and it tastes so good. The four-cheese milanesa was incredible, the Caesar salad was delicious, the tostones were crispy and juicy at the same time, and the sweet plantains were super tasty, with an incredible texture. They were covered in a sweet sauce accompanied by honey. You can imagine how delicious they were. ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xAa7AUzeHhc2A3rVNXJpPJ79WaB1H9t22qf6hpJT9MgArFmU9AAy5jmN1F88V7c4nd2.jpg) My experience today at lunch, visiting this restaurant with my family, was incredible. It was my first time here. I had always walked past it, but I didn't know they served such delicious food that was affordable for most people. I never imagined it would be expensive. That's not the case. The dishes cost between $8, $9, $10, and $13, which I think is super affordable for the quantity and quality they serve. It couldn't be better, not to mention that all dishes come with a drink included. They offered us peach and blackberry juice. I ordered the blackberry juice, and it was very tasty and thick. I recommend this place 100%. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uQtWHBgzgFd3bv1tygU8ZyBFfv1ivGCAFb38HHBs6YeoeaisiwwFb8VgahpmrYESBxm.jpg) The food my family ordered, as well as mine, was super delicious, so I invite you to visit and you won't regret it. It is located in a good part of the city, to the east, very close to Sambil. Since its walls are made of glass, you can see some of the buildings nearby from inside. The tables are very nicely decorated, but most of the walls are designed with black-painted iron pipes. The entire decor is black and white with artificial grass. ![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/241tUkx591SGzSyuxWqMvs7rk1td1NPNE6pMMFuWJRu3bFSeM1MfKjq5GXkApCta8Hpfp.jpg) ![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xyUofcawXhBnX5QmZ8mYZfH3y1712uopM5Stcs6nvcgUV3KFaAgwTWpCkpR9JFukdwa.jpg) The service was excellent in every way. It's a small but very cozy place, yet it has three areas: the terrace, the central area with air conditioning, and the second floor. I would really like to come back soon. I loved it. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EogNn7DWMQJaeGbKAevwAjMur3v5fMMkVhpn9rDjSMERqkmPYwBd72NGNgqHWR9nGwQ.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23x1BXacx1RAzYhAAm3Tg7TxCJKb29PXjvid5obtncxr4s91aae1XkKdtnKVcmG9Fi1ZX.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23w2o81dKunTjnSuURbhiSaiwmEQdxAjEnYz5qSBg5aTpyQRUo7cRmC6MBQ9AYrrb23QD.jpg) Well, my dear friends, I bid you farewell. I'm leaving you some photos so you can get to know the place. We'll continue reading and writing to each other through this medium. Bye...bye...bye...until next time. I hope you enjoyed my content. * Photos taken with iPhone 8 Plus * Cover designed with Canva * Text translated with Deepl Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@morepina/milanesa-de-pollo-cuatro-quesos-ensalada-cesar-tostones-y-pltanos-dulces-espeng-7xv)

links.title: Betty (Es.En)
links.body: ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcX7WHee6HM4Lh6BuweKXwYnEH4qgWCuBbz7Xkevvrgcc/poster_2026_03_09_043030.png)\n\nBetty camina por la ciudad como quien atraviesa un cementerio de almas encendidas con pilas usadas. A su edad, ya no cree en promesas ni en miradas que dicen \

entre un *like* y un *selfie*. Para ella, la generación actual es un eco sin origen: cuerpos despiertos, pero mentes dormidas. Chicos que se iluminan con la luz azul de las pantallas, pero que se apagan al contacto real. No son malos, piensa; solo están perdidos, como ella, pero sin darse cuenta.

Mañana no se presentará en la academia. Le concedieron unos días de licencia para reflexionar en casa. Sus abuelos soñaban con una carrera militar para ella y accedió a complacerlos. No le temía al peligro ni al rigor disciplinario que le exigen. Es una buena cadete y se conforma con pocos estímulos para alcanzar su meta.  

No tiene amigas. Las que tuvo se evaporaron en dramas de redes, en celos por seguidores, en amores de fin de semana que terminan con un bloqueo. Tampoco tiene novios. Los hombres que conoce juegan a ser rebeldes, pero su rebeldía es prestada: copian estilos, frases, actitudes de personajes que nunca vivieron. Se creen libres, pero están atados a la aprobación de extraños. Hablan de libertad, pero temen a la soledad. Hablan de amor, pero confunden pasión con posesión, intimidad con exposición.

Betty los ve pasar: adolescentes con relojes caros y corazones baratos, bebiendo energéticos para no dormirse de aburrimiento, bailando en fiestas sin música real, gritando sin decir nada. Son fantasmas con auriculares, buscando sentido en tendencias que mueren al día siguiente. Y los adultos… peor aún. Padres que se comportan como hijos, que regalan celulares en lugar de abrazos, que llenan el vacío con viajes, ropa, fiestas. Familias híbridas, como dice ella, donde nadie sabe quién es el jefe, quién es el amigo, quién es el adulto.

Todo es apariencia. Todo es fugaz. Los valores se negocian como criptomonedas: suben y bajan según el mercado del momento. El respeto, la paciencia, la lealtad… palabras anticuadas, como discos de vinilo en un mundo de *streaming*. Y ella, Betty, se siente como un anacronismo: una chica que aún espera una carta escrita a mano, un beso sin grabar, un silencio compartido sin miedo.

Betty no conoce el odio. Solo observa. Y en su mirada hay tristeza, no condescendencia. Porque también ella lucha contra el vacío. También ella, a veces, prende su propia luz falsa, solo para no sentirse tan fuera de lugar. Pero en las noches largas, cuando apaga el mundo, susurra al espejo: “No estoy muerta. Aún no.” Y eso, por ahora, es suficiente.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWhdjCeC962Y2hgjxPQGKzM2fufNkjUX6q2FKJHD4RHxR/diapositiva1_20_4_.jpg)

Texto y fotos de mi autoría \

Traducción por Hello Translate 

ENGLISH VERSION

Betty walks through the city like someone walking through a cemetery of souls lit with used batteries. At his age, he no longer believes in promises or looks that say \

between a *like* and a *selfie*. For her, the current generation is an echo without origin: awake bodies, but sleeping minds. Boys who light up with the blue light of screens, but turn off upon real contact. They are not bad, he thinks; They are just lost, like her, but without realizing it. 

He won't show up at the academy tomorrow. He was granted a few days' leave to reflect at home. Her grandparents dreamed of a military career for her and she agreed to please them. He was not afraid of danger or the disciplinary rigor required of him. She is a good cadet and settles for little encouragement to achieve her goal. 

He doesn't have friends. The ones he had evaporated in network dramas, in jealousy over followers, in weekend loves that end with a blockade. She doesn't have boyfriends either. The men he meets play at being rebels, but their rebellion is borrowed: they copy styles, phrases, attitudes of characters who never lived. They believe they are free, but they are tied to the approval of strangers. They talk about freedom, but fear loneliness. They talk about love, but they confuse passion with possession, intimacy with exposure. 

Betty watches them go by: teenagers with expensive watches and cheap hearts, drinking energy to avoid falling asleep from boredom, dancing at parties without real music, shouting without saying anything. They are ghosts with headphones, searching for meaning in trends that die the next day. And adults... even worse. Parents who behave like children, who give cell phones instead of hugs, who fill the void with trips, clothes, parties. Hybrid families, as she says, where no one knows who is the boss, who is the friend, who is the adult. 

It's all appearance. Everything is fleeting. Securities are traded like cryptocurrencies: they rise and fall depending on the current market. Respect, patience, loyalty… old-fashioned words, like vinyl records in a *streaming* world. And she, Betty, feels like an anachronism: a girl still waiting for a handwritten letter, an unrecorded kiss, a silence shared without fear. 

Betty doesn't know hate. Just watch. And in his eyes there is sadness, not condescension. Because she also fights against emptiness. She, too, sometimes turns on her own false light, just to not feel so out of place. But on long nights, when she turns off the world, she whispers to the mirror: \
And that, for now, is enough.\n\nText and photos of my authorship \

links.title: Splinterlands Leaderboards
links.body:
<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQoZ9twcyMuevQAEUz5Zzb8fcjU6qjdenwgtDsyHNU7tt/image.png)
</center>

Players that are ranked in particular leaderboard for specific competitions can be found in game.  There currently are a bunch happening and the most common one is rank leaderboard.  Picture of main post is an example of Foundation leaderboard.  There is also the modern, wild and survival leaderboards.  In terms of most seen these by far is up there as it is front of rank battles per each competition.  Top 100 are listed and top 50 or 100 at end of season earn additional rewards. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPSjVxyUvgYMKYyDGuD9oj3iM3CW7mLevVXt2DdcwM4Xb/image.png)

What would be the second most common type of leaderboard seen is the Guild leaderboard.  Since the beginning of brawls where guilds are ranked based on their overall performance.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU5uFAQQ5cb8dcyWPop4RuVeFKDA4jFa6THM3rEpKtqJd/image.png)

Somewhat hidden in game is the leaderboard for referrals.  Players who can bring in new players are listed in this leaderboard.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmST7guswFMbFDFzu76UiwTfpuDYgnnSFP4HxChQFvhMR9/image.png)

Then most recent in a few seasons ago is the SPS burn leaderboard.  In this list are the players who burn the most SPS with the most earning the most Glint.  Top 200 earns some Glint.

It is ideal to see more and more leaderboards and additional rank standings to see how one has progressed in the game.  As more leaderboards are formulated there will be more opportunities for players to shine in many ways beyond what is currently possible.

Until next time thanks for reading!!!

links.title: Getting fired!  Jobs I have screwed up in the past
links.body:
I was doing a quick scan of my posts a little while ago and came to the self-realization that I kind of present myself as a super wonderful person that always does the right thing in all situations.   In that way I am kind of like the life coaches that I have been making fun of recently and I'd like to come clean, I suppose you could say.  

I have done ok in life overall and believe that I am a moral and good person that has mostly made the correct decisions in life but let's not muddy the waters:  we have all screwed up at one point in our lives or another.   

While I am a great employee for the most part that is very reliable and honorable and now expect the same of the 2 dozen or so people that now employ, I wasn't always that way and I would like to look back on a couple of jobs that I lost, and deserved to lose, when I was quite a lot younger.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzebubba/23x1B36W6KxJY5GNqY2BLNDk733yyxRMhv3tbReWQUsPqCxA7uujjkeVqVMP3BEtwi4Jw.png)
[src](https://www.shutterstock.com/image-illustration/comic-illustrated-boss-yelling-youre-260nw-236277664.jpg)</center>

I went to school for construction management and would have liked to have worked in that same sort of job while attending college but almost all construction takes place during the same times that I would need to be in class and they don't generally take on part-timers.  I know for my own company, unless I am doing a friend a favor with one of their kids, I don't take on part-timers because it is usually more of a hindrance than a benefit and therefore almost all contractors don't do it.  

When I was in college I had a number of jobs that were mostly at restaurants and like most of the teenage or early 20's people that worked there, I didn't much care for the job.  They don't give the good jobs to people that age and you get paid as little as they can legally pay you most of the time.  

We would get a schedule normally just a few days before the start of the next week and unless there was a conflict with a college class schedule you didn't really get a choice on which shifts you wanted.   Well, some days the schedule would be something that you really didn't want to do and on one of those days I decided that I would just not go in, then not answer the phone at my house, then pretend as though I made a mistake and turn up for my next shift like nothing happened.   

This was a dick move on my part and screwed over my coworkers and friends and even though it was probably a minor thing in the grand scheme of life, it is something that I still think about today many years later.

Well, my master plan obviously didn't work and when I turned up for my next shift with my nicely clean work uniform 10 minutes before I was supposed to be there, thinking my BS was going to work, I was greeted by the assistant manager at the door.  

He had a kind of devious grin on his face and had a prepared statement:  he said \

I tried to give my BS excuse and think I even pulled of a level of genuine to it but it didn't matter.   Looking back it was foolish of me to even try that and later on I would run into that assistant manager at something social and apologized to him.  It was a terrible thing for me to do and even though mobile phones didn't exist at the time, answering machines and roommates did exist so it was really dumb of me to think that I would be able to come in a *full day later* thinking that my excuse of not knowing would actually work.  They DID call me, multiple times.   

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzebubba/23w2HcLxargyqGmY91AFCQkQQx4fVcLQnV7r7JVbSU3sxtnS1FJEU91oCkcXQGs9ZvWDc.png)
[src](https://media.tenor.com/Xuv3IEoH1a4AAAAe/youre-fired-donald-trump.png)</center>

My second firing was a bit worse because it involved something illegal that could have gotten the restaurant into serious trouble had someone that didn't work there discovered it.  

I was working as a busboy which is just someone that clears up tables after the customers had left at a relatively fancy restaurant.  Think about one step above Applebees or Outback Steakhouse... that level of fancy.  

We didn't have a great deal of responsibility and mostly just needed to not break things as much as possible.  The place treated us very well and we actually got paid pretty great too.  During the week they had a \

and all drinks were 50% off and this was really popular.  I enjoyed going to this as well but there was just one problem:  I was not yet of legal drinking age.  I rolled the dice and just told the staff that I was of legal drinking age.  Since they worked with me they never questioned it.   

I don't know exactly how it happened, but word got over to the management that I was hanging out at this event (multiple times mind you) and while the regular staff members might not know my age, the management was legally required to for my tax purposes.   I was immediately let go and not by wandering in either - it was done via very angry phone call.  

Let me tell you what can happen to a place that is serving booze to people underage in the United States:  It's really bad.   They will face enormous fines and in bad situations where the selling looks deliberate they can lose their liquor license.  This would mean that they would not be able to sell alcohol at all for a probationary period of time and since most of the profit from all restaurants comes from alcohol sales, this would probably ruin the business.   

They were very justified in firing me and once again, I would later see the manager that fired me at a party where booze was being served and I was STILL underage, and apologized to him.  He accepted my apology but not before giving me a great deal of a talkin' to and letting me know how fucking stupid it was for me to do that.   

<hr>

Maybe call it the ignorance of youth or the belief that the rules don't apply to you but I suppose I am just very lucky that this all happened before the digital age and lower level jobs didn't normally check references because it was too time consuming.   With today's tech, I think it would have been very difficult for me to get employed anywhere after these two screwups, especially the one that is highly illegal.   

There are more instances, just a few more thankfully, but these are probably the two worst ones.  Thankfully my work ethic got a lot better as I got older and it is pretty stellar these days.  I just wanted to point out my flaws instead of only talking about my successes.

links.title: 「生活」阅读写作直播课
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![P5926hv2BK0YlYFF_IMG_5356.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/P5926hv2BK0YlYFF_IMG_5356/P5926hv2BK0YlYFF_IMG_5356.webp)
![rHrwPO2jYFBzfCI3_IMG_5354.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/rHrwPO2jYFBzfCI3_IMG_5354/rHrwPO2jYFBzfCI3_IMG_5354.webp)
![jZy3izj9WfLewqsm_IMG_5353.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/jZy3izj9WfLewqsm_IMG_5353/jZy3izj9WfLewqsm_IMG_5353.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

从小学一年级开始，学校就要求孩子完成看图写话，后来逐步要求写简短的作文，但Sheya在写作方面一直是薄弱项，这也是她语文方面为数不多的短板。在背诵课文、拼音、写字认字等学习内容上，她的表现都很不错，唯独写作能力差了些。
 
其实这也不难理解，她的数学思维本来就不够好，而写作与思维能力、观察能力密不可分，自然也就成了她的弱项。

最近在朋友的推荐下，我了解到一个专门针对小学阶段，培养孩子阅读写作能力的教育品牌——少年得到，是由著名媒体人张泉灵老师创办的。
 
之前刷抖音也看到过这个推荐，二十几块钱买了试听课后，又添加了客服老师的微信后，被拉进了家长群，每节课时长约一小时。当时我内心满怀期待，真心希望这些课程能帮助Sheya提升阅读和写作能力。
 
从上周六到昨天，每天晚上18:55，我们都会守在学习机前，进入直播间等待上课。客观地说，Sheya非常喜欢这个课程，上课过程中她认真又投入，每次听说要上课都格外开心，还主动嚷嚷着要报名正式课程。
 
孩子和家长的视角当然不同，体验课上老师用了吸引小朋友的授课方式，让孩子感受到了寓教于乐的乐趣，自然会想要继续参与。

而从家长的角度来看：一小时的体验课，大部分时间是孩子听课、互动、回答问题。最后一小部分时间是面向家长讲解，内容大多是灌输品牌教育理念、宣传自身优势，同时也会提及同类型品牌套路化、模板化教育方式的危害。
 
除了直播间里的推销，客服老师还会在微信上频繁发消息。有一天我忙着上课没看手机，客服老师竟发来十几条消息，内容全是提醒我参与课程、尽快购买正式课，看得我直晕…
 
我们没有体验过它家的正式课程，因此没有资格评判其教学质量，但这种过度营销的方式，实在让人有些反感。

现在我陷入了纠结之中，一方面Sheya很喜欢课程，她倒是被直播间的老师打动了，另一方面我又不喜欢这种浓烈的推销氛围。倒不是单纯因为推销就否定课程，而是觉得过度的营销，反而给教学品质打了个问号。

---

links.title: Todos los caminos llevan al Pesto | #FoodieMood | Esp-Eng
links.body:
![1000490877.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23u5vMvKp8Sn8WJnTBsxZgd6WJCqLhfQcabo9tYG5Aa5UpGKJTkKQWnUnpSLWzeUcgU8T.jpg)
Cada vez que tengo la oportunidad hago pesto; es una salsa que aporta un profundo sabor. No la preparo con tanta frecuencia como me gustaría, pues ocupa ingredientes costosos aquí en Venezuela, como es el caso del aceite de oliva, el queso madurado y los frutos secos. El ingrediente más económico es la albahaca, pero de igual forma se puede alterar el presupuesto, ya que se necesita una buena cantidad de ella. >Whenever I have the opportunity, I make pesto; it's a sauce that adds a deep flavor. I don't make it as often as I'd like, because it requires ingredients that are expensive here in Venezuela, such as olive oil, aged cheese, and nuts. The cheapest ingredient is basil, but even that can break the budget, since you need a good amount of it. ![1000490871.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23vrpqUWA4CBs19CY98bm8rpQwF8xpFY3Mc7XEcwhTT5NwagcKQigV3uncPQWznD2httV.jpg) Para mí todos los caminos llevan al pesto, y en esta ocasión lo preparé de forma un tanto diferente, ya que por primera vez hice el blanqueado de la albahaca. Para llevar a cabo este paso, coloqué las hojas de albahaca en agua hirviendo por treinta segundos y, pasado este tiempo, las coloqué en agua con hielo. Leí en internet que de esta manera el pesto queda con un color más intenso, más verde. > For me, all roads lead to pesto, and this time I prepared it a little differently, as I blanched the basil for the first time. >To do this, I placed the basil leaves in boiling water for thirty seconds and then put them in ice water. I read online that this makes the pesto a more intense, greener color. ![1000493930.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23vsUmSX4fYa4fnxkLdJKUp3o6ZRbPhSnD2zq2eukiYEggo6yvfGwfttDJrDFzUkQ7ghn.jpg) En cuanto a los frutos secos que utilicé en esta oportunidad, fue una mezcla de nueces y almendras. > As for the nuts I used this time, it was a mixture of walnuts and almonds. ![1000490896.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23uQtWMfrsXEcu9E3ek6S3sy3P5o2gYNF6ocBmVe3fjD8d2kgsd2Xkw5KJ3NnMkgvCM26.jpg) En cuanto al queso madurado, compré, por vez primera, un trozo de queso parmesano. Suelo comprarlo rallado, pero la verdad que el sabor que aporta el parmesano recién rallado es especial. A este pesto le aportó un sabor extraordinario. >As for mature cheese, I bought a piece of Parmesan cheese for the first time. I usually buy it grated, but the truth is that freshly grated Parmesan has a special flavor. It gave this pesto an extraordinary taste. ![1000490899.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23vhsZaS3YRQuCM9Ju2XJRFqeZxvi16vJoqZGtZtTkQPy3gpvqtPvs9RPSWLYqVQfvBSS.jpg) Añadir un toque de pesto a la crema de auyama hace que los sabores se intensifiquen; cada bocado será único y especial. Pequeños detalles que elevan los sabores de cualquier platillo. >Adding a touch of pesto to pumpkin soup intensifies the flavors; each bite will be unique and special. Small details that elevate the flavors of any dish. ![1000490904.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/242YCMgQXk7uqSNUQRWZVSTsZrWXX4uYKXgQdp3Xi8zN4Smj4g1wvo8kA6qXLUWwbhWw9.jpg) ***En mis planes está hacer una focaccia y acompañarla con este rico pesto.*** > ***I plan to make focaccia and serve it with this delicious pesto.***
**¡Espero que te guste esta receta, cocina fácil y con sabor**!
**I hope you like it!**

links.body: > Last weekend I helped my uncle with some work. We needed to do maintenance on an air conditioner, but for that, we needed to find a place near water, so we went to the garden. To my surprise, it was full of large plants, and one in particular stood out: a very rare-looking hog plum. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXLD6FFSW3cp5WL3MY6i8FWcqxxTfCngjKj8NHt3XmBg1/1773114090746.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb9aJVkJD1yytqbFJdcG2Kn1EDj4F1cwGixj66E8TzyCS/1773114091422.jpg) That fruit is delicious, but unfortunately, there weren't any to enjoy. Although you can eat them green, since they were so tall, I left them as they were, perhaps waiting for another opportunity. A curious detail is that despite the constant water, the plant was drying out from the top down. Perhaps it's due to some pest or disease damaging it in such a peculiar way. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTnqysDNGjxSe66pq7LZKRugMhm7L47Vw5xyeLX79kSBf/1773114129262.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUfH2cAfchsPSWAhRKat6394JsKCdDq32C4ERRqMSaVo1/1773114129806.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYz3dk4hJzzQoatQQDxHBpAsSWSi1HZ8EwjqxFqP2krMf/1773114130343.jpg) In those photos, you can also see other plants, including lemon and orange trees in the background of the garden. I even wanted to go over and take some closer shots, but I felt it would be disrespectful since I didn't have the homeowners' permission, so I decided to stay where I was to avoid any problems. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSkfgbYW5erJ7T1LeLzim1bDLRdB2pXA3Rm6Mau4Pzg9w/1773114172101.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQJmBZqoLik86aeRasrt8jzjt4CTFPxRTZ9aDxTwbFSGE/1773114172774.jpg) On the other side were some avocado plants, which, like the hog plum, were also drying out from the top down. I think it's some kind of disease damaging them like that. It's always a pleasure to share with all our friends here in the #hivegarden community, where we show amazing photos of what nature offers us, and it's great to find plants that are quite uncommon, like the hog plum. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUJdkdTDr1hKMFcbh2QanvsC38Mc3bCmMKLS1qS3EHWcn/1773114209618.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPz6Yu2hfzS29Mq2UHMbyxGRcY7wPsigCspWHVD8cP9Vq/1773114210252.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYZDamrkmvrTnTc4kfQWExx9MthWUqGitrNfi9ar9XYwS/1773114210874.jpg)

Hello everyone have a nice day to you all.. hope everyone is okay despite of what is happening in this world today.. yesterday, heavy rain dropped from morning to afternoon.. i was worried about my daughter because she needs to cross from our island to the city just to go to school.. the wind is strong and the waves are getting bigger because of the bad weather.. but luckily, the rain stopped late in the afternoon.. my nervousness disappeared because the weather is getting manageable.. to relax myself i get my camera and go to the garden to capture the raindrops..

links.title: Book Study: The Alchemist (Another Lesson)
links.body:
![102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/EoKAfnpof1T7qqrydveWvzAeL54gKKg3zSetvM29Y5fsqsAeCurGQ6oiaCiW2fcGH9R.jpg)
Hi there, Welcome to another book study from me, where I talk about a quote from a book and my interpretation of its meaning. In this post, I will be talking about a popular quote from the book *The Alchemist* which says: ***“And, when you want something, all the universe conspires in helping you to achieve it.”*** I cannot hold it back anymore, but I have to admit that the quote sounds like something that you find in a book of magic, like The Chronicles of Narnia or Harry Potter. How exactly do you start to explain to an individual that the universe is willing to work for you when you need something? When did the universe become a human being that gives out helping hands? Anyways there is always something to be learned, no matter how small it may be. Well, when you read the book and discover that it is a novel based on the adventurous journey of Santiago, who is on a quest to obtain the treasure he saw in his dream. More like somebody I know, and that is Monkey D. Luffy from One Piece. It is understandable to grab hold of the quote when you come to realize that Santiago from the book *The Alchemist* encountered multiple setbacks on his quest. Still, at every turn, he found more reasons to keep going and used them as signs from the universe to keep going. It is more like you have to be delusional towards setbacks and keep going. Now I see that the quote talks more about staying committed to the course through your persistence. It is not only enough to have a dream, but it is also about how much action you are willing to take to achieve such a dream. It has become clear to me why, in business, it is more about the execution and not just the idea or dream. Anybody can have an idea or dream, but not everybody has the zeal to chase it through their execution. It is more about taking the step towards the dream you have, and the quote makes it better when it says the universe will conspire to help you. Now, here is what I am getting from this: the universe is willing to work, but only for an individual who is in the midst of their action towards achieving what they want. It even went further to say it is because the person is taking actions that is why they are going to receive help. With time, they begin to mingle with people who share in their dream, and they are taking actionable steps. So a committed person will find reasons to keep going and not stop despite the setbacks. The beauty of books is that it does not matter if it is a work of fiction or non-fiction; there is always something one can learn from it. It's all about being open to accepting the information that lies within the book. This book, ***The Alchemist***, is a novel by Paulo Coelho, written originally in Portuguese and later went on to be an international bestseller. The book was published in 1988, and the knowledge within the book is still valuable in the present world. These are kind of things that strengthen my love for books not matter what. So do not give up just because of the setbacks; take them as a sign from the universe to keep going.
___ ![samosti 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23t7DhyLBcxoXuUmgwLnZvioQ3v5QnMB9qFkMvfhpceXCucVBy9yV435N3hgNLQdeLYpm.png)

I am @samostically, a chess player and writer. I love to share the experience I have gained from different battles over the 64 squares and the knowledgeable insights from books I have read. But most importantly, [I am a Midnight Owl and I founded the community Midnight Letters.](https://peakd.com/c/hive-186424/about) ♟♟♟♟♟♟♟♟♟ ![samosti 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23t7DhyLBcxoXuUmgwLnZvioQ3v5QnMB9qFkMvfhpceXCucVBy9yV435N3hgNLQdeLYpm.png)

![IMG_20260309_231814.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwarlyn11/23xydoDJfwKQfrJjJ91n44RorM7RZFQEn1Ef8N9dgBwjwRVzZoS1BWJ9at23oA2jiQbZ4.jpg)



https://i.postimg.cc/JnSGFwyJ/111544972.png


Hola amigos de Hive❤️

Les doy la bienvenida a mi blog y feliz día para todos!

En esta oportunidad me encuentro uniéndome a esta linda comunidad para compartirles mi participación en este interesante tema. La atención, algo que muchas veces hacemos pero no con la debida importancia, porque muchas veces por no prestarle la debida atención a las pequeñas o simples cosas de la vida o la dejamos pasar o perder, y con esto me refiero a oportunidades que nunca se volverán a presentar. 

Recuerda mucho cuando de pequeña siempre nos enseñaban a prestar atención pero qué tanto le hacemos caso a ello?, no es fácil lo sé, el camino hay muchas situaciones que nos distraen de nuestro enfoque, de nuestro objetivo, y ahí cuando debemos recordar y nunca olvidar nuestro objetivo principal no perderlo de vista para poder cumplirlos.

>Hello, friends of Hive❤️

>Welcome to my blog, and happy day to everyone!

>On this occasion, I am joining this wonderful community to share my thoughts on this interesting topic. Attention is something we often give without realizing its importance, because we often fail to pay attention to the small or simple things in life, or we let them pass us by or slip away, and by this I mean opportunities that will never come around again. 

>I remember when we were little, we were always taught to pay attention, but how much do we actually do so? I know it's not easy. There are many situations that distract us from our focus, from our goal, and that's when we must remember and never forget our main objective, so we don't lose sight of it and can achieve it.



![IMG_20260309_231929.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwarlyn11/245mwHvQwkxJFCKbLbX4Q4CkgNPEvhdrxLbpvqZAdDpHFhJaqRxt8KqrwSVMBobdngzB7.jpg)

![IMG_20260309_231706.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/edwarlyn11/2449r5bUX1WmjF1nHVzN1wSQFiLMY3J4KewDPpbZDVKDTBZB311V44gWbxWhJVDKnq5Tp.jpg)

Basándome en circunstancias o viéndolo desde un punto de vista más general Yo podría decir que personalmente tiendo a prestarle más atención a las cosas simples de la vida, aunque desde pequeña siempre me he fijado mucho en los detalles ser perfeccionista estar atenta ante cualquier mínimo cambio porque me gusta que las cosas salgan tal y como yo las tengo planeadas, y eso para mí es una buena cualidad el hecho de fijarse mucho en aquello que quieres y no perder la esencia aquello por lo que luchaste y deseas con mucha fuerza cumplir. 

Por eso mi recomendación es esa y para uso personal también lo aplicaría, no deberíamos de valorar aquello tan bonito que la vida nos presenta por más simple y pequeño que sea, aquello que creamos insignificante, quizás prestándole el valor y la atención suficiente encontraríamos algo muy especial y significativo, aquellas cosas como la familia tener cerca a nuestros seres queridos una simple reunión una pequeña charla una tarde disfrutando una taza de café, o el hecho de usar de salud, si le prestamos atención podemos descubrir que tenemos toda una vida por delante a la que todavía podemos disfrutar y sacarle mucho jugo para aprender y cosechar experiencias y aprendizajes que quizás sin la debida atención la dejemos pasar.

Espero les haya gustado y pronto compartirles más contenido como éste...🤗, con esto me despido y nos vemos en una próxima oportunidad! ✨♥️

>Based on circumstances or looking at it from a more general point of view, I could say that I personally tend to pay more attention to the simple things in life, although since I was little I have always noticed details, been a perfectionist, and been attentive to any slight change because I like things to turn out exactly as I have planned them, and for me, that is a good quality: paying close attention to what you want and not losing sight of the essence of what you fought for and desire so strongly to achieve. 

>That is why my recommendation is that, and I would also apply it to my personal life: we should not take for granted the beautiful things that life presents us, no matter how simple and small they may be, the things we consider insignificant. perhaps by giving them enough value and attention, we would find something very special and meaningful, things like family, having our loved ones close by, a simple gathering, a little chat, an afternoon enjoying a cup of coffee, or the fact of being healthy. If we pay attention, we can discover that we have a whole life ahead of us that we can still enjoy and get a lot out of, learning and harvesting experiences and lessons that we might otherwise let pass us by without paying proper attention.

>I hope you liked it, and I look forward to sharing more content like this with you soon...🤗. With that, I bid you farewell and hope to see you again soon! ✨♥️

links.title: Crochet Bag Charm
links.body: > Are you a crochet beginner? Do you love crocheting? Are you looking for your next crochet project? Search no further because you’re in the right place😃 Today, I made a lovely bag charm. It was crafted with so much love and precision. This is a beginner-friendly project and can be done in a few minutes.
> This bag charm was easy to make and was made with a few materials. Bag charms are lovely pieces, they beautify our bags and are very light to move around with.
> To make this lovely bag charm, I used the following materials and followed the steps below. **Materials** Yarn Crochet hook Scissors

> **Terminologies** CH— Chain SL— Slip Stitch SC— Single Crochet DC— Double Crochet HDC— Half Double Crochet Tr— Triple Crochet **Procedure** **Step 1:** Start with a magic circle. Proceed to make 2ch, 3tr, 4dc and 1tr in the circle.
> **Step 2:** Make a tr, 4dc, 3tr, ch2 and slip stitch. Repeat step 1 but in the reverse order. End the round by slip stitching into the center of the circle.
> **Step 3:** Begin round two with 2sc, 2hdc in the same stitch, 3dc, and 2hdc. Complete the row by putting 1hdc each in the next 4 stitches.

> To get your center stitch, proceed to put hdc, dc, and hdc in the same stitch. Go ahead and put hdc in the next 4 stitches, 2hdc, 3dc, 2hdc, sc, sc, and wrap it up by slip stitching into the center of your circle, cut your yarn afterward. **Step 4:** To join the two hearts together, slip stitch into both hearts and chain one.
> Add your stuffings, close the remaining part, and make a chain of 35 for the hanger and tada! Your bag charm is ready!!

> Do you love my bag charm and would you love to make something like this? I’d love to read your thoughts in the comments. All images are mine except otherwise stated. **Thanks for stopping by** **Loads of Love🥰🥰** **XOXO**

links.title: A pleasant visit to Matanzas/Una agradable visita a Matanzas.  (English/Español)
links.body:
Hello Hivers.  
I hope everyone is well enjoying the publications of this magnificent community.  
Here I come today to show you mine.


At the beginning of this year I had the pleasant opportunity to visit Matanzas with other colleagues as part of the culmination of an event in which we had the pleasure of participating.

I particularly felt very motivated, because despite having visited that Cuban province on multiple occasions, it was the first time they visited the San Severino Castle, an old fortress built in colonial times to defend the city from attacks by privateers and pirates, as were others at the time, such as Castillo del Morro, La Cabaña, etc., in the city of Havana.
Currently the San Severino Castle is the Museum dedicated to the people who were enslaved in Cuba. 
From our arrival we were able to observe beautiful landscapes and the architecture of the place.






![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/245wKQsbwY2NCdoLfUBMgmz6aVWBgzAEWsm2SUGrMbJE8fooLnUSAi5ZShVKcaXYrvECi.jpg)







![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/2449wo9rqhPQC8CbsKkTC6aKF78KMLthx689uQXivkknDo5RcHQkj73bFwFtsMkfdLcHX.jpg)






![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23xyXRUubFrry6eDWRLNTzyXpaok2MPXJR235HJsHpNQXxVv3M49YfNt1ExUeNuxKuUrt.jpg)






![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23xedJMEznNGcPsiBDzvx4DP729t5JxGPnuFYsR96xab25oozxPrrk9KqWSzgeRAxCj1r.jpg)


This visit included other places in the Province that I was also visiting for the first time. 




![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23uQjuzHYozH9e6K47sguCjmp6ikgmSg5kjFAZaCa1WLWjZALLrssHihRkHAqG8pv6ChK.jpg)






![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23zkiKq6vCoZQLhKxxsXwhYvRXA4WFVccqNfjAnQ3VY3VcQaGFP5hT6TzFfY1koBSEDWX.jpg)



We were in Museums, in The Church of Monserrate and we went up to its viewpoint and we saw the beauty of the Yumury Valley.





![2 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/245cWQLxcmfHmSVo2sALLPqa5ZDXREWfdGe6FYcBGvyRHd7JWDQ6sd34pMNpwceHtqrys.jpg)

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23tGXrZCnEKoG149j6Mo6QcnyfMP2DxQBZQaC7gwWscRHLGABAzN2JhMqqg7MLTRyZsfK.jpg)

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23xAMESoXQuef4cuQeHDxbMcduFind26nbGML21G7NoCnzqZoEexDds8cZCfkAAapGmBN.jpg)




We shared experiences with musicians from the Casa de Alfredo Calvo and with the Afroatenas Community Project and of course we walked and photographed its streets.




![1 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lulyhive/23wMf8evXQDydJhCyKBLUWNXSquqnEsbvpwK2aLBeG2qBSweYwB6qwD63HtwQR4Mn6HK7.jpg)

This publication will be complemented by the next one, where I will show you the visit to the Callejón de las Tradiciones, one of the Community projects where there were many Cuban folklore dances.

For now I hope you enjoy this post and we will continue to see each other here. 
Good morning everyone and receive my cordial greetings.

Una agradable visita a Matanzas 
Hola Hivers.  
Espero todos estén bien disfrutando de las publicaciones de esta magnífica comunidad.  
Aquí vengo hoy a mostrarles la mía.
A inicio de este año tuve la agradable oportunidad de realizar una visita a Matanzas con otros colegas como parte de la culminación de un evento en el que tuvimos la dicha de participar. 
Yo particularmente me sentí muy motivada, porque a pesar de haber visitado esa provincia cubana en múltiples ocasiones,  era la primera vez que visitaban el Castillo de San Severino, antigua fortaleza hechas en la época colonial para defender la ciudad de ataques de corsarios y piratas, como lo fueron en su momento otras como el Castillo del Morro, La Cabaña etc, en La ciudad de La Habana. 

Actualmente el Castillo de San Severino es el Museo dedicado  a las personas que fueron esclavizados en Cuba. Desde nuestra llegada pudimos observar bellos paisajes  y la arquitectura del lugar.


Esta visita incluyó otros lugares de la Provincia y que yo visitaban, también,  por primera vez. 

Estuvimos en Museos,  en La Iglesia de Monserrate y subimos a su mirador y vimos la belleza del Valle de Yumury.


Compartimos experiencias  con músicos de la Casa de Alfredo Calvo y con el Proyecto Comunitario Afroatenas y por supuesto caminamos y fotográfiamos sus calles.

Esta publicación se complementará con la próxima,  donde les mostraré la visita  al Callejón de las  Tradiciones uno de los proyectos Comunitario donde hubo muchos bailes del folklore cubano.
De momento espero que disfruten este post y nosotros seguiremos viéndonos por aquí. 
Buenos días para todos y reciban mis saludos cordiales .
