title.title: RECIPE: Lasagna with ground beef and zucchini (Eng-Esp)
title.body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wgUJS2dv9rQo3ikpU67tghp6CV6htwSd3zb3JW5kb3S6AAXp65iGuKZVcUSxhc6gZ5r.png)</center>

* Good evening, friends of hivefood. I wish you a happy start to the week... Next, I will explain how to prepare a “delicious lasagna with ground beef and zucchini.” I hope you enjoy the step-by-step instructions for this tasty recipe. I am sure it will become one of your favorite dishes. Let's get started!

>* Buenas noches amigos de hivefood, les deseo un feliz comienzo de semana... A continuación, les explicaré como preparar una \

de esta sabrosa receta, estoy segura que se convertirá en uno de sus platos predilectos, empecemos!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EpnFbjcyRfaC5onq1MzfUx8AwFSgQWYnPWWs8dWQrMk28WniJhAwmE2PobRA8rayZF8.png)</center>

* INGREDIENTS: ground beef, onion, garlic cloves, green pepper, zucchini, fried tomato sauce, tomato paste, pepper, oregano powder, cumin, white cheese (grated), milk (preferably whole milk), nutmeg, lasagna sheets, and corn kernels for garnish.

>* INGREDIENTES: carne molida, cebolla, dientes de ajo, pimiento verde, calabacín, tomate frito, pasta de tomate, pimienta, orégano en polvo, comino, queso blanco (rallado), leche (preferiblemente entera), nuez moscada, láminas de lasaña y granos de maíz para decorar.

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* We start by sautéing our ground beef, cooking it until it changes color... We add the onion, along with the garlic cloves. We sauté over medium heat for 15 minutes.

>* Empezamos sofriendo nuestra carne molida, cocinamos hasta que cambie de color... Incorporamos la cebolla, junto con los dientes de ajo. Sofreímos a fuego \

durante 15 minutos.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EouAe74MUBKBURH6jRiLkMXRMU4sj1ShBq8yu4FDqQTTqNAmTkxd2jqFUTwzc4yXdTb.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23uFZyzF3TF4JtiQv4kZ3JteMgac78cRPLnoTKeEcMTey5WfSTjdeZuAxQnzkCdvcq7Q9.png)</center>

* Add the zucchini, cut into small cubes... Add the bell pepper. Sauté until the vegetables have softened a little.

>* Agregamos el calabacín, cortamos en cubos \

... Integramos el pimiento. Salteamos hasta comprobar que las verduras se ablandaron un poco.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tvpyiRa4ptwKzy9kYdDXF5BPWG3vSXrRkvtB6LSHAJ86A2K48YFjijv99m56bS5D9ZJ.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/Eoc8Wk5TVYqFniXwBR54rYNB6V5j88JBwHzxfeCC8P87cyXzdVMBo2oSMDEydM1MQ3N.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EoErQmsMhPFg1jUqNcB5w7rLMnw6pw2wA6D6Ko979XYB7jQTmbBJH1FyyAhAQGNq33x.png)</center>

* Add the fried tomato sauce and tomato paste... Add 1/2 cup of water. Season with pepper, oregano powder, cumin, and salt.

>* Añadimos el tomate frito, junto con la pasta de tomate... Colocamos 1/2 taza de agua. En este paso condimentamos con: pimienta, orégano en polvo, comino y sal.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/Eoptt3y3czgv81pkhosLe48WWFGAzcP5xCvDpeJ1CPF4umJFxdYomVe23zyq6CVnxHZ.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xKxqsaaz1gvQXxt12AbfMAPGzwagdeBz5oL2wn56waiX2yoaDiVfyiAX2NodzdDhWFw.png)</center>

* Add the milk, preferably whole milk... this ingredient will give it a VERY tasty creaminess!

>* Incorporamos la leche, preferiblemente entera... este ingrediente aportará una cremosidad MUY sabrosa!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xL2edZzYV6BG6VUM2pF6bQAyMWxvrVfmcvoQKUFjNwzhzH4GwEFemDoSHt7VPnx7Zyw.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wqpoPzwSbTaajhtbcP17CGoEHtz43Ko8nZ1D5JqycbHyCPU7iax6sLNAbBhHbPgGBJU.png)</center>

* Grease the bottom of an ovenproof dish with a little butter... Add the lasagna sheets, spread the delicious ground beef on top, and sprinkle with grated white cheese.
Repeat the process until you finish with a layer of ground beef and enough cheese.

>* Untamos el fondo de un envase refractario con un toque de mantequilla... Añadimos las láminas de lasaña, colocamos nuestra apetitosa carne molida, colocamos queso blanco (rallado).
Repetimos el proceso hasta terminar con una capa de carne molida y suficiente queso.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xyZCbpAqQXKkZmhT3J8iN6JYe6MxeiBRPc5ocUxXG9RS4ZM7atw87sqiR1BbMxrUonM.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EogPDTGYnvun3pQbNs9qBQMv3JJrKuwjDbvLhJzN7wY4EnCRbiTBxVNv6DYqR8DoMPM.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tmWq7T92U9n1nHTfAkSs762v7n2M6mMz2Ao4S5vtjmrHdS3zLsC5edk1u3Yumn8vxkM.png)</center>

* Bake at 180°C for 45 minutes or until done... Decorate with corn kernels, and your delicious dish is ready to enjoy!

>* Horneamos a 180° durante 45 minutos o hasta comprobar que está listo... Decoramos con granos de maíz, nuestro apetitoso platillo está listo para disfrutar!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wgSSz5sJvaD6DpioP8eRyBhJT9fACpqxALPHpRrk9ynDC3P7NsZAq3q6wVGSdASTRcf.png)</center>

* Friends, here is a delicious option for a family lunch, a real treat!
Thank you very much for visiting my blog. Sweet dreams... See you in my next post. Hugs!

>* Amigos, a continuación les presento una exquisita opción para almorzar en familia, un auténtico manjar!
Muchas gracias por visitar mi blog, les deseo felices sueños... Nos vemos en una próxima publicación, un abrazo!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EpnFbjcyRfaC5onq1MzfUx8AwFSgQWYnPWWs8dWQrMk28WniJhAwmE2PobRA8rayZF8.png)</center>

title.title: [ESP-ING] Square Bolívar Santa Cruz
title.body:
![Blanco Minimalista Collage de Fotos Naturaleza Viajes Postal_20260309_193055_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23xAgHAQ2dcpfhmvBSjLT7PzsBYMZzr1RLSvakMhJLDPUcJpMHNjddDMx6veF8P3jyspN.png)





<a href=\

width=472 height=49 border=0>
[//]:# (!worldmappin 10.18004 lat -67.51149 long d3scr)

>



Esta vez visite la Plaza Bolívar de Santa Cruz de Aragua, una plaza bastante grande y con un espacio hermoso y abierto para todos niños, adultos, ancianos, jóvenes, está plaza fue fundada en 1910 ya tiene un siglo y se nota muy bien cuidada y limpia, eso me encanta de esta plaza, se nota que la alcaldía está pendiente de ella, la misma se ubica en el municipio José Ángel Lamas. 



<center>


![20260309_165020.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23wMSHVUhoHgUkJZYsx1Ropcw5bdGnu9EBf63XxEMbSfzjPU6Xb13BzDzBiZssMMC4BZK.jpg)

 <sub>Parte de La plaza</sub>
</center>


<center>

</center>


<div class=\

>

Un dato curioso de esta plaza es que es uno de esas plazas que no está al frente de una iglesia o que no tiene ninguna iglesia a sus lados como la mayoría de las plazas Bolivar, esta plaza tiene es negocios y locales al frente de ella y en sus laterales también, me encanta un negocio de tortas y yogures que está allí, pero ahora vi uno nuevo de Cepillados, para lo que no lo conocen son como frappe, granizados, muy deliciosos y tenía que probarlos, así que aprovechamos de comer uno, el mio era de tamarindo con mantecado y fresa un 10/10 y el de mi esposo era de ron con pasas y mantecado y naranja, ame mi cepillado, el de mi esposo estaba muy dulce.

Entre los locales también hay ventas de empanadas, batidos, wafles entre otros, algo que sí me di cuenta que no habían vendedores ambulantes como siempre hay en las plazas, está se puede ver que esta muy bien organizada y debe ser por ello que está muy limpia.


<center>


![20260309_161638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23tbpu5ogZe5Edo3536p1Z3LhqPh7FewMBmm4cMsTvFryoznhyfAJYLVjYRkNkpNFPJi7.jpg)

![20260309_164525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23yJBwrKXutQptgKEA5dHQPjXWmGA1GAcfoqEfKsEngFioP4dQ5HuxNxnrCceDDsCiM5i.jpg)

![20260309_165104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/EoEqaJvGZaEvotgVFDwhkBLxUo187r7pAPmJsc2KSdE5tU2r7s3irbzZF32HMegwXXu.jpg)


<sub>  </sub>
</center>




<div class=\

>

Esta plaza tiene muchos árboles y de todo tipo,  tiene desde mango, palmeras, matas de caucho, samán, tiene algunas de flores y matas pequeñas, algo que me di cuenta de esta plaza es que tiene varias fuentes pero ninguna funciona lamentablemente, están pintadas de azul pero no tienen funcionamiento, algunas están dentro de la plaza pero se nota que algo deben de tener dañado porque no funcionan, y fuera de la plaza pude ver tres fuentes grandes pero que tampoco funcionan o quizás en este momento no estaba funcionando, pero se puede notar de que algo les sucede estas fuentes.


Fui a esta plaza en una tarde y se puede notar que esta plaza es bastante visitada, había muchas personas que estaban allí sentadas disfrutando de un ambiente tranquilo y otras hasta acostadas en los muros de la plaza, esta plaza tiene bastantes asientos o bancos para sentarse, los muros se aprovechan como asientos y también tiene pequeños bancos en todo los rincones de la plaza tanto por fuera como por dentro, así que habían bastantes personas y apenas se estaba haciendo tarde me imagino que en las noches esta plaza está bastante llena y llena de risas de niños quienes pueden disfrutarla.


![20260309_164243.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23vsFsLADTC6KSz5T8LD9B2gn2rvebhCkbogiJNNiLPA45ig6zEw2FF4carfd1koYg5YQ.jpg)

![20260309_164952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23vsBeSGupjxUNYi1QEaKJupu7hddoufjL8fyWWaRfQSKNmNAYddpm4BfZT9GXBuu2UXt.jpg)



![20260309_164942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23wWwRMWykLE8qyw681gwDxNeUocyTCPAQPW6cy8yFHXMCENoKqdHHgXkQEHhh3F7PyZr.jpg)


![20260309_161720.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23uFK5nqTr5mFVGobeZRqUAo3nzrhhLhC4narrKHYB7BtZUQK24FbQCxkZL54ku9nY7KY.jpg)

![20260309_161725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23wC1UGBa3oWtXUZFDPSkzsEjfu6WvLyUStekQgNMceToWXxWWijH5NuPNWdmYc2mK46u.jpg)

![20260309_164031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23u5zfjn2fjvLrNg4qTjG6geaH5rPyzMB62UcbUXvc4zGNK1snGLxcw4A6Lrwq5mbSnBP.jpg)

![20260309_164453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23tvZrRnXRv13WRTiwojkwdav6vPgHmevdUetq5Hz47YqvGzGNwcDp1dfs5rogHXyJ2H7.jpg)


![20260309_164640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23xVAqhHxUvx1CQthB34zV6mrTjQKMhL1VTJNyo6iLi5F9Xefm9bXxLsFwb3Z9eso7RCt.jpg)

![20260309_162039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23wgB1GvFJ8dp4shMuRZjinwfVmjNghuJbQJyvcuoZoUNkeB5h7gGm5kJKHvCDdF4UVzv.jpg)

Me gusta mucho también los faroles que tiene esta plaza, de noche se debe ver hermosa con tanto faroles que parecen del siglo 15, están hechos de hierro y en la parte de abajo están sostenidos con cemento, la plaza está muy bien pintada y en el centro hay una parte como redonda donde está la estatua de bronce de Simón Bolívar el Libertador de Venezuela, que mayormente se encuentra en casi todas las plazas del país, pude tomar una panorámica de la plaza para que la puedan apreciar completa o parte de ella y puedan visualizar de lo que les hablo, la plaza tiene un estilo colonial y tiene caico en toda la plaza.

--- >! [ENGLISH] > >This time I visited Plaza Bolívar in Santa Cruz de Aragua, a fairly large square with a beautiful, open space for all children, adults, seniors, and young people. This square was founded in 1910, so it is already a century old, and you can see that it is very well maintained and clean. I love that about this square; you can tell that the city government takes good care of it. It is located in the municipality of José Ángel Lamas. > >![20260309_165020.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23wMSHVUhoHgUkJZYsx1Ropcw5bdGnu9EBf63XxEMbSfzjPU6Xb13BzDzBiZssMMC4BZK.jpg) > >An interesting fact about this square is that it is one of those squares that is not in front of a church or has no church on either side, unlike most Bolivar squares. This square has shops and businesses in front of it and on either side. I love a cake and yogurt shop that is there, but now I saw a new one called Cepillados. For those who don't know, they are like frappés or slushies, very delicious, and I had to try them, so we took the opportunity to eat one. Mine was tamarind with ice cream and strawberry, a 10/10, and my husband's was rum with raisins, ice cream, and orange. I loved my Cepillado, but my husband's was very sweet. > >Among the stalls, there are also empanadas, milkshakes, waffles, and other items for sale. I noticed that there were no street vendors, as there usually are in the plazas. You can see that it is very well organized, and that must be why it is so clean. > >![20260309_161638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23tbpu5ogZe5Edo3536p1Z3LhqPh7FewMBmm4cMsTvFryoznhyfAJYLVjYRkNkpNFPJi7.jpg) > >![20260309_164525.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23yJBwrKXutQptgKEA5dHQPjXWmGA1GAcfoqEfKsEngFioP4dQ5HuxNxnrCceDDsCiM5i.jpg) > >![20260309_165104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/EoEqaJvGZaEvotgVFDwhkBLxUo187r7pAPmJsc2KSdE5tU2r7s3irbzZF32HMegwXXu.jpg) > >This square has many trees of all kinds, including mango trees, palm trees, rubber trees, and saman trees. It also has some flowers and small bushes. Something I noticed about this square is that it has several fountains, but unfortunately none of them work. They are painted blue but are not functional. Some are inside the square, but you can tell that something must be damaged because they do not work. Outside the square, I could see three large fountains, but they also don't work, or perhaps they just weren't working at that moment, but you can tell that something is wrong with these fountains. > >I went to this square one afternoon, and you can tell that it is quite popular. There were many people sitting there enjoying the peaceful atmosphere, and others even lying down on the walls of the square. This square has quite a few seats or benches to sit on. The walls are used as seats, and there are also small benches in all corners of the square, both outside and inside. So there were quite a few people, and as it was getting late, I imagine that at night this square is quite crowded and filled with the laughter of children who can enjoy it. > >![20260309_164243.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23vsFsLADTC6KSz5T8LD9B2gn2rvebhCkbogiJNNiLPA45ig6zEw2FF4carfd1koYg5YQ.jpg) > >![20260309_164952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23vsBeSGupjxUNYi1QEaKJupu7hddoufjL8fyWWaRfQSKNmNAYddpm4BfZT9GXBuu2UXt.jpg) > >![20260309_164942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23wWwRMWykLE8qyw681gwDxNeUocyTCPAQPW6cy8yFHXMCENoKqdHHgXkQEHhh3F7PyZr.jpg) > >![20260309_161720.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23uFK5nqTr5mFVGobeZRqUAo3nzrhhLhC4narrKHYB7BtZUQK24FbQCxkZL54ku9nY7KY.jpg) > >![20260309_161725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23wC1UGBa3oWtXUZFDPSkzsEjfu6WvLyUStekQgNMceToWXxWWijH5NuPNWdmYc2mK46u.jpg) > >![20260309_164031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23u5zfjn2fjvLrNg4qTjG6geaH5rPyzMB62UcbUXvc4zGNK1snGLxcw4A6Lrwq5mbSnBP.jpg) > >![20260309_164453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23tvZrRnXRv13WRTiwojkwdav6vPgHmevdUetq5Hz47YqvGzGNwcDp1dfs5rogHXyJ2H7.jpg) > >![20260309_164640.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23xVAqhHxUvx1CQthB34zV6mrTjQKMhL1VTJNyo6iLi5F9Xefm9bXxLsFwb3Z9eso7RCt.jpg) > >![20260309_162039.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23wgB1GvFJ8dp4shMuRZjinwfVmjNghuJbQJyvcuoZoUNkeB5h7gGm5kJKHvCDdF4UVzv.jpg) > >I also really like the lanterns in this square. At night, it must look beautiful with so many lanterns that look like they're from the 15th century. They're made of iron and are held up by cement at the bottom. The square is very well painted, and in the center there's a round area with a bronze statue of Simón Bolívar, the Liberator of Venezuela, which can be found in almost every square in the country. I was able to take a panoramic photo of the square so you can see all or part of it and visualize what I'm talking about. The square has a colonial style and is covered in caico throughout. > >![20260309_164746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23z7Hzmwso7VdRvENvLy48qPymqkhbuZyNJ8JrCqQhSyd8jLAA6h7ydbJ1et5zP8DrZNm.jpg) > >![20260309_164326.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23tbicDXREXXi1rbmQurJm6t6Y1ZfENRMyFrCZ9jfUVuXTe5nnm5nP51bbBq1kjh6D2XM.jpg) > >![20260309_164314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23ywktFEqcPAaia9qqFrhAwkdwgeauggzDyCdv5e3G8w7uAaTQBt6d9Q1oLzUJvqW1pTi.jpg) > >![20260309_164300.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23zkgLBKQMkXN5BHK8Deg3gNvtFRb8CbiTL7hZH1aD8A9XBx9TLLp5TkvPa4uYKmmpbHx.jpg) > >![20260309_164410.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23x17JiXDN2W6NK3YbDTVpLxuDCqKPUgGpGdaZfrmNp2wrfneTfbUxxpyv4mYiuijturH.jpg) > >![20260309_164413.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23uQpMr42jzJYBAf2S91yjLSC5nFKV4HWB4qmrb54N3o2jEmk2n9zF2ijY9FzsLQjp3NP.jpg) > >![20260309_164308.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yolimarag/23yTb2rUpMCCPQWNo8sB2nijYHWdj4Uk6p6HVEX3mAgYFGmwETmDxfPJSvNCpcrRV2CYj.jpg) > ---

Greetings, friends. Today, as every day, we thank God for the days He gives us. I want to share these beautiful birds with you.

Saludos amigos, hoy como todos los dias le damos las gracias a papa Dios por los dias que nos regala,quiero compartir con ustedes, estas hermosas aves.

![20260217_154637.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPDC1Bag7nmSmNHV6rSYaYsVeuDqE8xBjzQ7dVWVEVEJD/20260217_154637.jpg)

Yesterday, my husband and I visited some friends who live in the countryside, and we came across these beautiful birds, called macaws in my country. My friend told me that she has had them for a year. These birds repeat some words like “hello,” “how are you,” and “Yuli,” my friend's name. I can tell you that I fell in love with these birds. My husband opened some cookies for them. My friend says they love cookies. I can tell you that these birds with their colorful feathers are in danger of extinction. These birds are the queens of my friend's house. She is happy with these birds.

En el dia de ayer visitamos mi esposo y yo a unos amigos que se encuentran en el campo,nos encontramos con estas belleza de aves, llamadas en mi pais guacamayas, mi amiga me dijo que ella tiene un año con ellas, estas aves repiten algunas palabras como hola,como estas,yuli el nombre de mi amiga, les puedo decir que quede enamorada de estas aves, mis esposo les destapo unas galletas, dice mi amiga que les encantan las galletas, les puedo decir que estan aves con sus plumas de colores estan en peligro de extision estas aves son las reinas de la casa de mi amiga ella es feliz con estas aves.


![20260217_154351.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeWUNxgTZyEimEh3h5Ufcu7UiRw28NShRENPoad6cbckV/20260217_154351.jpg)

![Uploading image #2...]()

title.title: A afternoon of pure light || LOH Contest 279 [Eng/Esp]
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmabX8tuc7pF2ot1dx4aNhciUMPfmioG3b6UYTXiTvobB2/1773089596982.jpg)


***
***



There is a moment in the day when the world stops making demands on me, and it is exactly when I step outside the hospital doors. For hours, my world has been a microcosm of fluorescent lights and hallways smelling of antiseptic, and I walk out, and the weight of the day settles on my shoulders like a backpack full of stones. That exhaustion is not just physical; it is almost a kind of fog that clouds the senses.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeaT8FzDez42hYaKU22zXWkioP2PiiErPYn1gYQmCze69/1773089598587.jpg)


***
That is why, sometimes, I do not take the direct route home, and instinctively, like an animal, my feet lead me in the other direction. A few hundred meters from my neighborhood, there is a small wooded park. It is not large or imposing, and it has nothing spectacular about it for anyone looking from the outside, but for me, it is my cathedral, my sanity check.
***



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSjUCQzpjjhiBAUcnzf8N6GCNW4ktGBCCmSYtkw9Rt7g/1773089597713.jpg)

***
Upon crossing that threshold of trees, I undergo an abrupt change. The rumble of traffic becomes a distant murmur, like the memory of a worry. The air is different. I cannot explain it well, but I notice how, when I breathe deeply, that pure air with its scent of damp earth and dry leaves seems to have the ability to wash my lungs from the inside, stripping away the accumulated fatigue.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbjDf1BANZGZSagv7gv8XMJxNKTtKmPYSN7D9HbmGdBUC/1773089668263.jpg)


***
A couple of days ago, I arrived especially exhausted after a hard day, and I leaned against the rough trunk of an oak tree, one of the oldest in the park. I closed my eyes and placed the palm of my hand on its bark, and in that silence, I seemed to perceive a silent strength that had been there for decades, perhaps centuries, simply existing. Leaning on it was as if I could borrow a little of that unshakeable peace.
***



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRFRoWVnk2rfn1Phuvbna1LYAVh9tXmZGW129ayBSg9Cq/1773089599099.jpg)

***
There, some trees have decided, in an outburst of gratuitous generosity, to cover themselves in flowers. They explode in tiny points of color that, with the evening light, seem to ignite in pink, and then I cannot imagine a better place to spend the afternoon, and of course, I take the opportunity to answer the lovely question from @elizabethbit.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPb2QqXhUyedizoEMH2QSdoiRLVUj9t8SMGYQnso9RLHc/1773089668729.jpg)

***
Finally, there is the grass, and I take off my shoes. I feel the coolness of the ground and the tiny pricks of the grass under the soles of my feet. It is such a primal sensation, so inherently ours, that it connects something very deep, and in that instant, I cease to be the professional making quick decisions and I am just another living being, stepping on the earth that sustains me.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcntgjmXYDdGkGSpLuygXpJrbaapfCMpvsW3KXvLfUBwe/1773089666083.jpg)


***
There is no need for an exotic trip or a grand retirement plan, I convince myself of that. Sometimes, all I need to feel that an afternoon is perfect is those twenty minutes and that small ritual of arriving, greeting the trees, counting the flowers, and stepping on the grass. These afternoons are my return home, to the essence, and it is my way of feeling in harmony with the world.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTeTdEXkKDvQsv1MkcAEMthgQ3dA9hMceEye4t8ViLUQc/1772347782243.jpg)

<center>🌳</center>
<center>🌳</center>

<sub>✨ **𝑻𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒌𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈!** ✨  
𝑰𝒇 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒅𝒐𝒏’𝒕 𝒌𝒏𝒐𝒘 𝒎𝒆 𝒚𝒆𝒕, 𝑰’𝒎 𝒂 **𝑪𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏 𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓𝒐𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒊𝒔𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒘𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒆𝒓**, 𝒂 𝒎𝒐𝒕𝒉𝒆𝒓, 𝒂 𝒘𝒐𝒎𝒂𝒏, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒂 𝒅𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒎𝒆𝒓 𝒘𝒉𝒐’𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒖𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒂 𝒃𝒆𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒊𝒇𝒖𝒍 𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒔𝒐𝒂𝒓.  
𝑨𝒍𝒍 **𝒕𝒆𝒙𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒎𝒂𝒈𝒆𝒔 𝒂𝒓𝒆 𝒎𝒚 𝒐𝒓𝒊𝒈𝒊𝒏𝒂𝒍 𝒄𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏𝒔**, 100% 𝒉𝒖𝒎𝒂𝒏-𝒎𝒂𝒅𝒆 (𝒏𝒐 𝑨𝑰).  
𝑩𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒆𝒓 𝒅𝒆𝒔𝒊𝒈𝒏𝒆𝒅 𝒃𝒚 𝑳𝒖𝒎𝒊𝒊.
𝑳𝒐𝒗𝒆𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒊𝒔 𝒑𝒐𝒔𝒕? **𝑼𝒑𝒗𝒐𝒕𝒆, 𝒄𝒐𝒎𝒎𝒆𝒏𝒕, 𝒐𝒓 𝒓𝒆𝒃𝒍𝒐𝒈** 𝒕𝒐 𝒔𝒑𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒘𝒊𝒏𝒈𝒔 𝒐𝒇 𝒄𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒗𝒊𝒕𝒚! 💛</sub>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 
### <center>VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL</center>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 



## <center>Una tarde de pura luz </center>





![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTBwXqaLeLqnZdKiP6mKs8DfdLW2U9reJarkpqv3FvcgE/1773089597344.jpg)


***
***

Hay un momento del día en el que el mundo para mí deja de exigir, y es justo cuando pongo un pie fuera de las puertas del hospital. Durante horas, mi mundo ha sido un microcosmos de luces fluorescentes y pasillos con olor a antiséptico, y salgo, y el peso de la jornada se asienta sobre mis hombros como una mochila llena de piedras. Ese agotamiento no es solo físico, es casi una especie de niebla que nubla los sentidos.
***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeaT8FzDez42hYaKU22zXWkioP2PiiErPYn1gYQmCze69/1773089598587.jpg)


***
Por eso, a veces no cojo el camino directo a casa e instintivamente, como un animal, mis pies me llevan en la otra dirección. A unos pocos cientos de metros de mi vecindario, hay un pequeño parque boscoso. No es grande ni imponente, y no tiene nada de espectacular para quien lo mire desde fuera, pero para mí es mi catedral, mi termómetro de la cordura.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSjUCQzpjjhiBAUcnzf8N6GCNW4ktGBCCmSYtkw9Rt7g/1773089597713.jpg)

***
Al cruzar ese umbral de árboles, sufro un cambio abrupto. El rumor del tráfico se convierte en un murmullo lejano, como el recuerdo de una preocupación. El aire es diferente. No sé explicarlo bien, pero noto cómo, al respirar hondo, ese aire puro con olor a tierra húmeda y hojas secas parece tener la capacidad de lavar mis pulmones por dentro, arrancando de ellos el cansancio acumulado.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbjDf1BANZGZSagv7gv8XMJxNKTtKmPYSN7D9HbmGdBUC/1773089668263.jpg)


***
Hace un par de días llegué especialmente agotada después de un día duro, y me apoyé contra el tronco rugoso de un roble, uno de los más viejos del parque. Cerré los ojos y apoyé la palma de la mano en su corteza, y en ese silencio me pareció percibir una fortaleza silenciosa que llevaba décadas, siglos quizás, simplemente estando ahí. Apoyarme en él fue como si pudiera tomar prestada un poco de esa paz inquebrantable.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRFRoWVnk2rfn1Phuvbna1LYAVh9tXmZGW129ayBSg9Cq/1773089599099.jpg)


***
Allí hay unos árboles que han decidido, en un alarde de generosidad sin motivo, cubrirse de flores. Explotan en pequeños puntos de color que, con la luz de la tarde, parecen encenderse de color rosa, y entonces no imagino un lugar mejor para pasar la tarde, y claro, aprovecho para responder la linda pregunta que nos hace @elizabethbit.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPb2QqXhUyedizoEMH2QSdoiRLVUj9t8SMGYQnso9RLHc/1773089668729.jpg)


***
Finalmente, está el césped y me quito los zapatos. Siento el fresco del suelo y la pequeña punzada de la hierba bajo la planta de mis pies. Es una sensación tan primaria y tan nuestra que conecta algo muy profundo, y en ese instante dejo de ser la profesional que toma decisiones rápidas y soy solo un ser vivo más pisando la tierra que me sostiene.
***


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcntgjmXYDdGkGSpLuygXpJrbaapfCMpvsW3KXvLfUBwe/1773089666083.jpg)


***
No hace falta un viaje exótico ni un gran plan de retiro, de eso me convenzo. A veces, lo único que necesito para sentir que una tarde es perfecta son esos veinte minutos y ese pequeño ritual de llegar, saludar a los árboles, contar las flores y pisar el césped. Estas tardes son mi vuelta a casa, a la esencia, y es mi forma de sentirme en armonía con el mundo.


<center>🌳</center>
<center>🌳</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeQA2nwFQo3sZ1vuEqgLphQMjgqrarqB5nhtG2BYMxCbV/1772347782296.jpg)

title.body: Splinterland's: My 50 Foundation pack opening. ---------------------------------------------- I was opening the Foundation packs for quite some time to get my foundation deck upgraded to the maximum level. This 50-pack opening was part of the same strategy, and I guess this is my last pack opening for Foundation card too. It is not like I have achieved my max goal of the Foundation cards deck, but it now make more sense for me to fill the targeted gaps by buying cards from the market that are missing in my inventory instead of opening further packs which may now cause me to get extra copies of some cards and cause me to remain deficient in other cards. For the current pack opening, below is the snippet of my cards opening.

/> [Source](https://splinterlands.com/mana-well?t=350b0aada217afaf6ee00026d572baf669e391fe&ref=r1s2g3) I can definitely say that this is my best pack opening as it gave me 2 Legendary cards, 2 Gold foil Archons, 1 Gold foil epic with some other epic cards and I do received multiple Gold foil common cards. This was also first time in my pack opening where my pack opening cost is not at the break-even point or below the break-even point, but much more valuable than the cost of packs opened. I have some cards I can sell in the market to fund my upgrade of Foundation cards. This opening though did not helped me in any of the Archon upgrade but it do helped me in upgrading my multiple cards to upgrade their level. To be precise after this pack opening, I have upgraded 14 Foundation cards and noticable upgrades are upgrading Epic Sorrow harvester and Epic Glimmermancer to the max Foundation epic level. Though I am currently not able to take advantage of the upgrade of Epic cards in the current scenario as my both Earth and Death Splinter level is not maxed but I can say it is the matter of few more days as now my current priority to upgrade my Foundation Archon to max level and then I will take top to bottom approach, in which I wll first max all , legendary cards, followed by Epic ,rare and common cards. Even in this approach, I will give priority to upgrade Neutral cards first. Though I have no Element/Splinter choice for which I should upgrade first but I guess preference will go to life splinter as I feel my Life team is week and so need my attention first.

title.title: Alive & Thriving Goals Monday : A Freaky Day.. Oh Boy! ✨|| AATYr6 || Prompt A Day 😊
title.body:
<center>
![you go girl wheelchair.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamraincrystal/AJkRqmoB7on6G9JLDoZwKm9PfD6ohDxXGFfNBmrfD8AomPoLwC6k2Yg4KMJr2zX.png)</center>

All righty, I had a freaky day so I'm posting this late. I was supposed to work on this last night, but I was having really low energy. Thought it best to postpone for a few hours. 🙏❤️💡


<center>![smmoa.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamraincrystal/AK6YMCpDoNARR7Kh3vrpTRSvEuA4QsgNXCkhGW6TsqayMpUKudfhbfHtum5UhQQ.jpg)</center>

First off, an update on my one and only day off from work -- Sunday! Well, upon checking my March calendar, my Sundays are booked with activities to do except for this past one. Let's just say I blocked off the date on my mind with a clear intention of visiting SM Mall of Asia for the *KPop Demon Hunters Pop-up*. The mall is located more than an hour away from me, so I needed to book a Grab taxi to get there. I also had my lunch there before heading back home after accomplishing my plan. I dined at a Singaporean brand restaurant called *Killiney*. Truly enjoyed the hokkien mee I ordered. 😋


<center>![kpdhpopup.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamraincrystal/AK56W4bpSubjiV77fM2scXBnr8EBqEsVKCSxV38o52oH1syiz2iLoy46YNoBgPW.jpg)</center>

After initially walking to the opposite side where this pop up was located, I finally found it. Thankfully the first try was not a very long walk. Whew! I have been training for a bit of longer walk daily so I was a little confident that I'd have enough energy for this trek. I will share some other photos next time. Let's just say it was a successful activity day and I got home early enough to enjoy the rest of my afternoon. 😊


<center>![sunmonsteps.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iamraincrystal/23tGXhNUhUhgffUGyY2g6AwbUXvnqJkTm6NYzD2gAmL5hTiLPnyouFE4nFaBfvCXaJmsj.jpg)</center>

I personally think that the Google Fit app I'm using had a glitch of sort. I'm sure I should have gotten more steps for Sunday.. but oh well! It is what it is. Last night, however, I was not feeling all that good to push for reaching my daily 5K target. First off, my Internet connection died around three in the afternoon. I had to switch to data connection (thankfully I'm equipped for this). I've reported the matter but this must have been a major outage as it's still out this morning. Boo hoo! Truly inconvenient for me but I have to adapt for the meantime. 😒 Hopefully, I would be able to meet my daily 5K steps for today. 

___

### Prompt A Day : QUOTE

**\

- Charles Dickens** *shoutout to @shadowspub for the daily prompt (subscribe to her newsletter)* Spring time must be amazing. I can only imagine as we only have hot and hotter for our local weather. It got as hot as 35C here a few days back. It's slightly lower these few days as we did get that rain last Sunday (whew!) How I wish I could request for a little more rain from places getting lots of them. 😅 Personally, I don't feel like we get enough cool days in the year. Perhaps I should think of relocating to somewhere cooler in the long term. Inshallah! 😆
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/xlBAxSg959wAAAAC/springtime-typography.gif)

> **
ENGLISH
** This week I decided to start with a balanced and healthy menu, so I prepared a mashed taro root dish for my family lunch, which is one of our favorite vegetables at home, and served it with chicken breast and a vegetable salad with avocado. Here's how I made it. ![IMG_20260309_130501_531.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23uFaXqm3jNs3xTSvZViba1YieSEEEp9y94pLQrJmxxfVi3YWUsiQBfCDTCfR2yRm62UV.jpg) ![IMG_20260309_130525_449.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23zbae8S1aUHZZm2uLwiHY9xHatuLrXJ41T2nWog1PmyCEKftQi8jztCbvWztGpx9i1tT.jpg)

> **
INGREDIENTES
** para seis porciones: 2 kg de ocumo, 750 gr de pechuga de pollo, adobo, caldo de pollo deshidratado, sal, aceite c/n, 1 pepino, 2 tomates y unas rodajas de aguacate

> **
INGREDIENTS
** For six servings: 2 kg of taro root, 750 g of chicken breast, marinade, dehydrated chicken broth, salt, oil as needed, 1 cucumber, 2 tomatoes, and a few slices of avocado. ![IMG_20260309_120127_601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/EpEJJN92xvCpX7H77q2fXqoHdumm8ShePcvuUUdTB3BuDYdWTZjvEScLwoqVNtaZeSk.jpg) ![IMG_20260309_120213_397.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23xyb9PudsWmxmfAEFbvsCqP3Q3GpQi6q9cYTFTPjVuXjsMTRpvmzTCAXyUgYfrtYUQ8Q.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** Mientras el agua hervía retiré la concha del ocumo , los lavé muy bien, los corté a la mitad ;cuando el agua comenzó a hervir agregué un poco de sal y dejé cocinarlos . Al mismo tiempo preparé la pechuga de pollo, la sazoné con ajo, salsa de soya, adobo, comino ,un poco de aceite y llevé a cocinar volteando por ambos lados hasta que estuvo completamente cocida; y para la ensalada corte en rodajas el pepino y los dos tomates. Cuándo el ocumo estuvo completamente cocido lo trituré con ayuda de un tenedor y añadí un poco de mantequilla para preparar el puré

> **
PROCEDURE
** While the water was boiling, I removed the shells from the taro, washed them thoroughly, and cut them in half. When the water began to boil, I added a little salt and let them cook. At the same time, I prepared the chicken breast, seasoned it with garlic, soy sauce, adobo, cumin, and a little oil, and cooked it, turning it on both sides until it was completely cooked. For the salad, I sliced the cucumber and the two tomatoes. When the taro was completely cooked, I mashed it with a fork and added a little butter to make the purée. ![IMG_20260309_121911_842.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23zkvrmS9RHDRRzdjGaWcpe121vvWMtugKubZspBqM7UpfFUEVtz7Ne5JBUxf4tnhWEEt.jpg) ![IMG_20260309_122656_179.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23uFeDur6FWxTv1Qo7dp6aNvmSM1oWRppxSeuWW3twR59eweEiavwV4p2thnTV6F9fzWj.jpg) ![IMG_20260309_122911_401.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wMap1YNb8dGNpYV6WuHgQqzHe8xdyUZcf71FcJ5B1ifZecDSzzrP8hjnGHrtH5zNAYK.jpg) ![IMG_20260309_124603_159.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wCLHzyX9xGyULT74bLX16JMk2mPrpAwrrSnq8wHhC3dnxPaYgCzDXPgygsiMiiXgKHs.jpg) ![IMG_20260309_124937_611.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23ywwLdbwb18AS5UyrBCLftumXhTddt3uiufh4c3iZe6PeRgxp1nk2Pk3p4zZzoeQjVzx.jpg) ![IMG_20260309_123556_726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23vsN1tVhJ58VJqVWt8ZxeTsqoErRUqH9Lrw9uyDgmQUdJ2wFmfQZ7hR2Q1ZnfZw7UPc4.jpg) ![IMG_20260309_125433_564.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wMaSQTXBtCzfJSK5ZBh2gGhRwRsBBDjPANYFs8vNbiSeRvTpmPqfnqwCEyWKZJYHdTm.jpg) ![IMG_20260309_123942_074.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23uQy1Zdq5HiKLWK1VVCqC1xeGgkDkRHUnM3kgo3NpnTaNTGiM1HyqQbLp9NcTuymgxph.jpg)

> A la hora de servir, añadí al plato una rodajas de aguacate y, así disfrutamos este saludable y balanceado menú iniciando la semana. Espero que haya sido de su agrado . Gracias por visitar mi blog! Dios te bendiga🙏

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: March 10 2026
title.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gd15885ae285bbc8190e0ec14b6a3f1986ea72217aca9e0490cd4919339cfbc0d8777033d777dbd0f0cb6e97cb42d39378a556919a6a9bdf329e86ce824f3d175_640.jpg)
Hoy mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente refrescante. Comencé mi ruta en el parque central, donde el aire fresco y el sonido de las hojas me dieron energía. Allí conocí a un grupo de ciclistas que se detuvieron para descansar. Eran muy amables y compartieron algunas recomendaciones sobre rutas para explorar en la ciudad. Uno de ellos, un artista, me mostró algunas fotos de su obra mural que estaba por la zona; estaba ansioso por mostrarle a la comunidad su arte. Continuando mi camino, pasé por una pequeña librería que se había convertido en un refugio para amantes de los libros. Vi a dos personas sentadas en un rincón, discutiendo apasionadamente sobre su novela favorita. La calidez del lugar y el aroma a café me hicieron querer entrar, pero decidí seguir con mi ruta. Al final, llegué a un mirador que ofrecía una vista espectacular de la ciudad al atardecer. Allí, un grupo de fotógrafos capturaba el momento, y se generó una conversación interesante sobre la belleza de la ciudad y cómo cambia con la luz del día. Sin duda, estas pequeñas interacciones y momentos hacen que cada caminata sea única y enriquecedora. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

title.title: Chicken in tomato sauce (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
>

Today's lunch will be delicious chicken in sauce, but in a very practical way since I already had the natural tomato sauce ready, I just added onion for a more delicious result. I usually prepare this homemade sauce with ripe tomatoes, onion, paprika, sweet pepper, garlic, salt, and parsley. I took the opportunity to accompany it with a generous serving of short pasta with grated cheese.


<center>
![1000100741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xAkNLarqUUDUE96RybGhsngPhBcnuxT2vDt8pUoSn8ozg3fg24NdURobRbrxZ19nht2.jpg)
</center>


## Ingredients:

- 5 pieces of chicken
- 1/2 jar of tomato sauce
- 1 onion
- Pinch of salt
- Hard cheese

<center>
![1000100731.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23z7LGxPNBkBRM8H9QNrLkmWc2ts9evrMpwgvtUpeSccqU8Lb8rdKrFG6UmCChBXiguXr.jpg)
</center>

## Preparation:

I washed the chicken thoroughly, drained it, and added a pinch of salt. Then I heated a frying pan and added a measure of oil. I placed the chicken pieces in the pan with the julienned onion and cooked them until they were golden brown. Then I added the tomato sauce, stirring to spread it over the entire surface, and put a lid on the pan so that the steam would help speed up the cooking process.

<center>
![1000100734.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tmQ92hSjrNfKKR65firsFtCE2zDsrmyAfaSeypLimLXQWBj7DfftayEUHSA9xf2CHpx.jpg)
</center>



At the same time, I put a pot on the stove with a liter and a half of water and a pinch of salt. When it boiled, I added half a kilo of short pasta, known as \

I love this type of pasta because it usually goes a long way. In about fifteen minutes, it was ready, so I drained it and added butter. I made sure the chicken was cooked through by using a fork, and when I saw that it was done, I turned off the heat. The next step was to serve, first the pasta and then the pieces of chicken with their respective portions of sauce and grated cheese.
![1000100737.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23u6J3bG3idgPgL6SBTGcCnDtGgAMPpbUtH5QhQdCgH3iKDWSgogXzRwTzDE3NB4w9d96.jpg)
I particularly like to eat this way, while my husband, once I had served myself, proceeded to mix the rest of the pasta with the chicken in sauce in the same pot, stirring until all the pasta had taken on the color of the sauce, then served it on a plate and added cheese. So there you have two ways to enjoy the same recipe. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> El almuerzo de hoy será un delicioso pollo en salsa, pero de una forma bastante práctica puesto que la salsa de tomate natural ya la tenía lista, solo agregué cebolla para un resultado más delicioso. Suelo preparar esta salsa casera con tomates maduros, cebolla, pimentón, ají dulce, ajo, sal y perejil. Aproveché para acompañar con una generosa ración de pasta corta junto a su respectivo queso rallado.
![1000100741.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23xAkNLarqUUDUE96RybGhsngPhBcnuxT2vDt8pUoSn8ozg3fg24NdURobRbrxZ19nht2.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 5 piezas de pollo - 1/2 frasco de salsa de tomate - 1 cebolla - Pizca de sal - Queso duro
![1000100731.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23z7LGxPNBkBRM8H9QNrLkmWc2ts9evrMpwgvtUpeSccqU8Lb8rdKrFG6UmCChBXiguXr.jpg)
## Preparación: Lavé el pollo muy bien, escurrí y agregué un punto de sal. Luego calenté un sartén y puse una medida de aceite. Allí puse las piezas de pollo hasta que adquirieran un tono dorado junto a la cebolla cortada en julianas. Después añadí la salsa de tomate, removiendo para extenderla por toda la superficie y coloqué una tapa para que el vapor contribuyera a acelerar la cocción.
![1000100734.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tmQ92hSjrNfKKR65firsFtCE2zDsrmyAfaSeypLimLXQWBj7DfftayEUHSA9xf2CHpx.jpg)
En paralelo, monté una olla en la cocina con litro y medio de agua y un punto de sal. Al hervir puse en el agua medio kilo de pasta corta, de la conocida como dedalitos. Me encanta este tipo de pasta porque suele ser muy rendidora. En unos quince minutos estuvo lista, procedí a colarla y añadí mantequilla. Me cercioré que el pollo estuviera en su punto mediante el uso de un tenedor, al advertir que se había cocinado completamente, apagué. El próximo paso era servir, primero la pasta y luego las piezas de pollo con su respectiva ración de salsa y su queso rallado.
![1000100737.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23u6J3bG3idgPgL6SBTGcCnDtGgAMPpbUtH5QhQdCgH3iKDWSgogXzRwTzDE3NB4w9d96.jpg)
En lo particular me agrada comer de esta manera, en tanto mi esposo, una vez que me serví, procedió a mezclar el resto de la pasta con el pollo en salsa en la misma olla, revolviendo hasta lograr que toda la pasta adquiriera el color de la salsa, luego pasó a servir en un plato y agregó queso. Así que allí están dos formas de disfrutar una misma receta. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

title.title: Broken 💔 @ 20,000 feet
title.body:
**[RIP My Dear Friend Jax](https://rumble.com/vwkdxd-the-elusive-jax...-.html?e9s=src_v1_clr%2Csrc_v1_upp_a)**
The trip was planned. Hotel and Flight booked. 48 hours ago. We knew our boy Jax was having trouble. We had him scheduled for a veterinarian appointment Tuesday the day after I was to leave. In that 48 hours our second rescue kitty of 13+ years and Sammi Jo's first foster kitten Jax crashed hard. He was in real trouble as his mid section (tummy) doubled in size. We rushed him to the emergency vet at 7 am Monday morning. He could no longer walk and was in labored breathing. The ultra sound confirmed what we had feared. It looked like a tumour on or near his pancreas had burst filling his abdominal cavity with fluid.

> We said our goodbyes as his breathing slowed to a stop. Our hearts were breaking. We then scrambled to make my flight. My heart is broken for the girl person in my life that means everything to me. I also realize now how wrecked I am gonna be when my kitty girl Samantha's time comes. I am not there for either of them right now. My best friends are hurting and I am 1400 miles away. It is the thing I hate most about this career path I have chosen.

> As I sit here trying to find the words to type. I look out the window at the world 20,000 feet below. A clown world gone crazy. I wonder if anyone else who might read this has broken down sobbing like I have over their pets? I have had to put this phone down several times as I am having trouble holding back the tears. I do not wish to explain to the couple sitting next to me why I am crying.

> Goodbye my sweet sweet Jax kitty. You helped us along with Sammi Jo to change our lives. You should have been with us much longer. We saved you from a very rough start in life and we did the best we could to make your life with us a special time & place.

> I know Samantha will not stop looking for you to cuddle with in all the usual places we would find you two together. I will try to find more time to cuddle with her as I know my time together with Sammi is becoming shorter by the day.
>Love your Loved ones please. People and pets. Cuz they really are gone in the blink of an eye. **\n\n

title.title: Mi informe de Actifit: marzo 9 2026 .
title.body: > Saludos a toda la comunidad de #SWC, #actifit y #Hive 🙋🏻‍♂️🚶🏻‍♂️🤸🏻‍♂️. Aquí estamos de vuelta, activos con un nuevo reporte de actividad para contarles cómo estuvo la movida hoy. Esta mañana tocó retomar el trote semanal, y aunque el cuerpo a veces pide cinco minutos más, logramos vencer a la almohada. ​***El Inicio: Café Mental y a la Calle*** ​Todo empezó a las 6:00 am en punto cuando sonó la alarma. No les voy a mentir, me lo tomé con calma; me desperté, me despejé un poco y me alisté sin mucho apuro. A eso de las 6:47 am ya estaba en la puerta de la casa, listo para darle “play” al asunto. Salí en ayunas, como para activar bien el metabolismo y ver qué tal respondía el cuerpo bajo presión. ***​La Ruta: Entre Caminos y Descubrimientos*** ​La ruta fue casi la misma de la vez pasada, pero con un par de variantes para no aburrirme. Pasé por la primera entrada de la urbanización hasta llegar al Comando. Desde ese punto, decidí adentrarme un poco más por los caminos hacia Villa Betania. Esta vez agarré un sendero diferente que me llevó casi hasta el Llovizna Market 1. ​Desde ahí giré para emprender el regreso, agarrando la carretera que conecta con una de esas subidas empinadas de Villa Betania que te ponen a prueba las piernas. ​***El Reto: El Sprint Final*** ​Justo cuando estaba por llegar al tramo donde la inclinación se pone seria, decidí meterle fuego. Me lancé un sprint a máxima potencia hasta llegar a la cima donde termina la carretera. Les digo de una: me dejó totalmente liquidado. El corazón me iba a mil, así que me tocó caminar un buen tramo para recuperar el aliento y bajar las revoluciones hasta llegar otra vez al Comando. ​Ya de ahí, reanudé el trote como pude (más por orgullo que por otra cosa) hasta que finalmente llegué a casa. ​**Balance del día:** Siendo sincero, diría que me fue regular. No fue mi mejor tiempo, pero la meta aquí es ir agarrando resistencia poco a poco. Lo importante es que cumplimos y seguimos sumando kilómetros. ​¡Sin más que contarles por ahora, nos vemos en la próxima ruta!

> 

 Greetings to the entire #SWC, #actifit and #Hive community 🙋🏻‍♂️🚶🏻‍♂️🤸🏻‍♂️.

Here we are again, back with a new activity report to tell you all about how things went today. This morning it was time to resume our weekly jog, and although sometimes our bodies ask for five more minutes, we managed to beat the pillow.

​***The Beginning: Café Mental and Out on the Street***

It all started at 6:00 a.m. sharp when the alarm went off. I'm not going to lie to you, I took it easy; I woke up, cleared my head a little, and got ready without much rush. At around 6:47 a.m., I was already at the door of the house, ready to hit \

on the whole thing. I left on an empty stomach, as if to activate my metabolism and see how my body would respond under pressure. ***The Route: Between Paths and Discoveries*** The route was almost the same as last time, but with a couple of variations so I wouldn't get bored. I passed through the first entrance to the residential area until I reached Comando. From there, I decided to venture a little further along the roads towards Villa Betania. This time I took a different path that led me almost to Llovizna Market 1. From there, I turned around to start the return journey, taking the road that connects to one of those steep climbs in Villa Betania that really put your legs to the test. ​***The Challenge: The Final Sprint*** Just as I was about to reach the section where the incline gets serious, I decided to go for it. I sprinted at full speed until I reached the top where the road ends. I'll tell you one thing: it completely wiped me out. My heart was racing, so I had to walk a good distance to catch my breath and slow down before reaching the Command again. From there, I resumed jogging as best I could (more out of pride than anything else) until I finally got home. ​**Summary of the day:** To be honest, I'd say it went okay. It wasn't my best time, but the goal here is to gradually build up my endurance. The important thing is that we did it and we're continuing to rack up the miles. ​That's all for now, see you on the next route! --------

title.title: Life, it is also starting from scratch; like a new beginning...
title.body:
>When are we truly satisfied with our lives? Is it when we materially achieve what we long for and desire? Or, on the other hand, maybe it is when we finally reach a sense of fullness? These are the kinds of questions I have always tried to answer. Not because existential philosophy is my intellectual goal in life although I have no problem with that. Still, I believe that at many moments throughout our lives certainly in mine it happens often finding those answers becomes a necessity.

\n\n

>I have never been an ordinary person. As a child, I did not feel that I fit into what other kids usually agreed on. For me, an explanation has no value just because an authority says it. Some might call me irreverent or rebellious. I believe the approach to truth is something incredibly noble and pure. What do I really mean by that? Well, if I ask why Earth is spherical I deserve an answer that actually responds to the question not a simple it is a planet, and they are all round.

\n\n

>This preamble helps explain the need that all human beings have to long for better and greater opportunities. From my perspective, this is what gives life its meaning. The value of individuality and the ability to reach what we set our minds to. Sometimes irony and even a certain injustice take hold of our theoretical possibilities. To give another example, I will use myself. I am someone who has valued and cultivated intelligence on many levels, yet I have not been able to enjoy much material benefit from that habit. Am I worse than others because of it? I do not know, but every night when I go to sleep I feel that I still have several things pending.

![20260216_151514.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23u5y1qrSAcZtTbeHk9fb8GsLrsxRGcWEpFoiBioi9d6iJU5Q5Ye2pmhJRgbqHJDsq3M3.jpg) ![20260216_150726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wgFkV6bc6818eLoHzdT2TiCYg8JTWUGmkXkCivAPcG5RQRgHctdQhyvaE5Ph8DAQ8pn.jpg) ![20260216_151436.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23w2cJQH8cGEtQEMu4CSMCv9nAAkc3ZJ8FHfKhnPgr8vSAn7jGRgMiZ2wKPgTMtq7XAzw.jpg) ![20260216_150633.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23yJEERoU2WieTLtiQfkrRDuVtmHM3jbAaE4XLD8cMcgdpHSu3LWMjrYjLX1VtfR1ZoyH.jpg)

>And I like calling them that pending. Because unless I want to see Earth from space, in many ways I believe I can still achieve them. I am aware of certain limitations such as emigrating to a better country with more opportunities. That is where what you see in the photographs comes from. And that is also where the idea for this post and the importance of starting from scratch a new beginning comes from. The girl you see in the images is one of the women I have loved the most in my life. But do not get confused not in the way you might think but more like a sister. She is my best friend, and she left everything behind in her country of origin to begin what she needs and desires.

\n\n

>So the rhetorical questions I asked at the beginning of this post start to make sense. Can our longings and desires become reality? I think they can, but depending on each person's circumstances. In my case, no. I do not have the means to immigrate to a specific country. At that point, opportunities shrink within a certain margin. In her case, theoretically yes. And I do not say this to sound fatalistic or negative, but because it will also depend on the dedication, effort, and luck she has in achieving it. It is fair to say that nothing she has done was driven by impulse. Behind her new beginning there is planning, sacrifice, and effort that is admirable. I have also not told you about her abilities as a human being. Brilliance, intelligence, and capability are qualities she possesses and that I believe will make her life infinitely better according to what she has planned for her possibilities.

>Writing about this makes me feel much better. I am someone who does not process grief and pain in conventional ways. I am not someone who cries easily. Quite the opposite, in fact. I remember watching her cry over a reality that is both devastating and common at the same time. Physically, last Thursday was probably the last day we hugged and saw each other. I think it will take me a long time to fully adapt. For me she is not only my best and greatest treasure but also someone truly irreplaceable. I do not say that to flatter her but simply to describe her importance to me.

![20260220_155852.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wqa7eoQUbu7WekwRjKnPU9iNVnmktHZZxvFB6d68bAFSfEknJES6yRKvTk5zmqAbadC.jpg) ![20260220_155512.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/Eoru5GcRdTvTdtosxDb8588YjtNBa1S1cDxJeUyD7FMxxgnH8oVjQPqDGqd8FtmDL5Y.jpg) ![20260220_154931.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23ynNM1U5doWwqUdxUsqmoehynhFgvxcLZWHifrd8qhffH9neWoAZL8E1MqyMevvKgbGV.jpg)

>I love seeing that her possibilities both her desires and the opportunities ahead of her are now one step closer to becoming real. The fulfillment of her life involves stability in many aspects but also finding passion. And what is passion for her? Traveling, learning to refine photography as an art, and above all learning to unlearn. And I quote her own words: I do not want to think that life is just working from Monday to Saturday, 9, 10 hours every day. That would destroy me if I did it for 20 straight years. I want the independence to be and to do what here I could never do. That statement seems noble, beautiful, and above all admirable to me.

\n\n

>I share it with you, fellow Hivers, because I know there are many people who live with constant fear as if that were completely acceptable. I am not here to tell you what to do with your lives. I would never be that disrespectful or presumptuous. But I do want to show that possibilities are there. In one way or another, they exist. For some people it means starting from absolute nothing in a foreign land without knowing anything. For others it means doing it with their children, spouses, or simply alone. We are what we dare to do. Everything else is part of the process.

![IMG-20260221-WA0008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23xyhXeubmJTpPkZBnPeQbsEe4BikZYXt51YF4XAELkhTmDu9f7GRRkPnjNA6TvZbQM7L.jpg) ![20260216_154800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wMQ8C5CGrQ2x8S7w29De9p6RTPT1EXYepTJSUGcdwdMoPWcYiH9vbDZatjF3H7QmBHW.jpg) ![20260220_161238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23wBxn3tTpwf7U1xgCSSvJQDr1pWUavPHwog3shtJRUJohNKPrdyL81HTBVm8CYaoZ45e.jpg) ![20260220_153859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/244UmmAiQR968BvYYDkZSK9aWdhZDzrFFZHh2AzWVXNewaK1F4UdxPU8sXzKnc1FBcHSa.jpg) ***

title.title: A new era of parenting?
title.body:
>

Yesterday we were snuggling, Lily and I. It was time for her to fall asleep, and she loves it when I stay beside her after reading to her. It was early, we both had had bad nights since Lily came down with a weird cold-hot-normal sequence, where she'd complain about feeling very cold in the evening and demanding a lot of blankets. Then she would suddenly overheat and stay very hot for a while, before finally normalizing. 


![IMG_20260308_115328401_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EonkbWZH9BouhQp8FTAVMJJM7ZQ8nuQ7u2xuKQQsM6YWa4Lro8YAnSMecFZJGifAzHP.jpg)


Parents know that this kind of stuff costs us sleep. So, it was barely 7pm when I turned out the light since we were both incredibly tired. And then suddenly, she started talking. Not really asking questions. But making statements. And I listened. And answered. And gave my opinion. And argued. We had a real discussion. For around 45min (which didn't help our tiredness today...). 

It was the first time. And I was confused. We had some longer exchanges of words before, but not like this. Obviously, the situation we're in merits longer discussions, yet I wasn't sure how much a 7.5 year old can handle and do. Apparently more than I thought.

She talked about all the topics that are moving her at the moment. She knows that her mom wants to take her out of here again, and that the mom doesn't like the school nor her teacher (which Lily herself adores) and so many other things. Including me, top of the list. And she had been exposed to a lot of that from her mom's side.

*I want to be on mom's side.*

That's a phrase that caught my attention. Not \

. I knew she were conflicted between what she feels and what her mom constantly complains about, but I didn't know that it was that bad. In the end, even that whole cold-hot-normal-sequence could've been just an psychosomatic outburst of her emotions being hyper-stimulated.\n\nThe whole discussion made it clearer to me that she really wants to please her mom. She repeated several times \

, something she had said before. I think she feels somewhat responsible for her mom's well being, her happiness. Which is a lot to carry for a little girl. If it's too much for the mom to carry, how could the child? I'm not sure if I handled it all well. That's parenthood, I know. I wasn't prepared for this at all. But I'm incredibly happy about it. Her having the trust towards me to say it all. And I did make clear that she can (and should) always do that, and that it's absolutely fine if she has a different opinion than I. I tried to be as respectful as possible, recognizing her mom's opinions coming out of her in a way that makes sense to a little girl. It wasn't fun to notice her scrambling to find arguments to support those opinions. But in retrospective, I now know that I did the right thing, being respectful of those opinions, but also placing mine against them. It's clear that she's not only growing in body, but also in spirit and mind. Though I enjoyed that precious exchange of minds, I know that more of that is coming now. And not long, and the discussions will get harsher. I'll have to adapt my parenting to that now. Establish strategies, prepare answers, work on my patience. It's going to be a lot of work. But it also means that I made it. We have that connection, and it's only growing stronger, despite being under heavy fire. She might not yet be capable of breaking out of this vicious cycle of Child Adulting. *One day, she will.* ___ What are your thoughts about this topic? Please feel free to engage in any original way, including dropping links to your posts on similar topics. I'm happy to read (and curate) any quality content that is not created by LLM/AI, as well as read your own experience and point of view, I love to learn! > Pictures taken with a Motorola Edge 60 Pro, I reserve the copyright - but feel free to ask if you want to use one of the pictures!

title.title: Morning walk in Tataracual (Eng - Esp)
title.body:
> **
INGLÉS
** Hello fellow nature lovers, I hope you have a wonderful week with your loved ones. I take this opportunity to congratulate the women of the community and the beehive, as yesterday was International Women's Day, which aims to honor women for the great work they do daily in their homes and workplaces. It is a special day to celebrate and recognize their fundamental role in the socio-economic development of the country and the various functions they perform inside and outside the home. This time, I'm sharing a hike I took with a group of friends to celebrate Friendship Day. The idea was to do a short walk to exercise and spend a different kind of day by the river, enjoying nature. We started from Tataracual, a town located on the Cumaná-Cumanácoa national highway. It's known for its cassava bread production, beautiful swimming areas, and several suspension bridges. There are several suspension bridges along this highway, which I hadn't seen before. On previous visits, I'd only seen the bridges in Cedeño and thought they were the only ones in the area. However, that's not the case. The area has mountain rivers, most of which flow down from the Turimiquire mountain range. In some sections, several suspension bridges have been built. The structure consists of cables, iron supports, and iron sheets for the walkways. Compared to the Angostura suspension bridge, this one is quite different and simpler. It's functional and meets the needs of the locals, as no cars use it, only pedestrians, bicycles, and occasionally motorcycles (with light loads). We started our hike before 7:00 a.m., and to our surprise, the sun rose earlier than usual. The sun's rays were already quite strong, but that didn't stop our hike. After drinking water and packing our things for the trail, we set off for our destination, which was about 15 kilometers away. It's a busy road, and you have to be very careful on the sidewalk and dirt paths, and also pay attention to the hills and valleys. At first, everything was going well, but as we progressed, the intensity of the sun prevented us from picking up the pace, since we chose the side with the strongest sun. Wearing hats and carrying our water bottles, we continued on, and I must say it was a lovely experience. In fact, it's the second time I've hiked. The first time was in Caripe, and it was a completely different place. Here, we walked along the side of the road, observing the rivers, the vegetation, the houses, and more. The town has several houses and families who dedicate themselves to the production of cassava bread and the cultivation of various crops. It also has a small church.

> **
ESPAÑOL
** Hola amigos amantes de la naturaleza, deseo que tengan una excelente semana en unión de sus seres queridos, aprovecho la ocasión para felicitar a las mujeres de la comunidad y la colmena pues el día de ayer se celebró el Día Internacional de la mujer, que tiene como objetivo homenajear a las mujeres por la gran labor que realiza diariamente en sus hogares y lugar de trabajo, es un día especial donde se celebra y reconoce su su rol y papel fundamental en el desarrollo socioeconómico del país y las diversas funciones que desempeña dentro y fuera de casa. En esta ocasión, les comparto una caminata que realicé en compañía de un grupo de amigas, para celebrar el día de la Amistad, la idea era hacer un pequeño recorrido para ejercitarnos y pasar un día diferente en el río, disfrutando el contacto con la naturaleza. Iniciamos desde Tataracual, este pueblo se ubica en la carretera nacional Cumaná -Cumanácoa, el cual destaca por la producción de casabe, hermosos balnearios y varios puentes colgantes, en esta carretera se ubican varios puentes colgantes, los cuales no conocía, en visitas anteriores solo tuve la oportunidad de conocer los puentes de Cedeño y creía que eran los únicos que habían en la zona, pues resulta que no es así, dado que es un área que posee ríos de montañas, los cuales descienden en su mayoría de la serranía del Turimiquire, en algunos tramos se han construido varios de ellos, la estructura es de guayas, soporte de hierro y lámina de hierro para la caminería, en comparación con el puente colgante de Angostura, este es muy diferente y más sencillo, es funcional y se adapta a las necesidades de los habitantes, de esta zona pues por ellos no transitan automóviles, solo transeúntes bicicletas y en algunos casos motos (con poco peso), antes de las 7 am iniciamos la caminata y para nuestra sorpresa el astro rey se levantó más temprano que de costumbre, a esa hora ya los rayos del sol, estaban bastante fuertes pero eso no impidió nuestra caminata, luego de tomar agua y organizar lo necesario para el camino, salimos a nuestro destino, que era de aproximadamente 15 kilómetros. Es una carretera de tráfico rápido y hay que ir con mucho cuidado por la acera y caminos de tierra, además estar atentos a las subidas y bajadas de la zona, al principio todo iba muy bien pero a medida que avanzábamos la intensidad del sol nos impedía acelerar el ritmo, pues escogimos justamente el lado por donde más pegaba el sol, con gorras y nuestras botellas de agua seguimos avanzando y debo decir que fue una linda experiencia, de hecho es la segunda vez que hago caminata, la primera la hice en Caripe y era un espacio totalmente diferente, aquí íbamos por la orilla de la carretera, observando los ríos, la vegetación, las viviendas y más, el pueblo cuenta con varias viviendas y familias que se dedican a la producción de casabe y cultivo de varios rubros, también tiene una pequeña pequeña iglesia. ![Caminata (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqNEGP1WSWkBkvJ6d4nAvqFVgTrwhVhG5ip58ivnjdu5xLXS2jvAjjJnmR7U693E4q1.jpeg) ![Caminata (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EopspsBqtjYEckw92xxxkX9U3eL7Mc4ZxuZVGw7FyvxyjrsiVv76BS8rcQJtCXiA124.jpeg) ![Caminata (8).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Ep3eKqrNj3oYzua4WgQDco5kjkeBdj56P2bozcgnmPd7m7rB8AEbnDbvsdsyHLPiLJ7.jpeg) ![Caminata (12).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpNnQJfkKcPK7L3rmn3hdQi4NgvNqLFhCzkMybe9dbkqc26W5VWctnFmhrnpxGLSJEc.jpeg) ![Caminata (13).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eoc6XwKJJHTsv3Y7kkzBfo68RKrE5koN4KnFpmjLnUq5uGQkbB6VBbmygaCPn3CMv8B.jpeg) ![Caminata (15).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpEJJNuQ7uigz8z9J9Qtud8HyJRKc8w1qYy4nKwXs59KrcNLzZHosbPM5Q6wEKQScLd.jpeg) ![Caminata (19).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Ep5mo4VS9bitsjv4EUGmQwcMh7t6UwzouytJxvcW2qne3d788do9mgcVgNqnXcHxeei.jpeg)

> Our first stop was near the church, where we spoke with some residents. As we continued our walk, two things caught my attention: the dryness of the vegetation and the practically dry waterways, some with very little water. Regarding the vegetation, on other visits I've made to this area, the mountain was always green with abundant vegetation at its base. This time, I observed several areas devoid of vegetation, with dry trees and, most curiously, some branches with dry leaves while others remained green. According to one of the men we spoke with, this is due to the sun's effect on the tree; the part that receives the most sunlight dries out faster than the others. There are even trees near the river or a small stream that exhibit this characteristic: dry leaves alongside several branches with green leaves. According to this information, this year's drought has been different from previous years; the trees have retained their leaves for longer, and there are still areas with abundant vegetation.

> Nuestra primera parada, fue cerca de la iglesia, donde conversamos con algunos residentes, mientras avanzábamos en el recorrido llamaron mi atención la atención dos elementos, la sequedad en la vegetación y los cursos de agua prácticamente secos y algunos con muy poca agua, en cuanto a la vegetación, en otras visitas que hecho por esta zona, la montaña se veía siempre verde y con abundante vegetación al pie de monte, en esta ocasión pude observar varios espacios sin vegetación, árboles secos y algunos árboles, que fue lo más curioso, noté tienen algunas ramas con hojas secas y otras las conservan verde, según uno de los señores con quien conversamos, esto se debe a la incidencia que tiene el sol sobre el árbol, la parte que más recibe los rayos solares se va a secar más rápido que las otras, incluso hay árboles que estando cerca del río o un pequeño curso de agua tienen esta característica, hojas secas y conservan también varias ramas con hojas verdes, de acuerdo a esta información este año el período de sequía ha sido diferente a los anteriores, los árboles han permanecido más tiempo con las hojas y aún hay áreas con abundante vegetación. ![Caminata (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqjWfuqKG4XpE61GqDbjP5i7r7wdxDKb9nuoXTxNrRV8F8eFvhBiE5EVrDmMBdMSEUX.jpeg) ![Caminata (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqHyVwzLkEaR7sKZXaGxshcXBHq4jwiGNB1AMjQDBvQCemc3zm9iLAGN348D3suQwYp.jpeg) ![Caminata (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqFrvA8y99PJ32XivEriT2fFXdPtCmXujseTZPm9R9mbcnZrdnC21R1ZgtsZVKcjjQT.jpeg) ![Caminata (40).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqhNpPmYyMXDaV19o6n3ZmD4awYm3BUjXzjr846M7wGjVu4ZRneyLgDQZUryM5v6yWk.jpeg) ![Caminata (37).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Epdgg6Lm2NtJXkkBQ3Yqwx6Jaq7UGCXAfLpnBbJLhNjX5iMKT8tcNc2nSEAsKEv6o17.jpeg) ![Caminata (39).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqomUHJo6NAFFqFoYJQnDWcBoPitBHcvSDoWogxre8gfxQhV8soHuZu2KY5uSP776Ai.jpeg)

> Unlike the vegetation, the rivers have dried up faster, as have watercourses like springs and streams. In this area, a stream usually runs right behind the house, but we only saw it in a few places. One of the residents (a girl's uncle) accompanied us on the walk, as he had an errand to run. He explained that one of the most voluminous rivers now only has a small trickle of water, as he calls it, and in it, you can see the rocks that characterize these rivers. He also argues that the drought affecting the plants is due to the burning of the land, which some farmers do to clear the soil, fertilize it, and finally plant the seeds. With the arrival of the rains, the soil moistens, the fields turn green, the plants sprout, and in time, they bear fruit. Regarding the rivers, as we traveled, I observed dry riverbeds with many rocks. Some, approximately two meters deep, showed only a small trickle of water with completely dry rock walls. This is also due to the dry season. With the arrival of the rains, the river flow increases considerably, and the locals maintain constant monitoring. Nature is indeed wise; when it seems the river will not flow and vegetation is scarce, the rains arrive to bring life to the land and begin a new cycle. Each period or season has specific functions that contribute to maintaining the balance of the environment. The company of this kind gentleman was very pleasant and enriching. Undoubtedly, on-site observation is of great importance for understanding the characteristics of a given ecosystem.

> Contrario a la vegetación, los ríos se han secado más rápido y los cursos de agua como manantiales y quebradas también, en esta zona regularmente por los fondos de la casa pasa un curso de agua y los vimos en muy pocas partes, uno de los residentes (tío de una chica) nos acompañó en la caminata, pues debe hacer una diligencia y nos fue explicando que uno de los ríos más caudaloso, solo tiene un pequeño hilo de agua, como él lo llama y en él se observan las rocas que caracterizan a estos ríos, también argumenta que la sequía en las plantas se debe a la quema del terreno, que hacen algunos agricultores para limpiar la tierra, abonar y finalmente plantar las semillas, con la llegada de las lluvias el suelo se humedece, el campo reverdece, brotan las plantas y a su tiempo obtienen los frutos. En cuanto a los ríos, a medida que avanzábamos pude observar ríos secos y con muchas rocas, en algunos que son de aproximadamente dos metros de profundidad solamente se veía un pequeño curso de agua y las paredes laterales de roca totalmente secas, esto obedece también al período de sequía, con la llegada de las lluvias el caudal de los ríos aumenta considerablemente y los habitantes mantienen un monitoreo permanente, la naturaleza si que es sabia, cuando parece que el río no va a fluir y la vegetación escasea, llegan las lluvias para darle vida al campo e iniciar un nuevo ciclo, cada período o estación tiene funciones específicas que contribuyen a mantener el equilibrio en el ambiente. La compañía de este amable señor fue muy agradable y con grandes enseñanzas, definitivamente la observación *in situ*, es de gran importancia para conocer las características de un determinado ecosistema. ![Caminata (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eokc6t6Y9oVL9gG4avXQ4NWmqtBF7naqmMKhKFkniThpcL3DaZTktWST2pHJBFjm3kV.jpeg) ![Caminata (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpvjR4mN7D1sCzgcfbodPHoxgV7bhV1E3bhg3YjhAgZGJsqdvhuVE5ysApmfHqEx4sJ.jpeg) ![Caminata (11).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpLg3Qr62UBMPcJp2svtNUJGKK73DJSiiPRFe3V86iSKLPLJ7MfPTLADkSkrxH3RxsA.jpeg) ![Caminata (17).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpT3CcLPuoVWsjhr3hLAgBUkyNirra8Q6KkJV9PArTYXjWMfxpxhRCcMLmsmEzwtNQ3.jpeg) ![Caminata (21).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EqfGoaHzwKzBTthziYRZyU9ry5DFLJirckt1Xi6dKh4Bz2FBqqcKpygztDnQk1FLYui.jpeg) ![Caminata (38).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpEHHpLwZabNqE8YgDV5itzZYLhYX64777XRrcivsKBv2N5Yi66iiqLSUbuuELpNSV3.jpeg) ![Caminata (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EpNnPDjEUeEjRo1AgvuUkocTpDxQk4o3uKYv2CYMADPB5i4igXsrE1dZeQXexGRkpfa.jpeg) ![Caminata (23).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Ep3dLG77qDGF8axF4n4A5Xkfv7fG2wkF9tpknGzehpUkiy62bmLSsnwCxVAwWfUHscG.jpeg)
