title.title: (ESP/ENG) Helados Caseros de Choco Coco 🌴 // Homemade Chocolate Coconut Ice Cream 🌴
title.body: > Hola feliz noche para todos y feliz inicio de semana 💕 deseo que se encuentren super bien ❤️‍🩹 el fin de semana hice unos deliciosos helados y es que los días han estado tan calurosos así que le cayeron a los niños.como anillo al dedo... La realidad es que hice esto helados con galletas de coco, estás tenían varios días ya destapadas y realmente no quería perderlas así que se me ocurrió hacer estos helados... Les comparto mi idea 💡 **INGREDIENTES:** 1 1/2 de agua 5 cucharadas de leche en polvo 1 1/2 de cacao en polvo 1 cucharada de harina de trigo Galletas de sabor a coco Chispas de chocolate ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV2ok7VuZN3noS3ZKogEFTnHYWwqbnJK7cix5QE4TPWxf/1773108432537.jpg) **PASO A PASO:** Primero hice el chocolate para esto tome una olla, la coloque a fuego medio ahí agregue el agua, la leche mezcle bien, luego el chocolate en polvo y seguí mezclando inmediatamente agregue la harina de trigo pues está será la encargada de darle esa textura cremosa. Dejamos cocinar hasta que se vuelva un poco espeso; por último se deja reposar hasta enfriar... ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWvynNhCMtu8sCzGdShEkcT2QExNYwgGPMEANUCdUuHuJ/1773108745136.jpg) Ahora una vez este frío agregamos la galletas y procesamos en la licuadora ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeXcABNL7EuVNhRRiopCFjCFEyxid1jQ7qdAdvoaVnjUS/1773108823689.jpg) Triture un poquito de galletas para decorar ![]![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSUhc1iHfM4ZuioRB3ss9Ji3Wyr8kZoSiiRjk8tM6bCw9/1773108893830.jpg) Con todo listo, pasamos a la etapas de armar .. Coloque 6 vasos desechables, abajo le coloque una capa de galletas trituradas luego agregue mi chocolate cremoso, agregue las gotas de chocolate y finalicé con galleta triturada. Así quedó listo, lleve al congelador por 24hrs ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaToDtA3bAzHSmx9G1v5GgyMAy1LtvT16EHDxALFNLpsp/1773109139177.jpg) Ya pasado el día podemos disfrutar, quedan muy ricos y realmente siento que lo hice con las cositas que tenía en casa... ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWeyurnQnLpLXYHipSzVXZvzyfxX4ceXGiAcetiNHcyXt/1773109298852.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaGxJcnV9gqj3vhrhP3HQcJbVGpQkNkkXiUvU9cNPRzLj/1773109299118.jpg) La galleta puede variar el sabor, puede ser vainilla o galletas choco maní lo que tengan. También el chocolate puede ser solo leche o hacer una nata casera y eso quedará muy rica estoy segura... ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVwKvmRfxityvXnQPygPGMGEomTdBiNyq2sBewDEXeqEG/1773109399127.jpg) Deseo que les guste y que lo hagan en casa... Con mucho cariño **Portada editada con Canva** **Fotografías de mi propiedad** **Traductor DeepL** (https://images.ecency.com/DQmPQLemFz2DZkemgdschWSJuYGD5KfksQWGPNzeAfqS7xq/1773102343027.png) Good evening, everyone, and happy start to the week 💕 I hope you are all doing great ❤️‍🩹 Over the weekend, I made some delicious ice cream because it has been so hot, and the kids loved it... The truth is that I made this ice cream with coconut cookies. They had been open for several days and I really didn't want to waste them, so I came up with the idea of making this ice cream... Here's my idea 💡 **INGREDIENTS:** 1 1/2 cups water 5 tablespoons powdered milk 1 1/2 cups cocoa powder 1 tablespoon wheat flour Coconut-flavored cookies Chocolate chips ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV2ok7VuZN3noS3ZKogEFTnHYWwqbnJK7cix5QE4TPWxf/1773108432537.jpg) **STEP BY STEP:** First, I made the chocolate. To do this, I took a pot, placed it over medium heat, added the water and milk, mixed well, then added the cocoa powder and continued mixing. Immediately after, I added the wheat flour, as this will give it that creamy texture. Let it cook until it thickens a little; finally, let it rest until it cools... ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWvynNhCMtu8sCzGdShEkcT2QExNYwgGPMEANUCdUuHuJ/1773108745136.jpg) Once it has cooled, add the cookies and blend in a blender. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeXcABNL7EuVNhRRiopCFjCFEyxid1jQ7qdAdvoaVnjUS/1773108823689.jpg) Crush a few cookies for decoration. ![]![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSUhc1iHfM4ZuioRB3ss9Ji3Wyr8kZoSiiRjk8tM6bCw9/1773108893830.jpg) With everything ready, we move on to the assembly stage. Place 6 disposable cups, put a layer of crushed cookies at the bottom, then add my creamy chocolate, add the chocolate chips, and finish with crushed cookies. Now it's ready. Put it in the freezer for 24 hours. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaToDtA3bAzHSmx9G1v5GgyMAy1LtvT16EHDxALFNLpsp/1773109139177.jpg) Now that the day is over, we can enjoy them. They're really delicious, and I feel like I made them with the little things I had at home... ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWeyurnQnLpLXYHipSzVXZvzyfxX4ceXGiAcetiNHcyXt/1773109298852.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaGxJcnV9gqj3vhrhP3HQcJbVGpQkNkkXiUvU9cNPRzLj/1773109299118.jpg) The cookie flavor can vary; it can be vanilla or chocolate peanut butter cookies, whatever you have. The chocolate can also be just milk chocolate, or you can make homemade cream, which I'm sure will be delicious... ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVwKvmRfxityvXnQPygPGMGEomTdBiNyq2sBewDEXeqEG/1773109399127.jpg) I hope you like it and make it at home... With much love **Cover edited with Canva** **Photographs owned by me** **DeepL translator**

title.title: The Book of Voice: A Poem about Democracy
title.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmajNeaqDW6q9t1ySoSJ2mnZZUktpsqavvrTQGfQexUvNi/image.png)[](
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmajNeaqDW6q9t1ySoSJ2mnZZUktpsqavvrTQGfQexUvNi/image.png))

***


I refuse to wait for the moon to change
to collect the sounds intertwined in the air
The old calendar still hangs in my heart
with a painting without a canvas, carving your smile
which in the past months
you had transferred to the curve of my lips
then became our smile

The same numbers carved in silence
but the day has passed
tonight we write a story in the sky
about teenagers who spill their tales at the market of voices
in front of cruel pirates
or pirates of one night's warmth

Who knows who can read the book of voices
throughout the four-hour journey
we have built memories
from sounds arranged in a time machine

_Lorong Asa, 2025_
***
The poem above is included in an anthology titled WARNA KITAB SUARA. This anthology of Elections and Democracy is a book published by the Elections Supervisory Agency (Bawaslu). It contains 88 poems from a poetry writing competition held by the Bawaslu of Kulon Progo Regency, Central Java (Indonesia), to commemorate the 7th anniversary of the Bawaslu Regency/City and the 80th anniversary of Indonesian independence.

The poetry competition received 134 poems, which were then curated by a panel of judges consisting of Marwanto (Chairman of the Kulon Progo Bawaslu), Fajar Pramukti (Head of the Kulon Progo Bawaslu Secretariat), and Fajar Ayuningtyas (Kulon Progo Literary Community). Of the 134 entries, 88 were selected and deemed worthy of publication in this anthology.[]
***

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWUjLd1ZkBiD9Q5ALoXvKhgPwRQwXBzK9vqCDtk4JsRU7/image.png)[](
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWUjLd1ZkBiD9Q5ALoXvKhgPwRQwXBzK9vqCDtk4JsRU7/image.png))



***

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVNxxL3Tajk6QM6N5xkqUQgabr2ZybLreWBMyPfw8pEgB/image.png)[](
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVNxxL3Tajk6QM6N5xkqUQgabr2ZybLreWBMyPfw8pEgB/image.png))



***

# Kitab Suara
aku menolak penantian bulan berganti
untuk memungut suara yang berkelindan di udara
kalender lama masih tergantung di hati
dengan lukisan tanpa kanvas mengukir senyummu
yang pada bulan-bulan silam
sempat kau pindahkan pada lekuk bibirku
lalu menjadi senyum kita

angka yang sama terpahat sepi
tapi hari sudah berlari 
malam ini kita menggores cerita di angkasa
tentang remaja yang menumpah kisah di pasar suara
di hadapan para lanun kejam
atau perompak kehangatan satu malam

entah siapa yang bisa membaca kitab suara
sepanjang empat jam perjalanan
kita telah membangun kenangan
dari suara yang tertata dalam mesin waktu

_Lorong Asa, 2025_
***
Puisi di atas dimuat dalan buku antologi berjudul WARNA KITAB SUARA.  Antologi Pemilu dan Demokrasi ini merupakan buku yang diterbitkan oleh Bawaslu yang berisi 88 puisi hasil dari lomba penulisan puisi yang diselenggarakan oleh Bawaslu Kabupaten Kulon Progo, Jawa Tengah (Indonesia) dalam rangka memperingati hari jadi Bawaslu Kabupaten/Kota yang ke 7 dan 80 tahun kemerdekaan Republik Indonesia.

title.title: The Campus Life I Imagined vs The One I Lived
title.body:
Before I gained admission into the university, there were many things I admired about life on campus. From everything I had heard, read in books, and watched on TV, I was convinced it was an experience I needed to have myself.

One of the things I looked forward to was interacting with different kinds of people from all the geo-political zones of the country. I believed it would help me make less harsh judgements, as well as broaden my perspective on different cultures. I also remember watching movies where the girls on campus wore heels to lectures under the hot sun and partied every weekend like it was what brought them to school. 

Some even became responsible for supporting their families financially while still in school. I'll admit that the media never made these things look completely easy, but it also did not show how difficult they could be in reality. None of that was concerning to me at the time because I wanted to experience campus life both as an observer and a participant.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZ2vZ9c6FUrUTWY3QesQixbs8bJ2aLCrpMvgD8zFKPzKg/1000386419.jpg 
 [Image from unsplash ](https://unsplash.com/photos/people-walking-on-park-with-trees-during-daytime-h6QQiYftoO0) 

Personally, I was never obsessed with freedom because my parents raised me in a les restrictive way. They allowed me to go out with my teenage friends and visit their homes during holidays. They were only strict about timing. Each time I stepped out, I was always expected to return home before 6 p.m. This made me curious about experiencing campus life where leaving for a party at 6 p.m. was not considered late and night time was often considered as the time when the real fun started.

I also looked forward to becoming more independent since I would be living away from home. I believed that being on campus would help me build an income stream because I had heard many stories about students who learned skills and earned money while in school. Another thing I anticipated was exploring my style better, just like the girls I watched on TV. I have always loved looking good, and I thought university life would influence my taste in clothing and teach me how to style myself better.

Fortunately, some of these expectations and desires was fulfilled. I bought more clothes and shoes and gradually understood my personal style. I also learned some useful styling tips from my friends on campus. Away from fashion, I made casual friendships that exposed me to different perspectives and helped me connect more easily with people.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXMeYxhexW46Rk6eFFzHH4DrBKR4yuuDJebNG1FhJCvUv/1000386420.jpg 
 [Image from unsplash ](https://unsplash.com/photos/young-girl-writing-in-a-book-at-a-table--TbiGrjeujE) 

However, when it came to attending parties that lasted until dawn, I failed woefully. I realized I did not have the luxury of time to attend them unless I was willing to let my academics suffer, which I was not. Even when I could go out, I often preferred to sleep in than attend those late night parties.
This made me wonder how the girls in Nollywood movies and even some people around my neighbourhood seemed to live such lively social lives while in school. From the outside, it always looked like they were balancing everything finely. Maybe their academics suffered too, who knows?

I also discovered that combining school work with running a business was not as easy as I imagined. I had heard many stories about students who managed both successfully, but it turned out to be too demanding for me. I realized I would either burn out or constantly pause the business just to stay focused on school. So, I gave up on it.

Looking back, the biggest lesson I learned from living on campus is that what we hear or watch about university life is not always a reflection of reality. People often show the enjoyable parts but rarely reveal the true difficulties that come with them.

This is why it is best to take such stories with a grain of salt until you experience things yourself. Whatever seems too perfect or too easy is often missing an important part of the story. In the end, everyone’s campus journey is different, and the most important thing is finding what works for you.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb93G9wX8yBpnnSpgdwegAioiTvZFuRjUie7yHU3FqeRe/1000344395.png
This blog post is a response to the Hive Student's weekly prompt, which you can find  [HERE.](https://ecency.com/hive-109584/@hivestudents/hscpwk33-new-prompt-campus-life) I invite @daverick to participate in the contest this week. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb93G9wX8yBpnnSpgdwegAioiTvZFuRjUie7yHU3FqeRe/1000344395.png

Feliz inicio de semana tengan todos mis apreciados amigos lectores, iniciando una nueva semana donde tenemos la oportunidad de desarrollar cada una de nuestras actividades y realizar las respectivas diligencias personales, en esta oportunidad aprovecho para compartirles otro contenido, asistiendo a mi control de cita médica, en busca de restablecer mi salud integral. La semana pasada específicamente el lunes 2 del presente mes, asistir desde bien temprano a mi control de cita médica y sin embargo tenía dudas de ir, en vista de que la ciudad donde habito tiene problemas de agua es decir la distribución de agua potable por tubería está suspendida en todo el estado Sucre sin embargo tuve el conocimiento de que les han prestado el servicio continuo de cisterna para surtir el hospital del vital líquido, ahora bien mis amigos desde bien temprano, al llegar al lugar indicado me conseguí una gran cantidad de pacientes que también tenían cita ese día y muchos de ellos le iban a aplicar su tratamiento de quimioterapia, lamentablemente a ellos estuvieron que reestructurar a una nueva cita en vista de que las condiciones de higiene no estaban óptimas para aplicarle el tratamiento, muy lamentable esa situación. Puedo decir que según las listas habían más de 40 pacientes para ese día, yo estaba en el grupo de los que tenían consulta médica y sin embargo me tocó pasar toda la mañana para esperar mi turno y ser atendida, gracias a Dios voy bien de igual manera como prevención me mandaron a no desamparar mis diferentes vitaminas y a repetirme un eco de partes blandas en la zona donde estuvo la lesión de piel.

越是成长，越是懒得思考，但是很多事就像有无形的手，推着走，你不得不承认，命运的齿轮一直都在安静的旋转，你愿意不愿意，给你设置好的剧本，你都要经历个够！

title.title: Review: An essential book for understanding José Martí/Reseña: Un libro indispensable para conocer a José Martí(ENG-ESP)
title.body:
On the 170th anniversary of the birth of José Martí, the most universal of Cubans and, despite any differences of opinion among people, a figure who should be remembered by all Cubans who, in one way or another, present or absent, love their land blessed by the existence of men like him.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcz9p63LwJLuixYQDeJAXfsBwr2Wi3MdGbEZNBeMVZPFy/captura_de_pantalla_11_.jpeg)
A fundamental book for understanding his multifaceted figure came into my hands. This book was conceived to humbly approach the human being who, even after his physical passing, possessed a thought powerful enough to influence generations who, to this day, keep his ideals alive. No matter the perspective from which one views him, the challenge will always be to accurately measure the magnitude of this Cuban intellectual, just as we must be able to understand and define other Latin American heroes such as Bolívar, Sucre, San Martín, and others who may come to mind.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWwHneySfJzuRqkRLCoezJCwLTtrkUbjbkgGZ7DN9QYLC/captura_de_pantalla_10_.jpeg)
The book in question, titled \
collection published by Gente Nueva, is by Francisca López Civeira, PhD in Historical Sciences and recipient of the National History Prize. Her authorship includes several books, among them \
The book uses the apostle's own voice to answer questions that any Cuban, or anyone born in Cuba, might have about \

(as he was also known), which is the main reason his words appear in italics.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaqYHtTECRwti9hB16hsVgmhUx3mJSs87RimYfWQmSPfZ/captura_de_pantalla_8_.jpeg)
Questions such as: \

are part of this catalog of questions, inquiries, and doubts that can be fully clarified.

With over 200 pages, the book, its author, and the teacher pave the way for knowledge, allowing you to learn about their thoughts and experiences on the path to Cuban independence and the main traits of their personalities.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdandvtt37qDXQm1U9KWbTkwhVdspekwCXApQ5p87H8eF/captura_de_pantalla_7_.jpeg)
That's why I've dared to speak to you about this book, because it has a completely practical character, where the need to begin reading it doesn't arise on the first page, but rather in the space where the question arises and the answer is given on one of its pages, because any of them can be the starting point for this essential reading.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXMP5ERFBMvo2ajfgAwH2M7djPwMprKo3b9nnRoo5wjWt/texto_11_.jpg)

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZgEYwbWXsPtnALCquFf8frbap3fDb9s56qGhCcPDj5KD/_al_nhyamar78_1_.jpg)</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVY4EGuTB3o3vzY8R4UPP3dV29hXJfLBVDNx5eRYcTprx/versi_n_en_espa_ol_2_.jpg)</center>

Cuando se cumplió el 170 aniversario del natalicio de José Martí, el más universal de los cubanos y que debiera ser, a pesar de cualquier diferencia de pensamiento entre los hombres, para todos los cubanos que de alguna forma u otra, presentes o ausentes aman su tierra bendecida por la existencia de hombres como él.  

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcz9p63LwJLuixYQDeJAXfsBwr2Wi3MdGbEZNBeMVZPFy/captura_de_pantalla_11_.jpeg)
Llegó a mis manos un libro fundamental para acercarse a su extensa figura, un libro ha sido pensado para acercarse humildemente al ser humano que luego de su desaparición física, tuvo en su pensamiento la fuerza suficiente para influir en generaciones que hasta la actualidad mantienen vivo su ideario, no importa la arista desde donde se mire, porque el reto será siempre, saber medir con la vara correcta la magnitud de este cubano intelectual, como también seamos capaces de comprender y definir a otros próceres latinoamericanos como Bolívar, Sucre, San Martín y otros que pueden llegar hasta mi memoria. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWwHneySfJzuRqkRLCoezJCwLTtrkUbjbkgGZ7DN9QYLC/captura_de_pantalla_10_.jpeg)
En libro en cuestión y titulado 100 preguntas sobre José Martí integrante de la colección 100 preguntas de la editorial Gente nueva y de la autora Francisca López Civeira, Dra en ciencias históricas y premio nacional de historia con varios libros a su haber entre los que podemos mencionar, Los hermosos veinte, Cubanos hacia el siglo veinte, 100 preguntas sobre la historia de Cuba, entre otros. Se hace gala y uso de la propia voz del apóstol para contestar desde su propio visor las preguntas que cualquier cubano o no nacido en esta tierra puede hacerse sobre el Pépe (Como también fue conocido), y es la causa principal por el que las palabras del mismo aparecen en cursiva.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaqYHtTECRwti9hB16hsVgmhUx3mJSs87RimYfWQmSPfZ/captura_de_pantalla_8_.jpeg)
Preguntas como: ¿Sabes por qué a Martí lo llamamos héroe Nacional de Cuba y también el Apóstol y el maestro? ¿Cómo percibió Martí los problemas del Indio americano? ¿Cuando se conmemoró públicamente en Cuba, por primera vez, la fecha de nacimiento de José Martí? forman parte de este catálogo de interrogantes, consultas y dudas que pueden ser perfectamente aclaradas.

Con mas de 200 páginas el libro, su autora y el maestro, labran el camino del conocimiento para que usted conozca sobre sus pensamientos y avatares en el camino por la independencia de Cuba y los principales rasgos de su personalidad.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdandvtt37qDXQm1U9KWbTkwhVdspekwCXApQ5p87H8eF/captura_de_pantalla_7_.jpeg)
Por eso me he atrevido a hablarles sobre este libro, por tener un carácter totalmente utilitario, donde la necesidad de comenzarlo no viene en la primera página, sino en el espacio donde se genera la duda y la respuesta dada en una de sus páginas, porque cualquiera de ellas puede ser el principio de la lectura indispensable.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSc7JwGNfhUMw5Wywv3gQkhRwF3jo366vaiZUD2UNGYAt/texto_12_.jpg)

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZgEYwbWXsPtnALCquFf8frbap3fDb9s56qGhCcPDj5KD/_al_nhyamar78_1_.jpg)</center>

Image Source: DALL-E</center>


<center>**My Hive-Engine Daily Report – March 10, 2026**</center>

Today I went a lot wider than usual and spread liquidity across a mix of utility, community, and fun pools. The big headline is a massive BYTE : STEM add, with some strong supporting allocations into MEME : LOLZ and CENT : POB, plus a few smaller “maintenance” top-ups to keep some niche pools healthy.

Overall, this was a “cover the ecosystem” kind of day—one heavy anchor move, then a bunch of smaller strategic reinforcements.

<center>**My Transactions**</center>

Here’s what I added today:

- 9.8246 VOTE + 893.29088780 PAY
This felt like a governance-and-rewards style add—small VOTE alongside a solid PAY side to keep that lane active.

- 1138896 BYTE + 22066.683476 STEM
This was the main event today. BYTE absolutely dominated my allocations—basically a full-on liquidity anchor move into BYTE : STEM.

- 11.78807079 SWAP.HIVE + 0.00001088 SWAP.BTC
A classic “keep the bridge healthy” top-up. I like having SWAP.HIVE : SWAP.BTC supported even when the BTC side is tiny in raw units.

- 0.00000296 SWAP.BTC + 0.00010054 SWAP.ETH
A micro add, but it’s a useful cross-asset connector pool—this one is all about staying plugged into the BTC/ETH gateway flow.

- 257021.9603 MEME + 18598.59978389 LOLZ
Pure fun-energy liquidity. I like giving the meme-side of the DEX some depth—these pools can surprise you with activity spikes.

- 181637.30154904 CENT + 60588.23458903 POB
This one feels like community-building liquidity—CENT and POB both have “social layer” vibes, so I like reinforcing that pairing when I’m broadening coverage.

- 2429.51682 CCC + 2984.70 PHOTO
Creative token support. PHOTO is one of those niche pools that benefits a lot from consistent liquidity.

- 1.46425 CCC + 0.772366 MUSIC
Another creative micro add—small numbers, but it keeps the CCC creative cluster feeling “alive” instead of dusty.

- 172.12974 CCC + 208.77404897 WIT
Finishing the CCC trio with WIT—this one reads like a practical, lightweight reinforcement to round out the CCC-related pools.

<center>**Pie Graph of Transactions**</center>

Below is today’s pie graph showing the proportion of each token I added in total (using raw token amounts). You can immediately see BYTE (~67.6%) dominating, with MEME (~15.2%) and CENT (~10.8%) making up most of the rest—while BTC/ETH show up as tiny slices because their unit sizes are so different.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/holovision.cash/245TLHKGBguD8GqHAL5D4vazzXoYNLdEFmJe2YkQHWZtfjrStwUvzUyT1TQwxn7tms89g.png) Image Source: ChatGPT</center> <center>**My Thoughts / Reflections**</center>

What stands out today is the mix of one huge anchor allocation + ecosystem maintenance:

BYTE led the day (~67.6%), which makes this feel like a conviction move more than casual rebalancing.

MEME and CENT were the next biggest, so I clearly leaned into high-unit, high-community tokens today rather than spreading everything thin.

The SWAP.BTC / SWAP.ETH adds barely register on the chart, but I still like doing those “precision maintenance” adds because those pools matter structurally.

CCC got steady multi-pool support (PHOTO, MUSIC, WIT)—small individually, but together it’s a nice creative-sector reinforcement.

title.title: This is how life looks from a building in Ciego de Ávila, Cuba. [ENG] [ESP]
title.body:
<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQp3TREGcmz83CCX6kmgzzKcra6Y9kq4RYxNgiNKUVu8i/img_2615.jpg)
</center><hr>

Many people imagine Cuba for its beaches or for its streets full of colors, but few wonder what the buildings are like where people live.

> Muchas personas imaginan Cuba por sus playas o por sus calles llenas de colores, pero pocos se preguntan cómo son los edificios donde vive la gente.
<center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNh6rQAq8ZtHFAr2fqB9nSDnA1KD6B2cunRkAXNTAijZ4/img_8137.heic)
</center><hr>

Today I want to show you what one of them looks like, in addition to the views and those little everyday moments that I enjoy so much. Let's start by discovering the environment.

> Hoy quiero mostrarles cómo se ve uno de ellos, además de las vistas y esos pequeños momentos cotidianos que tanto disfruto.Comencemos por descubrir el entorno. 


<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYtafS2uPge8TNSwUtoE3Rbu8iu8J7u3sTJ8Wr5KhnQ1C/img_1958.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVq8GioWpqdfRkjPbNhRzpmTQVgzjbs9C95DVxswYWxst/img_2613.jpg)
<center><hr>

From the heights of the building you can see the contrast between the city and nature: lots of greenery, open sky and a feeling of tranquility that is sometimes not perceived from the street. 

> Desde las alturas del edificio se puede ver el contraste entre la ciudad y la naturaleza: mucho verde, cielo abierto y una sensación de tranquilidad que a veces no se percibe desde la calle.

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX88mK49T3hQr9857BGGf2KgiAemqDEhtSGryTq5P1LwH/img_1963.jpg)
</center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmavFmnm1yRtwKxhPptRNRDn7H8mochL2kdafFagYJR8Vk/img_1956.jpg)
<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWXcrd5ZGLYttdwajQtLc8poEz3VdJZQd9sfBr8Tv4Ans/img_1955.jpg)
<hr>

Like many buildings in Cuba, it has simple spaces but full of life. In them you can see the passage of time and the imprint of those who have passed through here. Some have left their mark in the form of graffiti, names or small declarations of love written on the walls, as if they wanted their memories to remain.
Silent witnesses of those moments are the stairs that we all walk every day and the rooftops, where it seems that the sky is getting a little closer to the earth. 

> Como muchos edificios en Cuba, tiene espacios simples pero llenos de vida. En ellos se puede ver el paso del tiempo y la huella de quienes han pasado por aquí. Algunos han dejado su marca en forma de grafitis, nombres o pequeñas declaraciones de amor escritas en las paredes, como si quisieran que sus recuerdos permanecieran.Testigos silenciosos de esos momentos son las escaleras que todos recorremos cada día y las azoteas, donde parece que el cielo se acerca un poco más a la tierra.

</center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQuiwTxwcmQNLzwm9hsf4jUZyf4BkTbvaVyEjL9SMfJ1K/img_6932.heic)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWNV6Vi7oLnozHRYNgP6mEcoc2mSoz1M5E3QPRT4GG3fi/img_0294.png)
<hr>

One of the things I enjoy the most is watching how the light changes throughout the day. Sometimes the sun enters through the windows in a way that transforms the environment and even the mood. Everything is filled with calm, as if for a moment I were in a fairy tale. 

> Una de las cosas que más disfruto es observar cómo cambia la luz a lo largo del día. A veces el sol entra por las ventanas de una forma que transforma el ambiente y hasta el estado de ánimo. Todo se llena de calma, como si por un instante estuviera en un cuento de hadas.

<center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVvdmmC2zeMRS4y7pHUJ6GGMs2Xc9MSjnjjqavfGFoZVn/img_0296.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYTH3ExPjoq6iL4jVHkMNAQ1Ly3rqRL22umHF4Eh6NBdv/img_6600.jpg)
<hr>

Sometimes I like to just sit and watch the sunset from here. And I take the opportunity to take some photos, trying to capture those moments of peace that appear in the middle of the routine. 

> En ocasiones me gusta simplemente sentarme a mirar el atardecer desde aquí. Y aprovecho para tomar algunas fotos, intentando capturar esos momentos de paz que aparecen en medio de la rutina.

</center>
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcfUzk9i7qX6a7yRGryDZqJd5rzLEU8XYTsqFZWtvsmay/img_2660.jpg)
<hr>

This building is not just a place to live. It is also a small viewpoint from which I can find tranquility in a life that sometimes feels too hectic. Small everyday details that, in some way, make Cuban buildings unique.

\

> Este edificio no es solo un lugar donde vivir. También es un pequeño mirador desde el que puedo encontrar tranquilidad en una vida que a veces se siente demasiado agitada.Pequeños detalles cotidianos que, de alguna manera, hacen únicos a los edificios cubanos.

 “Espero que hayan disfrutado de este recorrido.”

title.title: I finally finished Metro 2033 Last Light Redux | INCREDIBLE GAME
title.body:
![GIF1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23swZhLm1qzjYHSscpdSn35tjEDvszm6P32w9A8Hu2jg3yFDNxarLoiMRtKmw4LBcsMqr.gif)

Hey gamers, how are you? I hope you're all doing well. So, as part of my mission this year to play through as many games as possible, I finally finished Metro 2033 Last Light Redux, a fantastic game without a doubt. Metro 2033 was definitely one of those games that made a lasting impression on me when it came out. When it was first released, it was incredibly innovative due to its setting and other features. I played the original title and later played the remake (Redux), and then the game I'm writing this article about, which is its sequel, Metro Last Light Redux. As you know, I've written a few articles about this game. Not long ago, I wrote about a truly deadly enemy, but I managed to defeat the Mother Bear and move forward. More than recounting an adventure in the game, this is a piece about my experience with Metro throughout its entire history. There are no spoilers, so if you haven't played Metro 2033, you can read it without any problems.

# Metro has been quite a journey

![0126 (2)(6).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23xVGrAbGqg3GbLvvZacT4UQK2G3MC2g9T1UQdrowqaAHoRS1JK7nWaNL4fghWoFfH3ir.jpg)

From the moment I started playing Metro, I found the immersive process to be incredibly well-designed. The game completely plunges you into the atmosphere of the stations, creating a strange sense of comfort amidst the struggle for survival, and of course, anxiety and terror in many other scenarios. It's one of those games that's an emotional rollercoaster, and it certainly lives up to its country of origin. Undoubtedly, the ongoing conflict with the protagonist in this second installment is a plot that will answer many questions about the ending of the first game. Virtually everything he believed to be true, from friendships to comrades in arms, is affected by the realities of war, revealing a side of them he never expected. 


![0126 (2)(3).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23u5ZbR5NcLPELz2BWVQ2fKoy6jj5NDrcDJgdst3fjhxcbcHGDJMfDquKA9pbkWgGC5bd.jpg)


Along with traitors and false friends, he will find those who will fight alongside him to the end to uncover the dark secret within the Spartan order. The story surrounding the character is filled with intense moments of death, destruction, desolation, and a harsh, bitter gray landscape, where loneliness, despair, and the strange feeling of needing to see other human beings or find some small refuge are often palpable. I believe this is one of the most impressive aspects of the game's narrative immersion, something that is undoubtedly very well done. I can conclude that Metro offers one of those stories with memorable characters, warriors who make difficult decisions and who would undoubtedly do anything for their loved ones.

# Metro's landscapes tell a chilling story

![0126 (2)(2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23zbPkVn95wyD7zPyw4MbuCodFT3VDRqprmTDh4QSirbRioK5SxDUV5yJtbRrrqkbJvHf.jpg)

While the story itself—life, the suffering of growing up in a post-apocalyptic world inhabited by unknown beings and mutant creatures—is already quite difficult, the game's landscapes are undoubtedly unparalleled in their terrifying and desolate nature. There is no landscape that offers tranquility, harmony, or respite from the constant threat of being pursued or ambushed by mutants or enemies. The short stretches where we literally see no one, but are solely surrounded by the landscape, are memorable. The sense of nuclear catastrophe they evoke is unparalleled. They are exceptionally well-crafted and convey death without needing to show you many corpses—though there are some, but the landscapes themselves, the color palette, and the radioactive elements create the perfect combination that complements the game's story and the hero's journey.


# Humanity will always remain the same

![0126 (2)(10).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23wMRcsM5iNE499jxmcf43quc7Nb5xmwrB4FLe53RR5WxabkAJ4vevY1BthSKJ4QR8goJ.jpg)

One of the game's great morals is that humans will remain human no matter what. Despite the context and the year in which humanity unfolds, in the chilling post-apocalyptic desolation, humankind remains enmeshed in the same conflicts of power, politics, and the absolute need for total control, divided into groups, isolating those who don't think the same way, and generating a new society of organized armies that fight each other until yet another extinction. This is a point that both the game and the author of the novel on which it's based make clear.

![0126 (2)(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tkhS9ok3QSDujSkpLZGL6mnrWqwUPg8gU5Fft1isZXAcf1jam4ZpsuWTug3432hPYx5.jpg)

# Metro Last Light Redux 2033 was memorable

![0126 (2)(4).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23w2gpEuZ8V8wctZCQtQ3XfWHPtjZGk7QSEWpKpzZv12AywGttbJZ1hiMwNaWGzgipPB3.jpg)

Metro offers an epic finale in a massive battle against the Red Army where you can practically use your entire arsenal accumulated in your previous missions, along with new weapons that appear as the battle progresses. The battle has three phases, each more intense than the last, until you think you've won and the final enemy appears. 


![0126 (2)(7).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23xVJmbfQZMsZDYweHJBhHGJAbvmcCcqZre9b3jHdjVrtENVAjqfPSejLLKmDNvF448nG.jpg)


I can't really say much about this because it would be a spoiler, but I can tell you that if you like strategic FPS games with a good story, action sequences, stealth, and often total destruction in an emotionally charged narrative, you'll really enjoy Metro. I don't want to tell you more because I don't want to reveal anything, but the ending is tremendous considering everything that happens. So, gamers, see you in the next post.


![0126 (2)(9).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/242NeskwJLjKsqc1TPppjWCC96xeLSS7hezC4qskuZX4Jb5AptjffQNEa5jz5KSbYpnh8.jpg)

title.title: Harmony.
title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gf6a2aec26fe05b2321c2c3c78385cce38d04df138410a81a3dda7aecc4bc200e8b01804d818a8e8e87d67d888d4f60e311ce03112f3a31de0ff850cb3987ef57_640.jpg)</center>

***

# The Tale of the Harmonious Forest

In a lush, green valley, there lay a forest known as the Harmonious Forest. This forest was home to a diverse array of creatures—birds, deer, rabbits, and even wise old owls. Each creature played a vital role in maintaining the delicate balance of the ecosystem. The trees whispered secrets to the wind, while the rivers sang songs of life to the earth.

## The Celebration of Harmony

One day, the creatures decided to hold a grand celebration to honor their harmony. They gathered under the ancient oak tree, where the wise old owl was to share his wisdom. As the sun dipped below the horizon, casting a golden glow over the forest, the creatures danced and sang, reveling in their unity.

The wise old owl perched high on a branch, observing the joyous scene. When the time was right, he spoke:

> \

## The Seeds of Discontent

As the days turned into weeks, the creatures became complacent. The rabbits started to overpopulate, munching on the young plants that the deer needed for food. The birds, feeling secure in their numbers, began to squabble over territory, disrupting the peaceful songs that once filled the air.

The wise old owl noticed the changes but remained silent, believing that the creatures would soon realize their mistakes. However, the tension grew, and the once harmonious forest began to feel the strain of imbalance.

## The Breaking Point

One fateful day, the rabbits, in their greed, devoured the last of the young plants. The deer, hungry and desperate, confronted the rabbits, leading to a fierce argument. The birds, caught in the crossfire, abandoned their songs, and the forest fell silent.

The wise old owl finally spoke up, his voice echoing through the stillness:

> \

## The Path to Restoration

Realizing the truth in the owl's words, the creatures gathered to discuss their grievances. They acknowledged their mistakes and agreed to work together to restore balance. The rabbits would help plant new seeds, the deer would share their grazing grounds, and the birds would sing songs of encouragement to unite them once more.

Slowly but surely, the forest began to heal. The plants grew back, the creatures found their equilibrium, and the songs of the birds returned, filling the air with harmony once again.

## The Lesson Learned

From that day forward, the creatures of the Harmonious Forest understood that harmony is not merely the absence of conflict but a continuous effort to respect and support one another. They learned to communicate openly and to appreciate the unique roles each creature played in their ecosystem.

### Wisdom to Take Away

> **Harmony requires active participation; it is a fragile state that must be nurtured, lest it be lost.**

title.title: Musical Monday this is my cover of \
- JVKE by @oneysoul
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeaJmdyxMJsXYootLZAoLv3w8y5dwLUtLoFhyUmAUN3dc/20250513202313.jpg)

https://youtu.be/QVRZ9GxAMdM?si=tfTIWQXcOQay_hlh
Hey Music Zone family,  
For this Musical Monday I’m bringing you my cover of “Golden Hour” by JVKE. It’s one of those songs that feels like a snapshot of pure light — simple, emotional, and honest. That’s why I chose it.  

I kept it stripped down: just my voice and guitar. The original has this dreamy vibe, but underneath it’s about being present in a perfect moment. I didn’t want to overcomplicate it — no effects, no tricks, just me trying to let the song breathe. After a few takes, I found one that felt real, and I’m happy with it.  

Big thanks for always pushing our community forward. Having spaces like this where we can share music and connect means a lot.  

To everyone listening: I didn’t try to reinvent the song. Sometimes the best thing you can do is let music stay true to itself. That’s what I tried to do here.  

---

Versión en Español

Hola familia de Music Zone,  
En este Musical Monday les comparto mi versión de “Golden Hour” de JVKE. Es una canción que se siente como un instante de pura luz — sencilla, emotiva y honesta. Por eso la elegí.  

La grabé solo con mi voz y una guitarra. La original tiene un aire soñador, pero en el fondo habla de estar presente en un momento perfecto. No quise complicarlo — sin efectos, sin trucos, solo dejar que la canción respire. Después de varias tomas encontré una que se siente auténtica, y me quedé contento con ella.  

Un agradecimiento por seguir impulsando nuestra comunidad. Tener espacios como este, donde podemos compartir música y conectar, significa mucho.  

Para quienes escuchen: no intenté reinventar la canción. A veces lo mejor es dejar que la música sea fiel a sí misma. Eso fue lo que busqué aquí.

title.title: Victory Streak - a Master of YI ? / LoL Wildrift
title.body:
>


Good evening, #HiveGaming community. Guess who got another consecutive victory with the fantastic and unparalleled Master Yi in League of Legends: Wild Rift? Today I'm continuing to share my winning streak with this champion, one of my many favorites in League of Legends, especially on the mobile version.

>Muy buenas noches, comunidad de #HiveGaming. ¿Adivinen quién tuvo otra victoria consecutiva con el fantástico e inigualable Maestro Yi en Lol Wild Rift? Hoy les continúo compartiendo mi racha de victorias obtenidas con este personaje, uno de mis tantos favoritos de League of Legends y más aún en la versión para teléfono.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P5pyrQhCgfs

<div class=\

>

One of the best characters in this game is this ninja swordsman who can increase his health with a talent called meditation and deal massive damage so quickly that he vanishes from sight. As always, I like to get first blood, so at the start, I head into the enemy jungle to hunt down my foe.

> Sí, así es, amigos, sigo manteniendo mi racha de partidas invictas con este campeón que resulta ser tan ágil como un ninja y tan rápido como un rayo. Como bien saben, soy de los que les gusta profundizar un poco en la jungla enemiga para matar a mi enemigo o, en este caso, matar al mob que apareció en el lado contrario.

<center>![5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23tGZeCStFDw7e92JzXcT8Zz6XE9uAgC1p9cWC5oLexQj5HSewSqfdjuFiaA6Hbt67uVS.png)</center>


<div class=\

>

The enemy jungler took his time getting started, and I couldn't resist taking advantage of that to leave him without a crucial mob on his side that would allow him to level up. So, after that, I went to my side and killed the mobs I was supposed to.

You could call it cheating, but I prefer to see it as gaining an advantage and making the most of my time to get ahead of the enemy. This allows me to level up faster and also obtain my abilities in the shortest possible time.

> El jugador jungla del equipo contrario se tomó su tiempo para empezar y yo no pude evitar aprovecharme de ello para dejarlo sin un mob importante en su lado que le permite subir de nivel. Así que luego de ello me dispuse a recorrer mi lado y matar los mobs respectivos que me tocaban.
>
> Podría decirse que es hacer trampa, pero prefiero verlo como tomar ventaja y aprovechar al máximo mi tiempo para poder adelantarme al enemigo. Esto me permite subir de nivel más rápido y también obtener mis poderes en el menor tiempo posible.

<center>![6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23tGY58doSGzMBgwQdg9X88ECEZJvYHhychu1cipsbvU9pTM59xuu1D1frXhL5LimRcwn.png)</center>


<div class=\

>


And if you check out my video on my YouTube channel, you'll see my incredible feat when I managed to steal the dragon that the enemy team was determined to get first, even though I had a slim chance of doing so. This proves that as long as I'm in charge of the jungle, no dragon or baron will fall into the enemy team's hands.


> Y si le dan una oportunidad a mi video en mi canal de YouTube, podrán ver mi gran hazaña cuando alcancé con una mínima probabilidad a robar el dragón que el equipo enemigo estaba empeñado en obtener primero. Con esto les demuestro que mientras yo esté a cargo de la jungla, ningún dragón ni barón pasará a manos del equipo contrario.

<center>![7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/Eo1wwM92LzDRWBMj3vbVun3jfqW6AStDrR8HKHbXWPpTss3jHQQcKFpC9Y5iLNsTYZ7.png)</center>

<div class=\

>

I think nothing in this game is more frustrating than having your most powerful monster stolen, but it feels so good when you manage to get it back for your team's benefit. You could say they're two sides of the same coin. And the best part is that I not only stole the dragon, but I also killed it two more times, and the baron too.


> Creo que nada da más impotencia en este juego que te roben el monstruo más poderoso, pero se siente tan bien cuando logras obtenerlo para beneficio de tu equipo. Se podría decir que son dos caras de una misma moneda. Y lo mejor es que no sólo robé al dragón sino que lo maté 2 veces más y también al barón.

<center>![8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23tGbnYPGaV3uczaQJWnNPXCEZtemPg5hyaWHgd19E4qBgzHK1iiw9BYbu8Ww74kHkBCe.png)</center>

<div class=\

>

But seriously, sometimes it's more luck than anything else that everything goes so well, and if we hadn't killed the baron or the dragons, I think the opposing team would have beaten us without any problems because they were playing very offensively.


> Pero hablando un poco en serio, a veces es más suerte que todo se dé así tan bien, y de no haber matado al barón ni a los dragones, yo creo que el equipo contrario nos hubiera ganado sin problemas porque estaban jugando muy a la ofensiva.

<div class=\

>

And now I'll share the results. As you can see, I'm now Mastery 2 with Master Yi; in my previous post, I wasn't at this level yet, and I reached Mastery 3 in Platinum. Also, as always, I've included the final results table with all the players so you can see how close the match was between the teams.

> Y ahora les comparto los resultados obtenidos. Como pueden ver, ya soy maestría 2 con Maestro Yi; en mi anterior post todavía no era este nivel y en platino subí al tercer nivel. Además, les dejo como siempre la tabla final de resultados con todos los jugadores para que vean lo reñida que estuvo la partida entre los equipos.

<center>![13.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23tkhYsE7vbwumiVcZfPUvvhTLF74hnpfnBu2pDXkwkkd83hsnQ9cRKRb6dkUmeQHkKnf.png)</center>


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

<center>![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/EoCaQHNhNZwVfPjoaredxPGRtyenZDN34vt4uBNkSmZfYmtrbMK1xJ3DMYXge4TeZuP)</center>

<div class=\

> Before I go, I'm sharing my profile picture so you can invite me to play over there. That's all for now, but not before thanking everyone who took a few minutes to read this. title.title: Okora the Devourer: A Powerful Hunter Combining Opportunity and Bloodlust!
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXSe3VC2DV4tDcgbEziAvdAQnmRtNjFAMTf2o1LZPzew8/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog! We'll be looking at another Escalation card in today's post. This time it's the legendary Okora the Devourer. What makes her special is she is like one of my favorite gladiator cards: Fina Voxom that has both Opportunity and Bloodlust abilities, making her a strong damage dealer once her bloodlust gets triggered. 

***

# Lore

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmarPS1YobhYmgrpnXkvAbGHW3Heky6S9uWiHsSRN24Sj4/image.png)

I like how her lore explains why she is a Dragon splinter with Ulund bloodline. She gained her magic from eating the heart of a chaos dragon. That transformed her to a Dragon splinter and gave her dual attack of range and magic. She also got her title \

. 

>*While the Ascendency deliberated their next move, Okora descended into the fortress-city's deepest vaults. There, mounted on an obsidian pedestal, sat the preserved heart of a chaos dragon, one of the Host's greatest. The beast had burned entire armies before the rebels brought it down. The Ascendency kept its heart as a trophy.*

>*Okora stared at it. Then she lifted the organ in one hand, opened her massive jaws, and devoured it.*

>*Dragon magic flooded her body. Her ulund physiology rejected it, fought it, tried to expel it. Okora refused to let go.*

>*When the transformation was complete, she walked to the Ascendency's war room. The guards moved to block her. Dragon magic flared and they were hurled aside. She pushed open the doors.*

>*\

*

***

# Stats and Abilities

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUUm8PVnJ83hxTTFcXuTHHGBtbCFP8b1uj3ghEeZcpntv/image.png)

Okora is a nine mana Dragon splinter. She deals dual damage of two range and two magic. She also has eight health and is fast with five speed. Like Fina Voxom, she has Opportunity ability that enables her to hunt down enemy low health units. This will trigger her bloodlust and make her stronger after each enemy she defeats. She has other abilities but the combination of Opportunity and Bloodlust are her most powerful ones. 

***

# Rulesets and Combos

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdCXybi34TsvMsMbw83UREo7ePdjfTEbTe12p4BnaSb8n/image.png)

Being a long range attacker, Okora will be great in Going the Distance rulesets where her dual attacks will give her team a definite advantage. She's a good damage dealer in the backline protected by strong tanks in front. I would use a dual tank combo in front with her in the back. 

She can also be in an all Ulund team with the Bella Ratajowlski archon where she will get a Shield ability. She can combo with another Ulund legendary card, Moribund Arrowbait whose Bloodline Tribute ability will further increase Okora's stats.

***

# Featured Battle

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRTZiWPxGovruF25RLwzZMgucvJUqiMvVuzM2U2SX5wZn/image.png)

In the featured battle, player THEGCC used the combo I mentioned above. He had Bella archon and Moribund Arrowbait in the first position to activate her Bloodline Tribute ability and empower all ulunds in the team including Okora. THEGCC's team was not particularly strong and even included a level two Lifeward Channeler. 

His enemy also had an ulund team and had a mostly maxed units except for the zero mana card that was only level one. They both had the Moribund Arrowbait in first position but his enemy had more ulunds in his team.

Okora gained stats from Bloodline Tribute and her own bloodlust. Her attacks drastically increased to six range and seven magic while her speed was insane at fifteen. At this round, it's clear THEGCC will already win the battle. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWX9kjwDNiAjiSKKZw9KG7FSAVuiQFQA1E8Df6uxPsiCQ/image.png)

[Link](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_c08a3560ffd93f541124e6e4ca6ba44f?ref=logen9f)

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. Buying a spellbook allows you to earn SPS tokens and use the  market to sell in game assets. Also, we will both get 500 Credits which can be used top purchase cards once you buy a spellbook.

title.title: The first camera stabilization system mounted directly on a wheelchair
title.body:
The first camera stabilization system mounted directly on a wheelchair


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Us5GypTc47o

> A dream come true.


Irish filmmaker Christopher Lynch was born with osteogenesis imperfecta, a genetic condition known as “brittle bone” disease that makes bones extremely brittle and limits their ability to bear weight. Throughout his life he claims to have suffered more than 100 fractures, yet he always wanted to work as a camera operator in the film industry, a profession known for demanding great physical effort, especially when using heavy filming equipment.


But rather than abandon the idea, Lynch decided to create a solution. After 5 years of development, he created the Caerus Steadicam, considered the first camera stabilization system mounted directly on a wheelchair. The system was designed to work coupled to the Genny Zero, a self-balancing wheelchair capable of turning in very small spaces and reaching speeds of up to 20 km/h.


This allows operators to perform complex camera movements without the need for additional rails or equipment. The autonomy reaches about 25 km, allowing continuous filming both indoors and outdoors. Another interesting detail is that all the weight of the camera and equipment is distributed in the structure of the wheelchair, eliminating the need for the operator to carry heavy weights.


This does not only benefit people with disabilities and even operators without physical limitations can use the system to reduce fatigue during long recordings. The equipment can also be operated remotely or by camera assistants. In case the user needs to focus solely on controlling the chair. The result is a tool that expands inclusion in the audiovisual industry and at the same time there will be new creative possibilities for camera movements.

links.title: Plany i zmiany po spotkaniu wolontariuszy
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYi55jJ8zL6mkTiR6F7NkDNy39EtUXk14YRLXrt75iS1F/dfuns_2026_03_10_0214586e0b91f9fa23.jpg)

Za nami kolejne spotkanie wolontariuszy KBK. Mimo stosunkowo małej frekwencji (zwłaszcza na początku) było ono niezwykle owocne i zakończyło się nie tylko ciekawymi pomysłami, ale również wdrożeniami.

Jakie były główne tematy?

- Po pierwsze, rozmawialiśmy o problematycznych sytuacjach i uznaliśmy, że trzeba jak najszybciej uchwalić ustawę o sędziach i przeprowadzić ich wybór.
- Po drugie, postanowiliśmy podjąć starania w kierunku nawiązania stosunków dyplomatycznych z Wolnym Jazdowem, o którym pisałem [tutaj](/polish/@hallmann/wolny-jazdow-i-kbk-czyli), a o którym jeszcze szerzej napiszę.
- Po trzecie, po raz kolejny zrobiliśmy wizję lokalną na korytarzu w reakcji na sugestię @wstawarz'a o dodanie tabliczki OTWARTE na drzwiach. Wniosek był jednak taki, że wcześniej nie zadziałał bardziej widoczny potykacz ani nawet otwieranie drzwi, więc trudno oczekiwać by zadziałało dodanie tabliczki. Ale spróbować zawsze można...


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNbNVvJsBYTxnKWb1zBHVjGWpcyAg23exexyyfrK7AfJQ/dfuns_2026_03_10_0214598559cc5ec7d7.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR7Va9tU2SQTdSqBvbht4oJ29evgFZPsTtGokawVdKkTX/dfuns_2026_03_10_0214584eb461bdefa6.jpg)

Po dyskusji zrobiliśmy to co było zapowiadane od dawna, ale z różnych przyczyn nie zrealizowane, a mianowicie przenieśliśmy pianino z głównej sali do szafy. Zrodziło to co prawda nowy problem w postaci bezregałowych książek, ale rozpoczęło eksperymentowanie z nową przestrzenią, a to zawsze jest w cenie. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRQdZNvro2KcG7c2WyZPMJncQ9HZFWi4yqjqH8ytk6oHF/dfuns_2026_03_10_021458cb606e27a3b6.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma32tetMQufDpv6T4TRKqka76XBc1rYaTAfYyrEW7Vto5/dfuns_2026_03_10_0214586a7a24f94609.jpg)

Aktualne ułożenie jest na pewno tymczasowe, bo trudno spontanicznie dojść do jakiegoś optymalnego ułożenia. Niestety pole manewru ogranicza masa książek, których nie ma za bardzo gdzie trzymać. Może jutro po ceramice uda się coś pokombinować...

上周日是三八妇女节，周五的时候，Lightning就问我，周日是三八节吗？我说是啊，你要给我送礼物吗？好大儿没有吭声，笑了一下，我心想，可能是有点意思哦！

周日Lightning在外面补课，早上八点到十点，给他弄了早饭，吃完就自己骑车上课了，结果回来的时候我发现他的小天才电话手表支付了15元，估计这小子在路上又买饮料了。结果等到他回来，我看他拎着蜜雪冰城的袋子，里面装了两杯饮品，其中一杯奶茶说是买给我的。

哟，这原来就是好大儿给我的节日祝福啊，虽然说我最近一直在积极减肥，奶茶更是本来就不喝的，因为喝奶茶拉肚子是一直以来的问题。不过儿子的一番心意，我感觉不能辜负，还是喝了不少，再加上王先生出来，说怎么没有我的，我忙解释，这我们两个人喝一杯就行。给他喝了一口，结果他老人家也不爱喝，最好还是我全喝了，结果当天果然拉肚子三次。

中午吃完饭，嘱咐好大儿带上作业，写完再回来。他想带着手机，说是要给同学买生日礼物，这我不太好拒绝，毕竟他自己的同学朋友的事，还是他自己处理比较好。只好给他手机，等到他下课，看路线他直接到了家附近的龙蟠汇，我打电话给他，结果他说自己在盒马。

行吧，说是已经买好了。结果给我打了几个电话，一是说自己钱不够了，让我转点钱给他，接着又是说支付的限制不够，让我把限制调高一点。我开始还不知道怎么调，结果这娃直接给我发了消息，我一下子就转到支付宝页面，果然很快调高了支付限额。

等回家，看他买了一包吃的零食，这真是，一点都不会亏待自己啊！买了一盒巧克力蛋糕，说是给我买的，我忙拿出手机拍照，发朋友群，因为一大早，他们已经展示了自己好大儿给买的花、请吃的饭了，这我不也得发一发吗？哈哈哈，证明自己娃也是个好娃。

另一个朋友到傍晚也发了一张自己娃悄悄购买的景区的甜点，说是外卖的小哥腿都跑断了，笑死，我戏称，一个个的孝心大比拼，几个人都说儿子没白养。可能这就是妈妈，给点甜头啥都忘了，都不记得平时这个娃多费心了吧！

---

links.title: Ensalada de Chayote/ Hive Top Chef
links.body:
> Feliz Lunes amantes de la comida, deseándole bendiciones, en este día les presento una receta que preparé para mi almuerzo de hoy, **Ensalada de Chayote**. > Happy Monday, food lovers! Wishing you blessings on this day, I present to you a recipe I prepared for my lunch today: **Chayote Salad**.
![GridArt_20260309_174419447.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/AK7ydxUrcw25BDfs2bMUCFYHrn7xt26MwqZhA7ejSCYNnGnUrUBgPbux6Z2gfz7.jpg)

> Las ensaladas es un acompañante ideal para los platos con cualquier proteinas, y aportan muchas vitaminas y minerales con ese festin de vegetales frescos, además de lo rápido que es, pues en 15 minutos. Este plato lo preparé para el almuerzo, acompañe con pescado y tajas. Este es mi entrada para el concurso semanal de qurator. >Salads are an ideal accompaniment to any protein dish, providing lots of vitamins and minerals with that feast of fresh vegetables, as well as being quick to prepare, taking just 15 minutes. I made this dish for lunch, serving it with fish and chips. This is my entry for the weekly qurator contest.
![IMG_20260304_112638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/Eou9cAc78kPomxx6PRKBdtB9J9Mezq3cF5fFfFAeWpa44VEbwHpZKNqtJ2Pt4UHxzoH.jpg)
> * 3 Chayotes * 1 tomate * 1 Zanahoria * 1 pimiento * 1 cebolla * Lechuga * Aceite vegetal * Vinagre * Sal

> * 3 chayotes * 1 tomato * 1 carrot * 1 bell pepper * 1 onion * Lettuce * Vegetable oil * Vinegar * Salt
![IMG_20260304_100107.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/Eos1KrQaEZX7EgN7QnJxQf9mXi4MgMp2duJR1DmjMUB22BpyoK7cr2dJTjhRhUCNr8G.jpg)

>

Paso a paso| Step by step

> 1.- Primero,pelamos las chayotes, la agregamos por 5 minutos en agua hirviendo para cocinarlas, minetras tanto lavamos la lechuga con agua y vinagre, también vamos rayando la zanahoria. Al estar blanda la challates, picamos en cubos pequeños. > First, peel the chayotes, add them to boiling water for 5 minutes to cook them, meanwhile wash the lettuce with water and vinegar, and grate the carrot. Once the chayotes are cooked, chop them into small cubes.

> ![IMG_20260304_105236.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoGwTtTKB7SHhBfdnwYFCkY36tjgK1cMpbb1Q8k3BeZVy6MRnWzUtBHN1B2uSP6L2kA.jpg) ![IMG_20260304_110258.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoyNUcBu5hPMRfd7CBY2CBJAQhA2yEHPm1E8E1fU7VatC47bgxJSrV8tzS5cpptCQih.jpg) ![IMG_20260304_111117.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23tmHzxL4unbtT8sNCZoiYLUpFfWrrgY9rSjXVCVetZix8SbApZiawNAMM3F47hZrNGkp.jpg)
2.- Seguidamente, cortamos en rodajas la cebolla, pimiento y el tomate. La agregamos en un envase, mezclamos. > Next, slice the onion, bell pepper, and tomato. Add it to a container and mix.
![IMG_20260304_105735.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23tc18wNeaF3L6viVctuVUz43AmBpJEm5hKpTeDrHBba2PMyn5MUbD9pU6HUpvNdbjdVE.jpg) ![IMG_20260304_105741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23tScUb84Dy6yorhMi4quuxkxMyBPsSja4Pu6LUpjqbcyKbB66TjGHq4e9a4x26zWb9es.jpg)

>
3.- Por último, agregamos la chayote en cuadros en el envace, la lechuga y aderazamos con aceite, sal y mostaza. Mezclamos. > Finally, add the diced chayote to the bowl, along with the lettuce, and dress with oil, salt, and mustard. Mix together.
![IMG_20260304_110947.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23uQpCezxWhsvkTtwqK3zcyevJzimnkN6Vgbf7HdWfUEwpwG17aP1tsNjR4mUKmcjD14h.jpg) ![IMG_20260304_111110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoiVAQxnVzWJioDZoQZN6iYsTBLzMCQXeQVUU5ZvyYR6Bx5JioDMNSL2NWbcv6oJrDq.jpg) ![IMG_20260304_112742.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoGxQQ8Ws558wnoY4eCJ4ttBsi62ekUkXe8ShKWiz19e6CAwtwZjbzXRWxVoZrBU5UF.jpg) ![IMG_20260304_112720.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23vsLKAvCiSkDKGaKGpHp48948gNxi31SxVtYCyfwnE7ZJWibTedPPcLMjAXpQNFQTLCy.jpg) ![IMG_20260304_112738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23u616LWhoeRKuopZ13z3DeCHVaNcRgWqwi5pjWKQbi5EE18MYFUbkHmhgN4ANZCPo8B3.jpg)

> A disfrutar de este almuerzo, acompañe con Pescado frito y tajadas, su resultado es bueno, Hasta aquí mis aventureros. > Enjoy this lunch, accompanied by fried fish and plantain slices. The result is delicious. That's all for now, my adventurers. ![IMG_20260304_112635.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoErSyv2uBeyaBwraDnc2rSVSZ4YSUoSb3mVVbLhGz1Zm6snQnPaux3gSLqEnrMsx5W.jpg) ![IMG_20260304_112602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoEr4ahx4M9nyTnPqUM7BwwE28gnd3SkF7cpz6fCEXdc3NWk5fudcyV8V5G9VsrNEpf.jpg) ![IMG_20260304_122230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23tmNATBVL2EpQL4aYXFjW85EVYAdaZyztM6yhUBqzbuLxY3XwuVwEdLgSR1SFgka2zds.jpg) ![IMG_20260304_122227.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoGyosEcZYiGxnXqHxRiaR8XVpYTkpMDBAKNknXZEXNmBK6D6A37qQW9RPXzQ5osxn7.jpg)

>

![Captura de pantalla 2022-01-25 001845.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23zH3aQQiMFCYfc8ZXWUCM9eqxYcuYox1AcHj5SYycucEqedYrAvHdYVkjD8zjC3GWWDb.png) _**Fotos de mi propiedad tomada del celular marca Redmi Note 12// Texto traducido por DeepL**_ >_**Photos of my property taken from the Redmi Note 12/// Text translated by DeepL**_
